instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices.  Place in a 10x10 inch baking dish.  Top with sliced mushrooms.  Spoon cheese over sausage and mushrooms.  Cover with aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: vital wheat gluten,chili pepper flake,oyster sauce,mint leaf,tomato green chilies,red apple,peach schnapps
title: Grilled Apple, Peach Salad with Chili
ingredients: 1 -2 small firm tomatoes, cut into 2 slices | 1 red apple, cut into 2 slices | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves | 3 tablespoons peach schnapps | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons crushed chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon vital wheat gluten
instructions: Place the tomatoes, apple, mint and schnapps/oyster sauce in a large bowl and toss to combine.  Stir in the chili and florin or sprinkle with the gluten and serve.

title: Roasted Cabbage and Onions
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage | 1 medium yellow onion, sliced crosswise into 1/2-inch slices | 2 teaspoons minced fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place cabbage, onion and oregano leaves in a roasting pan.  Cover pan tightly with aluminum foil and bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes.  Uncover pan and roast for 45 minutes, or until cabbage is tender.

title: Canned Cannoli Shells
ingredients: 1 can chickpea flour | 1 can minced clams in juice | 9 cannoli shells
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, slowly blend flour and liquid until the mixture is thick, but not dry.  Fill cannoli shells, and bake at 350 degrees until the top layer turns a light brown.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,tahini paste,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese 5-Spice Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 cremini mushrooms, cleaned, trimmed and cut into cubes | chinese five spice powder | 2 tablespoons tahini paste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c or 150°c if using baking sheets.  Place mushrooms on the baking sheet and sprinkle with five spice powder.  Bake for about 15 - 20 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender and crispy.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,monterey jack pepper cheese,flat leaf parsley,cardamom
title: Grilled Cheese Wedges
ingredients: 4 flour tortillas | 2 cups grated monterey jack pepper cheese | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: Prepare grill.  Brush one side of each tortilla with nonstick cooking spray, then set on grill rack, sprayed with cooking spray.  Grill 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.  Place cheese wedges on serving platter, leaving at least 1/2 inch of cheese exposed.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,heavy whipping cream,cherry,chunk tuna,guajillo chilies,cannellini bean
title: Tuna and Cherry Rouladen
ingredients: 4 guajillo chilies | 2 cups light cream | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 can cannellini beans | 1/2 cup drained canned cannellini beans | 1 cup sweet potato, peeled and diced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Roast the chiles on a pan of medium high heat, turning once, until evenly blistered and charred, 10 - 15 minutes.  Transfer to a cutting board and split down the center.  Remove as many seeds as will comfortably fit into the pepper.  Set the chiles aside.  Remove the chiles from the skillet, slice the halves in half, and set aside.  Wearing kitchen gloves, combine the cream, cream and 3 tablespoons of water, and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat to low.

title: Chicken, Parsnips & Raspberry Salad
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 medium raspberries or 1 medium strawberry, quartered | 1 medium parsnip, peeled | 1/2 cup fresh basil, sliced | thinly sliced scallion, for garnish
instructions: Cut 3/4 of skin off each chicken breast in half.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,red bell pepper,white wine vinegar,caster sugar,buttermilk
title: Souper English Marinated Roast Pepper Pickles
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 150 ml dry white wine vinegar | 125 ml buttermilk
instructions: Chop peppers, and place in a glass bowl.  Sprinkle with sugar, and add boullion powder.  Mix well.  Add vinegar, buttermilk and stir until well blended.  Pour marinade into a glass jar, and stand jars in a wok.  Add hot water to cover the jar, and bring to the boil.  Reduce heat, and simmer gently for 3 hours.  Unwrap jars, and leave in the liquid for at least 1 day before using, then seal the jars.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,swiss cheese,curry powder,maraschino cherry,worcestershire sauce,pumpernickel bread
title: Tasty Curried Cheese Bread
ingredients: 12 slices pumpernickel bread | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 4 teaspoons curry powder | 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherry ( or cherry or green cherry ) | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Cut the bread into 3/4 thick slices, or use paper liners.  Using a 4 inch round cookie cutter or pizza cutter, cut the bread into triangles or quarters.  Place 1 teaspoons of cheese, curry powder, worcestershire sauce and maraschino or cherry in the centre of each triangles or quarters of bread.  Roll each piece in flour, pressing it into the cheese.  Place each slice on an oiled baking tray and bake for about 10 - 15 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Cactus (Mexican Mango) Salad
ingredients: 1 large oranges or 1 large yellow grapefruit | 2 ripe nopales ( mangoes ) | 1 sprig mustard seeds or 2 sprigs fresh thyme ( optional )
instructions: Peel the oranges if they are very fresh.  Cut them into pieces about 3 or 4 long.  Cut them in half and remove the pith, including all the pith, from the mangoes.  Slice the fruit into thin wedges.  Place all the ingredients into a large serving bowl.  Garnish with sprigs of mustard or fresh thyme.

title: Raspberry Gravy
ingredients: 1 can chicken stock | 2 tablespoons vinegar ( i used cider vinegar ) | 1 package frozen raspberries in preserves
instructions: Place chicken stock in a medium saucepan.  Bring to a boil.  When it starts boiling, stir in the vinegar.  Return to a boil, cover, and turn down to low to keep warm and simmer 20 minutes.  Stir in raspberry preserves and heat gently.  Pour gravy over warm fluffy veggies before serving.

title: Simple Glazed Parsnips
ingredients: 3 -4 cups parsnips or 3 -4 cups turnips, peeled and chopped | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: In a large, deep bowl cover the parsnips with boiling water and let sit for 10 minutes or until tender but firm.  Drain and reserve the water.  In a dutch oven melt the oil over medium high heat and stir in the parsnips, molasses and reserved cooking water.  Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, cover the pan and simmer for 5 minutes.  Uncover the pan, increase heat to high and stir fry the parsnips and water mixture for about 10 minutes until the liquid has almost evaporated.  Serve warm.

title: Mexican Red Beans & Eggs - Tapas
ingredients: 2 medium ancho chilies, de arbol pods ( in a jar ) | 10 slices bacon | 12 ounces small red kidney beans, cooked ( or red kidney beans of choice ) | 12 -12 anchovy fillets ( fillets or anchovies, preferably fresh or frozen, in oil or butter, if desired ) | 4 -5 medium oranges
instructions: Bring beans to a boil in a medium saucepan, simmering for 1 minute, then drain and set aside.  Chop arbol pods finely and set aside.  In a large saute pan, fry bacon until golden, then set aside.  In same pan, warm anchovies in oil for 1 minute, then add beans and cook until warm.  Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with anchovy and orange pieces.

Random Ingredients: white flour,kidney bean,brown rice,peanut,beef bouillon,sage,asparagus spear
title: Sausage and Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef or 2 lbs pork | 1 can whole tomatoes with herbs, undrained | 1 can cooked kidney beans | 2 bunches fresh asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into pieces about 1 inch long | 3 tablespoons brown rice ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground sage | 2 cups white flour | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.  In a dutch oven, brown the ground meat breaking up the meat into small pieces.  Drain.  Stir in the tomatoes and beans.  Bring to a boil and stir in the asparagus.  In a small bowl, stir the rice and sage together.  In a separate bowl, dissolve the bouillon in about 1 cup of water.  Stir into the stew.  Continue to cook and stir over the heat until bubbling.  Reduce the heat to cook 10 minutes then stir the flour into the stew.  When the stew starts to thicken, stir in the reserved bouillon mix.  Continue stirring over heat for 30 seconds and then stir until the gravy thickens.  Serve over hot rice.

title: The World's Best Chili Bruschetta
ingredients: 2 loaves rye bread ( or bread of your choice ) | 2 1/2 - 3 teaspoons dried chilies | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Cut each loaf in half horizontally on the bias.  Open each half and spread each cut lengthwise with olive oil.  Dry all the bread halves on paper towels.  Spread each side of the halved bread halves with the dry chile chili mixture.  Sprinkle with the chilies and cilantro.  Bake at 400 degrees for about 45 minutes or until bread is golden and bubbly.  Serve in a bowl while hot.

title: Beef or Chicken Buns
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped ( not drained liquid ) | 1/4 cup dark beer or 1/4 cup stout beer | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon celery, chopped | 1/2 lb ground round | 1/4 teaspoon instant dry active yeast | 1 tablespoon fresh peas or 1 tablespoon frozen peas
instructions: Drain the water from the canned chestnuts.  Drain the juice from the can of water chestnuts into a small sauce pan.  Heat the beer over medium heat.  Add onion powder and celery.

title: Cabbage-And-Barley Soup (Japanese Style)
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 3 cups pearl barley | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Clean cabbage and split it crosswise into very thin slices.  Place on a hot saucer, with some water, and cook until slightly wilted.  Remove with slotted spoon and place in a serving bowl.  Bring water to boil, and add barley.  Cover and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring frequently.  Stir in mirin.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: white flour,poppy seed,green chili salsa,chicken breast half,confectioner sugar,steak
title: Margarita® Chicken
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | 1 cup chopped green chili salsa | 1/2 teaspoon chopped green chili salsa | 1/2 teaspoon ground poppy seeds | 1 cup white flour, or more as needed | 1 cup confectioners'sugar, or more as needed
instructions: Place chicken into a medium saucepan with 1 cup green chile salsa, 1/2 teaspoon green chili salsa, and poppy seeds.

title: Roasted Winter Squash and Water Chestnuts With Prosciutto & Schmicks
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, cut into 10 wedges | 3/4 lb swiss cheese, cut into 12 slices | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced and drained | 1/2 cup double cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 9 square baking dish that has been brushed with non stick cooking spray.  Sprinkle with the croutons.  Bake at 220 degrees for 30 minutes, or until squash is fork tender.  Let cool slightly then cut into strips.  Serve with a crisp green salad.

title: Lamb Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground lean leg of lamb or 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb | 4 teaspoons kitchen bouquet | 1 tablespoon molasses ( corn syrup is excellent ) | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1/2 teaspoon kitchen bouquet | 1 egg substitute | 3 tablespoons walnuts, chopped
instructions: Mix everything together except the nuts in a large bowl using your hands.  Form into a loaf pan that resembles your usual meat loaf shape.  Prick the loaf all over with a fork.  Place in a shallow roasting pan and brown in oven at 350 degrees for 2 hours.  Remove, slice and serve.  You might have to do this in increments of 4, as the oven will vary.  Try adding 2 tbs of honey to your drippings.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,orange juice,tamari,apricot,beef,dashi stock,red wine vinegar
title: Orange-Apricot Smothered Beef
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb beef, prime rib type, trimmed and cut into 1 1 1/2-inch to 2-inch chunks | 1/2 yellow onion, quartered, thinly sliced on the diagonal | 1/4 cup tamari | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon instant or homemade dashi stock | 2 tablespoons apricots, very coarsely chopped
instructions: In a non metal skillet, combine all ingredients except the beef and the onion.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce to low.  Cover tightly and simmer until meat is tender and sauce thickens, stirring occasionally, about 30 to 40 minutes.  Uncover and allow the mixture to rest for 15 to 20 minutes.  Remove the pan from the heat, taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.  To serve, pour meat into a shallow bowl and garnish with onion slices.

title: Homemade Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 cup ranch-style salad dressing | 1/2 cup seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon anise seed, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.  Place on a cutting board or wax paper lined cookie sheet.

Random Ingredients: stock,cake flour,wine vinegar,dark sesame oil,elbow macaroni,white cabbage
title: Sweet and Sour Colcannon
ingredients:
16 ounces elbow macaroni | 1 small white cabbage ( about 12 oz.
    - ) | 2 tablespoons white cabbage vinegar | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | salt, to taste | stock, to fill empty soup can about half way up with water
instructions: Cut the core from the cabbage.  Slice the cabbage into thin strips, then set aside. .  Boil a large pot of water with the vinegar and oil, then add the cabbage.  When the water comes to a boil, add the dry macaroni and cook until the pasta is barely al dente.

title: Grape Tomatillo Turnip and Tomatillo Salad
ingredients: 3 turnips, peeled, cut lengthwise in half, then crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 2 cups fresh tomatillos, husked, washed and quartered or 1 1/2 cups tomatillos | 2 lemons, cut into wedges | 2 cups corn flakes, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Cut each tomato into 6 wedges and place on a tray.  Coat each wedge with 1 tbs of the sunflower oil.  Heat a little oil in a nonstick frying pan or wok on high.  When it is very hot, add the tomatillos and fry briefly until light brown.  Set aside and keep warm.  When ready to serve pour remaining sunflower oil into the wok.  Heat it up again, add the tomatoes and cook on high for 3 - 4 minutes.  Drain the vegetables, remove from the wok, cut in half and toss with the tomatoes, lemon wedges and cornflakes, if using.

title: Tomato Brochettes
ingredients: 6 roma tomatoes, halved | 3 tablespoons chopped green onions | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Place tomato halves on a baking sheet and broil 1 1/2 minutes.  Arrange tomato halves on a serving platter.  Sprinkle with green onion, marjoram and seasonings.

title: Spice-Rubbed Peach Appetizer
ingredients: 1 large red capsicum, red ribs and skin removed | 1 ripe peach | 2 teaspoons agave, to taste
instructions: Cut peel off and discard top third of peach.  Cut around peaches to remove stones.  Scoop out core and discard, or cut away the top quarter of peach.  Place cut side down in a bowl of cold water.  Cover, and set aside for 15 minutes.  Drain water from bowl and transfer peaches to a medium sized bowl.  Discard peel, and coarsely chop peaches into small pieces.  Add the peaches and agave to peach mixture.  Use a pestle to bruise the fruit, then mix together with remaining ingredients.  Pour into sterilized jars, and process in water bath for 20 minutes, so that the juice releases as much water as possible.

title: Grammy's Granola
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup triple sec
instructions: Combine crumbs and triple sec or other baking mix.  Press into a buttered 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish.  Refrigerate 3 hours or until cold, cut 1 inch slice across the top, dip in a little bit of the crumb mix and return to wax paper and repeat.  Store in glass baking dish in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,creme de banane,double cream,madras curry powder,baking powder,rigatoni pasta
title: Rigatoni Con Madras
ingredients: 2 cups rigatoni pasta, cooked & drained | 1/2 cup onion salt | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder | 1/3 cup creme de banane | 3/4 cup double cream
instructions: Add onion salt to noodles and let sit for 10 - 15 minutes.  Stir frequently.  Add baking powder, curry powder & creme de banane.  Bring to the boil stirring constantly.  Lower heat & simmer until noodles are tender.  Beat with a hand blender, or with a fork.  Add cream & stir.  Serve immediately or refrigerate.

title: Pork Roast and Fettuccine Sandwiches (Pork Loaf Recipe)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried bread, crumbs | 1 tablespoon dried dill, leaves | 1 1/2 lbs pork roast, trimmed of fat | 6 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Combine bread crumbs and dill.

title: Deliciously Easy and Easy Chocolate and Meatballs
ingredients: 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate | 1 can great northern beans, drained | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 2 packages frozen meatballs, thawed | 1 3/4 cups fresh broccoli florets
instructions: Heat chocolate in microwave on medium heat until smooth, stirring every 2 - 3 minutes.  Stir in beans, onions, and meatballs.  Heat through.  Serve over your favorite fettuccine noodles or rice.

title: Minty Chocolate Chippers
ingredients: 1 cup golden syrup | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 cup grated chocolate | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon of chopped of finely chopped mint | 1 teaspoon of chopped scallion ( optional ) | of chopped mint, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: Heat golden syrup and cream on medium high in a metal saucepot on a low flame.  Add all ingredients, except mint, stirring and stirring frequently until mixture is thick and creamy.  Pour mixture into a medium glass container, cover and chill in the fridge for several hours.  Garnish with mint leaves at the end.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,ricotta cheese,lasagna noodle,cherry tomato,cornflour,honey
title: Sweet and Sour Lasagne Rolls
ingredients: 5 sheets lasagna noodles | 250 -400 g ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup chopped dried cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons harissa paste with light sesame oil | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees celsius grease and line a baking tray with baking paper.  Cook the lasagne sheets according to the packet instructions until just starting to soften.  Drain and set aside.  In a bowl, mix together the ricotta and dried tomatoes.  Season with honey and sesame oil and mix.  Spread equal amounts of the ricotta mixture over each lasagne sheet, and roll.  Place lasagne rolls, seam side down, onto the baking tray and pour over enough boiling water to come 1 inch up the side.  Set on the centre shelf of the oven and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until the rolls are golden and firm to the touch.  Serve immediately.

title: Indian Pancake
ingredients: 200 ml plain dried coconut flakes | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 2 cups skim milk | 6 slices paper, 1 inch squares | 1 tablespoon desiccated coconut flakes
instructions: Put coconut, ginger garlic paste, cayenne in a blender.  Add dry coconut and blend until finely ground.  In a medium bowl combine milk, coconut milk and desiccated coconut.  Add the mixture to the bowl and set aside for 30 minutes.  Heat a non stick pan over medium high heat.  Brush on one side only of the paper squares with water.  Place a few pieces of the soaked coconut in the pan, pressing them down firmly so they don't stick.  When golden brown flip over and repeat until all of the coconut is used.  Repeat steps 7 to 8 with remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,nonfat beef broth,cornstarch,tarragon leaf,thai basil,lemon juice zest
title: Lemon Herb Gravy (Mchuzi)
ingredients: 1 can fat-free beef broth | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh tarragon leaves | 2 teaspoons grated lemon rind | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh tarragon leaves | 1/4 cup nonfat dry milk cheese or 1/4 cup gouda cheese, shredded
instructions: Mix broth cubes, cornstarch, garlic paste, and chopped fresh tarragon leaves in a medium saucepan over medium high heat.

title: Broccoro Parboiled Broccoli
ingredients: 12 ounces broccoli florets | 3 tablespoons chili flakes
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the broccoli and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or just until tender but crisp.  Drain.  Scoop off any remaining water in the bottom of each pasta bowl.  Spoon the broccoli into the pasta bowls on top of the hot water, leaving enough for everyone to stir into the hot broth.  Sprinkle with the chili flakes.

title: Grated Beef Croustades
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour, plus | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 2 large egg yolks | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1/3 cup red wine | 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 1 large jicama, peeled, cut into very small pieces, about 2 cups
instructions: Combine flour and next 3 ingredients and stir to blend.  Dry hamburger and jicama well and roll mixture into 12 small patty shapes by moistening edges of bag with water and rolling patty pieces in dry flour.

title: Kielbasa and Raspberry Wrapped in Berghul Bites
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb kielbasa | 2 cups crumbled dried apricot halves or 2 cups chopped fresh raspberries | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds | 2 serrano peppers | 1 oven cooking bag ( for boiling ) | 1 container low-fat sour cream | 2/3 cup bourbon | 2 tablespoons crumbled dried fenugreek seeds ( to garnish ) | 1 jar seedless raspberry rolls ( optional )
instructions: Place kielbasa in a medium pan, cover with water, and cook over medium heat until no longer pink, about 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook the apricots according to package directions, until they are soft and a little brown.  Drain and set aside.  Let cool a few minutes.  Remove sausage from marinade and cut into long, 1 to inch pieces.  Place pieces on a foil lined baking sheet, and bake in a 400 degree f oven for 30 minutes, or until crisp.  Remove from oven, reduce temperature to 300 degrees f, and cover tightly.  When cool, remove foil, tear apart roasts, and place on a baking sheet.  Place raspberries, 1 teaspoon of fenugreek seeds, and 2 serrano peppers on each raspberries.  Cover tightly with the raspberries, and tightly wrap with the foil.  Continue to bake in the same oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until berries are tender.  Combine sour cream, bourbon, 2 tablespoons of fenugreek seed, and 1 tablespoon of dried fenugreek in a mixing bowl.  Chill until serving time.  To serve, wrap around sausages in warm berry mixture, then roll in the reserved whipped sour cream mixture.  Garnish with the remaining 2 tablespoons of dried fenugreek.

title: White Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 1 cup white wine vinegar ( or white wine ) | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 2 teaspoons orange zest
instructions: Stir all ingredients in a small non reactive bowl.  Cover and chill for 30 minutes or up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,pork tenderloin,greek yogurt
title: Easy Peking Pork Tenders
ingredients: 10 ounces pork tenderloin | 8 ounces greek yogurt ( plain or lowfat ) | 3 ounces thai red curry paste ( i use kikkoman brand )
instructions: Heat oven to 500 degrees f.  Slice pork tenderloin into thin strips approximately 1 inch wide and 2 1/2 inches long.  Mix yogurt and curry paste in a bowl until well blended and pour over the pork.  Toss to coat.  Place meat into a large roasting pan or roasting pan.  Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until done to your liking.  Turn meat over.  Slice into desired serving size pieces.  Serve with plain boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: epazote,strawberry,escarole,golden syrup,rigatoni pasta,lamb shoulder,self raising flour
title: Cascadia Style Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 lb short rigatoni pasta | 2 lbs pork fat, extra-lean | 1 lb goat cheese or 1 lb sheep's milk feta | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 4 fresh epazote, leaves minced | 1 tablespoon chopped chives or 1 tablespoon scallion | 1 lb escarole, washed and chopped | fresh strawberries
instructions: In a large flameproof bowl, cook the rigatoni in boiling salted water for 8 minutes or until al dente.  Drain.  Heat the pork fat in a large saucepan or frying pan.  Add the meat and all of the sauce ingredients except the escarole and strawberries.  Bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the meat is tender and cooked through.  Add the escarole and cook a further 5 minutes, or until the escarole is crisp tender.  Remove the meat from the bones and return it to the saucepan.  Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer rapidly for 5 minutes or until the sauce thickens slightly.  Serve the rigatoni with the spicy sauce.

title: Quick 'N Easy Italian Tomato Chunk
ingredients: 6 italian-style stewed tomatoes | 2 cans limeade concentrate | 4 teaspoons cardamom seed
instructions: Place stewed tomatoes, limeade concentrate and cardamom pods in a 4 quart or larger slow cooker.  Cook on high for 3 hours or on low for 4 hours.  Stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: fruit,basmati rice,limeade concentrate,red pepper,bicarbonate soda,ancho chile powder,pesto sauce,candlenut
title: Sour Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 kg basmati rice | 2 cups red peppers, chopped | 3 -6 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 400 g frozen fruit | 8 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 150 g canned limes, drained | 1/2 cup concentrate, dissolved in | 1/2 cup water | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Cook basmati rice and red peppers in 2 - 3 liters boiling water.  Meanwhile make the salsa.  Scoop out most of the water from the frozen fruits, break fruit into chunks, add to rice mixture along with the 2 tablespoons of concentrate, stir well.  Place in an ovenproof casserole dish or baking dish and cover with foil.  Set aside for 25 minutes.  Remove foil, stir, add lime juice and bicarb soda, stir.  Serve warm.

title: Won Ton Wrappers
ingredients: 48 wonton wrappers | 1/2 cup dark rum, or as needed, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place wonton wrappers on baking sheet.  Spread about 1 tablespoon rum over the wonton wrappers.  Using your finger, brush the edges of the wonton wrappers on the paper.  Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, or until crispy and fragrant.  Use toothpicks to help keep the wrappers from sticking.  Let cool completely before popping into a jar or resealable bag.

Random Ingredients: celery,shell pasta,cheddar cheese,nut,english muffin,chicken breast fillet
title: Chicken Muffins
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets | 2 tablespoons chopped celery | 2 tablespoons chopped nuts | 1 tablespoon grated cheese | 1 small shell pasta, cooked | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, grated ( or to taste )
instructions: Toast muffins lightly.  Place chicken breasts on toasted bread cut side down on medium heat.  Sprinkle with celery, nuts and cheese.  Broil until cheese melts.  Meanwhile cook pasta until al dente.  Place chicken breast on toasted bun and top with sauce.  Allow to set 3 minutes serve with salad.

title: Cheese and Honey Biscuits
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded old cheddar cheese | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f / 220 degrees celsius.  Combine the shredded cheese, baking soda, and salt.  Stir well, then add honey, mixing well.  Roll into balls a little bigger than a whole nut.  Place on a tray lined with baking paper.  Bake for 20 minutes until cooked through and golden. .

title: Salsa Bruschetta Sandwich (Bread Salad)
ingredients: 2 loaves italian bread | 2 cans chunky salsa, divided | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 package sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, diced | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Preheat the broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat.  Slice the bread on the bias into 1/3 inch thick slices or thin.  Spread half of the salsa evenly over each of the bread slices and top with the other half of the salsa.  Place in the oven and broil until bubbly, about 8 minutes.  Drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with sun dried tomatoes.  Top with dill.

title: Simple Chunky Sweet Potato Fingers
ingredients: 2 cups sweet potatoes ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons sweetened coconut flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400.  Combine sweet potatoes, coconut, and salt in a large mixing bowl.  With a pastry bag fitted with a 1 1/2 inch round tip, pipe the sweet potato mixture into the bag until it is about 2/3 inch thick and 8 inches long.  Arrange on a 9x5x3 loaf pan or rimmed baking sheet.  Cook, loosely covered, in center of oven until softened and slightly browned, about 50 minutes.  Remove from pan with a metal spatula and cut into fingers, or place on a plate and cover with plastic wrap and keep warm in oven while preparing the remaining fingers.  Store the fingers warm in an airtight container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,ginger,chinese bean paste,romano cheese,sherry,pimiento,salmon,kernel corn
title: Salmon With Sweet Corn, Chilli Sauce and Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 2 pints cooked salmon, skin on | 1 cup firm whole kernel corn | 5/8 cup sweet chili sauce | 4 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/2 cup fresh romano cheese, grated | 24 -30 slices pimientos, cut in half | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 5 tablespoons chinese bean paste
instructions: Cut the salmon head and fins into 8 pieces.  Heat oven to 180c/160c fan forced.  Butter and line a roasting tin about 1/3 full.  Place the fish in the tin and cook on both sides for around 7 minutes until just cooked.  Remove the fish from the pan and set aside to rest.  Wipe the roasting tin out with kitchen paper afterwards.  Sauce, put all the ingredients in a small saucepan and cook for around 3 - 4 minutes or until the sauce has thickened a little.  Serve and sprinkle the salmon on top.

title: Gravy Topped With Guacamole and Juniper Berries
ingredients: 4 slices lettuce | 1/4 teaspoon cumin | 1/8 teaspoon finely chopped fresh ginger | 1 pinch saffron juniper berries or 1 pinch other mixed spice, crushed ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons low-fat mayonnaise | 1 -2 drop guacamole, to serve
instructions: Place all ingredients except guacamole in a food processor and puree until smooth.  Cover and refrigerate until served.  Serve with bread or crackers.

title: Lamb and Tarragon On the BBQ
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tarragon | 1 kg boneless leg of lamb | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Rinse lamb and pat it dry.  Season to taste with water.  Heat large grill pan or barbecue, on high.

title: Jungle Salmon

title: Bailey's Irish Cream Dumplings

instructions: Place one won ton wrapper over the center of a dinner plate. Repeat and place on the plate with the rest of the dumpling wrappers.  Cover with a plate and a lid and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. title: Sun Dried Tomato and Cucumber Salad from England and New Zealand

title: Chinese Bratwurst

title: Hot Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons corn oil | 2 ounces szechuan peppercorns ( ground ) | 1 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot lemon pepper ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons corn oil | 2 -3 teaspoons szechuan peppercorns | 1 head fresh broccoli, washed and trimmed | 6 -8 cups spaghetti noodles, washed and drained
instructions: Soak the whole peppercorns in hot water for 10 minutes.  Remove the seeds from 2 - 3 teaspoons of crushed peppercorn and set aside a few.  If the peppercorns begin to crackle during this process, remove the pan from the heat and soak the peppercorns in hot water for 5 minutes.  Do not remove the oil.  This step is highly recommended for the best flavor but even for an aromatic flavor, i prefer this option in my peanut oil recipe.  Pour 2 - 3 tablespoons of corn oil into a saucepan over medium heat.  Add the 1 teaspoon crushed peppercorns and 3 - 4 tablespoons of chopped sichuan peppercorns and shake the pan so that the peppercorns get coated with oil.  Stir until the pan has a uniform color.  You can add more oil to thin if necessary.  When the pan is very hot, stir in the sichuan pepper flakes and 5 or 6 tablespoons of corn oil.  Be careful, they will spit at you and spit so badly you don't know what to do.  Add the broccoli and stir fry for 5 minutes or until it has begun to wilt.  It should be slightly softened but still a little crisp.  Remove from heat and set aside.  When all has been heated, add the noodles to the broccoli in the pan and toss to mix.  Pour in the remaining 2 tablespoons of corn oil, toss to coat and taste.  It is best to start tasting the noodles after 1/2 hour, adding salt as necessary.  When it is done, add the szechuan peppercorns and toss well.  Continue to toss frequently until the noodles are cooked through, approximately 5 - 10 minutes longer.  Taste, adjust seasoning if necessary.  If serving immediately, add the remaining 3 - 4 tablespoons of corn oil and toss gently.  Serve immediately.

instructions: Mix all ingredients well.  Heat nonstick pan on medium heat.  Spoon the pancake mixture into pan in a circle.  Cook, turn until brown on underside.  Flip and cook till brown on second side.  Serve.

title: Potato and Arugula Kugel
ingredients: 4 medium russet potatoes, peeled ( about 1 pound ) | sea salt | 1 tablespoon arugula leaf | 1 tablespoon sage, chopped | 1 egg, lightly beaten
instructions: Place potatoes in a saucepan and cover with water by 2 inches.  Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, 25 minutes, and drain water.  Let potatoes cool.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer potatoes to a bowl, leaving 1/2 inch of excess moisture in potatoes.  Season with salt.

title: Tamarind Rice With Mango and Grilled Salmon
ingredients: 2 cups steamed basmati rice or 2 cups long grain rice, cooked | 1 can chopped green apples | 1 -2 teaspoon tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 green apple, peeled and grated | 1 smoked ham steak, finely chopped | 2 grey bonnet salmon fillets, skinned and chopped into 2 chunks, approx 2 1/2oz each
instructions: Preheat grill or broiler.  Combine cooked rice and apple in a serving bowl.  Add tamarind paste, vanilla essence, and cheese and stir well.  Divide rice mixture among 4 serving bowls.  Top with fish, apple chunks and green apple slices.  Drizzle with a little sunflower or balsamic vinegar.

Random Ingredients: raisin,black olive,bailey irish cream,cream chicken soup,spinach leaf,red onion
title: Irish Cream Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons baileys irish cream | 1/3 cup chopped red onion | 3/4 cup raisins | 1 can sliced black olives, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the frozen spinach in a medium bowl, and stir in the cream of chicken soup, bailey's, red onion, raisins, olives, and drained spinach.  Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish, and mix well.  Cover, and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: szechwan pepper,chicken bouillon,pork shoulder,barbecue sauce,lasagna noodle
title: Pablo's Szechwan Barbecue Pork and Noodles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon szechwan pepper | 1 chicken bouillon | 1 package dry lasagna noodles | 1 pound lean pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 bottle barbecue sauce
instructions: Blend the szechwan pepper and chicken bouillon in a blender with 1 cup boiling water until smooth.

title: Artichoke Poi With Mustard and Artichokes
ingredients: 500 g kok choi, trimmed | 1/2 cup artichoke bottom, drained from marinade | 1 tablespoon hot pickled mustard
instructions: Heat a large non stick frying pan over medium high heat.  Meanwhile, line bamboo steamer with tin foil extending over sides of pan.  Place kok choi on foil, spray surface with oil and bake in pre heated oven 12 minutes, or until crisp.  Transfer to a large bowl and cover with foil.  Increase heat to high and add artichokes.  Cook, tossing, until tender, 5 minutes.  Increase heat to high.  Remove from heat.  Add mustard and stir for 30 seconds.  Spoon artichoke mixture onto centre of kok.  Cover pan and heat through, 2 minutes.

title: Irish Whiskey-Corned Watermelon With Cornflour Crumble
ingredients:
1 bunch fresh dill ( or 1/2 t.
    - dried dill ) | 2 -4 kaffir lime leaves ( or a lemon ) | 1/2 liter watermelon juice | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey or 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 1 teaspoon cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1/2 cup oatmeal ( fine ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius.  Wash dill and cut into pieces.  Slice kaffir lime leaves in half and place into bowl of cold water, cover and leave to soften slightly.  Remove leaves from watermelon then cut into small pieces.  Melt butter in small saucepan over med low heat and add corn flour mixture and stir until thickened, stirring continuously until blended.  Add the juice, whiskey and chillies and bring mixture to a boil, stirring constantly and ensuring it does not boil over.  Turn off heat.  Stir through the dilled dill and kaffir leaves.  Cover with plastic wrap and allow to set for about 1 - 2 hours before serving.  Just before serving stir through the oatmeal and allspice.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,horseradish,irish cream,cardamom pod,monterey jack cheese,yoghurt,italian salad dressing
title: Tasty Grilled Cheese!
ingredients: 12 cardamom pods | 1 bottle good low-fat frondy yoghurt | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 -3 tablespoons horseradish ( or your favourite ) | 16 -24 ounces grated monterey jack cheese or 16 -24 ounces grated emmenthaler cheese | 1/3 cup low-fat italian salad dressing to dip ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon of crushed and ground black peppercorn or 1 tablespoon crushed and ground oregano
instructions: To make the paste, first of all, combine yoghurt, curry paste, horseradish, grated cheese, and italian salad dressing in a medium mixing bowl until cheese is completely melted.  It's as simple as that.  Cover and place in the fridge for at least one hour.  It really helps the flavours develop.  After dipping meat, you can also dip meat in prepared horseradish if desired.  Place meat on grilte and place under a preheated broiler, turning it once.  Broil until your cheese is golden brown, turning it over after 2 - 3 minutes and then serve on toasted lavender bread.  Note, you may also do this with bread or roast fish.  It lets the flavors mingle and the bread is crusty.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,vanilla,tart apple,tomato basil oregano garlic,apple,chickpea flour,sage leaf,date
title: Tomato and Date Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried chickpea flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1/4 cup apple, finely chopped | 1/2 cup tart apple, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dates, finely chopped | 1/3 cup dried dates, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dates, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons dates, juice from the tins, extra | 1 tablespoon vanilla, pulp | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine the chickpea flour and sage in a large bowl, combine chickpea flour, sage and apple with the remaining ingredients and toss to combine.  Press mixture into a 9 inch deep greased pie dish.  Spread topping evenly into the pan and bake on the middle shelf of the double broiler for 8 minutes.  Bake on the top shelf of the pie for 30 to 35 minutes, then set on a wire rack to cool.  Slice and serve with cream or ice cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,dijon mustard,wonton wrapper,yellow pepper,lamb,dark red kidney bean,red chilies,red wine
title: Korean Sausage and Dumplings
ingredients: 10 ounces ground lamb | 1 tablespoon prepared won-wrapped mustard ( i use dijon ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil ( dark-hot ) | 1 tablespoon yellow sweet pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried red chilies, chopped | 1 teaspoon sesame oil, dark-hot | 2 tablespoons red wine or 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 18 wonton wrappers | 1 1/2 cups dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a large bowl, mix lamb, woron wrap, mustard, sesame oil, yellow sweet pepper, chiles and sesame oil.  Place about 1 teaspoon of pork mixture onto 1 wonton wrapper.  Moisten edges with water and fold in half and seal.  Repeat with the remaining wonton wrappers.  Cut a small slit diagonally from the center of the each dumpling.  Place a heaping teaspoon of meat mixture along the narrow end of the dumpling and form into a semicircle.  Repeat with the remaining wrappers, meat and filling.  Steam over high heat for 15 - 20 minutes until tender.  Serve with your favorite red chili sauce.

title: Crock Pot Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs boneless leg of lamb, cubed | 10 1/2 ounces cream of chicken soup
instructions: Place lamb in crock pot.  Add soup and stir to combine.  Cook on low setting 7 - 8 hours.  Add milk or water.  Serve over egg noodles.

title: Spanish Fried Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely chopped bacon | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped seeded and jalapeno pepper | 1 cup dry long-grain rice | 3 tablespoons amaretto ( optional ) or 3 tablespoons other almond-flavored liquor ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon crushed dried dill | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | warm pita bread ( warmed in microwave oven or on hot grill )
instructions: Combine bacon, jalapeno, rice, amaretto, dill, and oil in a heavy medium skillet over high heat.  Stir constantly until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.  Spread rice mixture into a large, shallow casserole that has been coated with cooking spray and placed into microwave oven.  Cook, uncovered, until heated through, about 5 to 6 minutes on high, then reduce heat to medium and continue to cook until heated through and rice is cooked through, 20 to 25 minutes.  Sprinkle rice with additional fresh dill and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,french fry,guacamole,italian sausage,flounder fillet,green chile,salami
title: Italian Flounder and Sausage
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh flounder fillets | 1/2 pound hot italian sausage, diced | 1 can chopped green chiles | 1/2 cup apple juice | 4 french fries | 1/2 pound salami | 1/2 cup guacamole, or to taste
instructions: Place flounder fillets in a large pot of lightly salted water.  Bring to a boil, and cook for about 5 minutes, just until slightly browned.  Drain the scallops, and return to the pot.  Cook the sausage over medium heat until browned.  Drain the sausage, and set aside.  Mix the green chilies with apples juice in a bowl.  Place fries on a large platter.  Spoon sausage and green chile mixture over them on top of the fries.  Garnish with salami slices and guacamole.  Serve warm.

title: Cashew and Bean Salad
ingredients: 300 g beans, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 50 g cashews | 1 carrot | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup cornflour
instructions: Place beans, cashews and carrot in a bowl.  Pour all remaining ingredients in a pot and cook over low heat for about 10 minutes, or until heated through.  Pour over prepared salad.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: burrito flour tortilla,onion flake,mayonnaise,green pea,lamb leg steak,egg noodle,french baguette,cremini mushroom
title: French Onion-Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 can french baguettes, cut into 3/8 inch-thick slices | 1 1/2 cups green peas | 14 ounces lamb leg steaks, cut into 1/8 inch slices | 1 package cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 small onion flakes | 1 package dry egg noodles | 1/8 cup mayonnaise | 12 burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Place baguettes slices on rack in broiler pan and broil 5 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned.  Turn slices over and broil 30 seconds longer.  Remove from pan.  Pour off fat from pan.  Stir peas, meat, and mushrooms into baguette slices, adding onion flakes.

title: Cranberry Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat couscous | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 2 poblano chile peppers | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 small pickle, diced | 1 teaspoon freshly ground oregano or 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Soak cranberries in a small bowl of water for 15 minutes.  Drain and cool.  Place in a large bowl.  Peel poblano chilies and chop into 3/4 inch pieces.  Add to bowl with cranberries, cheese, pickle, oregano and allspice.  Toss gently.  Chill for several hours.

title: Sandy's Jerky
ingredients: 30 bamboo skewers | spice, for dusting
instructions: Preheat grill to medium for 15 minutes.  Use two skewers and brush generously with some spice.  Grill for about 5 minutes, flip and grill for another 5 minutes, or until crisp and reddish.  Dent with butter before eating.

title: Cod With Sausages and Cherries
ingredients: 500 g smoked sausage | 2 small courgettes | 4 tablespoons tahini | 150 ml white vinegar | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and halved | 400 g cod fish fillets, cut into large chunks
instructions: Combine the sausages, courgettes, tahini and vinegar in a heavy based saucepan and stir over a medium heat until all the vegetables are very well coated in the sauce.  Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes, then add the cherry halves, turn down the heat and simmer for about another 5 - 10 minutes.  Break the fish into chunks and warm them through.  Season and serve with the sausages and cherry halves.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts  with Greek Cheese & Beetroot Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 large boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 beets | 1 liter low-fat ice cream or 1 liter fat-free yogurt | 2 ounces reduced-fat feta cheese, crumbled ( about 6-8 ounces, and cut in 4 1/2-inch cubes ) | 1 tablespoon low-fat italian cheese blend | 4 -6 slices italian cheese, cut in 2 -4 slices and serve ( i recommend kraft's homemade cheese )
instructions: For the chicken, preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Wash the chicken breasts and pat dry.  Cut a lengthwise slit down one side of each chicken breast to form a pocket for stuffing.  Reserve the pocket you will use to stuff the feta cubes inside the chicken.  Place the 2 beets inside of the pocket.  Place on a sheet pan and cover with aluminum foil.  Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until tender when pierced with a knife or a fork.  Allow to cool 10 - 15 minutes.  Peel and cut the beets into 1/2 inch thick slices.  Peel the beetroot so that there are only 2 inches of beet left in each beets.  Remove the beetroot slices and cut them in half.  Cut the 2 halves in half again for garnish.  Remove the chicken breast from the oven and place one half chicken breast between two sheets of wax paper.  Use the flat side of a chicken pounder to pierce several small holes in the chicken.  Sprinkle 3 - 4 cubes of white italian cheese blend over the top of the chicken breast.  Remove both breasts from the oven and place on plates with beetroot slices and top with 2 slices of feta cheese.  Using a wide spatula, roll each breast into a cylinder and place it in the beetroot cheese.  Top each piece of chicken with a slice of italian cheese blend and put the other slice of cheese on top.  Set aside.  Serve the beets with dipping sauce, in a large bowl, pour some of the yogurt on top of the beets, then drizzle a little bit of yogurt.  Sprinkle the 2 tablespoons of grated cheese on top and dig in.

title: Luby's Cafeteria Chicken Tagine
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons saffron threads | 1/2 cup warm water ( or more )
instructions: Place the meat and saffron powder in a large bowl.  Pour warm water over the meat.  Taste, and add more saffron if necessary.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  The next day, heat oven to 300 degrees.  Put out the meat on a plate, and place on top of the hot water.  Cover and bake for 3 hours, turning once halfway through.  The meat should be browned, and the water bubbling.  Serve.  You can also pour the juices that are cooked into a crock pot to use as a soupy stew.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,turkey sausage,creole seasoning,chicken breast,yoghurt,olive oil,tamarind paste,onion powder
title: Sausage Tikka Burgers
ingredients: 1 small onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon dill weed | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 5 links turkey sausage with skin
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate.  Mix the onion, olive oil, and tamarind paste together in a large bowl.  Place chicken in a large resealable plastic bag and pour in the onion mixture.  Press out extra air, seal the bag, and mix in the creole seasoning, dill, onion powder, and turkey sausage with skin.  Close the bag and marinate in the refrigerator for 15 minutes.  Place the turkey sausage in a large skillet over medium heat and brown on all sides.  Serve on the side with a side salad.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,parsnip,creamy peanut butter,spring onion,farfalle pasta
title: Pesto Pasta Salad
ingredients: 350 g farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 150 g creamy peanut butter ( available in natural jar ) | 2 spring onions | 125 g kalamata olives | 1/4 cup chopped parsnip
instructions: Cook farfalle according to instructions on the packet.  Drain and put to one side to cool.  Meanwhile boil water to boiling and cook hot pasta until al dente.  Rinse with cold water.  Drain well and place in bowl with saucepan peanut butter and bring to the boil, stirring well.  Add in spring onion and olives and stir through.  Drain pasta and add to bowl of saucepan peanut butter mixture and mix to coat.  Add in parsnip and parsley and mix through.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,asiago cheese,green pea,chick pea,yellow bell pepper,veal cutlet
title: Veal Asiago
ingredients: 1 can canned chick-peas, drained | 1 can green peas | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 cup shredded lean asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 lb veal cutlets, pounded out
instructions: Heat 1 tblsp.  Oil over medium heat in 12 inch skillet.  Add 3 beef top round steaks and press to flatten slightly.  Pour 1/2 can of chick peas and peas undrained peas into slow cooker.  Combine remaining 1/2 can of chick peas with green peas, yellow pepper and asiago cheese together in slow cooker.  Stir in poppy seed.  Place top round steak in slow cooker.  Pour remaining 1/2 can of chick peas and peas over meat.  Cover.  Cook on low heat setting 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,yellow squash,red onion,italian parsley,mango,apricot preserve,red chili powder
title: Marinated Italian Bread and Veggies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs firm firm ripe yellow squash | 1 1/4 lbs firm ripe mangoes | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 red onion | italian parsley | red chili powder | swiss rye bread, loaf
instructions: Cut off and discard the stalk ends of the squash.  Slice 1/2 inch long, then slice again.  Rinse with cold water and set aside.  Rinse and pat dry with paper towels.  Cut the peeled mango with a sharp knife into 1/4 inch wide, very thin slices.  Slice the red onion with slices the long way.  Cut the loaf into 1/2 inch slices.  Dice the red onion thinly.  Place the cut squash slices in a large glass or ceramic baking dish, add all ingredients, cover and marinate in the refrigerator at least 3 hours or overnight.  The longer, the better.  Drain the vegetables from the marinade and discard marinade.  Remove the vegetables from the refrigerator and bake at 350ºf for 45 - 60 minutes, or until tender.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pineapple,lasagna noodle,lima bean,rump roast,tomato paste,grain white rice,gruyere cheese
title: Lamb and Gruyere Cannelloni
ingredients: 8 rump roast, trimmed of all visible fat | 8 slices gruyere cheese, 1/4-inch thick or 8 slices emmenthaler cheese | 1 can tomato paste | 1/2 cup whole grain white rice, cooked | 1 can lima beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 12 noodles, any shape
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Place the roast on a rack in a roasting pan in a flat layer.  Sprinkle the top with the gruyere cheese, spreading it out evenly.  Dump slices of tomato paste on top.  Cover the roast with remaining cheese slices.  Cover snugly with the tomato slices.  Cover roasting pan with foil and bake 40 minutes.  Add cooked lima beans and pineapple.  Cover with foil and bake an additional 15 - 20 minutes, until the sauce is thickened slightly.  Remove cheese from heat and cover tightly with aluminum foil.  This can be served at room temperature or chilled to bring out the flavors.  Let stand 15 - 20 minutes before slicing.  When ready to serve, bring a large pot of water, boil, then add some salt and the noodles.  Cook until just tender, about 3 - 5 minutes.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Drain.  Fill a large mixing bowl with the noodles, some of the liquid from the can of crushed pineapple and some of the sauce.  Toss with a fork and enjoy.

title: Gourmet Barley and Jicama Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 2 cans sliced jicama, drained and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup finely shredded cheddar cheese | 5 juniper berries | 3 dried anise seeds
instructions: In medium size saucepan, bring 2 cups water to boiling.  Add barley.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,pepper,tart shell,tomato,beef chuck roast,coriander seed,white wine,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon pepper | 8 teaspoons pickled jalapeno slices with seeds | 4 ounces kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 medium tomatoes, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 8 medium frozen tart shell, thawed | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Place beef in a bowl.  Add wine, coriander, pepper and jalepeno.  Stir well, cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.  Remove beef from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking.  Prepare tart shells according to package directions, adding tomato slices and kielbasa slices during last 2 minutes of grilling.  Spoon beef and sauce over prepared tart shells, sprinkle with cheese.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: cumin,poblano pepper,rice noodle,cream tartar,paprika,custard powder,leek,green chili sauce
title: Green Rice Noodle and Poblano Casserole
ingredients: 300 g rice noodles, dried or quick cooking rice noodles, uncooked | 2 large poblano peppers | 2 large leeks, white parts only | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | sweet green chili sauce | custard powder, to dust
instructions: Place the rice noodles in a large bowl with cold water to cover.  Soak for a few minutes over a bowl of warm water to cover, rinse with cold water and drain.  When the noodles have softened, put them into a food processor and pulse until it forms a fine noodle like texture.  Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium heat, add the peppers, leeks and paprika and saute for about 5 minutes until they soften.  Set aside to cool down a little, then peel the poblanos.  Seed by immersing in boiling water for about 25 seconds, and then roughly mince up the flesh with your hands into about 1 cm cubes.  Add the cubed poblanos back into the skillet, along with the cream of tartar.  Add the sweet chili sauce to taste and stir well.  Place this mixture into a well buttered baking dish and set aside.  Drain the cooked rice noodles well and divide on top of the noodles.  Pour the sauce over the noodles and toss together well.  Cover the casserole with aluminium foil and bake in a preheated oven at 150 degrees f for about 45 minutes.

title: Swiss Cheese and Oyster Dings
ingredients: 12 ounces swiss cheese, grated ( about 3 cups ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh oysters, scrubbed | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 cup currant jelly, chilled and drained | 2 teaspoons drambuie, chilled
instructions: Drain the oysters of their shells and clean them.  Cut the tops off the oysters, leaving a shell about 2 inches wide.  Using a pair of scissors or kitchen scissors, remove the beak, reserving the shells.  Cut the shells in half and remove the beak.  Place the shells on a baking sheet and spray them with nonstick cooking spray.  Bake in a 350 degree f oven for about 5 minutes or until golden brown.  Set aside to cool.  Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Pulse the cheese in a food processor until smooth.  Scrape in the cheese and mix.  Add the oysters and crack the shells in half.  Pour into the baking dish.  Place in the freezer and freeze overnight.  Remove the shells from the baking dish and crush with a fork.

title: Tandoori Curry Paste
ingredients: 1/4 cup curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Mix curry paste with rest of ingredients.  Use as required.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,kosher salt,picante sauce,no salt tomato,mayonnaise,lobster tail,pork loin roast
title: Lobster Tacos
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast | 1/2 pound kielbasa, sliced | 8 ounces no-salt-added whole tomatoes, chopped | 4 ounces canned no-salt-added whole tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 cup picante sauce
instructions: Trim fat from pork.  Cube pork and place in a bowl.  Add the kielbasa to the pork.  Stir in the tomatoes, mayonnaise, and salt.  Cover, and refrigerate for 8 hours, turning the pork halfway through.  Remove cheese from the pork and place on the tortillas.  Spoon the tomato and kielbasa mixture into the tortillas.  Top with picante sauce and serve.

title: Rhubarb in Sherry Sauce
ingredients: 10 tablespoons margarine ( no substitutes ) | 10 sprigs chives, leaves only | 3 cloves garlic, finely chopped | 1 1/3 cups greek yogurt ( no substitute ) | 1 1/2 cups half and half or 1 1/2 cups whole milk | 1 tablespoon dried sherry | 1/2 lb rhubarb
instructions: Put margarine into a small saucepan over medium heat.  Add 1 1/4 cups of the chives and garlic to melted margarine and let the mixture simmer, stirring frequently.  Add yoghurt, half and half, and sherry and heat for at least 10 minutes until it is smooth and creamy.  Strain and chill the rhubarb, cut it into thin slices and then slice the rest in half or thirds lengthswise the sections, depending on ripeness of the sections.  Remove the juice from the rhubarb pieces and place them in a saucepan with the rest of the chives and garlic.  Add water to just cover the pieces and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to medium and simmer, covered, until rhubarb is very soft.  Pour the sauce into a serving dish and let everyone add their own flavouring of the sherry at the table.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,date,apple juice,whipping cream,kaffir lime leaf,self rising flour,cream chicken soup,four cheese mexican
title: Creamy Apple Cake
ingredients:
4 ounces three-cheese mexican blend cheese | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 16 ounces sour cream | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup whipping cream ( light, vanilla or coconut flavor ) | 3/4 cup dates, minced ( not toasted! ) | 1 kaffir lime leaf, fresh leaves.

instructions: Mix cream cheese and cheese in a bowl until creamy.  Add cream of chicken soup, sour cream, vanilla, apple juice, and whipping cream until just mixed.  Spread this mixture in a 9 x 9 pan.  Cover with dried dates and kaffir lime leaves.  Sprinkle with paprika or other desired seasonings.  Use only dates.  Bake at 350 degrees for 55 - 60 minutes or until cake is golden brown and bubbly.  Cool for about 5 minutes and dig in.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,sourdough bread,graham cracker crumb,pea,kosher salt,yeast
title: Peas & Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb frozen peas | 2 slices sourdough bread | 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 2 cups sourdough bread | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs ( may need more, to get the right consistency ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Boil peas in water for 5 minutes.  Cool & drain.  Place 1/2 the frozen peas in a microwave safe bowl.  Cover, & cook on high for 2 minutes, or until tender.  Let cool slightly, then mash together with the sourdough & 1/2 cup of the hot peas.  Stir this into the mashed peas.  Dump all the bread crumbs in a large bowl, & mix in well with fingers.  Lightly sprinkle the remaining crumbs on top.  Turn it on your mixer, & knead on low for about 10 times or until smooth and supple.  Shape the dough into a ball & place it on lightly oiled, greased cookie sheets, or parchment paper.  Cover & let rise in a warm place for about 45 minutes.  Bake in a preheated 400°f oven for 15+ minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool for about 5 minutes before removing from sheets or paper towels.

Random Ingredients: french baguette,wonton wrapper,garlic clove,sesame oil,kielbasa sausage,red cabbage,sharp cheddar cheese,rice vinegar
title: Bier Rongettenos
ingredients: 1/2 lb kielbasa sausage, about 1/2 lb, halved lengthwise, then sliced 1/3 inch thick | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 garlic clove, minced | 20 wonton wrappers | 1 medium head red cabbage, cut into 1-inch wedges | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 3/4 lb french baguettes
instructions: Preheat broiler.  In a bowl, combine sausage, 1/2 cup vinegar, sesame oil and garlic.  Place 1 won ton wrapper at a time on a flat surface.  Dip one triangle into water to soften.  Drain, shaking excess, and cut into 5 1/2 long strips.  Arrange on a well oiled or baking sheet.  Brush with oil, season with salt and pepper and broil until browned, 3 - 4 minutes.  Transfer to a rack to cool.  When cool, wrap each wonton piece in half and place, cut side up, on a baking sheet.  Bake, uncovered, until lightly browned, 4 - 6 minutes.  Serve with cabbage, cheese, sausage, remaining vinegar, and sesame oil.  Serve with crisp bread.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,dill pickle,spinach,butternut squash,king prawn,chicken thigh,rice noodle,kielbasa
title: Chicken Soup
ingredients: 20 pounds boneless chicken thighs, cut into thirds | 2 pounds kielbasa, sliced in half | 2 large dried ancho chile powder | 1 1/4 cups rice noodles, soaked in warm water | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 2 quarts dill pickle slices | 1 pound fresh prawns
instructions: Line the bottom of a large stock pot with heavy duty aluminum foil.  Place the chicken thighs on top of the aluminum aluminum foil, leaving enough aluminum foil covering for steam to escape.  In the stock pot, place the kielbasa or sausage slices, dried ancho chile powder and raw rice noodles.  Place the chicken thighs atop the sausage and noodles.  Pour enough water into the pot to come approximately halfway up the chicken thighs.  Refrigerate the chicken until cool enough to handle, then remove the chicken, but leave enough additional water to keep moist if necessary.  Refrigerate the remaining chicken thighs for up to 2 days.  Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Slice the chicken meat into strips about 1/2 inch wide by 2 inches long, and place on top of the chicken.  Place the pickles and prawns on top of the onions, and place the dill pickles on top.  Cover with aluminum foil and a lid.  Place the stock pot into the preheated oven.  Bake the soup for 10 minutes, or until the chicken juices run clear.  Remove the bouquet garni from the water.  Remove the vegetables from the stock pot, and place into a serving bowl.  Cover, and set aside to keep warm.  Ladle out the broth, and skim off any surface fat.  Bring the broth back to a boil, and boil for 2 minutes.  Stir in the cooked rice noodles, spinach and pickles.  Cook for 2 more minutes, then serve.

title: Chicken & Beer on a Stick
ingredients: 1 chicken thigh | 1 sage | 4 ounces fish, from the smoked fish, fillets, etc | your favourite pie shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Skin the chicken thigh.  If you don't like all the bite, cut into chunks.  Using a knife, poke the thigh all over with the sage.  Cut the drumsticks in half at joint if you feel they are too long.  Place the chicken and drumsticks onto a baking tray, skin side down.  Bake for 50 - 60 mins, until golden and tender.  Once done, remove from oven and cool.  Open the pop and place the chicken onto a carving board.  Add a few drops of smoke or flavour.  Tear off the chicken into pieces and roll it into your favourite sauce.  Arrange them on a flat plate or individual plates.  Pour any remaining sauce over and serve.

title: Caribbean Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 banana, sliced | 1 orange bell pepper, sliced | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 3 cups fresh spinach
instructions: In a bowl combine the banana, orange bell pepper, apple juice, and spinach.  Toss to mix well.

title: Burgundy
ingredients: 4 veal chops, lean | 150 g bamboo shoots, ripe | white pepper | 1 puff pastry, ready-packaged
instructions: Take one plank and cut into four.  You should get a total of eight.  Cut the veal chops in two.  Take each chop and place each one in a pastry bag, add a generous pinch of white pepper and a good squeeze of water.  Wake the bag in a pan of boiling water and put in a pastry bag.  Cut a few slits between the top of your pastry bag and add to the mixture.  Leave to cook for about 20 minutes.  After 20 minutes, check that the pastry bag has sealed and turn out of bag.  You should have a good thick pastry browned, but not burnt.  If you don't, the pastry bag will keep it's shape.  If this does, put a piece of kitchen paper to cover and cover the board with it.  Take the tray of veal out and cut out four squares.  You will have a two layer burgundy with a thin layer of pastry.  Take a piece of veal and fill it up with the mixture.  Close the pastry bag at the sides.  Seal the pastry bag.  You will now have a pastry wrapped in place which is long enough to fold.  Place all your parcels on top of the burgundy.  This is the tricky part.

title: Irish Cream Laksa
ingredients: 1 cup crushed tortilla chips | 1/2 cup dried thyme leaves | 2 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Soak tortilla chips in water for about 10 minutes, then drain.  In a small bowl, mix the thyme, irish cream and salt.  Stir this mixture into tortilla chips.  Form into laksa shapes.  Refrigerate until serving.

title: Roasted Parsnips With Sun-Dried Tomatoes (Papouts)
ingredients: 20 small parsnips | 2 -3 slices flat bread | 1 -2 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Wash the parsnips.  Place in a large roasting pan or skillet.  Sprinkle with salt on both sides.  Roast, stirring once or twice, until tender.  Cool slightly, then cut into cubes.  Place bread cubes in a single layer on a foil lined baking sheet.  In small bowl, stir sun dried tomatoes until coated evenly.  Top bread cubes with the parsnips and drizzle with desired amount of sun dried tomato oil.  Roast and stir until bread cubes are lightly toasted, approximately 15 minutes.  Serve immediately, or store in a plastic bag for up to a month.

title: Easy Chunky Almond Sauce from Your Own Food
ingredients: 36 ounces rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Place the tomatoes in a bowl with a lid and sprinkle with a little salt.  Cover with plastic wrap and let chill in the fridge.  When ready to serve, microwave for 1 minute, stirring every 2 minutes to stir.  Place the almonds in a food processor and process until coarsely ground.  Stir into the tomatoes and mix well.  Serve warm on hot toast or rolls.

title: Cherie's Buttermilk Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chicken breast, cut into bite-sized chunks | 1 can beef broth | 1/2 lemon, zest of | 1/4 cup buttermilk
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425 degrees.  Line 9x13x1 pan with foil/grease.  Put chicken chunks on foil.  Bake for 20 minutes and then turn chicken over.  Top with broth.  Put in oven for 15 minutes and turn off oven.  Stir zest into buttermilk and put in oven for another 10 minutes and then take out of oven.  Serve with rice and a vegetable of your choice.  I actually like spinach.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,yeast,chicken bouillon cube,lime wedge,shrimp,vegetable oil
title: Portuguese Shrimp Loaf - Shrimp Crock:
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/3 cup golden syrup ( honey can be used ) | 3 3/4 cups vegetable oil | 10 ounces yeast | 5 chicken bouillon cubes | lime wedge, garnish ( optional, for garnish )
instructions: Dip shrimp in boiling water for 2 minutes.  Drain and cool to room temperature.  Add syrup and oil to a large, deep skillet.  Heat on medium to medium high heat.  Stir to mix well.  Dissolve 5 cube bouillon cubes in 1 cup of cold water and set aside.  Dissolve yeast in 1 cup of warm water, then stir into hot mixture.  Cook, stirring constantly until yeast has dissolved and color has turned lighter.  Add dissolved bouillon.  Scrape mixture out of heat.  Add shrimp, sugar, and lemon juice, mixing well.  Pour into a greased 8x4x3 baking pan.  Place in 400 degree oven and bake 75 minutes or until well browned, or according to package directions.  Let cool on a rack, then slice into 16 servings.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,milk powder,lima bean,rice paper,cumin powder,cinnamon oil,teriyaki sauce
title: Teriyaki Calabrese
ingredients: 2 cups snow peas, trimmed | 2/3 cup lima beans, shelled | 1/2 cup rice papers ( i used yellow ) | 1 3/4 cups skim milk powder | 2/3 cup teriyaki sauce | 2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon oil ( or other neutral oil )
instructions: Soak bag or saran wrap in water 20 minutes, remove excess water.  Cut bag into eight even pieces.  Boil until crisp, but still firm, drain and reserve.  Place snow peas and lima beans in microwave safe bowl, microwave on full power for 3 minutes.  Drain.  Wash rice noodles in cold water, drain.  Toast in frying pan with oil, until golden, about 1 - 2 minutes.  Place a large scoop of nori on one piece of noodles, and spoon some noodles on top of the bean/snow pea mixture.  Sprinkle generously with teriyaki sauce.  Fold other piece of nori over top, and wrap around the sandwich.  Secure ends with toothpicks.  Serve hot or cold with additional teriyaki sauce.  To freeze for up to 1 month, place bag in a freezer zip.  Remove air and add ice cubes to bag, cover tightly.  Freeze.  Heat oven to 400°f when ready to serve, defrost bag in fridge.  Wrap tightly and place in the freezer.  When ready to serve, thaw and heat through.  To serve warm, place on plate, wrap and serve.

title: Toffee Spread (Zwt 1)
ingredients: 2 cups apricots, chopped | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/4 cup tomato juice ( unfiltered )
instructions: Combine apricots, mustard seeds and tomato juice in a food processor or blender.  Process or process until smooth.  Store in refridgerator covered container.

Random Ingredients: white bread flour,chinese five spice powder,bourbon,chinese wine,noodle,chipotle powder,red potato
title: Mongolian Potatoes
ingredients: 10 medium red potatoes | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 3 teaspoons dried chipotle powder | 3 teaspoons dried instant dried noodle, broken into pieces | 1/4 tablespoon chinese wine or 1/4 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 tablespoon dry bourbon, whiskey | 1 5/8 cups unbleached white flour
instructions: Peel potatoes.

Random Ingredients: bow tie pasta,celery seed,butter,red wine vinegar,coffee,fruit
title: American Kitchen Classic Basic Italian Pasta
ingredients: 6 ounces bow tie pasta | 3/4 cup strong coffee ( cold ) | 1 tablespoon butter | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup crushed mixed dried fruit | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain and reserve 1 cup pasta cooking liquid.  Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix coffee, butter, vinegar, mixed dried fruit and celery seed.  Drain pasta, and toss with mixture.  Place 2 tablespoons pasta cooking liquid into a small saucepan over medium heat, and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: yellow corn flour,stewing beef,ginger ale,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chicken tender
title: Chef John's Chicken Pot Sticker Pies
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 4 chicken tenders, or more to taste | 1 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 6 cups yellow corn flour ( may substitute unbleached white corn flour ) | 4 bottles ginger ale, chilled
instructions: Place beef into a large dutch oven or heavy pot.  Toss with onions and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Lower heat and simmer until beef is very tender, about 1 hour.  Remove beef to plate and set aside.  Pour off fat from pot.  Stir in cheeses.  Cover and let stand 5 minutes.  Remove lid and stir.  Cut beef into 1 inch square pieces and add to pot.  Add ginger.  Stir and bring to a slow simmer.  Cover and simmer 30 minutes.  Turn off heat and allow to set until cool enough to handle.  Set the meat and vegetables aside to cool.  Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Stir corn flour into the beer to make a thin batter, about 1 cup total.  Drop batter by tablespoonfuls into simmering broth, stirring constantly.  Cook until the flour is very thick, about 5 minutes and remove with a slotted spoon.  Sprinkle each pie with ginger ale and place back into the oven.

title: Rosemary Fondant
ingredients: 1 lb pecan, toasted | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried rosemary | 1 lb olive oil
instructions: In your fondant place the pecans on a cutting board over a sink.  Grind them coarsely, put them in a sieve and toss them with the rosemary in the sieve.  Put a heavy weight on the top and squeeze them out into a bowl.  Let them stand for 10 minutes.  Add the oil, stirring it with the back of a spoon.  Heat the oil for dipping the fondants until it is just warm to the touch and serve them on a dry pumpernickel or rye bread.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,sriracha sauce,italian plum tomato,ice water,crabmeat,coriander leaf,plum tomato,feta cheese
title: Ghalian Crab
ingredients: 1 lb crabmeat, picked over and cut into bite-sized pieces | 8 sprigs fresh coriander leaves | 3 -4 red green cardamom pods | 1 bottle italian plum tomatoes | crushed ice water ( as needed ) | grated fresh low-fat feta cheese or greek parmesan cheese | ssriracha hot sauce
instructions: Soak the crabmeat in 3 or 4 cups of water for 20 minutes, or until completely soft.  Drain, place in a medium size bowl, and pour over a layer of crushed ice, leaving the remaining ice chunks and crushed ice separately.  Refrigerate crab for one hour.  Just before serving, place a handful of crushed ice in each of 8 small ramekins or sundae glasses, and microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until softened and slushy.  In a small bowl, stir together the crushed tomatoes, crushed ice and a touch of sriracha.  Spoon the tomato mixture into the ramekins or glasses, and sprinkle on the crumbled crab.  Place a few basil leaves on each glass, then spoon a small amount of the crumb mixture onto each of the 4 glasses in the order listed, ending with crumbs on top.  Serve immediately.

title: Rost Beef Brisket With Mustard Appeticles
ingredients:
5 lbs beef brisket ( on a hint of beef, i've used a large flat bottomed pan.
    - just add more if needed.
    - can also use a double, triple or even more if needed.

    - mustots will do ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon coarse grain english-style mustard ( must be dijon mustard ) | fresh dill, slivered
instructions: Make sure it is a good consistency.  Heat oven to 300 degrees.  Place brisket in roasting pan.  Mix mustard and spread on top.  Bake for about 3 1/2 to 4 hours till the meat is fork tender.  Take out of the oven, cover with foil.  Let stand 25 minutes while you prep the gravy.  To thicken gravy, mix mustard with lots of cold dry mustard, or mix with a fork until well blended.
