instructions: Pre heat the oven to 400 degrees.  In a small skillet heat the sesame oil to just smoking.

title: Roasted Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes ( about 7 pounds ) | 14 ounces beef broth | 1 tablespoon dried sage | 2 tablespoons dried italian parsley | 1 tablespoon dried capers | 2 tablespoons dried fruit jam
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f.  Place the baking potatoes directly on the rack in the center of the oven and roast for 1 hour, or until tender.  Remove the pan from the oven and transfer the potatoes to a baking dish and set aside.  Roast for 1 - ½ hours, turning occasionally.  Drain the roasting pan with the potatoes and set aside.  Place the beef broth, sage, parsley, capers and jam in a roasting pan.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,gruyere cheese,self raising flour,chili powder,potato,wine,iceberg lettuce,french bread
title: Cheese & Potato Lidli With Wine and Garlic Churros
ingredients: 8 slices gruyere cheese | 1 cup self-raising flour | 3/4 cup unwhipped english wine or 3/4 cup vermouth | 1 teaspoon chili powder, for marinate | 250 g shredded iceberg lettuce ( can use mixed salad leaves ) | 50 g shaved cooked potatoes | 2 tablespoons cocoa sugar or 2 tablespoons cocoa syrup | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar or 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175c or 170c if using fan forced oven.  Place 2 cheese slices on a board and roll slightly.  Press the cheese into the base of a greased, lined 2lb loaf tin.  Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden and melted.  Allow to cool on a wire rack.  For the churros, combine the flour, wine and chili powder in a bowl, stir well.  Combine the lettuce, potato and sugar in another bowl.  Add the dressing and stir to combine.  Spoon the mixture into the cheese slices and bake for a further 40 - 50 minutes or until golden and cooked through.  Serve with the churros.  Recipe courtesy of chese and garlic churros.

title: Fig and Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 8 figs, cut into quarters | 1/2 lb dried figs, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1/2 yellow pepper, cut into strips | 1/8 cup black olives, pitted and sliced or 1/8 cup green olives, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Place chopped figs and chopped bell pepper in container of electric blender, add garlic salt.  Blend until mixture becomes a paste.  Pour into a small bowl and refrigerate or freeze.  If needed, add more garlic salt to taste.  The tapenade can also be used immediately for a tangy french appetizer, adding olive oil to taste over the sliced or sliced slices of figs.  To make this delicious tapenade recipe, add 1/2 tablespoon of sour cream to tapenade and mix well.  To make French appetizers, slice 1/4 inch thick slices from top to bottom of each fig cup in a wide spatula.  Cut a slit in the rind of each fig and place 1/4 cup pear slices in each indentation.  Dribble tapenade over the pear slices, sprinkle with a pinch of paprika, and serve.

Random Ingredients: pork baby back rib,white bean,chicken breast fillet,sesame oil
title: Chilled Pork and White Bean BBQ Ribs
ingredients: 1/4 cup sesame oil | 800 g white beans, cooked and drained | 80 g baby back ribs, sliced | 150 g pork baby back ribs
instructions: Whisk together the sesame oil and 4 tblspn lemon juice and set aside.  Cook back ribs in 3 batches in lightly salted boiling water for 6 minutes or until slightly charred and cooked through.  Turn ribs over, brush back with half of the sesame oil mixture and cook for 10 minutes longer or until cooked through and golden brown.  Meanwhile.  To serve, slice pork in half crossways and arrange on serving plates with beans and baby back ribs.

title: Robyn's Salad
ingredients: 1 bag fresh raspberries | 1 bag frozen sweetened edamame | 2 cans rotel | 15 ounces frozen chopped fresh raspberries | 1 package frozen mixed chopped vegetables | 1 cup chopped fresh basil | 1 1/2 tablespoons orange blossom water
instructions: Blend ingredients until smooth.

title: Salsa Flavoured With Cardamom and Soy
ingredients: 1 jar salsa | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence ( optional ) | 1 cardamom pod, lightly crushed & seeds taken from the cardamon pods | 1 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a non metallic bowl.  Stir well.  Cover and leave for at least one hour.  Serve with bread, crackers or as a condiment to fish.

Random Ingredients: brandy,extra virgin olive oil,white potato,breadcrumb,tomato sauce,picante sauce,ancho chile powder,kielbasa
title: Mexican Style Brandy Potatoes (Sopa Seca De Maiz Pel)
ingredients: 3 lbs medium white potatoes | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon sazon goya brandy ( or sambal olek ) | 8 ounces kielbasa ( cut into thin bite size pieces ) | 1/3 cup tomato sauce ( muir glen organic ) | 1/3 cup brandy or 1/3 cup bourbon | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 - 3/4 cup country breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon grated peeled kielbasa ( or other spicy sausage )
instructions: Cut the potatoes lengthwise into thick wedges.  Peel the potatoes and cut them in half.  Place in a large saucepan and add enough cold water to cover.  Bring to a boil and cook until the potato skins float to the surface.  Remove from heat and put potatoes in a colander to drain.  Preheat the oven to 450ºf.  Brush the inside of a baking pan with oil and season with salt and pepper.  Line the bottom and sides of the pan with the potato slices, laying them about 1/2 inch apart.  Brush slices with olive oil and season with salt and pepper as desired.  Combine the tomato sauce, brandy and chili powder in a small bowl, stirring thoroughly but don't boil.  Dip the seasoned potatoes into the sauce mixture tossing to coat.  Sprinkle with the bread crumbs and the sazon mixture.  Bake on the middle rack of the oven for approximately 30 minutes or until the breadcrumbs are crispy.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,half,sherry wine,yeast,water chestnut,spanish onion,glace cherry
title: Sweet Wine Onion Rings
ingredients: 5 cups diced spanish onions | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 1 cup boiling water chestnuts, chopped | 3 cups half-and-half | 2 tablespoons chopped glace cherries
instructions: Heat 1/2 of the onions in a dutch oven over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until they are golden brown.  In a bowl, stir the soup, sherry and yeast until dissolved, about 5 minutes.  Gradually stir in remaining onions, and heat on high until the mixture is bubbling.  When it begins to bubble, reduce heat to medium.  Stir half and half into the soup mixture, and stir.  Add cherries to soup, and heat until mixture comes to a full boil.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard,chocolate,phyllo pastry,cooking oil,white pepper,cooking wine,heavy cream,pepper
title: Baklava
ingredients: 1 lb phyllo pastry | 6 tablespoons cooking oil | 3 teaspoons yellow mustard ( can be omitted, used sparingly ) | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper ( ground, not powdered ) | 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate, melted | 4 cups heavy cream | hot water or cooking wine | chocolate, grated ( optional, to serve )
instructions: Brush a large sheet of phyllo with cooking oil, keeping it covered with plastic wrap.  Cut the stack into 3 equal squares.  Place one pastry square on a flat work surface.  Brush the top with oil and use brush to paint the top with mustard.  Sprinkle with pepper and chocolate.  Repeat until all 3 squares are used.  Working with one square at a time, brush top of phyllo with oil and then cover with another sheet.  You will finish by brushing the phyllo with oil and baking it in a large non stick fry pan or a large oven proof skillet.  Repeat until all 4 squares are used.  Add heavy cream and cook over medium heat.  Allow it to thicken up slightly.  The sauce should look like a thin glaze or a slightly thick gravy.  Continue to stir as needed and add water or wine as necessary to obtain desired consistency.  Serve with the optional grated chocolate.

title: Gone and a Half Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 ripe mango | 1/2 cup canned pumpkin | 1 pinch pepper
instructions: Peel mango with skin on, cut into chunks.  Blend mango and pumpkin together in a blender for about 5 minutes, until smooth, or mash with a potato masher.  Add pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: hoagie,palm sugar,dijon mustard,red chilies,flour,roast beef,cayenne pepper
title: Hot Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb round roast, trimmed weight | 3 red chilies, seeded and chopped | 3 tablespoons dry dijon mustard | 1/2 cup palm sugar | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons flour | 12 hoagie rolls
instructions: Grind the chillies with the mustard till smooth using a garlic press or spice grinder.  Add in the grated chillies, palm sugar, cayenne and flour and mix till well blended.  Lightly brown beef in a frying pan.  Serve on hoagies with lettuce, salsa, red capsicum and a touch of red chile jelly or honey.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,canola oil,chicken broth,ghee,anaheim chilies,cottage cheese,corn flake
title: Agua De Queso, Quesadillas With Green Chilies
ingredients: 2 cups fat-free cottage cheese | 2 -3 tablespoons canola oil | 4 large fresh anaheim chilies ( about 2 ounces ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup canned chicken broth | 1/2 cup grand marnier, plus | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 tablespoon corn flakes ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon ghee ( optional )
instructions: Prepare grill.  Remove stems and seeds from chilies.  Lightly coat grill with some oil.  Grill chiles on oiled rack of grill, turning often and brushing once with remaining canola oil, until skin is lightly charred, about 10 minutes.  Remove chiles with tongs and set on a lightly oiled platter.  Poke holes in chilies with a fork, and set aside.  Heat canola oil in a nonstick skillet over medium low heat.  Drain excess oil, but leave enough to fry the cheese.  When oil is hot, fry 1/2 cup of the chilies until lightly browned, 30 to 45 seconds per side.  Remove chilies from oil and transfer to a medium bowl.  Repeat with remaining oil, chilies and cheese.  Wipe the skillet clean with a paper towel.  Melt a little ghee in the skillet at medium high.  When bubbly, add the remaining chilies and stir for 1 minute.  Add the reserved cheese and cook until bubbly and thick.  Add the grand marnier and stir until warmed.  Spread about 1/3 cup of the cheese mixture on one side of a tortilla, then spread half of the chilies over cheese.  Top with half the remaining cheese mixture and roll up.  Serve immediately.  Repeat with remaining tortillas.

title: Apricot Preserves
ingredients: 4 cups apricot preserves | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Finely chop apricot preserves and cilantro leaves.  Combine in a blender or food processor.  Pulse until mixture reaches desired consistency, about 2 minutes.  Pack into a well greased 10 inch square pan.  Refrigerate for at least 2 weeks.  When ready to use, spread mixture on parchment paper lined baking sheets and bake at 350 degrees f.  For 20 minutes, sprinkle top of preserves with remaining cilantro leaves.  Turn once toasting.

title: Beer and Kielbasa
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 bottle beer | 4 cups arborio rice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill, or to taste | paprika for garnish
instructions: Lightly grease a skillet with cooking spray and place over medium high heat.  Cook kielbasa in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove sausage and set aside to cool.  Pour beer into skillet and cook until beer is reduced, about 3 minutes.  Stir rice and dill into beer mixture, scraping up browned bits from the bottom of the skillet.  Stir sausage and rice mixture into the rice and pour into an oven proof 2 quart casserole.  Cover and bake in the preheated oven until the rice and kielbasa are tender and the kielbasa is golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,squid,sesame seed,chicken thigh,swiss cheese,portabella mushroom cap,apple juice
title: Stuffed Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 portabella mushroom caps | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chicken thighs, split into 2 pieces | 4 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 4 red bell peppers, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup apple juice ( use apple or lemon juice )
instructions: In a frying pan, toast sesame seeds over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, 30 seconds to 1 minute.  Place mushroom caps in a lightly oiled 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.  Set aside for 15 minutes.  Preheat broiler and position rack 6 inches from broiler element.  Broil chicken thighs, 4 minutes per side.  Remove and set aside.  Reduce broiler temperature to med low.  Arrange the mushrooms caps, cheese, bell peppers and apples on a baking sheet.  Brush vegetables with the sesame seed mixture.  Return to broiler.  Broil 6 minutes or until cheese melts.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: green olive,red capsicum,apricot,cream tartar,ginger,italian bread,cilantro leaf
title: Apricot Onion and Olive Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup diced red capsicum | 425 g apricots, in juice, peeled and chopped | 2/3 cup green olives, pitted and halved | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | fresh italian bread, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius.  Place capsicum in a small baking dish.  Sprinkle over the apricots and olives, then stir in the cream of tartar and the ginger and cilantro.  Serve crumb topping with hot Italian bread.

title: Cherry-Pesto Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 150 ml reduced-sodium chicken stock ( or water ) | 1/4 cup dry crushed pineapple, drained | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped bok choy, stems trimmed | sliced tart cherry ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped basil or 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine pesto and stock in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Simple Thai Coconut Stuffed Chicken Nibbles
ingredients: 14 ounces whole milk | 8 ounces shredded coconut ( i like the sweeter version at kroger brand ) | 10 egg roll wraps ( see below ) | 1 package frozen chicken nuggets, defrosted
instructions: To make milk, place milk and coconut in a pan and simmer over medium heat until coconut is very soft, about 5 to 10 minutes.  Stir eggs and simmer until the egg whites are very creamy and the yolks are very thick.  Pour the egg mixture into the milk in the pan, stirring over medium heat until thickened, about 2 minutes.  Stir in the noodles and cook over medium heat, stirring to coat everything well.  Remove from heat and stir in nuggets.  Cut off tips from chicken fingers.  Pinch the chicken nibbles on the meat in 1 or 2 handfuls.  Roll each nibbles in the egg mixture and set aside on paper towels to drain excess moisture.  Pre heat oven to 350°f.  Place chicken fingers in a baking dish, leaving space at the top of the dish and starting at the outside of the fingers.  Bake chicken until the breasts are cooked and no longer pink in the center about 25 minutes.  Place chicken on serving platter and remove strings and skin.

Random Ingredients: savory,nonfat cream,tomato soup,spaghetti,arborio rice,sea bass fillet,cream,black pepper
title: Spaghetti Al'accia

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, 9 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato and Turnip Croquettes
ingredients: 1 rhodes frozen graham cracker crust, thawed | 1 g graham cracker crust | 2 turnips | 1 tablespoon amaretto liqueur | 2 teaspoons amaretto liqueur, for dipping
instructions: Cut each rhodes graham cracker into 8 wedges.  Scoop out the inside of the graham cracker wedges then hollow out all 8 wedges creating 8 shells.  Chop the peeled and chopped turnips.  Place the two graham cracker wedger crusts into 3 or 4 large dipping bowls or glasses.  Place 1 tablespoon of amaretto liqueur in a small bowl and add the diced turnip.  Mix and add to the turnip.  Use a fork or a spoon to dip turnips in, coating them well.  Pour half of the liqueur mixture over the turnips and mix well.  Top off the bowls with more liqueur, if desired.  Serve at once.

title:
St.
    - Louis Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds eye of round roast | 1 package fresh sliced pepperoni | 1 pound sliced pattyces | 12 maraschino cherries, sliced | 1/4 cup dijon-style prepared yellow mustard | 1/4 cup brown sugar | crackers ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place the roast in the center of a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Cut a deep slit in each slice of pepperoni and stuff with a piece of sliced pepperoni and a slice of dijon style mustard, and a slice of cherry.  Dot each sandwich with some of the brown sugar. title: Grilled Salmon With Green Capsicum Chips

Repeat with the remaining tortillas.  Serve with more dark soy sauce, if desired.  Note, you may prepare the enchiladas in advance and store in the fridge until ready to eat.

In a medium bowl, combine the hazelnuts, basil, and pistachios.  Place 1 teaspoon of this spice mixture into the center of each hot noodle.  Sprinkle with remaining spice mixture, and set aside.  Bring a second pot of water to a boil, add the rice noodles, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.  Drain, and transfer to the bowl with the coconut sauce.  Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,oregano,garlic powder,pearl barley,white bread
title: Spanish Bread with Chiles

instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Cut bread lengthwise into 3/4 inch slices.  Separate the chiles, and cut a slit down one side of each with scissors.  Open and remove seeds and veins. title: Apple Onion Jam

instructions: If using cayenne, place it in the bottom of a large, heavy, deep heavy based saucepan and add enough water to just cover it. When the lid has completely melted remove it from the heat and leave to cool.  You will need to add more water if too thickened. Afterwards, the mixture may be picked up from the corners of the jar with your hands or a palette knife.  When ready to use, it might be put in sterilised jars, cover with a layer of onion conserve and seal the jars.  This can be stored in the freezer for up to a year.

title: Falagari Salad

instructions: Heat the peanuts until they become lightly browned, and remove.

title: Prosciutto-Wrapped Pizzas

instructions: To make prosciutto, cut prosciutto in half lengthwise through center of a small piece of cheese cloth.  Slice each piece into 1/8 inch thick strips. Cook on the first side until bubbles appear then turn and cook on the last side.  Serve warm.

title: Sesame Chicken

instructions: In a small saucepan, bring cream and sesame oil to simmering and boil for 2 minutes.  Pour mixture into mixing bowl and fold in chicken broth.  Serve.

title: Nigerian Barbecue Sauce (Tsek Fel)

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and whisk until well combined.  Set aside.  For a smokey smokey smokey smokey smokey smokey smokey smokey smokey smoke the product should be of a thick consistency.  For a mild smokey smokey smokey smokey smokey smokey smokey smokeyer smoke, add a pinch of habanero.  Mix well, remove from heat and set aside for the flavors to meld.  For a stronger smokey smoke smokey smokey smokeyer smokeyer smoke, mix the two ingredients together in a glass bowl.  Store the unused portion of the unused portion in the refrigerator.  This portion can be stored indefinitely.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,beef cube,pecorino romano cheese,chicken breast,bulk italian sausage
title: Italian Sausage Rollups (Sausage Rollups)
ingredients: 10 ounces bulk italian sausage | 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 boneless beef cube ( italian sausage rollated cheese )
instructions: Place the ground sausage in a freezer bag.  Remove all the air and then squeeze the meat of the bag into the bag.  Remove the air and then lightly pound the chicken using 2 to 3 pounds.  The amount depends on how thick or thin you want your rollups.  The sausage is usually not fully cooked or it will be tough while pounded.  Remove the pieces of meat when they are a bit too thin.  This is not going to be a long cooking procedure, just to let them rise to the surface of the sauce.  Remove the pieces of sausage from the sausage bag and set aside.  Slice the meat into 1 to 1 1/4 sections lengthwise and then into 1 to 1 1/4 strips.  Place each piece of meat between 2 pieces of plastic wrap and using your rolling pin, roll the meat into a ball or a roll approximately 5 inches long and 3 inches long.  The rolls may be kept in the refrigerator for up to two days to set up fully.  After about 15 minutes, preheat the oven to 450 degrees.  After five minutes, remove the rolled meat balls and set aside.  Place in a medium sized casserole dish and set aside.  Put the ricotta in another small mixing bowl, add the pecorino romano cheese and mix well.  Add the italian sausage slices from the casings, break into small pieces about 1 1/4.  When everything is mixed well, place in the casserole dish.  Put on the chicken breasts, roll up and secure with toothpicks.  Pour any remaining juices from the chicken/casserole into the casserole dish.  Place the sealed breasts in the oven and bake for about 50 minutes.  During the second half of baking time, remove the toothpicks and let the chicken come to room temperature.  Once the rolls are done, remove them from the oven and serve.

title: Lentil and Fenugreek Fritters-Cooking Light
ingredients: 3 cups lentils ( green or yellow ) | 2 bunches fenugreek leaves ( or 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fenugreek leaves and stems ) | 1 1/2 pints lentils | 5 pints light meaty bread | 12 ladyfingers | 1/3 cup fenugreek leaves | 1/3 cup ground cumin | 1 1/4 lbs asparagus ( about 1-pound each ) | 3 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Start by soaking the lentils for at least 15 minutes in water.  Remove lentils from water and set aside.  If using fresh, wash the lentils, removing any debris or stones if using.  Soak lentils in hot water for at least 1/2 an hour before beginning to cook, so that they are easy to handle.  If using dried pulses, soak them in hot water for at least 15 minutes then drain, rinse, and set aside.  Combine lentils, fenugreek, and 1 litre water in a large pot on medium heat.  Stir fry with a wooden spoon for about 3 mins, until lentils are tender when pierced with tooth pick.  Place cooked lentils and fenugreek mixture in a large mixing bowl with the heavy duty bread cubes.  Add more water if needed to blend well.  Cut ladyfingers or lady fingers lengthwise into halves, then cut into ½ inch squares and then into quarters.  When lentils and fenugreek mixture are ready, remove from heat and add fenugreek and cumin, stirring until well mixed.  In a hot, non stick frying pan on medium heat, add oil.  Dip half the lady fingers into water, then into lentil mixture.  Place in frying pan and cook till brown on both sides, about 4 minutes.  Remove from pan and keep warm.  Repeat process until all of the lady fingers and lentils mixture is used up.  Heat 2 tbsp.  Of olive oil in a large saucepan over low heat.  In batches, add lentil mixture to oil, then stir until the fritters are well coated but crisp.  Add more oil if needed, then fry for a minute.  Add the fritters to the pan and fry until golden and crisp on all sides, 3 - 5 minutes.  Turn over, add the chicken asparagus, and continue frying til the chickenatasi come away from the pan.

title: Jamaican Beef Kabobs

instructions: Note, for a quick stir fry or barbecue, combine the meat cubes, cognac or grand marnier, paprika gingerroot, allspice, mango, triple sec and fruit.

title: Oriental Turkey Dogs

instructions: Form the turkey meat into 4 inch long, 3 thick, flat, 1/4 inch thick links.  Place the oil into a large skillet.  Quickly brown the turkey links quickly on both sides.  Reduce heat to medium low.  Cover with a lid or two.  Cook the turkey until no longer pink and the juices run clear, 12 to 14 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Let stand, covered, 5 minutes.  Uncover, remove the meat and cool.  Serve warm topped with the sesame oil.

title: Scallops in Chili Sauce

Transfer the scallops to a platter and season with salt.  Let the scallops mingle on the plate for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Caramelised Turkey (Pfeffernusse)

title: Chinese Mushrooms in Vinegar
ingredients: 1 lb cremini mushroom | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Clean and trim mushrooms.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.  Allow to sit in fridge for at least an hour before using.

title: Tomato Couscous and Vegetable Salad

instructions: Prepare your couscous according to package directions.  Mix together sour cream, drained plum tomatoes, coconut flakes and icing sugar in a medium bowl.  Mix in cottage cheese until well coated.  Add cucumber mixture and stir until combined.  Serve warm.

instructions: Cut beef into thin slices with the grain, and place into the skillet with other ingredients, breaking it up with a fork or potato masher as it cooks.  Stir fry about 7 minutes, or until browned and liquid has cooked away.

Random Ingredients: wooden skewer,golden syrup,pumpkin seed,water chestnut,tomato paste
title: Tomato and Green Tea Salad
ingredients: 8 tablespoons golden syrup | 8 tablespoons canned tomato paste | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts, chopped | 8 tablespoons pumpkin seeds | 20 skewers, soaked for 1 hour
instructions: Pour the syrup and water into a medium pot and heat gently, stirring to combine.  Crush the tomato paste with your hands into coarse bits and add to the syrup.  Mix in the pumpkin seeds and heat for 3 minutes, then remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly.  Thread the pieces of soaked skewers onto the soaked skewers and grill over hot coals for 5 minutes on each side, or until well browned and crispy.

title: Munching French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup white bread, uncrumbled | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 cups stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Grease an oven proof soup pot or dutch oven, or even a crock pot.  Put the croutons in the pot and, if they are dry, add a bit of water to keep them from sticking together.  Put water on bottom of pot to get boiling.  Add bouillon cube and put pot into oven.  When it reaches temperature, put on lid, put in oven.  Turn on stovetop and simmer for about 15 minutes.  Turn burner off, let sit, and it will be ready for you.  Enjoy.

title: Homemade Penne
ingredients: 12 ounces penne pasta or 12 ounces rotini pasta | 3 ounces adobo seasoning
instructions: Prepare penne pasta according to package directions, al dente.  Drain pasta and return to hot salad pot.  While pasta is working, combine adobo seasoning with a little water and stir, add more water for spiciness, if desired.  Pour over pasta.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,salt cod fish,dark sesame oil,marsala wine,pasta sauce
title: Braised Cod in Marsala Sauce
ingredients: 8 -10 lamb shanks | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 1/2 cups pasta sauce, preferably a good one | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | salt cod fish, cut in 6 pieces
instructions: In a small skillet heat the sesame oil.  Then brown half of the lamb shanks in the sesame oil.  Place the shanks on a plate and then pour the wine.  Cover and simmer for about 50 minutes or until the meat is tender.  While the lamb is cooking, cook the pasta according to the package directions.  Once you have drained the lamb shanks and the pasta is done, put each piece of fish on a plate and arrange the warmed shank over it.  Pour a bit of the wine and wine over the pasta and then enjoy.

title: Spanish Inspired Okra
ingredients: 1 lb frozen okra, defrosted | 1 lb chuck, thinly sliced | 3 slices pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 saffron | 6 whole cloves
instructions: Place defrosted okra in a microwave safe dish.  Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 10 minutes.  Uncover and microwave on high for another 20 - 25 minutes, stiring occasionally.  Take off the microwave and cool the okra.  Mix beef, cheese, saffron, and cloves with okra and cheese and serve.

title: Apricot Apricot Jam
ingredients: 1 jar apricot jam | lemon wedge
instructions: Dip apricot jam first in boiling water.  Drain.  Warm apricot jam again, then pour over hot jam.  Garnish with a lemon wedge.

title: Onions and Celery
ingredients: 2 bunches celery - sliced | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 onion, finely chopped
instructions: Place the celery, pimentos and tarragon in a large saucepan.  Add water to cover.  Bring to the boil and immediately remove the pan from the heat.  Leave the pan on the heat so the celery has some good color.  Cover with a lid and let it stand for 30 minutes.  Remove the lid and fluff up the veggies with a fork.  Remove the onion from the pan and stir in the vanilla essence until just mixed through.  Sprinkle the mixture with the finely chopped onion.

title: Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 kg mango | 2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread
instructions: Heat the griddle.  Mix together the flour, saffron and mango to form soft dough.  Turn out onto a floured board and knead 10 times with hands.  Transfer to an oven dish and put in a slow oven.  Turn after 1 hour and then cook for another 45 minutes at 150c/400f/gas mark 4.  Remove from heat when cooked and stir until thick.  Allow to set before cutting into squares.

title: Homemade Parmesan Nuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups parmesan cheese | 3/4 cup vegetable shortening | 1/2 teaspoon ginger | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Add cheese, shortening, ginger and pepper to processor.

title: Pesto Salad
ingredients: 1 lettuce leaf ( washed and dried ) | 3 ounces shredded raw vegetables | 4 ounces sliced black olives | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons margarine
instructions: Put 1 tablespoon of the pesto in a small fry pan.  Turn and heat for about 6 minutes or until slightly darker in colour.  Take out of heat.  Put remaining pesto, nuts and vegetables in a bowl.  Add the pesto and margarine and mix to combine.  Put the lettuce on a plate, top with salad and roll up firmly.  Serve.

title: Sour Beef With Swiss Chard and Gouda
ingredients: 2 lbs beef roast, cut into 2-inch cubes | 16 ounces swiss chard, rinsed and finely chopped | 4 ounces gouda cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup red currant, soaked in 1 3/4 cups hot water or 1/3 cup raisins
instructions: Mix beef with chard, cheese and currants.  Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.

title: Red Cabbage With Pesto Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 red cabbage | 1 liter vegetable stock or 1 liter vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce or 1 tablespoon other flavourful oil
instructions: Slice the red cabbage into thin wedges.  Wash and slice the cabbage into thin strips.  Place the vegetable stock in the top of a pan and add enough water to cover the bottom and bring to the boil.  Place the cabbage in the liquid and simmer for 5 minutes.  Drain.  Add the cream until it has absorbed all the stock.  Add the pesto and keep boiling until you achieve your preferred consistency.  Pour into serving bowls, adding the sliced cabbage and drizzle with the warm pesto cream sauce.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,wheat flour,basmati rice,egg yolk,monterey jack cheese,cranberry
title: Cheese Fried Ripe Quinoa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 10 -12 medium chilies, chopped | 2 ounces frozen cranberries, defrosted | 8 ounces grated monterey jack cheese | 3 egg yolks, beaten | 1 tablespoon green chilies, finely chopped
instructions: Pour a cup of water into a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 3 minutes.  Stir in rice and microwave on high for another 6 minutes, stirring after each minute to ensure rice cooks evenly.  Meanwhile, pour flour into a bowl, break up any lumps with your fingers.  Using a fork, stir in rice with red chiles, cranberries and egg yolks, mix well.  Drain rice in a sieve and return rinsed rice to bowl.  Stir into rice mixture just until mixed. .  Stir in green chillies just until mixed.  Pour into a well oiled 13x9x2 pan.  Bake at 350 degrees for 15 - 30 minutes until golden.  Cool 5 minutes.  Cut into 1 squares.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: turkey,peanut sauce,chocolate coffee bean,white pepper,beef bouillon cube,russet potato,spaghetti,fish sauce
title: Thai Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti, preferably whole wheat, broken into 4 pieces | 1 cup peanut sauce | 2 beef bouillon cubes or 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 8 ounces shredded, cooked turkey ( optional ) | 1 cup chopped crisp fried russet potato, if desired ( optional ) | 1 can chinese-style coffee beans, undrained
instructions: Prepare spaghetti according to package directions, omitting salt and fat.  Drain.  Cover with boiling water.  Cook on high for 5 minutes or until spaghetti has cooked through.  Drain.  Meanwhile, in a skillet, heat peanut sauce, bouillon cubes, fish sauce, and pepper over high heat.  Cook until bouillon cubes dissolve.  Stir in turkey and cook 3 - 4 minutes, or until turkey is warm.  Add drained spaghetti, potatoes, and chinese beans.  Heat through.  Serve.

title: Wild Coconut Covered Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup light coconut cream, well chilled
instructions: Remove gills by soaking them 1 - 2 hours in cold water or until soft.  Dry and cut each mushroom in half and remove any stems or tough or loose skin.  Wash in cold water and dry in a dry towel.  Wrap them tightly in wax paper and set aside.  Place 4 - 5 mushrooms on a baking sheet with a lip or rim in between them.  Mix coconut cream with just enough water to form a paste.  Brush the mushrooms lightly with coconut cream and place on top of the mushrooms.  Cook at 450f degrees on a rack for 12 - 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.  Remove, drain and serve.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,spice,hot pepper,curd cottage cheese,basmati rice,poblano chile,flat leaf parsley,grape tomato
title: Mexican Stuffed Poblano Peppers and Tomato
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 3 tablespoons curd cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley | 1 pinch of dried mixed spice, such as cardamom | hot pepper, such as sriracha, or crushed red pepper flakes, to taste | 1 1/2 cups uncooked basmati rice | 2 grape tomatoes, thinly sliced | 3 -5 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Heat a grill pan over medium heat.  Peel the poblano chilis, leaving the stem on.  Set aside.  Combine cottage cheese, parsley, chopped parsley, mixed spice, and a pinch of crushed red pepper in a bowl.  Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Cut off the top of the poblano chilis with a serrated knife, making sure that all of the chilis have been slit down their sides.  Scoop out the seeds and white membrane.  Reserve 1 poblano chilis for garnish.  Fill the reserved poblano chilis with rice, and stuff with 2 poblano chilis, 1 tablespoon of reserved cottage cheese mixture, 1 tablespoon of chopped flat leaf parsley, 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat leaf parsley, 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, and a drizzle or two of oyster sauce.  Scoop out the inside of the reserved chilis and gently stuff the reserved poblano chilis with rice.  Repeat with the remaining rice and stuffing until all are stuffed.  Line a baking dish with foil and spray with cooking spray.  Spoon in remaining stuffing, making sure the excess stuffing is covered with stuffing.  Place the stuffed chilis in the preheated oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until the stuffing is browned and the chilis are tender.  Sprinkle with remaining parsley and serve.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,white balsamic vinegar,sirloin,shell pasta,sun tomato oil,meat,shortening

title: Spanish Tomato Soup

instructions: Pour contents of cans into a 6 quart pot.  Heat on medium and stir.  Slowly stir in the lemon zest.  If you use the zest in a bottle, it will turn sour.  Serve hot with bread or cheese slices.

instructions: Finely grate the cheese and then mix in the rest of the ingredients.  Pour into toasted tin foil and grill over hot coals, or in a pre heated oven at 220 degrees celsius for about 30 mins or until bubbling and golden.

Place in serving bowl with chilli, pepper, parsley and mace, taste again and add salt, if necessary.  Chill until serving time.

instructions: Whisk together rice, lemon zest and packet of taco seasoning in a large bowl.  Toss with cabbage, tomatoes, parsley and sugar.

instructions: Cut a slits in the bread and insert the pickle halves studded with the slices.  Drizzle with water and bake at 325f for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until golden brown and caramelized.

instructions: Place the cut sides of the bun in a grilling pan and toast until golden brown and crisp.  Rub both with chopped parsley.  Spread each bun with about 1/2 t.  Of the parsley and grill over medium hot coals for 3 minutes per side.  Serve warm.

title: Seafood

instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Drop plums on a baking sheet.  Bake for 6 to 8 minutes or until plums are lightly browned.  Remove from heat and drain well.  Mix crabmeat with crabmeat.

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the bacon fat on medium low heat until the fat is reduced by about 1/ spoonfuls, stirring often. instructions: Cook the meat or turkey, drain it and leave it out.  Combine the meat with the peas and spices and mix well until well mixed.  Shape the mixture into patties/fry.  Fry over a medium heat with some olive oil or cooking spray, when the patties are cooked put them on a heated serving platter and put them in the freezer.  They freeze a lot so you can easily thaw them at room temperature.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,red bell pepper,red cabbage,cottage cheese
title: Crock Pot Cabbage and Red Peppers

instructions: Rinse whole red bell pepper and cut into thin strips.  Cut red cabbage in half, length wise.  Place into a crock pot with a lid.  Slice pepper into large strips. .  Coat pepper strips evenly with egg yolk.  Place a heaping spoonful of cottage cheese into the pepper strips.  Slice cabbage pieces into bite size pieces.  Place all into crockpot.  Cook on high for 2 hours.  Stir to prevent burning.

title: Pizza Strips

instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Using a floured hands, form balls from the dough.  Roll dough into long rectangle on a lightly floured surface, about 1 1/2 inches wide. Spray tops of pastry with pam.  Bake in preheated oven until dough has puffed and is golden, about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Italian Beef Hot Sauce

instructions: Mix 1 tablespoon mustard and half the picante sauce into saucepan.  Heat to bubbling and boil for 2 to 3 minutes.  Stir in broth, cover and simmer for 5 minutes.  Stir in pepper and remaining mustard.  Serve over hot noodles.

title: Basic Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks ( i prefer round steak ) | 3 cups bread, cut into 4 slices | 1 beef bouillon cube | maple flavored tamari
instructions: Cut up steak and place in crockpot.  Pierce with fork.  Add 5 c bread and pour in beef broth cube.  Cook on low 12 - 15 hours.  When cooked, remove meat and shred with forks.  Remove meat with slotted spoon and slice in preferred bite size pieces about 1/4 inch thick.  Heat 3 cups bread and sprinkle with a little tamari.  Place meat mixture on 4 bread slices and top with bread slices.  You can also use shredded carrot, mushrooms and/or onions.  Variation, use fresh mushrooms, chopped celery and/or red onion in place of beef.

instructions: Pour beans into a medium saucepan and add hot water.  Cover and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes or until liquid is gone and beans are tender.  Stir in chili powder, taco seasoning and 1/2 t.  Of hot chocolate mix.  Heat through.  Serve over plain, hot tortilla chips, garnish with remaining t.  Of kahlua and chocolate curls, if desired.

It should become like a hot dog bun, rather loose and hard if burnt in one hand.  Let it cool in the bag. title: Spaghetti Aloo
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti ( small ) | 4 ounces sultanas ( medium ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 10 -20 coriander leaves ( whole )
instructions: Boil spaghetti in separate pot till tender and drain well under running water.  While cooking, crush the sultanas by using a pestle.  Mix into spaghetti.  Add to spaghetti all the chopped coriander leaves and toss till the sauce is nicely blended and well combined.  Enjoy.

title: Totally Twisted Italian Vodka (Vodka Mix)
ingredients: 3 ounces vodka, inexpensive vodka is good here | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped ( or to taste ) | leaves cilantro sprig, for garnish | italian seasoning ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan, cover italian vodka with cold water.  Stir and bring to a boil once it begins to boil.  Reduce the heat and simmer, stirring, for 15 - 20 minutes until the water has mostly evaporated, leaving a nice creamy residue.  Remove from the heat, then discard the solids from the vodka.  Cover to keep warm.  Let the vodka cool in the liquid, about three to four hours.  Stir in the cilantro, stirring well.  Spoon in pretty martini glasses and garnish with italian seasoning, if desired.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,dark chocolate,red enchilada sauce,red chili powder,mexican cheese,aluminum foil,mint
title: Spicy Stuffed Red Enchilidas
ingredients: 6 red enchilada sauce cans red chili powder, divided | 2 1/2 cups mexican blend cheese, shredded, divided | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, minced | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted | 1/2 teaspoon ground red chili powder | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1/8 teaspoon red chili powder | aluminum foil ( to cover baking dish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Unwrap 2 enchiladas and place on a cookie sheet.  Mix remaining 3 enchilada sauce cans choc into bowl.  Stir in 1 1/2 cup cheese, mint, 2 tablespoons chocolate, 1/2 teaspoons chili powder, cayenne, and remaining 1/8 teaspoons chili powder.  Spoon into enchiladas.  Top with 1 ounce of reserved cheese.  Bake 20 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Orange Sauce-Glaze Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1/3 cup orange marmalade | 1 cup catsup
instructions: Combine the rice and 1/3 cup marmalade in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium heat.  Cover, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for 20 minutes.  Remove from the heat and set aside.  Stir together the remaining 1/3 cup marmalade and 1/3 cup catsup in a small bowl.

title: Italian Bean Tartare
ingredients: 400 g refried beans ( canned beans ) | 1 cup frozen french french cut green beans, defrosted ( or fresh, frozen canola ) | 3 tablespoons bread flour | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 2 tablespoons capers | 1 orange, juiced | 8 slices soft bread ( for serving ) | 4 leaves fresh basil, finely chopped
instructions: Place a small pie plate on top of a large non stick pan so you can place a rack on the middle level of the oven.  In a small bowl, thoroughly blend the refried beans, green beans and french cut green beans.  Stir in rotel tomatoes and capers until smooth.  Pour mixture into a baking dish, or other prepared dish with baking paper or a parchment paper lined rim.  Bake at the rim of the oven for 35 - 40 minutes, or until crisp and hot.  Cool for about 5 minutes before topping with bread slices and garnish with basil.  This tartare is best eaten hot.

Random Ingredients: amarula cream liqueur,parmigiano reggiano cheese,butter,grain rice
title: Liqueur Risotto
ingredients: 400 g long grain rice | 600 g amarula cream liqueur | 3 1/2 tablespoons salted butter or 3 1/2 tablespoons oil | 100 g chopped parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Rinse the rice under running cool water.  Rinse the rice under running water until the water runs clear.  Put all the ingredients in a saucepan over low heat, and bring to the boil.  Cover pan, reduce heat to very low, and simmer without a lid for 15 minutes.  Remove the lid and continue simmering for 15 minutes or until risotto is creamy thick.  Take off the heat and leave to stand covered in its liquid until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: nonfat plain yogurt,white mushroom,yukon gold potato,farfalle pasta
title: Farfalle With Mushrooms and Yukon Gold
ingredients: 1 package yukon gold potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 package white mushrooms, sliced | 1 container nonfat plain yogurt | 1 package uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the potatoes and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain the potatoes and return the potatoes to the pot.  Add the mushrooms, yogurt and farfalle pasta and mix well.  Cover and let stand until the pasta is cooked through, about 10 minutes.

title: Easy, Healthy and Delicious Ziti
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta, drained and rinsed | 3 garlic cloves, minced ( garlic powder is not necessary ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 3 cups fresh spinach leaves
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring 2 1/2 cups water to a boil over high heat.  Add ziti pasta and cook 3 - 5 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: lingonberry,bread flour,radish,broccoli floret,lettuce,red cabbage,soda water,sea salt
title: Broccoli and Lettuce Wraps With Variations
ingredients: 12 lettuce ( webb lettuce or any lettuce will work well ) or 12 boston lettuce ( webb lettuce or any lettuce will work well ) | 1 small broccoli floret, cut into 2-by-1-1/4-inch pieces | 1 large red cabbage, cored, sliced into thin strips ( preferably savoy ) | 1 bunch radish, sliced very thin ( or a combination of both ) | 1 lb frozen broccoli florets | sea salt, to taste | 1 cup bread flour, or more as needed | 1/2 gallon soda water ( approximate )
instructions: Stack lettuce, broccoli, radishes, cabbage, and radishes in large bowls.  Sprinkle sea salt over and mix well.  If you need flour to glue the roll, mix about 1/2 cup flour with soda water until dissolved.  Repeat until all flour and soda water mixture has been used up.  Allow to rest at room temperature for 30 minutes or until the dough is very firm and pliable.  Prepare rice or pasta according to package directions. .  Wrap dough in foil.  Allow to rest for 15 minutes.  Place on baking sheet with tight fitting ends.

title: Basic Italian Pepper Bread Abm
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 3 1/2 - 4 1/2 lbs yellow bell peppers | 1 -2 cup whole wheat regular bread dough
instructions: If using the regular dough recipe, follow the instructions in the description.  Sprinkle the dough generously with melted margarine, and then sprinkle the dough generously with dried parsley flakes.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Grease and flour a large baking sheet, then turn dough out onto the baking sheet, and place into the preheated oven.  Allow to rise for 20 - 25 minutes.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes, or until the internal temperature of the dough reaches 150 degrees f.  With a small knife, check for soft ball form before turning.  If it does not reach the desired softball stage, it's ready.  Allow to cool 15 - 20 minutes before removing from baking sheet to a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,plain yogurt,baby back rib,green olive,black olive,green food coloring,lemon juice
title: Baja Style Ribs
ingredients: 1/3 cup green olives, sliced | 1/3 cup black olives, sliced | 1 1/2 cups plain low-fat yogurt | 3 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons green food coloring | 2 lbs baby back ribs | 1 cup mexican blend cheese, grated
instructions: Marinate the ribs in your favorite sauce, using a mixture of the above ingredients.  Place in refrigerator until ready to grill.  Grill the ribs on each side, basting with sauce until browned, 8 minutes per side.  Remove and serve with a dollop of cream cheese on top.

title: White Bean Hummus
ingredients: 410 g cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | chopped chives, to garnish
instructions: Place the cannellini beans and chives in a large serving bowl.  Pour over a cup of cold water and stir well to combine.  Serve sprinkled with chives.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,rice,black pepper,chicken,white onion,sea salt,tart apple,chicken bouillon cube
title: Apple Stuffing
ingredients: 400 g chicken | 200 g pork sausage | 1/2 medium white onions or 1/2 medium brown onion | 1 tart apple | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice | 2 -3 dried cranberry peppers ( to taste ) or 2 -3 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Use an 11 x 7 x 1 inch pan with the baking paper on the baking stone.  Cube chicken and sausage.  Finely dice onion, apple and dried cranberries or use the same size pan as the chicken.  Cook chicken and sausage with the onion and apple on the stovetop until cooked, browned slightly.  Add the rice and spices.  Add the leftover chicken to the mixture mix.  Use some chicken broth to clean the pan.  You can leave the mixture to cook for as long as you want to.  It will cook more in a slow cooker.  Cook on high to reduce the liquids and liquids.  Cook for 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

title: Fresco's Excellent Yummy Lentils, Tomato and Bacon Wraps with Tarragon Tapas
ingredients: 2 cups green lentils | 2 ounces chopped prosciutto ( about 1/4-inch ) | 1/3 lb sliced plum tomato | 1 sprig tarragon ( or 1 leaf ) | 3/4 cup drippings, plus extra to drizzle | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated peeled | tarragon ( or 1 leaf flat leaf ) | tulum ( or a few sprigs fresh tarragon, finely chopped, a pinch of perchervill garni ) | 6 slices prosciutto | 6 tortillas or 6 slices sandwich buns, buttered and brushed with oil, to brush
instructions: Wash and pick over the lentils until the water runs clear.  Put the lentils in a large saucepan with plenty of water, then bring to the boil.  Turn the heat down to a simmer, cook covered until the lentils are tender, about 40 - 45 minutes.  Drain and mash with a potato masher.  Add the prosciutto and tomatoes and simmer gently, crushing the beans with your hands a bit, until all the tomatoes are soft.  Stir in some finely grated tarragon and a drizzle of olive oil.  Add a squeeze of lime juice and a pinch of lime zest and juice, a squeeze of grated tarragon and a pinch of tarragon.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,avocado,tahini,romaine lettuce,tomato paste,rice wine,pecan,oregano leaf
title: Grilled Avocado Salad with Tahini Dressing
ingredients: 4 avocados, peeled and thinly sliced | 3/4 cup toasted ground red pepper | 3/4 cup chopped pecans | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 romaine lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the avocado slices with the red chiles and chopped pecans.  In a small bowl, mix the rice wine, tahini, tomato paste and oregano, and stir the mixture until well blended.  Pour over the avocado mixture and toss to coat.  Let sit for 1 minute, then arrange the lettuce leaves on top.  Drizzle with the tahini dressing.

title: Duck Breasts With Garlic Mash and Water Chestnuts
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs duck breasts | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh garlic ( to taste ) | 2 1/2 cups water chestnuts
instructions: Cut off the top and open the duck breasts lengthwise.  Spread the garlic around the outside of each breast.  Spoon 1 tablespoon of water into the open end, and gently press down to remove any stray garlic bits.  Place the breasts onto a large baking sheet.  Boil the salted water in a large skillet over medium high heat for 15 minutes, then cover and simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Toast the garlic over low heat in a dry skillet until golden brown, then set aside.  Discard any clove of garlic that didn't clump.  Slice the duck breasts into 1 1/2 inch slices.  Place the duck onto a platter.  Pour the gravy over the duck.

title: Rhubarb Chowder
ingredients: 2 lbs rhubarb | 1 pie crust | 1 box crushed crackers
instructions: Cut rhubarb finely, peel and dice,.  Place in bottom of a large bowl and mix with rind of 1 box crackers.  Fill top with rhubarb and sprinkle with crackers.  Cover bowl and refrigerate overnight.  On next day, remove cover and bake at 350 for two hours.  Serve with gravy, cream, or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,ramen noodle,green pepper,sherry wine,cumin powder,lasagna noodle
title: Quick Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup green pepper, diced ( green chilies can be substitued ) | 1/2 cup rice flour or 1/2 cup white flour | 1/2 cup dried ramen noodles ( or plain noodles ) | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 9 sheets lasagna noodles
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water as directed on package.  Combine noodles, peppers, rice flour or white flour and ramen noodles in large bowl.  Dip each layer of noodles into hot noodle batter and fry on high until golden brown.  Remove from heat and immediately place on paper towel covered tray.  Repeat with remaining noodles.  Serve immediately.

title: Barley Tacos
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 1/2 tablespoons canola corn tortillas | 1 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Cook barley according to package directions.  Drain barley and stir in remaining ingredients.  Heat in a skillet over medium heat until warm.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,portabella mushroom,rump roast,lima bean,red pepper,red onion
title: Easy Beef and Lima Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 rump roast | 1/2 lb fresh lima beans, sliced thinly | 1 can rump roast, drained and rinsed | 1 can red onion, drained and sliced thin | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained and sliced | 2 jars portabella mushrooms
instructions: Trim excess fat from roast.  Combine the roast with lima beans, onion, roasted peppers, and mushrooms in a shallow slow cooker.  Add the rind from the green peppers.  Cover and cook on low 5 - 7 hours or on high 4 - 5 hours.  Turn control to high.  Shake the contents of the slow cooker and simmer on high 30 - 40 minutes, until the meat falls apart.  Shred the meat and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,milk powder,pork loin roast,amaretto,tarragon,chuck,couscous,beef gravy
title: Couscous Cake Surprise (With Beef Gravy and Amaretto)
ingredients: 1/2 cup instant couscous | 1 1/2 cups milk powder | 8 ounces smoked pork loin roast, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 lb ground chuck | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon, leaves chopped | 1/4 cup amaretto or 1/4 cup creme fraiche, for drizzling | 2 cans beef gravy, divided | heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a large bowl, combine couscous, milk powder, meat, tarragon, and 3 tbsp cream.  Chill for an hour.  Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.  Add couscous mixture and cook until tender, about 12 minutes.  Drain off any excess liquid.  Serve with additional amaretto if desired.

title: Fondue (Polenta)
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal, plus | 1 tablespoon yellow cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups sea salt ( or kosher salt ) | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 4 -6 cups green beans, cut into 1-inch lengths
instructions: Place a colander in a large bowl and sprinkle the cornmeal over it.  Pour a few tablespoons of water into the colander to moisten the flour.  Using your fingers, press the seasoned cornmeal all over the surface in a rough, thin layer.  Let the cornmeal drip off of the cornmeal as it is added to the bowl.  This will take a bit of practice and patience for this.  After 1 hour, add the salt and pepper.  Add the green beans and toss gently.  Keep stirring.  Keep tossing.  The fondue should have a silky firm consistency.  Turn the heat off.  Place the fondue back on the stove and let it simmer until it coats the back of a spoon.  Use a slotted spoon or a slotted metal spoon to transfer the green beans to a bowl lined bowl.

title: Italian Baked Nuts
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | 1/3 cup kahlua
instructions: Place oven rack in upper third of oven and preheat to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, leaving 3/8 inch of room between each slice.  Place the bacon in a large, deep skillet.  Cook over medium heat until browned on the edges, turning often, about 15 to 20 minutes.  Drain all but 2 tablespoons bacon drippings.  Add italian seasoning and kahlua.

title: Pickle Relish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry pickle relish | thinly sliced radish
instructions: Stir together the pickle relish with the radishes.  Cover and chill.

Random Ingredients: basil,yogurt,italian parsley,flat leaf italian parsley,dijon mustard,gruyere cheese
title: Herb and Garlic Dijon Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh basil | 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese ( or gruha, about 1/4 cup ) | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/4 cup plain low-fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: In food processor, pulse basil, italian parsley, gruyere cheese, mustard and yogurt to blend.  Form mixture into 1 1/2 inch balls and place on a greased cookie sheet and sprinkle with parsley.  Bake, uncovered at 400 degrees f for 8 minutes, then transfer to a baking sheet and cool.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Mexican Chickpea and Artichoke Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces chickpeas, drained | 12 artichoke hearts, drained, peeled | 1 cup canned mexicorn, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup canned tomato puree | 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter, melted | 1/4 cup fresh orange peel, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon peppermint extract
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a salad bowl.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,parsley flake,avocado,thai red curry paste,italian bread,vanilla yogurt
title: Easy Thai Red Curry Bread
ingredients: 20 ounces italian bread ( boboli brand recommended ) | 1 cup fat free vanilla yogurt ( i recommend healthy harvest's ) | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1 ripe avocado ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven on broil.  Open container of yogurt and whisk in with a fork and set aside.  Place 1/2 cup of yogurt on a large piece of plastic wrap.  Place 1/2 cup of the red curry paste on top of the yogurt and gently roll it in the flour.  Place this in a casserole dish and set aside.  Slice bread on the diagonal lengthwise into 3 - 4 long slices.  Place pieces of bread into a serving bowl.  I like to use frozen avocado so that i take out about 2 t of the avocado.  In a separate bowl, mash the avocado with a fork and mix the milk and sour cream, stir until smooth.  Dip avocado pieces in the curry onion milk sour cream mixture, turning to coat well.  Spread salsa on top of bread, sprinkle with a few dried parsley flakes and a pinch or two of chili oil.  Top with a layer of avocado slices and serve.

title: Stuffed Parma
ingredients: 4 large dried sun-dried tomatoes | 12 slices genoa salami | 20 -30 leaves thin cut fresh swiss provolone cheese | 18 -20 thin baby spinach leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees, and generously butter a 6 oz ramekin.  Line the ramekin with cheese and spinach, then stuff the basil leaves with the roasted salami, adding more cheese on top if required.  Place on a baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,beef,self raising flour,curry paste,apricot jam,semolina
title: Auberge Biscuits
ingredients: 125 g self raising flour | 125 g semolina | 100 g ground beef | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 2 tablespoons basil pesto
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  In a mixing bowl, rub ingredients together.  Pour into a 20 x 30cm lamington pan.  Smooth top, place on tray.  Bake in oven for 30 minutes or until well cooked.  Leave to cool.  Cut into fingers.

title: Gluten-Free Flour Blend
ingredients: 2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 2 teaspoons lemon peel
instructions: Mix all ingredients with a fork until they combine.  Add more flour if necessary to obtain a glue paste.  You can use this gluten free dough for baking and fritters to use as required.

title: Healthy Egg Beaters Egg Drop Basket
ingredients: aluminum foil | 1 egg, beaten to blend | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 tablespoons fat free egg beaters egg substitute | iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place 1 teaspoon of beet givers inside of each foil cone.  Beat eggs and stock together then pour egg mixture over beet givers.  Sprinkle mustard powder over egg and vinegar mixture.  Close foil casket and place on tray.  Bake in 400f oven for 20 - 25 minutes.  Remove from the oven, unwrap foil, and place on counter top.  Carefully remove foil bag from oven and set aside to cool.  Serve immediately or store in refrigerator for up to 1 week, turning casket in the microwave for 1 minute after removing from oven.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Snow Peas

instructions: In a small saucepan, bring 2 quarts of water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: catsup,turmeric powder,chili garlic sauce,parsley,pastry dough,pecorino romano cheese,tomato,snow pea
title: Prawn Pie (Aka Seafood Pie)
ingredients:
1 pastry dough or 1 pie crust ( 1/2 lb.
    - of frozen shrimp ) | 1/2 lb cooked shrimp, cleaned and shelled ( leave tail on ) | 1 dash turmeric powder | 1 dash chili-garlic sauce | 2 tablespoons catsup ( or sauce ) | 1 tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup green pecorino romano cheese, grated | fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: On lightly floured surface, roll pastry into an oblong, approximately 14 inches long.  Carefully pinch edges together to seal in filling.  Cover with aluminium foil and set aside in refridgerator.  After thawed, shell shrimp and cut into small pieces.  Mix the shrimp, garlic, chile sauces, catsup, tomato and green pepper together. Cut a few slits for steam to escape.  Place pie on a preheated hot griddle in a steaming rack for approximately 1 - 2 minutes until crust becomes browned.

Random Ingredients: center pork chop,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Pork Chops
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 thick-cut pork chops
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Lightly spray a metal sheet pan with cooking spray.  Spray the pork chops with cooking spray.  Place each chop on the pan and bake until browned, about 10 minutes per side.

title: Grilled Salmon With Rice Noodles

2 salmon fillets, skin removed ( about 3/4 lb.
    - total weight ) | 4 teaspoons triple sec | 3 tablespoons rice noodles ( rice sticks or cellophane noodles may also be used ) | 1 can whole water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1/2 banana, sliced | lettuce leaf ( optional )
instructions: In a ziplock bag, mix the triple sec with the rice noodles, water chestnuts and banana.  Add salmon and turn to coat evenly.  Cover and chill for 30 minutes.  Grill salmon over high heat about 6 inches from the heat source for 3 minutes on each side or until desired doneness.  Serve with the dipping sauces.  For salad, arrange shredded lettuce leaves or lettuce leaves on 4 individual serving plates.  Cut salmon into thin slices.  Spoon fish and dipping sauces over lettuce.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,pear,fennel bulb,turkey,red pepper flake,beef stew meat,curly leaf parsley
title: Braised Beef With Pear-Beef Sauce
ingredients: 1 package thin sliced turkey | 1/2 cup firmly packed fresh curly-leaf parsley ( or 1/4 cup cilantro ) or 1/4 cup cilantro leaf ( or 1/4 cup cilantro ) | 1 small fennel bulb, sliced | 8 ounces beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes and sprinkled with salt flakes | 1 fresh pears or 6 dried pears, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Cut the turkey into 1 1/2 thick slices, then quarter each quarter so there are 4 slices lengthwise and 4 pieces crosswise.  Wash and chop the basil& fennel. Place a large spoonful of sauce into a small bowl.  Ladle the meat and its sauce in a slow cooker.  Serve the meat over the sauce, garnishing with the basil& fennel leaves.

title: Overnight Vegan Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 packet dry ladyfingers, sliced in half crosswise | 4 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/2 cup nutritional yeast
instructions: Mix tomato paste and nutritional yeast in a small bowl, place in refrigerator and let it sit for 30 minutes.  Separate lady fingers into two halves and spread 1 teaspoon of the tomato paste mixture in each lady finger half.  Dip the soaked fingers into the yogurt and arrange them in a single layer in a large glass baking dish.  Top with remaining yogurt mixture, pressing down gently.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or preferably overnight.  Best eaten within 2 hours.

title: Avocado Chip Chips and Avocado Burritos
ingredients: 1 large ripe avocado, halved, seeded and peeled | 2 tablespoons prepared dijon-style mustard | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon shortening, softened | 1/2 cup chopped roasted peanuts | 1/2 pound ripe hass avocados - peeled, pitted and sliced | tortilla chips to serve
instructions: Combine avocado, mustard, flour and shortening in a bowl and mix well.  Arrange half of the chips onto a plate and cover with about 1/4 cup of the chip, spreading the sides.  Spread with half of the avocado mixture and then spread with remaining chips.  Serve with remaining avocado mixture.  To make ahead, cover and refrigerate up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: arugula,pinto bean,chuck,hazelnut,vegetable oil,bread flour,coconut milk,ear corn
title: Chop Assacao
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground chuck | 1/2 cup bread flour, plain | 2 ears corn, fresh cut from cob | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 can coconut milk | 1 1/2 cups arugula | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, hazelnuts, sliced, toasted and chopped | 3 cups arugula
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix chuck with bread flour.  Form into a large roll and let rest in the fridge while waiting for the stock to come home to the plate.  In a stockpot heat oil over medium high heat.  Add corn and cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add coconut milk.  Increase heat to high and bring to a boil.  Cook until thickened, stirring gently and constantly.  Season with oregano and season with salt and pepper.  Remove from heat.  Cut each ear of corn from cob and scrape the husks and silk off of the cob and cut into thirds.  Scoop out the seeds and white part of the corn.  To make arugula, place on individual leaves of arugula and fold over into a bundle.  Tuck in sides with tooth picks to make it secure.  Bring water to boil in a large pot.  Place bundles in and steam 3 minutes, then remove.  Cook until done to preference.

title: Moroccan Garlic (Using gloves to protect your hands)
ingredients: 1 garlic clove | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Crush the peeled garlic cloves with the side of a heavy cleaver until very finely minced.  Put the minced garlic into an appropriate sized mixing bowl.  Add in the cinnamon and white pepper.  Stir everything together vigorously until it is thoroughly combined.  Put in the freezer for at least 2 to 3 hours if you feel you need to.  It's done when it becomes very soft about one day.

Random Ingredients: london broil beef,cabbage,maple syrup,lime wedge,pepperoni sausage,cream mushroom soup,orange peel
title: Sausage & Pepperoni Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb london broil beef, diced | 1/2 cup lime wedge | 6 slices orange peel | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 13 1/2 ounces condensed cream of mushroom soup | 12 slices pepperoni sausage, 1/8-inch thick | 1 medium head cabbage, cored and sliced ( about 10 cups )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place beef, lime wedge on cutting board.  Cut peel over beef crosswise into 5 slices and then crosswise in even thin slices.  Reserve beef.  Arrange slices in single layer in ungreased 11 x 7 inch baking dish or 13 x 9 inch metal baking container with wide ends toward each other.  Combine soups and 3/4 cup water in small bowl.  Pour over beef.  Cover and bake 20 minutes.  Uncover and bake 10 to 15 minutes, or until meat is just cooked through.  Spoon mixture evenly over meat.  Top with pepperoni slices and orange peels.  Bake 10 minute more.  Meanwhile for cabbage, in large bowl, combine cream of mushroom soup, sour cream and hot pepper mushrooms and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate until serving time.  Remove pepperoni slices and orange peels from beef mixture.  Layer cabbage over beef mixture and spoon soup mixture over cabbage.  Cover and bake 30 minutes.  Serve immediately.

instructions: In a shallow dish, combine icing sugar, mint, 1/4 tsp salt & crushed red pepper.

title: Indian Jicama

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place jicama in a baking pan that has been coated with cooking spray.

title: Peanut and Jicama Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts | 1 small jicama, peeled, and sliced
instructions: Toss together the peanuts and jicama.

title: Pork and Ricotta Stuffed Zucchini
ingredients: 2 zucchini | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 eggs | 2 ounces ground pork | 1 ounce cannelloni beans or 1 ounce shelled pink beans, drained | 1 ounce ricotta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon sugar cube | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Cut off the tops of the zucchini ends.  Scoop the pulp with a spoon and set aside.  Carefully scoop out the pulp from under the skin and discard.  You should leave about a heaped 1/4 cup flesh, and save the pulp for another use.  Discard the skins.  Cut out the pulp with a kitchen shears.  Put the pulp in a medium bowl, cover with boiling water and leave aside 30 minutes to macerate.  Preheat the oven to 400ºf.  Remove the zucchini peel and seeds from the inside by scoring the flesh on the diagonal.  Place a clean tea towel on a plate and weight it down with a wooden or other heavy object.  Leave for 20 minutes.  Remove the tewter string and squeeze out as much liquid and white matter as possible.  Heat the pesto in a frying pan over high heat.  Remove from the heat and add the ground meat, cannelloni beans, ricotta cheese, sugar and reserved zucchini pulp.  Stir in the pesto and heat thoroughly.  When the mixture is smooth, stir in the egg.  Slice the egg into thin wedges and arrange on a large ovenproof serving platter.  Sprinkle with cheese and press with the reserved pulp.  Bake in the hot oven for 15 minutes or until just set and golden.

Transfer to a bowl and mix in two cups of flour, 1/4 cup at a time, until the mixture comes together into a firm but sticky dough.  Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic.  Place dough in a large, oiled bowl, turning once to oil surface slightly.

title: Roasted Red Chili Mushrooms

instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Cover a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper.  Halve the poblano chiles lengthwise.  Remove stems from the mushroom stems and discard. Once cool, chop the chiles coarsely and toss with the beer and apple juice.  Stir to combine.

title: Crock Pot Pork Chops

instructions: Put chops in crock pot.  Pour mushroom soup over chops.  Cover crock pot and cook on high for 4 - 5 hours, adding more soup if needed.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,habanero pepper,currant,navel orange,self rising flour,kaffir lime leaf

Make a slit open along one side of each orange to get a 1/4 inch hole.  Place the hole in a microwave oven, and cook on high for 3 minutes, flip, and cook for 2 minutes, remove, and set aside.  Open the chocolate mixture and scrape the bottom of a medium saucepan over medium high heat.  Stirring constantly, boil 1 minute.  Immediately remove from heat, and add 1 tablespoon of the hot chocolate mixture, and stir until melted.  Place the 3 orange slices into the chocolate mixture and coat the oranges with chocolate mixture.  Fill small glass bowl or muffin cups two thirds full of the ole batter.  Place on a cookie sheet. instructions: Mix well.  Store in refrigerator.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  In a medium bowl, whisk together milk, vinegar and pickles.

title: Hot Apple Salad in Mini Dumplings(Tomoto Mushi)

instructions: Chop the apples and stems, and place in a bowl.  Toss in the cilantro stalks and mix well.  In the microwave, prepare the dumplings according to the packaging. In the meantime, preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the baking sheet in the oven for 20 minutes, or until the dumplings are lightly browned.  Serve hot, with the tomato sauce.

ingredients: 10 ounces linguine | 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb rigatoni pasta ( whole milk ) | 8 -10 dried black mushrooms, stemmed, soaked in hot water and sliced | 1 -2 serrano chilies ( or other green chili ) | 1 -2 lb fresh button mushroom, washed and soaked in hot water | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | raisins, heated ( to garnish )

title: Sauerbraten (Kalve)

instructions: Saute the minced onion in the vegie oil until soft.  Add meat and saute for 10 minutes.  Add the vinegars and simmer on low heat for 2 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.  If meat becomes too dry for your liking, add water, about 1/2 cup at a time.  Add the grapes at the end of the cooking time.  Serve with rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Cheesy Crispy Fried Tilapia
ingredients: 6 tilapia fillets, sliced in half horizontally | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, grated ( or any cheese you prefer )
instructions: Heat up some vegetable oil on high heat.  Put mustard seeds on plate and spread a layer evenly on both sides of the tilapia cutlets.  Sprinkle grated cheese on top of the tilapia.  Use as little or as much as you want, depending on your taste.  It takes a lil bit of practice to get everything to adhere.  When the bottom is browned on the bottom, flip the cutlets over, and repeat steps until all 5 pieces are used.  Keep turning the cutlets over until you have used up all the oil and your fillets have crisped up.  When done, place on greased griddle or skillet or frying pan.  Fry in batches to check doneness of fish if it looks fishy on the bottom then it is done.

title: Cucumbers

instructions: Heat a large nonstick sauté pan over medium to high heat for 2 minute or until hot.  Add 1 tsp olive oil and 1/2 t pepperjack cheese and cook, stirring until cheese melts. In a small nonstick nonstick deep fry pan, using medium heat, cook 1/4 cup oil and 1 t pepperjack cheese until cheese melts and starts to brown, 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese is slightly browned.  With tongs, transfer to plates or a rimmed platter.  Repeat process with remaining oil and pepperjack cheese.  Serve immediately.

Remove from oven, top with remaining raspberries mixture and top with a layer of toasted bread slices before serving.

title: Perfect Rice With Pesto Cheese

instructions: In medium saucepan, combine rice, broth and enough water to cover the bottom of the saucepan.  Bring to boil, then reduce heat to medium low.  Simmer covered until the rice is tender and most of the broth is absorbed, 25 to 35 minutes.  In mixing bowl, combine cheese and whipped topping.  Spread cheese mixture over top of warm rice.

title: Feta Tofu With Toasted Breadcrumbs

instructions: Bring a large, deep saucepan of salted water to a boil. title: Homemade Hot Carrots
