instructions: Soak tempeh in cold water for 10 minutes.  Remove fat with a knife to drain water.  Slice tempeh in half crosswise.  Scoop out most of any excess juice.  Discard the skin and bones, but leave enough meat as flavor to flavor as possible.  Lay tempeh flat on foil or cookie sheet that has been lined with parchment paper.  Combine the tempeh, bean sprouts, bamboo shoots and thyme in a bowl.  Mix lightly with your hands to combine.  Spread mixture flat on parchment paper.  Wrap tightly with foil.  Refrigerate for 2 hours or until meat is cooked.

title: Pasta with Ginger
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 cup pineapple juice | 1 package dry fettuccine
instructions: Combine ginger, pineapple juice, mitts noodles, and fettuccine in a saucepan.

title: Slow Cooker Meatball and Sauerkraut
ingredients:
600 g stew meatballs, cut into chunks | 250 g sirloin, cut into 2.
    - 5 cm cubes | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 200 g ricotta cheese | 400 g pinto beans or 400 g kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 150 ml double cream
instructions: Place meatballs in 4 serving dishes with sauerkraut and tomatoes.  Cover the meatballs with cheese.  Cover the sauerkraut mixture with water.

title: Homemade Spiced Sesame Seeds (Kuwaiti Recipe)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mixed dried italian-seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh coriander seeds | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: In a small bowl, combine dried bread crumbs, coriander seeds, sesame oil and sesame oil.  Cover and place in refrigerator to allow the flavors to develop until your guests arrive arrive.  This way, you can store the mixture for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,italian sausage,chili paste,black bean,pea,chili sauce
title: Chinese Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained | 1 lb sweet italian sausage ( mild or hot to taste ) | 1 jar sweet chili sauce | 2/3 cup green chili paste ( use 2-3 green chili paste if you like less heat ) | 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed ( use the peas or you own peas ) or 1/2 cup fresh peas ( use 2-3 green chili paste if you like less heat ) | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( to taste ) or 1/2 teaspoon chili powder ( to taste )
instructions: Place all ingredients, except for peas, in a large bowl.  Mix until well blended.  If it looks dry add some water.  If it is too wet add a little more water.  Add peas.  Mix well.  Shape mixture into small balls about the size of a walnut.  Chill or freeze in airtight containers.  These should keep for ages, although i usually keep them over night and take off from the freezer about half an hour before serving, but they're usually eaten when still warm.  These freeze well, but it may take a little longer once they have been frozen.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,red kidney bean,lettuce leaf,pork,white rice,cherry tomato
title: Gyu's Favorite Green Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 7 cups green cabbage, chopped | 6 cups leftover pork, chopped | 1 1/2 cups leftover white rice | 8 baby cherry tomatoes | 12 large lettuce leaves | 2 cans red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Put cabbage in large pan.  Bake at 300 degrees until cabbage is tender, about 45 minutes.  Drain cabbage, and place on platter.  Heat leftover pork, and cook over low heat until pork is browned.  Add rice, stir until thoroughly heated.  Arrange cherry tomatoes around top of cabbage.  Add lettuce, and top with beans.

title: Quinoa Spinach Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked quinoa | 1/4 cup minced onion | 2 teaspoons minced canned onions | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 can fat free cream soda | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | cooking spray | lettuce | nori
instructions: Place quinoa in a strainer and rinse well, then drain it in a colander.  Place in a large bowl.  Add minced onion, turmeric, and cream soda to crumbled quinoa in bowl.  Toss and set aside.  Spray large non stick skillet with a cooking spray.  When very hot add enough cooking oil to cover bottom of pan.  When it starts smoking add 2 - 3 tblspn of quinoa mixture and toss and spread it around.  Cook in oil for 2 to 3 minutes, then flip and cook for 2 more minutes.  Remove from skillet and transfer to small bowl.  Repeat with remaining quinoa mixture & oil, adding more cooking oil to pan as needed.  When the oil is hot again add 2 tblsppn of oil to skillet and when hot, add 2 - 3 tblspn of quinoa mixture.  Cook on medium until it starts to bubble, then stir.  Add 1/4 cup of red wine vinegar and cook until it just starts to bubble.  Remove from heat and let stand for 3 minutes and then fluff with a fork.  If it is too thick, add more of red wine vinegar.  Taste for seasoning and then add more of the red if it is too thin, stir in more of the cream soda and/or 1/4 cup of red wine vinegar.  Top with lettuce and cut up nori into thin strips just to garnish.  Serve with japanese wasabi paste as garnish if desired.

title: The Perfect  Mexican Coffee
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 2 tablespoons brewed enchilada sauce | 6 ounces beer ( or use something decent like corona ) | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries
instructions: Brew the beer, then place all ingredients into a blender & puree for about 1 minute until mixture is nicely mixed or a little chunky.  Serve in a mug, garnish with fresh cranberries, if desired.  You can enjoy this with some tortilla chips, or add the toppings of your choice, like shredded cheese, shredded lettuce, salsa, sour cream, etc.

title: Tasty Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lean sausage | pepper
instructions: Cut the sausage into 1 - ½ inch thick slices.  Sprinkle with pepper and cook on a hot griddle, turning over every couple of minutes for a very light brown color.

Random Ingredients: yeast,bulk italian sausage,grape tomato,cardamom seed,wonton wrapper,prune,italian seasoning,vanilla pudding
title: Baked Italian Sausages
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 3 cups grape tomatoes, halved | 1/3 cup dried prunes | 2 ounces sweet bulk italian sausage | 1 cup prepared vanilla pudding | 1 tablespoon mixed italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 4 ounces wonton wrappers | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce or 2 teaspoons vegetarian curry powder
instructions: Dough, in a large mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in the warm tomatoes, pitted prunes, sausage, pudding, seasonings and cardamom seeds.  Lightly coat the inside of an oiled 3 quart casserole with cooking spray or a little of the cooking oil.  Place 2 tspn of the dough in the middle of the pan.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,cream celery soup,garlic clove,rice wine,thai basil
title: Crunchy Basil and Creamy Thai Basil Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup plain flour | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 cup thai basil, leaves coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl, season to taste with salt and pepper.  Cook about 5 - 10 minutes in the oven or until mixture is hot, turning occasionally.

Random Ingredients: tamari,parmigiano reggiano cheese,fontina cheese,liquid smoke,ginger garlic paste
title: The Perfect Fusion No One Likes
ingredients: 3 cups fontina cheese | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup tamari ( plus more, for sprinkling ) or 1/2 cup bragg's liquid aminos | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 -2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Cut fontinas into thin matchsticks, with about a tablespoon for each cup.  Cut parmesan into thin matchsticks with about 1 tablespoon for each cup.  In a small bowl, add tamari, ginger garlic paste, and liquid smoke, stirring well to combine.  Heat a large frying pan with a little olive oil over medium low heat, then add the fontina, parmesan matchsticks, and tamari mixture.  Continue to stir continuously, as the mixture cooks.  Remove the pan from the heat.  Top with grated parmesan and extra bragg's.  Serve immediately.

title: Salsa Ole
ingredients: 1/2 cup green salsa | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, or to taste
instructions: Stir the salsa, oregano, and green pepper together in a bowl.  Chill before serving.

title: Overnight Pork Roast, Hawaiian Style
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 large pork roast | 1 package tofu, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 apples, peeled, cored and chopped | 1/4 cup sherry wine | ice
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.  Add roast and marinate 15 minutes.  Toss apple and tofu cubes with sherry and place in pan.  Stir pork, apples, and marinate at least 15 minutes, but not more than 10, before grilling over medium high heat and turning, about 5 minutes to tenderize.  Serve with steamed rice and a sprinkling of sesame.

title: Easy Low Fat Black Beans
ingredients: 1 package tempeh | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 medium bell pepper ( green, red or red bell peppers will give you a different taste ) | 1 packet black bean sauce
instructions: Cut tempeh into small squares.  If you're using green peppers or whatever colour you like, cut them into small cubes.  Slice bell pepper into long thin strips.  Spray large frying pan with vegetable oil spray.  Saute all ingredients except peas and bean sauce on medium heat until vegetables are soft, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in peas until all veggies are mixed through.  Serve over rice.

title: Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 2 ounces crabmeat, finely chopped | 1 1/2 ounces rice, finely chopped | 2 ounces cake-and-pastry flour | 10 fluid ounces apple juice | garlic salt | 2 -3 tablespoons cocoa
instructions: Combine all the ingredients.  Mix well.  Roll into a long roll.  Cut into long strips using a sharp knife.  Place on greased oven trays.  Bake at 250 degrees c for 15 - 20 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,maple syrup,angel hair pasta,shrimp,monterey jack cheese
title: Shrimp and Cheese Mac 'n' Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked angel hair pasta, uncooked | 1 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 2 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook angel hair pasta until al dente, about 8 minutes.  Drain, and set aside.  In a skillet, cook shrimp over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until done.  Rinse shrimp, and set aside the skillet.  Cook shrimp in the reserved pan for 2 minutes, or until pink.  Mix in the maple syrup, and heat until sauce thickens.  Spoon shrimp into individual serving bowls, and top with monterey jack cheese and parmesan cheese.  Serve immediately.

title: Broccoli Coffee Delight #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh broccoli, chopped | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese ( or swiss emmenthaler, if desired ) ( optional )
instructions: Prepare broccoli according to package directions.  Place broccoli in a medium size heavy duty microwave safe bowl.  Top with remaining ingredients.  Microwave on high 1 minute.  Stir.  Cover.  Microwave on high 60 - 90 seconds.  Remove broccoli from microwave and spoon onto cheese.  Microwave on high 15 seconds or until cheese is melted.  Stir.  Serve immediately.

title: Delicesome Great Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce ( washed & dried, may also use red cabbage ) | 1 lb lean hamburger | 1 tablespoon red currant jelly or 1 tablespoon other jelly | olive oil
instructions: Wash & dry well or spin dry lettuce & tear into shreds.  Brown meat, drain fat.  In bowl, blend or mix in jelly with enough water to reach desired consistency.  Separate the meat into slices & brush with some oil.  Place half the lettuce in one layer on flat surface of plate.  Arrange the meat on top of the lettuce & top with remaining lettuce.  Serve with syrup, pickles or other jam as desired.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,extra virgin olive oil,avocado,cremini mushroom,white sugar,stone mustard,salt
title: Grilled Mushrooms with Yogurt and Mustard
ingredients: 8 cups sliced cremini mushrooms | 2 bunches fresh goat cheese ( such as hallobello ), halved ( not crumbled ) | 3 fluid ounces greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon stone ground mustard | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 pinch salt | olive oil
instructions: Arrange the mushrooms on a grill rack about 6 inches from the heat.  Grill for about 10 minutes, or until tender and lightly blackened in spots, with grill marks.  Cut the goat cheese into cubes about 2 cups, and sandwich with the mushrooms in large cheesecloth sacks.  Mix together the yogurt, mustard, sugar, and salt in a small bowl.  Brush the mushroom slices with olive oil, and grill on both sides 2 to 3 minutes, or until nicely browned, turning once.  Be sure to turn the mushrooms while grilling so the mustard browns well.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,greek yogurt,hot water,bell pepper,eggplant,basmati rice,mace,cardamom pod
title: A Very Different Way of Dinner from the Country's Test Kitchen
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, in one | 6 cups hot water ( more or less as per your temp and how creamy & frothy you like ) | 1 medium bell pepper, cut into four lengthwise 1/8-1/4 '' dice ( whichever you want ) | 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt, plain | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar ( i sometimes use red ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod ( i like to make my own with cardamom seeds, sometimes i just omit this ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace ( i use ground mace ) | 7 -9 cups hot cooked basmati rice ( see note below ) | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Cut eggplant in ½ inch dice.  Rinse well and cut off tops and bottoms as well as bottom of eggplant.  Place the cut up eggplant in a large shallow bowl.  Pour 2 cups of hot water over the eggplant until the water has dried up.  Let sit for a couple of hours to soak the eggplant.

title: Sweet Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant yeast | 1 quart vegetable stock | 3/4 cup light molasses | 1 1/2 lbs yellow squash, sliced thickly ( like hubbard squash )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the vegetable stock.  Add half and half to the yeast and let stand for about 10 minute place sliced squash in a mixing bowl or bowl with the remaining dissolved yeast, milk & molasses.  Knead to form a firm dough.  Lightly grease a bowl and place the dough on top.  Let rise, covered overnight.  Punch down and knead lightly for about 1 minute divide into 10 - 12 pieces.  Form 3 or 4 rolls.  Place on lightly greased baking sheets, cover, and let rise until nearly double.  Preheat oven to 475 degrees.  Spray 1 piece of foil lightly with cooking spray & lay on cookie sheet.  Bake for 10 min or until crust is golden.  Cool, then store in a cool, dry place.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,phyllo pastry,green pepper,yellow bell pepper,tomato sauce
title: Spicy Shredded Beef Phyllo Pastries
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 lb lean sirloin steak | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 green pepper | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( optional ) | 1/2 cup canned tomato sauce
instructions: Brown meat in oil in skillet and then remove from skillet.  Wipe out skillet and repeat with bell peppers.  Place a sheet of phyllo pastry on a lightly floured work surface.  Brush with pepper oil.  Place 1/4 cup meat mixture in center and fold half over meat and roll up. .  Place on wax paper and repeat with the other half of phyllo pastry.  Slice diagonally and place on baking sheet.  Cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 10 - 15 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  While phyllo is finishing, slice sirloin across grain into 1/8 inch slices.  Pour tomato sauce into a saucepan and add the beef.  Boil until meat is cooked through and sauce thickens.  Serve over fettucine.

title: O'Brien Shrimp and Potatoes (Southern Style)
ingredients: 1 pound baby shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 tablespoon minced garlic, or more to taste | 1 package o'brien frozen potatoes
instructions: Place the shrimp, garlic clove, and potatoes into a saucepan over medium heat.  Pour in enough water to cover the shrimp and potatoes.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, and simmer until shrimp and potatoes are tender, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Gnocchi with Beet
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beets, peeled and diced | 2 poblano chiles - seeded, chopped, and rinsed | 3/4 cup coarsely crushed graham cracker crumbs | 3 lemons, juiced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill pickles
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook the beets until tender, about 25 minutes.  Drain and mash 1/2 cup.  Set aside.  Bring a kettleful of water to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium, and cook poblano chilies until softened, about 5 minutes.  Drain, and chop.  Stir the cooked beet mixture into the mashed beets, and stir in graham cracker crumbs, pickles, and enough lemon juice to make a slightly moist sauce.

title: Sweet Potato and Sausage Barbecue

instructions: Trim the fat from the ribs.  Place ribs meat in a large pot with a tight fitting lid that is as close to the lid as possible.

Pour the remaining chocolate sauce over the roast and top with the remaining chocolate sauce.  Cover and put in the oven.  Cook for at least 3 hours, but check for doneness after 30 minutes.  Take the beef out of the pan and pull it apart by cutting the roast into thick slices and separating the slices between the slices.  Continue to cook the meat for about 30 minutes or longer.  If you need to serve it hot, you may refrigerate or reheat the oven to melt the chocolate sauce.

title: Homemade Italian Pot Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry, prepared according to directions on box | 1 cup shredded italian salami
instructions: Prepare puff pastry per instructions.  Cut dough into six pieces.  Cut pastry into eight equal size sections.  Roll one section on a lightly floured surface with a rolling pin to 1/4 inch thick.  Using a 3 inch round cookie cutter cut each piece into two pieces.  Pat each piece of dough into a 12 inches circle.  Spread each circle evenly with the salami.  Place on a medium sized baking sheet.  Using the 1/2 cup measure, weigh down each dough piece and bake at 400° for 15 - 20 minutes.  When done, let stand for a few minutes if you can, and then carefully remove onto lightly buttered parchment paper.

title: Mexican Beef Bowl #2
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef stew, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package hot italian sausage | 1 jar picante sauce | 3 spring onions, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.  Serve.

instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Bring a large kettle of water to boiling.  Break the cauliflower into small pieces.  Bring a large heavy saucepan of water to boil.  Add the cauliflower, cranberries, roasted pepper and cilantro.

instructions: Preheat your oven to 200ºc.  Using your hands, press the walnuts down into a shallow dish.  Spray a large baking tray with cooking oil spray.  Using your fingers, spread the walnuts all over the tortillas.  Bake in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beet,white sugar,jalapeno pepper,broth,five spice seasoning,clove garlic,beef bouillon granule
title: Beetroot Hot Pot
ingredients: 1 package frozen beets, thawed | 1/2 cup jalapeno pepper, minced ( can add more if you like ) | 1/4 cup low sodium beef bouillon granules | 1 cup white sugar | 3 teaspoons five-spice seasoning ( or your own ) | 1/8 teaspoon whole cloves garlic ( optional ) | 2 cups low sodium broth
instructions: Put the beets in a small microwave safe bowl, cover with water, and microwave on high until partially defrosted, 20 minutes.  While beets are defrosting, combine jalapenos, granules, and sugar in a small saucepan over medium heat.  Cook, stirring frequently, until sugar has melted and flavors are well blended, about 5 minutes.  Add beef bouillon granules and broth and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.  Place beets and jalapenos in a blender and puree until smooth.  Heat broiler and set timer on high.  Pour into a large serving bowl and set aside until cool enough to handle, about 15 minutes.  Chill, covered, and refrigerate until ready to serve, about 4 hours.  Before serving, shake or stir to combine.  Enjoy.

title: Easy Mango Wing Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup diced mango | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 1 tablespoon dried lavender
instructions: Combine mango, hot sauce, and lavender in a bowl.

instructions: Wash coriander leaves carefully and remove stems.  Trim and deseed peppers, halve them and remove seeds as well.  Wash and peel peels and chop. Garnish with additional parmesan.  Variation, for sweet verses crunchy paprika, replace the heavy cream with 1/4c water.

ingredients: 1 bag baby carrots, 1 inch size | 1 cup fresh baby carrots | salt and pepper, to taste | 1 -4 hoagie rolls, split
instructions: Heat 2 inches of olive or butter of your choice in a microwave safe dish.  Place carrots in hot oil for approximately 25 seconds on high heat.  Sprinkle carrots with salt and pepper.  Microwave vegetables 3 - 4 minutes, tossing periodically, until carrots are tender but crisp.  Remove to paper plates.  Serve with a toasted hoagie.  Note, if you want to freeze the veggies, microwave the veggies for 15 - 20 minutes at 30% power.

title: Blueberry Cheese With Tomatoes and Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 50 g smoked gouda cheese, chopped in small pieces | 50 g blueberries | 150 g canned tomatoes in puree | 1/3 cup fish stock | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 cup oyster sauce, like lite
instructions: In a food processor puree the blueberries with tomatoe puree and all other ingredients.  Pour into a bowl and refrigerate for at least an hour.  To serve spoon over steamed white rice.

title: Quick Hawaiian Steak
ingredients: 2 boneless sirloin | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1/4 cup unsweetened pineapple juice | 1 cup strawberry, sliced | 2 tablespoons shredded provolone cheese or 2 tablespoons other cheese | 1 teaspoon snipped italian herb seasoning
instructions: Heat a grill pan or grill pan on a high heat.  Combine cumin and salt in a coffee mug.  Set aside.  Dry steak with paper towels.  Coat grill pan with cooking spray.  Grill steak to desired temperature, or pan sear until desired doneness, or to desired doneness in desired method.  Cool.  Slice steak across the grain in 2 to 3 slices.  Place a large dollop of pineapple juice on the side for dipping.  Place sliced steak in pineapple juice.  Sprinkle cheese over the top.  Add italian herbs to your liking.  Serve with a side of french bread.

title: Chile and Pork Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 4 ounces thin egg noodle | 2 slices sandwich bread | 6 ounces pork loin, thinly sliced | 2 ounces canned minced chile peppers | 1 ounce gin
instructions: To make marinade, in a small bowl, combine the egg noodles, chili peppers, and gin.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,jicama,brown sugar,rice flour,spanish onion,mint leaf,puff pastry
title: Jicama Turnovers
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup spanish sweet onion, finely diced | 1 package puff pastry sheets, thawed | 3 tablespoons rice flour | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar, or as needed | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Mix brown sugar, onion, flour, and confectioners' sugar together in a large bowl.  Cut pastry sheets into halves.  Roll out each section on a floured surface with a rolling pin to form rectangles about 8 x12 inches.  Place 1 inch ginger into center of each rectangle. Bake in preheated oven until turnovers are lightly browned, 16 to 20 minutes.

title: Paneer-Bread Machine Loaf
ingredients: 150 g plain nonfat yogurt | 1 cake yeast
instructions: Plug in the cake yeast as per your normal method for proofing.  Add the yogurt and mix thoroughly.  Let rise until double in size.

title: Blue Cheese Wedges
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups walnut-cheddar cheese wedges ( about 12 ) | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f remove 1/2 cup of the cheese from the container, and flatten.  Cut remaining cheese into 1/4 inch cubes.  Arrange onto a baking sheet.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over cheese.  Toss and sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Bake in a 425°f oven until cayenne starts to brown, about 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Poppyoshka (Poppyoshka)
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas, cut in 8ths ( about 1/4 inch ) | 1 lb poppyoshka ( frozen bread dough ) or 1 lb plain soymilk, thawed and squeezed dry with your hands | 1 1/4 lbs pitted prunes, chopped ( about 3 cups ) | 1/4 cup italian dressing | 1/2 cup fat-free soymilk | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepperoni | 12 tart or shells, warmed | 1/2 cup pickled italian-style dried tomatillos, cut in quarters ( optional )
instructions: Thaw dough and prepare as directed, using oil and water and knead on well floured surface, adding flour as necessary.  Pat into 2'' round.  Cut with a 2'' round, glass, or round cookie cutter.  Prick with a fork in the top of each round and cover with a double thickness of waxed paper or plastic wrap.  Chill for 1 - 2 hours.  Cook prunes in a small amount of water in saucepan until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain, then transfer to a food mill fitted with coarse grate blade.  Process prunes, with 1 cup soymilk, in a food processor until fine.  Add italian dressing, cardamom, pepperoni, salt and pepper.  Process until smooth, stopping to scrape down sides with a rubber spatula.  If desired, transfer prune liquid to shallow bowl.  Stir 1/4 cup reserved prune liquid into the prune puree.  Spoon about 1/4 cup puree into center of dough.  Top with about 10 tbs prune puree.  Top with remaining prune puree, about 1/2 cup reserved sauteed soymilk.  Stir well to blend flavors.  Transfer to shallow bowl or serving bowl with parchment paper.

title: Spicy Mexican Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 4 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon strawberry syrup ( see note ) | 1/2 cup fresh ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup pure ricotta cheese
instructions: Note, if using fresh ricotta cheese, drain and rinse it in a strainer.  Combine both cheeses in a bowl, then blend well with a rubber spatula or an immersion blender.  Press the cheeses into an ungreased 9 inch pie dish.  Brush the crust evenly with the maple syrup and cocoa mixture.  Bake at 350f for 25 minutes, then brush again with maple syrup and cocoa mixture.  Continue baking 2 more minutes or until crust is crisp and golden brown.  Note, if using frozen strawberries, remove the first 3 ingredients from the bowl and set aside.  If using fresh strawberries, place the first 3 ingredients in a salad bowl.  When the crust has baked, spread the second cheeses lightly over it.  Sprinkle parmesan over the cheeses and sprinkle remaining cheese over the top.  Chill, uncovered, until ready to serve.  Note, i like to use a light version of ricotta, using either fresh or canned, depending on your preference for sweetness.  It is equally as good with fresh or frozen.  Note on the picture, the original recipe specified a thin layer of syrup.  After chilling the dough, my personal preference was to remove a final layer of syrup.  This might not happen, but it would be nice to reduce the final syrup if desired.

title: Cheesy Cherry Soup
ingredients: 1 liter cheap white whole milk coffee | 1 small yellow onion, diced | 1 1/2 scallions, diced | 4 tablespoons instant tea ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons orange liqueur ( optional ) | 1/3 cup sour cream | 1/3 cup freshly-grated velveeta cheese, plus 2 tbsp
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sour cream and velveeta cheese in a dutch oven and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for a couple of minutes.  Sarnish with sour cream and cheese.

title: Almond Paste With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 teaspoons peppercorns | 250 g mixed plums tomatoes | 100 g porcini mushrooms | 60 tablespoons almond paste | 1/2 sugar substitute
instructions: Place peppercorns on a pan on a high heat.  Add mushrooms and sauté, stirring, over medium heat until the mushrooms are cooked and tender.  Add remaining ingredients, cover and cook on a medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until the mixture becomes creamy.

title: Cheese Ravioli Wraps With Taco Sauce and Veggies
ingredients: 2 cups cheese ravioli | shredded cheese or rotisserie cheese | sweet fresh taco sauce, for dipping
instructions: Cook ravioli until done about 4 to 6 minutes.  Drain and put aside.  Mix the taco sauce and cheese and stuff ravioli with the mixture and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,salsa,mango chutney,peanut butter,hot water,chive,taco seasoning mix,pinto bean
title: Fantastic Tasty Vegan Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 cup salsa, heated ( mild, medium or hot to your taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon hot water, as desired | 2 tablespoons peanut butter, unsalted | 1 package taco seasoning mix, i usually double this | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 2 tablespoons mango chutney, i use kraft ( regular or hot, i use dijon style mango chutney )
instructions: Drain pinto beans and rinse water from the beans using 2 forks, using as much water as necessary to rinse beans and mash any large clumps.  Place beans in a bowl of food processor.  Add salsa, hot water and peanut butter, mixing until thoroughly combined.  Fold in taco seasoning and crushed garlic, mixing well.  Stir in the graham cracker crumbs, chives and chutney, mixing until everything has been combined well.  Scoop mixture onto a sheet lined with parchment paper and shape into a small bowl and put into the fridge to chill for at least an hour.  Cut into 8 wedges or 12 pieces, serve with your favourite mexican entree.

title: Thai Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 300 g cauliflower | 2 bunches asparagus | 350 g cauliflower florets | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup cornflour
instructions: Break up cauliflower and asparagus into small florets.  Trim off any hard stems.  Separate into individual serving portions.  Place on a salad plate.  In a small bowl, combine sweet chili sauce, cornflour, and hot water.  Gradually stir until mixture forms thick paste.  Pour over vegetables.  Serve immediately.

title: Swiss Chard with Beets
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups mixed swiss chard, chopped | 1 large beet, peeled, chopped | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 lb bean sprouts
instructions: Place chard, beet, vinegar, and yeast in a large saucepan and heat to boiling.  Reduce heat and simmer uncovered until chard is tender and beet is quite soft.  Stir in bean sprouts just before serving.

title: Feta Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/4 lb feta cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons dry sherry or 2 tablespoons beef broth
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve.

title: Pineapple Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 can pineapple in juice, undrained | 1 package sweet potatoes, cut into 1/2- to 3/4-inch slices ( optional ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Spray 9 x 13 casserole dish with non stick cooking spray.  Place sweet potatoes in a large bowl.  Pour the pineapple with juice over the sweet potatoes and stir to combine.  Add cream of chicken soup and water and mix well, set aside.  Spoon mixture into casserole dish and bake at 350 degrees f.  For 45 minutes or until center is heated through and fruit is tender.  If mixture is dry while cooking, increase the heat to 350 degrees f and bake an additional 40 to 50 minutes, or until center is tender but centers are still firm.  Serves.  Great with egg noodles.

title: Wild Mushroom Jam
ingredients: 6 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 cups berries
instructions: Melt butter in medium size frying pan on low heat on lowest possible setting.  Mix 1 cup of mixed berries into the melted butter.  When butter is bubbling, add mushrooms and mix well using a spatula.  Let the mushrooms cook in the butter mixture for 20 seconds or so, stirring all the while.  Transfer the mixture to small microwave safe saucepan.  Cover and heat in microwave on high for 20 seconds or until warm.  Remove from the microwave.  Stir and check.  If you feel the mixture is too thick to stir, you can thin with 1 more cup of the mixture.  Cool slightly.  Pour the hot mixture over your choice of store bought or re heated preserve jam, like chocolate pudding, jelly, puddings, cream cheese, etc.  Let cool completely.  Once the mixture is completely cold, place in a bowl, but do not refrigerate.  It can be stored at this point for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,taco seasoning mix,beef steak,bell pepper,range egg,red onion,oil,active yeast
title: Easy and Healthy Mexican Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 packet taco seasoning mix ( mccormick brand recommended ) | 1/4 cup chopped red onion ( or any onion you like ) | 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper ( or green ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried active dry yeast | 1/2 cup oil | 2 large free-range eggs | 1 3/4 lbs top sirloin steaks | 1 large free range egg | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: For the bun, preheat the oven to 400°f degrees.  In a small bowl, combine the sour cream, taco seasoning, onion, bell pepper, yeast, oil and ¼ cup water.  Place the beef steaks in a gallon ziplock bag and pour in the sour cream and seasoning mixture, and let marinate for 30 minutes.  Put the remaining ¼ cup of water in a large sauté pan and heat, then remove the beef steaks from the bag.  Spray the meat with non stick spray on all sides with vegetable or non stick cooking spray, and place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.  Top with the marinated beef and set aside.  Beat together the eggs and remaining water, and brush the dough out onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Bake in middle of the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the eggs are set.  Turn the oven to broil with the rack 3 inches from the heat, and broil for the last few minutes.  Remove, and allow to cool slightly, then slice into strips.  Note when you are done, remove the meat from the oven.  Spread the meat evenly on a board, and place on a plate, cover with plastic wrap, and keep in the refrigerator until ready to serve.  For the buns, place the egg and vegetable mixture in a bowl, and beat with a fork.  To assemble, spread a dollop of the egg/veggie/nut mixture on a piece of the flattened bread, top with a piece of the flattened beef, and roll up like a jelly roll.  Cut off the ends and serve.

title: Southern Cabbage and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 medium cabbage, cored and sliced | 1 lb small white mushroom, sliced | 1 bag simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 -2 teaspoon horseradish, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Steam cabbage leaves until very limp, cool.

title: Mushroom and Kielbasa Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 can reduced sodium beef broth | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 package kielbasa | 1 package dried spaghetti | 1 1/2 lbs portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 lb chopped dried fig
instructions: Drain any liquid off of kielbasa.  Place broth, tahini, kielbasa, and mushrooms in a large pot.  Add pasta.  Stir and cook 2 - 3 minutes.  Drain any excess liquid from kielbasa.  Add figs and continue cooking 10 minutes on medium heat.

title: Mustard Biscuits
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cornmeal | 1 teaspoon ground mustard | 1/2 cup sugar | 1 package frozen mixed berries, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 cup chopped fresh mixed berries | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped soft lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Mix together cornmeal and mustard.  Stir in sugar.  Add mixed berries.

Random Ingredients: saffron,yellow bell pepper,spinach leaf,habanero pepper,kernel corn,jicama
title: Moroccan Sweet Corn Salad
ingredients: 3 boxes frozen spinach leaves | 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 4 yellow bell peppers ( optional ) | 1 small jicama, diced | 3 habanero peppers, diced | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: In a large bowl, place the spinach and cukes.  Add bell peppers, jicama, saffron, sugar, and hot pepper.

title: Pasta Rustica
ingredients: 200 g gemelli pasta ( or fettuccine ) | 1/2 cup white flour
instructions: Cook the gemelli till al dente and drain.  Place on paper towel and pat dry with a towel.  Mix flour and 1/2 cup water for a thick paste and make a vortex on the pasta to pour in the water.  Cook the pasta for about 3 - 5 minutes.  Cut pasta and remove from water with a pasta fork.

title: Orange Ginger Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 cup boiling water | 1 onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot ( chopped ) | 1/3 cup orange rind ( chopped ) | 500 g broccoli spears | 600 g asparagus spears ( halved diagonally ) | 1/2 cup instant coffee beans | 1 cup water | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley ( chopped )
instructions: Bring the water to the boil and add the soup mix, ginger and orange rind.  Cover and simmer for ten minutes.  Add the broccoli and asparagus and cook for five minutes longer or until the vegetables are just tender, stirring occasionally.  Dissolve the instant coffee beans in the water and add to the vegetables, cook for five more minutes stirring frequently.  Divide amongst 4 serving bowls and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Spanish Potato Rounds
ingredients: 6 medium yellow potatoes, about 2 pounds each, sliced about 1/4-inch thick | 1 dash tabasco hot pepper sauce ( optional ) | 12 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Arrange the potato slices on a foil lined baking sheet.  If desired, you can broil them in your oven on the middle rack.  If using the hot pepper sauce in the bread, heat it in a small saucepan until you have a warm sauce just like the hot sauce.  Top the potato slices with slices of the rye, using a spatula or spoon, using slices that are about 1 1/2 inches wide and 3/4 inch thick.  Broil in your broiler for about 1 minute or until the top has been bubbly and the rye begins to brown.

Random Ingredients: couscous,rice wine,monterey jack cheese,vermicelli,cherry,tapioca starch,basil leaf,part mozzarella cheese
title: Couscous with Vegetable (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups uncooked rice wine ( white ) | 1 1/4 cups cooked long-grain vermicelli ( refrigerated or fresh ) | 2 1/4 cups cooked small cherry beans ( canned or cooked canned ) | 1 1/2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup grated low-fat monterey jack cheese | 1 1/4 cups drained chopped fresh basil leaves | 1/3 cup tapioca starch | 8 basil leaves ( fresh or dried, to taste ) | 1 cup cooked vermicelli
instructions: Place rice wine and vermicelli in rice cooker.  Cover.  Select sweet rice setting and press start.  When the rice is finished, reset the rice cooker to high and fluff with a fork.  When the risotto has finished, stir in the rest of the ingredients.  Mix well, then let stand 5 - 10 minutes.  Stir in basil and serve.

title: Creamy Parmesan Bites
ingredients: 2 cups peanut butter | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Prepare a 9x13 inch pan with cooking spray.  In a medium bowl, blend peanut butter and parmesan cheese, creating a dip.  Spread the peanut butter mixture into the prepared pan.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,sharp cheddar cheese,thai fish sauce,kielbasa,broccoli floret
title: Kielbasa and Broccoli With Jasmine Rice(Nam Sod)
ingredients: 10 ounces kielbasa, sliced into bite-size pieces | 1 cup jasmine rice | 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 -3 tablespoons thai fish sauce, to taste
instructions: Brown kielbasa in a skillet.  Drain the kielbasa.  Place broccoli and rice in the skillet.  Stir and add fish sauce.  Cook on low heat for about 10 - 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  When serving, top with extra shredded cheese and chopped parsley.

title: Popsicles
ingredients: 1 1/2 quarts lotus root ( or ginger, 1 inch size ) | 2 1/2 quarts corn syrup | lime wedge, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Wash and remove all the peel from the lotus or ginger with a thin knife.  Cut away any discolored stem end, trim off the root end then cut into 2 inch by 4 inch long sticks.  Boil the lotus root in water for 4 minutes with the corn syrup and sugar.  Remove and plunge in ice water to remove the floating block of skin that forms.  Drain and toss the lotus skin with lime juice, if using.  Serve cool, at room temperature or set in the freezer.

title: Raspberry Chile Oil (Lebanese)
ingredients:
2 lbs fresh raspberries, stemmed and washed ( i use about 3/4 of a 5 lb.
    - can ) | 12 fresh limes, very thinly sliced | 4 -6 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red chile, minced ( i leave it out but it will give you a kick.
    - ) | 3/4 cup fresh parsley sprig, loosely packed
instructions: Place raspberries in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet, leaving as much as half the stem on the raspberries.  Poke a skewer through the stem to release any cracks, then brush tops with the limes or olive oil.  Bake in a 350f degrees oven for about an hour or until the flesh is soft and the raspberries have popped.  Remove from oven.  Sprinkle with chile.  While hot, add parsley and stir.  Pour into a screw top jar or a jar if using a regular jar.

title: Granny's Zucchini Calzones
ingredients: 1 package crescent dinner rolls | 1 english cucumber ( peeled, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ) | 1 zucchini ( cut into 1/2-inch cubes )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Grease a baking sheet or line it with parchment paper.  Place one dough rectangle onto the baking sheet.

title: Mexican Mango Grated Cheese
ingredients: 2 large mangoes, peeled and sliced | 1/2 cup shredded reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f.  Arrange the mango slices in a lightly buttered shallow baking dish or two 8 x 4/3 x 2 inch ramekins.  Sprinkle the cheese on top.  Bake for about 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,yellow tomato,cake flour,cabbage,tomato puree,baking potato,kirsch
title: Swedish Potato Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled and diced | 2 medium yellow tomatoes, peeled and chopped | 2 large head cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 cup shredded cabbage ( leaves and stalks ) | 2 teaspoons baking potato | 4 cups tomato puree, canned | 1/3 cup kirsch ( cherry brandy ) | 2 tablespoons celery seeds, crushed
instructions: In medium pot, place potatoes, tomatoes, and cabbage.  Add water to cover.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.  Remove mixture from heat.  While potatoes are cooking add tomato puree, kirsch, celery seeds and 1/2 the cooking liquid.  When potatoes are cooked, remove the whole vegetables from the stock.  Using an immersion blender, puree vegetables until smooth.  Ladle back into bowls and float a dollop of kirsch on each serving.  Also offer any remaining cooking liquid.

Random Ingredients: turnip,savoy cabbage,cream cheese,red lentil,five spice powder
title: Tasty Low Fat Lentil and Turnip Wedges
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red lentils | 1 1/2 cups turnips, cut into 3cm lengths | 150 g savoy cabbage, shredded | 2 tablespoons reduced fat cream cheese | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: Cook lentils, turnip and cabbage for 15 mins toss in cream cheese and five spice powder.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,ham hock,tamarind paste,cardamom,mirin,cherry tomato,tomato green chilies
title: Japanese Style Braised Sweet Red Chile Fish
ingredients: 2 lbs ham hocks | 2 pints cherry tomatoes | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, with juice | 1/4 teaspoon tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 1/2 tablespoons mirin or 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine
instructions: Trim fat from ham hocks, removing any skin fragments or undesirable portion of tail.  Rinse and dry well.  Place ham hocks in a non stick pot.  Add 1 quart of water to pot.  Add tomato slices.  Sprinkle diced green chilies over.  Pour tamarind concentrate over all.  Boil, uncovered, over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes.  Mix vinegar and cardamom in a small bowl.  Stir in mirin and rice wine and pour over hocks, keeping submerged.  Bring to a boil uncovered, then reduce heat to low.  Cook covered, 1 1/2 hours.  Remove ham hocks, drain and reserve vegetables.  Cut meat into 1 inch squares.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,orange flower water,fine sugar,green bean,chuck,part ricotta cheese,coriander seed,jumbo shrimp
title: Jumbo Shrimp and Green Bean Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground chuck | 1 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup fine sugar | 1/4 cup green beans, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander seed, crushed | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 2 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon orange flower water
instructions: Combine the lean chuck, shrimp and sugar in a fry pan and cook over medium high heat until browned and shrimp are pink, about 4 minutes.  Add the green beans and coriander and cook for about 2 minutes, stirring often.  Remove shrimp mixture to a bowl.  In the same pan, warm the chutney over low heat until hot, stir in the ricotta and orange flower water and blend until smooth.  Serve at once.

title: Lemon and Ginger Oil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon finely chopped gingerroot | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh gingerroot | 2 teaspoons coarse grain mustard | 2 tablespoons grated fresh lemons | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Mince the ginger and combine with remaining ingredients except oil in a large bowl.

title: Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups fresh watercress, rinsed, trimmed and finely chopped | 1/3 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Combine the watercress and grated pecorino romano cheese in a large bowl.  Stir in the pesto.  Cover and chill at least 2 hours before using as an accompaniment to roast chicken, vegetables or meat.

Random Ingredients: apple,mustard,dark chocolate,thai fish sauce,wheat germ,salt pepper
title: Melt Down Dark Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 300 g dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme or 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme | salt & pepper | 1 tablespoon wheat germ
instructions: Heat the dry mustard and soy sauce in a small pan over a low heat until chocolate has melted and is smooth.  Remove mixture from the heat and add the spice.  Break up any lumps.  Pour on unto dry chips and scatter with wheat germ.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,mango,kernel corn,fennel seed,espresso,oyster sauce,yellow pepper,graham cracker crumb
title: Espresso Mango-Corn Dip
ingredients: 28 ounces whole kernel corn | 14 ounces white mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 large fresh mangoes, diced | 1 can refrigerated espresso beans | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced nopales or 1 1/2 tablespoons minced nopales | 2 tablespoons minced fennel seeds | 1 tablespoon minced yellow pepper ( or more to taste ) | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese ( or more to taste )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f.  Line a cookie sheet with foil and spray with vegetable and cooking spray.  In a food processor, combine corn, mozzarella cheese, mango and nopales.  Blend until combined.  Transfer mixture to a medium bowl.  Stir in fennel and yellow pepper.

title: Ethiopian Red-Chili Capsicum (Red Cabbage)
ingredients: 2 lbs red cabbage, in a single layer or 2 lbs kale, in 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 large red chili pepper, seeded, devained and finely chopped or 1 teaspoon fresh chili pepper flakes | ice water | crushed radish, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cut cabbage in half lengthwise, then crosswise into 3/4 inch slices.  Place a teaspoon or two of chopped chiles in the center of each slice.  Bring a few cups of ice water to a boil, and drop the cabbage slices into the water.  Cook until very tender and a bright green color appears, about 5 minutes, depending on the cabbage.  Drain and arrange on serving platter.  Garnish with radish.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,chili pepper,curry powder,egg,snow pea,coriander seed,cider vinegar,red pepper
title: Curry Eggs With Snow Peas(Jidan Er Dun La)
ingredients: 12 eggs, hard boiled | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 dash mild curry powder | 1 dash chili pepper | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red pepper | freshly chopped coriander ( to garnish ) | freshly chopped small red pepper ( to garnish )
instructions: Peel yolks and cut in half lengthwise.  Remove yolks and place in separate, thick slices.  Put vinegar, vanilla, curry powder, chili, coriander and red pepper into medium sized bowl.  Dip egg whites into mixture and coat completely.  Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Tamari-Red Pepper Condiment(Gourmet)
ingredients: 1 cup tamari | crushed red cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine tamari and crushed red cayenne pepper in a small bowl until blended.  Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks, depending on how well you like the texture.  To use, stir it with your hand, or rub in 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch mixed with 1 1/2 tablespoons water.  Or alternatively, mix in 1 1/2 teaspoons tamari and blend again.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,cardamom pod,hazelnut,balsamic vinegar,thai fish sauce,chili pepper
title: Cambodian Style Red Lentils
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentils | 8 ounces chili peppers ( fresh or canned ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1/4 cup red thai fish sauce | 4 cardamom pods | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a large pot cover lentils with water.  Bring to boil over medium high heat, stirring often.  When water boils, reduce heat and simmer uncovered over medium heat, stirring often, until lentils are tender, 1 to 1 1/2 hours total.  Drain water.  Place chili peppers, hazelnuts, fish sauce, and cardamom pods in a blender and blend until fine.  Add mixture to lentils to pot over medium low heat and cook, stirring often, for 1 minute.  Remove from heat and stir in vinegar.  Cover and set aside stirring periodically for 20 to 30 minutes.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,white pepper powder,strawberry,dark red kidney bean,hazelnut,russet potato
title: Strawberry Potatoes and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 12 medium sized unpeeled russet potatoes, cut into chunks | 1/3 cup dark rum | 4 cups strawberries, washed | 1 cup dark red kidney beans, washed and drained ( you can buy this also in the ethnic aisle of your grocery store ) | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted, cooled & ground | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper powder
instructions: Mix all the above in a large bowl.  Chop the strawberries, and add them into the bowl.  Set aside at room temperature.  Put your potato chunks in a medium sized stainless steel bowl.  Add 1/2 cup rum to the bowl.  Pour all of the fluid in the bowl that your potatoes were soaked in and mix with the hands until the fluid is clear.  Dry the potatoes with paper towels and set them aside.  Add the strawberries to the bowl and stir.  Add the remaining 1/2 cup rum to the bowl.  Pour the liquid in the bowl into the potatoes and strawberries and gently stir with a wooden spoon.  Stir in a pinch of white pepper powder, taste and adjust seasonings.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,cheese,rice flour,brussels sprout,mint,tahini,cilantro leaf,chinese noodle
title: Vegetable Noodle Salad (Mae-Mae)
ingredients: 1 ounce rice flour | 200 g chinese noodles ( mae fun, see notes below ) | 400 g brussels sprouts | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint | 1/2 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint | 3 tablespoons chopped cilantro leaves | 1/3 lb cheese ( grated, you can use any tasty cheese you like ) | 420 -100 tasty spaghetti sauce ( see note below )
instructions: Make noodles as per instructions on the package.  Drain noodles and set aside.  Cut sprouts into 2 inch lengths.  In large bowl with a strainer, stir flour into water until absorbed, 1 - 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Toss sprouts with tahini mixture, 1 tbsp of mint, and 1/2 tbsp cilantro.  Top with cheese and remaining herbs, and set aside.

title: Salsa Delight
ingredients: 1 bottle dry apricot halves | 3 leeks, roughly sliced | 1/2 lb deli ham, cut into strips | 1 bottle strong hot salsa | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | 2 ounces raisins | 1 bottle chilled champagne
instructions: Remove the stems from the apricots.  Slice into strips 1/3 of the length and 1/4 of the other way through.  Seed and cut the leeks into 1 1/2 inch pieces.  Cut the ham into 1 1/2 inch strips.  Blend with the apricots, leeks and ham.  Add the salsa, dill, and raisins.  Refrigerate for 2 days, stirring occasionally.

title: Queso Fundido
ingredients: 12 ounces queso asadero ( mexican cheese blend ) | 4 ounces barbecue sauce, such as texas brandy
instructions: Place the asadero cheese into a small bowl, cut the cheese in half and cut a slice in half again.  Carefully scoop the cheese from the bowl into a warmed skillet or saucepan.  Quickly pour a small ladle of warm barbeque sauce over the cheese and continue to cook until the cheese has melted and begun to brown.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: veal,meat,gouda cheese,swiss cheese,red chili pepper flake,bulk italian sausage
title: Cheese and Sausage Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground meat, italian sausage | 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 12 ounces swiss cheese, in small chunks | 1 lb smoked gouda cheese or 1 lb romano cheese, cut in small chunks | 1/2 red chili pepper flakes | 1 can red chili peppers or ( 28 ounce ) can peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees, line a loaf pan/dutch oven with a single layer of parchment paper, then spray with nonstick cooking spray.  In a large bowl, mix the sausage meats together.  Sprinkle half the swiss cheese and all of the gouda over the meats.  On the top, add chilies, and half the sausage meat mixture.  Sprinkle remaining swiss cheese.  Add remaining swiss cheese.  Add remaining sausage meat mixture.  Add more chilies and sausage meat.  Stir well.  Pour mixture into loaf pan and bake about one hour, or till cheese is melted and meat loaf sounds hollow.  Remove loaf pan from oven, and turn onto serving dish, cover loosely with foil and continue baking for another hour.  Let stand five minutes before removing foil.  Serve hot.

title: Salsa and Mushrooms (Or Shrooms) Damadillos
ingredients: 3/4 cup buttermilk | 3/4 cup chunky salsa ( a mild salsa will do, as well as a chunky salsa of your choice ) | 1/4 cup fresh shiitake mushroom, finely chopped ( or 1/4 cup dried porcini mushrooms ) | 2 cups bread flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons sambal oelek ( or more, to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,double cream,anaheim chilies,rib eye steak,kale,scallop,yellow bell pepper,jicama
title: Caribbean Spicy Steak
ingredients: 4 australian king's eye steaks | 8 large scallops | 1 large jicama, peeled rindless round slab or 1 large zucchini, rind, ends trimmed off | 1 large anaheim chilies or 1 large red chilies, rind and all, seeded | 1 large yellow bell pepper | 8 -10 kaffir lime leaves, leaves washed, dried | 1/2 pint double cream | 2 tablespoons scotchor, chopped fresh
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c with the oven shelf about 4cm below.  Line a large roasting tin with foil and put steak in it.  Peel jicama and cut across in a cross, remove and discard seeds and membrane, finely dice the flesh.  Slice pepper and cut into chunks.  Place in large bowl with lime leaves, cream and chopped kaffir lime leaves.  Pour over steaks and sprinkle over scallops.  Cover tightly and cook 25 to 35 minutes at 200c/fan 160c/gas.  Line foil with baking paper and cook until steaks are tender.  Uncover and roast for 15 minutes for rare, 30 to 35 minutes for medium rare, or 40 to 45 minutes for medium.  Leave steaks for 5 minutes.  Slice and serve on large platter with lime leaves.

title: Pasta with Pistachios and Lemon
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta ( short pasta ) | 2 tablespoons lemon zest | 3/4 cup smooth, natural pistachios
instructions: Boil water and cook rigatoni pasta until al dente.  Drain and toss with lemon zest.  Let cool for 10 minutes.  Add pistachios.

title: Rice Porridge With Smoked Salmon (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 cup dried arborio rice | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1 cup dried small cranberries | 2 cups cooked smoked salmon | 1/4 cup diced tomato | 8 thin slices firm smoked salmon | 2 fresh mint sprigs | fresh mint sprig
instructions: Place all ingredients into Rice cooker and toss to combine.  Close lid securely and set on regular cook for 4 hours.  Remove from cooker and fluff rice with a fork before serving using.  To serve, place rice porridge into a shallow serving dish, decorate with slices of smoked salmon, and garnish with mint sprigs.

Random Ingredients: tapioca flour,coconut milk,tortilla chip,ginger,fennel seed,heavy whipping cream,shiitake mushroom
title: Coconut Ginger Soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup tapioca flour | 1 can light coconut milk | 1/2 cup shaved ginger | 1 can shiitake mushrooms, drained, cut up | tortilla chips, crushed
instructions: In a bowl whisk together cream and tapioca flour until well mixed.  Add coconut milk and blend into the cream.  Fold in grated ginger and mushrooms.  Turn into bowls, garnish with crushed tortilla chips and enjoy.

title: Cajun Queso Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces old monterey jack pepper cheese, cubed | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f.  Grease cookie sheet.  Stir first 3 ingredients together with wire whisk or fork.  Spread in 8x8 shallow bowl or 9x9 inch baking dish.  Bake 25 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until bubbly.  Let cool 5 minutes, stir again, and serve immediately.

title: Peaches with Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 15 large mixed ripe peaches | 1 cup bread flour | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Cut peaches into halves.  Using a potato peeler, take out the beak flesh, then slice the flesh into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Place bread flour, and 1 tablespoon of the corn oil, in a bowl, and toss to blend.  Cut the peaches into slices, and place on a plate.
