Add half and half and cook until warmed through.  Add cooked and drained rice and mix well.  Add red curry paste, stir, and cook for 2 - 3 minutes.  Add remaining half and half and stir.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,bay leaf,tart apple,brussels sprout,ginger,horseradish sauce,dark chocolate
title: Brussels Sprouts With Dark Chocolate
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout ( or use about 18 ) | 2 inches fresh ginger | 3 ounces dark chocolate | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish sauce | 12 rosemary leaves | 1 bay leaf | 2 ounces dark chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Scrape the root and root end off the ginger pieces and slice the ginger into rounds on the diagonal about 1/2 inch thick.  Slice the greenish ginger into fine julienne | Place the ginger with the chocolates into a small pan over low heat and warm until just beginning to melt.  Pour in the warmed chocolates and the horseradish sauce, stirring to combine.  Stir in the fresh spanish leaves and the bay leaf.  Cover and set aside for about 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Wash the brussels sprouts and remove the base of the leaves at the bottom.  Cut each head on the angle into about 2 1/2 inch lengths.  Slice the brussels sprouts into quarters again and lay out a generous heap of the brussels sprouts, along with them a little bit of the chocolates and a good grinding of pepper and horseradish.  Continue until the brussels sprouts are all used up and the whole mixture is used up.  Melt the chocolate, if using.  Serve warm or cold, with a little bit of the melted chocolate drizzled onto the brussels sprouts.

title: Cheese Logs
ingredients: 12 ounces mexican blend cheese, diced ( like kraft or velveeta ) | 1/2 cup romano cheese or 1/2 cup romano cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed, chilled
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the cheese, cardamom, bread crumbs, seasoning and cheese.  Mix well.  Shape into 6 logs and place on a cookie sheet.

Random Ingredients: saffron,penne,hazelnut,dijon mustard,cake flour,pizza crust,hard egg,cooking sherry
title: Hazelnut, Nut & Mustard Ravioli
ingredients: 7 ounces soft fresh brewed cake flour | 3 teaspoons dijon mustard | 3 teaspoons saffron | 100 g unsalted almonds, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup cooking sherry | 1 kg fresh pizza crust | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | fresh ground pepper | 1 packet instant pisti-glazed hazelnuts, roughly chopped, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Whisk the flour, mustard, saffron, nuts & sherry in a bowl.  Season with salt & freshly ground pepper.  Spread the prepared mixture onto the pizza dough.  Brush onto the sliced eggs & sprinkle with the pisti glazed hazelnuts before placing on the centre shelf of the oven.  Cook for 10 15mins until the pizza crust is golden & crisp.  Serve warm or cold with a sauce.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,cream cheese,shrimp paste,canadian bacon,cherry tomato
title: Shrimp Appetizers
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh shrimp paste | 8 ounces cream cheese | 8 ounces canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Wash shrimp paste thoroughly thoroughly, separating all the white and light coral from the green shrimp paste.  Dry shrimp in an oven safe dish or a towel for 5 minutes and set aside.  Blend the cream cheese with an electric mixer.  Add the shrimp paste, bacon, tomatoes and the cream or milk.  Mix well until a soft dough is formed.  Place small dollops onto wax paper lined cookie sheets and cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for at least 3 hours.  Prepare oil, either a cooking oil or a cooking spray.  Take off the wax paper and divide the dough into small balls.  Place on clean, dry baking sheets lined with wax paper and flatten slightly.  Using your fingers, make an indentation for each shrimp about 1/2 inch deep.  Heat oil in a frying pan until it registers 250°f.  Cook shrimp for 2 to 3 minutes on each side over moderately high heat.  Drain on paper towels.  Serve immediately before serving.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,pizza sauce,chicken thigh,rice wine,french bread
title: Vietnamese Grilled Chicken Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 12 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat.  In shallow dish, combine rice wine, fish sauce and rice wine.  Add chicken to marinade.

title: Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 lbs beef sirloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup marzipan, or 1/2 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Place meat in a large skillet.  Drain excess fat.  Place meat onto a rack in a roasting pan.  Pour marzipan over meat.  Place pan in oven.  Bake 2 hours, or until meat has internal temperature of 160 - 165 degrees f when carved.  Turn over roast, and brush with marzipan.  Keep warm.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,sun tomato paste,bicarbonate soda,hard egg
title: Bicarbonate of Soda Canning (Greens)
ingredients: 1 cup hard-boiled egg | 1 can sun-dried tomato paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Put a small wok on the hob on the gas.  Pour some sun dried tomato paste into the wok.  Crack an egg into a small container and mix with the sun dried tomato paste.  Heat up, stir, and then pour the egg mixture into it.  Once all the egg are in, stir, and then add the ginger garlic paste.  Bring the mixture to the boil, stirring with a wooden spoon.  Then pour the soda in and mix well.  Turn on the heat to low and keep the mixture simmering for 2 - 3 hours, stirring every now and then.  The water will have soaked inches.  This is a tasty green tea that is perfect for drinking.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,garlic powder,black bean,heavy cream,phyllo dough,black eyed pea,spanish onion,chicken thigh
title: Spanish Chicken & Black Bean Pie With Phyllo
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 15 ounces black beans | 14 ounces tomato paste | 2 tablespoons garlic powder | 1/2 cup spanish onion, diced | 2/3 cup heavy cream | 6 sheets phyllo dough | 1 can black beans | 1 can black-eyed peas
instructions: Cook chicken in boiling water and tomato paste.  Drain.  Combine garlic powder, onion, cream, and half of the beans in a saucepan and heat, stirring until hot.  Add the chicken, black beans, and white onion.  Set aside.  Wash and destem phyllo sheets.  Stack 4 sheets of phyllo dough and place 1/2 cup meat mixture in center of 5 sheets.  Brush top with a small amount of cream.  Brush with cream mixture.  Repeat with remaining 6 sheets and remaining beef mixture.  Heat over medium heat until pan boils and thickens.  Place over high heat for about 4 min and remove from heat.  Cut pie in half and arrange one half over the bottom and one half over the top.  Brush with cream mixture.  Repeat with remaining phyllo.  Layer olives and remaining meat mixture over it.  Lightly sprinkle with remaining black beans.  Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Allow to sit for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Paprika Paste for Chicken
ingredients: 500 g white chocolate, chopped | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Place in a microwaveable bowl with a lid.  Add enough water to just cover the base of the bowl and wrap.

title: Hungarian Style Salt
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon salt- i like to add 1/4 teaspoon | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Mix and put as much salt in as you like or 1/4 teaspoon in a small bowl.  You can add more or less salt to taste.  Enjoy.

title: Spicy Cucumber Relish
ingredients: 1 lebanese cucumber | 3 tablespoons coarsely ground spices
instructions: Remove and discard seeds from the cucumber, peel of skin and remove the pith.  Cut the cucumber into very thin slices about 1/4 inch thick.  Sprinkle spices over the cucumbers.  Place in a large shallow bowl and mash with a fork and stir to mix well.  Serve at room temperature or slightly warmer as a snack.  Variation, after mixing with ground veggie burgers and veggies, make an open face burger with the cucumber and the burger and vegetables in the middle.  I serve this with rice, pasta, or whatever takes your fancy and taste.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,lemon juice,icing sugar,chicken bouillon powder,anise seed
title: Moroccan Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs whole chickens | 1 1/4 cups icing sugar | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 1 2/3 teaspoons vanilla | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Note that the original recipe specified a few drops of bouillon powder or a small amount of sugar, i got ours without that.  Rinse chicken and pat dry.  Place chicken in greased 9x13 baking dish.  Pour 1/3 of the icing sugar over chicken.  Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of chicken bouillon.  1 tablespoon of vanilla.  Mix well.  Add the lemon juice.  Bake in 325 oven for 1 hour, basting every 15 minutes.  Remove from oven, and cover with aluminium foil.  Turn oven to broil.  Broil for the other 15 minutes or until chicken is done.  Turn on broiler to high, and broil for additional 15 minutes or until done.

title: Holy Hot Chili for Canning
ingredients: 4 ounces tequila ( this is about 2/3 cup ) | 1 serrano chili, deseeded and finely chopped ( can sub 1 jalapeno or chipotle pepper, if desired )
instructions: Place the chile in the canning jars and fill with hot water until the top 1/4 inch of the jar has reach an inch or so below the top of the jar.  Leave at least 1 inch of headspace.  Remove air bubbles and tighten rims.  Set the jars in a large pot of boiling water and turn off heat.  Let infuse for 10 minutes for perfect sealing.  Check each chile seals after 10 minutes by touching the seal with a toothpick.  Cool quickly before storing in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,fenugreek,onion,chicken breast fillet,vanilla bean
title: Easy Chicken Fingers
ingredients: 600 g chicken breast fillets, cut into strips | 1 liter vanilla bean, split & scraped | 100 g onions | 100 g dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek
instructions: Wash & trim any excess fat or gristle from the chicken.  Cut the onions in half lengthways & rinse thoroughly in a colander.  Remove the seeds & membrane.  Heat up the sesame oil in a wok over a med high heat & add the onions & cook, stirring constantly for about 2 mins or until they are softened.  Add the chicken & stir fry for a couple of mins or until chicken is sealed & cooked.  Add the vanilla bean + the seeds from the vanilla bean pods & stir for 10 minutes to allow the spices to infuse the flavour of the beans.  Place the chicken on a platter & cover tightly with foil or a damp cloth.  Set aside to marinated for 30 mins in the fridge.  Meanwhile, chop the fenugreek into small lengths using some of the sprigs.  Add the fenugreek to the pan containing the chicken & cook, stirring constantly for 5 minutes or until the fenugreek has lost its raw smell.  Remove the fenugreek paste from the heat & set aside.  Re heat the sauce in the saucepan until it is boiling & remove from the heat.  Brush the chicken with some of the sesame oil & season well.  Place the chicken on a lightly oiled baking tray & bake in a preheated oven, about 100c for 30 mins or until cooked through.

title: Homemade Boboli Appetizer
ingredients: 1 boboli pizza crust ( the one that you use at your groinder ) | 1/2 cup greek salad dressing
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425 f or 400 fahrenheit.  Brush a little oil onto your boboli crust.  Lay your boboli on a cookie sheet.  Spread the salad dressing on top.  Bake your boboli for about 15 to 20 minutes or until browned and crumbly.  Enjoy serves.

title: Yogurt Cheese
ingredients: 3 1/4 lbs yogurt, strained to remove pulp and | salt, if necessary | 2 -3 cups safflower oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Place the yogurt in a large bowl.  Add salt, if necessary.  Stir to blend.  Gradually mix in oil.  The yogurt can be kept in a cool place until ready to use.  A little salt may be added while working, as the yogurt tends to curdle.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,lemongrass,sea salt,celery rib,prosciutto,apricot,phyllo pastry,summer squash
title: Thai Stuffed Brioches
ingredients: 1 cup shredded montasio cheese | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried lemongrass | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 5 1/2 ounces prosciutto, thinly sliced 1/2 inch thick | 1 cup dried apricot, coarsely chopped | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Lightly spray 2 or 3 large baking sheets with cooking spray.  In a medium bowl, combine 1 cup of the montasio and mozzarella chees, lemon grass, celery, prosciutto, and apricots.  Stuff half of the mixture into 2 or 3 brioche cups, covering each one with half of the cheese.  Roll up each brioche cup, folding in the sides of the sides, so the bottom of the roll is completely enclosed.  Place the rolls in a large baking pan with a bit of water.  Cover loosely with foil.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes, or until meat filling is firm and filling is bubbling and filling is heated through.  Preheat the oven to 400°f cut pastry into 8 equal slices and arrange on a baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,peanut,onion powder,portobello mushroom,shortening,white wine vinegar,dark brown sugar,creme fraiche
title: Mushroom Tartlets
ingredients: 2 ounces butter | 1/4 lb portobello mushroom, stems removed, and caps thinly sliced | 1 small onion, peeled and thinly sliced | peanuts or cashews | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon soya sauce
instructions: Heat butter in a skillet and saute mushrooms and onions until soft, about 10 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in nuts or cashews.  While mushrooms are cooling, combine remaining ingredients in a mixing bowl.  Taste and adjust seasoning.  Stir in the mushrooms and nuts.  Chill until ready to serve or serve immediately.

title: Creamy Cod and Egg Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 1/2 pound cod | 1 package uncooked angel hair pasta | 2 packages pita breads | 1 1/2 cups milk | 3 eggs, beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Arrange cod in a baking dish with a rim just large enough to cover the fish.  Bake in the preheated oven until fish is opaque through and flakes easily, about 10 minutes.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 145 degrees f.  Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook angel hair in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes.  Drain.  Drain cod and flake with a fork.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook angel hair in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.  Drain.  Bring a small pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook angel hair in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.  Drain.  Rinse cod with cold water, and pat dry with paper towels.  Stir cod, pasta, mashed potatoes, milk, and eggs into the mashed potatoes until coated thoroughly.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Mexican Taco Nesto
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 packet taco seasoning
instructions: In a medium bowl mix the cumin and taco seasoning.  Mix well.  Add water and mix.  Refrigerate for about an hour.  Use right away.

title: Mile High Bones
ingredients: 8 ounces chicken tenders | 1/4 cup butter | 2 tablespoons diced roasted red potatoes (, i just use roasted red potatoes ) | 3 -4 juniper berries | marshmallows
instructions: Cut chicken tenders into 2 pieces, lengthwise.  Using 1/4 t.  Butter, rub into tenders.  Sprinkle with a large pinch of salt.  Fry on both sides in butter until browned.  Set aside and keep warm.  Turn grill to high.  Remove tenders onto a foil lined plate.  Place remaining butter, potatoes and juniper berries on top of hot chicken.  Grill for 5 minutes to brown potatoes.

title: Pear and Irish Whiskey Mousse
ingredients: 1 large ripe pear, peeled and coarsely chopped | 2/3 cup irish whiskey ( or whisky liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | fresh whipped cream
instructions: In a small food processor combine the pear, whiskey and lemon peels.  Process until fairly smooth.  Transfer to a bowl and using a teaspoon, press mixture onto the whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,shoulder lamb chop,soymilk,spaghetti sauce,sea salt black pepper,green bean,chicken breast fillet,yellow rice mix
title: Quick and Easy One-Pot Lamb and Noodle One Pot
ingredients: 1 lb baby green beans | 2 bone-in bone-in chicken breast fillets ( or equivalent of fresh and frozen ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons sodium-free soy milk | 1 teaspoon sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2/3 cup soymilk ( or whole milk ) | 2 tablespoons instant yellow rice mix, dry | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon bottled hot & tabasco sauce or 1/2-1 teaspoon tabasco sauce, to taste | 1 package spaghetti sauce, ragu | 4 ounces shoulder lamb chops or 4 ounces chicken breast fillets, shredded
instructions: If using frozen green beans, cook them till just tender and still crisp when tested with a fork.  Drain in a colander.  In a large pot, bring 1 cup water to a boil and add the cut up chicken breasts.  Reduce heat to a simmer and cook covered for 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked and can be turned.  Shred the chicken and place in a bowl with the soy milk.  Mash together with a potato masher to desired consistency using milk or water.  In a large bowl, combine the cooked green beans, cooked chicken, soymilk, rice powder & tabasco.  Dividing evenly, add the meat, spaghetti sauce & green beans to the bowl with the green bean/chicken mixture.  Mix well and serve hot or warm.  This recipe will feed 4 large people or 4 small to medium sized servings.

title: Molletes
ingredients: 6 hard boiled eggs, sliced ( or 2 large eggs ) | 2 cups beef gravy
instructions: Put all ingredients in a medium saucepan.  Stir well.  Cover and simmer over low heat for 25 minutes.

title: Seafood Cajun With Crunchy Tomato Crumble Top
ingredients: 500 g white bread | 500 g watermelon ( fresh or canned, cut into 4 pieces ) | 1 roma tomato ( or one large tomato with some seeds ) | 125 g smoked salami, torn into large chunks ( not too small ) | 125 g reduced fat smoked cod fish fillet ( thinly sliced ) | 3 tablespoons sweetened desiccated coconut
instructions: Place bread crumbs in bowl.  Add watermelon, tomato, salami and cod and toss to combine.  Divide evenly among four ramekins.  Spoon topping evenly over fish.  Sprinkle on coconut.  Serve with rice to soak up any excess liquid.

title: Polenta Bread
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups italian-style stone-ground yellow cornmeal | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup vegetable broth | 2 cans plum pieces ( drained ) | 1 2-pound sweet potato ( peeled and cut into 1/2-inch slices )
instructions: Place the cornmeal and yeast in a large bowl.  Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and pour in broth and liquid.  Add onions, sweet potatoes, and plum pieces until the mixture is well blended.  Cover with a damp cloth and place in a warm spot.  Let rise until doubled in bulk, about 45 minutes.  Turn out onto a lightly floured surface.  Shape dough into a round loaf and pinch the seams to allow some of the extra to escape.  Place on a lightly greased baking sheet and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes.  Bake at 475 degrees 12 to 15 minutes or until the top browns.  Remove from oven to a wire rack and let cool 10 minutes.  Place the loaves on a large sheet of waxed paper, cover tightly with foil and allow to cool completely.

title: Pecan Irish Whiskey
ingredients: 2 cans tomato puree, well drained | 2/3 cup golden caster sugar | 150 g soymilk | 2 tablespoons pecans, chopped | 2/3 cup black olives | 400 ml good-quality beer
instructions: Combine tomato puree, sugar, soymilk, pecans and olives in saucepan.  Bring to boil, stirring and cooking over medium heat for 15 - 20 minute.  Remove from heat and cool.  Add beer and stir to combine.

title: Italian Asiago Soup
ingredients: 5 1/2 cups hot chicken stock or 5 1/2 cups hot chicken stock, preferably homemade | 250 g asiago cheese | chili oil or espresso, to taste
instructions: Pour hot stock into a large saucepan.  Add asiago cheese and bring to boil over medium heat.  When broth is hot, add coffee.  Chill soup in refrigerator until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,oil peanut,wood ear mushroom,white pepper
title: Warm Wood ear Mushroom & Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb wood ear mushrooms | 1/4 cup oil, roasted peanut | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Remove the hard stem part of the mushroom.  Rinse& dry the mushrooms very thoroughly in a cloth, rubbing all the excess liquid from the mushroom.  Cut out the hard stem.  Remove the hard part.  Cut the mushrooms in quarters& place them between small sheets of wax paper.  Using the back of the knife, cut a horizontal slit lengthwise along the underside of each mushroom.  Push the mushrooms up the sides of the paper.  Spread the mushrooms evenly over 6 wax paper.  Use a fork to push the mushrooms out of the paper& sprinkle inside of the wax paper a pinch or two of salt& pepper.  Pour 1/2 cup boiling water over the mushrooms& let stand for 5 minutes.  Remove from the water and cut in small pieces.  Place the raisins& remaining oil in a small bowl& stir in the raisins.  Place mushrooms in a paper lined baking sheet cut side up.  Spoon the mixture over the mushrooms& bake at 350f degrees until the raisins are hot& golden around the edges, 15 - 20 minutes, basting every 5 - 10 minutes with the oil.  Serve at once.

title: Garlic Eggplant Dip
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, peeled, cut in half | 1 teaspoon canola mayonnaise | 1 pound boneless pork chops | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon salt-free garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Coat a 9x9 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Combine eggplant and mayonnaise in baking dish, and season with 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt per pound of pork.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,parsley flake,almond,chicken,chinese five spice powder
title: Almond-Glazed Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken, cut up | 3/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 3 tablespoons canned chipotle chiles, coarsely chopped ( use only the mild-spicy ) | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley flakes
instructions: Adjust oven rack to upper middle position and heat oven to 300°f.  Stir all ingredients together in a large bowl to make an aroma.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,molasses,pimiento,icing sugar,grain rice,popcorn,penne pasta,yukon gold potato
title: Yukon Gold Potato Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 300 g pasta, cooked | 1 bag yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cubed in 1 cm cubes | 4 tablespoons poppy seed ( or you could toast seeds in a dry pot and set aside ) | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup cocoa ( optional ) | icing sugar, for dusting ( confectioner's sugar ) | 1 jar pimientos or ( 400 g ) jar dill pieces, chopped ( 250 g ) | 3 cups cooked white short-grain rice
instructions: Combine the dry ingredients in a skillet and cook over medium heat until they start to turn golden, about 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Add the pimentos and rice and mix well.  Spread 1 cup rice on a plate and spread the potatoes over it.  Dust the top with confectioner's sugar, if using, and cut the crust off if desired.

Random Ingredients: rack louis pork sparerib,breadcrumb,orange bell pepper,tomato green chilies
title: Robust Mexican Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs rack linni pork spareribs, excess fat removed, cut in half | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 teaspoon orange bell pepper ( or other yellow peppers ) | 2 -3 tablespoons plain breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Lay ribs flat.  Cut away any excess fat.  Insert cut side down in a shallow roasting pan.  Mix undrained tomatoes, orange bell pepper, bread crumbs, and a dash of southwest pepper seasoning in a small bowl.  Spoon over the ribs.  Place in oven and roast 30 minutes, then cover tightly with a tent of aluminum foil and let roast for 1 hour and 20 minutes longer.  Remove foil, raise temperature to 350f and bake 1 hour more or until done.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,scotch bonnet pepper,garlic,spaetzle noodle,iceberg lettuce,thai basil,lamb shank
title: Tandoori Wraps
ingredients: 16 ounces spaetzle noodles | 1 tablespoon chopped garlic | 2 1/4 lbs lamb shanks | 12 -16 flour tortillas | 6 fresh thai basil, torn | iceberg lettuce | thai basil, to garnish
instructions: Soak spaetzle in a large pot of cold, salted water, covered, for at least 2 hours.  Drain and let dry.  Prepare the lamb, if necessary, and sauté with garlic over medium head in a non stick frying pan for 15 minutes, skimming off fat as it rises to the top of the pan.  Scoop 1 ounce of the cooked spaetzle into a small bowl, and return the spaetzle to the frying pan.  Stir in 2 - ½ ounces of hot water, cover the pan and simmer for 20 minutes, then stir in the spaetzle and basil until the spaghetti is ready.  Spoon about 3 - ½ to 5 tablespoons onto each tortilla, and float a few small leaves of basil on top.  Garnish with an additional sprig of torn basil.

title: Meyer Lemon Pickles
ingredients: 6 ounces fresh de arbol | 1 tablespoon mirin ( to taste )
instructions: Remove peels from the rind and cut the peppers into rounds about 3 x 2.  Heat the mirin over a medium heat, stir often and add the pepper strips.  Continue to heat for 5 minutes or until syrupy and coated with the mirin.  Cool.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,ice cube,olive oil,extra virgin olive oil,broccoli floret,grain rice,kirsch
title: Stuffed Beef Cubes With Rice and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 sirloin, cut 1 - 1 1/2-inch cube ( about 1 lb ) | 4 cups broccoli florets ( about 2 bunches ) | 1 1/2 cups short-grain rice | 1/3 cup kirsch ( cherry brandy ) | 4 ice cubes | kirsch ( garnish )
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Place 1 tablespoon oil in 4 sided skillet and heat over medium high heat.  Remove steak from skillet.  Remove excess fat from skillet with a slotted spoon and season with salt and pepper.  Add steaks to skillet and saute until just cooked through, about 3 - 4 minutes per side.  Cover steak and set aside.  Add 2 more tablespoons oil to skillet and heat over medium heat.  Add broccoli and saute until crisp tender, about 1 - 2 minutes.  Rinse and drain.  In the skillet, reheat pan until hot, but not smoking.  Add rice and saute 2 - 3 minutes.  Add 1/3 cup kirsch to skillet, bring up to heat and cook until sizzling, about 1 1/2 minutes.  Pile rice onto plate, top with steak cubes and broccoli.  Roll tightly in rice and then in additional kirsch, if desired.

title: Turnips and Mustard (British)
ingredients: 1 turnip, cut into wedges | 4 teaspoons brown mustard | 2 teaspoons olive oil
instructions: Dry the turnip wedges in a clean tea towel and dry on paper towel.  Stir and rub the mustard evenly onto the turnip wedges.  Heat the olive oil in a small saucepan or wok until hot but not smoking.  Add the turnip wedges and fry over low heat for around 10 minutes or until browned.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,vegetable oil cooking spray,sea salt,sirloin steak,green chilies,swiss cheese,turnip
title: Mexican Stir Fry Skillet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 lb boneless sirloin steak, cut into thin strips | 1 cup green chilies, thinly sliced ( wear gloves ) | 1 cup swiss cheese | 1 medium turnip, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | sea salt ( to taste )
instructions: Heat oil in 12 inch skillet over high heat until just smoking, then add beef and stir fry 2 minutes, or until browned.  Remove beef from skillet and keep warm.  Add chilies, cheese, turnip and lime juice, stirring until cheese has melted into the mixture.  Return beef to skillet, heat through, then serve hot.  Can be served with pico de gallo or salsa as a dip for beef and greens.

title: Penne Nuts
ingredients: 500 g penne pasta | 75 g jaggery | 50 g bacon
instructions: Cook bacon in a frying pan till crispy.  Add penne and coat well.  Add sugar and cook till pasta becomes firm and translucent.

title: Taco Bell Nips (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 medium parsnips, shredded | 2 cups chopped red bell peppers | 2 cups cubed smoked back bacon ( cooked till crisp ) | 1 cup chopped green spring onion ( with tops ) | 2 cups fat-free refried beans ( not reduced fat ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons low-sodium taco sauce | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried basil oregano leaves or 1 1/4 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | splenda granular | 1 bottle vinaigrette ( not salad dressing )
instructions: Microwave shredded carrots, celery, peppers and bacon on high till crisp, about 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,vegetable oil cooking spray,nori,purpose flour,pineapple juice,balsamic vinegar
title: Pineapple Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups all-purpose flour | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 package nori ( dried seaweed ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 cans sliced pineapple in juice ( juice reserved ) | 3/4 cup cold chopped pineapple, drained well ( reserve juice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f set out your ungreased nori sheets on a baking sheet.  When they are near to set but still shiny sprinkle them with salt then let dry in the oven.  Dry them on towels for about 10 minutes.  Place in the refrigerator to make sure all the oil is absorbed.  Place the flour in a bowl.  Make a well in the center.  Add the vinegar, salt, and enough water to make a firm dough.  Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface until it has elasticized sufficiently.  Add more flour if it is too sticky. instructions: Firstly we want to mix everything together, so that we have a good squabble going for every grain of veg.  Then we can put the beef eye in it.  For the filling we can use either fresh veg or tinned, diced potatoes, soy sauce, chopped onions and/or spring onions, etc.  If using chopped spring onions and garlic then take the beef eye out of the fridge a few hours before making the sauce.  If making into fake fake, fake and fake veg then just put the veg in a dish lined with cling cling film and leave it sitting in the fridge for a couple of hours or overnight to allow the flavours to mingle.  Make the meat out roughly the same as above to create a solid beef roll.  Take a strip of cabbage and tear apart it finely, then you get to lay it out on a lightly floured work surface.  Then cut it in half lengthways.  Then roll the cabbage into a log and slice into approx 10 thin slices, depending on how neat you want your rolls.  Repeat this process until all the veg are in you've rolled into the beef and cabbage.  If doing the fake or fake roll, just cut into small fingers or pieces.  You're left with a very simple, tasty 'heart' roll.  Get a little phyllo pastry out of the cling film and roll it up.  Leave the cling film on to tidy up the bottom for the pastry to expand and keep it sticking together.  Now lay out all the slices of beef on top of the cabbage/veg mixture and then use the cling film to get a neat 'heart' roll.  Now, lay out your pastry on the work surface.  You want to spread a thin layer of the soy sauce sauce on the pastry, then lay a handful of the sliced beef on top of the it, then put another handful of sliced beef on top of the beef.  Then take another layer of pastry and lay it across the top of the beef, leaving about ½ inch all around.  This takes roughly 45 min to 45 mins.  All you need to do is sit down and allow to rest a nice bit.  Now roll out the extra oil in a frying pan and fry the log until golden brown.  Keep all the oil aside.  The soy sauce recipe is now ready to be served.  Grab a bowl of a tasty and flavourful and stir the soy sauce into it.  Cut the log into thick slices diagonally, then gently put them under a hot grill for about a minute, or until golden brown.  You want to ensure that the 'heart' has reached the correct temperature, but don't let it burn.  You could also just eat it like crazy.  Serve with the soy sauce.

title: Koulourakia (Georgian Onion Bread)

instructions: Place the yolks in a bowl and mash them with an electric mixer.  Stir in onion and garlic, if desired.  The koulourakia will be soft.  Place in an oiled bowl, cover, and set aside to rise until very bubbly.  Add a tablespoon of water now if the dough seems dry.  Let the bread rise until doubled.  Beat the egg whites until soft peaks form.  Fold these yolks into the risen koulourakia.  Use the bread machine's dough cycle or knead on the french setting.  If it's too dry or not, add a teaspoon of water at a time.  The dough should come out of the pan easily.  You may need to add water or a teaspoon of flour while kneading.  After the dough has doubled, remove the dough to a lightly flour covered bowl, cover, and set aside at room temperature to rise for an hour or so.  Meanwhile, preheat over to 400 degrees.  Remove dough from the bowl and knead on lightly flour floured board for 2 - 3 minutes, incorporating some flour if necessary.  If you want, you can stretch the dough to fit your pressure cooker.  Turn it out onto greased baking sheets.  Press the dough out flat using the heels of your hands, stretching it into a rectangle shape.  Flip it over a few times so the stretched dough can fit inside your pressure cooker.  Repeat until the dough has doubled in size.  Cut a slit in the top of the dough rectangle, creating steam on the top.  This is the knuckle.  Place on the baking sheet.  Brush the top of the dough with egg whites.  Repeat with the second dough rectangle.  Poke holes in the top of the dough a few times with a fork.  Brush the dough with egg whites.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until golden brown.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a large bowl, combine well cooked rice, panko, celery seed, mustard seed, and celery seed.  Stir in 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes.  Shape mixture into 1 inch balls and place on cookie sheets.  Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together the raspberry jam, bouillon, and 1 cup of water.  Serve warm.  Store the rice balls in an airtight container.

title: Cauliflower, Belgian Endive and Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 250 g cauliflower florets, trimmed | 3 belgian endive, thick | 125 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 teaspoons almond extract | 1 bouquet garni
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius.  Boil half the cauliflower in salted water for 5 minutes, remove and refresh in cold water.  Meanwhile, halve the remaining cauliflower stalks, and cut into batons or ribbons.  Scoop out the seeds and ribs and trim the thick ends with a mandolin and then cut into florets.  Heat the oil in a large frypan and cook the almond extract for about 30 seconds, stirring until fragrant and slightly coloured.  Tip in the crème fraîche and fry for one minute, or until warm and bubbling but not dark.  Stir cauliflower and cherry tomatoes into the crème fraîche and warm through.  Arrange the endive on a baking tray, drizzle over the olive oil and sprinkle with the almond extract.  Top with the cauliflower and cherry tomatoes and bake in oven for 10 minutes until soft.  Serve with steamed new potato dauphinoise.

title: Artichoke & Kasseri Grilled Cheese (Aebleskivers)
ingredients: 2 cups kasseri cheese | 8 artichoke hearts | 1 1/2 teaspoons caramelskia honey or 1 1/2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds from kasseri | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon rubbed ale
instructions: Mix cheese and artichokes together.  Stir in 2 tsp caramelskia or balsamic vinegar and remaining 1/2 tsp caramel and the mustard seeds from the can of kasseri.  Place on foil lined grill over medium high heat and cook till cheese is melted and bubbly.  Cut in squares and serve.

title: Blueberry Shrimp
ingredients: 1 pound fresh baby shrimp | 1 pint fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Place shrimp in a large baking dish.  Roast in preheated oven until shrimp are peeled and deveined, and no longer translucent, about 15 minutes.  Arrange shrimp on a platter.  Return pan to oven, cover, and bake 25 minutes.  Sprinkle with blueberries, and continue baking 5 minutes, or until shrimp are bright and hot.

title: Smokey Smoked Salmon Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mixed lettuce, chopped | 6 ounces smoked salmon | 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo | radish, sliced | 1 package spaghetti, uncooked ( regular or dry ) | 2 teaspoons liquid seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill.  Cook pasta according to package directions.  Serve with additional chipsotle pepper flakes on the side or salad if desired.

title: Roasted Hazelnut Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef rump roast | 1 1/4 cups hazelnuts ( toasted, skins rubbed off )
instructions: Place beef roast in a roasting pan.  Spread hazelnuts evenly on top, roast under the broiler, about 8 minutes, turn and sprinkle with nut.  Broil until well browned, about 5 minutes.

title: Greek Kummus
ingredients: 1 package thin red potatoes | 1 green bell peppers, seeded and cut into 1/2 inch wide strips or 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch wide strips | 1/4 cup walnuts, toasted and chopped | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, chopped
instructions: Boil potatoes in 1 inch water, covered until just tender, about 12 minutes.  Drain and transfer potatoes to a large bowl.  Add peppers and nuts and toss to evenly distribute.  Serve warm or allow to cool.

title: Fried Chicken With Cream
ingredients: 500 g chicken fillets | 6 tablespoons double cream ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet and cook chicken over medium heat 3 mins on one side.  Turn and cook 2 mins more on other side.  Remove from skillet and keep warm.  Add cream to the skillet and beat with a fork until smooth.  Cook sauce 3 minutes, stir in chicken and heat through serve.

title: Creamy Clam Chowder
ingredients: 6 ounces lean ground veal | 3/4 cup thinly sliced red cabbage | 3/4 cup light-colored brandy ( such as kahlua ) | 4 1/2 cups chopped fresh littleneck clams | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: In a large nonstick saute pan over medium high heat, cook ground veal until brown, stirring to break into tiny pieces, about 5 minutes.  Transfer to a colander, and drain excess fat.  Add cabbage, and saute until soft, turning several times, about 5 minutes, stirring often.  While cabbage is cooking, in a small saucepan over medium high heat, combine kahlua and 5 spice powder.  Stir often until warmed, about 30 seconds.  Cook a minute or two until fragrant.  Stir in drained ground veal and littleneck clams.  Cook 1 minute longer, and serve over warm, fluffy noodles.

instructions: Preheat oven to 4000°f place quinoa in a large bowl and cover with water.  Add yogurt, zest, ketchup, marjoram and lemon zest.  Mix gently.  Cut bread into 1/4 inch thick slices and dip into lemon/quinoa mixture.  Place on cookie sheet and bake until just beginning to brown on the edges, about 15 minutes.

title: Chef John's Spicy Coated Pork for Two
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 3 cubes the lean pork loin | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 14 capers, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f.  Rub salt onto pork, then sprinkle evenly with cayenne and ground cayenne pepper.  Rub pork all over with bicarb of soda.  Heat a medium sized cast iron and heavy bottomed frying pan on high heat.  Place the pork pieces on the pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until lightly dry and browned.  Baste with oil if necessary.  Transfer to a plate and keep warm.  Wipe out the frying pan.  Add capers to the hot pan and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute or so while they cook, constantly shaking the pan so they do not catch on the bottom.  Drain pork pieces onto a rack and arrange in neat flat pieces on an oven proof serving dish.  Slice pork across the grain into thin slices and serve hot. instructions: Chop the jalapeno peppers coarsely and mince them coarsely.  Wash and rinse the sauerkraut thoroughly.  Peel away the seeds and rind of all the peppers, and cut into half or fourths. title: Easy Salsa for Canning

instructions: In a large plastic tub or large bucket, combine the beans, oranges, and jalapeno pepper.  Refrigerate overnight.  The next day, remove the lid, and let sit at room temperature for 2 hours.  Remove lime and zest, and use the juice to remove any seeds, as desired.

title: Baked Calamari (Ammagrod Puree) on Calamari Fritters
ingredients: 2 ounces panko breadcrumbs ( japanese bread crumbs ) | 12 ounces squid, cleaned, head removed, tentacles cut off and reserved
instructions: In a small bowl, blend panko and the crab meat with a fork.  Spray an oven pan with cooking spray.  Stir panko mixture, tentacles and prawns in a medium bowl into remaining panko mixture and season with salt and pepper to taste.  Place mixture into prepared baking pan and fill with about 1/4 inch of water.  Bake, uncovered in a preheated 350 degree f oven until golden, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Dairy-Free Fried Huitlacoche in Sour Cream, Cherry Tomatoes and Bay
ingredients: 1 lb of prepared horseradish-infused huitlacoche ( about 8-12 ounces ) | 1 tablespoon fine salt | 4 pints cherry tomatoes ( or grape tomatoes ) | 1 -2 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 2 tablespoons fine salt ( or cornstarch or white pepper )
instructions: Prepare and wash the horseradishinf.  In a saucepan, bring just enough water to cover the horseradish.  Bring to a simmer and turn the heat off.  Let stand for about 20 min until softened.  Drain and remove horseradish fiber, reserving liquid.  Cut horseradish into 2 inch lengths.  Place horseradish and 2 tsp of fine salt in a food processor.  Add horseradish fiber, tomatoes and the bay leaves.  Process until very smooth.  With the motor running, add shortening.  Stirring with a circular motion to emulsify.  Add remaining fine salt or cornstarch at a slow speed and process 30 seconds or until mixture forms small bits of horseradish that are mixed with liquid.  Transfer to a dish and spread evenly in an even layer.  Refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.  Drain and dry well.  To serve, cut into thin strips.

Serve hot.

instructions: Combine soy milk, cocoa, xanthan gum and soymilk in a pan.  Bring to boil and then simmer on medium heat for 5 minutes.  Add papaya. instructions: Fry mushrooms and cardamom over medium heat.  When mushrooms are fried, add cheese.  Stir until melted.

title: Cocoa Bar
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons light rum | 2 -4 tablespoons chile-flavored light rum | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 3/4 cups sweet unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Dip your hands into a little cocoa powder, you only want a few pinches of cocoa.  This will make sure the cocoa turns a light brown color.  In a small to medium sized bowl/jar just like you'll be using italian coffee, dip the hands into a little cocoa powder and begin shaking, sprinkling, mixing.  Continue until all jewlery is gone.  Now dip the spoon into the hot cocoa.  If they're wet enough to hold their shape in seconds then it is time to go.  Put the bowl on the counter, covered, and leave in the refrigerator.  On the day you're going to serve this, you can put the pot back on the heat.  Stir the cocoa vigorously with a wooden spoon or in a double boiler, whisking until the cocoa turns a lighter color.  Then you have two methods for doing this.  You should use a wooden spoon to mix.  If you're going to use a double boiler, take it out of the refrigerator and put in a plastic bag.  If you're going to do this ahead and make it ahead so it can be eaten right away, dump it in your bowl.  Stir until creamy again before serving.  To make it a paste, pour a little cocoa powder out of the bowl/jar and start dipping the spoon into.  You'll end up with cocoa mass.  It won't stick to spoon.  You should dip the spoon back into hot cocoa.  You can keep using plastic bag to dunk the cookies while doing this.  If the cocoa hasn't turned light brown, it will be very tricky.  Add more cocoa powder to make sure the cocoa is a little darker.  Serve warm with sweetened whipped cream, ice cream, chocolate shavings, etc.

title: Tropical Con

instructions: Place tamales onto a microwave safe plate.  Put in the 2 cans of tamales.  Pour in 2 cups of dark rum.  Microwave on high for 50 seconds or until tamales are warmed through.  Note, tamales can be frozen, refrigerated for up to three months.

title: Fiske Kettle #5FIX

instructions: Brown ground beef thoroughly and transfer into large deep pan.  Sprinkle with paprika and set aside on paper towels.  Pour off any fat and drain any liquid off of beef.  Cook uncovered on medium for 1 hour.  Spoon off any excess liquid and serve on crisp kettle.

title: Cheesy Yogurt Sauce With Pork
ingredients: 1 jar marinated pork | 1 container plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium size bowl.  Place in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: White Black Buns
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained ( white kidney beans are wonderful ) | 250 g plain flour | 100 g cocoa powder | 500 g french baguettes ( or similarly sized regular buns ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c grease 2 x 12 hole english muffin pans and line the bottoms with baking paper.  Combine beans in a saucepan and heat over a fairly high heat for around 4 – 5 minutes you want the beans to be just soft.  Drain the beans and put them into a bowl.  Pour the beans into a small bowl, add the flour and mix.  Add the cocoa powder and mix until everything is combined.  Add 1/2 of the flour mixture to the bean mixture.  Mix to a fairly soft dough and knead gently until smooth and the dough starts to stick to the sides of the bowl.  Remove the dough from the bowl and place on a lightly floured surface and knead lightly until it forms a round shape.  Using your hands, roll small handfuls of the dough into balls and press them onto the greased baking paper.  Repeat until all the pastry and beans have been used.  Make sure that you have enough baking paper over the top of the biscuits to stop them sticking.  Place the biscuits on muffin pans.  Sprinkle tops with cocoa powder.  Bake at 200°c for 20 minutes or until crispy and golden.  You can enjoy these hot.  Use a spoon or small ladle to remove a good little of the white foam and white bubbles from the top of the biscuits.

title: Green Curry Duck

Sprinkle 1 teaspoon curry paste into chicken skin.  Roast in the preheated oven until duck juices run clear, 1 hour to 1 hour and 45 minutes to 1 hour 15 minutes, depending on the duck.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh, which should read at least 165 degrees f, should read 165 degrees f.  Remove duck from the oven.

instructions: Heat oven to 375°f.  Cut a 9x13 inch baking dish into 10 wedges.  Cut each wedge in half so that you create 24 large triangles.  Mix together yogurt, brown sugar, noodles, and orange crystals.

Random Ingredients: miso,lamb fillet,thai chile,wheat flour,phyllo pastry,tabasco sauce
title: Lamb and Whole Wheat Tisane Rolls
ingredients: 4 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup miso | 1 lb boneless lamb fillet, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour, plus extra for dusting | 1 thai chile, cut into thin strips | 1 lb reduced-fat phyllo pastry dough
instructions: In large bowl, combine 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour and 1 teaspoon tabasco.  Add lamb.

title: Konbu (Key Lime Pies)
ingredients: 2 key limes, zested and juiced | 1 cup coconut milk | 2 packages frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1 cup shredded coconut milk | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Pour lime juice into a 1 1/2 quart baking dish.  Dice the limes and set aside.  In a bowl, stir together the key lime juice, 1 cup of the shredded coconut milk and the coconut milk.  Place half of the phyllo sheets in the baking dish and brush with some of the coconut milk mixture.

title: Black Bean and Ladyfinger Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 3 packages ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Arrange the black beans on the prepared baking sheet.  Place the ladyfingers onto the prepared baking sheet.  Open the cans of black beans, and fill with water to cover the surface of the beans.  Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the ladyfingers are soft and crusty, but not yet soft.  Allow to cool.  Spread each ladyfinger with about 2 tablespoons bean mixture.  Return to the oven, and bake until filling is browned and the filling is hot, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,beefsteak tomato,asiago cheese,flat leaf italian parsley,potato,peanut,coleslaw,chicken broth
title: Tomato and Pepper Burgundy
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs sirloin round tomatoes, thinly sliced, about 4 medium | 1 cup cooked and diced potato | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium chicken broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons crumbled asiago cheese | 1 bouquet garni, thyme or 1 teaspoon marjoram | freshly grated pecorino cheese | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts, coarsely crushed
instructions: Place tomatoes, potatoes, parsley and broth in a large saucepan, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer uncovered until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.  Sprinkle with asiago cheese.

title: Mexican Hot Sauce Mix Substitute
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons dried jalapeno pepper, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon minced ( seeded ) jalapeno pepper, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon chili, or more to taste ( seeded )
instructions: Combine the tomato paste, liquid smoke, jalapeno pepper, chili pepper paste, and chile in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: hash brown,white fish fillet,sesame seed,pearl barley,yellow squash
title: Korean-Style Baked Fish and Squash (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 bag frozen potato hash browns ( kim chee ) | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 white fish fillet | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 yellow squash ( thinly sliced lengthwise, and cut into chunks, or 2 cups cubed )
instructions: Add all ingredients, except fish and squash in 5 to 6 quart rice cooker.  Close lid, and let sit 5 minutes.

title: Turbinado Sugar Croutons
ingredients: 1/4 cup turbinado sugar | 1/4 cup flaked oats | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seeds | 8 focaccia bread
instructions: Preheat oven 325°f toast the cumin seeds in a dry nonstick skillet over moderately low heat, stirring often, until fragrant, 2 to 5 minutes.  Transfer to a bowl and stir in sugar.  Spread the mixture evenly on a baking sheet and cool.  Cut the focaccia bread into 16 wedges.  Coat with the sugar drizzled mixture and arrange on a sheet of waxed paper on a rimmed baking sheet.  Bake at 325°f for 10 minutes, until crisp and golden.  Let cool to almost room temperature before serving.

title: Irish Smoked Kielbasa and Grape Appetizer
ingredients: 1 smoked kielbasa | 4 green seedless grapes | 2 tablespoons black tea ( instant ) | 1/4 cup white wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons irish cream | 1 jar frozen mixed green grapes, thawed, drained, and halved
instructions: Place the smoked kielbasa, green seeds, and grape halves into the freezer for 10 minutes to soften.  Remove from the freezer, cut into pieces, and place on a plate.  Heat in the microwave for 5 minutes, or until heated through.  Remove from microwave, and cover to keep warm.  Place the frozen green grapes, tea, rum, and irish cream into the freezer.

title: Potato Loin with Cheese and Pepperoni
ingredients: 4 medium russet potatoes, sliced into 1/8 to 1/4-1/4 inch thick rounds | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless pork loin, cut in 1 inch cubes | 4 ounces blue cheese, crumbled | 7 -8 tablespoons hot pepperoni, thinly sliced | salt and freshly ground pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Spread out the potatoes on the greased or parchment lined baking sheet, and cook, stirring often, until golden, about 30 minutes.  Remove from oven, uncover, and let stand 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, prepare the bbq to medium heat.  Layer the pork and peppers on the prepared potatoes and then spread the blue cheese over.  Place potatoes in a roasting pan, and sprinkle over the pepperoni.  Bake in 425 degree oven, uncovered, for 30 - 40 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.  Serve immediately.

title: Beef With Cacik
ingredients: 1 kg chuck | 300 g goat cheese | 1 kg baby corn
instructions: Grill the chuck or roast till it is browned.  Let rest in the fridge for about 30 minutes.  The meat should get tender.  Cut the goats cheese into small slices.  Take the beef cubes on a tray on the grill or in a dish, or put them in the oven for about 20 minutes at 200 deg c.  Cut the baby corn in quarters.  Fry them in pan with olive oil with a little salt and pepper.  Remove and put it in the fridge to cool.  Cut the beef into pieces as thin as you like them, and put them in a pot with 1 kg of water, and bring it to a boil.  Turn it down the flame, add the baby corn and boil them for 3 - 4 minutes.  Drain and put it in a dish.  Take some of the meat from the grinder, put it in the dish, and then put it in the fridge.  Put the rest of the meat in the pot, and make into 1 kg meatballs, and put in the fridge until you eat it.

title: Macaroni With Smoked Cod and Herbs
ingredients: 350 g macaroni | 2 tablespoons tarragon | 200 ml heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry ( or other fresh herb ) | 200 g smoked cod
instructions: Boil the macaroni and half of the cherries.  Drain & return to the pan.  Add the rest of the cherries & herbs & pour over the cream.  Whip the rest of the cream w/beaten fork & fold into the macaroni.  Serve immediately.  Garnish w/extra cherries & more of any other garnishes.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,sirloin,strawberry,beef rib,pesto sauce,apple,italian salad dressing mix,green bell pepper
title: Betsy's Italian Beef
ingredients: 1/2 pound top sirloin, sliced into thin strips | 1/2 pound beef short cuts | 1/2 pound mixed greens bell peppers, sliced | 1 package italian-style salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup italian dressing | 1/2 cup strawberry-pepper spreadable pesto sauce | 12 fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced | 1/2 cup shredded italian-style salad dressing blend
instructions: Marinate sirloin strips for 15 minutes in italian dressing.  Combine greens with pesto and olive oil and grill over medium heat until greens are crisp tender, but not cooked through.  Cook sirloin strips over medium heat just until lightly charred, about 4 minutes per side.  Combine sirloin strips and green vegetables and drizzle with the dressing.  Garnish with strawberries and italian style salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,marinara sauce,farfalle pasta,tomato soup,egg,red wine vinegar
title: Pumpkin Seed Pasta
ingredients: 14 ounces canned pumpkin seeds, with liquid | 1 jar of roasted marinara sauce, including juices | 2 cans condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 4 eggs | 3 cups uncooked farfalle pasta
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a large pot.  Add all ingredients except the pasta.  Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.  Drain and return pasta to hot water, salt lightly and boil according to package directions.  Keep pasta hot while cooking sauce.

title: Mango Chutney Marinade
ingredients: 1 cup mango chutney | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 1/3 cup mirin
instructions: Combine chutney, serrano pepper, and mirin.  Place in a sealable container, and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Surprise
ingredients: 8 ounces cooked and prepared meat ( i like deli meat ) | 3 ounces cooked tapioca starch | 3 -8 ounces roasted sugar pumpkin | 1/4 cup roasted rice starch ( i like glutinous rice starch ) | 3 -4 ounces chicken bouillon or 3 -4 ounces instant ramen noodles ( 1/2 packet if available ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric ( optional, i like lots of it ) | 1 pinch cayenne powder ( optional ) | salt
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large pot bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer approximately 15 minutes.  Remove from heat add more tapioca starch if necessary.  Taste for seasoning, adding salt if needed.  Serve hot or cold with extra sugar, if using as main dish or as a cold snack for breakfast.

title: Fennel Jelly
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, trimmed | 1/2 liter apricot brandy
instructions: Wash the fennel bulb, removing the outer leaves, roughly chop the fennel stalks.  Bring a large pan of water to the boil with a good pinch of salt, and throw around the fennel.  Lower the heat and leave to cook for 5 minutes.  Turn off the heat and leave in the pan, covered with a plate or cloth for a further 8 hours.  Strain off the fennel and cut out the feathery leaves of the fennel bulb.  Mash the chunks with a wooden spoon.  Add brandy and stir.  Spoon the jelly into sterilised jars and put in the fridge until set.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,head garlic,oyster sauce,black eyed pea,salsa,thyme leave,sultana,italian seasoning
title: Spicy Black-Eyed Peas Stuffed With Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb black-eyed peas, cooked and drained | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leave | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 small head of garlic, smashed with the flat side of a cleaver | 1/2 cup sultana, soaked in warm water for a few minutes to plump it down a bit | 1 cup salsa, good quality ( i used herdez ) | 2 teaspoons extra oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Coarsely chop thyme and Italian seasoning in food processor.  Toss beans with the oil.

title: Cheesy Shallot Panini
ingredients: 5 shallots, green parts only, roughly chopped | 2/3 cup shredded pre-shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat an oven to 500 degrees f.  Spread the shallots evenly onto a baking sheet.  Roast in the preheated oven until the shallots begin to soften, 5 to 10 minutes.  Let cool and slice into 1/2 inch thick slices.  Spread mozzarella over both sides of each piece of shallots.  Return to oven and bake until the cheese is bubbly, about 5 minutes.

title: Mustard Peppers W-Cauliflower
ingredients: 4 large yellow bell peppers | 1 head cauliflower floret, trimmed | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 cup coarse grainy mustard
instructions: Cut all of the peppers in half lengthwise, discard the stem and seeds of the peppers.  Place the pepper halves cut side down on a square of heavy duty foil.  Drizzle the cauliflower with the mustard.  Pour 1 cup water over the cauliflower and fold the foil tightly around it to seal it.  Refrigerate for 24 hours.  Remove the foil 2hrs prior to grilling.

title: Beer and Feta Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 tablespoon feta cheese | 1/2 cup light beer | 4 eggs noodles
instructions: Bring 3 inches of water to a boil in a 2 to 3 quart pot, or lightly oil a 7 1/2 or 8 inch cake pan or skillet.  While water is coming to a boil, put rice and cheese into a medium bowl.  Heat 1/2 cup beer in a small saucepan over medium low heat, stirring to loosen browned bits on the bottom.  Pour mixture into a 2 quart saucepan.  Heat remaining beer in a cup over medium heat until it starts to bubble.  Remove from heat.

title: Apricot, Lime & Parmigiano-Reggiano Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 1/4 teaspoons fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons apricot preserves | 1 small plum, very thinly sliced
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a screw top jar with a tight fitting lid.  Shake well to combine.  Season with salt & pepper to taste.

title: Hawaiian Rolls
ingredients: 4 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 1 1/2 lbs of finely grated lean hamburger | 1/2 cup of finely chopped napa cabbage | 1 teaspoon chili | 1/2 cup of finely chopped pecans
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in soy milk.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Add hamburger, chopped cabbage, chili and pecans.

Random Ingredients: half,beef broth,anaheim chili,shrimp paste,serrano chili,rice vinegar
title: Chile De Arbol With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb small shrimp paste | 3 cups half-and-half | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar ( to taste ) | 3 tablespoons minced anaheim chili ( to taste ) | 2 serrano chili, minced | 1 cup beef broth
instructions: Marinate shrimp paste for 10 minutes at room temperature, or refrigerate for 20 minutes.  Heat a skillet until almost smoking and reduce heat.  Add shrimp paste.  Stir fry shrimp paste for 2 minutes.  Add half and half, rice vinegar and serrano chili.  Bring to a boil and reduce to a simmer.  Serve hot or warm.

title: Easy Tasty French Tri Pinwheels
ingredients: toothpicks or kitchen twine | 2 -3 tablespoons cream, for flavoring
instructions: Take a toothpick or kitchen twine.  Dip the toothpick in the cream just to coat the entire inside of the stick/twice.  If the toothpick is sticking to the breadstick, pop it into a plastic bag, and gently squeeze out any excess moisture, then dip the stick/towels in the cream, again, coating the entire inside.  Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: The Chunky Serrano Peppers
ingredients: 5 serrano peppers | 1 cup chocolate chips or 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f cut pepper tops off and discard stem and seeds from peppers.  Place pepper pieces in small metal baking dish.  Pour chocolate over peppers and allow to melt.  Place baking dish over sauce pan and allow to melt.  Pour cooled chocolate evenly over peppers.  Allow to cool, then cover bowl with towel or plastic wrap and store in hot spot until chocolate has set at least half way.

title: Italian Spinach and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb spinach | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Combine all in large saucepan or casserole.  Cover.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,coconut,couscous,tomato ketchup,tomato paste,rice,apricot preserve,snow pea
title: Couscous With Seafood
ingredients: 2 cups cooked couscous | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 cup tomato ketchup | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 2/3 cup white sugar, sifted | 1/2 cup coconut | 1/4 cup dried shrimp | 1/4 cup snow peas
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the preserves, ketchup and tomato paste.  Set aside.  Heat the curry sauce ingredients together in a small pot over medium heat.  Bring to a boil, stirring continuously.  When the mixture comes to a boil, add the shrimp, sugar, coconut, apricot preserves and couscous.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,lemon juice,bragg liquid amino,parmesan cheese,sharp cheddar cheese
title: The Best Cheese Ball!
ingredients: 2 lbs sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 5 packages soft light chewy buttery-type chevre cheese, crumbled | 2 quarts braggs liquid aminos | 2 lemons, juice of | 2 ounces dark rum
instructions: Combine cheeses, butter and cheese well.  Stir in liquid aminos.  Place in a greased 9 x 13 inch pan.  Sprinkle remaining cheese on top.  Bake covered at 350f for 45 - 60 minutes.  Remove, turn onto serving plate and garnish with lemon juice.  Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: paprika,pasta,beef bouillon cube,mint leaf,american cheese,straw mushroom,green pepper
title: Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 package pasta | 8 ounces american cheese, grated | 1 package frozen straw mushrooms | 1 green pepper | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves
instructions: Boil pasta with boiling water.  Saute peppers and mushrooms in fry pan.  Add to pasta with cheese, then stir.  Add paprika and bouillon stirring constantly.  Cook about 2 minutes.  Add mint leaves.

title: Chinese-style Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 lb cabbage or 1 lb kale, chopped | 1/2 lb polish kielbasa, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 jalapeno chile, seeded and minced
instructions: Blanch the kale by placing it in a large pot along with a cover or steamer basket and cover it.  Steam the leaves and kielbasa for 3 - 5 minutes.  Using 2 forks, shred the cabbage.  Toss cabbage, kielbasa, cream and minced chile together.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: gruyere,peanut butter,chicken breast,white wine vinegar,green tomato,flour
title: Chicken Salad Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast | 1/2 cup flour | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1 package chopped green tomatoes | 2 cups gruyere
instructions: Mix flour, peanut butter, vinegar, green tomatoes, and gruyere cheese together.  Slice chicken into four equal sized strips.  Roll in flour mixture and place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 375 for 40 minutes.  After 45 minutes remove and slice into 3/4 strips.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,tilapia fillet,greek yogurt,linguine
title: Lighter Italian Tilapia
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix | 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 package linguine
instructions: Prepare the pasta according to package instructions.  Place the tilapia fillets in a greased 9x13 inch pan and pour in the salad dressing mix.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f and grease a baking sheet with cooking spray.  In the meantime, in a medium bowl, stir together the yogurt and pasta.  Place the seafood fillets on top of the mixture, then spoon over the yogurt mixture.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 20 minutes, then remove from oven and stir.

title: Fried Chicken With Shiso Muffins and Shell Noodles
ingredients: 500 g skin-on chicken, cut into pieces | oil | 14 1/2 ounces shell pasta, broken into 3cm pieces | 1 pinch baking soda | 7 1/2 ounces shiso leaves ( i use the japanese )
instructions: Cook the chicken in oil in a wok in a single layer.  When the chicken changes color it is ready.  Add the shells to the chicken and cook briefly only until they start to color.  Add the noodles and remove from heat.  Sprinkle with a pinch of baking soda and stir in the shiso leaves.  Sprinkle with the toasted shiso leaves and serve.

title: Honey & Potato Rounds
ingredients: 2 cups mashed potatoes | 1 1/2 teaspoons honey | 1/4 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 12 slices rye bread
instructions: To toast the bread in a toaster or toaster oven, grease both sides of the slices.  Mix the cooked potato, honey, sesame oil& tabasco together.  Spread the potato mixture on the bread slices& spread on the rye slices.  Place on a cookie sheet& bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,creme fraiche,arugula leaf,wheat bran,garlic granule,taco,lemon zest,mexican tomato
title: Mexican White Bean and Veggie Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces whole wheat cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can mexican-style tomatoes | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | 1 dash taco | 1 teaspoon mexican basil or 1 teaspoon cilantro, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups arugula leaves, torn into bite sized pieces
instructions: Drain the beans and tomatoes.  Add the creme fraiche, lemon zest, garlic, and taco seasoning.  Mix well and refrigerate until chilled, about 8 to 10 hours.  When ready to serve, garnish the salad with the torn arugula and serve.

title: Granita's Easy Almond Free Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato juice | 1 cup almond meal
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender, except for the almond meal or you can leave it up to 6 months in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,chicken stock,white chocolate,chili powder,bell pepper,hazelnut,sugar cube
title: Roasted Chilli Pepper Salad
ingredients: 8 large bell peppers ( red spring onion or green mixture ) | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons dark good quality white chocolate | 4 tablespoons sugar cubes | 1/8 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup basil leaves | 100 g hazelnuts ( skinned if desired )
instructions: Place peppers on baking paper covered tray and roast under a preheated oven at 160°c for 15 - 20 minutes until skins blister.  Remove from oven and cut off tops, removing from peppers.  Peel off skins with a sharp knife and remove the seeds, cut peppers into small bite size pieces and place in a large bowl.  Add chocolate, stock, sugar, chilli powder, basil and nuts to the bowl.  Pour over the pepper mixture and toss thoroughly to combine.  Serve.

title: South American Potato Cakes
ingredients: 1 large red cabbage | 1 cup long grain rice | 3 eggs, lightly beaten | 3 tablespoons coconut cream | 2 tablespoons salsa ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups corn | 1/2 cup sliced kalamata olives | 1/4 teaspoon garlic
instructions: Prepare the rice according to package instructions.  Meanwhile, cut the cabbage in half lengthwise and then in half crosswise.  Place into a colander with a few holes punched in the core.  Rinse in several changes of cold water, then drain and pat dry.  Combine the eggs, coconut cream, salsa, olives, garlic and salt and pepper to taste in a medium bowl and lightly mix.  Heat a griddle to medium.  Grill the potato cakes for 15 minutes on each side or until cooked through and slightly browned on top.  Serve with guacamole and sour cream.  If grilling, you may put potato cakes in a baking pan and bake at 400° for 15 minutes, turning halfway through.  Place the potato cakes on a platter while cooling until warm.  Dressing, combine 2 tablespoons water with a tablespoon or so of oil.  Add the rice and cabbage a few at a time, stirring constantly as you add.  Serve at once on lettuce leaves.

title: Wild Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice, not instant | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 lbs lean pork, cooked and cut into bite sized pieces | 1 cup radish, diced ( optional )
instructions: Cover wild rice with 4 cups hot water and bring to boil.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes or until rice is tender and water has been absorbed.  Transfer to greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish that has been sprinkled with parmesan cheese.  Top with cooked meat and radish if using.  Sprinkle with a little of the chopped parsley if using.  Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350ºf for 30 - 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: olive,grain rice,chipotle chile,pineapple juice,potato,triple sec,green pepper
title: Spanish Rice & Pineapple
ingredients: 6 cups instant cooked long grain rice | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1 cup chopped green pepper | 1 cup chopped red pepper ( from leftovers ) | 1 cup chopped ripe olives | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1 tablespoon minced chipotle chile
instructions: Combine the cooked rice, canned fruit and peppers in the slow cooker.

title: Soup Sticky Peppers (Lahvede)
ingredients: 6 -8 green peppers ( red ones ) | 1/2 cup coriander seed | 2 teaspoons salt | 1 teaspoon dried hot chili pepper | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/4 cup fresh mint
instructions: Wash the peppers and remove stem before slicing.  Cut off pepper veins.  Remove seeds except for the stems.  Chop the pepper into 1/2 inch wide strips.  Combine all ingredients except mint in a blender or food processor and blend to a smooth paste.  Add the mint leaves and blend again.  Transfer to a skillet and cook over low heat uncovered until vegetables are tender.

title: Mexican Spicy Pep Candy
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces of mexican chocolate | 1/2 cup pomegranate molasses | 1/4 cup coriander
instructions: Warm the chocolate.  Take off the stove and add pomegranate molasses.  I add the coriander just about a minute before you eat it to prevent it burning.  Once cool but still lukewarm, beat the mixture with a spoon.  Once fluffy, but cool and mix with ice and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours.  It's best stored in refrigerator.

title: Miles of Beef
ingredients: 7 lbs round steaks, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons snipped flat-leaf parsley | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Coat the roast with 1 t salt and half each of the snipped parsley and allspice.  Heat the remaining tablespoon oil in a heavy 12 inch skillet over moderate heat.  Brown both sides.  Transfer to a shallow baking pan.  Add the beef and turn to brown on all sides.  Pour any accumulated fat from the pan into the pan.  Cover the pan tightly with foil.  Bake in a 350 degree f.  Oven, until the meat is tender when pierced with a fork 1 hour to 2 hours.  Cover tightly and braise in a 350 degree f.  Oven, turning the meat frequently, until it is tender when pierced with a fork, about 2 hours more.  Discard the foil.  Meanwhile, boil the sauce over high heat until it barely reduces.  Transfer the beef to a platter, sprinkle with the remaining parsley.

title: Salad With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 head bibb lettuce | 1 cup dried cranberries ( packed ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil ( drained ) | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Boil 8 cups of water and plunge in the cranberries.  Chop the lettuce and drain them.  Drain the tomato, cut off the stem, and add them to the lettuce and cranberries.  Heat sugar in a pan and melt it over low heat.  Pour hot sugar over salad then toss.  Serve.

title: Classic Beef Burritos
ingredients: 8 -10 large flour tortillas | 1 cup grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Lightly oil baking sheet and or shallow glass baking dish.  Cut a slit down the center of each tortilla and stuff with half the grand marnier.  Wrap tortillas tightly and place in a single layer on pan.  Bake 20 - 30 minutes or until golden.

title: Quick and Easy Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 beef top sirloin steak, fat trimmed | 1/4 cup lemon pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil.  Place beef steak on foil.  Rub lemon pepper into meat.  Place pan in preheated oven, and roast meat for 45 minutes, or until very tender.

title: Horseradish, Chilli, Snow Pea and Chocolate Meatballs (Peshawook)
ingredients: 400 g frozen snow peas, thawed and drained | 500 g ground lamb | 500 g ground goat meat or 500 g lean ground goat meat | 4 teaspoons fresh horseradish | 2 1/2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 2 teaspoons fresh tandoori mixed spice dried fruit and 2 teaspoons dried cherries | 3 1/2 tablespoons dark chocolate, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c line 2 oven trays with baking paper, or line with baking paper.  Combine meat, peas, horseradish, tomato ketchup, zest and dried cherries in a large bowl.  Dampen palms with water.  Shape mixture into 20 large meatballs, about the size of a ping pong ball.  Place in a large baking tray.  Using a fork, toss to coat meatballs and peas.  Bake in oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown on the outside.  Sprinkle with grated chocolate.  Variation, try reducing the meat, but not adding any of the dried spices.

title: Spicy Cajun Chocolate Fingers
ingredients: 200 g semisweet chocolate, chopped into pieces | 1 teaspoon saffron strand | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed red chile | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Place chocolate, saffron and crushed red chillie in a small saucepan over low heat.  Stir until melted and warm.  Remove from heat.  Stir in cajun seasoning.  Cut into fingers.

Random Ingredients: bouillon cube,chicken wing,habanero pepper,serrano chilies,chunky salsa,cocoa,vanilla extract
title: Mexican Hot Wings
ingredients: 20 chicken wings, tips tips removed | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1 bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1/2 cup water | 2 ounces canned deveined jalapeno peppers, with juice | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 habanero chilies or 1 serrano chili, seeded and diced
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Refrigerate for several hours, stirring occasionally.  Preheat oven to 350°f bake wings 15 minutes, basting and turning until golden brown.

title: Shallel in a Jar
ingredients: 1 red pepper, chopped into small cubes ( approx 2-3 tablespoons ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons harissa | 1 tablespoon tea, infused with oil
instructions: In a jar with a tight lid, add peppers, vinegar, harissa and spice.  Close lid and shake well.  Cover in the oven and leave overnight.

title: Broccoli With Sunflower Oil
ingredients: 2 bunches broccoli florets | 1/2 cup sunflower oil
instructions: Wash, peel and cut the broccoli into thick long strips.  In a wok, heat oil and fry the broccoli, stirring constantly until the broccoli changes color.  Place the fried broccoli in a serving dish and add salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,yellow cornmeal,grand marnier,picante sauce,mozzarella cheese,horseradish,taco seasoning mix
title: Easy Artichoke Horseradish Fondue
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced yellow cornmeal | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 5 1/2 ounces sour cream or 5 1/2 ounces creme fraiche, divided | 1/2 cup minced artichoke heart | 1 1/2 cups shredded smoked mozzarella cheese | 1 jar picante sauce, divided ( bottled preferred ) | 1 tablespoon minced fresh horseradish
