Remove from heat and leave covered for five minutes.  Stir in olives and season with soy sauce.  Remove from heat and cool in the fridge.  Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius and grease a shallow ovenproof frying pan with a little oil.  Place pasta in a large bowl and cover with boiling water.  Leave to soak until just tender.  Drain and set aside.  Place the remaining olive oil in a large non stick frying pan and fry the lasagna for 2 - 5 minutes, or until they turn pale golden in colour.  Spoon half the pasta into the pan.  Spread with 1/2 the quinoa and half the olives.  Repeat these layers and top with a third of the noodles.  Spread over half the remaining ingredients and top with remaining ingredients.  Cover with foil and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,soya sauce,red cabbage,ramen noodle,turmeric,dark brown sugar,white pepper,couscous
title: Thai-Spiced Cabbage and Ramen Noodles
ingredients: 7 ounces sliced red cabbage | 6 ounces ramen noodles | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 dash white pepper | 7 tablespoons pesto sauce, such as classico ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon goya soya sauce, such as classico ( optional )
instructions: Place the ramen noodles and cabbage in a large bowl.  Put the soy sauce, sugar, turmeric, and pepper in a cup and microwave for 2 minutes.  Combine pesto, soya sauce, and goya sauce together in a bowl.  Pour over noodle mixture in bowl and stir to combine.  Chill the bowl and noodle mixture in the fridge for 1 hour before serving.

title: Cod Rice Pilaf With Roasted Tomatoes, Mexicorns and Bliss
ingredients: 1 cup boil-in-bag rice, prepared | 1 medium tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 2 ounces belgian endive ( green swiss ) or 2 ounces melon, peeled cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon herbes de provence, crushed | 2 ounces cod, fillet ( fresh or frozen ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 300 degrees f.  Lightly oil a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.  Place the rice in an ovenproof dish.  Top the rice with the tomatoes, herbes and diced fish if using.  Bake for about 40 minutes.

title: Green Onion (Peruvian Style) Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons hot chili oil ( peruvian cayenne pepper oil ) | 1 bunch green onion, finely chopped | 2/3 jar roasted pepperoncini peppers, drained and crushed ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients thoroughly together and store in an air tight container.

title: Kiwifruit Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 quarts beef stock | 1 kiwi fruit
instructions: Place kiwifruit into a blender.  Pour the stock slowly into the blender and puree.  Pour kiwifruit puree back into the pan.  Slowly mix in the kiwifruit puree.  Simmer until the kiwifruit is tender.

Random Ingredients: salt cod fish,ghee,cider vinegar,semolina flour,bean sprout,grapeseed oil
title: Faux Cherese
ingredients: 500 g salt cod fish | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil ( or extra virgin olive oil ) | 1 tablespoon ghee ( or butter ) | 1 tablespoon sugar | 300 g dry semolina flour | 400 g bean sprouts
instructions: Cut fish into 2 inch length wide strips.  Bring large pot of water to boil, add salt cod and boil for about 3 minutes.  While cod is cooking make batter in a large bowl with sifted semolina flour and 2 tspn olive oil.  Dip the soaked cod strips into the batter and then fry in the ghee or butter for about 3 mins, or until fish changes colour.  Do not overcook drain in colander and rinse well with cold water.  Add drained fish and remaining oil to cooked semolina flour and mix well.  Drain in colander.  Add bean sprouts and fry briefly until slightly crisp.  Scoop rice into bowl and then toss in fish and sprouts and serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: garlic sprout,red bell pepper,pineapple,spinach leaf,cabbage kimchi,sirloin,taco seasoning mix
title: Taco Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked sirloin, sliced | 1/2 cup cabbage kimchi | 1/2 red bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup spinach leaves | 1/2 cup fresh pineapple, diced | 1/3 cup fresh tofu, diced | 1/2 envelope taco seasoning mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients except taco seasoning and pour into a greased rectangular container sprayed with non stick cooking spray.  Sprinkle with taco seasoning.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Remove from container, uncover and serve.

title: Roasted Pear, Poblano & Poblanano Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper, halved and seeded | 2 large ripe pears, peeled, cored, minced | 2 -3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Place poblano peppers on a baking sheet & bake 30 minutes, or until charred & soft.  Carefully remove poblano peppers, and place on a plate to cool.  Peel & core pears & poblanos.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,virgin olive oil,greek yogurt,tilapia fillet,seasoning salt
title: Greek Stuffed Tilapia(Patates Salatasi)
ingredients: 1 russet potato | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil, use extra virgin | 7 ounces tilapia fillets | 1 container greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: Boil potatoes in skins for about 15 minutes.  Cool and cut into 1/2 inch dice.  Mix all ingredient together and stuff potato around tilapia fillets.  Heat olive oil in a pan and fry tilapia for about 7 minutes, then serve on top of mashed potatoes with greek yogurt on the side.

title: Swiss Rye Bread With Walnuts and Fresh Riesling
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread | 1/2 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut a large slice of the bread in half horizontally.  Insert a sharp paring knife between the bread and the knife.  Using a brush, spread the walnut nuts evenly throughout the top of the bread, leaving at least 1/4 inch around the edges.  Starting at one end of each slice of bread, spread about 1/2 tablespoon each of butter and walnuts.  Fold over the bread, enclosing it like a taco and press to seal in any loose air pockets.  Slice into 4 pieces.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: French Canadian Lamb Chops (L' Au Jus)
ingredients: 600 g leg of lamb, trimmed | 1 cup apricot jam or 1 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 cup soft light brown sugar | 1/2 cup smoked gouda cheese or 1/2 cup gouda cheese
instructions: Heat a griddle or fry pan gently until it is very hot.  Drain lamb and set aside and keep warm.  Heat the oven to 190c/fan 160c/gas put jam, sugar and cheese in a baking dish and stir well until well mixed.  Spread a little jam on each chop and place under the grill for 3 to 5 minutes, until lightly browned.  Place on warmed plates and serve.

title: Kielbasa with Irish Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 3 kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup half's creamed butter, chilled
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the kielbasa on a baking sheet and brush with half the butter.  Bake in the preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes, until hot and beginning to brown, stirring once or twice.  Place the cheddar cheese into a small saucepan and place over moderate heat.  Heat but do not bring to boil.  Pour over the kielbasa.  Heat and stir to melt the cheese.

Random Ingredients: skewer,cream chicken soup,beef stock,pie crust,fish fillet,basil,fenugreek leaf
title: Greek Beef and Fish
ingredients: 1 pie crust | 3 cups beef stock | 2 tablespoons cream of chicken soup ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried basil, plus 1 small sprig tied with kitchen thread | skewer | fish fillet, for decoration | basil, leaves for decoration
instructions: Preheat the oven at 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Prick the pie crust with a fork, and bake for 5 minutes.  Remove from oven and set aside for 5 minutes.  Carefully pour in stock, soup, basil and any desired spices.  Add the fish and return to the oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until the fish is done.  Pour into a serving dish and decorate with basil leaves, and serve with your favourite green vegetables.

Random Ingredients: red chile,ziti pasta,white onion,lime leaf,chive,cabbage,chili pepper,baking soda
title: Tacimole With Chili Peppers & Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 1 white onion, finely diced | 1 small cabbage, coarsely shredded | 1/2 small red chile, thinly sliced | 1 roasted chili pepper | 2 fresh lime leaves | 1 teaspoon baking soda | chopped fresh chives, garnish ( optional )
instructions: In large frying pan melt chile pepper over medium heat, set aside.  Cook onion in frying pan with chile until brown.  Add shredded cabbage and cook 2 minutes.  Add chili pepper, lime leaves, and baking soda.  Cook, stirring frequently for 2 - 3 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in chopped chives.

title: Beet Chicken (Bissensalat)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh beet, scrubbed | 6 medium bone-in skinless chicken breasts | 1/3 cup fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Cut 2 1/2 inch slits crosswise in top of each beet to help prevent bitterness, and place on baking sheet.  Bake until just tender, about 40 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Meanwhile, trim beet root ends using a vegetable peeler, cut lengthwise in half, then slice crosswise into 1/5 inch slices, reserving peel.  Cut each piece lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices.  Transfer beets and chopped stems and reserved beet stems to a bowl, then toss with reserved beet stems and their liquid.  Arrange chicken breasts on top of beet mixture, sprinkle with thyme, and turn to coat.  Arrange chicken pieces on a serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: peanut,pea carrot,dark rum,quinoa,almond extract,mustard seed,chili powder,white bean
title: Dees Red Beans & Peas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 can white beans, drained ( bush's red beans ) | 2 ounces dried peas and carrots | 1/3 cup slivered almonds or 1/3 cup slivered almonds | 1/3 cup peanuts, chopped | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Heat mustard seeds in skillet over medium heat for 1 minute or until they pop.  Add beans and carrots and cook until heated through, about 6 minutes.  Add almonds.  Add rum, chili and almond extract.

title: Pears in Mustard and Almonds
ingredients: 2 large firm ripe pears, peeled, cored and cut into thin strips or wedges | 2 tablespoons whole grain mustard | 1 teaspoon curry leaf | 2 teaspoons slivered almonds | 1 slice dry dates, halved | 1 teaspoon ground almonds | chicken meat, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Arrange pears on lightly oiled baking tray.  Bake, stirring every 5 - 8 minutes, for 15 minutes until crisp.  Remove to a plate and set aside.  Place ground almonds in the bowl of a food processor.  Add dates and nuts and pulse to chop them.  Add mustard to food processor and blend until smooth.  Drain pears well and arrange in a single layer on the tray.  Sprinkle pears with almond meal.  Cook, turning, until pears are just soft.  Stir into mustard mustard mixture and cook, stirring, until mustard is slightly caramelised.  If mixture seems dry, gently add a little water.  Place mixture in serving bowl and spoon mustard mixture onto fruits.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,deli roast beef,italian dressing,raisin,pasta,beef,yogurt,garlic
title: Easy Italian Beef With Pasta
ingredients: 1 package tri-colored spiral pasta ( i use barilla brand ) | 1 lb sliced deli roast beef | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional ) or 1/2 cup sultana raisin ( optional ) | 3/4 cup italian dressing | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1/2 green bell pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 lb whole grain breaded beef roll, for dipping ( i use pepperidge farm brand ) | 8 ounces deli rolls
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.  While pasta is cooking, combine remaining ingredients except for bread.  Remove meat from marinade in skillet.  Brown meat in the marinade in the skillet, about 10 minutes or until no longer pink.  Remove meat from skillet.  Remove meat from skillet and allow to cool.  Slice meat thinly.  Set aside.  Place bread slices on a plate.  Spread on a layer each with some of the marinade.  Place one piece of meat on top of the bread slices, and repeat until all meat is used.  Place two pieces of the roll in your food processor, and process until dough forms a ball.  Place the rolled out roll on top of the meat and roll into a loaf.  Place the two loaves in a lightly greased baking dish.  Bake at 350 degrees for 30 - 40 minutes or until loaf is browned, and tops are bubbly.

title: Roasted Ham and Spinach Patties (Parma Con Ceci)
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground ham ( or pro-activio ) | 1 box fresh spinach, washed | 6 -8 ounces pecorino cheese, cut into 8 squares ( optional )
instructions: Place ham in a skillet with a lid set over medium heat and cook slowly until it is cooked, but not browned, about 10 minutes.  Break up any clumps with your fingers as your cooking and stir in the spinach.  When done, add the pecorino cheese and cook to melt the cheese.

title: Easy Toasted Feta
ingredients: 1 package brown sugar, packed | 3/4 cup marinade | 2 tablespoons fresh orange zest | 12 ounces feta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine brown sugar, marinade, orange zest and feta in a bowl.  Spread mixture on a sheet of parchment paper and toast for 15 minutes.  Cut into squares and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin,self raising flour,swiss cheese,cream mushroom soup,pistachio
title: Pumpkin & Swiss Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin, chopped | 1 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1 can pumpkin soup | 1/4 cup unsalted butter | 3 cups self-raising flour, sifted
instructions: Cook pumpkin in a pan of boiling water for approximately 10 minutes or until tender.  Drain thoroughly and return to pan.  Heat remaining ingredients in a pan, stirring well after each addition.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour into ovenproof dish and bake uncovered at c until well heated through and top is golden brown.

title: Roasted Brisket
ingredients: 1 jar pimento pepper - sliced dry pimento peppers | 1 can condensed beef consomme | 4 pounds beef brisket, trimmed with excess fat and silver skin removed | 1 teaspoon grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Cover a 2 1/2 quart baking dish or dutch oven large enough to accommodate the beef brisket with water, with pimentos.  Place the brisket in the pan and cover with sliced pepper slices.  Cover the brisket with beef consommé.  Cover, and bake 2 1/2 hours.  Drain liquid, reserving liquid.  Arrange brisket in a roasting pan.  Sprinkle brisket with romano cheese.  Cover and bake 15 minutes.  Remove brisket from oven, and remove the foil.  Bake about 1 hour more, basting frequently with the pan liquid until just tender.

Random Ingredients: coffee,maple syrup,bulgur,fontina cheese,tabasco sauce,ginger ale,white pepper
title: Spiced Baked English Burritos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground round | 4 ounces fontina cheese, cut into 2 equal squares | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons brewed coffee | 1/8 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon maple syrup, plus additional for serving | 1 cup bulgur, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground white pepper from the mill
instructions: Place the first five ingredients in large mixing bowl and mix well together using your hands.  Add tabasco sauce and maple syrup.  Mix well to combine.  Spread half of the spiced bulgar over the bottom and halfway up the side of a buttered ovenproof baking dish.  Spoon the spiced spiced bulgar around the bulgar.  Spread the remaining spiced bulgar over the bulgar.  Dot with remaining butter.  Cover with foil or parchment paper and bake in preheated 350f oven for 40 minutes.  Remove from oven and top with additional maple syrup.  Bake until top is well browned.  Serve as soon as out of the oven.

title: Cotija Cheese Balls
ingredients: 200 g plain breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons cotija cheese
instructions: Crush the cheese in a garlic press with a rolling pin until it resembles breadcrumbs.  Work all ingredients together to form a soft, soft, slightly crumbly ball about 3 cm diameter.  If desired roll small balls into the cheese crumbs, then set aside on an oven tray and flatten slightly.  Bake at about 200c/fan 160c/gas 4 for about 10 - 12 minutes or until golden.  Allow to cool slightly before taking them out of the tray and placing on your greedy finger.

title: Russian Tea
ingredients: 1 tablespoon black pepper | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons strong tea
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill until ready to use.

title: Figs With Mushroom Butter
ingredients: 1/4 lb dried shiitake mushroom, soaked in warm water for 1/2 an hour | 1/4 cup butter | 1/2 lb dried currant, cut into small pieces | 1/4 cup marinara sauce | 1 cup egg white | fennel seed
instructions: Cover mushrooms with water and bring to a boil, then simmer gently for 15 minutes.  Remove from heat, drain, reserving 1/2 cup cooking liquid and mushrooms.  Melt butter in a frying pan and fry currants until browned.  Remove from heat and stir in currants until coated, set aside.  To make figs, spread butter in a small ovenproof dish, then cover with mushrooms.  Spread marinara over butter.  Smooth top, sprinkle with fennel leaves.  Wrap with double thickness of foil.  Bake at 350°f for 20 minutes.  Cool 5 minutes and slice.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,za'atar spice mix,onion salt,curry powder,crabmeat,jalapeno pepper
title: Curried BBQ Crab
ingredients: 2 lbs crabmeat | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 onion salt, divided | 1 teaspoon ground jalapeno pepper, divided | 1 -2 teaspoon grated lime za'atar spice mix | soy sauce
instructions: Dip bread in soy sauce.  Toss bread in curry powder, onion salt, half of the jalepenos, 1 tablespoon of the lime peel, and 1/4 teaspoon of the kosher salt.  Let sit 30 minutes in the refridgerator, stirring every few minutes.  Rinse crab well with cold water, then transfer to a skillet.  Add remaining jalepenos and the remaining lime peel, soy sauce, and remaining kosher salt.  Lightly saute until crab is slightly pink inside.  Serve immediately.

title: Domingos De Pina [Fried Veal Liver]
ingredients: 1 slice pancetta, finely chopped | 1 lb veal liver, cut in thin strips | 4 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Cook pancetta in frying pan until light golden brown.  Drain off excess fat and slice into strips.  Meanwhile, dry fry liver strips by pouring fat into fry pan.  Fry until they are browned a little, drain.  Turn up heat and fry liver strips until cooked through and golden.  Tear off a piece of kitchen twine and use to lift liver mixture from pan.  Serve with toasted pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,self rising flour,greek yogurt,peanut oil vegetable,tomato,clam juice,mayonnaise,pecorino romano cheese
title: Spicy Tomato & Peppercorn Lentil Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentils or 1/2 cup green lentils, washed, soaked until they have swollen, drained | 2 cups self rising flour ( or plain gluten-free flour ) | 1 cup light mayonnaise | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 cup chopped plum tomato | 1/2 cup finely grated parmesan-romano cheese (, to garnish ) | 1/4 cup peanut oil or 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 3 -4 minced clams in juice ( optional )
instructions: Combine lentils with 3 cups of water in large pan.  Bring to a boil.

title: The Best Tacos
ingredients: 8 8 corn tortillas or 8 flour tortillas | 1 pint malt vinegar
instructions: Make the cider vinegar by covering the entire surface with some vinegar and heating it.  Add half of the salt and vinegar when the vinegar is just starting to boil.  Keep going over the vinegar as it boils away and use a paper towel to drain the vinegar.  Wrap each tortilla with a little piece of corn tortilla.  Cook over a medium high heat until the tortillas begin to smoke, being careful to not get burned.  Flip them around and continue cooking until all the sides are crispy.  The tortilla should be crunchy and slightly crisp.  Use a paper towel and eat as you like but can also be served with your favorite dip.

title: Italian Sausage and Broccoli Bread
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups loosely packed fresh rhubarb | 1/2 cup fresh broccoli, trimmed | 1/2 cup sliced leeks or 1/2 cup white onions | 4 italian sausages, halved lengthwise | 1 large red cabbage, cored and shredded or shredded into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup fast rising yeast
instructions: Rinse and drain the rhubarb, broccoli and leek.  Cut the sausage into strips about 1/4 inch wide and 3 1/2 inches long.  Arrange them in a medium mixing bowl and cover with salted water.  Soak for 30 minutes.  Drain and discard the water from the sausages.  Using a food mill or your fingers, make a paste with the ginger and flour to form a smooth paste.  Add the paste to the warm sausages and stir gently, adding more flour, if necessary to form a thick batter, until the batter is smooth.  Transfer the batter to a greased 9 x 5 loaf pan.  Spread the rhubarb, broccoli, onions, and cabbage evenly over the batter and sprinkle evenly with sausages.  Dissolve the yeast in a small amount of the warm water, then sprinkle a little over the top.  Cover the loaf pan loosely with a kitchen towel and place in a warm, draft free place until doubled in bulk.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Bake for 120 minutes, then remove the loaf pan from the oven.  Turn the crock pot on high, then transfer the loaf pan to a wire rack and let stand for 10 minutes.  Turn out the bread on to a platter and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,avocado,feta cheese,italian dressing,tilapia fillet,active yeast,red wine vinegar
title: Greek Feta and Avocado Flatbread
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup shredded feta cheese | 1 large ripe avocado, pitted and peeled | 1 1/2 pounds tilapia fillets, cut into large chunks | 1/4 cup almond paste, chopped | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, dissolve the yeast in the white wine and about 1/2 cup of the feta cheese.  Let stand for 10 minutes, or until bubbly.  Turn the mixture out onto a surface to rise.  Add the avocados, tilapia, and almond paste.

title: Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1 pork roll | 1 -2 slice swiss cheese or 1 -2 slice gruyere cheese | 1 hoagie roll
instructions: Spread the bread with the cheese.  Re place the roll and slice it as close to the edges as you can.  Place the rolls in a skillet over medium heat, turning occasionally, until the loaves have begun to brown, 7 - 9 minutes.  If necessary, place a cutting board or heavy object over the sandwiches to keep them from unrolling.  Remove the rolls and slice each diagonally and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,bailey irish cream,egg,lettuce leaf,russet potato,poblano chile,espresso
title: Mini Smoked Eggs With Chocolate-Flavored Tempura
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 1/4 cup espresso or 1/4 cup brewed coffee, cold | 1/4 cup baileys irish cream | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 12 lettuce leaves | 4 large egg, hard-boiled ( optional ) | 1 russet potato, baked ( optional )
instructions: Wrap a 1/2 inch piece of cheesecloth in foil.  Set aside.  Place poblanos on pan and grill over direct heat, turning occasionally, until skins are blackened, 15 to 20 minutes.  Transfer poblanos to a metal bowl, remove charred outer skin, and coarsely chop.  Pour espresso or coffee through a meat grinder, discarding solids, and process chiles for 1 minute to release remaining chile juice.  Set aside.  Heat oven to 425 degrees f.  Pour chile juice into a bowl and stir in baileys and ketchup.  Spread poblanos on cookie sheet and roast until slightly charred but still soft, 5 to 7 minutes.  Remove poblanos from oven and transfer to a bowl.  Gently loosen skins from foil and peel off foil.  Break poblanos into very small pieces and coarsely chop.  Place poblanos in a mixing bowl.  Add lettuce and cover and set aside in fridge.  Slice potato into 4 wedges, and add to poblanos in bowl.  When potato is cold, cut into small slices, and add to bowl.  To serve, scoop a small mound of egg onto lettuce leaf.  Top with cheese/parmesan/avocado mixture, and roll up.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate molasses,plain yogurt,cream tartar,chorizo sausage,tomato paste,dark brown sugar,avocado,marjoram
title: Chorizo and Avocado Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces chorizo sausage, casings removed | 1 tablespoon plain yogurt | 1 small ripe avocado, peeled and cubed ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1/4 cup pomegranate molasses | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato paste ( see note in description ) | 1/4 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon fresh marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Using a food processor or blender smooth chorizo.  Add yogurt and process until mixture is fairly smooth. .  If mixture appears dry add more liquid. .  In a small bowl mash together the avocado, remaining ingredients.  Spoon into a small serving bowl.  Top with sour cream if desired.  Chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Yogurt in a Hurry (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 7)
ingredients: 600 ml plain yogurt, thickly-curly | 1/4 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Line 2 serving plates with baking paper.

title: Corn & Caramelized Pecans & Corn
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked penne pasta, preferably whole grain | 1/4 cup fine breadcrumbs | 1 cup chopped pecans, or to taste | 2 cups diced baby corn | 1 cup currants | 1 teaspoon mixed spice, or to taste | 1/3 cup pecan pieces
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add penne pasta and cook for 13 minutes or until al dente.

title: Strawberries
ingredients: 4 fresh strawberries | 4 -6 ounces tuna steaks
instructions: Slice strawberries lenghtwise, put in a bowl.  Squeeze as much juice out as possible and put in freezer.  Slice tuna steaks into 1/4 inch slice.  Put tuna in pan and cover with strawberries.  Poke each one lightly with a fork then bake in 450f oven for about 10 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: wood chip,dark soy sauce,nori,kosher salt,green curry paste
title: Steamed Moong Green Curry Onigiri
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 2 teaspoons light-colored soy sauce | 1 sheet nori, seaweed sheets cut into very thin slices
instructions: Preparation directions, heat a steamer set to high heat.  Toss the sushi nori in a large bowl with 2 tablespoons hot tap water to soften.  Combine the curry paste, dark soy sauce, 1 teaspoon of salt, and light-colored soy sauce in a small bowl, and stir together until the salt and soy sauce are combined.  Drizzle about half of the peanut oil into a large, deep skillet, and place over medium high heat.  Add the nori and cook until the surface turns lightly brown, about 1 to 2 minutes.  Turn the nori with tongs so the excess spray adheres to the surface.  Carefully lay the nori on top of two fried nori slices, and gently pierce each one with a skewer.  Sprinkle the fried nori with remaining salt and soy sauce mixture.  Let cool in the refrigerator 3 to 5 minutes.  Serve with white basmati rice and green vegetable.

Random Ingredients: herb,vodka,anchovy fillet,coffee,ranch dressing mix,corn tortilla chip,meat
title: Kellymac
ingredients: 2 lbs minced steak | 1 envelope ranch dressing mix | 1 cup good strong coffee ( hot or non-hot ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons anchovy fillets | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs ( or less ) | crushed corn tortilla chips | extra coffee ( to cover ) or water ( to cover )
instructions: Mince the meat, then mix with all remaining ingrediants except the crushed tortilla chips.  Set aside while preparing the soup.  Spray a frying pan with olive oil or butter.  Heat oil to about 180 degrees celsius.  Using a cookie cutter, cut slits across the bottom of pan and fry slits until golden brown.  Serve in a bowl with crackers sprinkled over the top.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,sun tomato oil,raisin,agave nectar,shell pasta
title: Caramelized Onion Toss
ingredients: 3 cups diced peeled tart apples | 1 cup raisins | 1 cup agave nectar | 1 bag shell pasta | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped
instructions: Place diced apple in a nonstick skillet.  Add raisins, agave nectar and water.  Place skillet over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,cucumber,sea salt black pepper,beef brisket,graham cracker
title: Sha's Favorite Corned Beef With Lentils & Grapes!
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef brisket | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 2 cans organic brown lentils, drained, picked over and rinsed | 1 1/2 lbs medium cucumbers ( halved lengthwise ) | 1 graham cracker
instructions: Place the meat, fat side up in a baking dish.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Cover tightly and refrigerate for 4 - 6 hours.  Remove from the refrigerator and let come to room temperature.  When ready to cook, drain the meat and slice into 2 inch wide by 3 inch long pieces.  In a large heavy pot, layer the meat and the lentils, cucumber halves and the cheese.  Cover and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes, periodically pressing and tossing the vegetables with a wooden spoon until the beef is evenly shredded.  Add water to cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender, about 1 hour 15 minutes.  Transfer the dish to a serving platter with a slotted spoon and let rest for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,thai fish sauce,chipotle chile adobo,walnut half,white breadcrumb,prosciutto,self raising flour
title: Namibian Chipotle Nut Roll - Chipotle Croquettes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped walnut halves | 1/2 cup coarsely ground roasted vegetables, such as arugula, mint, pine nuts, pecans and hazelnuts | 200 g fresh white breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup finely chopped chipotle chile in adobo | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 2 cups self-raising flour | 3 slices prosciutto, chopped, cut into 1 cm chunks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c.  Line a 25cm loose bottomed roasting tin with non stick baking paper, allowing paper to extend over sides of tin above the rim of the tin.  Toss walnut halves with walnuts, roasted vegetables, breadcrumbs, chipotle and fish sauce in a bowl.  Place mixture on a work surface and roll into about 20cm/ 1 inch rolls.  Transfer to the lined tin and scatter with the prosciutto pieces.  Transfer to the oven and roast for 15 - 20 mins or until golden and cooked through.  Cool for 10 mins so that the nuts can absorb the flavours of the eggroll.  Serve warm.

title: Spanish Pecan Crumble
ingredients: 2 -3 cups pecan halves, toasted | 1/4 cup sweet marsala wine, for topping
instructions: Sprinkle the toasted pecan halves with a little water.  Combine the marsala and reserved pecan halves in a mixing bowl.  Stir in the pecan mixture into the dry ingredients and mix in well using a fork or a pastry blender.  Cover top with a clean damp cloth and allow to sit for 1/2 an hour before serving.  Serve this dish with any french loaf and the remainder of the marsala.

title: Bread Machine Tahini
ingredients: 1 3/4 teaspoons yeast | 1 3/4 cups tahini ( sesame seed paste )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the tahini.  Place the yeast and tahini into your bread machine in the order specified.  Use the dough cycle and start. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Brush tops on dough.  Place loaves on a sheet pan and bake for 15 minutes, or until bread is browned, bubbly, and no longer sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,chicken bouillon,vegetable oil cooking spray,ancho chile,sausage,saffron,orange peel,jalapeno pepper

Place in a 9 x 13 inch baking pan & bake in preheated oven until bubbly, about 30 minutes.

title: French Fried Onions (Lebanese)

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet.  Add the scallions and fry over medium heat till they're limp and beginning to sizzle.  Remove the scallions from the skillet with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper towel.  Remove all but about 2 tablespoons of oil and return skillet to heat.  Add the onions and cook till they are a rich golden color.  Add the vermouth and cook for 3 - 4 more minutes.  Serve in a serving bowl with toasted pita halves.

Random Ingredients: tahini,banana,spicy brown mustard,rotel tomato chilies,flour tortilla
title: Spicy Banana Quesadillas

instructions: Preheat oven to slice bananas into rounds about 3 or 4 thick on a baking sheet.  Spray with cooking spray.  Heat in oven for 5 minutes.  Mix tomatoes in medium bowl until smooth, stir in souse.  Heat tortilla in microwave until hot.  Spread with a small scoop of mustard.  On a tortilla spread about 1/4 of the tomatoes, souse with a little sauce and top with half of the bananas.

title: Fresh Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 2 cups watermelon, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns, or to taste
instructions: Combine watermelon cubes and sichuan peppercorns in a bowl.

title: Caribbean Pork With Mushrooms (Coxinhas De Porcini)

instructions: In a bowl, mix peanut butter, pumpkin puree, fajita seasoning, and pork tenderloin slices.  Mix in garlic, parsley, and mushrooms.

title: Cajun Quarter Pounder Cocktail
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces catsup | 1 1/2 ounces coke liqueur | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons pickle juice | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 4 slices provolone cheese | 1/2 mandarin orange, rind removed, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1/2 slice provolone cheese

title: Italian Baked White Batter
ingredients: 2 packages white chocolate baking squares | 2 tablespoons crushed oregano leaves, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Place baking squares into 2 8x2 inch pieces on an ungreased baking sheet.  Lightly butter the tops and sides of the squares with melted white chocolate.  Sprinkle with oregano.  Bake in the preheated oven until chocolate is melted and top is golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sherry,jicama,arborio rice,bourbon,sun tomato oil,chicken stock cube,savory
title: Jicama Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 500 g jicama, peeled, halved and diced | 1 liter chicken stock or 1 liter vegetable stock | 1/2 tablespoon dried savory | 1 tablespoon dried cherbon ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 cups arborio rice, cooked
instructions: Put the rice in a large saucepan with 1 litre stock.  Bring to the boil over high heat.  Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Cover the pot and simmer for 10 minutes, until most of the liquid has been absorbed.  Remove from the heat and allow to stand, covered, for 10 minutes.  Fluff with a fork, ladle into 2 warmed serving bowls, sprinkle with the chopped sun dried tomatoes.  Enjoy note, these can be cooked in the oven, but the aroma is subtle and the savory smell is perfect when served in a shallow dish.

title: Tempeh Tacos
ingredients: 1 package tempeh ( hawaiian style, or you could try regular tempeh ) | 4 limes ( the juice of one large limes should also be added )
instructions: Preheat grill pan for direct medium or medium high heat.  Remove the tempeh from packaging, slice them and place on a large plate.  Drizzle lime juice over tempeh and sprinkle with salt.  Grill for about 15 mins and turn several times, until slightly charred.  Turn tempeh over to grill and continue grilling for another 15 mins, or until the tempeh gets some grill marks.  Serve with your favorite taco toppings.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom,phyllo dough,sausage,snow pea,shiitake mushroom,new potato,salsa,russet potato
title: Sweet Potato and Sausage Phyllo Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb medium smoked sausage | 5 ounces new potatoes, peeled | 2 medium russet potatoes, cut into cubes 1/2 inch thick | 1/4 lb snow peas | 1/4 lb mushroom, sliced thin | 1 pinch green cardamom | 2 cups fresh salsa | 5 sheets phyllo dough, thawed if frozen and kept covered | 16 ounces salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Cook sausage in a medium saucepan over medium heat until browned, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes.  Remove sausage with a slotted spoon, leaving drippings in pan.  Place in a bowl.  Add potatoes and snow peas to sausage drippings in pan.  Reduce heat to low.  Cook until tender, about 20 minutes.  Transfer potatoes and snow peas to a plate.  Remove sausage meat from skillet, discard drippings.  Increase heat to medium high.  Add mushrooms and cardamom to sausage drippings in pan.  Reduce heat to low.

title: Walnut Rice
ingredients: 1 cup walnut pieces | 1 1/2 tablespoons oil | 4 cups rice ( arborio or parisienne ) | 1 1/4 lbs gruyere cheese or 1 1/4 lbs fontina
instructions: Soak the rice in plenty of hot water for a couple of hours.  In a large, deep bowl, crush the walnuts by hand or in a blender.  Heat the oil in a large, deep frying pan and fry the walnuts until they turn a golden brown color.  Remove to a paper towel lined plate to drain.  Add the cheese to the oil a few minutes before the rice goes brown.  Break up with a spatula, stir into the cheese and cook over medium heat, stirring, until soft, stirring often.

title: California Green Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 pound cooked brown rice
instructions: Toss lettuce with brown rice in a salad bowl.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,pork shoulder,asafoetida powder,ginger garlic paste,black peppercorn
title: Shredded Pork Roast (Murgh Makhani)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder | 3 sprigs fresh ginger-garlic paste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorn | 3 -5 red pepper flakes | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( hing )
instructions: Rinse meat.  Cut any excess fat off the meat, and discard the white membrane sections and impurities that float to the surface.  Rinse meat in cold water, and pat dry.  Rub ginger garlic paste around the meat and place the remaining 1 tsp of ginger garlic paste in the center, and sprinkle the peppercorns and red pepper flakes on top.  Wrap the meat and tie with twine.  Rub mixture all over the meat.  Tie the meat around the meat and tie the roast at regular intervals.  Place meat into large pot, and add enough water to cover it.  Cover the pot, and put on the fire for approximately 3 hours.  Skim any scum that rises to the surface.  You may take the stove top pot and use that to steam the meat.  It will catch fire and burn on the top.  Do not stir during this time or it will burn.

title: Garam Masala Prawns With Shrimp
ingredients: 400 g shrimp, uncooked | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 20 g horseradish, grated | 1/4 cup green olives
instructions: Preheat oven to c.  Peel and devein the prawns, leaving the shells intact.  Put all ingredients except prawns and olives into a large ovenproof dish.  Mix well with a fork until the mixture is well combined and the prawns are coated in the mixture.  Bake in the middle of the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until the prawns are pink and just cooked through.  Serve with plain basmati rice or naan bread.

title: Lentil & Syrup Baked Pastries
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 2 packets powdered caster sugar | powdered syrup or cream, to serve
instructions: Rinse the lentils and cook in a saucepan of boiling water until tender.  Place lentils in a mixing bowl.  Sprinkle over the caster sugar and mash them well with the back of a spoon.  Spread the lentils over a greased baking tray.  Bake in a preheated moderate oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until the syrup is bubbling and golden.  Serve with coulis and whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,salt black pepper,cake flour
title: Chinese Dumplings (Ggae Gee)
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups cake flour | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | chili-garlic sauce
instructions: To make sponge cake flour, use a pastry cutter or sharp knife and cut into 2 inch lengths.  Cut into the centre of the flour and form a well.  Pour the water slowly into the centre.  Stir the ingredients together and then make a well in the centre of the flour.  Drain the water out and use the water to mix the flour and salt together. Divide the dough into about 8 to 10 small balls and roll out into circle 4 - 5 inch diameter.  Take a large spoon and use the tip of the spoon to press each dough circle on to the unbuttered baking tray one half inch thick.  To test if the gee has risen, push a little dough with your index finger in a thick, straight direction.  It should immediately puff up.  If the dough does puff up, you can press and drop a few drops into the centre of the gee and the dough will puff up.  Remove the gee from the tray and place on the kitchen countertop or board to rest for about 10 minutes.  Cut a slit through the back of the spoon to reveal the filling and use to create dimples on the gee.  Sprinkle with chili garlic sauce and serve immediately with rice.

title: Greek Okra and Burgers

title: Banana Steak with Cognac

Top with lettuce and drizzle over the cognac mixture.

title: Peanut Butter and Italian Dressing

instructions: Mix together in a blender until smooth.

title: Haitian Jicama Toast

title: Spicy  Beef  Sloppy Samosas

title: Simple Cheesecake Butter

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit.  Rub and blend the butter into the butter until smooth.  Stir in the beef and season with mustard and white pepper. title: Spanish Caponata

Cover and keep warm.  Serve the caponata warm or cold at room temperature.

title: Oven Polenta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups instant polenta | 1/4 cup dried sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f combine all ingredients in an 8x8 pan, mixing well and pat polenta into an 8x8 pan with parchment paper.  Bake in a preheated oven for 40 minutes.  Remove and cool slightly.  Serve while warm, or store in an airtight container, or wrap with plastic wrap to store up to 1 week.

title: Poblano Peppers Yogurt
ingredients: 250 g greek yogurt | 4 poblano peppers, washed seeded and sliced
instructions: Toast the peppers under the broiler until their skin turns black white, about 5 minutes per side.  Remove peppers from broiler and place in a plastic bag to cool.  After 15 minutes, peel off skin and remove stem.  Place peppers in a blender jar with a little water, and blend until smooth.  In a separate container, combine yogurt and 1/4 c pomermano powder and mix well.  Fold in cooled pepper mixture and strain mixture into a bowl.  Chill for 1 hour then serve.

title: Chile Con Coco (No-Yeast Version) - My Favorite Recipe
ingredients: 250 g chile con coco | 900 ml light cream of chicken soup | 300 ml good quality coconut milk | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 packet hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing mix | 200 g medium udon noodles ( about 1 1/4 cups cooked per package directions )
instructions: Place the chile con coco in a wide shallow pan with the cream of chicken, and bring them to the boil. title: Crabmeat With Mushrooms

instructions: Rinse chicken breasts and cut into thirds.  Remove wing tips and excess fat.  Place chicken in a large pot and fill with water to just below the surface.  Bring to a boil. title: Pineapple Mashed Dressing

instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, toast the pistachio nuts until golden about 3 - 5 minutes.  Let cool slightly and chop coarsely.  Set nuts aside.  Place shrimp in a bowl and add 1/2 cup cold water and half the cinnamon sticks.  Let stand 10 minutes to soften.  Remove shrimp.  Rinse shrimp well and pat dry with paper towels.  Cook rice and allow shrimp to cool, approximately 20 - 25 minutes.  Add the remaining cinnamon and season with more salt if needed. Place rice on the pan, raise heat to high and add the mixture, cook about 4 - 5 minutes.  Transfer rice to a platter.  Reduce heat to medium and add the remaining cinamon or orange blossom water and grand marnier to taste.  Cook 1 - 2 minutes.  Serve shrimp, cranberries, pistachios, and remaining nuts on top.

Leave the figs in, stir once or twice, then pour into ice cream cones and leave to cool.

title: Hot Mexican Chicken

instructions: In a heavy frypan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium.  Season chicken with cayenne pepper, if desired.

title: Cucumber Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1 cup bulgar wheat ( cracked wheat ) | 1/2 cup cucumber - peeled, seeded, and chopped | 2 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Place the cracked wheat in a bowl, cover with water, and let soak overnight.  Add the drained wheat, cucumber, bacon, and dill together in a skillet over medium heat.  Cover, and simmer until thickened, 20 to 30 minutes.  Stir frequently.

title: Lettuce Wrapped in Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 kg lettuce wrapped in sour cream | 1 1/2 kg lettuce | 1 kg apple, skinned and grated ( i used a mix of apple and plum ) | 1/3 cup soy milk | 3 tablespoons lemon juice, from squeezable lemons | 1 1/4 teaspoons mustard | 1 tablespoon brown sugar, see note
instructions: Place lettuce on a tray, top with grated apple and drizzle with soy milk to cover.  Combine the lemon juice, mustard, brown sugar and lemon juice and use to glaze the lettuce and sour cream.  Note, to make Sour cream in advance of serving toss sour cream with lettuce and fruit, then coat with sour cream before serving.

title: Low-Cal and Gluten Free Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 250 g cherry tomatoes ( a combination of red plum, grape tomatoes and/or kalamata ) | 5 tablespoons xanthan gum
instructions: Slice tomatoes and arrange on a tray in a single layer.  Sprinkle with xanthan and toast in a preheated oven at 220°c for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden brown and softened.

title: Squash, French Bread & Bourbon-Wrapped Skewers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon bourbon whiskey | 1/2 teaspoon mild paprika | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried sweet basil leaves | 4 slices country-style bread | 8 skewers, 4 x 6, cut about 3/4 inch ( i like red oak skewers )
instructions: Prepare grill.  In bowl, combine worcestershire sauce, bourbon or apple liqueur and next 5 ingredients.  Thread 16 skewers onto a metal rack.  Brush on oil, sprinkle with salt & pepper.  Grill skewers about 6 minutes, turning skewers after 1 minute or so, until cooked through.  Transfer to a serving platter and serve with sauce.

title: Japanese-Style Fresh Vegetables (Tatsuta No-Yake)
ingredients: 4 cups frozen mixed vegetables ( see note ) | 1 1 cup frozen canadian bacon, crumbled | 1 cup frozen peas and/or vegetables | 1 cup dashi ( or more ) | 1/2 cup prepared ginger ale, or as needed | 1/4 cup shredded fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: Note, for variety, try orange soda or ginger ale with added sugar.  Note, dried fruit like currants, raisins, cherries, and apricots can also be used in place of the regular canadian bacon.  Dump the frozen vegetables into a large bowl, add the bacon and peas.  Use your hands to mix well, then stir in the dashi.  The mixture should be thick and the peas and vegetables coated with the dashi.  You can also add fresh mint leaves to the mix, if desired.  Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to meld.

title: Baked Gnocchi Cannellini
ingredients: 1 lb dry cannellini beans | 14 ounces chopped tomato & green chilies | 1 lb ricotta cheese | 1 loaf bread, cut in 3/4-inch cubes | 1 package gnocchi
instructions: Place the soaked beans in a pot of water and bring to a boil, lower the heat and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until tender.  Drain the hot water from the beans and place in a bowl.  Add the chopped tomatoes and green chilies.  Mix well.  Remove the bean liquid from the heat, then cool the mixture and add it.  Set the mixture aside.  Remove the bread cubes from the package of gnocchi, and set aside.  Preheat an oven to 375 degrees.  Combine the sauce ingredients in a blender and blend to a creamy puree.  Mix the gnocchi and sauce in a casserole that has been lightly coated with cooking spray.  Spread the mixture over the base of the dish and bring to a simmer.  Spoon the gnocchi mixture over the pan and sprinkle with croutons.  Bake in the 400 degree oven until the crouts are golden.

title: Tatties (From a Flavorful Momma's Recipe)
ingredients:
1 cup finely diced salt pork | 1/2 cup finely chopped sweet onion flakes | 2 tablespoons tamari ( optional.
    - see note in description ) or 2 tablespoons soy sauce ( optional.
    - see note in description ) | 1/8 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and stir to combine.  Refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine pasta,water,parsley leaf,red leaf lettuce,creole seasoning,lime wedge
title: Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 cup water | 1 package fettuccine pasta | 12 large red leaf lettuce - rinsed, dried, and torn into pieces | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves | 12 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat.  Coat grill with cooking spray.  To prepare salad dressing, whisk together creole seasoning and water in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil over hot, then remove from heat.  Add pasta and cook according to package directions.  Drain pasta well.  Stir lettuce, parsley, and lime wedges into pasta.  Pour dressing over salad and toss.  Serve at once.

title: Apple and Peach Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces mexican cheese, shredded | 4 medium apples, cored & amp, grated | 1 cup water chestnut, cut diced | 1 can peach slices, drained | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds, toasted
instructions: Place the cheese, apples, water chestnuts, peaches, sherry, fennel seed, and 1/2 tsp salt in a baking dish and bake at 350 f for 20 minutes or until the cheese has melted and turned a light brown.

title: Ribollita
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled ( about 20 medium ) | 1/2 lb cottage cheese | 1/2 lb pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place potatoes, cottage cheese, 1/4 cup chopped basil, 1/4 cup pecorino romano, and roasted peanuts in a large bowl and stir until well incorporated.  Pour into a greased 2 1/2 quart glass baking dish.  Bake, uncovered, for about 30 minutes or until top is golden brown and potatoes are tender, stirring every 10 minutes to loosen the bottom crust.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Kartoffelbrot - Norway and Utica-Style Meat Filled Focaccia
ingredients: 750 g lean ground veal | 100 g potatoes starch or 100 g cornstarch | 1 tablespoon instant yeast or 1 tablespoon bread machine yeast | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 80 ml hot mashed potato starch ( for softening dough ) or 80 ml potato starch ( for hardening dough ) | 100 g roasted salted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients in the order recommended by your bread machine in a mixing bowl.  Set the dough to a dough speed on your machine and begin making circles.  Pour 2 tbsp of the potato starch into the center of each circle and, with floured hands, roll 1 to 1 1/2 cm thick ropes about 5 in diameter and 6 in diameter.  Place the dough on a parchment lined baking sheet and brush the top with a little of the remaining potato starch and sprinkle with the chopped peanuts.  Bake the bread for 30 - 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Smokin' Hot Squeak
ingredients: 500 g smokey-smoky cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1/8 cup hot chili oil | 1 bottle light beer ( belgian is best ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chopped bamboo shoot ( from a jar ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: If your cheddar is dry you may need to add a bit more beer.  Cut cheddar into 2 pieces and then cut each slice into 4 pieces.  Combine cheese, tamari, chili oil, beer, hot pepper sauce in a pot or large dish, stirring well.  Heat on medium heat.  Do not allow mixture to boil.  Add cheese cubes and bamboo shoots.  Stir well.  Serve hot.

title: Prosciutto-Crab Spaghetti With Prosciutto
ingredients: 1/4 lb spaghetti | 1/4 lb prosciutto, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices | 2/3 cup triple sec | 1 can whole crab, drained well
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package.  Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot.  Add prosciutto and cook, stirring frequently, 3 to 4 minutes.  Add crab and saute, stirring frequently, until opaque.  Add spaghetti and stir until heated through.  Spoon hot dish onto plates and serve.

title: Chicken With Smoked Corn and Chive Potaoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari | 4 teaspoons peppercorns, cracked | 2 chicken breasts | 1 cup frozen corn, thawed ( i use frozen ) | 3 ounces plain yogurt | 3 ounces low fat chicken broth or 3 ounces low sodium chicken stock | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat a griddle, or large heavy skillet.  In a small bowl, combine the tamari with the cracked peppercorns and rub into all sides of the chicken.  Set the chicken aside.  Scatter the corn over the chicken, brush with the yogurt and put in the skillet.  Cook over medium heat, turning the chicken, until the chicken is no longer pink inside.  Meanwhile, in a small pan, bring the stock to a simmer.  Stir in the peas and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes.  Transfer to a platter, season the chicken with salt and pepper.  Serve with the stock and vegetables that you selected.

Random Ingredients: mint,phyllo dough,ricotta cheese,olive oil cooking spray,pimiento,swiss cheese,ice water,pepperoni
title: Eggless Spanakopita (Phyllo Rolls)
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 4 cups shredded swiss cheese ( about 10 ounces total ) | 2 cups shredded smoked mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons pimientos, drained and seeded | 1/4 cup shredded ripe olives with pimentos or 1/4 cup drained canned green olives | 1/4 cup thinly sliced pepperoni | 2 teaspoons water | 2 tablespoons finely chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Coat baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  Unroll phyllo phyllo dough.  Sprinkle dough with 1 1/4 cups swiss cheese.  Arrange 2 phyllo sheets on buttered baking sheet.  Bake 20 - 22 minutes.  Transfer phyllo sheets to cutting board.  Lightly brush top part of phyllo with nonstick cooking spray.  Cut phyllo crosswise intp 2 strips.  Place 1 phyllo stack, 1 cup cheese, 1 1/4 cup mozzarella, 1 tbsp pimiento, 1/2 cup pimento, 1 tbsp olives and 1/4 cup pepperoni in a stack.  Roll up lengthwise until phyllo is nearly covered.  Place seam side down on baking sheet.  Repeat procedure with remaining phyllo, mozzarella, remaining pimientos and pepperoni.  Bake 10 - 12 minutes until phyllo rolls are golden brown.  Drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons melted butter.  Sprinkle with fresh mint.

title: Lecho Me Makaron (Red Potato Chips)
ingredients: 6 red potatoes, scrubbed | 3 cups chili powder, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning, or to taste
instructions: Place potatoes into a sterile glass or ceramic bowl with a lid.  Fill with boiling water until water is nearly clear.  Tap water out of potato and discard.  Leave in the water for 15 minutes.  Drain and cut into chunks.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Sprinkle chili powder over potatoes.

title: Thai Salt Crackers
ingredients: 500 g plain flour ( approximately ) | 200 g ground roasted peanuts ( in asian supermarket ) | 1 cup peanut butter | 1 pinch table salt | 2 teaspoons fax-a1 1/2 tablespoons x 1 1/2 2/3 teaspoons x 1 pinch table salt ( or other )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until uniform and very criable consistency.  Dough has to be firm so peanuts do not over mix.  If mixture seems too dry, add more flour.  If mixture is too wet add more flour.  Dough will be somewhat sticky.  Use in place of bread dough and roll or stretch dough to about 1/4 inch thick.  Use extra flour if necessary, the fax a little will make it difficult to roll when cutting.  Use a cookie cutter to do this, or a bread maker to do it.  Place onto a greased baking sheet and brush liberally with nonstick spray, place in oven.  Bake in 200°c oven for around 10 minutes or until dark golden brown.  Set on wire rack to cool then store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,beef sirloin steak,tomatillo salsa,italian cheese
title: Peking Steak With Fresh Tomatillos
ingredients: 2 beef top sirloin steaks | 1 jar tomatillo salsa | 1 package shredded italian cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Trim fat from steak.  Arrange meat in a 9 x 11 x 2 inch baking dish, slightly overlapping.  Pour salsa over steak and sprinkle with oregano.  Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to 24 hours.  Preheat broiler.  Remove steak from dish.  Scoop out any excess liquid.  Sprinkle with cheese and broil.  Broil, turning once, 3 to 5 minutes or until well browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil corn,pecorino romano cheese,black cardamom pod,paprika,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheese Flavoured Crispy Rounds With Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 2 teaspoons peanut oil or 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1 black cardamom pod | 1 inch piece sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 medium parmesan rind, cut into 2 inch shreds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Trim the tops and bottoms off the rind of the cheddar cheese.  Slice the cheese into thin circles about 2 inches wide and 2 inches in diameter with a sharp knife.  Using the point of a small spoon, spread about half of the cheddar cheese on each circle.  Sprinkle about 1 tsp salt over each cheddar cheese.  Fold the circles in half over the cheese to form semi circles.  Place the cookies on a tray lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 - 20 minutes.  Remove from the oven and let rest for about 5 minutes before releasing from the parchment.

title: Guinness Poached Pears - Bite Sipper
ingredients: 12 medium sized ripe pears | 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes ( may be omitted if desired ) | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon, more or less to taste | 12 ounces guinness stout
instructions: Peel pears, without rind, and cut away the core with a small sharp knife, setting the stem in tact.  Cut off the hard bottom part of the pear and set aside.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

title: Rigatoni With Currants
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups whole milk | 1 cup dried currant | 1 lb uncooked rigatoni pasta, uncooked
instructions: Bring 3 quarts of salted boiling water to a boil.  Add the pasta, and cook for 8 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Apricot Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 16 dried apricots, chopped
instructions: Place apricots in saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to a boil and remove from heat.  Cover and allow to stand for 20 minutes until cool enough to handle.  Place apricots in blender and add condensed cream of celery soup.  Blend until smooth.  Return to saucepan and remove from heat.  Allow to stand for 20 minutes before serving.  Serve over noodles.  The recipe suggests serving this with sliced crusty bread rounds as a garnish on the completed dish.

title: Langoustine in a Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 1/2 cups bread ( best quality, but recommend hard crust ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1/2 cup white sugar | 3 eggs | 6 ounces clams, shucked | 3 tablespoons horseradish ( or a little crushed horseradish )
instructions: Saute the bacon, garlic, and ham until done.  Dice the ham and fry.  Add the rum and make sure it gets mixed in well.  When done, drain off all the grease.  Now stir in the yeast and cocoa.  Set aside.  You will need to add more bread to make this mixture stick.  Mix bread crumbs salt and pepper with your hands so that they will stick together later.  Add sugar to eggs, and add the egg mixture a little at a time until you get a soft dough.  Do not add flour, it should be sticky.  Put on to jelly roll pan that has been grease proofed, and cover with cloth.  Put in a warm spot for about 10 - 15 minutes until doubled in size.  Put on oven rack.  Take a loaf of bread, sprinkle with salt and pepper and lay on top of your bread.  This should make the bread look like a jellyroll.  Let this rise until doubled in size.  Put loaf on bottom rack of oven.  Slice bread about 1/2 thick on the bias.  Put a clam on top of the loaf.  Cover with plastic and cook for 3 hours on lo until doubled in size.  During the final 15 minutes of cooking, spread horseradish on the bread.  Slice the loaf thinly, and serve with hot mustard, beer, or any other type of sauce to moisten.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,peanut butter,sirloin beef,asparagus,acorn squash
title: Asian Sirloin Fritters for Two
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin beef, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1/3 cup acorn squash, sliced | 4 fresh asparagus, trimmed, woody ends snipped off, and cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup self-rising flour, divided
instructions: In a large skillet, cook beef, peanut butter and squash over medium heat, stirring until beef is done.  Stir in asparagus and 1/2 cup of the flour.  Heat to boiling point.

title: Picante Fritters
ingredients: 6 tablespoons plain flour | 6 tablespoons picante sauce ( we use pace or myzithra ) | 4 tablespoons dried fruit | oil ( for shallow frying ) | parsley leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat oil in large deep frying pan over medium heat.  Whisk together the flour, picante sauce and dried fruit.  Dip fingers into the batter and gently coat the fingers with flour.  Fry the fritters in batches for 3 - 4 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.  Serve with parsley leaves and salsa.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,white fish fillet,beef bouillon cube,cilantro
title: Brazilian Fish
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillets | 8 small celery ribs | 1 1/2 beef bouillon cubes | cilantro ( to taste )
instructions: Cut celery lengthwise in half.  Remove and discard the ends, then cut them in half crosswise and crosswise into 1/4 inch slices.  Sprinkle fillets with bouillon and place onto a plate.  Layer the veggies on fillets in a colander over a bowl, covering them with boiling water.  Reserve enough water to moisten the vegetables.  Place the platter in the center of a preheated 350°f oven until barely beginning to brown, about 7 to 8 minutes.  Transfer fish to a warm serving platter, discard the sauce and sprinkle with cilantro.  Serve at once.

title: Anchovy Paste Snack
ingredients: 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon raisins
instructions: Combine anchovy paste and raisins in a cup.  Spoon into resealable plastic bag.  Seal the bag, and press out excess air.  Chill several hours or overnight.  Snack can also be stored, uneaten, in the freezer for up to two months.

title: Irish Fondue
ingredients: 1 lb floury potato, thinly sliced | 5 -6 green onions, thinly sliced, white and light green parts only | 1/2 cup romano cheese | 1/2 cup sultana ( optional )
instructions: Put the flour in a large serving bowl and add enough water to just cover.  Add potatoes and onions and whisk lightly to mix.  Cover the bowl and refrigerate until the mixture starts to come off the sides of the bowl.  The water should not be too bubbling.  Remove potato mixture from bowl and place on serving dish.  Mash the potato mixture with a potato masher or the back of a fork.  Add the cheese and mix well.  Transfer fondue to a serving dish or saucer.  Garnish with sultanas.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: meatball,sugar,rump steak,rotel tomato chilies,oregano leaf,white onion
title: Sweet Skillet Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb lean meatballs | 1/4 cup uncooked quick-cooking rump steak, cubed | 1 jar rotel tomatoes & chilies, mild | 1/3 cup white onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Prepare instant brown meatballs per package directions using salt and a tsp of salt per package directions.  Combine the meatball mixture with all other ingredients.  You can even freeze half as much for later use.  Place meat mixture in a hot, sprayed skillet over medium high heat and cook, turning often with a wooden spoon, until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom,italian sausage,beef chuck,white pepper,onion powder,wild rice,basil leaf
title: Crock Pot Wild Rice With  Sausages
ingredients: 1 package dried mixed wild rice ( i use the long grain brown rice ) | 1 2 lbs 93 % lean ground beef chuck | 1/2 cup onion powder | 3 tablespoons dried basil leaves | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 2 large red, green or 2 large yellow, green peppers, diced | 1 teaspoon green cardamoms | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian sausage ( optional )
instructions: Place the mixed wild rice in a slow cooker.  In a skillet over medium heat crumble the beef and brown it with the drain onion powder, basil leaves, white pepper and green or yellow peppers.  Add to the slow cooker.  Stir in the cardamom, cover with the lid and cook on a low heat setting for 5 - 6 hours or on high heat setting for 4 - 5 hours.  Serve in a shallow serving bowl sprinkled with the italian sausage, if desired.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,deli ham,heavy cream,half cream,margarine,spinach,vanilla bean
title: Southern Shrimp Dumplings I
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 3/4 pound thinly sliced deli ham | 1/2 cup margarine | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 12 wonton wrappers | 1 small vanilla bean, halved | 3/4 cup half-and-half cream, or as needed
instructions: Lay frozen spinach in a colander, and sprinkle with enough water to cover.  Let stand for 30 minutes to remove excess moisture.  Squeeze excess water from spinach to squeeze to drain, and set strainer in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: basil,spice,ketchup,beef brisket,beef sirloin steak,cinnamon sugar,fruit chutney,macaroni
title: Beef 'n' Macaroni - Sweet
ingredients: 1 lb corned beef brisket | 1 beef sirloin steak, trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | coarse salt and freshly ground dallops mixed spices ( recommended morton's ) | 2 tablespoons mixed spice, or as needed ( mccormick -harvest brand ) | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar | 1 cup dried macaroni, cooked | 1/2 cup ketchup, or more to taste | 1/4 cup fruit chutney
instructions: Season corned beef strips with salt and freshly ground dallops mixed spice to taste.  Let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes.  Cook macaroni in a pot of boiling salted water until al dente, about 8 minutes, drain.  Place cooked macaroni in a shallow bowl or baking dish.  Sprinkle beef and brisket slices on top, then drizzle generously with ketchup, tossing to coat.  Garnish with dried fruit and/or chutney.  Serve with fresh fruit salsa, such as dill pickle chips or salsa fresca or your favorite salsa.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,sage leaf,prosciutto,green chilies,red wine,okra,chard leaf
title: Trinidad Okra
ingredients: 1 bunch okra, washed | 2 bunches chard leaves | 16 chilies | 2 lbs green chilies | 1 1/4 lbs smoked prosciutto ( italian sausage ) | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/4 lime, juice of | fresh sage leaf
instructions: Clean the okra and chard leaves, cutting off any bad looking parts.  Cut each into 2 inch lengths and wash.  Trim chilies and cut into 2 inches lengths.  Wrap prosciutto into a bundle of chilies and twirl them around the okra until the mixture looks like a cigarette.  Put each bundle into a large saucepan, add the wine and lime juice.  Cook over medium heat for 15 - 30 minutes.  Remove okra and chilis from the liquid.  Chop okra into 1/2 inch lengths, add to sauce.  Cover and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring from time to time.  Remove from heat and remove casing.  Place okra mixture into a warm serving dish and keep hot in a low oven with a lid placed on the pan.  Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,butter,cooking sherry,canola oil,part mozzarella cheese,mustard powder,cod
title: Microwave Cod Au Jus (((Wonderful)))
ingredients: 2 lbs cod ( cut into chunks or smaller portions ) | 24 ounces enchilada sauce | 3 ounces butter | 2 ounces quick-cooking sherry | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 12 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese ( thinly sliced ) | 4 tablespoons canola oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Cook cod with seasoning #3852, or follow package directions.  Microwave for 4 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Scallops with Browned Pearl Onions
ingredients: 1 kg bay scallop | 4 -5 pearl onions | 4 ounces chocolate | 1 pinch saffron threads | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 eggplant, sliced lengthwise
instructions: Slit the scallops open with a sharp knife.  Place in a flat ovenproof dish.  Slice the onions thinly, place over the onion slices, and microwave for about 10 minutes, stirring every 2 or 3 minutes or until starting to soften.  Pour any juices that have collected on base of dish into a small saucepan/pan and add the sugar and vinegar.  Stir to dissolve the sugar.  Cover & cook over medium heat for 2 - 4 hours.

title: Tamarind Squares
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 2/3 cup whole wheat flour | 2/3 cup tamarind paste | 1/3 cup vanilla sugar | 1 cup rice flour
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and mix.  With fingers add tamarind paste and mix.  Bake for 30 min in a preheated oven at 180c.

title: Orange Beef and Fruit Lettuce Wrap
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 500 g beef mince | 125 g orange, segments ( sections ) | 200 g lettuce leaves
instructions: Heat oil in wok or frying pan and stir fry mince until browned.  Stir in orange segments, cook briefly.  Warm lettuce leaves on plate, put beef mixture on and top with lettuce leaves.

title: Baked Fettuccine With Avocado-Feta Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces fettuccine, dried | 1/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 6 fresh red chilies, halved | 2 avocados, peeled and diced | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Place dried fettuccine in a large bowl of cold water.  Let sit 10 minutes, then drain.  Place half of crumbled feta cheese, all of the chiles, avocado, and maraszino cherries evenly over dried pasta.  Transfer to 2 large baking sheets.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes, until heated through.  Sprinkle with remaining feta cheese, and serve warm.

title: Grilled Sausages with French Dip
ingredients: 4 pieces sausages | chopped horseradish ( optional ) | white pepper
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium.  Cut each piece of sausagemeat on the bias about 1/2 inch thick, lengthwise.  Spread a little horseradish on each sausage piece.  Sprinkle with white pepper.  Grill for about 10 minutes, or until the sausages are thoroughly cooked and the horseradish is lightly browned.  Serve with crusty french bread.

title: Green Olive & Spinach Soup
ingredients: 4 cups spinach leaves | 1/2 cup green olives, coarsely chopped ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon ghee or 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb | 3 cups ice water
instructions: Steam the spinach leaves until tender, about 1 minute, and put in a sieve to get rid of the liquid.  Set aside the liquid.  Heat the ghee or butter in a saucepan over medium high heat.  If using olive oil, add it now.  When the butter melts and starts foaming, add the chopped frozen spinach leaves.  Stir for a few seconds until it begins to thaw.  Stir in the ground olives and cook for a few more seconds.  Add the bread crumbs and stir until evenly coated in the crumbs.  Add 1 cup of the liquid from the spinach leaves into the pot.  Stir and bring to a boil.  The consistency should be creamy and thick.  Turn off the heat.  Serve in bowls.

title: Mango-mustard Green Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb mustard greens, washed | 3 tablespoons sweet pickle relish ( the sweet & sour flavor ) | 3 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 1 small mango, peeled, finely chopped
instructions: Put the mustard greens in a colander & run cold water over them, until the greens is tender, but not soggy.  Cut all but one end off the greens & gently remove the hard 'hard'stem end from the center.  Pull off a little bit of the stem & discard, then slice off any remaining green, and chop the rest.  Toss the greens with the relish & parsley & refrigerate until served.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,green chili pepper,hot sauce,white wine vinegar,red apple
title: Fish in Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 hot green chili peppers | 2 red apple | 1/2 lb fish fillet ( firm ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons hot sauce
instructions: Cut apples into cubes and fry in oil.  Add fish fillet.  Add hot chili pepper to fry, mix in vinegar and hot sauce.

title: Mexican Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup mashed pumpkin | 1/2 lb ground pork | 1 can chopped green chilies | 6 tortillas | banana leaf
instructions: Mix meat filling, and roll in tortilla leaves.  Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,chickpea,cinnamon,mexican cheese cheddar,curry paste,beef,oyster sauce,penne pasta
title: Moroccan Beef with Noodles, Chickpeas, & Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb penne pasta | 1/4 lb ground beef | 2/3 cup chicken or 2/3 cup turkey and seasonings, mix | 1/3 cup cider vinegar or 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1 can chickpeas, drained, rinsed | 1/4 cup curry paste | 3/4 cup mexican cheese or 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon, plus more for sprinkling
instructions: Bring pot of water to a boil.  Add penne pasta and cook until al dente.  Meanwhile, in a large nonstick skillet, cook ground beef, breaking up with a spoon, over medium heat, until evenly browned, 8 to 12 minutes.  Pour off fat.  Stir in seasonings, vinegar, chickpeas, and curry paste, and bring to simmer.  Stir in pasta and simmer to warm pasta.  Sprinkle with cinnamon before serving.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,pineapple juice,peanut,chipotle chile adobo,butter,lamb,cottage cheese
title: Grilled Lamb With Chipotle Ranch Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces cottage cheese | 16 ounces ground lamb | 1/4 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts, lightly salted ( or cashews ) | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 1/3 cup orange marmalade or 1/3 cup canned pineapple-infused chipotle chutney, drained | store bought hot pita breads ( or other soft breads )
instructions: To make the sauce, in a mini food processor, process the paprika, chile and 1 tablespoon of the butter until it's evenly blended.  In a large bowl, stir the contents of the marmalade with the cottage cheese.  Mix in the pecorino cheese and process just enough to combine, but stop before it becomes a smooth paste, the consistency should be slightly thick.  If it gets too thick, add a little water.  Season with the remaining 1 teaspoon of butter or salt. .  Preheat the grill.  Grill the lamb just to desired doneness, turning once, or to desired doneness, but not overcooking, 12 to 15 minutes per side, or about 20 minutes per side for medium well and slightly longer if your meat seems dry.
