instructions: Brown stew beef and onions in a large heavy pot over high heat for 5 to 10 minutes or until meat is browned.  Stir the bell peppers into beef mixture and add additional beef stew seasoning, if desired.  Cover and simmer until vegetables and meat are tender, about 1 1/2 hours.  Stir in the snow peas and green chiles for about 1/2 an hour before serving.

title: Taro and Eggplant (Aubergine) Slaw
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, cut to 1/4-inch dice | 1 large head of cabbage, cut into 12 wedges | 2 large taro roots, peeled cut into 12 wedges | 1/4 cup toasted or coarsely chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler setting.  Mix the eggplant with the cabbage and taro.

title: Spanish Chicken and Onions
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken fillets | 6 ounces tomato ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Place chicken in casserole dish.  Combine ketchup and onion powder.  Pour over the chicken.  Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,cardamom,pork sausage,spanish onion,cinnamon,tortilla chip,cold water,white flour
title: Easy Sausage Stuffing
ingredients: 1 large white onion, finely diced | 1 1/8 lbs pork sausage | 4 cups unbleached white flour | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, to taste | crushed tortilla chips, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Using a food processor or blender, chop the onions very finely.  Add the sausage and pulse just until it is coarsely chopped, but not completely mushy.  If it is too crumbly add a few tablespoons of oil to the pan.  Add the flour and pulse just until it is pasty.  Add enough water to form a dough that pulls away from the sides as though you were working with it.  If dough is too dry, add water a tablespoon at a time until dough is moist but not sticky.  If it is too dry, add more water and pulse just a bit until dough is moist but not sticky.  You may need to add a bit more water.  The dough should be firm but not stiff.  Turn the dough out on lightly floured board and knead lightly about 5 times.  The dough should be smooth but not stick to the board.  Sprinkle some flour on the board and knead the dough for 4 - 5 minutes.  The dough should be smooth enough not stick to your fingers.  Cut the dough into 2 equal pieces lengthwise and cut each piece into 4, 6 or 8 pieces.  Work on 3 pieces at a time with your hands, adding all the remaining ingredients as you go and kneading each time.  On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough into a rectangle approximately 6 long.  Roll up the pastry jellyroll style, starting at one side, leaving the edges uncovered.  Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour or up to 2 days.  Unwrap the meat mixture, reserving any remaining stuffing.  Use your fingers to remove any excess fat.  Use the meat portion and stuff the tortillas with about 1 1/2 cups of meat mixture.  Sprinkle crushed plastic wrap on top of meat, wrap tightly, and refrigerate at least 24 hours and up to 24 hours.  Preheat oven to 350°f bake for 1 hour.  Remove from oven and cover for the last 15 minutes of baking.  Turn oven off, open the cover, and let the meat cool for about 20 to 30 minutes.  Slice and serve with salsa, sour cream, shredded cheese, or other desired toppings.  Note, a little leftover meat can be placed in a small bowl and frozen for up to 2 months.  To thaw, freeze, transfer to a small freezer bag.  Reheat and reheat the meat mixture in a microwave oven until very hot, about 20 to 30 seconds.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,italian tomato,garam masala,balsamic vinaigrette,chunky salsa,sherry,curry paste,key lime juice
title: Spicy Tomato Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf whole wheat bread | 1 cup chopped italian tomatoes ( approx 1 large ) | 4 tablespoons chunky salsa, such as valentina | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinaigrette ( approx 1 teaspoon ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh key lime juice
instructions: Slice a loaf of bread in thick slices about 1/2 thick.  Soak in a large bowl of water.  The key lime juice doesn't really matter.  Let sit for about one hour.  Meanwhile, prepare tomato puree.  Squeeze a handful of lemon juice, and chop finely.  Measure the rest of the ingredients, and store in a zip top bag.  If your bag has a lot of air, use that to measure the spices and store in a bowl.  Slice toast, and toast until golden brown.  Serve warm with sauce, or a yogurt or guacamole.  Variation, tomato puree can be canned or frozen, refrigerated, and reheated before serving too hot.  Or can be warmed, but then served warm, like your favourite tomato toast.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,cardamom,plum tomato,ghee,tangerine peel orange,white pepper
title: Chakchouka (Sweet Potato )
ingredients: 1 medium yam, peeled, and cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 4 medium plum tomatoes, seeded and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Place yam, creole seasoning, plum tomatoes, white pepper, and cardamom in a non reactive bowl.  Heat 1 tablespoon ghee over medium low heat in a large skillet.  Saute tomatoes until blackened.  Add yam mixture to skillet.

Random Ingredients: herb,mascarpone cheese,red pepper flake,turnip,baking cocoa,poblano chile
title: Sugared Turnip (Mexi-Style Turnips) With Herbs
ingredients: 3 lbs unpeeled turnips, cut into large wedges | 2 cups baking cocoa, sifted | all crushed red pepper flakes | 1/1 cup mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 1/2 cup chopped fresh herb, such as chives, parsley or 1/2 cup scallion, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup pernod ( licorice liqueur )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place wedges in a single layer on a rack lined with parchment paper and roast until lightly browned, about 45 minutes.  Meanwhile, to make the salsa, combine the cocoa, crushed red pepper and mascarpone cheese in a bowl.  Toss well.  Drain the turnips and toss with cheese and salsa mixture.  Season to taste with salt.

title: Hot Italian Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 bottle liquid smoke | 1 lemon peel ( about 1/2 teaspoon grated peel ) | 10 -12 teaspoons black fat, preferably bacon fat
instructions: Strain liquid smoke off of the bottle of liquid smoke, discarding solids.  Pour into medium saucepan, along with lemon peel and fat.  Cover tightly and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.  Cool until cool.  Store in airtight container for up to two months.

title: Spicy Beef Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pancetta, minced | 1 dash green bell pepper, minced | 1 dash asparagus spear, minced | 32 fluid ounces enchilada sauce, spicy | 1/4 cup roasted sweetened coconut, shredded
instructions: Saute pancetta over medium heat until it's soft and brown.  Add asparagus and bell pepper and cook 1 minute on each side.  Add enchilada sauce and coconut.  Heat to boiling and cover.  Cook 15 minutes untill everything is warm.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,beef stew meat,lemon juice,red shallot,raspberry vinegar,italian sausage,lettuce leaf,mango chutney
title: Chutney Beef Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot italian sausage | 2 lemons, juice of | 6 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons red shallots, finely chopped | 12 large lettuce leaves | 1/2 lb beef stew meat, diced into 1/4 inch pieces | 1/4 cup reduced-fat mango chutney | 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar
instructions: Heat a grill pan or a charcoal grill until it is hot.  Remove the casing from the sausage.  Cut the meat into 1/2 inch cubes.  Combine with the lemons, 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce, and 2 teaspoons chopped red shallots in a medium bowl.  Spread the marinade in a shallow dish or platter.  Add the beef and marinate at least 4 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.  Grill or broil the beef until it is browned and crumbly.  Cut into 1/2 inch pieces and arrange on the lettuce leaves.  Top with the beef.

title: Roasted Celery
ingredients: 3 lbs celery ( thick stems cut off ) | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt ( kosher is best ) | 3/4 cup dark brown sugar ( packed ) | 1/4 cup red wine ( good quality )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit.  Cut celery into quarters.  Place in a large ovenproof dish and sprinkle with salt.  Add brown sugar and red wine.  Roast until celery is tender and sugar is caramelized, about 30 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Torta Di Zucca (Chile and Nut Soup)
ingredients: 1 piece nori ( dry seaweed ) | 5 cups chicken broth, if necessary ( low-sodium or low-fat are best ) | 1/2 ounce cacao ( optional ) | 4 dried chile ( dried small hot chilies, pods seeds removed, cut in halves, seeds reserved ) | 4 whole cardamom pods | 100 g gruyere ( shredded ) | 1/3 cup light dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup chopped unsalted nuts ( such hazelnuts or macadamias ) ( optional )
instructions: Soak the nori in boiling water for 30 - 45 minutes, until soft.  Remove each piece and trim off the thin membrane.  Place in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped, then transfer to a bowl.  Wipe the food processor dry with a paper towel and process coarsely.  Set aside.  Add the chicken broth to the food processor and process to a coarse puree, adding a tablespoon of water if the soup has a thick texture, if necessary.  Transfer the puree to a saucepan.  Add the cacao and stir over low heat until dissolved.  Add the chile pods and cardamom pods and bring to a simmer.  Reduce heat and simmer for 5 - 8 minutes, then remove from heat.  Set aside.  Toast the nuts in a dry skillet over low heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 10 minutes.  Set aside.  Using a slotted spoon, remove the pods from the soup and stir into the soup with the brown sugar.  Simmer for 5 minutes, then stir in the nuts.  Serve immediately.

title: Nanas Dessert
ingredients: 1 box vanilla instant pudding mix | 3/4 cup liquid honey
instructions: Prepare jelly roll icing as per recipe.  Once jelly roll icing has cooled spread a layer of jelly roll icing on top of jelly roll icing.  Repeat layers until all jelly roll icing is used.  Once jelly roll icing is used, refrigerate for at least one hour to set all the liqueur.

title: Salsa Corn & Mint Chips
ingredients: 1 ear of corn kernels, husked, cleaned and kernels cut off | 1/2 cup salsa, or to taste | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Fill a pot with water, enough to cover the kernels, and bring to a boil over high heat.  Remove from the heat, cover, and let stand for 5 to 10 minutes.  Drain well, and reserve the water.  In a food processor or blender, puree the corn kernels into the water until smooth.  Stir the salsa into the corn and mint, and let stand for 5 minutes.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,white wine vinegar,stilton cheese,ladyfinger,red chilies,herbes de provence,red potato
title: Chile Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 8 medium red potatoes, unpeeled | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 10 red chilies, seeded and chopped | 8 ounces stilton cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 20 -24 ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Cook potatoes in boiling, salted water until tender, about 10 minutes, and drain.  While the potatoes are cooking, add all of the remaining ingredients except the lady fingers to a food processor and pulse until just chunky.  Add the potato mixture to the cheese and continue to process until the cheese is completely melted and the mixture has a nice sheen.  Remove the potatoes from the oven, and roll them in the herbes de provence.  Place onto a baking sheet and sprinkle with the remaining herbes.  Bake for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.  Serve with chopped parsley.

title: Mexican Potato Gratin
ingredients: 2 large red potatoes, thinly sliced | 1 medium yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb lean bacon, cut into 1 inch pieces | 4 -5 fresh cilantro stems, chopped | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda | fresh parsley stem, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 275°f.  In a medium bowl, toss the potatoes with enough cold water to cover and let sit, about 45 minutes.  Meanwhile, place the green pepper and yellow pepper in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped.  Add bacon, cilantro, sour cream and parsley and pulse to combine.  Place the potatoes into a gratin dish or roasting pan and pour vegetable mixture over.  Sprinkle lightly with baking soda and sprinkle lightly with parsley.  Bake uncovered, stirring occasionally, for about 50 - 60 minutes until tender and most of the liquid has evaporated.

title: Lenten Green Olives
ingredients: 2 pounds green olives, pitted and chopped | 2 stalks chopped sage
instructions: Combine the olives and sage.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 week before serving.

title: Coconut Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can coconut cream | 1 can chicken broth | 2 parsnips, peeled and cut into fourths | coconut cream
instructions: Add beef in crockpot with remaining ingredients to crockpot.  Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.  Turn control to high and cook 15 - 20 minutes or until beef is tender.  Taste, if necessary add 1/4 cup more broth.

title: Thick Mint Beans
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 can yellow mung beans, drained
instructions: Cook and stir mung beans in a skillet over medium high heat until tender, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,graham cracker,chive,chicken breast half,navy bean,chocolate morsel,curry
title: Quick Curried Chicken and Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut bite size pieces | 12 ounces roasted and salted greek-style beans | 12 ounces barilla plus graham crackers | 1/2 cup dark unsweetened chocolate morsel | 2 teaspoons curry | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh maraschino cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place chicken pieces into a large dutch oven.

title: Sausage and Beef Salad (Aka Ritako)

instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees.  Lay meat and cook on cookie sheet, about 3 minute each side or until cooked through.  While meat and veggies are cooking, cut off the ends of both romaine leaves.  Trim off both ends of each leaf and then tear into bite size pieces.  Divide lettuce on a 1 lb.  Package.  Put the meat on the lettuce.  Add desired amount of herbs to lettuce.  Drizzle with a little bit of olive oil if desired.  Roll in the herbs and then eat.

title: Pasta With Red Capsicum Dressing
ingredients: 600 g farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 tablespoon red capsicum, chopped | 1 tablespoon green onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon shallot, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon brandy | 1/8 teaspoon onion salt | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, chopped
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the directions on the pack and drain.  Cool completely.  Combine the pasta with the other salad ingredients making sure you stir well to combine.  Serve.

title: Mexican Seafood Bowl
ingredients: 400 g shrimp ( shrimp ) | 400 g scallops | 400 g baby carrots | 400 g baby tomatoes | 1/3 cup mango ketchup | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon cocoa
instructions: Chop mango ketchup into small pieces.  Slice apple thin, peel and cut into small pieces.  Combine everything, except the cocoa and rice, in a large bowl.  Pour in cocoa and mix thoroughly.  Add rice and mix thoroughly.  Place a generous cup of the mixture into the center of each individual bowl.  Place cocoa in small bowl.  Place curry/tossers in another bowl and put on top of bowls.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,flat leaf parsley,superfine sugar,raspberry,grand marnier

ingredients: 4 ounces raspberry puree or 4 ounces raspberries | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 fluid ounces grand marnier, extra | 1 ounce superfine sugar | 2 -3 drops liquid smoke
instructions: Place the raspberry puree in a saucepan with 4 tablespoons of the grand marnier and bring to the boil, stirring.  Lower heat and simmer 2 - 3 minutes.  Transfer to a large bowl and set aside to cool.  Add the remaining grand marnier and sugar and beat with an electric mixer until dissolved and slightly thickened.  Add the liquid smoke.  Chill 1 hour in t.  Hot water.  Heat the remaining grand marnier just before serving and dip a coulis glass into it.  Sprinkle with the crushed granulated sugar.  Serve on individual plates with the raspberries and grand marnier.

title: Hazelnut Roll-Ups
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas, halved | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup sliced hazelnuts, toasted | 1 can refrigerated french fries ( about 24 ) | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained
instructions: In 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat, arrange half of tortilla halves, overlapping.  Combine cabbage, nuts, and undrained fries.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,cabbage,nutmeg,sea bass fillet,peach,gruyere cheese,orange juice concentrate
title: Poached Sea Bass and Cabbage Salad
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 garlic head, sliced | 2 cans sliced peaches, drained | 2 pounds sea bass fillets | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed orange juice concentrate | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 pound cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray.  Heat a large skillet over medium heat and cook and stir garlic in hot oil until translucent, about 3 minutes.  Stir in onions and continue cooking until golden brown and softened, about 5 minutes more.  Stir in peaches and 2/3 cup orange juice concentrate until the mixture is well blended.  Spread mixture evenly over sea bass fillets and sprinkle with nutmeg.  Arrange cabbage on baking sheet.

title: Lobster Brunch
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey | 1/2 cup chopped white mushroom | 1/8 cup chopped ripe olives | 1 tablespoon grated fresh grana padano or 1 tablespoon freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 tablespoon juice, from the grape | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon white mushroom, chopped ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons sherry ( optional )

Divide among heated plates and garnish with sliced white mushrooms and sliced olives on top.  Serve right away.

title: Healthy Pomegranate Beef Steak With a Yummy Quarter
ingredients: 1 pomegranate, seeded and finely chopped | 1 mandarin orange, skin and all | 8 ounces lean lean boneless beef top round steak | 1 cup stale bread flour | 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 cup raw basmati rice | 1 eggplant, sliced into rounds | pomegranate sauce ( optional, for serving )
instructions: Combine the pomegranate, mandarin orange, beef tips and bread flour in a bowl.  Stir yogurt, taco seasoning and half of the pomegranate sauce into the beef mixture until well blended.

title: Pecan Cheese Spread

instructions: In a medium size bowl, mix the manchego cheese cubes with the pecans and chopped dill weed.  Cover with plastic wrap and press the mixture into a well buttered 9x5 inch square pan.  Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the cheese.  Place under the broiler until golden brown on top and crack on the top.

title: Quick, Easy and Inviting Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 rib roast, trimmed | 1 can frozen lemonade concentrate | 1/2 cup cognac | 6 slices fat-free steaks | 4 slices fat-free lettuce leaves | 6 hamburger-flavored lettuce leaves
instructions: Place the roast in a 9x12 or 8 inch square baking dish and set aside.  In a medium saucepan, combine the lemonade concentrate and cognac over medium heat. Cover with the plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 30 minutes, or until heated through and juices run clear.

title: Prawn Brik
ingredients: 500 g green cardamom pods | 400 g medium white onions, peeled and finely sliced into 1/2 inch rounds | 2 tablespoons curry powder
instructions: Boil the prawns in plenty of water for approximately 10 - 15 minutes.  Drain and keep aside.  Heat a heavy based saucepan on high flame.  Add the cumin seeds, black and green cardamoms and dry curry powder.  Let it splutter.  Add the onions.  Sauté until the onions turn golden brown.  Add the prawns and boil for 1 - 2 minutes.  Cover and leave on a low flame for 5 minutes.  Add 2 - 3 tablespoons of water if necessary to obtain a thick sauce.  The curry is ready when you smell the aroma of the onions and the oil floats to the top of the saucepan on the stove top.  Serve hot.

title: Crock Pot Shrimp With Scallops
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chuck roast, cut into 3 x 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 cups scallops | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 lb large shrimp, shelled and cleaned
instructions: Pour boiling water over mustard seeds and scallops then let stand 10 minutes.  Drain and rinse well.  Combine golden syrup and cardamom.  Dredge shrimp in mixture.  Place in crock pot with mustard, scallops, and syrup mixture.  Cook on high for at least 30 minutes.  Serve on bed of rice.

title: Tofu Chili Paste (Chili Dogs)
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 1 jar roasted red peppers | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste, or more to taste
instructions: Combine tofu, roasted red peppers, chili paste, and enough water to coat the tofu evenly.  Cover and refrigerate until water is rehydrated, about 3 hours.

title: Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1 can green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin ( plus additional for sprinkling on top ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray on one side with nonstick vegetable spray.  Slice the pepper cheeses into 3/4 inch rounds and put in a large bowl.  Cut the ends off the green chilis and cut 1/2 on each side and set aside.  Mix together the mustard, cumin, salt and pepper powder and toss with the pepper and cheese.  Using your hands or a teaspoon, make a patty about 1 inch thick.  Spray a 12 inch nonstick skillet with nonstick spray and heat over medium heat.  When the pan is hot, cook the quesadillas on one side 3 minutes.  Flip and repeat on the other side until the cheese is melted and lightly browned.  Cut into quarters and scatter with the chilis.

title: Mint Salad

instructions: Chop cherries in half, removing pit and pits.  Place cherry halves on a cutting board or other small serving platter or serving bowl that will fit the bread slices inches slice rippled with horseradish.  Place pepperoni slices in a line along one of the short sides of the rippled rye bread slices.  Place pepperoni slices in a line along the rippled rye bread slices.  Top with the cherry halves and place mint sprig on top.  Roll up the slice and enjoy.

Serve with pita bread or your favorite crackers.

title: Red Pepper Pasta

instructions: In a medium heavy pan over medium heat, cook the peppers with the bouillon until they are just beginning to color, approximately 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to the package directions.  When the pasta is almost done, drain and place it in the serving bowl with the peppers.  Gently fold the pasta and contents of the pan, and serve.

title: Portabella Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 3 portabella mushrooms | 2 green chili peppers | 1 chicken stock cube
instructions: Slice one large portabella mushroom and two chilli peppers.  Put all ingredients into a 4 quart pan that has been heated to boiling.  Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes and serve hot.

title: Chef-Boy-I-Be Illinois' Greek Polenta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt ( i get mine from yogies of milk | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal ( or you can add in a little almond milk mixed in a little nonstick cooking spray, like n so )
instructions: In bowl, mix yogurt and italian seasoning.  Mixture should be a little pasty.  Stir in cornmeal and mix well.  Let stand in a cool, dry place for 30 minute.  Lightly spray a 9x9 glass dish with cooking spray.  Put mixture into microwave.  Cook on high about 1 hour, making sure that it is not getting too thick.  If it seems like you need a little more liquid, remove lid, stir.  Cook on high for another 45 minutes.  The cornmeal will crackle on top.  When you remove from microwave, it will look like it is about to be cool, and it will harden on the bottom.

title: Thai Sweet Potato and Corn Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes, medium in size, grated on a coarse grate | 1 head cabbage, finely shredded | 1 cup italian seasoned crumbs | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 tablespoons honey | 1/2 cup fresh greek yogurt | 1/4 cup rocket, to serve
instructions: Preheat a griddle or heavy frying pan over high direct heat.  Dump the grated sweet potato in a large colander and toss it inches when it starts to colour, give it a shake to remove any potato that's stuck and then put it on a plate.  Meanwhile, cook the cabbage in a large pan of salted boiling water for 4 - 5 minutes or until just tender.  Remove the potato from the water and place back in the pan with the cabbage.  Stir, then combine the crumbs and fish sauce in a small bowl.  Add the honey to the yoghurt, stir, then add half of it to the sweet potato, then spoon over 5 tablespoons of yoghurt mixture.  Mix well.

Random Ingredients: shallot,graham cracker crumb,self raising flour,bacon dripping
title: Welsh Bangers and Mash
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/3 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1 onion ( large )
instructions: Mix flour, graham cracker crumbs and bacon dripping with your hands quickly until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs.  Add water a little at a time, mixing as you go, until a dough forms.  Knead until smooth.  Divide into 3 equal portions.  Divide 1 portion of dough between 4 pieces of greaseproof paper, press out to about 1/2 inch thickness.  Brush with a little egg wash.  Place 3 - 4 of these mixtures on a lightly greased oven tray, slightly flatten them so they are not too thick.  Bake at 160°c, for about 25 minutes until golden.

title: Tex-Mex Meatloaf Patties
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated pumpkin pie spice | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 slices bread crumbs | 1 tomato, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried dill, divided | 1 package processed cheese-stuffed french country-style hot roll mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Lightly grease a 9x9 inch baking dish.  Remove 1 can of pumpkin pie spice from the can and pour 1 can of picante sauce in the can.  Spread 1/2 the picante sauce in the bottom of the prepared baking dish.  Add 1/2 the bread crumbs, tomato and 1/2 t dried dill.  Stuff the meat into the dough by placing each piece of meat in the baking dish.  Drizzle with remaining 1 t dried dill, 1 t chili powder, and 1/2 t paprika.  Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until meatloaf is brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,garlic paste,palm oil,fajita seasoning mix,red chili paste,mutton,cumin
title: Prawn and Lamb (Shammi Kari)
ingredients: 250 -400 g mutton, sliced | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf | 1 tablespoon red chili paste | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon palm oil
instructions: Heat oil in a wok.  Toss in the fajita mix and fry for 2 mins.  Add the cilantro and onion and continue to stir fry for 1 - 2 mins.  Add the red chili paste.  Stir fry for 2 mins again.  Add the meat and cook until it is browned, stirring to keep from sticking.  Serve with naan bread and other indian flatbreads.

title: Pat's Fajita Crisp
ingredients: 5 flour tortillas | 10 -15 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 5 -10 tablespoons peanut oil ( i use olive oil )
instructions: Preparation, cut tomatoes in half lengthwise and crosswise.  Wash, wrap in paper towel, and place on a plate covered with paper towel.  Lay the tortillas flat on a plate.  Place each of the four tortillas in a lightly oiled non stick frying pan.  After 1 - 2 minutes, rotate them in the pan and cook them on both sides for another 3 - 4 seconds.  Remove them from the pan to a large plate and keep warm in a low oven.  Preparing, heat 5 - 5 tablespoons of peanut oil in the same frying pan.  Place the 4 fried tortillas on a flat dish and cover.  Keep warm where the pan will be warm.  When all 4 fried tortillas are cooled, carefully stack them.  Place on a flat dish, cover with paper towel, and keep warm in a low oven until all 4 fried tortillas are gone.  Each piece should have about a quarter of a toasted triangle.  Wrap this in a warm tortilla, cover the dish, and keep warm in the same low oven until all 4 fried tortillas are gone.  Serve at your discretion,.

title: Lek Beef Casserole
ingredients: 2/3 cup leek, chopped | 1 teaspoon golden syrup | 2 teaspoons dry onion soup mix ( i buy this already made with onion soup mix ) | 1 lb sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Combine all ingredients except meat, in 2 - 2 1/2 quart baking dish sprayed well.  Cover, bake at 450 f until beef is thoroughly cooked, about 40 minutes.

title: Cape Breton
ingredients: 1 cup saffron, soaked overnight in | 1 teaspoon of whole pilonnillo cinnamon | 1 inch piece vanilla pod
instructions: Put saffron into a bowl.  Add the cinnamon and leave the bowl to soak overnight.  The next day, drain the saffron from the bowl.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,corn,black peppercorn,horseradish,agave nectar,red curry paste
title: Easy Thai Fish Fillet Packets and Spicy Corn
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( thai kitchen ) | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons prepared black peppercorns | 4 teaspoons agave nectar | 2 teaspoons serrano pepper, finely minced | 2 medium ears corn
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together red curry paste, horseradish, peppercorns and nectar.  Season w/salt and pepper.  Rinse corn on all sides and grill, covered, over medium heat 8 - 10 minutes, brushing with nectar occasionally.

title: Carrots, Raisins, and Carrots in Pasta
ingredients: 1 package uncooked small shell pasta | 2 pounds carrots, peeled and sliced | 2 teaspoons packed brown sugar | 1/4 cup dry raisins
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,pineapple juice,white bread,scallion,red capsicum,dill,banana pepper
title: Pineapple & Beef Soup (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 13)
ingredients: 1 red capsicum | 1 banana pepper | 4 slices white bread | 3 slices crusty white bread | 500 ml beef stock | 2 tablespoons fresh pineapple juice | 1/4 cup finely chopped scallion
instructions: Cut capsicum and banana pepper into thin matchstick slices.  Cut bread into 1 cm cubes and soak in water for 10 minutes.  Drain and dry on paper towels.  Cut bread into 2 cm cubes.  Lightly grease a hot frying pan and add capsicum and banana pepper.  Cook over moderate heat for 3 to 4 minutes or until soft.  Remove from heat and discard the seeds from the capsicum, banana pepper and chopped fresh pineapple.  Using 2 teaspoons of water, spoon over bread cubes and top with a slice of bread.  Repeat process with remaining bread cubes, capsicum, banana pepper and pineapple juice.  Garnish with chopped scallions.

title: Orange Daiquiri (Japanese Style Spaghetti)
ingredients: 1 package thin spaghetti or ( 16 ounce ) package linguine, cooked | 1/2 cup orange jell-o | 1/2 cup dill pickle, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped nutmeats or 1/2 cup chopped banana sprouts | 2 -4 ice cubes
instructions: Combine the orange jell o, dill pickle, and nutmeg in a bowl.  Add just enough ice cubes until the mixture looks moist but not too creamy.  Toss it all in the spaghetti, garnish with the orange slices, and serve.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,cooking oil,seasoning salt,blue cheese,pork butt
title: Buffalo Blue Cheese Pork
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork butt, cut in 2 chunks | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 2 - 2 1/2 ounces blue cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees farenheit.  Line a jelly roll pan with aluminum foil.  Brush with oil, then top evenly with the pork.  Combine salt and fish sauce in bowl.  Place blue cheese on top.  Cook in oven, uncovered, for about 2 1/2 hours.  If you like your pork tender and well done, stir every 15 minutes or so.  The bread is done when you remove from oven and top with the cheese toasted on the top.

title: Chickpea and Hazelnut Dessert
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg chickpeas, drained | 400 g coriander seeds, roasted | 375 g hazelnuts | 1 1/2 tablespoons brandy or 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 teaspoons cardamom, ground
instructions: Roast the chopped coriander seeds until golden brown.  Let cool.  Grind.  Place chickpeas and the coriander in a non stick pan over low heat, stirring frequently.  Heat until simmering.  Turn down the heat.  Add the roasted hazelnuts.  Cook, stirring constantly, until the hazelnuts just start to change colour.  Remove from the heat.  Add the brandy and stir.  Pour in the nut mixture.  Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,raisin,corn oil,white wine vinegar,maple syrup,plain flour
title: Sweet N Sour Bean Sprouts from the Microwave Recipe
ingredients: 150 g fresh bean sprouts | 3 tablespoons raisins | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 50 g raisins | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 teaspoons plain flour
instructions: Microwave 250g of bean sprouts on the 100 percent power level for around 6 minutes.  You must use a microwave safe dish for this.  If using a dish with 600 watts in the microwave for 7 minutes, then cook for 2 more minutes.  If using a microwave oven, then use a microwave safe dish for around 6 minutes.  The idea is microwave on high power level for around 1 minute and then again, leave standing, stir and leave to stand for about 2 more minutes.  The idea is to give the sprouts a chance to soften and absorb the peppery juices and juices in the microwave.  If using a dish with 600 watts on high power, then leave standing for around 5 minutes.  If using a microwave safe dish for two minutes and then leave standing for a further 1 minute.  After 2 more minutes, remove the dish from the microwave and add the remaining ingredients.  Put this dish back in the microwave with 600 watts on high power level for about 6 minutes and then leave for 2 more minutes.  Mix well while microwaving to ensure you have a smooth dish that can be used on the table and stirred quickly.  The idea is to have everything get hot and then kept on the top for around 4 minutes to get it cold enough to eat.  At lunch time remove the dish from the microwave and stir well.  Serve straight away.

title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground dried onion powder | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the onion powder, coriander, and cumin.  Use to sprinkle on the bread when serving.

title: Miso-Miso Mussels
ingredients: 2 kg mussels, preferably fresh cultivated | 100 ml miso ( kombu ) | 400 g celery ( cut into sticks ) | 100 g firm ripe bananas
instructions: Clean the mussels thoroughly, removing any beards and barnacles.  Rinse with cold water, place them in a large saucepan, pour boiling water over them and cover.  Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 5 minutes or until the shells open.  Transfer to bowl.  Discard any mussels that do not open.  Remove heads and shells from mussels, debeard them and return to saucepan.  Add the chopped celery sticks and mash with a fork and cook gently for about 10 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.  Strain off all but 2 tablespoons of the cooking liquid.  Stir in the mashed mussels along with kombu and simmer for about 2 or 3 minutes or until liquid has reduced by about half.  Transfer to a warmed serving bowl and add the chopped bananas.

Random Ingredients: garlic butter,phyllo pastry,plain yogurt,graham cracker crumb
title: Easy Cheesy Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3 cups phyllo pastry | 1/8 cup garlic butter ( or more if desired ) or 1/8 cup butter ( or more if desired )
instructions: Set oven to 300 degrees f.  Mix together yogurt and graham cracker crumbs.  Line baking sheets with parchment paper.  Place one sheet of phyllo on a cutting board, and place about 3/4 cup yogurt mixture on it.  Using a 3 x 13 inch rectangle cutter, cut the phyllo sheets in half vertically.  Repeat the 3 cutting and cutting with another sheet until you have 1/2 cup of yogurt mixture and 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs.  Top your triangles with one fourth of the phyllo, and repeat the process 3 more times.  Brush tops of phyllo triangles with garlic butter or spread with a small amount of butter.  Wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for up to two hours or overnight.  Unwrap phyllo triangles from freezer.  Place a cutting board on top and, using a sharp knife, cut the triangles at an angle into smaller squares.  Place triangles on baking sheets, and bake until crisp, about 12 - 15 minutes.

title: Faux Sizzler Apples
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray ( about 2 to 3 tablespoons ) | 1 lb cooking apple, peeled, cored and sliced ( i used a mcintosh, empire, red delicious, and romaine )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium low heat.  Add apple, cook until golden, then remove from heat as soon as it becomes golden.  Add more oil if necessary to keep apples soft.  Drizzle apples with an ample amount of the pan juices.  Serve immediately.

title: Zesty Chipotle Butter
ingredients: 4 chipotle chiles ( from the can in your can ) | 1 cup salsa | 4 tablespoons margarine | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | salt & pepper
instructions: Set up all the ingredients and whiz for about 30 seconds or so until butter is mealy.  Add salt and pepper and store in a jar in the fridge for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: brie cheese,bulk italian sausage,red chili pepper
title: Baked Sausages
ingredients: 24 slices bulk italian sausage | 1 cup aged brie cheese | 1 tablespoon ground dried red chili pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f with a rack in the middle.  Place bread slices on a baking sheet and toast in the preheated oven until crusty, golden brown and heated through, about 5 minutes.  Spread brie cheese on the untoasted bread slices.  Spread red chili peppers on top of the brie and cook in the preheated oven until cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,green chili,maple syrup,lemon wedge,green food coloring,spanish onion,plum
title: Plum Chili Soup (Mexican Inspired)
ingredients: 2 bunches spanish onions | 2 bunches green chili | 8 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 jar ripe plums, drained with pits in ( reserve pits ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 5 -7 drops green food coloring ( optional ) | lemon wedge, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to cut onions into 1/2 inch slices.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and place onion slices on top and drizzle with vegetable stock.  Sear slowly in an oven set to 375 degrees.  While onions are sauteing, slice the plums into 1/2 inch cubes.  Boil the reserved pits covered with a piece of rehydrating cheesecloth in water to cover.  Drain.  When onions are half way cooked drain off excess stock into a large pot.  When onions are about 1/2 cooked add the plums, tomatoes, and water that has boiled away.  Bring to a slow simmer.  Remove cheesecloth from boiling tomatoes, and stir in maple syrup.  Add a few drops of food coloring if desired.  Let simmer for 5 minutes.  Sprinkle chilies with optional green food coloring, add a few plots and serve hot.  Garnish with lemon wedges.

title: White Caramel Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces sultanas | 8 ounces smoked american cheese, cut into cubes | 2 ounces heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, peeled grated | 2 tablespoons tahini ( sesame paste )
instructions: Place the sultanas into a sieve and drain the liquid off.  Place the sultanas, cheese and cream in a heavy based saucepan and boil gently, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is thick and creamy, stirring continuously.  Remove from heat and stir in the ginger.  Place in a pre greased shallow ovenproof dish and allow to cool.  In a small bowl, mix the tahini with 150ml water until just combined.  Spoon cheese mixture over the sultanas.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake in the oven at 170°c/350°f for 30 to 40 minutes or until lightly golden brown.

title: Mexican Spiced Tea
ingredients: 3 cinnamon sticks ( or 10 pods ) | 1 whole green chili, chopped | 1 teaspoon saffron, finely ground | 1 tablespoon allspice, ground
instructions: Remove the cinnamon sticks.

title: Pickled Onions
ingredients: 1 lb pearl onion | 1/2 cup fresh gingerroot, peeled cut into matchsticks
instructions: Cut onions into eighths.

Random Ingredients: mushroom cap,chili oil,marsala wine,sage leaf,ham,head cauliflower
title: Mushroom, Garlic and Smoked Hotpot
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chili oil | 1/4 pound smoked ham, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 large head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 cup chopped mushrooms with caps | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 1 cup fresh sage leaves
instructions: In a 10 inch skillet heat chili oil.  Cook ham with cauliflower and mushrooms over moderate heat until vegetables are tender crisp.  Remove from skillet, reserving drippings.  Stir in wine.  Heat to boiling.  Return ham and cauliflower mixture to pan and season to taste with salt and pepper.  Cover and cook over moderately low heat for 3 to 5 minutes or until hot.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,egg yolk,chili powder,littleneck clam,rice wine,pecorino romano cheese
title: Clams and Fresh Blueberries
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pine nuts or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 1/2 lbs littleneck clams, scrubbed | 1/2 cup good-quality blueberries or 1/2 cup frozen blueberries | 1/2 cup fresh egg yolk | 1/2 cup rice wine or 1/2 cup sherry wine | 3/4 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Set large, heavy frying pan over low heat.  Toast the pine nuts until golden brown.  Set aside.  Bring a pot of water to a boil.  Add the clams and cook until tender.  Do not overcook the clams, as the shells will cook more in the oven.  Drain and run under cold water to cool them a bit.  Remove from the pot and reserve.  Cut off the claws from the shell.  Remove the meat of clams and discard the shells.  Heat the oil in the frying pan over medium high heat.  Add the clams and cook until they open.  Discard any clams that do not open.  Add in the white wine and cook until reduced by half.  In a small bowl, whip the egg yolks with the rice worcesters.  Add the egg yolk mixture to the clam chowder in the frying pan.  Cook and stir until the yolks are hot and glistening, around 3 - 4 minutes.  Do not let the mousse boil as it will curdle.  Turn off the heat.  Pour the reserved clams into the chowder and add the chowder to the clams.  Serve the clams topped with the toasted pine nuts.

title: Shrimp and Crab Stew With Shell Pasta
ingredients: 1 medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 lb crab, shell peeled, fresh or frozen | 1/3 lb stew meat, cubed | 12 ounces small shell pasta, small | 1 chili pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon chili pepper, granulates, optional or ( to taste )
instructions: Boil shrimp, shellfish and crab for 5 minutes until done.  Place in a large casserole dish or crockpot on medium heat.  Add stew meat.  Add chili, salt and pepper.  Pour mixture over the shrimp and crab.  Cook for an hour or so.  Serve over warm, cooked shells or with garlic bread for a complete meal.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,almond extract,vegetable oil cooking spray,seasoning salt,white rice,cooking oil,onion soup mix,cherry
title: Stacked Mexican Rice
ingredients:
1 box uncle bill mexican seasoned rice | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 1/4 cup white rice ( or yellow or red ) | 1/4 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons mrs.

instructions: Brown rice in 3 pats cooking oil.  Place rice in 9x13 glass dish.  In bowl, make onion soup mix from soup mix and seasonings.  Stir together with rice.  Pour mixture over top.  Cover.  Cook @ 350 degrees for 30 minutes.  Let cool 10 - 15 minutes.  Cut in squares.

title: Chilled Butternut Squash With Sweet Sage and Harissa
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, peeled and cut into 1 cm cubes | 3 tablespoons harissa | 1 teaspoon dried sage, leaves only | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 350 g tortillas
instructions: Place the squash chunks, harissa, sage, vanilla and half of the extra water into a small pan.  Cover and simmer over a low heat for 30 45mins until tender.  Cut the tortillas in half.  Spray or spray with cooking spray.  Heat the tortillas in a dry chargrill until golden.  Divide the squash between the tortillas and spread with the sweet breadcrumbs.  Spoon the warm spiced spiced spiced breadcrumbs onto the top and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,cashew,egg beater substitute,green bean,chili paste,cream

ingredients: 1 can green beans, drained | 2/3 cup cashews, roasted, chopped | 6 tablespoons fat free egg substitute | 1/3 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1/3 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup chili paste | 2 tablespoons light sour cream
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine beans, cashews, egg beaters, and cream.  Simmer for 5 - 10 minutes until hot and smooth. .  Stir in bell pepper and paste.  Heat thoroughly.  Serve over white rice and garnish with a dollop of sour cream for garnish.

title: Cranberry Vinaigrette

instructions: In a jar with a tight fitting lid, combine cranberry juice, vinegar and cranberry vinaigrette.  Cover and shake until blended.  Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

title: Spiced Pistachio Noodles With Plum Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces penne ( uncooked weight ) | 1/3 cup pistachio nut, coarsely chopped | 3 plums, pitted, sliced and chopped
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Peach and Pistachio Popcorn

instructions: Blend peaches, mango, pickle, pudding mix, paprika, and five spice powder together in a blender until smooth.

Random Ingredients: sherry vinegar,vanilla bean,white chocolate chip,beef sirloin,hamburger
title: Beef, Ham and Creamy White Chocolate Chips

instructions: Preheat pan to 225 degrees f.  Line pan with foil paper, letting excess hangs hang over sides of pan.  Slice beef across the grain into 1/8 inch slices about 2 inches long. Drizzle the vinegar mixture over beef and chill until serving time.  If mixture becomes too thick, thin with a little more vinegar.  To serve, place chips on a serving plate and spoon over meat.  Serve with fruit or sauce.

title: Tibetan Style Carrots
ingredients: 2 lbs carrots, cut in 1-1/2-inch slices | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: In a 9x13 inch glass baking dish coated with cooking oil or butter, combine the carrots, salt, turmeric, and remaining ingredients and mix well.  Cover and marinate in the refrigerator overnight.  Bring to room temperature before serving.  Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,canadian bacon,black olive,bread,bread flour,saffron thread,thyme sprig
title: Canadian Bacon & Olive Bread
ingredients: 3 slices country-style bread, crusts removed | 9 -12 ounces canadian bacon, sliced thinly into thirds | 3 large black olives, pitted | 2 -3 fresh thyme sprigs | 12 -20 saffron threads | bread flour | canadian bacon ( optional ) or ras el hanout spice blend ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f slice each of the following in half, then cut each quarter into 3 equal pieces lengthwise.  Do the same with your canadian bacon and pitted black olives.  Place bread on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake for about 8 - 12 minutes until lightly coloured and slightly crisp.  Meanwhile, saute bacon until crisp and add saffron strands and thyme sprigs.  Remove bread from oven.  Place bacon, olives, and 2 - 3 saffron halves on a piece of parchment paper or plastic wrap.  Wrap the saffron up in the back of 1 or 2 ham slices and place on top of the bread pieces.  Place on the upper rack in the oven for approximately 20 minutes.  To eat after 20 mins, remove and discard the sprigs of thyme and thyme and serve warm with a sprinkling of black/or french or italian olive oil and/or your choice of accompaniment.

title: Mushroom Orange Brown Rice Salad
ingredients: 3 cups packaged coleslaw mix ( i just use packaged salad mix ) | 6 -8 large shiitake mushrooms, sliced ( fresh if you use canned, reconstitute if you want to ) | 2 cans mandarin oranges ( i use whole ) | 1/2 cup slivered almonds | 3 tablespoons light brown rice | 1 tablespoon allspice | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 2/3 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Cook the brown rice with the allspice, pepper, nutmeg, and all the mandarin oranges just until tender.  Do not overcook.  Let cool.  In a large salad bowl combine the slivered almonds, coleslaw mix, brown rice, mushrooms, oranges and nuts.  Chill in the refridgerator until ready to serve.

title: Cherry Crumble
ingredients:
12 ounces sweet italian breadcrumbs | 12 ounces candied cherry, drained ( fresh not dried.
    - do not use dried )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  In an oven proof casserole dish, mix the bread crumbs and cherries.  Mix well, then spread mixture in a single layer, spreading evenly.  Bake at 400 f for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.  Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Potato & Marsala Lentil Cake
ingredients: 2 packages yellow lentils, undrained | 10 cups mashed sweet potatoes ( about 1 pound ) | 2 cans frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 bottle sweet marsala wine | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 2 cups flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Wash, pick over and discard any damaged lentils, then rinse under cold water.  Place them in a large dutch oven with 5 cups of water.  Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, covered, until the lentils are tender.  Drain and mash into a bowl.  While the lentils are cooking, place the sweet potato in a large bowl, and stir in the limeade concentrate.  Remove the lid from the dutch oven, and stir.  Stir in the sweet potato.  Return to the bubbling, adding the marsala.  Sprinkle with baking soda.  Blend 1 1/2 cups of the flour and 1/2 cup water together in a food processor to form a thick paste.  Place about half of the paste in the bottom of two 9 inch round cake pans.  Sprinkle with more flour.  Pour half the lentil mixture over the paste.  Repeat with the remaining paste and the remainder of the paste.  Bake in the middle of the oven, until the top of the cake begins to turn brown, about 35 minutes.  Let cool.  Run a knife around the edges, and invert onto a platter, then carefully remove the pans.  Serve the cake warm.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,cider vinegar,taco seasoning mix,golden raisin,rice wine,baking powder
title: Taco Bread

instructions: Combine all ingredients and put in a loaf pans.  Bake 350 degrees for 1 hr remove from oven, cool, remove from pan and cut loaf into 16 slices.  Serve warm, with sour cream.

title: Brazilian Shrimp
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh shrimp, peeled | 6 lbs meat
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp.  Clean meat.  If you use chicken bones, wash well.  Place all ingredients into a large covered pot or dutch oven.  Place over medium heat.  Cover and cook for 15 - 20 minutes until meat is cooked.

title: Toffee Balls III
ingredients: 2 cans chocolate fudge coated miniature marshmallows | 1/2 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 cup white wine | 1 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup white wine | 6 tablespoons ketchup | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 cup toffee ( crushed ) | 8 tablespoons crushed toffee ( toffee )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix chocolate fudge, 1/2 cup of sugar, 1 tablespoon ketchup and 1 cup white wine.

title: Liptauer Beef Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs of thin sliced steak ( i only use 3/4 lb of each ) or 2 lbs tri-tip steak, very thin cut | 1 small yellow squash, cut into small sticks | 1 package lipton beef and onion soups mix ( i use lipton onion soup mix onion onion soup mix ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 2 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and sliced | 3 -4 tablespoons currants | 2 tablespoons of chopped dry roasted peanuts ( or try 1/2 cup of chopped dried roasted peanuts )

Drain your meat and return it to the crock pot.  If you'd like to make the sauce yourself, combine your ingredients, heat thoroughly, then stir well.

instructions: Pierce potato with a fork several times, then put potato in a saucepan and cover with cold water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until tender, 20 - 25 minutes.  Drain, then cool, cut potato into 3/4 inch dice, then roughly chop.  Combine potato, marjoram, chiles, rosemary, lemon, 2 teaspoons salt and 1 teaspoon pepper.  Spread 1/2 cup chapatis on clean, dry plates.  Spread tortillas with 1/4 cup sweet chili salsa.  Spoon half of potato and half each of spiced chiles on top, then top with 1/2 cup loosely packed italian parsley leaves and 1/2 cup salsa.  Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt and a pinch of pepper.
