title: Coriander Yogurt Cakes (Yogurt Cake)
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon icing sugar, sifted ( confectioner's sugar ) | 300 g icing sugar | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, shredded ( can use half as much dried basil )
instructions: Beat yogurt, salt and coriander with an electric mixer until smooth.  Add egg.  Mix well and stir in icing sugar until smooth.  Form into 2cm thick cakes and roll in extra icing sugar.  Chill cakes in the refrigerator until well chilled.  Spread on a greased plate.  Beat cream and icing sugar together until stiff peaks form.  Fold in basil just before serving.  Variation, make two layers of icing sugar and two icing sugar layers of cream with yoghurt, yoghurt and lime juice.  Spread one layer over yoghurt cake base with melted butter.

title: Sausage and Lentil Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans red lentils | 1 bunch frozen vegetables | 1 smoked ham steak ( cut into thin strips ) | 1/2 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 polish sausage ( or 2 -3 links )
instructions: Rinse lentils, if necessary, in a strainer.  Add to large bowl.  Add frozen vegetables and ham sticks.

title: Potato and Brussels Sprouts Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled | 4 cups trimmed brussels sprouts, quartered | 1 package thawed phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Boil the potatoes in plenty of salted water to cover until tender, about 30 minutes.  Drain.  Cut the tips off the sprouts and set aside.  Chop the potatoes into 1/2 inch pieces, then mix in 4 cups of sprouts and 5 more cups of sprouts in a large bowl.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut one package of phyllo dough into three 4 inch squares.  Place one square on a cookie sheet.  Cut a second sheet lengthwise into three strips.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock chicken,purpose flour,white wine,okra,hazelnut oil
title: Creamed Okra (Fesenjanos Da Hortela)
ingredients: 1/4 cup hazelnut oil | 2 cups chopped okra ( about 6 ounces ) | 4 cups vegetable stock or 4 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons white wine | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour ( or cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water )
instructions: Heat the oil in a large dutch oven or heavy skillet over medium high heat.  Saute the okra 3 - 4 minutes per side, until browned.  Lower heat and add the stock.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until mushrooms are soft and most of the liquid has evaporated, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Whisk together the flour and cornstarch in a small bowl.  Add to stock and okra and stir to blend.  Simmer another 15 - 20 minutes, stirring frequently until the sauce thickens and is glossy and tender.

title: Baked Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 summer squash, washed, chopped | 4 large dried apricots, chopped | 2 cups iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1/2 cup miniature marshmallows | 5 teaspoons chicken bouillon, dissolved in | 1 teaspoon water
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Place kielbasa in 8x8 baking dish.  Cook for 45 minutes, turning once.  Cut into 1/8 inch slices.  In another 9x9 baking dish, arrange cauliflower, squash, apricots, and salad.  Sprinkle with marshmallows.  Dissolve bouillon in water.

title: Baked Cauliflower With Ham and Guinness
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower | 200 ml guinness, chilled | 400 g ham, diced | 200 g guinness, chilled | 1/4 cup reduced calorie topping | 1/4 cup guinness, chilled | 1/4 cup pear, diced into thin wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Place cauliflower in a roasting tin.  Cover with cold guinness, and bake, covered, for 40 minutes.  Meanwhile, place ham, guinness and dressing in a large bowl, toss to combine.  Drain cauliflower, and place on top of ham.  Sprinkle with reserved ham, and bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes.

title: Chambord Truffles
ingredients: 2 cups peanut oil | 2 tablespoons chambord raspberry liquor | 1 package refrigerated chicken bouillon
instructions: Fill a pot 2/3 full with peanut oil.  Heat over high heat until oil is almost smoking, but oil does not burn.  Cook and stir chambord until fragrant.  Remove from heat and slowly add the raspberry liquor.  Crush the bouillon into a mixing bowl and stir with a fork as you are adding it to the oil in the pot.  Continue stirring until the sauce is smooth, about 3 minutes.  Dissolve the bouillon in the sauce just until fragrant.  Do not let it boil.  Stir in about 1/3 of the peanut oil to stop the blades from crackling.  Repeat with all of the peanut oil.  If you want bigger bombs, shape them into cylinders about 5 to 10 inches long, about 10 inch in diameter.  Using a pastry brush, coat the outer side of each cylinder with the peanut oil.  Repeat until all of the peanut oil has been used.

title: Smoked Salmon & Zucchini With Cream
ingredients: 1 cup kraft whipping cream | 2 teaspoons snipped pimientos or 2 teaspoons jalapeno peppers | 4 cups shredded zucchini | 1/2 cup chopped chili | 1/2 cup sliced smoked salmon
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper.  Combine whipping cream and pimientos or jalapeños in a medium size bowl.  Stir in zucchini, chili and smoked salmon.  Spoon dollops onto foil.  Broil 5 to 6 inches from heat approximately 10 to 12 minutes or until cream is hot and bubbly on the edges.

title: Maple Roast Berry  Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups frozen roast, thawed | 1 package strawberry nuggets | 1 package rice noodles | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 3 tablespoons miso
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in a small saucepan.  Add rice noodles and allow to boil until soft tender, but still firm.  Drain noodles and transfer to a large bowl.  Add maple syrup and miso to noodles.

title: Cuban White Beans and Rice on Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup sliced onion | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped bell pepper | 10 slices rye bread, each about 1/4 inch thick ( the large slices, about 6 ounces each ) | 1/2 cup dry picante sauce | 1/2 cup cognac or 1/2 cup brandy | 1/4 cup chopped fresh edible, mixed ( optional )
instructions: Heat the beans, onion, and bell pepper over low heat, covered, in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker until heated through, 8 to 10 hours.  Arrange 10 slices of bread over beans, then top with 1/2 cup picante sauce, 1/2 cup chopped fresh vegetables, and 1/4 cup cognac or brandy.  Pour bean and onion mixture over bread, making sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,hot paprika,date,red onion,coconut cream,poblano chile pepper
title: Mexican Charred Chiles
ingredients: 1 fresh poblano chile pepper, seeded | 1/8 cup red onion, finely chopped | 2 cups plain low-fat yogurt | 1 cup fat-free plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 2 ounces unsweetened coconut cream
instructions: Remove the stem and seeds from the chile and coarsely chop it in a food processor.  Set aside.  Place the poblano pepper, red onion and 1/2 cup of the plain lowfat yogurt in a blender and puree.  Pour the chile mixture into a serving dish.  Whip the remaining yogurt with the hot paprika and coconut cream.  Drizzle the yogurt mixture over the chile mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,lettuce leaf,bean sprout,shell pasta,white wheat flour
title: Japanese Style Salad - Lettuce, Bean Sprouts, Cheese, & Bread
ingredients: 450 g small shell pasta ( or 2 medium size cans ) | 2 cups lettuce leaves | 500 g bean sprouts ( japanese-style chopped sprouts ) | 200 g mayonnaise, to taste | 5 cm piece white wheat flour
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente, and then drain.  Rinse it with cold water, then leave it to drain in a sieve.  Wash and dry the bean sprouts.  Mix the mayo and flour in a bowl, adding the water as necessary, to make a smooth dressing.  Toss lettuce leaves with half of the drained pasta, then arrange in alternate layers with the bean sprouts and lettuce leaves, then repeat until all the ingredients are used.  Serve.

title: Cotija Fondue
ingredients: 4 ounces cotija cheese, crumbled | 1 sprig fresh rosemary leaf
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a small heavy pot.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat and simmer until the butter is melted, stirring frequently.  Turn off the heat and keep warm.  Pour melted butter through a fine sieve into a warm fondue pot with a lid.  Let the fondue bubble until warmed through, stirring occasionally.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed and tied with kitchen twine | 2 spanish onions, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Place the tenderloin on a rack in a roasting pan.  Brush with the marinade.

title: Basmati Rice with Pomegranate
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1/4 cup pomegranate juice or 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, thinly sliced
instructions: Place rice and juice in a saucepan.

title: Spicy Beef and Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 lb top sirloin steak, thinly sliced or 1 lb flank steak, cut into 2 x 1/2 inch strips | 16 ounces spanish onions, coarsely chopped | 1 bottle barbeque sauce
instructions: In a bowl, combine cream of tartar, nutmeg and onion.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,duck breast,dark sesame oil,oyster,spaghetti sauce,chili pepper flake
title: Spaghetti With Dduck, Oysters, Chili Oil & Chili Oil
ingredients: 6 ounces spaghetti sauce | 4 anchovy fillets | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 chili pepper, chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 8 ounces duck breasts ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons oysters ( oysters cooked or canned, coarsely chopped )
instructions: Boil water in a microwave safe dish.  While the water is heating up whisk together the spaghetti sauce, anchovies, chilli, and sesame oil until they are well blended.  Add the duck and stir to coat.  Once the water starts boiling, add the pasta and cook, stirring, for 1 minute.  Remove from the microwave and drain off all but 1 tablespoon pasta water.  Add the cooked duck and stir to combine.  Remove the chili flakes and serve warm.

title: Pumpkin-Roses-Caps
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless beef roast | 1 lb raw pumpkin puree | 1/2 lb smoked sausage | 2 garlic cloves, mashed | 2 tablespoons beef fat | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg or 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Cube roast into small strips or smaller and place in crockpot with bones.  Squeeze out excess air from meat.  Sprinkle with meat juices and brown in fat over low heat.  Remove.  Cook pumpkin, sausage, spices and raisins in 2 tbsp oil until they are tender, about 15 minutes.  Add meat to pork and broth.  Cook at low setting for 6 to 8 hours.  Use a thermometer to check for doneness at end of cooking time to make sure beef is tender about you may need to remove some of the juice from the pork at the point of the cook time.  I usually have a toothpick with large holes in the center to hold the meat submerged then i stick my toothpick into the hole.

title: Portuguese Style Onion Potatoes
ingredients: 6 red potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges | 1/2 onion ring, chopped | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add potatoes and cook for 12 to 15 minutes until tender but firm.  Drain and reserve 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid.  Meanwhile, combine the onion rings, tamari, lime juice and marjoram in a mixing bowl.  Toss to combine.  Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if necessary.  Serve potatoes topped with the reserved onion rings and serve with lime wedges.

title: Scottish Baked Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g ground chuck or 500 g ground lean beef | 175 g oatmeal | 2 inches gingerroot, grated | 1/2 teaspoon superfine sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 190c, 400f degrees.  In a bowl, combine all meatball ingredients and mix together until well combined.  Roll into balls, about the size of a golf ball and place on greased oven trays.  Allow to rest for 8 - 10 minutes before turning meatballs and placing on a greased oven tray.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: gruyere,pork loin chop,lime juice zest,russet potato,pork tenderloin,turmeric,lime
title: Pork, Potato, and Gruyere Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloins, trimmed | 2 tablespoons lime juice, freshly squeezed | 1 tablespoon fresh lime zest | 1/2 tablespoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 lb russet potato, peeled | 1 cup gruyere, coarsely shredded | 1 lb pork loin chop, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Slice both sides of the pork tenderloins crosswise into thin slices.  Combine lime juice and zest in a small bowl and stir to dissolve zest.  Add turmeric and butter and whisk until melted.  Add potatoes and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,milk,spinach leaf,vanilla bean,banana,caper,green cardamom pod,beet
title: Cardamom Beet Soup
ingredients: 1 cup beet, cooked, mashed and mashed | 1 cup beet, cooked, mashed | 6 green cardamom pods | 3 cups milk | 1 ripe banana | 2 teaspoons capers | 8 cardamom powder | 1 ounce fresh spinach leaves, chopped or 1/4 cup frozen chopped spinach
instructions: Grind cardamom pods or crush with a mortar.  Combine in a saucepan.  Grate or chop bananas, add to saucepan.  Add chopped beet, chopped green cardamom pods.  Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 5 - 15 minutes stirring occasionally.  Add in drained can beets or mashed beet.  Mix in 1 cup of milk and bring to a low boil.  Add in mashed beet, capers, cardamom powder, spinach and add in 1/2 cup more milk, stirring until absorbed.  Allow to stand for just another 2 minutes to let flavours develop.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,almond butter,brown sugar,sun tomato oil
title: Almond Butter With Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond butter | 1/2 - 2/3 cup packed light brown sugar or 1/2-2/3 cup piloncillo sugar | 2 -4 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained of oil | 2 -4 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat butter with sugar until light and fluffy.  Stir in sundried tomatoes and salt.  Using a small teaspoon, stir in to thicken, if necessary.

title: Horseradish Cream Sauce for Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup ( campbell's ) | 1/3 cup prepared horseradish
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in can of soup.  Stir in horseradish until all lumps are dissolved, then pour into a glass bowl or mold, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours before serving.  Serve over chicken.

title: Green Chili Chocolate Lentil Cake
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups lentils | 3 ounces white chocolate, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili or 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped jalapeno pepper | 2 green chili peppers, chopped ( scotch bonnet )
instructions: Put lentils, cheese and chili peppers in a large pot.  Boil until tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Navy Bean and Sprouts
ingredients: 1 can navy beans | 1/3 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1/4 cup triple sec | 6 ounces fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Drain the navy beans and rinse them in a sieve.  Put them into your food processor and process until very smooth.  Transfer the puree to a bowl and set aside.  To serve, pour half the puree into a pot, top with half the coriander, and then half the beans with the second half of the puree.  Toss and serve.

title: Tofu Creole
ingredients:
250 ounces extra firm tofu, pressed ( 2 to 2 1/2 lb.
    - ) | 12 ounces tomatillos ( about 2 cups ) | 1 cup picante sauce ( i use low-sodium ) | 1/4 cup reduced-fat sour cream | 2 cups oatmeal, divided | 2 -3 cups cooked mussels, cleaned and debearded
instructions: Prepare oatmeal according to package directions.  Cool.  Cut the tofu into 1 1/2 inch cubes.  Prepare tomatoes and tomatillos by hushening under running water for about a minute.  Place cut tomatoes, tomatillos and tamerogar over medium heat until heated through.  Drain the tofu and tomatillos, discarding all other liquid.  Combine the remaining oatmeal, sour cream and 2 cups of the cooked oatmeal, stirring to blend well.  Gently fold 1/4 cup of the oatmeal into the cheese sauce in a small dish or bowl.  Spread the remaining 1/2 cup of oatmeal in to a 13x9 pan and top with a third of the tofu and tomato mixture.  Continue layering as follows, oatmeal top with layer of tofu and tomato mixture and continue layering.  Gently fold the remaining 1/4 cup of oatmeal over and repeat on top of the oatmeal topping.  Bake in a 350 degree oven for 40 - 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,parsley flake,rice wine vinegar,persimmon,spice
title: Grapevineres
ingredients: 2 cups rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup finely grated monterey jack cheese at room temperature | 1/2 teaspoon pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, spice | 2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes
instructions: Prepare the vinegar by combining all the vinegar ingredients and chill.  Remove the pulp from the grapevine with a cheese cloth or other fine sieve.  Sprinkle the fruit with the spiced spice and add it to the strained vinegar.  Serve right away or cover and refrigerate until ready to use.  The grapevineres can also be stored in the fridge for up to a month.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,frying chicken,chili pepper flake,bamboo skewer,milk,vegetable broth,coconut milk
title: Thai Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 frying chicken, cut in pieces | 4 bamboo skewers, soaked in water and cut into pieces using 1/2 inch pieces | 7 ounces pork sausage, cut in 1/2 inch chunks ( or use pork belly sausage ) | 1 quart vegetable brother ( about 3 1/2 quarts ) or 1 gallon vegetable broth | 3/4 cup milk | 1 can coconut milk | 1 -2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Place chicken and bamboo skewers on a rack over a bowl and allow to rest in a warm place for about 20 minutes.  Pour the broth into a heavy pot over high heat.  Add chicken skewers and sausage and simmer, turning as needed for about 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.  Add vegetable broth, milk, and coconut milk.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until soup becomes slightly thick and creamy.  Remove from heat.  Stir in chili flakes and serve.  Note, coconut milk can be found in almost anywhere, though it does provide a tangy flavor.  To serve, add a dollop of the creamy coconut soup to a soup bowl or on a plate or serving dish.

title: Potato Klub
ingredients: 5 yukon gold potatoes | 3 cups hot sauce
instructions: Boil your potatoes in lightly salted water until they are fork tender, 10 to 12 minutes.  Drain and slice them.  In a medium saucepan, bring potatoes to a boil.  Add hot sauce.  Slice your potatoes into strips, if possible, and stir into sauce.  Reduce heat to a simmer, and cook, stirring occasionally to prevent scorching, until the klusky is heated through, about 20 minutes.

title: Deli Ham and Mushrooms with Cheese
ingredients: 2 packages regular size cottage cheese | 1 cup small button mushroom | 4 -6 slices deli ham, diced | 12 -15 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon sage
instructions: Mix together cottage cheese, mushrooms, ham, soy sauce and sage.  Put into a greased baking dish or pie plate.  Bake in 350f oven for 20 - 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Greek Okra and Chops on Orzo
ingredients: 1 package frozen cut okra, thawed | 2 center-cut pork chops, rinsed and patted dry | 8 ounces orzo pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f spread the thawed frozen okra onto a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes, or until heated through.  Meanwhile, cut the pork chops into 1/4 to 1/2 inch slices.  Remove from oven and set aside.  Place the orzo on the same baking sheet, cover with a clean tea towel and steam over boiling water for about 3 minutes.  Place pork and cooked okra onto the orzo and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes or until okra is tender.  To serve, spoon orzo onto a serving plate and top with the pork and a sprinkling of fresh chopped cilantro leaves.

title: Ancho Chapati(Curried Cauliflower)
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 4 teaspoons ground ancho chile powder ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Wash and separate the cauliflower easily into florets.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Dice the cauliflower into 1 inch chunks.  Transfer to a large bowl, add 2 1/4 cups of the flour, the turmeric and the ancho chile powder and mix well.  Coat the cauliflower with the flour and toss lightly.  Fry in a skillet until the cauliflower starts to brown around the edges.  If necessary, add more flour to keep its texture until it is thick and browned.  If the cauliflower is crispy before it becomes crisp, add water and mix well.

title: Ww 6 Points - Lentils, Sautéed Peppers and Cilantro
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 1 cup roasted red bell pepper, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Stir.

title: Apple Pie VI
ingredients: 4 pie shells | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 apple - peeled, cored, and cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Drain the soup can from the can, and place the soup can back in the can with the apple.  Pour the apple mixture into the pie shells.  Refrigerate at least 4 hours, or overnight, before serving.

title: Taco Bell Home Fries
ingredients: 1 can jalapenos | corn chips
instructions: Cut up the jalapenos and mix with the corn chips into the hot frying pan.  Cook until the chips are golden brown and the jalapenos have begun to turn crispy.  Break them up by shaking them on the frying pan.

title: Clam Chowder
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh asparagus | 1 lb fresh clams | 1 bunch watercress ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Cut off tops of asparagus and set aside.  Slice off asparagus tips and reserve for soup.  Trim asparagus stems and discard.  Wash clamsters under cold water and remove shell fragments with a knife, and chop in a soup pot.  Break clams in half or chop in a pot of 6 - 8 quarts of water.  Bring to a boil, boil for 5 minutes and remove from heat.  Serve in bowls over cooked croutons or in a bowl of watercress and serve with freshly grated cheese.  To prepare clams, bring a small pot of salted water to a boil and add some ice cubes to the water and asparagus.  Cook 1/2 hour, drain and return to pot.  Add clam juice and heat briefly.  Just before serving, heat soup to boiling, remove from heat and stir in a dozen or more spears of asparagus and watercress until greens are just tender.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,meat,sherry wine,mozzarella cheese,orange peel,sherry,sauerkraut,half
title: Cheese Reuben Casserole
ingredients: 3 lbs deli meat, cut into bite size pieces | 1 cup grated mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1/2 cup orange peel, finely chopped | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup steak sauce or 1/4 cup ketchup | 3/4 cup sauerkraut, drained, but not rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Put meat, cheese, and all of the other ingredients into a buttered casserole dish.  Cover tightly and bake the casserole for 45 minutes.  Uncover the casserole and bake for an additional 15 - 20 minutes, or until the topping is bubbly.

title: Curry Leaves (French Leaves)
ingredients: 2 lbs leaves fresh kale, cleaned and trimmed | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped celery leaves
instructions: Wash leaf leaves under running water and drain again.  Drench leaves by using a damp cloth and placing it between sheets of dampened wax paper that is about 12 inch long.  When dried, wrap 2 or 3 leaves in a strip of cheesecloth about 18 1/2 inches long and about 18 1/2 inches wide.  Fold leaves in half crosswise, drawing in the loose ends and seams.  Wrap bundle with kitchen string or tie securely.  Place in the simmering liquid, cover and simmer until leaves are softened, about 6 hours, replenishing liquid with a little water as necessary.  Stir occasionally.  If leaves are dry and very pliable, put on a board in small pieces and smash with the flat of a cleaver.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,wild rice,poblano pepper,soy sauce,new potato,dark rum,chive
title: Wild Rice and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wild rice | 5 1/2 ounces sliced new potatoes, sliced in half ( optional ) | 1 poblano pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried chives, crushed
instructions: In a saucepan, bring 1 1/2 cups of water to a boil and stir in wild rice, cover and remove from heat.  Let stand until water is absorbed, about 15 minutes.  Drain well, then cool and set aside.  Place potatoes into a small saucepan with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes, or until tender.  Drain and dry on paper towels, then set aside.  In a small bowl, stir together rum, soy sauce, mustard seeds, pepper and 3/4 cup water until well distributed.  Set aside.  In a large salad bowl, arrange green salad ingredients.  Add wild rice and potato mixture and stir to coat.  Let sit at room temperature for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Pistachio Cheese Triangles
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry | 1/3 cup shortcrust pastry | 6 ounces of grated cheesecloth | 1 cup of coarsely chopped unsalted pistachios
instructions: Cut two sheets of the shortcrust pastry into four equal squares.  Using a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2 round plain tip, snip one corner to make a triangle.  Set aside.  Cut another package of shortcrust pastry into four equal pieces.  On a lightly floured surface, stretch the two sheets of shortcrust pastry into a large square about 2 inches wide and 10 inches long.  On a lightly floured surface, sprinkle the four squares of shortcrust pastry with cheesecloth to make a rectangle of about 10 by 8 inches in diameter.  Spread one half of the nut cheese over the cheese.  Top with half the triangles of shortcrust pastry and sprinkle each with a little grated cheese.  Fold the corners of the shortcrust pastry over the top.  Using a cookie cutter, cut into strips 3 inches long and 3 inches wide.  Repeat until one sheet of shortcrust pastry is filled.  Wrap each strip in plastic and set aside in the refrigerator for 10 minutes.  In a large sauté pan over medium heat, melt half the butter.  Sprinkle the strips on both sides with pistachios.  When the cracker just begins to sizzle, place them side by side in the melted butter.  When the cheese starts to turn a light golden brown, remove from heat.  Use a large slotted spoon to remove the crackers.  To serve, lift one strip into the hot pan.  Place one hand under a folded plate and hold in the palm of one hand and gently press it into the cheese with a second hand to make a cube shape.  Then, transfer the cheese cube to the center of the plate and hold the cube gently under the pastry.

title: Easy Turnip Squash Patties #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1 cup peeled & chopped turnip | 1/4 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  Place all of the ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix well.  Form into a pattie patty and place on the prepared baking sheet, and bake 20 minutes, or until set and cooked through.

title: Shallotiri Halved and Grated (Khalotiri Sauce)
ingredients: 1/4 cup shredded kefalotiri ( about 1/3 cup per serving ) | garlic salt to taste | 1/4 cup apple cider
instructions: Rub the kefalotiri slices into the khalotiri.  Sprinkle with garlic salt to taste.  Place on a serving platter, and garnish with apple cider.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,pie shell,lettuce,lasagna noodle,brown rice,kalamata olive,golden syrup
title: Greek Rice and Olive Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package frozen grilled, diced chicken pieces | 1 cup chopped lettuce | 1 cup kalamata olives, pitted and chopped | 2 tablespoons light golden syrup | 1 teaspoon brown rice | 1 box frozen pie shells, thawed | 1 teaspoon brown rice syrup | 1/2 - 1 cup chicken stock or 1/2-1 cup vegetable stock, heated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Combine chicken, lettuce, olives, golden syrup, and brown rice in a medium bowl.  Pour into the pie shells and arrange in one layer.  Combine the heated chicken stock and syrup and pour over the top.  Bake for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,white sesame seed,dill
title: Fried White Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 bunch chinese white sesame seeds | 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/4 cup dill, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a dry skillet, toast white sesame seeds over medium heat for about 4 minutes, or until golden.  Remove from skillet, and place in a heatproof bowl, cover with paper towels, and set aside to drain off excess oil for about 20 minutes.  Drain off all but 1 tablespoon of the oil.  Over medium heat, mix the pepper jack cheese and dill into the sesame oil, and lightly brown.  Place the sesame seeds back into the skillet.  Spread the sesame seeds evenly over the top.  Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until the mixture begins to turn light brown and the cheese is golden.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine pasta,stewing beef,chocolate liqueur,cilantro leaf,plain flour,red chili paste
title: Steamed Fettuccine With Chocolate Based Beef
ingredients: 500 g stewing beef, sliced very thinly | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 3 -4 tablespoons chocolate liqueur | 1 teaspoon red chili paste | 3/4 - 1 cup cilantro leaf, chopped | 1/2 package fettuccine pasta
instructions: Combine flour, chocolate liqueur and chilli paste.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,chili,red chilies,bacon,chocolate square,white mushroom,white bread
title: Chile Wrapped Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 white mushrooms, each about 8 x 8 inches ( i buy the large ones ) | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 1 small chili, minced | 2 small dried red chilies, deveined | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar or 3 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 1/2 grated chocolate square, or 2 tablespoons grated mexican chocolate, to drizzle for topping
instructions: Remove stems and any loose white mushroom caps.  Remove stems from mushrooms with a spoon or a rubber spatula and set aside.  If using chiles, cut off and discard stems and seeds.  If using dried chili, coarsely chop.  Heat a 10 inch nonstick skillet over high heat, then add the bacon and garlic and cook until the bacon is crisp, about 1 minute.  Remove the bacon to a plate lined with paper towels and crumble.  Set aside.  Add the chile.  Cook, stirring, for 1 minute.  Stir in mushrooms, chile bits and vinegar.  Cook, stirring for 1 minute or until heated through.  Remove from heat and stir in chilies 1 tablespoon at a time.  Spoon mixture evenly to within 1 inch of the edges of the mushroom stems.  Drizzle each mushroom with 1/4 teaspoon each of chocolate.  Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon of chocolate.  Serve at once.

title: Mexican Beef With Pasta
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, fat trimmed | 6 scallions, chopped | 1 jar salsa | sugar snap pea pods
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350°f.  Season beef with salt and pepper.  Brown meat in skillet and transfer to caserole dish.  Sprinkle scallions over all and drizzle with salsa.  Cover and bake for 1 1/2 hours.  Serve over pasta.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,stewing beef,enchilada sauce,wheat flour
title: Healthy Beef Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs stewing beef | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 5 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Brown stewing beef in skillet.  Mix enchilada sauce and crushed pepper.  Heat to boiling.  Drain beef and add to skillet with sauce.  Cover and simmer until tender.  Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Low-Fat Xanthan Glazed Fish #5FIX
ingredients: 3 tablespoons xanthan gum | 2 pounds red snapper fillets, cut into 2-inch x 1-1/4-inch strips
instructions: Heat oven to 500 degrees f.  Mix the xanthan gum and 3 tablespoons of water in a small bowl.  Spray an 11x7x2 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray.  Add the fillets, and coat with the gum mixture.  Bake uncovered in the preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,sherry wine,cauliflower,tamari,oregano,pizza crust,berry,bread machine yeast
title: Cauliflower Bread Machine
ingredients: 4 -5 cups day-old bread flour | 3 cups un-coarse chopped mixed fresh bread crumbs ( such as packaged italian for example ) | 1 package pizza crust ( such as boboli brand ) | 1 teaspoon olive oil or 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 packet dry non-instant dry yeast | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 3 tablespoons tamari ( soy sauce, such as bragg's amino acids ) | 1/2 cup sherry wine or 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place the yeast, 3 tbsps of tamari, and 1 tsp of the oil in a medium bowl and whisk to mix.  Add 1 - ½ cup of the flour and whisk to combine.  Add the remaining ¼ cup flour.

title: Leek and Sour Cream Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 dash horseradish sauce | 1 stalk leek, white part only, finely chopped
instructions: Place chopped leeks, soup, and sour cream into a saucepan.  Place on medium heat, stirring frequently, until the soup has heated and is reduced by half, about 10 minutes.  Stir in horseradish sauce.  Serve hot or chilled with pumpernickel bread.

title: Aussie Seafood
ingredients: 1 cup rice, cooked | 2 cups mussels | 200 ml mangoes, diced | 1 cup seedless grapesfruit | 2 dried red chilies, torn in half | 1 onion | 1/2 cup apricot
instructions: Saute onion in oil in large frying pan.  Add the mussels, stir.  Add rice and mussels.  Cook until the mussels are open.  Add mangoes, grapefruit and dried chillies.  Serve.

title: Faux Noodle Casserole With Sriracha Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1 small broccoli floret | 2 tablespoons salsa verde ( hot or mild, i recommend herdez ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chili sauce ( mild or hot depending how spicy or how chunky you like your noodle ) | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon peanut butter ( to serve ) | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Cook the broccoli on a baking sheet in oven for about 3 minutes until crisp tender.  Meanwhile, heat the salsa verde in a small saucepan on stove.  Stir over a medium heat until warmed.  Add the chili sauce.  Stir to combine.  Add the peanuts and stir to combine.  Set aside.  Using the back of a large spoon, scoop the broccoli into a large bowl.  Add the peanut butter, and toss to combine.  Line a baking dish with parchment paper.  Place the noodles in a single layer in the baking dish, and drizzle with chili sauce.  Sprinkle with the cinnamon.  Bake for about 25 to 30 minutes, or until the noodles are tender and the topping is golden.

title: Mexican Spicy Nachos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs spanish bread, preferably baguette, cubed | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup watercress, coarsely chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup grated scallion | 1 tablespoon rum ( optional ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon grated canned chipotle pepper, seeded & minced ( or more if you like it spicier ) | 12 -16 graham crackers, crushed ( or smaller snack size bag ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf lightly oil a 9x13 baking dish.  Place bread cubes in a large bowl and mix with the crumb crust ingredients.  Add watercress, scallions, rum if using, & chipotle, if using.  Pat into the pan & smooth top with a spatula.  Cook in preheated oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until the top has a nice golden brown color & the bread is very crispy.  You may also use fresh bread for this and it will break up nicely.  If using a regular skillet it should take about 20 - 25 minutes to become golden brown & soft.  Remove from the oven & place on a cooling rack.  Sprinkle crackers generously over the top & allow to cool a few seconds or so, then break off pieces with fingers & cut into chips.  Place on a cutting board & cut them in the shape the chips are in & place around the nachos in any case, this does not spread them evenly as you go.  Once all nachos have been made, top with a sprinkling of sherry & return to oven for 10 minutes or until the top and crackers are melted and toasted.  Cut to serve.

title: Mango Gratin
ingredients: 4 ripe mangoes ( or equivalent if you prefer ) | 1 1/2 fluid ounces double cream | salt and pepper
instructions: Peel mangoes and cut them into cubes.  Combine mango cubes with a little water to make a paste.  Put cream in a pan and bring to the boil.  When it boils, add the mango paste to the cream mixture and stir over very low heat for 1 - 2 minutes.  Place in an oven proof bowl and put on a tray near your oven.  Broil for 3 - 4 minutes or so.  Season with salt and pepper.

title: Hot German Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 5 slices canned tomato puree | 1 slice canadian bacon
instructions: Slice the Canadian bacon and place in a medium skillet.  Cook over medium heat until almost crisp, about 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to low.  Add canadian bacon and tomato puree.  Stir, cover, and simmer 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,ramen noodle,rum,clove,russet potato,mustard,fennel seed,cauliflower floret
title: Sweet Sour Dressing Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 packages ramen noodles | 1/4 cup dried cranberries ( not marinated ) | 1 cup cauliflower floret | 1/4 cup fennel seed | 3 whole cloves, broken into small pieces | 8 tablespoons rum | 3 medium-size tart apples, cored and coarsley grated | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard or 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 4 tablespoons dry mustard
instructions: Place ramen in large nonreactive bowl.  Combine cranberries with cauliflower and fennel seeds.  Add remaining ingredients except apples, mustard, and mustard.  Mix well.  Cover and chill several hours or overnight.  Before serving, sprinkle with mustard and sprinkle with bread crumbs if desired.

title: Nokedles Wrapped in Banana's
ingredients: 1 large banana, halved and seeded | 1 herring, cleaned and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Cut the herring fillet into 6 equal pieces.  Place herring fillets on a baking sheet, and spoon slices of banana's onto herring.  Season with salt.  Bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes, or until the herring are tender when pierced with a fork.

title: My Favorite Arroz Con Salsa Verde
ingredients: 4 -5 garlic cloves | 5 -6 cups steamed medium-grain rice
instructions: Dice 4 - 6 cloves of garlic and combine them along with the rice.  Melt garlic in microwave on high for a couple minutes.  When garlic is mostly soft, add 2 cups of steamed stock, stir until the rice is covered.  Cook rice until al dente, usually 20 minutes.  I serve this with a mexican cheese, sour cream, guacamole, green onions, salsa, and tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,mustard,mayonnaise,button mushroom,extra virgin olive oil
title: Mushrooms With Sticky Mayo
ingredients: 3 cans button mushrooms ( in liquid ) | 1/3 cup good quality mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground dry mustard | 1 medium mint sprigs | extra virgin olive oil | 1 medium garlic clove, diced
instructions: Rinse out 1/4 cup of liquid from mushrooms with cool water and squeeze dry the caps with your fingers this allows the excess moisture to drain back into the mushroom and help it absorb the liquid.  Combine mayonnaise, olive oil, mustard and minced garlic.  Stuff mushrooms with the mixture ensuring that they are completely stuffed.  Put on a greased grill and turn a few times so that the mushrooms cook evenly.  Sprinkle with a little extra virgin olive oil and grill over medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes, until cooked through and brown.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,corn kernel,cream coconut,white flour,peanut,lemongrass,sage leaf
title: Thai Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup white flour | 1 cup sour cream, light and creamy | 1 teaspoon dried lemongrass, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves, crushed | 1/2 cup fresh roasted peanuts, chopped coarsely | 15 fresh curry leaves | 1/4 cup corn kernel
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients into a large bowl.  Add sour cream and lemon grass and mix well.  Add peanuts.  Place curry leaves on clean tea towel or parchment paper.  Place 4 - 5 curry leaves on an oiled griddle or cast iron skillet about 1/4 inch high.  Cook about 30 seconds on each side or until golden brown.  Remove from griddle.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,orange zest,white vinegar,fennel bulb,ham steak,garam masala powder,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Indian Style Indian Style Bamboo Skewers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 3/4 lb fresh ham steak | 1/2 garlic, chopped | 1/2 orange, zest of | 1 red italian tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 2 teaspoons white vinegar
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450 degrees.  Spray the foil lightly with cooking spray, and line a baking sheet with foil.  Cut the ham steak in half lengthwise, then crosswise into ¼ inch thick slices.  Spray a 9” x 12” metal cake pan with cooking spray, and place the ham pieces on the foil.  Spray the foil lightly with cooking spray, and then arrange the pieces evenly in the pan.  In a small bowl, stir together the garlic, orange peel and red tomato.  Brush the marinade evenly over the ham pieces, then scatter evenly with the garam masala and vinegar.  Cook for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the ham is cooked through and lightly browned on top.  Carefully remove the foil, and turn up the heat to 400 degrees.  Let cook for 10 - 15 more minutes or until the pan starts to darken.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,rhubarb,rosemary,yellow squash,curry powder,pea carrot,rice noodle,shrimp
title: Curried Beef and Shrimp
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles, broken 1 inch-wide, dried | 1 1/4 lbs boneless tilapia fillets, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 3/4 cup frozen peas and carrot sticks | 1 1/2 cups yellow squash, cut into 1/2 inch chunks | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 1/2 cups rhubarb, sliced ( use 4-6 stalks of the rhubarb stalks ) | 6 large shrimp or 6 large shrimp, each peeled if desired
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil over high heat.  Add the rice noodles and return to a boil.  Boil, uncovered, stirring occasionally until cooked through, about 5 minutes.  Drain and rinse under cold water, then dry on paper towels.  Set aside.  In a medium skillet, cook the tilapia or beef over high heat, stirring to separate the pieces, 3/4 cup peas and carrots, squash, curry powder, and rosemary until lightly browned.  Add the tilapia to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until fish is hot.  Add the shrimp or cooked shrimp to the skillet.  Cook, stirring, until shrimp turn pink, 2 to 3 minutes.  Serve the fish and shrimp over the noodles.

title: Apricot Cheese Spread - Microwave Recipe
ingredients: 500 g apricot jam | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil or 1 tablespoon butter
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a large microwave safe bowl, and microwave in the microwave for about 10 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes for a 3/4 3/4 cup period, until the cheese is melted, but not completely smooth.  Spread onto a greased dish for a snack or luncheon dish, and allow to cool before slicing.

title: Baked Burrines
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon cube | marshmallows | marshmallows
instructions: Add 1 to 2 tbsp instant bouillon to a mug of hot water.  Microwave the marshmallows in a microwave safe bowl, stirring to melt.  Sprinkle 3 to 5 pieces of butter onto the top of marshmallow.  Microwave the marshmallows on a microwave safe plate on low for 3 to 5 minutes, or until melted and bubbly, stirring every minute.  Use your fingers or spoon to remove marshmallow from the bowl, tipping the marshmallow out onto a plate.  Repeat until all marshmallows and butter have been removed, being careful not to crush the marshmallow.  Allow to cool to room temperature before serving.  Repeat with all marshmallows and butter until all marshmallows and butter have been removed.

title: Garlicky Rice With Beans and Prunes
ingredients: 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons coarse-grain rice | 3/4 cup vegetarian baked beans or 3/4 cup canned vegetarian baked beans ( 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 cup herb-chopped fresh tarragon | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup tarragon vinegar | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1/2 cup prunes, finely chopped ( 1 can ) | 2 tablespoons coarse grain rice ( to garnish ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon or 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves | 2 cups cooked long-grain rice
instructions: For the sauce, in a small bowl blend together the vinegar, herbs, garlic, and prunes in a small bowl.  Place the rice in a small deep, heavy saucepan, along with 2 cups water and the vinegar mixture, and bring to a boil.  Cover, reduce the heat to low, and simmer the rice for 50 to 60 minutes or until the rice is tender and water is absorbed.  Keep the pan covered until serving.  Uncover the pan and cook the prunes until brown and tender.  Drain well.  Serve the beans and rice over the beans and rice and sprinkle with the herbs.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,pecorino cheese,sunflower oil,salsa,almond,yellow mustard,bread crumb,french baguette
title: Mama D’ell’s Caribbean Breadcrumb Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup spanish creamed coconut cream | 1/2 cup pecorino cheese, freshly grated | 1/2 cup toasted sliced almonds | 1/2 cup yellow mustard, dry | 2/3 cup bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/3 cup salsa | 1 french baguette, loaf or 10 -12 slices crusty bread, of choice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f/190°c.  In a bowl, combine the creamed coconut cream and grated cheese.  Place the almonds on a baking sheet and toast them on both sides until golden brown, stirring halfway through.  Combine the french breadcrumbs and sesame seeds in a glass or metal bowl.  Dip the bread in the crumbs, shaking off the excess.  Using your hands, spread the bread slices on a baking sheet so that they’re evenly covered.  Spread the coconut cream mixture on the bread slices, top with the toasted almonds and then top with the pecorino cheese.  Bake until the topping is well browned and the loaf is slightly crispy, about 15 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Cucumber & Anchovy Filling for a Beef (Or Turkey) Sandwiches
ingredients: 600 g ground chuck or 600 g ground turkey | 4 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1 large cucumber, finely diced | 1 medium red capsicum, finely diced | 400 g mixed pulses
instructions: Cut the chuck or turkey into very small pieces and pat dry.  Combine with the anchovy paste and cucumber and roll into large balls.  Mix the pulses with 1/3 cup of cooking sauce and brush on rolls.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,cooking spray,grain rice,goat cheese,red potato,cognac,anaheim chilies
title: Chile Rice With Goat Cheese
ingredients: 4 small red potatoes, scrubbed ( about 1 1/2 pounds total weight ) | cooking spray | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oil | 1 cup arborio rice ( about 2-qts puffed rice that has been prepared to the gluten free option with 1/4 cup water ) or 1 cup carnarola rice ( about 2-qts puffed rice that has been prepared to the gluten free option with 1/4 cup water ) | 12 fresh anaheim chilies ( about 3-4 pounds total weight ) | 12 ounces goat cheese, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 12 -14 ounces ready-to-use-salad oil ( for frying ) | 10 -20 fresh small to medium-stick green chilies ( optional substitute jalapeno for a milder chile ) or 10 -20 poblano chiles ( optional substitute jalapeno for a milder chile )
instructions: Cut potatoes lengthwise into halves.  Spray a 4 by 8 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Place potatoes in baking dish and bake at 375~ 400~ 350~ for 22 minutes, until tender.  Meanwhile.  Place 2 cups water in a small saucepan over medium low heat.  Bring to a gentle simmer, cover and set aside.  Add rice to the boiling water and stir occasionally until just fully cooked.  Drain rice well and set aside.  Place chiles in a dry medium pan, set over high heat and dry out a little.  Set chiles aside.  When potatoes are done, remove chiles and set aside.  Heat oil in a 4 - 8 qt frying pan over high heat, then fry chiles.  Turn once, about 2 minutes.  Remove chiles and drain on a paper towels.  Remove all but 2 tbsp oil in pan.  Add rice, 2 tbsp oil and goat cheese to pan and stir until cheese is melted.  Mix in potatoes one cup at a time.  Serve warm with chile sauce.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: margarine,red cayenne pepper,corn tortilla chip,lime wedge,mascarpone cheese,masa harina flour,poblano chile
title: Poblano Chile Cheese Tamale Pie
ingredients: 5 poblano chiles | 1 1/2 pounds mascarpone cheese, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons margarine, divided | 2 tablespoons masa harina flour | 12 corn tortilla chips | 4 lime wedges | 1/8 teaspoon ground red cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat an oven to 475 degrees f.  Roast the poblano peppers under the broiler, setting each poblano onto a piece of aluminum foil.  Roast until evenly blistered, 5 to 7 minutes.  Place the poblanos in a bowl, and cover with plastic wrap.  Allow to sweat until they are cool enough to handle, about 20 to 30 minutes.  Remove the poblanos and place, skin side down, in bowl of a blender with a little water until completely smooth.  Beat in the mascarpone cheese, 1 tablespoon of margarine, and masa harina flour until smooth.  Cover the bowl, and refrigerate overnight.  Place oven rack in the center of the oven, and preheat broiler.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Place the tortilla chips into a bowl, and pour about 1/4 cup of the hot salsa in the bowl over them.  Shake well to remove any stray chips.  Spread the poblano into the prepared baking sheet.  Place baking sheet into the preheated oven, and bake until poblano is tender and no longer sweating, about 10 minutes.  Serve topped with some roasted chips.  To make your own masa harina flour, stir a bit of the shredded cheese into the masa harina.  Melt remaining 2 tablespoons of margarine in a skillet over medium heat, and stir in 1/4 teaspoon of ground red pepper.  Stir in flour for a few minutes to make a paste.  Do not allow to brown, or the flavor will turn bitter.  Transfer the mixture to a bowl, and stir in lime wedges.  Serve with tortilla chips, lime wedges, and poblano cheese.  Yield, 24 to 35 servings.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,white onion,tomato puree,caesar salad dressing,romaine lettuce,raisin,lima bean
title: Aussie Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, scrubbed | 6 tablespoons caesar salad dressing | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 head romaine lettuce, washed, patted dry | 1/4 red onion, chopped | 1 can lima beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can stewed tomatoes in tomato puree
instructions: Peel potatoes, cut into quarters and boil for 5 - 8 minutes until tender.  Meanwhile, make salad dressing.  Cut tomatoes into quarters and add to salad mixture.  Dice cooked potatoes, add them to salad mixture.  Add onion, and raisins to salad.  Toss well.  Serve chilled and enjoy.

title: Tamarind Tofu
ingredients: 250 g firm silken tofu | 3 tablespoons tamarind pulp
instructions: Cut the tofu into slices about 3/4 inch thick.  Soak tamarind pulp and tamarind for half an hour by steaming for 10 minutes or until soft.  Spread the tamarind mixture in a frying pan large enough to completely submerge the tofu.  Place over medium heat and bring up to a boil.  Reduce heat and allow mixture to boil gently, uncovered until mixture becomes very thick and has turned translucent.  Remove tofu slices from pan.  Spread some hot tamarind on the side of steamed tofu slices.  Add more tamarind mixture as desired.  Serve as a side dish with rice or indian/rice dishes.

title: Nuts and Oblesque's Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 6 large tomatoes, cut into quarters | 12 croutons | vegan margarine | 2 tablespoons vegan margarine | 1 tablespoon crushed nut
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  In a large baking pan, melt vegan margarine and margarine together over low heat and stir in nuts.  Remove from the heat and stir in the tomato wedges.

title: White Sauce II
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon | 1/3 cup black vinegar | 1/3 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the wine, bouillon, vinegar, and cheese until the cheese is mixed thoroughly, about 1 minute.

title: Italian Pork Soup
ingredients: 2 1/3 pounds boneless pork shoulder | 3 pounds farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Place pork into a roasting pan and roast in the preheated oven for 1 to 1½ hours, until no longer pink inside and tender inside.

title: Bacon and Canadian Chilli Toasts
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 slice canadian bacon | 1/4 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 teaspoons rose water
instructions: Place the toasts in a preheated 350f oven for 10 minutes.  Cut the bacon in half lengthways and cut each half of the length in half again.  Reserve two halves.  Place them on a baking tray.  Toss the coriander seeds in the rose water and spread on them until the toasts are crisp and evenly coloured.  Top half of the toasts with the canadian bacon pieces and place under the broiler.  Broil or baste the toast and bacon for around 6 minutes until the bacon is crisp and bubbling.

title: Crock Pot Beef Noodle Supper
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck | 10 ounces sun-dried tomatoes | 12 ounces egg noodles
instructions: Mix beef chuck and sun dried tomatoes on crock pot 6 - 8 hours on high.  Cook noodles according to directions on box.  Add noodles to beef and enjoy.

title: Greek Style Yogurt
ingredients: 150 g greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Using a sieve over a bowl, gently squeeze all the yogurt into the sieve.  Once the sieve is removed, sprinkle with the cheese.  This will give the yogurt the texture of yogurt.  Sieve again.  Let the yogurt drain in the refrigerator until it reaches a smooth consistency – about 45 minutes.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Simple and Delicious Basic Hummus
ingredients: 1 can canned chickpeas | 1 pinch saffron | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Drain chickpeas but, while they're hot, warm them in a little olive oil or butter.  Add the rest of the ingredients and mix.  Adjust the chili pepper flakes depending on your tolerance level.  Serve with pita chips or as an appetizer.

title: Armenian Bread and Butter Pilaf
ingredients: 3 cups long grain white rice | 2 1/2 cups whole blanched almonds | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Combine the rice and almonds in a large pot.  Cover with water to 1 inch above the rice and almonds.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed, adding water if rice remains moist and clumping.

title: Mexican Hot Chili Powder  (For Canning)
ingredients: 6 cans tomatoes with green chilies, drained and washed | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Combine tomatoes with chilies in a deep heavy saucepan.  Heat to boiling.  Add chili power.  Cover and cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 - 15 minutes.  Drain juice of tomato when cooked.  Remove from heat.  Allow to cool, then chill.

title: Homemade Moka
ingredients: 1 cup yogurt, whisked until smooth | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla or 1 1/2 teaspoons anise extract | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed
instructions: To make molasses place all of the ingredients in a blender and blend till frothy and mixed well.  Chill.

title: Curried Walnuts and Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 cup cooked wild rice ( i use uncle bill's converted ) | 1 medium firm pear, diced | 1 cup fresh corn kernels | 1 can sliced red chilies | 2 ounces walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground sumac, to sprinkle on top or ( 1/4 teaspoon )
instructions: Melt the curry paste in a non stick skillet over medium heat, add the wild rice and heat until hot.  Add the pear, corn, chilis, and walnuts to skillet and stir.  Simmer until all vegetables are crisp tender.  Sprinkle with sumac.  Note, i'm not really sure how this makes a serving.

title: Simple, Easy Rice Cones
ingredients: 4 cups uncooked instant rice | 1 jar grape jelly
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot.  Add rice and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until al dente.  Turn off heat and stir in jelly.  Drain and serve immediately.

title: Rhubarb and Red Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes, peeled | 1 lb rhubarb, trimmed but with stalks on
instructions: Wash and dry the potatoes.  Cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes.  Cut the rhubarb into 1 1/2 inch pieces and drop into 1 1/2 quarts of boiling water.  Reduce heat and simmer until the rhubarb is tender.  Drain the potatoes and add to the rhubarb.  Cook over high heat for a minute or two to heat through.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,stewing beef,bean sprout,grape tomato,pesto sauce,beef bouillon cube,cherry brandy
title: Torta Di Savoixo (Peperoncini)
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef or 1 lb stewing pork, cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 1 pint grape tomatoes or 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 can fresh bean sprouts | 1 cup fresh mixed mushrooms or 1 cup canned mushrooms | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 3 tablespoons prepared low-fat greek salad dressing | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed and dissolved in | 1 1/2 tablespoons clear brandy or 1 1/2 tablespoons dry red wine
instructions: Place all ingredients except the garnishes into a large, heavy nonstick skillet.  Cover and cook over moderately high heat, stirring often, until vegetables are softened, about 4 minutes.  Reduce heat to moderate.  Stir in the stock, cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until meat is tender, approximately 1 1/4 hours.  The stock should bubble and darken somewhat, about 25 minutes.  Uncover and cook, stirring, another 5 minutes.  Remove the pan from heat.  Stir in the brandy and heat, stirring, 1 minute.  If serving as a buffet, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cooking silver aluminum foil,stir fry oil,pork,kernel corn,rib eye steak,green cabbage,garlic scape
title: Filipino Pepper Pot Pork
ingredients: 2 pork, cut into 1-inch pieces | 8 ounces medium stir fry oil | 4 -5 cloves garlic scapes, minced or 2 -3 dashes red pepper flakes | 4 green cabbage ( about 2 inches long ) | 8 ounces sweet whole kernel corn ( about 2 ears of corn ) | cooking silver aluminum foil | 1 can whole kernel corn and green cabbage, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Spray the inside of a 9x11 casserole dish with cooking spray.  Place pork, stir fry oil, garlic and sherry in a large bowl.  Add the pork.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,stew meat,beef bouillon cube,cocoa powder,flour tortilla,plum,artichoke heart,english cucumber
title: Cha Cha  (Stir-Fried Beef With Cumin, Chocolate, Artichoke Hearts)
ingredients: 3 cans plum tomatoes, whole, drained | 3 cups stew meat, diced | 16 ounces canned artichoke hearts, drained | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed | 1 beef bouillon cube or 3 bouillon cubes | 10 large flour tortillas, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1 english cucumber, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the day before serving.  Heat a nonstick skillet to medium high.  Combine plum tomatoes and stew meat in a dutch oven.  Cover and simmer over medium low heat, stirring occasionally, until meat and tomatoes are completely blended and stew meat are crisp, about 1 hour and 20 minutes.  Transfer stew mixture to a bowl and keep warm.  If desired, prepare the cucumber.  Dissolve the bullion cube in 4 cups of hot water in a small saucepan to make a 1 cup liquid.  Stir in the cumin.  Transfer about 3/4 cup of stew liquid to the bowl containing the stew and blend in the cocoa powder, cuminseed, and bouillon until thoroughly combined.  Spread about 2/3 cup of stew on a plate and top with 2/3 of the cucumber slices.  Repeat with the remaining stew, tortillas, and the remaining cucumber slices.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,serrano chili,romaine lettuce leaf,pecan half,capsicum,curry leaf,paprika,arborio rice
title: Spice-Aduck: Ancient Renaissance Rice Stuffed Curd
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 1/2 cups pecan halves | 2 teaspoons salt | 2 teaspoons sweet paprika | 1/2 cup mild curry leaf | 1/3 cup low-sodium v8 vinegar | 1 small serrano chili | 2 romaine lettuce leaves | 4 crisp capicums, halved crosswise
instructions: Combine rice, pecans, salt, paprika and curry leaves in a small bowl.  Stuff cavicums with rice and spread the cavicums with a generous tablespoonful of spice mixture, close the lid and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 1 day.  Cut capsicum into 4 - 5 pieces, garnish with capicums and serve on a bed of chopped lettuce leaves.

title: Rhubarb & Guinness Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb rhubarb, finely chopped | 1/2 cup guinness stout | 2 tablespoons lime or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 teaspoons orange rind, grated | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | tortilla ( accompaniment )
instructions: Combine the rhubarb, guinness, lime rind and fish sauce.  Place over medium heat and cook 5 minutes or until rhubarb is tender.  Serve warm with tortillas.

title: Smoked Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 2 cans artichoke hearts | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Drain artichokes, reserving juice in large jar.  Using 1/2 cup reserved artichoke juice, add 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika and cumin seeds to the jar with reserved pan juice.  Cover and shake until well combined.  Add artichoke hearts and remaining paprika, then gently stir in artichoke juice.  Marinate, covered, in refrigerator at least 1 hour before serving, allowing flavors to blend.  Makes enough to cover and cover 2 cups of dip.

title: Crunchy Seed Squash Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 large yellow squash - peeled, seeded and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup sunflower seeds
instructions: Place the squash cubes in a bowl, and sprinkle with sunflower seeds.  Cover, and refrigerate overnight.  The next day, drain the seeds and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: arugula,cooking oil,red wine,canola oil,hot pepper,confectioner sugar,chicken tender
title: Chinese Chicken
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 package frozen skinless, boneless chicken tenders, thawed and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons red wine | 1/4 cup chopped red pepper | 1/2 cup chopped fresh arugula
instructions: In a medium saucepan, microwave 2 tablespoons canola oil.  Heat the remaining canola oil over high heat 30 seconds.  Add the chicken and sugar.  Stir to coat the chicken with the oil.  Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally until slightly browned, about 10 minutes.  Stir in the wine and red pepper.  Spoon chicken onto a work surface and roll up.

Random Ingredients: catsup,lemon juice zest,jeera powder,whipping cream,enoki mushroom,pork shoulder,penne pasta
title: Penne With Chilled Pork and Hijera Hot
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta, cooked according to package directions | 3 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 2 teaspoons jeera powder | 1 boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package enoki mushrooms | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: In a large bowl, pour boiling water over penne.  Mix catsup, lemon juice, and jeera.  Add pork.

title: Molay's Salted Herbs - Get the Real Mix!
ingredients: 5 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon lemon peel
instructions: Place all the dry ingredients in the bowl of your stand mixer or a bread machine tray.  Mix as quickly as possible with the dough hook provided of a hand held paddle.  When the dough becomes too sticky and dry, it will only take on a slightly sticky texture.  Knead this mixture, if necessary, for 3 - 5 minutes.  Place dough in a clean bowl, cover with plastic wrap and place in a warm spot.  Leave to prove, about 1 hour, until it has doubled in size.  Knock back the dough with your fist.  Roll out into about 1/4 or 1/3 inch thick x 1 1/2 inches.  Cut with rounds using a round cookie cutter, glass, biscuit or pastry wheel.  Let rise until it is doubled in size.  Punch down and flatten into a 5 x 12 inch rectangle.  Seal the edges and cut slits or diagonal slits in the loaf with a sharp knife.  Cover with damp cloth and leave to rise at room temperature for 60 - 90 minutes.  The loaf will be as soft as bread dough, but will firm up if it is allowed to rise.  Bake at 425 f.  For 20 minutes or so until nicely browned.  Allow on rack to cool.  The loaf is also very attractive with butter, crackers, bread sticks or fruit.

title: Red Lentils and Tortillas
ingredients: 2 cups red lentils | 2 -3 medium tortillas
instructions: Wash lentils and sort.  Put in large sauce pan and put over low heat.  Cook on low heat, stirring occasionally, until lentils start to dry out, about 20 - 30 minutes.  Turn off heat and let lentils sit for 1/2 an hour.  Heat a frying pan, and fry each tortilla on both sides until they start to crisp up.  Spray with cooking oil spray or use an olive oil.  Place tortillas on plate, and put in microwave for 15 - 20 minutes.  Top with favorite spices and serve with rice, beans, or anything else you like on top.

title: Saucy Crawfish
ingredients: 1 pound crawfish tails | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 green yellow bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add crawfish tails, and cook uncovered for 2 minutes, or until cooked through.  Drain, and mash hot crawfish in a bowl until creamy.  Return to pot, and stir in butter and green bell pepper.  Serve immediately.

title: Wheat Germ and Hazelnut Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mixed greens | 1 teaspoon toasted hazelnuts | 1 pinch balsamic vinegar | 1 small head lettuce, torn into bite size pieces
instructions: Place the mixed greens on a baking sheet.  Sprinkle with hazelnuts and drizzle with the vinegar.  Bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees f for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to make sure the hazelnuts stay crunchy.

title: Capers Cheese
ingredients: 2 ounces jarred capers | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 3 -4 teaspoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Heat 1 teaspoons olive oil in a nonstick skillet.  Add capers and cook over low heat for 1 minutes or until crisp tender.  Remove capers from skillet.  Combine drained capers and remaining 1 teaspoon olive oil, stirring until cheese is melted.  Place on a plate or in a small serving bowl and sprinkle with lemon peel.

Random Ingredients: italian spice,green chilies,tofu,garlic granule,purple cabbage,cilantro stem,orange juice
title: Tofu Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces firm tofu | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian spices | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules | 1/2 cup purple cabbage, finely shredded | fresh cilantro stem | 1 can green chilies, minced
instructions: Thinly slice the tofu lengthwise, then crosswise into 1/2 inch slices.  Heat the orange juice in a medium skillet set over medium high heat.  Saute the tofu in the hot lemon juice until browned, 5 to 8 minutes.  Spoon out onto a plate and allow to cool.  Mix the italian seasoning, garlic, cabbage, chilies, tofu and orange sauce with the orange mixture, tossing to blend.  Garnish with cilantro sprigs and serve at room temperature.

title: Creamy Date Crisps
ingredients: 8 ounces dates, pitted and finely chopped | 1 1/2 - 2 cups margarine
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over low heat or in the microwave until all the butter is melted.  Add the dates and toss to coat.  Drop the temperature to medium and stir every few seconds until the dates are coated.  Turn the heat to medium low and continue to stir and watch from time to time for a few moments.  The crumbs will thicken slightly and the dates will look golden brown at this point, taking about five minutes.  Keep stirring or shaking the skillet until they are all golden brown.  Remove from heat and allow the mixture to cool to room temperature.  Cut the squares at a 45 degree angle and roll into balls about three inches in diameter.  Dip into melted margarine to coat.  Makes about thirty four 1 1/2 inch balls.

title: Queso Blanco
ingredients: 32 ounces broth, black or white | 1 large jalapeno pepper, chopped
instructions: Bring the broth to a boil in a large heavy bottomed pan.  Add the jalapeno peppers and simmer for 40 minutes or until slightly soft.  Remove the stems, seeds and pith from the pepper and puree in your food processor until smooth.

title: Spicy Hot Dogs for Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb hot dog ( spicy or hot dogs ) | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ground szechwan pepper | 3/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: Grind fenugreek seeds and seasonings in a food processor or spice mill to a fine powder.  Drain hot dogs and rinse thoroughly.  Brush off excess fat wrap in foil and place on foil.  Toast in oven for 20 - 30 minutes.  Turn often until done.  Variation, place hot dog on paper towel covered plate for 10 minutes or until cool enough to handle.  Grill/bbq with your favorite mustard for the same amount of time.

title: Italian Bistro Steak
ingredients: 3 ounces beef stock ( not cream ) | 3 maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Bring beef stock to a simmer in a heavy skillet on the stove top.  Remove from heat.  Remove and discard maraschino cherries.  Sterilize 8 individual ramekins.  Pour beef stock into each ramekin and add 4 cherries to each.  Put each ramekin into an ovenproof dish and place under the broiler for 3 minutes or until puffed and hot.

title: Beetroot on a Skewer
ingredients: 2 pickled beetsroot | kosher salt | 1 bamboo skewer, soaked in water
instructions: Cut beets and slice about ¼ inch thick.  Sprinkle pickled beets on skewer and coat with kosher salt.  Let sit in the refrigerator for about 1 hour.  Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil.  Add bamboo skewers and remove from heat.  Leave soaking liquid in the bowling pot.  Warm bamboo skewers in an iron skillet over medium heat until ready to use, but do not let the metal touch the oil.  Remove the bamboo skewers from water and place them onto the hot bamboo skewers, leaving about an inch between them.  Cook for about 1 1/2 minutes on each side, or until they are a deep, golden brown.

title: Scotch Steak With Mustard and Peanuts - for the BBQ
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs beef short ribs or 4 -6 lbs veal shanks | 4 tablespoons flour | 1/2 teaspoon english mustard | 1 jar grape tomatoes, halved | 1 cup peanuts, roasted and salted
instructions: Preheat the grill to high.  Remove meat from bones and place in a large saucepan.  Dredge the meat in the flour, coating evenly on both sides.  Shake off any excess flour.  Add to the pork.  Add tomatoes and nuts.  Bring to a boil and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Easy Italian Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 package mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 chicken bouillon cubes or 8 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: In a casserole dish, layer cheese and then the chicken pieces.  Pour bouillon over.  Bake at 400 degrees about 20 minutes until bubbly and golden.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,sunflower seed,kidney bean,chili oil,german mustard
title: Chilli Bean and Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 250 g mixed beans ( pinto beans, rinsed and drained ) | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds | 2 tablespoons kidney beans, drained | 2 teaspoons sweetgerman mustard | 1 teaspoon mild chili oil | 1 teaspoon german mustard
instructions: Place seeds in a heatproof jug.  Cover and leave to swell for 10 - 15 minutes until slightly charred.  Place all other ingredients in a bowl and toss lightly.  Season with salt, to taste.

title: Mint Pouring Creme Fraiche
ingredients: heavy whipping cream, warmed | 1/2 cup sweetened mint leaves
instructions: Place each ingredient in a blender.  Start to warm your cream over very low heat just before serving the creme fraiche in a small bowl.  Pour into a champagne or other high sided glass bowl and let set.  When ready, give the creme fraiche a few stirs so the mint coats the back of a spoon.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,chicken breast,taco seasoning mix,cannellini bean
title: Taco Chicken
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, undrained | 3/4 ounce taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees.  In a bowl add the undrained cannellini beans, taco seasoning, lemon juice and chicken.  Mix well.  Transfer to a lightly greased 11x7 baking dish.  Bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Flamb and Mango Prawns

instructions: Combine prawns, mango chutney, tahini, and carrots in a saucepan over low heat, and cook until heated through, about 10 minutes.  Pour contents of saucepan into a serving bowl and sprinkle with caraway seeds and cumin.  Serve.

title: Shredded Pear with Chipotle Powder
ingredients: 4 pears, cores intact, peeled and quartered | 5 teaspoons chipotle powder
instructions: Place 1 pear into a blender.  Add 5 teaspoons chipotle powder to 1/4 cup water and blend thoroughly.  Repeat with remaining pear.  Pack mixture into a small, nonstick casserole dish, cover loosely and refrigerate.  Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Bake until pears are slightly soft, about 25 minutes.  Remove pears and pass through a strainer or slotted strainer to remove the seeds and juice.  Stir the pears and their juice into the chipotle dressing.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,extra virgin olive oil,pork tenderloin,salt,margarine,egg yolk,macadamia nut

ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed of any visible fat ( about 1 lb ) | salt | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 3/4 cup macadamia nuts ( may substitute pistachios ) | 1 lb sauerkraut, in | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Slice the pork in 1 1/4 cubes and sprinkle with salt evenly.  Brush the mixture with egg yolk.

title: Crazy Chocolate Rice Krispies Treats for Kids!
ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate | 250 g rice krispies | 5 tablespoons tarragon, chopped ( or fresh or dried tarragon, roughly chopped )
instructions: Break up the chocolate in a bowl with a fork.  Microwave it on a microwave safe dish on medium high for 5 - 10 minutes, stirring every minute to prevent it burning, or until melted.  Add the rice krispies and stir to combine.  Add the chopped tarragon and stir well to combine.  Let stand for 10 minutes or until the chocolate is set.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine rice, soup, chili sauce, and sherry.  Spoon 1/4 cup soup mixture into a shallow casserole.  Top with two slices of cheese.  Bake in preheated oven about 35 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Ethiopian Fish Chips
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 6 tilapia fillets | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pods | 1/4 teaspoon feshly ground green pepper | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/3 cup shaved parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f degrees.  Spread a layer of sprays of the vegetable cooking spray onto a cookie sheet. While fish is baking, mix green pepper with mustard and parmesan in a small bowl.  Place on another cookie sheet that has been lightly sprayed with cooking spray.  Bake for an additional 5 minutes.  Cut before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg quarter,coriander seed,turnip,beef roast,coconut,baby spinach

instructions: Place chicken legs in a shallow ovenproof dish.  Season with coriander and half the coconut.  Cover with the rest of the coconut. Place shredded meat on top and serve with salad.

title: Taste of India Pizza for Two (Taste of India)

instructions: Punch tomatoes gently with your hands and chop roughly.  Place in a large bowl and sprinkle with coconut cream.  Sprinkle yeast over and stir vigorously.  Let stand 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Scotch Style Country-Style Beef Short Ribs

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Fill a large baking dish half full with water.  Line a large cast iron skillet with aluminum foil. Sprinkle with the bread flour.  Cover loosely with aluminum foil.  Bake in preheated oven for 4 hours, or until meat is easily pulled apart.

3/4 cup packed dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 1/4 cup chopped crystallized aniseed ( i made my own by combining 1 t.

Let stand for 15 minutes for juices to redistribute during the cooking process.  Meanwhile place apples in a saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to a boil and simmer, covered, for about 5 minutes.  Drain apples well and finely chop.  Place pork tenderloin in a large zip top bag and pour in cream mixture.  Press out excess air.  Add apples and toss to coat.  In roasting pan, arrange apple mixture around tenderloin, and roast for 20 - 25 minutes, or until thermometer registers 175 f.  Transfer to serving platter and let stand for 15 minutes.  Slice and serve with vegetables.

title: Nepalese Potatoes (Botswana)

instructions: In a medium size saucpan, saute the canadian bacon.  Remove from the pan and set aside.  Add the flour to the pan.  Add the port, bbq sauce and bacon.  Cook over medium heat for a few minutes to thicken.

instructions: Heat a medium saute pan over medium heat.  Add the leeks and saute until transparent, about 3 minutes.  Add the beans, green onion, kale and pesto.

Put a large oven proof plate upside down and lay half the potato wedges at one edge of the pan.  Put 1 tablespoon of olive oil on the top of the potato mixture.  Put the baking sheet on the top of the lid.  Put the contents of the pan into the oven.  Bake until the potato wedges are crisp and brown, 15 - 20 minutes or until a skewer passes underneath the bread with ease and the bread is crusty and crusty.  Serve warm.

instructions: Remove peel from 2 large firm Asian pears, then cut them in 1/4 to 1/3 rounds.  Remove cores and slice the rounds into 1/4 inch slices.  Brush each slice well with 1/4 teaspoon of the chili oil and sprinkle evenly with pepper.  Grill apple slices over high heat until almost soft, just a bit crisp, about 1 or 2 minutes per side.  Allow to stand 2 to 3 minutes before serving.

title: Lamb and Nachos in Caramelized Spinach
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground lamb | 1/4 teaspoon white peppercorns, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon marjoram | 8 -10 cups baby spinach | 3 tablespoons caramel topping | 1 1/2 cups finely granny smith apples or 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded | corn tortilla chips, for serving
instructions: Brown lamb with white wine, peppercorns, marjoram and sauté till lamb is no longer pink.  Remove and place in large pan.  Add baby spinach and caramel.  Toss till wilted.  Sprinkle with cheese and sprinkle with chips.

title: Cheese Salad

instructions: Place the cheese in a bowl or food processor and pulse until the mixture is uniformly fine.  Add the mustard to the cheese and pulse until the mixture is finely shredded.  Taste and adjust the seasoning.  Add the spring onion just before serving, to taste.  Serve at room temperature.

title: The Banana & Burrata Burger
