instructions: Mash the banana with the basil and fennel in a bowl, being careful to leave it a little chunky for texture.  Form the mixture into four burgers and lightly press down with your hands.  Put the focaccia on a plate, then make each burger in the palm of one hand and place under a hot grill.  The burgers should be cooked to your liking and the focaccia should be golden brown.

title: Italian Meat Sausage
ingredients: 6 slices ground meat | 1/2 cup cashews, dry roasted | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs ( not dry ) | 2 medium baking potatoes, scrubbed | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Spray a 12x20 pan with cooking spray.

title: Quick & Easy Noodle Lasagna

instructions: Combine all ingredients except for noodles in one saucepan.  Simmer over low heat, covered, for 20 minutes.  Stir in noodles, and continue cooking 10 minutes, or until the noodles are tender.  Remove from heat, and mix in remaining sauce.  Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Quick Oven Coffee Snack
ingredients: 4 ounces cold strong coffee granules | 1 teaspoon dried asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 baguette ( optional )
instructions: In a small serving bowl stir together the coffee, asafetida and apple juice.  Soak the baguette in the apple juice mixture.  Cut baguette into cubes about 1/2 to 3/4, and dip the bread cubes into it.  The dip will keep for 2 days in the refrigerator.  This can also be made toasted on the grill.

title: Pumpkin Tacos (Raw)

instructions: Drain the pumpkin and chop into bite sized pieces.  Coarsely grate the pumpkin flesh.  Mix pumpkin, peppers, pepper and hot pepper sauce to make a soft, but firm paste.  Spoon the mixture into warmed taco shells.  Sprinkle with cinnamon, if desired.

instructions: Brown ground chuck in large dutch oven or skillet.  Add cheese and stir until melted.  Add wine and stir with spoon until absorbed.  Add fish stock.  Stir in rice. title: Stuffed Fennel

title: Cheese and Paneer Fondue

instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the cheese, buttermilk, curry powder and 1 tablespoon mint flavored cooking spray.  Transfer cheese mixture to a fondue pot set over low heat. Stir into fondue until smooth, then refrigerate until served.

title: Irish Leek Vinaigrette

instructions: Place leeks in a saucepan with enough water to cover.

title: Chicken in Herb and Ricotta Sauce

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a large bowl mix all ingredients together.  Add salt and anchovies and mix well.  Arrange chicken in a single layer in oven proof dish and add anchovies. Variation, instead of goat base, you can use ricotta cheese, goat cheese, goat meat and feta cheese.

title: Quick and Easy Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 jar roasted deli corned beef, thinly sliced, reserve liquid | 3 ounces unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1/2 cup brewed coffee or 1/2 cup hot espresso | 1 small-medium ladyfinger | cocoa
instructions: Using a 1 quart capacity zip top plastic bag, combine remaining ingredients, mixing well with your hands and set aside.  When your hands begin to form a ball, take 2 handfuls of the corned beef and roll them in the cocoa powder and press the mixture firmly around the inside of your bag.  Scoop the bag into your prepared pan.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hours to allow the flavors to mingle.  Preheat over to 300 degrees, placing a baking pan of water on the middle rack if your oven is too hot for the lid.  Remove 1/4 of the cocoa from the plastic bag, shaking the bag around to distribute the cocoa all around.  Slice off 1 green portion of the ladyfinger and carefully remove the rest with a knife.  Discard the white part of the ladyfinger.  Place the rest of the cocoa in an 8 inch glass dish, preferably glass to avoid splattering.  Using a fork, slice up each of the softened ladyfingers into small pieces without breaking the skin.  Place the pieces in the glass dish in a circular pattern.  Repeat above layering, finishing with a chocolate sprinkling of cocoa and a sprinkle of cocoa over each of the hardened ladyfingers.  Heat in the oven for 30 minutes, uncovered, turning once, until the chocolate is just beginning to darken.  Serve.

title: Sweet and Sour Tropical Meat Salad

title: Cheesy Beef Stew

title: Gorgonzola Meatball Soup

title: Tahousek (Lamb Chops Skewers Using Zatziki Sauce)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahousek ( to taste ) or 2 tablespoons other homemade tahousek | 1/2 - 3/4 lb lamb loin chops | tzatziki or sour cream, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Soak the tahousek overnight.  The next day, preheat grill.  Remove loin from the marinade, rinse thoroughly.  Pat dry with paper towels.  Thread meat onto skewers.  Grill on hot grill to internal temperature of 145ºf or until the internal lamb temperature reaches 160ºf on an instant reading thermometer, about 10 minutes depending on the thickness of the meat.  Serve immediately with optional sauce.

title: Irish Potato Slices
ingredients: 7 large russet potatoes | 6 cloves, whole
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Line baking sheets with parchment paper.  Cut a small slit in each russet potato about 1/2 inch deep.  Put potatoes in a large bowl of cold water.  Remove tops with a slotted spoon and rub off any remaining water.  Put potatoes in the water and toss to coat.  Sprinkle with whole cloves.  Cook in preheated oven until tops are lightly browned, approximately 20 minutes.  Turn off oven and set potatoes in a warm place.  Leave oven on.  Let potatoes rest, loosely covered with foil at least 15 minutes before serving.

title: Sweetcorn Mousse
ingredients: 1 cup frozen sweetcorn | 1/2 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons calvados ( apple brandy ) | cooking rolled oats, as required
instructions: Bring a small saucepan of water to boil.  Add the frozen sweetcorn kernels.  Cook and stir till the water has evaporated and the corn is crisp tender.  Blend in the ricotta cheese and calvados to combine well.  Serve warm with sliced fresh fruit.  To serve cold, chill in the refrigerator till service.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate chip,onion powder,cooking spray,kombu,scallion,sesame oil,cardamom
title: Sesame Chiles
ingredients: 4 dried kombu | 2 tablespoons minced scallions | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( i use cardamom pods ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried onion powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons white chocolate chips | 2 -3 tablespoons toasted sesame oil | cooking spray
instructions: Place the dried kombu in a bowl with the scallions, cardamom, onion powder, and white chocolate chips.  Heat oil in a 10 inch skillet over medium heat.  Stir often until the chocolate melts and begins to turn brown but retains fragrance, 3 - 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Holding one end of a long handled wooden spoon, gently push the chiles into hot oil, a few per turn, then press down on the centers so the chiles form balls about 1 1/2 inch in diameter.  Brown the chiles over medium heat for about 5 minutes, then transfer to a tray.  Keep warm in a low oven.  Repeat until all the chiles have been cooked.  Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,macadamia nut,oil vegetable,corn oil,pearl barley,cilantro
title: Macadamia Nuts and Garlic (Macadamia Nut and Barley)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup roasted macadamia nuts | coarsely chopped cilantro | fresh mint sprig | 1 teaspoon corn oil
instructions: Bring a water temperature to a boil and add macadamia nuts.  Simmer over low heat with lid slightly ajar, stirring occasionally untill nuts are tender and water has been absorbed.  Set aside and cool.

title: Rum Sticks
ingredients: 1 lb dark rum | 2 ounces chives, snipped
instructions: Place the rum, chives and rum in a highball glass.  Top up with club soda.  Stir well and serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,blue cheese,olive oil,anise seed,pepper jack cheese
title: Melt in Your Mouth Polenta Rounds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 package frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 1 cup low-fat blue cheese | 2 cups shredded pepper jack cheese
instructions: Heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat.  When oil is hot, stir in anise seeds.

title: Grilled Lamb Sandwiches for 2
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless leg of lamb | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish
instructions: Preheat grill.  Combine horseradish and 1/4 cup water, stirring to make a paste.  Rub the outside of the lamb with marinade.  Grill lamb, turning once, until medium rare, about 15 minutes.

title: Ninfa Di Manchego (Mexican Cheese Sauce)
ingredients: 5 ounces manchego cheese, grated ( about 7 tablespoons ) | 1 fluid ounce dry white wine | 1 -2 teaspoon red chili powder ( mild, hot )
instructions: Place cheese and chile in a food processor.  Pulse a few times and process until well combined.  Place in a small bowl.  Pour white wine into another small bowl.  Dip the spoon in white wine and drop the cheese into the wine then whisk until creamy and smooth.  Serve warm with prawns, fish or veggies.

Random Ingredients: sugar snap pea,pecorino romano cheese,self rising flour,dijon mustard
title: Bread Machine Italian Sugar Snap Peas & Pecorino Romano Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour, plus more | 1 1/3 cups unbleached self-rising flour, plus more | 1 1/3 cups pecorino romano cheese, coarsely grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 4 cups raw sugar snap peas, trimmed and seeded
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bread pan in the order recommended by the manufacturer.  Select the dough setting in the bread pan.  If the dough is too dry, add 1/4 cup of flour and 1/2 teaspoon of dijon.  Note, the bread machine may also be used to mix in 1 lb of dry roasted and unsalted pecorino romano cheese.  Sprinkle a few tablespoons of extra dijon on toasted pecorino romano and process until combined.  Transfer the dough to a 2 lb loaf pan and shape into a tight round loaf.  Place loaf in a large pan lined with wax paper, then cover and let rise until doubled in size.  Preheat the oven to 325°f.  Using a sharp, wet knife, score top of crust about 1/2 inch deep.  Bake the bread until a knife blade inserted in center comes out clean, about 50 - 60 minutes.  Serve warm and proceed with the pecorino romano topping recipe if you prefer.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,mini chocolate chip,butter,beef tenderloin fillet,saffron
title: Salt-Laced Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin fillets ( about 4 ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup butter | 5 cups mini chocolate chips | 1/4 teaspoon crumbled saffron or 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit.  Center beef on rack in shallow roasting pan.  Insert metal blade into center of beef.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,poppy seed,corn,margarine,reynolds wrap foil,nutmeg,coffee,rice noodle
title: Mongolian Poppy Seed Noodle Pancake #RSC
ingredients: 1 package frozen sweet corn, thaw, thaw, drained, and cooled | 1 cup cooked rice noodles ( about 5 per pancake ) | 4 tablespoons margarine, melted | 1 cup freshly brewed coffee, cooled | 1 egg yolk | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Lightly grease a 2 quart rectangular baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Heat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread 1/2 package of peas with about 1 tbsp of the margarine in a shallow baking dish, allowing it to stick.  Layer the noodles, 1/2 cup of cooled peas, and 1/2 cup of cooled soup, mixing to coat.  Sprinkle with the nutmeg, poppy seeds and remaining margarine.  Continue layering the noodle mixture, sweet corn, coffee, egg yolk, and nutmeg, respectively, ending with a sprinkling of the poppy seed.  Bake in the middle of the oven for 14 - 18 minutes, till golden brown.  Let sit for a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,bean sprout,herb stuffing mix,anchovy fillet,sun tomato,white sugar
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 package herb stuffing mix | 1 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/2 cup dry cranberries | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1 can anchovy fillets, mashed | 1/3 cup fresh cranberries | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries
instructions: Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions and refrigerate remaining ingredients in a large bowl.  Drain anchovies.  Add anchovies to salad and toss.

title: Pesto Dip II
ingredients: 1 jar dried morels | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 container prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Place the dried morels in a saucepan, and set them over a medium low flame.  Stir frequently with a wooded spoon to release any additional lumps and to help loosen any browned bits.  When the morels are golden brown, remove from heat and soak in hot water until softened, about 15 minutes.  When cool, remove and discard the hard cores.  Discard the hard outer green portion of the morels.

title: Oriental Noodles (Oriental Style)
ingredients: 8 ounces oriental flavor instant ramen noodles, softened | 1 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: In small bowl, mix crushed ramen noodles with half and half.  Place noodles in 2 quart glass baking dish.  Pour noodle mixture over noodles, and cover tightly with plastic wrap.  Microwave on hi for 3 minutes.  Poke plastic several times with a toothpick.  Remove plastic wrap from dish, stir thoroughly.  Cover.

title: Salmon With Tomatoes in Ouzo
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ouzo ( to taste ) | 1 plum tomato, skinned and chopped | 20 ounces salmon fillets | 1 -2 cup bean sprouts | watercress, chopped, to serve
instructions: To make ouzo, use a good quality olive oil to flavour 1 tablespoon olive oil, preferably one with good flavour and colour.  In a small dish, mix the chopped tomato with the chopped tomato, and set aside in its juices.

title: Lettuce - Raw Foods
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh lettuce, washed ( washed well ) | 1 medium carrot, peeled & grated | 3 tablespoons cumin seeds ( whole ) | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 pinch ground nutmeg
instructions: Prepare the lettuce, if using baby cos lettuce heads, remove all excess water then place all the other ingredients in a pan, bring to the boil, then lower the heat.  Cover & cook until all the liquid is gone from the tomatoes & the spices are fragrant, about 15 mins, depending on type of your lettuce.  If using baby cos lettuce heads place them on a hot tray & cook just until they are tender, or they may break to separate.  When the head is complete remove from the heat & allow to cool for about 3 mins.  With a slotted spoon remove the centre layer.  Place the cooled lettuce and any liquid in a large mixing bowl & toss well but not too much.  If using baby cos leaves place them in the bowl and toss with the spices.  Serve on a bed of roasted vegetables.

title: Chinese Spicy Oil
ingredients: 5 1/2 lbs cooking oil ( preferably solid-pack vegetable oil ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 1/2 - 3 1/2 teaspoons crushed star anise ( or 7 - 10 whole pods )
instructions: Heat the oil slowly in a heavy gauge skillet with the star anise pods.  As soon as it starts to smoke just a tiny bit, add the sesame oil.  When the oil is warm, pour very slowly into the sieve to remove the flavorings to the bottom.  After all of the oils have been added it should be about 1/8 inch thick.  If any salt or oil oozes out of the sieve, add little by little until you have achieved this consistency.  Do not try to use high heat.  This will not work very well.  Let the oil cool until you are able to handle it.  Pour the cooled oil in a clean jar with a tight fitting lid.  Keep in the refrigerator and use within 1 month.

Random Ingredients: okra,rump steak,wild rice,rocket,curry paste,tomato ketchup,beef broth,cream cheese chive
title: Beef and Okra Curry
ingredients: 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 cup uncooked wild rice | 6 ounces frozen okra | 1/2 cup beef broth | 2 ounces cream cheese with chives | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 2 tablespoons beef broth | 4 ounces fresh rocket, trimmed | 10 g fresh goat salted butter
instructions: Rinse and drain rice.  Cook on the highest heat for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, cover okra in boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes and drain.  Drain well, then fry in 1/2 cup oil for 3 - 5 minutes until golden.  Remove okra from the skillet and place in a bowl with okra.  Add rice, meat, onion, broth, cream cheese, ketchup and beef broth.  Mix.  Return the pan to the heat and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is almost absorbed.  Serve on steamed or fried salad leaves.

title: Swiss Chard and Chickpea Stew
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, leaves and stems chopped | kale, bunches about 9 ounces | 1 can chick-peas, drained and rinsed | rosemary sprig ( optional )
instructions: Put the chard leaves and stems in a large pot.  Slice them crossways into 1/8 inch thick slices.  Sprinkle them with salt.  Add 1 can chickpeas and just enough water to cover them.  Place the pot over high heat and bring the water to a boil.  Add the swiss chard leaves and stems in the last minute of cooking.  You may add additional water, if needed.  When the swiss chard has wilted and is almost completely wilted, remove it from the pot.  Cover and chill for at least 4 hours, or overnight.  Serve with fresh rosemary.  Note, to make a softer stew, add 1/2 cup of water and cook until tender, adding more liquid as needed.  When you are ready to serve this dish, reheat and mix in some more of the chickpeas to deepen the flavors and texture.

title: Spanish Cream
ingredients: 2 cups fresh white grape juice | 1 dash hot sauce | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon jam
instructions: Add grape juice and hot sauce to blender container.  Add garlic powder and jam.  Mix well.  Pour into tall glass.

title: Guava Daube Tortillas
ingredients: 4 lbs stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 8 ounces guava nectar | 2 ounces currants | 8 small dates, pitted and halved | 64 inches flour tortillas
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f combine half the stew meat, guava nectar and currants.  Divide evenly among tortillas and arrange the dates on top.  Spray 13x9 in baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Cook, uncovered, in oven uncovered 10 minutes or until tomatoes start to brown.  Remove from oven and arrange tortillas in baking dish, overlapping evenly, for 30 minutes.  Cut and serve.

title: Lobster With Potato Croutons and Arugula (Batata Charkes)
ingredients: 1 lb lobster, sliced | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 cups cooked shrimp or 2 cups cooked chicken, sliced | 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1 lb baking potato, cooked and shredded | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/4 cup arugula or 1/4 cup rocket
instructions: Cut a small cross on one side of lobster.  Toss lobster around in a large mixing bowl and add vinegar, mace, salt and pepper.  Toss and refrigerate for 30 minute.  Place potatoes in a large casserole and cover with cheese.  Place lobster on top and sprinkle with 1/4 cup arugula.  Cover and bake at 375 degrees for 15 - 20 minute remove and serve.

title: Italian Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons capers | 2 1/2 tablespoons chili flakes | 2 cups asiago cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  In a medium bowl, mash the beans with the capers and chili flakes.  Mix in the cheese.  Transfer to a medium baking dish or to a platter.  Bake for 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: French peach and peach sandwich
ingredients: 4 firm peaches, peeled, pitted, sliced | 1 egg
instructions: Slice each peach in half lengthwise, and scoop out as much flesh as possible.  Put peaches into a blender or food processor, and fill with 1 egg yolk, 1 tablespoon of egg, and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.  Blend, adding more egg if necessary.

title: Roast Lamb with Cherries, Tomatoes & Lemons
ingredients: 5 lbs leg of lamb, butterflied, with bones attached | 8 ounces cherry tomatoes | lemon pepper, to your own tastes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees.  Rub the lamb with the salt and pepper.  Slice the tomatoes 1 thick, and arrange them on a piece of foil.  Place on top of the lamb.  Pour over enough boiling water to nearly cover the lamb.  Place on a roasting tin 3 - 5 inches larger than the lamb.  Bake in the preheated oven for 1½ hours, then remove the foil and tomatoes and replace lamb.  Let lamb sit for 10 to 15 minutes to soak up juices.  Carve and serve with your favourite vegrette and greens.

title: Italian Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 ounce wheat pasta | 1 ounce half-and-half | 9 scallions or 1 small spring onion | white pepper, freshly ground
instructions: Heat a frying pan and add half and half.  Heat it and wait until it starts to slightly boil.  Add scallions or spring onion and white pepper.  When all the seasonings are absorbed add cooked and drained whole wheat pasta to sauce, mix well and put on low heat.  Add half and half and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,wild mushroom,hazelnut,angostura bitter,sparerib,tofu,chipotle chile adobo,broccoli
title: Smoked-Wild Mushrooms Au Gratin
ingredients: 30 dried wild mushrooms | 25 cooked spareribs | 1 -2 head broccoli ( or other large stem part separated into leaves ) | 1 piece smoked tofu ( cut into 4 squares ) | 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo, minced ( depending on taste ) | 1 teaspoon guajillo aji-zucchini bitters | 1/8 cup toasted hazelnuts | 3 -4 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Soak fresh mushrooms in water for 20 minutes, remove stems, reserve soaking liquid for sauce.  Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Remove stems from mushrooms and cut stems into 6 - 8 segments.  In a large bowl, combine the mushroom soaking liquid, mushrooms, spareribs and all, seasoning with guaja chilies, aji zucchini bitters and hazelnuts.  Stuff the mushroom mixture into the mushrooms and place them in a baking dish in rows.  Sprinkle the top with shredded mozzarella cheese.  Bake until mozzarella is melted and mushrooms are deep brown, about 6 to 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,chicken wing,fish fillet,enchilada sauce,basil leaf,caraway seed,chicken stock,green cabbage
title: Enchilada Wings
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 lb chicken breast fillet, diced | 8 ounces medium enchilada sauce | 1 large shredded green cabbage, and | caraway seed | basil leaves | 2 cups chicken stock | prosciutto
instructions: Combine chicken wings and chicken in large bowl.  Mix in enchilada sauce.  Sprinkle with basil and caraway seeds.  Pour in chicken stock.  Arrange cabbage on bottom of baking dish.  Place chicken mixture over cabbage.  Place chicken on top of cabbage.  Bake at 475 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Sausage and Parsnips
ingredients: 4 lbs bulk italian sausage or 4 lbs bulk sweet italian sausage | 1 cup fresh parsnip, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 bottle grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Place whole sausage in a large dutch oven or heavy kettle with a tight fitting lid.  Add parsnips, grape tomatoes and cover.  Cook over medium low heat for about 5 hours.  Remove sausage from kettle.

title: Sausage Tacos or Burritos
ingredients: 8 ounces ground beef or 8 ounces italian sausage | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons beef consomme | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace or 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) | 12 flour tortillas
instructions: In a large skillet, saute the sausage until browned on each side.  Set aside.  Drain the grease from the pan.  Add the vinegar and consomme to the hot pan and heat to boiling, stirring occasionally.  When the liquid is hot, return the sausage to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon or rubber spatula.  Add the mace, if using.  Spoon the sausage/sauce mixture onto the tortillas.  Roll up the tortillas and serve.

title: Banana and Sunflower Oil Dip
ingredients: 1 banana, peeled & sliced in rounds | 1 teaspoon pure sunflower oil | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler, peel the banana slices and then cut away the ends and peel completely, leaving one whole or one slice intact.  Slice the slices into thin rounds or rounds if you prefer.  Heat the oil in a medium sized pan, add the bananas and fry on high heat until golden brown on both sides.  Remove and keep warm.  Add the tabasco sauce to the pan and heat through then serve warm with the chopped fresh fruit for dipping.

Random Ingredients: cranberry juice,dill weed,green cabbage,pork roast,confectioner ' sugar,lime wedge,fajita seasoning mix
title: Mexican Glazed Pork Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 lbs pork roast | 1 package fajita seasoning mix | 1 cup cranberry juice | 1/4 cup granulated confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Remove pork roast from package and discard plastic and plastic from bag.  Use oven mitts to hang roast.  Place roast in a roasting pan and brown on all sides in a preheated oven.  Transfer roast to a cutting board, cut with a serrated knife and discard the fat in the pan.  Return the pan to the oven.  Bake for 1 hour.  Meanwhile, prepare cranberry juice cocktail sauce by combining the cranberry juice, sugar, dill weed and lime juice.  Set aside to cool to room temperature.  Spread some of the glaze over the roast and return to the oven.  Bake for 45 minutes or until pork is cooked through.

title: Sneaky Potato Fritters
ingredients: 3 pounds firm russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 lemon, juiced | 2 cups whole wheat flour, or as needed
instructions: Place the russet potatoes, clove, and lemon juice in a large pot and pour in enough water to cover the potato.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat.  Simmer until the potatoes are just tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Chipotle & Date Crusted Rice Balls
ingredients: 200 g quick-cooking oats ( not instant ) | 200 g chopped dates | 3 -4 tablespoons crushed canned chipotle chiles | 150 g uncooked minute white rice, rinsed and drained
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl, except rice, in the order listed.  Mix until ingredients are combined throughout.  Shape the mixture into 30 - 25 balls, and place on an ungreased baking tray.  Bake at 150 c for about 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,water chestnut,yellow mustard,poppy seed,lamb,lentil,emmenthaler cheese,chicken broth
title: Crock Pot Lamb and Lentil Casserole
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups chicken broth or 2 1/2 cups stock | 2 cans lentils, drained | 1 lb frozen baby carrots, thawed and drained | 12 ounces shredded lamb | 1 large yellow mustard or 1 large grain mustard | 1/2 cup grated emmenthaler cheese or 1/2 cup grated tasty cheese | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, rinsed, drained | 1 teaspoon poppy seed, toasted
instructions: Combine broth and lentils.  Add carrots and lamb.  Cover and cook on the low setting 6 - 8 hours.  Turn on to high to heat.  Preheat oven to 350°.  In a bowl, stir together mustard, cheese, water chestnuts, and poppy seeds.  Spread the mixture on serving platter and top with casserole mixture.

title: Lorusso
ingredients: 1 cup sourdough bread, dry cut | 1 leek, white part only, sliced thin and cleaned | 1/8 cup ricotta cheese | 1 lime, juice and rind of, grated | 1/2 cup gruyere, grated, divided
instructions: Soak sourdough bread in water for 15 - 20 min.  Drain.  Cut cheese, leek and zest into thin strips.  In bowl, mix sourdough with ricotta cheese, lime rind and juice and 1/2 cup cheese.  If using a loaf pan, spread bread with mixture.  Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup mozarella over top and bake in 375 degree f oven for 25 - 30 min.  Serve with salsa for dipping.

title: Passion Fruit Sauce - Chinese Recipe
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon passion fruit pulp | 1 -2 tablespoon hoisin sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan, stirring gently until combined.

title: Italian Pepper and Salami Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon pepper | 8 ounces salami or 8 ounces bacon, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 package precooked lasagna noodles or ( 13 ounce ) package rotelle pasta, cooked per package directions | 1 jar roasted sweet red peppers, drained
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cream of tartar, baking powder and pepper.

title: My Mom's Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles, broken up | 1 cup chopped kalamata olives
instructions: Boil noodles until cooked al dente.  Drain in cold water.  Toss in olives.  Let cool to room temperature.

title: Guacamole Wraps #RSC
ingredients: 1 package soft tofu | 1 head romaine lettuce | 3/4 lb fried guacamole | reynolds wrap foil | mustard
instructions: Wrap 1 package of soft tofu with reynolds wrap.  Fold in sides and ends and roll up.  Slightly flatten to about 4 - 5 inches thick.  Wrap remaining package in reynolds wrap.  Place in a gallon glass jar with a large tight lid.  You want a tight seal.  Use the jar to place the tofu inside of your jar.  This allows for extra liquid to be squeezed in the wrap.  If this does not allow right squeeze the wrap dry, add a handful of water and shake until the wrap is limp and dry.  Slice the romaine and add to the pan.  Slice the fried guacamole into small pieces and add to the pan.  Mix well.  Heat oven to 375°f.  Add about 1/4 of the crispy wrap to the microwave safe bowl and heat in microwave for about 45 seconds, stirring every minute or so.  Spoon a portion of the guacamole mixture in the center of each wrap.  Roll up the wrap and place on a large baking sheet.  Repeat until done, with another 1/4 of the guacamole mixture and another 1/8 of the guacamole mixture.  Bake for about 5 - 10 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Creamy Egg Noodle Soup
ingredients: 8 cups broth | 1 package egg noodles | 2 tablespoons uncooked egg noodles
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.  Add uncooked noodles to the broth.

title: Mama's Italian Sausage Sticks
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage, sliced very thin | 1/2 cup carrot, shredded | 10 slices pepperoni ( thin slices ) | 1/2 cup canned bamboo shoot, drained | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/4 teaspoon sweet paprika | extra virgin olive oil canola oil ( for brushing on dough )
instructions: In a large fry pan, add olive oil and heat to medium high.  Drain your sausage into a bowl and dump onto pan.  Shred your carrot and pepperoni.  Then add in the flour, mixing thoroughly with the sausages.  Mix in your sweet paprika and stir often.  The carrots will release some moisture but this is ok.  Turn heat down to low and cook until well blended.  While stirring, add your shredded bamboo shoots and mix.  If it looks like it is drying out add some water.  Let it cook about 10 - 15 minutes or until slightly thickened.  Place dough sticks on a clean plate.  Brush generously with olive oil and roll or stretch the dough until it sticks.  Place the sticks on a cookie sheet or cookie platter.  Repeat until all you have used olive ole, olive oil, and dough.  When your dough sticks are all coated with oil, place them in an air tight container, cover, and refridgerate.  When your dough is almost to your desired thickness, preheat your oven for 425°f.  Brush the tops with olive oil and sprinkle lightly with paprika.  Use a fork to help you avoid any sticking.  Place in oven 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Green Bean Chip - Chinese Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1/2 pastry dough ( pastry dough or egg roll ) | 1 1/2 lbs diced chicken breasts | 1/2 lb green beans, cut diagonally into 1 inch pieces | 1/3 cup tequila, divided | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/2 cup toasted chopped walnuts
instructions: Place flour in a large mixing bowl.  Dredge chicken in flour, shaking off excess, set aside.  Place beans in a small bowl with 1/4 cup of water.  Shake off excess.  Heat 1 tablespoon of the tequila in 10 inch cast iron skillet over medium high heat.  Add chicken and cook, stirring, until the chicken is cooked through, about 3 to 5 minutes.  Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.  Combine remaining 2 tablespoons of tequila and fish sauce in small bowl.  Add to skillet with beans.  Heat and stir until sauce boils, about 2 minutes.  Spoon mixture into 9 inch pie plate.  Sprinkle walnuts over beans.  Spread chicken mixture evenly over top.  Bake at 350 degrees for 40 - 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baby lima bean,chili pepper,baby carrot,orange bell pepper,cayenne,tart apple
title: Gran's Calico Beans
ingredients: 12 ounces baby lima beans, rinsed | 1 tart apple | 2 -3 baby carrots | 1 medium orange sweet bell pepper, cut to 3/4 inch pieces | 1 small hot chili pepper | 1 dash cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in large baking dish combine lima beans, apple, carrots, and pepper.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix.  Cover.

title: English Strawberry Pudding
ingredients: 5 tablespoons strawberry gelatin ( or 2 packages of vanilla jelly ) | 6 saffron strands
instructions: Prepare pudding according to package directions.  Dissolve the saffron in boiling water for 20 seconds.  Drain.  Prepare a small bowl the length of time recommended by the pudding package's instructions then pour the gelatin into it.  Quickly pour a handful of the jelly into the bowl to fully absorb the gelatin, leaving some for topping or dripping on top when cool.  Garnish with some of the saffron.  Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,onion flake,black cardamom pod,sage leaf,sugar,jumbo shrimp,yellow bell pepper,virgin olive oil
title: Shrimp Italiano
ingredients: 24 jumbo shrimp, shelled ( tails intact ) | 1 teaspoon ground black cardamom pod ( small black pith ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1/8 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 3 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1 cup white onions or 1 cup yellow onion, chopped | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated | 3 -5 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Dry the prawns with paper towels.  In a small mixing bowl, combine cardamom, dried onion flakes, dried sage, and finely chopped fresh sage.  Mix well.  Add the oil to a small skillet over medium heat, being sure that the oil doesn't burn.  Add the onion mixture, pepper and cheese.  Cook for 3 to 4 minutes on medium heat, stirring occasionally until the pepper is crisp tender.  Add the prawns and cardamom mix, stirring to combine, and stir in 1/4 cup of the parmesan.  Remove from heat.  Divide among four serving bowls and serve.

title: Wild Wontons for Two
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 1 package dry fettuccine | 3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 1/4 cups liquid smoke
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and add the wontons, bring water to a boil, and when water boils, add the fettucine, and cook for 6 minutes. instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet, over medium high heat.  Add beef and cook, stirring frequently, for 4 to 6 minutes.  Add amaretti crumbs and cook for 2 minutes.  Add rice or asparagus, stir to coat, and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until rice or asparagus is tender and beef is heated through.

title: Shrimp Gyros With Shrimp Rolls
ingredients: 36 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 36 cremini mushrooms, brushed with oil | 1 cup cucumber, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon capers | 5 -6 skewers, bamboo | sesame oil | fresh italian bread, rolls
instructions: Arrange the shrimp on the bamboo skewer and top with sliced shrimps.  Grill the roll, covered, over a medium flame or under a broiler 4 - 5 minutes or until shrimp are cooked through, turning once.  To serve, arrange 4 shrimp per person on a roll in a large wedge shaped pattern.

title: Smoked Salmon on Lettuce for a Wedge
ingredients: 1 smoked salmon fillet ( about 1 lb per fillet ) | 1 head butter lettuce ( washed ) | 1/2 cup hard alcoholic cider, such as 1921 | 3 tablespoons butter lettuce ( such as nicoise, or romaine ) | 1 medium stalk celery, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to place butter lettuce in a large roasting pan or roasting pan.  Arrange salmon on top.  Combine cider and celery.  Pour apple mixture evenly over salmon.  Roast in oven for 30 minutes, or until fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork.  Remove fish from oven and sprinkle with lemon juice and season to taste with salt.

title: Almond Oatmeal
ingredients: 4 cups quick cooking oats | 8 tablespoons almond extract, or equivalent ( or whatever flavor you wish )
instructions: Combine oats and almond extract in a bowl.  Gather oats up quickly with your hands and form into small balls.  Grate coarsely and drop into a medium size bowl. .  Wet your hands and press into balls.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,coconut milk,sake,chili paste,kaffir lime leaf,corn flake,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Sate Skewers
ingredients: 500 g hamburger ( good quality, and should be cheap type ) | 1 -2 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf ( or 2-3 lime leaves-or whatever ) | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon sake | 3 teaspoons corn flakes | 3 -4 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 2 tablespoons coconut milk
instructions: Preparing the meat, if using chuck steaks, or other cheap cut of meat, cut meat into 3/4 inch cubes.  In a small bowl, mix together all other marinade ingredients and rub into meat.  Add meat and coat in the marinade.  Put it in the fridge for about 1/2 hour.  If using shinds, marinate shinds overnight in the fridge or for a couple of hours, and then slice them thinly.  Drying, place the pieces onto a wooden / metal skewer or skewer and thread them onto the skewers.  The idea is to avoid making them too large, and for the meat to absorb the spices.  Grilling, put a large amount of oil in a skillet or barbecue.  Fry the skewers over medium heat in batches, as you would normal saki.  Serve on the side.  For a little extra flavour, you can add more chili paste.

title: Spiced Tomato Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces cottage cheese | 1 can condensed canned tomatoes in puree | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1 tablespoon chopped pear ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender, then puree until desired consistency.  Serve immediately.

title: Sharon's Noodles With Ginger in Creamy Pistachio Sauce
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry ( thawed ) | 1 egg noodles or 1 egg white | 1/4 cup roasted pistachios | 2 scallions, sliced | 3 tablespoons fresh gingerroot, chopped | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 package cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300.  Place puff pastry onto a baking sheet.  Bake for 45 minutes or until pastry is light tan in color.  Remove from oven.  While pastry is baking, cook noodles in boiling water for 7 minutes, or until tender.  Drain, rinse with water and drain again.  Set aside in a large bowl.  Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Stir in noodles, scallions, ginger and chili oil.  Spread noodles in a single layer on the baking sheet.  Sprinkle the nut over noodles.  Add 1/2 of the noodles to the cheese.  Sprinkle the other 1/2 of the noodles on top, followed by the cottage cheese.  Bake, uncovered, for 25 - 35 minutes, or until noodles are creamy and cheese is slightly crispy.

title: Lavender and Mustard Spread
ingredients: 400 g mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon whole black mustard seeds | 100 g chopped fresh lavender | lasagna noodle ( small, ovenproof )
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and mustard seeds in a bowl & stir in the lavender and parsley.  Remove the hard centre centre vein of the lavender from the jar.  Brush the inside of 20cm diameter non stick cake mould with oil.

title: Walnut and Orange Rhubarb Salad
ingredients: 2 large green rhubarb | 1/4 cup walnuts or 1/4 cup pecans, roughly chopped | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 orange, zest of, grated | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground tarragon
instructions: Cut away the crusts from the rhubarb and cut a small slice off the root end and use a knife to scrape out any fibrous bits.  Scrape out the centre of the rhubarb and cut into 6 medium sized pieces.  Place the chopped walnuts or pecans and oil in a small pan and gently cook on a medium to low heat, stirring constantly, until they begin to soften.  Remove from the heat and tip all other ingredients into a small bowl.  Place the walnut, oil and orange zest in the bowl and toss together.  Arrange the salad on four plates and drizzle the walnut and orange zest mixture over it.  Serve with your favourite chutney.  Serves 3,.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,coriander seed,linguine,russet potato,cooking oil,dark raisin
title: Linguine With Sweet Potato and Raisins
ingredients: 5 tablespoons cooking oil, divided | 1 tablespoon crushed coriander seed, divided | 2 1/2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 lb linguine ( i prefer spaghetti ) | 1 lb dark raisin | 1 1/2 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Place 3 tablespoons of the oil in a large skillet with the coriander seeds.  Add the potato chunks and cook over medium high heat for 8 minutes, turning occasionally.  Drain the potatoes, reserving 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid, and transfer to a bowl.  Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil and the coriander in the skillet.  Add half of the drained potato and raisins and cook for 3 minutes.  Cook the linguine according to package directions, omitting salt and fat.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Toss with the reserved cooking liquid.  Serve over linguine.

title: Tuna and Tortellini Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 small ziti pasta | 3/4 cup pappardelle pasta | 1 can sweet tuna, drain and flaked | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: Cook ziti in boiling water, drain and set aside.  Brown meat, drain.  Meanwhile cook tortellini according to directions on package.  Drain ziti and cool.  Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Chill.  Serve on bed of tortellini.

Random Ingredients: rum,nonfat milk,farfalle pasta,beef stew meat,streaky bacon,italian turkey sausage,ham,apricot
title: Crock Pot Irish Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs meaty ham ( i usually use hillshire farms farms ) or 1 1/2 lbs turkey sausage, cut into 1-inch chunks ( i usually use hillshire farms ) | 1/2 lb streaky bacon, diced ( or half and half ) | 1/4 lb turkey sausage, diced | 1 package dried farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk | 1/2 cup light rum | 1 ounce ground sweet paprika
instructions: Place ham, bacon and sausage in 4 1/2 quart crock pot.  Top with pasta.  Combine 1 cup milk, 1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk and rum in small bowl and pour over chicken and pasta.  Cover and cook on low 7 - 8 hours.  Remove lid and stir well.  Stir in paprika if using.  Cover and cook on high 30 - 40 minutes.  If not using bowtie pasta, cook for 40 minutes.  If using other 2 meats, cook for 45 minutes.  Serve over linguine or your favorite pasta recipe.

title: Rhubarb and Egg Hollandaise
ingredients: 500 g rhubarb | 2 egg yolks | 3 tablespoons rhubarb, jelly
instructions: Blend ingredients with the jelly in a food processor or blender until smooth.  Pour into clean jelly jars, leaving 1 inch headspace.  Top evenly with honey, making sure it is tightly covered.  Place in the fridge and leave at room temperature for 24 hours. .

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,pearl barley,biscuit,tomato green chilies,vanilla essence,sharp cheddar cheese,walnut
title: Chiles and Barley Pie
ingredients: 300 g tinned tomatoes and green chilies | 500 g canned chopped canned tomatoes | 1 cup cooked pearl barley | 2 1/2 cups coarsely grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup coarsely grated walnuts | 1 inch piece gingerroot, peeled and finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 4 teaspoons biscuit cases ( optional )
instructions: First, make the crust.  Mix all the ingredients well in a bowl.  Pre heat the oven to 200°c with the pan of water coming up to just below the boil.  Put a layer of the mixture in the base of an oven proof dish.  Top the dough with a layer of the remaining ingredients.  Finish with the topping ingredients.  Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes.  Remove the pie from the oven, leave for 5 minutes, take out and leave to rest for another 5 minutes before slicing into wedges.

title: Tahini and Meat Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 3 tablespoons white wine | 2 1/4 lbs stewing meat | 12 ounces flat rice noodles | 1 lb small red potatoes ( about 1 medium ) or 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled and thinly sliced crosswise ( about 1 medium ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger | 1/4 cup cornmeal
instructions: Combine tahini with 2 tablespoons white wine in a small bowl.  Add the meat and season with salt and pepper.  Set aside at least 5 hours, and up to overnight.  In a large skillet, bring 4 cups cold water to a boil.  Add the rice noodles and return to a boil.  Cook to desired doneness, stirring frequently, then transfer the pan to a large bowl, cover tightly and let steam 5 minutes.  Drain the noodles into a colander and rinse thoroughly.  Remove the strings that float to the surface.  Rinse the meat thoroughly and return to the skillet.  To make the tahini sauce, combine the tahini with 1/3 cup cold water.  Bring to a boil, then remove from the heat, cover and set aside.  In another large, deep skillet, heat 1/3 cup tahini with the red potatoes.  Reduce the heat to medium and fry the potatoes, stirring often, until golden, about 8 minutes.  Drain the pan and allow to cool.  Add the ginger and cornmeal to the potato mixture.  Add meat mixture to potato mixture and heat gently, stirring, until thickened slightly, about 1 minute.  Remove from the heat and stir in the sauce.  Serve hot.

title: Indian Beef With Cardamom and Mango
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, sliced into 1/8 slices | 4 green cardamom pods, split open ( i keep these pods in a plastic bag for about 15 minuted ) | 1 container mango, cut into about 1/2 inch cubes ( do not discard pits ) | 1 cup basmati rice
instructions: In a deep 12 skillet heat 1 tbls oil.  In batches of 5 add sirloin, 2 cardamom pods, and 4 browned slices.  Remove sirloin and add about 1 1/2 tbls oil.  Sprinkle the beef with 1 tbls green cardamom pods.  Sauce then cover and cook over medium heat until beef is done, then uncover and spoon 1 1/2 cup sauce over beef.  Place rice in bottom of platter, put beef on top and pour sauce over.  Let sit 5 minuntes.  Note, i usually leave the rest of the sauce in pan for the beef, but we are mainly making this dish after making it.

Random Ingredients: monkfish fillet,vermouth,french bread,chicken breast half,pineapple juice,spring onion
title: Grilled Chicken With Lemongrass and Pineapple
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 ounces vermouth or 2 ounces rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon grass or 1 tablespoon lemon verbena leaf, finely chopped | 1 1/2 ounces pineapple juice | 2 slices french bread | 3 spring onions, thinly sliced ( scallions )

title: Prawn Cocktail

instructions: Pour the chicken, prawns and chile into a large bowl.  Stir the broth into the bowl and season with salt and pepper.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. .  Make the scallions.  Place the mustard and green onions into a small chopper or food processor and pulse until finely chopped.  Add the scallions and pulse until everything looks like chicana paste.  Taste for seasoning and adjust if necessary.  Serve the cocktail over rice accompanied by a wedge of lime.

title: Danish Fried Cabbage
ingredients: 2 lbs red cabbage, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons minced ham | 4 tablespoons currants | 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons hing
instructions: Dice cabbage and ham.  In a large skillet or dutch oven fry cabbage, ham and currants over medium heat until cabbage has darkened and is beginning to caramelize.  Pour off pan drippings and add bouillon stir and heat over low heat for 15 minutes.  Cover and refrigerate until served.

title: Quick Beef and Beet Borscht
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks, trimmed of fat | 2 cans sliced beets, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 cans evaporated milk | 1/4 cup fresh gingerroot, peeled and minced | 1 cup celery, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1/2 cup white vinegar
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Heat a large skillet over high heat.  Spray with nonstick cooking spray the broiler pan with cooking spray and add beef.  Cook and stir beef for 3 minutes, until cooked well.  Remove to crockpot.  Stir beets, curry paste, evaporated milk, gingerroot, celery and triple sec into beef mixture.  Place crockpot on preheated broiler until heated through.  Top with additional curry paste and chopped fresh coriander if desired.

title: Beef and Lentil Couscous
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into 1/2-inch pieces and trimmed | 1 lb green lentil, washed and picked through | 1 cup couscous | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Cook the tenderloin in a large heavy based saucepan, covered, over medium high heat for 8 minutes.  Add the lentils, increase the heat to medium high and cook for 5 minutes longer.  Season with salt and pepper.  Add the couscous, cook 1 minute longer, then remove from the heat.  Cover and let stand for 5 minutes.  Fluff with a fork.  Transfer the beef to a platter and cover with foil.  Bring 2 cups water and the raisins to a boil in a large saucepan, then reduce the heat to low.  Heat to boiling, then cover and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes or until the beef is tender.  Remove the beef and let stand for 15 minutes.  Spoon the couscous onto plates, top with the beef and raisins.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,milk ricotta cheese,table salt,mozzarella cheese
title: Cheesy Cheese Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 8 tablespoons quick-cooking oats, toasted | 2 ounces whole-milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons fat free mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees and place the rack in the center of the oven.  In a large bowl, stir together the ricotta, 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese and 2 tablespoons quick cooking oats.  Spread the ricotta mixture into an 8 inch round baking dish and top it with the remaining 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese evenly over the surface.  Bake for 12 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly.  Cool for 5 minutes.  Drizzle the oat layer with the remaining 1 tablespoon oat bran and scatter the remaining 1 tablespoon mozzarella over the oat layer.  Bake 6 to 8 minutes longer or until the mozzarella cheese has melted and is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,cotija cheese,vanilla ice cream,self raising flour,wheat flour,tabasco sauce
title: Chile and Cotija Ice Cream Cake
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( to your taste ) | 1 cup cotija cheese or 1 cup other strong cheese | 2 cups vanilla ice cream, softened
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  In a food processor purée the flours, garam masala and tabasco.  Add the cotija and pulse until well mixed.  Add the ice cream to the flour mixture and pulse again till smooth.  Pour into an ungreased and floured 23cmx14 inch cake tin, spreading the mixture as evenly as possible.  Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until the base is well risen and golden brown and the sides of the cake are firm to the touch.  Allow to cool in tin for about five minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Mandarin Orange Meat in Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 sirloin | 10 marinated pepperoncini peppers | 1 package mandarin oranges | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 4 teaspoons baking powder | 1/2 cup snipped fresh chives
instructions: Slice meat across the grain into 1/2 inch slices.  Place in a large ziploc bag.  Add peppers and oranges.  Reserve marinade.  Refrigerate for 45 minutes.  Remove meat from refrigerator.  Discard marinade.  Slice meat across the grain into 1/2 inch slices.  Discard marinade.  Combine cream, baking powder, and chives in a medium saucepan, bringing to boil.  Boil for 2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Pour half of cream sauce over meat in pan.  Add sliced vegetables.  Serve immediately.

title: Apple Beef
ingredients:
1 lb fresh beef stew meat | 1 granny smith apple ( a large one, at least.
    - i like it with a lot of juice )
instructions: Cut stew meat into chunks if you are using stew pieces cut into chunks that have been sliced or diced about the size of the apple.  Place in crockpot with a lid and add juice.  Cook on low about 7 - 8 hours or high about 6 hours.  I serve it with hot prepared mustard.

title: Lebanese Style Polenta With Fresh Herbs
ingredients: 150 g polenta ( coarse coarse, or thick ) | 2 3/4 cups of strong tea, chilled | 150 g teapoons turmeric powder ( known as `` haldi '' in hindi ) | 1 3/4 teaspoons vanilla essence ( known as ajwain in hindi ) | fresh parsley leaves, chopped to garnish
instructions: Prepare polenta by grinding in a large bowl with a little water and turmeric.  Mix it gently so as not to break the grains.  Keep aside while you prepare the tea.  After five mins, mix the tea with the polenta in a pan and heat it on high heat.  Once the tea starts boiling, stir continuously so as to not let the teapoons crackle.  At the same time, boil the salted water on low heat.  Add the tea and mix well.  Reduce the heat and continue to cook on high heat for 5 minutes continuously.  Then, add the finely chopped parsley leaves.  Mix well.  Serve hot garnished with fresh mint leaves.  Enjoy your meal with any indian style style of polenta.

instructions: In a large skillet cook bacon over medium heat until crispy.  Drain bacon on paper towels and crumble.  Using same skillet, add terry's light rye bread cracker crumbs. Pour mixture onto prepared pan and sprinkle top with remaining taitories smoked garlic salt.  Cut into thin slices and sprinkle with remaining butter.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Macaroni and Cheese on Toasted

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Cut potato in half lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/4 thick slices. Add cooked and cooled macaroni.  Toss.  Serve warm.  Note, to toast, toast 2 slices of bread, or toasted.

title: Chipotle Bruschetta (Ww 3 Points)

title: Chipotle Pepper Pork With Fresh Smoked Peas (Pudim-Galbi)
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs country-style pork, 1-inch thick cut into 1 1/4-inch-thick slices | 1/2 cup korean red pepper flakes, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups frozen mixed peas, thawed
instructions: Put pork slices and a small pile of the red pepper flakes in a large, heavy, flat dish and press them down so that the peppers are completely coated in the adobo.  Spread the pork slices evenly over the pork.  Sprinkle the rest of the red pepper flakes over the pork and turn over a few times so that the peppers have been soaked completely.  Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes, stirring once or twice.  Drain the pork slices and pat them dry with paper towels and set them aside.  Discard the remaining liquid.  Pour the reserved Adobo liquid over the pork, coating the slices on all sides.  Cover and refrigerate overnight or up to 4 days, turning once or twice.  Remove the pork and any meat from the marinade and pat the meat dry between each paper towel.  Heat a large dutch oven over high heat until very hot. .  Add the pea mixture in a single layer and let it cook, stirring, until the peas are slightly softened, about 3 minutes.  Lower the heat, add the pork and cook, turning, until rich and moist and the meat is dry and no longer pink in the center, about 45 minutes.

title: Baked On the Rocks

Sprinkle a nice layer of season salt on the salsa verde pour in beer or club soda to cover and turn on a warm griddle.  Place in the oven for 7 minutes or until the tops are light brown and the bottoms are becoming crispy.

title: Tequila Beef Satay

instructions: Blend the chile peppers with the garlic, lemon grass and stock or vegetable stock until smooth and set aside.  Meanwhile, whisk the egg yolks with the mustard in a bowl and set aside.  Whisk together the reserved egg mixture and the thickened broth to make the dressing.  Strain the vegetables and chillies and pour them into the creamy onion mixture.  Remove the lemongrass stalk. When ready to serve, reheat the raita and stir in the dressing.

title: Spiced Orange Pearls

instructions: Pears can be replaced with other citrus fruit.  Combine orange juice and spices in a saucepan, bring to a boil. To keep pears from oxidizing in the flavor, add a few drops of balsamic vinegar or olive oil to the syrup.  This will also make a nice dressing that can be used as a marinade or glaze with.  Store in an airtight container.  To make, use a knife or cleaver to cut fruit into chunks.  You may also cut a few pears into the shape of a cocktail.  It does not matter whether they are small or not.  Use as dressing for salads, breads and tostada.

Wipe jar or can clean with an damp cloth, then add several layers of clean cheesecloth.  Cover with clean cloth or plastic wrap, then press the lid firmly on the jars to give it room to breathe.  Place a heavy plate on top and gently push the cloth to squeeze out any liquid that leaks out of the jar.  Keep the jars upright in a cool, dark place and refrigerate at least a couple of hours to develop flavor.  After the party comes up to a boil, remove the cloth/plastic wrap from the top of each mushroom mushroom and place on clean cloth cloth/s.  Pull the cloth up from the moist side of the mushroom and squeeze out any excess liquid that has gathered in the cloth.  This can be done by dropping the plastic wrap onto a tabletop of your choice and running it down the inside of the mushroom jars.  Hold them down to tighten the process so that the mushroom mixture can breathe easier.  To serve, place a mushroom bundle and a few slices of fresh greens on each plate.  Garnish with a small scattering of scallions.

title: Linda's Focaccia Balsamic and Chili Appetizer

instructions: Pour the green chili into a large stockpot and heat to medium, but do not brown.  Peel, then slice into rounds and set aside.  Preheat oven to 425°f.  Bring a large pot of water to boil.  While the water comes to a boil, peel and slice 5 large baking potatoes into rounds.  Place half of the rounds, cut side down, in the boiling water.  Cook 10 minutes, then turn over and cook 2 more minutes.  Meanwhile, slice 1 package of fresca di parma di parma into 4 slices each.  After 2 minutes, remove from water, and cut each slice into 3/4 slices.  Place bread slices in a large bowl and cover with cold water, allow to soften for 5 minutes.  In a small bowl, add sour cream, vinegar, and remaining green garlic chilies, and mix well.  Drain fries, and place on a plate with a slotted spoon, and cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate.  When ready to make, place baking potato slices back on a clean work surface and scoop out enough potato flesh to make about 15 potato pieces.  Cut remaining potato into slices to make about 10 total slices.  Set aside.  Wash and dry 1 loaf of focaccia.  Using your hands, place a scoop of crumbled feta, 2 slices of balsamic, and 1 tomato slice between each bread round and close the sandwich.  Repeat until all of the bread rounds have been used.  Place the breads on a baking sheet, and bake 40 minutes.  Remove from oven and brush lightly with a small amount of the balsamic vinegar.  Return to the oven and bake 10 minutes more.  Remove from oven and cool 10 to 15 minutes, then slice and serve.  This is also great served with a salad.

instructions: Pre heat oven to 160c.  Put the cubes of meat in a casserole dish.  Peel the banana and cut length wise into 4cm chunks.  Boil the cream in a small saucepan for 2 - 3 minutes and set aside.  Pour the cream mixture evenly over the meat and add the cheese and chopped radish.  Bake in the oven for 45 minutes until meat is cooked through and the cheese is golden brown.

title: Hot Red Chile Rub
ingredients: 2 dried hot red chili peppers, stems removed | 1 teaspoon coarse black pepper
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Lightly oil or line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place the chiles in a small bowl and cover with hot water.  Let stand 15 minutes.  The chiles can be made 3 days ahead.  Place the chiles in a resealable plastic bag, add the black pepper and shake to coat evenly.  Set aside 30 minutes.  Let the chiles dry at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours.  Heat the grill.  Drain the chiles and place on the prepared baking sheet.  Brush the tops of the chiles with the hot pepper rub.  The rub should be just on the top, not the exposed areas.  Allow the chiles to dry at room temperature, about 45 minutes.  Turn the hot chiles twice during drying.

title: Homemade Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g thick salt pork | 600 g hamburger | 2 large fresh gingerroot | 1 large bunch fresh dill sprigs | 1/4 cream or 1/4 coconut milk
instructions: Take a hammer and mix a few cubes of salt pork.  Press the salt pork into the ground using your palms.  Slice off some of the root part and scrape off the dark colored outer layer.  Put the salt pork into a clean bowl.  Pound the ginger root until you have very finely grated.  Put the ginger root in a clean mortar and crush.  Put the salt pork into the bowl and mash with the back of a large spoon.  You could also use a knuckle.  Add the fresh dill and the cream.  Mix together thoroughly with your hands this usually takes about 2 minutes.  You can make the meatballs and refrigerate them for as long as you are planning to use.  Form your meat into balls about the size of large walnuts.  Take a teaspoonful of meat you will be using, and flatten it into a round patty about 1 cm thick around the edge of the patty.  Push the patty down lightly with your finger.  You want to make the meat a bit thicker than the patty.  If you are lucky enough to have dental on hand, use that to flatten the meat a little less.  Repeat with all the meatballs.  Heat your grill.  You can also add a little oil if the meat is exceptionally lean.  When the oil is hot, place all the meat patties on the grill without turning and fry them for 2 minutes.  Flip and fry for 2 more minutes.  Turn and fry for 2 more minutes.  Turn and fry for 2 more minutes.  Turn and fry for a further 2 minutes.  Then place in a warm oven and keep in a warm oven until ready to serve.  It is important to leave the meatballs in the oven and turn the heat down when they are ready to serve as they will brown quickly on the standing end of a wooden spoon.

title: Jicama Stuffed Jicama

instructions: Diced jicama into 1 1/2 inch cubes.  Place cubes in a bowl.  In the blender, combine lemongrass, ham, cheese and bamboo shoots.  Heat 1 tbs.  Of milk or cream in a saucepan and simmer 2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Stir in oregano and basil.

title: Simple Pizza Crust

ingredients: 450 g white pearl onions, peeled, trimmed | 450 g zucchini, trimmed, trimmed and sliced | 150 g white pearl barley | 2 blood oranges, juice of | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 150 ml double cream | 4 tablespoons mango, chopped | 2 tablespoons red pearl onions
instructions: Cook onion & zucchini in plenty of boiling water until the onion turns tender.  Drain and set aside.  Add pearl barley and orange juice to the onion and stir.  Drain and set aside.  Place flour, orange rind & milk in bowl and stir.  Cook at low to medium heat until thickened and bubbly.  Stir in sliced onions & zucchini.  Heat pan to very hot.  Scoop mixture into the centre and sprinkle with chopped mango.  Scoop the filling into heated pancakes and roll up towards the side.  Serve with yoghurt & lime yogurt.

title: Steak Croquettes
ingredients: 1 cup dry bread | 1/4 teaspoon amaretto ( almond-flavored syrup ) | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1 lb steak ( cut into chunks ) | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1 bunch green cabbage, thinly sliced
instructions: Melt the soya sauce in a small pot over low heat.  Add 1 tbsp olive oil and keep warm while you slice the bread into 1/4 thick slices.  Remove the crusts of the bread with a slotted spoon and discard.  Spread the bread with the almond syrup and sprinkle on the amaretto.  Heat the oven to 300f degrees.  Put the bread slices in a medium size roasting pan and set aside.  Rub the remaining olive oil on a work surface and set aside.  When the oven is heated, place the steak in the oven and, using two chopsticks, turn frequently, until the meat is brown on all sides.  Spread the soya sauce over both sides of the meat and leave the pan in the oven.  Roast for 15 minutes.  When the meat is done, set aside.  In a medium size bowl, toss the cabbage with the soya sauce until evenly mixed.  Set aside.  After 10 minutes, remove the meat from the oven.  Turn on the broiler.  Cut into desired serving sized pieces and set aside.  Turn on a broiler pan.  Place the meat and cabbage slices on a broiler pan.  Broil them for a few minutes, then serve.  Tip, to check for doneness of the meat, use a fork to stab the meat with a toothpick.  You don't want the meat to overcook, because as soon as you can see the meat breaking apart, it will be done.  Tip, if you make the meat ahead and let it cool completely before chopping or serving, it will release some of the juices.  For the cabbage dressing, combine all ingredients, refrigerate and serve in a small bowl.  Note, this will make a lot, but you can leave it in the refrigerator for a few hours to let flavours meld.

title: Hot Buttermilk Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 small plum tomato, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili sauce ( chili sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 3 tablespoons pineapple juice
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the buttermilk, minced garlic and tomato.  Sprinkle with chili sauce and white pepper, stir until smooth and pour into a shallow bowl.  Heat the pineapple juice in a large skillet over high heat until almost smoking, or add the pineapple juice and stir in the buttermilk mixture.

title: Oriental-Style Green Olive Samosas
ingredients: 24 green olives | 1 lb phyllo | 1/2 cup rice wine or 1/2 cup sake | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Cut off the bottom and most green olives.  Place them on a large plate and cover with a dishcloth or other mesh, or several layers of paper towel.  Allow to drain for twenty minutes.  In a small saucepan, place enough water to cover them.  Place over medium high heat and bring to a boil.  Add the olives to the boiling water.  Boil for 2 - 3 minutes.  Remove and discard the skins.  Cut the cleaned olives in half lengthwise.  Take the largest one of the halves and measure 6.  Cut each whole one into about 6 squares.  Dip each square into 1 tablespoon of cornstarch and set on waxed paper for the moment.  Put a few shavings of cheese or sesame seeds in a pastry bag.  Set aside.  When the water is boiling, place a sheet of phyllo on a clean surface and lightly brush it with a little water.  Keep brushing the sheet with a bit more water.  Place another sheet of phyllo on top of the first buttered sheet.  Spread a small line of the olives in a circle about 1/3 inch thick.  Place a teaspoon of ham or pork on top.  Add a heaping teaspoon of olives along the length of this line.  Sprinkle a little rice wine on the olives.  Cut the phyllo in four pieces and stack on top of the ham or pork.  Continue making layers until all ingredients are used.  Keep on one side covered and you have two layered packages.

title: Potato Patties With Gruyere Cheese and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 ounces medium rye bread ( approximately 2 slices bread crusty bread ) | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 cups very finely grated cauliflower | 1/4 cup sweet cornflour | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 lb very finely sliced lean deli-stuffed idaho potato, about 3 medium
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c.  Place the breadcrumbs on a plate and cover with the bread crumbs.  Roll the biscuit on crumbs in either hands to lightly coat and set aside.  Mix together the cauliflower, sweetcorn flour, italian seasoning, mushrooms and grated potatoes in a bowl.  Spray an 8 inch non stick frying pan with oil and put over medium heat.  When the oil is hot, place about a third of the mixture into the hot frying pan and cook, turning often, until golden brown and firm, about 5 minutes.  Turn the patties and fry for 3 minutes more.  Drain the patties on a large tray or newspaper to remove excess oil.  Top each patty with about 1/4 cup gruyere cheese and more of the cauliflower mixture.  Put the tray in the oven for 5 - 10 minutes or until cheese is golden.

title: Moroccan Banana Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil | 4 medium bananas, cut crosswise into quarters lengthwise | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh cilantro | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh basil | 1 teaspoon snipped fresh cilantro | 1/2 lb leek, thinly sliced lengthwise | 1/4 cup snipped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup olive oil | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh basil | 1/4 cup snipped fresh cilantro | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk 3/4 teaspoon of salt together the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt with 1 teaspoon of water.  Dip half of the bananas, overlapping slices, into the salt water and let stand for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt with the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt, basil and basil.  In a small bowl, whisk together the 1/4 cup plus 1 tablespoon water, lemon juice & zest, olive oil and cilantro until dressing is combined well.  Spread half the dressing over the bananas and arrange the remaining half on top of the bananas.  Drizzle with remaining 1/4 cup of dressing.  Sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 cup of cilantro & poppy seeds & cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Tofu and Coconut Potatoes
ingredients: 250 g extra firm tofu | 2 tablespoons coconut cream | 2 red potatoes, sliced | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1/2 medium lean pork, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius.  Grease a 2 litre loaf tin with oil, place 1/3 the potato slices in the base of the tin, then cover with 1/3 each of the tofu, coconut cream and meat.  Repeat layers, ending with meat, sprinkling the top with remaining potato slices.  Bake, covered, for 1 hour, then set onto a plate to cool.  When cool, slice and serve.

title: Sesame Steamed Crepes

instructions: In a small bowl, mix the chili flakes with the sesame oil, if using them.  Set aside.  Place a few tablespoons of oil in a wok or fry pan. Place about a cup of cheese on one side of each flour tortilla.

title: Sea Scallops for Two
ingredients: 1 bunch sea scallops | 4 medium size red potatoes, scrubbed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Using a small, sharp knife, make a cut into the top of each scallop and push through the cut lines.  Remove the scallops with a plasic spoon or spatula to a shallow roasting pan.  Place potatoes in a large bowl of cold water, toss well and let them soften, about 10 minutes.  When they are tender, drain them.  Rinse the potatoes and pat dry with paper towels.  Lay them on top of the scallops.  Bake 10 minutes, stirring once.  Transfer to a cutting board and cut in half so that they form four servings.  Serve the sea scallops at once.

title: Easy Baked Soy Chicken With Sundried Tomato and Sun-Dried Tomato Oil
ingredients: 1 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 2 cups ice | 120 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c trim chicken thighs of fat and cut into 5 pieces set aside, then cut each piece between 2 pieces of wax paper, then rub each with salt.  Using a knife, make cuts 1/2cm deep through both chicken thighs, being careful not to cut all the way through the chicken.  Place in a pan, and add 2 cups of cold water with 1/2 cup of frozen sun dried tomatoes, cover and bring to the boil.  Remove from heat and put the pan in a larger one.  Cover and put in oven.  Cook for 90 minutes.  Then remove lid for the last 15 minutes of cooking and cook for 5 minutes.  Remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes.  Remove lid and stir.  Serve immediately.

title: Cinnamon-Infused Russian Tea
ingredients: 2 cinnamon sticks | 1 1/2 cups hot tea, room temperature
instructions: Fill a saucepan 3/4 full with water.  Bring to a full rolling boil.  Once the water reaches boiling, turn down the heat and leave the tea steeped for 20 minutes.  Remove the tea from the water using a strainer and allow to sit for at least another 20 minutes before using.  Leave the tea in the saucepan until cooled.  Strain the cooled tea into a tea infusion pitcher using a strainer or cheese cloth lined strainer.  Pour 1 to 2 tablespoons of hot coffee into a mug and top with a 1/2 teaspoon or so of the tea.  Top with whipped cream and toasted shaved chocolate.

title: Saucy Quinoa - Vegan Friendly
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quinoa | 8 ounces bottled sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 teaspoon hot mustard ( or more, to taste ) | 2 -3 tablespoons pickled jalapeno chiles, chopped | 2 tablespoons toasted nuts, chopped ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chili pepper ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon dried new mexico chili pepper, seeds and membrane removed, finely chopped ( optional ) | fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Wash quinoa in cold water and let stand until cool, about 20 minutes. instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Remove stalks from mushrooms and gently scoop out the most soft mushroom stems.  Discard, or save for another use.  Place on a greased baking sheet with holes brushed over the sides.  Bake in the preheated oven until the stems begin to soften, about 40 minutes.  Remove from oven and drain.  Chop stems finely.  Meanwhile, place cream, baking powder, chili pepper flakes and 1/2 cup cooked and drained mushrooms in a saucepan.  Simmer, stirring occasionally, until warm, about 5 minutes.  Transfer cream mixture to a bowl and stir in cheese.  Mash reserved mushroom stems to thicken cream mixture.  Stuff mushrooms with the cream mixture, and arrange in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Garnish mushroom caps with lemon peel and remaining 2/3 cup cream mixture.

title: Spanish Shrimp on the Barbie

instructions: Prepare the shrimp, in a large nonstick skillet, add the shrimp and bell pepper.  Sprinkle with the bouquet garni.  Add the rice and cook over high heat for a few seconds until the shrimp is just cooked.  Spoon shrimp among skewers and serve immediately.

title: Chermoula Salata Di Ricotta
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups ricotta | 1 tablespoon coriander seeds, crushed ( aka cilantro sprig ) | 1 grated parmigiano
instructions: Put a small pan on the hob, and bring the moisture to boiling while stirring continuously with a fork.  Stir occasionally, for around 15 minutes to allow the spices to flavour the liquid.  Meanwhile, rinse the coriander and cilantro leaves with cold water.  Place them into a clean tea towel or dry towel and rub all over the ricotta.  Cover and leave until softened.  Press out the moisture from the curds and discard.  Add coriander and cilantro to the ricotta with about a cup of the cooled coriander/cilantro mix and a grinding of pepper.  Mix well, and leave to rest for 2 hours to allow the flavours to develop.  Stir gently every 15 minutes or so, adding a little extra water if you feel the mixture is very dry.  When ready to serve, remove the lid from the pan.  Serve on fresh crackers or fresh puddings, or with crusty bread.

title: Hawaiian Steak

You will know the meat is done when a white label appears on steak, but it isn't hard.  Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Coconut Celery Casserole

Remove from oven and let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.  Note, you can reduce the chicken broth if desired, or leave out the chicken bouillon and add a little more broth.  To thicken, stir in a little hot water.

title: Spinach and Tomato Stew

Stir the peas in with the cornstarch mixture and add the butter.  Pour into a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.  Garnish with finely chopped coriander.  Serve with plain boiled rice.

title: Chiles Poached Tortilla, "the Chiles Rellenos"
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower | 4 anaheim chilies or 4 poblano chilies, roasted, peeled, seeded, and cut in squares | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh aubergine or 2 tablespoons onions | 2 teaspoons finely chopped pickled peppers ( aji amarillo peppers ) | 4 tortillas | yellow food coloring, optional

Fill and roll half each with a portion of food coloring.  Repeat with remaining tortillas.

Cut fish into serving sized pieces, about one portion for each salad and a potato wedge portion for each.

title: Pam's Crackling Pork

instructions: Trim excess fat from pork and cut into 2 to 3 pound portions.  Coat with crackling mixture and place in large zip top plastic bag.  Add sweet condensed milk, cayenne pepper and airtight container with lid.  Seal bag and combine.  Refrigerate, turning bag occasionally for at least 24 hours, or overnight.  Remove pork from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking to allow excess air to escape.  Heat your smoker to 250 degrees.  When your smoker is hot, carefully remove from oven and add pork.  Sear the outside of the pork on all sides, then turn off heat and cover.  For best results, refrigerate overnight.  Cook the pork on your favorite fuel on high for a few hours or on low for a few hours before cooking.
