title: Egg and Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chickens, halved and cut into pieces | 2 slices orange rind | 2 onions, quartered | 1 pinch lemon extract | 1 can unsweetened coconut milk | 1 hard-boiled egg, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Arrange chicken pieces skin side down in a shallow roasting pan.  In a wide, shallow skillet, combine orange peel, onions and lemon extract.  Cook over medium high heat until onions are translucent.  Stir in coconut milk and eggs.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce leaf,fish fillet,mozzarella cheese,parsley,garlic pepper seasoning,bean sprout,sea salt
title: Grilled Vietnamese Style Fish Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon garlic pepper seasoning | 2 pounds fresh fish fillets | 1 package seasoned refried beans with basil and garlic sauce | 10 romaine lettuce leaves | 4 slices fresh mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.  Grind the sea salt, garlic pepper seasoning, and fish fillets in a mortar or food processor until the fish is crumbly and completely dried.  Drain grease from the fish and place in a small bowl.  Spread the refried beans with garlic sauce and toss to coat.  Arrange the romaine lettuce on the grill.  Place salmon rolls on top of the romaine lettuce, top with the tomato slices, mozzarella cheese, and parsley, and season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Homemade Pork and Spinach
ingredients: 4 lbs cubed pork belly | 3/4 lb whole wheat pasta ( i like rotelle, but you can use what you have on hand ) | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions until it is al dente.  Drain when ready.  In the meantime, cut the pork meat into bitesize pieces.  Put the pork and its juices into a large frying pan which is heated to medium high.  Add the vinegar.  Cover the pan and cook for two minutes, watching regularly.  When the pasta is al dente, transfer it to a large serving bowl.  Pour the pork drippings into the frying pan.  Add the pork and its juices.  Raise the heat to high and cook for 30 seconds.  Ladle the pasta into the bowl with the pork and meat.  Note, we served this with a salad of green beans and red cabbage.  If you want the salad to last longer in the refrigerator, you can broil it briefly to brown them a bit.  Note, if you have leftover pork and meat from the refrigerator you can cook the pork and beef in the oven for a couple of hours, then grill everything separately.

title: Low Fat, No Bake, Low Fat Oat and Berry Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oat flour | 2 tablespoons wheat flour | 1/2 cup non-fat plain yogurt or 1/2 cup skim milk | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 85 g reduced-fat asparagus, ends trimmed, halved and cut into 3cm lengths | 85 g mixed berry halves, cut into 3cm lengths | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Heat oven to 190°c lightly grease a shallow, non stick gratin dish.  Combine oat flour and wheat flour in a medium bowl.  Add yogurt or milk, mustard powder, asparagus, berry and allspice and mix to combine.  Spoon the topping on top of the oat flour mixture and bake for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Pistachio Pesto (Pistachio Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 cup pistachios, shelled ( shelled raw pistachios ) | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce, plus more for dippers | 1 small serrano chili, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dark brown sugar, packed
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or blender or a food processor, finely grind pistachios to a coarse paste with a small amount of water.  Add remaining ingredients and combine well.  Scoop pesto into a small, shallow container and refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: butter,tomato green chile pepper,pea,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Maggie's Easy Peasy Tomato Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chile peppers | 1/2 cup butter | 1 package frozen peas, thawed | 12 romaine lettuce leaves
instructions: Cook peas in a medium size pot of boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes.  Drain and allow to cool slightly.  Using a fork, poke holes in lettuce leaves about 1/4 inch deep.  Place on a tray covered with paper towels.  Remove and separate large leafy portions of lettuce.  Set aside.  Place stewed tomatoes and green chilies in a large bowl.  Melt butter over low heat in microwave or in the crock of a large stovetop skillet.  Arrange half of the torn lettuce leaves in the bottom of a large bowl.  Pour stewed tomatoes and green chilies over the lettuce.  Sprinkle with peas.  Top with remaining torn lettuce leaves as desired.

title: Mediterranean Couscous and Meatballs
ingredients: 1 can baked beans | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 teaspoon tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon spanish olives, chopped | 1 1/2 cups couscous | 500 g ground lamb or 500 g ground beef | cheese | sesame sprite ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except couscous and roll into meatballs.  Pan fry or barbecue until cooked to your liking.  Serve with salad and salad dressing.  Sprinkle couscous on top.  Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: chili seasoning mix,red capsicum,pork loin roast,pork shoulder
title: Spicy Asian Pork Roast
ingredients: 4 lbs pork loin roast | 4 lbs red capsicums, cut into wedges | 8 ounces chili seasoning mix | 4 lbs pork shoulder, trim off excess fat
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees celsius place meat on rack in roasting tin.  Insert diagonal slice cuts 1 to 2cm deep all around the surface and fat.  Rub 1/4 teaspoon chili seasoning mix onto meat.  Cover tightly with aluminium foil.  Place roasting tin on centre shelf of oven.  Cook for 5 hours.  Remove from oven and slice thinly.  Place slices on warmed serving plates.  Garnish with chopped red capsicum.  Serve with noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,vermouth,gingersnap cookie,kernel corn,bacon dripping,yellow pea,cream cheese,rye bread
title: Miniature Reuben Rollups
ingredients: 4 slices bacon drippings, divided | 12 slices rye bread ( very coarse ) | 1 teaspoon clarified butter or 1 teaspoon ghee, divided | 1 dozen saffron strand | 4 -6 saffron strands | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup sweet vermouth | 1/2 cup whole kernel corn, drained | 1 package frozen yellow peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f degrees.  Wrap slices of bread in foil and refrigerate for 15 to 20 minutes to soften.  Melt 2 tbsp of the bacon drippings in 10 nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Dip the bread into the infused drippings and place in the skillet.  In batches, brown each side.  Transfer to a baking sheet.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until golden on each side.  Remove to wire rack to cool.  Repeat until all of the bread has been fried.  Whip the remaining 3 tbsp of the bacon drippings with the saffron.  Stir in sour cream and vermouth.  Arrange the bread and saffron around the edge of each warmed bowl.  Spoon the sour cream mixture into the center of the bread.  Add the corn and peas.  Fold the bread around the sour cream mixture.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: white flour,beef brisket,creme fraiche,cherry tomato,rise yeast,pork shoulder,deli roast beef
title: Pan-Fried Beef, Pork and Cheese for the Bread
ingredients: 4 ounces creme fraiche or 4 ounces sour cream | 1 1/4 cups white flour | 1 tablespoon quick-rise yeast | 2 tablespoons dried beef fat from a jar, dissolved in | 1 cup warm water | 2 lbs lean short rib of beef, cut into 3-inch pieces | 2 lbs deli corned beef brisket, cut into 3-inch pieces | 10 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Place oven rack in middle of oven and preheat oven to 425°f using 2 knives held parallel to work surface, cut short ribs into 3 pieces each and arrange on a large rimmed baking sheet.  Sprinkle with sea salt and pepper.  Place short ribs in a 3 quart bowl and stir in 1 cup warm water and yeast.  Cover tightly and let rest in a warm place 1 hour, or until creamy.  Add remaining 1 1/4 cups flour plus 1 tablespoon fat.

title: Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 1 medium chicken breast | 16 tortillas
instructions: Cook the chicken breast on medium heat in a cast iron skillet or a crepe pan.  Once the chicken is cooked, place it on the top of a tortilla and put a spoonful of the shredded cheese in it.  The tortillas should not move around the outer edge of the tortilla and the cheese will not burn when the tortilla is filled.  Cut in 1 - 2 strips and serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,baby spinach,mango chutney,honey,grain white rice,superfine sugar,rye bread
title: Baked Green Rice with Baby Spinach
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 8 cups leftover cooked long-grain white rice | 4 cups baby spinach | mango chutney | 8 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Mix together the ginger paste, sugar, mango chutney, and rice in a heavy 2 litre saucepan or casserole dish.  Add the spinach and gently toss to coat.  Sprinkle the rice evenly evenly over the surface.  Cover with a lid, with enough microwaveable film to allow steam to escape, and bake for about 1 hour, then uncover, and bake uncovered for a further 20 minutes or until the rice is crisp and golden.  Allow to cool for about 10 minutes.  To serve, transfer the toasted rice and spinach onto a large serving dish, scatter with mango chutney and toasted rye bread.

title: Molho de Vin (Vanilla Bean Snack)
ingredients: 4 large ripe onions, peeled | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Slice the unpeeled vanilla bean into two halves.  Place a generous teaspoon of sliced peeled onions and vanilla bean pulp into each half.  Wrap the halves with 2 thick toothpicks.  Place the halves into a pan, cover each with cold water and bring to boil.  Boil for 10 minutes, drain and serve.  Delicious.

title: Crusty Provolone Cheese Balls
ingredients: 3 pounds provolone cheese, cubed | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lay the provolone out on a piece of waxed paper and roll it into a rectangle about 10x13 inch.  Place the rectangles on a baking sheet.  Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until lightly browned.  Remove and set aside.  In a medium bowl, mix together the graham cracker crumbs, and the provolone cheese.  Roll the cheese mixture into balls, and place on a baking sheet.  Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven.  Turn the cheese balls over, and bake for 30 more minutes in the preheated oven, or until the cheese has melted and turned golden.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,serrano pepper,fennel seed,philadelphia cream cheese,saffron,navy bean
title: Spaghetti Alla Napoli (No Beans!)
ingredients: 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 serrano pepper, seeds and all | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, cubed | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 12 ounces dried spaghetti, cooked
instructions: Simmer navy beans over medium heat until they turn light yellow and begin to smell nutty.  Add saffron.  Set aside.  Heat cream cheese in microwave until soft.  Add fennel and pepper seeds, remove from microwave and stir in cream cheese mixture.  Add warm navy beans in small amounts to the bowl, and stir until well incorporated.  Add spaghetti in a small amount to bowl as well.  If you have a dry noodle maker, preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Pour mixture into well oiled casserole dish.  Bake for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Roasted Herb and Salt Dressing
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 tablespoon curly fresh parsley
instructions: Place the sage into a small bowl.  Break up any lumps of dried herbs with your hands.  With your hands, combine the dried herbs with about a teaspoonful of oil.  This will help mix in juices if needed.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Spanish Country Daredef
ingredients: 5 lbs country-style beef ribs | 1 package maraschino cherries, drained | 2 large potatoes, peeled and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Wrap ribs in aluminum foil.  Place in a roasting pan.  Sprinkle beef evenly with maraschino cherries.  Bake in preheated oven until meat is very tender, about 2 hours.  Remove beef from oven.  Drain ribs, reserving marinade.  Scoop out meat into a medium bowl.  Mash reserved marinade.  Combine mashed potatoes with reserved marinade.  Arrange potatoes around top of ribs, pouring reserved sauce over meat.  Cover and let stand for 2 hours at room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,ranch dressing,sirloin steak,peanut butter,eggplant,gelatin,red raspberry,straw mushroom
title: Peanut Butter Beef Burger
ingredients: 2 teaspoons unflavored gelatin, or more as needed | 2 1/2 pounds boneless sirloin steaks, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 red bell peppers, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons toasted peanut butter | 8 large eggs | 8 fresh straw mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup red raspberry | 3 tablespoons ranch dressing
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over steaks and set aside for 15 minutes.  Cook beef in a skillet over medium heat until almost completely browned, 5 to 7 minutes.  Transfer beef to a plate and set aside.  Reduce heat to medium low and stir peanut butter into fat remaining in skillet, scraping the bottom with a wooden spoon.  Cook and stir until it dissolves, then remove from heat.  Whisk eggs and strawberries with a fork in a bowl.

title: Greek Pizza
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 lb ground sirloin | 3 packets oxo chicken bouillon | 2 lemons, quartered | 1 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 1 loaf whole wheat pita bread | 1/4 lb cheese, shredded
instructions: Brown and drain meat.  Stir in 1 t c chicken bouillon.  Let cool.  Cut pita bread into 1 pieces and hollow out each one hollow out.  Stuff meat mixture inside of each pita.  Cover with chick peas, then top with cheese.  Bake at 350 for 10 - 15 mins.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,cider vinegar,yellow mustard,white vinegar,corn kernel,butter,part ricotta cheese,chuck
title: Grilled Mexican Corn Beef
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground chuck | 1 cup yellow mustard | 1 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/2 cup light corn kernel | 6 lime wedges | 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese
instructions: Drain beef.

title: Chicken Sausage and Spicy Peppers Nhettas
ingredients: 375 g spaghetti | 4 large chicken thighs | 1 red pepper | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Prepare spaghetti and place in a large pan of boiling water.  Boil for 4 - 5 minutes, drain and set aside.  Cut chicken up into bite sized pieces.  Cut red pepper into 2 - 3 cm chunks, place in a dish and put the chicken in the pan with 4 tbsp of ketchup.  Cook the chicken for 10 to 15 minutes until it is cooked through.  Remove chicken from pan and set aside.  Meanwhile, heat another saucepan in a low medium heat.  Place the cream in a pan and boil for 2 minutes.  Add the chicken back into the pan with the sauce.  Mix.  Add cooked spaghetti to the sauté pan with the chicken.  Cook for 5 minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,thyme,dark brown sugar,saffron,rom tomato,red potato,shaoxing wine
title: Chinese Three-Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 pound red potatoes, cut into 1/3 inch dice | 1 pound roma tomatoes, quartered | 1/2 cup shaoxing wine | 3 1/4 cups chili beans or 3 1/4 cups canned kidney beans | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Return the potatoes to the pot, add the tomatoes, shaoxing wine, and chili beans.  Return to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until thick, about 15 minutes.  Add the brown sugar, thyme and saffron.  Remove from the heat and allow to cool for 10 minutes.  Return the potato mixture to the pot and allow to cool completely before serving.

title: Easy Chilled Greek Chicken
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 3 mangos - pitted, peeled and diced | 1 package crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat.  Place chicken thighs with skin side down on hot grill.  Cook for 2 minutes on each side.  Remove chicken from grill and turn thighs.  Sprinkle with mango and feta cheese to cover.  Grill chicken skin side up until it begins to lightly brown, about 10 minutes.  Cut into wedges for serving.

title: Tortilla Chips Cream Pie
ingredients: 500 g pastry sheets | 125 g crushed tortilla chips | 310 g light cream or 110 g light cream | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons cornflour | 3 tablespoons wine | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Mix cream in a small bowl and stir in the sifted flour.  Use a fork or two spoon to mix in the wine and parsley until well blended.  Spread into a 12 hole tart tin and bake 25 minutes until golden.  Cool and slice into wedges.  Serve plain or with a dressing of your choice.

title: Baked Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Mix rice, beans and parsley together in a casserole dish.  Sprinkle top with some paprika.  Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Prawn and Chicken Manicotti (Tohini)
ingredients: 1 large bratwurst, cut into small pieces | 12 manicotti, wholemeal, cooked ( about 4oz ) | 1 can tomato puree | 1 small egg | 1 lb cooked baby shrimp | 3 tablespoons tahini | 6 tablespoons tahini ( for the pan for tossing )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  In a sauté pan, sauté bratwurst over medium heat 1 minute.  Remove bratwurst and set aside.  Pour off most of the fat, leaving just a few tablespoons of it.  Add tomato puree and mix well.  Add sautéed bratwurst, a few pieces at a time, mix slightly after each addition, until all bratwurst is coated.  Stuff manicotti with bratwurst.  In a small bowl, break egg into tahini and toss with pasta.  Pour egg mixture onto a baking sheet, put on oven and bake 10 - 15 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown.  Garnish with additional tahini.

title: Mexican Spicy Turkey or Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey | 2 cans pinto beans, undrained | 1 can chili paste | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | shredded cheese
instructions: Heat a large skillet over low heat, add ground turkey and cook and stir until no longer pink.  Add pinto beans, chili paste and pasta, cook until heated thoroughly.  Serve topped with shredded cheese.

title: Marinated Spring Mix for Spring Rolls and Chilled Beef
ingredients: 2 bags romaine lettuce ( not packed ) | 3 lemons, juice and zest of | 3/4 teaspoon oregano | 2/3 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Wash and cut the lettuces very thinly at the stem end.  The leaves will have more vitamins left.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,icing sugar,mirin,taro root,black olive,purpose flour,cheese tortellini
title: Taro and Crispy Tortellini and Olive Pastries
ingredients: 6 fresh cheese tortellini | 14 ounces taro root, cut into 1-by-1/8-inch sticks | 1 can pitted black olives, quartered | 1 red bell pepper, cored cored seeded cut into 1/8-inch strips | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 2 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place tortellini in a large pot of boiling, salted water.  Cook until just tender, approximately 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain.  Meanwhile, coat 9 x 13 glass baking dish with cooking spray.  Cut tortellini from top to bottom.  Carefully scoop out the center layer of the tortellini using a spoon and set aside.  Cut tortellini in half.  Remove seeds and membrane from the taro and olives.  Place tortellini and olives on a large platter.  Place tortilla sticks on top.  Arrange red bell pepper strips on top.  Combine icing sugar and flour in a small bowl.

title: Aubergine Breakfast in a Peanut and Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 aubergine, medium-sized | 1 tablespoon peanut butter ( creamy is ok ) | 1 french rolls, toasted or ( 6 ) french rolls, split
instructions: Peel and de vege the aubergines.

title: Cumin Rice Noodles
ingredients: 6 1/2 ounces rice noodles ( soaked in warm water for 15 minutes ) | 3 1/2 ounces apple juice, such as mango or 3 1/2 ounces orange juice, such as grand marnier | 1 rosemary sprig | cumin ( optional )
instructions: Cover a bamboo steamer basket with a few good rinsed noodles and place over boiling water.  Add the noodles, and steam gently for 2 - 3 minutes before removing.  Keep warm.  Place all the other ingredients in a blender or food processor.  Blend until fairly well blended.  Divide among warmed serving bowls and sprinkle with more cumin.  Serve warm, if desired.

Random Ingredients: grape,vegetable broth,chocolate cookie crumb,tahini,curry sauce,watermelon,dark chocolate
title: Thai Watermelon Smoothie II
ingredients: 2 cups diced watermelon | 1/4 can vegetable broth | 1/4 pound dark chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons curry sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped grapes | 1 cup coarsely crushed chocolate cookie crumbs
instructions: Place the watermelon, vegetable broth, 1/4 pound of the dark chocolate, and tahini in a food processor and process until smooth.  Stir sauce into the smoothie.  Pour into glasses and refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: taco shell,lebanese cucumber,pepperoni,red cabbage,oregano leaf,mozzarella cheese,madeira wine,lobster
title: Tortas de López
ingredients: 1/2 large lebanese cucumber, halved lengthwise, halved | 1/2 large red cabbage, halved lengthwise, quartered and thinly sliced | 1/2 lb lobster, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1/2 lb cooked shrimp, shelled and deveined | 2 ounces sliced pepperoni | 7 tablespoons madeira wine | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 8 ounces ricotta salata cheese ( about 3 cups ) or 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded ( about 3 cups ) | 12 large taco shells, warmed
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat.  Arrange the prepared lemon and cabbage on a large platter.  Arrange the lobster on top of the vegetables.  Arrange the pepperoni on the platter.  Mix together the madeira, oregano and remaining cheese.  Spread cheese mixture over the lobster and vegetables.  To serve, spoon the cheese mixture over the seafood and serve over warmed taco shells.

title: Red Beans
ingredients: 2 cans red beans, drained and rinsed well | 1 carton sour cream | 1/4 cup packed dark brown sugar
instructions: In a medium size bowl, blend sour cream and brown sugar until well blended.  Stir in beans.  Let stand at room temperature 3 to 5 hours to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,baby bok choy,onion soup mix,plum tomato,coffee,blueberry,radish,havarti cheese
title: Hot Grilled Broiled Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 head baby bok choy | 6 plum tomatoes | 1 small onion soup mix | 8 kalamata olives | 8 slices havarti cheese | 12 slices lavash fresh blueberries, rinsed | 2 cups hot brewed coffee
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat.  Brush bok choy with oil.  Place on grill and cook until lightly charred on all sides, about 3 minutes.  Place tomatoes and onion soup mix in a food processor with olives and process until smooth.  Place in a large serving bowl.  Add bok choy, then top with blueberries, cheese and lavash.  In a small saucepan, heat coffee until boiling.  Pour coffee into pan and boil over moderate heat until liquid is reduced by half.  Stir occasionally.  Top with reserved blueberries.  Serve with sautéed bok choy.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,pork broth,bean sprout,vegetable broth,savoy cabbage,cherry tomato
title: Tomato and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 4 medium ripe tomatoes, quartered lengthways | 2 cups cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup cabbage, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup veggie broth | 6 1/2 cups bean sprouts | 5 tablespoons pork broth | 1/3 cup bean sprouts ( optional )
instructions: Put tomatoes, cauliflower and cabbage in stockpot and add veggie broth.  Bring to boil and simmer covered for 30 minutes.  Add bean sprouts if using and simmer a further 10 minutes.  Remove lid and cook for a further 5 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Lamb and Garlic Pilaf
ingredients: 1 head garlic, roughly chopped | 500 ml chicken stock or 500 ml broth | 150 g long grain rice | 600 -500 g leg of lamb, cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 25 g pistachios or 25 g cashews ( toasted if desired )
instructions: Place the garlic in a large saucepan with the chicken stock or broth and bring to the boil, turn the heat down to a simmer and cook for 45 minutes.  Strain the stock in a colander and set aside to cool.  Preheat oven to 200c.  Place the rice and lamb in a large roasting tin with 600ml or more of the stock and allow to marinate for a few hours, turning the meat over occasionally.  Using a sharp knife, divide the lamb among ramekins, then scatter over the garlic powder.  Spread pistachios over the top of the lamb, then drizzle over the reserved stock and sprinkle with the pistachios.  Bake in the hot oven for 45 mins, uncovered until golden brown and bubbling.

title: Baked Apricot Chilies (Australia)
ingredients: 4 medium red chilies, seeded, chopped to a chunkyness or 4 medium green chilies, chopped very fine | 1 cup apricot preserves ( or any fruit jam ) | 1/4 cup cake flour
instructions: In a bowl, toss together the chile paste, preserves and flour.  Heat the oven to 150 degrees centigrade.  Spread the batter over the base of a well seasoned 15cm x 10cm ovenproof tin.

title: Crispy Bacon Raisin Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups rice | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 package canadian bacon, cut into pieces | 1 cup chopped rhubarb | 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f.  Cook rice according to package directions.  Rinse in a strainer under cold water to cool.  Combine rice, mayonnaise, orange juice, nutmeg, bacon, rhubarb, and raisins.  Pour dressing over warm rice and vegetables and mix until heated throughout.

Random Ingredients: spice cake mix,balsamic vinegar,rice wine vinegar,honey
title: Balsamic Glaze Cake
ingredients: 1 package spice cake mix | 2/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread 1 package of prepared spice cake mix in a 10x15 inch baking dish.  Blend honey, wine vinegar, and rice wine vinegar together in a blender or food processor until smooth.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,caster sugar,grain brown rice,vegetable shortening
title: Homemade Brown Rice Crisp
ingredients: 180 g sweet grains brown rice ( such as short-grain rice, white or brown ) | 2 tablespoons caster sugar, plus extra for sprinkling | black pepper | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening
instructions: Place the sugar in a heatproof bowl, add the rice and pepper, and stir well to combine.  Allow to stand for 15 minutes or until rice is creamy and set.  Rub the shortening into the rice in a small, heavy based, shallow bowl, then coat in the coarse sugar.  Wipe the bowl well with a clean tea towel to remove the shortening.  Preheat the oven to 190c, 350f, gas mark 8 and transfer all the mixture onto a lightly floured board and divide into 4 portions.  Press a portion of the rice onto the base of a 2lb loaf tin with a long, round edge.  Sprinkle with the remaining sugar, then smooth the top with a knife.  Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, then lower the temperature a little to prevent the pan browning.  Allow to cool completely before removing from the tin.  Cut into slices and store in an airtight container.

title: Rotini With Chicken & Crab
ingredients: 1 lb rotini pasta, uncooked | 2 cups chicken stock | 2 cans crabmeat, undrained
instructions: Cook rotini according to package directions or until al dente.  Remove from heat and allow to cool for 5 minutes.  Stir in chicken stock and crabmeat.

title: Kale Smoothie
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh kale | 4 ounces cool whip, whipped ( such as cool whip )
instructions: Wash, remove and discard kale stalks, then discard stems and any damaged leaves.  Rinse kale in a colander, and gently squeeze out the coarsely chopped stalks.  Remove stems and reserve.  Place kale in a blender, add 4 oz cool whip and puree until smooth.  Chill well.  Ladle into glasses and serve.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,yellow tomato,serrano chilies,chicken wing,cottage cheese,kale,cooking oil,vidalia onion
title: Chicken and Kale Soup
ingredients: cooking oil | 6 lbs chicken wings | 1 large vidalia onion | 3 large yellow tomatoes ( i like petite diced ) | 6 serrano chilies | 16 ounces cottage cheese | 12 leaves kale
instructions: In a large pot boil chicken wings in water until cooked through remove into a bowl drain and let cool.  Remove back into pot, saving 1 cup of the broth.  Skin onion, tomatoes and chili's and chop in a food chopper or mini chopper add the chilis, cottage cheese and reserved broth and pulse and mix til smooth return chicken back to pot add kale and heat through add more broth if soup becomes too thick add reserved broth and mix well.  Cover and let simmer for about 10 minutes.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Anchovy Appetizer
ingredients: 20 anchovy fillets ( about 5 per person ) | 100 ml orange liqueur
instructions: Clean and rinse your anchovies.  Rinse with a little bit of salt and sand to remove sand.  Cut the open and remove the skin from the anchovies.  Place the anchovies on paper towel or a clean dish towel.  Cover with plastic wrap, and leave in the fridge for a few hours.  Remove the anchovy fillets from the plastic wrap.  Place them on a tray and gently roll them in the orange liquor.  Use an electric mixer to beat the flavored liquor on low speed until it is thick and shiny.  Store in the refrigerator until ready to use.  This will keep for up to 3 months.

title: Rice Nests With Spiced Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups rice noodles, preferably long, cut in quarters | 3/4 cup dried cranberries, rinsed well | 3/4 cup toasted hazelnuts, about 2 ounces | 1/2 cup liquid pectin | 1/4 cup dried savory | 1/4 cup sweet picante sauce
instructions: Drain cranberries and nuts into a medium bowl and add pectin.  Stir in remaining ingredients, cover and refrigerate overnight.  Remove from refrigerator 1 hour before serving.  Serve cold.

title: Raspberry Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1 packet taco seasoning | 6 ounces raspberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons snipped herbs | 2 tablespoons oats
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet directions.  Drain and toss all in the taco seasoning.  Serve immediately.

title: Fruit and Chutney
ingredients: 1 can cherry pie filling | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 1 red chilies, chopped | salt and pepper
instructions: Drain cherry pie filling from can.  Chop chilies into strips or strips and mix with cherry pie filling in a small bowl.  Fold in salt and pepper to taste.

title: Pomegranate Pies

title: Thai Barbecue Chicken Bundles With Cajun Spices
ingredients: 10 lbs chicken | 2 1/2 cups cointreau liqueur | 2 1/2 cups cointreau liqueur | 5 tablespoons gingerroot | 1/3 cup cointreau liqueur | 1/3 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh garlic paste | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 3 tablespoons ground baking chocolate | 10 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: If your chicken have wings or skin, cut them crosswise into three equal parts.  Set the chicken parts aside and cover with cold water.  Place chicken wings, wing tips, heads and skin on a cutting board and using a meat mallet or your hands, crush the chicken meat.  Do not knead.  You will tear the meat.  Do not pound out the chicken.  Using the flat side of a meat mallet, pound the chicken pieces until about 3/4 inch thick.  With a meat mallet or rolling pin, pound the chicken until flattened.  Avoid pounding too hard or it will shred easily.  Use a rolling pin, which allows you to roll out a piece of chicken very thinly.  Use a meat tenderizing mallet and push down on the chicken to flatten it to about 1 1/2 inch thick.  Repeat with the remaining wings and the chicken parts.  Place the chicken pieces in a greased 9x13 inch glass baking dish.  Sprinkle the chicken with 2 cups cointreau or cointreau.  For best results, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 3 days.  For the chocolates, combine all ingredients in a small saucepan.  Boil, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes or until it is reduced to about 4 cups.  Do not boil or the chocolate will turn black.  Allow to cool at room temperature until chocolate is about 2/3 full.  Refrigerate until chocolate is cool.  This will make about 16 squares.

title: Arroz Guatemaltego

title: Hot Tasty Peaches With Coffee and Coconut Crusted Toast

title: Chok-Goi in a Spicy Mint & Black Pepper Sauce

instructions: In a deep 12 x 1 inch sauté pan over high heat, warm canola oil and liquid smoke until hot but not smoking. title: Spaghetti Agli Olai - Beef in Pastry Cream With Rose Water
ingredients: 500 g shortening | 500 g stewing beef | 2 teaspoons rose water | 8 spaghetti, sheets | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | cold water
instructions: Melt shortening and brown meat.  Add rose water and cook 20 minutes.  Cool in fridge.  Cut sheets of spaghetti and roll until 1/4 thick.  Cut again length ways, place in a buttered oven proof dish and sprinkle with icing sugar.  Bake at 200oc for approx 45 minutes or till golden.

title: Slow-Cooked Baked Beef Short Ribs With Tomatoes, Cavoured Chickpeas & Olives (Chana Kaihi)

instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Score your beef bones a few with a fork. instructions: Place saffron, rice vinegar and chile peppers into a jar.

title: Easy Feta Steak

title: Chef John's Collegiate Cola - Nerfed Calzone
ingredients: 4 hard salami, sliced | 1 yellow squash, sliced into 1/4-inch slices | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 can coconut milk | 1 cup cola-flavored carbonated beverage | 1 green cardamom pod
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler.  Arrange the salami slices onto a baking sheet.  Drizzle each one with a little of the coconut milk and herb marinade.  Place them under the broiler until the vegetables are tender and nicely browned.  When the vegetables are crisp and browned, turn them over to brown the other side.  While the salami and vegetables are cooking, combine the cornstarch and 1/2 cup cola in a small bowl, and stir in the remaining coconut milk.  Brush the exposed surfaces of the cornstarch mixture with the milk, and sprinkle over the hot calzones.  Place the calzones under the broiler until the tops are light brown and bubbly, 1 to 2 minutes.  Remove and place onto a plate lined with aluminum foil to finish absorbing any excess drippings.  Serve warm, with additional creamy cola for dipping.

title: Sesame Seeds and Chickpeas
ingredients: 450 g fresh chickpeas ( about 1kg ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Soak the chickpeas in water for 8 hours.  Rinse, place in a saucepan with 2 tbsp olive oil, and bring to the boil.  Simmer over medium heat for about 10 minutes, or until the chickpeas are tender.  Drain water and transfer to a food processor.  Add golden syrup and process until well mixed.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed,corn tortilla,red pepper flake,basmati rice,breadcrumb,mint
title: Tortilla & Mint Browned Rice Wedges
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, warm | 140 g breadcrumbs, plain | 1 tablespoon fresh mint, chopped | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 140 g chopped sunflower seeds | 1 tablespoon fresh mint, finely chopped ( optional ) | 6 whole corn tortillas, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c or 220 degrees c if fan forced.  Line a 19x29cm loaf tin with foil and grease foil.  Combine the rice, breadcrumbs, mint, red pepper flakes, sunflower seeds and mint in a bowl and stir to combine.  Spoon the rice mixture evenly into the tin, pressing down to ensure a level surface.  Using a skewer, firmly press the wedge of cornbread onto the rice mixture.  Place in the oven and cook for 25 minutes or until light golden brown.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,cardamom seed,dill,button mushroom,yellow squash,colby monterey jack cheese,chicken tender
title: Grilled Chicken Breasts With Dill & Cheese
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken tenders | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 yellow squash, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 button mushrooms, sliced into 1/4-inch slices | 1 1/2 cups chopped colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Place chicken tenders on large square of reynolds wrap heavy duty aluminum foil.  Sprinkle with cardamom seeds and place in a single layer on a wire rack in a 425° oven.  Let them sit for 10 minutes.  Preheat grill to high.  Brush chicken with milk.

title: Nahm Jeera (Red Chili Snack)
ingredients: 1 small red chili, halved | 1 slice lemon
instructions: Peel the chilie, and cut into 1/2 inch pieces with scissors.  Squeeze the lemon onto the cut chilie.  Pop the chilie into a small bowl, and add salt or olive oil, stirring to coat.  Store refrigerated snack nosh for up to 5 days.

title: Chew Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted cashews | 2 cups self-rising flour | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread cashews out onto a baking sheet.  Bake cashews in the preheated oven until lightly toasted and beginning to brown, about 40 minutes.  Cool to room temperature and grind cashews into a fine powder using a spice mill, if desired.  Set aside to cool completely.  Stir self rising flour and salt into cashews until flour has absorbed much of the liquid.  Use a slotted spoon to mash the nuts until they are sandy, fluffy, and no large chunks remain.  Sprinkle with black pepper and mix well.  Drain and allow to cool before storing in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,gluten baking powder,thyme,beef tenderloin steak,balsamic vinegar,lamb
title: Beef Tenderloin with Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: 1 tablespoon gluten-free baking powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 beef tenderloin steak, trimmed | 1 lamb, cut into slices | 1 teaspoon gluten free baking powder | 1 tablespoon gluten-free balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 beef tenderloin steak, trimmed | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Mix 1 tablespoon gluten free baking powder, 1 teaspoon dried thyme, and 1 beef tenderloin steaks.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Brush pan with oil and coat with a few teaspoons of gluten free baking powder.  Working in batches, sprinkle steaks with remaining teaspoon baking powder and 1 teaspoon dried thyme.  Cook until the steaks are seared and just beginning to brown, 3 to 5 minutes per side.  Remove steaks from pan.

title: Squash and Girard Champagne Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash | 4 tablespoons grape wine vinaigrette ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup milk | 2 cups girard's champagne or 2 cups other bistro champagne, chilled ( optional ) | 4 -5 thinly sliced serrano peppers | fresh lemon ( optional )
instructions: Cut butternut squash in half, remove seeds.  Cook squash in salted water until tender or cool in microwave.  Reserve cooking water.  Remove skin and seeds and puree in food processor.  Bring reserved cooking water to boil then add grape wine vinaigrette.  Cook and stir for 4 - 5 minutes, stirring constantly.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,spaghetti,pasta sauce,onion soup mix,icing sugar,mirin,cooking spray
title: Serve With Shrimp Pasta for Warm Seafood
ingredients: 1 package of your favourite dried noodles, i like penne in a pinch or 1 noodle per serving ( or spaghetti of your choice ) | 3 tablespoons mirin ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion soup mix | 1/4 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 can prepared spaghetti or 1 1 kg cleaned shrimp, shelled | 2 -3 tablespoons cooking spray
instructions: Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat, add the oil, onion soup mix and mirin and stir well.  Bring to boil and let simmer for 2 - 3 minutes.  Add the cooked shrimp, spaghetti or shrimp to the shrimp mixture and stir thoroughly.  Spray a casserole dish with cooking oil and pour the noodles into the dish.  Sprinkle the top with the grated cheddar cheese and a few pinches of icing sugar.  Bake in a preheated oven at 160 degrees for approximately 30 - 40 minutes or until cheese is melted and top is golden.  Serve with steamed green vegetables.

title: Blueberry Scented Tea (Tea)
ingredients: 24 cups fresh blueberries or 24 cups frozen blueberries | 2 small star anise | 8 leaves fresh sage or 1 teaspoon dried sage, shredded
instructions: Place the berries and star anise in an electric blender container.  Cover the berries with water and add about 1/8 cup of cold water.  Cover tightly and run until the berries are completely broken up.  Remove the star anise.  Cover tea with a tea towel and allow to steep for 1 hr or longer.  Let cool slightly then chill until serving time.  Enjoy your choice.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek leaf,gochujang chili paste,dark beer,rice noodle,turnip,ketchup
title: Lori's Korean Noodle Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces rice noodles | 1/2 cup dark beer | 3 ounces ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon gochujang chili paste | 1 small turnip, diced very small | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Drop the noodles into a pot of hot water.  As they cook, boil the noodles until they float, about 1 minute.  Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain well.  When the noodles are finished, rinse with cold water and drain again.  In a wok or large heavy skillet, add the beer, ketchup and chili paste.  When the water is boiling, add the noodles and turnip, and lower heat to simmer.  Cook 10 minutes, stirring now and again.  Remove the pan from the heat, stir in the fenugreek leaves, taste, and serve to each bowl.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,multigrain bread,nonstick cooking spray,pork,flat leaf parsley
title: Thai Pork Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pork or 1/2 lb ground beef | 1/3 cup packed fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon turmeric | nonstick cooking spray | 1 loaf multigrain country bread or 1 loaf other crusty bread
instructions: Place the pork or beef, parsley, turmeric and bread into a medium bowl.  Mix well.  Divide the mixture evenly into 4 equal portions.  Divide one portion into 4 sections.  Shape each portion into a patty about 3 inches in diameter.  Spray nonstick cooking spray over both sides of the patty.  On one side of each patty, press the bread sections into the meat and bread.  Fold both ends over to form burgers.  Set aside on a plate and cover with a plate to keep warm.  Repeat for the remaining portions.  Heat a large non stick fry pan.

title: Quick Vegan Enchilada Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces low-fat cottage cheese | 3 tablespoons tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 1 can low-fat enchilada sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 can of enchilada sauce together in your food processor or blender until smooth.  If using a food processor, do the same if making for a smooth mixture.  The cheese should still be chunky.  Spread into an 8 inch square dish.  Cover with remaining can of enchilada sauce and refrigerate.  Cut into squares to serve.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,carrot,watermelon,red chili pepper,coconut,spinach leaf,spring onion
title: Coconut Spinach Salad (Shaladi)
ingredients: 1 cup freshly cooked cannellini beans | 1 cup finely chopped spinach leaves | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped ( or other red chili ) | 1/2 cup finely shredded carrot | 1 cup coarsely chopped watermelon | 2 tablespoons grated coconut | 1 spring onion, finely sliced
instructions: Place the beans, spinach, chili pepper, carrot, watermelon and coconut in a large bowl and toss gently to combine.  Garnish with a few spring onion slices before serving.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,mayonnaise,pork sausage,corn oil,food coloring,chocolate,golden raisin
title: Sausages with Chocolate
ingredients: 24 sausage rolls, casings removed | 3 1/2 fluid ounces corn oil | 6 ounces chocolate, unsweetened chocolate | 3 1/2 fluid ounces cider vinegar | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 10 ounces golden raisins, chopped | food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Brown the sausages slightly on both sides in a pan with the corn oil.  Keep warm in a 200 degree oven.  In a microwave safe bowl, combine chocolate, vinegar, mayonnaise, nuts, and raisins.  Add coloring, if desired.  Remove sausages from the pan and place on a tray, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside for 10 minutes.  Heat remaining corn oil.  Dip the sausages into the chocolate mixture, coating evenly.  Arrange on serving plate, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Bring to room temperature before serving.  Store sausages in the refrigerator.

title: Peaches With a Bite
ingredients: 3 -4 fresh peaches | 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Slice open the ripe peaches and remove the stone. .  Melt the butter in a frying pan, and when sizzling add the peaches.  Keep stirring so they fry on both sides until they're heated through and the butter has started to turn light brown.  Serve hot.  Note, the peaches may also be cut in half.  Serve with a side of horseradish sauce.  Variation, instead of peaches, use your own peach bread.  Butter is an excellent substitute for butter.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,beef steak,onion powder,pita chip,tabasco sauce,mint
title: Quick Beef Pitas
ingredients: 1 can beef flank steak | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup onion powder | 2 tablespoons dried mint | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 pita chips, split
instructions: Heat pita chips in a dry pan or griddle over medium heat, stirring occasionally until browned.  Remove from heat.  Trim fat from steak and slice into thin strips or strips.  Combine steak, stock, onion powder, mint, and tabasco sauce in a medium skillet.  Cover and cook over medium heat until heated through, about 5 to 10 minutes.  Spoon beef mixture over pita chips in bowls, or serve on the side.  Serve the remaining pita chips as a dip.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,red curry paste,cardamom powder,ancho chili
title: Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon red curry paste ( available at asian oriental markets ) | 1 -2 tablespoon soy sauce ( or braggs amino acids, available at asian oriental markets ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder ( if you like a bit sweeter curry paste, you can omit the cardomomom powder ) | 1/2 teaspoon whole ancho chili ( or other chilli )
instructions: Heat a little oil in a pan on medium high heat.  Add the chili and saute for 2 - 4 minutes.  Add a few tablespoons of the curry paste to the pan.  Cook for a further 1 - 2 minutes on medium heat.  Stir a few times and add the rest of the curry paste.  Cook for an additional 3 - 4 minutes so that the paste releases flavour.  Remove from flame.  Store in fridge for several days.  You will need 2 tablespoons per cup of curry paste.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,ricotta cheese,broth,plum tomato,chipotle chile,goat cheese
title: Chile Cheese With Ricotta (Salsa Di Riso E Ricotta Con Chipotle)
ingredients: 4 ounces goat cheese, at room temp | 12 ounces ricotta cheese ( preferably organic ) | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 -2 canned chipotle chile, seeded and chopped | 1 small plum tomato, diced | 1/2 cup broth ( can be used to make salsa )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl.  Stir with a fork or spoon.  Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.  Serve chilled over any other type of cheese you like.  Use in place of chiles.

title: Easy Beef and Apricot Salad Recipe
ingredients: 3 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds, ground | 8 cups torn iceberg lettuce | 3/4 cup dried apricots
instructions: Place the bouillon and ground caraway seeds into a large skillet or wok.  Cook over high heat until the aromas of the spices have gone from black to white.  Stir the mixture once or twice, then add the lettuce and apricots.  Serve immediately.  I would recommend you do this when i was in a hurry.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,white vinegar,white sugar,graham cracker crumb,fig,button mushroom,grain rice
title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups finely chopped dried figs | 1/2 cup chopped button mushrooms | 1/3 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup coarse grain rice | 1/8 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Mix figs, mushroom, sugar, rice, salt, vinegar and egg white in a bowl.  Stuff into mushroom caps.  Sprinkle crumbs on top.  Place on an ungreased baking sheet, or a roasting rack.  Bake in the preheated oven until the tops turn golden and the tops begin to brown, about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chef Bevski's Easy Chefs Crumble
ingredients: 1 box graham cracker crumbs ( about 2-1/2 cups ) | 1 bottle vermouth, butternut flavored ( i use sweet vermouth, but use sweet breads as well )
instructions: Turn oven to 350°f.  Line a 9x9x2 inch baking dish with waxed paper.  Mix together graham cracker crumbs, vermouth and 1 cup of hot water.  Mix well until well moistened.  Add the crumb mixture and stir gently just until the ball is smooth.  Spoon mixture into prepared pan.  Sprinkle remaining 1 cup of hot water onto crumb mixture in pan.  Spread evenly.  Bake 1 hour or until top is light brown and it springs back when lightly touched.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,corn kernel,italian sausage,gouda cheese,cornmeal
title: Spicy Sausage Polenta
ingredients: 1 lb bulk sweet italian sausage | 3 cups canned corn kernels, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup uncooked cornmeal | 1/2 cup shredded gouda cheese | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.  Coat 12 inch ovenproof skillet with low, nonstick spray.  In skillet on medium heat, cook sausage.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,ancho chili,chicken thigh,cocoa powder,ranch dressing mix,kitchen bouquet
title: Shredded Butternut Squash Chicken
ingredients: 12 chicken thighs | 6 small butternut squash | 2 cans ranch dressing mix | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 -2 tablespoon kitchen bouquet | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chili
instructions: Place the squash in an 8 - 10 qt.  Bowl.  Combine the ranch with kitchen bouquet and pour over the squash.  Add the cocoa over.  In a separate pan, brown the chicken on all sides on both sides in a 2 tbs.  Drippings.  Bake the chicken in a moderate oven 325 deg f.

title: Butter Cookie Sugar
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter flavor shortening, softened | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 jar salsa
instructions: Measure butter flavor shortening into a bowl and mix well with brown sugar.  Add garam masala.  Spread on cookie dough into an ungreased 11 1/2 x 2 1/2 inch baking pan and bake in a 350 degree oven until the foam disappears and the cookies begin to lightly crisp, about 10 to 12 minutes.  Remove from the oven and immediately pour salsa into the center, swirling to coat.  Cool completely before storing.

title: Cafe Rio Tuna Spread
ingredients: 2 cans tuna, drained | 1 can mushrooms, sliced | 4 cups grape tomatoes, halved | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon roasted espresso or 1 tablespoon white wine | 1/2 - 3/4 cup taco sauce ( per your liking )
instructions: Put all ingredients in food processor or blender and puree the ingredients until smooth.  Serve chilled.

title: Herbes De Provence and Mango Juice or Mango Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup herbes de provence, with dried fruit ( or use a mix of both ) | 1/4 teaspoon mace | 1 cup mango ball ( optional )
instructions: Combine the herbs in small bowl.  Pour over mango balls, if using.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,beer,green chili pepper,curry leaf,almond essence,white pepper
title: Bombay Onion Kebabs
ingredients: 4 teaspoons vegetable oil | 4 green chili peppers, finely chopped | 4 fresh curry leaves | 1 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1 1/3 teaspoons curry leaves | 1/4 teaspoon almond essence | 1/4 cup beer
instructions: Heat oil in a small saucepan on medium heat.  Add chilies and curry leaves.  Stir fry for one minute, stirring constantly.  Add white pepper.  Stir in curry leaves.  Stir fry on high for one minute.  Remove from heat, and stir in almond essence.  Transfer to a plate, and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight if possible.  Cut the onion into very large chunks.  Thread onto metal skewers with alternating cuts each skewer.  Cook on grill/wok over medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes, turning twice, or until the onion is a rich color.  Serve hot, or let them stand for 15 minutes to absorb excess water.

title: Pasta rigate with rigatoni and hot pepper sauce
ingredients: 3 cups rigatoni pasta | 1 jar roasted red peppers drained and patted dry with paper towels
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.  Drain, cool and cut into 1/2 inch cubes.  While pasta is cooking, spread roasted red pepper slices over a large platter and season with salt.  Arrange half of rigatoni over the red pepper slices.  Place other half of rigatoni over red pepper slices and serve with roasted red pepper sauce.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,peanut oil,corn syrup,hash brown,virgin olive oil,tomato sauce,chinese five spice powder,nutmeg
title: Spicy Spelt Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs pot stickers ( your favorite flavor ) or 2 lbs spelt-sweat hash browns ( your favorite flavor ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 2 tablespoons mixed nuts or 2 tablespoons pecans, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 2 cups tomato sauce | 1/4 cup virgin olive oil
instructions: Place hashbrowns or spelt wate in a shallow baking dish, and coat with corn syrup and light corn syrup.  Bake in a preheated 400°f oven 30 - 45 minutes, turning once during cooking.  Meanwhile, whisk together tomato sauce and oil.  When potatoes are done, drain them on paper towels.  Turn hashbrowns over and sprinkle with five spice powder.  Serve with sauce.  Keeps well 1 week if refrigerated.

title: Easy Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 4 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 2 teaspoons salt | 1 -2 dash cayenne pepper
instructions: Wash the ricotta, removing the whey, and place ricotta in a double boiler.  Add rest of ingredients to ricotta and mix until smooth.  Serve with crackers.

title: Creamy Avocado and Soymilk Rigatoni
ingredients: 600 ml soy milk | 150 g freshly cooked rigatoni pasta | 1 avocado, sliced | sea salt, to taste
instructions: Pour the soy milk into a saucepan and heat until steaming.  Add the rigatoni and bring to the boil.  Cover and simmer over a low heat for 3 - 4 minutes.  Drain any remaining liquid and remove from the heat.  Place the avocado slices over the top and stir around with a wooden spoon until smooth.  Serve the rigatoni with the avocado cream on the side.  Note, this is not a vegan version.  To save money, just eat it as is.  You may have to add 1 tbsp olive oil or butter.

title: Spicy Grilled Okra
ingredients: 1/3 cup fresh okra, cut lengthwise into 4 slices | 1/4 cup red raspberry, sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Place the okra slices into a shallow nonreactive bowl.  Sprinkle with 1/8 teaspoon of salt and toss to coat.  Cover and refrigerate the okra for 1 hour or up to 8 hours.  Remove from the refrigerator and rinse well under running water.  Pat dry with paper towels.  Thread 3 slices of okra onto each soaked skewer.  Serve topped with sliced red and/or strawberry peppers.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,lime wedge,catalina salad dressing,seasoning,prego pasta sauce,turmeric,cream tartar,pineapple chunk
title: Tofu Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tempeh or 1 1/2 lbs tuna, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 head fresh pineapple chunk | taco sauce ( any brand ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/3 cup prepared catalina salad dressing | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 cup bottled prego pasta sauce | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Place the cubed tuna in a large, resealable plastic bag.  Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of the seasoning on the tuna, turning it to coat.  Place in the refrigerator.  Place the pineapple and pineapple chunks in another large resealable plastic bag.  Add the taco sauce, stirring to combine.  Place in the refrigerator.  Heat the taco grill.  Remove tuna to a platter.  Reserve the marinade for another use.  Remove the tuna from the marinade.  Place the tuna in a skillet over medium low heat.  Saute the pineapple until golden brown and cooked through.  Let cool.  Place the tuna in a serving bowl.  Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of the tumeric and 1/3 cup of the salad dressing over the tuna and pineapple.  Pour the reserved marinade over the salad.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours.  Before serving, sprinkle the remaining tumeric, the remaining salad dressing and the prego cheese dressing over the tuna.  Spoon the tuna salad over the salad.  Squeeze the lime wedge over the salad.

title: Yorkshire Lion Pie
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry ( half a pound ) | 1 - 1 1/4 lb cooked lamb or 1 -1 1/4 lb cooked goose | 1 -2 green food coloring | 1 -2 slice ham
instructions: Preheat oven to 400° f.  Divide pastry into 5 sheets.  Roll each sheet into a round circle, about 10 inches in diameter, and place on a cookie sheet.  Cut a slit in the center of each circle, making a slit into the center of the pastry.  Repeat, using a 6 inch knife, or a fork, working between each circle.  Place in oven, and bake for about 20 minutes, or until the pastry is puffed up. .  Remove from oven, and let sit for 15 to 20 minutes.  Remove from oven, and cut in half.  Serve with warm maple butter, jams and whipped cream.

title: Sweetcorn Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 can sweetcorn, drained, rinsed
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat.  Line up 8 small disposable foil pie pans with foil.  Trim excess fat from tender.  Rub pork with sweetcorn, and tie with kitchen string to secure.  Place meat on skewers, and grill over medium hot coals, turning to cook.  Grill pork until browned, about 3 minutes per side.

title: Tamarind Puffs
ingredients: 1/2 pound dried apricots | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste, or as needed | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans
instructions: Place apricots in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,fast rising yeast,ginger garlic paste,honey,shrimp
title: Baked Shrimp in New York Style
ingredients: 1 cup shrimp, frozen | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 package frozen cooked tilapia fillets | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place shrimp on a baking sheet.  In a small bowl, crumble ginger garlic paste into shrimp until it is combined and the shrimp are coated evenly.  Sprinkle shrimp with honey, and sprinkle with yeast.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until shrimp are cooked through and shrimp are browned.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,beef chuck roast,vanilla bean,colby monterey jack cheese,basmati rice,pomegranate juice,plain flour,squash
title: Yummy Beef and Bean Stoup
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed | 1 can condensed kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can pumpkin-flavored pomegranate juice | 1 vanilla bean, split and seeds scraped | 1 large bay leaf | 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 2 cups store-bought colby-monterey jack cheese, grated | plain flour ( for dusting )
instructions: Pour the canned beans into a large pot, and add enough water to make the mixture just covered.  Cover, and bring to boiling.  Turn down to medium low and simmer 3 hours, skimming foam and fat from surface.  When the mixture thickens, remove the beef and squash from the sauce and set aside.  Strain any solids from cooking sauce through a sieve or food mill, discarding solids.  Add pomegranate juice, vanilla bean pod, bay leaf.  Remove the vanilla bean pod, then place the strained bean mix into a medium saucepan.  Add enough water to cover the bean mix, then simmer about 20 minutes, skimming foam from the top as needed.  Add the rice and stir to combine.  Sprinkle the cheese over the top, and simmer until the cheese is melted — about 5 minutes, but check after 1 minute.  Taste for seasoning — if necessary, stir in a little flour if the soup becomes too thick.  Serve hot.

title: Poblano Chile Roll
ingredients: 1 poblano chile ( can use red anaheim or anaheim as a substitute ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 head iceberg lettuce or 1 head butter lettuce
instructions: Remove seeds of poblanos by placing on a small baking sheet.  Bake at 300 degrees in preheated oven for about 25 minutes or until soft.  Cool slightly, peel the skin off.  Place the poblanos in a processor or blender and process for several seconds to get a finely chopped mixture.  Whip the cream until stiff.  Spread about 1/4 cup cream on the bottom of a large clear glass or ceramic dish.  Arrange shredded lettuce leaves on the cream.  Sprinkle the poblano mixture on top, then dollop on the remaining cream.  Let set in refrigerator for 30 minutes to cool.

title: Red Mushroom Infused Tequila (Smoke)
ingredients: 12 dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups tequila | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source.  Arrange the shiitake mushrooms on a baking sheet.  Brush the mushroom with olive oil and sprinkle with red pepper flakes.  Broil the mushrooms until the mushrooms are tender, 10 to 15 minutes.  Cut each pepper slice in half, drizzle with tequila, and serve.

Random Ingredients: spice,cocoa,apple cider,rotel,italian bread,velveeta cheese,philadelphia cream cheese,cremini mushroom
title: Mushroom Swiss Rollups
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 1/2 cups velveeta cheese | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese | 1 package cremini mushrooms | 1 can rotel ( original ) | 1 can rotel chili hot pepper sauce ( original ) | 1 tablespoon spices ( spicy ) | 1/2 cup italian style bread ( such as ciabatta bread ) | apple cider ( optional )
instructions: In a microwavable bowl, combine all ingredients except bread.  Microwave on high for 10 seconds to combine and soften ingredients.  Spread mixture evenly in a rectangle baking dish.  Top with more bread and roll up jelly roll fashion.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 2 hours.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Slice into about 16 slices.  Bake in a preheated oven about 20 minutes or until lightly browned and cheese is melted.

title: Meatballs Marinara
ingredients: 10 frozen meatballs | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning
instructions: Place the frozen meatballs in a large freezer bag.  Sprinkle the sherry and the italian herb seasoning with the meat pieces.  Close and refrigerate for 5 hours to marinate.  Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  Remove the meatballs from the freezer bag, then place them on a baking sheet.  Bake in the oven for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,hot italian sausage,coconut rum,lime wedge,mozzarella ball,courgette
title: Viking Gourmet: Giada De Laurentiis
ingredients: 4 sweet italian sausage ( or kielbasa ) | 1 lb mozzarella ball ( about 10 slices ) | 3 -4 medium courgettes ( green and baby carrots ) | 1/2 cup light coconut rum ( optional ) | lime wedge | grated romano cheese or grated asiago cheese ( optional )
instructions: In deep skillet over medium heat, crumble sausage and cook until golden brown.  Remove sausage and set aside.  Raise heat to medium high.  Add mozzarella to sausage and cook until golden brown.

title: Italian Plum Tomatoes and Bamboo Shoots
ingredients: 6 italian plum tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup packed bamboo shoot, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients.  Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes to develop flavors.  Serve chilled.  Store in refrigerator.

title: Spicy Sausage
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sausage or 2 lbs rump roast, cut in 3/4 inch slices | 12 slices prosciutto or 12 slices salami | spices, to taste

title: Chipotle Zucchini
ingredients: 1 small head of garlic, cloves unpeeled | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 6 medium zucchini, cut on the diagonal in 1-inch pieces | 2 -3 tablespoons dry red wine | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon red wine | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Place the garlic cloves on a sheet pan in a single layer.  Bake 30 minutes, or until garlic is completely roasted.  Cool on a metal or paper towel lined baking sheet 30 minutes.  Remove the roasted garlic cloves from the oven and set aside.  Turn stove on to broiler setting.  Place the mustard seeds and chipoltes in a small skillet, bring to a boil, and immediately remove from the heat.  Do not let them sit for long enough to become dark.  Immediately transfer the chipoltes to a food processor, along with 1/4 cup of the chipotle oil from the can of chipoltes.  Process them to a fine powder, set aside.  Place the zucchini in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Roast 5 minutes and turn over.  Roast 7 minutes more.  Remove from the oven and cool on the baking sheet.  Place zucchini in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and set aside to marinate for 15 minutes.  Turn off the food processor and place the marinated zucchini in a saucepan with 1 cup of the reserved chipotle oil from the can of chipoltes.  Add the 2 - 3 tablespoons of wine, sherry, turmeric powder, remaining 1/4 cup chipotle oil, any remaining marinade from the meat or giblets, and bring to a boil.  Remove from heat and pour mixture over the zucchini.  Add the remaining 1/4 cup of chipoltes and 1/4 cup of sweet potato.  Cover tightly and set aside at room temperature for 2 hours.  Turn meat onto a broiler pan and broil until browned.

Lightly oil your hands with cooking oil, place a piece of dried red chile on the baking sheet, and sprinkle it with 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract and 1/4 teaspoon of red chile pepper.  Broil for about 5 minutes, or until the chile begins to crackle and turn brown around the edges.  Remove from the oven and serve immediately with dry ice cream, coffee or biscotti.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,water chestnut,rice noodle vermicelli,rice wine
title: Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 12 sheets fresh rice noodles or 12 sheets dried vermicelli | 1 can water chestnuts | 1/2 cup pineapple juice, chilled | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Cook noodles until tender according to package directions.  Drain.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,wood ear mushroom,red wine vinegar,yellow squash,caster sugar,meatball,pastry crust pie,flour tortilla
title: Meatball and Veg-Spritters
ingredients: 200 g frozen precooked meatballs | 1 red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 1/2 cups chopped yellow squash | 1 1/2 cups chopped red ear mushrooms | 4 large flour tortillas | 2 sheets pastry for double-crust pie
instructions: Combine the vinegar, sugar, vanilla and 1/2 cup water in a medium bowl and stand for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, place the frozen meatballs in a saucepan with the sugar and half the wine over a medium heat and stir until the sugar dissolves.  Increase the heat to high and cook the meatballs, gently turning, for about 5 minutes or until the meatballs have cooked.  Remove the meatballs with a slotted spoon and place on kitchen paper, covered with a clean tea towel.  Leave in the oven to cool.  Wipe out the saucepan and reheat the remaining wine, if using.  Cut out four long strips of foil and spray 2 sheets of pastry with oil.  Put a piece of pastry onto the foil and lay a few meatballs onto it, overlapping slightly.  Spoon a little vinegar mixture about 5cm/1in/1 3/4in from the edge and spoon over the meatballs, spreading it out evenly.  Dip the pastry edges in the vinegar and then lay the pastry strip on top.  Repeat with another sheet of pastry and meatballs, ending with a pastry strip in the centre and trimming it away from itself with kitchen paper making sure the pastry gets into the corners too.  Preheat the oven to 180 deg c/300 deg f/gas mark 6, 200 deg c/gas mark 4, or 170 deg c if you are using a fan forced oven.  Bake the dish for about 45 minutes or until it starts to smell very crisp and golden.  Meanwhile place the reserved sliced mushrooms in a medium saucepan with a little water.  Bring to the boil over high heat.  Boil for 5 minutes or until the mushrooms are just tender.  Drain the mushrooms and dry well, then set aside.  Reduce the heat to low and warm the rest of the vinegar, making sure it thickens a little bit.  Meanwhile, warm up the tortillas for a few seconds and, with a pastry brush, spread a little melted on each tortilla.  Then arrange the meatballs on top, drizzling with the sauce and sprinkling with the cinnamon and sugar.  Place under the grill for 3 - 5 minutes or until the meatballs are warm.

title: Lentil and Cabbage Saute
ingredients: 1 -2 medium napa cabbage, cored, core removed, and finely shredded | 2 tablespoons amaretto ( almond-flavored liqueur ) | 1 can green lentils, rinsed and drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium serving bowl.

title: Vermicelli and Cream
ingredients: 100 g vermicelli ( broken into 1cm lengths ) | 300 ml single cream | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar ( i used cider vinegar but any kind would do ) | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 garlic clove, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Cook the vermicelli in boiling water.  Meanwhile, in a small saucepan heat the cream until it is barely boiling and then stir through the hot sauce and vinegar.  Stir in the vermicelli noodles until coated and continue cooking until heated through.  Remove and drain the noodles.  Serve, drizzled with sauce.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,olive,ouzo,bean sprout,passion fruit pulp,heavy duty aluminum foil,gruyere
title: Fried Potatoes With Ouzo #5FIX
ingredients: 5 large baking potatoes | 1 1/2 cups shredded gruyere ( cheese blend ) | 1 -2 tablespoon olive oil | 1 can baked beans ( can use mixed sprouts ) | 1/2 cup fresh passion fruit pulp | 1/4 cup ouzo | 8 fluid ounces heavy-duty aluminum foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f/190°c.  Wrap each potato completely with an equal amount of cheese.  Lightly film with olive oil and place on rack in a broiler safe roasting pan.  Place pan under broiler for 1/2 hr 1 hr or until golden brown.  While potato is cooking, pour ouzo into a medium sized skillet over medium low heat and scrape the bottom and sides with wooden spoon until the oil is fragrant then pour slowly into the pan.  Whisk in the passionfruit pulp and bring to a simmer, whisking until thickened slightly.  Remove from heat.  Remove foil and spoon sauce over potatoes and toss to coat, place on baking sheet.  Bake for 30 minutes, or until crisp and golden brown.  Serve immediately.

title: Herbed Onion Rings
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons dried italian herbs | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 3/4 cup finely chopped white onion | cooking oil, for frying
instructions: Mix the flour and herbs together in a bowl.  Add in the finely chopped onions and mix with your hands until well coated.  Heat olive oil in a frying pan, and roll half of the mixture into a circle.  Place on a paper towel covered plate, and pat dry with oil.  Repeat until all the mixture has been used.  Sprinkle the onion rings with salt and pepper.  Fry them in the pan over medium heat for about 10 minutes, until golden.  Place in a warmed serving dish, and serve hot or warm.

title: Sizzler in Microwave
ingredients: 2 lbs ground round | 2 lbs ground lamb shoulder | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 3 ounces tomato ketchup or 3 ounces other good quality ketchup | 1 tablespoon dried phyllo pastry
instructions: Mix together the ground meat and spices.  Brush a 10 x 14 inch square of baking parchment lightly with oil.  Arrange 3 ounces meat mixture at one end of the pastry.  Place 1/3 of the ketchup on meat and sprinkle over another/side of meat.  Roll up and place seem side down, on hot papertowel.  Cook until lightly browned on all sides about 45 - 60 minutes.  Remove and store in fridge or freezer.  Serve with tomato sauce and crusty bread, or a green veg salad, or just eat them with anything and have them pop the pastry into the microwave for a minute or two.

title: Red Apple Chili Paste
ingredients: 1 lb sliced cooking apple | 1 small dried red chili pepper, minced
instructions: Cut all the apples into 1/4 inch slices, then slice the slices in half, lengthwise, cutting almost all the way through the core.  Remove the seeds.  In a saucepan heat the chili and the apple slices in enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer till the apples are soft.  Stir them every now and then and simmer for 10 minutes or till everything is well blended.  Transfer to a blender or food processor and process till smooth.  Stir in the chili paste.  Cool in the fridge or a sealed airtight container in the summer, store in the fridge till ready to use.

title: Garlic Clam Dip
ingredients: 500 ml bottled clam juice | 250 g fresh yeast | 4 bay leaves, crushed | 3/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 3/4 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 1/2 tablespoons ajwain
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the water then put the clams in a large pan, add bay leaves, marjoram, & mustard.  Let this cook for 5 - 10 mins over a medium heat, or until slightly reduced to a thick paste, stirring from time to time so it doesn't stick.  When you're ready to serve, combine the clams & the jam in a bowl, stir.  Re place the heat, if it's to strong, & boil vigorously, for 1 - 2 mins.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,chicken,penne pasta,farfalle pasta,pumpkin seed,grand marnier
title: Penne with Pumpkin Seed Sauce
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta | 1 pound ground chicken | 1 can pumpkin seeds | 1/2 cup roasted jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, and cook penne pasta at a boil until cooked through yet firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

instructions: Combine the chicken broth, mango chutney, miso paste, rotel tomatoes with chilies with chilies, and water in a large, heavy sauce pan.

title: Dynamite Seafood
ingredients: 1 lb fresh cod, skin on or 1 lb any other white fish | 1 package button mushrooms | 1 box baby carrots | italian dressing | shredded lettuce | 8 ounces cream cheese, softened | spicy hot sauce | paprika ( optional )
instructions: Place fish, mushrooms and carrots in large pot with italian dressing and bring to boil.  Reduce heat and let sit 15 minutes to an hour.  Remove from heat.  Combine cream cheese and chopped lettuce in a bowl with your favorite flavor.  Add hot sauce if desired.  Place seafood in a dish.  Top with cheese and toss.

title: Easy Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 2 jars alfredo sauce | 3 teaspoons dry mustard seeds | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Pour alfredo sauce into a saucepan.  Add mustard seed.  Cover and simmer for 90 seconds.  Stir in parmesan cheese.  Serve over pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,rotel tomato chilies,lettuce leaf,asafoetida powder,oat,cream cheese,italian salad dressing mix
title: Low-Fat Stuffed Italian Wraps for One
ingredients: 1/2 cup fat free cream cheese | 1 tablespoon reduced-fat italian salad dressing mix | 4 -8 large lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 tablespoons rotel tomatoes & chilies, chopped | 1 pinch asafoetida powder, msg ( to spice it up ) | 1 tablespoon raw oats
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together cream cheese, dressing mix, lettuce and chutney.  Add salt, to taste.  Set aside.  Heat oil in pan on medium heat.  Sprinkle with asafoetida and toast rolled wraps.  To serve, place 1/3 cup filling on roll.  Fold in both sides and serve.

title: Grilled Kiwi and Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup kiwi fruit, pulp reserved | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon dried chives | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 lb thinly sliced roast beef | 4 rolls, split | 2 cups sticky white rice, cooked
instructions: In blender, puree kiwifruit, honey, chives, and seasoned salt.  Remove half of beef.

title: Perfect Turkey Gravy
ingredients: 1 whole turkey ( skin on ) | 1/4 cup buttermilk, or to taste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons black vinegar, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place turkey in a pressure cooker, and cook on high pressure for 5 minutes.  Pour buttermilk into cooker to reach about 1 inch from the top of the turkey, and replace top.  Lock the pressure cooker lid in place.  Reduce heat to low, and cook for 10 minutes, or until pressure has been released.  Remove from heat, and allow cooker to rest for 10 minutes before opening lid.  Allow turkey to cool, but not freeze.  To serve, skim off any thick fat that forms on top, and skim fat from the surface of the gravy.

title: Ginger-Garlic Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream | 3 dried shiitake mushrooms ( rehydrated if not rehydrated ) | 12 tablespoons bread flour | 3 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | dried coriander | white pepper | 1 pinch caraway seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Rinse shitake mushrooms and pat dry.  Dampen hands and stuff with cream and place in a baking pan.  Add water to a depth of 1/4 inch.  Bake for 20 - 25 minute.  Remove from oven and let mushrooms cool for 15 - 20 minute in baking pan.  In a bowl combine water to cream flour, mix well with a fork and beat in a little at a time making a light creamy paste.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Place mushrooms in oven and bake for 10 min or until sauce is thickened and mushrooms are soft.

title: Crunchy Fettuccini Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1/2 cup crunchy fettuccini noodles
instructions: Preheat your grill or frying pan.  Slice the baguette into four thick slices.  Spread the sesame seeds on a plate or small baking sheet.  Grill slices for 1 - 2 minutes, turn and grill for another 2 - 3 minutes until just golden brown.  Place the fries or fettuccini noodles on the sesame seeds in a bowl, and drizzle with a little bit of olive oil.  Serve with more crispy fettuccini noodles over the chips.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,orzo pasta,grand marnier,spanish saffron thread,worcestershire sauce

ingredients: 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon minced spanish saffron threads | 4 cups uncooked orzo pasta | 3 1/2 pounds cooked leg of lamb, trimmed and cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.  In a medium bowl combine the worcestershire sauce, grand marnier, saffron, and 1 teaspoon salt and mix well. instructions: Whisk together flour, tamari, chipotle chiles, star anise, and 3 whole rosemary sprigs in large bowl.

title: Pollo Con Fagioli Con Piselli (Pilaf With Chicken and Walnuts)

instructions: Cook vermicelli noodles in a large saucepan of boiling water for precisely 8 minutes or until just tender.
