title: Anchovy-Spinach Bread
ingredients: 500 g white bread, white and a little crusty | 100 g shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 kiwi fruit, skinned and sliced | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon plain flour
instructions: Cut the white and the crusty bread into cubes.  Preheat the grill to high.  Mix the bread, mushrooms, kiwifruit, anchovy paste and the flour into a ball and press down with your hands.  Cook until the bread is golden brown but still crunchy, about 5 mins on each side.

title: Aioli for Veggies

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f generously spray a 10 inch square pan with nonstick cooking spray.  Separate biscuit mix into 8 pieces, and set aside.  Press one strip of dough flat on pan, or cut into 1 squares.  Carefully unroll remaining dough, brush over crust, and sprinkle with fennel seeds.  Sprinkle remaining fennel seeds on top.  Bake until edges are golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.  Remove from oven, and carefully spread mortadella over loaf.  Run a knife around edge of loaf.

title: Quick Mocha Biscuits (Cookies)
ingredients:
1 lb self raising flour | 1 tablespoon coffee crystals ( mixed with the 1 oz.
    - of the coffee crystals )
instructions: Sift flour into large bowl and rub in the coffee crystals.  Make a well in the center.  Add the liquid with your hands and stir with a fork so that the flour is evenly mixed with the liquid.  The mixture will be thick and sticky.  The friand should be soft but not soft.  Turn onto floured board and knead quickly with hands to work in the flour.  Roll dough out to 3/4 inch thickness.  Cut into strips 1½ to 2 inches wide and cut into desired shapes.  Bake on greased baking sheet at 350 degrees f.  For 25 to 30 minutes until light brown.  Cool and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,ham hock,shallot,elbow macaroni,shrimp
title: Linda's Macaroni and Shrimp With Ham Hocks
ingredients: olive oil cooking spray | 1 package elbow macaroni ( ronzoni ) | 1 - 1 1/4 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined ( a little over 1-1/4 pounds ) | 1 package ham hocks or ( 6 ounce ) package other smoked ham, sliced | 2 teaspoons shallots, chopped
instructions: Set the oven to 350 degrees f.  Coat a 9 x 13 inch baking pan with cooking spray.  Bring a large pot of water to boil.  Add pasta.  Cook for about 7 - 8 minutes, or until pasta is al dente.  Drain pasta in a colander and set aside.  Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and add half the shrimp and ham.  Cook for 1 - 2 minutes on medium high, making sure no pink remains.  Add half of pasta and sausage to pan and mix well.  Add half of shallots.  Mix, cook for 2 - 3 minutes.  Add remaining shrimp and ham and mix.  Cook for another 2 - 3 minutes.  Remove from the heat and serve immediately.

title: Salmon Tacos
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 1/2 pounds salmon fillet, cut into chunks | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup green olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread the refried beans onto the inside of a 9x13 inch baking dish, and spread about 3 tablespoons of the taco seasoning over the beans, reserving one t taco seasoning for another use.  Arrange the salmon pieces on top of the beans, and sprinkle the remaining taco seasoning over the top, reserving the reserved taco seasoning.  Bake in preheated oven until the salmon is easily flaked with a fork, 10 to 15 minutes, and the taco seasoning has begun to turn a golden brown color, about 20 minutes.  Spread the tomatoes, olives, and reserved taco seasoning over the warm salmon, and continue baking on top of the tomatoes and olives until the tomato juices have begun to evaporate, 12 to 15 more minutes.  Serve in warmed taco shells and garnish with minced parsley.

title: Pear Toss
ingredients: 4 pears, peeled, cored and quartered | 4 medium mushrooms, quartered | 1 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1/2 cup daikon radish
instructions: Mix all ingredients.  Cover and refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Caribbean Style Lentil and Mango Samosas
ingredients: 1 cup cooked brown lentils | 1 cup diced mango | 1 cup diced cassava | 1/4 cup white fish or other fish | white pepper | 1/3 cup fish fat or 1/3 cup coconut oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients.  Let set for a few hours.  Serve with coconut bread, fried onions and raita.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 1 cup fresh blackberries ( can sub frozen ) | 2 tablespoons tequila, to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons agar-agar sweetener or 1 1/2 teaspoons other artificial sweetener | fresh basil leaf ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon prepared guacamole
instructions: Combine blackberries in a small bowl and mash with a fork until they are very small and slightly coarsely chopped, about 1 minute in all.  Add tequila and agar agar.  Stir to combine.  Spoon into a 1 cup serving dish.  Top with basil leaves.  Sprinkle with guacamole.  Enjoy. ,.

title: Paprika-Flavored Seasoning Salt
ingredients: 1/4 cup paprika ( i use my `` ceylon '' paprika for this ) | 2 teaspoons oregano leaves, preferably fresh or 2 teaspoons regular oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: In a small bowl, mix all the above ingredients, stirring well.  Using a spice mill, coarsely grind the mixture into a fine powder.  Sprinkle on chicken before serving.

title: Tamarind Tea Mix
ingredients: 450 ml tamarind juice | 1 tablespoon marmalade ( or use your favourite )
instructions: Mash tamarind.  Pour into glass jug.  Add marmalade or use your favourite flavour.  Serve with ice.  Note, i have found that if i heat this up i may cause the drink to freeze before then it will be easier to scoop.  Note also with this drink, the consistency seems quite loose.  If you don's believe me, you will find yourself unable to shake the jug or shake it.  I think that this could easily be made without tamarind and would make a delicious homemade tea of the same.  Some reviewers have suggested adding the marmalade when you squeeze it as the marmalade is really nice.

title: Dill-Pepper Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 cups brussels sprouts, trimmed and cut in half | 2 cups club soda | 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1 small dill pickle, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pimientos | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon chopped fresh dill pickle, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Boil brussels sprouts in boiling water until sprouts begin to curl and are firm but still bright green.  Drain well.  Place sprouts in strainer over a bowl, and rinse with cold water until cool.  When sprouts have cooled, trim ends if needed.  Cut each sprout in half.

Random Ingredients: avocado,bay leaf,plain flour,extra virgin olive oil,dark corn syrup
title: Avocado and Watercress Batter
ingredients: 2 avocados ( ripe, fleshy ) | 1 tablespoon dark corn syrup | sea salt or sea salt | 1 bay leaf | 200 g plain flour
instructions: Pit and peel the avocados, then roughly chop them up.  Put them into a bowl with the corn syrup.  Wash and dry the chilie pepper, then add to the bowl and mash.  Add the bay leaf to the avocado and mash inches leave the avocado mixture to one side until it is required.  Meanwhile combine the flour on a board, add salt, then make a well in the middle.  Pour in the avocado mixture while the flour is working together with your hands.  Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead the dough a few times by hand to make a fairly firm and elastic dough.  Use a little extra water if needed to make it workable.  Cover with clingfilm and set in a warm place for 30 minutes.  Turn the dough out, knead it a few times, then roll out to a thickness of about 10cm.  Using some water, make a cross into the mixture and brush the top of the batter.  Slip it onto a floured board and cut a circle with a sharp knife.  Put the batter on to one side and use the back of a knife to flatten it out to a round, about 10 cm.  Cover with clingfilm and set aside for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, pre heat the grill to high.  If using a fan forced griddle, heat the batter for 2 - ½ minutes, or until golden brown.  If using a pre heated oven, grill the batter for 3 - 4 minutes, flipping it 180 degrees at a 45 degree angle.  Remove the batter from the grill.  The batter will bubble up and collapse as it cools.  Cut into quarters and serve with ice cream or sour cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,cashew,sirloin,green,thyme,extra virgin olive oil,plain flour,savory
title: Grilled Cashews
ingredients: 5 ounces mixed green beans | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1/2 teaspoon thyme ( to taste ) | cayenne pepper ( to taste ) or crushed dried red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup cashews ( not salted ) | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | savory ( optional for garnish ) | sirloin
instructions: Mix ingredients togther and coat nuts.  Heat up griller on high and toast nuts for 10 minutes until golden brown, turning once.  Set nuts aside to cool.  Cut meat into chunks and marinate in mixture for 15 minutes.  Grill meat until rare.  Top meat with a glaze of thyme and savory, if you like.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Combine the squash and the adobo sauce in a small square baking dish.  Divide evenly among the four wedges.  Sprinkle each wedge evenly with cheese.  Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes, or according to package directions, until cheese is melted and bubbly and lightly browned.

title: French Country Style Crisp Ham

instructions: Place half the ham in an oven proof dish with the mustard spread evenly over it.  Sprinkle the remaining ham over the mustard spread.  Cover with foil, and place dish in oven until bacon is browned.  Baste every 15 - 20 minutes.  Take out of the oven, and cover with foil, and set aside until ready to serve.  Serve with remaining mustard spread on top.

Random Ingredients: lemon,lamb shoulder,buttermilk,tahini paste,extra virgin olive oil,yeast,bell pepper,lime juice
title: Lamb and Spicy Red Pepper Skewers
ingredients: 400 g ground lamb shoulder | 1 lemons, juice and zest, in large ziploc bag | 1/2 bunch fresh lemon rind, finely grated | 1/2 kg extra virgin olive oil ( to combine ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons tahini paste ( to taste ) | 1 packet dry yeast | 350 ml buttermilk | 2 large red bell peppers, halved and seeded
instructions: Dump the lamb into a mixing bowl and make sure it is all coated in oil.  Add all of the other ingredients except the peppers to the bowl and mix well.  If too dry, add more buttermilk. title: Courgettes in Walnuts (Tapas)
ingredients: 6 large courgettes or 6 large butternut squash | 60 g walnuts
instructions: First make sure you cut down on each stalk and make sure it does not break.  Cut the courgettes lengthways into thick slices, then halve the squash lengthways.  Next, if using the large courgettes, cut them into bite size bits.  Spread a generous amount of oil into a medium sized frying pan, then put on the heat, then lay the courgettes over the top.  Add 1/4 cup water, cover and cook for 5 minutes, or until they are tender.  Remove from pan, then scatter over the walnuts.  Serve immediately, or let cool slightly before cutting into squares and eating.

title: Orange Baked Ham Hocks

Sprinkle the orange zest, maggi, and baking soda into the pan and stir to combine.  Cover and bake 30 minutes until ham is heated through, basting once or twice during cooking.

instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.  Spread the pizza crust with pimentos, chicken, red chili peppers, and boboli crust dough.  Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is golden brown, 10 to 15 minutes.  Top with remaining 1 jar of jalapenos and re cover with foil for 30 more minutes.

title: Sausage-Bolognaise

instructions: Combine mince, onion soup mix and lettuce leaves to form a roll.  Place in shallow oven tray and bake at 180c for approximately 20 mins.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,lemon zest,pork,fine sea salt,xanthan gum
title: Lemon-Glazed Coiled Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 cups coarse grainy mustard | 1 cup fine sea salt | 1/4 cup coarsely ground xanthan gum | 1 whole lemon, zest of | 2 lbs ground lean pork
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees.  In a large bowl, stir together the ground pork, mustard, salt, xanthan gum, and lemon zest.  Spread pork mixture into a 1 1/2 to 2 quart loaf pan.  Bake, uncovered, in the center of the preheated oven until the internal temperature reaches 160f degrees, about 1 hour.  Let stand for 20 minutes, covered in foil.  Cut into slices and serve.

title: Quick Sweet Corn and Mushroom Toss
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tapioca starch ( you might need a little more if you have tapioca ) | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce | 2 teaspoons sweetcorn ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 dash cayenne pepper sauce ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon button mushroom
instructions: Put corn or frozen sweetcorn into food processor and process until it resembles cornmeal.  Add cayenne and oyster sauce and process again until mixture like cornmeal.  In a small bowl, mix the sweetcorn, mushrooms and cornmeal mix.  Toss with your chosen salad and enjoy.

title: Pigs of a Woods
ingredients: 18 ounces salt pork ( a `` piece '', the size of a pea pod ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground celery | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 2 whole star anise
instructions: Put salt pork in a stockpot and place over a medium heat to bring to a boil.  Cover and boil about 30 - 45 minutes or until meat is easily pierced with a fork.  Drain fat from stockpot and place in an airtight container.  Cool, then discard as much salt that the salt pork is packed into.  Rinse off the salt pork from the pan, removing any fat that runs out. Place the celery and pepper in a mortar, fill with salt, and pound with a pestle until the celery and pepper are ground to a paste.  Place the star anise in a piece of cheesecloth or a coffee filter and pipe in the spice paste until all the salt is encorporated.  Pack the spice mixture into hot sterilized jars and secure with a screw top lid.  Process in a boiling water bath for 10 - 15 minutes or until the lids are sealed.

title: Chocolate Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 6 tablespoons whole wheat flour ( or 3 tablespoons for a firmer dough ) | 1 3/4 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder ( for the firmer tortillas, 1 3/4 teaspoons for a firmer tortillas )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f.  Mix the flour, cocoa, and cocoa powder.  Add the dry ingredients and mix just until combined.  Heat nonstick skillet over medium high heat, then add the dough mixture and swirl it into a thin circle.  Use a very lightly floured spatula to stretch it.  When it is golden, it should rise up the sides in a circle.  Using a fork, turn, and then slide it back onto the same flat skillet.  When ready to flip, slide a spatula into the hot area.  Using a metal spatula, remove the edge you have created to cook the tortillas.  If it becomes difficult to remove from the skillet, let it sit on the skillet bottom for a few moments.  Use the spatula to transfer the tortilla onto a lightly floured surface.  Using a wooden spoon, pull the tortilla toward the center of the pan.  Using your spatula, scrape the perimeter of the tortilla with your spatula into your surrounding circle.  You now have a triangular cookie cutter, with two or three inch segments.  Use a slotted spoon or a spatula to take one cookie round, and put a small amount of cocoa on top of it.  When it is about half of the way to the edge of the tortilla, lift it up and move it quickly as it comes out of the pan.  If the tortilla has settled just add a small amount of oil to the skillet.  The tortilla should be pressed and slightly browned underneath, when it is ready, its time to flip.  Remove to a cutting board, and cut into wedges to serve.

title: Quick & Easy Cheesy Quesadillas

instructions: Heat skillet over medium high heat for about 1 minute.  Spray or brush with cooking oil.  Sprinkle with shredded cheese.  Quickly add catsup, tilting pan to coat.  Quickly turn over to other side, sprinkle with additional cheese.  Cook until browned.  Serve immediately.

title: Mushroom and Pine Nut Burger
ingredients: 200 g portobello mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup light mayonnaise | 4 teaspoons dried thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon dried orange peel | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee ( optional ) | 1 -2 lb fresh shiitake mushroom
instructions: Using a small ladle, scoop out the mushroom stems and roughly chop them.  Soak mushrooms in water for 15 to 20 minutes, then drain, pressing out excess moisture.  Process mushroom stems and dried orange peel into a paste with a bit more of the mayonnaise if necessary, then add the mayonnaise, thyme, xanthan gum and instant coffee if using.  Mix well.  Divide the mushroom mixture into 16 equal portions and shape each into a patty about 1/4 inch thick.  Wipe mushrooms with damp paper towels and set aside.  Place a large, nonstick frying pan over medium heat, add the burger patties and cook for 2 or 3 minutes on each side, until browned on both sides, and cooked through.  Serve hot, topped with a dollop of creamy mayonnaise or chopped onions.  To make the nut brulee place the mushrooms in a small heat proof bowl.  Spray with cooking spray and sprinkle with the thyme and orange peel.  Place under a broiler for about 3 minutes, or until fragrant and lightly browned.  Serve the mushroom mixture at room temperature on a bed of lettuce leaves, topped with a burger patty.

title: Amaretto Pie Crust

title: Tabbouleh(Ramani-Ramadan's Meal)

instructions: Place the whole raw jicama in the microwave for a quick 45 second and 30 seconds so they get soft and mushy.  While that's warming up, mix rice, cardomon, chilli, and chilli mix in a bowl.  Place the mixture in a jar with lid and shake.  When it’s cool enough to handle, slice the chilled jicama into 1/4 inch chunks and put it in the bowl with salt, mix well.  Towards the end, mix in the rice mix and knead. title: Chocalate Delight!
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups self-rising flour ( or 1 cup for a sweeter dough ) | 3 tablespoons miso | 1/2 cup ground coffee ( any sort of sweet strong coffee will do ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons hot peppermint extract | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Pre heat oven to gas mark 3/160°c/340°f.  Grease baking paper, dust the surface with flour.  Put 3 1/2 cups flour, miso and coffee into a food processor and pulse to mix.  Add essence and blend for 15 seconds.  Add more flour if necessary to make a dough that's firm enough to form into balls.  Roll out to about 1 cm thickness.  Make a cut into the top or tail of each ball, then press down the hole with fingertips to remove air bubbles.  Put the balls on a baking tray lined with baking paper, lined with baking paper, to rise in the oven.  When you reach the correct temperature of gas mark 3/160°c/340°f place the tray in the pre heated oven for 20 - 20 minutes until golden.  Take a test, and check each side to see if it's soft or sticky.  The tester should come out a little sticky at this point.  Remove with a spatula, and roll again immediately to cool.  Repeat on all sides.  Allow cookies to completely cool before storing in an airtight container.  Keep in the fridge until you want to get them to taste.

title: Mexican Nogado
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1 teaspoon lime juice | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 cup apricot ( chopped ) | 200 g drained button mushrooms | 1 cup buttermilk ( or milk ) | 1 cup bean sprouts ( fresh or thawed )
instructions: Put the tahini, sour cream, lime juice, and oil in a mixing bowl and beat til creamy.  Set aside.  Put the apricots and mushrooms in a small bowl.

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.  Add potatoes, and cook until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain, and mash with a potato masher. title: Apple and Coconut Baked Mushrooms

Remove the cakes from the oven.  Pour the coconut flakes on top of the cake, then leave the oven on and bake the cake for a few minutes more.  Transfer to a serving dish, leave to stand for 2 minutes, then serve.

instructions: Combine the pork strips with 1/2 cup raspberry liquor.  Marinate for 20 minutes.  Remove pork from the marinade and fry in a wok over high heat. title: Grilled Pork Crescents
ingredients: 15 cups applesauce | 15 cups pork, cut into 3/4-inch cubes ( or more ) | 1 quart lemon and orange-flavored beer, or more to taste | 3 cups coarsely chopped cucumbers ( about 2 pounds ) | 6 tablespoons dried oregano leaves, or to taste | 6 cups pork fat, melted
instructions: Combine applesauce and 1 cup cold water in a large glass or ceramic nonreactive stockpot.  Stir in the pork, lemon juice, beer and cucumber. Brush the melted fat over the tops of the crescents, then grill until crisp, about 2 minutes per side.  Serve warm.

title: Rendering Beef and Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup chicken thigh, boned | 8 ounces croutons | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 1/2 cup beef broth
instructions: Trim and discard excess fat from chicken and cut into cubes.  In a heavy pan, fry chicken over medium heat until dark brown.  Reduce heat to medium and stir in croutons, palm sugar and beef broth.  Simmer for 5 minutes or until thickened.

title: Totally Twisted Twister
ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup kahlua or 1/4 cup other almond flavored liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees f.  Cut each package of puff pastry sheets into 4 equal pieces.  Cut a lengthwise slit in each piece of pastry.  Place each piece on a piece of pastry and roll out to form a rectangle that is about 6x8 inches.  Brush a little liqueur onto the exposed pastry for added flavor.  Place the dough on an ungresed cookie sheet or lightly flour one another.  Brush all edges with remaining liqueur.  Bake in preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until edges are golden brown and filling is bubbly.

title: Elegant Rum Balls

instructions: Combine the 2 cups of red salsa and baking soda in a small bowl.  Set aside.  In a medium bowl, combine the rum and remaining 3/4 cup of salsa.  Stir to dissolve the rum.

title: Biancom -- Minted Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 cup mint leaf, chopped
instructions: Place meat and mint in crockpot.  Cover with water and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.  If meat can be tough, remove bones.  Add a few of the mint leaves to taste before serving.

title: Tsukuneag (Beef and Green Tea) - Vegan
ingredients:
2 lbs chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 lb carrot, cut into matchstick lengths | 3 tablespoons sweet chili oil | 6 cups bok choy, thinly sliced ( or other greens as you like.
    - ) | 1/2 cup whiskey | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Cut carrot into matchstick lengths and soak in water for 30 min and then drain thoroughly.  In a large bowl, stir beef cubes with salt and pepper to taste.  Set aside until needed.  Heat chile oil in a deep nonstick skillet until simmering but not smoking.  Add marinated beef and fry over high heat until browned thoroughly about 4 minutes.  Cover and cook over low heat, stirring frequently, until meat is tender, about 45 min.  Add carrots and cook, stirring occasionally, 5 minute longer.  While beef and carrots are cooking, bring bok choy and whiskey to simmer in a medium saucepan over medium high heat.  Cover and cook for 3 min.  Or until tender.  Transfer beef and carrot mixture to serving bowls.

title: Herbed Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger buns, split, toasted | 1 teaspoon dried herbs | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 celery rib, chopped
instructions: Combine bun ingredients.  Divide into 4 portions.

title: Green Beans Prepared With Yeast
ingredients: 1 cup green beans ( frozen cut into 2-inch pieces ) | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 2 1/2 cups cooked fresh pork or 2 1/2 cups pork fat, cut into thin strips
instructions: Using a 9 or 10 inch skillet or pot, heat a few tablespoons of the pork fat in it over moderate heat until it foams.  Add the beans and let them cook until they are lightly browned, about 4 minutes.  Add the yeast and stir the mixture over high heat for a minute, adding more hot fat as needed.  When the foamy foam subsides, add the green beans and stir until they begin to soften, about another 1 - 2 minutes.  Remove from the heat.  Cover and let the mixture cool a little and then divide it into two 3 - 6 oz portions.  On a floured surface, knead the beans lightly.  Roll out each portion, 1/8 inch thick, into a circle about 12 inches in diameter and 6 inches wide using a cookie cutter or a round or circular cutter.  Transfer to a bowl.  Place another small circle on top of each mound of beans to make 4 circles.  Cover and let rise until doubled in bulk, about 30 minutes.  Heat the remaining fat in the skillet over moderately low heat until it foams.  Working quickly, add the rounds, 1 at a time, cooking them for 3 - 4 minutes, or until they are browned on the bottom, but still somewhat crisp in the middle.  Remove them with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.  Sprinkle with salt and serve warm, warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,green chile,rice krispies,frangelico,star anise,quinoa,vegetable oil,crabmeat
title: Crispy Quinoa Cakes With Crab and Beans
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quinoa | 1/2 cup canned kidney beans | 1 can chopped mild green chiles | 1 star anise | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 16 ounces crabmeat | 1/2 cup heinz chili-flavored brand dark heinz chili with star anise | 12 popsicle-shaped rice krispies ( optional )
instructions: Rinse quinoa and kidney beans well, then drain.  Pat the crab meat dry with paper towels.  If your crabmeat has been canned, chop it finely.  Chop chiles coarsely.  If you canned them, add them just.  If you cut canned crabmeat with a knife tip, it should chop into small chunks as well.  Place the quinoa and kidney beans in a medium saucepan over medium high heat, and add enough water to come up 1 inch in the pan.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until liquid is absorbed, about 15 to 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, place the anise in a small skillet over medium high heat.  Place the shrimp in the skillet, and cook just until pink, about 1 minute per side.  Remove the toasted anise and cut the shrimp into 1 pieces, then set aside.  Place the chili in a blender.  Add enough water to make a smooth puree, about two tablespoons.  Place the puree in a blender with the crab, and blend until smooth.  Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Saute crab meat in a little bit of the green chile sauce until it turns a little translucent, about two minutes, then stir in the puree.  Add rice krispies, if desired, and stir until hot, about two minutes.  Drop the krispies by heaping tablespoons into the soup with the quinoa, then turn the heat to low and simmer until warmed through, 1 to 2 minutes.  Serve in soup bowls, or over rice.

title: Beef Kebabs With Noodle Pies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roasted red peppers ( thai roasted red peppers preferred ) | 1 1/4 lbs top round roast beef or 1 1/4 lbs sirloin, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon minced fresh lemongrass | 1 tablespoon granulated garlic | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios or 1/4 cup almonds | 2 teaspoons egg yolks | 1 1/4 cups plain low-fat greek yogurt | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 12 uncooked egg noodles
instructions: Stir together red pepper, beef, lemon grass, garlic and nuts.  Toss with beef.  Cover and refrigerate 1 - 24 hours.  Brush beef with egg yolks and set aside for 30 minutes. .  Preheat oven to 425°f spray 2 - 15 x 2 inch cookie sheets with nonstick cooking spray.  Place beef mixture on cookie sheets.  Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until beef is cooked to desired doneness.  Sprinkle with greek yogurt and confectioner's sugar.  If desired, place a small dollop of greek yogurt on each piece of beef, garnish with red pepper nuts and serve.  Tip, if you cannot find roasted red pepper flakes, you can use 2 tablespoons of thai roasted red pepper paste.  This adds tons of flavor that can be added later.  Also, for a richer spicy flavor serve with 1/3 pound extra firm tofu, 1/3 pound extra firm tofu, and 1/3 pound fresh roasted garlic.

title: Bodacious Hunky Beef Tenderloin (Ww 4 Points)

instructions: Combine onions, cilantro and seasonings in bowl and refrigerate until ready to use.  Place beef tenderloin on rack of broiler pan and broil 4 - 5 inches of medium.  Turn beef occasionally until cooked to desired doneness, about 10 - 12 minutes for medium rare, 12 - 15 minutes for medium.  Remove from broiler and allow to stand 5 - 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Baked Avocados

Bake in the preheated oven until shrimp are opaque in the center, 15 to 20 minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Combine crabmeat and avocados in a bowl.  Pour 1 cup of vodka into a separate container, and stir into the crabmeat mixture.  Return wine to a boil, and simmer while seafood sauce simmers.  Transfer seafood sauce to plates, and ladle the vodka sauce over to serve.

instructions: Place the beef with the slivers of fat on a large rimmed baking sheet.  Dip the meat in the rose water until the beef is completely coated. instructions: Combine artichokes, oranges, and broth in a slow cooker.  Cover and cook on high setting for 1 hour.  Remove cover and cook for another hour.  Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with fresh thyme.

Drop the dough onto a greased cookie sheet, forming mini balls.  Bake at 375 degrees f for 3 - 4 minutes or until done.

title: Lorne's Kip Met Ris
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, split at the joint, tips removed | 1 lb sauerkraut, rinsed and drained well | 3 tablespoons yellow cornmeal | 10 drops bouquet garni | 2 tablespoons sugar, mixed with | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds, lightly crushed | 6 tablespoons pistachio nuts, roasted and chopped | 2 chopped spring onions or 2 green onions, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees.  Place chicken wings in a large roasting tin.  Add 1/2 cup water to the roasting tin, or enough to completely cover the wings, then add the sauerkraut, 1 tbsp cornmeal, 10 drops of bouquet garni and 2 tbsp sugar.  Add 1 1/2 tsp freshly grounded cardamom seeds, half the pistachios, half the spring onions or green onion, and remaining pistachios.  Place roasting tin over a burner on high heat.  When it smokes, add the remaining 1 1/2 tsp sugar.  The sugar will melt on itself.  Remove chicken from oven, pour sauerkraut mixture over, replace it back in the oven, and bake for 45 minutes.  Leave the kip metris in the oven, check them often so it doesn't burn.  Turn it around a few times during the 45 minutes or so cooking time, so that the kip metris cook evenly.  The last 10 minutes of baking, add the remaining 2 tbsp cornmeal, the remaining pistachios, the remaining spring onions or green onion, and remaining pistachios.  Note that the recipe will not allow me to include any type of seasonings on the kip metris, due to the nature of the spices.  Remove from oven and leave in the oven.  Check from time to time, and add if needed to make sure that its always moist and moist, or is completely dry.  Slice kip metris into rounds, garnish with slivers of pistachios and serve hot.  You can serve with roasted sweet potato chips.

title: Salsa Verde

instructions: Trim the ends off the broccoli, and cut it into florets about 1 inch in size.  Steam the broccoli in boiling water for 5 minutes or until tender.  Drain thoroughly.  In a medium pan over medium high heat, warm the rice wine.  When the liquid boils, add the broccoli and cook, stirring a few times, until the broccoli is tender, about 4 minutes.  Drain the broccoli and broccoli well and serve.

instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Roast whole chilie skin side up on baking sheet.  Bake until very fragrant and just beginning to brown, 10 to 15 minutes. title: Toad-Stuff Pig

instructions: If your sausage has been in the refrigerator for two days, scrape it from the loaf pan.  If the meat is fresh, drain off all the excess water by placing it in the refrigerator.  The water should only be in the short reach of the meat, the reason it is being there is some moisture in the skin. instructions: Mix the couscous, mince meat and salad dressing well.  Sprinkle sherry and french mustard on top.  Sprinkle caraway seeds.  Cool.  Put in the fridge for an hour and a half serve.

Random Ingredients: avocado,sherry wine,italian breadcrumb,dark rum,beef bouillon cube,island dressing,milk
title: Avacodo Burger (French Style Meat Loaf)
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh italian breadcrumb | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 cup milk | 1 cup island dressing | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 2 avocados, sliced | 2 tablespoons shredded fresh italian breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Scoop out large egg roll wrappers from freezer bag and place in large bowl.  Add the bouillon cube, the 4 tablespoons of sherry, and the milk to the large bowl.  Gradually add the sherry.  Combine well.  Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes.  Stir and cover again.  In another bowl, combine the 1 tablespoon of dark rum, the 2 olives, 2 tablespoons of shredded bread crumbs, and 2 more tablespoons of shredded bread crumbs.  Roll the meat mixture into a sausage shape, about 3 ounces each.  Place each loaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Bake loaves for 20 minutes.  Turn over, and bake for an additional 10 minutes.

title: Lamb Chops (South Africa)
ingredients: 1 kg leg of lamb, cut into 1 1/2cm cubes | 3 -4 tablespoons mayonnaise, to taste | 1 cup corn kernel, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Combine mayo and a little seasoning.  Coat lamb pieces thoroughly with the mix.  Saute in a little oil, over a moderate heat, turning often.

title: Broiler-Grilled Sirloin (Beef Sirloin)
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 2 lbs smoked bacon | 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter | 1 dozen habanero pepper
instructions: Trim the meat.  Put meat in a roasting pan with plenty of room for the pepper to pick up.  Poke holes for the smoke by inserting a pick in one of the holes.  Cut the bacon into thick strips.  Heat the margarine or butter in a cast iron skillet.  When the butter is bubbly and foaming, add the pepper strips.  Stir once or twice so that they don't burn.  Add the meat and bacon and turn the heat to medium high.  Put the meat and bacon on a rack above the coals.  Grill or broil about 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.  Turn and grill until meat is done to desired doneness.  Turn and grill until bacon is crisp and the other flavors combined.

title: Black Eyes (Steamed Breakfast With Cherries)
ingredients: 1 ounce olive oil | 12 black tea bags | 6 glace cherries
instructions: Add olive oil through saucer then place the black tea bags in and cover the tea with water.  Leave in fridge.  Once cooled, steam for 20 - 30 mins until the juice runs clear.  Top with cherries.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,vegetable oil cooking spray,lemon juice zest,orange liqueur,curry paste
title: Spice Rub for Roast Beef or Pork
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons lemon juice or 2 teaspoons lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle powder | 1/2 teaspoon hot curry paste | 2 teaspoons orange liqueur
instructions: Place all ingredients except the beef in a bowl and mix well.  Spray the beef and coat evenly over the meat with the spice mixture.  Remove the beef from the bowl using a slotted spoon.  Allow the excess marinade to drip back into the bowl.  Preheat the oven to 500 degress f.  Place the beef in a roasting pan, put into the oven and roast for about 5 to 7 minutes per 500 degress f.  Or until a fork inserted into the thickest part of the meat comes out clean.  Allow to rest for about 5 minutes before carving.  To serve, place in a large platter.

title: Smoked Swiss Steak With Pancetta and Dill Pickles
ingredients: 1 lb sandwich steak | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 12 slices pancetta | 12 slices lean hamburger, cooked | 15 -20 slices dill pickles | 12 slices smoked grapes
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat, add a thin layer of oil.  Place the burger, sliced pork, and thinly sliced pickles on a preheated skillet.  Cook the sandwich in 2 batches, using low heat if necessary, to set them.  Toast the pancetta slices on the bottom rack of a griddle pan.  Lay the pancetta on top of the meat, place the griddle pan under the grill, close the cover, and cook for 3 - 5 minutes, or until the pickle is crisp.  Repeat until all the meat and papery slices are cooked.  Cut the steak into slices about 1 inch wide by 1/2 inch thick.  Slice the sandwich into 4 smaller pieces.  Place a pickle slice on each slice of sandwich and serve.

title: Spicy Avocado-Pear Kuchen With Apple Cream
ingredients: 2 large avocados, peeled and very ripe | 2 large egg yolks | 2 tablespoons chopped apricots ( to taste ) or 2 tablespoons chopped dried cherries ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup chopped citron peel ( or 1/2 cup candied citron-peeled cherries ) | 2 medium apples, peeled, cored and chopped finely | 1 pinch dill or 1 pinch fresh dill
instructions: If using dried cherries, you may need to use 1/2 cup of liquid to measure.  Put apples in a deep, heavy pan with a light coating of oil and the chopped herbs.  Cover and simmer over low heat turning occasionally, for 30 minutes or until the apples are very soft.  You may also wish to add 1/4 cup of sugar to the apples during the final cooking stage.  Pour apples and apples into a colander and press out all the liquid.  Chop them finely and press them through a sieve or food mill into a bowl.  When apples are cool, peel and dice them.  Put apples and apples into a bowl.  Add the sugar, eggs, and the strained apple liquid and mix well.  Add 1 tablespoon of the chopped apricots or other dried fruit.  Mix.  Spoon the mix into a greased 11 x 7 pan and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of dill.  Put in preheated oven of 350&deg.

title: Turkey Salad
ingredients: 1 cup turkey or 1 cup chicken | 1/2 cup lemonade | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon minced chives
instructions: Place turkey or chicken in a serving bowl or saucepan.  Drizzle with lemonade, then sprinkle with almond extract, stirring gently to combine.  Sprinkle with chives and serve.

title: Chayote Tartlets(Fancy British Kebabs)
ingredients: 1 chayotes | 1/2 lb puff pastry ( frozen or fresh, thawed ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Peel and dice chayote crosswise.  In food processor, whirl the chayote, adding ketchup, sesame seeds and cardamom seeds to the chayote, and process well.  Cut pastry into 4 pieces.  Using your hands or a rolling pin, roll the pastry until it has 8 round circles.  On a floured pastry cloth, roll each circle into a log about 10 - ½ x 3 - ½ inches long.  Cut log into 3 equal portions, and roll each piece into a 4 inch square on both sides.  Seal edges under cold water.  Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Trim pastry edges with fingers or a blunt knife.  Working with one slice at a time, lift into a cake pan and coat well with sesame oil.  Repeat with remaining pastry slices and bake for about 25 minutes, until puffed and golden brown.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,pistachio,sesame seed,bacon,rotini pasta,butter bean,seasoning,beef chuck
title: Beef Rolls With Sesame Seed and Pistachios
ingredients: 250 g dried rotini pasta | 250 g butter beans, soaked overnight | 500 g lean ground beef chuck | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 2 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/2 cup pistachios, shelled, coarsely chopped | seasoning | 2 ounces thick cut bacon
instructions: Cook pasta following pack instructions.  Remove beans from water, allow to cool a little and then place in a large bowl and cover with cold water.  Allow to soak in the fridge overnight.  Heat a large frypan and cook bacon until golden.  Remove the bacon and drain, reserving the drippings.  Strain the pasta, keeping 1 cup of water, and return 1 1/2 cups of the cooking water to the pan.  Place pasta, pork, butter beans and sesame seeds in large bowl, pour over the soaked beans and pork juices, and toss until well combined.  Season with seasoning and mix well.  Shape rolls into balls.  Place a tbsp of pistachios on each roll, and roll around the pistachios so they firmly enclose the filling.  Cook rolls, fat side down, in a large covered pan for about 15 minutes, or until golden and cooked through.  Lift rolls carefully onto serving dish to serve, or serve on its own as an appetiser.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,green chili pepper,swiss chard,broth,skirt steak
title: Hot Skirt Steak With Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard ( or 1/2 of a bunch ) | 5 slices canadian bacon, thick slices cut in 1/2 | 2 swiss chard, stems | 14 1/2 ounces chicken stock and broth, can use low sodium | 3 -4 ounces thinly sliced trimmed top round steak
instructions: Heat a large, heavy skillet and sauté the chopped chard stems, 1 piece of bacon, and some of 1 tablespoon of water until just wilted.  Add the chicken and stock and chard stems and sauté for 3 to 5 minutes.  Cover and simmer until the meat is just cooked through.  Remove to warmed serving plate, garnish with remaining bacon pieces, and serve.

title: Napa Shu Rabe & Beans
ingredients: 1 package rice vermicelli ( not instant ) | 1 can kidney beans | 1/2 pound broccoli rabe, trimmed and sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add noodles and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until al dente.

title: Zesty BBQ Fruit Salsa (For Camping)
ingredients: 3/4 lb firm fresh fruit ( try apple, orange & pineapple ) | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Remove the fruit from the peel & discard the pith.  In a food processor or blender, with the cajun seasoning & chili flakes, blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,black cardamom seed,salad oil,edible flower
title: Basque Fried Sausages: Sausages With Fresh Flowers
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sausage, halved vertically | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom seed | 1 bunch fresh edible flower ( see below )
instructions: Remove casings from sausage.  Rinse and pat dry.  Sprinkle sausage with salt and lightly brown in hot oil in a skillet over high heat.  As soon as it starts to brown, add cardamom and stir around until spices become slightly aromatic.  Add the white parts of the edible flowers.  Turn sausage, cook, turning as necessary, until the mixture is evenly browned on all sides.  Do not drain.  Serve immediately.  This chardonnay would taste just fine without them.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,sandwich pepperoni,great northern bean,hot pepper
title: Italian Heroes (Beans)
ingredients: 3 jars great northern beans ( rinsed and drained ) | 3 cans sandwich pepperoni ( sliced ) | 4 hot peppers ( sliced into 1/4 slices ) | 4 yellow onions ( sliced )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a crockpot.  Cook on high for 3 - 4 hours.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,salt pepper,extra virgin olive oil,macaroni
title: Macaroni With Tomatoes and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni ( macaroni ) | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 can tomato sauce ( hunts, hunts, etc ) | 2 -3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | salt and pepper
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package.  Drain pasta and turn into large casserole dish, adding 1/2 cup olive oil and 1/2 tbls extra virgin olive oil.  Toss with remaining olive oil and season to taste with salt and pepper.  Pour tomato sauce over pasta and sprinkle with remaining salt and pepper.  Sprinkle with freshly grated parmesan, and bake at 350f for 30 - 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,cucumber,white mushroom,white sesame seed,grape leaf,avocado,baking potato,flour tortilla
title: Tortilla Filled Mushrooms With Avocado, Grape Leaves, and Yellow Onion
ingredients: 4 tablespoons flour tortillas | 1 large egg, beaten | 1/3 cup diced yellow onion | 1/3 cup white sesame seeds | 4 ounces white mushrooms, sliced 1/8-inch thick | 4 ounces peeled and diced fresh white sirloin steaks, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 large baking potato, peeled, cut crosswise into 6 thin diagonal slices | 1 large ripe avocado, peeled, seeded, and diced | 1/2 cup seedless grapeseed oil or 1/2 cup grape seed oil
instructions: Place flour tortillas between 2 sheets of plastic wrap.  Working with one tortilla at a time, lightly brush both surfaces of tortilla with the egg.  Spread tortilla with onion, sesame seeds, mushrooms, and sesame seeds.  Layer the beef and potato in three layers on top of the vegetables and top with remaining tortilla.  Roll up the tortillas tightly, seal the edges tightly with a moistened fork, and gently press to compact the filling.  Repeat with remaining tortillas, filling, and potato until all ingredients are used.  Heat grape seeds in a dry skillet over medium high heat until lightly colored and slightly fragrant, 1 - 2 minutes.  Brush tops and bottom of rolls with oil and sprinkle lightly with sesame seeds.  Let warm slightly and slice each in half crosswise into 6 - 2 segments.  Serve 2 pieces per person.

Random Ingredients: green onion,avocado,sesame seed,mustard seed,salt pepper,cherry tomato
title: Yummy Avocado Sesame Seed and Sour Cream Salad
ingredients: 8 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced | 1 bunch green onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together tomatoes, avocado, green onion and sesame seeds.  Add salt and pepper, to taste.

title: Ancho-Gruyere Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb gruyere cheese or 1/2 lb emmenthaler cheese, sliced 1/8-inch thick
instructions: Arrange cheese on an ungreased baking sheet and bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes, or until lightly browned and set.  Toast as directed in an ungreased 10 inch skillet.  Serve hot, warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: veal shoulder,sambal oelek,green olive,red cabbage,zucchini,broth,basil leaf
title: Oseng Kebab | Indonesian Beef Stew
ingredients:
1 3/4 lbs veal shoulder or 1 3/4 lbs pork shoulder, sliced very thin | 2 1/4 lbs red cabbage or 2 1/4 lbs swiss cheesecloth ( about 4 ) | 1 zucchini, sliced very thin and quartered, separated into large shreds | 1/2 large red cabbage, cored and cut into chunks ( about 2 � pkg.
    - ) | 2 cups broth ( beef or turkey ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves | 1/2 cup green olives or 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted and chopped ( for garnish ) | 1 teaspoon sambal oelek ( for garnish )
instructions: Cut meat into slices.  You should have approximately 16 squares each of meat, with meat slices.  Cut cheesecloth into four 4 inch lengths, twist to remove any excess moisture, and set in a large bowl.  Tie together zucchini and cabbage around meat by butchereling and tying it with a double thickness of cheesecloth or kitchen twine.  If using sausage, saute zucchini and cabbage for 1 - 2 minutes in the broth, then add to meat mixture, mix well and simmer covered for 30 minutes.  Strain broth into a bowl, add basil, olives, and sambal oelek and season with additional salt and pepper.  Serve with rice and chopped fresh basil for garnish.

title: Simple Vinegar Snack Mix
ingredients:
1 cup seasoned rice vinegar ( not seasoned ) | 0.
    -5 container frozen whipped topping, defrosted
instructions: Place the sour topping in a ziploc bag.  Seal, and shake to mix.  Add to the rice vinegar, and mix completely.  Place in the refrigerator.

title: Steak With Napa Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 6 napa cabbage leaves ( about 3 inches long ) | 4 1/2 ounces sliced round steak steaks | 1 tablespoon milk | 6 tablespoons tomato ketchup
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan or frying pan over medium high heat and add the sliced steak.  Cook until the steak is firm and cooked through and the knife marks appear on both sides.  Turn the meat and allow it to rest in the pan for 5 minutes, then cut across its grain into strips and transfer to a serving dish.  Meanwhile, cut the core off the napa cabbage leaves, removing excess paper.  Cut into 1 inch lengths and put into a bowl.  Tear off the ends of the cabbage and then cut them into thin slices.  Squeeze the cabbage leaves slightly to remove excess water and then cut each leaf into 12 slices, adding one end to each end as you go.  Transfer to a serving dish and coat with sauce.  Heat a small saucepan over medium high heat and add milk and the tomato ketchup, stirring well and cook, stirring frequently, until it has thickened slightly.  Pour the sauce over the beef and vegetables and serve.

title: Easy Baked Cod (Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 cups salsa ( use your favorite! ) | 2 cups fish, cooked, flaked small | fine breadcrumbs
instructions: Spray baking pan lightly with pam and set aside.  Mix the first 4 ingredients in a bowl.  Add cooked cod.  Mix until the fish is covered well by the salsa mixture.  Stir in bread crumbs.  Bake in preheated oven at 400 degrees for about 20 minutes or until fish is cooked.  Serve with mexican rice.

title: Leprechaun Zucchini
ingredients: 4 large zucchini | 1 1/4 cups cold water | 12 -15 whole peppercorns
instructions: Wash the zucchini.  Cut zucchini into 5 - 6 inch pieces, then slice into pieces or shred them with a sharp knife.  Bring the zucchini pieces, water, and peppercorns to a boil.  Cook for 3 minute.  Cover and simmer for 7 minute reduce heat to medium.

title: Seared Lamb on Skewers
ingredients: 1 leg of lamb, cut into 4 equal pieces | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 dried red chilies, seeded and cut into slivers
instructions: Thread lamb onto skewers and place on a plate.  Mix peanut butter with hot water and pour over lamb.  Rub in chillies.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight, turning occasionally.  Preheat grill to high.  Bake 30 minutes, turning with a metal spatula to brown all sides.  Serve hot.

title: Fried Rice With Ham
ingredients: 1 cup cooked ham, chopped fine | 3/4 cup rice, cooked | 3/4 chicken or 3/4 turkey, depending on how much meat you want | 1/4 cup parsnip, cooked & chopped ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon flour | 1 -2 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 -4 teaspoon jalapeno pepper, depending on your taste | 2 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients well.  Coat wok with cooking oil.  Spoon in a small amount of the mixture and spread around it in the wok.  Fry over low heat until browned or crisp.  Keep in mind the rice will absorb the oil.  Serve over jasmine rice with green chillies.

title: Persian Beef Kedgeree
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 navel orange, juiced | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 -2 cup cooked basmati rice ( i use jasmine rice ) | 1/4 - 1/3 cup currants ( to taste ) | spices | 1/4 cup matzo meal
instructions: Squeeze out excess liquid.  In a bowl mix together and add the sirloin and yoghurt.  Add the basmati rice, currants and spices.  Mix all ingredients well.  Divide into two balls and flatten out on a baking tray.  Place the flat patties on the tray and cook in a pre heated oven at 180c oven for 45 minutes to an hour.  To serve cut the round in half and serve with a raita.  We took the rice out and made the kedgeree.  Each time we made the rice it was eaten hot and the yogurt was on the side.

title: Cardamom Glaze for Chicken
ingredients: 2 green cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons dry white wine or 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Place in small saucepan, add water and bring to boil and skim off froth.  Boil rapidly for about 5 minutes and cool down then stir in cardamon and blend well.  Pour into bottle and put in oven at 220 degrees celcius for 1 hour.

title: Real Simple White Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw vegan butter ( or earth balance ) | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose white flour ( or king arthur flour ) | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt or 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Use a pastry blender or two knives to crumble the vegan butter in a fine shreds.  Add flour and salt and blend until mixture resembles coarse bread crumbs.  Add more flour if needed to be able to work out the desired texture of the sauce.  Transfer to an oiled bowl, cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight.  Cook on stovetop or microwave.

title: A Kiwi Warrior
ingredients: 200 g beef steaks | 400 g pork tenderloin | 4 green peas | 2 leeks | 1 large tomatoes | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup cooked green peas
instructions: Trim and devein the pork and pork tenderloin and slice into fine pieces.  Trim and slice into medium sized chunks.  Set aside.  Trim and slice the leeks into slices.  Heat a little oil in a frying pan and stir fry the green peas for a minute or two.  Then add the onion slices and fry for a further 2 - 3 minutes.  Add some of the meat juices as well as the sliced pork and pork meat and fry, stirring occasionally until the meat is cooked to your preference.  Add the peas and check for salt.  Serve with a good bread, salad and a nice glass of stout beer.

title: Banana & Avocado Mini Burritos
ingredients: 3/4 cup canned sliced avocado | 1 large ripe banana, sliced | 1/4 cup shelled blazed pistachios | 1/4 cup shucked oyster sauce | 50 g monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c degrees.  Combine avocado, banana, pistachios and oyster sauce.  Divide into mini burritos which have been sprayed muffin tins or oiled muffin tins.  Top with cheese, pressing together lightly.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until bubbly and heated through.

title: Quick & Easy Franks for Dogs
ingredients: 4 small hot sauce, or less to taste ( tabasco ) | 4 -6 large hard-cooked bell peppers
instructions: Set your oven to 350 degrees f.  In a medium size skillet saute the onions and peppers on low in the hot sauce until all the peppers are softened and brown.  Stir them gently in to the peppers.  Pour the mixture into a shallow medium cookie pan and broil till the top becomes golden brown.  Serve with your favorite hot dogs.

title: Spicy Buttered Beans with Corn
ingredients: 1 can butter beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 4 pinches white pepper | 1/2 - 1 green pepper, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Drain the butter beans and combine with the cornmeal and white pepper.  Spread mixture onto a greased microwaveable container.  Cover with wax paper and microwave on high for 15 minutes.  You may need to add a little water to cook the first time, if it becomes too thick.  To serve, spoon onto a baking sheet heated at 350°f for a minute or two.

Random Ingredients: tequila,cooking oil,sage leaf,onion soup mix,red pepper flake,guacamole,italian plum tomato,baking soda
title: Margarita Pizzas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 2 tablespoons minced sweet onions or 2 tablespoons chopped sweet onion | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, chopped, undrained | 2 cups quick cooking oil, or as needed | 2 tablespoons tequila | 2 tablespoons dry onion soup mix, or to taste | 2/3 cup guacamole | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: To make the margarita filling, in a medium bowl, stir together the garlic, sage, onion, and baking soda.  Mix in tomatoes, and transfer to a bowl.

title: Crock Pot Mexican Corn
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs assorted fresh corn | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 cup lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Cut corn across grain into 4 pieces lengthwise, then crosswise, across again.  Place in a crock pot and add lemon juice and zest,.  Turn on crock pot on high until warm.  Stir to mix and turn corn over once during cooking.  Cook for 1 hour, then turn down to low and cook for another 3 - 4 hours.  The kernels should be tender when poked with a fork.

title: Brown Rice (Soup Optional)
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice or 2 cups rice | 1 can sprite ( optional )
instructions: Add rice to sprite if using.  Add sprite if using.  Simmer for 3 - 5 minutes, until rice is done.

title: Tamarari Tofu
ingredients: 2 packets tamari ( kewpie brand ) | 2 teaspoons vegetable shortening | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: Combine one packet of kewpie tamari and the balance package of shortening together, and mix well.  Add turmeric and mix thoroughly.  Add the rest of the tamari and use as a basting sauce for rice, or add other items to tofu, etc.

title: Linguine Wraps
ingredients:
1 package linguine | 8 tortillas or 8 toothpicks, with peppers | 1 jar marinara sauce | 1 1/2 cups salad greens ( spinach, arugula, etc.
    - )
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on the box until al dente and drain.  Meanwhile, warm tortillas or toothpicks in boiling, salted water.  Cut a slit along one side of each tortilla or tortilla and stuff with cheese.  Spray a large baking dish with cooking spray and set aside.  When pasta is done, remove from heat and spoon over heated tortillas and cheese.  Spoon warm marinara sauce over cheese and add salad greens.

title: Garlicky, Elegant and Tasty Escarole Dinner
ingredients: 4 heads escarole | 1 -2 bell pepper, any color
instructions: Wash escarole and place in large pot.  Cover with cold water and boil 6 - 8 hours until al dente.  Remove from heat and let cool.  Chop or shred.  Serve with crusty bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: chicken,fenugreek seed,alfredo sauce,white pepper,green cardamom pod,baguette,water,salmon fillet
title: Albondigas (Stuffed Fish)
ingredients: 1 whole salmon fillet | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 1/2 cups warm water | 6 ounces alfredo sauce ( homemade is best ) | 1 pinch white pepper | 3 -5 slices baguette ( thick slices ) | extra water or a little extra heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Remove skin from salmon, leaving bones in fish and cutting away bones from thick salmon meat.  Slice flesh into 5 pieces.  Using your fingers lightly remove the white pith from the top of salmon, leaving about 1 inch skin on fillet with some of the white showing for color.  If the fenugreek seeds are left in, discard the white pith.  Combine water, alfredo sauce, white pepper, and cardamon in a small saucepan.  Place over medium heat and bring to a boil.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Season fish fillet with salt and pepper to taste.  Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons of sauce onto each slice of bread.  Place 1/4 of the stuffing under the fish, and wrap the bread around the stuffing.

title: Chicken Dopiaoon
ingredients: 1 kg chicken dopiaoon | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Place the chicken on a baking tray lined with baking paper.  Rub ginger garlic in the chicken.  Cover the tray with foil and bake in the oven at 220c for 25 minutes.  Turn the chicken and bake for further 20 minutes.  Meanwhile mix a good quantity of water with 2tbsp salt in a saucepan.  Add the paste to the water and stir to make a sauce.  Remove the chicken from the oven and place onto a dish.

Random Ingredients: red potato,pineapple juice,baking powder,egg,lemon pepper,lamb shoulder
title: Lamb, Pineapple Potatoes, and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pound lamb shoulder, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 large egg | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice, drained and juice reserved | 1 1/4 teaspoons baking powder | 1 large red potatoes, cut into 1/4-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place lamb in a large baking dish.  Beat egg and lemon pepper together in a bowl.  Pour over lamb, then dot with pineapple and juice.  Sprinkle with baking powder.  Cover dish with foil, and bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes.  Stir red potatoes around the lamb, cover, and continue baking 45 minutes, or until lamb is tender and potatoes are tender.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,green chili,salt pork,spanish onion,coconut,baking potato
title: New Zealand Meat and Potato Bake
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes | 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1 small green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup dried shredded coconut | 5 ounces salt pork, chopped | 1 teaspoon green chili, crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Peel the potato and cut into 1in.  Lengths.  Place in a large saucepan and cover with cold water.  Cook over high heat for 20 minutes.  Drain, dry with a tea towel and leave to cool.  When the potatoes are cooled, slice thickly across the grain into 3 slices each.  Place the potato slices in a large bowl, cover with water, then season to taste with salt.  Add the onion, green pepper, coconut, salt and chiles.  Mix well and stir in the pork and beef, making sure the ingredients are evenly mixed.  Arrange the potato slices on 2 baking trays and bake for 40 minutes.

title: Maple Chocolate Round Roast
ingredients:
1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 tablespoon pure maple syrup ( real if you have it ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon maple extract or 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 whole roast ( you could use another type of roast or use 3 -5 lbs.
    - beef round, roast, or other favorite roast ) | 3 ounces good quality chopped bittersweet chocolate ( optional, for dipping )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f.  Butter a 13 x 9 or 9 x 9 in pan.  Mix together 1st measure of maple syrup, 1/2 tablespoon maple syrup, and 1/2 teaspoon maple extract.  Place roast in pan and brush with maple syrup mixture.  Wrap tightly and place in a roasting pan large enough to hold the roast and allow the roast to come up 1/2 the height of the pan.  Roast for 15 minutes per pound.  When done, place in oven with the pan in which it was cooked and return to oven.  Bake for an additional 20 minutes or until cooked to your liking remove from oven, cut into thick slices, and place on a platter, serve with warmed biscuit or plain sweet and sour cookies.  If any leftover filling you may have left over, this is a great base for this recipe, just roll into little balls and fry on top of a pan of your favorite hot sauce for a few minutes.  Can also be made ahead for up to a few days and rewarmed before you serve them this way.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,chicken breast fillet,italian bread,applesauce,rye bread,sage,garlic juice,shiso leaf see pic
title: Chicken Rei
ingredients: 1 chicken breast fillet | 1 tablespoon fresh sage, chopped | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 tablespoon applesauce | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 3 slices rye bread | 1 slice italian bread | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice | 3 tablespoons shiso leaves, see note

title: Grilled Squash
