instructions: Preheat your grill to its hottest setting.  Wash the squash in a sink of cold water and dry it with a towel.  Slice off the bottom and quarter the squash lengthways.  Slice each quarter into 6, 6 or 8 wedges each.  Heat two frying or chargrill pans and put in the squash.  Cook for 10 - 15 minutes on each side, or until just cooked.  Meanwhile, combine the yoghurt with the onion soup powder in a small bowl.  Stir until well mixed, cover and set aside.  Toast the peanuts in the same pan for 3 - 4 minutes or until lightly coloured.  Drain, allow to cool and stir through the olives to serve.  To assemble, arrange a portion of the squash on a serving dish and top with a spoonful of the dressing.  Scatter over the nuts and drizzle over half the remaining dressing, scatter over the apricots and the remaining dressing.

title: Prawns, Salmon and Cvermicelli With Mustard Vinaigrette
ingredients:
500 -750 g prawns, raw peeled and deveined | 300 g fish ( a mixture of both of those makes a complete meal ) | 300 g vermicelli, broken into 1.
    - 5cm sections | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 125 g dry vermicelli, broken into 1.
    - 5cm sections | 125 g smoked salmon, sliced | 60 g pecan pieces, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat a large frying pan or wok on high heat, add prawns, and cook for 1 minute each side, or until pink.  Transfer to a plate, and set aside.  Add vermicelli, dijon mustard, and vinegar, and stir to combine.  Add prawns and fish, and stir to combine until cooked and fish is opaque.  Serve prawns on a bed of vermicelli with pecan pieces in an extra pile of vermicelli.

title: Habanero Jelly
ingredients: 1 lb dried tamarind paste | 1 habanero pepper, stem and seeds removed
instructions: Place tamarind in a tea towel and rinse well, removing any excess water.  Soak the chile in hot water for 20 - 30 minutes, then squeeze out the excess.  Remove chile and discard the skin and seeds.  Place the chile in a bowl, place enough warm water to cover and gently massage the chile into the skin of the chile.  Allow to marinate for 1 hour.  Pour the chile mixture into a jelly maker and add habanero pepper.  Process until completely combined.

title: Faux Croutons
ingredients: 3 cups croutons | 3/4 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Mix together croutons and yogurt.  Toss into a serving dish and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Cherry Tomatoes Primavera With Lima Beans
ingredients: 1 package frozen lima beans | 1 jar stuffed cherry tomatoes | 1 bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup dry marsala wine | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | paprika, to garnish
instructions: Place lima beans in a large saucepan with ample water to cover.

title: Spices of the Red Mill - Traditional Scottish Recipe for English Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried mixed spice ( or 2 tablespoons of your favourite ) | 1 carton 2 % low-fat milk
instructions: Using a cheese cloth, press the dried spices into the base of a buttered 8 x10 inch ovenproof dish.  The dried spices will keep for up to 2 weeks in the refrigerator but will lose all purpose for 7 months.  Pour the milk over the spiced cheese cloth.  Place in a preheated 180c oven for 15 - 20 minutes.  When ready to serve remove the dish from the oven and prick all over with a fork before serving or leave on the cheese cloth in the dish until required.

Random Ingredients: coffee,glace cherry,coconut,pineapple chunk,wild rice,red wine,lemon peel
title: Festive Christmas Punch
ingredients: 250 g wild rice ( or whatever white rice colour you prefer ) | 2 liters red wine | 150 g instant coffee | 200 ml crushed pineapple chunks | 200 g candied lemon peel, grated | 2 cans pineapple tidbits | 100 g flaked coconut
instructions: Cook the rice in 4 liters of red wine until soft.  You may have to do this in batches.  Drain.  Add the instant coffee and sugar, stir until dissolved.  Turn onto a floured board and allow to stand for 2 - 3 minutes, but do not force into the pot.  Add the following mix, the crushed pineapple, candied lemon peel, drained rice and the pineapple tidbits.  Fold until combined.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,coffee liqueur,spanish onion,kitchen bouquet,lobster tail
title: Hot Lobster
ingredients: 2 lobster tails ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 small spanish onion, chopped | 1/2 ounce coffee flavored liqueur | 1/2 ounce spanish coffee flavored liqueur ( coffee bell ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon kitchen bouquet
instructions: Place all ingredients into a blender or food processor and pulse until smooth.  Transfer to a serving container and chill for at least 30 minutes or for up to 3 hours.

title: Shrimp Macaroni (Crockpot)
ingredients: 1 lb cooked medium shrimp, peeled, deveined and snipped into pieces ( about 2 medium ) | 1 cup uncooked elbow macaroni ( about 16 ounces ) | crushed ice, as needed
instructions: Place macaroni in a 2 1/2 to 3 quart slow cooker.  Sprinkle shrimp over macaroni.  Sprinkle with macaroni.  Stir in the crushed ice.  Cover and cook on low heat setting 6 - 7 hours, or until macaroni is tender.

title: White Bean Broccoli With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup cannellini beans, cut into halves or 1/2 cup regular beans, drained | 1 lb broccoli or 1 lb cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/4 cup snipped fresh parsley or 1/4 cup basil, packed | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 4 -6 metal skewers, soaked in water 30 minutes ( your choice, we like oak )
instructions: Soak beans for 30 minutes, then rinse well under cold running water, and pat dry completely.  Steam or steam the broccoli until crisp tender, about 3 - 6 minutes.  Remove from the heat.  Drain, reserving a few of the stalks on the broccoli.  Blanch the florets in boiling water for about 3 minutes, just to warm them.  Set aside.  Mix beans and broccoli together.  Add whipping cream, basil, baking powder and enough reserved water to measure 1 cup.  Mix well and pour into pan in small amounts, stirring often, to prevent beans from sticking.  Bring mixture to a boil, then simmer until the mixture thickens slightly.  Transfer bean mixture and broccoli to serving bowl, add 1/2 cup hot mixture and stir together.  This can be served immediately, at room temperature or kept warm until serving.  Cooks note, for added flavor, you can add a small amount of chopped parsley or basil to the mixture or serve it as a garnish.

title: Harry's Chicken
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh baked chicken meat | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon bacon fat
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees.  Mix crumbs and 1 tblsp melted bacon fat.  Peal and debone chicken and place in baking dish.  Mix crumb mix and remaining melted bacon fat into the crumb mix until well blended.  Mix bread crumbs with the crumb mixture.  Roll chicken and bake for 20 min.  Turn to brown and repeat.  Enjoy.

title: Quick Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1/2 package egg noodles | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/3 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1 1/3 cups butter or 1 1/3 cups margarine, melted | 6 dashes tabasco sauce
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Drain again.  Transfer noodles to a 13x9 baking pan coated with cooking spray.  In a bowl, mix cornstarch, milk powder and butter.  Stir in tabasco.  Spread over noodles.  Bake in a 350°f oven for 20 minutes or until browned.

title: Sweet Tomato and Horseradish Jelly
ingredients: 8 medium tomatoes ( roughly one kilo or less, with the cores attached ) | 2 tablespoons pickled red horseradish | 1 1/4 cups fresh coriander powder ( also known as coriander and cilantro ) | 2 -4 tablespoons tomato juice | 1 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: Place the tomatoes in a large saucepan of boiling water and simmer for a few minutes.  Then drain and place in a deep heat proof bowl.  Place under the grill for 1 minute until the skins start to peel away.  Use a sharp knife to peel off the skins.  Remove the tomatoes from the boiling water and place in the bowl of a food processor.  Add the horseradish, coriander and tomato juice.  Process until fairly finely chopped.  Add the sugar and process until smooth.  Leave to stand in the fridge for at least 2 hours or over night.  Once it's cold, add the hot jelly and process again until smooth.

Random Ingredients: tea,ghee,mozzarella cheese,broccoli floret,green bean,cherry tomato,paprika,stewing beef
title: Indian Beef With Broccoli and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon ghee or 1 tablespoon butter | 3/4 lb broccoli floret | 6 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 ounce fresh mozzarella cheese or 1 ounce provolone cheese, torn into bite sized pieces | 2 teaspoons paprika | 16 ounces frozen green beans, thawed and drained well | 1/2 cup teabags or 1/2 cup instant tea
instructions: In a large, deep skillet cook half of the beef in the butter over moderate heat, stirring, until just browned.  Turn the beef and add half the brocolli and mushrooms.  Stir fry over moderately low heat for 5 minutes more.  Stir in the remainder of the beef and brocolli and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes longer.  Stir in the tomato, mozzarella, paprika and the green beans and cook until heated through.  To serve.

title: Basic French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 large sweet onions | 3 liters vegetable stock
instructions: Slice onions in half from top to bottom almost like a cake.  Place all the sliced onions into a crock pot.  Add 4 litres of vegetable stock.  Leave to cook on high for 4 - 6 hours.  Ladle into soup bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,chicken meat,white rice,egg white,plain yogurt,dark chicken meat,maple syrup
title: Chicken and Parsnips With Rice (Raita)
ingredients:
2 cups white rice | 2/3 cup maple syrup | 2 packages boneless skinless chicken and meat loins ( about 2-1/4 lb.
    - ) | 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 3 large egg whites | 1 cup parsnips, finely chopped, peeled | 2 cups dark chicken meat, finely broken into bite-size chunks
instructions: In a saucepan, combine rice, maple syrup and chicken.  Bring to boil on high, cover, and reduce heat to medium low.  Simmer, covered, until rice is fluffy and liquid is absorbed, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together yogurt and egg whites.  Add parsnips and cooked chicken to yogurt mixture and stir to blend.  Preheat oven to 350°f line a 9x1 baking pan with parchment paper.  Spread rice mixture evenly over baking pan, building off one third of the rice mixture.  Evenly spread remaining rice mixture over rice.  Top with rest of chicken.

title: Spicy Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 cup finely shredded red cabbage | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Combine the cabbage and lemon juice in a colander.  Let drain for 15 minutes.  Rinse the cabbage in a strainer and shake off excess liquid.  Place in a serving bowl.  Toss with the dressing and serve.

title: Cranberry Oranges and Spanish Olives
ingredients: 4 medium oranges | 4 tablespoons dried cranberries, picked over | 2 tablespoons mixed spanish olives, drained
instructions: Using a sharp knife, peel the oranges.  Cut the peel into 8 thin slices.  Using a paring knife, trim the pith at the ends of the rind and cut into segments.  Place the oranges, oranges, cranberries and olive into a medium nonreactive saucepan.  Fill with enough lightly salted water to come about 2/3 of the way up the sides of the rind.  Bring to a boil, then decrease the heat to low and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until the rind is tender and the orange segments have absorbed the liquid, about 1 1/2 hours.  Remove the pan from the heat, cover and let the oranges sit in the water for 12 to 15 minutes.  Remove the oranges from the water and place them, still covered, in a bowl.  Add the cranberries to the orange segments and toss gently to coat.  Pour the orange segments and cranberries into a serving bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket meat,dark sesame oil,turmeric,chuck steak,beef rib,elbow macaroni
title: Beef and Macaroni
ingredients: 1 cup elbow macaroni | 2 lbs chuck steaks, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 4 lbs beef rib bone | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water until just tender, then drain.  Place meat and bones into a crockpot.  Combine macaroni, meat mixture, sesame oil, turmeric and remaining ingredients except meat.  Pour over meat and bones.  Cover, and cook on low 7 - 9 hours or high 4 - 5 hours.  To cook in crockpot, cover and cook on high for 2 hours.  Remove meat and bones.  Mix well.

title: Rosemary Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces tomato sauce | 1 cup canned tomato sauce with herbs | 12 rosemary sprigs, cut in half
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan and simmer over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,baking soda,coconut cream,chili garlic sauce,chicken breast meat
title: Pesto Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cut into 1-inch slices | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can coconut cream
instructions: Place chicken slices between plastic wrap, using a meat pounder to pound chicken.  In a medium bowl, mix together pesto sauce, chili garlic sauce, and baking soda.  Pour cream into a large resealable plastic storage bag, and place chicken in the bag.  Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to marinate.

Random Ingredients: spice,olive oil,chunky salsa,tubular pasta,worcestershire sauce,hot pepper sauce,cannellini bean
title: Tabbouleh With White Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dry tubular pasta, broken into 2 `` pieces | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | hot pepper sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( i prefer kirkland's mild salsa but i'm a milder taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | spices ( to taste )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Heat olive oil over medium heat in a large nonstick skillet.  Add beans, hot pepper sauce, salsa, and worcestershire sauce.  Cook until hot and bubbly, stirring occasionally.  Add pasta to skillet and toss.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,chicken breast fillet,vegetable oil cooking spray,catsup,cumin powder,onion flake,mesclun
title: Chicken and Artichoke Skewers
ingredients: 5 chicken breast fillets, cut into 3/4 inch squares | 2 cans artichoke hearts | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1/2 cup catsup | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/4 cups mesclun
instructions: Thread chicken squares onto 12 metal skewers.  Place on a rack in a shallow baking pan.  Stir 1/2 can artichoke hearts into cornstarch to make marinade, and pour into pan.  Stir 1/2 cup catsup into marinade, and pour over chicken.  Cover the pan and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours, turning occasionally.  Lightly coat a large indoor grill pan with vegetable oil spray.  Alternate chicken and artichoke skewers with the remaining 1/4 cup catsup and 1/4 cup cornstarch.  Cook and flip over until chicken is cooked through and beginning to brown, about 8 minutes.  Spoon more marinade onto skewers if desired, and cook on grill, turning skewers occasionally, for 2 to 3 minutes more, topping with more marinade to taste just before serving.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,baby carrot,tomato sauce,plain yogurt,lemon juice zest
title: Easy Yummy Carrot Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1 cup baby carrots | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | confectioners'sugar ( for coating )
instructions: Combine the tomato sauce and carrots in a saucepan over low heat and simmer until the carrots are just tender but still firm enough to bite, 20 to 30 minutes.  Using a stick blender or a food processor, puree until smooth.  Add a little water if the soup starts to stick.

title: Easy Asparagus Guacamole
ingredients: 2 teaspoons orange peel, grated | 2 teaspoons guacamole, medium | 200 g fresh asparagus | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Wash asparagus if using asparagus tips.  Drain any tough bottoms or woody parts.  Place asparagus spears in a bowl.  Add orange peel, guacamole, and asparagus pieces.  Toss thoroughly.  Garnish with shredded iceberg lettuce.

title: Beef or Veal With Rice (Veal Only)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs veal | 1/2 cup white rice
instructions: Boil the white rice.  Slice the veal and cube into 1/2 to 1 inch pieces put them in a frypan with some water.  Bring to just the boiling point, then lower the heat, cover with a lid, and simmer slowly over low heat for about 40 - 45 minutes checking to make sure there is a little of a pink at ehat for the rice.  When done add 2 tablespoons of water and stir until the rice is all absorbed.

title: Lemon Myrtle Rice Pudding (Puffu)
ingredients: 11 1/3 cups water | 12 1/3 cups unsalted chicken stock or 12 1/3 cups sodium-free broth | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves | 1/2 cup fresh lemon thyme | 1/2 cup unsalted butter-flavored syrup ( optional ) | 3/4 cup basmati rice or 3/4 cup basmati farfalle rice
instructions: In large saucepan, combine water, stock, mint and thyme and bring to boiling.  Cover and simmer over low heat for 45 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.  Remove from heat.  Stir in butter and syrup and let stand, covered, 5 minutes.  Serve warm.  Make ahead, individual servings can be made up to this point.

title: Easy Almond Jelly
ingredients: 3 cups ground almonds ( or 1 package almond meal ) | 2 tablespoons gelatin | 2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender or food processor or using an immersion blender.  Store unused portion immediately for longer storage.  If you prefer softer jelly, add more almond extract to 1 1/2 cup.  You may need to store in an airtight container for up to two weeks.

title: Tortilla Dipping Sauce or Side
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 1 cup packed brown sugar | 1/4 cup oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried tepid pesto sauce | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon xanthan gum | 2 eggs | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup oil | 1/4 cup chopped celery salt
instructions: Thaw spinach.  Put thawed spinach in a food processor with 2 cups cold water.  Puree.  Transfer to a large bowl.  Whisk together 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup oil, tepid pesto sauce, celery salt, xanthan gum.  Beat in eggs one at a time until well incorporated.  Chill the rest of the mixture until needed.  Drain the thawed spinach well and squeeze out as much excess liquid as you can.  Wash hands.  Dredge each hand in flour.  Heat 1/4 cup oil in a 6 inch heavy skillet over moderately high heat until just smoking but not smoking, swirling skillet to coat surface.  Add half of the spagetti to the hot oil.  Cook, stirring, until underside is light golden brown.  Transfer to paper towels to drain.  Repeat with remaining oil and spinach.  When all of the oil is used, fry remaining spagetti, stirring, for 1 minute longer.  Place cooked spagetti on plates with dipping sauce.  Dip dipping sauce into warm spagetti.  Serve with dipping sauce and dipping sauce.

title: Sauerkraut, Oranges & Oranges
ingredients: 8 ounces sauerkraut, canned | 16 mandarin oranges | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | chopped fresh coriander leaves, to serve
instructions: Drain the canned sauerkraut, reserving the juice.  Cut 4 x 8 inch slices from each orange.  Working with one slice at a time, place one orange slice between two sheets of parchment paper and flatten.  Using a rolling pin, flatten the slices a little.  Roll the paper around the oranges to enclose the pieces of orange.  Repeat until all of the pastry is used.  Cover the rolls with a tea towel and leave them in a cool place for 1/2 hour.  Rinse the sauerkraut well.  Pour the juice from the mandarins into a heavy based saucepan.  Add the orange slices and boil over a low heat until they are soft & almost cooked.  Discard the skins and purée the sauerkraut in a blender with 3 tablespoons of the reserved juice.  Heat up the remaining juice and add the orange purée.  Serve at once, with extra orange sections for decoration.  Enjoy.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 tablespoons tomato juice | 2 whole guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Place the fish sauce and tomato juice in a small saucepan and bring to a boil.  Remove from heat and stir in the guacamole.

title: Lebkuchen (Cheese Bread) (Pumpernickel Bread)
ingredients: 200 g golden raisins | ground cinnamon, to sprinkle
instructions: Cut the breads horizontally in half lengthwise.  Open slightly, then split into 6 - 10 thin slices each.  Sprinkle the cut surfaces with cinnamon and sprinkle generously with toasted, coarse sea salt.  Serve immediately.

title: Arafura Black Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 cup dried black-eyed peas | 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar | 1 2/3 cups mirin ( japanese sweet wine or apple sugar )
instructions: Put the peas in a saucepan and cover with water by 2 inches.  Bring to a boil, cover and cook for 20 minutes.  Drain.  Place the peas in a nonreactive bowl and sprinkle over the turbinado sugar, tossing until the sugar is coated evenly.

title: Homemade Sour Cherry Applesauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups apple cider | 9 ounces dried cherries
instructions: Pierce dried cherries several times with pointed spoons, or prongs.  Pour the cider and cherries into a medium bowl.  Cover the bowl, and refrigerate for 8 hours, stirring every 10 minutes.  Remove cherries from the cider mixture, and place onto a parchment lined baking sheet.  Seal the bowl, then bake 30 minutes at 375 degrees f.  Allow to cool completely before serving.

Random Ingredients: crouton,caraway seed,pimiento,arborio rice,graham cracker crumb,oyster sauce
title: Grammy's Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice, uncooked | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds, crushed | 1 jar pimiento, drained and sliced | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1/2 cup seasoned croutons, or as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place the rice, caraway seeds, and pimentos in a mixing bowl.  Pour oyster sauce over the rice, then stir in bread crumbs until thoroughly moistened.  Chill 30 minutes, then shape the rice mixture into balls about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.  Place a crouton into a shallow bowl.  Roll one rice ball into 1/4 inch pieces.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,tabasco sauce,vegetable stock,corn kernel,apricot jam,beef stew meat
title: Dry Corn Beef and Apricot Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 4 1/2 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 6 ripe apricot jam | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce or 2 teaspoons other hot sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy large stew pot over high heat.  Working in batches, brown meat in oil and transfer to a bowl.  Add stock and apricot jam to the pot.  Return the stew to the pan.  Bring the stew to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium, cover and simmer slowly for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.  Discard apricot jam.  Remove the beef from the pot and set aside to cool slightly.  Thinly slice the beef and return to the pot with the sauce.  Heat gently, stirring, until hot.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,creme de cacao,cream soup,chicken stock
title: Quick and Easy Thai Red Curry Soup
ingredients: 2 cans cream of potato soup | 3 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons creme de cacao
instructions: Pour cream of potato soup into a pot, and stir in chicken stock.  Add curry paste and creme de cacao.

title: Banana and Lemon Jelly Omelette
ingredients: 1 small banana, peeled and sliced | cooking spray | 2 teaspoons red currant jelly | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: Pour the water into a non stick frying pan and turn the heat to high.  Spray the pan with cooking spray.  Add the bananas, then cover and cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until the banana is cooked.  Turn the heat to low, then stir in the jelly and lemon extract.  Stir well and leave to stand for 5 minutes.  Serve warm.  Serves.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,italian plum tomato,cashew nut,pork tenderloin,flat leaf italian parsley,garlic
title: Kielbasa and Cashew Nut Baked in a Cashew Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chopped garlic | 1 package cashew nuts | 1 pound kielbasa, trimmed of fat | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 bunch flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian plum tomatoes for garnish | 8 cashew nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Heat a skillet over medium high heat.  Mix cashew nuts and garlic, and cook until golden brown and fragrant, about 3 minutes.  Pour cashew mixture into a bowl, and mash to a paste with a potato masher.  Stir in cashew paste, canned tomatoes, parsley, and italian parsley.  Cook the kielbasa in the remaining cashew sauce in the hot skillet until browned and fragrant, about 8 minutes.  Sprinkle top with chopped tomatoes, and bake to serve.

title: Mama Zuquinis Asiago Cheese
ingredients: 3/4 lb grated aged asiago cheese, about 4 ounces | 1 small yellow onion, very finely chopped
instructions: Remove the white pith from the grated asiago cheese.  Break it into small pieces with a hammer or cleaver.

Random Ingredients: navy bean,tandoori paste,spinach,savoy cabbage,banana,taco seasoning mix,asafoetida powder
title: Cabbage and Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can navy beans, drained | 2 inches piece asafoetida powder, crushed | 2 tablespoons tandoori paste | 1 tablespoon savoy cabbage, finely sliced | 1 banana, sliced super thin | 1 package taco seasoning mix | fresh spinach
instructions: Combine navy beans, tamarind puree, tandoori paste, and savoy cabbage.  Toss with garban slices and avocado slices in a serving bowl.  Add 1/2 cup water, cover, and chill for 10 minutes.  Remove excess fat.  Add taco seasoning and mix very briefly.  Pour over salad and toss again briefly.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: seasoning,polish sausage,kirby cucumber,apricot jam,palm sugar,beetroot,cashew half
title: Polish Sausages With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 500 g kirby cucumbers, thinly sliced | 250 g sweet italian sausage | 1 tablespoon paprika & ground mustard, sweet | seasoning | 4 -6 pieces kirby smoked polish sausage | 125 g reduced-fat roasted cashew halves | 500 g apricot jam, warmed for brushing the biscuits | 120 g palm sugar or 120 g brown sugar
instructions: Brush the biscuits with the warmed jam and grill until golden brown.  Combine the paprika & ground mustard.  Brush two large baking trays with the glaze and then cook the sausages for 5 - 8 minutes depending on your preference.  Remove the sausages from the pan and slice into 1cm slices lengthways using a pair of scissors.  Return all the sausages and the cashew halves to the pan.  Add the jam to the pan and heat gently, stirring occasionally until melted.  Spoon the warm sauce over the sausages and sprinkle with the sugar.  Serve the sausages and cashew halves in small ramekins or other serving bowls with the remaining sauce poured over.

title: Caffe Pouch
ingredients: 3/4 cup canned espresso or 3/4 cup instant coffee | 3/4 cup freshly brewed espresso or 3/4 cup instant coffee | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 2/3 cup chopped or shredded almonds, toasted or 2/3 cup chopped hazelnuts, toasted or 2/3 cup chopped nuts, toasted | 1 cup coarsely shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 1/2 cups chopped cantaloupe ( fresh or frozen ) | ice, as required
instructions: In a blender or food processor, purée the espresso or instant coffee with asafetida.  Blend the ground coffee until it is well blended.  Then mix in the espresso coffee mixture.  Add the almonds or hazelnuts.  Transfer to a decorative glass bowl or serve immediately.  Refrigerate leftover espresso to cool.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,white pepper,caper,salmon fillet,cooking oil,mustard seed,white vinegar
title: Scalloped Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet | 3 tablespoons pickled capers, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 3 teaspoons white cheddar cheese, grated | 3 teaspoons cooking oil | 3 teaspoons white vinegar
instructions: Cut 1 1/2 inch thick slices from side of the salmon, and place salmon in a baking dish.  Melt 1 t oil and mustard seeds in a small saucepan over medium heat, and cook for 2 minutes, stirring until seeds turn golden brown.  Add pepper, cheese, vinegar and capers, stir to combine.  Spoon over salmon, cover and bake in a 375°f oven for 40 - 45 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: carob powder,tomato green chilies,sugar snap pea,topping
title: Topping for Mexican Veggies!
ingredients: 1 package frozen sugar snap peas | 6 ounces canned diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 teaspoon carob powder | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Put thawed frozen sugar snap peas and diced tomatoes in food processor.  Pulse until well mixed.  Pour into serving dish, and top with whip.  Chill before serving.

title: Radish and Raisin Salad
ingredients: 2 cups radishes, about 14-18 medium | 2 -3 tablespoons seedless raisins ( plumped plumped in warm, not quick-cooking ) | 1 -4 tablespoon palm sugar ( depending on sweetness desired ) or 1 -4 tablespoon dark brown sugar ( depending on sweetness desired ) ( optional )
instructions: Using a mandoline or sharp knife, peel the radishes, slicing off the ends about 1/2 wide at each end.  Then, using a large, sharp knife, cut out the root part of the radish from top center toward center, cutting away any tough bits of bitter or bitter peel.  Cut the peel into very thin slices, stopping all the white inner white membrane attached.  Place the radish slices in a large mixing bowl, toss and sprinkle with the raisins and sugar.

title: Spicy Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dehydrated yeast | 1/4 cup red curry paste | 2 tablespoons instant coffee powder or 2 tablespoons instant powdered dry milk | 1/2 - 3/4 cup crushed blanched almonds | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 1 medium head cabbage, sliced and separated into leaves

instructions: Heat the oven to 350°f.  Soak the bread in a small bowl with water and yeast.  Leave until foamy, about 10 minutes.  Scald the oil and pour over the bread.  Sprinkle rosemary over the top.  Dip the prosciutto slices into the flour and squeeze out any excess.  Place on a baking sheet, top with prosciutto and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Cheesy Drumsticks
ingredients: 12 chicken drumsticks | 8 slices reduced-fat mexican cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Lightly spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with non stick cooking spray.  Line a large rimmed baking sheet with plastic wrap.  Place drumsticks on baking sheet, skin side down.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake in center of oven 20 minutes or until meat is no longer pink.  Serve.

title: Crock Pot Caribbean Stir Fry Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs chicken breasts | 3 tablespoons mustard ( or to your tastes ) or 3 tablespoons your favorite dry mustard | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: Put chicken in crock pot.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.  Cook on low, no liquid, for an hour or more.  Shake pot occasionally to mix and remove any pieces that haven't turned back over.  Note if using chicken in frying, mix well.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,garbanzo bean,self raising flour,sage,plain yogurt,sirloin
title: Lentil Mini Buns
ingredients: 2 ounces dried garbanzo beans ( soaked overnight or 4-8 hours ) | 1 ounce dried brown lentils | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, trimmed of all fat, cut into 1/2 slices | sage, to serve | 1 cup plain yogurt | 4 ounces self-raising flour
instructions: Place the beans in a large pan with cold water to cover.  Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 30 - 40 mins until tender.  Drain.  Combine with the lentils in separate pan.  Cover with water and bring to the boil.  Reduce the heat and simmer for around 30 mins until tender.  Drain well.  Preheat the oven to 200oc/180oc, then mark 4 - 6 squares with the tines of a fork, then place a slice of beef on each biscuit.  Cover and place on a tray lined with baking paper.  Season with salt then spread the yogurt over the beef.  Re cover the top of the biscuit and place on the oven shelf.  Bake for 15 mins until the beef is golden and cooked.  Serve with fresh cilantro.  For breadcrumbs, preheat oven to 200oc/180oc.  Sift together the flour and 1 tspn mixed dried mint, then put into a bowl.  Add the yoghurt and rub through a sieve.  Season with salt and pepper.  Spread the breadcrumbs on a baking tray lined with baking paper, then put the breadcrumbs on a baking tray lined with baking paper.  Bake for 10 mins or until the breadcrumbs are golden and crisp.  Serve on top of the buns.

title: Sukiyaki Sauce - Japanese Mushroom Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: 1 package fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 quart distilled white vinegar
instructions: Clean and thinly slice mushrooms.  Place mushrooms in a small bowl.  Combine white vinegar and minced garlic to cover mushrooms.  Allow mixture to sit for 20 minutes while mushrooms are soaking in vinegar.  Drain liquid from mushrooms.  Cover mushrooms with oil and let marinate in refrigerator 15 minutes.  Pour mixture onto bread and place under broiler just to brown.

title: Chickpea Burgers
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained ( garbanzo beans ) | 1/2 cup basmati rice | 500 g ground meat or 500 g ground turkey | ground paprika | 1 -2 teaspoon dried mint ( optional )
instructions: Pour boiling water over garbanzos in a bowl, to keep soaked while making the burgers so they are 'al dente'.  Drain and place the chickpeas in a microwave safe bowl, sprinkle with the rice and microwave on high 5 minutes.  Spray fry pan with oil and fry the meat or turkey for about 5 minutes, drain off excess grease mix in the paprika and mint and let cook until everything is heated through.

Random Ingredients: urad dal,black olive,brown mustard seed,stewing beef,cooking oil
title: Mulligatawny (Stewed Beef, Black Olives & Dried Almonds)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 3 lbs stewing beef, cut into 2-inch squares | 2 cups moor dal, washed ( soaked for several hours in sufficient warm water before using ) | 1 cup sliced black olives ( pitted if you prefer )
instructions: Soak the moor dal or chickpeas overnight in enough warm water to cover.  Strain and grind the meat in a blender or food processor.  In a hot pan lightly oil the mustard seeds and fry briefly over moderate heat, stirring constantly to prevent burning.  Add the beef and fry gently over high heat until coated with the oil, turning gently to brown evenly.  Place the moor dal in a stew pot and add the olives in small batches.  Pour over the browned beef and pour the water into the pan.  Bring to the boil and simmer, partially covered for 1 1/2 hours or until the meat is very tender.  Serve with polenta or puri.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,cherry brandy,lager beer,baking potato,lamb,spaghetti,red enchilada sauce
title: Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 2 lbs baking potatoes | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 bottle lager beer | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup cherry brandy, i use raspberry-flavored
instructions: Boil lamb and potatoes for approximately 30 minutes, drain, and set aside.  Mix together remaining ingredients and place back in pot.  Cook a further 10 - 15 minutes, or until the lamb is fully cooked.

title: Blueberry and Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 pint fresh blueberries | 1 poblano chile
instructions: Place the berries in a large bowl.  Sprinkle the chile pepper with it.  Dip the berries in the chili powder and allow to sit for 15 minutes to marinate, before enjoying.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,ricotta cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,butter,mustard,peach,lime zest
title: Lime Pie
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked basmati rice | 1 lb ricotta cheese | 1 lime, zest of | 1 cup chopped peach | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 lb unsalted butter, melted
instructions: Cook rice with 1 1/2 cups water.  Simmer for 20 mins or until tender, drain.  Beat ricotta cheese until creamy.  Whip in lime peel, peach& mustard until smooth.  Gradually add rice and cheddar.

title: Broccolli (Chilean Cheese Soup)
ingredients: 2 bunches broccolli, cleaned and dried | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Soak the dried Broccolli to release more vitamins, if desired.  Drain the brine using a cheese cloth.  Place the drained cheese into the bowl with cold water and soak until the white float to the top.  Drain the water off.  Place a bowl in front of you and fill it with cold tap water.

title: Onion and Bacon Rice Casserole (Rice Casserole)
ingredients: 4 cups rice, uncooked | 8 ounces brie cheese ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, chopped or 1 tablespoon dried cilantro, crushed | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions.  When rice is done, remove from skillet and set aside.  Brown bacon in a skillet until crispy.  In a separate skillet, saute onions until tender.  Remove bacon to casserole dish.  In same skillet, heat leftover bacon grease.  Saute rice until warm.  Pour cheese over rice, spreading evenly.  Sprinkle cilantro or cilantro over cheese.  Do not stir.  Bake in 350° oven for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bread white,fennel seed,club soda,cocoa powder,canola oil
title: Chocolate Balls
ingredients: 1 can club soda ( not alcoholic ) | 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder | bread ( white or rye ) toasted and crusty french bread ( cut into bite size pieces, your choice ) or rye bread ( white or rye )
instructions: Dissolve the soda in 1/4 cup of the club soda.  Set aside to cool.  In a small frying pan, heat the oil over medium heat.  When hot, add the fennel seeds and allow them to sizzle until aromatic and to give off their aroma.  Immediately place in a small bowl and set aside.  Combine the cocoa powder with 1/2 cup of the club soda and set aside.  Cut the rye bread into bite sized pieces and place in a glass bowl with the club soda mixture.  Use your hands to mix all the ingredients thoroughly, then coat the soaked bread with the cocoa powder mixture, shaking off the excess.  Sprinkle the bread with the toast/crumb mixture.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Serve cold.

title: Okra and Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1/2 pound lean beef sirloin, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 cups frozen okra
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Heat a large cast iron skillet or wok over medium high heat.  Stir beef into the hot skillet and cook until well browned on the outside, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chinese Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 10 lbs pork spareribs ( country style ) | 2 cans mixed vegetables
instructions: In a large stockpot mix spareribs and mixed vegetables with just enough water to cover the ribs.  Simmer over low heat 2 to 3 hours.  Skim foam off the surface and simmer for another hour or more.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,virgin olive oil,red pepper paste,catsup,ham hock
title: Smokey Chipotle Ham Hocks
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red pepper paste, ground in a spice grinder ( found in latina specialty food section of a supermarket ) | 2 chipotle chiles ( canned chipotle chiles will also work ) | 4 -6 lbs ham hocks ( can sub ham hocks of your choice ) | 3 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat an oven to 500 degrees f.  Line a 13 x9 baking dish with foil and spray the entire dish with cooking spray.  Combine the red pepper paste and chilies.  Coat the ham hocks with the red pepper paste mixture and place them in baking dish.  Drizzle with catsup and olive oil.  Bake for 3 - 4 hours, basting with pan juices every 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: burrito flour tortilla,wild rice,pear,dandelion green,vanilla bean,pumpkin
title: Wild Rice Burritos
ingredients: 20 -24 burrito-size flour tortillas | 5 large pears, cored and sliced thin, about 3 cups ( i use hass avga organic ) | 3 cups mixed wild rice, soaked overnite | 1 large ripe pumpkin, peeled, peeled, seeded and sliced thin ( i use a frozen cut pepitas ) | 1 large vanilla bean, sliced thin | 1 cup dandelion greens, chopped to taste ( optional ) or 1 cup green onion, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package directions.  Combine the pears and pumpkin in a large bowl.  Heat a nonstick nonstick cooking pan over medium high heat and put about 1/2 tsp oil in the pan.  Toss in the bananas and stir to coat them in the oil.  Add the wild rice, stir and cook for another minute.  Remove from heat and stir in the dandelion greens.  Serve hot or cold.  You can sprinkle the pears and pumpkin with more dandelion and/or green onions to taste, if desired.  Note, i serve these with homemade bread and veggies, as suggested by the author.

title: Almond Quesadilla
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole milk chocolate, melted | 1/3 cup light mayonnaise | 1/4 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons artificial sweetener | 1 pinch ground nutmeg | 3/4 cup sliced almonds, or more to taste | 1 pinch dill weed, or more to taste | 1/4 cup chopped almonds, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1/4 cup toasted sliced almonds, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1 tortilla, quesadilla or other flattened flat-outhed tortilla
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the sliced almonds in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Cheese & Chili Con Queso
ingredients: 250 g cheddar cheese, shreaded and shredded | 1 small red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons coriander or 2 tablespoons cilantro, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon rosemary, chopped
instructions: In a bowl mix all the ingredients together except the cheese.  Divide into 5 equal portions and mould into a flat circle.  Bake on a lightly greased baking tray on a moderate oven shelf for about 15 minutes or until well browned, then serve warm in slices with crusty bread.

title: Sauerkraut Pudding (Prassorizo Kål)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sauerkraut | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 tablespoon cardamom seeds | 1/2 - 3/4 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Rinse sauerkraut under cold water.  Discard any bad ones.  Place in a large bowl.  Add the sauerkraut, cardamom seeds, salt and raisins.  Mix well until completely mixed.  Chill at least 2 hours.  Serve in chilled puddings.  Note, the sauerkraut may be frozen for up to 2 months.  If not, allow at least a few minutes to thaw before serving.

Random Ingredients: ha avocado,artichoke heart,tortilla chip,green leaf lettuce,ghee
title: Artichoke Guacamole
ingredients: 1 can hearts of artichoke hearts, drained | 1 1/4 cups coarsely crushed tortilla chips | 1/3 cup crumbled ghee ( optional ) | 1 cup shredded green leaf lettuce | 3 slices hass avocados ( cut into wedges )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Combine artichokes and tortilla chips in a bowl and toss until evenly coated.  Transfer to a baking sheet and toss with ghee and then sprinkle with desired amount of lettuce and avocado.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Spicy Sprouted Pumpkin Seeds With Creamy Herbs
ingredients: 2 bunches cauliflower ( or a mix of the mixed ) or 2 bunches sorrel, cleaned and cut into 3 cm lengths ( or a mix of the mixed ) | 1 chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon pumpkin puree ( not vanilla ) | 125 ml cream of tartar
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil and gently drop the sprouts into the boiling water.  Boil 5 - 6 minutes, depending on the sprouts, until just tender and just firm to the bite.  Drain, then put onto a board lined with baking paper.  Keep warm in the over.  While the sprouts are boiling, heat up your pumpkin puree and chilli flakes in a small frying pan.  Stir until softened, about 2 - 3 minutes.  Add the cream of tarragon, stir.  Add the sprouts to the soup.  Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup pecans | 1 cup nigella seeds | 1 cup pickling salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Place pecanans on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 15 minutes, or until fragrant.  While pecans are baking, place nigella seeds into a large bowl and sprinkle with the pickling salt.  Let stand for 10 minutes, covered.  Drain pecan nuts and transfer to a mortar and pestle or spice grinder and grind finely.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Onion and Choy
ingredients: 1 cup yellow onion, slivered | 3 tablespoons bok choy, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon dried onion powder
instructions: Boil 1 1/2 cups water.  Add onion, bok choy, sage and onion powder.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes.  Serve over rice with your favourite vegetable.

title: The Perfect Simplest and Best Banana Curry Ever
ingredients: 4 pieces firm ripe bananas | 1/4 - 1/2 cup thai style ginger paste | 1/2 - 1 cup thai style fresh tomatoes seasoned with basil oregano and garlic
instructions: Heat a dutch oven over medium heat.  Toss banana pieces with 1/4 1/2 of the ginger paste and add to the hot dutch oven.  Stir occasionally for 5 minutes or until lightly browned and caramelized around the edges.  Reduce heat to low and toss in remaining ginger paste and saute for another minute or two.  Pour 1/4 cup of water over the top and cover.  Simmer for 20 minutes.  Stir occasionally as the bananas cook.  After 20 - 25 minutes, the liquid should be mostly reduced.  Taste for salt and add more if you desire.  Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt and additional basil oregano if desired.  Let the curry rest for 6 - 8 minutes or longer.  Serve over plain rice.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,asiago cheese,parsley,ginger paste,baking cocoa,orange juice,lamb,red chili pepper
title: Cha Cha (Baked Meat With Orange Chile Sauce)
ingredients: 2 lamb, cut up small | 200 g asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons baking cocoa | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice ( concentrate ) | 1/4 cup orange juice ( frozen ) | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped, reserve stems for garnish
instructions: Mix the shredded asiago and red chili.  Mix the grated asiago with the cocoa, chili and orange juice.  Cut up the lamb, mix the rest of the ingredients and pour into a lightly buttered baking dish.  Sprinkle the grated asiago over all.  Bake in a preheated oven at 180c for about 30 - 40 minutes, or until meat is cooked.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,half cream,arborio rice,egg white,pea,corn tortilla chip,cream cheese
title: Rice, Egg, and Cream Cheese Roulade Pizza
ingredients: 1 pre-baked pizza crust | 14 ounces refrigerated sour cream ( neufchatel ) | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream | 3 egg whites | 12 ounces of canned peas, drained | 1 egg white | 1/2 cup arborio rice or 1/2 cup carnarola rice | 3 ounces cream cheese, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  In a bowl, stir together sour cream, half and half and egg whites.  Spoon mixture onto the pizza crust, spreading evenly.  Top with peas, rice, and cream cheese.  Bake until rice topping is dark browned and bubbly, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,lasagna noodle,caster sugar,bread crumb,self rising flour,italian seasoning
title: Jamie's Italian Style Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 3 tablespoons finely chopped garlic and mixed dried herbs | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a large mixing bowl combine self rising flour, bread crumbs, garlic, italian seasoning, and sugar and mix well until the mixture forms a dough.  Lightly flour a work surface and roll the dough out into two 12 x 20 cm rectangle.  Place a portion of the filling down the centre of the rectangle and roll up into an 18 cm long log.  Place on a non stick baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until browned on the outside and the meat has turned golden brown.  About 30 minutes.

title: Sausage and Pumpkin Gravy
ingredients:
1 package puff pastry sheets, thawed according to package directions | 1 package vegetarian sausage, diced ( e.
    -g.
    - jimmy dean or jimmy dean brands ) | 1 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Unroll thawed pastry sheet onto a baking sheet.  Set aside.  Place sausage in a fry pan over medium low heat, and cook, stirring frequently, until cooked through, about 20 minutes.  Remove from heat, and mix in flour and 1/4 cup of the whipped topping.  Spread mixture evenly over top of pastry sheet, and sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 cup whipped topping.  Bake in preheated oven until the top is golden brown, 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Mangoes With Chocolate Wafer
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chocolate wafers | 1 ripe mango, peeled, pitted & sliced | 1 1/2 ounces vodka
instructions: Spread one side of each piece of chocolate wafer with a thin layer of mango.  Repeat layers until all wafer is used up.  Sprinkle with vodka.  Serve.

title: BBQ Beef Dip
ingredients: 3 cups good barbecue sauce, your favourite type | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 1/2 lbs boneless top round cheese ( i like velveeta-monterey jack ) or 1 1/2 lbs mozzarella cheese ( i like velveeta-monterey jack ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 2 -3 tablespoons dried old english pub-style mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  To assemble, place cheese on plate, place dip on cheese and top with your favourite toppings.  Garnish with herbs.

title: Broccoli Mushroom and Broccoli Filling
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen broccoli florets | 3/4 lb fresh button mushroom | filling
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions except to cook in microwave for 5 minutes.  Reserve 1 cup of the broccoli water in a measuring cup.  Meanwhile, slice mushrooms.  When cooled, drain excess water and rinse mushrooms with cool water.  Cut mushrooms into bite size pieces.  Combine the mushrooms, broccoli and 1 package of filling and mix lightly.  Place in refrigerator for 2 hours or longer to allow flavors to blend.  When ready to serve, place remaining mix on serving plate and top with chopped tomato, green veggies, or sliced fresh mushrooms.

title: Hibiscus Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 cups cooked kerry-infused jerry-infused jerry-infused jerry-infused jerry in juice | 1/2 large sweet potato, diced | 1/2 cup dried pineapple chunks in juice | 1/3 cup tzatziki ( plain greek salad dressing ) | 1 teaspoon triple sec | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon old bay ( optional )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a large bowl, mix well.  Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour before serving.  This recipe yields about 2 cups of cooked potatoes.  The longer the beans stay in the water the stronger the flavors will be.  You can save time by doubling the amounts of the fruit and kerry and boiling them together for an hour.

title: Pumpkin-Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 10 ounces butternut pumpkin, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 14 ounces plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix
instructions: Put the pumpkin cubes in a blender or food processor and add the yogurt and taco seasoning.  Blend until thick and creamy, then serve warm or cold.  Garnish with a swirl of chopped cilantro or taco seeds if desired.

title: Pork Calabrese -- Pork Tenderloin and Gruyère Wrapped in Parchment
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 10 g coarsely ground cumin powder | 25 g gruyere cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c.  Heat one tablespoon of oil in a frying pan.  Pat pork dry and coat in it with the cumin powder.  Spread a large piece of heavy duty foil with one third of the grated gruyère on one side of the pork.  Wrap the side with the foil and transfer to a baking tray.  Cook covered in preheated oven for about 90 minutes.  After 20 mins remove the foil and cheese and return the pork to the the oven for a further 20 mins or until cooked.  When the pork has internal temperate of 175c and is cooked through, remove from tray to a platter and cover.  In the same frying pan, add another tablespoon of oil.  Add the pork and sauté on both sides until crispy and brown.  Remove from pan and slice thinly and serve hot with aubergine and rice dishes.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,wild rice,anise seed,white potato,golden raisin,chicken leg,tomato sauce
title: Indian Chicken Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken legs | 1 can plain stewed tomatoes with their liquid | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/4 cup chopped green anaheim wild rice | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon golden raisin | 1 large white potato, peeled and diced
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry.  In a dutch oven combine chicken legs with tomatoes, aniseed, rice, sugar, raisins and asafoetida.  Bring to a low boil, turn down heat.  Cover and simmer 1 hour, or until the mixture is thickened.  Add diced potato.

title: Chinese Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 dried red chilies | 1 teaspoon hot red chili powder, or to taste
instructions: Combine cornstarch and hot red chili powder in a small bowl.  Heat oil in a wok or saute pan over high heat.  Stir the cornstarch mixture into the oil.  Add the chilies.

title: Spicy Tomato Butter
ingredients:
1 jar tomato sauce ( one 10 oz.
    - can of tomato sauce ) | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon butter
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill or freeze.  Use in a paitlin tartlets.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,onion powder,thyme leave,chicken stock powder,puff pastry,meatball
title: Mini Meatballs & Sauce Twirls
ingredients: 12 frozen meatballs | 1 medium onion, diced | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leave, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chicken stock powder | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 sheets puff pastry
instructions: For the meatballs, place the frozen meatballs in a bowl with the onion, thyme and chicken stock powder.  Add the icing sugar, mix well and put aside for 30 minutes.  Roll each pastry sheet in a log of rolling flour, then in more flour, to form balls.  Roll each ball in the icing sugar.  Place on a tray lined with baking paper and bake at 190c for 20 minutes.  Remove from the oven and remove the paper.  Cool and leave the pastry in the oven to dry.  Serve while still warm with your favourite meat or vegetables.

title: Thai Savoury Bread
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups low-fat plain breadcrumbs ( panko ) | 6 kaffir lime leaves, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons low-fat dried milk | 2 tablespoons nonfat dry milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f combine breadcrumbs, lime leaves powder and 1 2/3 cup warm water in a bowl.  Whisk in the dry milk.  Spread the breadcrumb mixture evenly over the base of a rimmed baking sheet.  Bake about 15 minutes, or until lightly golden brown.  Serve immediately, cut into 6 wedges.

title: White Queso Blanco
ingredients: 1 ounce semisweet chocolate | 1 tablespoon unsweetened chocolate bars | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 2 teaspoons white chocolate | 1 serrano pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place chopped semisweet chocolate in a small bowl.  Place a small plate on top of bowl and pour small amount of water, 1 or 2 tablespoons at a time, through it.  Use your finger to rub around the edge of a small container or bowl to break up the chocolate, then pour about 1 teaspoon or so of water down the center of the chocolate piece and spread evenly.  Repeat with any remaining water on the outside of the chocolate.  Sprinkle white chocolate on top.  If using the serrano pepper, cut it crosswise into thin slices.

title: Almond Popsicles
ingredients: 15 ounces raspberries | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Place raspberries in a plastic bag with sliced almonds.  Seal and shake to coat.  Remove almonds.

title: Natasha's Easy Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1 large egg, beaten | 1 teaspoon fennel bulb, chopped | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/3 package taco seasoning | 1 large wrapper | taco sauce or salsa
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet to a rolling simmer.  Add fennel and cook until soft.  Remove from skillet and reserve.  Combine sugar, catsup and taco seasoning and whisk in enough water to create a thin sauce.  Add egg to sauce and stir well.  Add fennel to sauce and cook over low heat until sauce thickens.  While still stirring, drop a few drop by drop in fennel mixture, coating them well.  When the fennel mixture becomes crispy and shiny, use a small spoon to coat each wrapper with the sauce.  Fold wrapper in half.  Use a knife or fork to cut off one of the ends.  Make sure you twist the end into a small cup of the sauce mixture in each wrapper.

title: Whole Wheat Almond Pancake
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 cup almond milk | 2 slices pancetta, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped pancetta plus 1 tablespoon of the bacon fat | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper, pinch | 1/2 cup ice
instructions: Combine flour and milk.  Let rest 10 minutes.  Add pancetta, cayenne, and ice to flour mixture.  Knead until smooth.  Place on oiled pizza pan.  Lightly sprinkle with bacon fat.  Cover and let rise for 15 - 20 minutes.  Pre heat oven 425 degrees.  Bake 20 - 30 minutes until golden.  Cool on tray.

title: Pixie Dust II
ingredients: 3 cups unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 cup agave syrup | 2 cans chopped green chiles, drained | 1/4 cup finely ground ginger
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together cocoa, agave syrup, and green chiles.  Stir in the ginger.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,pizza sauce,pesto,vegetable oil cooking spray,vegetable oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,ghee
title: Pesto Pizza
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 4 -5 tablespoons pesto ( pesto ) | 1 teaspoon ground mexican oregano | 1 pinch mexican oregano | 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pizza sauce ( homemade or your favorite store bought )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the pesto, mexican oreggiano, and mexican oregano.  Set aside.  Dredge an 8 inch pizza pan with cooking spray.  Spread the pesto mixture on the bottom of the pan.  You may have to do this in batches.  Spread the pesto over the pesto and spread out the olive spread out to about ¼ inch from the edge of the pan.  Spread the cheese over the pesto.  Evenly scatter the grated parmigiano across, about 1/4 teaspoon thick.  Spread the pizzas over the cheese and spread the pesto over the cheese.  Sprinkle on the oregano and the cheese over the pesto and cheese.  Spread 1 - 2 tbsp pizza sauce over the pizza and dust with more grated parmigiano.  Set your pizza stone on the work surface.  If your pizza stone is not big enough, you can use your oven grill.  Set your oven to 450 degrees or a convection heat.  If you use convection oven, let it go.  After about a half hour, your pizza stone should have a solid, straight edge about 5  10 minutes.  If any spots get burned before pizza, let it go for about 3 minutes.  Remove from oven, remove pan with pizza toppings, and set to the side.  You may have to spread the pesto over the pizza to help it spread out evenly.  Cut into wedges, and serve hot.  Use the pesto as a dip for fresh vegetables or cheese sauces.  Variation, you can spread a bit of canned tomato paste on top of the pizza to make a thicker sauce for dipping.  Note, if you can't find pesto, you can use olive oil, which helps it keep from sticking to the spoon.

title: Tandoori Chicken
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 4 tablespoons pine nuts | 2 tablespoons chopped habanero | 2 tablespoons chopped boston lettuce | 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Combine the yogurt with the pine nuts, habanero and lettuce and season to taste with salt and pepper.  Place the chicken in a shallow baking dish, and pour the yogurt mixture over.  Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator at least 8 hours.  Preheat grill to medium heat.  Brush the marinated chicken with olive oil.  Grill chicken on the hot grate for 15 minutes.  Turn, brush with olive oil, and grill for 15 minutes more.  Serve on toasted buns.

title: Quick Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried kidney bean, sorted and rinsed | 3/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, minced
instructions: Place beans in a medium saucepan.

title: Guiness Marinated Veal With Chiles

title: Puerto Rican Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 cup smooth chunky salsa | 1 package cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 4 cups thick chilled ice cream ( about 8 oz ) | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon pickapeppa sauce
instructions: Stir together salsa and cream of tartar in medium bowl.  Stir in pie spice until dissolved.  Cover with plastic wrap and chill in refrigerator 15 minutes.  Heat oven to 250°f line a rimmed baking sheet with foil.  Press sesame oil into foil, then spread evenly over baking sheet.  Using a floured fingers, spread the ice cream evenly over salsa crust, leaving an inch at the bottom edge of the sheet.  Using the floured fingers, spread the pumpkin mixture evenly over ice cream.  Using a flat bladed knife, spread the pickapeppa sauce evenly over pumpkin layer.  Bake until deep golden brown in colour or 40 - 50 minutes, stirring half way through.  Cool in oven at 250°f, about 10 minutes.  Transfer to airtight container and cut into 8 squares.  Serve hot.

title: Feta Bean Snacks
ingredients: 4 ounces canadian bacon | 4 ounces feta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1 tablespoon ghee, melted | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f cut bacon into 1/4 inch strips.  In a bowl, mash bacon with fork.  Add salt, pepper, vanilla bean, cheese, and ghee.  Stir until all ingredients are incorporated.  Spoon mixture into a 9x9 inch glass baking dish.  Bake 20 - 25 minutes.  Cut into 4 squares to serve.

Random Ingredients: cuban bread,ginger paste,mushroom,celery rib,cream,absolut citron vodka,pork shoulder
title: Cured Spiced Kabobs: Braised Pork, Eggplant, and Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh mushrooms, halved ( use a variety of different types of fresh mushrooms ) | 1 ounce fresh ginger paste ( optional ) | 8 ounces cuban bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 ounces canned low-fat margarine, chilled and cut into chunks ( such as becel ) | 2 large celery ribs, very thinly sliced | 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, very thinly sliced crosswise into 1-inch-wide strips
instructions: In a bowl, toss the mushrooms, ginger, and bread cubes until evenly mixed.  Spread the bread/meat on a plate and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Heat the margarine in a skillet over medium heat.  Add the celery, pork, and mushrooms to the skillet.  Cook and stir until the pork is just cooked through, about 10 minutes.  Push the mixture to the sides of the skillet.  Arrange the cooked pork and mushrooms on top of the kabobs and brush with the margarine.  Cook for a few minutes to heat thoroughly, then flip and rearrange the skewers.  Cook until the meat is cooked through, about 5 minutes more.

title: Lobster Sauce
ingredients: 6 whole cardamom pods, cracked | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground paprika | 1 1/2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 1/2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 1/2 pounds cleaned baby shrimp, with shell fragments | 1 sprig fresh mint leaves, for garnish
instructions: Place the cardamom in a small skillet over medium heat.  Stir in the paprika and ketchup.  Simmer for 2 minutes.  Stir in the anchovy paste, poppy seeds and mint leaves.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Place the shells in the boiling water and cook for 1 minute.  Remove from the pot and drain.  Place the shrimp in a food processor, and pulse until shrimp are finely chopped.  Stir the shrimp into the paprika mixture, and blend until shrimp are fully covered.  Continue cooking until the mixture is creamy, approximately 3 to 5 minutes, depending on how well you blended the mixture with the shrimp.  Remove from the heat.  Place the shrimp mixture into a bowl, garnish with mint leaves, and serve hot.

title: Apricot Sauce (Brats No Mayo)
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine ( i prefer port, do not use the sweet ) | 1/3 cup paprika hungarian style sweet spiced apricot, chopped | 3 tablespoons ketchup or 3 tablespoons tomato ketchup | fresh thyme sprig | leaves dried orange rind ( i used a peeler ) | capers, rinsed | fresh italian flat leaf parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a saucepan.  Cover and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Reduce the heat and simmer, stirring frequently, until the apricots are soft, 25 to 30 minutes.  Transfer the mixture to a blender and puree until smooth, adding a little water if necessary.  Adjust the seasoning.  Add salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste.  Ladle the sauce into 4 small bowls and garnish with orange rind, capers and a sprig of parsley sprig.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,baguette,coconut pecan frosting,braising steak,anchovy fillet,yellow cake mix
title: Bread Crunch
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 can anchovy fillets, chopped | 4 tablespoons unsweetened coconut pecan frosting | 1 baguette, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 pound braising steak, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 orange peel, cut into bite-size strips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Place cake mix in a large bowl and pour in anchovies and coconut pecan frosting stirring well to combine. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown and cake is firm.  Let cool slightly, cut into squares or triangles and serve warm.

title: Kosher Richmond Irish Raisins
ingredients: 1 cup raisins | 2 limes, zest of

When ready to use, rinse the raisins and gently pat dry using paper towels.  In a clean, dry non metal dish, place the raisins and the juice of half a lime, covered with plastic wrap, on the raisins.  Warm the sauce on the stove top or in the microwave, stirring occasionally, until the raisins are hot and bubbling.

title: Chunky Tomato Jam
ingredients: 1 lb tomatoes | 2 cups dark brown sugar
instructions: Core the tomatoes and slice them into 3/4 inch thick rounds.  Place the tomatoes in a large heavy saucepan, and add the brown sugar in small pieces all at once.

title: Quick and Easy Tiramisiana
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups pearl barley | 5 cups baby spinach | 1/4 cup reduced-fat sour cream or 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 250 g shredded provolone cheese | 1/4 cup reduced-fat gruyere, grated | 1/3 cup basil pesto | 1/4 teaspoon splenda granular ( optional )
instructions: Combine the cooked and drained mushrooms, sour cream, cream of tartar, salt and pepper to taste in a large bowl and mix well.  Arrange alternate layers of the shredded provolone, gruyere and pearl barley atop the cheese mixture, starting with the cheese, ending with the provolone, making sure that the cheese is covered on all sides.  Drizzle with the flavored pesto just before serving.  Serve.

title: Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 3 large poblano peppers | 1 pound lean bacon ( optional ) | 3 cups ground beef | 2 serrano chilies, seeded and julienned | 1 1/2 cups italian-style vermouth | 1 cup shaved boston-style cheese or cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut a slit lengthwise into the stem end of each chile.  Remove the seeds, then cut a slit lengthwise into the remaining halves.  Set the chile shells upright in a 10x6 inch baking dish.  Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium high heat until evenly brown, about 10 minutes.  Remove bacon from skillet and set aside.  Raise the heat to high and brown the ground beef, peppers, and chile, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks, until the meat is no longer pink, 4 to 5 minutes.  Sprinkle the cheese over the meat, reduce heat to medium, and sprinkle the bacon mixture over the cheese.  Bake the chiles in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted and the peppers are soft and bubbly, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,thyme leaf,vanilla,pork loin,sauce,chicken stock cube,cream mushroom soup
title: Thyme Pork (Or Not!) Casserole
ingredients: 6 cups pork loin ( i used boneless ) | 1 -2 tablespoon hot sauce ( i use tabasco ) | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme leaves | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 4 cups chicken stock cube | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Preaheat the oven at 350 degrees.  Mix the chili sauce, thyme and stock cube in a crock pot.  Deeel the pork and place in bottom of the crockpot. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours.  Serve with crusty bread and/ or mashed potatoes.

title: Green Pea Puree (With Bread Flour)

Sprinkle the provolone and capers with salt.  Scatter over the ham slices and bake them in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden and bubbling around the edges.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

Cut off both ends of the stems and discard.  Cut chiles lengthwise into strips about 3 by 2 inches wide and set aside.  Heat the reserved oil in a medium skillet over medium heat.  Add the pistelli, stirring often, then cook, stirring occasionally, 1 minute.  Transfer pistelli to a small bowl.  Place the sun dried tomatoes in a large bowl of ice water, cover tightly and let soften for 10 minutes.  Drain tomatoes, then cut into 1/2 inch bits.  Mash the pistelli with potatoes masher until smooth.  Stir in pistelli, sun dried tomatoes, chicken bouillon powder, sherry, cardamom seeds and baking powder. title: Pickled Pork
ingredients: 1 whole pork ( pig's tail, belly or head will do ) | 1/2 cup vinegar
instructions: Rinse and trim the pork of all visible fat.  Put the pork into a large pot of cold water.  When the water starts to boil, add the water to cover.  Bring to a boil, remove from stove, and leave covered for 3 hours.  When completely cool, remove the fat and place the pork in a sterile container, making sure there is no blood or debris.  Strain and allow to drip dry, then place into the refrigerator for up to 1 month.  To use the pickled pork, boil 1/2 cup vinegar in a large pot.  The vinegar will stop the cooking of that once it is completely cool, and the liquid will come to a glaze consistency.  Pour this glaze over your salad or meat, and mix well.  Allow to cool and serve, or store in a cool, dark place before serving.

title: Tandoori Pork Biryani
ingredients: 1 pound boneless pork butt, trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup grated french baguette | 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 teaspoon dried basil at the 1/8-inch intervals | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 3 tablespoons ground cumin seed, or more to taste | 2 cups long-grain white rice
instructions: Blend 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar, 2/3 cup french bread crumbs, 1/4 cup shredded fontina cheese, bread cubes, thyme, 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin, 1 teaspoon garam masala, and ground cumin in a blender until smooth.  Add more bread crumbs, 1/4 cup fontina cheese, and 1/2 teaspoon garam masala.  Mix 2 more tablespoons red wine vinegar with 2 tbsp water in a bowl to make a paste.  Toss rice with the paste in the bowl to coat thoroughly.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spray a 2 1/2 quart baking dish with cooking spray.  Spread rice out onto the bottom of the baking dish.  Spread 1/4 cup fontina cheese around the rice.  Spread the rice with 1/4 cup pork butt.  Spread the remaining rice over the pork.  Cover with the remaining 1/4 cup fontina cheese and remaining 1/4 cup pork butt.  Cover with foil, crimping the seams to seal.  Bake in the preheated oven until the rice is tender and the top is golden brown, about 1 hour 10 minutes.  Remove foil.

title: Brown Lentil Soup (Lebanese)

instructions: Place the lentils, lentils, and hot cooked brown lentils in a blender or food processor, pulse until all ingredients are coarsely chopped.  Taste for salt, adding more to taste.  Transfer mixture to a soup kettle, heat over medium to low heat, and serve hot with bread, crackers, or as suggested in intro.

title: Solo Fruit Cocktail
ingredients: 1 jar solo fruit filling ( or a jar of your choice ) | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 pint fresh berries, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a cocktail shaker.  Cover and shake well.  Pour into a bottle with ice.  Cover and chill in the fridge.

title: Curried Sausages and Brown Rice
ingredients: 4 pinches curry paste or 4 pinches yellow curry | 1 pound mild italian sausage | 1/2 cup brown onion, finely diced | 2 cups brown rice | 2 tablespoons fresh lime rind, minced | 3 stalks celery, finely diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a baking dish, mix the curry paste.  Crumble the italian sausage and toss with the curry paste until coated evenly.  Bake in the preheated oven until sausage is nearly cooked, about 45 minutes.  When almost done, stir the onions and celery into the sausage along with the brown rice.  Return to the oven, stirring the sausage occasionally.  Simmer about 10 more minutes, until onions and celery are tender.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,green chilies,pork,walnut,serrano pepper,grain rice,creole seasoning,american cheese
title: Texas-Style Cheesy Pork and Rice
ingredients: 3/4 lb lean boneless pork, cut into strips ( i like to use lean deli meat ) | 3 tablespoons creole seasoning | 3/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 3 cups cooked long grain rice | 2 -3 serrano peppers, seeded and finely chopped ( depending on size ) | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted and roughly chopped | 4 slices american cheese, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Add pork to a medium size bowl.  In a small bowl mix creole seasoning, seasoned salt, and rice.  Set aside.  In a large frying pan add the chilies, walnuts, and american cheese.  Sauté for three to four minutes over medium heat until the american cheese has melted.  Add the pork mixture to the frying pan.  Stir well to coat.  Cover and cook on medium low until everything is well coated.  Note, i like to let the mixture cook down a little so the pan can absorb as much of the moisture from the ingredients.  This is where i have to turn down the heat.  You just want some liquid in the pan.  Let it simmer down a little.  You may have to lower the heat.  You want to keep stirring frequently or the rice will have a little too much liquid from it.  But it does have to be a good consistency for a good texture for the meal.  Taste for flavor and add any additional creole seasoning, salt, or creole seasoning to taste.  The longer this cooks, the better it tastes.  Enjoy.

title: Wine-Linguini

Transfer to a large, shallow casserole that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.  Sprinkle with half of the mozzarella, then stir in mustard and kahlúa.  Spread the remaining cheese evenly on top and in even rows across the surface of the linguine.  Bake for 20 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.  Remove and garnish with parsley.

title: Curried Spinach

instructions: Wash and remove the tough leaves from the spinach, then chop the leaves.  Place in a skillet with the curry powder, cream of tartar, prosciutto, onion and chicken broth.  Simmer, covered, on low heat for 5 minutes so the moisture evaporates and the spinach is tender but firm.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Divide the mixture evenly among four baking dishes.  Top each with swiss cheese and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until the cheese is lightly browned and bubbly.  Serve hot.

instructions: Bring a pan of water to the boil and add potatoes & orange peel.  Cook for 15 minutes, then drain and add to a warm serving dish.  Stir in cabbage, prunes & oil.  Dividing evenly, garnish with cinnamon.  Serve warm or cold.
