ingredients: 3 ounces rice vermicelli, broken in small pieces | 2/3 cup dark rum ( i prefer bacardi good brand, but bacardi is my favorite-i find bacardi is definitely my favorite ) | 2 -3 tablespoons adobo sauce ( from a jar with chipotles ) | 1/4 cup peppercorn
instructions: Put the vermicelli in a bowl, cover with water, and soak for about 5 minutes, or until tender.  Drain.  Place the noodles in a mixing bowl, and add the rum and the adobo sauce.  Add more, but do not add too much, as the chipotles will taste chewy so be careful, and stir.  If making them from scratch, remove as soon as possible.  Taste them to determine how hot the flavour will be.  When they have had a chance to settle, drain all and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream coconut,ear corn cob,beef stock,apple,cardamom seed,lamb shoulder,pecan half
title: Pecan Lamb Curry
ingredients: 1/2 cup cream of coconut | 1/4 cup beef stock | 4 ounces ground lamb shoulder | 4 ounces grated apples | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 8 ounces pecan halves, toasted | 4 ears corn on the cob, husked
instructions: Place cream of coconut in a small microwave safe dish.  Cover and microwave until hot.  Stir in beef stock until dissolved.  Place lamb into a lrg bowl.  Stir apple, cardamom, pecans, & corn into the lamb.  Pour heated cream of coconut over, coating lamb.  Cover & cook on 600 f for 7 - 8 minutes, turning lamb twice, or until lamb starts to crisp.  Transfer lamb to a serving platter.  Turn oven to broiler.  Place lamb on foil lined broiler tray.  Broil 3 - 4 from the heat 1 - 2 m inutes until browned.  Spoon curry onto plate.  Slice lamb & serve with vegetables.

title: German Style Sausage With Asparagus & Chili
ingredients: 1 lb sliced hot kielbasa | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped fresh asparagus spears | 1/4 cup chopped red chili
instructions: Remove asparagus from water and set aside.  Slice kielbasa across grain.  If the sausage can be longer cut it into 1/2 inch slices.  Combine all other ingredients in a skillet over medium high heat.  Cook kielbasa for 4 - 5 minutes or until it is cooked through.  Serve with noodles of your choice.  Note, kielbasa can also be cut into quarters instead of 4 slices.  Use your discretion.

title: Beef & Sausage Kebabs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 500 g pork kielbasa | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup chopped kielbasa | 1/2 cup chopped beef sausage | 1/3 cup sliced banana pepper | 4 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 12 to 15 minutes
instructions: To make the kebabs, place kebabs on a plate or tray lined with aluminium foil.  Sprinkle with taco seasoning, mix well and marinate 30 minutes at room temperature.  Remove the kate, cover and refrigerate over night.  For the filling, cut sausage into slices.  Slice banana pepper into thin strips or slices.  Thread onto bamboo skewers.  Grill sausage for 5 - 8 minutes on each side, basting with kate.  Add banana pepper at end of grilling time and continue until banana peppers are crispy and brown on all sides.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,saffron thread,double cream,chambord raspberry liquor,stew meat
title: French Pommes Au Sirop
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stew meat | 10 fluid ounces double cream | 11 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 3 -10 saffron threads, lightly crushed | 7 -9 drops chambord raspberry liquor
instructions: Boil the liquid of the stew meat until it reaches a boil.  Add 6 fl oz of heavy cream.  Simmer slowly on low heat for about 45 minutes until the meat is cooked and creamy.  Remove the meat and the cream and keep it hot.  Blend the other 7 fl oz of cream with the saffron.  Cut it into thick slices or squares, sprinkle with a little chambord.  Add a few drops of chambord at a time to the cream and pour over the meat or vegetables.  Serve this dish at room temperature.

title: Tex Mex Lobster

instructions: Combine all ingredients and place in crockpot.  Cover and cook on low heat 10 - 12 hours.

title: Pineapple-Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 2 cans low-sodium canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 can unsweetened pineapple tidbits | 1/2 cup chopped carrots ( fresh ) | 1/2 cup prepared pizza sauce, bottled | 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs | 3/4 cup prepared pizza sauce ( purchased or homemade ) | 2 tablespoons purchased dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs
instructions: In a large bowl, combine rinsed and drained canned chickpeas, pineapple tidbits, carrots, and 1/2 cup pizza sauce.  Mix well.  In a second bowl, combine 2 tbsp dijon mustard, 2 tbsp herb, and 2 tbsp tomato sauce using the back of a spoon.  Gently stir in the remaining 1 tbsp tomato sauce, stir to blend, and drizzle over salad.  Serve salad warm or at room temperature.  Tip, if using homemade sauce, do not stir after adding the dressing.  Use commercial pizza sauce, 1 tbsp to 1 tbsp dijon mustard and 2 tbsp tomato sauce.  Yum.

title: Filipino Beef and Potato Kielbasa

instructions: Preheat the grill to high.  In a large skillet over medium high heat, fry the kielbasa, roast beef, potato, and fresh spinach leaves until the vegetables are softened.  Stir in the garlic, and heat through.  Season with sugar.  The kielbasa mixture can be made 2 days in advance and kept in the refrigerator.  Bring the contents of the ziploc bag to a boil for 20 seconds in a wok, then strain.  Place kielbasa mixture on serving plates and spoon the gosu sauce over each portion.

instructions: Place potatoes into a pot and cover with salted water.  Bring to a boil, and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 15 minutes.  Drain and cool.  Cut into 1 inch cubes.  Mix edamame, olives, sweet olives, cucumber, orange juice, sugar, and cocoa in a bowl.

title: Southern Cabbage

1 white cabbage | 1 tablespoon mrs.

instructions: In large deep skillet, brown the onions in hot oil for about 5 minutes or until the onions are golden.  Sprinkle with warm basil sprigs.  Serve,.

title: Raspberry Chutney
ingredients: 1 red onion, cut into half moons | 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberry or 1 1/2 cups peach slices | 1 -2 red chili powder | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 chipotle chiles, minced | 1/2 - 3/4 cup prepared sweet-and-sour mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a processor or blender and process until smooth.  Transfer to a serving container and refrigerate overnight to blend flavors.

title: Lamb and Cranberry Sausages

instructions: Cook and stir dry cranberries, coriander, and basil in 1 1/2 tablespoons of water until just wilted.  Dissolve bouillon cube in remaining water in a bowl.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Line baking sheet with parchment paper.  Drain artichokes of marinade into strainer & press into a pyrex bowl or other baking dish if using. title: Easy Cheater's Shredded Beef for a Crowd

instructions: Layer beef on bottom of large dutch oven.  Cover with guacamole, being careful not to add too much and getting it to be too liquid to layer.  Spread a small amount of the guacamole on top.  Bake at 325 over medium heat about 5 minutes or until beef is browned and is heated through.

title: Simple Peppers and Whipping Cream
ingredients: 1 large green bell pepper, seeded, cored, and cut into 1 slices | 3/4 cup whipping cream

title: Tocino All'Amatraciana (Italian Beef Tenderloin)

Place in your preheated oven and broil for approximately 15 minutes, until it reaches desired internal temperature.  Remove from oven and allow it to rest for 4 to 5 minutes before slicing.

ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken, cut into portions | 1/4 cup pure maple syrup | 1/3 cup red onion, sliced thin | 1 slice prosciutto, thin, chopped
instructions: Cut chicken breast off the bone and skin and set aside.  Combine syrup and onion in a saucepan and heat slowly till it becomes bubbly.  Put the chicken in the syrup mixture and cook on low heat till the sauce is reduced and chicken is cooked through. instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Stir ketchup, sugar, asiago cheese, and herbs together in a small bowl.  Arrange half of ladyfingers in a layer on a large baking sheet.  Brush with ketchup mixture.  Repeat layers.  Sprinkle with snow peas.

title: Nigerian Spiced Sausages And Mango
ingredients: 2 lbs mangoes ( kent mango is better ) | 2 lbs sautéed kielbasa sausage | 6 kielbasa sautéed chili | 3 tablespoons brandy | 2 serrano chili, slices
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl, cover and put in fridge.  These are meant to last for a good week.

title: Clam Linguica

instructions: Beat eggs until very light, stir in graham cracker crumbs, dill weed and clams.  Pour into well greased 9x5 x1 inch pan.  Bake at 375°f for 40 - 45 minutes.

title: Chicken for the BBQ, Grill, or Stir Fry

instructions: Place cut side down on grilling tray/tray with no side pieces touching.  Sprinkle each piece with freshly ground pepper.  Cover tray/tray with foil to prevent steam burns.  Place grill/broiler pan on the grates rack set over high/low heat with plenty of room for the chicken.  Turn each piece of chicken often so that both side are evenly spread and the meat is evenly cooked.  Cook chicken for about 5 mins per side or until tender.  Remove chicken to a board, then cut into thick slices.

title: Olive Vinaigrette for Chicken or Fish
ingredients: 1 jar marinated stuffed green olives | 1/4 cup thai fish sauce | 1/2 cup chili powder | 1/4 cup dried marjoram
instructions: Add all ingredients to a glass bowl.  Cover and let it marinate for a day to allow flavors to develop.  Add more marinade if desired.  Skewer the vegetable onto wooden skewers.  Grill or broil to your liking on your favorite barbecue.

title: Maudie's Spinach -Charcoal-Roasted Fresh Spinach With Raisi
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 cup oil | 1 1/4 cups caster sugar | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 3/4 cup raisins | 1/2 cup chopped dried fruit peel | 4 -5 tablespoons cider ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400f degrees.  Tear the spinach into 2/3's length, or in thirds and set on a rimmed baking tray and place in the oven for 1/2 hour, or until tender, stirring occasionally.  When the cooking time is up, in a large frying pan, warm 1/4 cup of the oil and coat the spinach with the oil.  This should only take a couple minutes at the max temperature – stir regularly.  Remove the spinach from the oven when cool, place it, with any it left in it, in a clean dish and cover with foil.  Leave in the oven for 1 hour, or until dry.  It doesn't need to be cold if you put it in a strainer this time.  If you do it that way, then the spinach won't need a lot of time and you will just steam the spinach.  Stir in the rest of the oil and sugar, the marsala and raisins.  Roast the spinach for about 2 - 3 minutes, until the spinach wilts slightly and becomes slightly wrinkly & slightly crisp.  Place the spinach on a lined baking tray, drizzle with olive oil and bake for a couple minutes.  The spinach will only need a few minutes and the raisins should also be a bit crispy.  If you want to freeze it, put it on the tray and pop it in the fridge.  Keep in mind that if you serve it in advance, you can reheat it in the oven for 20 minutes or so in addition to the frying pan.  Enjoy i have made this when my cappellone is due for a large party and i have left overs too, however i have made several at the beginning of the evening and made sure that the party never lasts forever, so we don't want to be left out of leftovers.

title: Low Fat Blueberry Cheddar Colcannon

instructions: Combine cottage cheese and cocoa.  Wash and dry cauliflower.  Layer in a casserole dish.  Sprinkle blueberries on top.  Top blueberries with a sprinkling of cocoa and cover with cheese mixture.

title: Dolmades (Dolmades)

instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  In a small bowl, dissolve bisarbonate soda in enough boiling water to make a runny paste.  Set aside to cool. title: Chinese Style Bok Choy

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.  Spread mustard in the center of an 11 inch roasting pan.  Arrange parsnips around it.  Insert two meaty toothpicks into it evenly spaced on each parsnip. title: Italian Brunch

instructions: Heat about 1 tblsp.  Of oil in a large skillet over medium heat until very hot.  Do not let oil smoke.  Pour in sugar.  It should have a syrupy texture, but not too sweet. title: Nori Sushi (Japanese Stock)

Pick up and stretch each piece of nori with any loose seaweed and press lightly on the nori making sure the seaweed gets inside the nori.  Repeat steps 3 - 8 until all your nori is used up.  Bring the stock to a boil.  Reduce heat so the stock is simmering and a lid is tightly fitting. Wrap a large piece of plastic wrap or plastic wrap around the surface of the nori so it stays flat in the water.  Take the wrap and wrap a towel over the nori so it wont lose moisture. Remove plastic wrap and cut nori at a slight angle so it will be easier to eat when served warm.  Cutting from outside to the center makes the seaweed more rigid and easier to roll.  The nori are best eaten immediately, so eat them hot.

instructions: Blend strawberries, spinach, sugar, tequila and thyme in a blender until smooth.  If the mixture is too thick, add up to 2 tablespoons water. title: Hoggy Pies
ingredients: 2 teaspoons lemons | 1/2 cup white hominy, rinsed | 2 chicken breast fillets | 12 thick slices hoagie roll | mint leaf ( to garnish )
instructions: Place lemon juice in a medium size frying pan.  Place chicken breast fillets in pan, and cook until cooked through. instructions: Combine the glaze ingredients or place in a small jug or container with 2 tbsp water and whisk until combined. title: Braised Apples

title: The Best Beef Sandwich

Reduce heat and simmer for approximately 10 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in refried beans.  Spoon about 3/4 cup of liquid into a small glass measuring cup.  Pour 1 inch of water into small paper baking dish to a depth of 2 inches.  Cut sandwich bread in half diagonally.  Place each half diagonally on microwave safe tray. Spoon additional liquid on each half of sandwich, and sprinkle with additional sprinkles before serving.

title: Chicken Tenders With Rice & Cucumber Salad

In a small bowl, combine the cucumber, asafoetida powder and 3 tablespoons of water.

instructions: Combine feta, bread crumbs, lemon juice, zest, nigella, anise, cashews and olive or peanut oil.  Process until desired consistency is reached.  Refrigerate to develop flavors.  Serve chilled, or let cool completely until serving.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place beef roast in a large oven safe skillet, and cook over medium high heat until no more pink is left, and the outside is browned, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with more pinto bean and sour cream, and return to the oven, and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Currants

Sprinkle with pistachios and serve.

Dried fruit is available at specialty food specialty food stores, especially near specialty cheeses, in the black gourmet aisle of your groceys or safron. Mix the flour into the chilled coffee, if using.  Add the soaked rice/vinegar mixture, making sure all the dry ingredients are moistened.  Knead the dough briefly until it’s smooth and no longer sticky.  Cover with a damp cloth and set aside for 10 to 15 minutes at room temperature, then refrigerate for 10 minutes.  Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Roll out the chilled dough to 1/4 inch thickness.  Cut the rounds out of the chilled dough.  Place onto a flat surface and top with the shredded coconut mixture.  Seal and fold over the edges.  Prick a hole in the center of the dough using a fork.  Bake until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: szechwan pepper,pea shoot,worcestershire sauce,orange marmalade,potato,cider vinegar
title: Stick-It-Up Sweet Potato Relish

instructions: In a 2 to 3 quart slow cooker, place sweet potatoes.  Blanch the peas and shoots in boiling water for 3 minutes.  Transfer to a bowl of ice water to cool a little and remove peel.  Cut into 3/4 inch pieces.  Add all ingredients to the slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,mango,honey barbeque sauce,oat flour,basil leaf,italian seasoning
title: Quick Mango Oat Bars
ingredients: 1 pound sweet mangoes - peeled, pitted, and cut into 2-inch chunks | 1 cup prepared quick oats flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil leaves | 3/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 cup bottled balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup honey barbeque sauce
instructions: Place mango chunks in a saucepan with water to cover.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes.  Drain, then transfer mango chunks to a bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place mango chunks in a baking dish.  In a small bowl, mix cornstarch and balsamic vinegar.  Drizzle mixture over mango chunks.  Toss to coat, then drizzle with barbeque sauce.  Bake in the preheated oven until topping is golden, about 40 minutes.

title: Guacamole Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 pound leaves arugula | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1 tablespoon strawberry syrup | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 teaspoon minced ginger garlic paste
instructions: Chop arugula in a food processor until almost finely chopped.  Add remaining ingredients and blend until smooth.  Adjust seasoning with salt before serving.

title: Easy Spiced Cajun Peanuts
ingredients: 1/2 lb raw almonds ( you might want a few more, depending on size of your nuts ) | 1 celery rib | rock salt
instructions: Finely shred the celery or trim the ends off the nuts if using a food processor.  Dry them and put them through a food grinder or food mill.  It should take a few seconds to grind them a little and get a smooth paste.  Put 2 tbsp of paste into a shallow pan and put over med.  Heat.  Cook for about five minutes stirring often, or until it starts to brown and become dark in colour.  You shouldn't have to be able to smell this until you know exactly what it is right.  It is important to stir the cajun paste constantly so it doesn't burn on the bottom of the pan.  If necessary, cook a little more to coat the bottom.  While it browns, remove from stove and add rock salt to the rest of the paste and mix well so that the salt dissolves.  Add back to pan and fry for about 5 more minutes, stirring constantly.  You may need to add water to keep the paste from sticking to the bottom of the pan.  The cajun peanuts will make it a little chewier than normal peanuts.  Dip in the extra rock salt and enjoy.

title: Peach and Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 3 ounces brussels sprouts | 3 ounces peaches, peeled and finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon marjoram leaves | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste or 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 small serrano chilies, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Rinse the brussels sprouts and cut into 3/4 inch pieces.  In a medium bowl toss the sprouts with all the ingredients except for the brussels sprouts.  Place the brussels sprouts in a steaming basket for 4 minutes or until the brussels sprouts are beginning to soften.  Drain the brussels sprouts and serve.

title: Spicy Sausages
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausages, casings removed or 1 1/2 lbs hot italian sausages | 1 red capsicum, diced seeded and finely chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons seasoned flour | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce
instructions: Heat a large frypan on medium.  Mix together all your ingredients.  Cook sausages for 5 minutes.  Remove sausages and drain well.  Serve with rice and a tossed salad.

title: Blueberry and Mushroom Stuffed Pork
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh button mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed | 1 lb ground pork butt | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 1/2 cups berry-infused blueberries or 1 1/2 cups frozen blueberries, thawed and strained | 10 fresh mint leaves, slivered
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mushrooms, pork, cayenne, berry berries, and mint leaves.  Let marinate at least 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Remove pork mixture from marinade and roll between palms to flatten it slightly.  Transfer to a foil lined baking pan.  Bake 25 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 155 degrees.  Let stand 10 minutes.

title: Marinated Molasses BBQ Rub Rub
ingredients: 1 cup molasses | 1 cup light molasses ( light or dark ) | 1 cup mixed sprite | 2 1/2 teaspoons oregano bay leaves | 2 1/2 teaspoons lemon wedges | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mace | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon crushed chile pepper | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Place the molasses, light molasses, mixed sprite and seasonings into a large bowl.  Gradually beat in the salt.  Stir mixture until well blended.  Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour before using, or for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: guar gum,malt vinegar,swiss cheese,grand marnier,seasoning salt,white chocolate,rosemary,red capsicum
title: Christmas Quesadillas
ingredients: 180 g swiss cheese | 1 teaspoon guar gum | 1 teaspoon malt vinegar | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon minced rosemary | 1 teaspoon dry crushed rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 500 g white chocolate
instructions: Place the cheeses, guar gum, vinegar, grand marnier, rosemary and seasoning salt in a food processor and process until smooth until well mixed, about 10 seconds.  Remove the cheese mixture from the processor and place on a cutting board and using clean hands form into a 2cm thick log about 2cm thick.  Roll the log on the cutting board and cut into thin 2cm slices.  Place cheese slices on a baking tray and bake for 20 minutes at 180 degrees celcius, until the cheese is melted and starting to turn golden and crisp.  Leave to cool slightly, then transfer to a large serving dish and cool for 10 minutes.  Melt the white chocolate in a small pan over low heat and cool for 5 minutes.  Spread the warm white chocolate onto a warm flat surface and use your hand to spread the cheese sparingly.  Top with the crispy cheese and decorate with the rosemary sprigs and serve.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,monterey jack pepper cheese,garlic salt,rump steak,italian tomato
title: Quick Steak Fajitas (Cook's Country)

instructions: Heat skillet.  Add 1 or 2 drops of vegetable oil.  Sprinkle with garlic salt, mix and brown beef.  Add tomatoes.  If using peppers, heat in microwave on high for 90 seconds, stir often.  Add cheese.  Put lid on skillet and put on high until cheese is melted.  About 10 to 12 minutes, put lid back and put on for 5 minutes more, or until steak is cooked.

title: Beef Roast Italian Style
ingredients: 1 large beef roast | 1 package rotini pasta | chicken-flavored caviar sauce
instructions: Place the roast in a dutch oven or large heavy skillet.  Spread caviar over the roast, cover with water and bring to boil over medium high heat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.  Remove roast from refrigerator, let sit for 5 minutes before carving across the grain, 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons per pound of meat.  While the meat is resting, return the dutch oven to a medium heat.  Add the whole package of rotini and, using water that has been absorbed, bring to a boil.  Lower heat and simmer for 6 minutes or until pasta is al dente, and drain.  Serve the cooked, drained rotini with the gravy.  Leftovers may be warmed in the microwave or on the stove top.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,half,fig,brioche bread,fenugreek leaf,kitchen bouquet,black bean
title: Spicy Fig and Bean Stew
ingredients: 16 dried figs, stemmed | 2 -3 jalapeno chiles, stemmed and seeded, coarsely chopped | 2/3 cup dried black beans, soaked in water for 24 hours, rinsed, soaked for 24 hours and drained | 2/3 cup kitchen bouillon | 1 cup half-and-half | kitchen bouquet ( optional ) | 1 loaf brioche bread, cut into triangles
instructions: Place figs in a small pot, cover with cold water, and add enough water to cover by 2 to 3 inches.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. Place beans, kitchen bouillon, and half and half in a blender.  Puree.  When figs are cool to the touch, remove stems, slit and seed, and chop finely.  Place a broiler pan on the range or a large baking sheet.  Fill your bread cubes with plenty of the figs.  Add a sprinkling of pisto to your bread cubes in 4 large batches, pressing down gently.  Repeat for every batch.  To serve, place 4 to 6 to 6 pisto triangles on each piece of toast.  When serving, add a little to each plate with a little of the pisto left over.  If serving the stew, place 3 to 4 pieces of bread on top of each plate and then serve.

instructions: Combine all marinade ingredients in a small bowl and mix well to combine.  Reserve 1 cup of the marinade and whisk the remainder of the marinade into the dressing. Fry in the hot oil, turning until just beginning to turn flakey, about 5 minutes on each side.  Drain on paper towels.

instructions: Remove the roast from the pot and put it in the crock pot.  Cover the roast with water and add a pinch of salt.  Cook on low heat for 8 to 9 hours. title: Ketchup Island

title: Cauliflower Wrapped in Sausage and Dumplings
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret, cut into florets | 1 pound beef-suet, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Arrange cauliflower pieces in 9x13 inch baking pan.  Sprinkle with salt.  Place sausages in a 9x13 inch baking pan and cover with aluminum foil.  Bake in the preheated oven, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender, 45 to 50 minutes.  Serve with gravy poured over the top.

title: Salsa Fish
ingredients: 4 cups good quality salsa | 3/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 1/2 lbs salmon ( or other firm fish )
instructions: Place fish in ovenproof dish or roasting pan.  Cover fish tightly with salsa.  Sprinkle with cumin.  Cover and bake in 350f oven for 18 to 20 minutes basting occasionally with juices.  Serve immediately.  If desired, serve with salsa on the side for dipping.

title: Brown Rice With Raisins and Peppers
ingredients: 1 cup short grain brown rice | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 red pepper, cut into 4 wedges | 6 cups hot cooked pasta
instructions: Cook the rice using the brown rice setting on the package.  When done, set aside in a covered container in the refrigerator.  Saute red pepper wedges in a couple tablespoons of olive oil until slightly tender.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Wash, if necessary, dry, and dry pasta.  Return the package to the rice cooker.  Add the red pepper mixture and raisins.  Mix well.  Let stand several minutes.

title: Aloo Paratha
ingredients: 250 g fettuccine pasta, cooked | 3 long green chilies, sliced | 1 teaspoon coriander and coriander powder | 1 teaspoon shortening
instructions: Divide the fettuccine lengthwise into 8 pieces, making 12 pieces.  Mix together the corriander, corriander powder, chiles, coriander powder and shortening.  Spread it evenly over the entire dish.  Spread green chillies over top of fettuccine evenly.  Put in pre heated oven till the fettuccine is light brown.

title: Quick & Easy Eggplant "nests"
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cold chicken broth | 1 teaspoon agave nectar | 1 large eggplant | 2 -4 cups peanut oil ( for deep frying, i use canola ) or 2 -4 cups olive oil ( for deep frying, i use canola )
instructions: Cut eggplant into 3/4 inch cubes.  Heat stock, agave nectar and nests over medium high heat.  Test heat by placing a knife blade in the stock then pour into stock bowl.  Immediately drain the nests in strainer.  Dip eggplant into mixture and fry in peanut oil or coconut oil.  You can make a nest of nests just by placing one cup of oil in small heavy pot over low heat, stir constantly and shake pan to prevent burning.  After frying all 4 or 5 nests until golden brown, transfer them to paper towels to drain off excess oil.  Repeat for another nent.  Drain fried eggplant on paper towels and store in separate containers.  Serve warm, room temperature or at room temperature.  If using fresh oil, make sure your oil is deep enough to cover the nests.  Place a small amount of oil to cover the bottom of a saucepan, place a nent and a few baby sprinkles into the pan if needed, then turn over.  Brown the nits for 15 seconds on the other side if the nits have turned a golden brown color and the nits have turned a golden brown color if you add too much oil.  Remove nits while still warm and cover with plastic wrap until ready to serve.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 6 large lobsters meat ( with shells ) | 1 cup spearmint | 1/4 cup fresh herb ( thyme, oregano, rosemary leaves ) | 3 teaspoons candied garlic or 3 teaspoons garlic, crushed | 1 ounce carrot ( grated ) | red potato, scrubbed and sliced thinly | marshmallow topping
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the lobsters.  Cook for 4 minutes on each side, or until the lobsters open, and when flesh is easily flaked with a fork.  Transfer to a platter and cut in half.  Strain the cooking liquid through a colander and discard the solids.  Discard any damaged meat and shell parts.  Shred the lobsters.  Return the cooking liquid to a saucepan.  Add the spearmint, herb, pepper, garlic and carrot and bring to a boil.  Immediately whisk in the shaved spearmint or chopped rosemary leaves.  Add the lobster pieces and cook for 5 minutes, or until heated through.  Pour into warmed serving dish, sprinkle with additional grated carrot, red potatoes and marshmallow topping to serve.

title: Artichoke and Prawns in Olive Sauce
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups bottled clam juice | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and thinly sliced | 1 pound king prawns, peeled and deveined | 1 jar pitted green olives, drained
instructions: Pour clam juice into a medium saucepan, and add artichoke hearts.  Place the king prawns under the hot tap water.  When the prawns are almost cooked through, dip them into the clam juice, and allow to soak for about 30 minutes.  Remove prawns, reserving the clam juice, and set aside to drain.  Place artichoke hearts into the saucepan of artichoke hearts, and add the prawns, reserving about 1 cup of the liquid cooking water.  Cook and stir over medium high heat for several minutes.  Stir in the olives, and continue cooking for 5 minutes or so.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,raspberry,cream tartar,bean sprout,red potato,chicken soup base
title: Potato Clapshot
ingredients: 2 red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon chicken soup base | 1 cup canned coconut cream | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam or 1 tablespoon strawberry jam | 1/3 can baked beans sprouts
instructions: Heat oven to 400f degrees.  Cut each potato into 4 wedges and boil in water until tender.  Drain and place in a large bowl.  In blender/food process bowl combine cream of tartar, soup base and coconut cream.  Blend until smooth and pour over potato.  Add raspberry jam or strawberry jam and mix well.  Spread evenly on top of potato mixture.  Place on baking sheet and bake 20 - 25 minutes, or until hot.  Remove from oven and immediately cover with aluminum foil.  Allow to stand 5 minutes before removing the foil.  Place on serving plate.

title: Noble House Broccoli
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 4 tablespoons cider vinegar | 3 cups sliced broccoli
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the dark soy sauce, cider vinegar and chopped broccoli pieces.  Serve soy mixture over the hot cooked broccoli.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno seasoning salt,midori melon liqueur,jasmine rice,mustard,baby spinach
title: Midori Rice With Spinach & Shrimp
ingredients: 4 cups cooked jasmine rice, chilled | 4 cups fresh baby spinach | 4 1/2 ounces midori melon liqueur | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 teaspoon jalapeno seasoning salt
instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a small bowl.  When the water reaches a boil, add the rice.  Once the water reaches a boil again, stir the rice once or twice and cook for about 2 more minutes so the rice doesn't stick together.  Drain off any water left over, if any.

title: Greek Quinoa Stovetop
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa, washed | 1 teaspoon thyme, crushed
instructions: Place the quinoa in a strainer and rinse well.  Then place the quinoa and thyme in a heavy 4 quart pan.  Cover with cold water by 2 inches and heat to boiling.

title: Jamaican Jerk Meat
ingredients: 1 kg lamb | 2 tablespoons allspice | 2 tablespoons thyme sprigs
instructions: Trim the lamb of any fat and sinew and cut into 5cm cubes.  Cut the thyme sprigs into 5cm pieces and put them in a bowl.  Pour boiling water over them to cover them and leave to stand for 15 minutes.  Remove the thyme sprigs and stir them through the meat.  Cover the bowl and leave to stand for 2 hours.  Drain any excess liquid from the marinade and gently massage it into the meat.  Cover with plastic wrap and leave to mature for at least 2 - 3 hours before eating.

Random Ingredients: hot pepper,jalapeno chile,soy sauce,pineapple juice,red chili pepper flake
title: Spicy Shredded Pineapple
ingredients: 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper, crushed | 2 jalapeno chiles, seeded and chopped | 1 dash red chili pepper flakes, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.  Refrigerate for 30 minutes to let flavor develop.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,pinto bean,farfalle pasta,savory,dark soy sauce,parsley,shrimp
title: Pork Shrimp and Lobster Ravioli
ingredients:
1 1 lb pork tenderloin ( about 1 pound ) | 1/2 cup pinto beans ( about 1/2 lb.
    - ) | 2 tablespoons dark soya sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried shrimp | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried savory, crushed ( or use fresh thyme ) | 1 lb cooked and shelled shrimp ( peeled, deveined and chopped )
instructions: In a large skillet, brown pork over medium high heat.  Remove and set aside.  Add beans to skillet and stir for 2 minutes.  Return pork to skillet.  Add soy sauce and shrimps and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Stir in parsley, savory and shrimp.  Combine well.  Cook just until shrimp are pink.  Drain and rinse pasta and top with shrimp mixture for a few moments before serving.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,mustard,italian plum tomato,yellow pepper,gruyere cheese,teriyaki sauce,mascarpone cheese,ham
title: Mama's Cheesy Ham & Swiss Pizza
ingredients: 1 loaf refrigerated crusty italian plum tomatoes | 1/2 loaf gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/2 loaf swiss gruyere cheese, shredded | 2 loaves shaved ham | 2 jars prepared teriyaki sauce | 1 package mascarpone cheese | 1/2 cup dry mustard | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1 package frozen french's original rotisserie chicken and yellow pepper slices
instructions: Slice tomatoes lengthwise in half, then place cut side up on ungreased baking sheet.  Spray tops with nonstick butter spray, or mist with cornstarch.  In a medium bowl, mix together tomatoes, cheeses, ham, teriyaki sauce, and prepared mustard.  Spread mixture on top of tomatoes and bake at 400 degrees f for 10 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.  While cheese is baking, cut chicken into 3/4 inch strips.  Slice peppers into 3/4 inch wide strips.  Place shrimp and yellow pepper slices on ungreased broiler pan.  Cover and broil 4 - 6 inches from heat for 2 - 3 minutes.  Remove pan from oven and top each with a slice of tomato.  Return to oven and broil an additional 3 - 4 minutes or until shrimp turn pink.  While shrimp are in oven, combine mascarpone and mustard in a medium bowl.  In a small bowl, mash together with a fork, until smooth.  Spread desired amount of cheese mixture evenly over tomatoes, and top with chicken and yellow pepper strips.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,mini chocolate chip,water,drambuie,cilantro leaf,black bean,grand marnier,ice
title: Beef Mole for 1
ingredients: 2 lbs beef roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups water | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 tablespoon drambuie or 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 package mini marshmallow morsels ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups frozen black beans, thawed | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 5 cups crushed ice | minced dill, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Place meat in a slow cooker.  Combine the next five ingredients in a measuring cup.  Pour over the meat.  Cover and cook on high for 5 hours.  Turn setting to low.  Remove meat and serve in bowls with desired garnishes.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,black olive,cauliflower,fava bean,gouda cheese,dark chocolate,apricot jam,pistachio
title: Chili, Pistachio & Fava Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweet pickled sweet peppers ( i would use an english one ) | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate ( or a combination of your favourite dark chocolate flavours ) | 400 g shelled fava beans, drained & rinsed | 200 g crumbled gouda cheese | 100 g chargrilled black olives, roughly chopped ( or use green beans, red capsicum or olive tapenade ) | 1/3 cup pistachios | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh strawberries | 1 tablespoon good-quality apricot jam | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon hot chili oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c/350f/gas mark 2/moderate.  Pound the peppers with a pestle.  Break up the chocolate and heat in a shallow, non stick pan, stir in the beans, cheese & olives until melted, stir in the pistachios and apricots.  Pour into a 2l ovenproof dish sprayed with cooking spray.  Top with the cheese mixture.  Bake for 25 - 35 minutes until golden & bubbling in the middle.  Serve with a green salad, french bread and perhaps some simple greens.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,heavy cream,beef brisket,alfredo sauce,cumin seed
title: Cafe Rio Mojo Brisket
ingredients: 1 meaty beef brisket | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup alfredo sauce | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds
instructions: Trim the brisket of extra fat and silver skin.  Coarsely shred the meat using 2 forks.  Rub the adobo through a cheesecloth, or use a cheese gratine.  In a large bowl, combine the meat with the cream, alfredo sauce and cumin.  Use tongs to hold the meat, and use a spoon to scrape up any food residue.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Preheat oven to 250 degrees f.  Place brisket on a parchment paper lined jelly roll pan and spread with alfredo mixture.  Bake in the preheated oven until the brisket is tender in the center and beginning to fall apart, 45 to 60 minutes.  Allow to sit 5 minutes before slicing.

title: German Beer Battered Faux (Wolfgang Puckit Wee Shreds)
ingredients: 1 cup beer, of your choice ( a splash full ) | 1/2 cup pecan halves | lemon juice and zest, of one lemon ( the lemon will give the fattier brew a nice zing! ) | 2 -3 bamboo shoots ( the lemon can be found in the freezer section )
instructions: In a medium glass bowl, add all the components except the pecans.  Microwave until pecans are a uniform golden brown.  Be careful not to brown them just make sure they are not too brown.  Be sure to keep an eye on them.  Just keep warm.  If the smell of the beer while mashing your pecans is too strong for you, keep a close eye on it.  As soon as they are almost all burned off, add the pecan halves.  They can be covered and kept in the refrigerator.  To unmold, dip the fauge into the beer, letting excess drip off, then in a paper cone.  Put on plate and allow to get a nice round of beer.  Enjoy.

title: Fennel and Watermelon Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 2 tablespoons white peppercorns | 1 teaspoon freshly cracked red peppercorns | 2 tablespoons crushed fennel seeds | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 1 bunch fresh watermelon, cubed | 8 fluid ounces enchilada sauce
instructions: In a large skillet, toast the peppercorns, red pepper, and fennel seeds in the skillet over medium heat, stirring often, until fragrant and beginning to brown, 5 to 8 minutes.  Remove the peppercorns and spices from the skillet with a slotted spoon.  Cook the linguine according to package directions, and drain.  Place the watermelon cubes in a large bowl, and toss with the diced green onions and enchilada sauce.

title: Capellini
ingredients: 500 g strong white flour | 200 g white flour
instructions: You only need to use the soft white flour.

title: Fiery Chili Whipped Cream
ingredients: 24 fluid ounces heavy cream, whipped | 1 -2 green chili, roasted and skins removed, deseeded, finely chopped
instructions: In a mixing bowl, whip the cream until it's stiff enough to hold its shape a little bit.  Fold in the chili peppers and heat for 5 mins, or until very hot.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,turnip,wheat flour,sunflower seed,baking potato,cream chicken soup
title: Teed and Vegetable Scones
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 2 1/3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 1/3 tablespoons cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup chopped roasted red capsicum | 1/2 cup chopped turnip | 1 potato, medium, medium, peeled and cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c.  Spread sunflower seeds on a baking tray and bake in oven for 7 - 8 minutes or until lightly browned and dry.  Set aside.  Mix together flour, soup, capsicum and turnip.  Mix together with sunflower seeds.  Place potato on a baking tray and pour over the mixture.  Bake, in two batches, for 15 - 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender and the mixture golden.  Makes 8 servings.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,beef chuck,egg noodle,green chilies,italian turkey sausage,flour,mini chocolate chip
title: Baked Noodle and Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 10 1/2 ounces whole wheat egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1/2 lb italian turkey sausage | 1 small green chilies, seeded, chopped | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded ( about 12 ounces ) | 1/3 cup mini chocolate chip | 1/2 cup green chilies, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lightly grease a 10 1/2x6 inch glass baking dish.  In a large skillet over medium heat, cook italian sausage until lightly browned, breaking it up as it cooks, about 5 to 7 minutes.  Drain sausage, reserving 1/2 cup of drippings.

title: Coco - Currant and Jalapeno Baked Rice
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain basmati rice | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can sliced jalapenos, drained | 1/2 cup dried currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spread rice in a large rimmed baking dish.  Sprinkle baking soda over rice.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,mix,french bread,tortilla,chicken strip,apple,turbinado sugar
title: Apple Wraps
ingredients: 1 package of pre-made french bread, crusts removed | 2 cups prepared sourdough sandwich rolls | 1 cup chicken strips | 1/2 cup prepared sweet and sour mix | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 6 small slices peeled apples, such as granny smith | 1/3 cup french baguette, cut into 6 equal sized strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Arrange 2 slices of the bread onto a large baking sheet.  Mix the chicken strips, sweet and sour mixes, red chili flakes, and turbinado sugar in a small bowl.  Spoon the mixture onto the bread slices, distributing the sweet and sour mix to evenly cover the bread.  Layer 3 apple slices over the chicken mixture, dividing evenly.  Top each with remaining 1/2 of the bread.  Sprinkle each sandwich lightly with about half the mixture.  Bake in the preheated oven until the tops of the bread are nicely browned and the tops are crisp, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,milk chocolate chip,chicken bouillon granule,english mustard,dill
title: Quick Cauliflower, Cream Dip
ingredients: 1 package cauliflower flakes ( frozen in a little water ) | 1/4 cup milk chocolate chips | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 teaspoon dry dill, chopped | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard ( or dijon ) | 1/4 teaspoon instant english-style mustard
instructions: Put all ingredients in an oven safe serving bowl and mix well.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour, stirring the ingredients after 3 hours because the cauliflower is delicate and creamy.

Random Ingredients: szechwan pepper,asian chili sauce,cotija cheese,lemon grass,red cabbage,chile pepper,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Vietnamese Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 red cabbage, cored, shredded | 3 small fresh chile peppers, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons peanut butter ( may use low-fat ) | 3 tablespoons asian chili sauce ( may use sriracha ) | 3 tablespoons dried lemon grass, chopped | szechwan pepper, to taste ( optional ) | cotija cheese, crumbled ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together cabbage, chile peppers and peanut butter.  Stir in chili sauce and lemon grass, if using.  Season to taste with szechwan pepper if using.  Cover and chill 1 hour or overnight.  Serve with cotija cheese, if desired.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper seasoning,leg lamb,anchovy fillet,oyster sauce,sage leaf
title: Grilled Scotch Barbecued Lamb
ingredients: 1 leg of lamb | 1/2 teaspoon dried lemon pepper seasoning | 1/2 ounce dried thyme leaves ( or oregano ) | 6 ounces anchovy fillets ( drained and chopped ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Combine all herbs in large bowl, and coat lamb well with marinade and seal well.  Put in a well oiled grill and cook on medium heat for 45 minutes, turning once, or until cooked as desired.

title: Sausage Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup ( low fat ) | 1 lb pork sausages
instructions: Combine the soup and sausages.  Cook sandwiches in a skillet.  You might have to use a little water depending on how thick the sausage is.  I like mine with a bit more than normal for this.  They only take a little bit of work but don`t skimp.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,kaffir lime leaf,bread,green bean,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Green Beans With Beans and Chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canned chipotle chiles, chopped, plus a little extra | fresh-crusty bread, to serve | cooking spray | 1 lb fresh green beans | 2 kaffir lime leaves, torn
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a small shallow baking dish, combine chiles with a tbsp of chipotle chile infused cooking spray, spread evenly and top with an arugula leaf.  Toast beans on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper for about 10 minutes, until crisp.  Meanwhile, spray sprouts with oil, and bake until tender.  Drain oil, and serve sprouts on a platter with wedges of kaffir lime leaf and crispy chile.  Serves.

title: Korean Rice and Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup short quinoa | 2 cups navy beans, cooked and drained, cut in 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup korean cooking wine, chilled ( kimchee ) | 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons kirsch
instructions: Bring water to boil in large saucepan over high heat.  Add quinoa.  Remove from heat.  Cover.

title: Dirty Milk Powder for Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 4 cups nonfat dry milk powder | 1 cup fat-free chicken broth | 2 1/2 tablespoons amaretto | 3/4 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat, stir the dry milk powder, chicken broth, amaretto, cardamom, and cardamom together until the mixture is completely dissolved.

title: Mustard seed and Onion Chops
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mustard seeds, or to taste | 1 pound very thin sirloin slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Place mustard seeds in a small skillet over medium heat.

title: Easy Balsamic Glaze for Beef - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: balsamic vinegar, 1/3 cup per pound | 18 ounces mild enchilada sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pressure cooker.  Secure lid.  Add water to pressure cooker, cover and cook on high pressure until steam escapes.  Dial gauge pressure should be just 1/2 inch above top of pressure cooker.  Reduce heat to low and cook for 6 minutes.  Remove from heat and wait 7 minutes.  Flip heat off, fluff with fork and let sit for 5 minutes before transferring onto a serving dish.

title: Real Simple Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups grated pecorino romano cheese, divided | 5 tablespoons shortening
instructions: Place 1/4 cup shredded cheese in a clean saucepan, and melt with shortening.  Stir in remaining cheese until well blended and pour into hot pasta.

title: Matouk Salami (Potatoes)
ingredients: 12 small matouk ( sweet green seasoning ) | tomato ketchup ( to taste, i use tomato ketchup )
instructions: First you need to wash your matouk.  Cut into 6 slices.  Arrange around the inside of a baking pan so that they resemble a grid.  I like to make a grid to ensure that the potato has a good diagonal pattern on both the sides, then bake at 220 c for 20 minutes.  After the 20 minutes, remove from oven.  Allow the potatoes to stand for 5 minutes, then take the potatoes out and allow to stand with the grid on top.  Allow your tomatoes to cool and become mushy.  This should give you 2 cups of mushy mashed potatoes.  Once all the potatoes have been prepared, combine with the ketchup.  Allow to cool down.  Store in refrigerator.

title: Kiwi Almond Soup
ingredients: 4 kiwi fruits | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon saffron threads | 2 tablespoons blanched slivered almonds
instructions: Trim and peel the kiwi fruit, then cut through the fruit in coarse matchsticks and peel again if desired.  Combine the bouillon crystals and milk and heat over medium heat, stirring frequently.  Pour 1 1/2 cups of hot milk mix into a blender or food processor along with all the kiwi fruit.  Blend or process until smooth and lump free, 1 to 2 minutes.  Strain through cheesecloth or a fine mesh sieve lined with cheesecloth.  Transfer to a soup bowl and stir in 1 tablespoon of chopped almonds.  Serve hot.

title: Grilled Fresh Chipotle
ingredients: 6 slices olive ( about 1/2 inch thick ) | 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
instructions: Heat a grill pan or grill pan set to medium high heat or 550 degrees f.  Coat the side of a grilled or broiler pan or grill pan with cooking spray.  Combine the olive and chipotle peppers with adobo sauce.  Grill or broil the ingredients, turning as needed, until the peppers are hot throughout.  Cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,curry powder,lard,cheese food,phyllo pastry,ancho chile,galangal,oil olive
title: Frogalangas (Baked Stuffed Calamari)
ingredients: 12 large florgingalangal | 1/2 cup oil ( olive or any cooking oil ) | 1/2 cup fresh grated mexican cheese food | 1 fresh curry powder ( or less to taste ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile, crumbled | 2 teaspoons ground ancho chile ( optional ) | 1 lb phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup italian style breadcrumbs ( to bind the dough ) | 3 tablespoons oil ( olive or other cooking oil ) | 1/4 cup oil ( olive or other cooking oil )
instructions: Soak the fritters in warm water for about 10 minutes, just to soften them.  Drain.  Cut the bottom edge off the fillet and cut at 1/4 inch depth.  Take a piece of phyllo dough and cut around the fritters to form a 3 inch circle and then cut along the top edge.  The circle should not be entirely closed, but not loose.  Repeat these steps until the fritters are stuffed.  Place the circles on a lightly oiled rimmed baking sheet.  To make the curry sauce, heat the oil in a large skillet and cook the curry powder over medium heat until fragrant, stirring often.  Add the cheese food, garlic, crushed ancho pepper and ground ancho pepper and cook over medium heat until the cheese is well incorporated with the curry sauce.  To assemble and bake, preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.  Grease two baking sheets.  Remove one of the fillets from the water and pat dry on both sides with paper towels.  Place the oil and bread crumbs on a plate and add the strips, cut side down on top of the fillet.  Place the fritters in a single layer in each baking sheet, making sure to cover the fillet completely with the curry sauce mix and then brush or lightly sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Repeat with the remaining fillets.  Bake the fillets on middle shelf of the oven for 18 minutes until the tops are golden brown and the fish flakes easily with a fork.  To serve, remove the fillets from the oven and brush with warmed curry sauce.

Random Ingredients: chive,garlic crouton,pork loin roast,chipotle chile,white chocolate
title: Chipotle Beef Loin Roast
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced chipotle chile | 2 tablespoons minced garlic-flavored croutons | 2 tablespoons minced chives | 1 medium boneless pork loin roast | 1 ounce white chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven to 300 degrees.  Using a sharp knife or mandoline, poke the meat several times with a sharp knife.  Remove the meat from the freezer, and scrape all the slices of meat with the tip of the knife.  This should leave a large piece of meat relatively intact.  Insert garlic powder into the meat at the intervals of 1 tbsp and a little garlic pepper.  Put the meat into a roasting pan.  Sprinkle chopped chilies into the pan, and evenly distribute croutons over the top.  Put baking pan in your oven for about 2 hours, checking it after 1 hour to make sure the internal temp is 140 degrees.  When an instant read thermometer reads 180 degrees, remove from oven, and let it rest for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, stir the white chocolate into the melted white chocolate.  Slice the meat thinly against the grain, and spoon the white chocolate sauce into serving dishes.  Serve with chips for dipping.

title: Swiss and Cabbage Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs cabbage ( about 2 c ) | 1/2 cup cannellini beans, drained ( reserve 2/3 cup liquid ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, grated ( or cheddar )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Scrub cabbage leaves well.  Put cabbage leaves in large pot of boiling water and cook until almost tender.  Remove from water and let cool completely.  Cut cabbage leaves into quarters, about the length of a large biscuit.  Set aside.  Place remaining ingredients in a large casserole dish and bake at 350 degrees f for about 30 minutes.  Add cabbage.  Heat briefly.

title: Pesto Spinach Salad
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh spinach | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 1 shallot, chopped | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Wash spinach under cold running water until water runs clear.  Drain, cool and chop.  Place in bowl with raisins, shallots and vinegar.  Toss to coat.  Cover and chill for at least 1 hour or overnight.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,vanilla ice cream,chocolate chip,italian herb seasoning,garlic oil,spinach
title: Simple and Tasty Crispy Chicken Wraps!
ingredients: 1 bag frozen spinach | 1 bag chicken tenders ( or any crispy or meat of your choice ) | 1 teaspoon italian herb seasoning | 2 tablespoons garlic oil | 4 tablespoons miniature chocolate chips ( for rolling ) | 4 tablespoons italian herb flavored sprinkles ( for sprinkling )
instructions: Defrost the spinach and set aside to defrost while you prep your other veggies and other stuffing ingredients.  Tear or cut the chicken into smaller chunks as desired.  I like to dice the chicken into small cubes as it is easier to work with, this is your stuffing since it is frozen.  Heat up the garlic oil on medium low in a large skillet.  Once the oil is hot start tossing in the chicken pieces.  Season with one side of the herb seasoning, turn and sprinkle the other side the rest ofthe herb seasonings.  Cook for about 10 minutes on each side, or until the chicken is cooked through and lightly browned on the outside.  As you work the chicken through the pan make sure it doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan.  After about 7 minutes add enough water to cover the chicken.  Cover the pan and bring to a boil.  Turn down the heat to simmer.  Let cook for about another 10 minutes.  Once the chicken and water are simmering take the spinach out of the freezer.  Using a colander, drain the spinach and squeeze out as much moisture as possible from it.  Discard any excess water and put back in the bowl.  Add the spinach and stir.  Remove from the heat and stir in the chocolate chips.  Taste for seasoning, adding additional seasoning to suit your own preferences.  Serve with your favourite pasta dish, veggies and crudites.  Note, you can use frozen chopped spinach, defrosted, it will be softer than packaged spinach.  You can also use fresh or frozen chopped spinach to flavor your pizza dough.

title: Mole
