Random Ingredients: chicken breast strip,cardamom pod,oregano,scallion,mushroom,grain rice,okra,dijon mustard
title: Chicken and Okra Stir Fry
ingredients: 300 g stir fry mushrooms | 1/2 cup okra | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 chicken breast fillet, boneless and skinless | 150 g sliced mushrooms | 5 teaspoons dry oregano, dried | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom pods | 2 scallions, white and green parts, sliced
instructions: Cook the mushrooms in boiling water for 1 minute and drain.  Place the okra, mustard, mushrooms, and chicken in a large bowl.  Season with oregano and cardamom, pour over the mix and toss until the vegetables are coated with everything.  Set aside.  Heat a wok over high heat just until very hot.  Add the marinated veg and sear for about 30 seconds each side or until just cooked through.  Transfer the mix to a large plate and set aside.  Wipe out the wok.  Reheat it over high heat.  Add the scallions and sear for 2 minutes or until they are wilted.  Remove the scallions and keep warm.  Add the rice to the hot wok and stir fry for 3 minutes or until it has darkened a little.  Season the mix with salt and pepper and add the okra stir fry for further 3 minutes.  Serve with a garnish of scallions.

title: Herbed Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 1 ounce mixed herbs ( coriander, oregano, basil, rosemary )
instructions: Soak in cold wash and remove any extra tissue or excess moisture.  Rinse well and dry thoroughly.  Place chicken wings on a non stick rack and add a mixture of herbs and dried herbs.  Turn the chicken wings over and allow to marinate for at least 1 hour and up to a day.

title: Salmon Pie
ingredients: 1 pastry for double-crust pie | 2 cans salmon, drained | 1 can applesauce | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Roll out crust pastry, cut four 6 inch squares and bake at 450 f for 12 minutes.  Put salmon, applesauce and celery salt in bottom of pie crust.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,arborio rice,dark brown sugar,butter,green apple,sirloin,asiago cheese
title: Apple & Asiago Risotto
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups arborio rice | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted | 1 small green apple, such as fuji, diced | 1/2 lb thinly sliced sirloin, cut into bite-sized pieces | 12 ounces asiago cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 1/4 cups grated asiago cheese ( for sprinkling ) or 1 1/4 cups gruyere cheese, coarsely grated ( for sprinkling )
instructions: In a saucepan of boiling water, cook arborio for 10 to 12 minutes until just tender.  Stir in melted butter until well blended.  Add diced apple, sirloin, and 1/2 cup grated cheese and stir until well mixed.  Remove from heat.  Add the orange zest and remaining 1/2 cup grated cheese.  Let cheese melt, 5 to 10 minutes or until creamy.  Serve hot.  Note, i always use fresh grated asiago cheese and am guessing at the correct seasonings for this recipe.  Also, this recipe calls for 1 1/4 3/4 cups water to be added to the cooking liquid at the end to bring out the crisp creamy flavor.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,pork loin chop,tamari,green red bell pepper,chicken stock,lite olive oil,dill pickle
title: German Pork Chops on Pickles (Hutzelmesussen Nachosse)
ingredients: 1 green pepper, sliced into 1/4 inch half moons | 1 red bell pepper, sliced into 1/4 inch half moons | 1 lb pork loin chop | 3 -4 tablespoons lite olive oil | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill pickles | 1 cup chicken stock
instructions: Brush the outside of the pork chops with olive oil and place under the broiler, on medium heat, until they are toasty brown on the edges and almost cooked through.  Turn when they are a good distance from the eye and the meat slightly charred in places.  Serve the grilled chops with some pickles and pickles.  Variation, use sliced pork loin chops instead of pork chops.  Note, pickles are thin and can be made into strips.  If you are planning on eating a hot dog bun, cut off the tip of the wedge and scoop out the inside with a teaspoon or so of the wedge, then put the wedge inside the bun, and wrap the opposite half of the bun in pickles while you roll the meat.  Serve with a salad and bread, your way with fries.  If doing this, a cold new book, has two versions at hand.  If preparing the sandwich according to your usual method of eating the food, serve with bread and butter, crackers to pickles and pickles.  Note, use sliced pork loin chops instead of pork chops.  Note, pickles and pickles can be made into strips.  Note, the meat is now cooked and the pickles can be shredded with a fork.

title: Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: 12 strawberries, washed but whole | 125 g powdered saffron threads
instructions: Put 4 - 5 cups water in a saucepan.  Wash the strawberries then rinse them under cold water and drain them.  Place the strawberries in the pan and fry them on medium heat with the saffron until they are soft and all the liquid has been absorbed.  Add in the powdered saffron and simmer until thickened.  Add in 1 1/2 cups of water, stirring continuously until hot.

title: Beef With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut in 5-6 serving sizes ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained lightly, and cut into thin strips ( see note ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 325 degrees.  Lay the beef on a cutting board and sprinkle or use a paper towel.  Spread the beef with half the oyster sauce over the meat.  Turn beef over and spread the remaining sauce evenly.  Cover with a lid and roast the beef in the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is very tender.  Let beef stand for a few minutes, then slice thinly and serve with steamed rice.  Note, the sun dried tomato can be omitted if using dried tomatoes.

title: Italian Noodle Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup flour | 2 jars spaghetti sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.  Place beef, flour and spaghetti sauce in a 9x13 pan. .  Spread evenly.  Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Tunisian Harissa
ingredients: 1 can of harissa ( any spice of choice ) | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1/3 cup water | 2 teaspoons freshly chopped parsely
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and marinate at least an hour or more.  Serve with bread or pita.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,phyllo dough,grainy mustard,breadcrumb,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Cheese-Filled Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs phyllo dough, defrosted according to package directions | 1 lb loaf breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 4 teaspoons fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon grainy mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f mix the bread crumbs, cheese, mustard, and lemon juice in a bowl with a fork to combine well.  Add the phyllo dough and mix thoroughly until it is thoroughly coated with the spice mixture.  Using a pastry brush, generously brush the phyllo dough with olive oil and then lightly coat with oil and dust again with flour.  Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes.  Cool completely before handling.  Store phyllo in an airtight plastic container.  You may prepare the phyllo rolls after mixing the phyllo dough and making them as above.

title: Chop Suey
ingredients: 2 veal shanks | 3 1/2 fluid ounces milk | 3 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 ounce hot sauce | 6 tablespoons cocoa | 1 tablespoon basil, chopped | 3 tablespoons chopped vegetables
instructions: Place the veal shanks and milk in a roasting tin.  Season with sugar and hot sauce, cover and roast at 190c for 2 hours.  Turn the pieces over, stir through the cocoa and herbs and return to oven for 20 minutes.  Turn oven down to 150c, cook 30 minutes.  Serve with boiled potatoes.

title: Low Fat Smothered Chicken
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken breasts | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºf.  Take one chicken breast and carefully remove all of the bones and fat.  Cut both into slices.  Then place the slices into a casserole dish which has been greased, and season with any other spices you like.  Pour just enough water to cover the chicken, then cover the pan.  Place the chicken onto the middle rack of the oven and roast for approximately 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and lightly browned, taking approximately 20 minutes or more in the oven.  Remove all the bones and place chicken onto a tray and tent them with foil to cool.  Once cool transfer everything into a storage bag.  The chicken will last for 6 - 12 months.

title: Smooth, Healthy and Delicious Potato Pancakes (Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 1/3 lb baking potato, cut into fries | 2 cups broth | 2 cups wheat germ | olive oil ( i use sunflower ) | 1 liter molasses ( i use balsamic ) | 3 tablespoons dried currant jelly
instructions: Cook the potato in a little water, or a drop of olive oil mixed with vinegar.  Leave to drain.  Meanwhile, melt the molasses in a bowl, adding the currant jelly and set aside.  Boil the broth until it has reduced by about half.  Mix the potatoes with the molasses, and then transfer to a food processor.  Puree until smooth.  Add the wheat germ and mix inches heat the oven to 200 degrees c or 390 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Oil the sides and bottom of a heavy saucepan with a little olive oil.  Spoon potato/broth mixture into pan with the wet ingredients.  Sprinkle with wheat germ to taste.  Cook 20 - 30 minutes or until the top is light brown underneath and just firm enough to flip.  Variation you can add about 1 cup chopped fresh mushrooms or onions after cooking the rest.  Variation for mushrooms & onions, cook the potato until just tender.  Drain, and rinse under hot water.  When cool, chop roughly.

title: Tajine Ka-Chek Style Baked Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes, halved ( or 1 1/2 pounds of potatoes cut in half again ) | garlic salt | 2 tablespoons whole cilantro ( or 1 bunch fresh parsley ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 - 2/3 cup crushed pineapple ( or any dried diced fruit and optional toppings )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºf.  Place whole potatoes and 1/3 cup cilantro in a large casserole dish and sprinkle with garlic salt.  Pour in 1/4 cup cayenne pepper, followed by 1/2 teaspoon cumin and 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder then add remaining 1/4 cup cayenne pepper and/or 1/2 cup crushed and crushed pineapple. .  If making just two large batches, you may put the first batch in a water bath to dry the whole lot.  Cover the dish, and bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until tender.  If making larger batches, cover and bake for the full 20 - 30 minutes.  Take out of the oven, cover with foil, and set pan on burner.  Let stand for at least 10 minutes before serving.  Garnish with more cayenne, cilantro, or chopped parsley if desired.  Note, the yield will vary based on type of potato.  I just make a 1 in.  Pie, and cut up about a cup of potatoes into 1 in cubes, and put the cubes on the table for people to help themselves.  Dont be afraid to do things like using your hands, it's a lot of fun this way.  If you make this for a group and feed some, it will be less stressful and you will end up putting more potatoes on the table.  My family likes my potatoes so i keep a small pot of water in the fridge overnight, then i leave the water in the fridge when we're preparing it for my kids too.

title: Mexican Snow Peas and Pistachio Nests
ingredients: 20 snow peas | 1/2 cup salsa ( mild or medium ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped pistachio nuts ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons strong tea
instructions: Steam the snow peas, covered, for 8 minutes, then take off the heat and let the peas dry out to your liking.  You want to let them sit a while, then drain.  Blend or process them until they are really fine.  Set aside.  Stir the peas into the salsa and heat slightly, stirring constantly.  Pour the mixture into an airy serving bowl and sprinkle with pistachios, if using.

title: Italian Wedding Cakes
ingredients: 1 pound shrimp - peeled, deveined and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 2 cups confectioners'sugar, or as needed - divided | 3 tablespoons instant coffee
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix shrimp with italian herb seasoning.  On a floured surface, mix cake flour and 2 eggs.  Gradually mix in shrimp mixture.  Sprinkle confectioners' sugar over the top.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Drop the dough by rounded tablespoons 2 inches apart onto the boiling water.  Cook for 3 minutes, or until dough is slightly dente.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,demerara sugar,molasses,flour tortilla,green pepper,fruit preserve
title: Pizzelles With Puff Pastry
ingredients: 1 prepared 10 inch flour tortillas | 1 cup strawberry preserves ( jiffy brand suggested ) | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherry, sliced ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons green peppers, chopped ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons fruit preserves | 1 teaspoon demerara sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Prepare a pizzelle iron according to your manufacturer's directions.  Place one tortilla in the center of the machine.  Add a spoonful of the strawberry preserves, jam, molasses, cherries and green peppers to the tortilla.  Roll up into a cone with no openings.  Place cone in heated pizzelle iron and cook until crisp and dark.  Remove from iron.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,milk,vegetable oil cooking spray,butter bean,tomato green pepper onion,prosciutto
title: Butter Bean, Prosciutto and Snow Peas
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons butter beans | 1 tablespoon buttermilk | 1 teaspoon milk | 1 pinch salt and pepper | 1 slice prosciutto, toasted, torn into small pieces, and crushed | 1 tomato and green pepper and onion, sliced
instructions: In a medium sized saucepan, combine beans and buttermilk.  Cover and cook over low heat for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beans soften and have released their liquid.  Remove from heat, stir in butter and milk and season with salt and pepper.  Toss to mix and set aside until cool.  Heat a medium skillet over medium high heat.  Add slices of prosciutto and cook, stirring frequently, for 3 minutes or until golden.  Top with vegetables and ham slices and serve immediately.

title: Pan Seared Chiles
ingredients: 3 -4 small red chilies, seeded and deveined | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon corn flakes, crushed or 1 tablespoon coarse corn flour
instructions: Rinse the chiles under running water, rubbing off all the dirt and sand.  Heat a heavy skillet or wide frying pan over high heat until a bead of water sizzles.  Add chiles and continue shaking the pan to evenly coat with any oil which has collected on top but before it reaches smoking point.  Immediately add fish sauce, corn flakes and saute for 30 seconds to 1 minute or so to heat through.  Drizzle sauce over chiles.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,bacon,grain rice,triple sec,corn,cream mushroom soup,rotel tomato,button mushroom
title: Slow Cooker Chicken-Rice Dish
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, rind removed ( can use more ) | 3 lbs chicken thighs, skin on | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1 can creamed corn | 1 teaspoon triple sec | 1 bag sliced button mushroom | cooked medium-grain rice
instructions: Place bacon in a large skillet.

Random Ingredients: beef base,irish cream,heavy whipping cream,lemon juice zest,iceberg lettuce,cumin powder,garlic salt,anaheim chili
title: Creamy Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce ( or other green leaf lettuce ) | 2 anaheim chili, hot peppers seeded | 1 jar roasted garlic salt | 12 ounces beef base | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | iceberg lettuce 1/2 inch slices fresh chili pepper
instructions: Clean, dry, tear, and tear the lettuce or leaf lettuces into large pieces.  Slice anaheim chiles in half, remove the seeds and ribs, and chop finely.  Place in large pot of boiling water, cover, decrease heat to medium, and simmer 2 - 3 minutes or until peppers begin to soften.  Drain, remove stems, and finely chop chili peppers.  Combine garlic salt, cumin, lemon juice and zest in blender, blend until well mixed.  Strain mixture through a sieve placed in a medium bowl, stir in heavy whipping cream and add to chili mixture.  Mix well and chill.  Note, if you want to be fancy, serve the chili hot or cold.  If you like a little kick, toss 2 tbsp of chili infused vodka into sauce in a small bowl.  Use this lovely simple dipping sauce for shrimp, chicken or fish.

Random Ingredients: tofu,plain yogurt,black peppercorn,garlic,spanish onion,potato flour,lemon pepper
title: Spicy Tofu Balls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain fat-free yogurt | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon chopped garlic | 1/2 teaspoon spanish-style onions ( diced ) | 1 package tofu ( diced ) | 1 teaspoon potato flour | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine yogurt, lemon pepper, garlic, onion and tofu.  Mix well.  Set aside.  In another medium bowl, mix potato flour with cracked black peppercorns.  Dip balls in yogurt mixture and roll in peppercorns.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,thyme sprig,kaffir lime leaf,self raising flour,egg yolk
title: Herby Rosemary and Kaffir Lime Scones
ingredients: 3 lbs self-raising flour | 8 ounces kaffir lime leaves, freshly chopped | 6 tablespoons thyme sprigs, picked | 1 rosemary, finely chopped | 3 egg yolks
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450 degrees f.  Put 2 tablespoons of the chopped green leaves and the fresh rosemary into a bowl with the remaining chopped green leaves and half the thyme, then mix thoroughly.  Add the beaten egg yolks, stir to combine, then knead gently until smooth.  Turn the dough onto a lightly floured work surface and divide into 14 even sized pieces.  Roll each piece and cut out with a 4 ounce scone cutter.  Place on a lightly greased biscuit tray and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden, and well risen.  Leave on a wire rack to cool slightly.  Serve warm with a good butter or cream.

Random Ingredients: miso,guacamole,chili garlic sauce,kaffir lime leaf,white onion
title: Bunuelo Street Tacos
ingredients: 6 ounces guacamole | 1/4 cup white onion, halved and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon black miso ( shiro or laksi ) | 1/8 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce ( such as tabasco ) | 24 kaffir lime leaves ( available in any asian grocery store )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Spoon into palm sized molds, or use a funnel to fill a cone shape in the middle to form a cone shape.  Serve with a tortilla chip.

Random Ingredients: banana,bamboo shoot,chipotle chile adobo,chili pepper flake,dill,italian sausage
title: Italian Sausage With Fruit & Chips Bits
ingredients: 1 lb sweet sausage, cut | 3 tablespoons dried chili pepper flakes or 3 tablespoons chipotle chile in adobo | 2 fresh basil leaves | 1 -3 tablespoon dried chipotle chile flakes ( if you can find a whole chile ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried dill or 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 1/2 - 1 lb banana, sliced in half lengthwise
instructions: Slice up the sausage into 1/3 slices and place into a non stick skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes.  Add the dried chili flakes or chili powder mix, basil and chipotles and stir, scraping any other ingredients that have stuck to the pan.  Sprinkle in the dill and put bacon through a strainer.  Stir and add to the pan.  Turn the heat to low and cover, stirring occasionally for 10 minutes.  The sausages and fruit will be done when the bacon is fully cooked and no longer dripping.  Eat with bread and/or french fries.

title: Fresh Veggies Tacos
ingredients: 6 corn tortilla strips | 3 cups mixed vegetables ( i've used all beans, zucchini, or red bell peppers ) | 1 teaspoon freshly ground star anise
instructions: Warm tortilla strips in microwave for about 15 seconds or until warm. .  Place a single or two tortilla strips on plate and cover with a third of mixed vegetables.  Sprinkle freshly ground star anise on top of vegetables.  Top with rest of tortilla strips and fold in both sides to form a taco shell shape.  Heat in microwave about three minutes.  Serve with sour cream, guacamole, salsa, cilantro, etc.

Random Ingredients: grapefruit juice,plain yogurt,madras curry powder,bailey irish cream
title: Golden Jubilee Smoothies
ingredients: 1 1 cup plain yogurt ( or almond slurry ) | 1 tablespoon biancan madras curry powder ( or other curry powder ) | 3/4 cup grapefruit juice | 1 tablespoon baileys irish cream
instructions: Drain the yoghurt in a colander and press the excess out onto a clean tea towel covered bowl.  Mix all the ingredients together in a jug and pour into an ice cream maker with 1/4 cup of natural juice.  Swirl or process until smooth, then freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Easy Weeknight Red Pepper Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce ( el pato brand ) | 1 small red bell pepper
instructions: Cut the red bell pepper into thin strips, about 1/4 x1/4.  In a large bowl add the contents of the enchilada sauce mix and red bell pepper.  Stir to combine and refrigerate for 1 hour to allow the flavors to meld.  Serve over brown rice.

title: Capellini (Aubergine) Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salad green, chopped | 1/2 orange, juice and grated zest of | 150 g roasted lean beef chuck, chopped into thin strips | 1 cup orange puree | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 2 medium eggplant, peeled and sliced | 450 g canned pumpkin puree | 3/4 cup cream
instructions: Mix salad green with the zest.  Remove excess fat from beef.  Put beef in a shallow, ovenproof casserole dish.  Toss with orange juice.  Pour over the orange juice and beef.  Cover and let stand for 1 hour at room temperature.  Combine the flour, eggplant slices and pumpkin purée until smooth.  Pour over the beef.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake in a moderate oven, covered, for 45 minutes.  Remove the cover and bake for another 10 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Linguine With Winter Squash and Sesame
ingredients: 2 2 lbs butternut squash peeled, seeded and cut into 1 inch cubes ( about 1 3/4 to 2 3/4 pounds ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons baking soda | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon soy sauce ( optional ) | 12 ounces linguine
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add squash and cook 10 minutes or until tender but still firm.  Drain, and set aside.  In a large bowl, combine baking soda, hot pepper sauce and soy sauce.  Stir squash into baking soda mixture.  Add pasta and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or up to 3 days.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,pork fillet,baking soda,corn,safflower oil corn,red chile pepper,swordfish fillet,spanish rice
title: Aussie Safflower and Red Chili
ingredients: 1/4 pound swordfish fillet, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons safflower oil or corn oil | 1/2 pound cubed scotch bonnet chuka pork fillet | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 4 tablespoons hot spanish-style rice | 1 teaspoon crushed red chile pepper | 2 cups small cut corn
instructions: Place swordfish in a bowl with the safflower oil and toss to coat.  Cover and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 8 hours.  Heat safflower oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Cook, stirring, the chuka and pork in the oil, stirring, until golden brown on the outside.  Pour in baking soda, stir, and mix until well mixed.  Add corn, and stir to blend.  Arrange shrimp or fish on the surface of mixture, and sprinkle with red chilly pepper.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: rump steak,flat leaf italian parsley,banana,sesame seed,beef stew meat,chicken stock
title: Steamed Beef and Bananas
ingredients: 2 lbs rump steak | 4 -6 large bananas | 1 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 cup sesame seeds | 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Cut the steak into cubes.  Soak the banana in ice water for 10 minutes then drain the liquid off of the bananas and cut off the peel.  Cut into 1 cubes and set aside.  Prepare the stock.  Add the stock, parsley, sesame seeds, and steak to a sauceponng or deep vessel, and stir to mix.  Bring to a boil.  Steam the steak over high heat for 10 to 15 minutes.  Remove from water and set aside.  Set the oven to 325 degrees.  Pour off the oil from the meat, then put a pan on the burner and add a little olive oil.  Fry the meat with a pinch of salt until brown on all sides.  Put the steak back in the pan and pour in the stock and banana mixture, cover, and bake until the meat is tender and the liquid is reduced to about 1/2 and 20 minutes.  Put the meat back in the pan and warm through, then serve.

Random Ingredients: rum,vegetable,amarula cream liqueur,rice,salt black pepper,white mushroom
title: Mushroom Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice | 1 cup chopped mushrooms | 1/2 cup mirula sweet cream liqueur | 2 tablespoons amarula cream liqueur or 2 tablespoons grand marnier | canned vegetables ( optional ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a large salad bowl, toss the rice, mushrooms, and liqueur or grand marnier.  Cover and let stand 5 minutes or so, stirring occasionally.  Stir in the vegetables.  Adjust seasonings to taste.  Serve right away, or refrigerate for up to 1 week.

title: Tropical Bread
ingredients: 16 toothpicks | 2 teaspoons coconut extract | 4 cans refrigerated butter-flavored candies, crushed
instructions: Prepare an 8x8 glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Lay toothpicks out flat, spacing about 1 inch apart on baking sheets.  Sprinkle coconut extract onto each toothpick.  Pour the butter into a medium bowl and spread evenly over the toothpicks.  Cover the bowl loosely with waxed paper and a towel and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Unwrap toothpicks and remove the toothpicks.  Place the baking sheet on a wire rack and remove excess foil.  Bake the bread for 25 minutes.  Turn off oven.  Cool uncovered for 1 hour.  Turn oven off and let cake stand in water for a few minutes.  Use a metal spatula to remove toothpicks and cool completely and then cut into squares, serve with melted butter for dipping.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,wine vinegar,milk,thyme leave,apricot,mango chutney,apricot preserve
title: Apricot Sausages Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles | 1 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 cup sweetened condensed milk | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme leave | 2 cups apricot preserves | 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 1/8 cup milk
instructions: Cook lasagne according to directions on package.

title: Blueberry Pesto
ingredients: 1 quart fresh blueberries | 3/4 cup low-fat dried blueberries | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon oriental sesame oil, or use vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons celery, finely diced
instructions: In bowl, toss blueberries with red pepper flakes and allow to macerate about 20 minutes.  Transfer the blueberries to a blender and combine with remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: port wine,madeira wine,cinnamon,vermicelli,green cardamom,corn flake,lemon wedge
title: Port Madeira With Vermicelli and Cinnamon
ingredients: 1/2 cup madeira wine or 1/2 cup other sparkling wine | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/4 cinnamon stick | 2 tablespoons corn flakes | 4 -5 firm ripe port wine or 4 -5 cognac | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh lemon rind | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh lemon wedge
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a blender and process for 30 seconds or until smooth, then set aside.  Rim a 10 inch quiche pan with several layers of reynolds wrap heavy aluminum foil or some foil and grease.  Pour the port wine into the pan and cook over a very low heat, stirring frequently, until the syrup coats the back of a spoon, around 7 - 10 minutes.  Pour the syrup over the vermicelli.

title: Hot Crab with Beans
ingredients: 1 package frozen green beans, thawed and drained | 1 pound imitation crabmeat, cubed | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Lightly grease a large baking dish.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Slowly stir in the green beans and continue to cook and stir until crisp tender but still firm, about 5 minutes.  Place the cooked green beans into the prepared baking dish.  Place crabmeat into a medium bowl and drizzle with lemon pepper, tossing to coat completely.  Top the crab with green bean mixture.  Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until heated through and crabmeat is hot and melted.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,chipotle chile adobo,roasting chicken,pea,chicken breast half,apricot preserve,pork tenderloin,paprika
title: Cajun Chicken (Turkey)
ingredients: 4 ounces chicken breast halves | 4 ounces pork tenderloin | 3 ounces mozzarella cheese | 1/4 teaspoon sweet paprika | 2 1/2 ounces chicken breast halves | 16 ounces apricot preserves | 1 chipotle chile in adobo | 4 ounces chopped peas ( any fruit )
instructions: Cut each pork shoulder in half lengthwise.  Cut crosswise into 8 equal pieces.  Season both sides of chicken pieces with some of the paprika.  Wrap each piece in foil.  Place in a ziplock for at least 30 minutes.  Remove all the meat from the zipper.  Dry on paper towels.  Reserve the marinade in the ziplock bag.  Grill chicken until no longer pink and juices run clear.  Slice 1/4 thick and 2 1/2 thick.  Cut into 1/2 slices.  Place in a bowl.  Place mozzarella in a slice tin.  Slice the chicken, 1/4 thick, on a cutting board and roll each slice with the cheese.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,half,oyster sauce,porcini mushroom,self rising flour,celery seed,parmigiano reggiano cheese,sun tomato oil
title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Cheese Pierogi
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/3 cup chopped fresh chipped celery seed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh porcini mushrooms | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 3 tablespoons chopped grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 teaspoon ground celery seed | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 2 cups dry shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup white cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Make the pesto with the sun dried tomatoes, celery seeds, porcini mushrooms, and 1/2 cup half and half in a blender or food processor.

title: Black Eyed Peas, Blueberries, and Corn on the Grill
ingredients: 8 ears fresh back corn, shucked | 2 packages dried black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Put a grill pan on the gas grill and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source.  Lay the corn and black eyed peas onto the grill, close the cover, and grill until the kernels are tender, about 5 minutes.  Turn the corn and black eyed peas onto a platter and spoon the black eyed peas over the top.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,almond extract,currant,allspice,lime wedge,lemongrass,whipping cream,splenda sugar substitute
title: Lemongrass & Carrots Fool
ingredients:
2 3/4 lbs baby carrots ( or 1 15-oz.
    - bagged peeled baby carrots ) | 1/3 cup currants or 1/3 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon lemongrass ( or 3 small bulbs thinly sliced lemongrass ) | 3/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons lime juice, fresh | 2 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute
instructions: Peel the carrots, if using baby carrots, and halve them if using bagged baby carrots, cut the tips off the lemongrass stalks and set aside. Random Ingredients: white peppercorn,pimiento,almond flavoring,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Amish Peppercorn Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely blanched slivered almonds | 1 3/4 cups white peppercorns, coarsely ground | 1 can del monte chopped pimiento with fruit | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f degrees.  Place almonds in a shallow oven proof skillet.  Pour enough oven to drape a double layer of paper towels over them.  Bake 20 to 30 minutes, or until the almonds turn a very light golden brown.  Sprinkle with peppercorns and cool at room temperature.  Unroll and pat dry with towel.  Coarsely chop cooled almonds and set aside.  Transfer the nuts to a bowl, along with pimientos, and enough pepper oil to moisten.  Spread out nut mixture on a cookie sheet to cool.  Spray the nut mixture with oil and sprinkle lightly with sugar.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes, or until light brown.  Remove from oven.  Transfer to plates.

title: Pancakes
ingredients: 200 g snow peas | 200 g sweet potatoes ( kumara ) | 4 teaspoons plain flour | 1 spring onion, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c or 400°f.  Pierce the sweet potato in 5mm holes with a sharp knife.  Place the potato on to a baking paper lined tray, and bake for about 30 minutes, turning a couple of times, until brown.  Set aside.  Place snow peas in a steamer, place in a pot, cover and steam for 5 minutes, or until the peas are cooked and tender.  Remove the peas and mash well.  Place the flour on a board, and gently fold in the chopped spring onion.  Shape the mixture into small oval pancakes, about 10cm in diameter.  Wrap a small piece of tin foil with the hanging saran wrap.  Heat a small frying pan over a medium heat, add a teaspoonful of the pancake mixture, and fry until both sides are golden, turning once.  Spread the pancake with a little canola oil and top with spring onion if desired.

title: Coffee Crunchy Crawfish
ingredients: 1 lb raw crawfish tail | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 ounce espresso
instructions: Place crawfish tail in a bowl, pour hot water over, and let stand about 10 minutes.  Peel crawfish tail while still warm.  Remove tails and discard.  Pat crawfish completely dry.  Heat corn oil in medium saucepan or frypan, stirring until hot but not smoking.  Drop in crawfish tails, lower heat, and cook about 3 minutes, stirring as necessary, until golden.  If crawfish tails have begun to swell during cooking, cook 1 minute more.  Drain crawfish immediately in strainer lined with a paper towel.  Serve warm, garnished with a scoop of espresso.

instructions: Combine the ingredients into a large bowl.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Grease your tortillas before cooking.  Wrap tortillos in foil and place on wire rack in a baking dish.  Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Cook for 15 - 17 minutes until slightly crispy.  Top with toppings.

title: Taco Shell Tacos

title: Pears Barley

title: Noodles, Risotto, and Pepperoni Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 package of japanese noodles | 2 cans condensed farfalle or ( 16 ounce ) cans other short cooked rice, any variety | 1/4 lb pepperoni, sliced thinly ( optional ) | 1/8 tablespoon liquid smoke or 1/8 tablespoon salt | 1/8 cup uncooked wide noodles or 1/8 cup any other short-grain rice
instructions: Start a small pot of water to boil for the noodles and cook according to package direction.  Meanwhile, heat one can of condensed rice with liquid smoke till the liquid smoke is gone. When noodles are done, drain noodles and add noodles & pepperoni together.  Heat for 3 - 5 minutes and enjoy.

title: Baked Italian Beef Roll Ups

title: Brown Rice 'n' Brown Casserole
ingredients: 1 onion soup mix | 1 1/2 kg brown rice | 1 carrot, grated | 2 scallions | 4 -6 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Cook the rice and onion mix in a microwave for about 7 minutes.  Put in a large mixing bowl with the grated carrot and scallions.  Use your hands to mix everything together.  Place the mixture in an ovenproof casserole, cover with foil and cook at c for 1 1/2 hours.  Serve with salad or mashed potatoes or make sandwiches by tearing a piece of tin foil into small squares and placing some slices into the bottom. Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,ro tel tomato,enriched flour,date,black cardamom pod,brandy
title: Rajma
ingredients: 2 cups enriched flour | 5 large pitted dates ( such as castelvetrano ) | 2 cups ro-tel tomatoes | 2 cups pitted kalamata olives ( such as gaeta ) | 2 tablespoons brandy | 3 -4 black cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon enriched flour
instructions: Combine a food processor with the flour to make a rough dough.  If the dough feels dry, add more flour.  Knead in the dates and olives.  Form into a ball, cover and refrigerate until needed.  When ready to use, preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Shape the dough into 3 or 4 even round balls.  Transfer the balls onto a lightly floured baking tray lined with parchment or liners.  Cover with a damp tea towel and allow to rest while you prepare the sauce.  Prick the tops with a fork and bake for 10 minutes until lightly browned and puffed.  Remove from the oven and immediately brush with a little olive oil.  Sprinkle with a little aged aceto anamchil.  Set aside.  In a medium saucepan over low heat, add the ro tel, cava brandy and cardamom pods.  Simmer until the ro tel is very soft and beginning to brown, 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove the ro tel from the heat and slowly incorporate the caramelized sauce, stirring to dissolve the flavors.  To serve, stack the cookies up on a platter and pour the ro tel sauce on top.  Allow to soak until the cookies are completely dry.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,chicken breast half,apricot preserve,horseradish sauce,kosher salt
title: Horseradish-Glazed Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish sauce | 1 tablespoon prepared grated fresh horseradish sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried apricot preserves | 1/8 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Spread 1/2 tablespoon horseradish sauce on each chicken breast half, then sprinkle the remaining 1 tablespoon horseradish sauce onto each breast half.  Sprinkle the cardamom seeds, apricot preserves, and salt onto each chicken breast, then set aside to marinate.  Preheat grill for high heat.  Lightly oil the grill grate.  Grill the chicken until the chicken is cooked to your desired degree of doneness, about 5 minutes per side.

title: Rigatoni With Chocolate, Tomato, and Chocolate
ingredients: 500 g uncooked rigatoni pasta or 500 g spaghetti pasta | 1 tablespoon chopped dry basil | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 medium tomatoes, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon shortening | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 3 tablespoons rice milk or 3 tablespoons cream
instructions: Heat 2 tablepoons of water to boiling in a large pan and add the pasta and basil.  Boil for 8 minutes, until the pasta is al dente.  Meanwhile, in a griddle pan, heat the butter and 1 tablespoon of the caster sugar in the remaining tablespoon of sugar until it darkens in colour slightly.  Add the tomatoes and fry together for 5 minutes.  Drain the pasta and return it to the pan and stir in half of the tomato mixture.  Dish immediately, then add the remaining tomato and stir to combine.  Ladle over the remaining sauce and sprinkle with the cocoa powder.  Serve the griddle pan of rago griddle hot.

title: Faux Cheesecake Dip
ingredients: 20 ounces cream cheese | 1 teaspoon prepared english mustard | 1 -2 teaspoon dark sesame oil, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl.  If you have added oil, you can just whisk this into the dip.  Transfer to refrigerator and let it set on the counter for the flavors to blend.  It's best to use an electric mixer for this.  Enjoy with a cracker, as it turns a pretty yellow color.

Random Ingredients: raisin,double cream,cardamom,flat leaf italian parsley,italian sausage,quinoa,vegetable oil cooking spray,green chili pepper
title: Semiya's Italian Quinoa Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb quinoa ( if you use fresh, use 1/4 cup water instead of 1/4 cup ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon cooking spray | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups chopped italian sausage or 2 cups pork sausage | 3 -4 green chili peppers, sliced thin or 3 -4 jalapeno peppers | 1/4 cup raisins or 1/4 cup craisins | 1/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup double cream
instructions: In 2 cup measure, measure the liquid out.  Measure out liquid from the measurement cup.  If you want a thicker sauce, measure out 1/4 cup.  If you want a thinner sauce, measure out 1/4 cup.  Cook quinoa in 2 1/2 cups boiling water in a heavy large pot for about 10 to 12 minutes or until tender.  Note, if you are using dried quinoa, cook it up in the microwave for 45 seconds or so until cooked completely, then drain and run your fingers over the quinoa to remove all excess water.  Set aside in a microwave safe container and microwave on high for 30 to 45 seconds or until heated through.  Set aside.  Meanwhile, in a large nonstick frying pan, heat oil or cooking spray over medium high heat.  If your using fresh sausage, sauté 2 minutes then add peppers and chiles, breaking up as you go.  Remove the pan from the heat.  When quinoa is done, add ingredients in the pan.  Combine well and let mixture simmer 10 to 15 minutes, or until the liquids have been absorbed and the flavors have blended.  Serve in individual dishes.  My note, i've tried other kinds of mexi, including quinoa.  The quinoa is my choice.  The recipe is super easy to put together and the sausages & meat were amazing.  I didn't use any other ingredients.  My family loved it, and loved the addition of raisins/raisins/chilis.  I made a couple of changes, i used julienned bell peppers and sliced them on the diagonal.  They gave it a little kick, too.  You could add dried tomatoes with juice.  You could use canned green chiles, chopped tomatoes and green chilis instead of fresh green peppers.  You could also add 2 teaspoons chili powder instead of one.  I did not use salt.  No 1/4 cup of the raisins/chilis was needed.  I made this as a side dish at a dinner party, and it turned out great.  I have made this again, and it is always great when served with garlic bread.

title: Hungarian Cheese & Onion Baked Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces angel hair pasta, prepared as directions indicate on package | 4 ounces goat cheese ( soft ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1 white onion, sliced thin | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoni ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Cook angel hair in boiling salted water for 3 minutes and drain.  Drain well and set aside.  Beat cream cheese & cornstarch together till creamy.  Spread over bottom of 9x13 baking dish.  Arrange cheese mixture over cream cheese.  Cover with sliced onion slices.  Sprinkle on spices and pepperoni.  Cover with aluminum foil and bake in oven 15 minutes.  Remove foil and bake 5 more minutes, just a couple of minutes longer to brown cheese.

title: Chicken or Pork Sauce

instructions: In a medium bowl, add the pork meat and chicken or pork fat, corn syrup, and cream.  Mix or knead the ingredients by hand until the meat is covered with the coating.  Put on a plate and let it sit in the fridge for 3 - 4 hours.  Cook until the fat solidifies on top.

title: Auntie Anita's Christmas Pies

instructions: Roll out the pastry to 1/4 thickness. .  Cut out four circles with a biscuit cutter.  Bake on a greased/oiled tray and allow to cool on a wire rack.  This is great because they will keep the pies fresh for 2 days.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,oil,cumin powder,lemon zest,onion soup mix
title: Easy Lemon Pepper Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons cumin powder ( can vary depending on taste ) | 3 tablespoons lemon zest | 1 tablespoon oil | 20 sheets phyllo dough | oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Mix onion soup powder, cumin powder, lemon zest, oil, and 1 tsp of salt together and put into a bowl.  Brush 2 sheets of phyllo dough with oil and cut into 3 inch squares.  Spoon the pepper mixture on top of the 2 sheets of phyllo dough, brushing each layer with oil so it doesn't stick or burn.  Using a serrated knife, cut in half diagonally.  Roll each half diagonally to double thickness.  Repeat and use more phyllo if needed.  Cut each roll into triangles.  Deep fry until golden brown.  Serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,stewing beef,red bell pepper,parmesan cheese,cumin,beef sirloin,chicken bouillon,sherry wine
title: Beef Risotto With Red Pepper Rellenos

instructions: Spray large covered pot with cooking spray.  Sprinkle the ground cumin evenly on the top of stew beef.  Add water until approximately 2/3 of the way up the pot.  Cover and simmer on low 10 minutes.  Discard liquid that has gathered around the meat.  Add the raspberries and sherry and simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes longer, or until red pepper and raspberries are tender and raspberries have burst.  Add bouillon and remaining ingredients, if using.  Taste and adjust seasoning.  Let stand, covered about 2 hours.  After 2 hours, taste for seasoning and adjust.  If you like your risotto thinner, thin with a bit of water.

title: Chinese Peppercorns

instructions: Put peppercorns in a small bowl and add enough water to cover the peppercorns.  Let sit 15 minutes or more.

title: Beef Hash Browns With Noodles

instructions: Mix the potato flakes with liquid smoke and marinade.  Cook the noodles as directed on the package.

instructions: Divide fennel bulb into 4 pieces and lightly pound in a mortar.  Divide pistachios and pistachios evenly among 8 plates for garnish.  Repeat process with remaining fennel pieces.  Serve eggs on the side with pistachios and pistachios on the side.

instructions: Mix cheese and potato with milk, mix well.  Fold in bread crumbs and preserves.  Put wedges onto cookie sheet.  Cover and shape into 12 round balls.  Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.  Just before serving, brush with italian dressing.

title: Spicy Chile Cream Cake
ingredients: 5 cups self-rising flour | 2 cups cold water | 1/2 cup honey, divided | ice cream, for frosting | 1/2 cup salsa verde | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 can hickory-flavored cocktail piquillo peppers, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  To make cake, in a large mixing bowl, combine flour and 1/2 cup of its water.  Make a well in the center, and pour 1/8 cup of water into the well.  Mix with a fork until mixture forms a loose dough.  Don’t overwork dough.  Dump dough into a pastry bag fitted with a large star tip.  Pipe a third of the batter into a 7 inch circle on a lightly floured surface.  Repeat with another 7 cubes, filling each circle with the batter and placing about 1 tablespoon of salsa verde and 1 tablespoon of chili paste in the middle of each.  Scoop 1/4 cup of shrimp cocktail over each, and close the outer edges with a toothpick.  Poke holes all over cakes with a fork all over the top, and place the cake in a roasting pan.  Bake for 45 to 50 minutes in the preheated oven, until a toothpick poked in the center of a cake comes out clean.  Allow to cool in pan for 5 minutes.  Remove from pan and allow to cool completely.  In a small bowl, mix 2/3 cup of the honey with the remaining 1/2 cup of water.  Remove toothpicks from cakes using a brush, and then frost with the honey mixture, and top with the remaining salsa verde and 1 tablespoon of chili paste.  Serve with cocktail piquillo salsa.

title: Skewered Salmon With Dried Chili
ingredients: 1 large carrot, peeled and sliced into thin rounds | 1 cup finely chopped chilies, seeded ( such as serrano or jalapeno ) | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger root | 1/2 cup dried apricots | 1/4 cup sliced ripe olives | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram, crushed | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: In a 10 inch saute pan over medium high heat, stir carrots and chilies until they begin to soften, about 3 minutes, then add gingerroot and apricots and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until tomatoes soften and peppers are softened, about 1 minute.  Stir in olives and marjoram and remove from heat.  Dividing evenly, place salmon in a large bowl.  Drizzle cocoa over, then spoon the hot chile over evenly.

title: White Chocolate Covered Onions- " Espitasas" (Escabeche De Los
ingredients: 8 ounces spanish onions, peeled ( preferably white or purple ) | 1 1/2 cups white chocolate ( i use semisweet )
instructions: Slice the onions in half and slice along the lengthwise until very thin.  Combine the white chocolate and 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan over low heat.  Bring the mixture to a slow boil and simmer until all the liquid has boiled off and the chocolate is melted.  Dip the onions in the melted chocolate and allow to cool.  Place the cooled chocolate in a bowl and dip the whole thing well in the chocolate to coat completely.  Store in the refrigerator.

title: Roasted Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 red bell pepper | 1/4 cup finely chopped candied lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Halve bell pepper, removing seeds if necessary.  Spread pepper halves with lemon peel, about 2 t. , on a large baking sheet.  Roast peppers in the preheated oven until the peel is charred, about 10 to 15 minutes, depending on the size of the pepper halves.  Transfer the roasted pepper halves to a resealable bag and seal tightly, about the peppers.  Let cool to room temperature.  Wash peppers and dry on paper towels.  Cut in pieces and serve warm or at room temperature.

instructions: Place the lentils and lemon grass in a deep pan along with the cardamon, chiles and serrano peppers.  Pour hot water on top, about 1 cup.  Boil for about 15 minutes, until it has thickened to a thick sauce, stirring occasionally.  Uncover, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are cooked.  Add the confectioners' sugar, stirring until smooth.  Serve warm.  Yield, serving with white rice.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,graham cracker crumb,lemon zest,liquid honey,flat leaf italian parsley,self raising flour
title: Lemon Thyme Browned Mushroom and Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 lb self-raising flour, sifted | 3 ounces graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 tablespoon liquid honey
instructions: Rinse mushrooms with cold water, and pat dry and cut away the hard 'gills'.  Trim all the excess fat and silverskin from the mushrooms.  Slice the mushrooms thinly, taking care to cut in half if they are very large or more depending on their size and if they are small, you may wish to halve them if they are smaller.  Mix together the flour, graham cracker crumbs, parsley and lemon zest.  Add the chopped mushrooms and stir to just mix.  Spoon into a lightly buttered and floured square cake tin.  Bake in a moderate oven for 30 minutes.  Leave to cool, then remove from the tin.  Poke the base all over with a toothpick, and bake under a grill, oven or steam for 15 to 20 minutes.  Remove from the oven and remove from the tin.  Add honey, mix and remove from the heat.  Pour the lemon mixture over the browned side of the cake and allow to cool slightly before cutting into squares.

title: Potato and Noodle Sponge
ingredients: 300 g medium potato starch ( potato starch ) | 5 medium free range eggs ( optional ) | 500 g egg noodles
instructions: Dip the noodles in hot water and drain.  Place the hot noodles in a large bowl.  Cover them with potato starch and then egg yolks.  Leave the eggs and starch in the bowl while you make the batter.  Add a little water if the noodles are drying.  Heat a little of the oil and deep fry the noodles until soft.  Drain them on absorbent paper.  You can also serve these individually with lots of butter and cream on the side.

title: Irish Potatoes and Liver
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 1/4 pounds beef liver, sliced thin
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain and allow to steam dry for a minute or two.  Peel the potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch pieces, and spread the potatoes out onto a plate.  Heat the grape oil and vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Place the liver slices into the skillet, and cook, turning once, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes.  Place the potato slices onto a paper towel lined plate.  Spread liver slices onto the fried potatoes, and serve hot.

title: Butternut Squash, Urad Dal and Sugar-Free English Muffins
ingredients: 1 lb butternut squash | 3/4 teaspoon caster sugar ( or substitute with honey or brown sugar ) | 1/2 cup urad dal, split | 1 tablespoon butter
instructions: Peel the squash and cut it into bite sized pieces.  Place into a pot of boiling water, add a pinch of salt and bring quickly to the boil.  Simmer, covered, until soft, 15 minutes.  Drain and allow to steam dry for a few seconds.  If you don’t have a pressure cooker you can put into a water bath, cover and, as the squash cooks, steam until soft and tender, up to two hours.  While squash is cooking, heat the butter in a large frying pan and cook the turmeric powder and saute for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside.  In a mixing bowl, mash the squash well with a fork.  Stir in the sugar and toss well.  Add the urad dal to the mashed squash and stir until the mixture is warm.

title: Mexican Caipirinha

Using a slotted spoon, remove rolls from wrap and place wrap on top of roll.  Rolls will be very crisp and will hold their shape.  Serve immediately.

title: Easy and Simple Scented White Rice

instructions: Bring 8 cups water to boil in medium saucepan.  Add rice and cannellini beans.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer until rice is tender and water is absorbed, about 20 - 30 minutes.  Add coriander leaves and black salt.  Cover and continue cooking until rice is hot.  Serve warm.

instructions: Place yogurt, parsley, and peanuts in a blender jar and blend on medium speed, adding in 1 tablespoon warm water.  Continue this process until the mixture is smooth, about 5 minutes.  Stir in the tarragon leaves.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.  To serve, stir mixture into parfait  serve immediately.

title: Pasta With Quinoa and Struffles
ingredients: 8 slices bacon ( one per person ) | 8 ounces quinoa ( i use basmati rice ) | 4 ounces dates | 4 ounces pimento stuffed olives | 2 1/2 ounces sake | 4 eggs | pistachio-struffled chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Bacon should be removed and cut in chunks.  Boil in water.  Add the quinoa to the water.  At the medium heat, fry the bacon strips for about 5 minutes, or until they are crisp and brown but not dark in color.  Remove from the pan and add to the quinoa.  Fry the olives in 1 oz.  Of water for about 3 minutes.  Remove from pan and add to the quinoa.  Add the bacon, chopped dates, pimentos and bacon pieces to the remaining quinoa.  Stir to mix in the ingredients. Stir to break up.  Stir in the cheese of your choice.  Serve in a bowl, garnished with a sprinkling of pistachios and chocolate.

title: Lentil Rice Pudding

instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly.  Cook in a heavy pot with plenty of lightly salted water for 20 minutes, or until the rice is soft.  Add the lentils, molasses, and vanilla. Turn off the heat, cover, and set aside to cool.

title: Carrots & Sultanas in Cream (Saffron)

instructions: Season the steak cubes with salt and pepper.  Set aside.  Combine the processed cheese, broccoli, and brown sugar in a slow cooker.  Place the steak pieces into the cheese mixture while still hot.  Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours.  Use 2 forks to shred the steak.

title: Beef and Asparagus Soup
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus spear ( cut in 1-inch pieces ) | 16 ounces beef broth | 1/4 cup prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 cup quinoa ( uncooked ) | 20 grape tomatoes ( cut in thirds ) | skewer
instructions: Prepare quinoa as per instructions on can or rice package.  Heat broth to boiling, then add mustard and oyster sauce.  Meanwhile, cut asparagus diagonally into 1/2 2 inch segments.  Boil 2 - 3 minutes until crisp tender.  Drain and cool.  Drain tomatoes and put in bowl, add quinoa and stir.  Pour broth over quinoa mixture and let sit for about 5 minutes.  Serve with meat, if desired. .

title: Spicy Caribbean Rum Rabbit
ingredients: 1/2 lb rabbit, cut up | 1/2 lb crawfish, cut up | 1/2 lb papaya, peeled and cut into chunks | powdered sugar and freshly cracked black pepper | radish ( optional ) | spanish onion, chopped | fresh fruit, such as mango, pineapple, kiwi | capers
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water with a lid, blanch the rabbit pieces for 2 minutes, carefully remove.  Set them aside and drain.  Place the crawfish pieces and meat into the pot that is boiling, and heat to boiling over medium heat.  Then turn off the heat and cover.  Set the rabbit meat aside and keep the heat low.  In a medium bowl, mix the shrimp, papaya and onions.  In a separate bowl, mix 2 tablespoons of the infused rum seasoning and the remaining rum seasoning.  Pour 1/2 cup of the heated rum into a small bowl that has been dipped in rum, and dip the stuffed rabbit pieces into it.  Arrange the stuffed rabbit on a platter.  Spoon the shrimp and meat over the rabbit pieces.  Garnish with radish and optional fruit.  Enjoy for vegetarian use the shrimp and meat in this recipe.

title: Milderang Slyna
ingredients: 5 lbs beef chuck | garlic salt | 1/2 cup dark raisin | 2 tablespoons mixed tahini
instructions: Trim off large pieces of visible fat and excess fat from beef.  Place beef in large deep skillet with medium heat and sear slowly on all sides.  Do not crowd.  Add all ingredients into skillet, and stir.  Cover.  Reduce heat and simmer at least 1 hour, shaking the pan occasionally, or until meat is very tender.

Random Ingredients: barbeque sauce,ice,iceberg lettuce,rice vinegar,caster sugar,rice noodle,yellow bell pepper
title: Stir-Fried Rice Noodles With Sweet Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 6 tablespoons rice vinegar | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 large yellow bell peppers, sliced diagonally into 1 cm-thick slices | 2 1/2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons light ice boiling water | 3 tablespoons barbeque sauce | 2 large sheets iceberg lettuce, to serve | 8 ounces rice noodles
instructions: Combine rice vinegar, sugar and 1/2 cup water in a small bowl.  Add the 2 1/2 cups water.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the sweet chili sauce to a small saucepan and warm over a medium high heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.  Add the rice noodles and leave for 3 - 4 minutes.  Drain.  To serve, top a piece of lettuce with a slice of noodles and drizzle with the sweet chili sauce.  Sprinkle with the remaining sweet chili sauce.

title: Couscous Salad With Chicken Livers
ingredients: 450 g quick cook couscous | 350 g chicken livers | 2 chipotle chiles, chopped | 1/4 cup sultana | 1/4 cup basil pesto | lettuce, for garnishing | 4 slices sourdough bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c.  Place the couscous with the chicken livers in a large heatproof bowl.  Add the chipotle and sultanas, pour over 1/4 cup water, cover with tea towels and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff up as you like with a fork and arrange in an ovenproof serving plate.  Scatter over 2 tablespoons pesto.  Bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes until tender, then stir through the remaining ingredients until heated through and serve garnished with the lettuce.

title: Greek Antilles Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apricot preserves or 2 tablespoons amaretto | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh oregano | 1 vanilla bean | 1 teaspoon finely chopped almonds | cherries pepper ( optional )
instructions: Stir preserves and vinegar in a small bowl.  Stir in oregano, vanilla bean, and almonds.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Hot and Spicy Quinoa Sausage Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb breakfast sausage | 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 1 can diced italian stewed tomatoes ( italian style ) | 1/2 cup brandy | 2 teaspoons mace | 1/2 cup fine grain bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Brown sausage until cooked through.  While sausage is cooking, brown quinoa in a saucepan with a splash of water.  When cooked, set aside and cover completely with water.  When sausage is finished cooking, set aside.  When cooked, dice and set aside in a bowl.  Slice the loaf of bread into rounds and set aside.  Slice the rind off the smoked sausage and set aside.  Slice the stewed tomatoes and set aside.  Set aside.  Slice the loaves of bread into halves or quarters and set aside.  Place rinder and quinoa in a bowl.  Drain any grease from the sausage/sausage, mix well and set aside.  Place sausage mixture, tomatoes, brandy, mace into the quinoa and mix well.  Replace quinoa in bowl and mix well.  Add shredded bread and mix well.  Spread sausage and quinoa mixture onto bread or top with toppings of choice and enjoy.

title: Spicy Chili Powder Substitute
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried red chilies | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the dried red jalapeno peppers, ground cloves and red chili powder.  Store in a clean container.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,beef steak,cream chicken soup,yellow pepper,green onion,spiral pasta
title: Cheap Beef and Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef round steak ( cut into thin strips or strips ) | 1 medium yellow pepper, sliced | 1 package uncooked spiral shaped pasta ( i use multicolor ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup sliced green onion | 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Cook& stir steak strips in large skillet, in batches, over medium high heat about 5 minutes or until brown on all sides.

title: Elegant Mexican Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 1 hass avocado, peeled, diced and seeded | 1/4 cup dried apricot, diced | 2 cups mixed berries | fresh cilantro stem ( for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Toss lettuce with desired amount of dressing ingredients and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: half cream,guacamole,vanilla essence,millet,extra virgin olive oil
title: Spanish Queso (Cheese Filled Fritters)
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons milklet | 1/2 cup whole milk or 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional ) | 1/2 cup guacamole | 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place milk in a pan and cook to just below boiling point.  Meanwhile, mix the spices and place in a bowl.  Cut cheese in to small chunks and stir to combine in the milk.  Add in the half and half mixture and cook on low heat till cheese is melted and creamy.  Serve with salsa.

title: Mushroom Oat Squares
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground dried mushroom ( preferably creamed ) | 1 cup cheerios toasted oat cereal, crushed ( preferably organic ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place mushrooms and cereal in a bowl, and toss to coat.  Stir in salt and chili flakes.  Pour into a lightly greased 9 inch square pan that has been well buttered and floured.  Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until well browned.

title: Broccoli Beef Dip
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli cheese soup | 1 cup low-fat buttermilk ( not skim ) | 1/4 cup oil, if needed | 1 cup low sodium beef broth
instructions: Bring the broth to a boil and then reduce heat to simmer for 5 - 10 minutes.  Stir in the cheese soup and buttermilk.  Heat another pan with a lid.  When the pan is hot, ladle the dip in and wait for it to warm up for 1 minute.  Serve it with tortilla chips.

title: Vegetable Risotto - Risotto for Two
ingredients: 3 tablespoons arborio rice | 1 tablespoon turnip, peeled, cooked, and finely chopped | 1 lime leaf, washed, dried, and bruised
instructions: Soak the rice in boiling water for 20 minutes.  Drain well and set aside.  Fry the rice in a little oil in a large heavy based frying pan for about 4 - 5 minutes, stirring frequently until golden.  Put in the turnip and cook over medium heat for a further 3 - 4 minutes, stirring regularly, so the rice doesn't burn.  Remove from the pan and squeeze the lime juice into the rice.  Serve immediately.

title: Ziti with Pine Nuts & Pesto
ingredients: 3 cans ziti pasta | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 tablespoon shortening
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add ziti and boil uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Old Fashioned Country Style Biscuits
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut in 2-inch slices | baking powder | white pepper or salt
instructions: Spray a very large mixing bowl with cooking oil.  Sprinkle meat with baking powder, or use coarsely ground bread crumbs, seasoned with salt and white pepper or salt.  Dump in the water.  Do not use more than a couple tablespoons at a time.  Roll out until it is about 1/4 inch thick.  Cut biscuits in half, or make biscuits for soup by rolling out on a floured board.  Be sure not to use more than 2 halves of the bread.  You will be using them on top of the meat.  Fry them in batches.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,red pepper sauce,basmati rice,chicken bouillon granule,gorgonzola
title: Saffron Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand, crushed | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper sauce ( to taste ) | 1 gorgonzola or 1 other blue cheese, sliced
instructions: Place all ingredients except the cheese in a medium saucepan or frying pan.  Cover or bring to a boil over medium high heat.  Reduce heat to low.  Simmer covered for 10 minutes.  Stir rice gently, continue to cover, cook a further 5 to 8 minutes or until the rice is fluffy and all the liquid has been absorbed.  If rice looks a little curdled, remove the cover, raise the heat, and boil rapidly until the rice is clear and creamy.  Stir in the cheese, remove from heat, and stir into the hot rice.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: paprika,masa harina,strawberry,green olive,onion,monterey jack pepper cheese,sunflower oil,tofu
title: Tofu Mousse With Wilted Strawberries
ingredients: 1 package dry lasagna sheets, lightly brushed with olive oil | 1 medium size onion, finely chopped | 14 ounces firm tofu, drained from its package ( about 8 ounces ) | 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons masa harina | 7 cups strawberries, quartered | 1/4 cup sliced mixed green olives | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Place the lasagna sheets on a parchment lined baking sheet, brushing generously with olive oil.  Bake until barely beginning to crisp, about 13 minutes.  Remove and set aside.  While baking, stir the onion in the oil until it is limp.  Turn off the heat.  Drain the tofu, cutting into 1/2 inch thick slices.  Rinse and blot out the slices, then lay out on a clean paper toweling.  Spoon half of the tofu and onion mixture into the center of the toasted lasagna sheets.  Top with the remaining tofu, onions, and sunflower oil.  Drizzle with the harina.  Arrange the strawberries around the tofu.  Spoon the remaining tofu over it, sprinkle with the sliced olives, and top with the cheese.  Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours before serving.  Sprinkle the exposed cheese with the chopped olives.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,dark soy sauce,chicken bouillon cube
title: Asian Sweet and Sour Chicken
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube ( to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the chicken bouillon with the dark soy sauce, and lemon pepper.  Add to a microwave safe dish, or a resealable bag, and cover with plastic wrap.  Microwave on high 10 to 15 seconds or until the bouillon dissolves.  Stir to coat the chicken in the sauce.  Allow to cool 5 minutes to allow the steam to escape.  Discard remaining sauce ingredients.  Place in a resealable zip lock bag or a plastic bag containing about 2 or 3 tablespoons reserved sauce.  Seal, and leave bag in refrigerator at least 6 hours, but no longer more than 3 days.

title: Pimentos De Gherkins
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos, drained | 1/2 cup chopped gherkin | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage leaves
instructions: In a skillet, saute pimientos, and sage in 1 t.  Salted butter until softened.  Spread hot pimiento mixture over hot pimentos.

title: Easy-Peasy Halibut
ingredients: 1 can or bottle light beer | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 4 pounds halibut, rinsed and dried
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Warm beer, brown sugar, and halibut in a large, heavy saucepan.  Bake halibut in the preheated oven until fish is easily flaked with a fork, about 30 minutes.  Fish should easily slide off the bones.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,italian herb seasoning,pearl barley,margarine,mango chutney,scallion,pumpkin pie spice,romano cheese
title: Mexican Barley Pudding With Mango Chutney Crust
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried garbanzo beans ( chickpeas ) | 8 -10 slices romano cheese, 1/4 inch thick slices and 3/4 inch wide | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 2 1/2 cups fresh romano cheese | 1 1/2 cups margarine, softened ( i use 1/4 stick & 1/4 stick ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice or 1 1/2 teaspoons anise flavoring or 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1/4 cup italian mixed dried herbs ( we use basil, coriander & sage, use less if you like ) | 1 teaspoon dried mixed italian herb seasoning ( we use oregano berry mix or 1 tsp italian seasoning blend ) | 2 tablespoons finely diced scallions ( i add more for variety )
instructions: Soak the beans for 8 hours.  Drain the beans and cook them in fresh water for about 4 hours or until they are thick and tender.  Drain the beans again and place them in large bowl.  Dice the 4 slices of romano, then mix them in with the beans.  Set aside.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Line a small baking sheet with the remaining romano cheese slices and set aside.  Add margarine, pumpkin pie spice or anise flavor / cinnamon & italian herbs to a food processor and process until you get a nice mixture.  Add scallions and process again.  This is the vinegar & garnish.

title: Ajiaco
ingredients:
4 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1 mango ( no need to peel or stone it, the meat should be very lean.
    - )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 300 degrees.  Place meat in a roasting pan.  Slice some off the top of your mango and scrape out all of the sticky pulp from inside the fruit.  Place meat on top of the mango.  Place pan in your preheated oven and bake for approximately 1 hour.  When meat has nearly finished cooking, mix the meat with the mango and turn them so they are all mixed completely.  Allow to sit for 10 minutes before serving, to allow them to absorb all of the juices.  Note, this is really lovely served with fried rice, as an appetizer with other dishes like, as a burrito filler for your favorite dishes.  Note, the yield is for how much meat it makes.

title: Mexican Beans
ingredients: 4 -5 cans kidney beans, with liquid | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers
instructions: Mix all together.  Heat and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: black bean,celery seed,haddock fillet,queso blanco,campbell cheddar cheese soup,rice vinegar,oregano leaf,taco sauce
title: Italian Black Bean and Fish Baked over Rice
ingredients: 1 can campbell's cheddar cheese soup | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar ( seasoned according to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/8 teaspoon celery seed | 1 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 lb haddock fillet, cut into 3/4 '' pieces | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1/2 cup queso blanco, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a bowl, combine soup, vinegar, oregano, celery seed, and black beans.  Arrange fish pieces in a small baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes.  Spoon taco sauce over fish, and bake 10 to 12 minutes longer, or until flakey.

Random Ingredients: spinach,kaffir lime leaf,butter,cilantro leaf,pineapple,self raising flour,beef chuck
title: Pineapple Pineapple and Sago Pork (Pork and Beef) Mince and Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 400 g pineapple, grated and juices chopped up | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus extra to serve | 1 cup fresh spinach, chopped up ( about 2 bunches ) | 40 g butter | 3 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 cup cilantro leaves, finely chopped ( or parsley ) | 500 g butter | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 125 g grated raw beef chuck
instructions: Preheat a moderately hot, oven proof griddle pan until very hot.  Mix all of the ingredients together in a large bowl.  Divide the mixture into 24 pieces or roll each piece into a ball between two sheets of plastic wrap.  Slide the rolled mince into a flat, straight sided, even sized hole on the flat griddle pan.  Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until golden brown and cooked through, then set aside to cool.  Cut the spinach or any fresh greens off of the leaves from stalks, but leave the stems on.  Heat the butter in a medium frying pan over moderate heat.  Sieve in flour and cook, stirring with a whisk, for 3 to 4 minutes, allowing flour to brown slightly.  Reduce heat to low.  Stir in the spinach/spinach/spinach/spinach/spinach mixture and cook, stirring regularly, for 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in the grated raw beef and lime leaves.  Serve with extra grated cheese and some lime chutney.

title: Oma's Favorite Wine
ingredients: 1 cup burgundy wine, any flavor | 1 cup apple juice ( see step one )
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, combine the wine, juice, and the apple juice and bring to a boil.  When bubbling, remove from heat.

title: Bran & Eggplant Rolls
ingredients: 1 eggplant, sliced | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 cup gingersnaps, finely crushed | 300 g spinach, drained | 1 cup lettuce, shredded | 2 tablespoons natural bran
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 c.  Place eggplant on oven tray, then spray with cooking oil.  Bake for 20 mins, or until golden and tender.  Scoop out centres and mash roughly with a fork.  Combine chili garlic sauce, gingersnaps and yoghurt in a large bowl, then toss with eggplant.  Combine lettuce, spran and spran mixture.  Roll meat mixture into 24 rolls.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,wheat flour,plain flour,beef stew meat,white vinegar,rigatoni pasta
title: Shortcut Beef Pasta Salad
ingredients: 500 g beef stew meat | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon wheat flour | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 300 g rigatoni pasta | 3 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Cut meat into bite sized pieces and toss with plain flour and wheat flour.  Pour vinegar over and marinate meat for up to 4 hours minimum, if possible.  Boil rigatoni in plenty of salted water until al dente', according to the instructions on your packet.  Drain and rinse in cold water.  Cook the rigatoni in the same pan that you cooked the meat in, until it is tender and has taken on a deep orange colour.  Toss the meat through the vinegar and serve with the rigatoni.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,beet,beef tenderloin steak,plain flour,lime wedge
title: Beef and Beet Stew
ingredients: 600 g beef tenderloin steaks | 1/4 teaspoon black-eyed peas | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 3 cups mixed beet leaves or 3 cups kale, coarsely chopped
instructions: Trim any excess fat from meat and cut into 3/4 inch chunks.  Combine the pepper and flour in a plastic bag, shaking to mix.  Add meat, a few pieces at a time and shake well to coat.  Place in a large saucepan, pour in liquid, then stir over a low heat until the meat is covered.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes or until meat is tender.  Add the beet or kale and continue cooking until the meat is just cooked through.  Serve.

title: Sue's Bamya
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra | 1/2 cup port wine | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 can sliced marshmallows
instructions: Defrost the okra overnight in the fridge.  In a 2 - ½ quart pan, layer the okra and port over medium heat.  Pour in the cream of tartar and marshmallows and stir.  Reduce heat to low and cook for 20 - 30 minutes, stirring from time to time.  Keep an eye on it from time to make sure the cream or marshmallows are not burning.

title: Creamy Horseradish Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Mix well.  Keep.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,self rising flour,poppy seed,mexican cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,oregano leaf
title: Onion Cheese Pizza
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 teaspoon poppy seeds
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Spray a nonstick baking pan with vegetable oil cooking spray.  Whisk self rising flour, mexican cheese, oregano, salt, ground black pepper, and poppy seeds together in a bowl.  Turn the dough out onto the prepared baking pan, and spread out to the edges to cover the entire surface.  Bake pizza crust in the preheated oven until the edges are golden brown and the crust is bubbling, about 18 minutes.  Reduce heat to 300 degrees f while the pizza is baking, place a pizza cutter or pizza fork alongside the pizza to cut out the large holes.  Slide a thin knife or spatula under the edge of the crust to ease some of the dough out.  Slice the pizza into wedges, and serve.

title: Apple Jellies
ingredients: 8 cups tart apples, peeled | 1 jar lemonade concentrate, frozen
instructions: Drain juices from fruit.  Core apples, cut in half.  Place in a large bowl.  Stir in lemonade concentrate.  Spread evenly over apples.  Cover and chill 8 to 10 hours.

title: Fenugreek  Couscous With Cashews
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 3 large green chilies, chopped ( red or green, to taste ) | 2/3 cup roasted cashews, chopped ( salted ) | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries ( optional ) | 1/4 cup marsala | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried fenugreek | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry paste | 1 tablespoon agave nectar
instructions: Soak cashews in cold tap water until softened.  Drain, and set aside.  In an oiled bowl, combine cashews, cashews, blueberries, marsala, fenugreek, curry paste and agave nectar, and mix well.  Pour mixture over couscous until coated.  Serve warm, or chill.

title: Basic Oriental Seasoning  (for barbecues)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Place salt and sesame oil in a bowl and mix.  Apply the mixture on the barbecued or broiled barbecue.
