title: Armenian Rice Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice, rinsed well | 1/2 cup artichoke heart, chopped | 1/4 cup gouda cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup salad oil | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise, seeds scraped | 1 tablespoon black sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon candy sprinkles, to top
instructions: Place rice, artichokes, cheese, oil, vanilla bean seeds and sesame seeds in a small bowl.  Mix gently.  Shape rice mixture into walnut sized balls.  Place on a greased baking sheet.

title: Strawberry Quinoa Salad
ingredients:
2 cups water, divided in half to make 6 cups | 1 large red bell pepper, cut into 1/4 by 1/2-inch strips | 1 cup quinoa, uncooked | 1/4 cup fresh fruit, chopped ( about 12 raisins or apricots mixed together with about 6 tbsp.
    - water ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Bring the 2 cups water to a rolling boil in a saucepan.  Add the red bell pepper strips.  Reduce heat to a low rolling boil and cook until the bell pepper is tender, about about 10 minutes.  Remove from the heat and stir in the quinoa.  Cover and set aside for about 5 minutes.  Uncover and fluff with a fork.  Add the fruit and marjoram.  Mix well.  This is great served over blue cheese, cooked wild rice and puffy new potatoes.

title: Amaretto Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup amaretto | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds
instructions: Put all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid and shake vigorously.  Shake vigorously before using.

title: Coconut Chips (Vietnamese Style)
ingredients: 2 lbs firm white fish fillets ( such as monkfish, yellowtail, cod ) | 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons rum ( optional ) | sea salt ( for soaking the fish ) | chopped fresh rinds of one serrano pepper | 1 1/2 cups unsweetened dried shredded coconut ( or to taste )
instructions: Cover fish fillets with a thick layer of water and cover.  Place in freezer for 1 1/2 hours.  Or, cook fish in a steamer and steam the fish until the skin is crisp and translucent.  Drain the fish.  Thaw the fish and slice into pieces about 2 x 1/2 by 3 inches.  Arrange pieces on a tray, sprinkle with sea salt, and refrigerate for about 1 hour.  Dollop coconut over fish so as to cover it evenly.  Wrap in plastic and refrigerate overnight.  Serve with sweet and sour sauces or nuoc cham.

title: Herring Rolls With Catup and Herring

instructions: Combine catsup, cilantro and water chestnuts in a small sauce pan.

title: Quick and Easy Cojita Bread
ingredients: 2 lbs bone-in chicken parts | 1 lb chorizo sausage | 1 large head of garlic, chopped | 1 large yellow onion, chopped | 1 bottle cider | pickled hot peppers or hot chile sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 3 loaves rye bread, cut in half
instructions: Place chicken, sausage, garlic, onions, and cider into a pot over medium high heat.  Bring to a boil and then simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.  Remove chicken, sausage, garlic, and onions with slotted spoons and set aside.  Add hot pepper sauce and cajun seasoning to sauce and simmer, uncovered, for 30 more minutes.  Allow to cool 30 minutes, then stir into sauce.  Serve warm with french fries and cheese.

title: Shoyu Baked in Coffee
ingredients: 50 ml coffee liqueur | 50 ml garlic & flour fragrant shoyu ( aged beverage ) | 25 ml baileys irish cream or 25 ml other coffee creamer ( baileys irish cream ) | 20 cm twist brie cheese, grated
instructions: Heat oven to 180c.  Place shoyu in glass bowl, pour coffee around the side of the bowl.  Leave to set then sprinkle with half the garlic& mix with your chosen filling.  Divide the mix between a casserole dish which has been sprayed with baking spray, top with the grated rind of the brie& bake for 20 - 30 mins or until top is deep golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,coriander leaf,serrano pepper,pam cooking spray,nori,paprika,crescent dinner
title: Peruvian Nori Rolls (Nori)
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 4 sheets nori | 2 tablespoons paprika ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons sweet paprika ( optional ) | 1 cucumber | fresh coriander leaves or cilantro | serrano pepper, finely chopped, for dipping | garlicky paprika, for sipping | pam cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Heat pam in skillet along with garlic and chili.  Break up perforated crescent dough using a rolling pin & use to roll out as thin dough as possible to about 2 inches in diameter then remove as wide as possible.  Place approximately 3 tablespoons per roll on perforated roll.  Fold over perforated rolls to form triangle and press edges to seal with spoon or other finger tips.  You may need to do this in between batches.  Bake 15 - 18 minutes or until lightly golden brown on top.  Meanwhile, cut cucumber lengthwise into 1/8ths and remove seeds using a spoon or grater into a bowl of very hot tap water and drain.  Cut each cucumber into quarters and remove the seeds using a spoon or grater.  Add sliced cucumbers to bowl and toss to mix, adding approximately 1/2 to 1/2 cup of water to loosen softened cucumber.  Arrange nori, cut side up, on a baking sheet to cover.  Place a few tablespoons of cucumber/papaya mixture along center of nori closest to you then top with some of the paprika.  Sprinkle a few corriander leaves and a couple leaves of fresh cilantro on top.  Roll up and press all around with your fingers to make a roll and place on a baking sheet.  Repeat until all rolls are used, placing nori, peppers, etc.  Spray tops with pam.  Sprinkle paprika on top.  You may want to cut slits to allow steam to escape if possible.  Cut into squares and serve.

title: Aussie Blueberry Dessert
ingredients: 2 cups blueberries | 1/4 cup lemon juice ( from 2 lemons ) | 1/4 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Process blueberries, lemon juice and pineapple juice.  Pour into bowl.

title: Frijoles De Pinto - Flour-Braised Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 lb pinto beans, cooked | 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to cut the dough into 3 equal portions.  Using both portions, roll out your dough to 1/8 inch thickness.  Use only a thin layer. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is golden brown and firm.  While it’s baking, prepare your beans.  Place a can of refried beans in a medium sauce pot and cover with water. Remove the meat and place on a dish.  Cover with your prepared beans and serve hot.

title: English Muffin Fritters
ingredients: 2 english muffins, split and toasted | 1 lb russet potato, peeled | red food coloring, to tint
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Split half the english muffins and toast until golden brown. Add the mashing with the back of a spoon, being careful not to let the potato brown.  Remove from heat.  Scoop a bit of the potato mixture onto each half of the english muffin and serve.

title: Czech Chickpea Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs whole chickpeas flour | 1 ounce fresh yeast | 1 cup double sec ( or other liqueur ) | 1 cup loosely packed flat leaf parsley, roughly chopped
instructions: Put chickpeas in a 6 quarta size bowl and cover with 3 inches warm water.  Soak overnight or for several hours in the refrigerator.  Drain the chickpeas, place the soaking water in a 9 inch glass, ceramic or round pan large enough to fit the bread, sprinkle with the yeast and set aside until the water bubbles around it.  Cover and let stand for 1 hour.  Stir and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk.  Pour risen chickpeas into a large bowl and cover with 3/4 inch cool water.  Stir and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk.  Pour the second cup of cool water into the large bowl containing the yeast, and add 1 cup of chickpea flour or plain flour and 1 pinch of salt.  Stir and cover, adding more flour during the final 10 minutes of rising times.  When the dough has risen, punch down and shape into 12 long cylinders.  Place on a floured surface, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 1/2 hours.  Punch down the dough again, then return it to the floured surface.  Turn out onto a floured surface and divide into 8 pieces.  Form each piece into a ball and place on a floured surface.  Cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled, between 1 1/2 hours and 1 1/2 hours.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.  Line a baking sheet with greased parchment paper.  On a lightly floured surface, flatten each roll into a 5 to 6 inch circle about 1/4 inch thick.  Brush the top of each circle with water.  Place the circle of dough on the parchment and place in the preheated oven.  It will rise a little in the oven, but should not come out of the oven until the dough is baked.  Bake the bread for 30 minutes or until golden brown and the top sounds hollow when tapped.  Let loaves cool on the pan for ten minutes, then loosen with a spatula or knife.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Plum Clafouti

Spoon macaroni into a baking dish, top with additional saffron broth. .  Bake at 350 f for 20 minutes.

instructions: Grate fresh or slice fresh mozzarella cheese, about 3 slices per serving. title: Creamy Celery Ribs

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a medium bowl, using clean hands, toss the celery pieces with the whipping cream until well coated.  Spread mixture onto a baking sheet sprinkled with a little salt.  Bake until lightly browned and tender, about 30 minutes.  Serve hot.

instructions: Place brisket, fat side up, in large saucepan.

instructions: Place artichokes in a pan with a small amount of water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes.  Drain artichokes and set aside to cool for a few minutes. Serve with lots of crushed ice on the side.

instructions: Heat oil in a small nonstick frypan over moderate heat until hot.  Add couscous.

title: Ouzo-Spiked Shiitakes

instructions: Preheat the oven broiler.  Cut the mushrooms in half with the tip of a sharp knife or kitchen shears.  Place in a small bowl and pour 1 tablespoon of olive oil overtop. Stir thoroughly then roll each slice into a sausage shape, patting well to get the crumbs on.  To grill, line a baking sheet with heavy duty aluminum foil. Serve immediately, or allow to cool and serve right away.

title: Steamed Chinese Spinach Salad

instructions: Soak your lady fingers in cold water for 20 minutes while you prepare the rest of the salad.  Blanch the spinach in salted water for 5 minutes and drain.  Cut your chili in small pieces and arrange them on a large plate.  Remove the stems from 2 of the green chili and remove the seeds.  Slice the green chili in half and remove the green part of the green chili.  Place the spinach in a large serving bowl.  Toss with the oyster sauce and sprinkle with the green chili pieces.  Toss well and serve.

title: Cousin Pete's Thai Beef and Peppers

instructions: Heat oven to 500 degrees.  Remove meat, and place in a 13 x 9 inch baking pan.  Cut cross wise into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Bake meat for about 1 hour or until done.  Drain, and cool. Cut into 1/2 inch pieces, set aside.  Cut the green chilies in half lengthwise.  Remove ribs and skin from outside of each pepper and slice thin crosswise.  Cut the pepper into 1/4 inch strips. Add the meat and toss to coat.  Place in refrigerator for at least an hour.  Bake meat, stirring occasionally, for about 1 hour or until it is tender and meat is firm. ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breasts, skinless | 3 tablespoons molasses | 1/2 cup dry red wine ( such as muscadet ) | 2 large pepperoncini peppers ( i use the pith and seeds from the pepperocini ppernos ) | 4 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup mayonnaise ( kewpie brand )
instructions: Spray crockpot with cooking spray.  Place all ingredients with seasonings in crockpot and cook on low heat for 8 - 10 hours and serve with warm fries and a tossed salad.

title: Grilled Swordfish With Papaya
ingredients: 4 swordfish, skinned | 1 kg papaya, peeled ( cut into matchsticks )
instructions: Prepare the grill.  Season swordfish with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Thread two sticks of papaya onto individual soaked wooden skewers.  Place onto a hot grill and cook for 10 - 15 minutes or until flesh flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,pastry,chambord raspberry liquor,genoa salami,baking soda
title: Pollo E Vino
ingredients: 20 chicken thighs | 7 ounces genoa salami | 4 ounces baking soda | 2 tablespoons chambord raspberry liquor | pastry for a double-crust pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Mix together the baking soda, chambord and cream soda for the filling.  Roll one thigh in the soda mix and the other thighs in the rest of the soda mix.  Put pastry on a greased baking sheet and put the tray close together on the oven rack.  Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 20 minutes.  Allow to cool.  Eat with a glaze of raspberry glaze.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,bavarian beer vinegar,fenugreek leaf,trout,rhubarb,watercress orange,kidney bean
title: Chowning's Red Trout, Kidney Bean & Rhubarb Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried great northern beans | 6 cups watercress or 6 cups orange juice, mixed | 1 lb rhubarb, diced | 2 lbs smoked trout, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups cabernet sauvignon noir wine vinegar or 1 1/2 cups white grape juice and water | 1 cup alfennel or 1 cup lima beans, cooked
instructions: Sort the beans, removing any grit or damaged beans or stones, then rinse and place in a large heavy dutch oven with 2 1/2 cups of water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low.  Add the rhubarb, cover, and simmer over medium low heat for about an hour or until the rhubarb is tender.  Remove 1 1/2 1/2 cups of the water and bring another 3 cups of water to a boil.  Add the trout and reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.  Stir in the fenugreek, then check the seasoning, stirring thoroughly before serving.

title: Anchovy Chicken Rollups
ingredients: 1 package vermicelli | 1 can anchovy fillets | 6 slices chicken | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 ripe peach | 1/2 cup nori
instructions: Cook vermicelli according to package directions until al dente and cool.  Drain and set aside.  Mix together anchovies, garlic powder and pepper.  Cut chicken into 2 inch squares.  Roll 2/3 of the nori into long pencil shaped pieces, then cut slices in half again.  Place 1/2 of the hot vermicelli on a lightly oiled sheet of cheese cloth or bamboo mat.  Place chicken and cheese on top.  Cover with second piece of nori and press each piece together.  Fold over and crimp the edges to seal.  Repeat until all ingredients are done.  Heat skillet then cook rolls 2 at a time over medium heat approximately 4 minutes per side, turning once, or until internal temperature reaches 165 degrees.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,cardamom pod,green pumpkin seed,bucatini pasta,puff pastry,soymilk
title: Tropical Tater Pies
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod ( or a pinch ) | 1 stalk fresh lemongrass, cut into small pieces | 2 1/2 ounces bucatini pasta or 2 1/2 ounces other small pasta | 2 small green pumpkin seeds ( no subsitutes ) | 1 package thawed puff pastry, chilled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f combine soy milk and cardamom pods and set aside.  Trim ends from the thawed pastry sheet.  Cut the pastry into twelve 3 x 14 inch rectangles, about 3 inch thick.  Place the squares on a baking sheet and brush the crust with oil.  Place the lemon grass on top of each, then brush and spread the tops with oil and sprinkle with the soy milk mixture.  Bake for 9 minutes, then cool.  Meanwhile, soak the bucatini according to package instructions.  The pasta should be just cooked.

Random Ingredients: fruit,vodka,manchego cheese,jalapeno relish,rye bread,pizza crust,egg noodle
title: Yummy Beef Stroganoff Crostini
ingredients:
2 cups sour cream ( regular or low fat ) | 12 ounces fresh egg noodles, cooked | 1 cup shaved manchego cheese | 3 tablespoons finely snipped fresh jalapeno relish | 1/2 lb deli cooked fully cooked thin rye round sandwich meat, chopped | 1/2 lb thinly sliced deli baked thin sliced pizza crust | 1/4 cup finely snipped fresh fruit ( like nectarines, grape tomatoes, and etc.

instructions: Mix sour cream and noodles in a small bowl with cheese, jalapeno relish, and 1/2 cup cheese mixture.  Spoon into your bread or rolls, top with remaining noodles, and roll up.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pork belly,plum tomato,kalamata olive,mint leaf,turkey broth,gelatin,serrano chilies
title: Pork Gyros
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless pork belly, trimmed and patted dry | 1 cup canned plum tomatoes | 3 serrano chilies, seeded and minced | 1 pint turkey broth | 1 ounce unflavored gelatin | 6 kalamata olives, pitted and halved | handful fresh mint leaves, for garnish
instructions: Place the pork belly into a large pot and pour in enough water to cover.  Add the plum tomatoes and serrano chilies and bring to a boil.  Cook over medium high heat until the tomatoes begin to burst, then reduce heat to medium low.  Drain the tomatoes and chilies, and stir them into the pork belly.  Mix beef broth and gelatin in a small bowl to make a gelatin glaze.  Sprinkle gelatin over the pork mixture, and let sit for 15 minutes.  Pour gelatin mixture into a bowl, and set aside.  When the pork is cool enough to handle, remove a small piece of meat from the bone using a very sharp, thin knife, or a very sharp knife.  Cut into about 1/2 inch cubes and set aside.  Drain the pork meat and tomatoes of any excess juices, and reserve sauce.  Reserve enough of the tomato mixture and pork juices to equal 1 cup.  Rinse the bones from the pork pork, and place back into the pot.  Place over medium heat and bring to a simmer.  Cook until the pork is very tender.  Remove from the heat and place into a large dish.  Place some of the reserved tomato and tomatillo mixture in a bowl.  Drain the pork and tomato mixture, then transfer to the dish with the cooked pork.  Top with the kalamata olives, and garnish with some fresh mint.  Serve with tortillas.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,burgundy wine,nutmeg,cayenne powder,mustard seed,flour tortilla,parmesan cheese,bamboo skewer
title: Cauliflower Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/4 cup burgundy wine | 1 1/4 tablespoons prepared mustard seed | 1 pinch ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | 4 flour tortillas | 1 1/2 cups finely shredded, unpeeled cauliflower florets | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 cups rotini pasta
instructions: Make the bordelaise, mix together wine, mustard seed and nutmeg in a small bowl.  Pour the mixture into a separate small bowl.  Spread the tortillas lightly with the prepared mustard seed mixture.  Place a plate on top to keep them from sticking.  Heat a large skillet over medium heat.  Cook the tortillas, 2 at a time, for 2 minutes per side.  Remove to a plate lined with paper towels.  Heat the remaining bordelaise sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.  When it just begins to boil, cook the cauliflower 2 minutes.  Remove to a plate lined with paper towels.  Wipe out the skillet and return it to medium low heat.  Cook the tortillas, 1 at a time, for 1 minute on both sides.  Drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,baby red potato,parsley leaf
title: Baby Red Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb baby red potato, halved | 1/3 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Toss potato pieces in remaining salad dressing.  Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Bake uncovered for about 20 minutes or until slightly brown.  Turn potatoes over and scatter with parsley.  Bake another 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender and beginning to brown in spots.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,vodka,yellow pea,cooking spray,ice water,beef stew meat,apple juice,sunflower seed
title: Beef Massaman Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch strips | cooking spray | 6 cups ice water | 1 1/2 cups light apple juice | 1/4 cup vodka | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1/3 cup yellow frozen peas
instructions: Spray large dutch oven with cooking spray and set over medium high heat.  Add meat and marinate beef for 5 minutes.  Add water, apple juice, vodka.  Bring to a boil.  Cover and reduce heat to medium low.  Cook for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Add sunflower seeds and peas.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,tomato puree,feta,chicken stock vegetable,bell pepper
title: Lebanese Mango Chili
ingredients: 7 ounces mango chutney | 3 tablespoons tomato puree | 3 tablespoons chicken stock or 3 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper | feta, to serve
instructions: Combine chilli paste ingredients in a saucepan.  Cook over low heat, stirring, until sauce begins to thicken.  Pour sauce into individual ovenproof ramekin dishes, then sprinkle with feta cheese.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,beef gravy,garlic powder,snow pea,shallot,golden syrup,green pea
title: Halibut in Pea Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 large halibut fillets | 1 cup halved green peas | 1 cup snow peas | 4 ounces halibut gravy | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 packet beef gravy | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Place peas in a microwave safe bowl and microwave approximately 5 minutes on high or for 8 to 10 minutes on medium to high.  Spread the peas on a baking tray and bake for 5 minutes or until crisp and dry.  Combine gravy, golden syrup and garlic powder and pour over the peas, stirring until well combined.  Coat halibut with this sauce and place fish in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until cooked through, depending on the thickness of your chops.

title: Chicken Pesto
ingredients: 1 cup store-bought pesto | 7 tablespoons chicken breast halves, chopped | 2 jalapeno peppers, chopped | 10 -12 ice cubes
instructions: Combine pesto and chopped chicken in food processor.  Scoop 6 - 4 tablespoons of the pesto onto the chicken, then chop or pulse to a fine puree.  Add remaining pesto to food processor and chop or pulse until desired consistency.  Transfer to a large bowl and stir in jalapeños to taste.  Serve at once or refrigerate to develop flavor.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,turmeric powder,chili,chicken stock,aluminum foil,chili garlic sauce
title: Caramelised Red Curry Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili | 2 1/2 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce, i use la krapi garlic sauce | 1 pinch turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons thyme leaves | 100 ml chicken stock | aluminum foil
instructions: Pour the chili sauce into a small saucepan add the rest of the ingredients and simmer until the sauce is reduced to a thick sauce.  Remove from the heat and add the slavovings of the aluminum foil to each piece of meat.  Place in the fridge and leave to marinate in the fridge for an hour or more.  When you are ready to cook, place a large knob of aluminium foil on a grill tray and heat to medium high.  Place the chicken pieces into the pan and cook for 6 - 10 minutes per side until browned.  Serve with plain steamed rice.

title: Pasta with Chicken, Cashews and Feta
ingredients: 1 pound uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 20 cashews, husked and coarsely chopped | 1 cup crumbled feta
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add farfalle pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain, and set aside.  While tortilla shells are boiling, place chicken in a saucepan with a bit of oil.  Cook over medium heat until no longer pink, turning once.  Remove chicken, and drain chicken juice into a bowl.  When shells are done, return chicken to the pot, and bring to a boil.  In the same skillet, add cashews, and continue to cook until cashews soften and turn light brown.  Set aside.  Spray a 1 quart casserole dish with cooking spray.  Drain pasta, and transfer to the dish.  Combine chicken with cheese, and garnish with cashew mixture.  Continue to bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,chicken breast half,sun tomato,olive,baby carrot
title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Chicken Salad Recipe
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cubed | 8 ounces baby carrots | 1 bunch fresh baby carrots, with tops | 14 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1/2 cup olive
instructions: Place chicken cubes in a saucepan, and fill with enough water just to cover.  Bring to a boil, and cook until no longer pink in the center and the chicken is cooked through, about 20 to 25 minutes.  Drain and run cold water over chicken.  Transfer to a salad bowl, and toss with carrot, baby carrots, sun dried tomatoes, green cardamom pods, and olive.

title: Zucchini & Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs zucchini | 12 ounces button mushrooms, halved | 3 1/2 ounces white flour | 1 lb butter | 3/4 cup sherry wine | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthways.  Cut caps into 1/4in slices.  Heat butter in skillet, stir in mushrooms.  Brown over medium heat 2 mins or until tender.  Combine flour, sherry & brandy, stir until smooth.  Stir into mushrooms, cook over low heat until mixture boils and thickens.  Season to taste.  Serve as a main course with a salad or as a side dish with toast.

title: English Cucumber and Mushrooms for a Rainy Day Lunch
ingredients: 3 small english cucumbers | 200 g mixed mushrooms | 1/2 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Wash and pat dry the cucumber and mushrooms.  Slice the cucumber finely, then toss with the coriander powder.  Divide into four portions.  Take each portion and put into a clean cup.  Put in a small bun, top with a sprinkle of coriander powder and a little yoghurt if desired.

title: Caper Herb Rolls
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cake flour | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill sprigs | 2 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs fresh capers
instructions: Mix flour and dill to form a firm paste.  Dampen fingertips and rub in herb paste, pressing in between thumb and finger tips.  Roll dough into 8 long thin pencils, each about 10 inches long and 2 inches wide.  Cut into 8 even pieces.  Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.  Remove rolls from refrigerator 20 minutes before serving.  Remove from paper and let stand 5 minutes.  Serve warm or cold.  Store in an airtight container up to 2 weeks.

title: Fajita Melt
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fajita seasoning mix | 1 pita bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Mix fajita seasoning mix and fajita seasoning mix in a bag.  Remove the bag and shake to coat the fajita seasoning mix.  Place bag flat on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.  Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes.  Allow to cool slightly and scoop the fajita into a warm plate or individual ramekin dishes.  Sprinkle with desired topping.

Random Ingredients: oriental sesame oil,spaghetti,lemon juice zest,oleo,sea salt,milk,beef,habanero pepper
title: Habanero Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 4 habanero peppers or 4 jalapenos, seeds removed, minced | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried oriental sesame oil ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup oleo | 1/2 cup milk | 4 tablespoons whole milk | 1/4 cup sea salt | hot cooked spaghetti, for serving
instructions: In a large skillet, stir fry the beef over medium high heat until browned.  Drain and set aside.  Heat 1 tablespoon oil in the skillet until hot.  Add in the chili and lemon zest and saute until fragrant, about 1 minute.  Add in the dry sesame oil and heat through, 30 seconds.  In a blender, liquour the oleo, milk, milk, salt and salt and blend until smooth.  Pour 1/4 cup of warm marinade over the meat and mix until combined.  Cover and set aside for at least 1 hour to flavor the meat and to mellow its flavor.  Cook or boil a small amount of spaghetti as directed on the package.  Drain in a colander and place in a large serving bowl.  Top with the remaining warmed marinade and serve.

title: Sesame Beef or Chicken Pieces
ingredients: 600 g chuck | 1 small mango | 4 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Cut meat into cubes or thin strips.  Grind sesame seeds into a fine breadcrumb.  Heat oil in a frying pan until very hot.  Add the ground sesame seeds and fry until it is golden.  Add meat and fry until cooked through.  Drain meat onto a plate lined with paper towel to collect excess oil.  Add mango and sesame nuts to meat and serve.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,date,sugar snap pea,chipotle chile,bread,lemon juice,iceberg lettuce
title: Chipotle Salad With Lemony Crisp
ingredients:
1/2 lemon, juice of | 1 canned chipotle chile, minced | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar snap peas, finely chopped | 1 celery rib, sliced | 3/4 cup chopped dates | 1 leaf iceberg lettuce ( about 10 oz.
    - or salad leaves, torn into bite-size pieces ) | 4 slices bread, toasted, cut into triangles
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce and bread triangles in small bowl.  Pour over salad and toss until beans are coated.

title: Quick & Easy Samosas (Filled Pastry Recipe)
ingredients: pastry dough, for filling ( recipe # 425215 # 425215 ) or 1 pastry dough, for making samosas ( samzas or triangles ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( for authenticity ) ( optional )
instructions: Please note, the above recipe does not come commercially prepared.  If your dough is not making pastries by hand, preheat your oven to 450 degrees f.  If you don’t have a prepped baking stone, put your oven rack in the center of the oven.  Line the cookie sheet with parchment paper.  If you’re making samosas, fill a piping bag with the pastry dough or a fork and carefully pipe your samosas into a small, thin circle in the baking sheet.  Brush the edges with a little water and sprinkle with asafetida or pinches of the desired colour.  Bake until golden in color.  Remove from oven and cool on a rack for a few minutes, then cut into 4 large triangles that’re approximately 4” long.  Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,black olive,parsley leaf,green pea,baby carrot,tilapia fillet,cannellini bean
title: Spanish Seafood Tiolets for Two
ingredients: 1 cup canned cannellini beans, drained | 8 ounces frozen green peas | 14 ounces tilapia fillets, cubed | 1 1/2 cups baby carrots | 12 -14 black olives, pitted and halved | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads, crumbled | 1 tablespoon minced parsley leaves
instructions: In large skillet, stir together beans, peas, and tilapia fillets.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Sprinkle with olives.  Add saffron.  Cover and cook until fish is opaque about 1 to 2 minutes.  Sprinkle with parsley before serving.

title: Potato Chips and Chips
ingredients: 2 potatoes, scrubbed | 1 onion powder, plus more for sprinkling to finish | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Place the potatoes into a large saucepan and cover with salted water.  Bring to a boil, and cook for 15 minutes until just tender.  Drain.  Meanwhile, heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat, and saute the onion until soft and golden.  Remove the potatoes from the water with a slotted spoon and place the fries in the skillet.  Sprinkle the onions and sautee mixture generously, sprinkling with kosher salt.  Transfer to a baking dish, and bake at 425 degrees f 25 minutes, or until golden and crispy on top.

title: Sausage Wrapped Wraps

instructions: Mix paste, honey, and ranch dressing together in a bowl.

title: Pesto Pasta With Cabbage and Mint
ingredients: pasta, of your choice ( of your choice ) | 1 head cabbage, grated | 1 tablespoon dried mint | fresh cream | crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Bring 6 cups water to a boil.  Add cabbage and season with salt and pepper.  Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.  Drain and transfer to an ice bath or colander.  Gently squeeze the cabbage out of just the shreds.  Place in a bowl.  Add all the other ingredients except for the cream and crushed pepper.

title: Biscuits (For Dipping)
ingredients: 1/4 cup parsley, chopped | 2 -3 cups white flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Knead dough for 5 minutes or until smooth and elastic at the edges.  Place on floured board, roll out to 1/2 inch thickness.  Cut in 3/4 rounds or 3 inch rounds.  Place on greased baking tray, cover with towel and let rise till double in bulk.  Bake at 400 for 8 to 10 minutes.  Do not over bake, they will be dry.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,beef stew meat,basmati rice,apple cider vinegar
title: Apple-Cider Beef Cole Slaw - Pressure Cooker Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 3/4 lb napa cabbage, washed, cored and thinly sliced | 4 cups prepared basmati rice | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
instructions: Place meat in pressure cooker, add cabbage and vinegar and seal pressure cooker.  Over high heat, develop steam to high pressure.  Cover and cook for 15 minutes.  Remove from heat and leave pressure cooker tightly closed at this point.  Let pressure drop naturally, but be careful.  Remove lid and fluff with a fork.  You may also want to make these in a crockpot, but they will not work so long.  Serve with cooked basmati rice and any additional cabbage.

Random Ingredients: grape,hot red chili pepper,cinnamon,corn oil,bread,white bean,yellow onion,vanilla bean
title: Sopa De Frijoles Negros
ingredients: 1/4 lb medium-grain yellow onion | 1 cinnamon stick | 1 cup white beans ( canned, dry-cooked or homemade ) | 2 fresh hot red chili peppers | 1/2 cup grape or 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 cup corn oil | 2 slices bread | 2 tablespoons vanilla bean | 1 cinnamon stick | 1/4 cup grapes, toasted
instructions: For the beans and chilies,.  Remove peel from pods, removing seeds, and chop.  Place onion, cinnamon stick, white beans together in a large saucepan.  Add chilies and enough water to cover.

title: Lazy Bimini
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck roast or 1 1/2 lbs round roast, bone in | 8 ounces rotel | 4 small potatoes | baking chocolate bar
instructions: Trim excess fat or hard spots from the meat.  Cut the meat into 8 cubes and add to the pot.  Add rotel.  Cover the pot and bring to a boil.  Turn down to medium and let simmer for about 2 hours.  Drain any liquid from the pot you can place the meat in.  Remove the meat to a bowl or platter.  Slice the potatoes into 4 - 6 wedges.  Return them to the pot as well and simmer 10 minutes or until tender.  Stir in the chocolate.  Note, if you would like a more thick gravy like a roux, brown 1 tablespoon of butter in small fry pan placed over medium heat for 1 minute or until melted.  When the meat is done, remove the meat, draining the fat out of the pot.  Stir the meat back into the gravy and bring to a simmer to finish cooking the meat.

title: Muxiros -- Vietnamese Caramel Shreds
ingredients: 2 bottles dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 quarts ice, crushed
instructions: Heat the dark soy sauce in a bowl over hot water until the mixture turns a reddish brown color.  Mix in 2 quarts of ice.  Let rest in refrigerator for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,beef chuck,navy bean,pepperoni,arrowroot,fenugreek seed,brown rice
title: Stuffed Peppers Italiano
ingredients: 1 can navy beans, drained | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepperoni | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1/3 cup kalamata olives, sliced into 1/4-inch pieces | 1 beef chuck, cut into chunks | 3/4 cup pearl barley, cooked | 1 tablespoon arrowroot
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for beef and arrowroot in a bowl using your hands.  Place beef in the bowl with the olive mixture, and fold gently until well blended.  Place beef on a platter, cover with foil, and set aside to marinate for 1 1/2 hours at room temperature or up to 4 hours in the refrigerator.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place potatoes on a baking sheet, and bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork.

title: Lebanese Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken tenders | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 4 teaspoons instant espresso powder
instructions: Preheat grill to medium.  Wash tenders.  Coat with coffee powder and add the stock to a saucepan over medium high heat.  Cover and cook for 3 minutes.  Place tenders on a board.  Place in large baking pan.  Place under grill and cook for 15 minutes or until the chicken is golden.

title: Vanilla Steak
ingredients: 20 new york strips or 20 boneless sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons pure vanilla extract
instructions: Trim the fat from the steaks and trim it with a very sharp knife to get very thin pieces of meat.  In a shallow roasting dish set over a medium heat, add the steaks to the pan and rub them with the vanilla.  Cook the steaks, uncovered, for 15 minutes, turn over and cook for another 15 minutes or until the meat is just cooked through.  Remove the steaks from the pan and serve immediately.

title: Caribbean Coconut Fried Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 2 tablespoons onion powder ( if your family doesn't drink curry, use 1 t ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground beef or 1 1/2 teaspoons ground pork
instructions: In a resealable freezer bag, combine 1 cup of water and the coconut oil.  Add to bag, seal and turn to coat.  Refrigerate, turning bag over once or twice, for at least one hour or up to 6 hours.  Drain and discard marinade.  Heat a skillet or a large cast iron frying pan.  If you do not have a cast iron frying pan, add coconut oil to the skillet or fry pan, or use vegetable oil.  Slice the stew meat against the grain into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Fry in the hot oil until the brown on all sides, but not cooked through.  If using a cast iron frying pan, turn heat to medium low.  Add onion powder and ground beef to the skillet or fry pan.  Continue frying until meat is no longer pink and onion powder is incorporated.  Serve the meat and onions over cooked rice, if using.

title: The Very Versatile Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 packages dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup tahini, or as needed | 1/2 cup red wine, or as needed
instructions: In your blender or food processor, combine the dry soup mix, tahini, and red wine.  Blend until completely combined.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow cake mix,range chicken,chicken broth,oil,phyllo pastry
title: Poulet Au Beurre (Serves Many)
ingredients: 3 3/4 - 4 1/4-4 lbs free-range chicken, cut up | 1 lb yellow cake mix | 1 egg, beaten | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup oil | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets
instructions: Mix cake mix and egg together and set aside.  Heat the oil in a skillet and saute the chicken for about 3 minutes, then cover and set aside.  Preheat the oven to 375 fahrenheit.  Brush the bottom and sides of a 9x13 baking dish with some of the egg mixture.  Bake the bread for about 30 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from oven and let cool.  Cut into squares.  Mix chicken, and the remaining egg, and pour mixture over bread.  Bake for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Bacon, Canadian Peppers & Cashews -- Breakfast or Dinner!
ingredients: 12 slices canadian bacon ( bacon bits ) | 7 ounces cashews, chopped, dry | 1 small orange bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Fry the bacon in a nonstick pan or fryer.  If the bacon is so crispy that it is turning brown, take it out to drain it of its paper like residue.  Fry the cashews, if using, for only a few minutes.  Set aside on a plate.  Add the bell pepper to the bacon fat and fry for just 5 to 7 minutes until the peppers are golden.  Use a slotted spoon and remove the bacon and bell pepper from the pan.  Spoon the cashews onto a plate.  Tear off the bacon bits and slice the bacon about 1 1/2 inches thick.

title: Thai Fried Plantain Patties
ingredients: 2 lbs eggplants | 1/2 cup salsa, your favorite | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 3 cups ground salmon | 1 cup mashed papaya
instructions: Cut eggplants in half lengthwise and slice lengthwise into 1/4 thick slices.  Spray broiler pan with nonstick spray.  Arrange eggplant in single layer on broiler tray.  Combine salsa, peanut butter, and baking powder and spread mixture over vegetables.  Place in 300 degree oven for about one hour or until sticky.  Place meat or fish and/or seafood on separate plates.  When ready to serve, place patties over eggplant.  Serve with peanuts, sour cream or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,jamaican jerk spice,mini hamburger bun,blueberry,turnip,white rice,cabbage leaf
title: Jamaican Beef Burger
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced jamaican jerk spice ( mccormick ) | 1/2 lb mini hamburger buns | 3/4 cup diced turnip | 1/2 cup shredded cabbage leaf ( i use regular cabbage in a bag ) | 1/4 cup fresh blueberries, sliced on diagonal | 2 kaffir lime leaves or 1 lemon wedge
instructions: Heat a grill or a grill pan.  Place the jerk seasoning in a small bowl.  Place the cut up onion and turnips in the center of a piece of aluminum foil.  Divide the jerk seasoning evenly over the meat and sprinkle with the jerk seasoning.  Wrap the turkey mixture around the meat and place on the grill.  Cook for 3 minutes on each side and turn over to grill.  Repeat with the turnips and onions until they are cooked 3 to 4 more minutes.  Divide the shredded cabbage between the 2 cooked burger buns.  Top with the blueberries and fresh lime leaves.  If desired, garnish with a fresh wedge of lime. instructions:
Name:- ##
 Moolie (Hot Pepper Candy) 
 
## Ingredients ##
 2 cups chopped fresh cheese ( Swiss and Cheddar work best here ) | 1 1/4 cups unsalted kahlua cheese, preferably Ener-Gluger or 1 1/4 cups aged english toffee.  The strong flavor of the hot pepper is subtle and complimentary for those who would like a little heat for themselves.  It is usually quite strong in flavor but complimentary in how they flavor the toffee so keep that in mind.  In a small saucepan over heat, melt the kahlua and allow to get very warm over a slow heat.  When it has just melted, mix in the coffee and allow it to cool in the pan.  After the toffee has cooled, add the cheese to the pan and mix it well together with the hot pepper.  Take one spoonful at a time as a small part of the cheese mixture will sink into the pan and begin to melt over a moderate heat.  When the mixture begins to melt and firm up, remove it from direct heat and divide it between 4 - 1 cup or 2 cup sized ramekins.  Allow the mixture to harden for about 15 minutes.  Once the mixture has cooled and firm, you can frost it with a chocolate glaze.  Garnish your moolie with colored sugar sprinkles and a coriander sprig.

title: Salmon Steak With Potato Jackets and Watercress
ingredients: 1 red potato, peeled and cut into 3 cm cubes | 10 skinless chicken breast halves ( about 1 kg of these might be a little bit more ) | 4 skinless salmon steaks ( about 3oz each ) | sea salt | watermelon, steed removed, halved lengthways | sea salt | 150 g skinless smoked salmon steak | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh garlic ( about 1 teaspoon of dried )
instructions: Combine potatoes, chicken breasts, salmon steaks and sea salt in a large ceramic casserole dish.  Place dish over a medium high heat and bring to the boil, and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until tender.  Uncover, and reduce the heat to low, and simmer for a further 5 - 10 minutes until chicken is cooked just through and potatoes cooked through.  Divide chicken between serving plates, and top with potato mixture.  Add watermelon stel in a spiral over the chicken until fully covered and place under a hot grill until the watermelon turns to a slightly blackened skin and starts to curl up, then flip the melon over to get the other side.  Cut vegetables to 4cm/1½in cubes and place on top of salmon with sea salt and sea salt, then press a little coarse salt on the surface of the potato mixture.  Slice smoked salmon into wedges, and serve with the chicken.

Random Ingredients: white rice,black olive,rosemary leaf,rigatoni pasta,cauliflower,phyllo pastry,seasoning salt,saffron thread
title: Rigatoni with Cauliflower, Onions and Black Olives
ingredients: 3 cups cooked white rice | 2 cups cauliflower, chopped | 1/3 cup black olives, sliced | 3 cups cooked rigatoni pasta | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry, thawed and cut into 6 equal squares | 1 pinch dried rosemary leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a large mixing bowl, combine the rice, cauliflower, olives, and saffron threads.  Unfold one sheet of half of the pastry onto the work surface.  Layer rice mixture into 6 - 9 squares on the pastry, leaving a 1 inch rim around the edge.  Spoon about 1 tablespoon of vegetable mixture into the center of each rice and top with one fourth or more of the pastry squares.  Fold the sides of the pastry over the mixture and fold over towards the center to enclose the filling.  Repeat with remaining pastry and filling, placing the rice and cauliflower mixture on top of the pastry covered dough in three layers.  Spoon any remaining filling on top of the pastry layered layers until all the filling is used up.  Place each layer in a 13x9 inch baking dish.  In a small bowl, sprinkle half of the rosemary over the top of the sheets of pastry dough, then place the other half of the pastry on top and pinch a little salt over the top.  Cut several slits into the top of the casserole and drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.  Bake in the preheated oven for 30 - 35 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Taco-Style Mexican Salad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 slice american cheese | 1 romaine lettuce, outer leaves removed
instructions: Place fenugreek seeds on 1/4 inch hot griddle, roast or fry until dark and fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove from heat and spread on a plate.  Sprinkle toasted fenugreek seed onto a plate.  In a small bowl, mix taco seasoning with cheese.

title: Baked Spanish Rice With Sausage and Meat (Arroz Valenciana)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 1/2 lb pork sausage | 3/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 16 ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Prepare spanish rice and set aside.  Put sausage in a skillet of water with the parsley and garlic.  Bring to a boil, then drain and discard the pork fat.  Stir rice into the sausage to combine.  Place on a greased baking or baking sheet and bake about 30 minutes, stirring once, or until golden brown and firm.  Meanwhile, warm a grill pan or skillet over high heat.  Brush sausage with oil.  Cook and stir about five minutes or until sausage is warm and cooked through.  Drain.  Serve rice with sausage and meat.  Enjoy.

title: Greek Pasta with Shellfish
ingredients: 1 box uncooked pasta shells | 1 teaspoon the all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions.  While the pasta cooks, make the crumb topping.  In a large bowl, combine the crumbs with the greek seasoning.  Drain the pasta, discarding all but 1/4 cup of the pasta water.  When the pasta has been drained, mix in the crumb topping until well coated.  Serve hot.

title: Pan Seared Beef Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck | 1 lb medium-sliced boneless skirt steak | 6 anchovy fillets, oil-flavored, drained and coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut beef steaks into 2 by 1/4 inch thick pieces.  Place steaks into a large, heavy duty plastic bag.

title: Penne Arrabiata
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1 package penne pasta
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil.  Add rice, return to a boil.  Reduce heat, and cover.  Simmer 20 minutes, until all liquid is absorbed.  Remove from heat, and cover.  When water is absorbed, stir in pasta.  Cover.  Let sit 5 minutes, until pasta is dry.

title: Chewy Oranges
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon yeast | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 cup crushed ice, or as needed
instructions: Place the yeast in a small bowl.  Pour orange juice into the bowl and mix with your finger tips to dissolve yeast.  Set aside until the yeast forms a creamy yeast layer on the surface.  Place 1/2 cup of crushed ice in a microwave safe bowl, or in the sink, and pour in the yeast mixture.  Microwave on high for about 5 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes until the gelatin has turned into a slightly grainy layer.  Remove from microwave and stir vigorously.  Return to microwave and continue microwaving on medium power for 5 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,cilantro,cocoa powder,fennel seed,arugula leaf,rib eye steak,salt pepper,nutritional yeast
title: Cafe Rio Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb rib eye steak | 2 teaspoons crushed fennel seeds | 2 tablespoons cilantro | 3 tablespoons italian parsley | freshly chopped fresh cilantro | 1 teaspoon salt and pepper | 2 -3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/2 cup arugula leaf ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f lightly oil a large baking sheet.  Combine fennel seeds, cilantro, parsley, salt, and pepper in a small bowl and set aside.  Place steak in a small saucepan, cover with water, and cook 4 - 5 minutes or until just pink.  Drain, and pat dry with paper towels.  Pound steak with a meat pounder until thin to medium.  Place in a large baking dish.  Combine 1/4 cup cocoa, nutritional yeast, 1/4 cup cocoa powder, and 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan.  Heat over medium to low heat, stirring constantly, until chocolate thickens.  Pour over steaks.  Set aside at room temperature for about 30 minutes.  Using a metal knife, slice 1/4 thick and then diagonally across.  Arrange on baking sheet, then top with remaining cheese, and cover with parchment paper.  Bake about 20 minutes, or until just beginning to brown.  Serve on sandwich and top with arugula leaves.

Random Ingredients: pecan half,rum extract,arborio rice,apricot preserve,roasting chicken,white bean,crabmeat,almond paste
title: Dirty Apricot Baked Chicken
ingredients: 2 ounces roasted almond paste ( see note ) | 1 1/4 1 1/4 lbs roasting chickens or 1 1/4 lbs other boneless chicken parts | 1 package imitation crabmeat or 1 package imitation imitation crabmeat | 1 can white beans, rinsed & drained | 2 cans of cannabate rum-flavored apricot preserves | 2 packages arborio rice ( may not use light ) | 5 -6 cups peanut pecan halves or 5 -6 cups walnut pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350.  In a small bowl, combine almond paste with enough water to make a paste.  Sprinkle evenly over chicken pieces, cover and refrigerate while making the sauce.  Cut crabmeat into bite size pieces, marinate chicken in rum, remove from marinade & reserve.  Remove chicken from marinade & dry well.  In a large glass baking dish pour half of the rum apricot preserves, spread apricot preserves over chicken then place crab pieces over preserves.  Spread apricot sauce over chicken then top with remaining 3 cups of drained cannabate rum.  Place in preheated oven and bake uncovered for approximately 45 minutes.  Remove from oven & top with nuts & serve.  Note, the amount of rice per dish is up to how many servings you want.  You may also vary this by adding white beans, apricot preserves & coconut milk.  The rum and apricot flavor may vary widely.  Also see description for other fruits & aromatics.  Note, i use rum extract when making this dish as it can cause burns to occur during baking, which does not affect the flavor.  However if using imitation crab, crab, imitation chicken, pork or beef you may also use imitation ham, bacon, ham, bacon bits or other extraneous ingredients of choice & omit the ham & crab in step.

title: Low Fat Crostini With Chickpeas
ingredients: 3/4 lb beef brisket, trimmed | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 6 slices baguette | 3/4 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 3 tablespoons of fresh chervil, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Cut meat into 6 serving size pieces.  Place in a large casserole dish.  Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a medium sized saucepan over high heat.  Stir in chickpeas and reduce heat to medium.  Simmer for 25 minutes.  Remove meat and discard water.  Drain and discard any bones and gristle and cut meat into 8 serving size pieces.  Wrap baguette in foil and place on a baking sheet.  Bake baguettes for 30 minutes.  Remove from oven and stir in milk and cheese.  Cook for 5 minutes.  Spoon mixture onto 6 slices of baguette and top with chervil.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,artichoke heart,guacamole,rice wine vinegar,vanilla pudding mix,beef stew meat
title: Dijon Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut in bite-size chunks | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix ( jello brand recommended ) | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/3 cup guacamole
instructions: Place meat in lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,monterey jack cheese,green olive,ginger paste,bulgur
title: Vegetarian Gingersnaps
ingredients: 2 cups bulgur, pre-cooked | 3 -4 tablespoons ginger paste | 1/2 cup yellow onion, diced | 1 1/4 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 cup canned green olives, drained
instructions: Boil bulgur until thick and al dente.  Stir in ginger and onions.  Add cheese and olives.  Toss gently.  Drain off excess water.

title: Chilli Beef Wellingtons
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup coriander leaves | egg roll wrap
instructions: Cut tenderloin in half, then flatten with your hand to a ¾ inch thickness.  Place between 2 sheets of plastic wrap covered with plastic wrap and pound to ¾ inch thickness with rolling pin or flat object.  Cover and refrigerate for ½ an hour.  Cut a ½ inch slit along center of beef.  Place coriander leaves on counter and roll up from one end of the wrap.  Use any scissors or sharp scissors to carefully open roll.  Place each roll in a wellingtons or muffin tin.  Allow to rest for 15 minutes.  Serve with dipping sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,cremini mushroom,vegetable oil cooking spray,black bean sauce,turnip,vegetable oil
title: Wild Rice and Wild Turnips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 4 large yellow turnips | 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup other long grain rice | 1 teaspoon black bean sauce, i use sriracha | 1 can vegetable oil-packed, sun-dried tomatoes ( no subs ) | 2 cups uncooked wild rice | 1 cup thinly sliced cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium high heat.  Add the turnips and 1/2 teaspoon salt.  Stir fry, stirring frequently until just tender.  In a large bowl, place the wild rice, mushrooms and 1/2 teaspoon salt.  Add the sun dried tomatoes and 1/2 teaspoon salt.

title: Somerset Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces cucumbers | 1 tablespoon miso | 1 tablespoon sultana raisin, finely chopped | chili oil | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Chop the cucumbers into matchsticks or cut them into cubes.  Place in a large bowl, add the remaining ingredients.  Toss.

title: Panch Phora
ingredients: 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: Heat the cumin until just starting to smoke in a small skillet over medium heat.  Watch carefully, as the cumin tends to crackle at first.  When the cumin starts to crackle, lower the heat to low.  Meanwhile, combine the zest of one orange and the juice in a cup with a pinch of salt until the zest is dry on the surface.  Add the orange zest to the hot teh mixture in the pan and let it sit until it is cool enough to handle.  Smear the top of the teh with the orange zest and serve warm.

title: Dijon Swiss Bites
ingredients: 1/2 lb deli ham, sliced or 1/2 lb cooked ham, cut bite sized | 1/4 cup marshmallows or 1/4 cup regular marshmallow | 1/4 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 bag mixed nuts, of your choice
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a medium bowl.  Spray a 8 x16 baking dish with non stick cooking spray.  Arrange the ham/ham/swiss mixture in the bottom.  Dip your nuts into the mixture.  Sprinkle the top with more nuts.  Bake at 350° for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb english noodles | 3/4 cup yellow split peas, cooked | 3/4 cup shredded light cheddar cheese or 3/4 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley flakes, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon sweet paprika | 2 tablespoons chopped celery
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.  Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.  Combine in a large salad bowl, cheese, spices and celery and stir gently.  Serve warm.

title: Rick's Spicy Spanish Smoked Paprika Paste
ingredients: 4 tablespoons spanish smoked paprika | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons red sweet spanish paprika | 1 can chopped green chilies
instructions: Mix in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate chip,pecan,cottage cheese,glutinous rice flour,corn flake,pear
title: Pecan Rice Crispy Baked in Custard Cups
ingredients: 1 package glutinous rice flour | 150 g cottage cheese | 1/2 cup pecans, toasted, chopped | 1/4 cup light corn flakes, chopped | 200 g milk chocolate chips | 25 g milk chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c grease a large baking tray or line with parchment paper.  Combine all ingredients, except chocolate chips, in a large bowl and stir until everything is well combined.  Pour mixture in the prepared baking tray and bake for 40 – 45 minutes, until golden brown.  Remove from oven and set aside for 5 to 10 minutes to cool slightly.  Remove cereal mixture from the tray and place on a baking tray lined with paper.  Spread each square with about 1/4 cup of extra chocolate and 1 tbsp of chopped pecans.  Once cooled serve immediately.

title: Mama's Big Fat Lunch: Vegetarian Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 32 ounces veggie beans ( vegetarian brands ) | 26 ounces chicken wings, and giblets ( i used a homemade variety that doesn't take the calories ) | 32 ounces rice krispies | 2 bags baby carrots | 1 bag baby carrots | 8 ounces prosciutto | 4 large eggs ( to scramble, add to soup when boiling in a 1 qt saucepan )
instructions: Combine beans and broth, add in chicken wings, garlic, potatoes, carrots and ham.  Cook, if it looks like it might be dry at the end of the 2 3hr it is.  Cook for a further 20min and then add in rice krispies.  Beat two eggs and stir into soup.  Cook for an additional 5 10min and serve.

Random Ingredients: beer,beef bouillon cube,hoagie,parsley,fajita seasoning mix,table salt
title: Easy Low-Fat Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup fat free low-sodium beef bouillon cubes | 2 teaspoons fajita seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon table salt | 1/2 cup beer ( nonalcoholic, nonalcoholic ) | 16 hoagie rolls | chopped fresh parsley ( optional garnish )
instructions: Combine the bouillon cubes and 1 cup of water in a saucepan over medium heat.

title: Moroccan Bread & Butter Pudding
ingredients: 1 large orange, peel on about 1/4 inch wide | 4 celery ribs | 6 tablespoons bread, soft | 6 -8 green cardamom, very very small
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300 degrees f.  Wash the outer shell of the orange & celery & slice into 2 inch lengths.  Cut the rind into 3 inch segments.  Place the bread slices on a cookie sheet & bake until lightly toasted, 3 - 5 minutes.  Remove & set aside.  Crack open the cardamom pods & place in a small bowl.  Cut a slit down the side of each orange peel & put open as much as possible.  Open the cardamom pods & discard the husks.  Place the orange peel over the bread & spread the slices with some of the melted butter.  Place in the oven & bake for 1 hour, turn half way.  Remove & place on a plate for 15 - 20 minutes if desired.  To serve, place a scoop of ice cream in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Baquet Garni (Grammy's Eggplant)
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplants, about 2 1/2 pounds ( globe variety ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
instructions: Peel the eggplants, slice into 1/4 inch slices, and arrange on a baking sheet.  Place in oven and bake, turning once, until soft, about 30 minutes.  While the eggplants are baking, combine the cream and 2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan, and cook over medium low heat until the cream is reduced to 2 tablespoons, about 10 minutes.  Transfer to a bowl when done.  When the eggplants are done, transfer to a serving bowl.  Toss with the reduced cream.  Remove the eggplants and turn on paper towels.  Dry them for a few minutes in the oven, then remove their towels and rub off as much dirt as possible.  Pour a little of the cream sauce in the bowl, then carefully remove the skin from the eggplants using a knife.  Cut the eggplants lengthwise into half the long, thin slices.  Toss with 3 tablespoons of the cream sauce and set aside.  Reheat the remaining cream sauce in a large dutch oven over low heat.  The cream sauce can also be used as a dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,olive,bacon dripping,baby spinach,pepper sauce,jicama,rice wine,sesame oil
title: Jicama Spinach With Bacon and Rice Wine
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 1/2 lbs baby jicama, peeled and diagonally sliced into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 12 slices bacon, cooked and torn into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon seasoned rice wine | 2 ripe tomatoes, chopped | 1 can tomato puree | 2 cans sliced ripe olives, drained | 3 1/2 cups cooked rice, kept hot | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce, for serving
instructions: Heat the vegetable sesame oil in a 9 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat, then place the jicama in the pan.  Cook, stirring frequently, until beginning to brown, about 4 minutes.  Add the bacon, stirring until it starts to turn translucent, then stir in the rice wine and cook until it evaporates completely, about 2 minutes.  Stir in the tomatoes, tomato puree, olives, and hot pepper sauce.  Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the jicama is tender, about 20 minutes.  Serve warm, with hot rice.

Random Ingredients: black coffee,cooking wine,spanish onion,sea scallop,liquid smoke flavoring,broth,phyllo pastry
title: Sliced Scallops and Bro - Kålkålage - Icelandic Version,
ingredients: 2 ounces quick-cooking wine | 1 -2 ounce spicy spicy smoked salt black coffee or 1 -2 ounce coffee-infused coffee, such as smithwick's | 1 medium spanish onion, thinly sliced ( or 1 shallot, minced ) | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 3/4 teaspoon reduced-sodium maggi liquid smoke flavoring | 12 fresh frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 1 1/2 lbs small sea scallops | warm broth, as needed
instructions: Rinse salt and pepper on a clean dish towel.  Dissolve liquid smoke in a small saucepan and add 1/2 cup water.  Set aside.  Place onion slices in a small container with a lid, making sure all of the liquid is captured in the container.  Pour liquid smoke mixture over onion, set aside.  Arrange 5 sheets of phyllo on a work surface in a 3 to 4 inch square space.  Cover with a dampened cotton towel with some plastic wrap.  Brush top sheet of phyllo with water, cut sheet in half, leaving 2 or 3 edges whole, then brush each with a little bit more water.  Repeat steps #5 and # 6 with the remaining 10 sheets of phyllo and water.  Wrap the stacked phyllo sheets in a double thickness of dampened cloth or waxed paper.  Cover with a dampened cloth or waxed paper wrapped in plastic wrap and with a dampened cloth or waxed paper secured to the work surface with extra plastic wrap.  Set aside.  If you have time, preheat oven to 400 degrees f, then place a skillet over medium high heat and, when it is very hot, add the scallops.  Cook until brown, then remove with a slotted spoon, allowing any liquidized juices to drain back into gravy pan.  Reduce heat to medium.  Return the scallops to gravy and cook just until heated through.  To serve, ladle scallops and juices into a warm soup or serve immediately.  Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve with a crisp wide mouth spanish salad, such as vietnamese mint or a simple cucumber salad.  A crisp green salad will also make a nice accompaniment.  Note, to make mushroom garnish, soak wood ear mushrooms in hot water for 15 minutes, then remove and discard wood ears, then soak in hot water for 15 minutes.  Drain thoroughly and squeeze dry.  Cut roots of mushrooms and stems into thirds.

title: Kieli Dip
ingredients: 2 packages mexican-style processed cheese | 2 tablespoons dried dill weed | 1 bottle brandy, chilled | 1 package seafood ( optional )
instructions: Open all the packages of processed cheese and cut them into chunks.  Add the dried dill and the brandy to the processed cheese and mix to evenly distribute and mix.  Stir in the seafood if using.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.  Serve cold as an appetizer for a meal or snack.

title: Miniature Red Pies
ingredients: 120 g small red potatoes, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup pine nuts or 1/4 cup walnut pieces | 1/2 teaspoon sage, finely chopped | 1/2 cup caster sugar, firmly packed | pepperoni, pieces | pine nuts, toasted and finely chopped, to serve
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/180c fan forced.  Line 6 mini muffin pans with baking paper.  Place potatoes and pine nuts in a small bowl.  Add sage and sugar.  Sift pepperoni over potatoes and pine nuts.  Spoon equal amounts of mixture into each cup.  Using hands, gently press potatoes together.  Arrange in muffin pans.  Bake for 40 - 50 minutes or until top is golden and cooked.  Stand in pan for 5 minutes.  Remove from pans.  Serve warm or cool and freeze in freezer bags.

title: Apricot Paste
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried apricot, diced | 1/4 cup fresh marjoram, minced | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook over medium heat stirring constantly.  Cool and use in any recipe calling for marinated fish, poultry, and vegetables.

title: Pasta Nests
ingredients: 2/3 lb rigatoni pasta | 3/4 cup pine nuts | 1/2 cup pepitas ( dried crushed pepper flakes )
instructions: Put 2/3 cup of the pepitas and 3/4 of the pine nuts in a fry pan.  Bring to boil, stir occassionaly, reduce heat.  Cook till it is soft and has reduced, stirring frequently.  Cook pasta in boiling water till it is al dente.  Drain pasta.  Stir in pine nut mixture.  Toss lightly.  Sprinkle the remaining pepitas on top.  Serve cold.

title: Sauerkraut and Beans With Cream
ingredients: 1 lb sauerkraut, drained and rinsed and coarsely chopped | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons cornflour or 3 tablespoons flour | 2 tablespoons mirin ( cooking sherry ) | 3 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a large bowl, place the sauerkraut and beans.  Stir in the cornflour and 1 tablespoon of mirin or cooking sherry.  Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours to overnight.  Turn the sauerkraut mixture over half way through the marinating time.  Using a spoon, bring the cream to a boil.  Add the hot cream slowly while mixing with the sauerkraut and beans.  Stir and remove from the heat.  Serve immediately.

title: French-Style Green Beans
ingredients: french-style green beans, trimmed | cabbage-style green pepper, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Mix the vinegar with a little water to make dressing.  Cook over medium heat until vinegar is syrupy and the green beans are tender crisp.  Serve with fresh vegetables, such as cabbage salad.

title: Shelly's Green Beans & Za'atar
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed and cut into quarters | 3/4 cup oatmeal | 4 cloves, ground or 2 tablespoons ground coriander | 2 -3 tablespoons salsa, hot | 2 packages za'atar spice mix | 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place the green beans and oatmeal in a casserole dish, and place in the oven, stirring every 10 minutes for 10 - 15 minutes or until beans are tender.  Meanwhile, in a medium mixing bowl, mix the garlic, salt and hot pepper sauce.  Add the 2 pinches of za'atar.  When beans are tender, stir well to mix.  Stir in the butter.  Sprinkle the remaining za'atar on top.  Cover and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until the za'atar is bubbly.  Serve warm.  Variation, i usually stir half of the za'atar into the sauce left in the casserole dish and the last half of za'atar i'm coating in the butter before pouring on top of the beans before serving.

Random Ingredients: almond essence,baby bok choy,salt black pepper
title: Baby Bok Choy With Almonds
ingredients: 2 baby bok choy, outer green leaves removed | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped almonds, toasted and cooled | 1/2 teaspoon almond essence | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place blanched almonds in a bowl with boiling water, then cover and let sit for 1/2 hour.  Drain and set aside.  Boil baby bok choy leaves in salted water for 1 minute.  Drain and keep warm.  In a non stick frypan, grind almonds, almond essence and chopped bok choy leaves together with salt and pepper.  Spoon warm almond mixture evenly over bok choy leaves, then serve.

title: Radish Rolls
ingredients: 1 head boston lettuce | 1 bunch sliced radish | 2 cloves garlic | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped garlic | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Wash the lettuce well under running water, tear down the leaves and place them on a salad plate.  Remove any outer leaves as well.  Place the radishes, cut side up, on a cutting board and slice them thinly.  Mince the garlic.  Cut a slit in a groove in the center of each radish slice, forming a pocket.  Fill the groove with the garlic and spread it with the garlic.  Roll each radish slice up and place in the plate seam side down.  Stir the roll with your hands if you feel they are needed in order for the mixture to spread evenly.

title: Semolina Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup semolina | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning, from the pepper jar | 1 1/3 cups colby cheese, shredded
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large, deep skillet, stirring to mix well.  Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook for 15 minutes.  Use a slotted spoon to remove from heat and let sit for a minute or two before serving.

title: Cheesy Parsnip and Parsnip Stuffed Ravioli
ingredients: 2 cups fresh parsnips, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup green apple, chopped | 2 cups crushed cheese ravioli | 1 teaspoon dry crushed corn flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees.  Spray 11x15 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Mix parsnips, cheese, apples and ravioli.  Sprinkle with crushed cornwafers.  Bake in oven 10 minutes.  Cut each zig zag into 8 wedges.

title: Griottine's Linguine With Turnips and Fresh Berry Stuffing
ingredients: 1/4 lb linguine | fresh strawberries or fresh raspberries | fresh dill or fresh parsley | of fresh mint | diced yellow bell pepper | 1 turnip, peeled and diced small | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh mixed berry, chopped
instructions: In a pot of boiling salted water, cook the linguine until al dente.  While the linguine cooks, chop the strawberries or raspberries for garnish and place them in a bowl.  Add the chopped dill or parsley and mix.  Add small to medium sized chunks of small yellow pepper and toss with the linguine.  Then add diced turnip and toss well, and add the berry mixture.  Serve hot or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: dill,pistachio nut,tart apple,ice cream,espresso powder,pimento olive,pasta
title: Apple Cream Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup instant espresso powder | 8 ounces pasta, dried | 4 tart apples, peeled, cored and sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1/2 cup pistachio nut, ground | 1/3 cup pimento stuffed olive, sliced | fresh dill, for garnish | ice cream or whipped cream, for garnish
instructions: Put the espresso in a small saucepan, add ¾ cup water and bring to a boil.  Turn off to keep warm.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook 3 minutes or just until al dente.  Drain well and reserve.  In a medium bowl, toss the apples with ¼ cup pistachios, olive, almonds, and diced pimento.  In a small bowl, stir together ¾ cup pistachios, olives, and diced pimento.  Add dressing to the pasta and combine well.

title: Arepas With Feta, Pistachios and Wilted Wilted Parsley
ingredients: 1 cup white pearl onion | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 1 lb white pearl onions | 2 cups shredded tasty cheese | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 15 ounces mild enchilada sauce | 7 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Cook pearl onions in a non stick skillet over medium heat until tender, about 4 minutes.  Set aside.  Toss onions with pistachios.  Spread onions over a large baking dish or baking stone and bake 8 minutes.  Remove from oven and toss with pistachios and pearl onions.  Spread 1/4 cup sour cream over onions and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until cheese is bubbling.  Remove from oven and stir in cornstarch until mixture is smooth. title: Chicken and Cauliflower Marsala

title: Baked Bean Soup (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 1 bag canned baked beans | 1 cup milk | 1 cup cooked barley | 1 tablespoon cornmeal ( stone-ground, best-style ) | 1/4 teaspoon whole star anise pod | 1 celery rib | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce, medium-hot ( your choice, i used jazz b & b brown ) ( optional )
instructions: Plug in the pressure cooker on the cooker with your knuckles, and bring the pressure cooker up to high pressure, then set it to ‘high’.  Stir in the baked beans, and mix the rest well to combine.  When your knuckles stop releasing a bead of steam or air, and the blade of a knife blade is very sharp and slightly elastic, it’s time to ’remanual’ the pressure cooker can take a few minutes longer.  When it’s ’already’ you’re ready to use it again, take off the stove and allow the pressure cooker to return to full pressure for five minutes.  Remove the cooker from the pan and open up the lid.  If there’s a lot of liquid in the pressure cooker, take a handful of handfuls of water and place it with the lid on the pressure cooker and bring to high pressure – you’ll want to keep the pressure below medium low heat this will take a while.  This step will prevent the steam from coming out of the lid too much.  If too much liquid and/or steel parts of the lid come through the lid, then cook it to ‘high’ in this step as well.  Add the remaining ingredients to the pan, then place the lid on.  Close the pressure cooker and bring it up to high pressure, then set it to ’medium’.  Reduce the heat to medium, and let it steam for 15–20 minutes at this point, then turn the heat down to low and cook until the soup has thickened but is still very chunky, about 1 hour longer.  Turn off heat and wait five minutes more, then check it’s consistency and adjust taste if desired.  Stir well before serving.
