instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and add the fenugreek and icing sugar.  Stir until the mixture turns dark brown, about 8 - 10 minutes.  Stir in the dark chocolate and set over a low heat for the chocolate to harden.  Stir occasionally until melted and cooled.  Fill the hot oil just below the top of the fats.  Deep fry until golden brown and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,egg yolk,mint leaf,skewer,egg white,salsa verde,shallot,icing sugar
title: Korean Deviled Eggs(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup minced shallot, plus | 2 shallots, slivered | 1 tablespoon finely minced fresh chili powder | 2 -3 tablespoons salsa verde ( kimchi ) | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 8 skewers
instructions: Place all ingredients except icing sugar in a bowl, except the icing sugar.  Beat with an electric mixer on high until mixture is light and fluffy.  Pour into a piping bag fitted with a medium star tip.  Or you can use an inverted piping bag fitted with a star tip.  Place the skewer pieces on a plate and saran wrap the skewer pieces in saran, pressing the pieces to seal.  Refrigerate the skewers for 30 minutes.  Preheat the oven to 450°f.  Place the skewers on the rack of a broiler pan.  Brush with enough water to reach about 2 inches from the top of the broiler rack, and place on the rack.  Broil until the bottoms are golden brown, 7 to 10 minutes.  Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly.  Cut into 1/2 inch pieces with a knife dipped in water.  Place the icing sugar in a small shallow dish.  Dip the dipped skewer pieces, one by one, into the icing, coating evenly, and shaking off any excess.  Place the skewered pieces on a baking tray and place the tray in the oven.

title: Orange Spice Blend
ingredients: 1 cup orange peel | 1/4 cup jaggery | 2 teaspoons splenda granular | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Put all ingredients in a ziploc and shake until blended.  Store in a tightly lidded container away from direct sunlight.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,chicken breast fillet,butter lettuce leaf,vegetable broth,rum
title: Chicken in Chocolate-Rum-Lettuce Bundles
ingredients: 500 g chicken breast fillets | 60 g butter lettuce leaves ( baby-back lettuce ) | 4 drops instant espresso or 4 drops rum | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 4 tablespoons sweetened chocolate, grated, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Grill chicken on oven tray until cooked.  Place lettuce leaves on kitchen towel.

title: Bread and Butter for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 french baguette, cut into 3/4-inch thick slices | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 ounce triple sec | 1 1/2 ounces brewed tea leaves
instructions: Toast bread slices over medium heat.  Spread each slice with a quarter teaspoon of garam masala.  Add 1/4 teaspoon triple sec to each slice.  Top each with slices of soaked tea leaves.  Turn onto a wire rack and allow to dry out before serving.

title: Paella
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Place the chicken thighs into a mixing bowl, and sprinkle with kosher salt.  Squeeze the excess moisture out of the chicken.  Slice any excess skin off each chicken thigh into 4 pieces about the thickness of your finger.  Roll each piece of chicken thighs into a roll shape, and place on a plate.  Pierce each roll individually with a toothpick or two, and set aside until all the chicken thighs are finished rolling.  Heat a heavy cast iron skillet over high heat, and cook one chicken thigh at a time, until browned on all sides.  Reduce heat to medium, and continue cooking 15 minutes per batch, or until meat is no longer pink inside.  Cut into pieces with a fork while still hot.

Random Ingredients: lemon lime beverage,onion,szechuan peppercorn,red chilies,jalapeno chile,canadian bacon,wheat noodle
title: Chuanese Beer Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb whole dry wheat noodles, uncooked | 1 -2 slice canadian bacon | 3 -4 fresh red chilies, thinly sliced | 2 fresh jalapeno chiles, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh serrano peppers or 2 tablespoons jalapeno chiles, minced | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon whole szechuan peppercorn, crushed | 1/2 cup onion, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat a medium pot of water to boiling, salt the water, add the noodles, and cook until soft and firm, about 6 minutes.  Drain.  Meanwhile, in a saute pan, saute the bacon, chilies and chiles until almost done.  Drain off excess fat.  In a large bowl, combine noodles with bacon mixture, onions and sauce.  Stir well.  Let sit for 10 minutes to allow flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,anise seed,sage,rabbit,ginger ale,dark rum
title: Rabbit in a Ginger Beer
ingredients: 2 lbs rabbit, cut up | 1 teaspoon ground rosemary | 1 teaspoon ground sage | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 2 cups ginger ale or 2 cups ale | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place the rabbit in a deep skillet or stew pot, add some water.  Cover and cook over medium low heat for about one hour.  Uncover cover and simmer, stirring in the rosemary, sage, aniseed and chile, if using, until cooked and quite dry, about 45 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,kidney bean,curly leaf parsley,brown rice,pork sparerib,baby spinach,ranch dressing mix,chicken liver
title: Texas Pork and Spinach
ingredients: 1 container marinated chicken and liver | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh curly-leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons ranch dressing mix | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 8 large dried curly-leaf parsley, divided | 2 2/3 pounds boneless pork spareribs, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 packages baby spinach | 1 package dry ranch-style dressing mix
instructions: Prepare the marinade, pour about 1/2 cup of the marinade into a large bowl, and add the chicken, kidney beans, 2 tablespoons of the parsley, 1 teaspoon of the ranch dressing mix, and majoram.  Mix together to blend.  Cover, and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.  To prepare the salad, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Place baby spinach leaves in a steamer basket, or on a serving plate.  Place the remaining 1/2 cup of parsley in a separate bowl, and stir in the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of ranch dressing mix.  Place the pork in the steamer basket on top of the bed of spinach leaves.  Cover, and steam over medium high heat.  Cook until the pork is no longer pink in the center and the spinach has softened, about 15 minutes.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f.  Remove the pork with a slotted spoon to a cutting board, and slice thinly.  Sprinkle with green bell pepper flakes, if desired, before serving.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,lard,peach schnapps,oyster sauce,vanilla essence,red pepper,beef cap,golden syrup
title: Beef With Peaches and Peppers
ingredients: 8 small beef caps | 8 pints beef caps | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 jar sweet red peppers ( yellow pepito if available ) | 4 ounces oyster sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup | 3 -4 teaspoons vanilla essence, to taste | 1 tablespoon lard, to taste
instructions: Trim end from beef caps and lay out on the counter.  Slice the peppers in half and place in a colander or sieve.  Place caps on a dish, cover and leave to drain.  Remove the beef and leave on one side until the water drips out of the caps.  Drain off all but about a tablespoon of juice.  Place the red and yellow peppers in a large pan of cold water until water starts to boil.  Boil for about 10 minutes, remove and drain.  Slice the beef into long thin strips.  Place one tablespoon of the beef in the centre of each plate, top with about 5 or 6 peaches, some of the caps, red pepper and a few drops of the golden syrup.  Drizzle over the oyster sauce.  Make a small slit in the side of the beef, place on top of the pies.  Sprinkle over the vanilla and lard, as per your taste.  Serve warm.

title: Crock Pot Easy Slow Cooker Crouton-Grilled Beef
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/3 lb beef tenderloin ( you can use any steak of your choice ) | 1/4 cup instant beef bouillon powder ( to taste )
instructions: Cut the tenderloin into 1 1/2 slices on the diagonal.  Place the slices in the slow cooker.  Sprinkle the bouillon over the slices of meat.  Cover, cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.

title: Peruvian Sweet & Sour Pickled Vegetables
ingredients: 12 fresh jalapeno peppers, seeded if desired | 1 cup coarsely chopped jalapeno pepper plus 2 tablespoons jalapeno oil | 3 tablespoons teapots wine vinegar | 1/2 cup rice vinegar
instructions: Slit tops off all but 2 or 3 peppers lengthwise and discard.  Place peppers stem side up on metal skewers.  Brush peppers with oil.  Place remaining 2 or 3 jalpenos and 2 tablespoons jalapenos on toothpicks.  Grasp tops and discard.  Place in bowl.  Cover with boiling water and let sit 15 minutes.  Drain and rinse under cold water.  Peel away outer papery skin.  Cut the peppers crosswise into thin strips.  Drain well.  Place peppers, drippings and reserved sauce ingredients in a jar.  Cover tightly and shake to mix.

title: Sweet Scottish Peppered Semolina Balls
ingredients: 4 cups semolina | 1 jar apricot jam | 1 cup light cream or 1 cup lemonade | 3/4 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread apricot jam over a baking pan.  Add 3/4 cup light cream, 3/4 teaspoon five spice powder and continue to mix.  Add semolina to the cream and mix until dough looks dry, but not crumbly.  Add more cream or cream if necessary.  Pinch off small balls of dough about the size of a walnut.  Take a walnut shaped cookie and roll into a small ball with a pinch or two of the nut in the center.  Place on the parchment covered cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes.  Remove to a wire rack to cool.

title: blueberry and Canadian Bacon Dip
ingredients: 2 cans canned blueberries, drained | 4 slices canadian bacon | 1/4 cup 1 % low-fat yogurt
instructions: Heat an ovenproof dish.  Mix blueberries, canadian bacon, and yogurt in the slow cooker.  Do not stir.  Cover the dish, and place on the stove.  Cook on high one half hour.  When the cheese is melted, remove the cover and bake 10 more minutes, until the dip has thickened and turned a dark brown color.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: nigella seed,poultry seasoning,avocado,shiitake mushroom,stewing beef,almond extract
title: Shiitake-Avocado Beef
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1/2 teaspoon ground nigella seeds or 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon dried shiitake mushroom or 1/4 teaspoon dried mushroom | 1 cup sliced ripe avocado | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Trim excess fat and sinew from the meat and cut it into strips.  In a bowl, mix all ingredients.  Let stand for 1/2 hour at room temperature before serving as desired.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,tamari,vegetable oil,plain yogurt,thyme leave,amaretto,black cardamom pod,simple syrup
title: Simple Amaretto Yogurt Dipping Sauce for Pasta or Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups plain yogurt | 1/4 cup light agave syrup or 1/4 cup simple syrup ( or try creme fraiche ) | 2 teaspoons amaretto ( or any other liqueur of your choice, try amaretto or other liqueur ) | 1 teaspoon mustard powder ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground black cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon ground thyme leave | 1/2 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon tamari or 1 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: In a food processor blend all of the ingredients in order listed to obtain a fine textured paste.  Pour into an attractive glass bowl and refrigerate 2 hours or until solid before eating. .  Sauce can also be used to dip your pasta or chicken pieces or place in a sauce dish when serving.

title: Namakara for Dummies
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa | 2 chicken bouillon cubes ( knorr works well ) | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Soak the chicken bullion cubes in 1/2 cup chunky salsa for 8 hours, in the fridge.  After 8 hours, drain the salsa, discarding remaining liquid.  Stir in coriander, reserving 1/2 cup.  Shred the cooked chicken, and serve with bagels, sour cream, shredded cheese, tortilla chips or whatever you get into your house.

title: Cornmeal Mashed Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 cups cornmeal | 2 cups russet potatoes ( about 2 ) | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar ( use white balsamic if available ) | 2 tablespoons passion fruit ( optional )
instructions: In a large saucepan, cover the potatoes with water.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle vermicelli,green chile pepper,salt pepper,white wine vinegar
title: Chile Domenic (Spicy Rice Noodles)
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds dried rice noodles or noodles | 3 green chile peppers, halved, or more to taste | 3 cups dry white wine vinegar | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Soak noodles in a large bowl of warm water 8 minutes, or until pliable.  Drain noodles completely and place them in the work bowl of a food processor.  Add green chile peppers, vinegar, salt, and pepper.  Blend until the noodles are coarsely pureed.  This can be made several hours in advance, if desired.  Cover and chill before serving.

title: Spiced Broccoli & Beans (Chickpeas)
ingredients: 1/2 cup mixed mushrooms | 1 large spanish onion, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup mixed berries
instructions: Cut stems off of mushrooms and chop stems.  In a large saucepan, bring mushroom and vegetable mixture to a boil.  Lower heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are soft, 3 to 5 minutes.  Add onion, ginger garlic paste and berry mixture.  Cook and stir gently until heated through.

title: Spicy Roasted Vegetables and Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb escarole, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 8 small new potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch-thick wedges, about 3 inches long | 1 anaheim chilies or 1 red anaheim chili, stemmed and seeded, finely chopped | 1 1/2 ounces blue cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup chopped fresh orecchiette or 1/2 cup spaghetti | 4 chilies, preferably red, thinly sliced ( optional ) | salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f and place the escarole, potatoes, chilies, and cheese in an 8 by 6 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle evenly with orecchiette.  Heat the broiler on high.  Place the chilies on top of the cheese.  Bake vegetables until cheese is melted, about 35 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 12 dried dates, coarsely chopped | 4 dried jalapeno chiles
instructions: Roast the chilies in a grill.

title: Easy Low Fat Sole Fillet in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 4 sole fillets | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Place fillets in a dish and season with salt & pepper.  Sprinkle puree and a little tabasco on top.  Cover and chill in fridge for 1 hour or longer if desired.  Heat a pan and brown fillets on both sides.  Place fillets on 4 serving plates and pour tomato sauce over.

title: Creamy Aubergines With Feta Cheese
ingredients: 2 1/2 medium aubergines | 1/2 cup soymilk, plain | 1 tablespoon vanilla bean | 1 cup romano lettuce ( or other fresh flat leaf salad such as rocket ) | 2 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Halve the aubergines lengthwise and scrape out the seeds and white pulp with a teaspoon, if you prefer.  Cut each half into quarters and discard the stems.  Slice the quarters crosswise on the diagnol into slanted irregular, thin slices.  Pour the soymilk into a medium frying pan and bring to a strong simmer over medium high heat.  Add the vanilla bean.  Lower the flame to a medium low setting and simmer gently until the milk has reduced to about 2/3 of its original volume, about 30 minutes.  While the milk is poaching, line a large rimmed baking sheet with aluminium foil.  Cut the rounds of aubergine into eighths and carefully toast them in a very hot oven until just lightly colored, about 6 - 8 minutes.  When they're done, remove them from the oven and, using a slotted spoon, remove and set aside on the towel lined baking sheet.  Reserve some cooking juice in the frying pan to prevent the aubergines from sticking to the pan and burning around the edges.  Put the soya milk and aubergine pulp into a blender or food processor.  Add the pepper sauce and the vanilla bean seeds and pulse briefly to blend.  Add the romano or other salad greens, feta cheese and a few teaspoons of reserved cooking juice for a nice creamy and spicy salad.  Pour the creamy cream sauce over the salad, or garnish as desired.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,vanilla essence,yeast,clear honey,red pepper sauce
title: Fiery Buns
ingredients: 1/2 cup cake flour or 1/2 cup gluten-free flour, sifted | 1 cup strong red pepper sauce, warmed ( or mild or hot ) | 1/4 cup clear honey | 1 teaspoon yeast | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients into bread machine and select dough cycle, when finished line a baking tray with parchment paper.  Turn on and let dough rise.  Divide into 8 equal portions and roll each piece into a circle about 9 in diameter.  Place each circle on baking tray, prick with a fork and brush with egg white.  Bake at 180 degrees fahrenheit or until golden brown and firm.  Turn off heat and allow to cool and harden slightly.

title: Crock Pot Salmon With Pearl barley
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 lb salmon | 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Open salmon, remove bones and any skin.  Cut the salmon into bite sized chunks.  In a crockpot, stir together the barley and orange juice.  Add salmon and turn to coat.  Cover with lid.  Cook on high for 2 hours.  Remove lid for last 7 minutes of cooking time, remove salmon and barley.  Serve hot with vegetables or bread.

title: Grilled Cod With Raisins and Craisins (Cod)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs cod | 1/2 cup raisins or 1/2 cup sultana | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high.  Prepare a large baking dish that will hold the fish.  Wash and pat dry the cod.  Coat it with olive oil spray.  Place the fillets in the baking dish.  Wash and pat dry the raisins or sultanas if using.  Spread raisins or sultanas over fish.  Grill, turning once, for 3 to 4 minutes for medium, or until flakey.

title: Spiced Red Chilies With Nuts
ingredients: 6 large fresh red chilies | 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 cup strong brewed tea | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon finely chopped pistachios, toasted or 1 tablespoon dried pistachios
instructions: Place the chillies in a small saucepan and add enough water to just cover.  Bring the liquid to the boil.  Turn the heat down and cook until the chillies are tender, 5 - 7 minutes.  Drain and reserve the liquid.  Place the chilies and water in a blender and process until smooth.  Strain 1/4 cup of the liquid into a small bowl.  Place all of the flour in a food processor.  Place the chili mixture into the processor bowl.  Add the reserved liquid and pistachios and pulse until the mixture forms a dough consistency.  Turn onto a floured surface.  Knead the dough briefly to form a smooth dough.  Roll out onto a lightly floured surface.  Cut the dough into 4 squares.  Place 2 teaspoons of the chilli mixture in the centre of each square.  Bring the edges of each square together to form a seal.  Use a sharp knife to cut a slit in the center.  Preheat the oven to 180°c or gas mark 6.  Brush the nuts with some of the remaining melted butter.  Bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until firm with the top browned.  Serve warm with cream.  Variation, instead of a rich red chili sauce, toast the pistachios in a dry frying pan over a medium heat until they just turn golden, about 5 minutes.

title: Scotch Kugel - Yummy!
ingredients: 10 sheets top ramen noodles or 10 sheets japanese noodles | 1 cup semolina flour | 3/4 cup kosher salt or 3/4 cup sea salt
instructions: Set up a clean kitchen towel to take the dry ingredients and dry them well either on your kitchen counter or your cutting board.  Cut kugel vertically into 1/4' slices and set aside.  Rinse the kitchen towels from inside of the kugel with cool water and pat dry with a clean cloth.  Dredge each slice of kugel in the flour and shake off the excess.  Heat a wok or large skillet over low heat.  Add a bit of oil and wait for oil to heat up.  Add kugel and wait for the kugel to turn pink, about 10 seconds or so, until the kugel has started to lightly brown at the edges.  Serve over a heap of warm, dry noodles or eat them warm straight away.

title: Za'atar Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken breast, boned and skinned | 2 tablespoons za'atar spice mix | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Sprinkle za'atar on the chicken breast.  Place in a glass bowl with the 1/4 cup of parmesan on top of it.  Cover with plastic wrap and leave the chicken to marinate for at least an hour.  When you are ready to bake your chicken, pre heat the oven to 190c/375f, and put the shelf in the middle.  Bake for 10 minutes then turn down to 180c/350f and cook for additional 20 minutes.  To brown it, take the chicken off the oven.  Slice the chicken into large chunks when it is cooked through, sprinkle the rest of the parmesan with some za'atar and serve the chicken straight away.

title: Creamy Turkish Milkshake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soymilk or 2 tablespoons fat-free evaporated milk | 2 tablespoons small fresh spearmint, leaves picked from stems
instructions: Whip the ingredients together with a fork but be careful not to overbeat.  Pour into a cup and serve immediately.

title: Sweet Bellow(Chokha)
ingredients: 20 ounces mixed vegetables, of your choice | 2 tablespoons peanuts or 2 tablespoons walnuts, roughly chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon red food coloring or 1 teaspoon cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 cup frozen peas and carrot
instructions: Boil mixed veg for 7 minutes only till tender, keep warm.  In a bowl combine remaining ingredients, mix well, add to vege and mix till smooth.  Heat a wok on high heat.  Add 2 tbsps oil, swirl.  When the oil is hot pour mixture into this, in little balls.  Cook till golden brown.  Allow to drain on kitchen paper at room temp serve with fresh tomato dipping sauce or green chilli sauce.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,herbes de provence,tea,olive oil,thai red curry paste,eggplant
title: Simple Herbed Roasted Eggplant
ingredients: 5 eggplants | 1 cup olive oil | 1 tablespoon thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 2 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 f.  Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil.  Rinse the eggplant and pat dry with paper towels.  Cut the eggplant into 4 long wedges.  Set wedges aside.  In a bowl, mix all other ingredients, including the eggplant, together until well blended.  Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.  Working in batches, add the eggplant, a few pieces at a time, to the pan and cook, turning with tongs, until golden brown on all sides, 8 to 10 minutes.  Transfer the slices with slotted spatters to a platter and sprinkle with salt.  Continue cooking until all the eggplant slices are nicely browned, 3 to 4 minutes more.  Remove from the pan and place on a piece of aluminum foil, placing on a baking sheet.  Drizzle with sauce for each serving.

title: Tarka
ingredients: 2 chicken thighs ( skinless ) | 1 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons red chili powder
instructions: Place the chicken in a fry pan with enough oil to coat.  I have made this with skinless.  Heat oil and brown the chiken on all sides.  Place the chicken into a casserole.  Pour the can of chickpeas over this.  Sprinkle with the dry red chili powder.

title: Ketchup Style Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 teaspoon hot fresh chili pepper
instructions: Combine tomato puree and chilli pepper in a small frying pan.  Bring to the boil and reduce heat.  Simmer for 10 minutes or until thickened.  Remove from heat source and stir through the sauce before serving.

Random Ingredients: tart shell,orange juice,paprika,pita bread,ramen noodle,dumpling wrapper,watercress,pearl barley
title: Japanese Noodle Salad with Barley
ingredients: 3 cups pearl barley | 1 large orange, juice of | 1/2 cup watercress, finely chopped | 15 ounces cooked chicken-flavored ramen noodles | 16 miniature tart shells, cooked as per pkg instructions | 2 pita bread or 8 mini hamburger buns | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika | 2 teaspoons dried parsley
instructions: For pearl barley, cover barley with water, and bring to boil.  Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until tender.  For soup, add soup ingredients except paprika and parsley.  Combine well, and chill.  Serve over the pita.

title: Peppered Blue Cheese and Green Pea Gratin With Chili-Pesto
ingredients: 1 bunch green pea, strings removed | 1 package sugar snap peas, strings removed | 4 slices gruyere | pepper flakes, to taste | chili paste, for drizzling ( optional )
instructions: Preheat ove to broil until blackened on all sides.  Remove from oven and spray lightly with olive oil.  Lay peas in a single layer on a cookie sheet or cookie sheet, drizzle with olive oil and broil about 6 inches from the heat for 3 to 5 minutes or until lightly golden and crunchy.  Turn peas around and broil another 3 minutes or until golden, but still black.  Remove peas from oven and sprinkle with garlic powder, pepper and chili paste.  Place in a serving dish and sprinkle with gruyere.  Serve immediately.  Tip.  If using chili pesto, drizzle chili paste into chili and add enough of the hot pepper flakes to it to have your sauce like.  Note, chili paste may be substituted for chili powder or other mild red pepper.

title: Cheese and Parsnip Crostini
ingredients: 4 ounces cottage cheese ( canned or fresh ) | 4 teaspoons plain flour | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds | 1 slice french bread, for dipping ( optional )
instructions: Mix the cottage cheese with the flour, cardamom and black pepper to taste.  Cut the bread into 3 cm cubes and transfer the mixture into a food processor and process until smooth.  Dip the crostini into the batter and fry either in a non stick frying pan or deep fat in a little oil for 3 minutes each side.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,vegetable stock,egg white,white bread,turmeric,pork butt,gruyere cheese,chunky salsa
title: Peanut and Chile Poached Egg Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean pork butt, finely ground | 2 slices white bread | 3 tablespoons chunky salsa ( mild or medium ) | 6 large egg whites | 3 tablespoons granulated sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 5 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( mild or medium ) | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: Position a rack in the center of the oven and heat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Sprinkle the ground pork with salt.  Place the bread in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake until lightly toasted and fragrant, about 10 minutes.  Set aside.  Mix all 3 filling ingredients in a medium size bowl.  In a large bowl, whisk the egg whites with a fork until very firm peaks form.  Add the sugar and turmeric and fold them into the egg whites.  Pour in the stock and salsa.  Transfer to a pastry bag fitted with a 3 inch round tip.  Add the sausage and pork to the bag.  Stir until well mixed.  Pour into a 13 by 9 inch pan.  Bake until the filling is hot and the pork is browned, about 25 minutes.  Remove from the oven and cool to room temperature, transfer to a bowl and set aside.  To assemble, cut the sandwiches in half.  Spread half the egg whites evenly over the tops of the sandwiches.  Top each sandwich with the remaining toasted bread, cheese and salsa.  Wrap sandwiches in foil and place on a cookie sheet until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: sultana,heavy whipping cream,green onion,red currant jelly,rice wine vinegar,chocolate chip,celery,matzo meal
title: Matzoh Cake
ingredients: 1 box of matzo meal | 1 bunch greens, chopped and washed in plenty of water, for garnish if desired | 4 -6 green onions, chopped | 4 scoops sultanas ( red currants ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 cup red currant jelly | 3 cups chocolate chips | 1 cup seasoned rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup sultana, finely chopped to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Prepare matzoh batter by placing matzoh batter in a pan, pour over hot hot water to a soft, but not bubbly stage with a whisk, and let it rest 5 minutes.  While matzoh batter is cooking, make syrup by stirring, creaming, and jelly.  Set aside while matzoh batter is resting.  Remove from heat when matzoh batter has rested for at least 5 minutes, and slowly pour in syrup, stirring constantly.  Pour cooled matzoh batter into lined 8 inch cake pans, and let the batter run down the sides of the pan so it coats the bottom evenly.  Spread the warmed matzoh batter evenly across the top of the pan, and sprinkle a thin layer of the green onion and a scattering of scallions on top of the batter.  Top with red currants and sultanas, if using.  Drizzle chocolate chips over the top of the cake, and spread evenly.  Sprinkle rice wine vinegar over the top.  Allow the cake to sit at room temperature for at least 1 hour, and the cake will absorb any excess liquid.  The chocolate may cause the cake to become more and/or stick to the pan, so it may be easier to remove to a plate when it is taken up of the pan.  Cut in 8 wedges when cold, and serve cold.

title: Bread and Beef  Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups farfalle pasta | 2 cups of thinly sliced sourdough bread | 1 1/2 cups beef gravy ( or other type of gravy ) | 2 cans diced green chilies | 1 cup vinegar
instructions: Brown the farfalle pasta and drain.  Place in crockpot and add all other ingredients.  Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours.  Remove the bread slices from crockpot and crumble.  Put on serving dish and pour chili over top.

title: Green Chilies Italiano
ingredients: 2 lbs bulk italian sausage | 3 tablespoons garlic oil | 2 tablespoons flour | 4 cans diced mild green chilies | 1 can seedless raisins
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet with garlic oil.  Drain grease.  Add a 1/2 teaspoon of salt.  Add flour and mix well.  Add green chilies and raisins.

title: Turkish Delight
ingredients: 2 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons strained fresh mint leaves ( dried or freshly chopped ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix together the egg yolks and mint leaves in a bowl.  Serve.

title: Chicken, Sausage and Fruit Saute
ingredients: 1 lb skinless chicken breast, cut into thick slices | 1 lb fresh hot polish sausage, sliced diagonally | 1 cup fresh apricot fruit, peeled, quartered | 1 cup fresh snow pea | 3 tablespoons hot sauce, divided | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 1/2 cup toasted walnut halves, divided | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: In large nonstick skillet, saute chicken slices over medium high heat until browned, 4 to 5 minutes.  In large serving bowl, toss sausages with apricots, peas, 1/2 cup chives, 1/2 cup walnuts, hot sauce and 2 tablespoons chives.  Spread mixture over chicken and serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: treacle,rice wine,margarine,parmesan cheese,cardamom powder,chickpea flour,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Puff Pastry (Chopatis) With Chickpeas, Cheese and Treacle
ingredients: 2 cups chickpea flour | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter | 1/2 cup treacle ( sweetened or molasses ) | 1/4 cup light greek margarine or 1/4 cup dark cane syrup | 2 -3 tablespoons rice wine | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for grating | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | grated parmesan cheese, for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: Put the flour in bowl.  Make a well.  In it, add all the other ingredients except for the cheese and garnish and mix carefully.  Knead for 10 minutes.  Put in a large bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and rest in low oven overnight.  After about 90 minutes, knead a few times and form into balls.  If using the garnish and topping option of your choice, knead it again at 90 degrees.  Dip balls in flour, roll in melted or flavored treacle.  Let cool.  Sprinkle a little parmesan cheese over top.  If using the cheese as directed, you may wish to fry the balls in a skillet that has been lightly brushed with a little melted butter or margarine just before serving as an appetizer.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,sirloin tip roast,monterey jack cheese,fish,pork sausage,red bell pepper
title: Grilled Beef With Sausage and Roasted Red Bell Peppers (Antigua and Barbuda)
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin tip roast, trimmed ( from chuck roast ) | 1 packet pork sausage | 3 red bell peppers | 2 teaspoons toasted sesame oil | 2 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese, grated | 2 cups fish or 2 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Place chuck roast in a shallow, heavy baking dish.  Prick roasts with a fork, then rub with one tsp of sesame oil.  Lightly salt the roast roast.  Add roast and 1 1/2 cups of beef stock to the oven preheated to 475°f place roast in preheated oven for 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, remove seeds from peppers and cut into 2 inch long strips.  Place pepper strips in saucepan.  Cover and bring to a boil over high heat for 1 minute.  Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.  When meat is done, remove from dish.  Drain liquid from pan.  Place meat on cutting board and slice thinly.  Add the red pepper strips to soup with the remaining stock, then place over low heat and let cook for 10 to 15 minutes.  Add the remaining 1/4 tsp sesame oil and mix.  To serve, divide pepper mixture among shallow serving bowls with a slotted spoon.  Top with meat and sauce.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,corn,part ricotta cheese,iceberg lettuce,mccormick grill seasoning,green cardamom pod,spring onion
title: Healthy Ricotta Veggie Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped spring onion | 1 -2 teaspoon mccormick grill seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed green cardamom pods | 1 cup tomato sauce | 1 cup corn, drained & rinsed | mccormick grill seasoning | iceberg lettuce or other greens
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill for at least 2 hours prior to making burgers.

title: Oriental Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground chuck | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: In large nonstick skillet cook chuck and soy sauce over medium heat with occasional stirring, breaking up meat with a spoon until meat is browned on all sides.  Add meat mixture and bring to a boil.

title: Pepper Papaya Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry red cooking wine ( or red wine vinegar ) | 2 tablespoons prepared italian dressing | 1 teaspoon papaya, finely diced | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon basil ( optional )
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients and mix well.  Chill at least one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,self raising flour,black coffee,french bread,gruyere cheese,button mushroom,apple cider
title: Normandy Lentil and Apple Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup dry brown lentils | 2 cups self raising flour, plus extra for dusting | 1 cup brown sugar | 3/4 cup black coffee | 1 apple, diced | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 2 loaf french bread, sliced in half lengthways and toasted
instructions: Place lentils in a saucepan, cover with water and bring to the boil.  Reduce heat, simmer for 20 mins until tender.  Sift flour into a large bowl, pour over lentils and stir to combine.  Place apple, cheese and half of the bread in a microwave safe bowl, cover with coffee, and microwave on high for 1 min until hot.  Add remaining bread to bread mixture and then spread half of the lentil mixture into toasted bread rounds, sprinkle with remaining bread, place on two baking trays cut side up.  Pour heated mixture into muffin pans and bake in 180c for 20 min or until top is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,broth,penne pasta,pineapple juice,dark brown sugar,yogurt,head iceberg lettuce
title: Pineapple Hearty Chicken
ingredients: 1 large head iceberg lettuce - rinsed, dried and shredded | 1 bottle pineapple juice | 1/2 cup chicken breast halves - cooked, cubed | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons rice noodles noodles, soaked in warm water | 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Combine the lettuce, pineapple juice and chicken in a large skillet over medium heat.  Bring the mixture to a boil and cook until the chicken is almost cooked through.  Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside to cool.  Stir the brown sugar and rice noodles into the skillet and cook for 1 minute.  Remove the rice noodles from the heat.  Stir in the yogurt, stirring well.  Serve the chicken topped with the noodles and serve immediately.

title: Lettuce, Horseradish & Thyme Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, washed, dried, torn into bite sized pieces | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 teaspoons horseradish, grated | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place the lettuce in a serving bowl.  Combine the remaining ingredients and pour over the lettuce.  Serve at once or let set for several hours to allow both flavours to combine.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pancit noodle,pepper flake,asparagus,hot green chili pepper
title: Spicy Italian Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus | 1 cup pancit noodles, uncooked | 1 teaspoon hot green chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Cook asparagus according to package directions.  Add remaining ingredients and cook at low heat until asparagus is cooked and tender.  To cut off tough asparagus, cut off asparagus tips and reserve in refrigerator or freezer for up to 2 weeks.

title: Homemade Oat Taco Meat
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 1 tablespoon dried oatmeal ( or quick cooking mix of oatmeal and regular quick cooking mix ) | 2 tablespoons baking powder | 2 cups organic pinto beans
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and cut in half.  Place into crock pot and add pork.  Cook on low 3 hours.  Shred with 2 forks.  Strain.  Serve with warm flour tortillas, beans, etc.

title: Roasted Saffron Cheese on Sides
ingredients: 1 lb fresh ricotta | 1 pinch saffron | 3 -4 cardamom pods | 16 ounces pre-shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven, 400 degrees.  Mix the saffron with a few drops each.  Stir in 1/4 teaspoon of water.  Place ricotta in a bowl.  Pour saffron water on top of ricotta.  Mix until the ricotta is completely covered.  Spread the top of the ricotta with 1/4 teaspoon of saffron.  Place on a piece of parchment paper, or other object you like on your baking pan surface.  Sprinkle some more saffron over the cheese.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Place in the oven and bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown on top.  Take the foil for 10 - 15 minutes so the cheese will be easy to stir.  Let cool for 5 minutes on the counter before moving it onto a serving plate.

title: Pimiento Cheese Soup
ingredients: 6 -7 tablespoons dashi ( basic vegetable stock ) | 1 package old cheddar cheese ( shredded ) | 1 jar sliced pimientos, undrained, rinsed if canned | kosher salt, to taste
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine dashi and 3 cups water.  Bring to boiling, reduce heat.  Simmer for 2 minutes or until dashi is dissolved and soup is thickened.  Add cheeses and simmer until cheese is melted.  Stir in pimientos.  Heat through.

title: Aubergine and Lamb Stuffed Crostini
ingredients: 500 g ground lamb | 1 medium eggplant, peeled halved crossways | 300 g bread, cut into 6 slices | 1 small baguette, cut into 8 small squares | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Mix together meat and eggplant.  Place slices of bread, on the baking trays of your oven, on a lined tray.  Cut baguette into quarters and place on the tray, cut side up.  Combine oregano, flour and 2 tbsp water in a bowl for sauce.  Spread sauce over bread and then cover with foil.  Bake for 20 minutes, remove foil and bake for 10 minutes more.  Serve immediately with remaining sauce for dipping.

title: Guilt-Free French Dip
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons grainy mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons vinegar ( low-fat-virgin is fine ) | 1/3 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl, stirring well with a whisk.  Use immediately or refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Calde De Olla  Meul (Fillet Steamed Skewers)
ingredients: 1/2 cup quince, crushed | 1/4 cup black olives, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon mixed spice, sifted | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 sugar cube | 3 lbs fish fillets, boned and skinned
instructions: Mix the crushed quince, black olives, mixed spice, rice wine, and sugar cube.  Pierce fish fillets several times with a fork, rub mixture evenly between toothpicks.  Add a little water to coat the fish.  Place on a rack in a shallow, heated pan or broiler pan.  Pour hot water slowly into pan to a depth of 3 inches.  Place pan under the broiler and broil for 5 minutes.  Turn fillets to brown both sides and broil 2 - 3 minutes longer.  Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Spaetzle With Leeks
ingredients: 2 2 leeks or 2 leeks, white parts only, cleaned and trimmed, cut into 3-inch lengths | table salt
instructions: Boil 3 quarts water with a table salt until the leaves appear split down the length of the leaf.  Drain the water.  Tie the stalks or leaves of the leeks into a small bundle with kitchen twine if they look like little strings.  Put the bundle into a large nonstick frying pan of cold, salted water.  Bring to the boil over medium high heat, skimming the scum off the surface.  Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.  Uncover and boil over medium heat for about 15 minutes.  Use a slotted spoon to remove the bundle from the water.  Using the flat of a sharp knife, score the thickest part of the bundle into 1/4 inch thick diagonal slices about 1 1/4 inches wide.  Arrange the slices in an attractive pattern over the spaetzle.  Cover and cook just long enough to heat through.  Remove the cover at the end of the cooking process and serve right away.

title: Artichoke Raspberry Snack
ingredients: 1 can frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup raspberries | chili pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Rinse and drain artichoke hearts.  Spread artichoke hearts in a 9x9 inch glass baking dish.  Spread raspberries over the artichoke hearts.  Sprinkle with chili pepper.  Bake 35 minutes, or until bubbly.

title: Gordita's Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 3/4 cup finely crushed green pico de gallo ( pico de gallo ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne, if desired ( optional ) | lime wedge ( for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine the pico de gallo, cayenne, and optional lime wedge in a bowl, using a pinch of salt for spiciness.  If desired, serve with your favorite toppings, such as olives, tomatoes, tomatoes, sour red cabbage, cheese, sliced onion, etc.

title: Green & White - Sushi Rice
ingredients: 4 cups sushi rice | 1/2 cup green beans | 1/2 cup chopped iceberg lettuce | 1/4 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Cook rice in 2 quart saucepan until tender.  Cool until warm.  Wash and cut beans into 1 inch lengths.  Remove and discard tough stems from green beans.  Place rice on a large platter.  Arrange beans over the rice.  Sprinkle with cumin, then top with lettuce, then sprinkle the bean mixture over the top.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,black peppercorn,lime wedge,salmon,mayonnaise,adobo seasoning
title: Smoked Salmon Salad With Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 lb salmon ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns, cracked | 3 black cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon black mayonnaise | 1/4 tablespoon adobo seasoning | lime wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the salmon under cold water.

title: Vermont-Saint Peter's Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 2 cups dry vermouth, divided | 36 ounces bottled pepper jack cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon dried mint | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Place 1/4 cup vermouth into the bottom of a 2 quart slow cooker.

title: The Anti Irish Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats | 2 maraschino cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the oats in a bowl and crumble the cherries and maraschino cherries into the oats.  Shape the mixture into 1/2 inch balls.  Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake for 10 - 10 minutes, or until bottoms are lightly browned.  Cool on a rack.  Store in closed container.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,part mozzarella cheese,lasagna noodle
title: Cheesy Lasagna With Lazy Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles, uncooked ( the small ones ) | 1 package shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 jar fat-free grated part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f with 2 baking sheets on the middle rack.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Prepare the lasagna noodles as directed on the package by removing the center layer of uncooked noodles.  Rinse with cold water and drain.  Spread about 1 tablespoon of the fat free grated cheeses onto each of the sheets of noodles and top with about 1/2 teaspoon of each of the mozzarella and the colby/jack cheese, spreading evenly.  Place the lasagna in the oven, and bake until bubbly, about 10 minutes.

title: Simple Thai Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemongrass | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon dill
instructions: Crush lemongrass in a mortar with a pestle, or in a small mixing bowl if making in a food processor.

title: Easy Chicken Curry
ingredients:
4 skinless chicken thighs | 1/3 cup of pickled asian cucumbers ( found in the asian section of the supermarket, such as a asian delicatessen ) | 1/2 cup curry paste | 1 tablespoon anise ( the dried mexican or indian spices ) | 1 lemon peel, grated ( about 1 tsp.
    - ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Place chicken thighs in the refrigerator and let sit for one hour at the most room temp.  Meanwhile, stir together curry paste, anise, lemon peel, turmeric and curry powder.  Drain chicken of marinade.  Toss with the curry paste mixture.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat for 2 - 3 minutes.  Quickly place the chicken thighs in the skillet, skin side down.  When skin bubbles and darkens on top, turn over, and repeat on the other side.  Remove from heat and transfer to a platter covered with plastic wrap to keep warm.  Wipe out pan and return to heat.  Add a little oil.  When it's hot, add the remaining curry paste mixture.  Return chicken to pan, skin side up.  Place a piece of plastic wrap on top, and return to heat.  When thicken on the bottom, it is done.  It should take about 7 - 10 minutes.

title: Guiness
ingredients: 1/2 cup guinness stout, plus | 1 teaspoon guiness ( or equal gimmie ) | 1/2 stick red wine vinegar
instructions: In a large, clean glass bowl, pour the guiness into the guiness and stir until lumps form.  Pour the guiness into a jar on the side of the bottle and let it stand for at least 2 weeks to absorb the flavor.  Unused guiness should air air out of the bottle and into the bottle.  It should be stored in the fridge for up to 2 years.  For a thicker, hotter guiness, add only 1 teaspoon of guiness.  If your guiness is too thin, you can always add a small amount of water.  In a small saucepan, combine the red wine vinegar and 1 teaspoon of salt.  Heat the mixture over medium heat for 1 minute to bring out flavors.  Remove from the heat when mixture begins to bubble in appearance.  Cool slightly and transfer into a clean bottle.  When you are ready to store it, take it out of the refrigerator, allowing to settle for at least 2 days.  When you are ready to use it, wipe the bottle of guiness off of the bottle and pour the mixture into resealable plastic bags.  Close the lid of the bottle and seal the bag.  Note, you will need to press the mixture to release air into the bag before opening.

title: Za'atar Coleslaw (Barefoot Contessa's Recipe)
ingredients: 1 medium head savoy cabbage or 1 medium head savoy cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon instant za'atar spice mix | 1 tablespoon champagne vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh dill ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon dried dill ( optional )
instructions: Place cabbage in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,coconut,brown mustard seed,pea,celery seed,dark sesame oil
title: Bombay Pea Salad With Coconut Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1/8 teaspoon celery seed | 1/8 teaspoon dark mustard seeds | 8 tablespoons sweet unsweetened dried shredded coconut | 1 head lettuce, separated | 1 cup frozen peas ( or fresh peas )
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients in a medium size bowl.  Toss with lettuce just until well coated.
