title: Thai Beef and Whole Wheat Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 1/2 lbs new york strip steaks, cut 1 1/2 inches wide | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili powder ( mild, medium or hot, depending on your taste ) | 1 can of unsweetened coconut milk ( or use light ) | 2 cups beef broth | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 3 -4 tablespoons dry sherry or 3 -4 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 lb dry tubular pasta or 1 lb tri-tip pasta
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, cocoa, and chili powder.  Rinse steak and pat dry with paper towels.  Slice or cut steak diagonally across the grain into 1/4 inch thick, 1/4 inch wide slices.  Pour tomato chili broth over steak and let marinade at least 4 hours or overnight.  In a large sauté pan, grill or broil the steak.  Brush steak with oil and sprinkle with garlic paste and chili powder.  Sear steak in pan for 2 minutes per side.  Remove steak from pan and reserve.  Deglaze pan with cocoa powder and sherry or vinegar.  Add enough liquid to sauce to cook off moisture if it starts to thicken.

title: Herbed Wine Bread
ingredients: 2 cups self raising flour | 1/2 cup italian herbs | 1 cup wine
instructions: Mix flour and herbs.  Add wine to mix.  Knead, cover, bring together.  Roll out on floured surface.  Cut into pieces and bake on greased tray for 1 hour at 180°c.

title: Easy Asian Style Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package fettuccine | 1 pound pork spareribs, cubed | 3 cups ketchup | 1 cup fresh key limes, juice | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 3 pounds boneless, skinless chicken meat - cut into strips
instructions: Place the fettuccine pasta in a large pot and fill with enough lightly salted water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and cook until al dente, about 8 minutes.  Drain.  Meanwhile, place the reserved fettuccine pasta in a large saucepan, and cover with several inches of cool water.  Bring to a boil.  Add the pork, and cook until no longer pink, 2 to 3 minutes.  Stir in 2 cups ketchup, lime juice, 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce, and 2 more cups of water.  Reduce heat to low, and cover.  Simmer for 20 minutes.  Place the chicken strips in a separate large skillet.  Cook over medium heat until the chicken is just cooked through, about 15 minutes.  Drain well.  Add the cooked fettuccine to the pot to warm the chicken, and continue cooking until the noodles are creamy and tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Kaffir Lime Kebabs
ingredients: 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 6 kaffir lime leaves, torn into pieces
instructions: Place about 3 tablespoons of shredded mozzarella cheese in the center of a kaffir lime slice.  Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of shredded mozzarella cheese over the cheese and squeeze the kaffir lime pieces over the cheese.  Repeat with remaining kaffir lime kaffir lime leaves.  Chill in refrigerator for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Buttered Crescent Danish
ingredients: 2 cans pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 2 1/2 cups chicken broth ( or use enough for 2 1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup butter, melted
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f.  Roll out dough on lightly floured surface.  Cut into 4 squares.  Place in a greased 9x13.  Repeat until all dough squares are coated.  Pour chicken broth, vanilla sugar and butter in a large pot on the stove.  Bring to a boil.  As soon as mixture comes to a boil, add danish.  Cover pan and remove from burner.  Place on greased cookie sheet.  Bake for 20 - 25 minutes.  Serve warm.  Variation,.

title: Delicious and Delicious No-Brainer Baked Stuffed Reuben
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked orecchiette | 1 can pinto beans | 1 can cream-style corn | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine | 1 teaspoon cognac | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 3 cups cubed ham | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the orecchiette pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Easy and Delicious Beef Salad (Killer Lettuce Wrapped in Bacon)
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs flank steaks | 1 head boston lettuce | 1 cup white vinegar ( or less to taste )
instructions: Place the flank steak on a cutting board you can work with if needed to get it evenly sized, it should be well floured.  It should be roughly the width and thickness of your bacon strip.  Slice across the grain of the steak to make 8 slices.  Place in a plastic bag with a tight seal and marinate for 15 - 30 minutes. .  While the meat is marinating, place the lettuce leaves on the counter for 5 - 10 minutes to cool down and then cut them into large squares or long strips.  When the skewers are done drain off the marinade.  Place about a cup of the steak marinade on a plate and place one or two lettuce squares on each plate.  Dip the steak into the vinegar and then coat in the bacon marinade.  Place on the lettuce in a single layer on a serving platter or serve warm.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,ginger,broccoli,gingerroot,cremini mushroom,quark,egg white,ricotta cheese
title: Broccoli Quark Roll
ingredients: 3/4 cup quark ( not reduced fat ) | 1 egg white, beaten | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped gingerroot ( dried ) | 1 tablespoon grated gingerroot ( dried ) | 1 tablespoon chopped green bell peppers ( dried ) | 1 ounce cremini mushroom ( dried mushrooms, sliced ) | 6 ounces broccoli ( fresh, steamed and chopped or fresh baby carrots ) | 3 teaspoons chopped green bell pepper ( dried )
instructions: Dough, combine all ingredients in medium bowl and mix until just blended.  Divide into 4 equal portions.  Roll each portion of dough into an 8 inch circle.  Wrap each portion in wax paper and heat on griddle, about 3 minutes each side, until it starts to crackle.  Do not burn the dough.  Roll each circle out as thinly as possible, about 1/8 inch.  Stack uncooked portions on top of each other, keeping in mind that the egg white adds to the filling.  Continue rolling each piece of dough into a log about 6 inches long.  Wrap each one tightly in wax paper, refrigerate one more rolled portion of dough and a third rolled portion of the egg white in wax paper.  Slice each log into 12 rolls, wrap in wax paper, refrigerate until egg white cools slightly.  Slice each log diagonally into eight slices.

Random Ingredients: bacon dripping,grain white rice,chili oil,ice,russet potato,orange zest
title: Spanish Rice and Bacon Livers
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings | 4 small russet potatoes, scrubbed and cut into 1/4-inch dice | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 1/4 cup chili oil | 1 1/4 cups ice, crushed
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a saucepan over high heat.  Stir in rice, cover, and reduce heat to small simmer.  Cook 25 minutes.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Set a baking sheet on a baking sheet.  Heat bacon drippings in a skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 3 minutes.  Stir potatoes with reserved bacon grease in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,heirloom tomato,dish pie shell,oyster,white bean
title: Heirloom Tomato and White Bean Tartlets
ingredients: 1 heirloom tomato, sliced | 1 jar preshred white beans, drained | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves, crushed | 1/4 cup oyster | 1 unbaked pastry dough, baked
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place the tomatoes, beans, thyme and oysters in a non stick skillet, bake them for about 20 minutes, depending on the size of the tomatoes.  Cool about 5 minutes.  Turn the oven off, remove the crusts from the pastry dough, and roll out the crust on a floured surface to 1/4 inch thick.  Cut out circles or hearts, arrange the tartlets on a baking sheet, and bake them for 5 - 10 minutes, until light brown.  You can freeze the tartlets for future use.

title: Kraut and Thyme Pies
ingredients: 8 ounces dry sauerkraut, rinsed and drained | 1/2 ounce cream cheese or 1/2 ounce mascarpone cheese, softened | 2 ounces strong coffee or 2 ounces hot brewed tea | 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup chopped mixed fresh thyme leaves ( optional ) or 1/4 cup oregano leaves ( optional ) | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped toasted pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees.  Drain sauerkraut, reserving any liquid.  Place the sauerkraut in a large skillet, cover with water and bring to a boil.  Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until the sauerkraut is crisp tender, about 3 minutes.  Drain the water.  Combine with the cream cheese, coffee or hot tea.  Remove skillet from heat, stir in the thyme and cool slightly.  Cut the pastry sheets into 8 wedges, then cut the wedges in half.  Cut the wedges into nine slices.  Place a pastry strip over each wedge of pastry.  Spoon the sauerkraut mixture into the pastry strips and scatter with the chopped nuts.  Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the pastry is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,baking powder,tart apple,tomato ketchup,soymilk,rice krispies,mango chutney,vegetable oil
title: Apple Mango Chutney Treats
ingredients: 350 g baking powder | 2 teaspoons salt | 225 g pure maple syrup, divided | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 225 g raw peeled tart apples, pared and chopped | 115 g raw ripe mango chutney | 175 g soy milk or 175 g plain soymilk
instructions: Place the maple syrup, oil, chili flakes, ketchup and apples in a pan and gently cook until the liquid has evaporated, about 5 minutes on a medium low heat.  Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly.  Preheat the oven to 180 c, and line 2 baking trays with baking paper.  Stir the soy milk into the cooled maple mixture a little at a time.  Place the apples in an ovenproof bowl and cover them with the chutney mixture.  Bake until the apples are tender and the apple chunks have softened, about 30 minutes.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,plum tomato,carrot,icing sugar,potato chip,romaine lettuce
title: Lettuce with plum tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb potato chips ( or pretzel or other crisp potato chips ) | 3 medium sized plum tomatoes | 1 medium sized carrot | 6 cups torn romaine lettuce | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Peel potatoes or pretzels and cut into 3/4 inch rounds or into small dices.  Place in baking dish and toss with icing sugar, sesame seeds, and carrot.  Bake at 350 for about 20 minutes, or until golden.  Serve with lettuce, tomato slices and pickles, if desired.

title: Baked in the Shell
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups swiss cheese, coarsely grated | 2 tablespoons unsweetened coconut rum | 1/4 cup dry wine
instructions: Pour 3 t.  Of rum into an 8 x 12 inch ceramic baking dish or shallow glass.  Mix the cheese, remaining rum, and wine in a large bowl until well blended. .  Dot the cheese mixture evenly over the rum.  Cover the dish or cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes, or up to 24 hours.  Remove the plastic wrap and bake in a preheated 400°f oven until golden brown, about 40 minutes.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Chilled Blueberry and Tarragon Salad
ingredients: 1 lb blueberries | 1/2 cup walnuts | 2 ounces stoned fresh tarragon | 1 tablespoon low sodium dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Line a large serving platter with a piece of greaseproof paper or parchment paper.  Halve the berry halves, and put in the middle.  Drain any excess liquid, and put a slice of walnuts on top of each half.  Place a few fresh tarragon sprigs, or sprigs of fresh tarragon, along with a sprinkling of dark soy sauce.  Drizzle some olive oil or vinegar over the salad, and a few fresh tarragon sprigs.  Drizzle a grinding of fresh black pepper over the salad.  Set the platter in a serving dish, and leave to stand while you prepare your garnish.  In a small bowl, blend together any remaining walnuts, the remaining dark soy sauce, and olive oil or vinegar.  Just before serving, scatter the chopped herbs around the bottom of the warmed platter.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,camembert cheese,russet potato,vodka,pork sausage
title: Smoked Veal Smothered in Vodka With Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb smoked pork sausage | 1/2 lb smoked camembert cheese | 2 large russet potatoes | 1 small red bell pepper ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Place a baking sheet on the center shelf of the oven, and place the smoked sausages on the sheet.  Slice the sausage into 1/4 inch thick slices, and place slices on the baking sheet.  Slice the camembert crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices, and place on the roasting sheet.  Slice the potatoes into 1/2 inch thick slices, and place on the baking sheet.  Sprinkle the potatoes with salt.  Place in oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until golden.  Remove from oven, and let cool for 5 minutes.  Place a slice or two of smoked sausage on top of the potato slices, and cut into small quarters, and place on top of the sausage.  Add the red bell pepper to the vodka, then pour the vodka sauce over the potatoes.  Place back in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the vodka glazes the potato slices.  Allow to cool for at least 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,flat leaf italian parsley,lime zest
title: Lime and Parsley Noodles
ingredients: 4 ounces dry egg noodles ( egg noodle ) | 2/3 cup finely chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling water about 7 minutes, or until tender.  Drain.  While the noodles are cooking, bring a large pan of water to the boil.  Stir in the parsley and the zest.  Drain the noodles and toss well with the zest.  Add the noodles to the hot water and toss.

title: Quick Reittake
ingredients: 1 cup ice | 8 hard-cooked eggs, peeled | 1 1/2 ounces swedish arrack punsch, or other swiss cheese | 8 ounces thin spaghetti | 2 cups shaved gruyere cheese
instructions: Fill a large pot with ice and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the ice has begun to melt, whisk in eggs, one at a time, then stir in arck punsch, then divide between two 8 oz ramekins.  Divide shaved gruyere evenly among ramekins.  Cook filled ramekins in the boiling water until a knife pierces the top.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,ladyfinger,black pepper,green cardamom pod,pork belly
title: Auntie Lori's Tofu
ingredients: 12 small green cardamom pods | 3/4 cup unsulfured pork belly, sliced into 1/4 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1 package ladyfingers | 1 1/2 cups angel hair pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Cut 6 cardamom pods in half lengthwise.  Place the sliced pork pieces into a small bowl, and sprinkle with black pepper.  Combine the noodles, meat, and 2 more cardamom pods in a glass roasting pan.  Squeeze out excess moisture from the ladyfingers, and arrange some of the ones along the bottom of the pan along with the remaining ladyfingers.  Dot with some of the left over marinade, and pour in enough water to cover.  Bake in the preheated oven until the stuffing filling is hot and bubbling on top, and meat has begun to show no pink color, about 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Welsh Salmon (Dublin Bay)
ingredients: 1 chicken | 75 g dark rum | 200 g plain flour | 1/4 kg salmon steak
instructions: Clean, then slice the chicken meat into approximately 6cm pieces.  Place the chicken pieces in a large oven proof dish with the rum and the flour.  Stir the contents of the tin together.  Place in a preheated oven of 200c for approximately 45min.  Remove from oven.  Carefully place salmon pieces on top and brush with a little beaten egg.  Bake for approx 15min.  Or until cooked through.  Serve with a salad and a crisp baguette.

title: Chili Pepper Steak
ingredients: 4 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika | 3 tablespoons chili sauce | 3 teaspoons ground coriander seed | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 6 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 2 teaspoons steak seasoning | 4 lbs flank steaks ( trimmed of fat )
instructions: In bowl, mix 2 teaspoons sweet gatrikash, 5 tablespoons chili sauce and coriander and ginger.  Rub spices under grill.  Coat both sides of steak with spice/sauce mix and let stand 5 minutes before grilling.  Grill steak and brush with remaining 1 tablespoon sweet gatrikash and the remaining 2 tablespoons sweet gatrikash mixture.  Grill 6 - 8 minutes per side, side meat thermometer 160.  Let stand, uncovered, 2 minutes before removing slice with fork.

title: Bahraini Noodles With Tahini & Grand Marnier
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini paste | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 4 tablespoons dry rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained ( medium size ) | 12 ounces grand marnier, chilled
instructions: Combine tahini paste, mustard seed and rigatoni in a bowl.  Whisk together grand marnier and 1/2 cup warm tahini until creamy.  Transfer half of sauce to another bowl and whisk with remaining tahini mixture.  Add remaining sauce to bowl and stir to combine.  Divide noodle mixture into 4 serving bowls, mound in center and serve, dusted with more grand marnier.

title: Grilled Skirt Steak
ingredients: 4 large skirt steaks | 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine | 3 tablespoons white cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups shredded lettuce | 1/2 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate.  Place the steaks onto the grill, and lightly oil the grate.  Cook steak on the prepared side until medium rare, about 5 minutes.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 160 degrees f, or slightly lower the temperature of the steaks.  Cover with a lid while grilling, about 10 minutes.  Slice into thin strips, and set aside.  Melt the margarine in a skillet over medium heat.  Whisk in the cornmeal, and cook and stir the cornmeal mixture until thickened, about 3 minutes.  Reduce heat to low.

title: Hot Kid Beans
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: In a medium size bowl combine the canning jar or the hot kidney beans.  Add the hot sauce. .  Close the lid, and turn the jar upside down.  Let the jar sit undisturbed for 24 hours if you can.  The longer it sits the more it gets into the cracks of the jar.  After 24 hours it will lose all of its flavor.  Use 1 1/2 teaspoons per pint of hot beans and rinse well under cold water.  The less you use, the hotter it will be. .  You can keep in the refrigerator for up to a month.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,chili paste,chocolate chip,egg yolk,red cabbage
title: Choc Chip Glazed Cabbage and Eggs
ingredients: 1 red cabbage, shredded | 1 egg yolk | 1 lb lean ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 1 jar chocolate chips, warmed | 1 cup beef stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili paste
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the ground meat, cheese, and egg yolk and mix thoroughly.  Spread the mixture in a non stick pan coated with cooking spray.  Heat over medium heat and cook meat mixture until it crumbles when dropped by a spoon.  Add the warmed chocolate and beef stock and simmer for 10 minutes.  Turn out onto a plate and cool for 5 minutes then stir in the chili paste.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,yellow bell pepper,asparagus,butter,turmeric powder,lemon zest,white sugar,salad oil
title: Turmeric Poached Eggs
ingredients: 2 dozen hard boiled eggs | 50 g mixed salad oil | 1/2 lemon, zest of | 1/2 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 yellow bell pepper, roasted | 1 sprig asparagus, roasted
instructions: Slice the boiled eggs in half lengthwise.  Remove hard shells with a spoon.  Cut the remaining hard boiled eggs into four pieces.  In a blender or food processor, blend with oil, lemon zest, turmeric and chopped red pepper.  Pour olive oil and lemon juice into a skillet.  Add a dash of salt and sugar.  Place on low heat and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 - 3 minutes.  Pour mixture into a cold bowl or dish for a snack.

title: Sour Cream and Broccoli Sprinkles on the Barbie
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sour cream or 3 tablespoons creamed mixed salad dressing | 1 tablespoon mirin | 3 tablespoons canned black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 cups fresh broccoli, cut into small florets | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne or 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Pour a few teaspoons of the dressing over 2 tablespoons of the sour cream or creamed salad dressing.  Stir in the mirin, beans and broccoli and toss to coat.  In a separate bowl toss with cayenne or chile powder.

title: Portuguese Sweet Chili Paste
ingredients: 1 can marzipan | 24 small dried hot chili without beans | 6 cups white bread, crusts removed | 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt
instructions: In a large pot, combine the marzipan, hot chili with beans, and 1 cup bread.  Simmer on low heat, stirring often, until smooth, about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat.  Remove seeds from the remaining bread and blend with food processor, until coarse bread crumbs form.  Pour the bread crumb mixture back into pot.  Stir and cook 30 minutes over medium high heat.

title: Simple Crusted Flounder
ingredients: 4 -6 flounder fillets | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 2 spring onions
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Lightly spray or grease an ovenproof gratin dish.  In a small bowl mix together the salt and spring onions.  Slice the fillets to about 1/8 inch thick.  Sprinkle the salt and spring onion on 1 side and roll them up starting on the salt side.  Put the fish in the dish and repeat with the other side.  Bake for about 15 minutes or until fish is flaky and golden.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,green cardamom pod,lime zest,sirloin,shrimp,broccoli floret,cherry tomato,corn oil
title: Beef Stir Fry With Shrimp
ingredients: 1/4 cup corn oil | 1/2 lb top sirloin, sliced in thin bite-sized strips | 1/4 lb prawns, peeled uncooked shrimp, shelled and chopped ( or 1/8-1/4 pound shrimp, peeled and deveined ) | 1/4 cup green cardamom pod, smashed | 3 large tomatoes, chopped | 1 cup broccoli floret, thawed ( about 2 large heads ) | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: In a large wok or frying pan, warm the corn oil over high heat.  Stir in the beef and shrimp and cook, stirring, until beef is no longer translucent.  Add the remaining ingredients and cook until the shrimp are almost cooked.  Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Baked Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks or 3 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut 1 inch thick | 1 bottle mesquite-infused tequila | 3 tablespoons light molasses | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dry red chili powder | 1/2 tablespoon dried basil, crushed
instructions: Preheat a broiler.  Place steaks on aluminum foil.  Broil 7 inches from heat 3 to 5 minutes on each side or until cooked to desired doneness.  Remove steaks from oven.

title: Hazelnut Roast Beef
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef chuck, trimmed | 1 1/2 pints hazelnuts, lightly toasted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f in a large, heavy roasting pan, roast the meat until the outside is a deep golden brown.  Remove the pan from the oven and place the roasting pan on a rack in the center of the oven to keep it warm.  While meat is roasting in the oven, remove and discard the neck and other fat from your roasting pan.  Rinse the roasting pan under cold running water and dry the surface with paper towels.  Transfer the roast to a platter and keep warm.  Spoon the hazelnuts onto a large plate that you have lined with parchment paper and set aside.  Using the back of a large spoon, press a few toasted hazelnuts into the hazelnuts.  Use your fingers to pull the nuts off of the parchment and spread over the surface of the raw hazelnuts.  Continue lifting the nuts up so that they are as flat as possible.  Serve on top of the hazelnuts and with the juices that have accumulated from the meat and other juices.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,ice,okra,habanero pepper,star fruit,creole seasoning
title: Crispy Okra and Okra Filling for Perogies-Biscuits
ingredients: 4 star fruit, cut 1/4-inch thick slices | 1 lb okra ( trimmed and washed if necessary ) | 1 lb creole seasoning | 3 ounces habanero peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded | 3 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | ice | 1/4 cup diced fresh okra ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a food processor and pulse just enough to puree.  Transfer mixture to a saucepan and reheat.

title: Crispy Almonds
ingredients: 4 ounces filet mignon | 1 tablespoon slivered almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees.  Wrap almonds in damp paper towels, then place on a foil lined baking sheet.  Roast in the oven for 25 - 40 minutes, until golden and fragrant.  Carefully remove from oven and cool, then crumble nuts, and toss with the almonds.

title: Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 4 garlic cloves | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Mince the garlic cloves finely, and pass it through a strainer.  In a medium size sauce pan over low heat, add whipping cream, and heat until warm and heavy enough to coat bottom of pan.  Blend with a fork.  Pour cream into 4 - 6 cup ramekins or wide mouth ramekins.  Do not stir at this point.  Set aside to cool.  Preheat oven to 350f degrees.  Remove the ramekins from ramekins, and shake off excess.  Place ramekins, inside roasting pan, and bake in preheated oven for about 30 - 45 minutes, or until heated through.  If the cream does not run or congeal, you may need to add a little water.  If it does, drain and use the clear and fluffy milk.

Random Ingredients: red wine,pea,coriander powder,spaghetti,jumbo pasta shell,mango,salad oil
title: Indonesian Style Pea and Mango Pasta Salad
ingredients: 500 g fresh jumbo pasta shells, peeled and cut into 2 cm lengths | 3 tablespoons salad oil | 750 g frozen peas | 1 mango | 100 ml red wine, chilled, about 4 | 80 g fresh coriander powder | spaghetti, cooked orzo, steamed
instructions: Cook the pasta in rapidly boiling water for about 7 - 10 minutes.  Drain well and cool under cold running water.  In a large bowl, combine the salad oil and peas.  Slice the mango into long thin strips and add it to the salad and mix well.  Pour in the wine and coriander and season with salt and pepper.  Toss the pasta with half the dressing and arrange the fruit on top.  Sprinkle with the remaining dressing.

Random Ingredients: turbinado sugar,yeast,water,orzo pasta,parmesan cheese,cold water,red wine
title: Chef Mika's Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups water | 1 3/4 cups water | 4 cups orzo pasta ( broken into small pieces ), uncooked orzo ( broken into small pieces ) | 1/3 cup turbinado sugar ( or other raw sugar ) | 6 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 5 teaspoons fresh yeast | 2 cups freshly grated freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 pinch instant yeast | 1/2 cup red wine ( optional )
instructions: In a medium size bowl combine water, buttermilk and sugar.  Cover and let stand for 15 - 25 minutes.  Preheat oven to 400f degrees.  Mix together flour and yeast in a large bowl.  Add one cup of the grated cheese.  Mix well.  Add half the grated cheese and yeast mixture and mix again.  Add remaining grated cheese.  Gradually mix in the remaining flour until the dough is thoroughly blended.  Dough should be slightly tacky.  Knead dough for 4 - 5 minutes, adding more flour if necessary.  Place dough in bowl, cover and let rise until double.  Dough should feel satiny and very slightly sticky.  Punch down and knead again.  Divide the dough into four portions.  On floured surface, pat each piece into a 6 round.  Repeat with remaining dough leaving just enough of the remaining.  Bake bread for 25 - 35 minutes.  Serve warm.  You may also stretch it to work on the dough, but you need to be well kneaded if you add sugar.  It makes the bread dough easier to handle.  For breads, place 2 - 3 large pieces of heavy plastic on your bread dough, top with dough, then cover with towel and allow dry bread to rest until dough has doubled.  Roll each piece into a 3 strand and cut out the middle of the dough.  Brush tops with more buttermilk and sprinkle the top with the rest of the grated cheese.  Place bread on a cookie sheet and cover with towel.

title: Savory Red Pepper Seasoning
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornflour | 2 teaspoons savory, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon thyme, crushed | 1/8 teaspoon clove, crushed | 3 red bell peppers or 3 green bell peppers
instructions: Mix all of the dry ingredients together.  Roast peppers in a dry frying pan sprayed with oil.  Cool slightly.  Using an electric spice grinder, grind the hot peppers with the remaining dry ingredients.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,white sugar,graham cracker crumb,basil pesto,hot water,aluminum foil
title: Crusty Pesto Crumbs
ingredients: 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 teaspoons hot water | 32 graham cracker crumbs | aluminum foil
instructions: Mix ketchup, basil pesto, sugar, and hot water.  Dip graham cracker crumbs in ketchup mixture until coated.  Roll in crumbs.  Place on a tray lined with foil with waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.  Remove crumbs from fridge an hours before preparing recipe.  Remove foil from dish and place rack on crumb side up.  Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes at 400 degrees f.

title: Cod Fritters With Jicama
ingredients: 2 lbs cod, cut in half lengthways | 1 1/2 lbs jicama, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place jicama chunks and cod in a large baking dish.  Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 20 - 30 minutes until just cooked through.  Serve with a green salad or steamed baby potatoes.

Random Ingredients: parsley,mushroom,egg yolk,cayenne pepper,sea salt,heavy whipping cream,jalapeno pepper,mint
title: Mushroom Tortilla
ingredients: 4 tablespoons minced fresh parsley ( optional ) | 5 tablespoons minced fresh mint ( optional ) | 1/4 cup minced jalapeno peppers | 4 tablespoons minced fresh parsley ( optional ) | 1/4 cup salt | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 4 large egg yolks, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 pint fresh mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a large bowl, combine the parsley, mint, jalapeno, 1 tablespoon parsley, 1/4 cup salt and cayenne pepper.  Mix well and season with 1/4 cup salt.  Add the egg yolks one at a time and mix well.  Stir in the cream.  Place one layer of mushrooms in a 9 inch springform pan.  Cover with half of this mixture, then repeat with the rest of the mushrooms.  Sprinkle with remaining parsley and additional salt.  Refrigerate, covered, until the filling is very firm, at least 8 hours.  Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Easy Creamy Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated alfredo sauce, chilled | 1 1/2 cups chili sauce | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Open and drain pasta rolls, lay out on a flat surface.  Spread chilled alfredo sauce and 1/3 of the chili sauce over rolls.  Arrange 4 vanilla bean slices over pasta sauce, top with remaining half of chili sauce and vanilla bean slices.  Refrigerate at least 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,lemon juice zest,coconut milk,chocolate,serrano pepper,head garlic,orzo pasta
title: Caribbean Orzo Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked orzo pasta | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 tablespoons lemon juice ( from lemon zest ) | 1 small head of garlic, minced or 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 2 serrano peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 cups coconut milk | grated chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Cook the orzo in a large pot of boiling water for 8 - 10 minutes or until al dente.  Meanwhile to make the sauce, in a large, deep skillet, heat the oil over medium heat.  Add the lemon juice, the garlic and chiles to the pan.  Toss the pasta and the sauce together until coated.  Serve over rice or in a salad bowl.  Sprinkle with grated chocolate if desired.

title: Baked Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup rose water | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 1 1/2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla, diluted with 1/2 cup hot water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the cardamon in a small baking dish.  Briefly toast the cardamon a few seconds on each side, remove and set aside.  Mix the spices together in a small bowl.  Brush the cooled cardamon mixture on both sides of each fish fillet.  Place fish on rack in baking dish and bake 10 minutes.  Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Tahini Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon garam masala
instructions: Whisk together the tahini with 1/4 cup water.  Stir in 1 tablespoon garam masala.  To serve, heat remaining 1/4 cup water over medium heat and whisk into hot sauce, then add a bit of the sauce to heat through before serving.

title: Wild Rice With Gruyere Frites
ingredients: 2 cups wild rice | 1/4 cup canola oil | 50 g muenster cheese ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the wild rice well with cold water and drain the water.  If you need to do this in advance, keep the rice covered in the fridge.  Bring a pot of water to the boil and add the wild rice.  Boil slowly until all the water is absorbed.  Turn the heat off and leave the rice in the hot water.  Leave the pot for 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan.  When it's just starting to smoke, fry the muanster cheese until it's just beginning to turn crispy.  Drain on paper towels.  Divide the rice between 2 large plates, spoon over the cheese and pour over the muanster cheese.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,chickpea flour,kalamata olive,cocoa,pork tenderloin,milk,vanilla sugar,beef stock vegetable
title: Brazilian Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon caribbean ground red chili pepper powder or 1 tablespoon mild fresh chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1 lb pork tenderloin ( or cut of the thin, not fatty cut ) | 1 can chickpea flour | 1/2 cup beef stock or 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1/4 cup milk | 6 dried kalamata olives, pitted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f combine cocoa, chili powder, turmeric and pork in bowl.

title: Scottish Baked Fish
ingredients: 1 smoked ham hock | 1 1/2 pounds cod ( whole ) | 1 red potato | 2 ears corn kernels | 1/2 cup tea | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Cut the smoked ham hock in half lengthwise, or pound out the thick flesh.  Place a whole smoked fish on a solid piece of aluminum foil, and top with about 1/2 cup of the diced potato.  Wrap the wrapped ham hock around the fish, and fold the ends into the foil with a knot over the fish.  Place the packet in a shallow roasting pan.  Pour the tea, and honey over the fish.  Bake, turning after 5 hours, until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Homemade Chicken Wingers
ingredients: 5 lbs bone-in chicken pieces ( legs, thighs ) | 2 cups chocolate syrup | 3 dill seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f place all ingredients in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart pan and place in oven.  Bake 1 hour.  Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: black bean,marinara sauce,triple sec,cooking oil,fontina cheese
title: Black Bean and Fontina Antipasto Spread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 pound reduced-fat fontina cheese, shredded | 1 can black beans, drained & rinsed | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | 1/4 cup triple sec
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium high heat and stir in the fontina cheese.  Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.  Stir in the black beans and tomato sauce.  Remove from heat and add triple sec.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: filet beef,tomato puree,vanilla extract,garam masala,garlic clove,grain mustard
title: The Best Beef (Australia)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coarse grain mustard | 3 garlic cloves, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala ( scant | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 3 1/2 lbs filet of beef | 14 ounces tomato puree
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Mix all of the ingredients and pat the beef into four long oval shapes.  Place them on a rack in a roasting tin.  Cover and roast in the oven until no pink remains, about 1 1/2 hours.  Cool.  Remove the beef from the oven and brush generously with the melted fat from a pan.  Transfer to a cutting board.  Cut into thin slices.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet choice,wheat pastry flour,bread dough,italian salad dressing mix,fennel seed,citron,great northern bean
title: Baked Fish and Bean Pie
ingredients: 4 fish fillets, such as rock cod, halibut, and or cod | 8 cups bread dough, prepared according to package directions ( like you do for your own recipe ) | 1 1/2 cups italian salad dressing mix, bottled | 4 -5 fennel seeds, to taste | 1 jar sliced great northern beans | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons dried italian salad dressing mix or 2 tablespoons dry italian salad dressing mix ( made with dry italian salad dressing mix ) | 5 ounces candied citron ( about 4 ) or 5 ounces candied orange ( about 4 )
instructions: Boil fish for about 10 minutes.  Remove fish, remove heads and bones, and cut up fish into bite sized chunks.  Place chopped fish and any other meat or vegetables in a 9 x 13 pan, or a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish.  Sprinkle fillets with toasted fennel seeds, and set aside.  In a medium mixing bowl, combine 1/2 cup italian dressing mix and remaining 1/2 cup dressing mix.  Add beans, worcestershire sauce, and both amounts of italian dressing mix.  Add more to taste, if desired, but the flavor is very subtle.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Drain fish from water and rinse lightly.  Place fillets between two sheets of plastic, using a spoon to press gently.  Place fillets in a single layer in the baking dish.  Pour remaining dressing mixture over fish.  Cover and bake 35 - 45 minutes or until fish flakes easily over top.  While fish is baking, prepare the citron topping.  Cut 4 ounces candied citrus peel in half through its width.  Sprinkle 1/4 cup sfreen or pecorino all over fish.  If lemon juice is still clinging to the fish chunks at this point, sprinkle with remaining sfreen or pecorino.  Place 2 fillets on top of each citron and then drizzle with remaining sfreen or pecorino, and sprinkle on the remaining 2 oz candied citrus peel.  Place in a cool place, and cool about 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Herby Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 lb graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs, chopped ( i have used dried, if fresh herbs are not available )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and press in a buttered shallow dish.  Bake at 350ºf.  For 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,white rice,beef stew meat,thyme sprig,yogurt
title: Easy Beef & Yellow Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup white rice | 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 2 inch pieces, about | 8 basil leaves | 8 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 cup low-fat yogurt, plain ( optional )
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions.  Meanwhile, spray a 12 inch nonstick skillet/stickening coated with cooking spray with cooking spray.  Add meat and brown, approximately 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add basil and thyme sprigs.  Mix well.  Pour rice mixture into skillet/stickening coated skillet.  Cover and cook over medium heat until water boils, about 10 - 15 minutes.  Turn heat to low.  Cover and cook until liquid is absorbed, about 25 - 30 minutes longer.  Add yogurt, if desired, and mix well.  Cover and cook on very low heat until mixture is creamy, about 10 minutes.  Transfer to serving plate.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: half cream,coconut,self raising flour,chicken wing,grain bread,chicken breast,scallop,shallot
title: Chicken Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup grated desiccated coconut | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh shallots | 50 g shredded cooked chicken breast | 4 scallops | 50 g sliced thick half-and-half cream | 200 g sliced chicken legs | 2 slices thick white sandwich bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat grill to medium.  Combine flour, coconut and shallots in a large bowl.  Stir in the chicken, scallops and half and half and toss until evenly covered.  Using 2 pieces of bread, flatten to the top of a large non stick muffin tin.  Place 3 pieces of bread onto each muffin tin and top with half chicken mixture.  Place two slices of chicken legs atop the sandwiches and top with remaining bread.  Place on oven tray and grill for 12 to 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through.  Serve immediately.

title: Simple Mexican Corn
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 12 ounces whole kernel corn, undrained
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Spread corn on baking sheets coated with cooking spray.  Bake 10 minutes, stirring once.  Sprinkle with salt.  Cut into 4 wedges.

title: Tandoori Mixture
ingredients: 1/2 pound mild cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup garam masala
instructions: Place the cheese into a resealable plastic bag.  Poke holes in cheese with a knife to release steam.  Place the bag in a slow cooker.  Pour the garam masala over the cheese.  Close the lid, and set on the cooker set to high until the cheese is completely melted, 2 1/2 4 hours.  Allow 10 - 15 minutes to set.  Allow to cool completely before serving.

title: Italian Olive Rolls
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen puff pastry, thawed | water | 1 jar sliced green olives ( drained ) | 1 bottle ranch dressing | 1 jar tabasco sauce
instructions: Roll out puff pastry into a 13 x 9 pan.  Arrange olives and ranch dressing on pastry.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Evenly spread mixture over top, making sure to cover the olives.  Bake at 400 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Red Enchiladas (With or Without Corn)
ingredients: 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup kahlua or 1/4 cup other coffee-flavored liqueur | 14 -16 peppercorns | 1 1/2 cups frozen corn kernels
instructions: Combine all ingredients except corn in a 2 quart slow cooker.  Stir well.  Cover and cook on high 7 - 8 hours or low 8 - 9 hours for an even longer terrific enchilada sauce.

title: Ghoray (Dry Fried Bananas)
ingredients: 4 large bananas ( medium ripe ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander ( ground finely ground )
instructions: Cut each banana lengthwise into 3 slices, removing the peel and any pith.  Sprinkle the pieces with the coriander and leave for 15 to 30 minutes to marinate.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Remove the banana pieces from the oil remaining in the skillet, remove the peel from the peel, and pat dry.  Using a spoon, squeeze the oil from the banana pieces.  Put them in an ovenproof frying pan and bake for about 40 to 50 minutes, or until well browned.

title: Homemade Flour Mix (For Meat Loafs)
ingredients: 2 cups flour | 1 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl set on top of a clean flat board.  Make a well in the center of the flour and add water.  Knead dough until the dough can be stretched very thin.  Pat out to a thickness of approximately 1 inch.  Form balls of dough 3 1/2 to 4 ounces.  Place 1 inch apart on an ungreased griddle or large brown pan.  Flip when underside is light golden.

title: Roasted Orange Sweet Orange Bell Peppers and Almonds

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the onions in an 8x8 inch baking dish or roasting pan, overlapping them in an overlapping fashion, with the almonds evenly over them. title: Hoisin Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: sirloin ( inexpensive sandwich meat ) | 1 can water chestnuts or ( 16 ounce ) can bamboo shoots | 8 hoagie rolls
instructions: In a freezer bag, place the beef, bamboo shoots and water chestnuts.  Seal and freeze for at least 48 hours, or overnight.  Take out and thaw bag, and slice thinly.  Remove meat, and place on hamburger buns.  Top with any sauce that you desire.

title: Horseradish Chipotle Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint sour cherry | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey or 1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons chipotle chiles, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh coriander | cooked rice wine, to serve
instructions: Puree the cherries with the wine, sugar, chilies, and coriander.  Whisk in the sour cherry mixture with your food processor until well mixed but not runny.  Season to taste with freshly ground black pepper.  Serve over fish.

Random Ingredients: spinach,sirloin tip steak,mini chocolate chip,chunky salsa
title: Salsa Beef Wraps
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip steaks, fat-trimmed of excess fat and cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1/2 cup prepared chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons mini chocolate chips ( or semi sweet ) | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed
instructions: Heat the beef in a skillet.

title: Butternut Squash Roasted
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash, peeled | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon other cooking oil
instructions: Cut squash lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices, each about 1/8 inch thick.  Insert a small deep, sharp knife between slices and gently press through the holes of the knife to cut the squash down in the cutouts.  Taste for seasoning, stir in the oil and spread evenly with a spatula to evenly spread over the squash.  Allow to marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes.  Adjust oven rack to lowest position and heat oven to 375 degrees f or place an ungreased large sheet of aluminum foil on a baking sheet.  Using your fingertips, remove 1 tablespoon of mixture from the cavity of each squash slice.  Spread the rest of the mixture evenly over all of the squash slices and seal the edges of each one with a spatula or toothpicks.  Roast the roasting chickens about 45 minutes or until a knife inserted into the thickest part of a piece of squash comes out clean.

title: Spareribs With Seafood Chowder
ingredients: 2 lbs country-style spareribs | 2 cans clams, drained | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 cups swiss cheese, cubed | 1/4 cup red wine
instructions: Place spareribs, clams and picante sauce in crockpot.  Cover and cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours or until ribs are tender.

title: Easy Pecan Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup toasted pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Pour an entire can of enchilada sauce into a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle the pecans over the sauce, and top with the remaining enchilada sauce.  Bake in the preheated oven until bubbling, about 1 hour.

title: Chipotle Noodle Skillet
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons dry vermicelli, broken into 1/2 inch pieces | 4 chipotle chiles, dried, seeded and minced ( more or less, to taste )
instructions: Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until shimmering.  Add the vermicelli.

title: Simple Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1 large yellow bell pepper, or a little larger, for spanish rice
instructions: Stir together beans, yellow bell pepper, and extra water in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer 10 to 15 minutes, until peppers are tender and beans are heated through.

title: Quick and Easy Fresh Fruit Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried fruit | 2 pinches green peppercorns ( optional ) | pizza dough
instructions: Rinse dried fruit with cold water.  If necessary, drain the fruit of your choice.  Place fruit in pot and cover with water.  Simmer for 1 to 3 hours on medium heat.  Do not remove the cover until the end of cooking time.  When the fruit mixture is tender, remove from heat and stir and allow to cool completely.  Meanwhile, heat pizza dough for 10 to 15 minutes on each side in your preferred way.  If using fresh fruit, sprinkle with the green peppercorns and lightly sauté for a few minutes to toast them.  Remove cooked pizza dough from refrigerator, and spread out on a baking sheet.  Spread the cooled fruit and fresh fruit mixture on the bread, and bake under the preheated pizza dough at 400°f about 20 minutes.  Serve hot or cold.

title: Spaghetti and Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 6 ounces pecan pieces | 6 ounces sun-dried tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Place pecan pieces on a parchment lined baking sheet.  Spread sun dried tomatoes onto a cookie sheet or broiler pan with a baking brush.  Bake 20 minute, stirring once.  Let cool 5 minute set aside.  When pecans are cool toast, using oven mitts or clean hands spread the roasted seeds onto the roasted seeds.  Use the seeds to press the pecan nuts evenly onto the roasted seeds.  If you have any leftover, use these to put on the top of the cooked spaghetti before serving.  Some like to use a coffee bean sprout dip when you add the sun dried tomatoes.  You can also add a sprinkle of grated parmesan cheese.

title: Dublin Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup guinness stout | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 2 cups cooked kumquats, chopped | 2 1/2 pounds salmon fillet
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the guinness and hot pepper sauce.  Place kumquats into a shallow dish and pour the guinness mixture over them.  Allow them to marinate at least 30 minutes.  Drain the salmon and place on a baking sheet.  Bake at 350 degrees f for 10 to 15 minutes.  Remove from the oven and add the hot sauce.  Serve with fries.

title: Smokey Orange Spread
ingredients: 2 oranges, peeled and cut into chunks | 1/2 tablespoon smoked liquid smoke
instructions: In a food processor or electric blender, combine the oranges, liquid smoke, and smoked fat.  Process until smooth.  Use immediately, or store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

Stir the roast into the sauce.  Serve immediately.

title: Niter Kiyaar (Fenugreek Leaves in Paper)
ingredients: 4 dozen dried fenugreek leaves | 1/4 - 1/2 cup minced fresh italian parsley | parchment paper, to cover rim of parchment sheet
instructions: Soak dried fenugreek leaves in cold water over gentle heat until softened, about 1 - 2 hours.  Rinse.  Drain well and pat dry.  Stuff the leaves with 1 teaspoons of minced parsley.  Using a very sharp knife, slice off the top third of each leaf and place them in a lightly oiled wide mouthed colander set over boiling water.  Allow the excess liquid to drip away, about 3 - 4 minutes.  Lay one leaf out on your work surface along with 1 teaspoon of minced parsley and roll tightly.  Repeat until all the leaves and/or parsley have been used.  Stack leaf upright on a platter.  Sprinkle with reserved parsley and top with remaining leaves, pressing gently so as not to break up leaves.  Serve at room temperature or slightly warmer.

Random Ingredients: caul,extra sharp cheddar cheese,rice,tuna,green bell pepper,artichoke heart,ha avocado,broth
title: Artichoke Avocado & Tuna Risotto

instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in a large bowl.  Add 1 1/2 cups of cheese.  Season, with salt and pepper to taste.  Place on a platter.  Heat broth on low heat in a large pot, but do not bring to a boil.  Add the cooked rice to the broth and continue to cook, stirring frequently.  Pour this risotto over the rice, then sprinkle the remaining 1 1/2 cups of cheese over the top.  This will be served at once, as cheese can be added later on the rise of the risotto.  Serve immediately on the side.

title: Limoncello
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges | 1/2 cup dry red table wine | 4 large eggs | lemon wedge
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot, cover with water and simmer over medium heat until tender and easily pierced with a fork, 45 to 50 minutes.  Drain, cool slightly and scoop out potato flesh into a bowl and reserve.  When cool enough to handle fold potatoes together to create a firm paste.  Press potato mix into the base of a buttered and floured 3 quart soufflé dish, tilting to coat bottom and sides evenly.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Beat eggs in a small bowl until well combined.  In a separate bowl, mix wine and reserved potato mixture and spoon over potato mixture.  Toss to coat thoroughly.  Sprinkle lemon wedges evenly over top.  Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,mayonnaise,flax seed oil,nutmeg,russet potato,margarine,beef bouillon cube,green chili pepper
title: Potato Stir-Fry

instructions: Wash and peel potatoes and pierce with a fork several times with a knife or fork.  Boil them just until soft.  Mash the potato in the bowl of a standing mixer with a fork. title: Filipino Spiral Pasta

instructions: Place a heavy based frying pan on heat.  Place in a bowl the pasta following box directions.  Add the bitters and let melt. title: Miso & Broccole

instructions: Break up the cracked wheat with the flat side of your drinking glass or small spoon.  Add the miso and stir together.  I usually double the recipe, but it doesn't taste as good or as if everything is equally distributed.  Serve immediately as a snack or appetizer.  Also, if you've managed to get to date a date, use 1 tbsp miso for 5 - 7 days.  Remember this also makes delicious breakfast cereals.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,chard leaf,lemon peel,cod fish fillet,flat leaf parsley,wheat flour,straw mushroom,apple juice
title: Cod With Chard, Mushrooms, and Parsley

Sprinkle with remaining chopped parsley and smoked fish.  Serve with wedges of apple.  Variation, try using a combination of chard and spinach.  Aubergine, also known as zucchini or potato, should also be used.

instructions: Put spinach and herbs into bowl with other ingredients and mix well.  Place buns, fat side up, in greased oven proof dish.  Bake at 220c for 10 - 15 minutes or until mushrooms begin to brown and spinach is wilted.  Serve with mustard and salad greens.

title: Queso Fresco Cheese

instructions: Mix the queso fresco and cheese together until smooth.  Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.

title: Amaretto Amaretto Maple Pie (Vegan)

instructions: For the crust, place the barley in a strainer/ strainer and let it sit for 15 minutes to remove excess barley water.  Drain and discard the barley water. Lower the oven temperature to 325 degrees f and continue to cook 40 - 45 minutes until golden brown and crust is crisp.  You may need to tent the pan with foil to prevent the top from burning.

title: Baked Maple Syrup Pie

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a medium bowl, combine the cornmeal and cream of chicken soup.  Pour cornmeal mixture into a 9 inch pie dish.  Mix together maple syrup and flour till well combined and add into the cornmeal.  Stir until well combined.  Spoon into prepared pie shell and bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

instructions: Mix lemon juice and zucchini in a bowl and toss with half of the diced tomatoes.  Place in refrigerator.  Drain the meat, reserving the liquid.  Thread the meat and zucchini alternately onto two skewers.  Place in resealable plastic bag.

title: Apple Sherdough With Tahini Sauce

instructions: Peel, core and slice the apples into thin rounds.  Cut the peppers into thin strips.  Chop the cored apples in small pieces.  Combine the sour tahini with the miracle whip and vermouth and place in a wide, shallow bowl and mix.  Add tahini mixture to bowl and mix well.  Add apples, green bell pepper, and cilantro. title: Turnip (Stir-Fry) in Coconut Milk

instructions: Place the turnips in a large pot with water to cover, about 1/2 inch above the turnips.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and cook until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain the turnips, return to the pot, and mash with the chicken bouillon.  Return to the cooking liquid.

title: Quick Dogs

instructions: Combine together cream cheese and mushroom in a small bowl.  Spread mixture on cutlets.  Arrange over mushrooms.  Serve.

title: Beef and Bacon Satay or Ceviche
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 10 slices bacon, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander powder | 1 medium onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons black olives, chopped
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, add the ground beef, sliced bacon, fresh coriander, chopped onion and olives.  Mix well.  Pour into a shallow dish or tray and place in the fridge to marinate for about 3 hours.  Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Spiced Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 300 g bacon, chopped | 200 c sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon whole cloves
instructions: Wrap bacon in a piece of cheesecloth and put over a pan of hot water to soak.  Fry over a fairly high heat until light brown and crisp which will take about 15 minutes.  When done drain.  Remove bacon when cool enough to handle but leave some fat in the pan and leave it dripping.  Add a pound of raw, toasted sesame seeds and 1 tablespoon of the reserved drippings aswell as the whole cloves.  Turn the heat down to a very gentle gentle simmer and cook, stirring for a further five minutes and stirring from time to time.  When well mixed and sesame seeds are golden brown remove the cheesecloth and leave them to drain and cool down slightly.  Powder some more and then leave to cool to room temperature.  If possible chill the sesame seeds in plastic wrap overnight under cold water.  The oil will solidify and you can now pop them straight into the hot pan.  They should be a dark, toasted colour.

title: Chicken Wings
ingredients: 12 chicken wings | 1 yellow onion, chopped
instructions: Wash and pat dry the wings.  Using tongs, remove the tips of the wings.  Cut off and discard the tips of the wings.  Set them aside.  Place the onions into a large skillet.  Over medium heat cook and stir the onions until they are beginning to brown.  Immediately add the chicken wings from the skillet.  Cook until the chicken is cooked through and is cooked through, about 15 minutes.

title: Brussels Sprouts Softie
ingredients: 8 cups plain gluten-free prepared loaf dough, such as boboli | 2 packages fresh yeast, softened in 2 tbsp warm water and sprinkled with 1 tbsp flour | 3 cups brussels sprouts, sliced | 24 large lettuce leaves, rinsed and dried | 32 grape flavored crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f punch down the dough and separate into 4 pieces.  On a floured surface, using palms of your hands pat each piece into a 9'' round.  Spread 2 tablespoons of the yeast softness and 7 cups water into the center of each round.  Cover with plastic wrap and put a baking sheet over the dough and set aside for 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, mix the remaining yeast, 1 cup water and salt in a large bowl.  Add the sprouts and let stand 10 minutes.  When the dough has rested 20 minutes, place it on a flat surface and stretch in 3 batches.  Place a cabbage leaf on it and roll up tightly.  Place in a large greased baking dish and cover loosely with plastic wrap or kitchen foil.  Let rise 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, add crumbs to 2 cups of hot water, stirring well.  When the dough has raised its first rising the cabbage should be soft, not mushy and a little sticky.  Drain the sprouts and place on a platter.  Top with cheese and bread crumbs.  Let cool 10 minutes before slicing into 1/4 slices.

Servings depends on the size of fillet and the size of chicken.

title: Pork, Ginger, and Horseradish Tarts
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork roast | 1 sheet commercial puff pastry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f.  On a lightly floured surface, roll out the sheet of puff pastry into a 12x8 rectangle.  With 1 tablespoon of butter for each tart. Gently pull up the edges of the pastry over the pork, leaving a 1/2 border along the edge of the pastry and the parchment round inside it and trim it as best you can. title: Blue Cheese Casserole with Sausage

instructions: Drain saffron and place in a bowl.  Add the tomato ketchup, saffron and saffron and mix well.  Preheat your oven to 180°c combine sausage and ketchup mix well with the saffron mixture in the strainer.  Spray an oven proof dish with oil and sprinkle with the blue curacao.
