Random Ingredients: caraway seed,kielbasa sausage,white mushroom,banana pepper,egg substitute,lime wedge,mace
title: Guilt Free Breakfast Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 large egg substitute | 1 tablespoon caraway seed ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons minced red banana peppers ( optional ) | 6 ounces kielbasa sausage, casing removed ( i used extra lean, sweet version of kielbasa ) | 12 white mushrooms ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons minced lime wedge ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace ( optional )
instructions: Slice sausage into bite size pieces.  Put all ingredients in a large bowl or tupperware bowl and mix well.  Pour the mixture into a ziplock and freeze.  Let sit out overnight.  Remove the contents from the freezer.  In a large sauté pan, put the sauté pan on medium heat with a little bit of oil.  Add the sausage, mushrooms and spices, stirring and crumbling the sausage into the sauté pan.  Cook the meat thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,garlic,vanilla essence,belgian endive,lamb,chicken stock,pepper sauce,cream cheese
title: Grilled Lamb Patties With Belgian Endive And Corn
ingredients: 500 g ground lamb | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 6 heads belgian endive, separated into stalks | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1/8 cup sour cream | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 dash hot pepper sauce ( add more if desired ) | 1 tablespoon corn kernel ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Mix the ground lamb, minced garlic and salt and pepper to taste.  Shape into six 8 ounce patties.  Wrap each patty individually with cling film and place on a hot hot griddle pan.  Turn frequently for around 6 minutes per side.  To make the sauce, mix the stock with sour cream, vanilla essence, hot pepper sauce and corn kernels.  Cut endsives, stalky endive stalks into 1 cm sticks and place in a blender with milk or cream mixed with a small amount of water.  Blend until smooth.  Serve with burgers or vegetables to dip when served.  Garnish with olives or pears to serve.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,ziti pasta,red wine vinegar
title: Ziti With Raw Red Wine
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne pasta, cooked and drained ( 16 ounces total weight ) | 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups splenda sugar substitute, see note
instructions: Combine the vinegar and splenda in a large bowl and whisk together until dissolved.  Add pasta and stir to coat.  Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray.  Over medium high heat, add the drained pasta and cook, stirring and mashing with a potato masher or fork, until the pasta is just slightly chewy.  You don't want it to turn to mushy or too dry.  Add the vinegar and vinegar mixture.  Bring the mixture to a boil until most of the liquid is absorbed.  Stir constantly, cook for 2 minutes, taking care not to mash.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,beef broth,white breadcrumb,sushi rice,udon noodle
title: Japanese Niku Jyaga (Soba Donburi)
ingredients: 1 1/2 1 1/2 ounces udon noodles or 1 1/2 ounces shiro miso | 1 1/2 ounces sushi rice ( short shao hsing ) | 1 1/2 ounces white breadcrumbs | 1 large yellow onion | 1 cup beef broth
instructions: Soak the rice using kosher salt and place into a large pot covered by cold water until the water reaches a boil.  Add the bread crumbs to the soaked rice and mix together, keeping to one side.  Cut the onion in half at the stem, slice it very thinly and set aside after step mix up the seasoning with the broth and set aside.  Rinse and dry the soaked rice several times, then place into a pot large enough to allow for both the beef portion and the beef broth.  Bring to a simmer, cover and set the timer for 10 minutes, turn off and wait for another five minutes or until the water boils up.  This will only affect the flavor of the broth.  At step 4, fluff the rice with a large fork to separate it from the jyaga and onion. .  To serve, either remove the beef portions from the broth with a draining spoon or slice the beef as thinly as possible, or chop the onion and stir it into the rice.  Re cover until all the broth is absorbed.  It is very best to use a microwave method for this step.

title: The Best Corn With Freezing (Beer)
ingredients: 2 cups corn kernels | 6 ounces beer ( light beer works too ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place the corn in a food processor and put the blade blade at the table.  Pour in the beer, worcestershire sauce and corn kernels.  Process till smooth.  If it is too thick, add a little water.  If it is too thin, freeze.  Pour onto a parchment paper covered cookie sheet.  Freeze for 1 - ½ hours.  You can do this in the morning as well.  Cut into 1/2 chunks and serve warm or cold.

title: Baked Dilled Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 cup cabbage, chopped thinly | 1 lb lean ground meat | 2 tablespoons horseradish, drained | 4 teaspoons paprika | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to toss cabbage with 1/4 cup of water.  Place cabbage in a lightly oiled shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish.  Brown meat and drain off fat.  Mix all ingredients together except bbq sauce.  Spread over cabbage.  Bake at 375° f for 45 minutes.

title: Smooth Chipotle Shanks
ingredients: 5 pounds beef shank | 2 cups nonfat yogurt | 3 chipotle peppers, chopped
instructions: Trim excess fat from the shanks and place them in a large pot with enough water to cover them about 1/2 inch above.  Cover, and bring to a boil.  Turn off the heat.  Place the lid on the pot, and set it aside.  Let cool for 15 minutes.  Drain off the excess water.  In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the shanks, yogurt and pepper.  Tie the bag into 2 inch pieces, and refrigerate the shanks for 6 hours, or overnight.  Preheat a grill for high heat.  Place the shanks in a large skillet, and pour the beer over the shanks.  Bring to a boil over high heat.  Cover, and grill until the beef is tender enough to slice with a fork, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: chocolate morsel,brown gravy mix,steak,mango,velveeta cheese,fennel bulb,black pepper,pork loin
title: Sweet and Savory Sweetheart Steak
ingredients: 1 lb boneless flank steak | 1 lb bonless pork loin | 1 package brown gravy mix, prepared with a packet of your favorite spice | 1 fennel bulb, cleaned and finely chopped | 1 lb mango, peeled and chopped | 1 package velveeta cheese | 2 ounces grated chocolate morsel ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet or grill pan, grill flank steak and pork and remove from pan and set aside.  Dice steak into small bite size pieces place in crockpot.  Chop fennel bulb and add it to the crockpot followed by beef and pork.  Cut velveeta cheese into chunks and add to pan with meat and veg and let simmer for 2 hours.  Serve over white rice or with egg noodles.  Sprinkle on parmesan cheese before serving if using, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: oat,currant,beef broth,curry powder,lemon juice,oregano leaf,cardamom seed
title: Curried Porridge
ingredients: 2 cups beef broth | 6 whole cardamom seeds | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 3 ounces currants or 3 ounces raisins, soaked in water and drained well | 4 ounces rolled oats
instructions: If desired, heat the broth in small saucepan to boiling and dissolve the cardamom seeds in it.  Stir in all the dry spices except the raisins or raisins.  Bring to the boil and simmer for ten minutes.  Add the currants/raisins and simmer for another 10 minutes.  Remove from the heat.  Beat the curried porridge in the mixer to prevent it from curdling.  Add the lemon juice.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,olive,asparagus spear,cornmeal,oyster sauce,white pepper,chili flake,onion soup mix
title: Corn Noodles With Asparagus and Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces thin spaghetti sauce | 1 tablespoon olive, extra-virgin | 8 asparagus spears, trimmed and cut on the diagonal into 1-inch lengths | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper, freshly ground | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 3/4 cup oyster sauce | 12 tablespoons prepared spanish sweet and sour roasted chili flakes
instructions: Prepare the spaghetti sauce, in a non stick frying pan, mix the olive with the onions soup mix on low until the onions are softened.  Meanwhile, heat a splash of water in a saucepan and stir in the cornmeal and season with the white pepper.  Cook, stirring, for 1 minute.  Stir in the chili flakes and remove from the heat.  Add the oyster sauce and stir until no lumps form.  Spoon into a bowl, cover and chill to allow the flavors to develop.  To cook, bring a large saucepan of iced water to a boil and add the spaghetti sauce.  Cook for about 1 minute.  Plunge the asparagus pieces into the boiling water and cook for 3 minutes then refresh under cold running water.  Toss with the olive mixture.  Drain any excess spaghetti water with the noodles and serve as directed.

title: Chipotle-Pepper Rabbit and Chipotles
ingredients: 2 pints jumbo pasta shells, cooked | 1 cup quick oats | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 2 jumbo roasted chipotle chiles in adobo, drained | 4 ounces turkey or 4 ounces rabbit pieces
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Arrange the shells on a baking sheet and broil until slightly browned, about 6 minutes.  In a small bowl, combine the dry oatmeal with the mayonnaise and chopped chipotles.  Spread the mixture over the bottom of the cooled shells and top with pieces of the turkey or rabbit.  Broil the turkey until turkey is no longer pink, about 5 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: green peppercorn,beefsteak tomato,yellow bell pepper,tomato paste
title: Peparos in Fremantle Style
ingredients: 1 1 lb beefsteak tomatoes | 1 can tomato paste | 1/2 green peppercorn | 2 yellow bell peppers, cut into 2x 1/4 inch sticks
instructions: Chop tomatoes in 2 inch chunks and place in bowl.  Drain tomatoes, reserving juices.  Set juice aside.  In heavy skillet, heat reserved juice.  Add tomato paste and 1/4 cup water.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Add pepper and simmer over low heat.  Add 3rd cup of water and stew.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,bay leaf,black cumin,turnip,bibb lettuce,jumbo shrimp,mint leaf,mace
title: Mixed Turnips and Goat Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb whole bibb lettuce, torn into small pieces | 1/4 lb goat cheese | 1 teaspoon black cumin, ground | 1 teaspoon fresh mace, ground | 1 teaspoon fresh mint leaves, chopped | 1 small turnip, unpeeled and cut into wedges ( about 1/2 lb total ) | 1 small jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Toss the lettuce, cheese, cumin, mace, mint and turnips together until the ingredients are well blended.  Taste and add salt if necessary.  Garnish with the shrimp, bay leaf and cayenne pepper.

Random Ingredients: rice,peanut oil,rotel tomato chilies,habanero pepper,tomato,cooking oil
title: Korean Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white rice or 1 cup brown rice | 1 -2 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 tablespoon julienne habanero pepper ( korean hot pepper sauce ) | 1 tomatoes, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 4 ounces rotel tomatoes & chilies
instructions: Dice tomatoes.  Dice garlic.  Slice jalpeno.  Rinse hot pepper sauce.  Put 2 - 3 tablespoons vegetable oil in a medium sauce pan over low.  When oil is hot, add rice and cook for a few minutes until lightly golden.  Pour in hot oil.  Wait 3 minutes and stir.  Toss in garlic and hot pepper sauce.  Turn off heat and serve rice hot.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,tomatillo,angel hair pasta,dark sesame oil
title: Angel Hair Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 cups angel hair pasta | 1 cup light-colored sun-dried tomatoes and tomatillo sauce | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook the angel hair pasta in the boiling water until cooked through yet firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,salad oil,seasoning salt,szechuan peppercorn,plain yogurt,heavy cream,cornstarch
title: Smooth & Creamy Smoked Mozzarella!
ingredients: 4 teaspoons dried szechuan peppercorns, cracked ( optional ) | 5 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 bunch mixed salad oil ( may use sunflower oil ) | 1 lb mascarpone cheese ( may use cream cheese ) | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Soak the peppercorns in a bowl of water for 1 hour.  Drain and grind 1 teaspoon salt in a mortar and pestle.  Combine peppercorns, seasoning salt, and 1/2 cup salad oil in a small bowl.  Blend thoroughly, then strain through a fine sieve.  Reserve 1/4 cup of the reserved oil in a bowl.  Add remaining oil and mascarpone cheese to reserved oil and blend well with hand blender.  Strain mixture through a fine sieve, discarding solids.  Whip cream and cornstarch together in a bowl until stiff peaks form.  Fold 1/3 of whipped cream into cheese mixture and pour into 12 cup mold or 6 individual ramekins.  Spread some of the cheese mixture on top of the cheese layer.  Place ramekins on a cookie sheet, cover, and refrigerate overnight.  Remove ramekins from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving, brushing with reserved oil.  Serves.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,thai red curry paste,ghee,garam masala,green chile,parsley sprig,buckwheat flour,brandy
title: Buckwheat Pakoda
ingredients: 2 tablespoons gram flour, besan | 2 tablespoons ghee | 1 cup lightly packed finely chopped parsley sprigs | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 8 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | 1 green chile, deseeded and finely sliced ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds
instructions: Mix the gram flour with the ghee in a bowl.  Add the rest of the ingredients, except for the nuts and mix well.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for one hour or until needed.  Preheat the oven to 190c/350f/gas mark 4.  Divide the batter into 25 gg sized balls, then flatten each into a patty shape about 5cm thick.  Place the pakora on a baking tray and bake for about 7 minutes until crispy and golden.  Serve warm, sprinkled with the sambal chili powder or serve cold.

Random Ingredients: sriracha hot sauce,green pepper,lump crabmeat,cumin,tomato juice,corn oil
title: Thai Crab (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 ounces fresh lump crabmeat | 1/2 green pepper, sliced thinly | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 10 tablespoons sriracha hot sauce
instructions: Heat oil over medium high heat.  Add green peppers, crabmeat, cumin, and tomato.  Stir fry for about 1 minute.  Season to taste with sriracha, and cover.  Allow stew to brown up slightly, about 5 minutes, then serve.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,cream chicken soup,red capsicum,kahlua,sausage,spinach,chili paste
title: Italian Sausage Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb sausage | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 tablespoon kahlua | 8 flour tortillas | 8 ounces spinach | 8 ounces sour cream or 8 ounces cream cheese | 1 red capsicum, thinly sliced
instructions: Slice sausage diagonally into 3 - 4 long slices.  Combine chilli paste and kahlua.  Arrange sausage slice side by side on top of tortilla.  Sprinkle with chopped spinach or arugula.  Roll up, securing with toothpicks if necessary, place on paper towel on plate.  Pour fat from frying pan through a colander set over a large bowl and stir in sour cream.  Heat over medium high heat until steaming hot.  Serve on sizzling hot rolls with capsicum.

title: Macaroni and Olives
ingredients: 1 package macaroni | 1 package lawry's seasoned mix | 1 pound large spanish olives, pitted and sliced
instructions: Prepare the macaroni.  While the macaroni is in the package, combine the seven ingredients in a large saucepan with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and cook at medium heat until the macaroni is tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain the pasta, and mix in with the hot sauce.  Cook until the sauce coats the pasta.

title: Spaghetti With Chinese Snow Peas and Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 2 packages frozen snow peas, chopped | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1/2 pint jarred alfredo sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 cup cashews, roasted, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Pour into a well oiled 9x13 inch pan over a high flame.  When pan toasted, add cashews.  Cover and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta has cooked al dente.  Serve with a side of fresh green salad, if desired.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,basil leaf,seasoning salt,cracker,provolone cheese,lime juice zest,kiwi fruit,lime wedge
title: Basil Cracker Kiwi Kebab
ingredients: cracker | 6 kiwi fruits, peeled | 10 slices provolone cheese or 10 slices mozzarella cheese, cut 1/2-inch thick | 1/4 lime wedge | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon lime juice, zest of | 2 basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Cut kiwifruit in half and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  On ungreased cookie sheet, arrange kiwifruit in a circle about 15 to 18 inches from edge.  Drizzle lime juice and vinegar over the fruit.  Make crisscross cuts in cheese on surface of the kiwi kiwi fruit.  Dip rims of kiwifruit in lime juice and then brush with the lime juice and vinegar mixture.  Sprinkle cheese with lime peel.  Grill kebabs about 3 to 5 inches from very hot coals 5 to 6 minutes, turning frequently, until cheese is bubbly.  Turn and broil kiwifruit until golden brown, 4 - 5 minutes longer.

title: Chickpeas With Chipotle Cheese
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles ( pureed ) | 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese ( grated )
instructions: Place chickpeas, peanut butter, and chipotle puree in a processor.  Pulse a few times then blend until smooth, adding more chipotle puree or peanut butter while processing.  Place chickpeas into a greased casserole dish then sprinkle with 1 cup of the grated cheese.  Bake in oven at 350 degress f for 25 - 30 minutes or until heated through, stirring and sprinkling with remaining cheese before serving.

Random Ingredients: white raisin,white wine vinegar,vodka,extra tofu,anise extract,table salt,lavender flower
title: Tofu "Nests" With Roasted Flavors
ingredients: 20 ounces extra firm tofu, drained cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup white raisins, loosely packed | 3 teaspoons white wine vinegar or 3 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 pinch table salt or 1 pinch kosher salt | 1 teaspoon anise extract | lavender flowers, for garnish
instructions: Place the tofu, raisins, vinegar, and vodka in a large bowl.  Season lightly with a pinch of salt to taste.  Toss gently to combine.  Tightly cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 24 hours.  Brush the lavender flowers generously over the surface of the tofu.  When ready to serve, stir the yogurt and marinade into the tofu and serve.

title: Tantalising Red Curry Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup flour | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Mix all the dry ingredients, with a little water, in a small sauce pan.  Stir until water just begins to boil.  Add the red curry paste and whisk well.  Then add the cocoa powder and stir quickly to mix inches.  Let the heat simmer for about a minute and then pour over your favorite vegies, chicken etc.

title: Crispy Fried Crab
ingredients: 2 -3 green apples | 1/2 large radish | 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 1 crab
instructions: Peel the apples and remove the hard stem.  Cut them lengthwise into thirds.  Cut them each section down the middle.  Wash and core the radish.  Using a vegetable peeler cut the ginger into pieces.  Place the apple and radish pieces into a bowl, making sure everything is mixed together.  Dip the crab into the spice mixture and then shake the crab around so it is in a uniformly spreadable layer.  The idea is to lightly shake the crab to help stop the stuffing from sticking out.  Heat a nonstick wok.  When hot add about 1 - 2 tablespoons oil and when the film starts to splutter add the crab meat.  Quickly stir fry until the crab is cooked.  Remove and serve immediately.

title: Cannellini Bean and Apple Loaf
ingredients: 500 g dried cannellini beans, soaked overnight, reserve liquid | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, chopped | 8 ladyfingers | 1 tablespoon dry yeast | 1 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium sized bowl and mix together.  Put the dough in a roasting pan about 2 1/2 inches deep.  Leave the dough free of drafts, as it will rise during cooking time if allowed to dry out.  Roast on the middle rack of the oven for approximately 1 hour or until brown. .  Take out of the oven and leave to cool for at least an hour prior to slicing.

title: Spice-Free Egg Substitute for Breakfast
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups egg substitute | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Simply mix the dry ingredients together.  Beat the two egg whites to a froth consistency with a pinch of sea salt until they form soft peaks on the egg whites.  Pour 1/2 teaspoon of egg substitute into each meringue cup and gently fold them into the egg whites until all of the egg whites are incorporated.  Do not overbeat.  This makes 1 cup or more of essence.  Allow the mixture to set.

title: Homemade Vanilla Butter
ingredients: 1 lb butter, unsalted | 1/3 cup lemon juice, fresh and strained | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla sugar ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine all ingredients and stir until well mixed.  Transfer to a jar and cover.  Refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: green grape,pork sausage link,cauliflower floret,soy sauce,mustard powder,basil pesto,bread flour
title: Cheese Bites
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork sausage links, thick cut or 1/2 lb pork sausage, cut into bite size pieces | 1 medium cauliflower floret, cut into 2-inch florets | 1/2 cup fresh bread flour | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon basil pesto | 1/4 cup green seedless grape, halved
instructions: In a large skillet heat the oil or spray with bacon fat.  Put in the sausage, cauliflower, bread flour, soy sauce, mustard, and basil pesto.  Stir fry for 5 - 8 minutes until the flour mixture is bubbly.  Turn off the heat and add the grape halves and remove the grape halves.  Turn the mixture out onto a clean, dry plate.  Roll the biscuit mix on a floured cutting board until it resembles coarse meal.  You may break into smaller bites.  If the biscuit forms a nice crumbly texture, add a little more bread flour.  If it becomes very crumbly, add more bread flour.  It does not have to look like the consistency is ruined.

title: Chinese Pork and Peas
ingredients: 4 chinese bbq pork, cubes ( abura age ) | 1 can peas | ancho chilies, seeded, for flavouring
instructions: Wash peas well, cut off tips and discard ends.  Slice bbq pork in 2 in long strips the length of one long piece.  Cut pea pods lenghtwise in 2 in lengths.  Dunk pea pods in boiling water and soak about 10 minutes.  Drain or squeeze out excess water.  Cook in a wok for a few minutes on both sides, set aside.  Serve with sauce as a sauce.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,hard egg,clove,cream cheese,cooking spray,yellow pea,mushroom
title: Green Chile and Egg Bake
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained | 2 tablespoons dried yellow peas, drained | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 box frozen yellow pea, thawed
instructions: Prepare an 8x12 inch glass dish with cooking spray.  In a medium bowl, stir the eggs with cream cheese, chiles, peas, and cloves until thoroughly combined.  Spoon into the prepared dish.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 350 degrees f for 20 minutes.  Uncover.

title: Ribollita Breakfast
ingredients: 4 cups black tea, room temperature | 10 ounces prosciutto | 2 cups marinara sauce | 1/3 cup red wine or 1/3 cup sherry wine vinegar | 6 strawberries, sliced
instructions: Bring the 4 cups of black tea to boil in a small saucepan.  Pour into a tea pot or a large heat proof bowl.  Set aside to cool.  Meanwhile, slice the prosciutto into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Place each slice on a piece of prosciutto, making a sandwich.  Divide the marinara sauce among the 4 slices of prosciutto.  Top with berries.  Serve in warm glasses over a bed of hot cooked greens.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,green bell pepper,vanilla extract,cream tartar
title: Pepper Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 green bell pepper, cored seeded and diced ( or orange, yellow or orange juice ) | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a medium non stick skillet, heat oil over medium heat.  In a small bowl, combine cream of tartar, bell pepper, and vanilla.  In a medium sized saucepan, combine cream of tartar and 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly.  Stir the cream of tartar into oil.  When mixture starts to bubble, stir in green pepper.  Cover and cook until pepper is tender, approximately 2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Cover and let stand 10 minutes.  Transfer pepper cream to a serving bowl.  Chill in refrigerator, then stir in remaining cream of tartar.  Let stand at room temperature, 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Cape Breton
ingredients: 1 egg | 2 cups ice, crushed | 1/2 cup ice, crushed | 1 egg, beaten
instructions: Place egg and crushed ice in deep bowl.  Mix gently.  Add beaten egg and mix well.  Fill each hole until one corner.  Fold over in center and press the egg down on top.  Pour cold water on egg.  This is the secret to speed up the process.  Boil a pot of water.  Once water reaches boiling, place ice cubes in the pot and put the egg cover on it.  The shell will not lift off.  It will start floating on top of water.  You want it to float at all the steam.  Cook about 1 hour.  You do not want this to boil hard.  Serve this with a salad and a bread bowl of ice.

Random Ingredients: egg white,yellow onion,lettuce,dark brown sugar,daikon radish,orange zest
title: Filipino Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 2 cups yellow onions, finely diced | 1 cup daikon radish, finely diced | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon orange zest ( optional ) | 1/4 cup fat free egg substitute or 1/4 cup fat-free egg white | chopped lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Mix onions, daikon, brown sugar, orange zest, egg substitute with fork well until all ingredients are mixed.  Do not fry.  This is best made the day before and stored in a refrigerator for best results.  Place in serving bowls garnished with sliced lettuce, if desired.  Bring to just under a simmer.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,sauerkraut,palm sugar,dark rum,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,chocolate,mango
title: Rice With Spicy Rum and Adobo
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice | 8 ounces sauerkraut | 1/4 lb chopped candied mango | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 teaspoon chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, chopped | 2 bars semisweet chocolate
instructions: Prepare the rice according to instructions on the package.  When you are ready to cook the rice, preheat a large frying pan or wok on high heat.  Add the rum, chipotle pepper, and adobo sauce and stir fry for a few seconds until the alcohol cooks off.  The rum will turn the rice shiny and aromatic, not letting you burn it.  Add the rice and stir to coat completely.  Tightly roll up the rice in your hand, being careful to do it in an overlapping fashion.

title: Sautéed Beef and Lettuce (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 14)
ingredients: 1/4 cup beef stock or 1/4 cup chicken stock | 12 lettuce leaves, preferably baby lettuces, washed ( 12 total )
instructions: Heat stock in a saucepan over medium high heat.  Toast greens in toaster oven.  Place on plate and toss with a splash or two of hot stock.  Serve immediately.  Recipe courtesy of snack snacks snacks snacks dinner by jean christian jury.  Get the book here, https, //www.  Amazon.  Com/45x9ycgfkgn.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,rice vermicelli,salad oil,apricot,broccoli,chickpea flour,avocado,chicken bouillon powder
title: Vegetable Phyllo Roll
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mixed chopped broccoli | 1 cup chickpea flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice vermicelli | 2 cups romaine lettuce, chopped | 2 large ripe avocados, diced | 1/2 cup chopped dried apricot | 1/4 cup salad oil | 3 cups low-fat sesame rice vermicelli
instructions: Place the rice vermicelli in a fine strainer and press through a fine mesh strainer.  Set aside.  In a large bowl, stir together all of the above ingredients.  Set aside.  Place about 1/2 teaspoon of the mixture on the work surface.  Over the filling, roll it up from the long end.  Repeat until all the mixture is used.  Brush the all around the end of the roll with a little oil.  Place them in a well buttered roasting pan, seam side down.  Cover the rolls with plastic wrap and set aside for about an hour or longer.  Preheat the oven to 425°f.  Remove plastic wrap and brush the pastry rolls again with oil.  Place the pans in the preheated oven and bake for about 15 - 20 minutes or until tender.  Remove and set aside on a wire rack.  Serve warm.

title: Chili Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 can chili without beans | 1 dash vanilla essence
instructions: Blend or process mixture until smooth.  Press into a greased and floured pan.  When cold, freeze again.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,orange zest,balsamic vinaigrette,curry powder,rye bread,stewing beef
title: Balsamic Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef, cubed | 3/4 cup balsamic vinaigrette | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 bunch fresh curry leaf, chopped | 1 loaf rye bread
instructions: Place all ingredients except bread into a large bowl.  Add the bread and mix well.  Refrigerate and allow flavors to mingle for at least 24 hours.  Stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,cherry,beef tenderloin,blueberry,red chili powder,seasoning salt
title: Chinese Steak Salad
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, about 2 1/2 thick ( about 3 pounds ) | seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili powder | 1 pint fresh mixed dried cherries or 1 pint canned mixed baby cherries, drained ( 4 cups ) | 1 pint blueberries, washed and dried
instructions: Remove the tenderloin from marinade.  Rinse well, pat dry and cut into 4 pieces.  Place on a rack in a roasting pan and sprinkle with seasoning salt.  Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with red chili powder.  Roast in a 500° oven for 15 minutes, turn and roast for another 15 minutes or until thermometer reads 140°f remove from oven.  Let stand for 10 minutes.  With a fork, poke holes all over the meat.  Place under broiler on high rack.  Broil meat, turning occasionally, for 4 minutes.  Transfer roast to cutting board. title: Garlic Roast Beef
ingredients: 4 -5 pounds beef roast | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 package of croutons | 1 -2 tablespoon garlic-flavored croutons | 1 jar crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Place rack in top third of oven.  Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle ground black pepper to taste.  Insert a meat thermometer into the center of the roast.  Place on a rack in the oven.  Bake at 325 degrees f about 2 hours, or until internal temperature reaches 130 degrees f for rare.  Transfer the roast to a platter, and let rest at least 20 minutes before slicing.

title: Baked Beans Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package quick-cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 20 ounces bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat 9x13 dish with cooking spray.  Heat beans sprouts in microwave for 2 minutes, stirring half way through.  Drain in paper towel.  Spray with cooking spray before continuing.  Mix yeast with 1/2 cup bean sprouts.  Sprinkle yeast on top and top with remaining sprouts.  Bake at 400 f for 20 minutes, or until hot.  Variation, after removing from oven, sprinkle with minced garlic, mushrooms, etc.

title: Roasted Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 tablespoons aged red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon thyme
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.  Cover and allow to come to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat, and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  If the vinegar becomes too thick, stir in a small amount of water, until it reaches the desired consistency.  Note, the wine vinegar does not need to be fully heated, but can be stirred up or down.

title: Tea Bellinis
ingredients: 100 g heirloom tomatoes | 2 ounces tea bags ( you can substitute ordinary teabags )
instructions: Cut heirloom tomatoes into 1'' by 8'' strips.  Sprinkle tea bags or teabags on top of the tomatoes.  Leave to stand for 10 minutes or until tomatoes are softened.  Enjoy.

title: Italian Love Rollups
ingredients: 1 package mozzarella cheese ( cut into squares ) | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | basil ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Spread mozzarella slices evenly on two greased baking sheets.  Sprinkle the 1 teaspoons of liquid smoke on top of cheese.  Sprinkle basil on top and bake at 350 degrees for about 15 - 20 minutes or until cheese is hot and cheese is slightly golden.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,cumin powder,colby monterey jack cheese,hot chili pepper,yellow onion,pomegranate,oreo cooky,sun tomato
title: Stuffed Jalapenos With Pomegranate Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 8 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds | 8 ounces sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/2 cup yellow onion, chopped | 1 small hot chili pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon oregano-flavored cooking spray or 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon white vinegar
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Place cheese on broiler pan.  Spread cheese on cheese and broil 3 - 5 minutes or until top is bubbly and lightly browned.  Meanwhile combine pomegranate seeds and sun dried tomatoes.  Place on a plate, and cover with plastic wrap.  Let sit 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, prepare pesto.  Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.  Add onions, chile peppers, oregano and cooking oil.  Sauté 3 - 5 minutes, or until onion softens slightly.  Remove from heat and add vinegar.  Stir and set aside to cool a little.  When cool enough to handle, remove cheese from the pan and cut in strips.  Pile cheese onto the cheese on an oiled cookie sheet and broil 3 - 5 minutes on each side, or until cheese becomes lightly browned.  If oven continues to run, switch to broil for the last 10 minutes of baking.  To assemble, spread some pesto onto one side of each jalapeno.  Next, remove one jalapeno at a time from the oven.  Top with remaining cheese, and serve.

title: Potato Mushroom Lasagna
ingredients: 8 small red potatoes, peeled | 16 ounces alfredo sauce, store-bought or homemade | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons gherkins, fresh or pickled and finely sliced ( may substitute pickled beetroot )
instructions: Bring a medium sized pot of salted water to the boil.  Add the red potatoes, cook for 10 minutes, drain and immediately return potatoes to the pot.  Add in the alfredo sauce, the cornflour, and the sliced gherkins.  Mix well until everything is combined and the sauce is warmed through.  Allow to sit 10 minutes and serve.

title: Chicken with Vanilla Sauce
ingredients: 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 4 1/4 pounds skinless, bone-in chicken thighs | 1/2 cup marinara sauce for dipping
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.  Place the vanilla bean and the cut side of the vanilla bean into the skillet.  Cook and stir occasionally, constantly scraping the bean and vanilla bean with fingers as the pods roast, about 10 minutes.  Remove vanilla bean from skillet and set aside.  Place thighs in the skillet.  Pour the chicken sauce over the chicken and reduce heat to medium low.  Cook and stir often until the sauce has thickened, about 10 minutes.  Gently stir in the vanilla beans until fragrant, about 2 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Beef Bowl With Dressing
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin steaks | 1 cup fat-free beef flavored dressing
instructions: Trim all visible fat from steak and cut into serving size pieces.  Place the beef and dressing in a resealable plastic bag.  Seal bag.  Refrigerate overnight, turning bag once.  On a preheated hot grill, discard marinade.  Place bag onto hot grill and cook 3 minutes per side or to desired doneness.

title: Szechuan Chicken Cottage Chicken
ingredients: 2 ounces cashews | 1 whole head cauliflower, cut into pieces | 1 can beef gravy | 1 jar apricot preserves | 2 cups cooked chicken, shredded | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns, or more to taste
instructions: Place cashews into a skillet, and toast until fragrant, about 2 minutes.  Drain cashews on paper towels, and set aside.  Place cauliflower in a large pot, and cover with water.  Bring to a boil over high heat.  When cauliflower is boiling, cover, and simmer over low heat until cauliflower is tender and easily pierced with the tip of a sharp knife, about 20 minutes.  Drain, and place into a bowl.  Place beef gravy into a separate large pot, and warm over low heat.  When hot, mix in the apricot preserves.  When sauce is warm, stir in cashews, cauliflower, and raisins.  Heat through, and serve hot as an hors d'oeuvre for rice and noodles.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,cooking oil,panko bread crumb,yukon gold potato,rice noodle,puff pastry
title: Quick and Easy Potato Rolls
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | cooking oil for frying | 3 medium yukon gold potatoes, sliced | 1 1/4 tablespoons rice noodles ( dry, such as nishiki ) | 1 1/4 tablespoons panko bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place frozen puff pastry sheets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Cover on baking sheet with a clean cloth towel, and press a piece of aluminum foil over the sheets to dry them.  Allow pastry to rest in refrigerator while preparing potato filling.  Place potato slices in a large pot, and cover with water.  Bring to a boil, and cook for about 20 minutes, then drain.  When potatoes are cool enough to handle, peel off potato skins or chop them.  In a medium bowl, mix together the rice noodles, panko, and lemon juice.  Set aside.  Place the sheets of parchment paper on a sheet of aluminum foil.  With a pastry brush, brush pastry with oil.  Place about 2 tablespoons of the potato filling in the center of each sheet, and roll up.  Seal by laying a toothpick through the center.  Repeat with remaining pastry and filling.  Place potato rolls into a large baking dish, and brush with oil.  Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

title: Simple Oat and Crunchy Macquechow
ingredients: 3/4 cup rolled oats | 1 cup cornflour | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 2 tablespoons hot sauce ( i use sombel tabasco ) | 2 -3 tablespoons pasta, cooked
instructions: Stir oats, cornflour, sugar and pepper sauce in a small bowl with your hand until well combined.  Cook pasta in a saucepan of boiling salted water, stirring constantly until just tender.  Drain and divide among serving bowls.  Spoon topping over warm.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,olive oil cooking spray,red curry paste,corn tortilla,raisin,turkey,guacamole
title: Beef and Turkey Tacos
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 lb ground turkey | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper | 1 package corn tortillas | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Coat a non stick skillet with cooking spray and set over medium high heat.  Add turkey and raisins.  Cook for a few seconds to start the liquid and add all the curry paste and cayenne pepper.  Cook, stirring, until turkey is evenly browned and raisins are hot to the touch.  Wear a heavy skillet of your favorite fashion spray with olive oil spray.  Heat the pan until the pan is quite hot, about 2 minutes.  Quickly add the tortillas so they form a flat circle.  About 1/2 inch thick.  Place the tortillas on the flat top of the skillet, about 1 minute per side.  Remove the skillet from heat and place on a large serving plate.  Add some guacamole and spread on top of the tortillas.  Serve with your favorite toppings.

title: Yoghurt Crunch
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 1/3 cup icing sugar, sifted
instructions: To make icing you can use a coffee spoon or your favourite icing sugar or cream cheese.  Mix yoghurt in bowl.  Add icing sugar.  Beat well until thick and creamy.  Serve with ice cream or fresh fruit.  Makes about 8 cups depending on how much icing you add.

title: Roasted Poblano Chile
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, roasted | 2 oranges, peeled and thinly sliced into round rings | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Arrange poblano chiles on a small baking sheet, drizzle generously with olive oil, and drizzle with aniseed orange slices.  Sprinkle with snipped fresh chives.  Bake for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,beef brisket,jalapeno chile,milk,pimiento,pork loin roast,rice noodle
title: Mexican Beef and Pork Loose
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 2 lbs lean boneless pork loin roast | 2 -3 jalapeno chiles, stems removed | 6 tablespoons finely chopped pimiento | 2 cups dry rice noodles | 1/2 cup milk | 2 -3 sage leaves
instructions: Cut the brisket in half, and leave the pieces intact.  Trim any excess fat.  Cut the meat in to 1/2 inch cubes.  In a large plastic bag, mix the meat with the chiles, pimientos, and noodles.  Refrigerate, covered, for at least 2 hours.  Remove meat from the marinade, drain, and reserve.  Skim any fat that rises to the top, and discard.  Reserve the marinade.  Place meat in a roasting pan, and set aside.  Reserve marinade.  Cover the pan with tin foil, and roast at 160°f for 2 hours or until the meat is tender when pierced with a sharp knife.  Remove from oven, and let rest for 10 minutes.  While the meat is resting, make the sauce, in a blender, or food processor, puree the reserved marinade with 2 to 3 tablespoons water to make a syrupy sauce.  Heat remaining marinade in a skillet, and add chopped sage.  Bring to a boil.  Place the sauce in a saucepan, and stir in the sauce.  Return to a boil, and cook about 3 to 5 minutes.  Adjust seasoning.  Slice the meat, and serve it with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,tamarind paste,taco seasoning mix,red onion,pickle juice,jalapeno pepper,chickpea,beef brisket
title: Santa Fe Style Beef Brisket
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef brisket, trimmed | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 4 red onions, cut into wedges | 2 jalapeno peppers, thinly sliced ( i use 2 large ones ) | 1/3 cup pickle juice | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 package taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Combine the first eight ingredients in a 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 quart slow cooker.  Cover, and cook for 3 1/2 hours.  Stir in tamarind paste.  Cover and cook for an additional 1 hour.  Remove from heat and stir in taco seasoning.  Cool to room temperature.  Spoon brisket onto a serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,plum tomato,baking soda,maraschino cherry,coriander leaf,vegetable stock base,oxtail
title: Savoury Oxtail Soup
ingredients: 500 g oxtails | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock base | 2 tablespoons cream of chicken soup ( optional ) | 2 plum tomatoes, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander leaves or 2 tablespoons cilantro | 2 maraschino cherries, drained and split lengthways
instructions: Trim the tail end of the oxtail and trim the tail fins.  Cut them into 2 inch chunks.  If you have a sharp knife, remove the tip of one third of the bone.  Cut the tail bones into 5 inch pieces.  Combine the baking soda and vegetable stock base in a medium bowl.  Cut the oxtail pieces in half and coat them in the mixture.  Add the oxtails, making sure they are thoroughly coated.  Cover and set aside whilst you continue to cook the soup, toasting the tomatoes.  When you are ready to serve, add the tomatoes to the soup pot along with the coriander and the cherry.

title: Asian Grilled Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs top sirloin, thinly sliced | 1 head spring onion, thinly sliced | 1 large head green cabbage, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat grill to high heat.  Brush beef with the half hour of oil, grill for 3 - 5 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking.  Cut beef into strips about 1 inch by 1/2 inch wide and 3 to 4 inches long.  Combine sliced spring onions and cabbage and divide between 3 plates.  Top with the sliced beef and the cooked onions and cabbage.  Serve with some green salad and a hot red chili sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: rosarita traditional bean,ginger paste,dark brown sugar
title: Roasted Beans
ingredients: 1 can rosarita traditional baked beans | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1/2 teaspoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Combine all ingredients and heat in small saucepan over medium heat for about 5 minutes.  Serve.  Makes enough for 3 - 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,dark chocolate,garlic powder,yellow pepper,lettuce,hot red pepper flake,chickpea,superfine sugar
title: Slicing Hot Chocolate Salad
ingredients: 2 cups lettuce, torn into smaller bite sized chunks | 1/2 small hot red pepper, seeded and finely chopped ( i only use 1-3, so i get lots! ) | 4 teaspoons super fine sugar | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese, freshly grated | 1 medium yellow pepper, seeded and cubed | 2 tablespoons chickpeas, drained | 1 teaspoon dark chocolate, chopped | 1 drop hot red pepper flakes
instructions: Place the lettuce into a salad bowl.  Pour boiling water over the veggies to wilt and soak for 5 minutes, or until cool.  Drain and place in a serving bowl.  Add the chiles, sugar, garlic powder, cheese and seasoning.  Serve with a drizzle of chocolate and drizzle of red pepper flakes for a lovely presentation.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,romano cheese,pineapple juice,veal,chicken breast fillet
title: Easy Baked Pork Schnitzel
ingredients: 6 pork tenderloin or 6 pork schnitzels | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 cup freshly grated romano cheese or 1 cup parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 cups fresh pineapple juice or 1 1/2 cups apple juice | 1 1/2 lbs veal, strips cut into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Slice tenderloins or pork schnitzels into thin strips about 1 1/2 inch wide and about 1/8 inch thick.  Spray large baking dish with nonstick spray and arrange meat strips on the dish.  Toss with baking powder.  Spread cheese and pineapple juice evenly over meat and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until meat is well browned on the outside and cooked through.  Let stand for 5 minutes.  Remove beef from dish and serve with slices of veal.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,serrano chili pepper,ladyfinger,crisco,plain yogurt,egg yolk,sherry wine
title: Hot Spicy Tiramisu
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 2 teaspoons sherry wine | 1 large egg yolk | 24 ladyfingers | 1 -2 tablespoon crisco, melted ( or other vegetable oil ) | 2 serrano chili peppers, minced | 1 1/2 cups chopped ripe bamboo skewers
instructions: In a bowl, combine yogurt, sherry, egg yolk and 1 teaspoon salt.  Place ladyfingers in a glass baking dish and brush with 3 tablespoons crisco.  Brush generously with remaining crisco.  Bake, covered with plastic wrap, in a 350 degree oven until browned, 7 to 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and set aside.  Heat remaining crisco in a small skillet over medium high heat.  Sauté chili and chiles until fragrant and softened, about 1 minute.  Remove from heat and stir in reserved yogurt mixture.  Layer cooled ladyfingers with yogurt mixture.  Sprinkle on chili and chiles.  Top with remaining fried ladyfingers and drizzle with remaining 1 teaspoon of crisco.  Bake in a 350 degree oven for 10 minutes, until golden brown.  Sauce can be made ahead and kept in the refridgerator, covered with plastic wrap, for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,grand marnier,single cream,penne,taco seasoning mix
title: Tacos With the Seasoned Penne
ingredients: 400 g penne | 1/2 cup single cream ( pouring consistency of whipping cream in a jar ) | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 2 small cardamom pods ( crushed ) | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Cook pasta al dente.  Reserve pasta water.  Drain pasta, mix reserved pasta water, cream, seasoning and cardamon until smooth.  Place a little pasta water just so that it coats the back of spoon.  Place pasta in saucer and top with sauce.  Serve immediately. .

title: Coconut-Oamc -- Easy French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  In a 12 inch saute pan or ovenproof skillet, heat oil over medium.  Add bread slices, coating all sides with oil.  Spray with non stick cooking spray, turn and brown on all sides.  Drain excess oil from pan, remove french bread and place bread on cookie sheet.  Bake 8 - 10 minutes or until bread is crispy.  Serve warm.

title: Rice With Daikon and Lamb
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 4 lbs daikon radishes, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces ( about 3 ) | 2 cups rice ( preferably jasmine ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine or 1 1/2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Place lamb in a deep dish and sprinkle with salt.  Cover with water and refrigerate, turning once, for 4 hours or overnight.  Add daikon and stir.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Drain.  Cover with water and refrigerate for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Meanwhile, in a medium skillet, bring 3 cups water to a boil.  Add rice and stir.  Return lamb and any accumulated juices to skillet.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer until daikon is tender, about 1 hour 15 minutes.  Add rice and mix.  Serve hot.

title: Beef and Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 cup canned cannellini beans | 1 teaspoon pepperoni, crushed | 1 lb sirloin
instructions: Brown meat well in a skillet.  Add cans of cannellini beans with liquid.  Bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer on medium heat for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Cut meat into bite size pieces, serve on top of stew.

Random Ingredients: red bean paste,beef brisket,cayenne,cream chicken soup,taco seasoning,grape tomato
title: Red Bean Fiesta
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed of excess fat | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 cans red beans paste | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 11 grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat grill.  Prepare brisket on grill.  Place brisket on grill rack coated with cooking spray.  Cook for 3 hours, until tender.  Remove from grill.  Remove meat from bones and discard.  Shred meat using two forks.  Return meat to bones and season with taco seasoning.  In a saucepan combine soup, red beans paste, cayenne, and tomatoes.  Bring to a boil.  Remove from heat and serve over meat.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,mini chocolate chip,blue cheese,arborio rice,beef chuck,chipotle chile,chervil,vegetable stock
title: Chipotle Risotto Stuffed Peppers With Garlic and Cheese
ingredients: 225 g arborio rice or 225 g valenciano cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons garlic and herb stock | 225 g beef chuck ( trimmed and sliced thinly across the grain ) | 225 g mini chocolate chips ( roughly chopped ) | 1/2 cup of diced small chervil | 1 tablespoon of chopped chipotle chile | 50 g blue cheese
instructions: Place 1 tablespoon of rice into a frying pan with a small splash of cooking oil and cook the rice until the rice begins to give off a little of the oil.  Add the beef in batches that will fit into your straight straight sided steamer basket and cook over medium heat.  Cook for 3 minutes each side or until browned, turning and adding more oil as necessary.  Transfer the risotto to a plate and set aside.  Pour the rest of the oil into the frying pan and cook the sliced beef quickly, removing it to a plate.  Add the rest of the ingredients, except for the cheese, to the pan and toss briefly, season with salt and pepper and add the cheese.  Stir in with the beef to warm through.  Serve sprinkled with the chervil and crumbled cheese.

title: Fig and Cashew Nuts
ingredients:
6 large dried figs, quartered ( about 1 lb.
    - total ) | 1/4 cup cashew nuts, chopped
instructions: Wrap figs tightly in plastic wrap.  Soak 10 minutes in cool water.

title: Green Kale Salad
ingredients: 10 leaves kale | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 teaspoons salad oil | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Cook the kale in boiling water for 5 minutes and refresh under cold water.  Combine all ingredients and serve over greens.

Random Ingredients: turkey meat,seasoning salt,fontina cheese,cool whip lite,field mushroom,green pepper,dill
title: Microwave Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 36 field mushroom | 1 cup finely chopped green pepper | 1 cup finely chopped sweet red peppers or 1 cup finely chopped yellow pepper | 1 - 1 1/3 cup fontina cheese, grated | 1/3 cup cool whip lite | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill, for garnish
instructions: Open and remove mushroom stems.  Cut off top 1 inch of mushroom cap.  Remove 1 - 2 teaspoons of filling from cap and discard.  Set mushroom caps aside.  Stuff each mushroom cap with approximately 1/4 cup fontina cheese, a generous amount of green pepper, and another 1/4 cup of sweet red and yellow peppers if desired.  Fold top and bottom of the mushroom caps over the filling, making a well in the center, and secure ends with toothpicks.  In a small dish, whisk together cool whip and salt.  Spread half of this mixture evenly in the bottom of a 5 quart casserole dish.  Layer stuffed mushrooms over the cool whip mixture.  Continue with remaining filling and mushroom tops, ending with the melted cheese.  Cover with foil, venting ends, and microwave for 1 minute.  Remove toothpicks if desired.

title: Lamb and Pistachio Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 600 g lean lamb fillets, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can pitted ripe olives, in olive oil, drained | 1/4 cup toasted pistachio nut, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1/4 cup loosely-packed chopped unsalted pistachio nuts | 2 cups cooked quinoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 230°c.

title: Pepperoni Sandwiches for 2
ingredients: 1 medium tomatoes, diced | 2 teaspoons anise seed | 1 tablespoon fresh minced ginger powder | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 teaspoons dry minced onions | 1/2 teaspoon chopped canned peach | 2 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: On a platter, mix together the tomato, the anise seeds, the ginger, garlic salt, onion, and peach.  Drizzle the amaretto over the mixture to coat.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Ginger Pizzas
ingredients: 1 lb pasta sauce | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger powder | 1 dash onion salt | 1 dash dried tarragon ( or basil ) | 2 lbs frozen grilled mini kielbasa ( or 2 lbs fresh ) | 1/2 cup dry sherry
instructions: Heat a large frying pan over medium heat and add the 1oz of pasta sauce.  Add the ginger powder and onion salt and stir to mix well.  When it begins to pop, add the tarragon and cook for a few minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Cut kielbasa into 1/4 inch cubes and set aside.  Using tongs, add one slice of kielbasa to the frying pan of sauce and fry for about 2 - 3 minutes, just until the kielbasa is slightly crisp on the outside and no longer translucent on the inside.  Pour the remaining sauce into the frying pan and stir to mix well.  Bring sauce to a boil and then reduce heat to a good low, low simmer.  Place the kielbasa cubes in the sauce and allow to heat through.  Serve immediately.

title: Cambodian Potato Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, cut into chunks | 1 red onion, chopped | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 pinch curry powder | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 teaspoon rose water | 30 large basil leaves
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss potatoes and onion with vodka.  Stir in curry powder, brandy and rose water.  Chill until ready to serve.

title: Southwest Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 bunch green olives or 1/2 bunch pimento stuffed olive, sliced | 1 small yellow squash, cut into chunks ( or 1 medium squash, if you prefer ) | 1 small onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped spring onions | 2 tablespoons caster sugar or 2 tablespoons light muscovado sugar ( if preferred ) | 1 ounce sachet taco seasoning mix | 7 ounces rigatoni pasta or 7 ounces pasta
instructions: Heat about half of the oil in a frying pan.  Cook/drain the pasta, reserving some liquid to make sauce.  Place all the vegetables, the olives, spring onions, sugar and seasoning in a large bowl and mix well.  When finished drain pasta well, place back in pan and toss with pasta sauce, mix well and then serve right away.

title: Strawberry Trifle
ingredients: 4 cups rice | 40 g pancetta, crumbled | 200 g fresh shiitake mushrooms, quartered | 100 g dried apricots | 200 ml strawberry liqueur or 200 ml apricot-flavored liqueur | 400 g fresh strawberries, hulled | 150 g plain yogurt | lite olive oil, for drizzling
instructions: Cook rice according to packet directions.  Set aside to cool.  Meanwhile, heat oil in pan, fry pancetta until golden and crunchy.  Set aside.  Add shiitakes and fry for 3 - 4 minutes, or until golden, then add mushrooms, then fry for 2 - 3 minutes, or until mushrooms have been softened.  Add apricots and strawberry liqueur, reduce heat to low and allow to cook for 5 - 10 minutes, depending on the thickness of the apricots.  Add rice, stir until well mixed.  Add strawberries to top, drizzle with olive oil and serve immediately.

title: Filipino Beef (Noodles)

instructions: Cook noodles until al dente, drain and set aside.  Heat beef drippings on high in a skillet.  Drain and set aside.  Put beef in another skillet and add all the rest of the ingredients and cook till brown.  Add noodles and mix.  Serve.

title: Mahogany's Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 2 cups tahini | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 cup minced white cabbage | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup chopped dates | 4 chicken thighs | 1/2 cup chopped button mushrooms | 6 ounces white cabbage, rinsed and shredded

ingredients: 3 fresh poblano chiles | 2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 1/2 cups walnut halves | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 orange, juice and zest of, grated | 12 ounces cream cheese | 1/2 cup shredded basil leaves | 2 1/4 lbs center-cut beef tenderloin, cut into bite-size pieces
instructions: Heat broiler.  Place poblanos about 4 inches from the heat.  Broil 6 minutes, turning once, until golden brown on both sides and just cooked through. In a food processor, combine remaining 3 chiles with the walnuts.  Add nuts and pecan mixture to pan and sauté 1 minute, until fragrant.  Add cream cheese and basil and fold until heated through. title:
St.
    - Paul Shrimp Bread
ingredients: 10 ounces medium shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 3/4 cups soya sauce | 4 1/2 tablespoons fast rising yeast | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: If using raw shrimp, rinse under cold water for five minutes, then rinse with cold water and pat dry. instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, orange juice, coriander, and cardamom pods.  Spoon into serving bowls, and top with the olives.  Chill for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,self raising flour,vanilla yogurt,parsnip,dark brown sugar,basil,dark rum
title: Shiitake Fritters
ingredients: 500 g dried shiitake mushrooms | 2 parsnips, peeled & sliced | 1 tablespoon dark rum or 1 teaspoon cognac | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 2 teaspoons dried basil | 2 teaspoons self-raising flour, sifted | 1 teaspoon vanilla yogurt, mixed with sugar | chopped fresh basil, to garnish
instructions: Soak shitake mushrooms in boiling water for 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook parsnips until tender, drain& set aside.  Remove the stems from the mushrooms& chop caps.  Place caps, rum, basil& rinds in a small skillet.  Cook over low heat for 4 - 6 minutes, until liquid is reduced by half pour the soured mixture into the pan& stir.  Remove& serve in a shallow bowl garnished with finely snipped basil.

title: Butterscotch Chip Nuts
ingredients: 5 tablespoons butter, melted ( no subs! ) | 2 cups of roughly crushed butterscotch chips ( optional ) | 1 long hot red pepper flakes ( optional, for spicier nuts use 4-6 long flakes, crushed slightly ) ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. .  Spoon into a buttered 9 x 13 glass pan and smooth out the top slightly.  Allow to get to room temperature and set, covered, for at least 2 hours before serving.  This is great on crackers, as they can be very chewy if left in whole.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,bean,cocoa powder,tarragon,half,dark chocolate,chunky salsa,golden raisin
title: Baked Kollandaise
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 cup golden raisins | 14 ounces fat-free refried beans | 14 ounces low-fat chunky salsa | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 1/3 cup kalamata olives ( pitted and sliced or sliced ) | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, minced | dark chocolate, grated ( or cocoa powder )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°f coat the inside of a baking dish with the cocoa powder, and then line it with aluminum foil.  In a bowl, toss the raisins with their soaking liquid and let drain before pressing with the side of a spoon.  In a bowl, stir the refried beans with chunky salsa, half and half, and olives.  Spread the bean mixture over half of the dish, and sprinkle the spiced raisins over.  Bake for 15 minutes and top with grated chocolate.  Leave it to cool a bit before cutting.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white fish,kahlua,chicken liver,apricot,green bell pepper,black sesame seed
title: Black Sesame-Apricot and Chicken Liver Pate
ingredients: 1/3 pound fresh chicken livers, finely chopped | 1/3 pound white fish, firm, skinned, deveined and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/3 cup pitted dried apricots, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon kahlua | 1 tablespoon black sesame seeds, freshly toasted
instructions: Place chicken meat, fish, apricots, bell pepper, kahlua, and sesame seeds in a blender container, add a little water if desired — and process to a smooth but chunky mixture.  Transfer mixture to an impeccably clean bowl, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before using, up to 2 days, then freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Blueberry Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup fresh blueberries or 1 cup frozen blueberries | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 3 tablespoons dried hazelnuts
instructions: Put blueberries, celery and hazelnuts on a cookie sheet and toast in a 350 degree oven for 10 minutes.  Spread on a buttered or floured piece of bread and top with crumbs.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,chili powder,wonton wrapper,crescent,pork shoulder,poblano chile,mussel,snow pea
title: Saucy Pork Empanadas
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | poblano chile | 1/2 cup red currant jelly | 8 dried mussels, scrubbed and debearded | 1 pound boneless pork shoulder, cubed | 1 jar red currant jelly | 3 teaspoons chili powder | 1 bunch snow peas, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Arrange 4 won ton wrappers on a baking sheet.  Brush each wonton wrapper with 1 tablespoon of red currant jelly.  Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Scoop filling into poblano chile shells, being careful not to leave too close to the filling.  Repeat process with remaining wrappers, jelly, mussels and pork.

title: Okinawa Minado (Fish head and tentacles)
ingredients: 2 sheets konbu kelp | 3 -5 small squid, sliced | 3 -5 -5 large carrots, grated | 16 -18 fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Soak the konbu for 1 - 3 hours, changing the water every 24 hours.  Soak the squid for 4 - 6 hours.  If using bamboo steamer, you can use it later to cook the water.  Start the water boiling away and allow it to boil for 20 minute drain the konbu and discard.  Slice the konbu thinly into rings about 3 pieces each.  Add carrot slices to konbu and cook for 3 minutes.  When done, add bean sprouts to konbu and mix.  If you wish, cut the fish head into 2 large pieces.  Heat some oil in kokchuka pan.  Add the small pieces of fish into oil and toss with some konbu oil, tossing to coat it with the oil.  After a few minutes, add remaining konbu and mix, cooking only until you achieve the desired browning.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,jalapeno pepper,romaine lettuce,cannellini bean,reynolds wrap foil,red wine vinegar,red cabbage,pizza dough
title: Spicy Bacon Pizza
ingredients: 1 rreynolds wrap foil | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 4 slices bacon, trimmed, chopped | 1/2 cup red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup shredded red cabbage | 1 jalapeno pepper, minced | 2 teaspoons orange zest | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 packages pillsbury refrigerated pizza dough
instructions: Heat 1 strip of reynolds wrap foil on the grill.  Spray with cooking spray.  Add cannellini beans and bacon.  Cook 1 - 2 minutes to warm and bacon heated through.  Stir in red cabbage, red cabbage, jalapeno pepper, and orange zest.  Remove from heat.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Stretch each puff dough on a lightly floured work surface.  Spread each dough with some of the sauce and beans mixture.  Top each with a small amount of the cooked bacon, sausage, cheese or other toppings.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder roast,basil,spinach leaf,spice,tequila,dijon mustard,coffee,beef tenderloin
title: Cafe Rio Spiced Soft Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dry instant coffee | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef tenderloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder roast, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs fresh spinach leaves, washed, trimmed and torn into bite size pieces | 12 fresh basil, stems removed | 9 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/4 cup tequila | 2 -3 teaspoons mixed spice
instructions: In a medium bowl add the instant coffee and stir well.  Add beef and pork.

title: My Favorite Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup dark raisin ( i had craisins that i made with )
instructions: Mix everything and marinate 24 hours.  Broil or grill.
