title: Spicy Roasted Eggplant
ingredients: 2 large yellow bell peppers | 3 large eggplants | 3 plum tomatoes | 2 cups szechwan pepper | 1 tablespoon sherry wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 6 black cardamom pods | 12 ounces egg noodles, cooked | 2 tablespoons premium szechwan pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f cut a slit in the side of each eggplant.  Cut peel off, remove eggplants, place in a roasting pan, and cut the ends away at the top.  Roast eggplants for 1 hour or until tender, turning once or twice.

title: Brie and Beer Encrusted Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts | 1/3 cup grill seasoning | 1/4 cup beer | 10 slices brie cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f.  Place chicken in a 9x13 inch dish.  Combine grill seasoning and beer.  Pour over chicken, turning chicken to coat.  Bake until done, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pizza dough,habanero pepper,self raising flour,romaine lettuce,garlic powder,purple onion,madeira wine,meat
title: Homemade Tortilla Fritters
ingredients: 1 pizza dough, thawed ( use 1-1/2 tsp if making your own ) | 250 g finely chopped romaine lettuce | 2 -3 roma sweet pizza dough | 1 large purple onion, finely chopped | 1 lb finely diced cooked meat | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 2 teaspoons dried aniseed or 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seed | 1/4 cup madeira wine ( or red grape juice )
instructions: First you need to prepare your tortillas, roll out each ball of dough and place on a lightly floured baking sheet and chill for approximately 30 minutes.  Then cut each ball into approximately 16 pieces.  In a bowl large enough to accommodate all your ingredients, toss the onions, ground meats, garlic powder, and dried anise or seeds with your hands, mix together the onion mixture and prepared fritters thoroughly.  Lay out approximately 10 fritters on the hot baking sheet.  Spoon 1/3 of onion/meat mixture in the middle of each fritter, fold the fritters over and flatten the edges by moving your hand in and tucking them underneath.  Bake in a moderate, 325 degree oven until browned on top.

title: Harissa
ingredients: 1/4 cup rose water or 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup lemon zest | 1 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Put the rose water or wine, lemon zest, and caraway seeds into a small bowl and pour into the glass jar with the caraway seeds.  Close the lid and shake vigorously until the oil has settled on the top of the drink.  Let stand a few hours at room temperature, shaking the jar once a day, until the oil has absorbed most of the liquid.

title: Quick and Easy Green Chili Chicken
ingredients: 4 -5 chicken strips | 1 can chopped green chili ( hot if you like the heat )
instructions: Brown chicken a little and set aside.  While browning chicken add green chili stir fry about 5 minutes until browned and hot.  Put chicken into crock pot and pour green chili on top.  Cook on low for two hours.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,pimiento,white flour,pork tenderloin,mango chutney,clear honey
title: Garlicky Pork Tenderloin With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 450 g pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 50 g white flour, seasoned with salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mango chutney | 1/2 cup chopped fresh pimientos
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c.  Line an oven tray with foil.  Place the pork cutlets under the skin of the tenderloin.  Spread a large spoonful of clear honey on each side of the pork.  Wrap the foil around the pork, ensuring that the honey covers it evenly.  In a small bowl, combine the flour, rosemary leaves and mango chutney.  Season with salt and pepper.  Using a skewer, gently slash each side of the pork until the honey runs out.  Place the pork in the middle of the oven and cook for 15 minutes.  Reduce the temperature to 150°c and continue cooking for an additional 15 minutes until very tender.  Transfer the pork to a carving board and cut into thin medallions, about 1cm thick and 3 4cm wide.  Serve.

title: Sooji
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 2 -3 red chiles | 1 medium red capsicum ( capsicum sliced thinly )
instructions: Rinse and drain the asafoetida mixture.  Grind the peppercorns with cardamom, chillies and the red pepper.

title: Apricot and Cherry Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup chopped dried apricot | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 8 burrito-size flour tortillas | 8 nori, sheets | 8 maraschino cherries
instructions: Combine apricots, pimentos and tortillas and mix well.  Fill each tortilla with a spoonful of apricot mixture.  Wrap burrito style and pinch shut with two toothpicks, secure with toothpicks.  Arrange burritos on a baking sheet, brush tops of tortillas with a small amount of oil, bake in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes.  Serve with desired condiments.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,barley,grenadine,turmeric powder,cake flour,lime juice,parsnip,vanilla pudding mix
title: Caribbean Parsnip Fritters
ingredients: 4 poblano peppers, chopped | 4 parsnips, chopped | 1/2 lb cake flour | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 2 ounces instant vanilla pudding mix | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/4 cup pearl barley | grenadine
instructions: In a medium bowl with a wire whisk or a mixer beat the flour until it starts to turn into pale yellow in color.  Then with a spatula with kitchen shears start mashing the flour, and continue to mix.  Add turmeric, mix.  Add poblano and parsnips.  Add vanilla pudding and lime juice, and mix.  Let it cool a few minutes.  While the dough mixture is cooling mix the pearl barley with a few splashes of grenadine to make a slurry, this is optional, but it adds great flavor.  Heat a bit of grapeseed oil in a frying pan.  Drop the fritters into the oil and fry them, flipping once, until they are crisp on both sides, but have the desired crispiness.  It will keep a little for a few days in the fridge, but i like mine crispy crispy on the outside and slightly more crunch.  After frying they should be a bit crispy and brown in color.

title: Steak Au Poivre (Steak in Cream Sauce)
ingredients: 4 large stewing beef, such as sirloin | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce double cream, heated until steaming hot ( see my note ) | pepper, ground ( see my note )
instructions: If the meat is thick, you may need to make a slit in the thickest part of the steak after marinating.  If you’d like your sauce a little spicier, just pour over the meat in a sealed glass bowl, or in a sealable baking container for the gravy.  Sprinkle the meat with all but a thin coating of cumin.  Pour in the warm cream. .  Sprinkle with pepper.  Let it marinate at room temperature for at least 2 hours or the chilled meat may be steamed or fried right away.  Serve with crusty bread with a side dish such as steamed vegetables.  It’s good either way, though the meat loses its specialtyness in time to allow for a richer gravy.

title: Green Pea Gujarati With Pear Chutney
ingredients: 2 medium green peas ( green prawns ) | 2 large firm ripe pears | 2 dried thai chiles or 2 jalapeno chiles, to taste
instructions: Wash and steam the peas or prawns for 2 to 3 minutes, or until they are bright pink.  Cut the pears into slices, then thinly slice.  Peel the chile, then cut into thin slices.  Heat the oil in a skillet, pour in the sliced chile, then stir in the peas, prawns, and chile.  Reduce the heat to a low simmer, and cook, stirring, for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the peas are tender and the prawns have gone opaque.  Season with salt and pepper, then serve straight away, or let cool.  Garnish with a fresh sprig of mint if desired.

Random Ingredients: burrito flour tortilla,cashew,pineapple juice,swiss cheese,tarragon vinegar,beef rib,tarragon
title: Quick and Easy Beef Rib Fajitas
ingredients: 1/2 cup cashews ( raw or salted ) | 1/8 cup tarragon vinegar | 7 ounces beef short ribs | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 8 burrito-size flour tortillas | 2 cups swiss cheese ( shredded ) | 1 teaspoon tarragon ( dried )
instructions: Preheat griddle.  Toast the cashews and vinegar in a small pan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown.  Cut beef into thin strips.

title: Green Chili Chicken and Raspberry Soup
ingredients: 2 cups sliced chicken | 1 cup chopped leek ( green onion ) | 1/2 cup chopped green chili pepper, deseeded | 2 cups raspberries, frozen and thawed | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer gently for 20 minutes.  Ladle into serving bowls and garnish with extra grated nuts.

Random Ingredients: onion,rice wine vinegar,pecorino cheese,gorgonzola,juniper berry,cayenne pepper,sherry wine,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke and Gorgonzola Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 2 packages store bought frozen artichoke hearts, defrosted if necessary for at least 2 hours or thawed and drained well, reserving liquid | 1/2 cup grated pecorino cheese, packed | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 3 -5 slices fresh gorgonzola or 3 -5 slices other hard white cheese | 2 -3 juniper berries | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Prepare the dressing, combine sherry and vinegar in a small bowl and add 1/4 cup of the artichoke liquid and set aside.  Drain the artichoke hearts well and coarsely chop the hearts.  Put the artichoke hearts and gorgonzola into a large salad bowl.  Add chopped onion, sauteed gorgonzola, and remaining artichoke liquid.  Stir in reserved artichoke liquid and juniper berries.  Garnish with cayenne pepper and the remaining 1/4 cup artichoke heart.  Note, you may substitute hard or med grade cheese for the gorgonzola.  You may add more minced onion or cayenne pepper or parsley or garlic powder if desired but not as authentic as most commercial gorgonzola has a high acidity.

title: Teriyaki Marinade for Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup snipped fresh chives | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the teriyaki sauce, ginger, cilantro, chives, and lime wedges.  Place the chicken in the marinade, cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before cooking.  Preheat the grill for high heat.  Place the chicken on the grill, and frequently turn and baste with the marinade until tender and done to your liking.  Cook until no longer pink in the center, 5 to 10 minutes.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh, near the bone should read at least 145 degrees f.  Serve with the lime wedges.

title: Quick and Easy Raspberry Salad
ingredients: 2 cups raspberries, frozen and thawed | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon chickpea flour | 1/4 cup yellow onion, minced | 1 tablespoon bacon, cooked and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh raspberry juice, from cooked and drained bacon
instructions: Place raspberries, preserves, chili fiesta and chickpea flour in bowl.

title: Cajun Sausage and Pasta
ingredients: 2 pounds spaghetti | 2 tablespoons spanish olive oil | 1 pound salami, sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.

title: Coconut Salted Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh beans, snapped in half crosswise | 3 tablespoons coconut rum ( sweetened to taste ) | 6 serrano chilies ( small fresh chiles ) | 4 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste, grated
instructions: Place beans in a pot of boiling salted water.  Cook 2 minutes, stir, remove and discard any that do not soften.  While still warm, drain beans.  Stir in rum, chiles and garlic.  Heat through.

title: Kiwifruit Jelly (Kefal)
ingredients: 1 lb kiwi fruit, peeled | 1 cup vanilla sugar or 2 cups fruit puree | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 habanero pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon vanilla puree | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Cut kiwifruit in small pieces, and boil in salted water about 5 minutes, or until soft drain, put in a large pan with the vanilla sugar or sugar.  Set over moderate heat and fry until golden brown and jam forms.  Add the vanilla and habanero, then leave to cool.  Pour the jelly into sterilized jars to within 1 cm of the top and seal with lids.

title: Breaded Garlic Steak Sandwich With Oregano
ingredients: 4 slices stale bread or 4 slices rye bread | 24 garlic cloves, thinly sliced ( from about 2 3 oz/1 pound loaf ) | 6 fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or other high heat source.  Place the bread on the grill or in a medium oven proof sandwich roll.  Cut the slices of garlic into 12 thin slices.  Toast the bread lightly over high heat until just soft and light yellow in color, about 4 minutes on each side.  Remove the toast from the grill, sprinkle with oregano and top with the garlic slices.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,orange zest,masa harina,white mushroom,cornflour
title: Corn Tortilla Con Crema (Taquitos)
ingredients: 250 g white mushrooms, sliced | 150 g cornflour | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 orange, zest of | 1/2 teaspoon instant masa harina
instructions: In a saucepan, sprinkle 1/8 cup water on the bottom of the pan, place a lid on, let it boil.  Once water is boiling, add 1/4 cup more of the water to the corn flour.  While stirring, add 1/4 cup more of the corn flour to the cream of chicken soup.  The idea is to not get lumps or to break up the chicken.  As the saucepan is heating, pour the soup into a bowl and start adding 1/4 cup more of water to the soup.  Once the water becomes luke warm to the bone, add the corn flour mix to bowl of soup mixture and mix well.  After the soup has been heating for about 10 minutes, remove the lid from the pan.  Use a spoon to drop and stir mixture into the boiling soup.  Add 1/2 tsp instant masa harina on soup and mix well.  Continue cooking for 20 - 25 minutes.  Serve with tortillas.

title: Okra Pulao
ingredients: 1 pound okra, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons melted ghee
instructions: Place okra, cilantro, and ghee in a large skillet over low heat.  Cook and stir until okra starts to soften, about 5 minutes.  Spoon okra mixture over bread to serve.

title: Pine-Steamed Meatball Sandwiches
ingredients: 5 slices ciabatta or 5 slices other bread | 500 g lean ground beef or 500 g ground lean pork | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 -2 tablespoon chicked peas ( optional ) | 4 -5 slices of your favourite lean pork steak
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into 10 even round balls with hands.  Heat grill pan, place meatballs on grill and cook until cooked through.  Spread the meatballs with a little of the pesto, wrap in a clean tea towel, and eat like a sandwich.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,russet potato,italian cheese,salt,tuna vegetable oil,steak,sambal oelek
title: Beef Tuna Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb top round steak, 1 inch thick & cut into 1/2 inch thick ribbons | 1 tablespoon italian cheese, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons sambal oelek | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1 3/4 teaspoons beef broth | 2 russet potatoes, very thinly sliced | 1 can tuna in vegetable oil, drained
instructions: In a bowl, combine beef, cheese, salt, olek and sambal, mix well.  Heat a large nonstick wok over medium heat until hot.  Working quickly, add potatoes.

title: Rose Limes and Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 3 -4 -5 tablespoons fresh rose's lime juice
instructions: Soak the chickpeas overnight.  The longer they soak, the more flavor they absorb.  Drain, rinse and drain again.  Place the drained, cooked chickpeas in a large zip lock.  Cover with the onion soup mix and lime juice.  Let sit at room temperature for 1 hour or so.  Note, if there are extra dry onion soup mix in the can, just drain them, put them in a small dish and stir in some.  When you can get that, you can add some other dry soup mix such as a water soluble envelope.  Enjoy your 1st night, you can serve this as a side dish with pasta, rice, bread or as an item in a wrap, and you will feel all cozy if you don't have leftover soup. .

Random Ingredients: cashew,filet beef,sherry wine vinegar,coffee,french bread,broth,coriander seed,green chili
title: Beef in Coriander-Cashew Sauce - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 cup coriander seed, husked and crushed | 1 kg filet of beef | 1 1/2 cups sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon coffee | 100 g cashews, salted, dry roasted | 400 ml reduced-sodium broth | 1 green chili, deseeded and finely sliced | 4 slices toasted french bread
instructions: Combine coriander seeds and 1 cup water.  Soak for 1 hour.  Drain.  Pat beef dry with paper towels.  Trim excess fat.  Combine sherry vinegar and 1 tablespoon water in heavy based frying pan.  Heat over high heat until a bead of water vaporises around the edge.  Remove from heat.  Add coriander vinegar and set aside for 15 minutes.  Drain coriander.  Place meat in crock pot.  Cut into 3cm slices.  Add to crock pot.  Top with coriander.  Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or on high for 3 hours or until meat is just tender.  Turn control to high.  Stir in cashews.  Stir in stock.  Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes or until meat is tender and sauce thickens.  Add green chilli.  Stir, replace cover and cook on high for 2 - 5 minutes or until heated through.  To serve, remove from crock pot, place on serving plate.  Spoon sauce over meat.  Serve with toasted french bread slices.

title: Moroccan Tamarind and Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini ( sesame ) | 1 tablespoon chopped orange sweet bell pepper | 1 teaspoon agave ground anise seeds | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,tomato vegetable juice cocktail,double cream,cinnamon
title: Chilled Tomato Cream
ingredients: 1 cup tomato-vegetable juice cocktail, from a can of canned tomatoes ( i use v8 vegetable juice cocktail ) | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 cup double cream ( thickened with 2 tsp boiling water mixed with a pinch )
instructions: Combine tomato juice, soy sauce and cinnamon in a small saucepan, bring to a boil, lower heat.  Simmer gently for about 5 minutes.  Remove mixture from heat, cool to room temperature in refrigerator.  Stir heavy cream into tomato mixture, beating until soft peaks form.  Serve on warm ice cream.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,greek yogurt,curry leaf,turmeric,soy sauce,pistachio nut,romaine lettuce heart,salt
title: Turkish Nogado(Dairy Free, No Mayo, and Very Delicious)
ingredients:
4 heads romaine lettuce hearts, washed and dried ( about 1½ lbs.
    - total weight ) | 3 pinches salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill weed or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chives | 1/2 cup unsalted pistachio nut, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup soy sauce, tamari | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt ( lactose-free plain yogurt, if possible ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon mild curry leaf ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Make the dressing by combining all ingredients in a medium bowl & mixing well ~ set aside covered.  Rinse the dry lettuce heads and place them in a salad bowl.  Sprinkle the salt & dill over the heads & toss to coat.  In a small skillet, toast the pistachios for about 3 minutes or until golden brown, shaking skillet occasionally to remove.  In the very top of a double boiler or large saute pan, melt down the melted butter & then add the yogurt & curry leaves.  Allow yogurt to thicken & remove from burner when the yogurt starts to curdle ~ remove from heat & allow to cool.  Remove the yogurt from the heat & stir in the oil & spice mixture.  Taste & adjust the seasoning, if necessary.  Pour dressing over the lettuce & toss well to combine.  Serve immediately.

title: Fennel Broccoli Rice

instructions: In a steamer basket, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,orange,peach,alfredo sauce,red pepper sauce,lentil,sage leaf,salt
title: Beef With Lentils and Peach
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 jar alfredo sauce ( or you can use homemade, but the alfalfa is the creamier the more flavorful it is and it will not split down ) | 2 medium oranges, sliced and seperated | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 1 cup lentils ( brown or brown frozen mixed ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 teaspoon red pepper sauce ( i prefer penzey's ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Brown beef in hot oil in a large skillet.  Stir in cooked lentils, oranges, peaches, sage, and red pepper sauce.  Sprinkle with salt to taste.  Cover and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Tasty Easy Sweet Pepperoncini Sauce
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated cinnamon bark | 7 ounces hot pepperoncini peppers | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Prepare the cinnamon bark by heating the water to boiling in a medium skillet over medium heat and stirring in the cinnamon bark a few pieces at a time.  Cook for about 35 seconds, then remove from heat and leave to cool.  Place the chili peppers into a mortar or coffee grinder and grind with the ginger garlic paste until mixture resembles ground nutmeg and oradish.  Pour into a jar.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 days to blend flavors.

title: Beef Brisket With Tang Orange Sauce and Fresh Fruit
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket, trimmed | fresh ground black pepper | kosher salt & freshly ground coarse black pepper | 3 tablespoons bacon grease | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice ( or orange juice ) | 1 ounce dried orange blossom water | 10 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | topping
instructions: Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper and reserve 2 teaspoons of the kosher salt for later use.  Place beef in a flameproof roasting pan and top with bacon grease.

title: Italian Pork Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 1 bulb of garlic, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Rinse and pat dry the pork.  In a 3 to 4 quart baking pan, place pork and 1/2 the mixed dressing mix.  Sprinkle chopped garlic over top.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Bake about 2 hours.  Let meat rest before slicing.  Serve with remaining dressing mix and lots of freshly ground black pepper. Place the top of the pie shell on a baking sheet, and then cover it with plastic wrap. Roll into logs and cut each log into 1/2 inch thick cookies using a cookie cutter or a drinking glass.  I cut mine into 1/4 inch discs because i like my cookies to have a nice round shape.  Place on a baking sheet that has parchment paper covered with a silicon paper sheet and bake at 425f for 15 - 20 minutes until lightly golden.  Remove from the oven and place back in the hot oven.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,velveeta mexican cheese,white bread,shoyu,beef chuck,rhubarb,italian breadcrumb
title: Beef Philly Balls With Shoyu
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck | 1 1/2 lbs shoyu ( japanese horseshake ) | 6 ounces velveeta mexican cheese | 1 lb fresh italian breadcrumb | 1 lb fresh rhubarb | sea scallops, washed | rye rustic white bread ( optional )
instructions: Peel beef and remove most of the excess fat.  Cut beef in half across the grain.  Remove meat from bones so they stick together well.  Place meat in a large mixing bowl.  Place cheese in the top of the meat and cut into chunks.  Add enough cheese chunks that they are of a size about the size of a dime.  Add the shoyu with a little water till all of the liquid is absorbed.  Place the mixture into the freezer till the mixture is firm enough to form into balls up to 1 1/2 inches.  Remove the mixture from the freezer into a shallow dish.  Add corn meal to the meat on a cutting board.  Dredge the meat in the corn meal.  Remove meat from the corn meal, dipping board into the corn meal.  Then, dip the grain into the corn meal, allowing the corn meal to run through the meat in a sharp knife.  Dip grain into the white bread, and then into the bread again, allowing the breadcrumbs to spread out over the bread.  Place on a greased baking sheet and refrigerate till set, about 20 minutes.

title: French Bread "slices" With Peppercorns
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cracked black peppercorns | 2 1/4 - 3 loaves french bread | 1 1/2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Spread cracked peppercorns on both sides of one side of a bread slice.  Place slices on a cutting board, sprinkle bread with salt, and cut diagonally to make 2 triangles.  Top slices with cheese and the peppercorns.  Wrap loaf in saran wrap and chill for 1 - 2 hours.  Bring to room temperature before serve.

title: Fusilli With Chocolate-Mint Glaze
ingredients: 1 cup margarine or 1 cup butter, softened | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 2/3 cup cake flour | 1 1/4 teaspoons dry mustard | 6 ounces semisweet chocolate shavings | 1 cup chopped red onion
instructions: To make the glaze, in a small bowl beat the margarine, sugar and cake flour together just until smooth.  Stir in the mustard.  Gradually add the chocolate shavings, stirring well.  Cover with plastic wrap and set aside to cool.  Meanwhile, fill the prepared pasta tubes and refrigerate for 90 minutes.  Remove the chilled pasta tubes from the refrigerator and drain the noodles when slightly cool, drain again.

title: Grape With Pesto  Appetizer
ingredients: 4 slices white bread | 1/4 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup pesto sauce, prepared with your pesto from the jar | 2 tablespoons pimento | 1 tablespoon red capsicum, finely diced | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, grated | 1/4 cup seedless grapes, halved | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Brush a frying pan with oil and heat, add bread, turning occassionally until crisp and golden colour.  Remove from pan and place on absorbent paper.  Add milk and stir until thickened.  Spread each slice with half of the pesto.  Place on serving plate top with remaining pesto, and garnish with capsicum, ginger and grapes.  Serve with pappardis.

title: Piggy's Oat Sausages
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces pork, fat removed | 6 ounces yellow onions, diced | 1 -2 red pepper | 1/2 yellow pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1 tablespoon dried currants | 6 ounces oats ( not quick-cooked ) or 6 ounces barley ( not quick-cooking )
instructions: Grind sausage to desired consistency.  I usually use a food processor and pulse several times to mix.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,extra virgin olive oil,jalapeno pepper,sherry,semolina flour,tomato,baby corn,chicken meat
title: Johnd's Pumpkin Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups semolina flour | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 5 medium tomatoes - cut into small cubes | 1 package pumpkin puree | 1 can canned baby corn, drained | 1 cup jalapeno pepper, diced | 1/3 cup sherry | 1/2 cup chicken meat, cooked and diced
instructions: Combine semolina flour with olive oil in a large bowl.  Toss the tomatoes with the tomato mixture to coat them evenly.  Add pumpkin, corn, jalapenos, sherry and chicken.  Toss everything together well to mix, forming a dough.  Transfer the dough to a floured surface, knead it gently about 1 minute, then place the dough onto a baking sheet with a piece of the baking parchment sticking out across the table.  Use a floured knife to shape the dough into small round balls, then transfer to a floured baking sheet with a tea towel on top.  Cover with a tea towel, and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour.  Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Bake the pastas for about 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: The Best Salsa
ingredients: 1 -2 chipotle chile, canned in adobo sauce | 2 -3 garlic cloves, whole
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and pulse until you get how your like it.  Add to your favorite hot sauce and blend.

title: Pineapple in Green Ginger Syrup
ingredients: 2 cups pineapple chunks in juice, not in syrup syrup, save the juice | 1 inch fresh ginger, peeled and sliced | 2 -3 cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons fresh basil, sliced, if you wish
instructions: Pour in a pot full of water to cover pineapple.  Bring to boil over high heat.  Then reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.  Drain and put on a plate to cool. .  When completely cool, put the ginger in a processor or mortar and add the cardamon pods and basil.  Pulse to a fine paste, adding a little of the pineapple juice if the mixture is a bit too crumbly.  Refrigerate, covered, and stir in the rest of the pineapple juice if needed for best results.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,nonfat yogurt,red curry paste,green pepper,barbecue sauce,cream coconut
title: Beef Kebabs with Cream of Coconut
ingredients: 6 tablespoons nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( or your favourite curry paste ) | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 cups light cream of coconut | 1/2 medium red sweet peppers or 1/2 medium green sweet pepper, chopped | 4 -5 ounces barbecue sauce, of choice
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together.  Cut the meat into 2 or 3 inch chunks.  Cut the meat in half or into 2 to 3 - 1 1/2 inch squares, depending on the size of the meat.  Thread meat onto skewers.  Grill over hot coals for 3 to 5 minutes per side, turning so meat does not burn.  Serve warm with your choice of dipping sauces or rice.

title: Guinness and Mushroom Rice Noodle With Strawberries
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh rice noodles ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 cup guinness stout ( guinness is good ) | 1 jar button mushrooms, sliced ( 1/2 ounce jar ) | 1 bag fresh strawberries, cut in half and left whole | 24 -30 ounces dashi ( about 3 t ) | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Prepare guinness and mushroom according to package directions.  In a very large pot, add 1/3 cup water and bring to a boil.  Add noodles and return to a boil.  Drain.  Add back in mushrooms, stir.  Put dashi, sugar and remaining 1/3 cup of water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.  Add noodles and turn down to a simmer.  Cook until cooked through and sugar has dissolved and noodles are al dente, about 30 to 45 minutes.  Turn off heat and let noodles stand for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,monterey jack cheese,marsala,sea salt pepper,red cabbage
title: Beef and Cabbage
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, fat trimmed | 2 carrots, sliced | 1 loaf red cabbage, leaves separated | 1/4 cup marsala | sea salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Score the tenderloin with a diagonal cut in the thickest part of the steaks to within 1/2 inch of the other side.  Place the steaks between sheets of plastic wrap and flatten into a thin layer on the top and bottom, about 1/2 inch thick.  Lay the sliced carrots around the steaks and lay the red cabbage leaves around them.  Heat the marsala in a skillet.  As soon as the pan starts to boil, pour 1/2 cup of the marsala mixture into a small bowl and reserve for garnish.  Place a layer of meat on top of the vegetables and top with the remaining marsala mixture, sprinkling with sea salt and pepper.  Cover tightly with a piece of plastic wrap and place in the oven.  Bake for 30 minutes or until tender.  Remove the meat from the oven and slice across the grain, setting aside the juices.  Serve with sausages, if desired.

title: Quickie Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb finely ground beef sirloin | 1 small white onion, minced | 10 plum tomatoes, diced | 20 pieces frozen tortillas, warmed | 2 lemons, cut into wedges
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet cook beef and onion over medium heat 5 minutes, stirring often.  Cover and cook 5 minutes.  Stir in tomatoes and tortillas and heat through.  Divide among plates.  Top with 1 lemon wedge.

title: Baked French Toast II
ingredients: 2 slices french bread | 2 teaspoons light dark brown sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Place bread on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Combine sugar and sprinkle over the bread.  Bake 5 minutes at 400 degrees.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,iceberg lettuce,dill pickle,icing sugar,zucchini lengthwise,flour,salt black pepper
title: Persian Chopped Zucchini Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/3 cup icing sugar, sifted | 1 1/2 tablespoons flour, sifted | 2 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons dill pickles, chopped | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: In a shallow baking tray, dry roast pistachios over moderate heat, shaking frequently, until golden, about 10 minutes.  Let cool before moving to a large bowl, combine pistachios with salt and pepper, & toss with icing sugar until evenly coated.  Sprinkle flour over zucchini, toss to coat, cover & refrigerate about 30 minutes or until mixture begins to firm.  Transfer skillet to medium heat, add choped zucchini and dill pickles, cook, stirring, until zucchini is tender, about 8 minutes.  Remove from heat & cool, toss with lettuce leaves, adjust seasonings.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,tart apple,chili pepper,beef tenderloin steak,seasoning salt,apple,pine nut
title: Salsa of the Beef
ingredients: 4 slices tart apples ( i prefer red and/or green ) | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1 -2 lb trimmed beef tenderloin steak ( depends on how thick the steak is ) | 2 teaspoons chili peppers ( adjust accordingly ) | 1 teaspoon fresh ground dried chili pepper ( adjust accordingly ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( adjust accordingly ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Toast the pine nuts in a skillet on med high heat until they are browned and fragrant, watch the nuts carefully they burn easily remove from heat and keep warm.  Trim and slice the beef steaks into thin slices, approximately 1/8 thick.  Place the meat slices on a large platter.  Combine all the remaining ingredients in a medium bowl.  Pour over the beef slices and marinate in refrigerator for up to 1+ 1/2 days.  Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Homemade Bitters(Brazilian Cheese Cocktail)
ingredients: 3/4 ounce dried orange peel | 1 ounce parmesan cheese ( or comms ) | 1 dash angostura bitters
instructions: Place in a cocktail shaker or in a bowl.  Shake or stir with a fork and pour into a collins glass or a glass.  Float a splash of angostura bitters on top if using.

title: Fried Tomatillo Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup chopped cooked tomatillo salsa | 1 can water chestnuts, drained | 1/2 cup self-rising flour
instructions: In a medium serving bowl, mix together the tomatillo salsa, water chestnuts, and flour.  Serve warm.

title: Lemon Grass Daoyu
ingredients:
2 lbs fresh lemongrass, stalks white part part only, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 cup green chili pepper, stemmed, seeded, deveined ( or 2 tsp.
    - chopped fresh chiles ) | 1 cup golden raisin | 3 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup catsup ( or vegetarian style sauce ) | 1 cup orange juice ( or water )
instructions: In a bowl, combine the lemongrass, green chile, raisins, tomatoes, catsup and 1/4 1/2 cup of orange juice.  Toss with the remaining orange juice.  Let stand at room temperature for 2 days, mixing once a day.  Refrigerate at least for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: risotto rice,cilantro,cream mushroom soup,mustard powder,cod fish fillet,kahlua,star anise,red wine vinegar
title: Cod With Mushroom Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod fish fillets, skinned & sliced into chunks | 4 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 4 ounces creamed churros or 4 ounces kahlua | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard powder | 1 star anise | 1 ounce red wine vinegar | 2 ounces kahlua | fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f.  Line an 11 x 7 inch baking dish with foil or lightly greased with nonstick cooking spray.  Combine the soup, creamed churros, mustard powder and the star anise in a bowl, stir until well combined.  Add the cod, toss to coat and coat all over.  Place the cod in the prepared dish, spoon over the soup mixture.  Bake for about 45 minutes or until fish is fork tender.  Garnish with cilantro.

title: Koulourak -- Spicy Seed Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups sesame seeds ( raw ) | 24 ounces flour | 8 cups vegetable shortening ( solid white ) | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, coarsely powdered ( ground )
instructions: Blend sesame seeds with the coarsely powdered sesame seeds in a food processor to a fine meal.  Add flour and mix well.  Add more flour until mixture is crumbly.  Roll in 2 tablespoons sesame seeds and let rest 3 - 4 hours.  Drop dough into oiled and floured miniature muffin cups, they usually rise to the surface when the tops are puffed up, they should be rather thin and well lined.  If any dough cracks on top of the oiled, they may crack on the pan.  If making these for a party, you can pipe them on waxed paper lined cookie sheets and bake at 350 degrees f until golden.  These cookies may be frozen for up to 3 months.

title: Niter Kebab
ingredients: 2 dried sage leaves | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat a nonstick or cast iron skillet over medium heat for about a minute.  Stirring constantly, add sage.  Cover.  After about 2 minutes, add cayenne.  Turn and stir until mixture is well blended and evenly distributed.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,coconut cream,bacon,margarine,green chili,spring onion
title: Filipino Bacon, Bacon and Coconut Sauce
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, chopped | 1 spring onion, chopped ( including green ) | 1 hot italian sausage | 2 tablespoons margarine ( or butter flavored ) | 300 ml coconut cream ( or cream coconut milk ) | 6 slices crisp fried bacon | 1 tablespoon chopped green chili
instructions: Saute bacon over medium heat, until crisp, about 5 minutes.  Remove from pan with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels for 10 minutes, leaving the drippings in pan.  Melt margarine in another pan.  Stir fry spring onions for a few minutes, and remove with slotted spoon.  Break up sausage into pieces and add to pan.  Cook, stirring, 2 - 3 minutes.  Return the sauteed bacon and onions to the pan, stir in coconut cream and bring to boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.  Lift cover and continue to simmer until thickened.  Stir in chopped green chilies and remove from heat.  Serve warm garnished with crispy fried bacon and chopped crispy hard boiled egg slices.

title: Kolbogi (Raisin-Stuffed Raisins)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raisins, plump | 5 teaspoons anise seed
instructions: Soak the raisins in very hot water for 20 minutes.  Strain the plumped plumped raisins through a sieve and discard any remaining moisture.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,chicken breast half,pumpkin seed,tomato basil pasta sauce
title: Pumpkin Chipotle Chicken Skillet
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes and basil pasta sauce | 2 tablespoons canned chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon fresh pumpkin seeds
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.  Cook chicken in hot skillet until browned and no longer pink in the center, 5 to 7 minutes per side.  Pour tomatoes with basil pasta sauce and chipotle chiles into the skillet.  Reduce heat to low.

title: Quick Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons roasted rice noodles | 1/4 cup white beans | 2 tablespoons fish sauce, divided | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1 package linguine
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add rice noodles and cook for 6 to 8 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,avocado,stewing beef,artichoke heart,tomato,pickle juice
title: Coco - Chilli Beef
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cubed | 3 tablespoons pickle juice | 1 cup pickled artichoke hearts, drained | 8 ounces canned diced tomatoes | 1 large red chile pepper | 1 avocado, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place beef in a casserole dish.  Sprinkle with pickle juice, artichoke hearts, tomatoes, and chile pepper.  Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour, or till serving.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,yeast,red potato,garlic salt,fennel,cooking oil,black pepper
title: Easy Fennel and Garlic Sausage on Stilts
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 cup fennel or 1/2 cup sage leaf, loosely packed | 1/3 cup fresh garlic salt | 2 teaspoons dried yeast | 1 teaspoon smoked fennel, powdered | 1 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Scrub the potatoes.

title: Curried Herb Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup agave nectar | 1/3 cup sweetened buttermilk | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced white onions | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 tablespoons buttermilk | 1 1/2 cups chopped lettuce | pistachios ( garnish ) ( optional ) | shredded lettuce ( garnish ) ( optional ) | half-and-half ( optional ) | pistachios, garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Combine first five ingredients and mash with a fork.  Stir in lettuce.  Spread mixture in a lightly oiled 9 inch round cake pan or shallow casserole dish.  Broil for 8 - 10 minutes or until golden.  Spread over lettuce and top with optional garnishes.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,vanilla bean,red chili pepper flake,chocolate,chunky salsa,teriyaki sauce,chili pepper,mint sprig
title: Spicy Chocolate Mojito
ingredients: 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate | 1 large red chili pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate ( for spreading on mugs ) | 1/2 vanilla bean | fresh mint sprig ( optional ) | 1 dash red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Microwave the chocolate and 2 tablespoons of the teriyaki sauce, the peppers, and sugar until very warm and smooth.  Microwave for 3 to 5 minutes to dry out the chocolate.  Meanwhile pour the remainder of the teriyaki sauce into a saucer.  Drain the vanilla bean, scrape it out, and reserve.  Slice the vanilla bean into thin segments.  Place the pieces in a bowl, pour the remainder of the teriyaki sauce over, and toss.  Refrigerate until ready to serve, at least 20 minutes.

title: Cocoa Beef and Clam Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cans minced clams | 1 can diced tomatoes | 1 can green beans, sliced | 1 package corn tortillas | 1 package old el paso chocolate shredded sweet roll | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Drain clams, tomatoes & green beans.  Place corn tortillas into a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with a layer of clams.  Sprinkle with chips & cocoa.  Combine other two cans of drained clams with the green beans.  Layer with shredded chocolate.  Bake at 350°f or use your favorite color.  Or you can mix in your sauces or whatever else floats your boat.  Enjoy.

title: Grecian Style Asparagus
ingredients: 1 pound fresh asparagus | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Trim asparagus tough ends.  Cut asparagus into 2 inch florets, or smaller if desired, keeping them whole.  Place in a steamer basket with a lid.  Fill a pot with boiling water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Cover, and reduce heat to medium low.  Simmer asparagus, covered, until tender but still bright green, about 25 minutes.  Drain asparagus and cool on paper towels.  Place on a platter and sprinkle with salt.  Place remaining asparagus in a large serving dish.  Stir in vinegar and oregano, and keep warm.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,berry,salsa,beef bouillon granule,peanut oil vegetable,tomato ketchup,fine herb
title: Chunky Tomato Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 300 g mixed ripe tomatoes and ketchup, chopped | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules or 1 teaspoon vegetarian beef stock powder | fine herbs, to serve | fresh sweet chilli sauce or salsa, to serve
instructions: Heat the oil in a large ovenproof saucepan.

title: Apricot Rice Pudding With Apricots
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups apricot pieces, chilled | 1 3/4 cups basmati rice, washed and drained | 2 1/4 cups whipping cream, chilled | 1/4 cup agave nectar
instructions: Wash rice in strainer until water runs clear and then drain.  Combine rice and apricots in a 2 quart saucepan.  Place over high heat.  Bring to boil.  Cover and reduce heat to low.  Simmer 30 to 40 minutes or until rice is soft and rice is tender.  Add cream and agave.  Heat till warmed through.  Transfer to bowl.  Serve warm or chill and serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,bun,virgin olive oil,shallot,dulce de leche,tamari,cashew
title: Super Easy Tasty Cashew Buns
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 bunches pitted fresh unsalted cashews | 1 small shallot, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried dulce de leche, crushed | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1/3 cup dulce de leche ( dried mexican spice ) | 1 tablespoon tamari
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread the cashews in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Bake until lightly brown, about 10 to 15 minutes.  Set aside.  Heat the oil in a small, heavy saucepan over medium heat.  Saute the shallot until translucent.  Pour in the soup and cashew nuts and stir to mix well.  Lower heat and simmer 15 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in the dulce de leche, tamari and 1 tablespoon of the tamari.  Set aside to cool, then chill until ready to serve.  Spread the chilled mixture evenly onto the toasted cashews and top with more dulce de leche.  Serve with extra dulce de leche and extra tamari.

Random Ingredients: canning salt,garam masala powder,dijon mustard,phyllo dough,double cream
title: Spiced and Spiced Filo
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo dough | 2/3 cup dijon mustard | 1 cup double cream | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | canning salt
instructions: Mix mustard with cream.  Place 1 sheet of filo on a greased baking sheet.  Spread with a thin layer of mustard mixture.  Place second sheet on top and brush with more of the cream.  Repeat this process with remaining filo, mustard and cream, brushing each sheet lightly with more cream.  Sprinkle garam masala powder on top and bake for 25 - 30 minutes at 180°c.

title: Blueberry and Parsley Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup fresh blueberries | 2 garlic cloves, chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 2 slices bacon, finely chopped
instructions: Place blueberries in food processor or blender.

title: Mint Jelly
ingredients: 4 lbs pork butt | 2 ounces dried mint | 4 ounces red maraschino cherries | 1 quart arrowroot
instructions: Make deep cuts in the pork using a sharp knife, removing fat, and making diagonal cuts with a cleaver.  Place pork in a pot and cover with cold water.  Add dried mint, red cherries, and arrowroot and bring slowly to a boil.  The jelly will rise to the surface at boiling point.  This should take about 2 hours or more.  When the time is up, skim and discard any solid fat floating out of the surface.  Remove from heat.  Allow to cool and bottle. .

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,green cardamom,kosher salt black pepper,yellow pepper
title: Beef Kebab
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 lbs trimmed beef brisket, cut into portions 1 1/2x2-inches | 2 tablespoons kosher salt, plus more | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 20 -25 small red bell peppers, halved, seeded and sliced into 1/2-inch wide rings | 1 teaspoon green cardamom, lightly crushed
instructions: Place the beef portions into a food processor.

title: Cod Baked for 1
ingredients: 16 ounces fish, fillets cut in 1-inch slices | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chili | 1/2 cup sliced onion | 1/2 cup chopped dry roasted pistachio nuts | 1/2 cup miniature marshmallows | 1/4 teaspoon almond flavoring, or to taste | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Pour enough boiling water into a large mixing bowl to completely immerse the ingredients in the first step.  Place the fish, chili, onion and pistachios in the baking dish just to cover.  In a small bowl, stir together the chocolate and marshmallows.  Stir the chocolate mixture through the fish.  Spread on the fish in the dish.  Bake for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the mixture is hot.  Add the beans to the mixture in the baking dish.  Bake until heated through.

Random Ingredients: catsup,lite olive oil,ortega green chili salsa,fennel seed,chicken wing,cooking oil,coconut cream
title: Easy Chicken or Fish Buffalo Wings
ingredients:
3 frozen chicken wings, thawed ( or 3 boneless chicken wings ) | 1 can ortega green chili salsa | 1 cup catsup | 1 can ortega whole mixed sprouts | 1/2 cup lite olive oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 cup cato olive oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 0.
    -5 can coco lopez or can green chili salsa ( 1/2 bottle with each hot and sour ingredient ) | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Line a cookie sheet with foil.  Rinse and pat dry chicken wings.  Place in a bowl and cover with salsa, then set aside.  Combine oil, catsup and ortega green chilis in a saucepan and cook on medium heat.  Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Spread olive oil evenly over chicken wings.  Sprinkle fennel seed on chicken wings, then add can of coco rallado or chili sauce.  Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in oven, or until chicken is cooked through. .

title: Chinese Pizza Bites
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 3/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f.  Spray two jelly roll pans with cooking spray, 15 x 10 x 1 rectangle slices.  Place on prepared pan in oven to heat through.  Meanwhile, combine yogurt and soy sauce in small bowl.  Unroll crescent dough.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,red pepper,bourbon,spinach leaf,chick pea,saffron thread
title: Spinach With Spicy Yellow Squash and Chickpeas
ingredients:
1 green chinese-style squash | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 teaspoon dried sweet red pepper | 2 cups yellow squash, sliced ( about 1 lb.
    - total ) | 1/2 cup thawed frozen chopped spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons bourbon ( optional )
instructions: Trim the long thin peel on the squash, remove the seeds and cut in half lengthwise.  Cut the half cut squash into 6 thin slices.  Heat the skillet over moderately low heat until tiny bits of squash are sizzling, but not brown.  Transfer the squash slices to the skillet and sprinkle with saffron, hot red pepper.  Add the squash and cook, stirring, until almost tender, about 3 minutes.  Add the yellow squash and cook, stirring, until tender, about 2 minutes longer.  Stir in the spinach and turn off the heat.  Transfer the mixture to a serving dish, sprinkle with bourbon, and serve.

Random Ingredients: wheat macaroni,soy sauce,pumpkin puree,pam cooking spray
title: Papouts With Spiced Pork Nibbles (Macaroni Grill)
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup pumpkin puree, canned | 2 cups whole wheat macaroni or 2 cups egg noodles | pam cooking spray
instructions: Put the soy sauce in a saucepan and place over medium heat.  Whisk frequently or use a whisk that can be made with an immersion blender or regular whisk, whisking often to keep the mixture from sticking to the pan.  You should be able to smell the soy sauce and see the raw flavor.  Stir in the pumpkin puree and cook for 3 - 5 minutes.  Add the pasta and cook until just heated through and creamy.  Add a little water if the sauce is too thick.  Spray pam on your workspace and transfer the pasta to a platter or tray, covering each serving.  Serve with extra soy sauce, if desired.

title: Potato & Beet Latkes - Low Fat
ingredients: 1 large beet, peeled, sliced in 1/4s | 3 red potatoes, peeled, sliced in1/4s | 1/3 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon chinese rice wine ( shao hsing ) | 100 g shredded chocolate
instructions: Put all ingredients except chocolate into a processor and add 1tbsp rice wine.  Process for 30 seconds or until desired consistency is achieved.  Scrape down the sides of the processor and blend for 10 seconds or until smooth.  Transfer to a lightly oiled, shallow bowl.  Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, turning once.  Sprinkle shredded parmesan over the top.  Makes 6 latkes.

title: Flourless Chocolate Fondue
ingredients: 8 ounces high-quality dark chocolate | 2 tablespoons finely chopped celery
instructions: Heat the chocolate in a double boiler over simmering water until melted.  Place the celery in the bowl of a large stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment.  Pour in the melted chocolate, stir well and adjust the speed to blend thoroughly.  Add the chocolate slowly, mixing by hand, until the mixture begins to form soft ball like chunks of chocolate.  Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth, about 5 minutes.  Divide the dough in four and roll into 1 1/2 inch thick ropes on a lightly floured pastry cloth.  Repeat with another piece of dough, until the chocolate is all used up.  Cover with plastic wrap and set aside until slightly puffy and doubled in size, about 20 minutes. ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 2 cups whole kernel corn, cut from the cob | 1/3 cup tequila | 1 package dry grits ( such as wheaties ) | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/3 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder, or to taste
instructions: Combine vegetable stock and corn in a stockpot and set over medium heat.  Bring the stock mixture to a simmer.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,grain rice,saffron strand,parsley,lemon wedge,button mushroom,queso fresco,phyllo pastry
title: Armenian Triangles
ingredients: 1 box medium grain rice | 4 slices lemons, zested or 4 slices lemons, white pith removed | 10 button mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups queso fresco ( crumbly cheese ) | parsley | 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 3 -5 saffron strands | 1 dash dried rosemary leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  In a pan, bring 2 cups of water and 2 tablespoons of olive oil to a boil.  Add rice.  Cover and then gently boil over low heat until all the water is absorbed.  This will take 10 to 12 minutes.  Transfer rice to a sieve set over a big bowl and allow to drain for another 2 to 3 minutes.  Set aside.  Slice mushrooms into quarters and remove stems.  Wash rice well with water.  Place in bowl and add zest or lemons.  Stir through and set aside.  Add the cheese to the bowl and stir until it become creamy.  Set aside.  Place 2 sheets of pastry on a flat surface, brush both sides with olive or grapeseed oil.  Place 2 - 3 heaping tablespoons of the rice mixture and a little of the cheese mixture along the perimeter of each layer.  Fold pastry over mixture and roll up and wrap loosely.  Place on a greased or a baking sheet and brush again thoroughly with olive or grapeseed oil.  Repeat steps 4 to 9 until all the ingredients have been used and the mixture is used up.  Gently brush the tops with more olive or grapeseed oil and sprinkle with the herb leaves.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pasta shell,red capsicum,swiss cheese,rice,sirloin,cottage cheese,basil,broccoli rabe
title: Pasta and Beef - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 9 ounces raw sirloin, sliced very thinly | 4 ounces broccoli rabe, sliced thinly | 2 ounces red capsicums, cut into strips | 16 ounces tri-colored pasta shells | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 1/2 cup ritzi-style swiss cheese, grated
instructions: Add the sirloin and broccoli rabe to a pan of boiling water and cook until crisp tender, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,monterey jack cheese,rye bread,broccoli,white chocolate,lamb steak,nonfat milk
title: Miniature Lamb Stroganoff-Sour Cream Sandwiches

instructions: Arrange 6 bread slices on a plate.  Spread 1/4 of yogurt dressing on each side of 4 slices of bread.  Divide cooked lamb among bread slices.
