title: Guacamole and Cabbage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons guacamole | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 cup hot cabbage, shredded | 1 lb fresh snow pea, trimmed
instructions: Combine the guacamole, bouillon and cabbage in a mixing bowl.  Add the snow peas and toss together.  Serve at once.

title: Chana Punjabiya (Methi Pickled Beef Tenderloins)
ingredients: 1 kg beef tenderloin, cut into 8 equal sized pieces | 4 tablespoons urad dal ( washed, soaked in hot water for 5 minutes under clean cloth and drained ) | 25 g cornstarch
instructions: Take meat out of refrigerator.  Take pieces of meat, length in length and size and coat each piece with salt and keep aside for 45 minutes on clean paper towels.  Heat oil in a heavy pan on high flame.  Add urad dal in the pan for a minute.  Add beef and cook for 20 seconds on high flame.  Add 1 tablespoon of corn starch and stir.  Once you can see the raw meat colour, the gravy is ready.  Add 2 cups of water.  Allow the gravy to boil.  Once the gravy thickens, remove from flame and serve immediately hot.  Enjoy.

title: Mushroom and Beer Chili Grilled Skewers
ingredients: 1 can beer | 2 tablespoons dried mushrooms | 2 tablespoons ground beef or 2 tablespoons lamb fat | 1/2 tablespoon rice wine | 4 cups cooked lamb, cubed or 4 cups cooked chicken, diced | 2 tablespoons dried pecans | cooked spanish rice or spaghetti
instructions: Combine beer, mushrooms and beef or lamb fat in small bowl.

title: Persian Herbed Butter
ingredients: 1/4 lb margarine or 1/4 lb butter | 1 cup dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Cut the margarine into small pieces.  Put the butter into a glass jar, and add the oreganos and turmeric.  Cover the jar, and shake the jar until the liquid and butter are thoroughly mixed.  Store in the refrigerator.  Makes enough to generously fill 2 dozen butter crocks.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,chicken stock,cooking spray,marinara sauce
title: Quick and Easy Beef Bouillon - Pressure Cooker Recipe
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 1/3 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon cube | 1 cup prepared marinara sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the cooker except the bouillon and stir until well blended.  Stir in bouillon and heat on high for two minutes.  Pour into hot pressure cooker.  Turn off heat and leave lid slightly ajar, and gently stir the contents of the cooker.  If you want a thicker pot pour liquid through a strainer and use as necessary to make your desired consistency.

title: Gran's Famous Cherry Crumb Fudge
ingredients: 1 package graham cracker crumbs | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and juice reserved
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line 2 - 8 or 10 inch squares of aluminum foil with plastic wrap.  Press graham cracker crumbs firmly onto foil, forming crumbles as you go.  Arrange about 1 cup of cherry juice into center of graham cracker crumbs.  Starting at center, roll up each piece of graham cracker crumb.  Repeat with remaining graham cracker crumbs and cherry juice until all graham cracker crumbs have been used.

title: Prawns & Steamed Filtered Rye Welsh Pearls
ingredients: 250 g good quality extra lean ground beef | 200 g raw tiger shrimp, cleaned | 350 g steamed rye bread | 2 tablespoons double cream, to serve | 4 whole cloves, whole | 2 tablespoons wine, to serve
instructions: Place ground beef in a heavy frying pan and cook over a high heat for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Reduce heat.  Add shrimp to pan and cook, stirring, for 1 - 2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Slice the steamed pearls in half lengthways, scoop out and discard flesh and cores.  Place bread into a heatproof bowl.  Heat cream in microwave, 1 teaspoon of oil and pinch of ground cloves in a small pan until warm and smooth.  Remove from heat.  Cover bread bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours but preferably overnight.  Preheat oven to 180c degrees or 190c if fan forced.  Remove bread bowl from fridge.  Place bread on oven tray.  Cut beef into 2 cm cubes and place in a large heatproof bowl.  Add the cream mixture and wine to the beef and shrimp.  Mix well.  Divide mixture between bread bowls, dividing evenly.  Wrap each with glad wrap and place on a tray.  Cook for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: macaroni,purpose flour,chicken bouillon,jalapeno pepper,chicken broth,carrot,asafoetida powder,celery
title: Tacutti (Macaroni Soup)
ingredients: 2 bags macaroni | 6 stalks celery, chopped | 6 carrots, diced | 1 can jalapeno peppers, diced | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 can chicken broth | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Place the macaroni in a pot and pour hot water on to the macaroni to soften.  Set aside to drain, rinse and drain again.  In a pot, add the celery, carrots, and the jalapenos and saute for 5 minutes stirring often.  Add the flour and saute until the vegetables are golden.  Add the broth to the vegetables and cook for an additional 2 to 3 minutes.  Add the bouillon.  Cook for one minute longer before removing from heat.  Add asafetida and cook until soup thickens.  Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,pastry,beef rump roast,cucumber,almond meal,beef stew meat,french bread
title: Saucy Beef Sandwiches With Cucumber Beef
ingredients: 6 lbs stewing beef, from the freezer, from the freezer, thawed | 1 bag beef rump roast | 2 cans french bread, from the loaf, sliced in half lengthwise, and cut in half lengthwise again, for hoisin sauce | 1 bag almond meal, for dredging beef | 2 packages frozen stewing beef ( the meat that's frozen ) in sauce ( thawed, in the freezer ) | 1 package sliced cucumbers | 8 -12 slices toasted slivered almonds
instructions: Place frozen beef, including as much of the juice as is needed or the freezer bag, in a crockpot.  Add thawed french rolls, including as much of the juice as is needed or the freezer bag.  Use the thawed beef slices to line the bottom of the crockpot.  Top evenly with slivered toasted almonds.  Cover and cook on lo heat for 4 - 6 hours or on hi for 10 to 12 hours or on hi for 4 1/2 hours remove meat from crockpot and shred.  Return beef to crockpot.

title: Pasta e Vedillo
ingredients: 1/2 lb corkscrew macaroni, or any pasta, such as ditalini, rotelle, or as a combination | 8 ounces tamarind paste | 32 fluid ounces whipping cream
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the pasta for 8 to 10 minutes, or until just fork tender.  Drain, then mix in the tamarind paste and cook for 2 minutes longer.  Remove from heat.  Stir in the cream, adjust seasonings, and serve over pasta.  Note, 1 tablespoon of tamarind concentrate can be mixed in with 1/2 cup water to produce a nice thick cream sauce.

Random Ingredients: flour,orange juice zest,kosher salt black pepper,liquid honey,kale
title: Kale and Honey Braised in the Oven
ingredients: 4 bunches fresh kale, washed thoroughly, about | 6 tablespoons flour | 4 ounces orange juice or 4 ounces lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 2 -3 tablespoons liquid honey | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil, drizzle it with 2 tbls.  Of oil, lay kale on it, cover with foil, and bake for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, make the sauce, combine the remaining tbls.  Water, orange juice, juice from the kale/juice, honey, salt, and pepper to taste and whisk until smooth.  Remove the kale from the oven and drain excess fat.  Drizzle with the honey and toss until the kale is coated with the honey mixture.  Transfer to a serving bowl.

title: Chickpea Toast
ingredients: 20 slices bread | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 2 green apples, sliced | 1 small onion powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry bread crumbs ( optional )
instructions: Using a loaf pan, layer the bread slices to the edge of the pan starting with a slice of the bread.  Drain the chickpeas to the side of the bread.  Arrange the apples on the bread.  Sprinkle the onion and bread crumb over all.  Add enough water to just cover the top.  Cover and let sit overnight at room temp, but not for 24 hours.  Heat oven to 250 degrees.  Bake about 45 to 55 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and crispy.

title: Prawns in Syrup
ingredients: 200 g pine nuts, shelled and blanched | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Shell, devein and rinse the prawns.  In a small bowl, combine the prawns with the lemon juice and stir well.  Arrange the prawns in one layer in a baking dish, sprinkle with pine nuts and season to taste.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the prawns are cooked.  Serve warm or warm.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,parmesan cheese,corn tortilla,filling,clove,chinese wine,thai fish sauce,raspberry vinegar
title: Quick and Easy Thai Beef Filling
ingredients: 3 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns ground roasted sirloin steak | 2 teaspoons minced peeled fresh garlic | 1/4 cup chinese wine ( shaoxing wine or shaoxing rice wine ) | 2 tablespoons sesame seed meal or 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar | 1/3 cup fresh grated parmesan cheese | 2 cups refrigerated pastry dough ( thawed if frozen ) | 12 corn tortillas, warmed
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns in a heavy skillet over medium heat, stirring, until fragrant and beginning to smoke, about 2 minutes.  Add minced garlic.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,pimento olive,tilapia fillet,ricotta cheese,vanilla sugar
title: Crispy Roasted Tilapia With Cheese
ingredients: 1 packet ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup pimento stuffed olive, roughly chopped into small cubes | 3 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 lb tilapia fillet
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a mixing bowl of an electric mixer, combine the ricotta, chopped olives, vanilla sugar, balsamic vinegar and pimento stuffed olives and mix until smooth.  Line the baking tin with foil and spray with nonstick cooking oil spray.  Toss fillets in the prepared baking tin and bake 10 minutes or until just cooked through.  Serve the fish with the cheese, and top with the cheese mixture.

title: Parsnip Fritters With Dried Bread
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip | 1 ounce cake flour | 2 ounces yeast, dissolved in | 1 teaspoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon mustard powder ( optional )
instructions: Melt the margarine or butter, when warm up the flour.  Add the honey mustard and dry yeast mixture.  Roll into small balls, about 5cm diameter.  Dip in the melted margarine or butter.  Place on a greased tray and bake 375 f/ 180°c for 15 - 20 min's or until cooked through.  The patties should have bubbles and not be browned.

title: Creamy Rice & Fish Ball Soup
ingredients: 2 fish balls ( such as sea bass or grouper ) | 1 cup long grain rice, rinsed
instructions: Place the rice in the top half of a 4 cup boiling glass bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let soak 20 minutes or longer.  Remove the rice from the bowl and pat dry.  Carefully lift off the plastic wrap with a paring knife and discard.  Rinse the rice with water, cover the bowl with a damp cloth, and let soak for 1 to 2 hours, or until completely cooked.  Remove the rice bowl from the heat and cool to near room temperature, about 15 to 30 minutes.  Break the fish into bite sized pieces.  Heat a heavy deep pot over medium high heat.  Sprinkle the fish balls with salt and place in the hot pot.

Random Ingredients: gingersnap cooky,vidalia onion,cranberry juice,self raising flour,seasoning salt,egg substitute,bamboo skewer
title: Homemade Cranberry Sausages
ingredients: 4 cups cranberry juice | 1 medium vidalia onion | 1 large egg substitute | 1/2 cup fat free egg substitute | 1/2 cup quick cooking oats ( not instant! ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 japanese pickled gingernap cookie
instructions: Dice onion to 1/4 inch cubes and place in mixing bowl.  Bring cranberry juice to a boil in a large saucepan while making egg mixture.  Add onion and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes.  Place onion and egg substitute in a food processor and process until slightly fluffy.  Add oatmeal, salt, and seasoning salt and process until oatmeal is fine and well mixed.  Fold in cranberry mixture in half into the mixture and mix well.  Add more cranberry juice if the mixture is too thick.  Pinch off little ping pong sized pieces of mixture and roll into balls.  Chill for 30 minutes prior to cooking to allow flavour to develop.

title: Pork Salad With Parsnips and Peppers
ingredients: 600 g pork shoulder, skin on | 4 medium parsnips, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 125 g green bell peppers, thinly sliced | 4 wooden skewers
instructions: Cut the pork into 3 inch strips.  Using a sharp knife cut through the base of the parsnips into a cross.  Toss with the sugar to combine.  Place the pork in a shallow bowl place the vegetables of your choice on the pork, and use your hands to press the meat.  Poke skewers through it all.  Thread 3 skewers through the pork allowing 4 pieces per skewer.  The meat will be slightly flattened, slightly moist.  Grill over preheated grill until cooked to your liking and golden brown.  Remove when cooked to your liking.

title: Pasta with Peas and Rigatoni (Pasta With Noodles)
ingredients: 2 cups cold water | 1 1/2 lbs rigatoni pasta or 1 1/2 lbs penne pasta | 3 cups frozen peas, thawed ( or fresh corn, peas or corn of your choice ) | cayenne powder, dash
instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a large frying pan.  Add the pasta, stirring to separate them as they cook.  Boil, uncovered for 20 - 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Drain pasta and peas, reserving 1/4 cup cooking liquid.  Bring reserved liquid to a simmer in another large frying pan, and add 1 teaspoon of cayenne powder, stir in peas and cook 1 minute, then remove from the heat and toss to warm.  Serve the pasta with warm peas on the side, sprinkle with more cayenne and lots of the pepper.  Note, you might want to add another 1/4 teaspoon of cayenne powder to the peas when you add the pasta and other ingredients.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,oat,fish stock,curry paste,cardamom seed,grain mustard,pork shoulder
title: Sydney Meat Salad
ingredients: 1 cup shredded pork shoulder | 3/4 cup cooked bean sprouts | 2 teaspoons raw whole grain mustard | 2 tablespoons curry paste, more if you like it mild | 2 -4 tablespoons fish stock | 1 -2 teaspoon cardamom seeds, black | 1 tablespoon whole oats, un-grated
instructions: Heat a large frying pan on a medium high heat.  Add the pork and cook, stirring frequently, for 4 - 5 minutes until it has the texture of ground meat.  Lower the heat to medium and add the bean sprouts, mustard, curry paste, stock and cardamom seeds.  Stir well, cover, and cook for a further 5 - 7 minutes.  Remove from the heat and leave to stand for a couple of minutes.  Sprinkle with oats before serving.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coffee,lettuce leaf,sage derby cheese,ziti pasta,beef steak
title: Beef and Baked Pasta on the Grill
ingredients: 400 g ziti pasta | 1 lb lean beef steaks or 1 lb top round steak, thinly sliced | 16 slices sage derby cheese | 1 cup coffee or 1 cup cream | shredded lettuce leaf
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or electric griddle.  Cook pasta according to directions on packet.  Tip, to make sure it doesn`t become too crisp, put a piece of aluminium foil between the foil and the pan, if it does, the moisture from the cheese will run out.  Spread the steaks with some beef fat and bake in a hot oven, 200 degrees c, for 8 to 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, warm the coffee or cream over a medium heat.  To serve, arrange three thinly sliced cheese on a serving plate.  Put a slice of steak in the centre of each plate and top with a slice of cheese.  Put the beef on the grill and heat through for 3 to 5 minutes.  Serve with the pasta.

title: Yautia French Toast
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 yam, peeled and cubed | 4 tablespoons cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 small lime
instructions: Cut the baguette into 5 inch slices and place in a medium bowl.  Mix cottage cheese and rum together.  Add yam, mix together and coat.  Heat a skillet with a bit of oil, and cook the yam mixture.  When golden brown, turn with a spatula and heat the other side in the same skillet.  Serve with some extra marinade.

title: Indian Beef Fry
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground beef | 2 eggs, beaten | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 1/2 cups unbleached white flour | 1 envelope active dry yeast or ( 100 mg ) envelope fast rising yeast ( 3 g ) | 1 large green chili
instructions: Brown beef in a large nonstick frypan until no pink remains.

title: Italian Ziti
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 3 cups fresh baby spinach | 2 oranges and bell peppers, cut into wedges
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add ziti and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Creamy Cabbage & Sauerkraut
ingredients: 3 cups green beans, rinsed | 2 lbs sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 6 cups shredded green apples | 8 cups hot cooked long grain rice or 8 cups hot cooked polenta
instructions: Bring a large kettle of water to boil.  Add the beans and sauerkraut and boil 2 minutes.  Turn onto a large plate, drain well and mix with apples.  Add hot rice, or mix with cooked polenta according to the package directions.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Pear and Pepper Spread
ingredients: 1 -2 fresh pear half ( depending on size ) | 16 ounces mustard seeds ( depending on size )
instructions: Peel pear halves and cut off all of the pulp.  Set aside.  Grind and peel fresh peels as smooth as possible.  Put into mixing bowl and add mustard seeds, mix well.  Add pepper seeds.  Stir well.  Add the pear mixture and blend well for a smoother paste.  Transfer to a sterilized canning jar.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,vanilla essence,salmon fillet,dill sprig,sage leaf,button mushroom,pineapple juice,onion soup mix
title: Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked salmon fillets, skin on | 1 packet dried onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 tablespoon dried dill sprigs | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 can chopped pineapple slices in juice | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1/4 cup crushed natural low-fat evaporated milk or 1/4 cup canned low-fat evaporated milk
instructions: Combine salmon, onion soup mix, chilli powder, dill, sage, pineapple, vanilla, evaporated milk and salmon in an ovenproof dish.  Pour pineapple mixture on top if using.  Cook at 180c for approximately 50 minutes or until salmon is cooked through and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,saffron,mushroom beef gravy,cake,sage,brown mustard seed
title: Smoky Roasted Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 6 poblano peppers | saffron, a few drops of | 4 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 16 ounces mushroom beef gravy | 12 slices cake | 1/2 teaspoon sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Clean poblanos and slit lengthwise into 1/2 inch wide strips.  Insert a couple of zest slivers of brown mustard seed in each poblano strip.  Place the poblanos on a sheet of parchment paper.  Pour brown mustard seeds all around them, keeping them attached if needed, so they sizzle and turn black.  Place poblanos in oven and roast for 15 minutes, turning them around after 15 minutes.  Remove the poblanos from the oven.  When halfway through the roasting time, carefully transfer the poblanos to a plastic bag and close bag.  Refrigerate.  When poblanos are done, remove paper and all fat with poblanos from bag.  Heat a small dry fry pan over medium heat.  When you can smell the smoke, it's ready.  Using the dry fry pan, dry fry the powder an saffron a few drops of brown mustard seed in it.  Immediately, toss the poblanos a few times.  Do not over crowed the peppers.  Place poblanos in the oven for 10 minutes.  They should not have any colour on them, but they should still give off their aroma.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,heavy whipping cream,beef bouillon,hard egg,clam juice,alfredo sauce,cider vinegar,carrot
title: Deluxe Cabot Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 cups freshly squeezed heavy whipping cream | 1 dash of chicken bouillon ( optional and if you want a'soft'cheese sauce-you may add a dash of sugar to the sauce ) | 1 lb sirloin steak, thinly sliced ( any meat should be sliced to desired thickness ) | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 cup alfredo sauce or 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 3/4 cup sliced carrot, cut into matchstick size | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cherries in juice | 1/4 cup sliced hard-boiled egg | pickled garlic clove ( or chopped fresh garlic ) ( optional )
instructions: In a 3 cup glass measure stir together the whipping cream, vinegar, and chicken bouillon if using it.  Set aside.  Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the cream.  Set aside.  Over medium high heat, lightly brown beef and carrots.  Add the cream mixture and cook 1 minute, stirring to coat the meat.  Bring to boil over high heat, reduce heat to medium, and cover.  Simmer for about 5 to 7 minutes, until meat is hot.  Add the alfredo.  Cook for another 5 minutes, stirring to avoid any over cooking into the meat.  Add the cherry tomatoes and stir.  Serve over noodles, rice or noodles with a garnish of sliced hard boiled egg, if desired.  A nice touch would be to add a splash of garlic, then a fresh clove of garlic if desired.

title: Autumn Apple Pumpkin Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup pure pumpkin puree | 1/3 cup kahlua | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored, diced | 1/4 pound fresh pumpkin seeds or almonds, roasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a large bowl, mash half and half, pumpkin puree, and kahlua together until smooth and creamy.  Combine half and half and apple and mix with pumpkin mixture about 1 minute over medium low heat.  Transfer casserole to a 9x13 inch baking dish and sprinkle with half of the roasted almonds.  Bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Farfalle Pasta
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 cup pineapple juice, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook farfalle in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,ham,dark chocolate,hot pepper,spring onion
title: St George's Day Hot & Sweet Chilli Dogs
ingredients: 180 g sliced ham | 4 -6 small hot peppers | 2 spring onions ( scallions ) | 200 g dark chocolate or 200 g milk chocolate, melted | 1/3 cup virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat the grill or frying pan to high.  Line the base of an oven tray with baking paper.  Cut each hot pepper in half lengthways and remove seeds and membrane.  Discard the seeds and membrane.  Place them on the lined tray, cut side down.  Place the hot peppers over the peppers, then season lightly.  Brush each slice with the melted chocolate, then wrap the ham slices in aluminium foil and put in the preheated oven.  Grill for 8 - 10 minutes until golden, turning occasionally.  Wrap the spring onions in a clean tea towel.  Place the hot pepper halves under the foil and return to the oven for a further 3 minutes to soften slightly.  Brush with the oil and keep warm.  Remove the foil and hot peppers from the oven and place under a grill or frying pan.  Grill for 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until just turning dark.  Remove the pepper halves and slice into strips.  Remove and discard the spring onion skins.

title: French White Beans with Olives and Buttermilk
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 pound dried white beans, rinsed | 1 jar pitted kalamata olives, drained | 1/4 cup diced kalamata olives
instructions: In a medium bowl mix buttermilk, vanilla, and beans.  Cover, and refrigerate.  Preheat grill for high heat.  Place bean mixture in a large casserole dish, and sprinkle with olives.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes in the preheated grill, until bubbly.

title: Almond  Phyllo Sticks( Vegan )
ingredients: 12 ounces sour cream or 12 ounces greek yogurt | 1 cup hot water | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 3 tablespoons nuts, chopped
instructions: The night before work place the sour cream or yoghurt in fridge for 10 minutes or so until smooth & creamy.  Warm the hot water on the stovetop w/o the honey & set aside.  Combine the yeast w/the warm yoghurt & almond & mix well.  Add the herbs & stir until well mixed.  Stir in the sour cream / yoghurt mixture & set aside to proof.  Stick into your fancy bread tin, cut into approx 3 pieces & put into fridge to firm or freeze to form sticks in later.

title: Baked Salmon With Mexican Topping
ingredients: 4 ounces country style white bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 4 skinless salmon fillets | 4 teaspoons packed light brown sugar | 4 teaspoons mexican blend cheese
instructions: In a bowl, toss butter with clove and place in a shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish.  Add bread cubes and toss to coat.  Stir in sugar.  Dot with fish.  Bake at 400f degrees f.  For 12 minutes or until fish flakes with a fork.  Top with cheese.

Random Ingredients: cream,cola,dark brown sugar,garlic clove,fennel bulb,pistachio nut,jicama
title: Spicy Thai Jicama Salad (Or Tossed Dressing)
ingredients: 2 fennel bulbs, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup pistachio nut, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons sour cream | 6 ounces jicama, thinly sliced | 2 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 cup cola
instructions: In a large salad bowl combine the fennel, pistachios, sour cream, jicama and brown sugar.  Pour in the cola, and toss.  Adjust seasoning, adding more brown sugar if necessary.

title: Cauliflower and Feta Spread
ingredients: 500 g cauliflower, small florets | 300 -400 g feta | 3 tablespoons green peppercorns | 50 g superfine sugar
instructions: Cut off and discard large stems from cauliflower.  Cut the cauliflower into florets using scissors or a knife.  Place the florets in a pan.  Add cold water to cover and bring to the boil.  Turn heat down to a simmer and cook for 10 - 15 minutes or until florets are soft when picked up with a fork.  Put the drained cauliflower through a strainer into a bowl.  Add the cheese, peppercorns and superfine sugar and mix with a wooden spoon.  Add the hot water until the mixture reaches as thick as you want it, stirring to make sure the cheese does not burn.  Stir. Place cereal and pico de gallo, stirring in the parsley, raisins and seasoning to taste.  Makes 8 - 12 servings.

title: Artichoke Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon vinegar | shredded red pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a screw top jar.  Cover tightly with lid and shake until mixture is well blended.  To store for up to 3 days, remove and discard marinade.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,chicken broth,red curry paste,mustard seed,carrot
title: Red Curry Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb carrot, julienne cut | 1 can chicken broth | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, black | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a large pot, simmer carrot until tender but still firm, about 4 minutes.  Drain.  Transfer carrot to bowl, add broth, curry paste, and mustard seed.

title: Mock Beef Dip
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces cream cheese or 1 1/4 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into small cubes | 2 bay leaves | 2 teaspoons dill weed or 2 teaspoons fresh dill, minced | 1 1/4 cups soda water | 2 tablespoons hot sauce ( or to taste )
instructions: In bowl with a spoon, combine cheeses, bay leaves and dill weed.  Add soda water.  Mix well.  Slowly blend in hot sauce.  Serve with crackers or on hamburger rolls.

title: Peppered Irish Smuggler's
ingredients: 1/3 cup quick-cooking oil | 5 large cloves | 1 1/2 cups shucked whole cloves | 3 1/4 cups shucked quince, with flesh | 1 cup black-eyed peas or 1 cup kidney beans, and liquid | 2 large sheets of parchment paper
instructions: Place the oil, cloves, and quince in a large dutch oven or heavy kettle.  Cover the pot with about 2 inches of water and bring to a boil over high heat.  Skim off the froth that rises to the top, then reduce the heat slightly to maintain a gentle simmer.  Cook for about 15 minutes.  Stir in the black eyed peas and cook for another 15 minutes or until the beans are tender.  Remove from the heat.  Place the paper sheets in a baking dish or shallow baking dish and pour the peeped mixture over them.  Wrap the pan tightly with foil and chill the peeped mixture at least for up to 2 days.  Remove the peeped mixture from the refrigerator and refrigerate for up to three weeks or freeze up to three months.  When ready to serve, bring the peeped mixture to a boil.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,curry paste,cocoa powder,white pepper
title: Easy Microwave Curried Baby Bok Choy
ingredients: 4 bunches baby bok choy, trimmed | 5 tablespoons low-sodium curry paste, such as korma | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder ( optional ) | 1 dash white pepper
instructions: Microwave the bok choy on high 3 to 4 minutes, or until bright green and slightly tender.  Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together 1 tablespoon of curry paste, unsweetened cocoa powder, and white pepper.  Stir in remaining curry paste and microwave on high 2 minutes.  Stir and microwave for 15 to 30 seconds more, or until heated through and beginning to brown.

title: Quick and Easy Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef brisket | 1/4 cup raisins | 2 salmon steaks ( i prefer red- eye ) | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro ( chopped )
instructions: Place brisket in a crock pot set as low as possible.  In small bowl sprinkle raisins over brisket.  Add 1/2 cup fresh cilantro for garnish.  Cover and cook on high 6 hours.  After removing brisket, remove brisket and place in serving platter and keep warm.  Skim the fat from the pan juices, return liquid to the pan juices and simmer over high until slightly reduced.  Pour liquid over brisket, sprinkle with remaining fresh cilantro, cover and allow to cool for 20 minutes.  This will thicken slightly as it cools.  Cut into thin slices.  To serve, ladle broth into a serving bowl, place a piece of brisket on top, pour broth and raisins over meat and garnish with cilantro sprigs or fresh parsley for garnish.  Serve with hot rice or noodles.

title: Quinoa With Chocolate
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/4 cup lemon juice ( from the zest of the lemons ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened chocolate | 2 cups radishes ( or more )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a sauce pan and bring to boil.  Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.  Remove from heat, stir in chocolate and radishes.  Cover and refrigerate for about half an hour or until completely cold and set up.  Variation, this would be great with grated espresso or espresso beans.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,basil leaf,hot salsa,ladyfinger,extra virgin olive oil,button mushroom,liquid smoke,cooking oil
title: Pista Press (Portuguese Ladyfingers)
ingredients: 1 cup prepared hot salsa | 12 pieces ladyfingers | 1 1/2 cups very thinly sliced button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves ( italian basil is best ) | 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke ( portuguese-style smoke is preferred ) | 1 kaffir lime leaf, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Put the hot spanish ladyfingers in a shallow dish.  Pour warm salsa over the ladyfingers.  Sprinkle mushrooms, basil, and oil over the scallions.  Press down lightly.  Put the kaffir in a small bowl and squeeze the lime leaf over it.  Drizzle the lime juice over all.  Set aside while the paprika presses work.  Heat 2 tablespoons of oil over high heat in a skillet or sauté pan.  When the oil is about 1/4 inch, put in the paprika press and, when it begins to colour, put in the mushroom press.  Sprinkle with a little salt.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,fruit,salt black pepper,ginger,chive,sesame seed,italian tomato,currant
title: Mixed Fruit Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons dried currants | 1/2 cup mixed fruit ( currants, cranberries, strawberries ) | 2 cups seeded diced italian tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh ginger | 3 slices whole wheat bread, toasted | salt & freshly ground black pepper | fresh chives, snipped for garnish
instructions: Toast sesame seeds in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring, until fragrant.  Cool seeds completely.  Combine sesame seeds, currants, mixed fruit, tomatoes, ginger and some salt and pepper to taste in a bowl.  Spread on toast slices and sprinkle with chives.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Sugar Snap Pea Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes, packed in oil | 2 teaspoons sugar snap peas ( i use regular peas ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 - 1/3 cup catsup, for heat ( or more to taste ) | 1/4 cup crumbled queso blanco, for top
instructions: Slice tomatoes into strips about 1/8 inch thick.  Heat a wok or large, deep skillet over medium high heat.  Stir fry the sun dried tomatoes in the oil until they just start to turn golden.  Add the snap peas and ground cloves until they're brightly colored.  Stir fry another minute.  Add your desired amount of sugar snap peas.  Stir fry another 2 - 3 minutes.  Add your cooked tomatoes.  Stir fry another 2 - 3 minutes until tomatoes are soft, but not mushy.  Mix in your curry powder and catsup.  Continue to stir fry an additional 3 minutes, until mixture is well blended.  Serve immediately with extra queso blanco.

title: Pork, Pork, & Peas
ingredients: 1 cup chopped dried apricot | 1 cup chopped fresh dill weed | 12 pepperoni slices, halved | 6 boneless pork roast | 3 cups green beans, halved | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( to taste ) | 1 lb of sliced fresh meatballs or 1 lb bulk pork rinds
instructions: Place apricots and dill weed in a shallow bowl, and cover with approximately 1/2 cup water.  Cover and chill, about 1/2 hour.  Heat grill pan to medium heat and lightly oil grate.  Set meat aside, and combine with remaining marinade ingredients except for the meat, and bring to a boil.  Cook, stirring often, about 4 minutes per side until crisp.  Place meatballs on a foil lined baking sheet, and top with cooked apricots, if desired, and beans.  Make a slit in the center of the lamb, and stuff with pepperoni slices and some meat.

title: Tried Almonds for Christmas
ingredients: 2 lbs blanched almonds, unhusked | 1 1/2 lbs mixed spice, such as cinnamon, cloves, cloves | 2 ounces lard ( or oil )
instructions: Spread the almonds in a deep pan and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: raisin,margarine,chicken breast,cumin seed,white wine vinegar,vanilla extract
title: Moroccan-Spiced Marinated Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts ( about 10 ounces total weight ) | 2 tablespoons margarine, melted | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/3 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla extract | 1/3 cup raisins
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f.  Toss 6 chicken breasts with 1 tablespoon margarine, 1 teaspoon cumin, 1/3 cup vinegar, vanilla and 1/3 cup raisins in bowl.  Arrange in single layer in large roasting pan in single layer.  Pour boiling water into pan.  Bake for 35 minutes or until thermometer registers 170f for fat, juices run clear and chicken is crisp and cooked.  Meanwhile, combine remaining 2 tablespoons margarine, remaining 1 teaspoon cumin, remaining 1/3 cup vinegar, vanilla and 1/3 cup raisins in small skillet.  Cook over medium low heat 2 to 3 minutes or until mixture boils, stirring.  Boil, stirring, 1 minute.  Pour over chicken.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,self rising flour,bacon,lemongrass,chicken wing
title: Lemongrass Crusted Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 lemon grass | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 2 kg chicken wings ( wingettes ) or 2 kg chicken drumsticks ( drumsticks ) | 8 slices bacon, rind removed | 1 liter self-rising flour
instructions: For the drumsticks, trim the root end and then cut the drumsticks in half lengthways.  In this case, throw out the tough sections of the legs, the fibrous sections and the thin membrane of the membrane.  Trim them all the way round the joints at joints, then take the section holding the drumsticks straight across at the joint you should have 6 drumsticks approximately 5 inches long, which is approximately 1 inch in length.  Trim and cut away the hard bottom end of the rind and cut off approximately 1 1/2 inches of the top 5 inches of green portion.  Cut the rind and membrane away from you if there is any membrane and discard the outer layers.  Cut the strips into approximately 5 inch lengths and then cut them into a length of about 12 inches length and then all the length of that length.  Wash and pat dry the chicken pieces and pat dry.  Place the strips on a tray with a small piece of parchment paper and cover with a dish towel.  Put the dish towel in the fridge to chill.  For the criss cross casserole, in a small bowl, mix together the lemon grass, lime zest, juice and chicken breast and then coat the chicken in the batter.  Place in the fridge to chill for about 15 minutes.  Preheat the oven to 200 c or 400°f.  Fry the bacon in a large frypan for about 10 minutes until crispy.  Drain on paper towel.  Put the flour in a bowl and gradually add about half the water and enough cold water to form soft dough.  Roll out the dough to about 6cm thick.  Cut out 10 fingers and dip each piece of chicken in the flour and then shake off any excess.  Put the fingers on top of each other on the tray until all the chicken is covered.  Make sure the chicken sticks well to the hands.  Put in the oven for about 30 minutes, or until the chicken has turned golden brown.  For the criss cross casserole, in a large saute pan over medium heat, fry the bacon until crispy.  Drain on paper towel.  Put the chicken in the crisscross casserole dish and top with criss cross casserole.

title: Cocktel à L’escargot
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 -2 cup chicken stock
instructions: In a large stockpot, bring ½ cup of water to a boil.  Add shrimp, cook one minute, and remove shrimp with slotted spoon.  Repeat step 6 with remaining water, stock, and shrimp.  Cover and simmer until shrimp are cooked and tender, about 15 minutes depending on size of shrimp.

title: Caribbean Meat Patties
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3/4 cup unsweetened pineapple juice ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dry-roasted unsalted peanuts | 1 lb ground pork
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Mix flour and turmeric together in a large bowl.  Add pineapple juice, if desired.  Mix lightly.  Stir in peanuts.  Stir in ground pork.  Shape into 6 patties, 1 - ½ cup meat per patty.  Place in a nonstick baking pan and bake for about 20 minutes.  My personal favorite is to bake them in a shallow fry pan over medium heat for about 15 minutes, and then turn them over and bake another 15 minutes.  My oven is a little spongy but it does cook the meat well and the fat doesn't burn.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,chicken bouillon granule,thyme sprig,dark soy sauce
title: Rich and Creamy Roasted Chicken Bites
ingredients: 6 tablespoons extra thick dark soy sauce | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | fresh thyme sprig ( garnish ) | freshly ground mixed arabic ( breadcrumbs or plain white breadcrumbs )
instructions: Combine soy sauce and bouillon in a small shallow baking dish, then sprinkle over thyme.  Let stand 20 minutes.  Preheat oven to 375°f spread the mixed bread crumbs on a baking sheet and lightly pat.  Place chicken on baking dish and spread each with some soy sauce.  Roast until chicken is cooked through, about 1 hour 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,cocktail onion,beef stew meat,rotel tomato chilies,red potato,thai fish sauce,chicken
title: Kelesby's  Grilled Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 20 small red potatoes | 20 medium cocktail onions | 15 whole green chili peppers | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 12 small cans tomato sauce | 3 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: First put your stew meat in the crock and put in your big crock pot.  Cut the potatoes in half and put in the crock pot.  Pour all the can goods over the beef that has been in there for about 3 hours.  When that has been in the crock pot put on a plate, and then start putting your food in the plate.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,plum jam,double cream,cream cheese,black olive,breadcrumb
title: Plum Pasta
ingredients: 5 tablespoons plum jam, warmed ( or more ) | 2/3 cup double cream | 1 lb rotini pasta | 7 ounces cream cheese | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1 large black olives, pitted and minced ( optional )
instructions: Remove tough muscle tabs on outside of spaghetti.  Prepare pasta according to recipe direction and set aside.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  In a heatproof bowl, combine jam with cream, stirring until melted and warmed.  Combine pasta with cheese and spread in a greased ovenproof dish.  Top with bread crumbs, then spread with cheese mixture.  Sprinkle olives on top.  Bake for about 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,baby spinach,chicken broth,sesame oil,plum,cake flour,cellophane noodle,sparkling water
title: Sizzling Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 package paper-thin spaghetti or angel hair macaroni, broken into 3/4 inch pieces | 6 ounces dry cake flour | 1 can chicken broth ( or vegetable broth ) | 1/3 cup sparkling water | 2 tablespoons grated cheddar cheese | 1 cup fresh baby spinach, rinsed, dried well, and halved ( or any fresh vegetable )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Cook pasta in boiling water until just tender.  Meanwhile, heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.  Add spaghetti and cook until golden, about 1 minute.  Stir in 1 cup chicken broth, sparkling water, and sesame oil.  Bring to boil.  Remove from heat.  Spread half the noodles in a greased 13 x9 inch baking dish, and spread evenly with spinach.  Sprinkle with 1 cup cheddar cheese.  Repeat with remaining noodles, spinach, and cheese.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Aubergine Linguine
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 4 cups aubergines, sliced | 2 cups mangoes, diced
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions.  Meanwhile, place aubergines and mangoes in a bowl.  Drain linguine and add to aubergines and mangoes.  Toss lightly so that all the ingredients are coated in mixture.  Serve right away.

title: Danish Eggplant
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, sliced lengthwise and crosswise | 2 cans tomato ketchup
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place sliced eggplant in a 10 x 15 inch baking dish and coat with ketchup.  Cover with foil and bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Uncover and bake for 20 minutes longer until lightly browned and eggplant is slightly tender.

title: Spanish Tomato and Pepper Pizza Dough
ingredients: 3 ounces tomato paste | 1 ounce whole wheat flour or 1 ounce cake-and-pastry flour | 3 ounces mixed dried fruit | 5 ounces of finely diced bell peppers | 4 ounces of diced roasted peppers
instructions: Sauté the diced peppers in a non stick frying pan until softened and slightly coloured.  Mix the tomato paste with the flour and add gradually to the frying pan.  When the mixture begins to thicken up quickly add the sun dried tomatoes and mix well.  Add the bell peppers, mix well.  When the pizzas are on a rolling surface, roll out each piece into a circle and then into a 6 inch circle on a lightly buttered pizza peel.  Cut the pizzas into four and place on the peel with the pizza base.  Bake in a pre heated oven at 220°c for 10 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,dill weed,pizza sauce,mustard seed,tamari,asafoetida powder
title: Homemade Chicken Wings With Sambal Overnight
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings | 2 1/2 cups tama | 14 ounces pizza sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 3/8 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Line a baking tin with aluminum foil.  With scissors, split open wings at joint.  Remove excess fat.  Score skin lengthwise in 5 or 6 strips across the top.  Place wings in a large casserole dish.  In bowl, combine pizza sauce, mustard seeds, asafoetida and dill.  Pour over wings and toss to coat.  Bake, covered, 1 hour.  Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,green capsicum,tomato juice,beef liver,cranberry,pancake noodle,corn oil,italian sausage
title: Craned Sausage & Beef Liver Salad With Pancake Noodle Cratter
ingredients: 200 g beef liver, thinly sliced | 200 g sweet italian sausage, sliced | 400 g pancake noodles | 1 green capsicum, sliced | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 cup cranberries, washed | gluten-free rice vinegar
instructions: Drain the pancake noodles, rinse under cold water and set aside.  Cook sausages and liver in a large frying pan in the oil, stirring until cooked.  Remove from the pan, cut into pieces and place on paper towel to cool.  Cut capsicum into slices | 2 cm cubes and place on the noodles.  Toss to coat well with oil.  Heat through, toss once and set aside.  Toss the sauce ingredients together.  To serve, place salad, sausage and liver on individual plates and top with the noodles mixture.  Garnish with cranberries.

title: Mexican Chicken with Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 box long grain brown rice ( mccormick long grain brown rice is the best to use ) | 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 1 can tomatoes, with jalapenos and jalapenos in season ( drain juice from can )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.  Meanwhile, remove chicken from packaging and place it in the skillet with the juice from the tomatoes.  Add the jalapenos and bring to a boil.  Add chicken and cook until no longer pink.  Drain chicken and return to skillet.  Drain tomatoes.  Return to heat and reduce heat.  Serve over brown rice.

title: Blackberry and Gruyere Cheese Pumpernickel Rounds
ingredients: 1 bag fresh blackberries | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 415 degrees f.  Line two 3 to 4 ounce ramekins with parchment paper.  Cut a slice off the tops of the blackberries, keeping the blackberries for later use.  Place the ramekin bottoms in a roasting pan and spread the gruyere cheese evenly over them.  Spoon about 1 tablespoon of the blackberries evenly into each ramekin.  Bake the pumpernickel for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the cheese is bubbling.  Set aside to cool slightly before serving.

title: Frangelico With Goose
ingredients: 2 goose, legs and thighs | 2 packets dijon mustard | 18 basil leaves | 10 -12 fresh basil leaves | 3 cups hot cooked spaghetti
instructions: Cut goose into serving pieces.  Arrange skin side down on rack in broiler pan.  Bake at 400ºf.  For 12 to 15 minutes, or until meat is brown and crispy.  Brush often with dijon mustard.  Add basil and hot cooked spaghetti.  Continue to bake for an additional 5 minutes.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: crab,taco seasoning,button mushroom,grain white rice,italian plum tomato,cauliflower,corn,chive
title: Italian Seafood Stuffed Mushrooms & Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup sweet corn | 2 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 1/2 cup frozen cauliflower | 1/2 cup canned corn | 1 1/2 cups canned italian plum tomatoes | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning, with basil and garlic ( the milder the saltiness ) | 1/4 cup snipped fresh chives or 1/4 cup green onion top | 2 boxes imitation crab, cooked and drained
instructions: Boil the rice in water with taco seasoning over medium heat.  Stir, cover and set aside.  Bring a pot of salted water to boil, add the rice and cauliflower, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender but firm to the bite.  Drain the rice cauliflower and rice, and let it sit while cooking the shrimp mixture.  Cut the tomatoes into pieces and set aside.  Remove the cauliflower from the water, and rinse under warm water.  Drain and set aside.  Crack the crab in the bowl of a food processor and whiz to fine crumbs.  Toss everything together, except the shrimp, in a large bowl.  Mix in the cooked shrimp mixture.  Stuff the mushrooms with the rice and cauliflower mixture, making sure it is completely surrounded by crumbs.  If not, refrigerate the stuffing and shrimp mixture for a few hours to soften before serving.  Note, i don't like hot stuff or overcooked shrimp like i do when i make these, which tends to overpower any seafood.

title: Anamatic (Sour Rice Balls with Apricots)
ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice | 1 pint apricot, chopped
instructions: Cover rice with water and bring to boil over high heat.

title: Chili Dogs
ingredients: 1/4 cup guacamole | 1/4 cup chile sauce | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper | 1 can creamed corn ( drained ) | 8 ounces chocolate chips | 1 apple ( peeled, cored and diced ) | 8 fiddleheads ( fried )
instructions: Spoon 1/4 cup guacamole over the top and sprinkle with chili & black ground pepper.  Place on a plate cover & refrigerate until ready to serve.  Top with the remaining guacamole.  Combine the creamed corn and chocolate chips & spread over the creamed corn, followed by apple & fiddleheads.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,virgin olive oil,cauliflower,corn,tarragon,parsnip,tart apple,cardamom pod
title: Moroccan Apples With Parsnips and Crisp Parsnips
ingredients: 2 lbs rutabagas, peeled and each rutabagas cut crosswise into quarters | 5 tart apples, preferably good quality | 1 1/2 lbs cauliflower, cut into small florets | 2 tins cauliflower, cut into thin florets | 2 parsnips, cut crosswise into thin florets | 1/2 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped tarragon | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 5 cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Prepare all ingredients and place in a 4 quart stainless steel saucepan.  Add enough water to just cover and cook over high heat, stirring often, for 10 minutes.  Turn heat to medium.  Cover and boil 10 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender.  Drain well and set aside.  Meanwhile, place apples in a small saucepan with cold water.

title: Green Chile-Avocado Barley Smoothie
ingredients: 2 ripe avocados, peeled and mashed | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 tablespoon molasses | 2 ounces barley ( i use yellow rice or brown rice )
instructions: In a blender whirl all ingredients until smooth.

title: Barley Soup (Kabaybah)
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley or 2 cups wild rice, cooked | 6 -8 cups hot milk or 6 -8 cups soup stock | 2 slices limes
instructions: Place all ingredients in a soup pot.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to very low and cook for about about 2 - 3 hours or until barley or quinoa is tender.  Allow soup to cool for about 10 - 15 minutes.  Sieve soup with an immersion blender.  Return liquid to the empty pot with a teaspoon.  Stir gently until the liquid is used up.  Add more water if needed to thin soup. .  Serve hot.  Note, this soup can be served alone or with a fried chicken or sausage flavored crumbled with the other ingredients.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,yogurt,swiss cheese,grapeseed oil,duck,yellow pepper ring,green chilies,pistachio
title: Duck Party
ingredients: 1 lb duck, skin on | 1/4 cup grapeseed oil | 1 can chopped green chilies | 2 tablespoons ground pistachios | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 cup dry yogurt ( optional ) | 2 yellow pepper rings | 3 cups swiss cheese ( shredded )
instructions: In a large skillet, brown duck skin and oil.  Stir in green chilies, pistachios and bouillon.  Cook until liquid comes to boil.  Stir in yogurt.  Top with pepper rings, and place cheese in the center of the dish.  Place duck into oven, and cook in 350 oven until meat thermometer registers 170° for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: white bread flour,chickpea,chili powder,mozzarella cheese,cayenne pepper,orange,beef stew meat,button mushroom
title: Pizza Burgers
ingredients: 2 lbs beef and mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/4'cubes | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 lb button mushroom, cut into 1/4'slices | 1/2 cup chopped orange ( i sometimes get this from a can of orange peel ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | white bread flour, for coating pan | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, coarsely shredded
instructions: Drain cheese on paper towels.  Pat the cheese dry.  Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl except flour and cheese, making sure to mix well.  Add the flour, about half a cup at a time, stirring and kneading.  Divide mixture on baking sheets.  Roll into balls and then cut into 1/4 slices across.  Arrange bread slices on pizza pans.  Bake at 425°f for 25 minutes or until nicely browned.

title: Alaskan Oatmeal
ingredients: 4 cups quick-cooking rolled oats | 2 -4 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced
instructions: Combine the oats and jalapenos thoroughly in a 9x5x3 inch baking dish. .  Spread mixture evenly in baking dish, and sprinkle with additional chopped jalapenos if desired.  Bake in moderate oven until topping is lightly browned and bubbly, about 30 min.

title: Vegetable and Horseradish Croutons
ingredients: 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 12 ounces small white mushrooms | 1 loaf rye bread
instructions: Spread 2 tablespoons of horseradish onto the cut side of the bread.  Sprinkle with a little salt.  Spread the remainder of the horseradish onto the bread so that both halves have a good light coating of horseradish.  The bread should be just slightly flat.  Set aside.  Peel and slice the mushrooms.  Toast the bread in the oven or over a hot grill.  When it is golden underneath, turn and toast the other side.

title: Nettle With Chips and Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 large tomatoes, cored and sliced | 1/2 cup shallot, minced | 3 tablespoons pimientos, chopped | 1 can tomato puree | 1 lb linguine | 6 ounces banana, sliced
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling water until al dente, rinse w/hot water and drain well.  While linguine is cooking, peel and slice up tomatoes.  Set aside.  Mince shallots and mushrooms.  Add in pimientos, tomato puree and diced bananas.  Mix tomato mixture into cooked linguine and sprinkle w/mexican or toasted ground nuts.  Enjoy.

title: Tuna Nachos With Avocado
ingredients: 1 can tuna in water, drained | 4 large hass avocados | 1 -2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | tortilla chips, for serving
instructions: Cut the avocado in half, remove pit and scoop out the white flesh.  Place the scooped out flesh into a bowl then mash with a fork until it's creamy.  Mash in a couple of tbsps of the tabasco.  Place the tuna on a large platter or bowl.  Using 1/4 cup of the tuna mash, layer the tuna mash, avocado avocado mixture and tortilla chips to serve.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,tortilla chip,ramen noodle,italian tomato,bacon dripping,apple,orange zest
title: Sicilian Noodle Side Dish (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons bacon drippings, plus more for brushing | 6 tablespoons bacon fat, plus more for brushing | 7 ounces diced italian tomatoes | 1 medium apple, peeled and chopped | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 8 ounces crushed tortilla chips | 16 ounces ramen noodles or 16 ounces spaghetti | dark chocolate
instructions: Heat bacon drippings in a large skillet.  Add tomatoes and their liquid, and heat to boiling.  Cook for 5 minutes, or until liquid has thickened slightly.  Stir in the orange zest.  Cook noodles for 3 minutes, or until tender and drain.  Coat skillet with a thin layer of peanut oil.  Add bacon and cook for 1 minute more, being careful not to burn.  Remove bacon with a slotted spoon.  In same skillet, melt butter.  Add ramen noodles and heat on both sides.  Serve noodles with warm sauce.  Garnish with melted chocolate.

title: Vietnamese Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs roast | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: Rub the roast with the fish sauce.  Wrap in plastic wrap and refridgerate overnight for best results on rare.  Heat up oven to 400°f.  Place the meat on a rack in a roasting pan and roast for 45 minutes or until browned and cooked as desired.  You can also cook the roast on a outdoor grill pan over medium heat for 20 minutes on each side or on the grill, depending on the temperature.  Remove the roast from the oven and let rest.  Slice the beef into strips, then return the juices to the pan.  Stir together the sauce and pepper and drizzle over the beef.

title: Cactus Rub

title: Linguine With Apple-Cambodian Salad

title: Cafe Rio Tofu Steamer(Beef, Tofu, & Tomatillo Sandwich)

instructions: In a glass bowl, stir cream, chili garlic sauce, and hot pepper sauce together until smooth.

title: Mexican Greens Salad

instructions: Place kale leaves in a steamer over boiling water.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,tartar sauce,mexican tomato,vermouth,monterey jack cheese,pasta sauce,black olive,flour tortilla
title: Cheese and Veggie Burritos
ingredients: 1 package pasta sauce ( i like bertolli ) | 12 flour tortillas, halved | 1 1/2 cups peas and carrots, fresh or frozen ( i use frozen ) | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes, chopped with liquid | 3 ounces grated monterey jack cheese or 3 ounces grated gruyere cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry vermouth or 1 1/2 teaspoons dry white wine | 1 jar hot pasta sauce, mild or regular | 12 ripe black olives, sliced | 12 slices crusty artisan-style bread or 12 slices other crusty bread

Uncover and heat in microwave until hot.  Place 2 slices of bread on a plate and spoon a small portion of sauce on it.  Spread some beans on the bread.  Place 2 slices of bread on top of each other.  Spoon 2 tablespoons hot sauce onto center or side of bread and put 3 tablespoons of cheese mixture on and around each bread slice.  Top the cheese with a third slice of bread.

title: Sake and Veggie Pasta Salad

title: Meat With Irish Whiskey Applesauce

instructions: Heat the broth to boiling in a medium saucepan over medium high heat.  Remove from the heat, add the whiskey, cilantro, and apple.

title: Perfect Patron Cocktail

instructions: Pour the tequila into a highball glass.  Stir the cheese into the glass to create a creamy layer.

Random Ingredients: butter bean,tea,margarine,baking soda,rotini pasta,chicken thigh fillet,fish
title: Fish and Noodles
ingredients: 400 g dried tri-colored fish, cleaned | 250 g tea ( rooibos ) | 80 g margarine ( softened ) | 1 -2 tablespoon teas ( flavoured ) | 500 g rotini pasta, cooked | 4 chicken thigh fillets, skin on, cut into thick strips | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons butter beans, mashed
instructions: Cut rind off fish and set aside to drain.  Cut the rind into shreds and place into bowl and add 1 tablespoon of the melted margarine.  Combine the fish rind with teas, and stir in the packet ingredients.  Pour mixture into a roaster tray and bake at 180c for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Tardine Broccoli Snack
ingredients: 1 package broccoli, ends trimmed | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons capers | 3/4 cup scallion, white and light green parts, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon cardamom pods | 2 drops red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Break the broccoli into florets and cook over medium high heat, just until the stem begins to flake off the leaf.  Immediately drain and put into a bowl of cold water until cool enough to handle, about 1 to 2 minutes.  Remove the tough, triangular stem ends with scissors and slice each section on a bias across the stalk.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Place the chopped broccoli into the boiling water, stir occasionally, and cook just until the stems are just crisp tender.  Drain and repeat with the remaining broccoli and cook for an additional 1 to 1 1/2 minutes.  Drain.  Drain well in a colander and return to the pot.  Measure the cornstarch into a cup, make a well in the center, add the remaining scallions and cardamom pods and, if using, the food coloring.  Stir until the coloring is consistent with a similar shade.  Slowly pour in the cornstarch mixture while whisking.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until the mixture begins to thicken, about 1 minute.  Remove the casserole from the heat and stir in the capers.  Drop the broccoli into the sauce.  Scoop out into a 9x13 inch baking dish lined with waxed paper, cover and chill for 3 to 5 minutes.  Uncover and sprinkle the scallions on top and serve.

title: Curry Lasagna Rollups

instructions: Mascarpone cheese filling, mix curry powder, mascarpone cheese and broccoli together.  Brush the lasagna with some water and lightly sprinkle with curry powder until the cover is no longer covering.

title: Calypso (Malaysian Shrimp Balls)

title: Sicilian Beef Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs rump roast | 5 tablespoons olive oil | 1 can tomato paste | 3/4 - 1 cup dry bow tie pasta | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 lb fresh linguine
instructions: Brown meat on all sides in hot olive oil.  Drain well.  In large pot combine tomato paste, 1/2 cup water, pasta, cayenne pepper, and cook over medium heat until tender.  Add meat and any accumulated juices.  Cover and simmer about 1 1/2 hours.  Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente and drain well.  Serve stew over heated pasta.

instructions: Cut the leeks into thin slices.  In a bowl, combine the first six ingredients.  In a 3 1/2 to 4 qt.  Stove, stir fry or microwave noodles.  Add the stew to the noodles & mix well.  Heat over medium heat, stirring often.  When stew is hot, remove from heat & serve in individual bowls with tomato salad or chopped tomato.

title: Spanish Roast Beef With Pits
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated dough rolls | 3/4 lb lean beef chuck, trimmed | 12 kalamata olives
instructions: Position a rack 3 inches from the broiler and heat over high heat.  If roast comes in netting, remove the netting.  With metal spatula, poke holes on top of roast 3 inches apart.  Spoon out fat and discard.  Cover netting with plastic wrap, pressing on roll to loosen.  Slide roast onto a rack set over a baking sheet.  Cover with plastic wrap and let stand for 5 minutes.  Transfer the beef to a platter and set aside.  Pits will form a crust as they cool.  Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight, turning the beef over after 5 hours.  Bring pot of salted water to a boil, lower heat and simmer beef 1 hour 10 minutes per pound, until very tender.  Transfer roast to a cutting board and set apart.  Toss together olives and reserved fat in a large bowl.  Slice meat and serve with olives and reserved fat as a gravy.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,dark soy sauce,amaretti cooky,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Amaretti Cookies - 2 Crescents
ingredients: 2/3 cup dark soy sauce ( or tamari ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons amaretti cookies | 3 cups vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 1/2 cups self raising flour
instructions: Blend the dark sauce and amaretti in a bowl until smooth.  Heat up the spray of oil in a wok or frypan over a medium/low heat.  Dough is ready when it pulls away from the sides, but the texture is still quite thick and slightly sticky/scalide like texture.  Stir through the flour just before placing the crescents in the heat proof paper.  The mixture will rise to the top of the pan.  Drop the cookies a few at a time, for 2 - 3 minutes to form a thin paste, taking care not to cook more than half of the cookies at a time.  Use two spoons to drop about a little dough onto each cake.  Leave to swell whilst you shape the remaining cookies using as much or little as you like.  Put on a piece of greaseproof paper, allowing the paper to hang over the sides of the cake, then leave in a warm place for another 15 - 20 minutes to dry.

title: Mango Dal

instructions: Slightly mash the lentils with the back of a wooden spoon.  Combine lentils and mango with the confectioners' sugar.

instructions: Using a vegetable peeler, remove stem and fat from beets leaving them intact. Mix well and set aside to marinate overnight.  Preheat oven to 400 deg f/200 deg celsius.  Brush brunede Kartofler with a little of the marinade.  Line a baking tray with tin foil and put half the beet slices in the centre.  Place the other beet slices over the beet, then drizzle with the remaining marinate.  Bake in the preheated oven for about 30 mintes.  Remove from the oven then place ham on top to serve hot.  Eat with a little lemon juice as you want.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350f/190c.

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook the bow tie pasta at a boil until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

title: Grilled Chicken Salad With Chunks
ingredients: 8 skinless chicken thighs | 10 ounces frozen curly dried currants | 1/3 cup catalina salad dressing mix, such as good seasons | 1/4 cup catsup | flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook the chicken in a skillet 10 minutes on each side and remove from the skillet to a bowl.  When cool enough to handle, remove the skin.  Cut the chicken into bite size pieces and set aside.  Place the currants into a saucepan along with the dressing mix.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and keep warm, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is slightly thickened.  Stir in catsup and parsley then transfer to the bowl with the chicken.  Serve salad with parsley.

title: Beef for Lovers on a Gas-Roasted Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds chuck roast | water to cover
instructions: Place chuck roast in a dutch oven or heavy pot, and fill with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and continue boiling until the roast is tender, about 1 hour.  Remove the roast to a cutting board, and place the pan into a 300 degree f oven to catch the drippings.  Skim surface residue from the cooking liquids to clean up the pan.  Place the dutch oven into a roaster set on top of the stove over medium heat.  Bring to a boil, then pour the molasses into the hot liquid.  Simmer and stirring often, until the gravy thickens and the liquid is reduced by half, about 1 hour.  Remove the roast from the oven and drain off the fat.  Heat an empty broiler safe skillet on high heat.  Place the roast onto a rack, place in the pan, and broil in the preheated oven until nicely browned and well browned on the bottom, 10 to 15 minutes.  Turn and broil until the entire outside of the meat is well browned and the juices run clear, about 15 more minutes.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees f.  Remove roast from oven, and let rest for about 10 minutes before slicing.  Slice, and serve.

title: Robust Italian Mini Rolls

instructions: Stir together the yeast and 3 tablespoons of the brown sugar in a large mixing bowl.  Add 1 cup of the italian bread crumbs and bread crumbs, then stir in the oil.  Add the zucchini and stir once.  Transfer the mixture to a greased, shallow sided large bowl, spreading it evenly over 2 1/2 cups of the bread crumbs.  Turn the dough out onto a floured cutting board.  Pat the dough into a rectangle 1/4 inch thick.  Sprinkle the remaining 3 tablespoons of brown sugar evenly over the crusts of the dough, then top with 2 to 3 zucchini slices.  Starting with one end, roll up the dough, jelly roll style and pinch off pieces of dough about 1 1/2 inches long and 3 inches long and 3 inches in diameter.  Sprinkle the loaf rolls with half the bread crumbs.  Arrange the breaded rolls, seam sides down, in a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish in two layers.  Cover the baking dish and set aside at room temperature for 1 hour.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Bake the rolls for 35 minutes, or until the bottoms are lightly browned and the tops are tinged with brown fleck.  Spray each piece of mozzarella with cooking spray.  Remove from the baking dish and sprinkle with remaining bread crumbs.  Cool 5 minutes, then serve.

title: Tin Cakes With Chilli, Lime And Chilli

title: Grilled Beef Kabobs With Horseradish and Pearl Vegetables

title: Mexican Chocolate Brownie Pizza

instructions: Mix together the prepared brownie mix and cornpeper berries.  Spread on the crust.  Sprinkle with chocolate.  Add olives.  You may need to add more or less cornmeal, depending on how dry it gets.

title: Zurie's Queso Blanco (Quick Mexican Cheese Ball)

Wrap and fry queso in paper towels until well browned.  Serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: Spicy Tuna Spread
ingredients: 12 ounces tuna in olive oil, drained ( i like king oscar's original tuna ) | 1/2 cup chili paste ( like sambal oelek ) | 12 ounces beer ( corona or modelo ) | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon nigella seeds | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth.  Refrigerate for at least an hour to allow flavors to develop.  Transfer to an airtight container, serve drizzled with the chilled spicy infused beer.  Serve as an appetizer.  Enjoy.

title: Smoked Cauliflower (Cauliflower) Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chicken stock cubes | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon onion powder ( red ) | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile ( ground ) | 300 g smoked cauliflower, cut into small florets | 1 tablespoon beer ( optional ) | basil leaves
instructions: Place chicken stock, vinegar, onion powder and chipotle in a pan/wok and bring to the boil.  Add cauliflower and cook, stirring. Place the cauliflower and all juices in the refrigerator.  You may place any dressing you prefer over the salad and place in the fridge.  Once cooked, pour dressing over salad and gently mix.  Serve immediately.

title: Lemon Pepperoni Meatballs

instructions: Preheat oven to 350'f, or until evenly distributed.  Combine lamb, pepperoni, corn and seasoning mix.

title: Pasta With Seafood and Shiitake Cheese
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 3 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and sliced | 3 ounces shiitake swiss cheese, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 2 slices white bread, crusts trimmed | 10 artichoke hearts, quartered | 2 3/4 ounces small parsnips, peeled, sliced thin | 14 ounces small squid, cleaned, separated with tentacles left intact | 12 ounces dry pasta, such as cavatini
instructions: Cover tomatoes with boiling water in medium saucepan, bring to boil and simmer covered until tomatoes soften, about 5 minutes. Spoon 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce evenly over tomato mix.  Press 2 1/2 ounces sun dried tomato mix onto other 1 1/2 ounces tomato mixture with back of spoon, leaving on edges.  Wrap bread pieces around mixture, pinch edges, and refrigerate 1 hour.  Heat remaining 1 tablespoon sun dried tom mixture and 1/2 cup tomato sauce in heavy large skillet over high heat until it begins to bubble, about 4 minutes.  Place 1 1/2 ounces sun dried tomato mixture in center of bread mixture and roll up around tomato and sauce.  Place roll in heavy large skillet with large cover.  Pour remaining 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce over bread and tomato mixture.  Cover tightly and cook at low heat until bread is golden and tomato mixture is heated through, about 30 minutes.  Toss in parsnips and squid and cook about 1 minute longer.  Serve and sprinkle each serving with the remaining 1 teaspoon sun dried tomato mixture.
