instructions: Spray crockpot with cooking spray.  Place meat in crockpot.  Add tomatoes and cornstarch.  Cook on low heat for 7 - 8 hours or on high 3 - 4 hours.  Turn crockpot to high and stir in cream cheese.  Sprinkle with chinese noodles or egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: okra,chicken bouillon cube,ziti pasta,vegetable broth,cannellini bean,oatmeal,tortilla,five spice powder
title: Healthy and Delicious One Pot Meal
ingredients: 400 g low-fat oatmeal, broken into small pieces ( half a bag or packet of gluten-free bread doughnut meal ) | 1 3/4 cups low sodium vegetable broth ( or a mix of both ) or 1 3/4 cups chicken broth ( or a mix of both ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 200 g frozen okra, in 1-inch pieces ( thawed ) | 1 cup cannellini beans, rinsed and drained ( cannellini cooking liquid ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 cup broken chinese rice noodles ( i used somen ) or 1 cup other small shell pasta ( i used somen ) | 1 packet presweetened frozen spiral ready-to-eat ziti pasta, thawed | 1/4 cup tortilla, cut into small dice
instructions: Place the oatmeal and broth in a pot over medium heat.  Stir and allow to simmer for 6 - 8 minutes or until it has absorbed most of the liquid.  Raise the heat to high and bring to a boil.  Add okra and okra and continue cooking, stirring, for another 3 minutes or until okra are crisp tender.  Add the broth and bouillon cube.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low.  Cook for 20 - 25 minutes, stirring every 5 - 7 minutes.  Stir in the cooked rice noodles and cook for 4 - 5 minutes or until rice noodles are tender and heated through.  Remove the soup from the heat.  Toss through the chinese noodles until coated with soup.  To serve, divide the soup among large soup bowls.  Place 4 small scoop of pasta in each soup bowl and top with soup.

title: Chinese Cornmeal With Maple Flavoured Sweet Oranges
ingredients: 2 cups cornmeal | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 dash cayenne | 2 dried dates, small, chopped
instructions: Combine soy and grand marnier in a dish.  Boil the cornmeal in a pan for 5 minutes, stirring continuously, then stir in the date.  Serve hot or cold, while still hot.

title: Blueberry, Lettuce and Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 lb small pasta ( farfalle, penne ) | 3 cups beef stock or 3 cups consomme | 1 head iceberg lettuce, cut into thin shreds | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries | 6 lemon wedges, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta according to directions on package.  Meanwhile, bring beef broth to a simmer in a large saucepan.  Cover and add cooked pasta and lettuce.  Cook over medium heat until most of the liquid cooks away, about 2 to 3 minutes.  Add blueberries and continue cooking for 5 to 10 minutes more, until the soup is slightly thickened.  Garnish with lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: green peppercorn,rom tomato,red capsicum,parsley flake,onion soup mix,black bean
title: Foolproof Roast Beans
ingredients: 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 can black beans, drained | 1 tablespoon green peppercorn ( crushed ) | 1 red capsicum ( diced ) | 1 roma tomato ( diced ) | parsley flakes
instructions: Soak the beans overnight.  Heat oven to 200°c.  Empty the roast beans into an ovenproof dish.  Add the onion mix and the crushed pepper.  Roast in the 180 oven for 1 hour 30 minutes.  Add the roma tomato and parsley.  Return to oven, and continue roasting till cooked.

title: Mixed Chard and Beef Rissoles (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 7)
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon cacao | 500 g beef tenderloin, trimmed of excess fat | 1 bunch chard leaf, thickly sliced | 3 tablespoons coriander leaves | 3 tablespoons fennel leaves | 8 large crusty bread, to serve ( gluten-free if required )
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the bread into a blender or food processor.  Blend until smooth.  Pour into 2 shallow, well greased shallow dishes.  Preheat grill to high.  Lightly brush the rissoles with oil.  Grill for 10–12 minutes on each side, until just cooked but still moist when pierced with a skewer.  Keep warm in a 200 degree celsius oven.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,cold water,double cream,shortcrust pastry,cottage cheese
title: Cheese and Ginger Gravy
ingredients: 225 g cottage cheese ( use low fat cottage cheese, grated if you can ) | 50 g shortcrust pastry | 1 small ginger-garlic paste | 150 ml cold water | 1 tablespoon double cream
instructions: Blend the cottage cheese and garlic paste in a food processor until completely blended.  Combine with the cold water in a saucepan and bring to a boil stirring continuously.  Remove from the heat and add the cream and the finely grated ginger.  Place the mixture into a greased pan and bake in a medium heat oven for about 20 minutes, until golden and bubbly.  Cool.  Serve on a piece of greaseproof paper with a piece of the pastry on top.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,chili sauce,romaine lettuce,white corn,sirloin,chunky salsa,butternut squash
title: Spicy Beef and Butternut Squash Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons bottled sweet chili sauce | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 10 cups romaine lettuce ( i buy the already packaged leaves and tear them into bite size pieces ) | 1/2 butternut squash, peeled and chopped into large chunks | 2 cans white corn, drained
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the beef or turkey and season with chili sauce, salsa and cayenne.  Mix together and let sit for 10 minutes.  In the meantime, in a large bowl, toss and toss all the salads for about 15 minutes.  When ready to serve, remove beef/meat and stir to combine.  Taste meat for its hotness and add more chili chili sauce, if desired.  To serve, divide salad among four dinner dishes and top with meat and chunky veggies.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate chip,chuck,sharp cheddar cheese,farfalle pasta,sage leaf,chili pepper flake,adobo sauce,chipotle pepper
title: Farfalle in the Chipotles - Chipotle Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 3/4 lb ground chuck ( do not use sausage meat ) | 1/3 cup adobo sauce ( from can chipotles in adobo, or use chipotles in adobo ) | 1 chipotle pepper, whole in adobo | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes, from chipotles | 6 fresh sage leaves | 6 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | sage & fresh chili pepper flakes, to taste | salt & fresh coarse ground white chocolate chips, to taste
instructions: In a large saute pan cook the meat over moderate heat until lightly browned.  Pour 1/4 cup of the adobo sauce from the chipotles in adobo over it and simmer for 3 minutes.  Add the pepper flakes and sage.

title: Monkeyboy
ingredients: 4 slices toasted hoagie rolls or 4 rye rolls | 1 lb fresh crabmeat | 1/2 cup vegetarian baked beans, drained | 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup carnaroli rice | 1 cup shredded coconut or 1 cup shaved coconut | 1/4 cup shavings tangerine rind | 1/4 cup chopped dried cranberries | 1/4 cup palm sugar or 1/4 cup light brown sugar ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon trimmings from fresh tangerine
instructions: Place bread on a serving platter.  In a nonstick skillet, heat 1/4 inch of oil over medium heat.  Sprinkle the top of the bread with the crumbs, crabmeat and beans.  Dish on bread, sprinkle with rind, cranberries and sugar.  Eat immediately.

title: Tortilla Delights
ingredients: 5 tortillas | 1 cup instant coffee, hot ( regular or decaffeinated ) | 1 cup cafe scoops coffee flavored liqueur ( or cream )
instructions: Warm the coffee with the coffee and cream in microwave/pot.  Spread onto tortillas and roll up.  Heat in microwave for about 1 minute and enjoy.

title: Brussels Sprouts Triangles
ingredients: 1 package frozen brussels sprouts, thawed | 1/2 lb raw egg dough ( all i have is 1 tablespoon egg beaters ) | 2 tablespoons parsley flakes | chili powder, to taste
instructions: Melt egg and mix with rest of the ingredients.  Roll the dough out on floured board until about 6 inches by 2 inches.  Cut pastry in half and place on cookie sheet sprayed with pam.  Sprinkle the sprouts on top of the dough.  Brush with egg mixture.  Bake in 400 degree oven for about 25 to 30 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Spicy Corn and Parsnip Bake
ingredients: 6 chicken drumsticks | 6 ounces parsnips, diced | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 220degc.  Mix together all ingredients except corn.  Place chicken in baking dish.  Bake in oven for 1 hour.  Allow to sit for 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: seasoning,kaffir lime leaf,tomato green chilies,white vinegar,sugar cube
title: Homemade Sweet Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 kg sugar cube | 1 bunch kaffir lime leaf ( use 2 fresh limes ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning, paste ( optional ) | 2 -3 dried red chilies ( optional ) | 3 -5 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Boil two large water containers for about 3 - 4 hours.  When its cooled, put the sugar in the container with it and keep adding till a light brown colour.  After about 30 minutes, take off from the heat.  Wash the lime leaves and soak them in warm water for 10 - 15 minutes.  Drain, then cut the leaves into 2 - 3 inch lengths.  Take one batch of lime leaves and cut the rest into 1 - 2 inch strips.  In a small bowl, mix up the salt paste, dry red chillies and vinegar.  Add this to the sugar.  Once it has become thick, pour it over the sour cream.  You can add your desired amount of sugar, but you'll have to adjust accordingly.  Store in the fridge after three weeks.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,rigatoni pasta,coriander seed,tamari,plain yogurt,cream tartar,coconut cream,currant
title: Rack of rye with naan bread
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 lb rye bread | 4 ounces sour cream | 1/2 lb arugula or 1/2 lb collard greens, well washed and coarsely chopped | 1 3/4 cups plain yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari | 3/4 cup coconut cream | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta or 12 ounces other small shell pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f.  Place the coriander in a dry frying pan and toast for 2 - 3 minutes, crushing them with a pestle.  Spread both sides of the rye bread with the coriander seeds.  Cut the bread into four slices and place on a baking sheet.  Bake for 15 minutes, turning once, until crisp.  Allow to cool slightly, then break into little pieces.  Mix together the sour cream, arugula, yogurt, tamari and coconut cream in a large bowl.  Slice the bread slices into triangles, then dip them in the sour cream mixture to coat evenly.  Transfer to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in the middle of the oven for 12 - 15 minutes, or until crisp.  Serve immediately, or store in the fridge until ready to serve.

title: Arabic Saffron
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons saffron strands ( known as 'baharat'in middle eastern stores ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Heat the oil in a non stick pan over low heat.  Add saffron to the oil and stir so that it is well incorporated.  Remove the saffron from heat when it turns light golden in color.  Remove the saffron from the heat and transfer the pan to an airtight container.  Add the remaining ingredients to the oil used to cook the saffron.  Stir to combine and then leave it to cool.  Wipe the pan clean by pressing down on it with your finger tips, then place it over medium high heat and add the saffron oil, or alternatively you can use your hands to mix well.  Cook for approximately 10 - 15 minutes, until golden and crisp.  Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,tahini,coriander powder,sumac,mexican oregano,shell pasta
title: Shrimp and Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon sumac | 1 lb small shell pasta, cooked | freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Put a large pot or dutch oven over medium heat and add tahini, oregano, coriander, and sumac.  When the oil shimmers, add the pasta and cook for 2 minutes.  Sprinkle in the cheese and continue cooking for 1 minute or until the cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: mochiko rice flour,seasoning salt,green curry paste,chicken breast half,white sugar,yellow mustard
title: Green Curry Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup mango chutney ( major greys ) | 2 tablespoons light light green curry paste | 3 tablespoons yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt, divided | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 packet mochiko sweet rice flour
instructions: Stir mango chutney, curry paste, and mustard together in a large bowl.  Add 2 teaspoons seasoning salt, then stir in chicken.

title: Easy and Simple German Dressing
ingredients: 4 ounces vodka | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon salad oil | 1 cup frozen corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in a glass container.  Store refrigerated.

title: Tomato and Sour Cream Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tomatoes, deseeded and coarsely chopped | 5 ounces chicken broth | 1 ounce mexican crema | 3 tablespoons cornflour | 3 ounces vodka | 1/2 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a small pan, then tip in the tomatoes and chicken broth.  Bring to the boil and simmer for 20 mins until the tomatoes are soft.  Stir the cornflour into the coconut oil, then stir in the vodka.  Then add the tomatoes and sour cream.  Bring to the boil and simmer very gently.  Sprinkle in the parsley and serve.

Random Ingredients: pea,feta cheese,scotch bonnet pepper,potato starch,dark sesame oil,advocaat,peanut oil,lemongrass
title: Pea Fritters (Gurudelhos)
ingredients: 1 large potato sticks | 6 large scotch bonnet peppers, chopped ( wear rubber gloves ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 stalks lemongrass, chopped | 1 package frozen peas, thawed | 1/2 cup thickened cream | 1/4 cup advocaat | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Cut potato into 12 wedges.

title: Apple and Nut Roast (Beef Stew)
ingredients: 1 -2 medium tart apple | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast or 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin roast, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup walnuts, chopped | 3 tablespoons coconut oil | 3 tablespoons walnut pieces, chopped and toasted
instructions: Core and slice apples into 8 wedges or thick wedges.  Place beef in a heavy dutch oven.  Add all other ingredients except nuts and stir well.  Cover tightly and simmer about 3 hours, or until meat is tender.  Remove meat and strain liquid as necessary.  Return to pot and stir.  Serve with toasted walnuts.  My note, i made this in the slow cooker and the kids loved it.  First i made it for a change of pace, i made it the night before, and when ready to go to work, substituted a chuck roast for the chuck roast and added a few apples and nuts.  They were so tender i could never measure anything else.  I made enough for my pressure cooker.  Next i cut the meat into bite size pieces and used all of it.  The meat was very tender and had a wonderful smell.  Next i put it in the crock pot on low to warm up.  The walnuts gave it an excellent flavor and added flavor to this dish.  Next, when i added the nuts i decided to put the walnuts in the pot instead of the walnuts.  It really turned out great.  I would recommend this to other family members if you've got any leftovers.

title: Hawaiian Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice | 1 package wonton skins | 1/2 pound green peppercorns
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the pineapple juice and the wonton skins.  Let stand 5 minutes at room temperature before dipping.  Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  Remove the skins from the peppercorns.  Cut into 1 1/2 inch lengths with scissors.  Place one end of a screw on a plate.  Place 1/2 the peppercorns in the prepared wonton skins.  Place 2 teaspoons of the pineapple juice mixture in the center of the peppercorns and roll up tightly.  Secure with a toothpick.  Place the rolls cut side down in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Bake for 30 to 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until browned and heated through.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,ketchup,white rice,cardamom pod,cream celery soup,rigatoni pasta,wheat flour,goat cheese
title: Ribatoni and Beans
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rotisserie-cooked white rice | 1 cup uncooked rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 6 tablespoons sour cream or 6 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 cup crumbled goat cheese
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.  Pour rice into a greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish.

title: Escarole with Chestnuts
ingredients: 1 pound fresh escarole | 1 pound smoked pork belly, sliced | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Place escarole into a large pot with enough water just to cover.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and cook until tender, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,thai fish sauce,red pepper flake,arugula leaf
title: Crispy Thai Fish Focaccia(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 lb grated medium firm white fish fish fish ( such as tilapia fillets ) | 1 pinch baking soda | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 bunch arugula leaf, washed
instructions: In a large nonstick frypan, combine the fish, baking soda, and fish sauce.  Cook, stirring constantly, for about 5 minutes or until the fish is flaky.  Stir in the arugula.  Using a spatula, remove the pan from the heat.  Transfer to a serving platter and serve.

title: Aussie Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain brown rice, uncooked | 14 1/2 ounces artichoke hearts, drained, reserving liquid | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 cup canned apricot, thinly sliced, reserve liquid | 20 g smoked sausage, diced
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.

title: Spicy Green Kale
ingredients: 1 bunch kale | 12 cherry tomatoes | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: In a large wok or skillet over medium heat, bring the kale and cherry tomatoes to a boil.  Cook until the kale is soft, 2 to 4 minutes.  Drain and mash the kale with a potato masher using the back of a spoon, or in a blender, while stirring constantly.  Stir in artichoke hearts and maple syrup.  Cook until heated through, 2 to 5 minutes.  Transfer the kale mixture to a serving bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: butter,date,szechwan pepper,star anise,bacon grease,cream mushroom soup,hoagie
title: Szechwan Hot Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons smoked bacon grease | 2 teaspoons szechwan pepper | 1 teaspoon butter | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 4 chicken pieces | 1 teaspoon hoagie roll | 1 teaspoon star anise, or | 1 teaspoon powdered szechwan pepper
instructions: Heat bacon grease over medium, and add szechwan peppers and butter.  Stir, then add soup.  Cut chicken in pieces to taste.  Place roll on a hot griddle, and place szechwan pepper flakes on it.  Cook both sides, and serve on the side.

title: Ginger Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup crushed ice | 4 teaspoons minced fresh ginger | 4 teaspoons red peppers or 4 teaspoons red chilies, minced | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut | 2 tablespoons unsweetened instant coffee
instructions: Take crushed ice and put in a blender along with remaining ingredients.  Blend till smooth.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,ginger garlic paste,corn black bean salsa,saffron strand,anise seed,cooking oil,grain rice,beef brisket
title: South American Corn & Black Bean Salsa
ingredients: 500 g extra lean ground beef | 400 g tinned sweet corn & black bean salsa | 1 teaspoon saffron strand | 1 teaspoon dried anise seed, crushed | 2 teaspoons grated ginger-garlic paste | 1 beef brisket | 2 teaspoons cooking oil | 1 cup short-grain rice
instructions: Combine beef, corn and black bean salsa in a large oven proof dish along with saffron, anise, ginger & garlic paste.  Toss well to combine.  Wrap beef in foil and put in a roasting tin, in a preheated oven at 180°c.  Combine oil and remaining ingredients in a heat proof jug or pan.  Bring to the boil, cover, reduce heat to low and simmer 20 minutes.  Remove from heat, cover and stand, covered for 15 minutes.  Uncover and place meat on a plate.  Cover and stand for 10 minutes while preparing rice.  Stir through rice and serve.

Random Ingredients: apricot brandy,rice wine vinegar,strawberry yogurt,english pea
title: Fruit Lassi
ingredients: 1 can frozen english pea, thawed and drained | 1 carton strawberry yogurt | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 12 ounces apricot brandy
instructions: Blend drained canned beans, yogurt, brandy and apricot brandy together in a blender until smooth.

title: Homemade Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 cans refried beans | 1 can fat-free fat-free evaporated milk | half pint fat-free evaporated milk
instructions: Combine refried beans and about half pint milk in a food processor or blender.  Blend until smooth.  Pour blended milks into a bowl.  Heat refried beans in a pan over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring often to prevent burning.  Pour hot refried beans into individual serving bowls and top with the melted fat free evaporated milk.  Serve warm.

title: Quick Halibut in Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce ( found in asian grocery aisle ) | 1/2 lb halibut steak, 4 to 6 inches long, sliced into thin strips ( can use other firm white fish or seafood ) | 2 tablespoons canned mandarin orange segments, drained, but the juice reserved | 8 ounces canned whole shucked oysters, drained
instructions: Prepare hoisin sauce and set aside 1/3 cup.  In a large skillet over medium high heat, stir fry halibut until opaque, 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove.  To same skillet, stir fry mandarin oranges until heated through.  Stir fry remaining garlic.  In crockpot, stir fry halibut, oranges, and shrimp in reserved juice until just hot or about 1 minute per side.  Spoon over meat mixture in crockpot.  Cover and cook on low for 10 minutes.  Serve.

title: Homemade Mashed Yellow Corn
ingredients: 6 ears fresh corn kernels | 1 cup chocolate chips ( i used a good quality and quality chocolate flavor ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Set your oven to 400.  Clean and rinse your corn, place into a very big oven safe bowl, cover with a damp paper towel and set aside.  Bake corn on center rack for about 30 minutes or until the kernels are tender and lightly charred in spots.  Allow the kernels to cool and then scoop out the kernels of the cob.  Discard the husks and any remaining husks.  Set the kernels aside by placing a cloth under the ears to absorb the excess water.  If a knife comes out clean it is ready, but it was not dried out, simply cut it off.  Melt the chocolate chips, and set aside.  Stir together the cumin and onion powder with a fork.  To assemble, spread the chocolate chips evenly over the corn, and then spread the corn out onto a large cutting board.  Place a clean spoon or platter inside the corn.

title: Spicy Steak With Tomatoes and Pear
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tequila | 2 fresh pears, peeled | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes | 2 tablespoons crushed red chili
instructions: Cut the pears in half lengthwise and remove core.  Remove seeds and pith from the pears by using a spoon.  Slice the pit out of the tomatoes and chop enough to make about 1/4 cups total.  Mix the tequila, 2 tablespoons of the crushed red chilies, and half of the crushed dried chilies in a bowl.  Add the pears.  Add a tablespoon of the oil to a skillet or griddle and sear the steaks on both sides until done to your taste.  Serve the steaks on a plate with the tomato mixture and pour the chili over them.

Random Ingredients: basil,cremini mushroom,iceberg lettuce,mozzarella cheese,gorgonzola cheese,brown sugar
title: Vegetable Pizzas
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 2 cups sliced cremini mushrooms | 3 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese | 2 ounces gorgonzola cheese | 2 teaspoons brown sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Arrange lettuce in ovenproof baking dish and drizzle with olive oil.  Top with mushrooms, mozzarella cheese and gorgonzola cheese.  Bake for 15 minutes and sprinkle with brown sugar.  Top with basil and bake another 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,shallot,cherry,tomato,grapeseed oil,coffee,peanut butter,high protein crisp rice wheat cereal
title: Healthy Lunchbox Lunch
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1 shallot, finely chopped | 1 cup low-protein crisp rice or 1 cup hot cereal | 1 tomatoes, finely chopped | 150 g mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/4 cups hot coffee | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 tablespoon dried cherries ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a wide pan or frying pan and stir fry the shallots until soft, about 5 minutes adding the mushrooms and hot coffee.  When it boils, stir in the crisp rice.  When the steam starts to escape the grains, add the peanut butter and stir until combined.  Pour the hot coffee mix into the pan and cook over a medium heat until the coffee melts and the jelly starts oozing from the rice.  Continue cooking until the jelly is completely melted and the jelly is starting to turn syrupy, about 3 minutes.  Scatter the dried cherries over and serve.  Enjoy.

title: Caesar Haluski
ingredients: 2 slices provolone cheese | 1 tablespoon dry caesar salad dressing, or as needed | 1/2 teaspoon fresh wheat germ
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Arrange provolone cheese slices on a baking sheet.  Drizzle with caesar dressing and sprinkle with wheat germ.  Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is bubbly, about 5 minutes.

title: Quick Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump roast | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon cognac ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 3 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Slice the beef thinly across the grain.  Combine the hoisin sauce, cognac and thyme in a small bowl.  Pour into a large heavy pot.  Add the beef and the vegetable broth.  Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: thai red chili pepper,seasoning,farfalle pasta,wheat bread,tabasco sauce
title: Olive Garden Whole Wheat Bread Crunch
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked farfalle pasta | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon thai red chili peppers, minced or 1 teaspoon jalapeno chile powder | 1/2 loaf whole wheat bread ( i use pumpernickel bread ) | 2 teaspoons seasoning
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions.  Boil pasta until done.  Drain water from pasta and run under cold water to cool the pasta slightly.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Prepare the noodles per package directions.  Drain thoroughly and transfer to a large bowl.  Add tabasco sauce, chili peppers, bread crumbs and seasoning.  Mix thoroughly.  Using 1/2 teaspoon of oil in a 9x13 inch pan, spread the bread on the bottom evenly.  Bake until the bread absorbs the spices, topping is golden and crunchy.

title: Mexican Green Chiken
ingredients:
1 lb ground meat | 1 can low-fat soymilk ( not vanilla-flavored ) | 1 green cardamom pod | 3 -4 drops chicken bouillon ( i use 2 teaspoons.
    - if you like a lot of cardamon, try 3 teaspoons ) | picante sauce
instructions: Heat up the grill to med high heat.  Place the cardamon pods on it on the hot grill.  Sprinkle the cardamon on the cardamon and sprinkle the meat on the grill if desired.  The meat should be slightly crusty.  Place the ground meat in a bowl and stir in 1/4 cup of the soymilk.  Sprinkle 1/4 cup of soy milk over the meat.  Mix well then add another 1/4 cup of soy milk.  Stir the soymilk into the meat and milk mixture and continue to mix.  Pour a cup of picante sauce in a baking pan, about 2 tablespoons.  Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes, stirring the soymilk periodically just until it is bubbly.  Turn the broiler on the highest setting to medium.  Turn the meat and broil for about 7 - 8 minutes.  Remove from the oven and plate.  Spread the remaining 1/4 cup of soy milk over a platter and place the platter under the broiler to brown the soymilk.  If desired, you can also spoon the meat into a gravy boat for serving.

title: Raspberry Basil Jam Filling
ingredients: 1 lb raspberry jam or 1 lb white sweet jam | 1 pint fresh basil leaf, washed well | 1/2 teaspoon extract
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender until mixed.  When smooth, stuff as desired.  For thicker, richer, add 1 tbls of puree.  For thinner, add 1 - 2 tbls.  Water.

Random Ingredients: green,purpose flour,cayenne pepper,creme fraiche,steak,coffee ice cube
title: Steak Au Poivre
ingredients: 4 ounces green tea steaks, cut into 1/8 dice ( or cubes ) | 4 1/2 ounces creme fraiche, thick or 1 1/2 ounces sour cream | 2 ounces coffee ice cubes | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon cuppa
instructions: Put the diced steak into the blender or food processor.  Blend to a coarse paste.  Blend in the creme fraiche, coffee, flour, cayenne pepper and cuppa.  Mix together well.  Refridgerate for at least 1 hour, or you can serve it immediately.

title: Pumpernickel Bites
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray ( such as pam ) | 1/3 cup chopped chives | 6 slices pumpernickel bread, about 1/2 inch thick
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Spray a 13x9x2 inch baking dish with vegetable oil cooking spray.  Place 5 slices of the bread, 1/4 cup at a time, on the dish.  Spray each side with the cooking spray.  Sprinkle half of the chives over the bread.  Add another slice.  Sprinkle with remaining chives.  Bake uncovered for 15 minutes.  Remove from oven and top with the remaining slice.  Bake for 5 minutes more.

title: Mirin Beefsteak Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 beefsteak tomatoes | 1 1/2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Cut each of the tomatoes in half.  Use a very sharp knife to cut a slice down one side of the tomato.  Remove the tomatoes from the peel and cut a long slice down the left side.  Discard the tomato halves.  Place the tomato halves in a heavy skillet with enough water to cover them by an inch or two, or submerge them into a steamer and bring it to a boil.  Let the tomatoes simmer until they are no longer translucent.  It should not be too thick.  It should taste like a balance between a tomato and a steak, about 7 to 10 minutes for medium or more for well done.  This will depend on the thickness of the steak, which should be about 2 1/2 inches wide.  Drain the tomatoes and return them to the pan.  Turn them over gently, add the mirin, and stir gently.  Cook on medium heat until the sauce has thickened, about 25 to 30 minutes.  Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt, if necessary.  Serve warm.

title: Peach Melba
ingredients: 2 cans sliced peaches,, drained | 1/2 cup lemonade or 1/2 cup lemon lime beverage | 2 -3 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded

Place on parchment on cookie sheet, brush with remaining melted butter, and bake at 425f for about 30 minutes or until golden, puffy, and slightly browned.  Serve warm.

title: Apple-Avocado Salsa
ingredients: 3 medium cooking apples | 3 tablespoons cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 bag baby spinach | 1 large avocado
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Peel and core apples.  Slice into fine 1/4 inch pieces and set aside.  Place all ingredients into a medium baking dish and mix thoroughly.  Bake for 20 - 30 minutes or until apples are tender and mixture is thickened.  Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Baked Outdoor Fries
ingredients: 4 lbs white potatoes | 2 large oranges
instructions: Wash and peel potatoes.  Heat oven to 250 450°f.  Cut an x across top of each potato to allow steam to drain out.  Drop potato slices into boiling water.  Cook until potatoes are tender, about 15 to 18 minutes.  Drain potatoes well and immediately immerse in ice water until completely cooled.

title: Vegetable Shortbread
ingredients: 6 tablespoons cake flour | 1 cup vegetable broth ( or water )
instructions: Put all the dry ingredients in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment and pulse for just 30 seconds, or until the ingredients are thoroughly blended.  Add the liquid, 1 cup at a time, and process until it forms a ball, about 30 seconds.  Transfer the dough to a floured surface and knead briefly on a lightly floured board until the dough is elastic.  Form the dough into a compact round ball and place, covered with plastic wrap, in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to an hour to dry the surface and develop a gluten.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Lightly dust and flour a 10 inch round or larger baking sheet.  Transfer the dough to the prepared baking sheet and cut into 2 or 3 wedges about 2½ inches wide.  Lightly flour the top of each wedge and place on the prepared sheet.  Press any excess dough off with your fingers.  Bake the cookies until the edges are slightly shiny and very lightly browned, about 30 – 35 minutes.  Transfer the cookies to a wire rack to cool completely and serve.  Store the baked cookies in an airtight container at room temperature, at least 12 hours or in the freezer.

title: Spaghetti With Feta and Feta (Pasta Salad)
ingredients: 1 lb dried spaghetti | 1 lb feta
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling water.  Drain.  Mix together with feta in a large bowl.  Toss with extra virgin olive oil and serve.

title: Baked Avocado
ingredients:
3 avocados ( each weighing approx.
    - 1 1/2 lb.
    - ) | savory
instructions: Cut the avocados in half.  Remove the pit from the underside in order to leave enough avocados on one side of the pit to support a wedge of bread.  Place the avocado halves on a greased or parchment lined baking tray and sprinkle with savory.  Bake in a hot oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until the bread is lightly browned.

title: Tomato Pasta With Strawberries
ingredients: 4 ounces penne pasta | 8 ounces strawberries | 1 - 1 1/2 cup wine ( you can use champagne if you prefer ) | 1 3/4 ounces tomato puree | coriander ( to garnish )
instructions: Boil pasta in a saucepan of water following the boiling water.  Meanwhile, halve strawberries and chop finely.  Boil a pan of water and add strawberries to pan, then reduce heat and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes until strawberries have softened.  Drain pasta and strawberries, then serve hot, topped with tomato puree and coriander.  You can also serve this with parmesan asiago.

title: Pizzelle Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg whites | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon dill weed | 3/4 cup picante sauce | 1 package refrigerated tortellini | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat pizzelle iron, then spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Stir together egg whites, vanilla, salt, dill weed and 3/4 cup picante sauce in a medium bowl.  Add tortellini, mixing to combine.  Transfer the pizzelle mixture to a baking sheet.  Spray the top of the batter with nonstick cooking spray.  Bake for 12 to 15 minutes.  Remove from the oven and sprinkle cocoa over the batter.  Serve immediately with your favorite side dishes.

title: Garlic Oil Cookies With Variations
ingredients: 4 cups all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup garlic-infused olive oil
instructions: Set out the four cups of flour in a bowl.  Create a well in the center.  Pour in the olive oil.  With a fork, mix the dough until it is well mixed, being careful not to tear it.  If you can, form dough into two balls.  Set aside to rest for about 30 minutes.  Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Take each ball out of the bowl.  Using a pastry brush, coat the inside of each ball lightly with olive oil.  Pinch the top skin off of the ball and carefully lift onto the pastry brush, smoothing the top with a spatula.  With your finger, make an indentation into the center for the garlic flavored oil to sit inches.  Repeat with remaining balls of dough and coat with olive oil.  Place on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.  Remove from the oven and cool completely.  Serve immediately.

title: Ras El Hanout - Moroccan Coconut Powder
ingredients: 1 cup desiccated coconut | 2 teaspoons dried coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.  Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,broccoli floret,salt pepper,pimiento,vanilla bean,flour,breadcrumb,watercress
title: Suzanne's Chinese 5 Spice Blend Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 cup soft breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder ( or other curry powder ) | 1 cup chopped watercress | 1/8 cup dried pimiento | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt & pepper | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, scraped | 2 cups cooked broccoli florets
instructions: Place breadcrumbs in a large bowl.  Blend in 5 spice powder, mix well.  Add watercress, pimentos, garlic and seasonings and mix well.  With hands, work spice mixture into broccoli until coated.  Roll mixture into small balls with assorted shaped pieces, like small balls or ping pong balls.  Place balls on a parchment lined baking sheet and keep in refrigerator until needed.  To finish cooking, fry broccoli in a large saucepan over medium high heat approximately 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp tender.  Remove from pan and add to bowl with bread crumbs.  Add additional 5 spice powder to bread crumbs to taste.

title: Broccoli Buffet in Red Wine
ingredients: 4 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 4 ounces crumbled cotija cheese | 1 cup chopped broccoli florets | 1/2 cup dry red wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place crumbled feta, cotija, and 3/4 cup broccoli in a 2 quart casserole dish.  In a small bowl, stir together red wine and remaining 2/3 cup broccoli florets.  Spoon cheese mixture over feta mixture.  Bake in the preheated oven 15 minutes, or until broccoli is tender.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,egg yolk,onion flake,baguette,cocoa powder,rice vermicelli
title: Meat-Free Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dried rice vermicelli | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon ginger juice | 1 cup chopped onion | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Boil vermicelli according to package directions.  Drain and add all ingredients except noodles to noodles.  Mix well.  Keep warm and serve noodles hot.

title: Easy Egg Nog
ingredients: 2 cans rotel diced tomatoes, undrained | 6 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 green onion, chopped
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine rotel, eggs, parsley and green onion.  Place in a large mixing bowl.  Stir well with a wooden spoon.  Cover.  Let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.  Stir again and serve.

title: Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 3 chicken legs | 4 ounces citrus peel | 1 ounce chow mein noodles ( chan mae )
instructions: Place the chicken legs in a large saucepan with enough water to cover them, bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 30 minutes.  Remove the chicken from the pan, place in a shallow dish and pour over enough hot tap water to cover.  Allow to stand for 30 minutes to rise, then drain.  Place the citrus peel in a small sieve and rub over the chicken legs.  Cover and dry in a warm place for 10 minutes, remove the bones and peel and set aside.  Heat a griddle until smoking, then brush with oil and fry or fry chan mae noodles until it is sizzling hot, stirring continuously.  Add the chicken legs and return them to the frying pan, bring to the boil, then arrange the noodles around the chicken.  Add a few ice cubes to the saucepan if required for moisture.  Simmer until the chicken is cooked, serve.

title: Easy Garlic Garlic Pita Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf greek style pita bread | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Slice loaf in half.  Take out the middle and discard the pitas.  Put the pitas on a cookie sheet with a little bit of the olive oil showing in it.  Bake at 350 degrees for about 10 - 15 minutes.  It should still be slightly moist but crisp.  Remove from oven and let the bread absorb the oil.  You can also put it back on the oven if you need to.  Cut into halves or wedges and serve with other things for dipping.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti noodle,chicken breast half,clove,nectarine,mexican cheese,worcestershire sauce
title: Chicken Jaffa
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti noodles | 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, chopped | 1 lb nectarine, peeled, and cut into bite size pieces | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon instant minced clove | 1 cup mexican cheese, shredded
instructions: Pour boiling water over noodles, let sit five minutes or so, and drain.  Combine with chicken, worcestershire sauce, and minced clove.  Place in a microwave safe container with a lid.  Cook on high one minute, uncovered.  Cover, and cook on high 5 - 7 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Top with cheese.

title: Beet Salad With Chilli & Mozzarella
ingredients: 20 ounces roasted beets | 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 3 teaspoons agave syrup | 1 teaspoon chilli paste | 1/8 cup fresh shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons shredded lettuce
instructions: Cut the beetroot into matchsticks and cook in a heavy based, small saucepan of simmering water for 5 mins or until tender.  Drain and cool.  Cut into matchsticks.  Heat the peanut and agave oil in a small skillet and cook over a high heat for 1 min, stirring.  Pour over the beetroot beetroot and stir fry for 3 mins until warm.  Place mixture in a bowl, add the chilli paste and cheese and mix well.  Add lettuce to the beetroot and serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,italian parsley,bicarbonate soda,chicken breast half
title: Simple Spiced Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves ( i use bone in, 5 cm in thickness ) | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon italian parsley
instructions: Cut the chicken into serving size pieces.  Put the chicken in a shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle the sugar, soda and garam marsala over the chicken.  Bake in a moderately hot oven for 35 - 45 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the coating of coating is crispy and a golden glaze.

title: Greek Shrimp and Veggies
ingredients: 4 -5 cups baby spinach | 2 cups dark sweet potatoes ( yellow or white, peeled ) or 2 cups leeks ( yellow or white, peeled ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh rosemary or 1/2 cup fresh thyme | 1 lb cooked shrimp, peeled | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dark brown sugar ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 - 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Place the spinach in a microwave safe bowl.  Spray a skillet with cooking spray.  Layer the vegetables in the pan starting with the sweet potato or leeks, finishing with the chopped fresh rosemary or thyme.  Spray the shrimp with cooking spray and place under the broiler for 2 - 3 minutes or until shrimp is pink, but not as hard.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Serve immediately.

title: Lobster Fettuccine

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.  In a small pan, bring a kettle of water to a boil.  Add caraway seeds.  Remove pan from the heat and set aside. Stir the cheese and caraway seeds into the mayonnaise mixture.  Stir the noodles into the cheese and mustard mixture until coated.

title: Apple and Pork Soup (for the Crockpot )
ingredients: 2 cups apples juice | 6 cups chicken stock ( or beef )
instructions: Pour the apple juice into the crockpot.  Add the stock.  If using your crockpot to be stewing in a frying pan, you can do this by adding the stock slowly while stirring.

title: Simple Scrambled Burritos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark chocolate ( if your choc is very strong ) or 2 tablespoons margarine, melted ( if your choc is very strong ) | 8 slices bread, crusts removed, toasted | 24 large cremini mushrooms | 4 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted | 8 sheets nori, broken into triangles perferably 8 x 8 square
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of the melted dark chocolate in a small bowl.  Cut a circle 1 in diameter from the toasted bread, about as big as an index finger.  Place one side of each toast circle in a large nonstick skillet with an ovenproof handle.  Place a few ounces of the mushroom pieces inside the toast circle, placing them in a single layer.  Spread each of the cooked mushroom pieces with melted dark chocolate.  Place a nori triangle in the center of each burrito and drizzle the melted chocolate over it.  Place 1 or 2 more nori triangles around the chocolate.  Lightly press each burrito closed with a fork or your finger.  Cook in a nonstick skillet over a medium flame for 3 - 4 minutes, until the chocolate is almost fully melted.  Use a large spatula to flip the tortilla, pressing hard for a few moments just to warm all sides.  The tortillas should also be slightly softened by the time they are done.  Cut the tortillas into wedges and serve topped with the melted dark chocolate.  Alternatively, warm a nonstick frypan on medium high heat, add 1 tablespoon butter and toast each side quickly so as not to burn the butter.  Alternatively, heat a heavy skillet over high heat and brown a few minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: sage,skirt steak,italian salad dressing,french bread,chicken thigh fillet,peanut,burgundy wine
title: Coquilleur a la Coquilles
ingredients: 6 chicken thigh fillets, skinless and boneless | 6 boneless chicken breast fillets, skinless and boneless | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 2 teaspoons rubbed sage | 1/3 cup burgundy wine | 1/3 cup italian salad dressing | 4 cups burgundy wine
instructions: Cut each chicken thigh fillet into 5 wedges.  Place both the chicken and chicken breasts in a large mixing bowl, sprinkle with half the peanuts and half the sage and toss to coat.  Spread the chicken evenly on 4 dinner plates, top with the remaining peanuts and remaining sage.  Pour the wine around the chicken.  Make 4 sandwiches with the remaining ingredients and marinate in the mixture for at least 3 hours, or overnight, turning the chicken occasionally.  To serve, line a baking sheet with foil and heat the broiler.  Slice the sandwiches diagonally and arrange on a baking sheet.  Broil 4 to 5 inches from the heat, turning once, until nicely browned and the chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes.  Let rest for about 5 minutes before slicing.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,rice vinegar,pork,tomato green chile pepper,mandarin orange,ice,dark sesame oil,rye bread
title: Spookyishly Sweet, Cold, and Salty Pork Strata
ingredients: 1 cup chopped cooked pork | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 can mandarin orange slices ( drained ) | 1 package rye bread | 1 loaf focaccia bread | 1 1/4 cups rice vinegar | 1 1/4 cups dark sesame oil | 1 package dark sesame oil for drizzling | ice
instructions: Place the pork, tomatoes with green chiles, mandarin oranges, rye bread, focaccia, rice vinegar, sesame oil and sesame oil into the bowl of a food processor.  Blend until well combined.  Spread mixture evenly into the loaf of bread.  Drizzle bread with dark sesame oil and cut into 1/2 inch cubes.  Place cubes into a bowl with ice and toss until ice is melted.  Serve immediately.

title: Hot Sambal
ingredients: 5 fresh red chilies, deseeded and chopped | 200 g hamburger buns, split | 1 tablespoon watercress, leaves only | 1 teaspoon palm bean paste | 200 g cream cheese, cut into 1 cm cubes | 8 fresh tomatillos, halved and cored | 60 g pecans, toasted and roughly chopped
instructions: Place the chillies and watercress in a food processor and whizz for 20 seconds.  Scrape into a bowl and stir in the palm bean paste and cream cheese.  Remove the seeds and the flesh from the tomatoes.  Add tothe chilies and mix well.  Tear the meat into pieces and place in the tomato mixture and stir in the pecans.  Serve sprinkled with additional palm bean paste.

Random Ingredients: demerara sugar,pork loin roast,egg noodle,paprika,pecan half
title: Pecan Crusted Pork Loin Roast
ingredients: 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon demerara sugar | 4 -6 pork loin roast | 1 package egg noodles | 3/4 cup toasted pecan halves, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees.  On a flat tray, mix paprika and demerara sugar and rub over pork roast.  Place on oven rack and brush with 1 tbsp oil.  Bake 45 minutes, basting often with remaining 3 tablespoons oil.  Remove from oven and set aside.  Meanwhile in a large nonstick skillet, melt the remaining 2 tbsp oil.  Add the noodles, nuts and pecan halves.  Stir to coat.  Remove pork from oven and brush with remaining 3 tbsp oil.  Return to oven and bake 45 minutes or till thermometer registers 155f degrees.  Let meat rest in pan 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Soupy Lentils
ingredients: 8 ounces lentils, dry | 2 1/2 ounces chopped pimientos | 15 fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Soak the lentils for 30 minutes.  Drain well and put to one side.  Boil the lentils with the pimientos and the spinach leaves until tender.

title: Mom's Sweet and Sour Smoked Smoked Brisket (Pulls)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pickling spice | 4 lbs smoked kielbasa ( or smoked turkey ) | 2 lbs corned beef brisket, well trimmed | 1 can pineapple rings | 1 1/4 teaspoons lime zest, finely chopped
instructions: Rub pickling spice all over brisket and place in crock.  Add remaining ingredients and let stand 2 hours, then remove from crock and allow to cool for 4 hours.  Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and keep chilled in refrigerator up to 1 week.  Keeps well up to 1 year.

title: Cherried Lamb Rolls With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg leg of lamb, boned | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons coriander cilantro leaves, roughly chopped, plus extra sprigs for garnish | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground cherries, halved | 12 fresh oysters, shucked, stoned
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150°c/170°c fan forced.  Cut the meat into 12 to 16 squares if using a leg of lamb.  Using a sharp knife, trim away any excess fat from the meat and carefully separate the meat from the membrane with your fingers.  Lay the meat on a sheet of baking parchment paper, cover and place in the oven.  Bake for 45 minutes, then uncover the lamb and transfer the lamb to a dinner plate.  While the lamb is cooking, combine the mayonnaise, coriander, mace, cherries and a grinding of black pepper in a food processor or blender and process together until smooth.  Slash the lamb to make 2 thin slices, then remove the paper and cut off any excess fat.  Spread the mayonnaise mix over the top of each slice and place each slice on a serving plate.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Polish Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, sliced | 1 medium cucumber, chopped | salt and pepper | 1 loaf white bread | 2 teaspoons fresh oregano
instructions: Place the sliced cabbage into a pan with some water over medium heat.  Once the water has reduced a bit, pour the cabbage out in a sieve set over a bowl.  Rinse the cabbage in the strainer and place it back into the pan with the water.  Boil until the cabbage is soft.  It should now have a sort of crisp appearance.  Once it is, drain and drain.  Put it back in the pan with the rest of the water and stir well.  Peel out the crusts, if necessary and cut the bread into wedges.  Place the slices onto a plate.  In a pretty bowl, arrange the cucumber, add all of the dry oregano, salt and pepper, and bread.  Pour the dressing over the bread and toss them together.  Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Real Simple Beef Rouladen
ingredients: 1 kg ground chuck | 1 kg graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Mix it all together thoroughly then shape into rouladen.  Refrigerate and bake at least 6 hours.

title: Rice and Scallop Ravioli
ingredients: 4 sheets cheese ravioli | 2 cups glutinous rice, prepared according to directions on box ( japanese rice ) | 3 -4 tablespoons flour | 1 lb fresh scallops or 1 lb frozen scallops, thawed | 1 1/2 lbs red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb turnip, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups low-fat yogurt or 1 1/2 cups reduced fat sour cream | fresh basil ( optional ) or cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Combine the ingredients of rice and flour in a large bowl.  Dredge the ravioli in the mixture.  Allow to sit for 10 minutes. .  Place a steamer inside of a saucepan and fill with enough water to submerge the ravioli.  Heat on high until the steamer stops boiling.  Stir the rice and rice into the steamer and steam for 2 minutes.  Remove from the steamer, cover and let stand 15 minutes.  Transfer the rice and rice to a large platter.  Cut the scallops on the diagonal into a 2 inch thick slice.  Thinly slice the red cabbage and turnip into a 2 inch strips.  Arrange the strips in the center of the rice and cabbage mixture and arrange the turnips around the vegetables. .  Serve at once garnished with a dollop of yogurt or sour cream and basil or cilantro, if desired.

instructions: Place beef and chopped spinach in crockpot.  Mix well, cover and allow to cook on low 4 - 6 hours.  Sprinkle with chilies or raisins and hot sauce and continue cooking on low for one more hour.  Serve with warm tortillas or corn bread and enjoy.

title: Cheesy Wontons

instructions: Place the mustard seeds, flour and bread crumb in a small bowl.  Sprinkle over the cheese. Place on a greased oven tray and bake in a preheated oven for about 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Barbecue Lambs

instructions: Spray the meat generously with barbeque.  Place chops on a rack in a shallow baking pan.  Coat the chops with hot sauce.  Turn and coat all sides.  Cover and refrigerate, about 4 hours.  Preheat barbecue on high.  Drain chops and cook on high 5 - 6 minutes per side or until desired doneness.  Let come to room temperature before serving.

title: Beer Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces beer | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 -2 white onion ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1/2 cup shredded colby cheese
instructions: Add the cumin seeds and cayenne pepper to the beer.  Stir and bring to a low boil.  Add the cream of mushroom soup, and mix.  Drain the vegetables.  Add cheese and stir to melt into the mixture.  Serve with corn chips enjoy.

instructions: In a medium skillet, heat 2/3 cup oil over medium heat.  Add 2 garlic cloves, a pinch of salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.

instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  In a bowl combine all the ingredients except for the cream, cocoa and red bell peppers.  Grease 2 ramekins with vegetable oil. title: Easy  Pungent Feta Salad (Salad Shiraz)
ingredients: 1 package crumbled feta cheese ( or other mild flavored cheese ) | 2 tablespoons good asian chili sauce or 2 tablespoons sambal oelek

title: Pasta Salad With Halloumi and Jicama

instructions: Drain all but 1 cup of water from the pasta and put under cold running water to cool the pasta slightly.  Drain, cool slightly.  Dice the cheese and toss with the pasta. instructions: In medium bowl, stir biscuit mix, pork, broccoli, apple and baking powder.  Pour half meat mixture in 1.  6 quart greased baking dish or two 1/2 quart microwave crocks. Microwave at high power for about 15 minutes, stirring several times, until potatoes are tender.
