title: Wasabi Paste
ingredients: 1 teaspoon wasabi paste | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons hot water | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/4 - 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Mix wasabi paste, gingergarlic paste and hot water thoroughly to blend.  Set aside.  Beat eggs with a fork thoroughly.  Add egg mixture and raisins and mix well.  Chill.  Makes one serving.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa sausage,anise seed,corn oil,pita bread,mint leaf
title: Kielbasa Pita Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons corn oil | 8 ounces kielbasa sausage, casing removed | 3 small pita bread, cut into triangles | 6 mint leaves | 1 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, warm oil.  Add the kielbasa.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until no longer pink, about 15 to 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut pita breads in half.  Remove casings from sausage and cut into halves.  Stick a piece of kielbasa onto each side of fried pita.  Divide the mint leaves between pita halves.  Garnish with anise seed.  Serve.

title: Cubanelle Peppers
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion, chopped | 2 1/2 pounds cubanelle peppers, chopped | 2 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Cook onions in a large pot with the cubanelle peppers, vegetable stock and water until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Nori Rolled Fish
ingredients: 4 soft lobster, fillets ( cod, pike, hake, perch, perch, snapper ) | 4 sheets nori ( seaweed or dry seaweed ) | 3 tablespoons cooked turkey breast
instructions: If using soft lobster fillets, carefully remove any muscle muscle from the underside of the fillets and carefully remove the fuzz under running water – if any areas of shell will float, tap the water gently to dislodge them.  If using hake fillets, remove any muscle and place them in the center of the nori sheets, and lightly moisten the top layer with more water.  Cut the sides of the nori sheets with scissors into strips 2 - 3 inches long.  Place about an inch or two at a time, between sheets of plastic and cut with a knife horizontally, vertically, until the filling is just barely under the surface of each nori sheet, leaving a 1/4 inch border.  Brush the nori lightly with more water.  Lay a sheet of plastic on the cutting board or a cutting board and place another sheet over the top.  Press one side of the nori strip firmly onto a cutting board or board and cut the strip into strips about 1/2 inch wide.  Spread the fish mixture over the nori in a straight line.  Starting at the right side, roll the nori, then cut the roll into 1 1/2 inch wide strips longer, ending with 1 1/2 inch wide strips of nori.  Repeat with the rest of the nori and filling.  Serve in a bowl or small dish while still hot.  Enjoy.

title: Mustard Roasted Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the dark sesame oil and mustard seed.  Stir in caraway seed.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Coat a 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray.  Pour the mustard seeds into the oil.  Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, checking after 10 minutes to make sure they brown on all sides.

title: Chickpea and Chocolate Instant Pot Mix
ingredients: 14 ounces chickpeas, canned drained and rinsed | 2 cups moist instant chocolate pudding mix
instructions: Place all ingredients in the bowl of a food processor and process on high for 1 minute until it looks like rice.

Random Ingredients: cellophane noodle,wine,queso sauce,mango salsa,chocolate syrup,jumbo shrimp,chocolate curl,red chilies
title: Chocolate Prawns and Mango Salsa!
ingredients: 3 cans jumbo shrimp, rinsed | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate syrup | 2 cans muir glen chocolate-covered sliced mango salsa | 2 -3 small red chilies | 1/2 cup queso sauce | 1/4 cup wine | 24 ounces cellophane noodles | 1/2 cup mango salsa
instructions: Place jumbo shrimp in a mixing bowl.  Dip shrimp in chocolate syrup then fry on a pan with 2 tablespoons of peanut oil.  Fry both sides until golden brown.  Remove shrimp to a serving dish and top with muir glen, mango salsa and red chili.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,fish sauce,asparagus,bicarbonate soda,sage,pepperoni,sage leaf,chicken bouillon cube
title: Faux Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 200 g asparagus | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | pepperoni | 1 tablespoon creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon fish sauce
instructions: Soak asparagus overnight in cold water – then drain excess water from the stalks.  Slice asparagus into 1/2 inch lengths.  Place everything in a large bowl, add the asparagus and mix with your hands, breaking the asparagus up while moving it around in the bowl.  Let it sit for 45 minutes before serving.

title: Chatni Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g fresh raw cashews or 500 g fresh unsalted raw cashews | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/3 teaspoon curry powder | 1/3 teaspoon amchri amchoor powder ( dry mango powder ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon apricot jam, heated and dissolved
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a plastic bag.  Close the bag and shake to combine.  Marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature.  Make sure the cashewnuts are covered with a little water and refrigerate for an hour or two.  Remove the cashewnuts from the bag and thread onto metal skewers.  Broil under normal conditions for about 5minutes until the cashewnuts are brown and crispy.

title: Linda's Quinoa Pizza
ingredients: 1 -2 medium pizza dough | 1 cup cooked quinoa | 1 cup sliced button mushrooms | 1 cup sliced watermelon | 1 cup pizza cheese balls | 1 -2 anchovy, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Rinse quinoa.  In a bowl mix together quinoa, mushrooms, watermelon slices and pizza cheese balls.  Sprinkle a couple of tbsp of anchovy on top if desired.  Slice into small balls then bake on pizza tray until brown and crispy.  I like cooking this at the oven at 190c for a couple of hours.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,tomato ketchup,basmati rice,lemon peel,olive,filling,basil leaf,malt vinegar
title: Baked Basmati Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped onion | 2/3 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup tomato ketchup | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 1/2 - 2 cups cooked basmati rice | 1 can olives, sliced, undrained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves | 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a bowl, stir together the onion, vinegar, ketchup, onion soup mix, rice, olives, basil, and lemon peel until evenly mixed.  Line a baking sheet with waxed paper.  Place rice mixture onto sheets with the waxed paper side up.  Bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.  Allow to cool for 10 minutes before eating.  Great for dipping or serving with tomato sauce, or to taste.

title: Spanish Red Pepper Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red bell peppers, minced | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: In a large bowl, combine red bell peppers, garlic and sherry vinegar.

title: Barley Mustard
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coarse grain mustard | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 150 g pearl barley, rinsed
instructions: Place mustard and rum into a small heavy based saucepan.  Heat oven to 140c on a baking tray or baking sheet.  Add 1 cup boiling water, then stir in barley.  Cook until liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat, cover and leave to stand 10 minutes before serving.  Cooks note, barley can be made up to two days ahead and chilled.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,buttermilk,sharp cheddar cheese,tarragon vinegar,liquid honey,cayenne,lime juice,mushroom
title: Cheddar and Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup bottled liquid honey | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon vinegar | cayenne | 1/3 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 12 medium mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 1/2 cup packed fresh tarragon vinegar
instructions: Whisk together first 5 ingredients in a bowl.

title: Feta-Stuffed Pork Roast
ingredients: 4 pork loin roast, fat trimmed | 100 g feta, crumbled | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 -2 teaspoon curry paste or 1 -2 teaspoon other curry
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Place all the ingredients in a dish with a lid with a lid, press together.  Make sure fat gets into each piece of roast and tie with kitchen twine.  Place roast on a rack in a roasting tin.  Roast for about 1 hour, turning once or twice so the fat doesn't burn,.  Check temperature after 1 to 1 1/2 hours and see if it's cooked to your liking.  Allow to cool slightly before carving.

title: Indian Vegetable Smoothie
ingredients: 250 g skinless turnips | 50 g green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon greek natural yoghurt, to serve
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender and process until smooth.

title: Cape Capsicum (Chinese Style Peppercorn Condiment)
ingredients: 1 cup szechuan peppercorns | 1 red chili pepper, crushed
instructions: Wash the salt with a cloth and rinse through several changes of damp cloth.  Remove and discard any white seeds.  Use a mortar and pestle for pound/pound the peppercorns against the flat surface of the spices.  The peppercorns are ground into a coarse powder and should not be pulverized by the blades of a knife.  Add the hot chilli pepper.  Place in a mortar and mortar and grind together well until there are large fine pieces of peppercorn.

title: Wild Rice With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice | 1/2 lb fresh portabella mushroom, sliced | 1/3 cup light brown onion, diced | 1/4 cup shallot, diced | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup fresh lemonade | 1/4 cup toasted pecans
instructions: Over medium high heat combine all ingredients except for pecans.

Random Ingredients: steak,pea,lemon juice,confectioner sugar,cumin powder,linguine,angel hair pasta,cumin seed
title: Pasta With Steak and Peas
ingredients: 1 pound flank steak | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 2 tablespoons ground cumin powder ( i use chipotle ) | 2 tablespoons ground cumin seeds | 1 package dried linguine | 6 ounces frozen peas, thawed | 2 teaspoons crushed dried cumin powder | 1 cup confectioners'sugar, for dusting | 1 package frozen, linguine
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions.  Coat a large saucepan with cooking spray.  Cut steak into thin strips.  Whisk together steak and next 4 ingredients in a medium bowl.  Add pasta to steak.

title: The Best Shrimp Brochettes
ingredients: 1 kg shrimp, uncooked, peeled | 3 tablespoons juniper berries
instructions: Pre heat broiler or grill.  Cut the shrimp in long chiffonnade lengthwise, using only the backs and tail and leaving the tail on.  Place on an oiled baking tray or in a shallow non metallic dish.  Crush the juniper berries, and then scatter over the shrimp.  Sprinkle over the juniper berries.  Broil or grill for about 5 - 10 minutes, or until the tops are dark & black and the shrimp are cooked and bubbling.  The shrimp should not be cooked, but just cooked.  Note, if you prefer to serve quickly, allow yourself 3 to 5 minutes per person depending how high quality you like your shrimp.  Serve with boiled potatoes, as an accompaniment to pasta or on its own.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,balsamic vinaigrette,oyster,flat bread,bell pepper,scallion,white bread flour,caraway seed
title: Oysters Rockefeller
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces oysters or 4 1/2 ounces other frozen seafood, thawed | 4 tablespoons pimento, drained | 4 tablespoons sweet butter or 4 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinaigrette | 1 1/2 cups chopped scallions or 1 1/2 cups chopped green onions | 1 1/2 cups grated carrots or 1 1/2 cups grated peeled carrots | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 dash of caraway seed | 1 loaf white bread flour | chopped flat bread or toasted rye bread
instructions: Cut off the shells from the shrimp and discard.  Rinse well under cold water and pat dry.  Set them aside.  In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients and mix well.  Coat the shrimp pieces well.  On a piece of bread, lay 1 shrimp on it, top with half the shrimp and then with the rest of the shrimp.  Roll the shrimp up.  Wrap each shrimp in a piece of string or tie on a piece of bread.  Set aside.  Place the bread dough in the refrigerator.  Preheat the broiler.  Roll each shrimp roll in cornmeal, coating evenly.  Remove the shrimp.  Cut one end off a shrimp roll and use to make an opening for the shrimp.  Place each shrimp on a shallow dish.  Cover with the mozzarella cheese and top with a slice of rye bread or toasted bread.  Broil or grill each shrimp until golden and bubbly.  Serve immediately.

title: Bourekia (Grilled Sandwich)
ingredients:
8 slices white bread | 1 medium russet potato, boiled, but cooled | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1/3 cup honey | 1/4 cup a.
    -1.
    - original sauce ( sweetened a & b ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thai seasoning | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat.  Cut bread slices in half, then into quarters.  Cut potato slices in half, lengthwise.  Place halves on cutting board, cut side down, on grate, close grill.  Grill bread slices with a small splash of oil, turn slices once, grill on second side until dark brown and crisp.  Transfer to cutting board and let sit 5 minutes.  Turn off grill.  While bread is grilling, whisk ketchup, honey, sauces, and seasoning in small bowl to blend.  Remove bread from grill.  Brush tops with sauce.  Slice bread to make 5 triangles, then serve with asafoetida.

Random Ingredients: flour,rigatoni pasta,frying chicken,plain flour,coleslaw mix,shiitake mushroom,raisin bread
title: Chinese Chicken Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 500 g dry rigatoni pasta | 2 frying chickens | 1 bunch coleslaw mix | 1 cup shiitake mushroom, halved | 1/3 cup plain flour | 2 cups coleslaw mix, shredded | 1/3 cup raisins or 1/3 cup sultanas | plain flour, for dusting
instructions: Bring large amount of water to boil.  Cook rigatoni according to the packet instructions and drain.  Cut the rest of the ingredients into small pieces, toss through the flour and keep warm.  In a hot frying pan fry the chicken for 3 - 4 minutes or until golden brown and sealed.  Turn off the heat and remove the chicken to a plate.  Add chicken back to the pan and add the mushrooms, mix through, and serve with coleslaw and hoisin sauce.

title: Oven Fried Chicken Breasts Basil-Tarragon Style
ingredients:
8 boneless skinless chicken breast halves ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 teaspoons dried basil ( or 1 tblsp.
    - fresh basil )
instructions: If using fresh basil, wash and remove stems.  Pat dry chicken with paper towels.  Sprinkle each breast with salt, pepper, and 1 tblsps basil.  Place on a rack in a 10 x 6 x 2 inch baking dish.  Using a sharp knife, cut crosswise through the chicken crosswise every 2 inches.  Remove chicken from the dish and set aside.  Repeat with remaining chicken.  Spread 1/2 teaspoon dried basil on each chicken breast.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Bake chicken uncovered 25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.  Pour off any excess liquid.  Serve.

title: Jeera Pulao
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons garlic paste, crushed | 2 1/2 tablespoons ground yellow bell pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh ginger paste, peeled and crushed | rice ( to serve )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well with electric beater.  Store in an airtight container in the fridge or the freezer for up to 2 months.  To serve, place a thin coating of the seasoned hot sauce on one end of each pulao.

title: Almond Powder With Season (Smebec)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 teaspoons paprika
instructions: Combine all ingredients and spread on your favorite cookie.  Store unused portions in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: leek,pepper jack cheese,juniper berry,boston butt pork shoulder roast
title: Chef John's Potted Pork
ingredients: 5 pounds boston butt or pork shoulder roast | 1 cup sliced leeks, well rinsed | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped juniper berries | 1/2 cup shredded pepper jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Cut shoulder roast into 6 to 8 portions, lengthwise.  Spread leeks onto a baking sheet, arrange half of the portions atop leeks, and top with half of the juniper berries.  Repeat layers until all ingredients are used.  Bake in preheated oven until the fat on the bottom of the pan has rendered completely, about 2 hours.  Remove and discard the fat cap from the oven, and top off with the cheese.

Random Ingredients: egg white,cashew nut,hoisin sauce,baking soda,mayonnaise,alfredo sauce
title: Hoisin and Cashews Nuts
ingredients: 3 cups raw cashew nuts | 4 egg whites | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 jar garlic and herb alfredo sauce | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease and flour a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Place nuts in a large bowl, and set aside.  Beat egg whites in a large bowl with an electric mixer until smooth.  Gradually add mayonnaise and garlic herb alfredo sauce.  Fold in cashews.  Place into prepared baking dish.  Pour hoisin sauce over top.  Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick or knife inserted into the middle of the cake comes out clean, about 45 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes before removing from baking dish.

title: Mexican Corn Salad
ingredients: 20 corn ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 ears fresh apricot jam | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 3 tablespoons chopped hazelnuts ( toasted ) | 2 teaspoons table salt | 16 bamboo skewers
instructions: Dry the corn on paper towels and cut off the tips.  If you are serving the salad on the same day, you can wrap the corn around them as directed on the wrap package, and refrigerate.  When ready to serve, arrange 1/4 corncobs over 1 end of the corn.  Spread 1/4 apricot jam on the kernels and then sprinkle 2 tablespoons sugar on the jam.  Place 1 more corncob on top of this jam followed by sprinkling more nuts and 1 teaspoons salt.  Place the skewers on the rack of a broiler pan and broil or grill until the corn is hot and lightly charred.  Sprinkle with more sugar while still warm and serve warm.

title: Lamb and Carrots Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g baby carrots or 500 g baby potatoes, scrubbed | 750 g ground lamb
instructions: Boil water and vegetables for 10 - 15 minutes or until tender.  Transfer to a large bowl, add lamb and knead with hands until smooth.  Divide mixture into 30 pieces and shape into small patties using approximately 5cm diameter of carrot.  Heat grill pan until moderately hot.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs halibut fillets | 1 dozen medium prawns | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place fish in a large dutch oven, add bay leaf.  Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, turning fish halfway through.  Add prawns when just cooked.  If shrimp are too thick, thin with water.

title: Nacho Cheese Fajitas
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon prepared chili | 1 1/4 cups prepared pasta sauce
instructions: Spread 1 tablespoon of mayonnaise in the center of one tortilla.  Sprinkle chili over the mayonnaise.  Roll up the tortilla completely and slice in half.  To make fajitas, place 1/8 of the tortilla in a lightly greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish.  Cover the tortillas with the remaining tortillas and the sauce.  Cover with foil and bake in a preheated 400 degree oven 12 to 15 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.  Serve hot.

title: Basic Polenta
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shortening or 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1 small onion flakes | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon demi-glace or 3/4 teaspoon chili paste
instructions: Melt shortening or grapeseed oil in a small saucepan.  Cook onion for 1 - 2 minutes or until tender.  Add remaining ingredients and cook till liquid is almost evaporated and mixture is thickened.  Drain off any excess fat.

title: Chipotle Beer Baked in Spanish Toast
ingredients: 2 fresh chipotle peppers ( see footnote for recipe link ) | 24 ounces beer, i used dark mexican beer | 4 ounces coffee liqueur | 4 slices white bread, thick slices ( like challah or other bread ) | 1/4 cup salsa ( see my recipe link )
instructions: Place all ingredients in medium bowl.  Stuff the bread with the beer.  Dip bread in bread and bake at 350°f until golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes per side.  Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,olive oil,golden mushroom soup,cornstarch,lemon zest,squid,button mushroom
title: Soup for Two
ingredients: 3 cans condensed golden mushroom soup | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 20 -24 medium button mushrooms, quartered | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 lb fresh snow pea, trimmed | 3 lbs fresh squid, cleaned, cut into 1 pieces
instructions: Heat oil to boiling in large pot.  Add mushrooms, cook 3 - 5 minutes on medium heat, stirring constantly.  Add soup, cover and simmer 20 - 25 minutes.  Turn heat off.  Stir in lemon rind, stir to combine and cover.  Set aside.  In separate pot, mix cornstarch with 2 1/2 cups of boiling water.  Stir into pot.  Stir constantly until mixture thickens.  Add snow peas, bring to boil.  Add squid pieces, simmer, uncovered 4 - 5 minutes.  Serves.

title: Creamy Peanut Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soy milk | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon raw peanuts | 1 tablespoon black vinegar | 2 containers rag� pasta sauce ( the brand in the grocery store ) or ( 12 ounce ) containers ranch salad dressing, for dipping
instructions: Place the soy milk in a small saucepan, and heat until warm.  Add the chopped mint leaves and peanuts.  Dip the noodles into the warm soy milk, and then drain.  Place into a bowl, and toss with the vinegar until coated.  Divide salad among 4 serving dishes.  Top with noodles, and drizzle with remaining dressing.

title: Bacon and Eggplant Stew
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 4 plum tomatoes | 4 japanese eggplants | 1/2 lb bacon | 8 pak choi ( japanese eggs ) | 1/4 cup curry leaf
instructions: Cut the bacon into 1 inch squares.  Rinse the chicken under cold water to remove the gagged surface.  Peel and remove the membrane from each tomato, and cut lengthwise in half.  Cut the eggplant lengthwise, and then crosswise into 1/2 inch slices.  Cut up the tomatoes in a food processor with a cross hatch blade and set aside.  Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Put the chicken in a very large roasting pan.  Pour enough water into the pan to cover the chicken, and place into the preheated oven.  Roast the chicken for 45 minutes, until a meat thermometer reads 180 degrees f.  Meanwhile, steam the eggplant over boiling water, turning once, until soft, about 25 minutes.  Slice the eggplants crosswise into 1/4 inch slices, and place into a colander.  Rinse briefly, and drain.  Cut the bacon strips crosswise into 1 inch squares, and place into a large, heavy frying pan.  Cut up the tomatoes, and pour 1 1/2 cups hot water into the pan.  Set the pan over medium heat, and when it begins to boil, add the chopped eggplant.  Stir, and season with salt.  Return to the boiling, and cook for about fifteen minutes.  Remove from the heat and set aside.  When the chicken is cooked, carefully remove it from the pan, place it into a large saucepan, and pour off any fat on the pan bottom.  Cut 2 pieces of aluminum foil smaller than the chicken.  Place a piece of chicken in the center of a piece of foil.  Break an eggplant piece into a medium bowl.  Hold the bowl at the bottom, and use it to scoop out a portion of the eggplant pulp into the bowl.  Add the pieces of chicken and chopped tomatoes to the bowl in the same manner.

title: Salsa Mango Rolled Moco-Coating (Bacon Rolls) (Gluten Free Copycat Recipe)
ingredients: 1/2 package mochiko sweet rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 2 ripe mangoes | bacon, strips | mango salsa ( homemade or hot ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix mochiko and vanilla until a dough forms.  Add sliced mangoes and roll into a log.  Slice off a corner or 2 around the mango and place on a piece of paper towel.  Rub or pat the paper towel to remove any air pockets and to keep them from drying out.  Heat grill to medium/high.  Slice log on bias into 1/4 inch thick pieces, about 3/4 inch wide.  Put them on grill and cook until golden, about 3 minutes per side.

title: Corn, Raspberry-Raspberry and Coriander Grilled Corn Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn kernels, frozen, thawed | 1/4 cup unsweetened raspberry vinegar | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped coriander seed | 1 tablespoon low-fat mayonnaise
instructions: In medium bowl, combine corn, vinegar, soy sauce, coriander and mayonnaise.  Stir gently to mix.  Season over to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Beef Fries With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, trimmed of fat | 1 lb cremini mushroom, thickly sliced | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place steak and mushrooms in large bowl.  Cover with saran wrap, and marinate at least 2 hours and preferably overnight.  Drain vegetables and mushrooms.  Whisk together vinegar and oil until blended.  Place 2 tablespoons of mixture on each steak.  Bring to boil, then lower heat.  Cover and simmer gently for about 25 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Havana Rasam(Indian Ouzo)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ouzo | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and mix with a fork.  Done note, i love to sprinkle a bit of cardamom powder on my hava mixture.

title: Rooster in Sherry
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cut crosswise into large pieces, or more to taste | 1/4 cup sherry wine, or more as needed
instructions: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet.  Cook and stir bacon in the hot bacon and sherry over medium high heat until heated through, about 10 minutes.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lipton onion soup mix,chive,roast beef,port wine
title: Oxford Beef Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs roast, about | 5 packets lipton onion soup mix | 1 cup port wine ( good quality ) | 1 teaspoon dried chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit.  Place roast in oven with au jus if using, cover and roast for approximately 8 hours or until tender.  Remove the roast, tent with aluminum foil and let rest for 15 minutes before removing the aluminum foil.  Drain the fat from the pan, add the dry onion soup mix, port and dried chives.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  If gravy seems too thick for your taste, you can thicken with a bit of water.  I have also served over potatoes or noodles with this recipe, and liked it with a slice or two of beef brisket.  I have even baked this with rice, but this is a favorite in our house.

Random Ingredients: red onion,cilantro,dark soy sauce,star anise,white vinegar,fish sauce,russet potato
title: Vietnamese-Style Baked Spicy Potatoes
ingredients: 3 cups grated russet potatoes | 1 1/4 small red onions, minced | 1 tablespoon fish sauce or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground star anise | 1/4 bunch cilantro, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f, and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place grated potatoes in a large bowl and toss with onion, fish sauce, dark soy sauce, vinegar, star anise, and cilantro.  Mix well.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Pour potato mixture into a casserole dish, and bake for one hour, until potatoes are browned and tender.

title: Shrimp and Pork Temptation
ingredients: 400 -500 g shrimp, peeled, deveined ( uncooked ) | 1 beef starlet ( i used red cardamom star or you can use 100g sun-dried tomatoes with a bit of oil ) | 350 g chicken stewing meat or 350 g pork tenderloin | 500 g baby carrots, with tops | 1 can sliced and drained olives, drained | 400 -500 g white flour ( more if you're not using all of it ) | 250 -250 ml water, mixed with | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 12 large tortillas
instructions: If using pork tenderloin cut into strips, not chunks, cut into cubes, cut into chunks place in bowl of cold water, toss, cover and marinade for about 1 hour drain shrimp if necessary.  Cut meat into strips and toss through flour till you have a paste, adding more if need be till paste like texture.  Don't over marinate the meat, or it'll be dry.

title: Tomato, Spice & Juniper
ingredients: 28 ounces stewed tomatoes | 7 -8 juniper berries | spices
instructions: Rinse tomatoes and cut in half the way through.  Slice about 1 centimeter thick.  Place in a clean dish and sprinkle generously with spice, leave overnight.  Fry tomatoes in oil until browned, turning to brown evenly.  Leave in dry pan and continue heating until thick and aromatic.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,currant,kaffir lime leaf,canadian bacon,rotini pasta,ice,italian seasoning,shrimp
title: The Easiest Shrimp and Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rotini pasta | 1 1/2 cups cooked shrimp | 1 1/2 cups canadian bacon, diced | 10 kaffir lime leaves, sliced at a 45 degree angle | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 3 cups shredded marshmallows | 6 cups miniature marshmallows | ice, as needed
instructions: Cook pasta according to package.  Dice the shrimp into 1/2 inch pieces.  To cook, cook shrimps and cook them until pink, about 2 - 3 minutes.  Drain the shrimp then return them to the pot and cook them until they are just firm to the bite.  Set aside to cool, then finely chop the shrimps.  Place drained shrimp, bacon, lime leaves, italian seasoning, and marshmallows in a large bowl.  Pour the pasta into a larger bowl.  Make a v in the center of the bowl and pour in the shrimp mixture.  Toss.  Add ice if mixture becomes too dry.  Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,self raising flour,onion,juniper berry,chicken bouillon cube,red wine
title: Braised Onions
ingredients: 10 ounces self raising flour | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons red wine | 1 ounce flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 onions, halved and cut into half moons | 1 small bay leaf
instructions: Dissolve the bouillon cube in the red wine.  Add all the other ingredients and combine lightly, but gently, so the flour doesn't mix.  Roll the mixture into a long roll.  Place in a non stick ovenproof casserole dish, cover and cook for 1 hour at 160°c.  This will give you the onions nice crisp glaze.  Remove the onions and bay leaf, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: veal,head iceberg lettuce,orange juice concentrate,crouton,jalapeno pepper,ginger root
title: Veal and Orange Salad with Ginger
ingredients: 1 jar frozen orange juice concentrate | 1 pound ground veal | 1 1/2 cups finely shredded red-leaf lettuce | 1 small head iceberg lettuce, rinsed and dried | crouton | cooked chopped jalapeno pepper ( optional )

instructions: Stir molasses, salt and paprika in small bowl until combined.

title: Chew Nuts & Brittle
ingredients: 6 tablespoons turbinado sugar ( or to taste ) | 2 1/4 lbs small hard rolls | 2 1/4 lbs cashew nuts
instructions: Place the sugar in a 2 quart heavy saucepan.  Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally, and boil hard rolls 1 minute.  Reduce the heat to low and keep hot over low heat.  Place the nuts onto a baking sheet lined with lightly floured wax paper.  Turn nuts, 1 at a time, and dry on paper towels.  Spread each with the turbinado.  Bake at 300 degrees for 8 minutes.  Cool.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Shaoxing Sauce
ingredients: 4 pieces chili peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 cup dry sherry
instructions: Place the chili peppers and sherry into a glass jar with tight fitting lid.  Cover the jar and shake until the alcohol has melted and is thoroughly mixed inches.  Alternatively, you can place the chili peppers and sherry into a small saucepan and bring it to a boil.  Reduce the heat and simmer for 3 minutes.  Allow to cool, then pour into a glass jar and refrigerate.  This will keep for up to five days.

title: Pork Cutlets With Chickpeas and Radishes
ingredients: 2 pork cutlets | 2 chicken breast | 1 ounce washed chickpeas | 1 ounce radish, cut into thin strips | 1 ounce worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Marinate the pork, chicken and chickpeas with worcestershire sauce and lemon juice.  Cook the vegetables with some seasoning, drain.  Place mixture under the grill for 3 - 5 minutes until chicken is cooked.

title: Cocoa Mix
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cocoa powder | 4 tablespoons kim chee or 4 tablespoons other dry chunky peanut
instructions: Put the cocoa powder, kim chee, and dry mix in a bowl.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,white wine vinegar,basil leaf,white sugar,red pepper flake,green chili pepper
title: Salsa with Green Chiles
ingredients: 2 cans mild green chile peppers | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup white sugar | 5 large fresh basil leaves | 1/2 cup thick and chunky salsa
instructions: Remove seeds from chiles with a spoon, but leave stems intact.  Place in a bowl with water to cover.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.  Drain.  Place chilies in a pot of fresh water to cover.

title: Winter Seeds and Raisins Salad
ingredients: 1 lb butternut pumpkin, peeled and cubed ( about 3 ) | 1/2 lb seedless cucumber, diced ( about 3 ) | 2 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: Put pumpkin cubes and cucumber in a large microwaveable bowl and microwave uncovered on medium high power 7 min.  Or until cucumbers are plump, heated through and slightly softened.  Stir in the raisins.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,sultana,bulb garlic,oregano,grain white rice,red onion
title: The Easiest Spanish Rice!
ingredients: 1/2 red onion, peeled and finely chopped | 1 bulb of garlic, peeled and crushed | 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup sultana
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well,.  Cover and chill for 30 minutes or overnight.  Turn oven on and heat oven to 200 deg c.  Spread rice evenly in a large shallow, ovenproof dish big enough to fit the dish.  Sprinkle the top with grated cheddar cheese.  Bake for 20 minutes until heated through.  Turn the rice out upside down onto a dish towel and leave until cold enough to handle.

title: German Beef and Cornbread
ingredients: 1 lb rump steak | 12 ounces rye bread, thickly sliced | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables, defrosted
instructions: Trim any excess fat off the steak and slice across the grain into 1/4 inch thick strips.  Arrange strips of meat on a preheated baking sheet which covers loosely with foil.  Roast in a preheated oven at 375°f for about 25 – 30 minutes or until cooked through, turning once.

title: Japanese Onion-Cilantro Beef
ingredients: 2 sirloin steaks, boneless about 1 pound | 1/4 cup mirin | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 2 tablespoons cumin | 1/4 cup cilantro, minced | 5 tablespoons maraschino cherries
instructions: Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to high.  Cut meat into 1/4 inch slices.  Sprinkle with salt, if desired.  Grill onion slices 5 inches from heat for 4 minutes.  Turn slices and grill for 2 minutes or until they are lightly browned.  Remove meat from heat.  In a bowl, combine all remaining ingredients except maraschino cherries.  Mix well.  Pour marinade over meat.

Random Ingredients: bragg liquid amino,whipping cream,pecan,dill weed,romaine lettuce
title: German Style Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream | 1/2 cup dried dill weed | 1/3 cup light braggs liquid aminos | 1/3 cup chopped pecans | 1 head romaine lettuce ( washed and cored )
instructions: In a blender, combine cream, dill, braggs, and pecans.  Cover and process at high speed a few seconds until smooth.  Add lettuce and process until the lettuce is well mixed.  Season to taste with more sugar.

title: Irish Country Ham Hock and Barley
ingredients: 2 ham hocks | 1 cup green cabbage | 1/2 cup barley ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pearl barley ( optional )
instructions: Place ham hocks in a soup pot and cover with 2 inches of boiling water.  Place bay leaf on ham hocks and add optional ingredient of choice.  Cover and boil for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,balsamic vinegar,green pepper,white peppercorn,green bell pepper,sesame oil,vinegar,brown mustard seed
title: Aurora's French Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, seeded and sliced into 1/4-inch pieces | 1 small green pepper, seeded and sliced into 1/4-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons white peppercorns ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the mustard seeds, balsamic vinegar, curry powder, and peppercorns.  Dressing, pour over vegetables and toss to coat.  Note, we often add a bit of red food coloring and/or sprinkling of green pepper.

title: Easy Tasty Red Curry Soup
ingredients: 1 can chicken-flavored broth ( you can use beef broth for a richer soup ) | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste ( i used vietnamese ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening, plus | 2 -3 tablespoons vegetable shortening ( i used becel for this )
instructions: In a large pan add the broth to a simmer for 5 - 10 minutes or until reduced by half and rich.  Add the curry paste and continue simmering for 2 - 3 minutes stirring.  Add the shortening and return to simmer.  Serve in bowls and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,wheat spaghetti,ladyfinger,marjoram,kaffir lime leaf,egg white,flour,vanilla bean
title: Tunisian Eggnog
ingredients: 500 g whole wheat spaghetti, preferably organic | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/3 cup flour | 4 egg whites | 2 tablespoons grated kaffir lime leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/8 teaspoon dry marjoram | 2 small vanilla beans, split lengthwise | 4 cups confectioners'sugar ( icing )
instructions: In a large pot boil the water and 1/2 the sugar.  Put in the spaghetti and cook until the pasta is al dente.  Drain and keep warm.  Meanwhile, in another pot, combine 1/2 cup of sugar and 3/4 cup of water.  Bring to a boil while stirring and watching closely to avoid scorching.  Cook until the sugar dissolves.  Turn off the heat and set aside to cool.  In a bowl, beat egg whites until stiff.  In a small mixing bowl, combine remaining sugar, a little flour, lime leaves, marjoram, marjoram, and vanilla.  Then, fold the egg whites into the sugar mixture.  Drain cooked pasta on paper towels and mix with 1/2 of the sugar/flour mixture.  Fold in the rest of the dry ingredients, and chill.  Prepare ladyfingers as per instructions on box.  Dip ladyfingers into half of the egg whites to coat the entire bottom and sides of two 8x8 inch metal baking pans.  Cover with 1/4 of the spaghetti mixture.  Cover with 1/4 of the sauce mixture.  Spread with half of remaining spaghetti and 1/4 of the remaining sauce.  Cover with 1/4 of the ladyfingers.  Repeat layers once more, ending with spaghetti and remaining remaining sauce.  Garnish with more lime leaves.  Refrigerate.

title: Sopa De Albondigas Y Caseras - Mexican Meatballs in Hot Pink Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground lean veal | 1 can chickpeas | 4 tablespoons dry crushed red food coloring | 1/3 lb country-style spareribs | 1 jar stuffed olives ( optional ) | 1 can white hominy, rinsed and drained
instructions: Combine veal, chickpeas, food coloring, spareribs in a large bowl.  Using hands, mix well.  Cover and refrigerate for several hours. .  Prepare posole and cook according to package instructions.  Remove from heat.  When meat is cool enough to handle, remove bones and skins, dice, and place in a large, deep saucepan.  Return soup to a boil, add water if the pot gets dry.  Cover and reduce heat to low.  Cook about 2 hours.  Add olives and cook for another hour, stirring often.  Add hominy.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,dashi stock,corn oil,tart apple,monterey jack cheese,garlic powder
title: Tasty Chinese Grilled Apples
ingredients: 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 1/2 teaspoons dashi stock | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 3 tart apples
instructions: Warm the oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Stir in the garlic powder and taco seasoning.  Add the dashi and cook until heated.  Add the apple slices and continue to cook until the mixture is light brown.  Serve immediately.

title: Creamed Spinach
ingredients: 1 cup white onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup spinach, chopped | 3 tablespoons low-fat soymilk | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | nutmeg
instructions: Mix onion, spinach and soy milk together.  Add grand marnier.  Add nutmeg and mix.  Serve over rice.

title: Cheese and Halva
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 3/4 cup kahlua | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1 lb cheese, shredded
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.  Reserve 1 1/2 cups water.  Drain pasta and return to pan.  Stir in keahlua, sugar and cayenne.  Remove cayenne pepper from sauce.  Stir bread crumbs into sauce and toss with pasta.  Spread pasta in greased 10x15 jelly roll pan and top with cheese.  Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.  Uncover and bake an additional 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: orange,bacon,canola oil,chili oil,thai peanut sauce,cheddar cheese,dark rum
title: Caribbean Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/3 cup dark rum | 3/4 cup thai peanut sauce | 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese | 1 large orange, zested, juiced | 1/2 cup chopped crispy bacon | 2 tablespoons chili oil ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together canola oil, dark rum and thai peanut sauce until smooth.  Stir in cheddar cheese until melted.  Stir in orange zest.  Slice orange in half, zest from an orange, and slice into thin wedges.  Reserve the other half of the orange for another use.  Place one strip of bacon in each of four small ramekins.  Divide peanut butter among the ramekins.  Pour marinade over the bacon and orange slices.  Sprinkle chili oil over peanuts, and place ramekins on a plate until ready to serve.

title: Creamy Japanese Salad
ingredients: 300 g lettuce | 1/2 cucumber | 1 teaspoon soy miso ( optional ) | 3 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 3 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Cut the lettuce into thin slices, and keep in a bowl.  Slice the cucumber into rounds, then chop roughly.  Mix together the yoghurt, dashi, miso, worcestershire sauce and vanilla essence.  Add lettuce, cucumber slices and yoghurt mixture, making sure to blend everything together properly.

Random Ingredients: mango,kalamata olive,part mozzarella cheese,chervil,red chili pepper,walnut
title: Souvlakia
ingredients: 10 pitted kalamata olives | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chervil | 1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese, divided | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mango | 1 fresh red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | crushed walnuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.  Sprinkle with a few crushed walnuts to serve.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,pumpernickel bread,wheat flour,red kidney bean,taco seasoning,cajun seasoning
title: Torta Mexicana
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup taco seasoning | 1/4 cup cajun seasoning | 2 cups raine lettuce, chopped | 4 cups red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 4 pumpernickel bread rounds or 4 sourdough bread
instructions: In a medium bowl.

title: Samaki
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck | 1 pint whole milk | 3 tablespoons hot asian sesame oil
instructions: Cube the chuck into large cubes.  Bring 2 quarts of water to boil and add beef cubes.  Cook for 2 hours.  Drain liquid and skim off the grayish white foam.  Measure 2 quarts of liquid and add to the meat and bring to a boil.  Skim and bring to a boil again, skimming the foam.  Continue to boil until meat becomes tender.  Cut into 1/2 inch thick slices and return to the pot.  Heat milk with sesame oil and pour into the pot.  Remove the foam from the top of the pot.  Slice meat into 1/2 inch wide strips and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: flour,ginger garlic paste,sourdough bread,brandy,beef chuck roast,red wine,green cardamom pod
title: Sogan Josh
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck roast, cut into cubes | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 3 tablespoons dry red wine | 4 green cardamom pods, split open | 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | 1 loaf sourdough bread, day old cut into 1 inch cubes | flour ( for dredging )
instructions: Coarsely chop the roast and transfer to a shallow dish.  Sprinkle with the ginger garlic paste and toss to coat well.  In a small bowl, combine the wine, cardamoms and brandy.  Pour the flavored brandkle over the roast in the dish and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, overnight if possible.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Remove the roast from the marinade and dry on paper towels.  Dredge the roast in flour, pressing as much aside as possible.  In a large dutch oven, dutch oven or roasting pan, arrange the meat in a single layer.  Pour the marinade over meat and return to the stove.  Cover and bake until the meat falls apart.  Stromboli should take approximately 2 hours.  Remove meat from the oven and let rest.  Cut into 2 inch pieces, return to the pan and toss to coat with juices, add salt and pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,italian sausage,maple syrup
title: Easy Glaze and Basting Salt for Sausages
ingredients: 12 italian sausages ( i prefer mild ) | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 8 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Preheat the salsifyer and preheat your cast iron skillet.  Remove the casings from the sausages and cut them into thin slices.  Cut them lengthwise with a serrated knife and place them on a small sheet of waxed paper or parchment paper.  Brush each slice with olive oil, then brush the slices with maple syrup.  Bake at 375 for 12 - 15 minutes.

title: Papaya (Filipino Beef and Beans)
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 lb fresh mushrooms, finely chopped | 1 can italian cut green beans, rinsed and drained | 2 teaspoons walnut oil | 3/4 cup catsup | 1/3 cup brown rice vinegar | 1 can tomatillos, drained and sliced | 1 can beer
instructions: Brown meat in a large skillet or wok over medium high heat.  Drain.  Add mushrooms to meat and cook until no moisture remains.  Add beans, walnut oil and catsup.  Stir to mix.  Add vinegar, tomatillos and beer.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes or until sauce is thickened.  Serve over rice.

title: Sauerkraut Tacos (Copycat)
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 1/2 cups sauerkraut, drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and serve.

title: Chipped Beef With Coconut Rice
ingredients: 20 ounces shredded steak | 10 ounces boneless skinless coconut milk | 1/4 teaspoon oregano leaves, crushed | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 3 -4 fresh green chilies, chopped | 1 1/2 cups cooked basmati rice, and steamed jasmine rice
instructions: Coat meat with the marinade & set aside at least 1 hour.  Place meat in a saucepan along with the coconut milk, oregano & chilies & mix well.

title: Dark Chocolate Bark
ingredients: 4 -5 ounces premium dark chocolate | 2 ounces spanish paprika
instructions: Place all ingredients in a heavy plastic bag and stir to combine.  Store in refridgerator for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,chili oil,garlic granule,peach,ear corn,onion flake,celery rib,artichoke heart
title: Savory Peach-Artichoke French Toast
ingredients: 1/2 cup onion flakes | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules | 1/3 cup dried artichoke hearts ( not canned ) | 1 can sliced canned peaches ( drained, not mashed ) | 1/2 cup dried celery rib | 1/4 cup sliced canned artichoke heart | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried celery granules | 1/2 teaspoon dried instant minced onion flakes | 4 slices whole wheat bread | 1 teaspoon ground chili oil
instructions: Sauce, in a small bowl combine the first seven ingredients.  Toast, in a large non stick skillet or griddle, heat the chili oil until very hot over high heat.  Add all the ingredients except the bread.  Stir fry for about 1 to 3 minutes or until mixture is hot.  Spoon the warm sauce over the toast and serve immediately.

title: Quick Italian Tomato Sauce (For the Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 cans tomato basil pasta sauce | 1 jar maraschino cherries, sliced ( about 5 cups )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low in crock pot for 6 to 8 hours.  Serve with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

title: Flemish Caraway Cream
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seed, roughly crushed | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 60 g sour cream | 125 ml double cream
instructions: Place the caraway seeds in a small frying pan and fry over a moderate heat for 1–2 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally.  Tip in the sherry and bubble for 1–2 minutes, until reduced by half.  Remove the pan from the heat and leave to cool slightly.  Whip the sour cream until soft peaks form and fold in them gently.  Place the caraway cream in the refrigerator.  To serve, place the caraway cream into serving dishes, and top with a dollop of sour cream.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef,green bell pepper,cashew,chicken bouillon cube,chicken bouillon,chicken breast half
title: Cashews and Chicken Fritters
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, sliced | 32 ounces ground cashews | 2 green bell peppers, sliced | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 chicken bouillon cube, mashed with a pinch of salt | 16 chicken wings or 32 chicken drumsticks
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook chicken with cashews, bell peppers, bouillon, and chicken in hot bouillon until chicken is no longer pink inside, about 5 minutes per side.  Remove from heat.

title: Homemade Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 can of crushed chili, your choice | 1 slice bacon
instructions: Mix chili powder with bacon.  You can dehydrate it.  I prefer the fat/oil method, so i put it in a ziploc bag.  Use as directed for chili.

Random Ingredients: brown bean sauce,bread crumb,black truffle,mango,phyllo pastry,bicarbonate soda,marjoram,vegetable
title: Baked Green Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown beans sauce | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | 1 pinch marjoram | 2 teaspoons vegetable fat, softened | 1 teaspoon mangoes, diced | 1 teaspoon black truffles, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c and grease a 20cm/4x8 inch/10tray baking dish with cooking oil or butter.  Mix together the brown bean sauce and vegetables, and spoon into the prepared dish.  Sprinkle the bicarb of soda on top.  Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through.  Remove from oven and stir the mango pieces and truffles through the vegetable mixture.  Return to oven and bake a further 10 - 15 minutes until golden, crisp and slightly softened.  Serve with bread or as a topping with savoury biscuits and fresh herb leaves.

title: Christmas Eve Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pink beans, canned, but drained | 2 tablespoons pimientos | 2 tablespoons chopped dill pickles | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped | ground black pepper & celery salt, to taste | 1/4 cup melted chocolate syrup | 1/2 teaspoon mixed herbs, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees.  Combine the beans, pimentos, pickles, chives, black pepper and celery salt.  Stir to blend and set aside.  Toast the sandwich by spreading a thin layer of chocolate syrup on the untoasted side.  Place the sandwich on a cookie sheet, drizzle the melted chocolate syrup over.  Sprinkle the top with additional sprinkleings.

Random Ingredients: black bean,red capsicum,mustard seed,self raising flour,sage,pork,bell pepper
title: Baked Pork and Black Bean Baked in a Bag
ingredients: 250 g pork ( in one piece ) or 250 g chicken pieces ( in one piece ) | 1/2 cup self-raising flour, sifted | 1/2 cup black beans, soaked over night and cooked | 2 red capsicums, chopped | 2 bell peppers, chopped | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon sage
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200 200c degrees.  Grease & line a baking tray.  Rub the pork or chicken pieces with a little salt and pepper.  Place the flour, beans and capsicum in a bag then shake to coat.  Add the pork or chicken pieces and shake to coat.  Place on the baking tray.  Place the bag in the pre heated oven and bake for 30 - 40 minutes, until browns and cooked through.  Serve with a tomato sauce or a salad and steamed green beans.

Random Ingredients: pineapple ring,sea salt,octopus,red onion,green bell pepper,bread brown,lump crabmeat,tofu
title: Tropical Stuffed Prawns
ingredients: 15 large shrimp | 6 large octopus, cleaned, deveined | 15 crabmeat, picked over with your hands | 1/2 small red onion, quartered | 1/2 small green bell pepper, chopped | 12 -14 pineapple rings, cut in half ( see illustrations below ) | sea salt ( to taste ) | 6 tablespoons toasted bread and butter, divided
instructions: Shell prawns into their shells and set aside.  Wash and devein the octopus, and use your fingers to flatten the shells a bit.  Rinse well and clean the octopus carefully with cold water.  If you don’t have any shrimp, just add 4 of them to a large mixing bowl.  Add the octopus, crab, onion and bell pepper.

title: Sauerkraut and Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings ( split and tips removed ) | 1/2 cup peanuts oil | 1 jar sauerkraut ( drained )
instructions: Clean wings, rinse under cold water and dry on paper towels.  Heat 2 tablespoons peanut oil over medium high heat in skillet, brown wings on all sides.  Place in a 9 x13 baking dish and cover with a towel to keep warm.  Heat remaining oil over medium heat.  Add sauerkraut and cook until heated through, about 1 minute.  Spoon sauerkraut into hot oil and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,great northern bean,guacamole,coconut,thyme,red wine
title: Mexican White Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 4 1/2 cups red enchilada sauce ( mild or hot, your choice ) | 2/3 cup guacamole | 2 tablespoons red wine ( or any sweet white wine, your choice ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 cup caked coconut ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  In a bowl mix all of the ingredients except the coconut.  Add the chopped coconut and mix thoroughly.  Transfer the mixture into a 2 cup casserole dish.  Bake for 45 minutes until the cheese is golden brown.  Serve as an entree with warm tortillas or over rice.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,rom tomato,cocoa powder,raisin,pine nut,sage,fish sauce
title: Mongolian-Style Goat Cheese
ingredients: 4 roma tomatoes, halved | 2 ounces pine nuts | 1 package dried pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon cilantro-flavored pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons ground buffalo mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  Line the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish with cheesecloth or parchment paper.  Place the tomato halves cut side down, on the cheesecloth.  Pour remaining cheese over the top.  In a small bowl, combine 2 tablespoons of pesto sauce, worcestershire sauce, ground buffalo mozzarella cheese, cocoa powder, and remaining pesto sauce.  Pour over cheese.  Bake in the preheated oven for 50 minutes, until bubbly and lightly browned.  Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Asparagus in Cognac Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, trimmed | 16 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons milk | 3 tablespoons dry sherry or 3 tablespoons marsala | 1/2 cup brandy ( optional ) or 1/2 cup cognac, cooking wine ( optional )
instructions: Bring 3 cups of water to boil over high heat and add the asparagus.  Simmer until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain the asparagus and let cool.  Peel, and cut the stem into 1 chunks.  In a bowl, mix the asparagus, ricotta, milk, sherry and cognac.  Cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours.  Just before serving, garnish with additional grated rind if desired.

title: Virgin Italian Pomodro
ingredients: 1 can italian-style tomatoes, undrained | 1 1/2 cups orange-flavored pineapple juice
instructions: Punch down tomatoes in a large bowl and transfer.  Into the can, add pineapple juice and stir.  Chill for at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,salad green,tilapia fillet,baby spinach leaf,lime juice,hazelnut
title: Spanish Tilapia With Hazelnut Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup hazelnuts, toasted and finely chopped | 4 teaspoons golden syrup, to taste | 3 tablespoons lime juice, to taste | 2 -4 tilapia fillets, cooked ( we like red fish ) | 1 bunch salad greens | 2 cups baby spinach ( or use any greens of your choice )
instructions: Combine dressing ingredients & mix well.  Set aside.  Dry the tilapia fillets & set aside.  Toss salad greens with hazelnuts.  Place warm salad in a decorative serving dish.  Top with warm dressing & serve.

title: Ribnic Pork
ingredients: 1/4 pound pork tenderloin, cut into 4 equal pieces | 2 eggs | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/8 teaspoon ground green cardamoms | 1 bouillon cubes ( optional )
instructions: Season pork with salt and pepper.  Pound pork to 1/4 inch thickness.  Beat eggs with paprika and cardamom in a bowl.  Dip pork into egg mixture, then transfer to a baking dish.  Spread 1 bouillon cube on top of the pork.  Cover with foil and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Bake uncovered for 45 minutes.

title: Gomae (Noodles and Potatoes)
ingredients: 3 cups japanese boiling potatoes | 1 1/2 cups udon noodles ( dried ) | 1 teaspoon tea, base | toasted sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Boil potatoes in water until just tender, drain and cut in large chunks.  Dry potatoes completely and mix with potato flour.  Set aside.  Cook udon noodles according to package directions and set aside.  Place sesame seeds on a plate and set aside.  Place noodle on pan and let sizzle for a few seconds.  Remove sesame seeds from pan and place in a bowl using hands to stir.  Place boiled potato chunks in bowl with sesame seeds.  Mix and serve.

title: Pork Chops in Mushroom Pot
ingredients: 1 lb pork, thin cut | 2 tablespoons green onions | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 package portobello mushrooms, cut in half
instructions: Place pork on a tray or baking sheet.  Sprinkle with green onion.  Sprinkle with garam masala.  Bake at 400 until internal temperture reaches 165 degrees in a frypan or frypan.  Remove from oven, cut off fatty portions of pork.

title: Pasta With Sweet Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat spaghetti | 1/2 lb fresh button mushroom, sliced | 1 yellow sweet pepper, sliced | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente, drain well.  Place all ingredients in large casserole dish, stir and put into preheated oven for 25 minutes, stirring a couple of times, if it looks like it is drying out too quickly.  Serve immediately.

title: Chive and Chili Beans
ingredients: 2 cans chive beans, drained | 5 tablespoons fresh chives, snipped
instructions: Rinse and drain the chives.  Combine with remaining ingredients and serve as a side dish with salads, bread, meats or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,pumpkin pie spice,arborio rice,vodka,self raising flour,buttermilk,red onion
title: Pumpkin Rizogalo
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 500 g ground pumpkin | 1/2 medium red onion, finely chopped | 30 g butter, melted | 2 tablespoons low-fat buttermilk | 5 teaspoons vodka or 5 teaspoons vanilla extract | 4 cups arborio rice or 4 cups carnaroli rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c or gas mark lightly flour the inside of a 12 hole muffin tin with a removable base, to prevent the ritz cracker from sticking and the outside from sticking.  Place everything except for the vodka in a large bowl, and using your fingers rub the mixture into the base until it is very well blended.  Stir in the vodka, stir together, and then slowly pour in the buttermilk stirring.  Turn the mixture into the muffin tin.  Place the tin in the oven and immediately turn the temperature up to 190c, gas mark 3 or 170c if you have the oven.  Cook for 40 - 45 minutes until risen and golden.  This can be cooked quickly but really has more satisfying than normal risotto.  Remove from the oven and leave to stand for a few minutes then carefully run a knife around the edge of the tin.  Serve immediately.

title: Southern Shank
ingredients: 2 pounds bone-in beef shank | 1 container mayonnaise | 1 pinch seasoning, or as desired
instructions: Place the shank into a pot, and fill with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil.  Cover, and boil 2 hours, until tender.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a medium baking dish, mix mayonnaise and seasoning.  Place shank into a large saucepan, and pour in the mayonnaise mixture.  Place onto a baking sheet, and bake 90 minutes in the preheated oven, coating the shank with the mayonnaise and seasoning mixture.  Be sure not to overbake, or the shank may get tough.  Serve over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Beef with Vegetables in Red Wine
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek | 1/2 cup crushed red wine | 1/2 cup grated yellow squash | 2 tablespoons baking cocoa | 1 1/4 cups coarsely chopped celery
instructions: Cook meat, fenugreek and red wine in dutch oven over medium high heat until meat is crumbly and no longer pink, about 5 minutes.  Add squash and cook until the squash and meat are hot and the cheese is melted, about 3 minutes.  Stir in cocoa and cook stirring until mixture is completely smooth.  Serve warm.

title: Indian-Spiced Cauliflower and Spinach
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower, break into florets | 1 bunch baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Fill a large baking dish with water.  Bring water to a boil.  Cook cauliflower until just tender but firm, about 15 minutes.

title: Noodle and Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound egg noodles | 1 jar marinated pickled marinated pickled jarlsbergs
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the egg noodles, and return to a boil.  Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still slightly firm, about 10 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  While the noodles are cooking, heat a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat.  Pour in enough beer to cover the bottom of the pan and bring to a boil.  Add the pickled marinated jarls, and remove the skillet from the heat.  Drop the cooked egg noodles into the heated beer, stirring to coat the noodles, and cook until the noodles are evenly coated.

title: Smoked Red Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs of smoked sirloin | 10 bell peppers ( assorted colors with some sweet and some red ) | 1/2 lb prosciutto or 1/2 lb salami | 1/2 cup red wine or 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup dry red wine or 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 teaspoon ground gingerroot
instructions: Mix the ingredients for the smoker and smoke until tender.  When cool, strain out fat and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: coffee liqueur,saffron,rice wine,cardamom pod,chocolate pudding mix,tortilla,orange zest
title: Saffron Spritz Wrapped Burritos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant rice wine | 2 tablespoons coffee liqueur ( or water if you don't like instant ) | 1 pinch saffron ( optional, it's not the entire sachet, but it adds a nice, subtle flavor ), crushed | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1 pinch cardamom pod, ground | 1 can fat-free sweetened condensed milk jello instant chocolate pudding mix ( one 14 ounce box ) | 6 8 inch tortillas | 1 -2 teaspoon instant chocolate flavored coffee liqueur, for drizzling & serving
instructions: For the chocolate pudding, combine softened sweetened condensed milk, one 14 ounce box of instant chocolate pudding mix, orange zest, cardamom and coffee liqueur.  If using the saffron flavor, put that in a small tea ball jar with a lid.  Set aside for at least two hours to chill.  Just before serving, drizzle about 1 teaspoons of chocolate flavored coffee liqueur over the hot burritos, and allow to soften for a few seconds, just enough to coat them.

title: Mexican Seasoning Salt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 tablespoon mexican ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Place ingredients in a salt shaker or spice mill.

title: Cheesy Indian Cheese Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese or 4 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, coarsely shredded | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: In a medium size bowl, stir together the cheese, hot pepper powder and garam masala.  Enjoy.

title: Beef Steak for Two
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless beef chuck | 2 baby portabella mushrooms, stemmed | 2 cups cod or 2 cups another small white-fleshed fish
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Cut steak diagonally across the grain.  Remove and discard any fat and silver lining on the inside of the bowl.  Place steak inside the bowl and wrap steak in towels.  Place the plastic wrap directly over the steak in the bowl and place on a rack of a broiler pan.  Broil 5 to 7 inches from heat for 10 to 12 minutes or until desired doneness.  Slice steak diagonally across the grain.  Serve meat and mushrooms separately.

title: Apple Dill
ingredients: 2 large apples, peeled, cored, and sliced 1/4-inch thick | 3/4 cup cold finely chopped dill weed
instructions: Arrange the apples in a shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle with dill weed.  Bake at 350°f for 30 minutes or until apples are tender.

title: Konaf (Luchow's Beef Bavarian Stroganoff and Dumplings)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chuck ( any fat cut such as brisket, brisket, or top round ) | 1 pint whipping cream
instructions: Cut the meat into 1 1/2 chunks and place one piece on each quart of cream and set aside.  If this is difficult to do, some might just stick to the surface of the cream and use a small heavy skillet to skim excess moisture.  In a medium stock pot, bring just to a boil and add the meat chunks and the cream.  Once they are all in the cream, they are done.  They will be ready when they float to the surface of the broth.  Use them immediately, or refrigerate until needed.  You may make your own fresh dumplings, or make your own from scratch.  Make sure all the pieces have been well rinsed and patted dry before dumpling and fry in a large pot over medium high heat.  Turn down heat and fry in small batches until browned.  You may also make this in the oven, placing the dumplings in a casserole dish and set in a 300f oven for one hour and 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,cabbage,heavy whipping cream,beet,ra el hanout spice mix,thai red curry paste,pearl barley
title: Creamy Barley Red Curry and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons thai red curry paste, such as rogan josh ( or more to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 cup brown rice wine or 1 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon thai red curry paste, such as rogan josh ( or more to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 6 cups finely shredded cabbage | 1 cup chopped fresh pearl barley | 2 cups small dried cooked vegetables ( such as baby bellas )
instructions: Combine curry paste and 1/2 cup cream in a 1 qt saucepan.  Whisk in remaining cream with curry paste.  Bring just to boiling over medium high heat.  Add rice wine and curry paste.

Random Ingredients: nectarine,beef stew meat,liquid smoke,bamboo shoot,yogurt,barbecue sauce,cayenne,chicken breast meat
title: Nectarine and Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup barbeque sauce | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 cup nectarines, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 cup sliced bamboo shoots, drained and chopped | 1/2 pound boneless chicken breast meat cubed in the shape of a beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Cut the stew meat into 1 inch cubes.  Combine the soy sauce, barbeque sauce, barbecue sauce, cayenne, nectarines, bamboo shoots, and chicken in a large resealable plastic bag and let marinate for 30 minutes.  Heat the grill to high.  Thread the meat onto skewers, weaving them under the meat to make wooden sticks 3 inches long and 2 1/2 inches wide.  Discard the marinade.  Place the skewers on the oiled grill grate and cook until the meat is browned all over, 7 to 10 minutes.  Garnish with chives and serve.

title: Pork Chops, Yams and Potatoes
ingredients: 4 -5 medium yams | 4 -6 whole pork chops | bay leaf | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/4 - 1/2 cup water ( optional )
instructions: Peel yams and potatoes.  Cut into 1/2 inch cubes.  If using potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch slices lengthwise.  Cut chops into 1 1/2 inch pieces.  Trace pieces of yams lengthwise, leaving tails on.  Slice potatoes, peel and slice.  Heat oven to 425 degrees.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,ladyfinger,tuna steak,monterey jack cheese,wild rice
title: Wild Rice With tuna, Wild Rice & Tuna
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups wild rice | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 package extra large frozen ladyfingers | 2 cans tuna steaks, drained and broken into chunks | 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese, divided
instructions: Directions for rice, in a large saucepan, add wild rice and garlic powder and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 40 minutes, or until rice is tender.  Add enough water to cook wild rice until it covers, about 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, prepare tuna and french bread.  Slice french bread lengthwise and spread tuna on one side of toast.  Sprinkle half of each slice of toast with half of cheese.  Then top with tuna and french bread.  Cook in a 350 oven for approximately 12 minutes or until cheese melts and the bread is lightly toasted.

title: Chicken and Strawberry Parfait
ingredients: 1 package chicken tenders, sliced into strips | 1 package fresh strawberries
instructions: Place the chicken tenders in a shallow dish or platter.  Add sliced strawberries to the top of the tenders.  Turn the tenders to coat, and refrigerate, covered, for 1 hour.  Serve the fruit alongside.

title: Spicy Sauerkraut
ingredients: 200 g sauerkraut | 2 papayas, sliced
instructions: Pour 1 cup boiling water over the papayas.  Seal.  Heat and serve.

title: Quick Chili Oil
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 ounces fresh serrano chilies
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a gentle heat.  Add the chilies and stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes.  Pour the oil over the chilies.  Remove from the heat, cover and leave to cool slightly.  Transfer to a jar and store in the fridge.  Use immediately or store in the fridge for up to 3 months.  This oil will keep for months.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,garam masala powder,artichoke heart,graham cracker crumb,canadian bacon,cumin,cheddar cheese,mint sprig
title: Minty Quesadillas - Canadian Bacon Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into strips | 3 tablespoons canadian bacon, chopped ( reserve one half for sprinkling on the grilling surface, and the other half for grilling on the bar ) | 16 ounces frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and quartered | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | fresh mint sprig ( to garnish ) | 8 slices canadian bacon, halved crosswise ( or canadian bacon )
instructions: In a bowl, toss beef strips with chopped bacon, artichokes, grape jelly, cumin, garam masala, ginger, mint, and salt and pepper to taste.  Brush pan with a small amount of grieven spice oil, and heat.  Quickly fry beef strips in batches.  The strips will be somewhat crisp in the middle and should be kept to a near crisp finish, so cook them until golden and tender.  Transfer to a serving plate.  Spoon more grieven spice on strips while still hot, and serve with more grieven spice for dipping.  Garnish with sprigs of fresh mint.

title: Rosemary Tea
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh rosemary ( i like to use dried rosemary leaves too ) | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon good quality powdered dried rosemary | 1 -2 tablespoon good quality vanilla essence
instructions: Wash the rosemary branches and remove the stems if using stems.  Trim any large leaves from the stalks.  Finely chop one of them up and toss it all in a bowl with the vanilla essence and dried rosemary.  Mix well with a spoon to ensure the flavour is properly mixed through and leave to stand.  Add extra rosemary just before serving, if desired.  Serve in a tea cup for a lovely bite or as a sweetener for breakfast.

title: Farfalle With Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 500 g farfalle pasta | 1 1/4 cups jasmine rice | 1/3 cup double cream | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry
instructions: Cook farfalle as per instructions on packet.  Once cooked, drain well and rinse under cold water.  Meanwhile, mix rice, cream and cherry together.  Heat saucepan, place farfalle in pan and quickly saute for a minute or two.  Serve with fresh salad and garlic bread.

title: Ww, Crockpot Chocolate Beef and Corn Mini Meat Pies
ingredients: 1 beef sirloin, thawed ( or a chuck steak of your choice ) | 1 can baby corn, drained | 1 packet sweet biscuits | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Place beef in a large, deep skillet.  Cook over medium high heat, breaking up with a spoon to break up any clumps.  Drain beef and discard any juices.  Pour beef, corn, and canned corn into the skillet and cook on high for 5 minutes, or until mixture is warm.  Remove beef mixture to a paper towel lined plate.  Sprinkle with 1 tbsp cocoa powder.  Serve warm in mugs with toppings as described above.  Variation, if using chuck steak, remove the meat only after slicing, and cut in 1/4 inch pieces before slicing into 2 inch long pieces.  Follow directions on biscuit release kit.  Add desired meat to crockpot and top with favorite toppings to desired taste.  Add a can of sliced tomatoes that have been diced, drained, or any other desired filling, along with a can of sliced mushrooms for an extra kick if you like.  If making with ground beef, brown it in a skillet in a little bit of oil then place beef and corn mixture in the crock with the tomatoes and mushrooms.  Use a crockpot for high nutrient distribution, if desired.  If using chuck steak, brown the meat on medium high heat to a medium rare or medium well doneness, or to your taste.  You can also use boneless, sliced steak.

title: Weight Watchers (Btw) Paleo Pork Gyros
ingredients: 1/2 kg pork shoulder | 500 g chopped spinach leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons xanthan gum | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Rinse and drain excess fat from the pork, and trim off excess fat, and discard any visible signs of tissue or undesirable pieces of fat.  Trim and discard fatty ends from the pork, discard the excess fat.  Slice the meat into roughly roughly 2 - 3 inch long slices, and place into a bowl.  Place in the freezer for approximately 2 hours or until completely frozen.  Once the meat is fully frozen add in the spinach and xanthan gum, and set aside.  Heat up a heavy based frying pan, or a griddle, and lightly sauté the pork mixture on medium high heat.  Cook for approximately 5 - 7 minutes each side, or until browned and crumbly, turning once.  When the pork is cooked, remove from heat.  To serve, place a piece of meat onto the plate, and top with some of your favorite healthy fillings for a wonderful, tasty, and satisfying meal that goes well with left over left over filling.

title: Rice Casserole for 2
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1 can tomato soup ( campbell's condensed milk ) | msg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf/180ºc.  Place rice in casserole dish.  Sprinkle soup over rice.  Top with msg or just a dash of salt.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Bake for about ½ a hr to an hour.

instructions: Mix ingredients until smooth.  Serve over ice.

title: King Prawns Wrapped in Pepper Crumb Filling

instructions: Prepare the prawns, place the breadcrumbs in a pan and turn the heat up to medium. Prepare the cauliflower, cut away the ends from the head and discard.  In a large mixing bowl combine the cauliflower, flour, broth, and tomato puree. title: Sausage Rolls

instructions: Brown meatballs.  Remove from pan.  Saute onions in fat until translucent.  Add parsley.  Return meatballs and any accumulated juices.  Simmer gently covered, for 2 to 3 hours or over gentle heat 1 hour.

instructions: Combine drained mushrooms, water, fish sauce, basil, and cheese in a bowl.  Toss until the cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.  Divide mixture into bowls.  Sprinkle reserved cheese on top of porcinis.

instructions: Combine curry paste and teapoon oats and onion in a small bowl and stir thoroughly.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes or up to 2 hours.  Stir in the dry meal and refrigerate until cold and firm.

instructions: Place popcorn in bowl, add remaining ingredients, popped popcorn, and mix well, it will stick to the popcorn.  Microwave until popcorn begins to turn color, about 3 minutes.

instructions: Heat 1/2 can of cream of steakhouse stewed tomatoes in a pan for a few 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Stir into hamburger patties and cover with lid. title: Green Beans and Greens - Easy OAMC Friendly!

instructions: Drain the beans to remove any excess liquid.  I use an 8 x 8 pan.  Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour, but do ahead of time.  Serve in a wide bowl with crackers, bread or veggies.

title: Sautéed Tofu, Tomato and Pepper

instructions: Place tomatoes in a food processor and whirl until fairly smooth.  Add salt, pepper, oil and mustard and whirl until well blended.  Pour over tofu and mix well. instructions: In a large saucepan over medium high heat combine the soup, rice, lemon or lime rind, peppers, cauliflower, beans, and barley.

instructions: Combine chopped green chiles with tequila and mix thoroughly, so that all ingredients are evenly blended.  Add lemon peel.  Add seasoning salt, stir well, and strain into hot or prepared ice block ice block dishes.

instructions: Carefully drain oranges.  Place in a large bowl.  Sprinkle with cayenne.  Toss to combine.  Cover and chill.  Before serving, add more orange and cayenne for garnish.

title: Chicken, Lentil and Noodles Salad

instructions: Preheat oven to cut chicken legs and chicken breasts into manageable portions.  Do not remove bones.  Season the chicken with salt and pepper and brown in a large saute pan or large pot with a little olive oil.  Remove to a plate while preparing salad.  Take off excess grease if necessary, then slice chicken into smaller pieces.  Place salad in oven for 15 - 20 minutes.  Remove from oven, cut bacon into chunks and add to it with cabbage, bamboo shoots and stock, stir thoroughly.  Return to oven for further 15 minutes until everything is hot and noodles are nice and soft and tender.  Take out chicken and set aside, then remove any fat left in pan.
