Serve warm with salad bread or on the side.  Note, i usually place the salad on the plate just to warm it up.

title: Indian Popcorn Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup chopped italian parsley | 1/2 cup chopped poppy seed ( or more if desired ) | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Place popcorn in a large heatproof bowl, or in a bowl of hot water, and stir to coat.  Let stand for 1 - 2 minutes, then drain.  Place in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a dandy/candy attachment and mix until well combined, about 1 - 2 minutes.  Stop the mixer, scrape down the sides and stir in remaining ingredients.  Cover and refrigerate for an hour to let the flavors meld.  Use within about 3 days, but i think this popcorn recipe will last up to 2 years in the refrigerator.

title: Italian Sauteed Veal Chops
ingredients: 1 ounce veal chops, cut to size, 1/2 inch, then pounded to 1/2 inch | 1/4 cup canned italian tomatoes ( or similar brand ) | 2 cups lettuce
instructions: Heat oil in 12 skillet.  Add veal.  Cook 6 more minutes or until browned on both sides.  Strain off all fat.  Stir in tomatoes, lettuce and enough water to barely cover.  Heat to boiling.  Cover and cook until veal is cooked through.  Remove veal and pour off any accumulated liquid.

title: Garam Masala
ingredients: 2 medium baking potatoes | 1 bunch fresh basil, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons chopped dates | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Lightly grease an oven safe baking dish.  Peel and cut the potatoes into 1 inch thick slices.  Place the slices in a saucepan with a lid. Pour the ghee/oil into the prepared baking dish, and spread evenly.  Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the gravy has turned a nice golden brown color.  Sprinkle with the minced ginger to serve.

title: Spicy Chickpeas Vinda

instructions: Boil chana dal with white wine for about 5 minutes, then remove from stove and let it sit for 5 minutes then drain completely, then put aside and add some water and bring back to a boil. When both dry and creamy, pour over vinda.  Sprinkle with asafoetida and serve.

title: Crock Pot French Onion Soup

instructions: Place onion and beef broth in crock pot.  Cook on high or low until onions are soft and falling apart.

instructions: Put the parsley, brown sugar, salt and pepper in a large bowl.  Dab the whiskey through the strainer over the bowl and stir the liqueur gently to mix.  Add the stock, onion and tomatoes.  Mix well.

title: Indian Mustard

instructions: Combine the mustard powder and ground red chiles in a large bowl.  Coat the duck with the mustard mixture and let stand.  When ready to cook, arrange the duck in a lightly buttered baking dish.  Add the peas, arranging them snugly around the duck, and cover with foil.  Bake in a moderate oven until the duck is done, about 45 minutes.  Remove the foil and bake 30 to 40 minutes longer, or until the peas are tender.

title: Grilled Pork and Mushroom Skewers

instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together and allow to sit for a few hours.  Thread the pork cubes onto skewers.  Grill under a hot grill to your liking.  Serve with sauce.

instructions: Boil the portabella mushrooms in lightly salted water until they are just barely softened, about 10 minutes.  Drain and then coarsely chop.  In a small bowl, stir walnuts into the mushrooms.  Pour into a serving dish and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Mandarin Orange and Mandarin Confit Rounds
ingredients: 1 box mandarin oranges | seasoning salt, to taste
instructions: Cut one orange in half and remove the membrane.  Place the cut orange halves into a bowl and cover with water, about 1/4 inch clear.  Cover the bowl and refrigerate the orange flesh overnight.  Place drained oranges into a pot with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil and cook until the skins split at the tops.  Slip off the skins and discard.  Preheat oven to 400°.  In a strainer placed over a bowl or clean rimmed colander, drain oranges well in a colander and allow to dry for 1 hour.  While they are still warm, peel off the skins.  If desired, place them onto a plate, cover with plastic wrap and leave until cool enough to handle.  If you do not have mandarins you can roll each orange with a rolling pin or a rolling pin, until coated with an even amount of salt.  Place the oranges into a 2 quart baking dish and sprinkle with seasoning salt.  Bake in the preheated oven about 15 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a cup comes out clean.

title: Spicy Pear and Parmesan Chips
ingredients: 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 3/4 teaspoon corn tortilla chips | 1 ripe pear, cored and coarsely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Stir together the soy sauce and tortilla chips in a bowl.  Mix in the pear, ground red pepper, and salt.

title: Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups fresh pesto ( the italian kind, available in health food stores ) | 1 cup pine nuts or 1 cup slivered almonds
instructions: In a large bowl, mix pesto ingredients.  Cover and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes for the pine nuts to absorb the flavors.  Serve right away.

title: Brown Rice (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 2 )
ingredients: 85 g brown rice | 1 iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place brown rice in to a large bowl.  Top with lettuce and toss to combine thoroughly.

title: Tightly Crumpet for Gifts
ingredients: 3 tablespoons salt | 1 tablespoon fresh yeast ( optional )
instructions: Mix salt with yeast until dissolved.  Use immediately for compost, or put in a large mixing bowl and set aside in an airtight container.  It should resemble a thick paste that rises as it cools.  Dissolve yeast in the sand, add to bread mixture and mix well.  Refrigerate for 2 days, to ferment.  Use over other foods and as a dip for vegetables.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,wheat pastry flour,rump roast,chuck steak,bocconcini,baking soda
title: Easy Beef and Bocconcini Flatbread
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 cup chuck steak, shaved into 3/4 inch cubes | 1/4 lb cold rump roast, thinly sliced | 4 ounces bocconcini, sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: In a bowl, combine flour, baking soda, steak, and a little water to make a crust.  On a lightly floured surface, add a little of the flour mixture and knead until dough holds together.  Knead dough and divide into four portions.  Shape each into a ball and roll one ball into a rectangle measuring about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.  Repeat process with the second ball.  Spread meat, leaving 1/4 inch of the edges.  Place a slice of cold rut on top of meat.  Roll to enclose meat, place on a lightly oiled baking sheet.  Flatten out dough to 4 inches in diameter.  Repeat with the second ball.  Repeat with the third ball, the third and fourth balls and the last two, rolling to form four flatbreads.

title: Roasted Salsa
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper | 2 tablespoons dried apricots ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups vodka
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f.  Slice the poblano over the open flame of a gas stove flame.  This will blister the poblano and make it smoke.  After a few minutes, remove the poblano from the flame.  Cover the poblano with aluminum foil, and roast it under the broiler or in a baking dish in the oven, about 8 minutes.  This will get the peppers blackened from all their sunshine.  After about 8 minutes, remove the poblano and put it in a plate to catch juices.  Toast the poblano for about 5 minutes.  Remove the poblano from the oven, and place on paper towels to remove all the burned skin.  Set aside until ready to serve.  After about 10 minutes, remove the foil and toast the poblano until the skins blacken, popping the whole thing up some in your mouth.  Once the poblano is done, remove the skin, and cut the poblano into chunks.  This will make the skins blacken in an extremely spicy flavor.

title: Spicy Onion Rings
ingredients: 3/4 cup white onion | 4 tablespoons sour cream ( kool whip is good ) | 1/8 teaspoon crystal hot chili paste | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Finely dice the onions.  Combine all of the ingredients and refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: ginger,fennel bulb,papaya,taco seasoning,sun tomato oil,beef tenderloin,white breadcrumb
title: Fennel-Stuffed Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fennel bulb ( fronds only ) | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1/2 cup white breadcrumbs | 1/2 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon papaya ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 2 lbs beef tenderloin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f arrange fronds in a roasting pan.  Place the fronds in the pan, and place in the oven.  Roast until fronds are browned on all sides 5 to7 minutes.  Transfer roast to cutting board, and using a very sharp knife, cut 2 incisions through each slice of beef.  Insert a thermometer into the thickest part of each slice.  Place meat in a large bowl of ice water.  Drain the fronds, and then squeeze to remove excess water.  Cut fronds into 3/4 inch lengths and set aside.  In a small bowl, stir together the fennel, sun dried tomato and bread crumbs.  Stir in the taco seasoning, papaya and ginger.  Slice the beef into thin rounds.  Arrange one slice of meat at a time on top of the cheese mixture, then spoon half the stuffing mixture over the meat.  Top with the other slice of meat, and spread remaining stuffing over the top.  Top with remaining beef slices, making sure to secure around the meat with a toothpick.  Pour enough boiling water into the pan to come half way up the side of the meat.  Cover, and bake until meat feels firm when pierced with a fork, about 1 hour 30 minutes.  Remove the toothpick, slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,dark rum,chinese cabbage,self raising flour,italian salad dressing mix
title: Creamy German Slaw
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely shredded chinese cabbage | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1 -2 tablespoon greek seasoning ( or your favourite seasoning ) | 1 cup plain fat-free greek yogurt | 1/2 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Place cabbage in a bowl together with rum, cheese, greek seasoning, yoghurt and flour.  Mix until well combined.  Cover, and let sit for 20 mins before using.  Cook as desired in a bunless you prefer.

title: Raisin and Chile Powder Dip - Homemade
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces raisins, currants or 8 fluid ounces dark raisins | 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground dried chile powder
instructions: Place raisins in a small bowl and pour hot water over them to cover.  Leave at room temperature for 1 hour.  After soaking, drain, rinse and dry.  In another small bowl, mix brown sugar with the ground chile and stir until dissolved.  Stir the dry ingredients into the raisins and mix until combined.  Serve with chips or in a wide mouthed bowl.

title: Grilled Corn and Squash Rounds
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn kernels | 6 tablespoons sweet hungarian smoked paprika | 1 tablespoon dried savory ( optional ) | 3 scallions, finely chopped | 1 habanero peppers or 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory | 1/2 teaspoon spicy hungarian smoked paprika | 1 teaspoon finely chopped unripe scallion top ( optional )
instructions: Place corn, 1 tablespoon sweet spiced smoked paprika, and 2 chopped scallions in a large baking dish or roasting pan.  In a small bowl, mix together the remaining 1 tablespoon smoked paprika, savory, scallions, habanero pepper, savory, paprika, and 1/2 teaspoon green onion.  Sprinkle topping mixture evenly over all.  Preheating a grill.  Close grill lid and grill the corn and squash until tender, about 15 minutes, turning and spraying grill with oil every few minutes if corn begins to burn.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,green chili,yoghurt,chili powder,baby bok choy
title: Baby Bok Choy Salad
ingredients:
500 g baby bok choy, washed, trimmed and cut into wedges approximately 10 x 15 cm and about 1.
    - 5 cm | 2 green chili, washed, ends trimmed and finely julienned | 1/2 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon yoghurt
instructions: Grind together all the ingredients mentioned under bran mixture to make a fine paste.  Add the bran mixture to the bok choy and toss well so as to coat the bok choy thoroughly.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Serve chilled with flatbreads or steamed basmati rice.  Note, if you have bought all purpose flour bran flour, you can use this instead of 1/2 cup bran.  The taste is quite different, depending on the quantity of flour used.

title: Homemade Beef Jerky (Mock)
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and brush on briskly buttered racks of beef jerky to remove any extra fat.  Store in a dark plastic container to improve drying.

title: Homemade Irish Stewed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb fresh baby potatoes | 3 tablespoons flour | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 2 teaspoons pork fat, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit.  Drain the potatoes and place them in a large casserole.  Sprinkle the flour on top and stir together.  Sprinkle the celery seed on the potatoes.  Place the fat on top.  Cover the casserole and bake for approximately 30 minutes until the potatoes are tender.

title: Beer and Cabbage Chocolate Chip Wedges
ingredients: 4 leaves napa cabbage | 1/4 cup chocolate chips | 1/2 cup beer ( i prefer pacifico ) or 1/2 cup cider ( i prefer pacifico )
instructions: Cut cabbage into wedges.  Line a shallow baking dish with the wedges, spacing them out evenly in a single layer. .  Combine chocolate chips and beer or cider.

title: Barley Potato and Tuna Salad
ingredients: 250 g pearl barley | 150 g swedes, diced | 400 g tuna, in water | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 lime, zest of, grated | 2 pandan leaves
instructions: Bring a pan of water to the boil, then add barley.  Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until al dente.  Drain, then tip barley into a large bowl.  Add remaining ingredients and toss.  Serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive,rice vinegar,grill seasoning,grand marnier,feta cheese
title: Greek Olive Feta Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup spanish olive, pitted | 1/4 cup chopped smoked feta cheese | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon grill seasoning
instructions: Shred or cut olives into thin 2 inch pieces.  Combine with cheese and allow to sit 1 hour.  Mix and pour over salad greens before serving.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper,extra virgin olive oil,dill,golden raisin,chicken bouillon cube
title: Tunisian Chick Pea Dip
ingredients: 3 cups cooked chick peas ( i sometimes cook them whole in the juice which helps prevent them from floating ) | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 -2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon dried dill or 1 teaspoon fresh dill, chopped | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper, crushed
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  If more than one cup of liquid is needed, you can add the rest of the liquid up to 2 - 3 cups.  Add salt, pepper, or any other seasoning desired.  Serve with toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: galangal,celery,canola oil,paprika,sharp cheddar cheese,rice wine vinegar
title: Clemongrass-Korean Grilled Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 1 stalk celery, cut in 1/2 inch pieces or julienne | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon fresh galangal or 1/2 teaspoon ground galangal | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 2 -3 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Place celery in a plastic resealable plastic bag set aside.  Heat 1/2 inch of water in a saucepan until boiling.  Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients and oil.  Dip wooden skewers in oil and thread onto soaked wooden skewers.  Grill skewers over hot coals 8 - 10 minutes or to desired doneness, brushing frequently with remaining sauce.

title: Grilled English Muffins With Cardamom
ingredients: 1 english muffin, toasted | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Arrange english muffins evenly on grill or baking sheet.  Grill over high heat on grill, turning occasionally, until lightly toasted and split in half when first side.  Turn over and toast the other side.  Sprinkle with cardamom and serve immediately.  Store in a cool place.

title: Pesto Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1/4 cup prepared pesto sauce ( homemade or prepared or prepared purchased )
instructions: Put the basil in a small bowl.  Stir in the pesto sauce.  Place in a serving bowl and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beer,serrano chili pepper,frangelico,onion powder,pastry dough,yellow pepper,coconut milk
title: Carne Des Pinos (Spicy Baked Pastry)
ingredients: 9 inches pastry dough ( from a 17-ounce pastry bag ) or 9 inches pastry dough ( from a 17-ounce pastry bag ) | 1/2 lb frankfurter, thinly sliced ( we used the deli meat from our deli ) | 1/2 cup chopped yellow pepper | 1/2 cup chopped red chili pepper | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped coconut milk | 1/2 cup frangelico ( or brandy ), liqueur ( we used frangelico ) | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Prepare the pastry dough according to package directions.  Cut out as many circles as possible on a lightly floured surface and set aside.  Preheat the oven to 375ºf.  Arrange the pastry circles on a greased baking sheet.  Bake the pastries for 10 to 12 minutes or until light gold.  Remove them from the oven, brush them again with olive oil, and remove the baking sheet from the oven.  Brush the hot pastry with olive oil and arrange the franks on top.  Bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until the franks are lightly browned.  Remove from the oven, brush on the olive oil, and sprinkle with chopped peppers and onions.  Pour the franks and peppers over the hot pastries and serve warm.

title: Rutabaga With Caramelized Onions(Bangan E Piselli)
ingredients: 1 lb rutabagas, medium peeled | 1 large spanish onion, peeled | 8 ounces pecorino cheese, grated | 1 bouillon cube
instructions: Quarter rutabaga in length wise.  Cut into 3/4 inch rounds and set aside.  Slice onions into thin wheels and set aside.  Remove all remaining pieces of rutabaga that can be peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices and set aside.  Heat 1 tbs oil in heavy large skillet over medium low heat.  Add onions and cook until onions are golden brown about 10 minutes.  Put rutabaga in oven.  Add bouillon cube and cook, stirring occasionally, until rutabaga is very tender about 10 minutes.  About five minutes before rutabaga mixture is done, place 1 layer of rutabaga on top of onion mixture.  Repeat until all ingredients are used and rice is used.  Serve warm.

title: Soy Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted peanuts, unsalted | 1 1/2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons kosher salt ( adjust to taste ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil ( can use less )
instructions: Place peanuts in blender and process until they become fine crumbs.  Add soya sauce, salt, and oil and process well.  Let sit at room temperature 2 hours or overnight to allow flavors to develop.

title: Mexican Style Ham
ingredients: 3/4 lb butter | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 3/4 lb deli ham, cut thin in 2-3 slices | 12 teaspoons salsa | 1 teaspoon grated gingerroot
instructions: Heat oven to 350f & grease a 9 inch pie pan with 1 tbsp butter.  Mix all ingredients except bacon & ham.  Layer ham on pan.  Cover well.  Bake for 45 - 60 minutes or until center is brown.  Uncover & return to oven for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Tilapia (Savory Noodle Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked macaroni | 1/2 lb baby spinach | 3 tablespoons light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios
instructions: Rinse the macaroni and then drain, then add to a large bowl with the spinach.  In a small bowl, mix the soy sauce and tamari together and set aside to use as the dipping sauce.  Add the soy mix to the spinach, followed by the pistachios.  Note, if you prefer your noodles a bit more bland, mix a bit more tamari and tamari, but don't let that blend to thicken.  Let the salad stand for about 3 mintues, then serve.

title: Easy Sausage and Snow Peas Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 package frozen sliced snow peas | 1 package smoked bulk italian sausage | 1 package frozen puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line the bottom of a 9x9 inch baking dish with pastry.  Arrange frozen peas and sausage over the pastry in layers, finishing with a layer of sausage.  Cover with the remaining pastry and cut a slit in the top.  Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

title: Home Cooking Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups shell pasta, uncooked | 3/4 cup dried red currants, rinsed and patted dry
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: potato,bean sprout,oyster sauce,hot chili sauce,goat cheese
title: Crispy Bean Sprouts on Goat's Cheese Ball
ingredients: potato | salt | 7 -8 ounces fresh bean sprouts ( if using frozen, cook them first ) | hot chili sauce | 100 g soft fresh goat's cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c or 200 degrees fahrenheit.  Bake potato for 35 to 40 minutes or until tender and golden brown.  Cool slightly, peel and cut into small even sized round balls.  Chop bean sprouts into quarters.  Place in a bowl with salt and allow to stand for 5 mins, then drain off all excess water.  Toss gently with enough hot water to moisten thoroughly.  Place on a towel to dry.  Place in a serving bowl with soft fresh goat's cheese.  Using a large rolling pin, roll bean sprouts until well covered.  Divide sausage meat and seasoned bean sprouts evenly on top of bean sprouts on the goat's cheese ball.  Re roll and serve at once.

title: Pancake Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 8 ounces frozen peas and carrots ( or carrots cooked carrots with carrots, peas with celery ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 2 slices cucumbers, cut in half lengthwise
instructions: Heat the honey in a small skillet and add carrots and peas or frozen carrots.  Cover and cook 5 minutes or until peas are hot but do not boil.  Season with salt.

Random Ingredients: tempeh,heavy whipping cream,vodka,navel orange,italian tomato,bread crumb,chunky salsa,wheat flour
title: Semi-Homemade Stampede Skillet-Chef John's Style
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tomato-based prepared chunky salsa | 1 navel orange | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup italian-style dry bread crumbs | 3 tablespoons coarse-grained semisim di padano vodka ( optional ) | 1 cup shredded tempeh | 1/4 cup shaved italian-style thin-sliced radish, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Stir together the tomato salsa and navel orange in a small bowl.  Let stand until the salsa is infused, 10 to 15 minutes, then stir the olive paste into the tomato mixture.  Transfer the mixture to an oiled 13 by 9 inch glass baking dish and press in the bread crumbs.  Bake for 10 minutes.  Turn the bread out onto a rack to cool completely.  When cool, melt the vodka, if using in a jar with a tight fitting lid over simmering water, stirring frequently, until about 1 tablespoon vodka is dissolved, about 2 minutes.  Remove the vodka from the heat and whisk until the mixture is smooth, about 1 minute.  Stir the seasoned vodka into the bread crumbs in a 3 to 4 ounce glass measuring cup.  Sprinkle the bread crumbs onto a plate.  Pour the vodka flavored vodka into the baking dish.  Arrange the orange slices over the vodka, then spread over the bread crumbs.  Using the back of a small spoon, press the bread crumbs into the ole and vodka.  Set the baking dish on its side and bake for 20 minutes.  Remove the orange slices from the baking dish and set aside.  When cool, drizzle the shredded Tem Peh with shaved italian plain radishes and dollop the seasoned vodka around the orange slices.  Replace baking dish from oven and return the baking dish to the oven.  Bake until the margarita mixture has thickened slightly, 10 to 15 minutes.  Transfer baking dish to a serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: aji amarillo chili paste,coffee bean,pork tenderloin,spice,mint sprig,black sesame seed,cooking spray
title: Moroccan Spiced Baked Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs pork tenderloins | cooking spray | 1 cup brewed coffee beans, warmed ( any strong coffee ) | 1/4 cup minced of fresh mint sprig | 2 tablespoons aji amarillo chili paste ( or more to taste ) | 2 teaspoons unsalted black sesame seeds, toasted | 1/4 teaspoon spice blend, see note
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Season tenderloins with salt and pepper and place, fat side up, on a rack in a roasting pan.  Roast until meat thermometer inserted in center registers at least 145 degrees f, about 50 - 55 minutes.  While meat is cooking, combine all ingredients except sesame seeds and garnish in a medium bowl.  Transfer the roast to a platter and set aside.  When meat is cool enough to handle, slice crosswise into thin slices.  Insert a thin metal spatula in one end of each slice and, using the spatula, gently press slices into the prepared baking dish.  Bake until hot, about 10 minutes.  If desired, sprinkle reserved sesame seeds on loin when ready to serve.

title: Pecans Crackers or Chips
ingredients: 1 cup pecans, finely crushed | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon or 1 teaspoon other vegetarian instant chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f.  Mix all the ingredients together.  Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray.  Drop by the heaping teaspoonful onto the cookie sheet about 1 inch apart.  Bake 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Turn once before removing from oven.  These chips will harden after being removed from the cookie sheet.  My note, i did make a couple of variations based on the size of the chips used.  Instead of pecans, i made a garlic flavored crumb mixture for each ingredient in small increments, adding 1/2 tsp of cayenne pepper for a milder crumb.  I also added 1 tsp of garlic powder to the chicken bouillon and added 2 teaspoons of garlic powder to the chicken bouillon before adding.  This eliminated the salty taste of any commercial chicken bouillon.  No other flavor would be as good.  The first time i made these i added some finely chopped raw mushrooms, finely chopped carrots, or shredded or shredded or finely chopped potatoes.  This worked out great, my kids even ate them as a side dish.  It is even tastier after about a half an hour of baking.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,taco seasoning mix,mint,water chestnut,cream celery soup
title: Churros
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1 package light sour cream with celery soup or ( 10 3/4 ounce ) package low fat sour cream reduced-fat sour cream | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried mint | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped fresh peppercorn ( optional )
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients.  Chill in a refrigerator for 2 hours.  Place 1/4 cup of the churro batter among 1/2 cup of the churros batter.  Fold batter over once or twice, in half inch circles and place on a baking sheet.  Bake at 400°, uncovered 20 minutes or until crisp.  Allow to cool slightly.  Repeat with remaining batter.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: date,burrito flour tortilla,peanut butter,udon noodle,celery leaf,chicken breast,white tequila,leek
title: Chicken and Vegetarian Breakfast Burrito
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts | 3 leeks | 4 large burrito-size flour tortillas | 4 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 medium celery leaves | 12 dates | 1/4 cup white tequila | 1/4 cup white tequila | 1/2 cup chopped unsalted roasted peanuts, toasted
instructions: Put the chicken breasts in a pot and cover with water.  Bring to a boil, then simmer until the chicken pulls apart easily with a fork.  Shred the chicken with two forks.  Reserve the chicken and vegetables.  Remove the leeks if they are already cleaned.  Wash the leeks and slice the entire stalk into rounds.  Place the sliced leeks in a bowl and refrigerate.  Peel the whole celery leaves and slice them to about the size of the leeks.  Separate the white and tequila from the liquid.  Put the tequila and olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Add the chicken, vegetables, and celery.  Saute for about 5 minutes, or until the broth is reduced by half.  Stir frequently.  Add the reserved chicken and cook for about 15 minutes, adding a bit of the broth to the liquid if it gets too thick.  Stir occasionally.  Remove the chicken and vegetables from the skillet and put on a platter.  Add the chopped peanuts in a skillet with a little olive oil, salt and pepper.  Stir often, then add the dates to the mixture.  Stir constantly.  As soon as the mixture begins to thicken and coat the peanuts, mix in the cooked noodles.  Serve with lots of freshly ground black pepper on the side.

title: Pounded Gorgonzola
ingredients: 3 slices bread, crusts removed ( each slice about 1/2 inch thick ) | 4 ounces gorgonzola, crumbled | 1/3 cup salted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup chopped orange peel | 1 tablespoon minced fresh oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon freshly grated orange peel | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaves, crushed | 2 teaspoons vodka
instructions: Divide the bread between two slices of heavy plastic wrap.  Using one slice of gorgonzola and peanuts, roll it from the other slice.  Transfer the gorgonzola roll to a plate and cover the plate with another slice.  Repeat with remaining bread and peanuts.  In a medium bowl, stir the cocoa, orange peel, oregano, and orange peel until well combined.  With a pastry brush, spread the sesame seed oil evenly over each piece of cheese roll.  Starting at a long side, roll up the cheese like a jelly roll.  Place each roll into the plastic wrap, turning the wrap tightly around the cheese.  Allow the cheese to sit at room temperature for about 1 hour, then unmold onto a plate and place in a warm area of your refrigerator.  Repeat with remaining cheese, placing plates in freezer for a total of 8 hours.  To serve, remove the cheese rolls from the plastic wrap and wipe off excess oil.  Cut each roll into 6 slices.  Serve with vanilla ice cream.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,caper,buttermilk,irish cream,bibb lettuce,white wine vinegar,velveeta cheese
title: Creamy Beef in Lettuce Leaves, Irish Cream, and Capers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons drained capers | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons irish cream or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 4 ounces velveeta cheese, at room temperature | 3/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 head bibb lettuce, outer leaves discarded | 3 tablespoons drained capers, rinsed
instructions: In a small bowl stir together 4 tablespoons of the capers with the wine vinegar and the irish cream.

title: German Bread and Butter Recipe
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread | 1/4 can tomato paste | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Slice bread at a slight angle.  Spread with tomato paste.  Place bread on baking pan.  Add enough buttermilk to just cover bread.  Place in oven and cook 1 hour or until bread is brown and bread has absorbed flavor.

title: Pancetta With Bows
ingredients: 2 extra-large eggs, lightly beaten | 1 1/4 lbs fresh asparagus, trimmed | 6 ounces fresh snow peas | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place the first group of noodles in an ovenproof skillet.  Top each noodle with 1 egg, and 1 spears of snow peas.  Place in the preheated oven and bake until the noodles are tender, about 15 minutes.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,extra virgin olive oil,bailey irish cream,sherry wine
title: Rice With Kick
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup sweet sherry wine | 1 1/2 cups baileys irish cream
instructions: Coat rinsed rice with olive oil and put in a baking dish lined with parchment.  Bake 400 degrees for 20 minutes, turn the rice over and bake another 20 minutes.  You want to make the rice crispy and have all the liquid hot.  If your rice won’t go creamy you can always add water or stock to moisten it.  To make the ice cream, mix baileys and irish cream together and stir until very well combined about 10 minutes.  Spoon over the hot rice in the baking dish and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,green cabbage,applesauce,cottage cheese,corn,bacon dripping,italian seasoning
title: Cheesy Beef and Barley Veggies
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, crisply cooked | 1/4 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1/4 cup prepared roasted vegetables or 1 tablespoon dried vegetables | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice ( optional ) | 3/4 cup pearl barley | 1 1/2 cups green cabbage, cored, chopped ( about 3 cups )
instructions: In a 10 inch nonstick skillet, cook barley in enough lightly salted water to cover with boiling water for about 5 minutes or until tender.  Reserve 5 cups cooking liquid for garnish.  Meanwhile, in large bowl, mix bacon and cottage cheese.  Stir in remaining ingredients except reserved cooking liquid and spoon mixture over barley in skillet.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for about 5 minutes.  Drizzle with reserved cooking liquid.

Random Ingredients: bean paste,ziti pasta,baking potato,hard alcoholic cider,glutinous rice,brussels sprout
title: Smoked Lusky
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 1 cup hard alcoholic cider | 2 2 slices smoked lusky smoked sausage or 2 slices smoked ham | 1 -2 teaspoon baking potato fat | 3/4 cup mixed sprouts, julienned | 2 teaspoons fermented bean paste
instructions: Cook ziti as directed.  Meanwhile boil vinegar and water with sausage, in separate pot.  Drain.  Place sausage, vegetables and jelly in a small casserole, and add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Cover and bake at 350°f approximately 50 minutes until pasta is done.

title: Somali
ingredients: 500 g rice vermicelli, soaked in warm water for 20 minutes
instructions: Drain the soaked mince.  Soak the rice vermicelli in sufficient water and keep aside.  Heat oil in a non stick pan.  Add the soaked mince till the raw smell of the mince is gone.  Keep aside.  Heat a tbsp.  Of oil in a thick bottomed vessel.  Add the soaked rice vermicelli.  Cook on high flame for 5 minutes.  Cover.  After 25 minutes, remove the cover and cook for a further 5 minutes till the vermicelli is crisp on the outside.  Remove from the flame.  Serve hot with cream or chutney.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,peanut oil vegetable,black bean,cooking apple,red food coloring,rice wine,rice noodle,egg noodle
title: Spinach and Noodles With Noodles

Reduce heat, simmer sauce, covered, over moderately low heat until chard is tender and beginning to wilt, about 20 minutes.  Remove from heat and remove chard leaves with a slotted spoon and arrange in a colander to drain.  Discard stems and coarsely chop.  Toss chard and any accumulated juices with sauce.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Garnish with pinches of parsley, if desired, and serve at room temperature.

title: Diet Rolls
ingredients: 1 package crispy rice wrappers | 1/2 cup white sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Place the crispy rice wrappers into the boiling water, and immediately remove from the pot using a strainer placed over the boiling water.  Rinse the rice wrapper with a strainer and place on a plate.  Place the sugar, and 1/4 cup of water into a skillet, and stir until the sugar is melted.  Pour the syrup over the sweetened rice wrapper, and quickly roll up.  Serve warm.

title: Chipotle Puree - Vegetarian?
ingredients: 1 dried chipotle chile | 1 large yellow bell pepper | 1 red bell pepper
instructions: Remove the chilis from the pods, remove the stems, seeds & pith.  Wash, core & coarsely chop the peppers and place in a blender or food processor with the chilies. .  Grind the solids until it is a smooth paste.  Transfer to a jar and refrigerate.

title: Potato, Zucchini and Chickpea Curry on Spoon
ingredients: 1 cup diced seedless watermelon ball | 1 diced zucchini | 1 -2 diced red potatoes or 1 -2 potato, as desired | 1/2 teaspoon madras curry powder | 1 cup cooked drained chickpeas
instructions: In a non stick pan, heat curry powder and chickpeas for 1min.  Add frozen potato/zucchini and zucchini and mix.  Simmer for 10 - 15 minutes.  Add zucchini/chickpea mixture, heat through and serve with green vegetables.

title: Ballymaloe Yams
ingredients: 500 g raw yams | 500 g flour | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley leaves
instructions: Peel the yams and cut into thick slices.  Place in microwave and cook on high power for 7 minutes.  Drain the yams, cool and then shell.  Cut into 1cm slices.  Melt butter and add yams, stirring until coated with it.  Stir in orange juice and parsley.  Pour into greased oven tray.  Bake in a pre heated 375 degree oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: The Grape Leaves and Cream
ingredients: 15 fresh grape leaves | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream
instructions: Wash the grape leaves and remove the fuzzy stems, if necessary, from the stem end of each leaf.  Trim away any woody parts of the stem.  Lay about 20 fresh grape leaves on your work surface.  Sprinkle about 2/3 cup of sour cream into the slit of each leaf, covering the tips of your fingers with cream and letting the cream run down the sides of the leaves.  Use your fingers, fingers, or a knife to roll the leaves between your fingers until the leaves are covered.  Wrap each leaf tightly with plastic wrap or foil.  Freeze for up to 2 weeks or serve right away.  Note, this recipe freezes very well for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,garlic powder,lamb shank,scallion,self raising flour,white onion,rye bread,escarole
title: Lamb Shank and Scallion Pies
ingredients: 1 medium white onion, thinly sliced | 2 medium scallions, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 lbs trimmed lamb shank, roughly cubed | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 -2 bunch escarole, finely chopped ( or other fresh greens ) | 1/4 cup self raising flour | 8 slices rye bread | 1/2 cup roquefort cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.  Put the onion, scallions, lamb, garlic powder into a roasting tin, add the escarole, then bake for 20 minutes.  Remove the lamb shank from the oven, remove any skin, then pull the meat from the bones.  Shred the meat and stir it into the pan juices.  Add the flour and stir until incorporated.  Remove from the heat and cover with foil.  Leave to stand for 15 minutes.  Spoon the mixture into a food processor whiz until smooth.

title: Dukkah
ingredients: 300 g muesli | 1 key lime, juice of | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Preparing your muesli by washing and sweating in a microwave safe bowl, combine mint leaf, key lime juice, and cayenne.  Place the muesli into a dry tea ball type bowl.  Pour over the mint and lime juice mixture and gently toss.  Cover with a tea towel and leave to set.

title: Rice Wine Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 8 ounces rice wine | 8 ounces mesquite wood chips | 12 ounces oatmeal
instructions: Cut an x with the top of a heavy book, or use a cookie cutter to cut pieces roughly the size of the chicken, but make sure they are free of blood or sand.  The goal is for the piece that is flat with flecked outside but not dark inside.  Put the pieces in a large skillet and set to medium and fry, turning once halfway through.  When the chicken is well browned, remove from pan and place on a paper towel lined cookie sheet.  Turn heat up a bit, scraping the bottom, for about 10 - 20 minutes.  Turn heat back down and fry remaining piece until brown.  Return chicken to skillet, add rice wine and enough oatmeal to cover.  Cook 1 to 2 minutes over medium high heat just to warm up the oatmeal enough that you don't feel any more raw grainy bits of oatmeal in the oats.  It is unlikely that most of the oatmeal will dissolve, so watch out for splatters.

Random Ingredients: corn muffin mix,red chilies,tahini,red curry paste,ice
title: Thai Peanut Dipping Sauce With Coconut Cornbread Wedges
ingredients: 1 box corn muffin mix | 1 1/2 cups tahini | 1/3 cup red curry paste ( i like maesri brand ) or 1/3 cup thai red curry paste | 3 cans red chilies, whole ( in own juice or seeds from the can ) | ice ( or crushed wheat pita crisps )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  For cornbread wedges put 3/4 cup cornhusks in a baking pan and sprinkle on some cornhusks and drizzle or spoon a bit of tahini in.  Top with other 1 1/2 cup cornhusks.  This will keep from browning.  Mix together red curry paste, whole chilies and 1/2 cup of water.  Add to cornhusks and mix.  It will be thick and runny, but you can use up to 4 cloves of minced garlic.  Just sprinkle this over the cornhusks and sprinkle with more cornhusks.  If you're using whole red chilies, slice them into thin half moons and then place in a bowl with the curry paste.  Mix well. .  Enjoy this with jasmine or regular rice.  It can also be toasted in a toaster oven or on a baking sheet sprayed with a bit of cooking spray.  Serve with coconut coconut bread wedges over top of the toasted cornhusks.  I use a plastic bag, but you can also just buy it.  We eat by dipping it in peanut oil, which is the same thing.

title: Aussie Baked Cheese

instructions: Combine the cheeses, cream flavour and essence in a bowl and mix well together.  Pour into baking paper lined 2 3cm oven proof dishes and bake at c degrees for 25 minutes, until just firm to the touch.  Cool slightly and remove toasted biscuits to serve, cool and roll in the coloured sugars.

title: Smoky Rye Bread

instructions: Preheat oven to 400° f.  Spray baking sheet with nonstick spray.  Cut a circle out of top of parchment paper.  Using a pizza cutter, cut circles of bread.  Place bread in the middle of the dough.  Brush bread with olive oil.  Place on pan.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, or until light brown.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,spinach,red leaf lettuce,cheddar cheese,snow pea,amaretto

title: Pistachio Pizza

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.  Line a jelly roll pan with parchment or baking paper.  For the crust, mix sugar, almonds, and anise seed in a food processor and process until finely ground. Transfer dough to prepared pan.  Bake 20 minutes until lightly golden brown.  For the almond yogurt, pour warm milk into a small bowl and gently whisk in almond milk.  Keep warm. instructions: To clean the garlic make sure to remove all bitter, black or blistered clumps.  The more bitter the bitter the bitter the bitter the bitter, the more bitter you will want this to smell. Wearing plastic wrap or disposable gloves, rinse off the bitter, black or blistered garlic and place the cloves in a bowl with the vanilla sugar, zaytoon's sumac, and just enough boiling water to make it viscose.  Pour off the remaining water into the bowl with the bitter and add it to the bowl with the garlic paste.  If you have an old kitchen that would allow the garlic paste to sit for 15 minutes before using drain and add to the bitter mixture or pour back into the bowl now.  Mix well before serving.

title: Pasta With Shrimp and Shrimp

instructions: Cut shiitake in half lengthwise.  Remove root section, then slice into thin 1 inch slices.  Heat oil in pan, add shrimp, then shrimp so that all shrimp pieces are covered. Stir fry for a further minute on high heat.  Season with sake and cook for a further minute.  Add shark and stir to combine.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Place halibut fillets on baking sheet.  Mix baking soda and baking powder together in a large zipper type plastic bag.  Brush halibut fillets with rum flavored olive oil.  Sprinkle evenly with baking soda mixture.  Bake halibut in preheated oven until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cherie's Crab Salad
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat | 1 cup sweet onion and onion ( or less ) | 2 tablespoons dried hot chili peppers or 2 tablespoons tabasco jalapenos | 1/4 cup orange bell peppers or 1/4 cup red bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup coriander, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Soften the crab meat in boiling water and drain.  Set aside.  Cut onions and bell peppers into 1/2 inch pieces.  Add crab meat and all the herbs and mix.  Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: A Different Kind of Brie Cheese
ingredients: 1 pound brie cheese | 1 sheet nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut brie into slices or desired shapes, working with 1 piece at a time, with a sharp knife being sure to cut slices all the way through.  Arrange slices as follows, with a sharp knife, in one row, on a towel, and place under running water.  Let drain in a colander for 15 minutes, then shake off excess liquid.  Place cheese under running water until completely dry, about 1 minute.  Repeat process with remaining cheese slices.  Spread seaweed over a flat surface and sprinkle generously with salt.  Roll cheese slices in seaweed until completely covered, and place on a baking sheet, or a baking stone until heated through.  Allow cheese to cool slightly.  Repeat process with nori sheets using another baking sheet and a flat pan on the outer edge.  Preheat a deep fryer to 375 degrees f.  Spread cheese slices evenly with paper towel.  Cook until cheese is browned and crispy, about three minutes per side.

title: Spiced Cauliflower Sprout and Coriander(Pawpaw)

instructions: Place the stock or broth in a pot, bring to boil over high heat.  Add the cauliflower, cover, and let simmer over medium heat for 18 to 20 minutes, or until the cauliflower is tender. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes.  Put the lettuce pieces in a large bowl and toss with 1/2 cup of the sauce.  Cover and let stand in a warm spot for about 5 minutes.  Stir the remaining stock into the salad and stir until thoroughly combined.  Taste and adjust seasoning.  Serve at room temperature.

instructions: Whisk together the beer, soup mix, oil, and asafoetida in a shallow dish or bowl.  Add the chicken, cover, and refrigerate until chilled, about 20 minutes. Cook, turning once, until the chicken is golden brown and the cooked all over, about 8 minutes.  Remove from the skillet and set aside. ingredients: 450 g red burgundy wine | 175 g ghee ( butter ) or 175 g olive oil | 450 g couscous | 175 ml chicken stock or 175 ml vegetable stock | 100 -150 ml pesto sauce | 1 small red capsicum, diced | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 175 g plain flour
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/fan 180c/gas cook couscous for 10 minutes or until just firm just starting to brown. title: Dried Bean and Pea Dipping Sauce

instructions: Soak dried beans for 3 days in cold water until soft.  Drain and rinse.  Heat wok, add oil and fry dried beans for 4 minutes.  Add other ingredients and stir well.  Place peas on serving plate.

title: French Onion Soup (Hint)
ingredients: 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 kg apple, peeled and grated
instructions: Place the grated apple in a large bowl.  Add the condensed french onion soup to the bowl and stir until well mixed.  Pour into bowls one at a time.  Serve immediately.

title: Tzatziki (Yogurt Cheese and Olive Spread)

instructions: Pour the yogurt into a bowl and stir in the olives.  Stir in the nutritional yeast, cover, and set aside for about 3 hours for the flavors to incorporate.  Serve with pita chips, as an appetizer, or with breadsticks for a healthier main dish, or with pita bread as an accompaniment to pizza or pita chips as a filling for pita chips.

title: Baked Onions With Lamb
ingredients: 3 medium maui onions, peeled | 2 teaspoons ghee | 500 g ground lamb | 4 hoagie rolls, split lengthways
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c.  Cut the root ends off the onions and trim the root ends if they are dirty.  Then peel off the onions if they are dirty.  Spread the onions out on a baking tray and roast in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until charred and soft.  Cool, then slice into thin rounds.  Melt the ghee in a pan and fry the onion over a low heat until golden, then stir in the ground lamb and fry until browned, stirring often.  Turn the mix out onto the roasting tray.  Spread the hoagie rolls with the lamb and onion mixture and top with the sesame seeds.  Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until the meat is cooked through.

title: Gluten and Dry Breakfast Rancher
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice and wild rice blend, dry ( see note ) | 1 cup gluten ( option # 1 ) | 3 egg yolks, lightly beaten | 8 cups ice water | 2 teaspoons mango powder ( optional, i don't see what mango powder is called for in this recipe ) or 2 teaspoons vanilla extract, optional ( optional, i don't see what mango powder is called for in this recipe )

title: Hot Espresso Pie

instructions: Dip beans in water and let sit, upside down, for 5 minutes.  Dipping sauce, mix thawed tamarind with 1 cup cold water, stir until dissolved.  Combine with remaining ingredients in a saucepan, stirring until combined.

title: Blackberry-Apple Soup With Olives

instructions: Sauté the apple, green chilies and blackberries until the apples are tender, stirring occasionally.  Add the peas and apples and the half and half and bring to a simmer. instructions: Bring 2 quarts water to a boil and add pita bread rounds.  Stir once or twice while they are toasting.  Place a baking sheet over high heat and set aside. instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f place 1/4 cup of the bread cubes in a small bowl and sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the porcini mushrooms.  Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp of salt and set aside for 1 hour. Wrap the top of the pastry sheet with a double thickness of double thickness kitchen twine.  Make 4 small slits in the middle of the pastry.  Cut steam vents at the top of the dough.  Brush the with remaining butter.  Bake for 20 - 25 minutes until golden brown.

instructions: Cut pork shoulder into about two long pieces, about half a pound.  Place in a dutch oven and pour in enough hot water to cover.  Add pickle and chili oil.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until meat feels firm when the center of the meat is gently pressed, and tender.

title: Baby Spinach and Bean Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup navy beans ( red kidney beans are the best ) | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar, to taste | 1 package no-cook lasagna noodles | 1 package baby fresh spinach | 1 bag bean sprouts | 1/4 teaspoon chat masala
instructions: Put the beans and vinegar into a frying pan over medium heat and bring to a boil, covered.  Reduce heat to low, and simmer, until the beans are tender, about 10 minutes.  Drain the beans and put to one side to cool.  While the beans are hot, heat a dry large frying pan over medium high heat for 2 to 3 minutes.  Break the noodles into 1 1/2 inch squares.  Spray the noodles with cooking spray.  Cook for about 4 minutes, stirring frequently, until the noodles are soft and white.  Add the beans to the noodles and stir to combine.  Set aside until cool.  Once cool, stir in the spinach, spinach, and bean sprouts.  Add the cooked noodles, sprinkle with the chaat masala, and toss together to combine.

Random Ingredients: london broil beef,parsnip,pancetta,spinach,tomato paste,hot dog bun
title: London broil  Burgers
ingredients: 1 package london broil beef | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 package hot dog buns, split | 3 slices pancetta, chopped | 2 cups diced tomatoes with tomatoes | 2 tablespoons tomato paste
instructions: Cut each steak horizontally in half, creating two 1/2 cup pieces.  Place each piece between two sheets of wax paper and pound with a mallet until thin.  Cut the steaks crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Place each steak into a large, resealable plastic bag.  Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours.  Place spinach in a medium bowl and lightly squeeze out excess liquid.  Add the frozen spinach to the spinach, stir to mix.  Fill each bun with approximately 1/4 cup spinach mixture and 1 slice of pancetta.  Top with 1/4 teaspoon tomato paste and 1 tablespoon tomato to taste.  Serve.

title: Pineapple Fruit Fritters

instructions: Place ingredients in a medium saucepan and stir over low heat just until combined.  Drop spoonfuls of mixture onto a hot griddle and cook just until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,cannellini bean,beef stew meat,chicken bouillon granule,lamb,horseradish
title: Slow Cooker Lamb, Cannellini and Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 jar cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 5 pounds boneless lamb stew meat | 1 pound triple sec | dissolve chicken bouillon granules in 3/4 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish ( optional )
instructions: Place the drained cannellini beans into the bottom of a slow cooker.  Toss the lamb over top of the beans.  Pour the triple sec over the lamb and beans.  Dissolve the chicken bouillon and horseradish in the water, and pour it into the slow cooker.  Cook on high until the cooker is hot, but not boiling, 5 to 7 hours, depending on the lamb's size.  Remove lid, and cook until lamb is no longer pink in the center, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Downhome Stuffed Prunes (Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh backfin crab meat, cleaned and picked clean ( or frozen crab meat ) | 18 dried prunes, soaked in hot water 15 minutes
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Remove the crab meat from the bones and set them aside.  Cut off and discard any pieces of the soft underside and neck portion from the crab meat and cut away the hard muscle or the white matter matter from the shell.  Carefully scrape the inside shell of the crab using the back of a sharp knife.  Tear off the shell and discard the other portions of the shell.  Carefully cut out a small, deep opening about a tablespoon or so at each end of the body that will hold the crabmeat.  The cavities should be about 1 x3.  Fill each shell with the crabmeat from the cavity, leaving about 1 1/2 inch space on the top and the tail fins intact.  Cover with cheesecloth and place on a large piece of wax paper and put in the oven.  Bake in a 325°f oven for about 1 hour, or until the crabmeat is dark brown and the stuffing is soft.  Allow 6 to 8 minutes before removing from the oven.  Remove the cheesecloth and cut a slit in the side of each prune and remove the pits.  Fill the shells with stuffing and serve.

Random Ingredients: red shallot,fine herb,baby carrot,chihuahua cheese,walnut oil,green chili pepper,romano cheese

Bake until golden brown on top and slightly crispy, about 25 - 30 minutes.  If desired, sprinkle with grated cheese.

instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend the apricots, black olives and about 2 cups of the hot tea.  Serve this immediately.

title: Spicy Thyme Salt
ingredients: 2 teaspoons fine sea salt | 2 egg whites | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme, very finely minced
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk the salt and egg whites until soft peaks form, about 5 minutes.  Add the thyme and mix well.  Using a pastry bag fitted with medium mouthed plain round tip, pipe a narrow border on the inside of the pastry bag.  Spoon into the centre of the circle.  Using a sharp knife, pierce the top of the pastry bag with the tip of the knife, leaving at least 1/2 to 1/4 inch of the ragged border on the outside.  Place on a foil lined baking sheet.  Cover and let stand at room temperature 1 hour.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f and bake for 20 minutes.  Leave oven off, but leave oven door slightly ajar.  Set oven rack for the last 5 minutes of baking.  Transfer the parchment paper onto the top rack of the oven.  Return baking sheet to oven and continue baking the same until a knife incerted through the parchment comes out clean, about 30 minutes.

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat until hot.  Add the scotch bonnet or dried scallion or crayfish flakes and heat about 30 seconds.  Add the mushroom caps and fry, turning, for about 8 minutes or until softened and golden. title: Homemade Cracked Salt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sea salt or 1 tablespoon kosher salt | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Make sure a good level layer of salted water on your kitchen counter.  Start by coating your hands with oil, and then shake the salt around the bowl to make sure the salt is wet.  Dredge the bowl into a small pot of water to rinse out any excess water, then place the bowl over the water, then let sit in the refrigerator for 24 hours.  To clean your hands, grab the bowl of water, and wipe your hands dry with about 1/2 teaspoon of cold water, then shake the bowl back into the water.  Repeat this procedure until you have about 18 fingers in total.  Do not use more than 18 fingers at a time, because the remaining fingers can become rubbery.

title: Chili Rice Bake
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, chopped ( optional ) | 4 chicken drumsticks, skinned and boned | 2 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 cup tomato juice | 4 ounces chocolate cake mix | 8 hoagie rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a large skillet over medium high heat, cook bacon until crisp.  Remove bacon from skillet and crumble.  Save drippings. In a blender or food processor with coarse chop motor, whirl tomato juice in small bowl until smooth.  Pour over rice. instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Spray a large roasting pan with nonstick cooking spray and place green bell and yellow bell peppers in the pan.  Sprinkle with chili paste and cover. You may use chicken with other vegetables instead of green peppers.  I have also added cooked, shredded cabbage and chopped jalapenos to this for a bit of kick and have served with the lime wedges as a garnish.

title: Bread Tacos With Taco Seasoning Mix, Caramelized Onions and Garlic

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,chili bean,brown lentil,lemon lime beverage

instructions: Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat until very hot but not smoking.  Stir in the lentils and the chili beans.  Continue to sauté until the lentils and chili beans have cooked about 5 minutes.  Stir in the lemon lime soda and serve warm.  I served this immediately as part of a mexican inspired meal.  Use the lemon lime beverage as a beverage.

title: Country-Style Roast With Dates
ingredients: 1 lb rump roast ( i used my pork sausages ) | 2 large dates, pitted | 2 -3 hot stock cubes, depending on the amount of stock that comes in | 2 tablespoons raw sliced dates ( or dried )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150c/170c fan/gas and line the oven tray with foil.  Place the rump roast in the centre of the oven.  Slice the dates and put into a small bowl.  Add hot stock to the crumpled foil, leaving a 1cm/2cm/3/4 inch/inch border around the top of the roast.  Dump the dates into the bowl, then scatter over the sliced date.  Put the oven shelf near you on your roasting tray, so the oven is hot enough when it passes you will need to reduce the heat if nothing else.  This could take up to 3 hours depending on how old or old your dates are.  When the beef comes to room temperature, remove the meat from the oven and rest for at least 20 minutes.  Cut the meat into thick slices, about 1cm/1inch/4 inch thick.  Place the slices on the tray.  I prefer to bake them well apart, with the meat, for up to 30 - 35 minutes, depending on the size of the roast.  They shouldn't be soggy either.  Remove the tray from the oven and arrange the slices on a platter or platter.  Pour any excess fat or oil from the tray and discard before returning the meat to the oven.  Keep the oven at 150°c / 160°c fan/gas.  Put the roasting tray on the bottom shelf of the oven.  When the beef is done, take the beef out of the oven and set it aside for at least 20 minutes.  Do not open the door of the oven when you want to make the gravy.  Now return the oven to 150°c / 160°c fan/gas pour boiling water to the pan to start the gravy.  Drain off any fat that rises to the top.  Pour the gravy into the tray with the beef and dates and cover the tray with clingfilm.  Put the roast into the oven and cook for 1 hour.  You will need quite a bit of time to do this.  Test to see if the meat will be tender after 1 hour, if not, then leave for a few minutes.  If there is some liquid left on the tray and if it is, reduce some more or some more.  Remove the truss paper, replace the wrap with a clean, damp tea towel, and put it back on the tray.  You will need to add more water.  Cook for another 10 minutes to an hour or until the meat is brown and cooked, adding a splash more of the gravy or some more raw sliced dates. . .  Serve the meat from a large pan, or use the gravy from the oven instead.

instructions: Take a peaches and if they should be on a sharp knife score the skin on the top and bottoms on the diagonal.  Remove them and cut the fruits into thin slices.  Wash the peaches, remove the stone, peel back, reserve the stone for garnish.  In a pan put the pepper tapenade into it warm the peach slices.  Take the pan of peach slices, and dip the peaches in it, remove it from the heat and place it on top of the chilled tapenade.  Garnish with a peach and piece of reserved pepper tapenade.

title: Watermelon and Edamame Frittata
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1 small red spring onion, finely chopped | 2 1/2 tablespoons chopped shelled edamame ( or rocket ) | 3 tablespoons fresh picked watermelon rind ( not frozen, can use a can of drained rinds ) | 3 eggs, beaten | 2 tablespoons freshly chopped spring onions, for garnish ( white and green part )
instructions: Place all ingredients except greens in the bowl of an electric blender or food processor and blend until a very smooth puree and the watermelon is finely chopped.  Spoon into a bowl with the greens and season with salt and pepper.  Place under a medium hot grill for 2 minutes on each side, until just beginning to turn brown.  Cut into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,beef bouillon granule,collard green,rice paper,wonton wrapper,ice,dill weed
title: Polish Dumplings (Dumplings)
ingredients: 1 package dried rice papers, preferably jonagang ( available at the korean supermarket ) | 1 package frozen collard greens, defrosted | 1 granny smith apple - peeled, cored and diced | 2 packages wonton wrappers | 4 cubes beef bouillon granules | 1 quart ice | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce to taste
instructions: Place the dried rice papers up into a colander set in the sink, and cover with several inches of room around the water.  Place a bamboo steamer over the top, and fill the bowl with water to reach 2/3 of the way up the rice papers.  Soak the rice for about 15 minutes or until soft and pliable.  Remove from the water as soon as it becomes soft enough to remove.  Drain once it's cooled enough to handle, and cut the rice papers into quarters.  Place the rice paper squares on a work surface, and spread about 2 cups of greens out in the center of the rice papers.  Top with the diced apple and about 1 1/2 teaspoons of beef bouillon granules.  Fold the left and right edges of each wrapper over the filling, and roll up into 12 - 12 dumplings.  Repeat for the rest of the rolls.  Place the dumplings on a stellg pan or dutch oven, and fill the stellg with water.  Bring to a boil, and simmer until the dumplings float to the top.  Cover, and cook 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, strain, and serve hot.

title: Labriya (Yogurt Cheese Spread with Pistachio and Pistachios)
ingredients: 1 container plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 tablespoons pistachios, finely chopped | 2 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, chopped
instructions: Whisk together all of the ingredients except the provolone.  Place on a large serving plate and top with chopped pistachios or sliced mozzarella cheese.  Serve with pita bread or crisp rolls.

title: Herbed Beef Steak
ingredients: 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried herbs | 1 boneless chuck steak
instructions: Prepare the spice bag.  Combine all ingredients and pour half into slow cooker.  Add the steak and turn on low enough to marinate in refrigerator for a few hours.  Reserve remaining marinade.  Cook the steak on low 10 hours.  Serve on italian rolls or tostada with cheese, sour cream, lettuce and tomato.

Random Ingredients: dill,pizza crust,yogurt,red enchilada sauce,rye bread,green enchilada sauce,bean,rock salt
title: Enchilada Pizza
ingredients: 1 pre-baked thin crust pizza crust | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup light yogurt ( or nonfat ) | 1 cup prepared vegetarian refried beans | 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon rock salt ( optional ) | 1/2 cup fresh dill, sliced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup light yogurt, extra-virgin, for basting on the pizza while baking | 1/4 cup nonfat plain yogurt, for basting on the pizza while baking | 8 -10 leaves fresh dill, for garnish
instructions: Heat 1 inch of oil in a medium sized pan to medium heat.  Turn down the heat to low.  Spread all of the bean/noodle in the pan and spread the sour cream or yogurt over the top of the spread.  Next spread the enchilada sauces over the spread.  Add the dill or dill and mix thoroughly.  Transfer to the prebaked pizza crust and bake 20 minutes at 400 degrees.  Remove from oven and place top crust on with remaining toppings, as you choose.  Remove from oven and brush with egg wash or extra virgin olive oil.  Slice down the center and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,gin,green enchilada sauce,jalapeno pepper,coconut extract
title: Jackin' Juan Tasty Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 16 ounces refrigerated green enchilada sauce ( or homemade ) | 1 can green enchilada sauce ( or homemade ) | 2 tablespoons diced fresh jalapeno peppers | 3/4 teaspoon coconut extract | 3/4 teaspoon liquid smoke ( i recommend smen ) | 1 1/2 fluid ounces gin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a 3 to 4 quart baking dish, combine green enchilada sauce, green enchilada sauce, jalapenos, coconut extract, liquid smoke and gin.  Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until heated thoroughly, stirring once.  Serve enchiladas warm or chilled.

title: Ancho Bitter
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ancho chile powder | 4 sprigs mint leaves, for garnish
instructions: Use a small glass bowl or coffee cup to pour ancho chile into the glass bowl, and let the chile warm.  Do not allow the chile to harden, or it will become bitter.  When the chile has hardened, remove the garlic.  Use a spoon to scoop out the green chile pulp and discard.  Crush into a clean bowl, and set aside until needed.  When the ancho bitter has cooled, spoon the flavored extract into the bowl and garnish with mint leaves.

title: Oatmeal Burritos
ingredients: 2 quarts water | 1 cup old-fashioned oatmeal, ground in the food processor | 2/3 cup montasio-reggiano cheese, grated, plus additional for rolling | 1/2 cup picante sauce or 1/2 cup mild picante sauce | 6 large lettuce leaves ( for taco meat, green chili, or whatever you prefer )
instructions: Cook the water in a large soup pot over medium heat until the water is boiling.  Add the ground oatmeal and whisk until completely mixed, about 1 minute.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the oatmeal to a bowl.  Sprinkle the oatmeal with the montasio cheese.  Add the picante or chile or picante sauce into the pot.

Random Ingredients: salt,fast rise yeast,bay leaf,brown sugar,wheat flour,egg white,garam masala
title: Easy Low-Fat Naan Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons salt | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup wheat flour | 1 teaspoon fast rise yeast | 1 egg white | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Cream together sugar, flour, yeast, salt and half the egg white in a standing mixer fitted with a dough hook.  Transfer the mixture to the paddle and beat on medium speed until combined.  Stir in rest of egg white.  Combine garam masala and bay leaf.  Add to dough, and mix on low speed until dough loses its raw texture and starts to form a ball.  Turn out onto a floured board and knead until smooth and elastic, about 3 to 5 minutes, adding more flour if necessary.  Place dough into an oiled bowl, turn to oil all sides, cover and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour.  Punch dough down, divide into 6 portions and shape into loaves.  Place loaves on a lightly oiled baking sheet, cover and let rise until doubled, about 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Brush loaves with marinade.  Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: green olive,apricot,cherry tomato,lemon wedge,heavy whipping cream,cream chicken soup,marjoram,adobo sauce
title: Piccata Salad (Catalan)
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup chopped green olives, such as nicoise or 1/2 cup other brine-cured black olives | 1 jar dried apricots, stemmed and cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh marjoram or 2 teaspoons dried marjoram leaves | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh lemon wedge | 1 dash hot adobo sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the soup, cream, olives, apricots, marjoram or marjoram, lemon wedge and adobo sauce.  Toss to coat.  Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Cherries Tomato and Cranberry Covered Salad
ingredients: 8 cherry tomatoes | 1 cup fresh cranberries | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander, leaves
instructions: Chop the tomatoes and cranberries roughly.  Chop basil and stir through chopped herbs.  Serve in a glass bowl with the tomatoes and cranberries as a garnish.

title: Pineapple With Sesame Oil
ingredients: 2 pineapple | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Remove and discard the ends from all of the pineapple, and cut off the top and bottom leaves by removing the stem from the base and the stalk.  Cut the pineapple down the length of its stalk at the rib joint.  Slice crosswise into thin slices about 3/4 inch thick.  Heat the sesame oil in a small pan over low heat.  Add the pineapple halves and fry until golden on both sides then serve.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,white wine vinegar,fenugreek seed,bok choy,oyster,malt vinegar
title: Yummy Vietnamese Pork Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs coarsely chopped pork shoulder | 3/8 cup dry white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons of roasted fenugreek seeds | 1 bunch of chopped bunches of fresh oysters, shucked | 2 lbs of chopped bok choy
instructions: Mix together the pork, white wine vinegar, malt vinegar, and fenugreek seeds.  Toss with hot greens and enjoy.

title: Mexican Carrot-Stuffed Orzo
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder or 2 lbs blade steaks ( 8-ribs ) | 2 tablespoons coffee | 4 medium carrots, peeled and finely chopped | 2 1/2 cups orzo pasta, cooked according to package directions using 2 cups hot water | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 -2 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon prepared file powder | guacamole, garnish
instructions: Cut away as much fat from the pork shoulder or steak as possible then remove any large bone fragments or undesirable pieces of meat.  Cube the meat very finely.  In a large deep skillet, heat the coffee over medium high heat.  Add the pork and stir in the carrots.  Add the orz, spices, and the remaining liquid.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then remove from the heat.  Let stand at room temperature for about 25 - 30 minutes.  To stuff the meat, slice the meat across the grain into about 1/4 thick rounds.  Arrange the pieces on a platter.  Top with guacamole and serve.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,red wine vinegar,tomato sauce,savoy cabbage
title: Spicy Savoy Slaw
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage, finely sliced | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 300 g tinned tomato sauce | 1/2 cup coriander leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.  Toss until well combined.  Serve with warm jacket potato.

title: Vegetable Salsa
ingredients:
2 quarts cabbage, finely shredded | 1 1/2 cups celeriac, shredded | 1/2 - 1 cup yellow squash, shredded | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fish sauce ( use soy sauce ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup apple cider ( or veg.
    - juice ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried horseradish ( for flavouring )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients thoroughly and combine well.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 - 8 hours or overnight.  Stir well before serving.  To serve, spread over crisp cooked hot bean or jasmine rice and top with a spoonful of hot sauce.  Note, this is good with a variety of root vegetables such as potatoes and carrots.

title: Jalapeno & Radish Bark
ingredients: 6 -10 fresh jalapeno peppers, sliced with the green left on | 1 bag radish, rounds
instructions: Place on foil lined cookie sheet and spread with jalapeño slices.  If not using right away, place on rack over baking pan.  Bake for 20 minutes or until dry.  Let cool for 5 - 10 minutes.  Use as directed.

title: Baked Beans With Rice and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons dried szechuan peppercorns | 1/2 cup dry rice wine | 7 tablespoons dried minced onion soup mix | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1/4 cup brown rice | 1/8 cup tomato paste | 3/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 cup accent roenka chili sauce
instructions: In small bowl combine dry soup mix, peppercorns, dry rice wine, onion soup mix, chili sauce, brown rice, tomato paste, celery salt, and accent roenka sauce.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,vegetable oil,apple cider,dark soy sauce
title: Teriyaki Glaze (Glaze for Beef Steaks)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons apple cider
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small saucepan.  When it reaches a boil, remove from the heat and allow to cool.  If you wish to do this, place the glaze in a small plastic bag and allow it to reach room temperature before using.  Once the glaze is chilled, use to brush a little mixture on an exposed meat piece before cooking, or use as a glaze on your favourite steak before barbequeing the meat.  The glaze can be kept refrigerated, and use in any recipe calling for dark soy sauce and other dark soy sauce.

title: Cocoa Baked Catfish
ingredients: 1 cup matzo meal | 1/2 cup frangelico | 1/8 teaspoon pepper | 1/8 cup unsweetened cocoa | 3 cups cubed catfish | 1 cup plum tomatoes, canned, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons dried anise seeds | 1/4 cup semisweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Add matzo meal, frangelico, pepper, cocoa, catfish and tomatoes to a large glass or ceramic baking dish and mix well.  Add anise seeds and chocolate and stir until chocolate is melted.  Spread the fish mixture on top of the matzo mixture.  Bake for 25 minutes or until catfish is tender.

title: Tropical Melon Balls
ingredients: 2 lbs honeydew melon | 2 tablespoons potato starch | 1 teaspoon green onion, finely chopped
instructions: Peel melon and cut in half.  Take out all the seeds and then dice into 1/2 inch pieces.  Then combine equal parts of the potato starch and the green onion and mix well.  Place on wax paper lined cookie sheet about 1 inch thick.  Make diagonal slashes about 1 inch apart on each melon ball.  Bake at 350 degrees.  Remove when golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,dark chocolate,gingerroot,white balsamic vinegar,bread flour,lasagna noodle
title: Easy Balsamic Ginger Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 lb lasagna noodle | 1 lb fresh gingerroot, peeled, cut into matchsticks about 3 inches long and 3 inches long | 2 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 2 cups country-style bread flour | 8 ounces dark chocolate, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f in a small, heavy bottomed saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat.  Add the noodles and cook until they are tender, about 3 minutes.  Immediately drain onto a paper towel to dry.  Set aside.  Roughly grate the ginger.  Transfer the ginger to a bowl and add the vinegar and set aside.  In another small bowl, mix together the bread flour and grated ginger until a paste is formed.  Add the soaked noodles and the dry ingredient mixture and mix to combine.  Scatter the grated chocolate over the top.  Put the lasagna sheet on a baking sheet.  Bake the lasagna for 12 to 15 minutes, then remove from the oven and place on a serving platter.  Serve with your favourite ganache or a simple tomato sauce.  Variation, for those with a harder dough, you can use a food processor to combine the flour and ginger.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,basil leaf,sandwich bread,quail egg,chili powder,flax seed,sugar,tofu
title: Quail Eggs With Spicy Garlic Naan
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried red chili or 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 75 g chopped tofu or 150 g firm tofu | 1/3 cup coriander leaves | 1/3 cup fresh basil leaf | 1/2 teaspoon toasted ground flax seeds | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 5 -6 slices sandwich bread, thinly sliced | 4 -5 fresh curry eggs
instructions: Combine crushed red chili and the crushed dried red pepper in small bowl.  Use as the dipping sauce for the toasted paneer bread.  Place tofu in a bowl.  Add coriander, basil, flax and sweet red chilli paste to tofu and mix well.  Spread tofu mixture evenly over bread and sprinkle with sugar.  Heat 1 - 2 tbs oil in a large non stick skillet and cook the quail eggs over medium low heat stirring frequently.  Serve hot, topped with the dipping sauce.

title: Baked Rind Jalfard (Bean Burghul)
ingredients: 2 cups red quinoa | 150 lbs beef rump, split into 3 portions | 1 1/4 cups pinto beans, soaked | 3/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 3 tablespoons plain whole-grain rind jalfard ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit.  Spread quinoa on a large, oven safe baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.  Turn oven temperature to 375 degrees fahrenheit.  Place split green rind in a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 20 minutes or until blackish in color.  Turn the heat to medium and roast rind for 10 minutes or until blackened in color, turning oven off if rind is browning too quickly.  Wrap bag of beans in aluminum foil and place in oven to dry.  In a large mixing bowl, mix drained rinds with ground beef, 1 1/4 cups of the cooking liquid, and cardamom.

title: Mashed Nogales
ingredients: 3 hass avocadoes - peeled, pitted and diced | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon himalayan salt | 1 whole chicken, cut into pieces
instructions: Mix avocados, fenugreek, turmeric, and himalayan salt in a bowl.  Spread a thin layer of the seasoned masala onto the chicken pieces to cover.  Arrange chicken in a single layer on a plate and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.  Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate.  Grill chicken until no longer pink and juices run clear, 3 to 5 minutes per side.

title: Spicy Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless beef top sirloin, cut into 3/4 inch strips | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: Place beef in a resealable plastic bag.  Pour in the cayenne pepper.  Close the bag, and shake to coat meat with seasonings.  Let marinate in refrigerator for at least 20 minutes.  Heat an outdoor grill for medium heat.  Arrange strips of beef on the grate, and cook until desired doneness, about 7 minutes per side.  Top with cayenne, and serve.

title: Green Taco Salad (Oriental Salad by Doreen Miranda)
