instructions: Note, i can get my laches out of this recipe.  This is a simple recipe that has been my family's favorites.  I don't use a blender, just a large bowl of food processor, and chop the lachón while it is still liquid.  Put everything into a medium sized mixing bowl, and stir well.  Refrigerate until ready to make the salad right before you serve.  Note, my husband likes to toss the sweet chili sauce with the torn romaine just until it is evenly coated.  It would be great with a bit of mozzeralla, too.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tofu,vanilla essence,chicken breast fillet,cognac,prune,chicken wing,ice cream,liquid smoke
title: Casco Glut
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets | 240 g whole ice cream | 60 g prunes | 240 g whole chicken wings | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 250 g firm tofu | 1/2 cup cognac ( optional ) | 300 ml liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Cut up chicken, and place in a large bowl.  Add ice cream in the same sized bowl with chicken.  Add vanilla essence and stir together.  Add prunes and leave to marinate in the ice cream.  After an hour it's ready to cook.  The longer it rests the stronger the flavour will be.  Place ice cream in the freezer and set to chill for 15 minutes.  Then remove from freezer and place on a tray in the fridge.  Drain the ice cream, and place in a microwave safe bowl with water in it.  Cover with cling wrap and microwave on high power 3 - 4 minutes.  Remove cling wrap and place on the fridge.  Take out half the of the ice cream and place in blender.  Turn blender over and process until smooth.  Place ice cream, prunes, marinated chicken skin, and remaining ice cream in a large bowl.  Add vanilla essence.  Cut up tofu into slices that are 3 4cm thick, and place on top of the ice cream.  Pour cognac over the surface of the chicken and prunes.  Stir until incorporated.  Let sit for 15 minutes, then mix in liquid smoke.

title: Pecorino-Pecorino Pasta
ingredients: 2 lbs pasta ( i prefer linguine ) | 10 cups fish stock | chopped fresh pecorino romano cheese or parmesan cheese | 1 -2 hot anchovy ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon dry crushed espresso beans ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil, add a large pinch of salt and cook the pasta according to package directions until al dente, drain the pasta.  While doing this, pour the fish stock into a heavy large pot, set to high.  Slice the anchovies into thin slivers and add to the pot along with the cocoa and optional ingredients.  Bring to boiling.  Add the drained, cooked pasta immediately and stir well to combine.  Serve in bowls topped with freshly grated pecorino or parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,hamburger,mushroom,mexican chocolate,zucchini,olive oil cooking spray,swordfish
title: Mushroom Baked Swordfish, Zucchini and Shiitake
ingredients: 1 lb swordfish, 1 inch thick, skin and fat removed | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 medium zucchini or 2 large summer squash, cut lengthwise in 6 slices | 3 cups mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 8 ounces mexican chocolate, grated ( about 1/4 cup ) | 4 tablespoons sliced pitted ripe olives or 4 tablespoons sliced pitted ripe olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Spray a 12 x 9 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Lay swordfish strips on cutting board.  With a serrated knife, cut each into 1/4 inch wide strips.  Place zucchini or squash on sprayed baking sheet.  Set aside.  Using a fork, prick the tops of the strips with a fork.

title: Raspberry-Fig Rollatio
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups red seedless raisins ( about 12 ounces ) | 2/3 cup canned crushed fresh figs | 1 tablespoon yeast | 1/4 cup corn kernel | 1/3 cup fontina cheese, julienned | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves, roughly chopped | 6 1/2 cups whole-fat unbleached lettuce, lettuces | 2 large red ripe figs, halved and reserved | 2/3 cup fontina cheese, julienned | 2 1/2 cups fresh raspberries, quartered and reserved | 1 large lettuce sheet, leaves separated | 1/2 cup mint leaf, roughly chopped | 3 cups fresh raspberry
instructions: For the filling, combine the raisins with the figs in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the blade.  Process, until mixed, about 30 seconds.  Add the yeast, corn kernels and fontina cheese and process about 15 seconds.  Drain the raisins, reserving 1/2 cup of the juice.  Using a fork, stir in 1/2 cup of the raspberry juice.  In a small bowl, mix the mint, corn kernels and the reserved juice.  Cover and let stand at room temperature until the flavors combine, about 15 minutes.  Spread the raspberry filling evenly on each lettuce leaf, top with the fig mixture, and roll up the leaves jellyroll fashion.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and place the rolls on the baking sheet, cut side down. .  Cover the rolls with plastic wrap and let rest at room temperature until the flavors have developed, about 15 minutes.  To make the vinaigrette, using a blender, blend the reserved juice from the figs.  Add 1 tablespoon of the raspberry vinaigrette and the mint, blend until well blended.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.  For the rolls, preheat the oven to 200°c.  Line 2 small, rimmed baking trays with foil or parchment paper.  Place the rolls on the baking sheets.  Bake for 12 minutes, then remove the baking sheet and the buns from the oven.  Spread the raisins and fig juice mixture evenly over the rolls.  Return the baking sheet and the sheet to the oven and bake for 5 minutes, or until the vinaigrette has reduced slightly.  Remove the rolls from the oven and scatter the minted cheese over the tops.  Return to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, until the cheese has melted.  Cut halfway through the rolling, for each roll an x forms a hollow in the center of one of the rolls.  Remove the plastic wrap and top with the raspberries, the reserved raspberries and the minted cheese.  Slice crosswise, diagonally, and serve.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,lima bean,semolina,italian sausage,russet potato
title: Lima Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs mixed frozen lima beans | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, removed from casing | 2 russet potatoes, scrubbed | 2 oranges, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup semolina
instructions: In your food processor, pulse the lima beans until they are coursely chopped.  Remove the beans from the food processor and, with the motor running, start the purée, adding the remaining vegetables.  Put the purée in a large container or freezer bag.  Cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 2 hours.  When ready to serve, pulse with the zest for desired sweetness and color.  Serve with semolina flakes.

title: Smoked Codfish and Chickpeas
ingredients: 4 cod fish fillets | 1 can chickpeas | 1 can mixed beans | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1/4 cup shredded coconut ( optional )
instructions: Place cod and chickpeas in large bowl and top with pine nuts, coconut if using.  Cover tightly with plastic wrap or lid and refrigerate overnight.  Cut cod into 4 chunks.  Wrap in foil and bake at 350 or 450 for 10 - 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Pasta and Steak Frites With Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 small round steaks, cut into 1 '' strips | 8 ounces farfalle pasta, cooked according to package '' directions | 3 ounces baby portabella mushrooms, halved | 1 can diced tomatoes, undrained | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs, chopped | 1/2 cup green olives, sliced | 1/3 cup cocoa, nibbles
instructions: Place steak in shallow bowl, add salt and pepper to taste.  In medium size skillet, heat oil to medium hot.  Add steak, cook until golden brown, about 3 minutes each side.  Set aside.  Add mushrooms and cook until tender, 2 - 3 minutes.  Stir in tomatoes and herbs, then pour over pasta in skillet.  Serve sprinkled with cocoa nibbles.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,salmon fillet,turbinado sugar,kosher salt,ginger garlic paste
title: Gingered Salmon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons spanish onion, slivered thin | 2 2 lbs salmon fillets or 2 lbs salmon steaks | 4 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons turbinado sugar | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Heat oil in an ovenproof pan until hot but not smoking on the outside.  Place onion slivers in hot oil, 2 at a time, and fry until the onions are golden brown.  Carefully flip the salmon and put the cooked onions on top.  Sprinkle ginger garlic paste and sugar over the salmon fillets.  Put oven rack in centre of oven and place pan in oven.  Cook until the fish is barely done.  If it doesn't turn around just turn the heat down.  Serve right away.

title: Shrimp in Tomato
ingredients: 1 pound shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup dried marjoram
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Stir in shrimp, and sprinkle with dried marjoram.  Cook and stir until shrimp are no longer translucent, about 5 minutes.  Cook seafood for 3 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: double cream,french baguette,broccoli,shrimp,rigatoni pasta,serrano pepper,thyme,virgin olive oil
title: Stuffed Rigatoni With Shrimp and Broccoli
ingredients: 4 ounces rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 3 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1 lb medium raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 8 ounces broccoli, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, minced | 1 serrano pepper | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon double cream | 1 french baguette, cut into 1/2 inch rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  In a large pot, bring 3 quarts of water to a boil.  Add rigatoni, and cook until al dente, about 5 minutes.  Drain pasta, and return to pot.  Bring remaining 2 quarts of water to a boil.  Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.  Add shrimp, and cook until barely opaque, about 2 minutes.  Remove shrimp with a slotted spoon, and place in medium bowl with the shrimp.  Cut broccoli into small florets, and combine with thyme, and chile pepper in a bowl with cream.  Lightly oil a 9x13 inch baking dish, or place in an oven proof baking dish.  Fill bread rounds with rigatoni.  Drizzle with olive oil, and place on baking sheet with bread rounds.  Bake in preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until lightly puffed and lightly browned.  Serve with shrimp and broccoli sauce.

title: Jicama in Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs jicama | 1 lb white pearl onion | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In medium size bowl, add 1 cup cold water and cut jicama into cubes.  Add remaining ingredients and toss.  Let stand 30 minutes, refrigerate overnight.  Serve cold.

title: Sauerkraut and Carrots
ingredients: 1 pound baby carrots | 3 cans sauerkraut | 1 can chopped jalapeno peppers | 1/4 cup hot sauce, or to taste | 1/2 cup white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Bring large pot of salted water to a boil.  Add carrots, and cook until tender but firm, about 20 minutes.  Drain, reserving 2 cups of the cooking water.  Chop carrots into bite size pieces, and return carrots to the pot.  Mix sauerkraut with jalapenos in a bowl, and mix in hot sauce and sugar until thoroughly mixed.  This will make the sauerkraut mixture more creamy.  Serve in bowls with a sprinkling of sugar sprinkled over.

title: Roasted Turnip Patties with Eggplant and Turnips
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled and sliced | 4 turnips, peeled and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with tin foil.  Open eggplant and turnip slices, and spread both sides with the roasted olive oil.  Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, until eggplant is soft and dry.  Serve with saltines and salad.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,pecorino romano cheese,plum tomato,currant,parmigiano reggiano cheese,raspberry,bell pepper
title: Roasted Tomato & Pepper Gratin
ingredients: 2 plum tomatoes ( small ) | 3 firm fresh mozzarella cheese | 8 ounces fresh baby arugula or 8 ounces baby spinach | 3/4 cup raspberries ( canned ) or 3/4 cup blackberries ( canned ) | 1/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon grated pecorino romano cheese or 1 tablespoon grana padano | 4 small bell peppers, chopped ( red, green or yellow )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high.  Slice tomatoes into 8ths then roughly chop into bite sized pieces.  Place the tomato pieces evenly on a plate and drizzle with cooking spray or olive oil which helps prevent sticking.  Season tomatoes with salt, if desired.  Place a grilling pan over medium high heat.  When the grate just starts to smoke, place the whole tomatoes, with their juices, face up, without moving them, on the grate.  Grill them on both sides for 6 - 10 minutes, or until the tomatoes are completely blackened.  Turn off the grill.  Transfer the tomatoes to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 10 minutes before serving with the arugula and fresh Baby Spinach.  Dress with raspberries, cheeses and pecorino romano.  Place a large dinner plate over the tomatoes.  Turn on the broiler element, and position the tomatoes directly on the broiler rack.  Broil them for 4 - 5 minutes, until the top is light brown and crisp, the tomatoes are heated through and the cheese has melted.

title: Italian Sausage and Peppers for a Crowd
ingredients: 2 lbs bulk italian sausage | 2 cans no-salt-added stewed tomatoes or ( 16 ounce ) cans stewed, diced tomatoes
instructions: Brown italian sausage with the stewed tomatoes, pepper sauce, and salt and pepper to taste.  I like a little bit of the extra tomato and pepper sauce to mine, but the flavor doesn't boil away just boil away before you do anything.

Random Ingredients: almond,corn flake crumb,self rising flour,chicken breast,vegetable,mozzarella cheese,white pepper
title: Homemade Chicken Calzones
ingredients: 1 cup chicken breast, shredded | 1/2 cup mixed vegetables, chopped | 2 cups corn flakes crumbs | 3/4 cup self rising flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 cup sliced almonds, toasted
instructions: In a well oiled bowl, toss shredded chicken with vegetables.  In a separate bowl, stir together cornflake crumbs, flour, pepper and cheese until well blended.  Add milk or water to flour mixture to make a soft dough, about 2 tbls.  Keep moistening your hands with a bit of flour while working and squeezing the mixture into thin but not floury creases.  Turn and coat with mixture.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Cut slits in top of the crust.  Drop about 2 tbls.  Of mixture by rounded tablespoon onto a lightly greased, floured pan.  Bake until golden brown, about 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Soused Meat for Perogies
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1 1/4 cups chicken stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f and line a small baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place meat in a large bowl, add just enough stock to moisten it a bit, then knead with your hands until the meat comes together and is completely wet.  Cover the bowl loosely with plastic wrap and place in freezer for a few hours, then take the meat out and pat dry in a colander or spaetzle press.  Wipe the bowl dry with a clean cloth or paper towels.  In batches, transfer the meat to a large mixing bowl.  Stir in the rest of the stock and mix gently.  The mixture should be soft and slightly sticky but not mushy, if it is too stiff add a little more stock.  Divide the mixture among the prepared baking sheets, keeping enough to roll out the meat if necessary.  Bake for 20 minutes, until the tops are dark brown and the meat golden brown.  To test for doneness, place a wooden fork in one end of a toothpick and poke deeply in the bread.  It should feel neither dry nor sticky, if your finger leaves an impression on the underside it should feel dry again before it breaks or a little jiggles.  Let meat cool and slice into thin 2 or 5 mm slices.  Serve with your favourite german meal.

title: Italian Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup walnuts, finely chopped | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garlic paste ( you can add more if you are using a jar ) | 1/8 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs, divided in half | 1/4 cup coarsely ground walnut pieces, for topping ( optional )
instructions: First dip the walnuts in a little hot water, making sure they are all wet.  Add them to a food processor and pulse until finely ground.  Add the garlic paste, italian seasoning, panko and 1/2 to 1/3 cup of ground walnuts.  Blend until the walnuts are chopped fine.  Add more panko if the consistency is too thick.  Store in the fridge in a glass jar.

title: Pickled Turnip
ingredients: 5 -7 small turnips | 8 ounces cream cheese | chili sauce | horseradish sauce | 2 tablespoons bouquet garni
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the turnips into round slices.  Arrange slices on a plate, pour over half a pint of hot sauce and leave to marinate in refridgerator for 3 hours.  In a saucepan, melt the cream cheese on a hob.  When the mixture is smooth, spread onto the turnips, sprinkle with the horseradish and bouquet garni.  Reheat the pan and serve.

title: Namibian Style Vietnamese Style
ingredients: 16 large crisp lettuce leaves or 16 large iceberg lettuce leaves | 16 slices firm-textured rice wine
instructions: The goal is a lettuce leaf that is just slightly softened.  If you have lettuce that is large, you may tear it into smaller pieces or cut it in a different way.  Wash the lettuce very thoroughly and place it on kitchen towels, and allow to dry a few hours or overnight.

title: Tommy Mai Tai Tostada
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces tequila | 1 ounce tequila | 1 ounce ground melon, drained | 1/2 ounce taco seasoning, divided | 1 mango, cut in thin wedges | 1 plum tomato, cut in thin wedges
instructions: Shake tequila, lemons, and 1/2 to 1 teaspoon taco seasoning in cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes.  Strain into a cocktail glass.  Squeeze a wedge of mango wedge into cocktail.

title: Mexican Ravioli
ingredients: 1 package frozen ravioli ( ravioli are perfect in our house ) | 1 cup milk | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 cup chopped turkey pepperoni | 2 teaspoons dried epazote
instructions: Bring milk and cheese in medium saucepan to boil.

Random Ingredients: white corn,dill sprig,italian bread crumb,nutmeg,half,red pepper flake,pork loin roast,double cream
title: Pork Stuffed With Dill
ingredients: 2 pork loin roast | 1 container half-and-half | 1 cup white corn ( frozen or canned ) | 1 cup double cream | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoned bread crumbs ( see note ) | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | fresh dill sprig ( optional )
instructions: Place pork in slow cooker, season with salt and pepper, top with half and half, corn, cream, bread crumbs, nutmeg and crushed red pepper.  Cover, and cook on low for approximately 8 hours while preparing the dill.  Remove pork from slow cooker, and discard the fat and gristle.  Slice the pork into eight slices, about 1/4 thick.  Place slices into a lightly oiled baking dish that holds two slices each.  Place under medium hot broiler, and broil for about 7 minutes, turning once, until lightly browned.  Serve with a dill sprig if desired.

title: Stir Fried Pepperoni Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine pasta or 1 lb spaghetti | 1 package pepperoni, sliced | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons ghee | pepperoni
instructions: Put the fettuccini in for to boil, drain and set aside for about 10 minutes in the meanwhile, toss the pepperoni slice with 2 t s cornstachter cornstarch and coat it well with oil.  You can also pound it with the back of a wooden mallet.  Remove the pepperoni slice from the oil, drain and set aside.  Add a little more oil to a large skillet and put the pepperoni slices over top of them in order to lightly brown them and keep them crisp, or you can put it in the oil and fry on high heat in order to crispy them.  When they are well cooked, take them out and turn them over.  Drain the fettuccine or spaghetti and toss in a little more oil.  Add mustard and mix with the cornstarch.  Add the ghee, pepperoni, and hot pepperoni into the pot and put it in the oven until warm.

title: French Coffee Mustard
ingredients:
1 teaspoon dry instant coffee ( or 2 tbs.
    - water and 1 teaspoon instant coffee ) | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon minced fresh parsley stems ( optional )
instructions: To make coffee, add 1/4 cup strong coffee to a mug and stir in dry mustard.

title: Apple Surprise
ingredients: 3 large tart apples, peeled, cored and cut into chunks | 3 tablespoons hot sauce
instructions: Place apple chunks into medium bowl.  Sprinkle hot sauce over.  Spoon hot sauce into the cavity of the apples.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.  Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,cake flour,sherry,dill leaf,sirloin,orange peel,marinara sauce,white vinegar
title: Pate - Italian Meatball Skewers
ingredients: 3/4 cup chopped fresh marinara sauce | 1/2 cup sherry | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup quick-cooking rolled oats | 1/4 cup finely chopped candied orange peel | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh dill leaves | 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin | 3 cups dry cake flour
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients.  Mix in ground sirloin.  Mix in cake flour until thoroughly mixed.  Shape into 1 inch balls.  Arrange on greased or parchment lined rack.  Chill 10 minutes before cooking.

title: Spiced Onion Salad
ingredients: 1/2 loaf bread, torn into pieces | 1 red onion, sliced | 1 cucumber, cut into rounds | 1/4 cup butter | 1 1/2 cups palm sugar | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, slivered
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place bread in a bowl.

title: Chicken in Champagne
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken, with a whole chicken, innards left | 1 1/4 cups canned chickpeas, with liquid | 2/3 cup prosecco or 2/3 cup dry champagne | 12 ounces penne
instructions: Brine the meat, reserve broth to use for another use.  Remove neck from chicken and discard bone and obvious fat.  Rinse well and pat dry.  Using fingers or a sharp knife, poke holes all over chicken.  Place chicken, breast down, in a roasting pan.  Place chickpeas in a bowl.  Pour boiling water until half the chicken breast is covered.  Place pan in a pre heated 350°f oven, about 4 minutes.  Lower temperature if pan starts to brown.  Continue cooking until chicken is no longer pink in the middle when pierced with a paring knife, about 30 minutes.  With a slotted spoon, remove chicken to a warm platter.  Turn oven to broil, place roasting pan over drip burner and broil chicken until slightly charred and crusty, about 4 - 6 minutes.  Turn oven off.  Place chicken back into pan.  Turn oven up to 400°f arrange the platter of chicken on a bed of cooked pasta.  Pour wine over and around the chicken.  Cover chicken with foil and allow to set for 10 minutes.  Serve with crusty bread or toasted baguette slices.

title: Beef and Parsnips in Cacao
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs rump steak | 1 lb parsnip | 2 red seedless grapesfruit, peeled and cut in halves | 1 cup crumbled cotija cheese | 1 ounce instant coffee powder ( or a mixture of both )
instructions: Rinse meat with cold water and pat dry with paper towels.  Cut into 1 inch cubes.  In a large nonreactive roasting pan, place beef, parsnips, grapesfruit, cheese and coffee powder.  Heat to boiling, cover and steam for 3 - 5 minuts or till meat is heated through check for seasoning and serve.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,chipotle pepper,spinach,icing sugar,extra virgin olive oil,beer,mint leaf,tortilla chip
title: Spinach Nachos
ingredients: 500 g fresh spinach | 1 large chipotle pepper, seeded and minced | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 dash cumin seed | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, plus extra for brushing | 2 cups crispy tortilla chips | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup beer
instructions: Prepare and boil the spinach according to instructions on the package.  Place the chipotle and the mint into a mortar and pestle and crush with the pestle.  Pour in the oil through the hole in the mortar, add the crushed spice mix and stir into a paste.  Set aside 1/2 cup of the mint leaves for later use.  Place the remaining mint leaves into a separate bowl and allow to chill before using these leaves to remove their crispness.  Slice and serve the spinach and the chopped mint sprigs on a plate with the crispy tortilla chips and drizzle over the mint sprigs.

title: Coconut Macquechaus
ingredients: 8 ounces desiccated unsweetened coconut
instructions: Mix well.  Cover.  Refrigerate.

title: Fried Green Beans in Hot Syrup
ingredients: 2 lbs raw green beans | 2 cups sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, minced | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup mild picante sauce
instructions: Wash and trim green beans.  Rinse under running water.  Drain well.  Combine with remaining ingredients. .  Refrigerate overnight.  Makes about 6 servings.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,chili sauce,olive,green onion,vegetable oil cooking spray,liquid smoke flavoring
title: Smoky Ginger-Licious Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup cooking spray | 3 green onions | 1/2 cup sliced ripe olives | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Slice green onions diagonally into 1/4 inch wide strips.  Coat pan with cooking spray and add green onion strips,.  Add olives and sweet chili sauce.  Stir constantly for 3 - 5 minutes.  Add liquid smoke flavoring and minced ginger garlic paste.  Taste and adjust salt if desired.  Pour over hot cooked chicken, pork or tofu.

title: Tofu Teriyaki Salad
ingredients: 100 g firm tofu, drained and cubed | 10 ounces fresh strawberries, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon coffee liqueur | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 garlic clove, peeled | 2 dates, pitted, finely chopped
instructions: Place tofu in colander and press out excess water.  Toss tofu with tamari, coffee liqueur, mirin, tomato puree, garlic and dates to combine.  Serve immediately, or refrigerate for later.

title: Bread and Pepper Bowtie Pasta
ingredients: 6 ounces pasta | 1 package bow tie pasta | 2 1/2 tablespoons ponzu sauce ( mizkan style, kobo brand or kombu brand ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Boil water in a pot for pasta.  In the meantime, rinse bow tie pasta under cold water.  Heat ponzu in a frying pan or microwave for 30 - 40 seconds.  Drain pasta.  Add italian seasoning to bread/pepper ponzu and italian seasoning mixing well.  Add crumbled italian bread/pepper/mizkan sauce to pasta and stir to combine well.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,asparagus,broccoli floret,green apple,red enchilada sauce,fontina cheese,oregano
title: Grilled Asparagus Broccoli Salad With Apple-Herb Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, trimmed and cut in 1 inch chunks | 1 large green apple, cored and cut into eighths | 1 large green bell pepper, sliced into thin strips | 1 package frozen chopped broccoli florets, thawed and well drained | 12 3/4 ounces red enchilada sauce | 16 ounces sliced fontina cheese ( about 2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano
instructions: Prepare grill to medium heat for direct, indirect cooking over high heat.  Arrange asparagus and apple on preheated grill.  Grill, turning once, until asparagus is barely softened, about 3 to 5 minutes.  Transfer asparagus and apple to a large bowl.  Add green pepper and broccoli to bowl and toss until vegetables are coated with red enchilada sauce and season with salt.  Serve topped with cheese and oregano.

Random Ingredients: single cream,wheat flour,corn tortilla chip,elbow macaroni,savoy cabbage,summer squash,beet,chocolate chip
title: Pastel De Choclo (Cheese and Potato Tortilla Chip Casserole)
ingredients: 1 large beet, chopped | 1 large summer squash, chopped | 1 tablespoon corn tortilla chips or 1 tablespoon crumbled plain corn chips | 150 g elbow macaroni | 400 -400 g carnation low-fat sour cream or 400 -400 g full fat sour cream | 200 g shredded savoy cabbage | 25 g chocolate chips or 25 g plain chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c.  Place the beet and squash in a pan with salted water and bring to the boil.  Cook for 8 - 10 minutes until tender.  Drain and add the tortilla chips.  Cook until both the vegetable and chips become the colour of caramel.  Toss half the veg.  Cabbage together with 1tbsp of the sour cream and spread in the base of a 2l ovenproof dish.  Layer the beef roulade, cheese and corncabbage mix.  Repeat.  Top with remaining sour cream and the remaining cheese.  Cook in the oven for 45 - 60 minutes until heated through, covering occasionally.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,heavy whipping cream,lemon,cream tartar,chili oil
title: Hot Pepper Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 dash cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 tablespoons grated lemons, rind of | 2 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded
instructions: In a small saucepan combine cream, cream of tartar, and chili oil.  Cook on medium heat until mixture reduces by half.  Stir in lemon rind.  Stir in shredded cheese.  Spoon sauce into an 8 inch by 8 inch glass baking dish.  Chill in the refrigerator to blend flavors.

title: Lazy Firecracker
ingredients: 1 medium shallot | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Wipe the shallot dry.  Wrap in foil and place on a sheet pan with a rack, or place in the oven on the middle rack of the oven at 450°f.  Bake for 15 minutes, then remove from oven.  Add the liquid smoke and stir well.  Allow to cool, then taste and adjust seasonings if necessary.

title: Tart Tarts for Bonfire
ingredients: 1 package black pudding | 1 pound mixed peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread the peels into four 6 ounce packages of bread dough or wax paper, and allow to dry thoroughly.  Place the packages on a baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until the edges are lightly browned, 10 to 20 minutes.  Allow to cool and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,onion soup mix,hamburger bun
title: Hamburger Buns
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger buns | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 4 tablespoons red currant jelly
instructions: Mix all together.  Cut buns in half, and place in greased 9 x 12 pan.  Stick buns in pan.  Sprinkle with jelly.  Bake at 375f for 30 minutes, or until warmed through.

title: Rosemary Fresh Fruit Cocktail
ingredients: 1 pint frozen whipped topping | fresh rosemary leaf | ice cube
instructions: Scoop the frozen whipped topping into a mixing bowl.  Stir in the rosemary leaves.  Fill half the cocktail shaker or collins with ice.  Shake vigorously and pour over the ice in 2 to 8 ounce glasses.  Shake the drink with the stem of a rose.  Garnish with a rose sprig.

title: Pesto-Seasoning Rice Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt
instructions: In bowl, whisk together pesto sauce, rice vinegar and seasoned salt.  Pour over rice.

Random Ingredients: chili,egg yolk,hot chili sauce,nutritional yeast,vanilla extract,grape leaf
title: Grape Leaves
ingredients: 2 cups grape leaves, washed | 5 large egg yolks | 1/2 cup raw sugar ( or use honey ) | 1/4 cup hot chili sauce | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground chili ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients except leaves and vine leaves in a food processor or blender and blend until very smooth.  Pour into a bowl and set aside.  Place a grape leaf vein side up on a large piece of cheesecloth, suspend with cheese cloth over top, or your damp kitchen towel.  Lay one flat on a kitchen towel on the floor of your sink, place a couple of grape leaves, cut side up, in this fashion, wrap tightly the cheesecloth around the grape leaves.  Tie with cotton string to keep leaves loose.  Wrap tightly in the cheesecloth.  Place in a container and let marinate in the refrigerator for up to 6 days or for up to 2 weeks.  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a medium baking pan with aluminum foil.  Place a large sheet of plastic wrap over loaf pan bottom, loosely film with water, and lay on a cookie sheet.  Transfer the grape leaves with the marinade to the oven, unwrap cheesecloth, and place in the oven.  Fill the grape leaves with the grape leaves.  Return to the oven, remove the foil, and continue baking until leaves begin to turn a light golden color and crisp, about 20 minutes.

title: Jamaican Pork Calfs
ingredients: 3 pork fillets | 2 cans frozen limeade concentrate | 1 cup dry roasted peanuts | 4 tablespoons prepared mustard
instructions: Place pork in a large baking dish.  Pour limeade concentrate over pork.  Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 3 hours.  Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat.  Drain pork.  Spread peanuts onto the prepared grill grate.  Reduce grill temperature to medium.  Grill pork for about 10 minutes, or until it starts to turn a nice dark color.  Turn and grill until dark brown on all sides.  Place on a platter.  Drain limeade concentrate and stir until well combined.  Serve with pork.

title: Hot Mustard Mushrooms Spread
ingredients: 8 button mushrooms, stems removed | 1 pint miracle whip | hot mustard
instructions: Place the mushrooms and Miracle Whip in a blender and whip until creamy.  Spread onto a bread slice and sprinkle with mustard.

title: Nana's Chilled Vinegar Mustard for Sausages
ingredients: 4 cups malt vinegar | 6 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: In a medium size sauté pan, heat the vinegar over medium high heat without boiling it.  When it begins to get hotter then, add the salt.  If it starts to thicken, add a teaspoon of vinegar at a time.  Let the jar of mustard come out clean.  Once it does, it will have mustard consistency.

title: Five-Spice Orange Spread
ingredients: 2 navel oranges | 1/2 kg five-spice powder
instructions: Scrub navel oranges with a damp cloth.  Cut a strip of orange peel at the base of each orange, and carefully remove the rind from the membrane.  Cut the rind into 4 - 5 cm long pieces.  Cut four slashes in each orange, then using a sharp serrated knife cut 2 cm slits through the rind from each piece to form a'snape', giving little stripes, to resemble a star.  Rinse the orange pieces with water so the rims don't curl or pith anything sticks to them during final final preparation.  Place orange pieces in a large glass bowl and rub with five spice powder until all surfaces are covered.  Cover.  Place 1 tablespoon of orange peel mixture into each orange and squeeze the juice from the orange to get a good pourable consistency.  Repeat this step with no orange rind mixture.  Pack rinsed oranges into glasses, and cover each glass with plastic wrap.  Place a small piece of aluminium foil on top to keep the orange moulds from sticking.  Put the glasses into a steamer and steam for 20 mins, or until set.  Allow to cool a little while you can slice easily.

title: Cheese and Sultana Casserole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sultana | 100 g fontina, grated | 8 tablespoons cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons orange sections, lightly crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees centigrade.  Put sultanas, fontina, cheddar and orange peel into a large bowl.  Sprinkle over the grated cheese.  Put mixture into a non stick, ovenproof and lightly spray or grease an ovenproof casserole dish.  Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes or until top is golden and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,apple juice,farfalle pasta,green cardamom pod,pork steak,graham cracker crumb,thai fish sauce
title: Shrimp and Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/3 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup thai fish sauce | 2/3 cup unsweetened apple juice | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 green cardamom pod | 2 pounds pork steak
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Grease the bottom and sides of a 9x13 inch casserole dish.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut,ziti pasta,phyllo pastry,spinach leaf,nutritional yeast
title: Vegan Paneer (Vegan)  Phyllo Pasta
ingredients: 3 cups ziti pasta, whole milk type | 3 cups fresh spinach leaves, chopped | 12 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup macadamia nuts, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons nutritional yeast
instructions: Combine macadamia nuts and yogurt in a food processor.  Pulse until very finely ground.  Combine nuts and nutritional yeast in a large bowl.  Stir in nuts and nutritional yeast mixture.  Let macadamia mixture stand to 1 hour while preparing ziti and vegetables.  Bring large pot of water to a full boil.  Add ziti, then cook for 1 hour.  Drain pasta, and rinse with cold water to cool.  While baking pasta, add spinach, and cook until cooked, then drain.  Stir in macadamia nut mixture and remaining ingredients if desired.  Place ziti onto a work surface or a greased cookie sheet.  Spread 2 - 3 tbsps.  Of the mac nade mixture in the center of each sheet.  Brush with a little water.  Using a pastry brush, lightly brush edges with water.  Place 3 sheets of dough on top of each other on the work surface, and flatten slightly.  Bake in 400 degree oven for 10 - 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce heart,flat leaf parsley,coconut milk,chipotle powder,cilantro stem,italian sausage,tuna water,sake
title: Coconut-Sausage Skewers #RSC
ingredients:
2 -4 links italian sweet sausage ( cut into 1-inch thick slices and lightly soaked in 1 t.
    - lime juice ) | 2 cans unsweetened coconut milk | 1/2 lb fresh linguica sausage ( cut diagonally into 3/4-inch thick slices ) | 2 tablespoons dried chipotle powder | 4 romaine lettuce hearts | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro stems | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 package fresh nashi seaweed seaweed, with husks ( can sub 2 tbsp.
    - dried sea salt )
instructions: Place the italian sweet sausage, the coconut milk, and the 1 1/2 tablespoons of chipotle powder in a heavy pot over medium low heat, stirring constantly and continuously and making sure nothing bubbles.  Bring to a simmer for 5 minutes, then add the linguica.  Simmer for 3 minutes.  Then add the celage and cook 4 - 4 minutes longer, remove to a platter.  Stir the noodles through the sauce 1/2 the at a time until coated thoroughly with sauce.  Add the cooked linguica, the cilantro, and the parsley, and toss.  Set in refrigerator to chill.  Skewers are served warm or at room temperature.  Note, to make sushi, refer to the following, http, //food4.  Com/recipe/coconut sausages and noodle cooking.

title: Baked Parsnips (Crispy Beef and Parsnips)
ingredients: parsnip | 2 slices spanish onions, sliced thinly | 1/2 lb ground chuck | 2 tablespoons soya sauce ( sweet soy sauce ) | 1 ounce cake flour ( or pastry flour ) | 1/2 teaspoon brown sugar
instructions: Peel parsnip and slice it in a julienne.  Grease roasting dish, put onion slices on top of parsnip and cover with meat.  Mix other ingredients and pour over meat.  Bake 375°f for 50 minutes, basting once or twice to get some brownish color.

title: White Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup white flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried maraschino cherries | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Whisk flour and cherries to mix.  Pour into saucepan and add bay leaf.  Heat on medium heat and stir.  Cook about 5 minutes or until thickened.  Serve.

title: Broccoli Oatmeal for Two
ingredients: 1 package frozen broccoli or ( 1/2 lb ) package steamed broccoli | 10 ounces frozen mango | 2 tablespoons cooking oats, old fashioned | 1 cup italian-style stewed tomatoes ( or salsa ) | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning, chipotle, chipotle powder or 1 teaspoon other seasoning | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme or 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon capers ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon kerry syrup ( optional )
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil, add in the broccoli and the rest of the ingredients and cook according to the package instructions.  This makes enough sauce for two servings.  You can add more sauce if you prefer, but the sauce tastes best when allowed to steam for a few minutes.

title: Spinach and Rhubarb Crostat
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped orange rind | 1 cup chopped rhubarb | 1 package unflavored gelatin | 1/4 cup cold catsup | 1/4 cup orange juice | 2 cups thawed baby spinach | 1/4 cup self rising flour | 1 seedless cucumber, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Combine orange rind, rhubarb, and choclate in a plastic sealable plastic bag.  Sprinkle gelatin over rhubarb mixture, seal, and let stand 5 minutes.  Stir occasionally.  Unwrap gelatin bag.  Add catsup and mix well.  Dissolve gelatin in water.  Pour gelatin mixture into bowl with rhubarb mixture.  Reserve 1 cup of batter for topping.  Sprinkle reserved mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Top with spinach and chopped cucumber.  Garnish with reserved orange rind mixture.  Refrigerate overnight to firm up.  Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate 3 hours.

title: Creamy Ham & Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup beans, any kind | 1/2 cup diced ham | 1/4 cup whipping cream ( not sweetened )
instructions: Cook dry beans until tender drain.  Cook ham until lightly browned.  Add cream until well incorporated and cool.  Pour the beans over your favorite chips.

Random Ingredients: cherry,tomato puree,cherry jell o,pie shell,italian parsley
title: Italian Cherry Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 large frozen pie shell | 2 jars cherry jell-o | 6 ounces cherries, pitted and coarsely chopped | 1 cup cherry puree | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Place frozen pie shell in a pie dish.  Stir together cherry rollettes and cherry puree in a small bowl.  Pour cherry mixture over pie shell.  Sprinkle top with parsley.  Cover the pie with aluminum foil and bake in a 350 degree oven until the filling begins to bubble and the top is golden brown, about 1 hour.

title: Fruit Soup

Stuff figs with meat mixture, being careful not to stuff anything into the figs.  Serve immediately, garnished with mint, if desired.

title: Polenta and Apple Dip (Pork or Chicken)
ingredients: 500 g polenta ( yellow cornmeal, not egg-free ) | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh jalapeno, finely chopped ( optional ) | cooking tapioca ( optional ) | cooking spray ( optional )
instructions: Pour the tapioca into a colander and leave it to drain for a few minutes depending how dry your tapioca is.  Spray a shallow dish with cooking spray.  Place the polenta in a mixing bowl and add the breadcrumbs, chopped jalapenos and tapioca.  Mix well.  Place your mixing utensil onto a medium heat and begin to stir the tapioca mix with a fork or spoon until the mix becomes sticky but not sticky.  This should take about 3 - 4 min or until the mixture starts to pull away from the sides of the bowl.  Transfer into a large mixing bowl and pour over your tapioca mix.  Using a clean spoon or two turn off your mixer, add a bit of water and your mixer will start to form a cohesive dough.  Transfer it into a bowl and place back into the same bowl and cover with cling wrap.  Refrigerate to chill, then remove it from the fridge and leave to come to room temperature.  Transfer it to your freezer for an hour and then cut into bite sized chunks.  Return it to the freezer again to chill.  You can also use a plastic bag to freeze this for up to a couple of days.

title: Chewy Date Pita Bread
ingredients: 8 ounces white cooking chocolate | 8 ounces dates, pitted and chopped | 3 tablespoons chopped hazelnuts | 3 teaspoons curry | pepper | 6 pita bread
instructions: Melt 1 oz butter in a saucepan then add dates and hazelnuts and let simmer on low heat stirring frequently until warm.  Meanwhile, microwave the remaining butter for a few mins to make a smooth paste.  Cool slightly then slowly pour butter paste into the mixture.  Take off the heat and stir in the curry.  Add pepper and mix.  Cut the pita bread in half and spread with butter/nut mixture.  Re wrap each pita half in aluminium foil.  Add more slices to form a ring around each ring.  Put on a bar grill and cook over a medium heat for about 5 mins until they crisp.  Serve with a cup of milk.

title: Broccoli and Pea Melt
ingredients: 1 bag frozen peas | 1 large bag frozen chopped broccoli | 3/4 cup frozen bread, thawed | 1 spring onion
instructions: Cook and dice broccoli and peas.  Melt 1/4 c butter in a frying pan and add chopped vegetables.  Mix with toast.  Top with a generous amount of green onions if you like.  Enjoy.

title: Germans Chocolate Sour Cream Liqueur
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 1 package german sweet chocolate | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Place sour cream and sweet chocolate in a double boiler.  Melt and stir until smooth.  Serve warm, or refrigerate.

title: Quick Fried Rice Vinegar and Egg
ingredients: 3 egg whites | 1 cup white cooking spray | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Place egg whites in a clean bowl of the rice cooker and set it on 'low'.  Add the rice vinegar and stir in.  When the rice starts to steam, take the bowl from the'slow' and let it cool 5 minutes.  Carefully peel egg whites.

title: Crock Pot Raita
ingredients: 1 can fat-free soymilk or 3/4 - 1 cup of warm milk | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley | 8 very ripe jalapeno peppers, washed, stems removed & sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl.  Cover & chill well.  Place in crock pot on high heat.  Turn to low.  Cook on high for 4 hours, turn to low & cook for 2 - 3 more hours until thick and syrupy.  Pour into a serving dish.  Serve warm with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,pinto bean,bisquick baking mix,cheddar cheese,tomato sauce,peanut oil vegetable
title: Mexican Pizzadillas
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups bisquick baking mix | 1 lb pinto bean | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons veg oil | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded ( your favorite ) | corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place a paper baking sheet in the oven to set the timer for 5 minutes, or until the oven comes back to temperature.  In a large skillet, brown beans in the peanut vegetable oil for 8 - 10 minutes, until soft and a little crispy on the edges.  Move to a side, remove baking sheet from oven.  Spread the bottom of the skillet with a little corn oil, then spread the bean mixture evenly on the pan.  Turn heat on stove to medium, then ladle the tomato sauce evenly over the beans.  Then sprinkle the top with cheese.  Put back the baking sheet in the oven and bake another 20 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly.  Serve.  Enjoy.

title: Ham and Sherry Biscuits
ingredients: 12 ounces ham, cut into 2 inch strips | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line baking sheets with parchment paper.  In a bowl, combine ham, sherry and baking powder.

title: Mexican Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, undrained | 1 package frozen egg substitute | 2 -3 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cans stewed tomatoes | 2 tablespoons mexican oregano | 4 tablespoons tequila, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Mix all ingredients in 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.  Bake for 4 - 5 hours, or until meat is tender.  Remove beef from pan.  Stir well and serve.

title: Quick Sweet and Sour Crepes
ingredients: 24 inches crepes | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 cups sodium-reduced sodium vegetable broth
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Season lightly with salt and pepper.  Drizzle enough vegetable broth to cover bottom of pan.  Place 2 crepes, 1 at a time, on the skillet and cook until bottom is dry, about 2 minutes per side.  Repeat for remaining crepes.  Keep crepes warm until ready to serve.

title: Vermouth Mustard
ingredients: 1 lb fresh steak, cut into thin slices or 1 lb frozen steak, thawed if frozen | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder ( freshly ground ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | pepper ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder ( freshly ground or ground ) | 1/2 cup ice water | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 2 tablespoons grapes or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | pickled peppercorn, optional for drizzling on top of finished dish ( optional )
instructions: In a heavy, heavy skillet combine the cardamom, turmeric, pepper, cardamom, and salt.  Add the steak and allow them to saute at medium heat for 3 minutes per side.  Add vermouth and allow it to boil for 1 minute.  Serve as soon as possible, on a bed of grapes or a bed of fresh peppercorns.  Drizzle with additional vermouth or olive oil for taste.

Random Ingredients: jumbo pasta shell,red leaf lettuce,eggplant,vegetable broth
title: Eggplant-Spanakopita
ingredients: 3/4 cup vegetable broth | 4 large eggplants, peeled and thinly sliced ( about 6 medium ) | 24 jumbo pasta shells, uncooked | 12 small red leaf lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.  Bring broth to boil in 6 qt skillet.  Cook eggplant and shrimp according to package directions.  Arrange eggplant and shrimp in an even layer on baking sheet.  Bake until eggplant and shrimp are well cooked and eggplant is tender, stirring occasionally, about 25 minutes.  Divide pasta among 4 bowls.

title: Low Fat Blue Cheese and Squash Baked in Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 cup blue cheese | 1 stick celery seed | 1 yellow squash | 1 cube chicken bouillon ( i use knorr )
instructions: Open chicken bouillon cube.  Open bag of squash and put it on a plate.  Add a sprinkle of celery seeds on top.  Coat a sauté pan with olive oil and heat over medium heat.  Add sauté pan contents back to pan.  Slice and cook until browned on all sides.  Plate and top with browned cheese and a little celery seed to garnish.

title: Sauerkraut and Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 can sauerkraut | 1/8 cup uncooked medium grain white rice or 1/8 cup instant rice | 1 medium banana, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to in a small saucepan, cook rice until tender, about 10 minutes.  Combine the beef and sauerkraut.  Place in a 10 x 14 casserole dish and surround with sliced bananas.  Cover the dish with foil.  Bake for about 30 minutes, basting occasionally.

title: Homemade Green Chili Powder
ingredients: 3 cups pure green chilies ( mild and hot ) | 3 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 4 quart jar or deep pot.  Close lid and shake vigourously until powder is evenly dispersed.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips, peeled and grated | 1/4 cup dried marjoram
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in an iron skillet.  Cover and cook over low heat for about 60 minutes.  Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,lemon,half cream,italian dressing,prosciutto,vegetable bouillon cube,tamarind pulp,red capsicum
title: Tamari Creamy Low Cal Tamarind Raita
ingredients: 2 tablespoons buttermilk | 2 containers low-fat plain fat free half-and-half cream | 1 frozen vegetable bouillon cubes | 1 green shallots or 1 red onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp | 2 slices prosciutto ( dry cured deli ham ) | 1 teaspoon fresh grated lemon rind | 2 teaspoons low-fat italian dressing
instructions: Pour buttermilk into a large bowl and add remaining ingredients.  Toss to combine.  Cover.  Place in fridge for at least 1 hour.  Strain and serve.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,basil,walnut,strawberry,nutmeg,sun tomato oil,green lentil
title: Lentils With Strawberries, Sun-Dried Tomatoes, and Basil
ingredients: 8 ounces green lentils, rinsed and picked over | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 3/4 cup walnuts, toasted ( about 2 ounces ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained ( not oil packed ) | 10 -12 whole strawberries, stemmed | fresh basil, to garnish
instructions: Spray a 3 1/2 quart or larger, cast iron skillet with cooking spray.  Place in a large bowl, and sprinkle with walnuts.  Toss with nutmeg.  Toss with lentils, and spread evenly in pan.  Sprinkle lightly with a pinch of nutmeg.  Bake at 400 degrees f until lightly browned, about 15 minutes.  Add sun dried tomatos and strawberries.  Bake until tender, about 10 to 12 minutes.  Cut into wedges, serve garnished with basil.

title: Tamarind and Coconut Powder
ingredients: 1/3 cup chopped coconut | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 inch cube red chili pepper | 4 cardamom | 1 tablespoon fresh red chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Store in airtight container.

title: Microwave Cabbage
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1 cup gouda cheese, shredded
instructions: Place cabbage in a microwave safe bowl or a covered container that has been cover with microwaveable wrap.  Cover with a damp paper towel and microwave on high for 4 minutes.  Remove from microwave and stir.  Top with cheese and return to microwave and micro, uncovered, on high for 3 more minutes.

title: Homo Pasta With a Yummy Milk
ingredients: 24 ounces rigatoni pasta | cooking spray | 3 cups 2 % low-fat milk | 12 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Boil rigatoni or fusilli according to package directions.  When the pasta is nearly done, heat the milk in a small saucepan over medium heat.  When it starts to thicken, but before it boils, add the soy sauce and stir until it has all been absorbed by the pasta.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,saffron,vanilla ice cream,celery,mexican cheese,vanilla bean,yellow pepper
title: Mexican Daikon and Pepper Salad With Saffron
ingredients: 1 cup yellow sweet pepper, sliced | 1 cup daikon radish, peeled, sliced small | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean or 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 3 cups vanilla ice cream | 1/2 cup celery, sliced thin | 1 mexican cheese, grated
instructions: Cook the yellow sweet pepper, daikon and daikon in boiling water for 7 minutes or until just tender.  Drain and allow to cool.  Place the saffron in a tea towel.  Spray a frying pan with oil and cook the saffron for 10 minutes, or until golden, stirring occasionally.  Add the vanilla bean and chill until cool.  Wash, trim stem, and slice thinly.  Place the cooled veggies, cooled saffron and vanilla bean mixture in large bowl and chill.  Top with the cold cream and shredded mexican cheese.  Mix well.  Serve cold.

title: Lentil and Bean Sprout Fritters
ingredients: 3/4 cup lentils, rinsed and drained | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup tequila | 2 ounces sprouts, drained, rinsed, and drained
instructions: Combine drained and rinsed lentils in a bowl of boiling water and let sit for no longer than 15 minutes.  Drain and transfer to a large mixing bowl.  Stir in flour.  Make a well in the center of the lentil mixture and pour in the tequila and sprouts.  Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Flour Tortilla Receipe# 78
ingredients: 4 cups flour | 4 cups hot sauce ( your favourite flavor )
instructions: Blend flour and hot sauce thoroughly in a large bowl.  Dough should have some small lumps.  You may need a little more or less hot sauce or hot sauce depending on your favorite sauce.  Divide dough in half and roll out each piece as thin as you can.  Cut into 8 equal segments and place into hot pan with little oil in the center.  Cook until edges start to curl like pillows.  Flip over and cook on other side for another 2 - 3 minutes.  Repeat until all mixture has been used.  Serve immediately.

title: Orange Peel Straws
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 lb orange peel, with pith | 4 lbs raw sugar-free sweet orange peel
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f.  Pierce the top of the orange peel with a sharp knife several times on both sides and place on a parchment covered foil lined baking sheet.  Spread with the oil then scatter with the orange peel slices.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours, stirring every 20 to 30 minutes.  It will look like they are turning a dull golden brown.  Cool for 5 minutes.  Stir in 1 pound orange peel.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chile pepper,extra virgin olive oil,olive oil
title: Easy Roasted Salsa Fresca
ingredients: 1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 1 -2 teaspoon minced fresh guajillo chile pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Place the 1/3 cup olive oil into a large, microwave safe bowl.  Add the chile pepper.  Microwave on high for 15 seconds, then micro on medium high 2 minutes, or until it begins to smell strongly.  Remove bowl from microwave.  Heat remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil in a small saucepan on the stovetop or oven shelf until shimmering.  Pour the hot oil into the bowl with the chile pepper, swirling to blend in all the oil.

title: Best Ever BBQ Corn
ingredients: 1 can or bottle beer ( this beer is usually found at a local farmers market ) | 1 can or bottle white shoepeg corn, drained
instructions: In a large deep skillet with a lid, add beer, corn and cover.  Let corn steam on the bottom over low heat to thicken and develop the flavor.  Once heated, remove skillet from heat and let stand for 10 minutes.  Use clean utensils to remove corn, reserving 1/2 cup of the beer.  Use a large spoon to mash and push corn off of the back of the spoon.  Place back in skillet and stir.  Pour remaining beer into the skillet and bring to a boil over high heat.  Let the heat return to a simmer, cover, and let stand for 10 minutes.  Stir well, then let stand for 10 more minutes.

title: Sweet Batch Japanese Pancake
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup vegetable broth, warm | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f.  Mix flour, sugar, and mirin in a bowl.  Pour heated broth into the bowl slowly, mixing well.  Stir flour mixture into liquid in bowl until smooth.  Pour batter on a floured surface.  Use a floured knife to make small holes into the batter, in whatever shape you want it.  Spray baking sheet with non stick cooking spray.  Pour about 1/2 cup batter into each hole.  Bake in one pan until browned, abut 30 seconds, flipping halfway through.  Serve topped with a bit of sugar.

title: Jalapeno Pepper Poppers
ingredients: 6 fresh poblano peppers, seeded | 8 small yellow jalapeno peppers | 1 bell pepper | 3 radishes
instructions: Roast peppers by placing them in a glass pie dish, skinning them, and broiling them in oven, turning them over a few times, until the skin loosens and peppers are blackened, about 30 minutes.  Let peppers cool enough to handle, and then peel off the skin and discard.  Remove tops of peppers, and seeds, and put them in a large bowl.  Cut the bell peppers in half, and devein them by cutting off the stem and leaving the stem ends intact.  Cut out the eyes and ribs around the peppers until the jalapenos are broken into chunks.  Add the bell pepper pieces and the radishes to the bowl with the peppers.  Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes.  To serve, spread the peppers with a little of the reserved pepper juices, and garnish with a few chopped jalapenos.

title: Sparkling Brewmaster's Kebabs!
ingredients: 18 skewers ( from a skewer or use more ) | 3/4 cup sunflower oil, for brushing | 1/2 cup sour mix | 2 -5 juniper berries
instructions: Place oil in large pot on stove and turn burner to high.  Soak skewers for about 3 - 5 minutes per side.  Place skewers into pan, add sour mix and juniper berries.  Let bubble 5 minutes or so, scraping bottom frequently to prevent sticking.  Pour mixture into a clean jar, cover, put on lid and refrigerate for about 8 - 24 hours, shaking regularly.

title: Quick Zesty Spresso Squash
ingredients: 1 zucchini, chopped | 1 yellow squash, chopped | 3 - 3 1/2 cups strong coffee | 1/2 tablespoon dried rosemary or 1 tablespoon fresh roseme leaves, snipped | 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large pot and set over med high heat.  You may choose to cook for 3 mins to really get a lovely zesty zing.  Stir and heat thoroughly, serve warm.

title: Polish Tomato and Dill Pickle Spread
ingredients: 1 kg ripe tomatoes, chopped | 2 -3 dill pickles, finely diced
instructions: In a large mortar, pound together the tomatoes and dill to a pulp.  Add the pickles and pound until the mixture becomes very smooth.  Transfer the mixture to a food processor or food processer and blend until it forms a coarse paste or thick paste.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,gruyere cheese,cardamom seed,chinese five spice powder,graham cracker crumb,mexican rice
title: Cheese & Grapes With Rice Crumbs and Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 bunch bok choy, washed ( about 3-4 cups ) | 7/8 cup shredded gruyere cheese, cheese | 1 cup finely shredded mexican-style rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom seed | 2 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs, approximately
instructions: Rinse and dry bok choy.  Trim the leaves.  Wash under cold water and cut each leaf in half lengthwise.  Place half of the leaves in a colander that fits snugly over a bowl of warm water, cover, and let stand for 20 minutes to drain.  Remove and discard the remaining leaves.  Using a paring knife in a 1, 2, 3 inch saucer, lightly pound the leaves to flatten slightly.  Transfer the leaves to a large bowl.  Add the cheese, rice, cardamom, 5 spice powder, and half the cheese.  Stir to combine.  In a separate large saute pan, bring 6 cups of water to a boil.  Pour a ladleful of the water into the pan.  Stir in the graham crackers.  Cover the pan, reduce heat to medium low, and cook until the cheese is melted and beginning to thicken, about 15 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, remove and discard the cheese slices, place on a plate, and keep warm.  Remove the pan from the heat and keep it covered until all the liquid is absorbed.  Working quickly to keep it warm, ladle 1/3 cup of the sauce over each slice of bokchoy, spreading it to 8 inch circles.  Arrange a few pieces of the remaining cheese over the top.  Return to heat, and continue cooking just long enough for the cheese to melt, about 3 minutes.  Serve hot.  If desired, spread the remaining sauce on the bokchoy.

title: Guacamole Steak and Ham Steak
ingredients: 4 ounces sliced hamburger | 1 lb steak, cut 1/2-inch thick ( rib steak, or other cut of meat ) | 3/4 ounce guacamole | 3/4 ounce steak, sliced in 4 slices | 1 bouquet garni | 1 tablespoon espresso powder
instructions: Preheat your broiler or grill to high heat.  For each steak, arrange it on a foil lined baking sheet.  Brush both sides of the steak with the espresso powder, and top with 2 slices of ham and 1/2 ounce of steak on top of the ham as below.  Close the foil and place on the grill/broiler/grill for 9 minutes.  Turn the steak over, and brush the other sides of the steak with espresso powder, and top steak with guacamole, then sprinkle with onion rings if desired.  Grill the steak for another 3 to 5 minutes until cooked to your liking, or to your preferred doneness and internal temperature of the meat.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,snow pea,garlic powder,white vinegar,red enchilada sauce
title: Microwave Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen snow peas, thawed | 1/4 cup red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/3 cup distilled white vinegar
instructions: Place frozen snow peas, enchilada sauce, taco sauce, garlic powder, and vinegar in a microwave safe dish.  Cover, and microwave on high for 4 minutes, or until bright green and crisp.  Pour over salad immediately, and toss immediately to coat.  Chill for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Miso-Braised Miso Fish
ingredients: 400 g miso, miso | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Place the miso and parsley in a small ovenproof dish, stirring to combine.  Cover and bake for 10 minutes.  Remove lid and reduce oven temperature to 140°c.  Bake for 10 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Remove fish.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Salsa Crusted Cod With Asparagus
ingredients: 4 ounces medium shrimp or 4 ounces cod | 4 ounces asparagus tips, ends trimmed, ends trimmed ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup cashew halves | 1/2 cup raw cashew halves | 1/4 cup sweetened salsa | 2 teaspoons arrowroot or 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon or 1 teaspoon granulated sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated fresh ginger or 1 gingerroot
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Place the shrimp in a small baking dish.  Bake for 30 seconds to 1 minute or until the shrimp are pink.  Remove from the oven and spread the asparagus tips decoratively around the rim.  Bake for 3 to 5 minutes or until the asparagus is just tender.  Remove from the oven.  Spread the cashews over the top of the asparagus.  Drain the shrimp well and distribute evenly over the cashews.  Combine the asparagus, salsa, arrowroot or cornstarch, cinnamon or sugar and ginger in a bowl, stirring well to blend.  Spread the mixture over the top of the asparagus and shrimp, sprinkle with the remaining asapargus.  Place on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the mixture is hot and bubbling.  Watch carefully, as cashews burn easily.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,red onion,chicken stock cube,scotch bonnet pepper,peanut oil,yellow cornmeal
title: Cornmeal (Beef) Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock cubes, dissolved in | 1 cup chicken stock cubes or 1 cup water | 1 small red onion, sliced thinly ( optional ) | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal or 1/2 cup plain cornmeal, or coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped peanuts or 1/4 cup raw cashews, toasted, see note | 1 large scotch bonnet pepper ( optional ) or 1 large habanero pepper, seeded, minced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped red onion | peanut oil, for brushing
instructions: Combine chicken stock and water in saucepan over high heat.  Bring to a boil, then simmer, uncovered until reduced to about 2 cups, about 10 minutes.  Remove from heat, cool completely, and skim off any foam that rises above stock.  Measure out liquid and reserve.  In a large bowl, stir together 2 cups of simmering stock or cooking liquid and cornmeal.  Stir in about 3/4 cup reserved liquid until cornmeal is thick and well mixed.  Stir until well mixed and add in remaining ingredients.  Preheat grill or broiler.  Brush oil over grill grate or broiler pan.  Place remaining corned beef on grill or broiler pan, brush with oil, and leave 4 inches of space between each cutlet.  Cook approximately 4 minutes and flip, brushing with oil, until steak is cooked medium rare, 3 to 5 minutes longer.  Meanwhile, spread cornmeal evenly on plates.  Top with corned beef, top with remaining sauce, and serve.

title: Chipotle Carne Guisada(Chile Fries)
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef chuck roast
instructions: In a large, deep skillet, heat 1/4 inch of oil over medium heat until the temperature reaches 350 degrees f.  Remove the roast from the pan and pat dry with paper towels.  Add the beef and cook, stirring occasionally, until brown on all sides, about 30 minutes total.  Transfer the roast to a warm platter and slice into strips about 2 inches wide and 1/2 inch thick.  Return all the beef to the pan and bake in the preheated oven, turning frequently and skimming any foam at the edges, until the pieces have begun to brown, about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sizzlin' Cannellini® Mango Queso
ingredients: 2 tablespoons diced mango chutney, divided | 1 tablespoon milk chocolate | 1 dash granulated sugar | 2 cans cannellini, drained | tortilla chips
instructions: Prepare sauce by whisking remaining 2 tablespoons chutney, milk chocolate and sugar together.  Drain juice from can from can into a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: greek salad dressing,beef stock cube,coffee,rice noodle,turmeric,orange
title: Moroccan Coffee Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice noodles | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 beef stock cube ( optional ) | 1 orange | 1 tablespoon instant coffee ( optional ) | 1/4 cup of your favourite greek salad dressing
instructions: Slice your orange and microwave it with the turmeric for 15 seconds, or until you see it has a little colour.  Pour into a microwave safe mug or bowl.  Microwave your stock cube in the microwave until dissolved.  Slice the beef.  Dice it finely.  Combine all ingredients in the microwave safe mug or bowl and microwave for 30 secs on high power until the noodles are softened.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard seed,tomato soup,madeira wine,beef broth,onion soup mix
title: Madeira Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs boneless sirloin steaks, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/3 cup madeira wine | 1/4 cup prepared yellow mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  In a 13 x 9 inch baking dish, place cut pieces of beef and onion soup mix into single layer.  In a medium bowl set aside, whisk together soup, wine and mustard seeds.  Pour soup mixture over beef and onions.  Bake for 1 hour.  Serve over hot, cooked grits.

title: White Beans With Apples
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 8 medium tart apples | 4 cans white beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a 2 or 3 quart baking dish with foil and spray with a nonstick cooking spray.  Core apples and cut in half crosswise.  Using a large dinner fork, dip apples into prepared pan, flipping once.  Remove apples when just softened and place them in baking dish.  Rinse and drain beans.  Arrange apples over the beans.  Pour 1/2 can of the beans over them.  Sprinkle remaining bean mixture over apples.  Dot with a little of the nonstick cooking spray.  Bake for one hour.  Remove from oven and let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chinese Bok Choy Bake
ingredients: 4 tablespoons minced fresh ginger with juice | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 lb bok choy ( about 2 bunches ) | 1/2 cup packed cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon granulated sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  In a saucepan, combine the ginger, fennel seed and 1/4 cup cold water.  Cover pot and simmer over medium–high heat for 3 minutes.  Remove pan from heat.  Add the bok choy, cover and cook for 5 - 7 minutes, or until softened but still brightly colored.  In a small bowl, mash the remaining 1/4 cup of cold water with sugar and add to the pan.  Cook over high heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil, about 3 minutes.  Remove from heat and pour into a lightly greased 7 x 11 baking dish and spread evenly.  Sprinkle with the cheese and cover with crumbled bok choy.  Bake for about 20 minutes or until the topping is bubbly and browned.  Let cool 5 minutes.  Uncover and cut into squares with a serrated knife.

title: Krispy Clams
ingredients: 10 lbs fresh clams, scrubbed | 8 medium baking potatoes, cut into rounds | 1 large onion, peeled and sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried basil | 1 1/2 tablespoons spices | 1 2/3 teaspoons curry powder or 1 2/3 teaspoons cayenne pepper
instructions: Scrub clams well, removing any barnacles.  Place clams in a large pot or dutch oven, and add enough water to cover them by about 2 inches.  Cover, bring to a boil, and reduce heat.

title: Soyabbals in a Pond (Smoorish Spaghetti)
ingredients: 2 packages biscuit mix | 1 cup tahini ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 3/4 cup radish, chopped ( optional ) | pepper | 1 lb spaghetti
instructions: Cook pasta.  Drain and put into a large bowl.  Add everything else and mix well.  Enjoy with a glass of wine.

title: Pimiento Guacamole
ingredients: 2 avocados | 2 -3 tablespoons tomato ketchup | pimento, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Slice avocados in half and scoop out most of the seed.  Mash the avocado, add in the tomato ketchup and chopped pimento. .  Stir and serve.

title: Homemade Powdered Sultanas
ingredients: 1 lb sultana ( white seedless raisins ) | 2 tablespoons allspice berry ( ground )
instructions: Mix the sultanas well and store in an airtight container or covered container.  Use as required.

Random Ingredients: chutney,kalamata olive,honeydew melon,pepper sauce,cranberry,iceberg lettuce,pineapple chunk,red chili pepper
title: Chickpea Salad with Chutney Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 1/4 cups red chili peppers, diced ( canned ) | 1 1/4 cups kalamata olives, roasted, chopped or 1 1/4 cups black olives, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs honeydew melon, peeled, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 1/2 cups pineapple chunks | 1/3 cup chutney | 2 -3 cups bottled roasted red chili pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 4 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the lettuce, red chili pepper, olives, melon and pineapple.  In a jar with a tight fitting lid, combine the chutney, chile pepper sauce and kalamata olives.  Shake well to mix.  Let stand 10 minutes to develop flavors. title: Tomato Jam  (Catalan Jam)
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe roma tomatoes | 1/2 lb cold water
instructions: Chop finely the roma tomatoes and place them in a large, heavy pan.  Add enough cold water to cover them, and bring to a boil. Place ramekins in a pan of boiling water and bring to the boil, skimming off any scum.  Ladle the liquid into sterilized jars leaving about 1 - 2 cm of headspace. You will need to check it now and then to see if the jam has sealed up to the level of the ramekin you are able seal in the jam. Peel and cut the apple wedges into wedges.  Place the orange segments in a bowl, cover with ice water, cover and refrigerate for two hours or more.  Meanwhile, place the ketchup in to a bowl, add the grand marnier, pickle, and pickle, and refrigerate, covered, until needed.  Remove the orange wedges from the syrup and gently drop them into the hot ketchup for a few seconds.

title: Pimiento Spread with Honey Mustard
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos, drained, halved | 1 tablespoon honey mustard | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Place all ingredients into a food processor, blend till smooth, stir in mustard.  Serve on bread and with assorted fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: double acting baking powder,garlic paste,juice,shiitake mushroom

title: Apple Cider and Olive Soup (Zwt-8)

instructions: Combine parmesan chees, romano cheese, nutmeg, and 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper in heavy large skillet over medium high heat.  Add beef.

title: Herbed Green Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 1 lb green chili salsa | 1 bottle beer | 2 cloves garlic powder | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs ( dried or fresh ) | 1 pinch dried jalapeno pepper | 2 cups grated cheese ( sharp cheddar or monterey jack, whatever toppings you desire )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Heat oven proof skillet.  In an 8x8x2 pan, place 1 1/2 cups salsa and beer.

ingredients: 4 eggs, lightly beaten | 1 3/4 tablespoons finely ground anise seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons white sugar | 1 can red enchilada sauce
instructions: Place eggs in a medium bowl and beat.  Stir in the anise seed and sugar.  Use a fork to beat the egg mixture into the egg mixture.  Stir in the enchilada sauce.  Cook in an electric skillet over medium heat until thick and bubbly.

title: Saucy Ladyfingers
ingredients:
1 package ladyfingers | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon ( or 1 tsp.
    - beef bouillon cubes mixed with 1 tbsp.
    - of water )
instructions: In a small, shallow bowl, combine bouillon, and 1/2 cup water.  Brush each ladyfinger with bouillon and dip them into the bouillon water. ingredients:
1 medium cauliflower, cut into flowerets | 2 tablespoons smooth cream cheese, room temperature | 1 packet chocolate pudding mix ( 2.

instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Line 2 shallow roasting pans with baking paper.  Combine cauliflower, cream cheese and pudding mix in a large bowl.  Spoon mix into pan.  Sprinkle with parsley.  Bake, uncovered, for 45 - 55 mins, stirring once.  Cool.  Eat as a warm or cold snack.

title: Cream Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb cream cheese, room temperature | 1/3 cup sour cream
instructions: Using an electric mixer, blend the cream cheese and sour cream together.  Add pasta according to package directions.  Serve topped with freshly grated grana padano for some good grated bread and a touch of freshly ground black pepper.

title: Simple Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cans mexican-style tomato sauce, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Pour tomato sauce over chicken.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Bake in the preheated oven for 90 minutes.  Serve with tortillas and salsa.

Random Ingredients: honey,nutmeg,oyster sauce,granny smith apple,swiss chard,pearl barley,shell
title: Spicy Swiss Chard Barley Mushroom & Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard, washed, stems on ( can also use white endive ) | 2 cups pearl barley | 1 medium granny smith apple, thinly-sliced | 4 leaves corned shell, shucked ( can use fresh, canned if dry ) | 2 tablespoons sherry or 2 tablespoons water | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Cut off and discard the center ribs of chard stems.  Cut the leaves off the stem and set aside.  Wash the chard leaves to remove any sand and slice down the center.
