Pour barley mixture into a large bowl.  Stir in corned shell, sherry, oyster sauce and nutmeg.

Random Ingredients: garlic infused olive oil,sun tomato oil,brandy,rosemary
title: Brandy-Crusted Roasted Tomato
ingredients: 2/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/2 cup brandy or 1/2 cup vodka | 1/2 cup fresh rosemary | 3/4 cup light olive oil | 3 tablespoons garlic-infused olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f line 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 quart baking dish with foil.  Toss together the sun dried tomatoes, brandy, rosemary, 3/4 cup olive oil, garlic infused olive oil and remaining 3/4 cup olive oil.  Spread mixture on top, then bake for 15 minutes, then reduce oven temperature to 400°f bake for 20 minutes longer or until hot and lightly browned.  Cool completely.  Serve warm.

title: Sake Mushrooms
ingredients: 18 portobello mushroom caps, shiitake, stems discarded | 1/4 cup sake ( japanese sweet wine )
instructions: Clean the mushroom caps and rinse under running water.  Set aside.  Place the mushroom caps in a bowl with enough ice water to cover.  Set aside to soak for 20 minutes, then drain.  Pat the mushrooms dry with paper towels.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add the mushroom stems, and boil for 6 minutes.  Drain the mushrooms, and set aside.  Place the marinated mushrooms in a bowl, and add the sake.  Cover and refrigerate 2 hours, or overnight, turning the mushrooms occasionally to coat.  Preheat the broiler or oven.  Brush mushroom caps with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.  Place mushrooms on the prepared oven rack, and place under the broiler.  Roast 7 to 10 minutes until the mushrooms are lightly browned.

title: Grape and Parsnip Pintos
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip or 1 lb potato, peeled and sliced into 1/4 | 1 lb tarragon, leaves picked off | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 granny smith apple, sliced lengthwise into 3/8 inch thick wedges | 4 grape tomatoes, halved ( or about 2 pints or grape tomatoes, washed ) or 3 roma tomatoes, quartered ( or about 2 pints or grape tomatoes, washed ) | 2 jar pimiento slices, drained | fresh thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Line 4 large baking sheets with foil, or line with parchment paper.  For vegetables with stemings, wash and pat dry the parsnips, then remove the tough membrane.  Cut into 1 inch chunks and place in an ovenproof dish or dutch oven along with the parsnips, tarragon leaves, fresh tarragon and tarragon.  Top with the apple slices.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or till the mixture is heated through.  Turn the pintos over and bake until the apple slices are tender crisp, about about 20 minutes more.  Remove from the oven and stir well to loosen the pintos, then cover to keep warm.  Transfer to a platter if serving as an appetiser, or serve with some of the grape tomatoes alongside for a snack.  Garnish with sprigs of fresh thyme serve warm or at room temperature with crackers.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,sirloin,balsamic vinegar,palm oil,self raising flour

title: Korean Country Ribs

instructions: Stir the paprika with the ribs in a large skillet over medium high heat.  Cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 2 minutes.  Stir in the ribs and reduce heat to medium low.  Simmer covered for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Remove the ribs from the skillet, arrange on a serving platter, and skim excess fat from the surface.  Cover and chill overnight.

instructions: In a bowl, toss the beans with 3/4 of the ham, 1/4 of the pepperoncinis, tomatoes with the basil and garlic dressing.  Arrange in a small to medium serving bowl and top with more dressing, if desired.  Makes 6 servings.

title: Red Curry Rice Paper Rolls

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of sunflower oil in a wok over medium heat.  Add the curry paste and cook for about 1 minute.  Add the pumpkin seeds and ground flaxseed and stirfry for about 5 minutes. instructions: Place the potatoes and leek in a large saucepan and cover with 1 inch of water.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain and cool in cold water.  Meanwhile, prepare the filling.  Combine the maple syrup, lime juice and prosciutto cheese.  Set aside.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Coat the beef with cooking spray.  Add the beef and sauté until the beef is browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.  Remove from the heat and cover.  Allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.  Serve the burger mixture on large plates topped with the sour cream, a drizzle of maple syrup and a sprinkle of provolone cheese.

title: Shrimp Paste

instructions: Shell and devein prawns, leaving tails intact.  In medium pot, stir fry shrimp paste and anchovy paste in 1tb oil for 3 minutes until the shrimp turn pink.  Add the asafetida and remove from heat.  Cover and set aside to marinate for 1 hour or longer at room temperature.  Stir occassionally.  The shrimp paste will keep for 1 week in the fridge.  Stir a few times during the last hour or two.  Add sugar or tamarind to taste.  Let stand until the paste is dark.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook faucinet pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.  Drain and transfer to a large bowl.  Stir in 2 cups filling and 2 tablespoons flour.  Stir until thoroughly combined.  Fill a large bowl with ice water and shape faucinet mixture into 24 balls using fingers.  Roll balls in remaining flour to coat.  Arrange on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray.  Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Simple Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package directions, or to your liking.  Let cool, or eat cool and refrigerate until served.

instructions: Place dry rice and liquid in a small saucepan.  Bring to a boil.  Turn down heat and simmer covered for about 10 minute.  Add the drained, washed, and drained peaches.  In a small bowl, combine the liquid smoke, dashi, and peanut sauce.

title: Braised Beef Shank With Coleslaw (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 2 beef shanks | 4 ounces pickled napa cabbage | 6 cloves roasted red peppers ( found at asian grocery stores ) | 1 cup beef broth or 1 cup chicken broth | 3/4 cup bottled clam juice ( i used liquid from the cherry peppers ) | 1 tablespoon braggs liquid aminos ( optional, i didn't have any ) | 1 1/2 cups uncooked arborio rice or 1 1/2 cups arborio rice
instructions: Prick the meat with a toothpick so that it can be picked off the bone if desired.  Cook the beef shanks in a large pot of boiling water over high heat until slightly browned, 12 to 24 minutes.  Transfer to a slow cooker for a few minutes prior to slicing, if you want.  Remove meat from pot and rinse well to remove grit, if desired.  Set aside.  Using a medium mesh colander, transfer the colander to a large bowl and rinse the colander well.  Drain liquid from the jar of roasted red peppers in the microwave.  Stir the pepper juice and broth into the colander and return the colander to the pot.  Add the cabbage, roasted red peppers, bragg's liquid aminos, rice and any accumulated juices from the meat.  Cover and cook on low for 1 - 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or on high for 3 1/2 hours.  Uncover and cook 30 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.  Discard broth.  Serve immediately.  Note, if using the cherry pepper pickled red peppers, stir in 1/2 cup of broth and heat until warmed through. .

instructions: Cut off stems and slice asparagus spears into 1 - 2 wide pieces.  Place each piece on a clean work surface or waxed paper and stretch and roll jellyroll style, starting with the stem end and working down to the tip.  Repeat rolling until all the pieces have been shaped.  In a large bowl, toss the asparagus with the cheese.  Serve.

title: Saffron Nuts
ingredients: 3 tablespoons good quality natural-style peanut butter | 1 1 cup unsweetened brewed coffee | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | crushed ice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in coffee shaker.  Shake vigorously for 2 minutes.  Strain into tall glass and serve.

title: Agua (Portuguese Hot Soup)

instructions: In a small saucepan bring the beef stock to a boil.  Turn down to a simmer heat and stir in the hot coffee powder.  The soup should have a velvety consistency.  Sprinkle additional agua on top while continuing to stir.  Serve immediately.

instructions: Peel the potatoes, if they are too big or if they are small enough to slice in a single layer, slice them in half lengthwise.  Cut each half into 3 or 4 slabs.  Cut the chiles into 1/8 slices and set aside.  Place the jalapeños, the chipotle chile, and the red chili peppers in a mortar or food processor with the minced chiles.  Pound the chile into slabs, pressing it into each slit with the back of a tablespoon pressing the chile into the potato.  Stack the potato slabs lengthwise on a cutting board or a rack and slice them crosswise into about half rounds and place them in a deep casserole dish or other deep non reactive container.  Cover and let stand in a warm place until serving.

title: Ahi Poke with Pepperjack and Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 lb liver, chopped ( about 1 large ) | 1 lb shrimp, chopped into large chunks ( about 1-1/4 pounds ) | 11 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | wasabi | oil, for frying | toothpick | maraschino cherry, leaves chopped ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarse grain mustard
instructions: Place the liver and shrimp in a large bowl.  Toss with 1 1/2 ounces each of the cheese and wasabi until thoroughly incorporated.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.  Heat the oil in a large nonstick frying pan over medium high heat.  Working in batches, add the shrimp and pound the shrimp until they're tiny and a bit crispy, about 1 minute per side.  Using a slotted spoon or slotted spoon, transfer the shrimp and cheese cubes to the cutting board.  Season with salt.  Drain off any excess oil.  Working with 1 shrimp at a time, transfer the crabmeat mixture to a large, flat, round plate.  Using your fingers, gently press a piece of shrimp into the shell and continue press the shrimp into the cheese until they are completely coated with the mixture.  Using a large, deep frying pan, heat the remaining oil to 375°f.  Working with 1 crab or shrimp at a time, roll out the crabmeat mixture until completely coated.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer any crabmeat mixture that remains inside the shrimp.  Working in batches, add the shrimp and crabmeat mixture into the pan.  Cook, stirring constantly, for a minute or two, until the shrimp are no longer bright in color and the crabmeat is cooked through.  Transfer the toasted wasabi to paper towels, sprinkle to taste with salt and set aside.  Repeat until all of the crabmeat has been used.  Serve the ahi asad with wasabi and cherries in dipping bowls.  Variation, this dip also works well with green beans and potatoes.

title: Spinach and Pepperoni Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely sliced pepperoni | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup broth | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 package frozen sliced spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly
instructions: In large nonstick skillet, place pepperoni and broth.  Cover and cook over high heat until hot, stirring occasionally.  Stir in fish sauce and cornstarch until cornstarch is dissolved.  Add spinach and cook, stirring occasionally, 1 - 2 minutes or until spinach is crisp tender.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,vegetable,boursin cheese,baking potato,peanut oil,sun tomato oil
title: Potato Cheese Balls With Peanuts

instructions: Wash and cut the unpeeled and chopped potatoes into ¾ inch cubes.  Put the nuts in a bowl and mix well with the dry ingredients.  Heat the oil or oil and fry the potato cubes in batches until golden brown outside but still firm inside.  Remove and drain on paper towels.  Spread each piece with ¾ cup of cheese and roll up placing the cheese balls on a piece of foil.  Place on a cookie sheet and bake at 350°f until golden brown on top.

title: Bruschetta with Sage (Or Dipping Sauce for Veggies)
ingredients: 3/4 cup pizza sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh sage, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon marjoram, dried
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a small bowl.  Serve with your healthy green vegetables.

title: Crab Racks

instructions: Mix up the first five ingredients with a sharp knife or a pastry blender until they are well mixed.  If you like a bit of bite, add a bit more vinegar. Heat about 1/4 cup of olive oil on a non stick pan or frying pan to a depth of about 1 inch and just a few slices of crab will be sticking together.  Put the crab mix in the oil and fry or bake for about seven or eight minutes on either side.  It should be crispy, not hard and crusty.  Serve at once.

ingredients: 2 tablespoons white wine | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 3 tablespoons horseradish | 1 tablespoon italian dressing | 2 tablespoons strawberry preserves | 1 can pinto beans | 1 cup fresh strawberries, sliced | 2 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Combine the wine, lemon juice, horseradish, and italian dressing in a small bowl.

title: Lime Crisp Method

Pinch off walnut sized pieces and roll them into balls about the size of a golfball.  Flatten them with the bottom of a glass or rolling pin.  Place the rolled balls on a parchment lined baking sheet.  Gently press a lime wedge into each ball and bake at 375' for 15 to 20 minutes until crisp and golden.

title: Mom's Creamy Dressing

instructions: In a bowl, mix the cream of chicken soup, lemon juice, and grated lemon peel.  Stir in the beaten eggs.  Add vinegar, mix well.  Cover, and refrigerate.

title: The Best Beef Burgundy Ever

instructions: Brown beef and add in all ingredients except stuffing mix.  Simmer in covered dish for at least 30 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad With Clams

ingredients: 1 pound broccoli rabe, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 sprig fresh thyme | 3 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 3 tablespoons dry red wine | 1 pound scallops | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 cup irish cream
instructions: Cover broccoli rabe with water in a saucepan, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes.  Drain, and set aside to steam off the heat.  Combine the minced garlic, thyme, and paprika in a bowl, and mix together.  Reserve 1 tablespoon sweet paprika for topping.  Slice the scallops into 1/2 inch thick slices, and set aside.  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Lay the phyllo pastry sheets in front of you with one at a time, so the sheets cover the bottom and the sides of the baking dish, respectively.  Cut the remaining phyllo pastry sheets into three squares.  Place 1/3 of the pastry triangles in the center of the phyllo sheets, brush with olive oil, and top with 1/3 of the sausage and broccoli rabe mixture.  Place 1/3 of the sauteed broccoli rabe on top.  Cover with 1/3 of the scallops.  Sprinkle the reserved sprig of paprika over the sauteed broccoli rabe, and place another 1/3 of the sausage and broccoli rabe on top.  Place the last 3 ingredients under the sage and bacon.  Top with remaining pastry triangles and sausage.  Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until pastry is golden brown and crispy.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,channa dal,garlic clove,rigatoni pasta,ra el hanout spice mix,hot red chili pepper,ghee,adobo sauce
title: Panch Phoron (Rigatoni With Lentils)
ingredients: 8 ounces channa dal ( lentils ) | 9 hot red chili peppers, stems removed | 2 garlic cloves | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix ( see note below ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 3 tablespoons ghee or 3 tablespoons butter | 1/4 cup adobo sauce, from jar ( see note below )
instructions: Cook the chana dhal in boiling water with the hot red chilies, garlic, cumin seeds and ras el hanout until lentils are soft, about 10 - 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a skillet warm ghee or butter or oil, and cook the adobo on high heat for 20 seconds.  Pour half a cup of the cooked chana dhal into skillet.  Cook for 2 minutes on medium high heat until dhal is a rich, golden brown color, and smells richly toasted.  Be careful not to burn add chana dhal to skillet along with 3/4 c.  Water.  Cover, reduce heat to medium low.  Cook for an additional 10 - 15 minutes, or until the lentils and chana dhal are soft.

title: Maggie's Smoori
ingredients: 200 g buffalo mozzarella | 300 g green cardamom pods ( or 2-3-4 pods fresh crushed, to taste ) | 1/4 cup sweet sherry
instructions: Place mozzarella slices on baking tray and bake in a moderate oven till cheese is bubbling.  Remove cheese from oven, sprinkle with cardamom pods, and set aside to cool, then cut into quarters.  Place sherry in a small saucepan, add a little water and bring to a slow boil then pour over cheese and serve immediately.

title: Pesto Ricotta Margaritas
ingredients: 3/4 cup tequila | 1 package frozen ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1/4 cup pignoli nuts
instructions: Prepare the margarita glass according to package instructions.  Dip each ramekin into a bowl of ice water before dipping into the margarita.  Place ramekins on plates and cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: baby lima bean,kiwi fruit,star anise,cocoa,red potato,fennel seed,red wine vinegar
title: Caramelized Kiwi Potato and Lima Beans
ingredients: 1 lb small red potato, scrubbed | 14 ounces baby lima beans | 3 star anise | 10 black fennel seeds, crushed | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 10 tablespoons cocoa | 4 kiwi fruits, sliced
instructions: Toss potatoes with 2 tablespoons sugar, the orange spices and 2 tablespoons of water in a nonstick frying pan.  Cook, uncovered, over medium low heat or until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.  Transfer to a large bowl.  In a second frying pan, toast the fennel seeds over medium heat or in a griddle pan for 1 minute.  Transfer to a plate and crush.  Stir fennel seed mixture into potato mixture and add 1 teaspoon of water.  Bring to a boil and reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for about 1 hour or until potato mixture thickens and sauce thickens slightly.  Add remaining cold water if mixture is too thick.  Remove from heat and cover.  Let stand about 10 minutes before serving to allow flavors to mingle.  To serve, slice kiwifruit and arrange on top of potato mixture.

title: Chinese Pickles
ingredients: 8 slices sweet hungarian paprika | 1 -2 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1 -2 dill pickle, cut into thin rings
instructions: Tightly wrap the paprika rings around each hot pickle and place on the grill.  Keep turning the slices until they have a nice, crisp crust.  Remove from grill and wrap hot rings in foil, place on serving platter and drizzle generously with a little sweet and sour pickle sauce.  Serve hot.

title: Kurdish Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cups soymilk | 2 tablespoons rum | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 pinch saffron or 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: In a large bowl pour the soya milk, rum and asafoetida powder.  Mixture is ready when the milk is about half way full.  Drop the tablespoonful of mixture onto hot griddle pan.  Fry until brown and then flip.  Repeat for two more batches.  Serve with yogurt or fresh fruit.

title: Smoked Salmon Tacos
ingredients:
1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1/2 cup chopped fresh marjoram | 1 tablespoon orange zest, finely grated | 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 4 chicken tenderloins, about 1 lb.
    - each, trimmed | 1/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients.  Sprinkle evenly over chicken.  Place chicken on foil lined baking sheet.

title: Wasabi Glaze (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 8 ounces white mushrooms | 4 tablespoons lard | 4 ounces vegetable broth | 2 packets wasabi paste ( see note # 1 ) | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: Prepare a non stick sauté pan and heat the lard.  Then add the vegetable broth and mushrooms.  Boil gently for 5 minutes or until the mixture thickens slightly.  Stir in the wasabi paste.  Cook until it is thickened.  Blend together the glaze mix with the wasabi and set aside in a covered container.  Notes, white mushrooms may be substitued, such as crimini.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,mustard powder,lemonade concentrate,seasoning salt,vegetable broth,onion seed
title: Vegan Chicken and Dumplings (Skillet)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon onion seeds | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1 dash seasoning salt | lemonade concentrate
instructions: Combine ingredients, except lemonade, and stir to coat in lemonade concentrate.  Cook in 3 quart pot or dutch oven over medium heat, stirring frequently, until slightly thickened.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,chili bean,jalapeno,stewing beef,golden raisin,kosher salt,champagne vinegar,ladyfinger
title: Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, trimmed | 3 lbs fresh brussels sprouts or 3 lbs frozen brussels sprouts | 2 tablespoons chopped pickled jalapenos | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/4 cup champagne vinegar | 1/4 cup dark aged beer | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup dried salted anchovies or 1/4 cup sliced scallions, toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f.  Cut the beef into 1/2 inch thick strips, about 3 inches long each.  Place in a 6 quart roasting pan or baking dish.  Using a slotted spoon, remove any browned bits on the inside of the meat.  Add the pickled jalapeños, salt, and vinegar to a blender.

title: Rigatoni With Swiss Cheese Strawberries
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 250 g swiss cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 150 150 ml plain yogurt or 150 ml sour cream | 12 medium strawberries, washed and hulled
instructions: Cook rigatoni to your liking but be sure the pasta is al dente not too soft.  Meanwhile mix the soya sauce and yoghurt together well for the dressing.  Drain the rigatoni well, then toss with the cheese, strawberry and dressing.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,meat,cream cheese,spinach leaf,green cardamom pod,raspberry jam,almond extract,allspice
title: Smørrebrod - Norwegian Meat Balls
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread, crusts removed | 1 package cream cheese, cut into cubes | 1/3 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and drained | 1 can raspberry jam | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 1 pound ground meat | 1 cup crushed thawed frozen raspberries and sliced almonds, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place one slice of rind removed from top of a rye bread slice.  Set aside.  Crumble the bread slices into a bowl.  Place the cream cheese cubes in a mixing bowl.  Mix in the spinach and raspberries.  Stir in the jam, almond extract, allspice, and cardamom.  Mix thoroughly.  Add the meat.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,soup stock,horseradish,mace,onion powder,spinach leaf,barbecue sauce,oyster sauce
title: BBQ Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1/3 cup barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon tomoto paste | 1 ounce mushroom soup stock | 10 spinach leaves | 1/2 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon dried horseradish
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and store in an airtight container, until ready to serve.

title: Danish Green Olives
ingredients: 1 lb whole green olive | 3/4 cup salt-reduced black pepper or 3/4 cup kosher salt, plus more for seasoning | 1 medium yellow sweet dill pickle, finely chopped | 1/2 orange peel, finely chopped | 1/2 cup tequila or 1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Rinse, pat dry and place in a glass jar with one third full of water.  Cover and shake vigorously until the water begins to cloudy.  When the water is cloudy, immediately remove from the jar.  Let stand to cool, about 1 hour.  In a medium bowl, combine the olives, pepper, onion and orange peel.  Add 1/2 cup of water and 2/3 cup salt and stir lightly until the salt dissolves.  Place the jar with the olives on the counter, in the refrigerator, and shake vigorously.  Add 1/2 cup tequila or sweetened condensed milk and stir.  Serve at once.

title: Cheddar, Cherry and Marshmallow Salad
ingredients: 2 cans cheddar cheese soup | 2 cups miniature marshmallows | 1 can cherry tomatoes
instructions: Mix all together, chill till ready to serve.

title: Chinese Noodle and Sprinkles With Asparagus
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups diced asparagus | 4 cups thinly sliced mixed greens ( arugula, zucchini ) | 1 can corn, drained and rinsed | 8 ounces chinese noodles, soaked | 1 cup half and half light cream | 3/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 package crumbled tortillas | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the asparagus, mixed greens, corn, and noodles.

Random Ingredients: matzo meal,gruyere cheese,pepperoni,taco seasoning mix seasoning,mango chutney,tea
title: Taco Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 2 cups matzo meal | 1 package taco seasoning mix with mushrooms and chutney | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup hot mango chutney | 12 slices pepperoni, sliced
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  In a medium bowl, mix together the matzo meal and taco seasoning mix until moistened.  Spread 1/3 1/2 cup of the cheese mixture over the bottom of the prepared pan.  Layer with 1/3 cup of the chutney, 1/2 cup of the hot chutney, pepperoni slices, and 1/2 cup of the rice.  Continue layering the ingredients, ending with sauce and cheese.  Cover and bake in a 425 degree f oven until the rice is tender and the cheese has melted and begun to brown, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,italian sausage,mint,iceberg lettuce,sesame seed,phyllo dough,walnut half,vanilla extract
title: Sausage Rolls (Pockets)
ingredients: 6 italian sausage, casings removed | 32 sheets phyllo dough | 3 cups iceberg lettuce, coarsely chopped | 1 cup walnut halves, coarsely chopped | 2/3 cup sesame seeds | 1/2 - 3/4 cup of fresh mint, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup iceberg lettuce, coarsely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon sesame seeds
instructions: In a skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until browned and crumb stage is gone, stirring regularly.  Drain well on paper towels.  Wash and dry lettuce.  Set aside.  Place a sheet of phyllo dough on your work surface, brush with a little oil or a little more than half the oil in a wide, shallow bowl or bowl that you have parchment paper on hand.  Using lightly floured hands, roll each piece of dough to a thin 5 inch circle about 1/8 inch thick.  Keep unused dough covered with a damp cloth.  Transfer dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with a little more oil.  Cover with a damp cloth and lightly brushed with oil.  Repeat with 5 additional phyllo dough rounds.  Spread 1 cup of the walnuts over dough.  Scatter 2/3 cup of sesame seeds over walnuts.  Top with remaining phyllo dough rounds and spread evenly, leaving 3/4 inch between each other.  Use two toothpicks to hold tops firmly in place using your fingers.  Brush tops with a little more oil if necessary.  Bake at 375° about 10 or 11 minutes or just until golden brown.  Remove and allow to cool.  Cut out as many slices as desired with a large serrated knife.  Arrange each turnover in a warm serving dish.  Garnish with fresh mint, fresh mint leaves, and a drizzle of more olive oil.  Serve immediately with iceburg lettuce rolls.

title: Sweet Potato and Ham Salad With Currants
ingredients: 3 lbs sweet potatoes or 3 lbs yams | 2 ounces ham, diced | 1/2 cup sweet red pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1/2 lime, juice of | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup seedless plum, chopped ( or canned fruit ) | 1/3 cup dried currant
instructions: Peel potatoes, cut into 4 chunks boil in water 20 minutes or until tender.  Drain, rinse and cool, cut into 1/4 inch slices, arrange on a shallow plate.  Place ham, red pepper, sweet potato, mayonnaise, lime juice, cumin, and 1/4 cup currants in a bowl toss, add remaining currants serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,vanilla ice cream,white sugar,chicken,fish sauce,vanilla sugar,vegetarian worcestershire sauce,white flour
title: Vietnamese Meatballs (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon vegetarian worcestershire sauce | 1 bay leaf in the palm | 1 pound ground chicken | 4 cups vanilla ice cream | 1 cup white flour
instructions: Whisk the sugar, fish sauce, vanilla sugar, worcestershire sauce and bay leaf together in a large glass or ceramic bowl.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,yellow bell pepper,spanish onion,cream tartar,caper
title: Grizz's Tapas Onion and Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, peeled and quartered | 1/3 cup red capers | 1 -2 tablespoon drained capers or 1 -2 tablespoon fresh parsley | 2 small yellow bell peppers, sliced in 1/4-inch slices | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Chop the onion and place in a food processor with all the other ingredients.  Pulse until smooth.  Transfer to a serving bowl and serve at once.

title: Persian Watermelon and Cauliflower
ingredients: 3 cups diced watermelon, seeded and chopped | 1 cauliflower floret, peeled and sliced | 1/2 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Place the watermelon in a large pot with cauliflower, and enough water to cover.  Place over high heat.  Stir in tahini.  When it begins to toast, remove from heat, and place in a bowl covered with plastic wrap to keep warm until serving.

title: Chicken Drumsticks in Gravy
ingredients: 12 chicken drumsticks | flour, for coating
instructions: Pat chicken dry and dust with flour.  Place in a baking dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray.  Bake at 425 degrees fahrenheit for 20 - 30 minutes, or until the chicken is no longer pink inside.  Allow to cool.  Cut into bite size pieces as desired.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,rhubarb,salmon steak,ginger garlic paste,monterey jack cheese,parsley
title: Gramflione
ingredients:
4 salmon steaks | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, if desired | 2 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese, if desired | 8 slices fresh rhubarb, cut into 1 1/2 inch thick pieces or 2 ounces frozen rhubarb, cut into 1 1.
    - 1 inch chunks
instructions: Trim and rinse salmon under cold water until all of the pink is gone.  Place salmon between 2 sheets of wax paper.  Use a meat mallet to pound the salmon and then pound it out into even, even thin slices using the mallet.  Place fish in a nonstick skillet, and add remaining ingredients over medium high heat.  Cook, stirring to loosen and brown the salmon.  Turn the fish and continue to cook, stirring often, until the fish is just cooked through.  Turn the salmon over and continue cooking until all of the juices run clear.  Transfer to a serving platter, and top with fresh slices of rhubarb.

title: Saudi  Salad
ingredients: 8 celery ribs | 8 saffron
instructions: Wash and dry celery.  Put the celery into a deep, glassed dish with some holes in it.  Sprinkle over saffron.  Wrap the saffron around and around the celery.  Place on the table, garnished with chives or parsley.  You can also cover the salad with tinfoil for some decorative look.  Letting sit for 1 hour will also help.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,garlic clove,red chile pepper,vegetable juice,tea,flat leaf parsley
title: The Perfect Blender Russian Tea
ingredients: 10 tablespoons apple juice | 10 garlic cloves, peeled | 5 tablespoons vegetable juice | 4 ounces tea | 1 small red chile pepper | 1/2 bunch fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Put the apple juice, garlic, and vegetable juice into a blender, and blend on low until completely incorporated.  Pour the frozen tea into a pitcher, and stir in the chile pepper and parsley.  Refrigerate 1 - 2 hours, or until the drink is cold.

title: Jamaican Eggnog Drink
ingredients: 1 quart eggnog | 1 can red kidney beans
instructions: Fill a tall glass with ice.  Pour in eggnog.  Place the beans in the jug of eggnog.  Gently stir with a spoon to break them up into a bit.

title: Chicken Soup in a Cup
ingredients: 1/3 lb penne, dried weight | 4 cups chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon dill
instructions: Bring the chicken bouillon to a boil.  Add the dill and boil for 5 minutes.  Add the penne and simmer for 5 minutes, or until al dente.  Eat.

title: Mexican Cabbage  Salad(Ensalada De Natal)
ingredients: 1/4 lb queso fresco | 12 small cherry tomatoes | 1/2 head cabbage ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 dried ancho chiles | 1 tablespoon dried savory | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon ancho chile ( dried ancho chile flakes )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the anchoishe with the dried ancho.  Cut the cabbage into long crosswise slices.

Random Ingredients: pepperjack cheese,caraway seed,amarula cream liqueur,wine,strawberry jam
title: Frozen Melon With Chai (Ribbons)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/2 cup strawberry jam | 8 ounces pepperjack cheese, diced | 1/4 cup wine | 1/4 cup amarula cream liqueur or 1/4 cup other aromatic liqueur, such as kahlua ( or other complimentary liquor )
instructions: For the berry sauce, combine jam, cheese, wine and liqueur in a small bowl.  Cover and chill for up to 8 hours.  Serve chilled.

title: Hurry up
ingredients: 1 lb stewing lamb | 1 can pineapple tidbits
instructions: Place the lamb in the pot for 10 minutes.  Add the cans of pineapple tidbits and stir.  Cover and cook on low heat for about 2 hours or until meat is tender and falling off the bone.

Random Ingredients: trout,honey,green curry paste,chicken breast,grain white rice,pillsbury crescent dinner,plum tomato
title: Baked Thai Chicken With Crescent Rolls
ingredients: 2 teaspoons green curry paste | 1 whole boneless skinless chicken breast | 1 1/2 cups uncooked long-grain white rice ( or jasmine ) | 1/3 cup thai birds nest honey ( we used honey nut thai honey for the recipe ) | 1 can pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 1 cup plum tomatoes, diced | 1 1/2 cups cooked thai bird nest thai red pepper, drained, julienned
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  In a large nonstick skillet, stir curry paste over medium high heat for one minute or until fragrant.  Add chicken and cook until lightly browned on the outside but still firm on the inside, about 5 minutes.  Transfer chicken to a large bowl, add rice/jasmine sauce, honey, and 1 teaspoon water.  Trotate chicken over rice mixture and set aside for about 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, line baking sheets with plastic wrap.  Separate crescent rolls and arrange them in a circle in front of you in a circular fashion and overlapping slightly.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,vegetable,peanut butter,mint,raisin,red curry paste
title: Curried Chicken
ingredients: 4 large skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( or curry powder ) | 1 bunch fresh vegetables, chopped, such as broccoli, carrots and cauliflower, to serve
instructions: In a large resealable bag, combine peanut butter, raisins, curry paste, and chicken.  Seal and marinate in refrigerator, turning occasionally, for at least 30 minutes or overnight.  Preheat oven to remove chicken and vegetables from bag.  Place chicken and vegetables in 2 large ovenproof dish or baking dishes.  Pour curry liquid over chicken pieces and bake for about 40 minutes, or until chicken is cooked and tender.  Serve with steamed jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,egg wrap,gravy,lime wedge,ginger garlic paste,rump steak,pizza dough,bicarbonate soda
title: Rump & Lime Rolls (Pissaladiere)
ingredients: 500 g rump steak, thinly sliced | 1 egg roll wrap | 1 dash ground ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons gravy, from the can | 2 tablespoons gravy, from the jar | 2 slices limes, juice of | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Heat oven to 220c.  Grease a large baking tray for the rolls.  Put the meat in the tray.  Add the ginger garlic paste, gravy, lime juice and bicarb of soda to the pan juices, stir.  Put the meat on top of the meat.  Cook for 30 minutes.  Take out of the oven.  Allow to cool.  Lay the roll out on your rolling pin.  Slightly moisten the top with water and set aside.  Roll the meat out a little on the rolling pin.  Use the top of a sharp knife to pinch the edges to seal.  Place the roll onto a greased baking tray.  Brush the top with beaten egg.  Bake at 220c for about 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,vidalia onion,mint leaf,pizza crust,tea,ricotta cheese,cream cheese
title: Individual Russian Tea Pizza
ingredients: 12 ounces plain low-fat cream cheese | 1/2 vidalia onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup light ricotta cheese | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 3/4 cup strong brewed tea | 14 ounces pizza crust | 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: In a bowl, mix the cream cheese, onion, ricotta cheese, and cayenne.  Spread the cheese mixture in the pizza crust.  Bake at 375 degrees in a 400 degree oven for 8 - 10 minutes, until the cheese is bubbly.  Top with the chopped mint and serve.

title: Quick Ricotta Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 bottle tomato juice | 3 cups ricotta cheese | 8 ounces dry pasta shells
instructions: In saucepan, combine ricotta cheese and saucepan of tomato juice, breaking up any clumps.  Bring to boil, stirring frequently.  Add pasta and boil until al dente.  Drain.  Serve over cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,lime wedge,chili sauce,cardamom seed,chicken stock
title: Spicy Asian Crabs
ingredients: 1 kg light rye flour or 1 kg wheat flour, for coating | 1 liter chicken stock, or ( 10 ounce ) liter vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon chili sauce ( i would probably use sriracha ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Using a food processor or machine pulse the flour to form a coarse mixture.  You should have fine grains.  Stir the stock through the flour liquid and set aside.  To further proof the gluten in the flour add an extra 1/2 cup water or extra stock as desired.  Heat your griddle or frying pan up to high until smoking.  Spoon the flour into a wide, shallow dish, preferably non stick.  Dredge the griddle in the flour and fry the strips in batches, until golden brown.  Transfer to a warm serving platter.  Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,grain white rice,cayenne,sea bass fillet
title: Bun Yuka (Baked Sea Bass With Rice)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice, chilled | 1 package long-grain white rice | sea bass fillets | 1 pinch sea salt | 1 pinch ground cayenne, or to taste | 16 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 10 minutes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.  Scoop chilled rice into a bowl, and stir to combine.  Arrange the sea bass fillets on top.  Season each with sea salt and cayenne, and roll in the rice, coating evenly.  Place 1 piece of sea bass on top of the sea bass.  Pour the remaining rice onto a plate, and set aside.  Place bamboo skewers on a rack in a roasting pan.  Place the baking sheets in the oven.  Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown and the flakey rice is melted.

title: Green Beans With Vanilla Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, washed and trimmed | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 scoops vanilla ice cream
instructions: Place beans in a saucepan and stir in sherry or dry sherry to coat peas.  Cook, covered, over medium heat for 3 minutes, or until tender.  Remove from heat, cover and transfer to a bowl.  Let cool 5 minutes or so, stirring occasionally.  Serve over ice cream.  Note, i made a large, quick and easy version of this and served it with the bananas on top instead of the vanilla beans.

Random Ingredients: cold water,white breadcrumb,canadian bacon,chili oil,active yeast,dark beer
title: Pain Perdu II
ingredients: 1 lb canadian bacon, smoked | 1 cup dark beer | 1 1/8 cups cold water | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup dry white breadcrumbs | 6 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: In a small non aluminum bowl, combine beer, water and yeast.

title: Stove Hot Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mushrooms, chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup ( heinz ) | nonstick cooking spray | fat free sour cream or sour cream mixture, for garnishing
instructions: Spray a pan with cooking spray, then add mushrooms and worcestershire sauce, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.  Remove from heat, stir in sour cream, and drizzle over some extra sauce, if desired.  You can also add any mushrooms for a variation.

title: French Dressing (The Anti-vinaigrette)
ingredients: 500 ml prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon mustard powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar, shake.  Shake with newman's dressing, if required, for more pronounced flavor.

title: Lemongrass Roasted Red Pepper Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh lemongrass ( or frozen ) | 1 large red bell pepper, roasted peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 can ortega roasted red bell peppers, chopped | 2 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios | 2 tablespoons salsa | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: Preparing the roasted red pepper soup, remove the stem and leaves from the lemongrass, place on cutting board, and cut into thin slices.  Reserve for later use.  Add the red bell pepper, roasted zest, minced lemongrass or frozen lemongrass leaves, chicken stock, ricotta cheese, chopped pistachios, salsa, and pepper to soup pot.  Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer uncovered over low heat until soup is hot, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Ladle into small soup bowls and serve with fresh pita bread, slices of lemon bread, fresh salsa, or toasted sliced pita.

title: Lamb Leg Steak II
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh mustard greens, washed, trimmed, and chopped | 1 pound cubed lamb leg steak | 1 pound steak pieces
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil grate.  Mix mustard greens, lamb leg cheese, and steak pieces together in a bowl.

title: Vegetable Loaf
ingredients: 2 loaves italian bread, halved | 1 cup lima beans or 1 cup other beans, cooked | 1 medium rutabagas, peeled and diced | 12 button mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 tablespoon paprika or 1 tablespoon smoked paprika | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise
instructions: Preheat oven to lightly grease a loaf tin, or line with aluminium foil.  Place the loaves of bread cut side up on the foil.  Spoon the beans around the bread crumbs.  Dice the remaining ingredients & spread a little over the top of the bread.  Dot with mayonnaise if desired.  Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Coconut carrots
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg baby carrots, peeled, ends trimmed | 1 teaspoon orange rind, finely grated | 1 teaspoon light coconut oil
instructions: Using an apple corer or specialised sharp knife, carefully remove the base of the carrots from their crown to leave a stem of 'eye' and cut into 1 cm lengths.  Using the peeler, cut the carrot's corer into 3 cm wide strips, then crosswise into thick chunks.  Place them in a bowl with the orange rind, and toss well.  Using a fork, gently separate the pieces of carrot and orange rind into the carrot mixture.  Heat a wok over a medium heat until hot.  Test with a slotted spoon for oil, and when almost smoking, scatter in about 2 tablespoons water.  Add two cups of water and bring to a boil.  Add the carrots and toss them until they soften slightly.  Stir in the orange rind mixture, increase the heat and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Reduce the heat to low and simmer, partially covered, for about 50 – 60 minutes, stirring frequently.  Taste for seasoning.  Serve hot.

ingredients: 4 boneless sirloin tip roast | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile | 2 slices cheddar cheese | 4 thin-cut boneless pork loin chops
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a small bowl, combine paprika and onion powder.  Sprinkle paprika mixture over both sides of roast.  Place roast on a greased rack in a roasting pan.  Smear with paprika mixture.  Sprinkle chiles over top.  Cover and bake for 1 hour.  Preheat broiler.  Place chops on a broiler pan.  Broil, 4 inches from heat, 3 minutes per side for medium rare.  Transfer to a cutting board.  Let stand, covered, for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 oranges, peel of 1 finely grated orange | 1 bunch parsley sprig
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°f toss the meat with the orange peel and parsley to coat the cubes very well.  Arrange all of the meat on a baking tray, and bake the meat for 2 hours.  Take the meat out of the oven, and leave for 2 hours, basting with the juices from the pan.

title: Lebanese Hummus
ingredients: 19 ounces chickpeas, drained and rinsed ( 2 cans ) | 3 tablespoons italian dressing | 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( from 2 lemons )
instructions: Place all ingredients except for the lemon juice into the bowl of a food processor.  Add lemon juice, and process until smooth.  Pour into an airtight container, and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours to blend flavors.  Enjoy and make sure to use the lemon juice as a sweetener for a sauce, so that you don't get any acidity from the lemon juice.

title: Pasta Farfalle - Pasties
ingredients: 150 g farfalle pasta | 1 -2 slice cake | chopped clove ( optional ) | plain flour ( optional ) or gluten-free bread crumb ( optional )
instructions: To shape the pasta mixture, make a cross over the base and sides of a large rectangular serving dish with a circle of pastry about 5'' in diameter.  Bake in a preheated 160° c oven for about 20 minutes until the pastry is lightly browned and the edges are flaky.  While the farfalle are cooking, preheat your oven to 200°c place the cake slice on the farfalle and top with any optional toppings.  Pour in enough boiling water to just cover the farfalle.  Add a little water and if necessary, a little flour to prevent the farfalle from sticking or burning.  Place the farfalle on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for about 25 minutes, or until puffed up.  Cut into wedges and serve hot with a little crusty bread.  Note, i like to make the farfalle with plain flour, which will make it firm, easy to roll out, and tasty enough to roll out.  For more flavour, roll the farfalle into a balls and bake them on a preheated baking sheet until golden brown.

title: Baked Mangoes (Tortas Y Queso)
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground lamb | 2 hard cooked eggs, chopped | 1/4 cup dried bread crumbs | 1/4 cup dried bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1 pinch old bay seasoning | 1/4 cup brewed espresso | 1 large hass avocado - halved, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Tear off one 12x10 inch piece of aluminum foil large enough to enclose one half of the tortillas.  Heat the aluminum foil wrapped tortillas in the preheated oven until warmed.  While tortillas are heating up combine lamb, eggs, bread crumbs, dried crumbs, mint, and old bay seasoning in a mixing bowl.  Shape lamb mixture into 6 to 8 meatballs.  Place meatballs on prepared foil.  Bake in the preheated oven until meatballs are cooked through, about 20 minutes, flipping every 1/2 to 3/4 minutes.  Warm the espresso in a small saucepan over medium heat.  When meatballs are done, place them on a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until cooked through, about 15 minutes.  Cut slices of avocado into 1/4 inch slices and arrange on top of the tortillas with a sprinkling of melted chocolate for garnish.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,italian sausage,watermelon,heavy whipping cream,green chili,pineapple chunk,garlic salt,black coffee
title: Pina Colada Salada- Sausage With Watermelon, Italian Sausage and Coffee
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 1/2 cup pineapple chunk | watermelon, halved, pitted, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1/2 cup black coffee, freshly brewed | 6 green cardamom pods, split at points | 6 whole green chili | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Pound the sausage until it is about 1/4 thick, remove the casings.  In a large pot, over medium heat, cook the the sausage until heated through, breaking up the meat with a wooden spoon.  Drain off any excess fat.  Stir in the pineapple, watermelon chunks, black coffee, cardamom pods, chili, and garlic salt.  Cook until the flavors are blended, about 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer, and simmer until the flavors are slightly reduced and the watermelon is very tender, about 15 minutes.  Stir in the cream and simmer until the sauce has thickened slightly, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,pork shoulder roast,bamboo shoot,wild rice,black fig,rice wine

instructions: Place the pork roast in a shallow roasting pan.  Combine wild rice, figs, and bamboo shoots in a 2 quart saucepan.

title: Easy Onion & Garlic Strudel

instructions: Pre heat oven to 400of / 180c if using a fan forced oven and set aside.  Add minced onions and minced garlic to a skillet and sauté until soft. Place into your pan and brush the top with beaten egg.  Place in the pre heated oven and bake for 20 mins or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: red wine,mozzarella cheese,red chilies,cannellini bean,flour tortilla,oyster sauce,purpose flour
title: Antroccito Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed well ( or great northern beans ) | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 can chopped hot red chilies | 2 cups dry red wine | 3/4 lb mozzarella cheese, grated ( about 2 cups ) | 15 -20 large tortillas or 15 -20 large spanish rice cakes
instructions: Heat oven to 350ºf.  Lightly oil or spray 11x7x2 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray.  Combine beans, flour, oyster sauce and chilies in a bowl.  Spread half of bean mixture into bottom of prepared shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle with half the cheese.  Repeat twice with the remaining mixture and cheese.  Pour tomato juice mixture evenly over all.  Cover loosely with foil and baking dish or sheet.  Bake for 40 minutes or until heated through.  Batter may be prepared up to this point 1 day ahead and refrigerated.  Bake covered with foil and baking dish or sheet at 350ºf about 12 minutes.  Uncover, sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Bake uncovered 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.  Let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Guisado De Arroz (Southwest Spice Rolls)
ingredients: 1 lb round steak | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh savory | 1 tablespoon chopped green pepper | 12 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies | 2 packages crescent roll dough
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Add round steak and cook until well browned, 4 - 5 minutes.  Transfer the meat to a bowl and set aside.  Stir in the savory and pepper.

title: Spicy Turkey Macaroni and Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey | 8 ounces elbow macaroni, uncooked | 4 -6 lime wedges ( to garnish )
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente.  Meanwhile in a frying pan, warm skillet over medium high temperature.  Add ground turkey.  Cook until brown and cooked through.

title: Super Easy Guacamole
ingredients: 1 cup guacamole | 1/2 teaspoon soya sauce
instructions: In a bowl mix first three ingredients and stir.  You may also mix in an extra big spoon of guacamole.  Enjoy with your favorite vegetable of your choice.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,vegetable oil cooking spray,chocolate syrup,jumbo shrimp,orzo pasta,herb,onion salt,margarine
title: Jumbo Shrimp With Orzo and Shiitake (Aka Shrimp With Chocolate Syrup or Chocolate Sauce)
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked orzo pasta or 12 ounces orecchiette | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 3 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs uncooked jumbo shrimp, cleaned and deveined | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate syrup or 2 ounces other chocolate syrup | 1 tablespoon dried mixed herbs ( any combination of chives, tarragon, parsley, oregano or rosemary ) | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 small onion, minced | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt ( to taste )
instructions: Boil orzo according to pkg directions or until just beginning to tender and drain in a colander.  Coat orzo lightly with oil then shake to remove excess oil.  Place on paper towels to drain extra water.  Heat the broiler, setting the rack about 6 inches from the heat source.  Melt orzo in a pot of boiling water according to package directions.  Meanwhile, heat 1 tblsp.  Of the butter or margarine in a skillet set over moderately low heat.  Stir in the onion.

title: Lamb Chops on a Country-Style Buns
ingredients: 4 hamburger buns, split | 1/2 lb hamburger patty ( thinly sliced, not cut into thin strips ) | 3 eggplants | 4 slices country-style bread or 4 slices whole wheat bread | 1/2 cup croutons ( to garnish ) | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Place buns on a cookie sheet and broil, 3 to 5 minutes, then turn, and broil 3 to 5 minutes longer, or until lightly toasted.  Remove from broiler, spread split side of each bun with half the hamburger patty, and top with eggplant slices, bread slices and croutons, respectively.  In a medium skillet, melt remaining hamburger.  When meat begins to brown.  Add water.

title: Spiced Brisket
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter, room temperature | 8 ounces beef brisket or 8 ounces beef brisket, well trimmed | 4 ounces half-and-half | 2 cups grated ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground sumac
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f butter a baking dish well.  Wrap bottom of dish with foil and lightly film with vegetable spray.  Spray foil with nonstick spray.  Place brisket in baking dish, fat side down, in oven.  Bake 15 - 20 minutes for medium rare or until thermometer registers 115°f for medium.  Cool slightly.  Remove brisket to cutting board.  Using an electric meat fork, break the meat into chunks that measure about 1/2 in.  Loaf in a medium bowl.  Stir together the butter and remaining ingredients except the cheese.  Stir in meat, mixing to coat evenly with the sauce.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake, uncovered, until heated through and brown, about 40 minutes.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: basil,bell pepper,cooking oil,pea carrot,amaretto liqueur,pickle relish
title: Peas-N-Pota "N'dizi"
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups sweet peas and carrots | 1 bell pepper, chopped ( either red or green ) | 1/4 cup amaretto liqueur | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon sweet pickle relish ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil ( to taste )
instructions: Place peas& carrots in a pot with fresh water.  Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes or until carrots begin to soften.  Using a slotted spoon transfer the peas to a colander to drain.  Return to the pot stir in sweet pepper, amaretto& cooking oil, cover and cook over low heat for 1 minute.  Stir in pickle relish and basil.  Stir again and serve immediately.

title: Penne With a Kick
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs penne or 2 -3 lbs ziti pasta | 1/2 cup light rum | 2 -3mint sprigs
instructions: Fill large pot with water and boil pasta until tender but firm.  Drain pasta and return it to the pot.  While the pasta is boiling, prepare the sauce.  When the pasta is still cooking, place rum in a small bowl.  Heat the rum in it over low heat until it begins to boil.  Pour rum over drained pasta.  Top with mint and fresh mint leaves.  Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,green pepper,cheddar cheese,tomato,dark soy sauce,red onion
title: Tomato-And-Cheese Appetizer

instructions: Microwave onion and green pepper in small dish on high, about 2 minutes or until softened.  Stir in soy sauce, tomato puree, and vanilla.  Pour into casserole or baking dish.  Add cheese on top.  Cook on high 1 - 3 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.  Serve with your favourite veggies on top.

title: Eggs Ole Ole'

instructions: Spray an 8 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray.

instructions: Cut the papayas in half on their diagonal.  Remove the seeds.  Place pulp in a small baking pan, along with any remaining seeds.  Bake for two hours in a slow oven.  Remove from oven when golden brown and set aside to cool.  In a glass or ceramic pot, combine the pineapple juice, ketchup, vinegar, picante sauce and anise and mix well.  Place the pulp in a jar and pour over the marinade in the baking dish.  Seal and refrigerate for up to three weeks before using.  Store in the refrigerator.  Use in sandwiches, as a marinade for chicken, pork, and shrimp.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,kiwi,black pepper,maple syrup,vegetable oil cooking,bean sauce
title: Simple Kiwi Cheesecake Recipe

instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place cream cheese in strainer with water in a large bowl.  When cheese is cool, melt cream cheese in microwave.  Mix together kiwis, maple syrup, pepper and cream cheese in microwave safe bowl.  Pour kiwi mixture over cream cheese in microwave safe bowl.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for 1 hour.  When ready to bake, remove wrap and refrigerate 1 hour.  Bake cheesecake for 15 minutes, then remove from oven and sprinkle top of cheesecake with the kiwi glaze.  Cool.  Note, to cut calories, skip the 2 tablespoons spread and replace with 2 tblsp water.  Also, the cream cheese freezes and seems like a lot of moisture when i make this.

title: Chinese Style Broccoli, Cucumber and Red Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 bag mixed greens ( i like collards, or kale ) | 1/2 seedless cucumber, cut into 1/4 inch slices ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 small red onion, sliced into half-moons | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | tortilla chips ( optional )
instructions: Arrange mixed greens on plates, then top with cucumber, onion, vinegar and optional tortilla chips.  If desired, garnish with additional sliced red onion.

ingredients: 3/4 cup basmati rice | 3 green cardamoms | 1 -2 canned jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 2 teaspoons tamarind juice | 1/4 cup peach schnapps | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 2 tablespoons chilled dry-roasted unsalted sunflower oil ( if not using sunflower )
instructions: Cook rice according to pkg.  Directions on package.  Meanwhile, heat sherry, tamarind, schnapps and cayenne in small saucepan over medium heat until mixture is heated through and sherry has gone smokey.  Pour over rice and toss.  Cool in fridge 15 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Maple Biscotti
ingredients: 24 ounces packages ladyfingers | 16 ounces chocolate | 1 tablespoon cumin | maple syrup
instructions: First line the bottom & sides of an 8 by 13 inch or larger square pan with parchment paper.  Split the ladyfingers in half so you get 24 slices, keeping some of the cream.  Melt chocolate and spices in a pot & stir for 3 - 5 minutes.  Pour chocolate mixture into lady fingers, allowing some to run down the sides.  Spread evenly in pan, leaving a 1 inch overhang.  Chill in refrigerator at least 8 hours, or overnight.  To bake, preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until done.  Cool for 15 - 20 minutes.  Turn onto cutting board.  Using serrated knife, slice diagonally into 1/2 inch slices.  Serve with syrup.

Random Ingredients: hot sauce,spaghetti,sharp cheddar cheese,water chestnut,dill pickle
title: Quick Spaghetti and Nests
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 1/4 cup water chestnut, slices | 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh dill pickle, minced
instructions: Cook spaghetti to desired doneness as directed on package, drain and set aside to keep warm.  In a small bowl, stir hot sauce and water chestnuts to mix.  Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add spaghetti and toss to coat.  Stir fry 2 minutes or until heated through.  Remove and drain.  Sprinkle with cheese and pickle.

instructions: Cut apples into quarters and place in a bowl.  Add soy sauce, oregano and celery.  Mix well.  Spread mixture on a serving platter and place in freezer.  Serve at once.

title: Tasty Garlic Mashed Potatoes

instructions: In large saucepan of boiling water, cook potatoes until tender, about 5 - 7 minutes.  Drain and toss with kielbasa.  Cool potatoes for one minute, then mix into mayonnaise or miracle whip in a large bowl.  Heat through.  Stir in pesto, cocoa, if using.  Serve with your favorite toppings like crackers.

title: Sauza®
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 cup basmati rice | 2 cups fresh bean sprouts | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1 lemon, juiced
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add farfalle pasta and cook according to package instructions.  Meanwhile, bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add basmati rice and cook until tender, about 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain, and rinse with cold water.  Place the bean sprouts in a steamer over boiling water.  Cover, and steam the bean sprouts until tender, 2 to 3 minutes.  Drain.  In a small bowl, mix garam masala and lemon juice.  Pour the hot cooked farfalle into the sauce, and toss.  Serve over hot cooked basmati rice.

title: Amaretto Meatballs
ingredients: 2 pounds lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 1 can condensed milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a shallow bowl, mix together ground beef and amaretto mix until well combined.  Form the mixture into 6 balls and place on a greased baking sheet, about 1 inch apart.  Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until browned about 10 minutes.  Remove meatballs from the baking sheet, and set aside.  Heat a large skillet over medium heat.  To the skillet, add condensed milk and hot amaretto and mix well.  Place meatballs in the liquid mixture to coat them completely.  Bake in the preheated oven 20 minutes, or until well browned.

title: Beef Rolls for Two
ingredients: 20 baby carrots, peeled and diced | 4 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons instant tea | 50 g sirloin steaks or 50 g steak fillets | 25 g butter
instructions: Place the carrots in a saucepan with the sugar and 2 tablespoons of water.  Bring to the boil, cook for a few minutes and drain.  Lay the steaks on a board or work surface, brush with water and cover with plastic wrap.  Using paper towel, pat the steaks dry.  Place the sugar and salt in a large frying pan or fry pan and stir over a low heat until caramelised.  Add the carrots and cook for 3 minutes or until softened.  Remove from the heat.  Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in the frying pan, and, when hot but not smoking, sprinkle the sirloin with the caramel.  Cook for 5 minutes on each side.  Remove from heat, cover and keep warm.  Add the remaining butter to the pan, reheating gently.  Lift the steaks out of the pan and place on absorbent paper towels.  Roll them in sugar/salt/pepper mixture and slice thinly.  Serve with whipped cream.

title: Pomodoro

instructions: Heat the vodka in a small sauce pan over low heat.  Stir in the heavy whipping cream.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut the turnips in half lengthwise.  Make slits in the top and bottom of the turnips.

title: Mustard Chicken Breasts With Ginger and Corn Relish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry mustard | 2 tablespoons fresh dill weed | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 cup merlot | 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts | 2 cups frozen corn kernels
instructions: Place mustard, dill, ginger, cloves, hot pepper sauce, and merlot in a heavy skillet.  Bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat.  Simmer, partially covered, for 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, preheat broiler.  Cut chicken meat into 1 inch cubes.  Place chicken in a 1 1/2 quart baking dish.  Spoon sauce over chicken.  Broil 5 minutes or until chicken is just cooked through.

Place the ricotta and pears into a clean container with a lid, pour boiling water on the ricotta and shake to combine.  Let sit for a bit or two to let the acids settle a little and the pears soften.  Drain the ricotta and pears, and divide among serving plates, and serve.

instructions: First you must get a rice cooker.  Put rice between the rice cooker lid and press with quick push cook using the regular press method.  After 20 minutes remove lid and fluff up rice with a fork and set aside. Cut the watermelon into about four cm x four cm square cubes.  Cut it into about four centimetres squares.  Cut the honey roasting chicken in half length ways cross wise.  Wash the turkey and drain it of any excess water.  Cut them into quarters.  Combine the confectioners sugar and ghee together well and rub the confectioner's sugar all over the turkey.  Place the turkey, watermelon and the turkey strips in the bowl with the rice wine mixture and toss to mix thoroughly.  In an oven proof casserole dish add ghee butter and melt it on high, it will be very hot when you pour in the ghee but not smothered in it, cook the turkey in a preheated oven, it will be cooked in about 15 minutes, if you use a stovetop turkey it will be done in about an extra ten to fifteen minutes.
