title: Beef Kebabs With Pecans
ingredients: 3 lbs beef roast, cut in chunks | 1 can beer | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 tablespoon cardamom powder | 2 tablespoons chopped pecans | 1 1/2 lbs fresh asparagus | 1 teaspoon dry fish fillet ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients except for beef, and set aside.  Trim asparagus, cut into 2 inch pieces and soak about 15 minutes in ice water.  Mix the meat with the marinade, and refrigerate overnight.  Drain excess marinade from meat, and thread onto skewers.  Grill until nicely browned and tender, about 10 minutes.  Serve with asparagus and remaining beer.

Random Ingredients: black olive,white bread,filet beef,red cabbage,lemon curd,chilies
title: Beef and Chilli Casserole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon curd | 250 g lean stewing beef | 2 tablespoons chilies, chopped, drained | 1 bunch of thick fresh red cabbage, shredded | 4 slices thick white bread, crusts removed and torn into small pieces | 2 tablespoons black olives, sliced
instructions: In a small casserole dish, mix the lemon curd with water.  Add the beef, chillies, cabbage, and the bread to the mixture and toss to combine.  Spoon into a baking dish and top with olives.  Cover the dish, refrigerate overnight, or for up to 3 days, then put the casserole into a 325f oven for 1 1/2 hours or until the beef is cooked throughly and the vegetables are tender.  Serve as soon as possible.

title: Crock Pot Chilli Pork
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs pork, chunks | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon kashmiri chile pepper, paste
instructions: Place all ingredients in the crock pot.  Cook on high for 3 hours.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,pasta sauce,italian seasoning,tabasco sauce,lemon wedge,amaretto,caraway seed
title: Oriental Grilled Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces pasta sauce | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed or 1/2 teaspoon ground caraway | 1/2 dash tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons bottled bottled dry adobo sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Whisk together ingredients and set aside.  Drain pasta and arrange on grill over low to moderate heat.  Grill 4 - 5 mins or until done.  Turn over, brush with more marinade, and brush with sauce.  Cook 2 min or until heated through.

title: Spiced Beef
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat - cut into cubes | 1 package cellophane noodles | 3 tablespoons anise seed
instructions: Combine the stew meat, cellophane noodles, and anise seed in a large pot over low heat, stirring occasionally until the noodles are tender, about 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: coconut,sea scallop,methi leaf,black olive,pesto,rice wine,apple cider
title: Scallops with Pistou
ingredients: 4 large scallops, cleaned from their shells, tentacles scored onto a plate | 1/2 cup pesto | 1/2 - 3/4 cup rice wine ( or a 1/2-2 cup dry white wine ) | 1 tablespoon sea scallop, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup black olives, sliced | 1/4 cup grated coconut | 1/2 tablespoon methi leaves ( optional )
instructions: In a large shallow casserole dish arrange the scallops and pesto as desired.  Drizzle the scallops with the wine, salt to taste, and top with the scallops.  Cover the dish and refrigerate overnight to thoroughly combine the flavors.  If adding the scallops to the dish, uncover just before serving.  Before serving, garnish with the olives, coconut and mepi.

title: Spicy Breakfast Sandwich
ingredients: 4 raves brioche bread | 2 tablespoons chorizo sausage, thinly sliced
instructions: Toast brioche.  Spread chorizo/sausage slices on one side of toast.  Top with the other slice of bread.  Cut into five wedges, enjoy.

title: Mushroom Sticks (Canapes)
ingredients: 1/2 cup shallot, finely chopped | 12 medium mixed mushrooms, sliced very thin
instructions: Finely chop or cut shallots and mushrooms, if used, into fine bits.  Stir with chopstick.  Poke some holes in the mixture with a fork.  Spread out on a flat surface sprayed with vegetable spray, such as pam.  Broil, uncovered, for about 5 minutes on each side until golden, or, let cool for a few minutes, then store in an airtight container.

title: Baked Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 4 slices of uncooked orange or 4 slices of uncooked lemon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Arrange 2 chicken breasts in a 9x13 baking dish coated with cooking spray.  In a small bowl, stir together cream of tartar and cream of tartar.  Spread mixture over chicken.  Bake chicken for 45 - 50 minutes or till no longer pink.  During the last 5 minutes of cooking, sprinkle with orange or lemon slices, then return to oven and bake for 10 - 15 minutes more.

title: Roasted Red Cabbage (Cheryla)
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, preferably purple | 1/4 cup unhydrated lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Cut the cabbage into four wedges.  Rinse wedges well, and then place them in a roasting pan.  Sprinkle with half of the lemon peel, and toss to coat.  Roast for 30 to 40 minutes until golden brown.  Cool slightly before removing the lemon peel.

title: Gluten Free Irish Casserole for a Crowd
ingredients: 3 ounces lean lamb ( meat cut into bite size chunks ) | 1/2 cup brown rice ( not instant ) | 3 ounces fresh white fish fillets ( skin removed and finely chopped ) | 4 ounces mangoes | 5 tablespoons irish cream ( thickened cream )
instructions: Lightly spray a round 2 cup capacity ovenproof dish with oil.  Heat oil in saucepan, pour in rice and add meat.  Cook stirring for 2 minutes, add mangoes and mix in.  Mix well and bake with lid on 1 1/2 1 2/3 hours at 180°c.  Check to see if rice has cooked.  It should be sticky and a little dryer then remove lid.  Mix ingredients, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Serve with cream.

title: Swiss Apples (Baked Apples)
ingredients: 4 tart apples | 2 tablespoons jaggery
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 180°c/350°f.  Wash apples, remove as much skin as possible, and cut apples in half lengthwise, and remove core and stem.  Slip fruit in melted jaggery and place on a rack to dry out, but not excessively.  Put apples at once into oven and bake for 30 - 45 minutes, or until soft.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,liquid honey,rotini pasta,lemon peel,spearmint,pineapple chunk,cream celery soup
title: Smokin' Sweet Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta | 1 can chunk pineapple chunks, drained | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1/4 teaspoon dried lemon peel, or more to taste | 1/4 cup spearmint, chopped
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in rotini, and return to boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Place the pasta in a large bowl, and stir in the pineapple chunks, creamed soup, tomatoes with green chiles, honey, lemon peel, and spearmint.  Gently stir in the cooked pasta.  Allow to chill in the refrigerator, about 5 minutes.  Stir to mix, and serve.

title: Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1 package dry active yeast | 4 cups warm room temperature white vinegar | 1 package dry onion soup mix
instructions: Mix yeast and warm water in measuring cup.  Add vinegar and onion soup mix and mix well.

title: Italian Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( fresh squeezed, not canned ) | 4 tablespoons dried basil | 2 teaspoons onion powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Add to salad.  Chill.

title: Strawberries With Ginger and Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 2 pints fresh strawberries, hulled | 3 tablespoons coarse fresh white breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon crushed grated gingerroot | 1 large pinch ground cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons grenadine syrup | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Wash the strawberries thoroughly under cold running water, dry well and slice in half lengthwise.  Toss with breadcrumbs and season to taste with ginger, cumin and grenadine.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 - ½ hours.  Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat and fry the strawberries until just beginning to lose their shape, turning them occasionally for 4 - ½ minutes before they are cooked through.  Set aside.  Drain the strawberries, reserving the marinade, and sprinkle with breadcrumb mixture and serve with the remaining marinade.

title: Artichoke Slaw II
ingredients: 1 package brown gravy mix | 3 jars marinated artichoke hearts ( drained and chopped ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Combine brown gravy mix and artichokes in a large bowl.  Stir in red onion.  Cover, and refrigerate overnight.

title: Tomato Pudding (Makaronia)
ingredients: 200 g dried apricots | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon tomato puree
instructions: Wash the apricots.

title: Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 lb mushroom | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Drain mushrooms.  Combine cocoa and thyme.  Roll out on a lightly floured board to 1/8 inch thickness.  Cut with a 2 inch round cookie cutter, or use a 3 x 4 inch diamond shaped cookie cutter.  Heat a griddle or skillet over medium heat until hot.  Coat the cookies with the cocoa mixture, swirling quickly to cover the surface completely.  Cook until lightly browned, about 1 1/2 minutes.  Transfer to wire rack to cool completely.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Vanilla Meringue Cookies
ingredients: 6 eggs | 1 1/4 cups sugar | 5 tablespoons vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Beat the eggs until frothy and then add the sugar and vanilla.  Mix well.  Mix in the sifted powdered sugar.  Dip the hands into the egg mixture and roll into walnut sized balls.  Bake for 11 - 13 minutes, until the cookies turn light golden brown.  Allow to cool for five minutes, then dust with powdered sugar or leave plain.

title: Basic Vegan Broth
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups raw converted egg noodles or 1 3/4 cups regular uncooked egg noodles | 2 1/4 cups chicken bouillon cubes ( i use knorr, though it's in the wideest aisle of a grocery store ) | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: If using regular uncooked egg noodles, the steel blade that comes with the noodles is good for this recipe, or you will have egg noodles that are about a half ounce or so long.  You'll have approximately 3 cups of noodles.  Using a mortar and pestle, finely grind the cardamom pods to a paste.  Using a large heavy bottomed pan, toast the cardamom paste until fragrant and slightly darker in color.  Add the chicken bouillon cubes and bring to a simmer over medium heat.  Stir.  Add the cardamom paste and simmer until the bouillon cubes are dissolved and the mixture is a light rich red color.  It may take up to an hour to let the broth reduce a bit, depending on the acidity of your chicken broth or the flavor of your cubes.  Remove from heat and serve warm.

title: Roasted Banana Salad
ingredients: 4 unripe bananas, peeled | 1 plum tomato, sliced | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f.  Scrub the bananas thoroughly and prick them with a fork.  Place them in a large roasting tin and sprinkle them with a little sea salt.  Roast the bananas for 30 minutes – check the doneness by piercing the skin.  Serve at once, with slices of tomato alongside.

title: Raspberry Vinegar Shoot Shooters
ingredients: 12 slices fresh raspberries vinegar | 2 cans sliced bamboo shoots
instructions: Cover a bamboo shoot with water and bring to a boil.  Remove from heat.  Let cool for about 15 minutes.  Remove the seeds and slice the pepper into 1/2 inch strips.  Drain the pepper strips and add to a blender jar with the vinegar.  Blend well until smooth.  Store in the refrigerator.

title: Mexican-Style Capers & Capers
ingredients: 1 jar capers | 4 tablespoons margarine | 1/2 cup finely chopped drained canned salsa ( mild, medium or hot, to your liking ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray.  In a blender or food processor combine capers and margarine and process to a smooth paste.  Stir in salsa and vanilla and process until well mixed.  Spoon mixture into a pastry bag.  Pipe mixture onto prepared baking sheet.  With fingers, press down flat, about 1/3 inch thick to form 4 - 1 1/2 inch wide mounds.  Bake until top of crust is golden and edges are light brown, about 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Chili Oil Varela
ingredients: 10 ounces hot coffee ( i use chai spiced hot ) | 10 -15 drops chili oil | 16 caraway seeds, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Fill a medium sized glass bowl with hot coffee.  When it starts to float on top, start testing the coffee with a wooden spoon.  If it starts to stick, your coffee is done, and the heat should stay about a half inch below the top.  When the coffee is settled, pour into the glass bowl.  Add 2 or 3 crushed caraway seeds to the drink.  If desired, dust with a little extra cinnamon.  Enjoy.

title: Danish Chicken
ingredients: 4 -6 slices bacon, chopped | 1 whole chicken
instructions: Fry chicken until golden brown.  In the meantime, fry bacon until it is crisp and add to chicken.  Fry until done.  Serve with mashed potatoes and green beans.

title: Thai Chicken Wings (Pad Kee)
ingredients: 10 chicken wings | 1 red pepper, sliced | 3 -4 dried red chili peppers, sliced ( more or less to taste ) | 2 heads packed lettuce
instructions: Clean and wash the wings, removing tips.  Split wings at joint, scrape off any tough parts, and place in a large pot of water, with 2 whole sliced red peppers and whole dried chili peppers.  Boil until tender for about 15 minutes or longer.  Drain wings, cut apart, and return to pot.  Cover and return water to boil again.

title: Magic Bullet Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup water | 1 cup reduced-sugar chicken stock | 1 cup canned pineapple chunks | 3/4 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 3 tablespoons champagne vinegar | 2 drops hot pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender.  Blend until blended and pour into tall glass.

title: French Blankets
ingredients: 1 head boston lettuce, washed, dried well, and shredded | 4 slices gruyere cheese ( about 1 ounce ) | 4 ounces frozen okra, defrosted and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a large bowl combine the lettuce, cheese, and okra.  Stir to combine.  Spoon enough of the bean mixture into the bottom half of each sheet of boston lettuce to cover the top.  Roll up the lettuce into a tight tight bundle.  The remaining side of the bundle should be facing toward the center of the table so you can take the leaves and place a toothpick through it for presentation.

title: Pesto Beef Heart and Potatoes
ingredients: 500 g beef heart ( i use heart whole eye only ) | 500 g baking potatoes, washed and quartered lengthways | 1 liter vegetable stock ( use the stock from eating the beef ) | 1 teaspoon dried basil pesto
instructions: Trim fat from meat.  Slice meat thinly across centre, about 1 inch thick.  Place on greased oven tray and bake at 325f for about an hour or until cooked.  Serve.  To make stock, bring stock to the boil in large saucepan over high heat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes until reduced by half.  Add pesto.  Remove meat from oven, let cool slightly.  Remove and dice.  Heat the stock over high heat until boiling, stirring constantly.  Add meat to stock and simmer for 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, boil potatoes until tender, drain.  Add potatoes to stock and stir through with hand held mixer until evenly coated, about two minutes.  Spoon stock over meat and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tahini,button mushroom,green maraschino cherry,white balsamic vinegar,napa cabbage,pecan,chunky salsa
title: Vegetable Salad With Chunky Salsa
ingredients: 4 cups napa cabbage, roughly chopped | 4 cups baby spinach ( i like to use fresh spinach ) | 4 cups white balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa ( or more to taste ) | 2 cups green maraschino cherries ( i only use about 1 cup ) | 1 cup toasted pecans, chopped ( optional ) | 12 large button mushrooms ( about 1 1/2 cups total )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except mushroom and nuts in a large glass bowl.  Toss well.  Serve immediately or chill for up to one 3 days to allow the flavors to blend.

title: Wild Rice With Apples
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice | 2 medium granny smith apples | 1/2 small red onion
instructions: Wash rice and place in the microwave.  Place on high for 5 minutes.  Using an electric mixer, mix the rice, apples and red onion.  When cooked, fluff rice and place in a casserole dish.  For a nice appetizer, garnish with fresh fruit and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,chicken wing,chili pepper,egg noodle,oyster sauce,marshmallow,farfalle pasta
title: Hot Wings
ingredients: 2 packages egg noodles | 10 ounces chicken wings, chopped | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 dash oyster sauce | 1 dash chili pepper | shredded farfalle noodles | marshmallows
instructions: In large skillet cook the noodles according to package directions.  Mix the soup, oyster sauce and chillic pepper and pour evenly over noodles.  Top with chicken wings and marinate for one hour.  Serve over noodles with marshmallows at table.

title: Beef Tex Mex Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 onion flakes | 16 ounces corn tortilla chips
instructions: Brown stew beef and add onion and cook down for 10 minutes.  Add corn tortillas, and mix well.  Put chips in microwave, and cook in microwave for about 12 minutes.

title: Feta Bites
ingredients:
1/4 cup fresh herb and spice or 1/4 cup dried herbs, of your choice | 2 cups crumbled feta | 1/3 cup fresh fruit, chopped ( your fav.
    - kiwi, banana, pineapple, cherries or mangos ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice or 1 tablespoon freshly-squeezed lime juice | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Prepare the crumb topping by whisking the lemon juice, thyme leaves and crumbled feta together, adding the fruit last.  Dry the feta mixture in the dry ingredient/vegetable food processor until it is of a coarse consistency.  Add the lime juice.

Random Ingredients: red potato,corn tortilla,beef rib roast,mexican oregano
title: Mom's Easy Beef Tortilla Tacos
ingredients: 3 lbs beef short rib roast | 3 tablespoons mexican oregano ( dried ) | 2 teaspoons fresh ground red potato ( or yellow squash ) | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Remove beef rib from refrigerator.  Place beef in slow cooker.  Sprinkle evenly with the oregano and potatoes.  Cook on low for 7 - 8 hours or on high for 4 - 5 hours.  Serve tortillas with the leftover gravy for dipping.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,rump steak,white bread,eggplant,lettuce leaf,chili pepper flake,superfine sugar,lasagna noodle
title: Italian Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 1 lb skirt steaks or 1 lb rib eye steaks | 1 large eggplant, unpeeled and cut into 8 diagonal slices | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili peppers flakes, such as chipotle | 12 slices white bread, 1/2 inch thick | 4 large lettuce leaves | 1 package lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit.  Trim steak of fat, and cut across grain into thin strips.  Transfer strips to a small bowl.

title: Simple orzo and Chipotle-Cilantro
ingredients: 1 bunch escarole, rinsed clean and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup orzo pasta, uncooked | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the orzo and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 11 minutes.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Heat a large saucepan of olive oil over high heat.  Add the garlic, cumin, and chipotle powder.  Saute for 1 minute.  Add the escarole to the oil and saute until it begins to soften, 1 to 2 minutes.  Add the pasta and cook until the pasta is lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,vanilla pudding mix,green bell pepper,chili powder,tomato puree,brandy,pickling salt,chutney
title: Easy Chutney Pickles
ingredients: 1 package dry vanilla pudding mix or ( 3 ounce ) package vegetarian instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped ( or use red or or yellow ) | 2 cups tomato puree | 1/2 cup brandy ( optional ) | 1/3 cup lemon pepper | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon pickling salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large saucepan.  Bring to boil.  Cool for 30 minutes.  Stir well before coating glass bottles or jars.  Store in refrigerator.

title: Chocolate and Thyme Bark
ingredients: 400 g unsweetened chocolate | 3 tablespoons fresh thyme, leaves only, grated finely | 200 ml chopped dried unsweetened chocolate ( for a softer skin it becomes difficult to blend )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/400°f.  Melt the chocolate with the thyme in a bowl in the microwave.  Stir until just smooth and stir in the choclate mixture.  Press into an 8x8x2 inch greased/microwallow tin.  Chill for 15 minutes or until firm.  Spread or drizzle over the dried unsweetened chocolate and allow to set.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,salt pepper,coffee,pork liver,corn tortilla,tea,chicken bouillon
title: Irish Peanut Butter and Coke Fondue
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh hot brewed coffee ( i like cava ) | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons instant tea | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon ( or 1 tbsp homemade if you prefer ) | 1 cup hot cooked pork liver, chopped ( or your favorite leftover hot cooked meat ) | salt and pepper | corn tortilla, wedges ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in fondue pot and turn heat on low.  You can add any optional ingredients like corn chips to make it a fondue.

title: Pumpkin & Rice Mustard Chinese Pancake
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 cup sweetened condensed milk or 1 cup soy milk | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 tablespoon prepared dijon-style chili-garlic sauce or 1 teaspoon chinese chili paste | 3 cups cooked basmati rice or 3 cups jasmine rice
instructions: Combine pumpkin, sweetened condensed milk, maple syrup and chili paste in a pot.  Stir over moderate heat until boiling.

title: Greek Green Olives
ingredients: 3 heads green olives, very finely chopped ( see notes ) | 1 lb yellow grated zest ( from about 6 orange-colored peel ) | 2 cups unsweetened plain yogurt ( or greek 7-up ) | 1 orange peel
instructions: Finely chop yellow grated zest in food processor.  Combine all ingredients and store in covered container.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,cardamom seed,chili oil,cream chicken soup,salt black pepper,chicken breast
title: Spicy Chicken (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 lbs skinless chicken breasts, cut into cubes | 4 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/8 cup chili oil ( optional ) | 1 orange, zest of | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom seeds ( or 1 tsp powder of each ) | 1 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in large crockpot.  Cover and cook on high for 3 - 4 hours.  Remove chicken from crockpot and shred or cut with 2 forks, or use an immersion blender to thicken the soup to a smooth sauce.  Reheat and serve.

title: Smoked Salmon Gremolada
ingredients: 300 g macaroni | 300 g smoked salmon | 3 saffron strands, soaked in | 6 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 1/4 tablespoons cornmeal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c/fan 160c/gas 5/400f/gas cook the macaroni in a large pan of boiling water until al dente.  Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons water in a sauté pan over medium heat and fry the flaked salmon for 5 minutes, until the flesh flakes easily from the skin.  Roughly chop the salmon and drain the pasta.  Place in an ovenproof dish.  Sprinkle half the saffron on the pasta and the remaining saffron.  Bake for 15 minutes, top with the smoked salmon and bake for a further 20 minutes/high heat.  Gremolada should be golden and moist.  Sprinkle with the cornflour and scatter with parsley.

title: Stuffed Beet Bites
ingredients: 12 small beets | 50 ml basil | 50 ml ginger ( fresh, peeled and grated ) | 3 egg whites ( hard-boiled ) | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | basil leaves, to decorate | 1 baguette
instructions: Preheat the oven at 200°c/gas cut off the tops of the beets and discard the tops and blemishes.  Leave the beets whole, scoop out the inside flesh and seeds with a small scoop.  Place the eggs, fresh ginger and tomato puree into a blender with the puree and process to a paste.  Drain the beets and roughly mash them.  Place into a deep roasting tin and scatter over the mixed paste and bake for 30 - 40 minutes until the beets are tender.  To serve, cut off and discard the beetroot, then spread the beet filling along one side of the baguette then decorate with the basil leaves.

title: Chinese Style Spicy Carrots
ingredients: cooking spray | 3 carrots, washed, peeled and sliced | vegetable shortening | catsup | hot steamed peanuts ( optional )
instructions: To make the carrots, arrange the carrots at the bottom of a colander, or toss with a large spoon so as to wilt them a bit.  Place the carrots on several layers of paper towels or several layers of paper towels.  Spray a large skillet with vegetable oil spray and heat over medium heat.  Add carrots and toss until lightly browned, approximately 2 - 3 minutes.  Be careful not to burn the carrots.  Place on a paper towel covered plate to drain any excess moisture.  Cut shortening into chunks and mix in.

title: Quick and Simple Ham Casserole
ingredients: 500 g ham, cut into 1-inch squares | 1 cup sunflower seeds | 100 ml unsweetened applesauce | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Combine the ham, seeds, and applesauce in a large casserole dish.  Bake for 1 hour.  Stir in tomato paste and bake an additional 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mortadella,jalapeno coarsely,basil leaf,cooking oil,penne pasta,new potato,chocolate baking square
title: Grilled Potato, Basil & Chocolate Pasta With Chilled Herring
ingredients: 12 ounces penne pasta, cooked al dente | 12 ounces smoked ham, cut into 1/4 inch dice | 4 teaspoons chocolate baking squares, melted and divided | 15 1/2 ounces new potatoes, chopped | 1 teaspoon bottled deli pickled jalapeno, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves, snipped | 1/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: Preheat your grill for high heat.  Oil the grate.  In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except cooking oil.  Dress your salad with cooking oil and remaining 2 tablespoons of chocolate.  Toss with hot pasta.  Add more cooking oil if needed.  Serve immediately.

title: Tee-Seared Cheese Tartlets
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry | 2 tablespoons tahini paste | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon grated gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 2 tablespoons chilled smoked aubergine slices ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons tuna, cooked ( optional )
instructions: Thaw puff pastry according to package directions.  Cut dough into 4 - 5 pieces.  Lay out pastry on a nonstick baking tray.  Sprinkle with half of the pesto, the gruyere, celery, and the remaining pesto.  Arrange 4 slices on the bread, pressing slightly so that the edges are not stuck to each other.  Top with remaining 8 slices of dough.  Lightly brush the tops of the tarts with the remaining pesto.  Refrigerate for 10 minutes.  Cut into squares and serve.

title: Rutabagas With Cranberries and Corn Flour
ingredients: 2 cups corn flakes, divided | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries, divided | 1 1/2 lbs rutabagas, peeled and sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 4 cups loosely packed grated fresh cheesecloth
instructions: Place 1 cup cornflakes, 1 t.  Cranberries and 1 t.  Dried cherries in a 6 qt saucepan.  Add 4 cups water.  Bring to a boil over moderate heat, stirring to dissolve the cornflakes.  Remove from the heat and let stand 10 min. , until it is cool to the touch.  Scald the remaining corn flakes, drain ans set aside.  Scrub and slice the rutabagas into about 5x8 wedges.  Sprinkle with the yeast.  Let stand about 5 min.  Drain the corn flakes, then measure out 2 cups.  Make a well in the center and add the corn flakes, 2 tsp.  Cranberries and 1 1/2 teaspoons dried cherries.  Pour the yeast mixture into the well.  Stir the flour into the yeast mixture and blend to make a sticky dough.  Dough should be slightly sticky.  Shape 1 c.  Rutabaga into a ball.  Lightly grease the bowl, cover, a warm spot for about 12 min.  Place the dough on a floured board and roll out to about 1/8 inch thick.  Using a 2 inch round cookie cutter, cut out circles using a 3 inch round cookie cutter.  Place on a greased baking sheet.  Cover and let rise in a warm spot until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour.  Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Using a 3 inch round cookie cutter, cut out a hole in the center of the rutabaga.  Place the rutabaga on a baking sheet, cover with a warm spot, put in the oven and bake until cooked through, about 25 min.  Cool slightly and let cool slightly.  Transfer the rutabaga to 1 wire rack and let it stand until cooled completely.  Using a 3 inch round cookie cutter, cut out a hole in the center of the rutabaga.  Make a small slit in the center of the rutabaga, pull out the soft shiny portion of the rutabaga, leaving the outer shell intact.  Turn the rutabaga over and cut out the same vein on the outer shell.  Repeat with the remaining rutabagas and rutabagas.  Spread the rutabagas out on a large baking sheet and sprinkle them with 1/2 tsp.  Cranberry flavoured sugar.  Let them sit at room temperature 10 min.  Spread the remaining 1/2 tsp.  Cranberry flavoured sugar over them.  Bake the rutabagas for 10 min.  Then bake for about 10 min.  Turn them over and bake for another 10 min.  Turn them over and bake for another 10 min.  Makes 4 servings.  Danish, rutabagas.  Rutabagas, rutabagas.  Bread.

title: Spanish Peixe
ingredients: 1 3/4 pints pork stock | 1 3/4 pints water or 1 3/4 pints stock | 1/2 green bell pepper, sliced | 1 pint double cream
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan with a tight fitting lid, combine the stock and water.  Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 1/4 hours, or until most of the liquid has reduced by half.  Stir in pepper and cream, then serve.

title: Cheesy Spinach Beans
ingredients: 6 ounces beans | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon mustard | 2 ounces cheese, grated

title: Perfect French Toast

title: Coconut Cauliflower (Sweet Potato) Salad

instructions: Place beef and 2/3 cup jello in a crockpot.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours, or on high for 3 - 4 hours.

instructions: Place crescent roll dough on a floured surface and roll dough until 1/8 inch thick.  Using a 3 inch round cutter, cut out as many circles as possible from scraps. Starting with a long side, roll up long side of the dough and jelly roll fashion.  Seal with a fork.  Repeat process to make two 3 rolled up dough rolls.  Place roll onto a baking sheet and keep in a warm place, covered with a clean towel, until ready to cook.  Place the 3 rolls into a preheated 350 degree oven for 20 - 25 minutes.  Remove, drizzle with desired amount of sauce and serve.

title: Anchovy & Coconut Baked Chips

Sprinkle with the coconut extract & dip the fingers in it.  Store them for up to 1 week in the fridge.  Variation, use canned tuna.

title: Grilled Sirloin Beef Burger

title: Kidney Bean Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 1 package kidney beans | peach, sliced, canned | 8 ounces deli turkey, sliced | 1 egg substitute | fresh tarragon leaves
instructions: Set oven to 325°f.  Place the bean beans, sliced pepper, turkey and egg substitute in bowl.  In greased 8 x 8 baking dish, layer 1/3 of the bean mixture, bean mix, the rest of the bean mixture and top with remaining 1/3 of bean mixture.  Sprinkle with fresh tarragon leaves.  Cover with foil and bake until puffed, about 1 hour.

title: Ancho Chili Oil

instructions: Pour oil into a small saucepan and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 1 - 2 minutes.  Poke holes several times with a long skewer or knitting needle.  Stir in chives.  Cool and refrigerate.

title: Apple Bacon and Raisin Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients: 1 can apple pie filling | 4 slices bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup golden raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Grease the bottom and sides of an 8 inch pie dish.  Open the can of apple pie filling onto the bottom of the prepared dish.  Place one piece of bacon atop the pie filling to hold in place.  Spread peanut butter into the dish.  Sprinkle raisins over the peanut butter.  Spread peanut butter over the raisins and bacon.  Do the same with remaining pie filling.  Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Beef & Grape Tomatoes on Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin | 2 1/2 teaspoons potato starch ( corn starch ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 pint grape tomatoes
instructions: Cut beef into bite sized pieces.  Cut tomatoes into chunks, if desired.  Place sugar and vinegar in a bowl and put in to microwave for 1 minute.  Add salt& pepper to taste. instructions: Soak the barley, corn oil and the gelatin in 10 cups boiling water for a few minutes until dissolved.  Rinse the swiss chard and slice crossways into very thin slices.  Chop coarsely into ¼ inch dice.  Combine the rice with the peanuts in a blender, or a food processor and process until smooth.  Place in a bowl and add the cream, stirring until smooth and thickened.  Add the saffron and set aside overnight to set.  Serve in the refrigerator.

title: Blueberry-Date Jam

instructions: Put the blueberries in a pan with the dates and cook gently over a low heat for about 15 minutes, stirring so that the whole mixture doesn't stick to the pan. Return to a medium flameproof dish.  Pour the warm mixture into a sterilized jar, seal with a tight fitting lid, and leave the jam for several hours, but ideally overnight.  After several hours or overnight you can stir the jam well to smooth it out and use as required.  Store at room temperature in an airtight tin for up to 3 weeks.  If a jam starts to make a lot of liquid just skim off the excess before it has dried. title: Beef, Jicama and Horseradish Rollups

title: Homemade Turkey Lard
ingredients: 2 bags of regular lard | 2 cans turkey broth | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Boil turkey broth for 10 minutes.  Then stir the turkey and the sugar in a non stick pot over medium heat until the sugar dissolves.  Turn off heat and let it rest for a few minutes.  Pour the heated broth mixture into a large tub of cheesecloth lined with a very thin layer of grease proof paper.  Roll the lard from the tub in the warm lard and tie securely with cotton string or twine.  Let any extra fat drain out of the cheesecloth until it reaches 1 inch.  Wipe out the pot and place over medium heat.  When it's hot, put 2 tablespoons of the turkey fat in the hot fat and let it melt, stirring occasionally.  This is what gives it that pinky color.  It takes about 5 to 10 minutes for the fat to begin separating.  Turn the skillet off but still leave the fat in the skillet.  Put the cheese cloth into the empty pan and add the turkey broth.  Turn the burner to medium high and let the gravy bubble like crazy until the fat starts to separate.  When the broth comes to a boil, turn heat back down to a simmer.  Remove the cheese cloth from the skillet, but leave as much juice on the bottom of the skillet as possible.  Turn the burner back on but leave as much gravy behind as possible.  Let the remaining gravy bubble until thickens, 10 to 15 minutes.  If you want a thicker sauce, stir in 1 teaspoon cornstarch dissolved in a tablespoon of water before adding it.  Serve over pasta and enjoy.

Cover with foil if meat appears to wet.  Allow meat to stand 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, peel and slice onion.  Place onion on serving platter and slice meat off the bone.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,raspberry jam,phyllo pastry,garlic,grape tomato,beef,squash,cardamom pod
title: Moroccan Party Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 grape tomatoes, sliced | 1/4 cup raspberry jam | 4 packages frozen miniature phyllo pastry sheets | 1 jar grape-sized raspberries in heavy syrup | 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef in a skillet over medium heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes.  Drain.  Dissolve cardamom in the beef mixture.  Stir sliced tomatoes, raspberry jam, and bouillon cube into the skillet.  Cook and stir until heated through, about 5 minutes.  Cut phyllo sheets into 1x1 inch strips.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place a portion of cheese filling onto the center of each phyllo strip.  Cover cheese with a layer of the raspberries and pinch sides together to seal.  Place triangles on a baking sheet, and brush with beaten egg.  Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,white rice,swiss cheese,cayenne pepper sauce
title: Crispy Rice
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups white rice | 1 jar cayenne pepper sauce ( or more to taste -- i use the hot pepper sauce ) | 3 cups shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Coat a jelly roll pan with cooking spray.  Place rice in a 3 cup measuring cup.

Random Ingredients: savory,spaghetti noodle,beef rib roast,simple syrup,port wine,chipotle chile adobo,penne,vermicelli
title: Chipotle Beef Rib Roast
ingredients:
2 -3 lbs beef short ribs or 2 -3 lbs beef chuck roast | 1 package uncooked penne, i prefer spiral style but any pasta will do.
    - | 1 jar vermicelli ( or fideo if you prefer ) | 1 cup port wine | 12 ounces chipotle chiles in adobo, canned | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon savory, depending on how spicy you want it | 1 -2 cup simple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and grease a large, deep roasting pan.  Cut meat into thin long thin slices, about 1/2 inch thick and about the size of the tortilla strip and length the length of a regular tortilla strip.  You have 8 thin slices from all the beef.  Place meat slices in a flat dish and place in oven.  Roast at 350 degrees until the internal temperature reaches 120 degrees, about 40 minutes.  The meat should be lightly browned, but not cooked as this will toughen your crockpot.  Cook the pasta according to directions on the package, drain.  Meanwhile, in a deep frying pan, heat the chipotle peppers and their adobo sauce in the port until the pepper is fragrant and the chilies are soft.  Add the cooked and drained pasta and stir to mix well.  Drain meat slice well on paper towels.  Drain excess liquid from the pan.  Using two forks, separate the strips of meat from the pasta and set aside.  In a small bowl or cup, stir together the simple syrup and sour cream.  Pour over the meat slices, tossing well to coat evenly and adding a few slices of the vermicelli to the end if the pasta is sticking together.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,rye bread,bouquet garni,white vinegar
title: Traditional Cornichon (French Crusty Rye Bread Salad )
ingredients: 1 lb rye bread, sliced thick | 6 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon bouquet garni ( thyme-flour mixed )
instructions: Cut the rye bread through the middle in half and cut each half into 1/4 thick slices.  Cut the two slices in half again and cut the pieces into thin shreds.  Transfer the bread to a baking sheet.  Mix the vinegar, vinegar and bouquet garni in a large bowl.  Pour the dressing over the bread shreds, then toss to mix evenly.  Spread the bread mixture evenly among 4 plates.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,italian sausage,button mushroom,spring onion,alfredo sauce mix
title: Baked Sausage and Garlic Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package sausages | 8 button mushrooms | 1 package arugula sauce mix ( ragu bolognese ) | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 spring onions, sliced
instructions: Cut sausage in half lengthwise, and then slice into 1/4 inch rounds.  Heat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lay sausage on a baking sheet, lightly sprinkle with cocoa, and bake 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, slice mushrooms, and place in a small bowl.  Place drained sausage onto a baking sheet, and roast in oven for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.  Meanwhile, combine spaghetti sauce mix, cooked mushrooms, and spring onions in a medium size mixing bowl.  Spray a 10x15 baking dish with vegetable oil spray, and pour the spaghetti sauce mixture into the baking dish.

title: Wasabi Pesto Shells
ingredients: 1 package of thin tube-shaped isabi paste | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 bell pepper, seeded | 1/4 cup chopped toasted pine nuts | 10 precooked tart shells
instructions: Toast the pine nuts slightly, but not too lightly.  Spread a small amount of ketchup on the bottom of the prepared tart shell.  Top with a small amount of pesto.  Then layer with the bell pepper, sprinkle generously with the toasted pine nuts, and pour over a little more ketchup, if desired.  Sprinkle the top with more ketchup, if desired.  Bake at 325of according to package directions, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,wine,graham cracker crumb,cheddar,egg white,mussel,lite olive oil
title: Mussels & Cheese With Ra el Hanout
ingredients: 2 lbs mussels, scrubbed, debearded and rinsed well ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup ras el hanout spice mix | 3 1/3 cups dry wine ( i used a combination of sweet and dry red burgundy, blush or bordeaux ) | 1 tablespoon lite olive oil or 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1 large beaten egg white | 1/3 cup graham cracker crumbs or 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese | 3/4 cup grated cheddar
instructions: Place the mussels in boiling water and cook for 3 minutes or until just cooked through.  Scrub under running water just enough to pull out any beards.  Place in a large bowl and cover with cold water.  Refrigerate for 30 minutes or until cold.  Remove and discard any beards or which have cracked shells. .  If using dry wine, deglaze with 2 tablespoons of the wine and let reduce just a bit, about 1/2 hour stirring often, until the liquid has reduced by half.  Heat the oil in a 10 inch skillet over medium heat.  Add the bread and crumbs and saute for 2 minutes or until golden.  Add the cheese and stir well until melted.  Toss with the mussels and coat well with the cheese sauce.  Serve with a green salad.

title: Chipotle Raisin Salad
ingredients: 2 cups sultana raisins | 1 chipotle powder ( or fresh ) | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 3 tablespoons sultana raisin | 2 tablespoons roasted pistachios
instructions: Drain the raisins and place them in a small saucepan.  Add the chipotle powder or chipotle pepper, a splash of vinegar and the white vinegar over the raisins, cover and bring the mixture to a boil.  Once the mixture reaches boiling point, lower the heat to a simmer and allow the mixture to simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.  Remove from the heat and stir in the sultanas and pistachios.  Taste to adjust seasonings and serve straight away.

title: Mushroom and Spinach Pie
ingredients: 1 kg button mushroom ( assorted mushrooms, such as oyster, oyster, and or shiitake ) | 150 g gruyere cheese, grated | 150 g baby spinach | 1 medium cucumber, peeled, chopped | 8 teaspoons white flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat the gas grill to medium high.  Place the mushrooms in a microwave safe dish and cover with aluminium foil.  Cook in the microwave on high for 4 minutes, turning halfway through.  The mushrooms should have some crunch left.  Leave to cool.  Scrub the mushrooms with a damp paper towel.  Chop the spinach leaves.

Random Ingredients: vermouth,golden syrup,salt black pepper,italian turkey sausage
title: Italian Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1/4 cup vermouth | 2 tablespoons sweet vermouth | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 12 ounces hot italian turkey sausage | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the vermouth, sugar syrup and hot italian sausage.  Cover.

title: Italian Bread
ingredients:
3 1/2 cups dry roasted deli style bread ( about 1.
    -5 pounds total ), room temperature | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl combine bread ingredients.  Mix well with a wooden spoon or dough hook fitted with dough hook.  Cover and let stand 2 hours at room temperature.  Drain off bread liquid and discard.  Turn dough onto floured surface and knead well for about 3 or 4 minutes.  Lightly oil a large round baking dish well.  Place bread in baking dish and turn to cover the top with oil.  Cover with plastic wrap or a clean cloth and let stand, in a warm place, 1 hour or until bread is brown and dough is bubbly.  Using the tines of a fork gently press dough evenly into hot dish.  Place baking dish on a cookie sheet and leave at least 5 inches of oil underneath.  In a small bowl place parsley leaves and stir together.  Sprinkle evenly over bread.  Place under broiler until golden and bubbly, about 5 minutes.

title: Fried Rye Crisp
ingredients: 4 cups sifted rye flour | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Add all ingredients into a bowl and mix thoroughly.  Wet your hands and divide dough into 8 pieces.  Roll into balls.  Heat a frying pan with a few drops of oil on medium and fry the crisps on all sides.  Drain on kitchen paper and serve.

title: Tropical Nuts
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups pitted black olives | 1 1/2 cups mango powder
instructions: Wash and core the olives.  Cut into smaller pieces with a knife.  Put into a bowl.  Sprinkle the mango powder over the olives, and mix thoroughly.  Store in air tight container.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,yellow pepper,oxtail,olive,lemon pepper,arborio rice
title: Oxtail risotto
ingredients: 2 pounds oxtails | 1/4 cup olive, preferably kalamata | 1/4 cup finely chopped orange bell pepper | 1/4 cup finely chopped yellow peppers | 1/4 cup grated oxtail | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon arborio rice
instructions: In a large stockpot, combine the oxtails and enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 90 minutes, skimming any foam that rises.  Meanwhile, combine the olive, bell pepper, and oxtail peices.  In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper and arugula.  Drain the oxtails and vegetables.  In a pot, bring 3 cups water and 1 tablespoon oil to a boil over high heat.  While the water boils, add the rice and stir.  Stir once or twice while the water returns to a boil.  When the water comes to a boil, reduce the heat to low.  Cover and simmer until the oxtails are tender and the rice is tender but firm, about 20 minutes.  After 15 minutes, transfer the oxtails and vegetables to a large bowl and mix with the lemon pepper and arugula.

title: Chile Poblano
ingredients: 1 poblano chile | 1 onion salt or 1 large onion, sliced | 1/3 teaspoon chili pepper
instructions: Cut off the top 1/4´´´ off the chile.  Remove seeds as you would for an anaheims or you will use the chile elsewhere, cut chile in half, removing seeds.  Cut off the top 1/4´ off the chile.  Place chile on a plate, cover and microwave on high for 10 minutes.  Turn chile over and microwave on high for 20 - 25 minutes or until the skin has blackened and is soft.  Remove chile and allow it to cool.  Skin the chile and remove the flesh.  Roughly chop the flesh.  Mix the chile with the remaining marinade in a medium bowl or food processor.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.  Use to baste the chile while grilling.  Alternatively, if using a blender, combine all the ingredients in a food processor.  Process for 40 seconds or until chopped, but not pureed.  Set aside to chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: extra wide egg noodle,worcestershire sauce,red sauce
title: Quick and Easy Red Sauce
ingredients: 3 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 3 teaspoons red hot sauce | 1 package extra wide egg noodles
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender.  Drain.  Rinse with cold water, drain.  Combine worcestershire sauce and red hot sauce.  Pour over cooked noodles.  Serve hot.

title: Melt-Over Burritos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons milk chocolate ( i use maxwell house ) | 10 flour tortillas | 2 teaspoons msg, optional but i don't recommend it
instructions: Lightly coat the bottom of a heavy skillet with nonstick cooking spray.  Place a large spoonful of warm milk chocolate onto the center of each tortilla and roll up.  Place the burritos seam side down in the skillet.  Allow the excess liquid to drain away before adding remaining milk choclate.  Sprinkle with msg, if desired.  Cook the burritos until the tortillas have lightly browned on the outside and start softening in the middle.  Serve immediately, and if desired, top with a drizzle of unsweetened cocoa powder.  Yummy eat hot/cold.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,catsup,spinach leaf,red food coloring,gruyere cheese,key lime juice,graham cracker crumb,mint sprig
title: Spinach Daiquiri Roll Ups
ingredients: 8 fresh spinach leaves | 2 key limes, juice of | 1 1/2 - 2 cups gruyere cheese or 1 1/2-2 cups fontina cheese, shredded | 1 -2 teaspoon garam masala | 3 drops red food coloring | 1 carton dry graham cracker crumbs | fresh mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: Chop spinach very fine, making sure to include some of the water.  Mash the leaves with the key lime juice in a bowl while still mixing and getting the juice into the bowl.  You don't want the juice to be entirely absorbed, but rather get some of the juice out of it.  Place the spinach and cheese in a bowl and gently mix.  Add one teaspoon garam masala and food coloring to the cheese mixture.  Mix well.  Mix in graham cracker crumbs.  Add more garam masala or a few drops of food coloring if desired.  Shape into 1 1/2 to 2 inch diameter balls roll in graham cracker crumbs, then dip into mint leaves.  Allow to sit on the counter for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Dal in Cream
ingredients: 1 cup toor dal, washed and soaked for 20 minutes | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons olive oil ( to taste )
instructions: Cook the soaked and dal gently until soft but not mushy.  Drain in a cheese cloth and reserve.  Pour cream into a saucepan.  Heat the cream over high heat.  When it begins to boil, add the drained dal, stirring very gently.  Then add the olive oil.  Cover and cook over low heat until the cream is absorbed.  Season, to taste.  Serve hot.  Makes 4 servings.

title: Cherry Snacks
ingredients: 1 lb small cherry | 2/3 cup rice, uncooked | 4 ounces dried rice or 4 ounces vermicelli, soaked in hot water for 10 minutes
instructions: Boil the cherries, with 2/3 cup water, in the pot until soft, about 15 minutes.  Dissolve 2/3 cup of rice into the cherry juice and let this sit until the cherries have soaked up all the juice, about 10 minutes.  Drain the cherries and place in a bowl.  Sprinkle the remaining 1/3 cup of rice over the cherries and let them sit, covered, while you cook the remaining rice.  When ready to serve, spread the rice in a cone shape on a tray.  Add the cherry mixture in the center of the rice cone and spread out to cover the entire tray.  Make a circular patty by moistening the edges of the wrap with about 2 - 3 tablespoons of olive oil.  Put the stuffed cherry into the center.  Wet your fingers again if necessary and press the sides together to seal it tightly around the cherry.  Sprinkle the remaining 1/3 cup of rice over the stuffed cherries and bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 - 40 minutes, basting once or twice.

Random Ingredients: green onion,corn tortilla chip,ladyfinger,red delicious apple,dijon mustard,celery rib
title: Apple Charlotte
ingredients: 1 large red delicious apple, cored and diced | 1 small celery rib, diced | 1 tablespoon chopped green onion | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 package soft corn tortilla chips | 1 ounce soft ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a small bowl, mix together the apples, celery, sliced green onions, dijon mustard and crunched tortilla chips.  Spread onto a parchment lined baking sheet.  Bake for 13 - 15 minutes or until edges are golden brown.  Remove from oven and scatter ladyfingers over the hot apple mixture.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,turkey carcass,green pepper,napa cabbage
title: Roasted Nappa Slaw
ingredients: 2 lbs napa cabbage, shredded | 1 green pepper, cut into thin strips | 12 ounces turkey carcass | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  In a large bowl, toss together the cabbage, green pepper and turkey carcass.  Toss the mixture until it is coated in the vinegar.  Place in a roasting pan and roast for 15 minutes.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,yukon gold potato,shiitake mushroom,sesame seed
title: Potato Kebabs With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled, halved lengthwise ( about 1 large or 2 medium ) | 1 cup shiitake mushroom, stems removed ( about 1 1/3 cups ) | 1 cup corn kernel ( can be frozen or canned, drained ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds
instructions: Cut peeled potatoes lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Place potato in a colander and lightly sprinkle potatoes with salt.  Let sit for about 10 minutes.  Rinse with cold water and pat dry with paper towels.  Set aside.  Remove potato slices from colander and pat dry again.  Cut each shiitake mushroom in half lengthwise.  Place sliced mushrooms in a bowl.  Add 1/2 cup water and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt to potatoes.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,almond paste,water,hot water,yellow onion,active yeast,lemongrass
title: Molho Bread (Thai Cheese Bread)
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast, with active dry yeast | 2/3 cup hot water | 1 1/4 cups warm water | 3/4 cup yellow onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons lemongrass, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons slivered almonds, toasted | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: In a medium size bowl, stir together the yeast and hot water.  Let sit about 10 minutes, until foamy.  Stir in the onion, lemongrass and almonds.  Stir in the cheese.  Then stir in the lukewarm liquid, a little at a time, until you have a sticky consistency.

title: Homemade Oatcakes
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 cup oatmeal ( old-fashioned )
instructions: Put all ingredients into a bowl and mix well.  Cover with plastic wrap and set aside to rest for 10 - 15 minutes before cooking.  The texture of the dough will vary, so you may need to use your hands to rub the dough to achieve an even texture before proceeding with recipe.  I've found that a cookie press with a rolling pin can also work better.  Heat a flat griddle or large frying pan over medium high heat.  When the griddle is hot, form the dough into balls about 2 1/2 by 3 inches in diameter.  Flatten the ones slightly with the bottom of a drinking glass.  Put a few teaspoons per cookie at a time onto the griddle.  Cook each side for about 5 minutes or until lightly browned.  Serve immediately with jam, honey or fruit preserves.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,spice essence,pork tenderloin,cornflour,chili pepper,coriander,coconut milk,kidney bean
title: Tia Juli's Chilli Pork
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon chili pepper | 750 g pork tenderloin, cubed | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 can coconut milk | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1/4 teaspoon spice essence
instructions: Mix coriander, cumin and chili pepper in a bowl.  Coat pork cubes in maroc mixture.  Heat coconut milk in a pan on the stove.  Add pork and cover.  Simmer for 30 minutes.  Stir in sugar, spice essence and coriander.  Serve with rice.

title: Baked Steak and Macaroni in the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, trimmed of fat | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill seed | 2 cups elbow macaroni, uncooked | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place steak in slow cooker.  Sprinkle with flour, dill seeds and 1 cup of water.  Cover and cook on low 4 to 5 hours, or until steak is cooked and water has evaporated and mixture is thickened.  Stir in the pasta and 1 cup of water.  Cover and cook on high 10 to 15 minutes, until pasta is tender.  Stir in the cilantro before serving.  Tip, stir in fresh cilantro for a spicier, spicier and spicier dish.

title: Mader's Napa Cabbage
ingredients: 1 cup shredded head napa cabbage | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 can almond paste ( almond spread, not condensed ) | 1 -2 cup frozen peas ( optional ) | 1/4 cup jalapeno pepper ( minced if desired )
instructions: In a deep fryer or large saucepan melt margarine till light.  Place cabbage in the fryer and fry till light brown and firm to touch.  In the meantime, mix almond spread with 1 cup of warm water and set aside to thaw.  Remove cabbage from oil by dipping the tip of a knife into it and scraping off the darker green outer bits.  Drain cabbage on paper towels and set aside.  Add sliced jalepeno peppers to the oil and cook till it starts to brown.  Drain cabbage on paper towels.  Pour almond spread, heated chilies, and chopped jalepeno into a large bowl.  Sauté peas a minute or two, then add to bowl.  Slice cabbage in half, removing tough edge.  Fill with the cabbage mixture, and top with additional jalepeno, peas, and almonds spread.  Serve immediately.

title: Red Curried Sweet Potato - Quick and Easy
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons mild hot sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 teaspoon english mustard | 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce
instructions: Peel sweet potatoes and cut into wedges.  Place in a microwave safe dish.  Cover with 2 cups of water and microwave on high for 6 minutes.  Remove from microwave and stir in curry paste, hot sauce, cumin, hot sauce, mustard, apple sauce and return to microwave.  Cook on high for 7 minutes or until potatoes are tender and sauce is slightly thickened.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Healthy Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 300 g dried rice noodles | 2 tablespoons oatmeal ( see notes ) | thyme ( see notes )
instructions: Place the oatmeal and thyme in a bowl and crumble it over the noodles.  Break up the noodles with a fork and pour over boiling water.  Leave for 10 minutes and then drain completely, tossing the salad a bit to make sure it gets all the flavours.  Stir in salt and pepper and mix through.  Notes.  The more you eat, the spicier the salad.  Dont eat the noodles until lunchtime.

title: Minted Herbs (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1 )
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups ground mint leaves | 3 fresh thyme sprigs | 6 cardamom, lightly crushed
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and, using your hands, mix them together.  If they are too dry, a pinch of kosher salt may just be visible.  Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: mint,basmati rice,sushi rice,chili powder,vanilla bean,halibut fillet,active yeast
title: Pacific Rim Steamed Fish
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups sushi rice ( prepared ) or 1 2/3 cups arborio rice, cold | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 1/4 cups warm, divided | 1 cup basmati rice, unseasoned | 2 small halibut fillets or 2 small sirloin steaks, 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick, cut into 1-inch wide pieces | 1 chili powder | 1 small vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Dissolve yeast into 1/4 cup warm water in a large bowl, then stir in rice, then set aside to proof until foamy, 10 to 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat 1 cup of the warm water with the yeast mixture until it begins to foam.  Set aside.  Meanwhile, put rice in a large bowl.  Pour yeast mixture and remaining warm water into the rice.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,harissa,irish whiskey,penne rigate,thai green chili,romano cheese,fish fillet,yogurt
title: Fish With Whiskey and Crispy Pasta With Wilted Fresh Strawberry
ingredients:
1 cup loosely packed and roughly crushed fresh strawberries | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 2 lbs romano cheese, finely grated | 4 1/2 - 5 lbs fish fillets | 2 tablespoons fish sauce or 2 tablespoons harissa | 1 bunch fresh thai green chili, stemmed ( seeded if desired ) | 0.
    -5 package penne rigate
instructions: Marinate the strawberries in the whiskey overnight.  The next day, coarsely chop the romano and place in a bowl.  Mix in the yogurt, cheese, and half of the chopped chilies. Dunk the cooked fish in the sauce, add it to the pasta, and stir to coat everything.  Serve hot or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,spaghettini,cane sugar,shiitake mushroom,fast rise yeast,lime wedge,egg noodle
title: Chinese Chow Mein With a Spam
ingredients: 1 package frozen egg noodles | 1 package fleischmann's fast rise yeast | 1 1/2 cups dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup unbleached cane sugar | 4 1/2 - 5 cups unbleached cane sugar | 1/2 lb fresh shiitake mushroom, sliced | fresh lime wedge ( for garnish )
instructions: Boil noodles until al dente then drain noodles well.  Meanwhile, in a large bowl combine yeast, soy sauce, 1/2 cup sugar, and 2 1/2 cups water. Sterilize muffin cups and dust with 1/2 cup sugar.  Pour noodles into muffin cups, about 3 cups full.  Bake for 15 minutes or until light brown.  Top with remaining sugar and lime wedges and serve.  Note, these can also be baked in a deep fryer according to directions on package.  Cook time is short since the yeast yeast is bubbly, and it is hard to mess with.  Note, if you like a thicker syrup, add sugar to your syrup.

title: Spicy Pear and Green Chile Curry
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon green chili pepper, sliced | 3 green cardamom pods, split | 6 tablespoons half-and-half | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet plum sauce ( see note ) | 2 2 cups diced pears or 2 cups pears, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( about 6 cups if smaller ) | 1 tablespoon chili oil ( see note ) ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: To make curry, heat green chili pepper, cardamom, and half & half in medium saucepan over medium low heat, stirring occasionally, until warm.

title: Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/3 cup grand marnier
instructions: Drain raisins, reserving the raisins.  In a 1 1/2 quart saucepan heat the sherry and grand marnier or beef consomme.  Bring to a boil.  Add reserved raisins.  Cook 5 minutes or until heated through.

title: Chili Black Beans

instructions: In a bowl combine all ingredients and stir to combine.  Pour into ice water glasses.

ingredients: 2 lbs country-style ribs | 6 egg yolks | 1 jar alfredo sauce | water-packed artichoke hearts
instructions: In a large pot, bring 4 quarts of water to a boil.  Add ribs, reduce heat, and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for 40 to 60 minutes or until tender and easily pierced with a skewer.  Drain, then place in a large bowl.  Place egg yolks in a medium bowl.

title: Basic Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints white sugar | 3 tablespoons hot sauce
instructions: Stir the sugar, hot sauce and hot sauce together in a skillet.  Cook to the desired consistency in the microwave, about 10 minutes.  Store in the refrigerator in a glass container.

title: Lentil Rice from Scratch
ingredients: 8 ounces dried lentils, rinsed | 8 ounces white wine | 8 ounces marinated artichoke hearts ( in water ) | 2 tablespoons chopped celery | 1 tablespoon freshly cracked black peppercorns | 6 -8 slices american cheese | 12 slices pepperoni, chopped | 14 ounces linguica sausage or 14 ounces other white sausage | 15 -20 sprigs fresh parsley, leaves cut into thin ribbons
instructions: Place lentils in large bowl, cover with cold water and let stand for 25 to 30 minutes.  Drain in a colander and rinse under running water until no resistance remains.  In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook lentils for 10 minutes or until tender.

title: Italian Sausages With Yellow Bell Pepper
ingredients: 1 lb bulk sweet italian sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 bag frozen french onion soup | 1 can tomato juice | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/2 cup chopped yellow bell pepper | 1 habanero pepper, stemmed seeded and finely chopped
instructions: In a 5 - 4 qt crockpot, stir pork sausage, 1 1/2 cans french onion soup, tomato juice, fish sauce, and chopped bell pepper.  Cover and cook on lo heat for 1 to 1 3/4 hours, or on hi heat for 7 to 8 hours.  Stir in habanero if using.

title: Caramelized Pearl Onions and Cabbage
ingredients: 4 spring onions or 2 spring onions, halved lengthwise | 1/4 cup pecans, chopped | 1 teaspoon thyme sprig | 1 small cabbage, crown cut into thick pieces
