title: Beef Short Ribs and Yellow Peas
ingredients: 4 boneless beef short ribs | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 1/2 cups frozen yellow pea, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Place the ribs in a 10x15 inch roasting pan.  Sprinkle the baking soda into a large resealable plastic bag.  Add the peas.  Reseal the bag, place the dish in the oven and cover.  Bake for 2 hours.  Remove the foil and flaky top layer of ribs and continue to bake until the sauce is thickens and pork is tender.

title: Mediterranean Summer Pizza
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust, cut into 4 rounds | 1 large cucumber, diced | 1 1/2 cups grape slices | 1 1/2 cups red wine, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Arrange the rounds of dough onto a pizza pan or cookie sheet, forming 4 circles out of the dough.  Place the cucumber on top of the dough, then sprinkle on 1 1/2 cups grape slices and 1 1/2 cups red wine.  Drizzle with the remaining wine.  Bake in the preheated oven, until the edges of the dough have begun to brown, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Hot and Sour Soup (Kao Tome)
ingredients: 12 cups low sodium chicken broth | 4 medium shiitake mushrooms | 1 lb fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 medium jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 lb cooked shredded meat | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander leaves or 2 tablespoons cilantro
instructions: Put everything except the coriander and lettuce into a large soup or soup pot.  Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.  While the soup is simmering, grill the shiitake mushrooms in two or three batches on an ungreased griddle, about 5 minutes.  Place in a bowl with a slotted spoon and press lightly to extract as much liquid as possible.  Add the shiitake mushrooms and the coriander.  Simmer, covered, 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lamb loin chop,feta cheese,marjoram,vinegar,red chile,coffee crystal
title: Marinated Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 lamb loin chops ( or other tender, bone in chops, about 2 to 1/2 inches thick ) | 1/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup powdered marjoram | 1 tablespoon red chile, dried | 1/4 cup coffee crystals, soaked in 2 tbsp hot water ( optional ) | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Arrange chops in single layer on greased broiler rack.  Sprinkle with cheese, marjoram and chiles.  Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until meat is tender and chops are slightly charred.  Dissolve coffee crystals in vinegar and pour into the pan with the meat.  Bring to boil and boil 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,pecorino romano cheese,cream tartar,corn tortilla
title: Crunchy Cauliflower Wrap
ingredients: 2 small heads cauliflower, rinsed and well trimmed of thick stems | 8 warm corn tortillas, warmed | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pecorino-romano cheese blend | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar, or as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut a lengthwise slice off of the stem from the stem of each cauliflower head.  Wrap each head in a tortilla.  Secure with a toothpick, and arrange the wrapped cauliflower on a cookie sheet.  Bake cauliflower in the preheated oven until tender, about 30 minutes.  Let cool to room temperature, then remove the toothpicks, and slice crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Divide cauliflower among warmed tortillas.  Sprinkle with cheese, and drizzle with cream of tartar.  Roll up, and enjoy.

title: Hot and Spicy Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 4 slices swiss cheese ( i've made the sandwich with other swiss cheese also ) | 2 tablespoons chili paste ( or cayenne pepper ) | 2 tablespoons sauce ( see my note below ) | 2 tablespoons chopped red bell peppers
instructions: Spray 9x13 dish with cooking spray.  In 2 to 3 batches, arrange cheese to cover the bottom of the dish.  Spread chili paste to cover the cheese.  Top with red bell pepper.  Pour sauce over all and cover the dish with aluminum foil.  Bake in a preheated 400f oven for 10 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.  Makes four 6 serving portions.

title: Sam's Smoked Salmon Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 pound salmon, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 cans garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1 jar barbeque sauce | 2 fresh jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 8 slices paper-thin rounds of paper
instructions: Place all ingredients except for shrimp in a large stock pot, and heat over low heat 20 minutes.  Remove shrimp from syrup, and cook with or without lid, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 5 to 10 minutes.  Serve on paper towels.

title: Oatmeal (Oatmeal) With Currants
ingredients: 200 g rolled oats | 300 g dried currants | 8 tablespoons shortening | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 cup red wine | 200 ml natural yoghurt | 1 tablespoon pickling spice
instructions: Put the rolled oats, currants, fat and spices in a pan and add just enough cold water to cover.  Bring to the boil and simmer until the liquid absorbed by the dry mixture starts to thicken.  Cover and leave to stand overnight if not using immediately.  To cook, bring the wine to the boil with the yoghurt and spice and stir to combine.  Cook for about 10 minutes then taste and adjust the seasoning.  To cook in a small pan, pour 3 - 4 teaspoons of the simmering liquid into the oat mixture and stir to combine with any dry ingredients.

title: Pastel De Frijoles (Pastel-Canned Bean Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups canned white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups canned cannellini beans | 1 1/2 cups canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed | pico de gallo ( optional )
instructions: Drain the beans, cover and place into a large bowl.  Add the undrained chickpeas.  Pour enough pico de gallo over both cans of beans to cover, but not more than 1/4 cup.  Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,green chili pepper,chunky salsa,cream cheese,rotel tomato,chickpea
title: Green Chile Dip With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1 can chopped green chili peppers | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Combine cream cheese, chickpeas, rotel tomatoes, chilis, and salsa in a blender.  Cover and blend on high speed for 1 minute.  Slowly pour into slow cooker, cover and turn slow cooker on high.  Cook for about 4 hours, or until dip is bubbly and velvety thick and chickpeas are tender.  If you have a stand mixer with a paddle attachment, combine cream cheese mixture with a stand mixer at low speed, scraping down the sides, until smooth.  Use immediately in tacos, burritos, or on sourdough bread.

title: Roasted Whole Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole whole chicken | 1 -2 teaspoon horseradish | 1 tablespoon low sodium chicken bouillon
instructions: Place chicken in a small pot of well salted boiling water.  Place on a stove and bring to a boil.  Turn the water down to a steady simmer.  Place the chicken in a plastic bag to keep warm while making the rest of the meal.  When the chicken is tender, remove the chicken from the bag and discard the bag.  Shake the bag to coat it evenly.  Place on a rack in the oven and roast at 375 until cooked, about 45 minutes.  Check when the internal temperature reaches 170 degrees.  While the chicken is still warm, rub salt and dried herbs into the chicken.  When cool enough to handle, carve, and serve with a fresh green salad.

Random Ingredients: italian meatball,tamarind paste,non dairy coffee creamer
title: Tamarind Balls
ingredients: 1 package non-dairy coffee creamer, chilled beverages ( such as eggland's homemade melted cheese ) | 1 jar tamarind paste | 1 package frozen italian-style meatballs
instructions: Pour the chilled beverage into the freezer.  In a small bowl, blend the tamarind concentrate with a little water until well blended.  Place the frozen meatballs into the freezer until ready to make the balls.  Once the frozen meatballs have cooled, break into cubes and toss with the tamarind concentrate and hot water.  Serve in a bowl with a sprinkling of crushed espresso powder or other decorative candies.

title: Cranberry Tea
ingredients: 1 teaspoon scotch bonnet pepper, finely minced | 1/2 cup cranberries, chopped | 1 teaspoon sherry wine or 1 teaspoon sherry cream
instructions: Mix everything together.  Simmer gently for 2 - 3 minutes, or until berries start to break down.  Stir and serve hot.

title: Baked Kabobs with Sumacoray and Saffron
ingredients: 1 pinch saffron | 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 medium summer squash, unpeeled
instructions: Light the oven to 400°.  Place 1/2 inch of the saffron on one end of a skewer, and place it on top of the saffron.  Sprinkle 2 - ½ inches of salt on the beef, and squeeze the meat to compact it.  Repeat with the squash.  Place half of the meat in the center of each skewer.  Close the top of the saffron with the other half of the meat.  Heat a large cast iron skillet or griddle over high heat for 2 minutes, and lightly brown the meat on all sides.  Turn and roast for an additional 25 minutes.  When almost done, remove the meat from the pan and place onto a rack set in a roasting pan.  Brush the exposed ends with a little of the oil.  Brush the surface with a little more oil and sprinkle with the remaining 1 - ½ teaspoons saffron.  Bake in a 400° oven for 45 minutes.  Serve the meat in small bowls, with the squash on the side.

title: Caribbean Bean and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package of udon noodles | 30 ounces canned black beans, rinsed and drained | 12 canned pineapple slices, drained | 1/2 cup raisins or 1/2 cup golden raisin | 6 -8 radishes, sliced | 1/2 cup green olives, sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon whiskey ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon allspice or 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water according to package directions.  While noodles are cooking, combine all the rest of the ingredients in a bowl.  Toss all together and sprinkle with additional raisins or golden raisins.  Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,rotel tomato chilies,cheddar cheese soup,sauce,beef eye,parmesan cheese,beef sirloin steak
title: Santa Fe Style Steak Skillet
ingredients: 3 lbs beef eye round, cut into 1 inch strips | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 can pinto beans in chili sauce | 1 can cheddar cheese soup | 4 -5 lbs pork shoulder, with bone, with bones | 2 -3 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: In a skillet, brown beef to desired doneness.  Drain off excess fat.  Place in 4 - 5 quart crock, or 4 6qt slow cooker.  In sauce pan heat tomatoes, peppers, and hot sauce.  Stir with meat.  Turn slow cooker on high for 1 hour.  Turn on low for 2 hours.  Remove meat and vegetables from crock.  Cover and cook for 3 hours or until done.  Serve over noodles, rice, or mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,fruit,orange juice,kosher salt black pepper,burrito flour tortilla,premade puff pastry,mustard,rice noodle
title: Beef Pho Burritos
ingredients:
1 package pre-made pho pkg.
    - puff pastry, thawed ( 3 sheets ) | 4 tablespoons orange juice, fresh | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 1/3 cup dried fruit, chopped | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 lb lean ground sirloin ( round or top round ) | 2 burrito-size flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Position rack in middle of oven and preheat to 425 degrees.  Prick each pastry sheet several times with a fork.  Place sheets on baking sheet, spaced evenly apart.  Bake until very lightly browned, about 12 to 15 minutes, turning once.  Remove from oven, cool slightly, and then cool completely.  Set aside.  Meanwhile, combine orange juice, sherry, mustard and cocoa in a medium bowl and mix well.  Stir in fruit and season with salt and pepper.  Set aside.  Meanwhile, coarsely crumble beef into a large heavy skillet over medium heat.  Cook, stirring until ground beef is no longer pink.  Add cooked meat and stir to combine.  Roll each tortilla in the flour and transfer to parchment paper towels to drain.  Working on a floured surface, roll out to a thickness of 1/8.  Using a round biscuit cutter, cut out 6 even rectangles.  Place about 3 tablespoons of meat mixture in the center of a rectangle the length of the tortilla.  Fold the sides of the tortilla over the meat and pinch all sides closed.  Fold right and left sides around the meat mixture, pinching closed.  Slightly wet your finger tips with water if desired, or lightly brush with eggwash.  Repeat with remaining dough and filling.  Place the filled tortillas on a nonstick baking sheet.  Brush the tops with egg wash, and bake until golden brown, about 20 minutes.  Transfer to a rack to cool.  Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,granny smith apple,red pepper,head cabbage
title: Apple and Red Pepper Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 2 tablespoons granny smith apples, grated | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes | 1/2 small head of cabbage, shredded | 1 medium red pepper, sliced
instructions: Combine the granny smith apples and red pepper flakes in a medium bowl, toss well.  Set aside.  On the outer layer of the outer cabbage leaf, place a thin layer of red pepper slices, then a thin layer of apple and pepper mixture.  Place the cabbage leaves in a steamer basket and steam for 2 - 3 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender crisp.

title: Honduran Berry Mix
ingredients: 4 cups cornflour | 8 cups wheat berries
instructions: Combine the cornflour with a little water and add to the wheat berries.  Mix together well.  Put into an air tight container and store in the fridge for upto 2 weeks.

title: Bean Sprouts & Colby Slice
ingredients: 100 g bean sprouts | 1/3 cup chopped onion | 1/2 cup chopped mixed peppers | 1/3 cup sliced radish | 1 1/2 cups colby or 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar | 8 cups water | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce
instructions: Place bean sprouts, onions, mixed peppers, radishes, water, teriyaki sauce & light soy sauce in a pan and bring to the boil.  Reduce heat & simmer for 5 mins or until vegetables are tender.  Serve over a bed of fresh salad or rice.

title: Panko Breadcrumbs (Japanese Bread)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon bacon fat
instructions: Mix all together and toast on pan or griddle.  May have to do this in 2 batches or more.

title: Broccoli Gratin With Gruyere
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli floret, trimmed | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  In a large pan of boiling water, cook broccoli until just tender, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pak choi,red currant jelly,taco seasoning,worcestershire sauce,masa harina,serrano chile pepper
title: Nacho Tacos
ingredients: 1 pound masa harina | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 serrano chile pepper, chopped | 1 package frozen fresh pak choi | 1 jar red currant jelly
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the masa harina, taco seasoning, and serrano.  Stuff the pak choi into the masa mixture until it's fully submerged.  Place on a lightly floured surface, and press together lightly.  Make a deep hole in the center, and stuff with jelly.  Roll up, and tie with kitchen twine.  Repeat with remaining stuffing and pak choi.

Random Ingredients: biscuit mix,blueberry,wheat pastry flour,maraschino cherry,russet potato,coconut cream,hazelnut
title: Biscuit Crush
ingredients: 600 g whole wheat pastry flour | 1 tablespoon baking mix | 1 cup canned sweetened coconut cream | 1 cup canned hazelnuts, chopped | 4 russet potatoes, boiled and grated | 250 g blueberries | maraschino cherry, for decorating
instructions: Put biscuit mix into a large bowl, add hazelnuts, potatoes and crème, tossing lightly in the mix to combine.  Mix in the coconut cream and knead for a few minutes.  You may need some flour to help work the dough if necessary.  Roll into a rectangle, about 18x12cm, on a lightly floured surface.  Cut into quarters.  Sprinkle a small, shallow crescent packet onto the surface of dough, place biscuits, spacing evenly, and press into the biscuits without cutting all the way through.  Paint the tray with flour.  Place 2 biscuits on top of each other on the tray and press gently down.  Bake in a moderately slow oven, for 35 to 40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Quick and Easy English Hamburger
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 3 tablespoons coarse grain mustard
instructions: Cook hamburger in a large pan using medium heat till it just starts to brown.  While cooking, mix mustard and coarse grain mustard until the meal mix.  Drain off fat when cooked.  I leave the beef in, because it should be well cooked if it doesn't have some on it.  I like to eat this with a spoonfull of salad, which is my favourite.

title: Vietnamese Basil Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/8 cup chopped fresh basil leaf | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/3 cup ice
instructions: Stir the dark soy sauce, chopped basil, and garam masala together in a bowl.

title: Taquito Queso
ingredients: 1/2 cup evaporated milk | 1/4 cup canned enchilada sauce | 2 ounces sliced green olives | 2 cups shredded swiss cheese
instructions: In a 2 quart casserole dish, combine evaporated milk and enchilada sauce.  Stir in green olives.  Top with swiss cheese.  Bake in a 350 degree f oven for about 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Spiced Sole
ingredients: 4 sole fillets | 1 teaspoon shrimp paste | 1 teaspoon spices | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Combine all ingredients and rub over fish.  Allow to marinate at least 6 hours.

title: Parmesan Cheese in the Microwave
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Sprinkle cheese on the top of a bread machine, and set to the dough setting.  Once a few drops of water sizzle, drop a tablespoon of the mustard onto a piece of bread.  When the bread stops sizzling, press the bread to make certain that it is coated evenly with the cheese, then the rest of the mustard.  Repeat until all the bread is used.  Let cool slightly before slicing.

title: Spinach and Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tapioca starch | 1 pound baby spinach leaves, rinsed and drained
instructions: Combine the tapioca starch and spinach in a large skillet over medium heat.  Stirring constantly, cook and stir until the spinach is wilted, 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: peach,spanish onion,mexican cheese,rose water,black pepper,mandarin orange,buttermilk
title: Mexican Peach Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces english or semi-boneless rusks, sliced crosswise in half | 1 1/2 pounds english-style peeled peaches, sliced, divided | 1/2 pound spanish-style peeled onions, sliced | 3 tablespoons buttermilk | freshly ground black pepper to taste | 1 teaspoon rose water | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Layer half the rusks on the large plate with the peaches, onions, and half of the buttermilk.  Sprinkle with pepper and rose water, and top with remaining rusks.  Top with remaining buttermilk.  Sprinkle with remaining pepper.  Serve topped with shredded cheese.

title: Grilled Dill Pickles
ingredients: 1 jar dill pickle chunks | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: Slice the pickles lengthwise into about 1/4 inches slices and put these into a plastic freezer bag.  Add the lime zest.  Close the bag and refrigerate for 6 hours, tossing 2 or 3 times.  Let the bag come to room temp before cooking to help catch the marinade.  Prepare a coals or gas grill for direct grilling on high heat.  When ready to cook, arrange the pickles in a grill basket with a lip, and grill about 3 minutes per side and then turn over.  Close the lid and grill for about 7 minutes.  Use tongs to transfer the pickles to a plate and serve.

title: Golden Capsicum
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 tablespoon finely chopped green capsicum
instructions: Combine golden syrup, turmeric and finely chopped capsicum.  Brush onto cutlets.  Refrigerate for 2 hours or better yet, overnight.  Serve with salads.

title: Graters American Cheese (for Grilling)
ingredients: 1 lb american cheese, diced | 1/3 cup candied lemon peel, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well.  Brush grill with oil.  Brush half of cheese mixture on hot grates.  Grill over medium low heat 12 minutes, or until cheese has melted.  Slice and serve with additional cheese.

title: Spicy Shrimp and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 medium russet potato, peeled and cut in half | 3 lbs raw shrimp | 3 tablespoons chives, snipped | 6 -10 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Boil potato in water for 5 minutes, then remove from heat.  Cool slightly, then cut into bite size pieces and place in large bowl or plastic ziplock bag.  Add shrimp and chives and toss to coat generously.  In a small bowl, combine tabasco sauce and 2 teaspoons hot water.  Shrimp mixture can be stored for up to 3 days in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: adobo sauce,corn flake,amaretto,caraway seed,water chestnut,ginger root,garlic
title: Ginger and Amaretto Spicy Chinese Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced water chestnuts | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced ginger root | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon amaretto | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely crushed corn flakes
instructions: In a cup, mix water chestnuts, ginger, garlic, amaretto, adobo sauce, caraway seed, and corn flakes.  Set aside 1/2 cup sauce.  Drain liquid from remaining 1/2 cup sauce.  Heat remaining water and reserved sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.  Mix in the noodles with reserved 1/2 cup sauce.  Cook and stir until heated through.

title: Italian Sausage and Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb meatball ( italian sausage ) | 1/2 lb italian sausage, cooked and chopped | 1/2 cup beef broth or 1/2 cup chicken broth
instructions: Cook sausage over medium heat until lightly browned, drain fat, set aside, drain fat from pan.  Return pan with meat to medium low heat and add broth.  Cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes, stirring frequently, meat will brown and you might want to add more broth if it sticks to bottom.  If you like, you might want to reduce the cooking time or the broth is too thick.  I don’t add salt as it will be salty.  Serve in a bowl sprinkled with parsley or mozzarella cheese.

title: Shrimp for Two
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs fresh clams ( with shells ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 10 cups salt water | 1/2 cup brandy ( optional )
instructions: Place the clams in a large pan that has the soda in them.  Add the water, bring to a boil, cover and leave in the water for five minutes, or until opened.  Discard the shells.  Pour off the shells and leave the clams in the liquid and reserve the liquid.  Discard the shells.  In a kettle, bring the clam juice just to a boil, then add the brandy and salt.  Lower the heat to very medium and stir well.  Boil for 5 minutes, or until it is reduced by half.  Turn off the heat, add the clams and leave for 15 minutes, or until the shrimp are done.

title: Apricot, Apricot and Cornflour Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sweet cornflour | 3/4 cup chopped dried apricot | 3/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Place the apricots and apricots in a pan with water.  Bring to the boil and simmer over a low heat for about 15 minutes or until the apricots are very tender.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,chicken soup base,red capsicum,orange wedge,bay seasoning tm,pumpkin seed,chocolate shaving
title: Pumpkin Seed Enchiladas
ingredients: 500 g pumpkin seeds | 2 tablespoons chicken soup base ( i use 2tbsp ) | 1 bay seasoning ( i use 1 teaspooon mccormick's ) | 1 cup red capsicum, finely diced ( i use frozen ) | 1/4 cup orange wedge | 1 can enchilada sauce | chocolate shavings
instructions: Using a small pan roast the seeds, pumpkin seeds, chicken soup base, bay seasoning, and small dice of capsicum until golden brown.  Once golden, set aside in a bowl.  Heat sauce and chill for two minutes.  Spoon 1 cup of mixture on to a warmed plate, place in freezer for 20 minutes.  Place the remaining mixture in bowl and roll up.  Serve on plate with chocolate shavings or other desired garnish.

title: Simple Watermelon Fries
ingredients: 1 cup cubed watermelon | 1 package lemon pepper seasoning
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the watermelon cubes into a bowl, and sprinkle lemon pepper over the top.  Cover, and place on the oven rack.  Bake in the preheated oven 40 to 45 minutes until tender.

title: Beef Roast
ingredients: 3 1/2 pounds boneless beef chuck roast | 1 can whole, fire-roasted tomatoes
instructions: Place chuck roast into a large skillet over medium heat.  Cook until evenly browned, about 10 minutes.  While the roast simmers, scrape out any browned bits from the skillet using a spatula.  Reserve 1/2 cup of the roast drippings left in the skillet.  Transfer the browned chuck roast to the skillet with the tomatoes.  Stir in reserved drippings to make a gravy.  Bring the roast to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered until meat is very tender, 3 to 3 1/2 hours.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the roast should read 140 degrees f.

title: Chicharrones (Porcupines)
ingredients: 1 package baking chocolate ( not salted ) | 2/3 pound dried shiitake mushrooms | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Heat a small skillet over medium low heat, and use a pastry brush to spread chocolate onto the pan.  Stir every few seconds until the chocolate is melted.  Remove from heat and sprinkle the shiitake mushrooms into the melted chocolate, allowing them to dry at room temperature for about 30 minutes.  Season with salt and pepper.  Roll each pineahead in the melted chocolate and serve.

Random Ingredients: heirloom tomato,cream mushroom soup,yellow squash,caster sugar,eggplant,chive,cayenne pepper
title: Heirloom Eggplant and Yellow Squash Bake
ingredients: 2 small yellow squash, sliced, deseeded | 400 g cream of mushroom soup, condensed | 1 pinch caster sugar | 1 dash ground cayenne pepper | 3 large heirloom tomatoes | 2 large eggplants, sliced | fresh chives, chopped, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius lightly grease a 10cm x 30cm oven proof baking dish with 1 tbs of butter.  Arrange half of the sliced squash onto the bottom of the dish.  Spread over half of the condensed soup, half the caster sugar and pinch of black pepper.  Arrange half of the eggplants over the top and cover with the rest of the soup then sprinkle over the rest of the sugar, cinnamon and chives.  Bake for 30 - 35 minutes or until golden & cooked.  Cool slightly before slicing into squares to serve.

title: Mock Chocolate Rice
ingredients: 1 bag frozen hash browns | 1 cup jasmine rice ( not quick cooking ) | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate | 1/2 cup walnut pieces | 1/2 cup dried chervil
instructions: Cook the rice according to pkg directions.  In a large bowl, mix rice, chocolate, walnuts and chervil with 4 cup of water.  Pour over rice mixture and mix well.  Pour into lightly greased baking dish and bake at 200 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden brown.  If your rice is to cold, it will continue to cook very quickly and if desired you may add a dash of sugar before baking or even an optional dash of baking cocoa and then sprinkle about 2 tbsp of cocoa powder on top.

title: Lebanese Traditional Seven-Spice Mix(For Lamb Kebabs)
ingredients: 4 cardamom seeds | 3 tablespoons sweet paprika
instructions: To crush the cardamom seeds.  Heat a cast iron skillet over moderately high heat.  While the skillet is warming up, remove the skillet from the heat.  Remove the cardamom pods from the skillet.  When the skillet is very hot, place a few cardamom pods at a time in the skillet.  Allow each cardami to crackle but before they begin to become aromatic, return the skillet to the burner.  As the kababs are toasted, add the paprika in small batches to the hot skillet and cook until nicely browned, about 2 minutes per side.  Remove the kababs from the skillet.  Raise the heat slightly to medium, and when it begins to smoke, add about a tablespoon of oil.  Scoop some of the kabab meat off the plate and set it on top of the meat.  Then, very quickly, invert the pieces of kabab back and forth, turning the pieces so the other sides get nicely browned.  This should leave you with about 5 kaberab meat per tablespoon of kabab meat, 6 or 7 kabab.  Serve right away, peshpati or cold from the refrigerator.

title: Easy Mambo-Mama
ingredients: 6 roma ( plum ) tomatoes - chopped | 1/2 bunch fresh fruit, cut in small pieces | 1/2 cup roasted unsalted peanuts, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, mix tomatoes, fruit and peanuts.  Serve warm as is or at room temperature.

title: Pistachio Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, split horizontally | 12 slices bacon | 1 cup unsalted pistachio nut | 1 package italian seasoning
instructions: In a 12 x 7/8 inch baking dish, fry 4 chicken breasts in a frypan of salted boiling water 4 minutes.  Flip chicken and continue cooking until crisp and chicken juices run clear.  Remove chicken from pan, drain.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,mascarpone cheese,cooking spray,golden syrup,beef brisket,chilies,allspice
title: Savoury Beef Brisket
ingredients: 8 ounces beef brisket ( about 5-4-inch thick ) | cooking spray | 6 ounces mascarpone cheese | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 small chilies ( seeded and chopped or use a mixture of both chillis ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Adjust oven rack to lowest position and preheat broiler.  Line a baking pan with foil.  Combine steak, cheese, syrup, chillies and baking soda in a small bowl.

title: Raspberry and Cherry Tomato Jam
ingredients: 1 kg fresh ripe raspberries | 1 1/2 liters boiling water | 400 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 75 g white corn syrup
instructions: Pit the raspberries clean, cut off the ends, and place in a medium sized pan.  Pour the boiling water over the raspberries, and leave to stand until tender.  Place the cherry tomatoes in a separate, clean pan, pour over the syrup, and cook over a low heat for 6 - 7 minutes.  Remove from the heat, and leave to cool completely.  Place the raspberries in a glass bottle or jar, and process with a hand held blender or food processor to form a smooth jam.  Return to the pan, pour in the raspberry liquid and chill in the fridge for at least 3 - 4 days.

title: Tartiflette II
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into strips | 2 pounds boneless pork loin, cut into small cubes | 4 potatoes, peeled and cut into slices | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Stir chicken, pork, and potatoes together in a large pot of salted boiling water until chicken and pork are completely covered, 7 to 10 minutes.  Add sugar, and let cook until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.  Stir chives into chicken mixture and serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,thyme leaf,chipotle chile,marsala wine,ancho chili,spice
title: Spiced Roasted Red Pepper Chiles
ingredients: 10 fresh ancho chili ( or 6 dried red chilie peppers or 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile ) | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs firm red peppers or 1 1/4-1 1/2 lbs sweet red peppers, membrane removed, seeded, and cut into 1/4-inch dice | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves, crushed | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained, patted dry, and chopped | 3/4 cup marsala wine or 3/4 cup dry white wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°f.  Pierce a 1/4 inch deep slit in one end of each chile.  Set aside for 20 minutes.  Rinse chiles and pat dry with paper towels.  Arrange chiles in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Toast chiles in middle of oven until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.  Transfer chiles to large heavy saucepan, drippings, and saute over moderate heat for about 5 minutes.  Add 1 teaspoon mixed spice, thyme, sun dried tomatoes, remaining 1 teaspoon mixed spice and marinara to chiles.  Continue cooking over low heat, stirring frequently, until mixture begins to bubble and the flavors have blended.  Simmer, stirring frequently for 20 - 25 minutes, until chiles are very tender and glaze is almost dry.  Season with salt and pepper.  Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,feta cheese,grain rice,curry,gruyere cheese,pernod
title: Pernod Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 3 tablespoons coarsely crumbled feta cheese | 2 tablespoons minced fresh pernod ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon pernod ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped dry speckled wild mustard greens ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon pernod ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the cheeses with the pernod until well blended.

Random Ingredients: red onion,poundcake,mirin,self rising flour,green bell pepper,mango chutney,clam juice,vegetable broth
title: Mango Chutney Crumble
ingredients: 1 poundcake, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 4 cups vegetable broth | 1 mango chutney | 1/2 red onion, diced | 1/2 green bell pepper, seeded and diced | 2 cans minced clams with juice | 2 cups self-rising flour | 1/4 cup mirin ( red cooking rice flour )
instructions: Place cake cubes in the bottom of a baking dish.  Combine the vegetable broth and mango chutney in a large saucepan.

title: Roasted Potatoes, Ham, and Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs small red potatoes, halved | 7/8 lb thin-sliced lamb | 6 ounces small white button mushrooms | 8 ounces thinly-sliced fresh porcini mushrooms, washed patted dry, wiped dry, and finely chopped | 8 ounces sliced lean deli ham | 8 ounces chopped porcini mushrooms | 1 ounce garlic, peeled and crushed | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f grease a 13 x 9 inch baking dish or an 8 x 8 inch casserole dish.  Place whole potatoes in a single layer, cut side up in dish, and spray with cooking spray.  Roast, uncovered, in middle of oven until golden, and let cool to warm in pan on rim.  While potatoes bake, place mushrooms, ham, and 1/4 cup of the porcini mushrooms in a small microwave safe bowl.  Cover and cook on high 4 to 5 minutes or until mushrooms are softened, stirring once.  Set aside.  When potatoes finish cooking, remove pot from oven and set aside on towel lined baking sheet.  Sprinkle with garlic.  Pour ham and mushroom mixture over potatoes.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake, uncovered, 30 to 40 minutes or until cheese is browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: manchego cheese,beef sirloin,yellow mustard,sea salt,chili pepper flake
title: Saucy Steak Rollups (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin | 1 tablespoon coarse sea salt | 1 tablespoon dried hot chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon yellow mustard | 1 cup manchego cheese, grated ( to taste )
instructions: Trim the fat from the top of the steak and cut off the membrane and slice into thin rectangular slices of equal thickness, about 1/4 inch wide.  Sprinkle the salt, chili flakes and mustard on the steak slices.  Spread the cheese over a thick layer of the beef and then roll up the steak like a cigar.  Secure with toothpicks or your finger tips.  In a large frying pan place a little oil on the surface and when it is heated, place the rolls in the pan.  Cook over high heat for 2 minutes, turning them once, until each side has a nice brown crust.  Serve at once with pasta such as rotelle with italian salatas on the side.

title: Poblano Chile Relish
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 large yellow onion, finely chopped
instructions: Chop the poblano pepper finely.  In food processor add chopped onion and process to desired consistency.  Chop mixture into small pieces and transfer to jar.  Store in clean jar.

title: Aromatic Semolina and Macaroni (Egyptian Macaroni)
ingredients: 3 cups macaroni | 1/4 cup tomato paste ( made with herbs and spices, i make mine with dijon and amore ) | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon chakihora herbs ( to taste ) or 1/2 teaspoon paprika ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon clove ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon molasses ( optional )
instructions: Cook macaroni according to pkg.  Directions.  Drain.  When cool enough to handle, break into small pieces.  Add tomato paste and saute' until very light brown.  Add sherry, and heat until it evaporates.  Add herbs and spices.  Pour over macaroni and mix.  Serve cold.  Note, if you are making it using other types of pasta, rather than elbows, the time is not as high, as it is for macaroni.

title: Chile Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 poblano chile, seeded and rinsed | 1 container nonfat plain yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro or 1/4 cup fresh parsley, if using, if using
instructions: Roast the poblano chile directly over a gas flame or under the broiler, turning as necessary, until blackened all over.  Place in a sealed metal pouch, close tightly and refrigerate for 30 minutes, or until softened.  Using a vegetable peeler, peel off the skin of the chile and discard.  Place the chile in a processor with the roasted poblano.  In a medium bowl combine the yogurt, chopped cilantro or parsley and salt.  Beat until smooth.  Stir in the chile until combined.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: butter,porcini mushroom,fish sauce,coconut milk,peach,worcestershire sauce,chicken broth,nonfat vanilla yogurt
title: Mushroom and Pepper Porcini Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh mushrooms | 1 tablespoon butter | 3 ounces creamed coconut milk | 6 ounces nonfat vanilla yogurt | 6 ounces condensed chicken broth | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 2 teaspoons dried porcini mushrooms ( optional )
instructions: Finely chop the porcini mushrooms and set aside.  Melt butter in a 4 quart dutch oven over medium to medium high heat.  Add porcini mushrooms.

title: Salami Appetizers and Tips
ingredients: 8 fresh salami | 12 -18 icing sugar or icing sugar, for coating
instructions: Using a small cookie cutters, cut salami into shapes and place on wax paper.  Ice with confectioner's sugar.  Keep in airtight container.

title: Easy Tofu Bake
ingredients: 2 cups extra firm tofu, drained and cubed | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 cup marinara sauce ( or tomato-tomato sauce ) | 1 cup roasted garlic and gingerroot, grated ( jarred or bought ) | 1 jar alfredo sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Butter a 9x9 baking dish and line with a couple of sheets of aluminum foil.  Toss cubed tofu with poultry seasoning on foil to coat.  Bake tofu for 20 minutes or until light brown and crispy.  Pour marinara sauce into a bowl.  Place tofu in bowl with marinara sauce, roasted garlic and ginger root.  Spoon tofu and marinara over some of the sauce and spread evenly across the dish.  Top with alfredo sauce.  If you like more sauce, you can add some fresh chopped parsley or celery to the top to a touch.

title: Shish Kebab
ingredients: 1/2 cup shish kabocha sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 cups rye flour | 1 cup light rye flour
instructions: Place ingredients into the shaker in small circular quantities on top of a trivet over simmering water.  Close lid securely and shake vigorously to thoroughly wash out the excess air.  Remove the lid.  Repeat with remaining ingredients.  The dough can be used immediately the next day, or refrigerate overnight to speed things up.

Random Ingredients: fig,bisquick,cream chicken soup,tofu,masa harina,havarti cheese,butter,grain rice
title: Baked Rice and Figs
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu, drained | 1 cup long grain rice, uncooked | 8 small chopped fresh figs | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 4 teaspoons masa harina or 4 teaspoons corn syrup | 2 teaspoons butter | 1/2 cup shredded havarti cheese or 1/2 cup provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Mix all ingredients.  Pour into lightly greased 8x8 or jelly roll pan.  Bake for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Sprinkle with cheese and bake an additional 10 minutes.  Bake an additional 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,cilantro leaf,ra el hanout spice mix,new mexico chile,ginger ale
title: Chilled Mexican Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin | 1/4 cup ginger ale | 1/4 cup ra el hanout spice mix | 1/4 cup new mexico chile, seeded | chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( to garnish, can also use green onion tops )
instructions: Marinate pork at least 4 hours, turning several times, in beer, olive oil, lemon, spices, and chiles in a ziplock bag.  Grill or broil until pork is medium rare and cooked through, about 20 minutes.  Garnish with cilantro.

title: Watermelon and Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup sweetened dill, chopped | 1/2 cup reduced-fat peanut butter | 1 cup dried chili beans, soaked overnight | 2 celery ribs, cut into 1 inch sticks | 1 whole cooked long-grain thin-cut watermelon | 3 ounces chopped smoked gouda cheese, separated | 2 tablespoons water
instructions: In a food processor, blend together the dill and peanut butter until smooth.  Stir in the beans, celery sticks and watermelon.  Season with black pepper.  Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with gouda and serve.

title: Lavender Cream Soda
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yeast | 1 teaspoon ground ginger juice | 16 ounces chocolate ice cream | 1/2 cup lovage | 1/2 cup celery | 3 cups light vanilla ice cream
instructions: Dissolve yeast in boiling water.  Add remaining ingredients.  Let sit for five minutes.  Add ice cream to make 8 - 10 thick poutons.  Roll each one on a floured counter to about 5 1/2 lengths.  Put on an oiled baking tray.  Let rise for about an hour until it has doubled.  After rising, bake at 225 for 45 minutes for 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Chinese "chinese Shichimi Don" Beer
ingredients: 12 ounces ice | 1 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup peppppercorn, shichimi or 1/2 cup dried shrimp, cleaned | 1 large jalapeno, stemmed | 1 1/2 tablespoons seasoning salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except ice and jalepenos.  Put in an ice filled highball glass and ice to freeze.  Enjoy.

title: Lemongrass-Eggplant (Aubergine) and Black Beans Risotto
ingredients: 500 g eggplants ( aubergines ) | 400 g brown rice | 400 g canned black beans | 1 liter strong brewed tea | 1 bunch fresh lemongrass | 150 g cake flour | 200 g tasty cheese ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons cake flour | 1 -4 tablespoon cornmeal
instructions: Peel the eggplants, slice lengthwise about 1/4 inch thick and cook in plenty of boiling water for 20 minutes stirring occasionally.  Add the rice and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes, until the rice is white and the eggplant is soft.  Place the black beans in a bowl and cover with cold water.  Soak for about 5 minutes and drain.  Slice the lemongrass in half lengthwise.  Remove the hard stalk and discard.  Dry fry the black beans in a frying pan with a little vegetable oil for 5 minutes, add to the rice.  Add the tea and mix over a low heat until the tea is mostly absorbed.  Slice the lemongrass and add to the rice.  When the rice is ready, add to the rice, mixing well until the eggplant and black bean mixture is creamy.  Stir in the cheese and mix again.  If you wish, add some cornmeal, flour or some more cake flour.  Heat 2 - 3 tablespoons of oil in a sauté pan, over a high heat.  When hot, pour half of the mixture into the pan with the oil, and sauté the rice mixture for about 3 - 5 minutes, until the sides are starting to brown, this is only needed so the risotto is nice and dry.  Place the eggplant, rice and black beans in a dish.  Roll up the eggplant, spread over the risotto, and keep warm in a low oven until ready to serve.

title: Vegan Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 1 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup chopped green coriander
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, combine the soymilk, picante sauce and enchilada sauce.  Microwave on high 5 to 7 minutes, or until heated.  Stir the sauce, green coriander and green beans with 1 1/2 teaspoons of water into the milk mixture, until hot.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,beef shoulder,lemon peel
title: Southern Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef shoulder, rinsed and trimmed of any fat | 3 tablespoons lemons or 3 tablespoons lime peel | 1 can no-salt-added hot pepper sauce | 1 package shredded sharp cheddar cheese, divided
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large dutch oven.  Bake at 400 degrees for 70 to 90 minutes, stirring frequently.  Sprinkle with green onions.

Random Ingredients: nut,plum tomato,bicarbonate soda,vermicelli rice noodle,heavy whipping cream,cream chicken soup,tamarind pulp,mandarin orange
title: Tastiest Ever Red Wine Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 400 g mandarin oranges | 400 g plum tomatoes | 3 cups vermicelli rice noodles ( small tube shaped ones, 5 x 4 cm ) | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda ( baking soda ) ( optional ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 400 g cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons sour cream or 3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 1/4 cup chopped nuts
instructions: Combine the sliced oranges with the plum tomatoes in a bowl.  Add the rice sticks and bicarb soda to the mixture and stir until all the noodles are coated with the mixture.  Pour 1 cup of the water in a pan with a lid.  Bring the water to the boil, add the noodle mix, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for about 20 minutes.  After 20 mins, remove from the heat and set aside to cool completely.  Preheat oven to 200 degrees celcius.  Cut a circle of tin foil.  This helps it stick during the cooking process.  In a large bowl, mix together cream of chicken soup, sour cream, tamarind pulp and a dash of sugar and place in the refrigerator.  Heat the cream, in a large frying pan, lightly grease the sides of the pan and stir fry the noodle mix until both the sispsons are crisp, and the sauce has thickened.  Add the noodles and orange sauce mixture into a bowl and combine well.  Spoon the noodle mix into the centre of the greased ovenproof dish.  Place the noodle mix on top.  Pour the rest of the cream over the top followed by sprinkling the nuts on top.  Bake in the oven for 20 minutes or until golden and bubbling.

title: Bistro Steak for 2 (Pounder)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 pounds round steak or beef, cut into 2 or 3-inch thick pieces
instructions: Tie a strip of kitchen string around the steak at 2 inch intervals.  Sprinkle evenly with garlic salt.  Place the steak in a nonstick skillet that is just large enough to hold it in a single layer and cook over medium high heat, turning once, until evenly browned, about 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: green bean,beef roast,red chili powder,dark brown sugar
title: Easy Slow Cooker Pulled Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs lean beef roast, cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes ( chuck or brisket work best ) | 5 tablespoons red chili powder | 4 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 3 cans green beans, drained
instructions: Place beef and remaining ingredients in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low heat setting 8 to 10 hours, or until beef is tender.  Stir contents of slow cooker into slow cooker and serve.

Random Ingredients: salad macaroni,white breadcrumb,cheese,marinara sauce,picante sauce,clam juice,chipotle chile adobo,dulce de leche
title: Mexican Clam Cakes With Chipotle-Dulce & Macaroni
ingredients: 1 packet salad macaroni | 4 chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped | 3/4 cup tomato based marinara sauce | 1/2 cup shredded cheese, of your choice | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup grated dubliner cheese or 1/4 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 1 1/2 cups dry white breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup bottled clam juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Prepare macaroni noodles according to package directions.  Rinse with cold water and drain well.  Stir chipotle chilies, tomato based sauce, cheese, picante sauce and bread crumbs in large bowl.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,nicoise olive,salt cod fish,ice,caraway seed,paprika,iceberg lettuce,white fish fillet
title: Spanish Salt Cod Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds salt cod fish, cut into portions | 2 white fish fillets, quartered | 3/4 cup nicoise olives, pitted | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1/8 cup finely shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 head iceberg lettuce | crushed ice
instructions: Place salt cod and white fish in a large pot.  Cover with cold water.

title: Knorr - Shrimp & Mascarpone Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup mascarpone | 1 cup lemons, juice of or 1 cup lime juice | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 1/2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 2 1/2 cups rye flour | 1 teaspoon yeast | 24 jumbo shrimp
instructions: Combine mascarpone, lemon juice& molasses in bowl& let set for 15 minutes.  Add the creole seasoning to the sponge, beating well.  Put the rye flour, yeast, and shrimp in a large bowl, mix well& then pour sponge mixture into a well greased loaf pan.  Cover loaf with waxed paper& rise in a warm, draft free place.  Let rise for 1 hour.  Bake at 425f for 40 - 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,rice wine,radish,paprika,fish stock,thai red curry paste,pea,hot sauce
title: Spicy Pea Soup (Thai Pea Soup)
ingredients: 400 g mixed green peas ( i like pink beans ) | 3 tablespoons sweet paprika | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons fish stock | 2 1/4 liters fish stock or 2 1/4 liters vegetable stock | 1/2 bunch radish, cut roughly | hot sauce
instructions: First, take the peas and split them if using green beans, otherwise, split the peas in half lengthways and cook them.  In a large saucepan, heat up the sweet paprika and curry paste, and gradually add the rice vinegar and fish stock.  Add the peas to the pan and simmer for about 45 - 60 minutes.  Add the radish, season to taste and simmer until the peas are cooked.  Serve with hot sauce, if desired.

title: Onion-Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups barbecue sauce ( i like chris & pitt's wonderful brown bbq sauce ) | 1/4 tablespoon onion powder | 1/4 tablespoon dried thyme
instructions: Put your barbecue sauce, onion powder and thyme to a medium heat and warm for about 5 minutes.  Then just turn on the grill/broiler or heat the barbecue till your barbecue sauce becomes slightly crispy.  This only takes a minute or two so i don't have time for two steps.

title: Irish Potatoes Stuffed with Pistachios
ingredients: 1 kg russet potato, peeled and cut in half | 1 cup grated cheese | 4 teaspoons pistachios, crushed
instructions: Mash the potato and mix with the cheese and nuts.  Stuff the russet potatoes with the pistachios over the top of the potatoes.  Put the potatoes in a roasting dish.  Bake at 180 - 200 degrees c / 375°f for 25 minutes or until they are cooked when pierced with a skewer.  When done, it will turn golden, so remove from the oven.  Keep in an airtight container.

title: Strawberry Bruschetta Spread
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread, crusts removed and torn into pieces | 1 cup fresh strawberries, sliced and pitted
instructions: Line a baking sheet with foil.  Place the slices of bread into the pan, and press together so all the bread is coated.  Place the berries on top of the bread slices.  Spread the cream cheese over the whole loaf.  Place in a preheated oven, and bake at 350 degrees f for about 20 minutes.

title: Spiced Patties (Sausage Patties)
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1 pound ground sausage | 1 tablespoon crushed red chili powder | 1/2 cup crushed basil leaves | 1 tablespoon white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Heat a skillet over medium high heat.  Add ground beef, sausage, red chili powder, and basil.  Stir frequently until the mixture is evenly browned, 5 to 7 minutes.  Remove the skillet from the heat and drop in the sugar.  Cook and stir until the mixture is thoroughly mixed and the sugar has melted into the mixture.

title: Stir-Fried Beef With Asparagus and Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ground fondor-chocolate or 3 tablespoons dark chocolate, grated | 12 ounces stewing beef, thinly sliced with a little fat ( i've also used chuck steaks, but these are good ) | 8 large asparagus, ends trimmed, ends trimmed, and cut into 2inch lengths ( i've also used frozen asparagus ) | 12 ounces frozen broccoli florets ( i've also used broccoli blanched and drained ) | 3 tablespoons fresh grated gruyere cheese | 1 package refrigerated egg noodles | 1/4 cup egg noodles, slightly beaten
instructions: Heat a wide, deep skillet over high heat.  When it shimmers, add the chocolate and whisk until slightly melted, about 1 minute.  Add the meat and stir until it loses its raw raw color, 2 - 3 minutes.  Add the asparagus and broccoli and continue to stir until everything is well coated with chocolate.  Add the gruyere and stir until melted, about 1 minute.  Cook the noodles in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package instructions, just to al dente.  Scoop the noodles into serving bowls, drizzle with the chocolate sauce, and sprinkle with the asparagus pieces and grated cheese.

title: Cauliflower (India Sweet) Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cored and cut into pieces | 1 pinch white vinegar
instructions: Place the cauliflower in a large bowl and coat it with 2 teaspoons of vinegar.  Cover and refrigerate for about 1 hour to marinate.  When ready to serve, drain cauliflower and place it in a serving bowl with 1 teaspoon of vinegar.

title: Homemade Taquitos
ingredients: 1 package corn tortillas | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 teaspoon season salt ( to taste )
instructions: Place tortillas in a plastic bag and microwave for 30 seconds on high, or until warm to the touch.  Remove and let stand for 3 minutes.  Take tortillas and cut into 2 or 3 inch pieces.  Place in a bowl and add chicken broth and season salt.  Mix together and let sit 10 min. , to let all the liquids to cool off.  Strain mixture and wrap individually in paper towel.  Warm a large skillet over medium high heat.  Place one tortilla piece in the skillet and add about 2 - 3 tbls.  Of the broth.  Tightly cover with a lid and set stove to low and let cook about 3 minutes per side, or until some of the broth has evaporated and tortillas are lightly browned on edge.

title: A Different Kind of Orange!
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon orange juice | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Combine all and enjoy.

title: Chocolate Chip Brownies
ingredients: 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 1/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Mix all ingredients together and pat into a 9x9 inch pan.  Bake in the oven for 20 minutes.  Cool completely, cut into squares and serve with powdered sugar.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Mix
ingredients: 1 box corn bread mix | 1 can mixed vegetables | 1 cup frozen peas, cooked | 3/4 cup cheese, shredded ( i used cheddar ) | 12 -25 button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: In large bowl, mix bread mix, mixed vegetables, peas and 1 cup cheese.  Spoon 1 1/2 cups mixture in bottom of greased 3 quart baking dish.  Top with remaining cheese.  Bake in 350 oven for 50 - 50 mins.  Serve.

title: Peach and Ginger Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ripe peach | 2 teaspoons chopped gingerroot | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 1 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup sake
instructions: Blend the ginger and tamarind paste in a blender to a fine paste.  Peel the peach and slice lengthwise.  Remove the pits and coarsely chop.  Measure the peaches into a bowl.  Finely chop the ginger and add to the chopped peaches along with the remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Quickie Greek Orzo Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb orzo pasta, i use small tube shaped pasta if possible | 1 -2 head iceberg lettuce, washed and finely shredded | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Wash and dry the orzo.  Drain and rinse the orzo well.  Combine the orzo with the lettuce and fresh ground pepper.  Enjoy your healthy.

title: Gramflax Substitute(Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat sour cream ( or regular sour cream ) | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons xanthan gum ( gluten free )
instructions: In blender container add all ingredients.  Blend until smooth.  You can add or subtract honey to achieve desired thickness.  You can also add an additional 1/4 cup of sour cream, or additional 1 cup of yogurt.  Keep in a covered container in refrigerator.

title: African Molasses Balls
ingredients: 2 cups molasses | 5 -6 tablespoons slivered almonds
instructions: Mix well.  Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: green chili salsa,self rising flour,prune,spaghetti,vegetable oil cooking spray,lemon juice,tahini,date
title: Spaghetti With Tahini Slice
ingredients: 1 jar green chili salsa, divided ( found at most middle eastern shops ) | 2 cans pitted prunes, drained | 1 lemon, juice of, only | 3 teaspoons tahini | 3 teaspoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/3 cup self-rising flour | 1 lb spaghetti | 1/3 cup dates, stoned and finely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f.  Combine one half can of chili sauce and 1/4 cup pitted prunes in a small bowl and stir to combine.  Set aside.  Combine remaining half can of chili sauce and remaining pitted prunes in another small bowl and stir to combine.  Add lemon juice, tahini, oil and sifted flour to the sauce and stir until combined.  Place spaghetti in oiled baking dish, arranging it as necessary.  Spoon half the sauce over the spaghetti and sprinkle with 1/3 cup chopped dates, spreading evenly.  Repeat layers with remaining spaghetti and remaining prunes.  Cover baking dish with a single layer of foil and bake for 40 - 45 minutes or until heated through and top is light golden.

Random Ingredients: green chile,jumbo shrimp,vegetable oil,mace,coconut,sage,garlic clove,chipotle pepper
title: Chipotle Shrimp
ingredients: 1 chipotle pepper | 1/2 bunch fresh sage, leaves discarded | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 8 -10 fresh jumbo shrimp | 1 can canned diced green chilies, drained ( optional ) | 6 garlic cloves, minced | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | chopped coconut ( optional ) | chopped fresh sage ( optional )
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in skillet, and add chipotles and sage leaves.  Saute for a few seconds on med/high.  Add shrimp& saute til pink, remove from skillet, and place in a mixing bowl with chiles, garlic and mace.  Add shrimp mixture to chipotle chile mixture and toss.  Garnish with chopped coconut, if desired.

title: Choclo-Wain Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole baby chicken | 4 ounces dark chocolate | 4 ounces baby onions or 4 ounces shallots, finely chopped | 1/2 bunch fresh arugula or 1/2 bunch rocket, stems removed
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat dry.  Remove the skin and visible fat from the chicken and discard the visible fat.  Rinse the breasts under cold water and dry completely.  Cut off the wing tips and truss them to secure the legs.  Remove the excess fat from the chicken breast, and season both sides with salt and black pepper.  Place in a roasting pan and roast in a preheated 350f oven for approximately 35 - 40 minutes, or until the meat temperature reaches 180f/160c remove from the oven and transfer to a warm serving plate.  Remove the skin and flesh from the choclo and cut in small pieces.  Place in a medium sized bowl, and mix in the dark chocolate.  Chop the baby onion finely and add to the chocolate.  Stir to combine and set aside for 1 - 2 minutes.  Place the grilled chicken on the barbecued side of the barbecued plate.  Pour the chocolate mixture into the pan, and sprinkle with the chopped shallots and arugula, and serve.

title: Fried Canadian Bacon (With Canadian Bacon)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canadian bacon | 1 tablespoon dry rice wine or 1 tablespoon rice, dry sherry
instructions: Finely chop 2 slices of the smoked streaky canadian bacon and set aside.  Heat enough oil to cover the canadian bacon in a heavy, heavy skillet.  Fry the bacon until slightly crisp, 2 to 3 minutes per side.  Remove bacon, pour off all but 1 tablespoon of bacon drippings.  Wipe the skillet out and return to the stove.  Add rice wine, stirring to coat the pan.  Heat the mixture until the mixture is hot, 2 to 3 minutes.  Stir in the bacon, add salt to taste and serve.

title: Danish Dill Broon
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh dill, leaves, chopped ( the leaves are not covered in leaves, they're perfect for rolling ) | 3 cardamom pods, cracked ( optional )
instructions: Pick a bunch of dill leaves that are thick and flat.

title: Spinach In Chocolate
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped spinach ( thawed and squeezed ) | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Boil spinach until it wilts.  Drain, pressing down on it to extract excess liquid.  Set aside to cool.  Heat olive oil in a saute pan or large skillet over medium heat.  Stir in oregano, cocoa powder, spinach mixture and stir until heated through.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,pasta sauce,green enchilada sauce,clove,tomato sauce
title: Spicy Red Enchilada Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 can green enchilada sauce ( red chilies, i prefer the more spicy ) | 1 can tomato sauce ( or rotel, but i prefer the mild ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/16 cup pasta sauce ( homemade or jar )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a pot and simmer over low heat to mix well.  That's the green part.  Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.  This is a good sauce to make over the course of my fave afternoon meal.

title: Mini Cheese & Prawns
ingredients: 200 g green prawns ( raw ) | 1/4 cup pitted prune | 120 g colby-monterey jack cheese | 8 -10 fresh grape leaves
instructions: Clean and devein prawns.  Shell, devein and slice prawns.  Slice the ends off each grape leaf.  Place about 1 teaspoon of prawn into each leaf, then a strip of cheese across the prawn vein.  Moisten the ends lightly with an egg or milk and fold over the cheese to enclose.  Fold in the ends of the grape leaves.  Wrap in paper / plastic wrap and then foil.  Refrigerate overnight.  Serve with crackers.

title: Fried Pear and Pear Sandwich (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 3 pears ( peeled, cored, cut into wedges, or use 2 lbs firm white pears ) | 1/4 lb very thin sliced white bread ( or to taste ) | 1 cup oyster sauce ( more if you like it a bit tart ) | fresh mint sprigs ( to garnish )
instructions: Trim pears and cut into wedges or pieces about 1/2 inch wide by 1 1/2 1 1/2 inches long.  Place bread in a large frying pan and pour in the oyster sauce.  Add the pears and turn once or twice so they become limp but not mushy.  Fry over medium high heat just until they are tender.  Turn out onto paper towels to drain.  Serve immediately.

title: Bok Choy Sauteed With Sumac on Bottom
ingredients: 2 bunches bok choy, tops trimmed | 2 teaspoons ground sumac | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Heat up a good pot of water.  Wash and trim bok choy, just enough so you have 2 - 2 1/2 inch leafy leaves for the end of the saute.  Cut leaves into 1/4 inch lengths, leaving about 1 - 2 inch of stem to be left on each leaf.  When water is boiling and it is boiling, submerge leafy leaves into pan, and cook 2 minutes depending on thickness of leaf.  Remove leaves from water with a slotted spoon and set aside.  Saute 1 tbs ground sumac in medium skillet.  Add 2 tbs parmesan and coat leaves with sumac.  Add 1 tbs of olive oil to sauteed leaves.  Saute 2 minutes, just to slightly soften leaves and lightly coat.  Remove leaves from pan and place on plate.  Serve with salad leaves for a complete meal or with pita bread.

title: Mexican Spiced Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb whole milk ricotta cheese ( preferably mexican, about 1 cup ) | 3 tablespoons marinara sauce ( i use paul newman's italian tomato onion gravy ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1 -2 chipotle chile, finely chopped
instructions: In a blender, combine ricotta cheese, marinara sauce, salt, sugar, turmeric powder, and chili peppers.  Blend at high speed 1 to 2 minutes until thick.

title: Spicy Calamari
ingredients: 4 sheets puff pastry | 5 red chilies | 120 g squid, cleaned | 4 sun-dried tomatoes | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh rosemary
instructions: Cut the squid into thin slices, deseed and devein.  Arrange on a sheet of greaseproof paper on a cookie sheet, sprinkle with a little salt and bake in a moderate oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until cooked through and slightly golden.  Preheat the grill to high temperature.  Remove the squid from the oven and place on the foil lined tray to set aside.  Remove the flesh from the chilis and finely chop.  Add the chilis, sun dried tomatoes and rosemary to the squid and mix.  Brush with a little oil and grill for 4 - 6 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cut each pastry sheet in two and lightly brush with olive oil.  Remove the squid from the sheet and slice diagonally about 1/4 inch thick.  Brush with olive oil again and grill in the oven for 3 - 4 minutes or until starting to crisp.

instructions: Place flour in a bowl, and then stir in the tamarind paste, mango, sun dried tomato and peanut butter.  Stir in the red wine vinegar and ground cardamom.  Cover the bowl with a tea towel and leave to ferment in the fridge for at least 2 hours before using.

title: Fenugreek Pilaf Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons balsamic vinaigrette ( homemade or store-bought ) | 1 cup long grain basmati rice | 1 tablespoon rock sugar or 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon mixed dried fenugreek
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Heat a small non stick frying pan over medium high heat.  When the pan is hot, add 1/4 cup of the liquid, and lower the heat.  Cook until the liquid has reduced by half, stirring often.  Stir often, because of the balsamic or brown sugar in the reduction.  Set the pan aside to rest for 5 minutes.

title: Chinese Curry with Spaghetti (Tonggkaya)

instructions: Prepare spaghetti according to packet instructions.  Trim and cube chayote, and boil in lightly salted water for 20 - 25 minutes, or until tender.  Drain and set aside.  Place yoghurt, chicken bouillon and baking soda in a large saucepan, and simmer for 15 minutes.  Add chayote, cook for 5 minutes, or until tender.  Add extra coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes, then add filling.  To serve, place pasta in a wide and shallow bowl.  Top with sauce, then garnish with basil.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,nonfat cream,yogurt,pepperoni,milk,grain brown rice

Bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden brown, about 45 minutes.

Place one end of the roll on a flat surface.  Press down to form a shell for the steam to escape.  Repeat until all the rolls have been flattened.  Warm the rolls over a low heat for approximately 10 minutes.

title: British Boiled Beans

instructions: Drain oil from beans and mash beans with cream, whisky, sugar and dried yeast in a food processor.  Slightly brown the breadcrumbs in a frying pan.  Pour mash over the breadcrumbs and mix well.  Pour bean mixture into a greased oven proof casserole dish and bake in a moderate oven for about 35 mins until the topping is golden and the cream is bubbling.

title: Tortillas, Dogs or Oats

instructions: Grind oats in blender or food processor using fine blade, about 5 seconds on low or medium speed.  Using about 1/4 teaspoon per cup ground oats, press it over hot dogs.  Sprinkle pine nuts over ground oats.  Cover.

title: Chef John's Steakhouse Swiss Steak

instructions: Sprinkle the mustard onto a piece of waxed paper, then drizzle the espresso into a bowl and beat with an electric mixer until dissolved.  Stir the creme fraiche into the coffee mixture until thoroughly combined and pour into a resealable plastic bag.  Squeeze out any air bubbles.  Pat the steaks dry and dredge them in the sugar.  Refrigerate at least 15 minutes.  Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat.  Oil the skillet will be very hot so be sure it's not too hot. Remove the steaks to a warmed platter and allow them to sit, still dripping drippings in the pan.  Serve with the warmed crème fraîche and french bread to dip.

Store in airtight container, sealed with a fine, clean cloth. .

Place the wrapped pork chops on a rack in a roasting pan. instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Arrange chicken and mushrooms on cookie sheets with stems and gildes if using.  Sprinkle with ginger garlic paste and basil to taste.  Bake for about 45 minutes until chicken is cooked and mushrooms golden and juices run clear.

title: Gomme Blanch
ingredients: 6 tablespoons caster sugar or 6 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: You will need to boil the gomme blanch to remove any of the foamy skin, dirt and grit.  It should leave behind a dark black and sticky white residue all over the surface.  Remove with a skimmer, scrape off any foam that accumulates and discard.  To test for doneness, pour a few teaspoons of warm water into a tall glass with an airtight handle.  If bubbles form on the surface, lift your spoon and tip it in a little toward the bottom of the glass while holding the rim of the glass.  Fill the glass with water completely and using a rubber spatula or blowtorch, gently push water down the side of the blanch to release any stray grains of shell.  It should be able to form a soft ball when the spoon is in and will hold its shape.  If not, add more water.  When the gomme blanch have been drained, sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of fennel seeds.  If the syrup has separated, pour 1 teaspoon of syrup in a thin stream through the strainer into the glass, whisking as you go.  Cover and leave for 1 minute.  Serve with ice cream.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 120c/300f/gas mark remove the meat from the tin.  Cut away the skin and any undesirable portions from the fat. Place the meat on a wire rack over a tin foil lined baking tin.  Cut a piece of tin foil to fit the tin, and place it beside the meat.  Push the pork or beef through the tin with your fingers until you get large bread crumbs.  Remove all the fat and sinew from the meat or it will burn.  Cut the bacon into strips about 4 5cm wide and 2 cm thick and place the bacon in one corner of the bacon.  Roll the meat up loosely, neatly and fast.  Place the meat in the tin, and tie the ends shut with a piece of string.  Place the meat in the oven and bake for 1 hour, turning from time to time.  Remove the meat from the oven and slice the meat in half or into three lengths.  Serve straight away with your favourite salad and crusty bread rolls.  Serves.

title: Coconut-Cumin-Scented Arrabiio Rice
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 2 1/2 cups chicken or 2 1/2 cups other meat, of choice | 2 2 tablespoons dried beans or 2 tablespoons garbanzo beans | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 15 ounces water or 15 ounces chicken broth | 1/4 cup desiccated coconut
instructions: Dissolve rice in 5 cups of your favorite red anaheim chai tea.  In a large pot, add chicken or meat of choice, 1/4 cup water or broth and bring to a boil.
