Pour salsa over sausage and let it simmer in the microwave to warm up a little bit.  You don't want the salsa to be completely warm.  It doesn't have to have fully heated.  Enjoy.

title: Soy Slivers
ingredients: 16 ounces sugar snap peas, thawed and drained | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise ( low fat or light )
instructions: Place the sugar snap peas in a strainer and push it out with your fingers or a fork into a mixing bowl.  Toss with the mayonnaise.  Let stand for at least 5 minutes to soften, stir occasionally.

title: Italian Meatballs (Oamc)
ingredients: 1/2 lb roast beef | 1 tablespoon graham flour | 1 cup pasta sauce ( i used classico italian pizza sauce ) | dark rum or white rum ( to your preference )
instructions: Soak the roast in water for 30 minutes.  Drain most of the water out of the roast, and lightly dust with the graham flour.  Melt the sauce in a saucepan, add the meatballs and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour.  The meatballs should be soft and cooked through, with no visible liquid.  Serve with cooked pasta.  If the sauce is too thick, add more oatmeal, oats or corn starch at the table.

Random Ingredients: mix,gruyere cheese,puff pastry,pickling spice,american cheese,orzo pasta,sirloin,chicken bouillon
title: Gruyere Beef Strudels
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin, trimmed | 3 cups prepared prepared sweet-sour stir fryery mix | 2 tablespoons pickling spices | 2 bags frozen puff pastry | 1 package american cheese, cut into 1-inch slices | 3 cups gruyere cheese, grated | 3 cups prepared sweet-sour stir fryery leaves | 1 -2 cup prepared pickling spice
instructions: In one 5 gallon ziplock bag combine all the beef and 2 cups of prepared sweet sour sour stir fry mix.  Let stand at room temperature 5 hours or in freezer.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  On ungreased baking sheets, put 8 - 10 rolls of beef in a single layer and pat into a rectangle.  Sprinkle 3 cups of grated gruyere cheese and 3 cups of chopped sweet sour stir fry mix over all.  Sprinkle 4 ounces of american cheese and 3 - 4 slices of the remaining american cheese over all.  Sprinkle 3 cups of prepared sweet sour sour sour sour stir fries over all.  Cover beef with remaining grated cheese.  Cut one 8 inch x8 inch rectangle of puff pastry, with the long edge closest to you, cut out 8 - 10 inch circles from each pastry.  Put a small amount of pickling spice into each pastry circle.  Seal seams by moistening with water.  Brush about 1/3 of pastry with water.  Brush a second 1/3 of pastry with water.  Brush 1/3 of the remaining pastry with water.  In small bowl, sprinkle about 3/4 cup of remaining pickling spice over beef.  Put a few beef slices into each pastry circle, fold the unfilled side of the pastry over the beef, and place on baking sheet.  Brush top of pastry with water.  Bake 45 minutes or until pastry is golden brown.

title: Fenugreek and Fenugreek Spread
ingredients: 3 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 1/4 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Stir cannellini beans with fenugreek and cheese together in a large bowl.  Spoon mixture into 4 individual serving dishes.  Refrigerate until chilled, at least 1 hour.

title: Mexican Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sour cream or 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1 1/2 cups grated mexican blend cheese
instructions: Place the sour cream or yogurt in a bowl and stir in the cheese.  Form the mixture into 2 inch balls.  Place balls on parchment or wax paper lined baking sheet 1 inch apart.  Refrigerate the balls for at least 15 minutes before baking in oven.  Preheat oven to 250 degrees.  Bake in a hot oven for 30 - 60 minutes, or until the tops are browned and crispy on the outside.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,rose water,large shrimp,lemon peel,italian sausage,chili oil,yellow pepper,lime wedge
title: Shrimp With Italian Sausage
ingredients: 2 lbs large shrimp, peeled, deveined | 2 1/2 - 3 cups sweet italian sausage, coarsely chopped | 4 -6 yellow sweet peppers or 4 -6 red sweet peppers, coarsely chopped | 4 -6 medium lemons or 2 -3 limes | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup limes or 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup rose water | 2 tablespoons chili oil | lime wedge
instructions: Place shrimp in a large pot of lightly salted water, set over high heat.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to 1 cup, cover, and cook 5 minutes, until shrimp are pink and shells feel firm.  Using slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to a large bowl.  When cool enough to handle, chop shrimp, discarding shells, heads, and tail.  Add sausage and vegetables to spinach.  Add remaining ingredients except rose water, plus rose water if desired.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.  Add rose water, cover, and simmer 5 minutes.  Serve with lime wedges.

title: Raspberry Cheese Ball (Mango Nut Cheese Ball)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh raspberries | 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted and coarsely ground | 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese, grated | 1 cup coarsely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | mango chutney ( optional )
instructions: Place berries in a food processor.  Add walnuts and process until combined.  Add cheeses and process at high speed until smooth and light.  Fold in chutney.  Refrigerate the ball of cheese in a ball plastic wrap about 12 hours, refrigerating the cheese balls the next day.  Remove the ball from the plastic wrap and roll in coarse salt to coat.  Sprinkle with paprika if desired.

title: Spiced Raspberries and Vinegar
ingredients: 500 g arborio rigatoni pasta or 500 g penne pasta | 150 g chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon raspberry gelatin powder | 2 teaspoons harissa
instructions: Boil or microwave 1 litre of water and add the arborio or penne pasta.  While cooking, mix the chunky salsa with the jelly in a small bowl.  While pasta is cooking, boil water and add 2 tsp of harissa powder.  Stir in the arborio and drain pasta and put back in the pan.  Add the salsa and mix well.  Tart with a spatula before serving.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,leek,dill weed,ice,rice vinegar,taco flour tortilla
title: Fiesta Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups finely diced leeks | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1/8 cup shredded unsalted butter, softened | 1/4 teaspoon minced fresh dill weed | 1 large soft taco-size flour tortillas | fresh dill weed ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat over to 400&deg.

Random Ingredients: tangerine juice,nut,self rising flour,sage,shaoxing wine,tapioca flour
title: Teisen Tangerine Drop Scones
ingredients: 3 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup tapioca flour | 1/4 cup unsalted butter or 1/4 cup lard | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 3 tangerine juice | 1 cup mixed nuts, such as pecans, hazelnuts, cashews, walnuts, almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  In a 3 1/2 or 4 quart electric mixer, beat the butter/lard, sage, and tangerine juice with a rotary beater on slow speed until well blended.  Sift the flour and tapioca flour twice.  Combine with the dough on low speed, beating well after each addition.  On a lightly floured counter, work the dough until it forms a cohesive mass.  Press the dough into a 2½ to 2½ inch circle about 1½ inches thick.  Cut the circle into 4 wedges, then place onto a baking sheet and arrange the wedges on top.  Dot the tops with a pinch of butter or margarine.  Dust with remaining flour and bake, uncovered, until golden brown, about 20 to 25 minutes.  Transfer to a rack and cool the scones.  To serve, cut into wedges and drizzle with honey.

title: Hawaiian Noodles and Turnips (Hawaiian Pulled Kebabs)
ingredients: 1 lb kabocha lo mein noodles | 6 small turnips or 2 large turnips, peeled thinly sliced | 2 slices pineapple, cut into 4 1-inch chunks | 1 pinch oregano leaves, sprinkled on top if desired | 4 kaiser rolls, split
instructions: Preheat grill to high.  Rinse turnips and place them in a shallow roasting pan or dutch oven.  Pour just enough water to cover them, about 2 inches deep.  Stir the turnips gently to distribute the seasonings.  Cover the vegetables with cold water, cover tightly, and cook until the turnips are soft, turning once, 35 - 45 minutes, turning the turnips once halfway through the cooking time.  Transfer the turnips to a cutting board and let cool slightly.  Cut off any hard core with a large spoon or cleaver.  Rinse the turnips and pat dry with paper towels.  Slice the turnips thinly lengthwise.  Drain the noodles and place in a bowl.  Cover with cold water and let stand 30 minutes.  Drain the noodles well and stir well until thoroughly drained.  Taste and season with salt, if needed.  Fill a large saucepan half full of water.  Place the kabocha in and bring to a boil over medium heat, skimming any foam that rises to the top.  Scrape the kabocha with a slotted spoon out of the shell.  Scrape the turnips out onto a board with tongs and gently toss with the kabocha.  Drain the turnips and toss them into the noodles, adding more water as needed to cover.  Taste and season with more salt, if needed.  Divide the noodles among 4 small heat proof bowls.  Cover and cook the turnip noodles until they are just limp and beginning to wilt, about 5 minutes.  Remove and discard the pineapple.  Arrange the turnips over the noodle mixture and scatter the oregano over.  Serve immediately or keep warm in preheated oven at 200 degrees f until serving.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,turkey ham,graham cracker crumb,grain rice,flour
title: Pasappeh Sabzi (Moroccan Rice Balls)
ingredients: 1/2 cup short-grain rice | 1/4 lb turkey ham, very lean ( or other lean meat ) | 4 ounces fresh serrano peppers, minced | 1/4 cup flour | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Soak rice for 10 minutes in several changes of water.  Drain.  Soak ham in boiling water for 30 minutes until very tender.  Finely dice ham and set aside.  Add minced serrano and rice.  Stir until well coated.  Mix in flour.  Add graham cracker crumbs and knead lightly.  Shape into small, golf ball sized balls.  Place on cookie sheet and bake for 25 minutes at 375 degrees.

title: Pears-Anise Dip
ingredients: 2 cups thick & chunky salsa | 3 pears | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, crushed
instructions: Put salsa, pears, and anise seeds in a food processor and process until smooth.  Refrigerate for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,pineapple juice,cake flour,jalapeno juice,spinach,egg yolk,potato,ice
title: Tortilla De Platano (Potato, Spinach, Pina Colada)
ingredients: 8 small boiling potatoes | 8 slices cake flour or 8 slices all-purpose flour | 2 egg yolks | 2 -3 tablespoons finely chopped canned jalapeno peppers in juice | ice | 4 -5 fresh spinach | 2 -3 medium fresh cherry tomatoes | 1 cup canned pineapple juice
instructions: Peel the potatoes if they are a little too big.  Boil for 30 minutes, making sure not to boil over.  Peel the rinsed out potatoes or boil them in the microwave for 20 minutes.  Peel the tomatoes so that they can be easily sliced with a knife.  Mash the potatoes to break them up a little bit.  Drain out all water from them.  Sift the flour and the lightly beaten egg yolks together in a separate bowl.  Mix in 2 -3 tbsp of jalapeño.  Add the chopped canned peppers and mix together with the mashed potato, adding a little bit of water if needed.  In a small frying pan, add enough ice to cover the bottom, about 3 - 5 inches above the bottom of the pan.  Heat until the ice turns light brown brown.  Remove from the heat.  Turn them in a clean pan and add enough ice oil to cover them.  When the pan is cold enough to handle, take out the ice and quickly fry the potato slices until golden, but not crisp anymore.  Drain on paper towels, then slice thick slices on the diagonal.  To serve, place a piece of tomato on a plate, top with a piece of potato slices, then add a small scoop of some of the fresh spinach on top, then add 1 cup of the canned pineapple juice.  The key is to squeeze as much juice as possible from all the canned pineapple slices.  Serve.

title: Peanut Dip
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Boil the cheese in the oil until it is thick, usually about 5 minutes.  Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside.  Mix in the oregano.  Place in a bowl, cover, and let stand.  Drain fat from the saucepan, and blend into cheese with a wooden spoon.  This can be stored in the refrigerator, as well as in freezer bags.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,white wine vinegar,sunflower oil,maple syrup,chocolate chip,green bean,enchilada sauce,palm sugar
title: Chocolate Glazed Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, strings removed and cut into 2-inch lengths | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 11 ounces roasted unsweetened chocolate chips ( about 3/4 cup ) | 1 cup dry white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 1/2 cups enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon palm sugar, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray.  Place the green beans in a medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,brandy,zucchini,chinese cabbage,poblano chile,nonfat milk powder,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Low Fat Zucchini Slaw
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut lengthwise into thin slices lengthwise ( about 1 pound ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( nonstick or olive oil ) | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1 teaspoon low-fat powdered milk powder | 2 poblano chiles, diced ( fresh or roasted ) | 2 tablespoons nonfat dry milk powder | 1/4 cup shredded fat-free swiss cheese-parmigiano-reggiano cheese blend, blend
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Line a large baking sheet with foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Arrange the zucchini slices on the baking sheet in one layer and brush with oil.  Sprinkle zucchini with lemon extract.  Broil zucchini slices 3 inches from heat until zucchini starts to brown, about 4 minutes turning slices occasionally, about 3 minutes longer total.  Remove zucchini slices from oven and brush on remaining oil.  Broil zucchini, turning once, until edges are dry, about 4 minutes.  Transfer zucchini slices to a large bowl.  Sprinkle zucchini with 3/4 cup of the cheese blend, 1 tablespoon of nonfat dry milk powder, and poblano chiles.  Cover and chill in refrigerator at least 1 hour.  Cover and refrigerate remaining cheese blend.  Serve zucchini slaw on a bed of zucchini.

title: Black Beans in Romaine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried black beans | 2 cloves garlic paste | 1 head romaine lettuce hearts, washed and dried
instructions: Cook the dried black beans in boiling water for two minutes, or until softened.  Drain beans and cool.  Place them in a food processor and process until smooth.  Return to the pan over medium low heat.  Add garlic paste.  Cook over medium heat until paste is fragrant and starts to lightly brown.  Remove from heat.  Cut hearts into halves or thirds and arrange on serving platter.  Spoon beans over hearts.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,rice noodle,corn oil,bay leaf,red apple,chicken bouillon,onion soup
title: Fried Rice Noodles With Vegetables
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles ( i like to use long english ones ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 large red apple, chopped fine | 1 bay leaf | 1 packet onion soup ( preferably campbell's ) | 1 tablespoon onion soup ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons coriander leaves ( dried ) ( optional )
instructions: Boil your noodles in plenty of water.  Heat up the oil and fry your noodles on a high heat, till just cooked.  This is optional.  Add the chopped apple, salt and pepper and saute' for a few seconds.  Drain the noodles and add to a large warmed bowl.  Add your onion soup or one pwdr seasoning, the coriander and soup.  Mix, serve and enjoy.

title: Chocolate Sea Bass
ingredients: 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup chopped cheddar cheese | 10 whole black peppercorns | 4 whole black peppercorns | 1 orange-flavored rotisserie-cooked squid, cleaned, tentacles and tentacles cut away from the head and tentacles and split into rings | 4 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: To make a paste, combine the vinegar, cheddar cheese, whole black peppercorns, whole black peppercorns, and orange flavoring in a bowl.

title: Tofu on a Dollar
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef eye round | 1/4 cup corn oil | 4 ounces soft tofu | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 2 -3 tablespoons drained capers
instructions: Trim and discard any excess fat from steak.  Slice into 1/4 inch slices.  Cut the meat into 1/8 inch strips, or smaller if it is exceptionally lean, like hamburger steak.  Cut the lime zest into slices, and reserve.  Place the corn oil into a deep frying pan, and set over high heat.  When the oil starts hissing, quickly add the meat and fry until it is seared on the outside, reddish brown on the outside.  Pour in the water, lime juice, zest, salt, almond extract, and capers then stir to combine.  Lower the heat to medium, then stir once or twice while heating through.  Remove from the heat, and serve warm.

title: Strawberry Surprise
ingredients: 3 cups strawberries, washed or 3 cups raspberries | 1 cup vanilla | 1 cup vinegar
instructions: Wash frozen strawberries.  Cut fresh strawberries into pieces.  Mix together in a bowl with other ingredients.  Cover and chill for atleast an hour.  Serve with cream or ice cream.

title: Grilled Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup honey | 1/4 teaspoon guacamole | 1/4 teaspoon harissa | 1/8 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste | 6 thick cut salmon fillets
instructions: Whisk honey and guacamole with a fork in a bowl.  Season with harissa and salt and pepper.  Spread sauce over salmon fillets.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until fish is easily flaked with a fork.  Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate.  Remove fish from marinade.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,chipotle chile,vegetable oil cooking spray,pistachio nut
title: Watermelon Chipotle Salad
ingredients: 3 cups seedless watermelon | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup roasted pistachio nut, chopped ( garnish ) | 1 chipotle chile, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cut melon in half and remove stone.  Using a melon baller, scoop out flesh into a bowl.  Cut melon skin into thin rounds.  Spray a small skillet with veggie spray and heat over medium heat.  Sauté the pistachios until golden brown.  Stir nuts and chopped chipotle chile into the melon, and remove from heat.  Garnish with chopped pistachios.

Random Ingredients: ginger powder,jasmine rice,creole seasoning,clove,plain nonfat yogurt,new potato,whipping cream,pork tenderloin
title: Slow Cooker Pork & New Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin ( trimmed ) | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 pinch ground cloves ( optional ) | 8 small red new potatoes ( cut into large chunks ) | 8 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup whipping cream | jasmine rice, to serve
instructions: Place pork in the slow cooker and scatter with creole seasoning, ginger, and ground cloves.  Cover and cook over low heat for 5 hours.  Using a peel from the potatoes, slice into rounds and boil until tender.  Drain potatoes and place potatoes in a large glass baking dish.  Place the yogurt, whipping cream and 1/2 c water in a medium sized saucepan.  Heat over a low heat and stir until hot, but not boiling.  Pour over the pork mixture and sprinkle with remaining creole seasoning.  Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes.  Serve over jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,pork shoulder,rigatoni pasta,soya sauce,red pepper flake,straw mushroom
title: Rigatoni With Straw Mushrooms and Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs raw lean pork shoulder, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup soya sauce | 8 ounces fresh straw mushrooms, stems trimmed | 2 lbs rigatoni pasta, cooked, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f in 1 gallon skillet, saute the pork over high heat, stirring, until browned and remove meat mixture to a baking dish.  Season pan drippings with salt and crushed red pepper, add enough soya sauce to barely cover meat and bring to a boil, add mushrooms and return meat to pan.  Cover and bake for 2 hours or until tender.  Meanwhile, cook rigatoni according to package directions, drain, and set aside.  In remaining fat, saute pork over medium heat, turning often, until browned.  Remove pork mixture to casserole dish.  Add pasta to skillet and toss to coat.  Spoon sauce over noodles and top with shredded cheese.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: garlic sprout,white button mushroom,marshmallow,white cabbage,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Moo Shu Fun Giardinhas
ingredients: 8 -10 large white button mushrooms, washed | 3 -4 leaves white cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup shaved white gruyere or 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about about 1 1/2 ounces ) | 16 teaspoons white miso paste, heaping ( about 1-2 tablespoons ) | fresh shaved shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese or shaved mozzarella cheese ( about 1 ounce )
instructions: Using your fingers, remove the tough outer hard bottom of the mushroom stems and rinse thoroughly in running water.  Dry out the liquid with scissors.  Use a vegetable peeler to remove the stems and place the mushroom caps inside the caps, pressing gently to extract any excess moisture.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over medium heat.  In a bowl, toss the mushrooms, cabbage, cheese, miso paste and 1/2 teaspoon salt, tossing the mixture well to combine.  Transfer to a colander and press to drain off excess liquid.  Transfer to a platter.  Sprinkle with more shaved cheese.  Serve in small piles with additional miso paste on the side.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,chili sauce,rice wine,vegetable broth,mandarin orange
title: Mandarin Oranges & Rice Soup
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable broth | 1 cup rice wine ( not shao hsing, please ) | 8 ounces mandarin oranges | 8 corn tortillas | chili sauce ( optional )
instructions: Simmer broth and rice wine until rice wine has reduced slightly by about 1 minute.  Rinse mandarin oranges under running water and cut into 1/2 inch julienne strips.  Slice 3/4 inch julienne strips crosswise.  Bring broth and oranges to boil.  Add julienne strips and simmer about 4 minutes.  Add hot tortillas, reduce heat and simmer about 3 minutes.  Add 1/2 cup soup if desired.  Stir gently so soup doesn't break.  Garnish with more warm soup.  Serves 4.  Variation, serve as is with sour cream, chow mein noodles, hot bean sprouts, or hot cooked tortillas, along with a bit of sauce for a more substantial meal.

title: Grilled Ginger Chaat
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ginger paste | 3 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 4 sprigs mint
instructions: Place the ginger paste on the work surface.  Sprinkle with adobo.  Sprinkle with mint.  Roll up starting with the tines down the sides of the skewer.  Grill for about 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli Toasts With Chocolate and Spicy Balsamic
ingredients: 3 inches piece unsalted chocolate, grated | 3 ounces small broccoli florets | 1/4 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 french baguette, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f combine the chocolate, broccoli and coriander seeds in a large nonreactive skillet.  Cook over low heat, stirring, until the chocolate is melted and the mixture is smooth.  Spoon a small amount of the chocolate mixture into the center of each slice of bread.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,mirin,apple juice,cornflour,broccoli floret,button mushroom
title: Beef, Broccoli and Apple Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 800 g cut beef top sirloin steaks or 800 g boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1 1/2 cm cubes | 10 small broccoli florets or 10 small cauliflower florets | 1 tablespoon mirin or 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/4 cup apple juice
instructions: Mix cornflour with 2 tsp water to form a thick paste or coat the beef.

title: Sweet & Savory Kiwi Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 kiwi fruits, firm and unblemished | 4 ounces yellow sweet onions, finely chopped ( such as vidalia ) | 4 leaves basil leaves, chopped ( about 1/3 cup ) | 2 teaspoons chives, minced
instructions: Peel and section kiwis.  Cut kiwi fruit in half lengthwise and scoop out the pulp.  Carefully remove the membrane using a melonballer or a melonballer that has been crushed into small pieces.  If the kiwis are exceptionally ripe, cut them into large pieces.  If using vidalia, drain the wine very well and allow to cool.  In a large bowl, combine the cooked fruit flesh with all of the other ingredients.  Mix well, season with salt and pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,double cream,french bread,cardamom powder,butter,italian seasoning
title: Gramma's Buttered French Toast
ingredients: 1 1 loaf french bread | 1 cup unsalted butter, softened | 1 1/4 cups cake flour | 1 1/2 cups double cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom powder | 1 ounce mixed italian seasoning
instructions: Slice bread into 1 in thick slices.  Brush both sides of the slices with 1 - 2 tbls butter.  Combine flour, cream, and cardamom in a deep, flat dish.  Dip the slices of bread into the batter and transfer to the coated bread, coating well.  Lightly brown on both sides and set aside to cool.  When cool, place in a freezer bag with a plain tip, or 2 zip lock bags in between.  Freeze overnight or at least overnight.  Keep the freezer bag on top.  Makes about 25 - 30 servings.

Random Ingredients: turnip,vermouth,water,red wine vinegar,sea salt,goat cheese,brown mustard seed
title: Roast Turnips With Vermouth and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs turnips, peeled | 5 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons dry vermouth | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 2 ounces soft fresh goat cheese, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Place turnips in a large roasting pan.  Combine the vinegar, water, mustard seeds and vermouth in a medium saucepan and heat on medium heat until boiling.  Add the drained turnips.  Cover the pan with foil and bake for 3 hours.  Toss the turnips every 30 minutes and add more water if necessary to restore the crisp color.

title: Cafe Suji
ingredients: 12 small red potatoes | 1/3 cup vinegar | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherry, drained with juice reserved | 3 teaspoons ginger paste | 1/4 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Place potatoes in saucepan of salted water, bring to a boil.  When potatoes are nearly cooked, drain and mash with vinegar, salt and maraschino syrup.  Allow to cool.  Add ginger paste, coriander, and turmeric.  Transfer to container and refrigerate.

title: Rooibos Mexican Beef Sandwiches for 2
ingredients: 1 rump roast, trimmed | 1 avocados - peeled, pitted, and diced
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler.  Place the meat on a broiler pan, and cook under the broiler until the beef is well browned, about 10 minutes.  Stir in the avocado, and set the oven's broiler on.  Cook under the broiler until the meat should also be tender, about 10 minutes.  Slice the roast with a serrated knife into 10 thin slices for dipping.

title: Chile Paste with Ginger
ingredients: 1/2 cup candied ginger root, chopped | 1 1/2 cups icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Combine ginger and sugar in a bowl.  Spread ginger mixture evenly over cut surface of a cookie sheet, and place on cookie sheet.  Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, 10 to 15 minutes.  Turn off oven, but leave cookie in oven for 10 to 15 minutes.  Allow ginger to cool for 5 minutes.  Remove ginger and dry on paper towels.  Store in an air tight container.

title: Grilled Peppercorn Lamb Sandwiches with Garlic Sauce

instructions: To make garlic sauce, in a medium non reactive saucepan, combine pecorino, chilies and garlic powder.  Bring to boil over medium heat.

title: Watermelon Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 egg yolk, beaten | 1 1/2 pounds fresh watermelon - peeled, seeded, and cubed | 1 tablespoon caraway seed
instructions: In a large serving bowl, stir together the soup, egg yolk, watermelon, and caraway seeds.  Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.  Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Bacon With Maraschino Cherries on a plate!
ingredients: 8 slices smoked bacon, diced | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained & juice squeezed out | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Spray or grease a large frypan with pan drippings, or heat some oil in the microwave.  Fry the bacon bits, in batches if necessary, until golden brown.  Remove & drain on paper towels.  Pour the juices into the frypan & stir in cherries with juice.  Cook, over a low heat, stirring to warm through the juice, for about two minutes or until cherries are heated through.

title: Creamy Lamb With Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 lbs lamb, and legs | 6 ounces carrots, cut into small strips | 6 ounces italian salad dressing | 6 ounces catsup | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried dill
instructions: Cut lamb into 6 thin strips.  Place lamb in glass dish or a shallow roasting pan.  Place lamb between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. title: Chef Flower's Puerto Rican Grilled Chicken With Cuban Pork and Mozzarella
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken legs ( per person 4 whole legs, 3 whole wings, and 2 whole breasts ) | 1/2 lb salt pork, shaved | 1 cup mozzarella cheese ( plus more on top if desired ) | 1/4 cup cacao ( optional, i recommend hershey's ) | salad greens ( to garnish ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup rice wine ( optional ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs sirloin, cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Place a bamboo steamer on a rimmed baking sheet.  Fill bamboo steamer with water, and add one chicken breast to cover chicken.  Set aside while preparing the rest of the ingredients, if using.  Remove the excess fat from the meat of your choice as well as a piece of foil or wax paper.  Roughly dice the meat and set aside. Poke some holes in the salt pork with the tip of a meat tenderizing needle.  Stir the mozzarella into the mozzarella in a single layer.  You can also use the back of a spoon to crush a piece of fresh cheese.  On the bamboo steamer, place the chicken on the salt pork.  Sprinkle the cacao, if using, over everything except the cheese.  You should end up with about 1 cup of crumbs or crumbs on the bottom of the steamer.  You may need to spread a little water onto the bottom of the steamer just to cover the bottom of the pan.  Place the bamboo steamer on the rack.  If using a bamboo steamer over a plate, place another pan on top of the bamboo rack to weigh it down.  You would have to place several heavy weights on the bottom of the pan to weight up the bamboo steamer.  Place the rack in the fridge and leave for an hour.  After an hour, remove the pan from the fridge and start the grill pan.  Remove the steamer onto a grill pan or ridged grill if your rolling into meat.  Add about 1 cup of cheese to the meat and sprinkle the rest over the top of meat with more cheese, and a little oil.  Grill this over direct medium heat, or medium high heat in a cast iron skillet. title: Cheats® Wild Rice Chips
ingredients: 2 packages simply potatoes chipits | 2 pounds potatoes crisped wild rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons tandoori seasoning | 2 1/2 cups dry vermouth, divided | 1 teaspoon garlic paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line two baking sheets with aluminum foil.  Place potato crisco™ chips into a large resealable plastic bag, and close the top securely.  Shake off excess air.  Set aside.  Arrange potatoes crisco™ chips onto the prepared baking sheets.  Bake in preheated oven until crispy and brown, 15 to 20 minutes.  Remove from oven, and set aside.  Meanwhile, heat 2 1/2 cups vermouth and 2 1/2 cups vermouth in a saucepan over medium heat, and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, and simmer until reduced to one half, about 20 minutes.  Strain the reduced vermouth, and set aside to cool to room temperature.  Place remaining 2 cups vermouth into a microwave safe bowl, and heat on high until bubbling, about 2 minutes.  Stir in 1 teaspoon garlic paste, and cook in the microwave 1 minute more, until aromatic.  Spread cooled vermouth mixture evenly over crisco® chips.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,purpose flour,caster sugar,brandy,chili pepper flake,garlic,lasagna noodle,sauce
title: Spicy Pineapple and Garlic Lasagne
ingredients: 500 g linguine pasta or 500 g spaghetti pasta, cooked | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice, strained bottled | 1 tablespoon brandy or 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon mild chili pepper flakes | 5 cloves garlic, crushed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sweet chili peppers or 2 tablespoons hot pepper flakes | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) or 1 teaspoon packed dark brown sugar ( superfine sugar )
instructions: Heat oil in large pan over medium heat.  Add garlic and saute 3 minutes or until aromatic.  Stir in pineapple juice, brandy, chili, chilli flakes, garlic, sugar and hot pepper.  Bring to boiling.

title: Budino's Infamous Rum Balls
ingredients: 1 cup sweetened flaked coconut | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Put coconut into a bowl and stir in rum extract.  Mix thoroughly until thoroughly combined.  Roll into 1 balls, or less, and roll in coconut.  They should be firm enough to coat the bottom of your beverage container.

title: Quick Girlfingers
ingredients: 13 ounces ladyfingers | 1 -2 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube ( i used 3 teaspoons )
instructions: Dissolve chicken bouillon in boiling water.  Brush ladyfingers with bouillon, drain liquid.  Put half in a muffin tin and cover with remaining half.

title: Low-Fat Garlic Napa Slaw
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage ( or 2 large ones ), rinsed, dried well before cutting | 10 cloves minced garlic or 2 teaspoons bottled minced garlic, from a jar ( from a jar of garlic natures ) | splenda sugar substitute or sugar for sugar
instructions: Cut the green leaves off of the cabbages and cut off the hard spine, then cut them finely across the head.  Rinse well with cold water, drain well.  Place all ingredients, except splenda or sugar, in a non reactive bowl and mix until the sugar is dissolved.  Let sit for at least 1/2 an hour to allow flavors to mingle, then sprinkle splenda or sugar on top.  Best if served at room temperature.

title: Chicken IV
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cup brown sugar, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Pour brown sugar into a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Lay the chicken breasts in the dish, skin side up, making sure both sides are covered.  Pour any remaining brown sugar into a saucepan or dutch oven over medium heat.  Place the saucepan over medium low heat, and bring to a simmer.  Cook and stir 2 minutes, until the brown sugar has melted and begun to brown.  Place the chicken breast pieces into the hot brown sugar, and stir to coat.  Pour any remaining brown sugar onto the chicken, being careful to pour out any excess juice.  Cover the dish with aluminum foil.  Bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the chicken juices have begun to run and are beginning to cook into the tender meat.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,hazelnut,liquid smoke flavoring,lemon peel,peanut butter,tomatillo salsa,bread crumb,chili flake
title: Spicy Chipotle-Glazed Goat’s Feet
ingredients: 2 cans tomatillo salsa | 1/2 cup finely chopped hazelnuts | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon finely ground dried chili flakes | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes ( optional ) | 1/4 cup smooth peanut butter | 1/4 cup liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and set aside.  In a large bowl combine the tomatillo salsa, hazelnuts, bread crumbs, chili flakes, lemon peel, garam masala and chili flakes.  If desired, stir in the peanut butter until blended.  Shape into 12 balls, then press lightly into the skins of the goat’s feet.  Sprinkle on additional paprika, and bake in the preheated oven until the tops are very lightly browned and the toe outsides are a bit crisp, about 30 minutes.  Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then remove to a cutting board.  When cool, remove from the pan onto your cutting board.  Slice in half lenghtwise, then cut each half crosswise into ½ inch slices.  Transfer to warm serving platter or serve as desired.

title: African Style Collard Greens with Apricots
ingredients: 1 bunch collard greens | 1/4 cup dried apricots | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Wash and cut collard greens from stalk to bottom, removing tough ends, and cut pieces of greens crosswise into thirds to make long slices.  Combine remaining ingredients in a covered container and place over a medium heat source.  Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture simmers.  Do not let boil.  Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Serve immediately.

title: Tilapia
ingredients: 1 tilapia fillet, fresh | 1/2 cup pickled gherkin, pickled | lettuce
instructions: Place tilapia in a large, flat dish.  Sprinkle with gherkins.

title: Sweet Beef Tips With Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 3 tablespoons prepared spaghetti sauce | 6 teaspoons fennel seeds | 3 spring onions, chopped | 2 drops red food coloring | 1 lb spaghetti sauce, for dipping
instructions: Trim fat from steak.  Slice steak in thin slices crosswise.  Combine hoisin sauce, spaghetti sauce, fennel seeds, spring onions, and red food coloring and pour over steak.  Marinate several hours or overnight.  Broil or saute in a skillet about 4 minutes on each side for medium doneness.  Serve over a bed of pasta.

title: Grilled Cremini Mushrooms & Confetti Eggs

instructions: Prepare the grill.  Cut the rhubarb lengthwise into thin slices then cut into thin long, diagonal slices crosswise.  Cut the red pepper and chanterelle mushrooms into thin slices crosswise.  Remove the stem from the goat’s butter knife then cut into thin strips.  Combine the thai red curry paste and cayenne and set aside.  Remove the zest from three of the 4 eggs and cut the whites into 1/2 inch wide strips.  Place the eggs and bell pepper slices in a large mixing bowl and set aside.  Place the sliced mushrooms in a large skillet with the red curry paste and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring regularly.  Drain the mushrooms and place in the egg white mixture and stir.  Transfer to a plate and allow to cool for 5 minutes.  Grill the cremini mushrooms until crispy, about 4 minutes or so.  Transfer to individual plates and top with a few cremini mushroom slices, then drizzle with the thai red curry paste.  Serve at once.

instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.  Cover and chill at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Romeo's Easy Tomato-Cashew Soup
ingredients: 5 large italian plum tomatoes | 1 lemon, juice of | 1/2 cup roasted cashews ( not unsalted ) | 2 -3 tablespoons red wine ( optional )
instructions: Dice tomatoes into pieces about an inch big.  Squeeze lemon and put into pot.  Add 2 - 3 cups water to food processor with cashews.  Stir well to start breaking up tomatoes.  Add tomato pieces along with lemon juice, red wine.  Simmer over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Serve hot with parboiled egg noodles, for dunking in. title: Peking Corned Beef
ingredients: 1/2 lb flank steak, boneless | 1/3 cup flour, seasoned with | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons oyster sauce | 1/4 teaspoon onion, minced
instructions: Place flank steak between sheets of waxed paper.  Spread 2 teaspoons of sugar over flank steak.

title: Apricots With Thyme
ingredients: 24 small apricots | fresh thyme leave
instructions: Preheat oven to 180'c, 200'f or 190'c if using a fan forced oven.  Slice apricots lengthways and arrange, cut side down on a baking tray lined with 1cm sliced thyme leaves.  Sprinkle with thyme leaves.  Bake for about 15 minutes.  Turn and bake a further 5 minutes or until apricots are just tender.

title: Simple Sangria
ingredients:

 3 lime wedges ( about 4 limes ) | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Stir the wine with a fork or teabag.  Pour into a large wineglasses glass or pitcher and freeze until partially frozen, 2 to 3 hours.  To serve, add lime to rim of a chilled glass and top with lime wedge.

title: Mango Chutney
ingredients: 3 cups mango chutney | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dried mushroom ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Store in a small container in a cool dry place.  This can be made up to 5 days in advance.  Enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken on the Grill
ingredients: 2 chicken legs ( thighs attached to drumsticks ) | 6 chicken wings ( legs attached to drumsticks ) | 6 tablespoons grand marnier | 4 teaspoons grand marnier
instructions: Preheat grill to medium.  Rinse wing tips off with water and blot dry with paper towels.  Put 1 piece of chicken legs, thigh side down, on one end of a piece of chicken leg, and close the chicken up like a book.  Place the other piece of chicken legs, thigh side up, on the chicken parts of the grill.  Grill chicken for approximately 8 mins per side or until the skin of the meat is crispy and black.  Using tongs, transfer to a serving dish.  Repeat for the other parts of the chicken until all of the chicken legs and thighs are cooked.  While the chicken is grilling, combine the liqueur ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.  Arrange 1/4 of the chicken legs, thigh tips, and drumsticks on a foil lined baking sheet.  Distribute 1/4 of the bottle of grand marnier among them.  Return the chicken legs to the sheet and drizzle about 1/2 the grand marnier over.  Remove the foil, and continue grilling until the chicken is charred on the underside and the juices run clear, 6 to 8 mins per side, depending on thickness of leg meat.  Turn the legs frequently.  If they get too dark, sprinkle with some more Grand Marnier.  Transfer the chicken legs and thighs to a serving dish, spooning the remaining sauce over them, and garnish with the remaining 1/2 cup plus 3 tbsp of grand marnier.  Serve hot.

title: Beer Puffs
ingredients: 1 can pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 can pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 1/3 cups beer | club soda
instructions: Prepare the 24 count per recipe.  On a greased baking sheet, spread about 1/2 cup of the crescent dough per crescent dough, covering the entire pizza.  To the bun.  Place a few spoonfuls of the beer in the middle then sprinkle with club soda to taste.  Sprinkle with more club soda if necessary to cover.

title: Minted Cucumber and Cucumber Smoothie
ingredients: 1/2 cucumber | 4 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Peel and slice the cucumber finely.  Remove all of the seeds.  Soak the mint leaves in cold water for 3 hours to plump them up.  Take out with a slotted spoon, then dry on paper towel.  Place in a blender with the cucumber and mint.  Blend until smooth.  Refrigerate until chilled.  Serve chilled.

title: Tortellini Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped romano cheese | 1/4 cup grated mozzarella cheese | 1/2 grated romano cheese | 1 dash caramels or 1 dash brown sugar | celery seed ( optional ) | 1 -2 rotisserie chicken meat ( optional ) | cooked tortellini | fat free chicken stock or water
instructions: Place rice in bowl of food processor.  Grate both cheeses and stir into rice.  Add salt, pepper and caramels.  Pulse 2 - 15 times, pulsing each time. To serve, ladle into soup bowls with tortellini.  Garnish with fat free, fat free chicken or water.

title: Chilli Pepper Arborio Rice

instructions: Put rice in a bowl with a tight fitting lid.  Fill with water and mix.  Turn heat on high and bring to a boil.  When water is boiling, add chili & peppers, stir.  Turn off heat.  Cover rice with lid and let sit 2 minutes, then remove lid and continue heating.  When you remove rice from heat, toss in the apricots & white pepper & mix it inches.  Serve hot.

title: Mango and Goats Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 mango | 2 tablespoons toasted dry mustard seeds | 4 ounces soft fresh goat cheese | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon grated lime zest
instructions: Peel and chop mango into small slices.  Toast and crush the mustard and poppy seeds.  Put mango, mustard seeds and cheese in a salad bowl and pour cider vinegar over.  Sprinkle with lime zest, and toss, just before serving.

title: Pot Roast With Potatoes (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 large red potato, cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed
instructions: Heat oven to 320° f.  Cut the potatoes into 1/2 inch thick wedges.  Put the meat in a roasting pan.  Sprinkle half of the potatoes over the meat.  Sprinkle with half the cloves.  Arrange the potatoes and rest of the cloves over the meat.  Bake covered for 4 hours.  Remove the lid, and bake for another hour.  Cool, and slice.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Au Jus
ingredients: 1/4 cup au jus mix | 4 fresh thyme sprigs ( or 1/2 tsp dried )
instructions: Combine ingredients and knead until dough is easy to handle, approximately 8 - 10 minutes.  Cover with a clean kitchen towel and refrigerate overnight.  On a parchment lined baking sheet spread out rolls, approximately 9 x 5 inches in size.  Cut each roll lengthwise in half, making eight pieces.  Scoop out stuffing by tucking in sides.  Repeat with remaining rolls.  Brush tops with a little olive or wine from cooking the rolls.  Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 15 - 20 minutes.  Serve warm with your favorite side dishes.

title: Fried Peanuts
ingredients: 1 lb raw peanuts | 3 tablespoons peanut oil or 3 tablespoons other vegetable oil | 4 tablespoons jarred chopped pimiento ( or other spicy food of your choice )
instructions: Using a very sharp knife, remove the skins and eyes from the peanuts and discard the outer shell.  Cut off the hard shell and all of the white layer, without tearing the peanuts.  Rinse the peanuts, dry and place in a bowl, cover with cold water and place in the refrigerator. .  Drain the peanuts, dry and place in a clean bowl.  Measure out about 1 cup of the peanuts, and toss in the oil or vegetable oil.  Spread the peanuts out flat onto a sheet pan, and using a teaspoon, carefully scoop the peanuts from the water so that they are roughly the size of rice.  Shake the peanuts in the oil or vegetable oil, until they are evenly coated and are heated through.  Do not fry more than just about 2 - 3 minutes, until the peanuts are lightly crisp and golden.

title: Cafe Con La Cerveza
ingredients: 2 cups boiling watercress | 4 dashes coffee ( optional ) | fresh watercress, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Put the four cress in a large, clean pillow case.  Pour boiling water in the base of the pillow case to within 1/4 inch of the rim, making sure the water is completely immedded below the cress.  Carefully, close the lid, and shake the cappuccino several times so that it evenly coats the bottom of the glass.  Leave the cappuccino in the water for 1 minute only, then shake again so the water is evenly dispersed around the cappuccino and the cress has turned white and fragrant.  The cappuccino should slide from the edge of the pillow case around the edges, as it slips out of the pillow case with the force of your fingers.  Remove the cappuccino from the water and place it on a serving platter with the cover on it.  Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.  Garnish with fresh watercress, if desired.  Note, if you can't find coffee with cappuccino just use 2 tsp instant coffee powder.  You can use one hot or sweetened milk and some more watercress if you wish.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,cremini mushroom,chicken,dark soy sauce,squid,chicken bouillon cube
title: Korean Chicken-Seafood Soup
ingredients: 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 4 cups thinly sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 lb raw shrimp ( shelled ) or 1 lb mixed seafood ( shelled ) | 2 -3 serrano peppers ( seeded ) | 2 packages frozen squid
instructions: Place stock cubes in a large pot and bring to a boil.  Add dark soy sauce and mushrooms.  Cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes, or until broth is reduced by about 3/4 its original size.  Remove from heat, and stir in shrimp and serrano peppers.  Scead with fresh, warm water if required.  Note, if you are serving soup immediately, add frozen squid for the last ten minutes for a thicker sauce.

title: Salt Cod Chips (Catalan Style)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salt cod fish | 7 fluid ounces ketchup | 3 fluid ounces sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Remove any skin and bones from the salt cod.  Rinse the fish under running water.  Dry it well on paper towels.  Cut the cod into 4 equal pieces, each cod about 3 by 3 inches square and each piece about the length of the fish.  Put the kosher salt cod and ketchup together in a ceramic or glass bowl and stir in the vinegar.  Put the fish, skin side down, on a plate.  Place a piece of cod about 1 inch below an open cone, skin on.  Cover it tightly and refrigerate, turning the pieces over every now and then over once or twice, for several hours or longer.  Turn the fish over on its side and take out any remaining pieces of fish if you feel they need it.  Turn the heat up to 400°f and put the fish into a single layer, skin side down.  Turn the heat down to 375°f and put it in a 500°f oven, flesh side up.  Cook for a further 1 hour, or until the sauce has reduced, coating the fish and bringing it to a boil.  Serve it hot.

title: Triple Threat Silver Margarita

instructions: Rim and clean glass serving container with metal rims.  In a blender combine galliano, tequila, marjoram, achiote, turmeric, cardamom, italian season and blueberries.  Cover and process until smooth.  Transfer to a chilled glass serving container.

title: Coconut Balls or Shrimp Rolls
ingredients: 1 cabbage | 2 1/2 cups napa cabbage | 8 tablespoons coconut flakes | 2 cups club soda ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons custard powder
instructions: Chop cabbage and napa cabbage, and steam until cooked, about ten minutes.  Stir cabbage and napa cabbage into the ice cold crab claw ice cubes, and process until just smooth.  Scoop out ice cubes and transfer to a bowl.  Stir coconut flakes into the ice cubes and combine thoroughly.  Form the ice mixture into small balls about a tablespoon in diameter, and roll in coconut flakes.  Serve in a chilled glass bowl.

title: Mushroom and Edamame Pork Strudel
ingredients: 1 fresh boneless pork loin chop, diced | 1 package frozen edamame | 3 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 12 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed according to package directions | 1 box frozen sliced edamame
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spray a 9x13 inch metal pan with non stick cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,red bell pepper,artichoke heart,salmon steak
title: Italian-Style Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon chopped drained can artichoke hearts | 1 red bell pepper | 4 salmon steaks
instructions: Place mushrooms in micro safe bowl and micro dry on 100% power for 10 minutes.  Stir in artichokes, pepper and heat throughly.  Reserve in refrigerator.  Heat oven to 400°f place salmon steaks in single layer on foil lined baking sheet.  Cook for 12 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with fork, or registers 160ºf on an instant read thermometer.  Remove foil from roasting pan and arrange salmon on foil covered pan.  Roast 4 - 6 minutes until meat is cooked through and juices are clear.  Serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,garam masala,red wine,baking potato,adobo sauce,orange zest
title: Papassinos
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 3 tablespoons minced orange zest | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh tarragon, leaves | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 4 tablespoons adobo sauce, from can | 1 tablespoon garam masala
instructions: Place potato in a large pot and cover with water.  Bring to a boil, and cook over high heat until lightly, tender, and just about halfway done, for the potatoes.  Drain the potatoes, and set aside.  Mash potatoes throughly with a potato masher.  In a small bowl, mix the orange zest, tarragon, wine, adobo sauce, and garam masala.  Add to the potatoes, and stir to combine.  Cover, and refrigerate overnight for flavors to blend.  To make ahead, cover, and refrigerate ahead.

title: Cauliflower Stuffed With Sauteed Scallops - Sauteed Scallops
ingredients: 1/4 cauliflower floret | 2 -3 tablespoons red enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs sea scallops ( fresh ) | 2 pinches dried kalonji
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Saute cauliflower floret and saute until just tender.  Spray a cookie sheet with oil, put cauliflower mixture in it and just pop it in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until cauliflower is soft.  Stir together enchilada sauce and red enchilada sauce and set aside.  Devein the sea scallops and rinse under warm water and drain.  Lay them on your clean dry napowelle towel and sprinkle with kalonji.  Roll the sea scallops in the kalonji until well coated.  Put in large bowl and pour sauce over.  Enjoy.

title: Baghare (Potatoes) and Onions (Michael Smith)
ingredients: 8 large red potatoes | 10 spanish onions, thinly sliced | 5 sprigs parsley leaves | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Cut potatoes into thick slices.  Place potato slices in a baking dish and arrange onion over them.  Sprinkle with turmeric.  Cover with a dampened towel and bake in an oven for 40 - 50 minutes until potatoes are tender.  Uncover and bake for an additional 25 - 30 minutes, turning potatoes with a spatula so they brown evenly on all sides.

title: Saucy Peanut Dressing
ingredients: 5 tablespoons smooth peanut butter | 1/2 cup prepared bottled horseradish | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons grated fresh horseradish | 3/4 cup diced cooked bacon | 3/4 cup finely shredded carrots
instructions: In a blender or food processor, whirl 1 tablespoon peanut butter until smooth.  Stir in 1/2 cup bottled horseradish, 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce, italian seasoning, 3/4 cup shredded carrots, and remaining 1/2 cup peanut butter.  Cover, and refrigerate.  When ready to use, shake contents of blender or food processor until thoroughly blended.  Pour 1/2 cup reserved peanut butter dressing.

title: Cod Fish - Pollo a La Galinha
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chicken broth | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 cup chopped fresh serrano peppers or 1/2 cup anaheim pepper, chopped
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the broth, preserves and peppers.  Bring to a boil and simmer for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently.  To serve, spoon sauce over warm fish.  Enjoy.

title: Fast and Easy Green Beans with Tomatoes and Cream
ingredients: 1 pound fresh green beans, trimmed and snapped in 1 inch pieces | 6 cherry tomatoes with dried tomatoes
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add green beans to the boiling water and cook 2 minutes.  Drain and place into a large bowl.  In a small skillet, pour in cherry tomatoes and spread on paper towels to drain.  Dip tomatoes in the prepared cherry tomatoes to coat.  Place on a plate.  Serve hot.

title: Mexican Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 cups dry macaroni | 1 large red pepper, cut into bite size pieces ( or use frozen red pepper, chopped, with no seeds ) | 1 cup crumbled queso fresco | 1 cup cubed queso fresco ( to taste )
instructions: Pour boiling water over macaroni in a large bowl.  Let stand 5 minutes of cooking before draining.  Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again.  In a large bowl, combine macaroni, red pepper, queso fresco, and queso fresco.

title: Beans With Goat Cheese and Asparagus Appetizer
ingredients: 1/3 cup goat cheese | 4 asparagus, ends trimmed | toothpick
instructions: Slice a bunch off the stems of the asparagus.  Cut the top portion of the asparagus off just enough to be easy to work with.  Using a spoon, scoop out all the'meat' with care to leave just a bit of shell on the top.  Repeat to get the asparagus back into the stalks.  You will probably need about 20 slices depending on the thickness of the stems.  Place cut asparagus on a plate and scoop out as much flesh as you can.  Mold mixture with goat cheese about 7 x 1 - ½ x 1 - ½ inches and place on toothpicks.  Use a toothpick to hold the goat cheese in place.

title: Middle East Spice Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/2 cup dried pomegranate | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 small apple, peeled and shredded | 1/4 cup vegetable juice ( or apple cider )
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together, and let sit in the refrigator for a few hours.  Keeps up to 3 days.

title: Italian Broccoli Lettuce Rolls
ingredients: 12 slices italian-style tomatoes, cut into half-moons | 2 red leaf lettuce, leaves separated, chopped | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1/2 cup frozen italian-style stewed tomatoes, thawed | 1 cup fat-free cream or 1 cup milk | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons low sodium soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Arrange the 4 tomato halves on a baking sheet.  Bake the tomatoes in the 400°f oven for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the tomatoes begin to soften.  Transfer the tomatoes to a heatproof bowl or platter and let cool, then cut the tomatoes into thin slices.  Arrange the lettuce leaves on the bottom lettuce leaf.  Place the broccoli on top of the lettuce and top with the stewed tomatoes and cream.  For the sauce, combine the remaining ingredients in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring until heated through.  Spoon 1 tablespoon of sauce over each salad and serve.

title: Shrimp Paste

instructions: Dry fry the shrimp paste on low heat for about 20 - 25 mins and grind them through a food processor or mortar.  Alternatively, mince the shrimp paste with mortar and pestle.  Use more or less shrimp paste depending on the preference.  Enjoy with indian breads.

title: Aunt Fanny's French Fries
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes | 14 ounces carnation evaporated milk | 1 tablespoon anise seed
instructions: Quarter potatoes and boil till tender.  Drain off water & place in large skillet.  Add remaining ingredients and cook over low heat 20 - 30 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Beer Spice Sauerkraut with Herbes De provence
ingredients: 1 cup beer | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 cup prepared mustard horseradish or 1 cup prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 1 tablespoon powdered ginger | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Put the herbs de provence and lemon pepper into a small bowl.  In a saucepan combine the beer, oil, horseradish, herbes, and seasonings.  Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.  When ready to serve, heat the sauerkraut.  Note, if you don't like the herbes de provence add 1/2 teaspoon of garlic powder or a bit of onion powder.  You can add up to 1/4 teaspoon of kosher salt if you prefer.

title: Tori Sushi
ingredients: 2 nori, sheets | 1/2 cup dried tarragon | 1/2 cup dried chili flakes | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 medium bell pepper

An instant read thermometer inserted into the center of a piece of steak should read just above the center of the steak.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,cardamom pod,pasta,jicama,rom tomato,spice,baby spinach,sirloin tip roast
title: Spinach Beef and Pasta Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 3/4 lb sirloin tip roast, trimmed of fat | 3 roma tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 bag frozen mixed spinach | 2 containers store-pepperdried pasta, such as linguine or ( 12 ounce ) containers chianti rice pasta | 1/2 teaspoon ground mixed spice ( try baharat aka middle east mixed spices ) | 2 cardamom pods, pods crushed | freshly steamed jicama, sliced into wedges ( to garnish )
instructions: Place roast in a dutch oven, add all ingredients and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 2 hours.  Stir occasionally and add water if needed to obtain desired consistency.

title: Danish Pork Neck Bones
ingredients: 1 pound pork neck bones | 2 1/2 cups maple syrup
instructions: Soak neck bones in the maple syrup overnight in a cool location.  The next day, drain the bones and place them in the oven preheated to 250 degrees f.  Bake until browned, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,yogurt,tandoori masala,white rice,avocado,chili powder,green curry paste,chard leaf
title: Erosome Indian Special Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup white rice | 2 cups fresh chard leaves, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons green curry paste | 3 teaspoons chili powder | 1 can tomato puree | 1 1/2 teaspoons tomato puree, liquified | 4 tablespoons natural yogurt | 2 teaspoons tandoori masala | 1 -2 avocado, peeled, pitted and diced into tiny pieces, and to serve
instructions: Combine the rice, chard leaves and green curry paste in a medium saucepan over medium heat and bring to the boil. Drain the rice and discard any excess liquid.  Stir in the tomato puree, tomato concentrate, and yogurt into the rice.  Garnish with avocado and serve over salad greens.

title: Chargrilled Eggs With Mango and Asparagus Puree
ingredients: 1 fresh beet, washed, trimmed, and cut into very short strips ( beets are the best ) | 450 g fresh mango, peeled, pitted and cut into thin strips | 3 hard-boiled eggs | 150 g double cream | mixed herbs, to garnish
instructions: Cook the beet strips in boiling salted water for 10 minutes or until just tender and drain.  Peel and discard beet skins.  Drain and discard the excess beet cooking water.  Mash together with mango and eggs.

Random Ingredients: white onion,wheat flour,parsnip,tamari soy sauce,chipotle chile,pickle
title: Noodle & Brunch
ingredients: 1 lb raw noodles, cleaned, dried and salted ( see notes ) | 1/2 white onion, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsnips | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce ( see notes ) | 2 -4 drops chipotle chiles, to taste ( see notes ) | 2 -4 tablespoons whole wheat flour ( see notes )
instructions: Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to the boil.  Place a large sieve into a large bowl and pour over the noodles.  Leave for a few minutes to rid the noodles of any excess water.  Drain and then place into the fridge to chill slightly.  Meanwhile, in a separate large pan of boiling water, cook onion for 2 minutes, then drain and refresh under running cold water.  Drain well then set aside.  Now drain the noodles, pat dry and then divide between two bowls.  Place the noodles on a large, shallow ovenproof dish.  Combine onion, parsnip and dressing ingredients and pour the dressing over the noodles.  You can also pour salad dressing over if desired.  Top with extra chips, if using, and perhaps a drizzle of extra dressing if you want.  Place under a grill for 4 - 5 minutes, until crispy and lightly browned, and noodles are heated through.  Taste for seasoning and serve immediately.  Notes, you can use any brand of noodles that is specified for brunch, but do not use extra dressing until the noodles are cooked.  If the noodles absorb too much dressing, they will release a little more flavour when ready.  The best way to check if they are done is to turn two or three noodles over and allow them to cook and finish cooking.

Random Ingredients: rutabaga,dark rum,purpose flour,lime,salt black pepper,horseradish,celery salt,vanilla extract
title: Rutabagas
ingredients: 1 large rutabaga | 6 stalks celery salt, or more to taste | 2 cups sifted all-purpose flour | 2 cups dark rum | 2 limes, juiced | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour, or more as needed | 1 teaspoon salt-free black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate.  Mix the rutabaga, celery salt, flour, rum, lime juice, horseradish, flour, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl.

title: Karela (Czechoslovakian Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 large head of cabbage | 1 pound walnut halves
instructions: Rinse and core the cabbage, and place in a saucepan with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil over high heat, and cook until tender.  Drain, and slice across the grain.  To serve, place pieces of walnut halves, cut side down, on the cabbage.  Serve hot.

title: Sour Pea and Apple Casserole
ingredients: 3 cups fresh peas, thawed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 apples, peeled & diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with non stick cooking spray.  Place thawed peas in the baking dish.  Stir together the cream of mushroom soup and diced apples and pour over the peas.  Cover lightly with aluminum foil.  Bake for 30 - 40 minutes.  Remove the foil, scatter with crumbly mix, or serve on top of casserole.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,granny smith apple,green cardamom pod,marinara sauce,french onion
title: Tian Style Beef
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs extra lean ground beef | 4 tablespoons marinara sauce ( i like amy's ) | 1 small french onion, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup green cardamom pods, coarsely crushed | 1 granny smith apple, peeled cored and thinly sliced
instructions: Combine the beef, marinara sauce, onion, cardamom pods, and apple in a bowl.  Tear off 3 - 12 inch pieces of heavy aluminum foil from each piece of meat and place them on 2 cookie sheets.  Bake at 425ºf for 20 minutes.  Turn the oven off.  Cover the foil with foil, place the meat, and bake for 1 hour or until cooked.  Note, if your oven is not very hot in the center, you should not lift the foil until just before you are done.

Random Ingredients: vodka,red pepper sauce,wheat flour,butter,ham steak,flour tortilla
title: Easy Steak and Pepper Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons red pepper sauce | 4 tablespoons vodka | 4 slices cooked ham steaks | 4 flour tortillas
instructions: Melt butter in skillet over medium heat until bubbly.  Stir in flour, red pepper sauce, and vodka.  Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes, until mixture thickens.  Wrap steak in tortillas and saute in remaining butter until cooked through.  Serve with salsa.

title: Gnocchi and Orange Marinated Vegetables (Fagioli)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs zucchini or 1 1/2 lbs oranges, cut in half crosswise and crosswise | 2 cups diced mixed vegetables ( broccoli, potatoes and red peppers ) | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried majoram ( dried, mixed spices ) | 1 orange, juice and zest of, grated
instructions: Place zucchini or oranges and mixed vegetables in a bowl.  Sprinkle with dried spices.  Mix well.  Place in refrigerator for an hour.  Strain vegetables reserving marinade.  Place vegetables into a non reactive shallow pan, pressing down with spatula to release excess juice.  Spray a skillet with nonstick cooking spray and preheat over medium high heat until very hot.  Place one half of the vegetable mixture in skillet and gently press mixture with spatula.  Cook for 1 minute until slightly golden brown.  Turn heat down.  Place remaining vegetable mixture in pan on top of vegetables.  Add the reserved marinade.  Cook until veggies are tender and flavors have come together, stirring gently.  Remove from heat and serve or keep warm if serviniged over cooked pasta.

title: Rosemary, Lemon & Basmati Flour Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 4 1/2 cups white flour | 1 sprig rosemary, plus extra | rosemary, for garnish
instructions: Wash the rice, and remove the stems.  Place rice and rosemary into a large basin and pour boiling water over.  Stand for 10 minutes, then stir, cover and leave to stand for 2 - 4 hours until the rice is very soft and creamy.  Preheat the oven to 180°c.  Grease a 25cm cake tin and line the base with baking paper.  When the rice has soaked for 2 hours, drain the water and pour the rice into the bowl with the rosemary.  Stir well to combine and set aside for 1 hour to set.  Turn the rice out onto a clean tea towel and fluff with a fork.  Press the rice onto the baking paper to remove air bubbles.  Sprinkle with rosemary and extra rosemary.  Bake for 50 - 60 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Danish Christmas Smoked Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lump crabmeat or 1 lb fresh shrimp | 1 cup fresh fat-free pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom or 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: To remove saltiness from crabmeat and shrimp, rinse well with cool water.

title: Tartar Shortbread
ingredients: 2 cups white flour ( all purpose or bread flour will also work in a pinch ) | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 300 ml white flour ( all purpose or bread flour will also work in a pinch ) | 150 ml brandy or 150 ml cognac
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour with cream of tartar, sugar and brandy mixing well.  Using hands, mix together the mixture until it forms a firm dough.  Divide the dough in half and knead each half over the course of your table for about 10 minutes, until lightly floured, but not sticky.  Roll out each dough to a thickness of about 8mm and cut into 2 squares.  Place on baking paper lined cookie sheets.  Bake in a moderate oven for 15 - 20 mintues until light golden and very slightly crisp.  Transfer the shortbreads to a wire rack to cool.  Store in an airtight tin for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,marjoram leaf,orange peel,chicken bouillon,curry paste
title: Spicy Citrus Chicken Kabobs
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped peeled fresh orange peel | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh marjoram leaves | 2 teaspoons low-sodium instant chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon curry paste | 3 tablespoons prepared soy-free chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon curry paste, or more to taste | 8 bamboo skewers, or more as needed
instructions: Mix orange peel, marjoram, 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon, 2 teaspoons curry paste, and soy-free chicken bouillon together in a bowl, stirring to dissolve chicken bouillon powder.  Cover, and refrigerate 2 hours or up to overnight.  Thread skewers onto skewers, reserving marinade.  Preheat grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate.  Place skewers on the prepared grill, cover, and cook about 10 minutes, just until no longer pink.  Remove skewers from grill, and serve with sauce.

title: Homemade Mint

instructions: Place 2 cups mint leaves in a mortar and crush together using a pestle.  Stir crushed mint leaves, oregano, and salt into the prepared mint leaves and pour into a 2 to 4 cup jar.

title: Chinese Peanut Nuggets
ingredients: 1 lb coarsely ground sausage ( schneider's brand ) | finely ground peanuts, walnuts or crushed peanuts, of choice
instructions: Combine the sausage and peanuts in the bowl of a food processor.  Pulse a few times, until chopped fine.  Form mixture into 3/4 inch balls.  Roll each ball into a ball and drop it into a colander set over a bowl covered with a plate or a bowl of iced water.  Repeat 2 more times until all balls of the sausage stick together.  Cool on a rack for at least 1 hour.  Serve at room temperature.  Nuts can be stored in the fridge for up to 1 week.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,mung bean sprout,ice water,mostaccioli pasta,heavy cream,topping
title: Creamy Spinach Pasta
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped spinach | 1 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 cup mung bean sprouts | 3 boxes mostaccioli pasta | 2 cups cubed frozen whipped topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a bowl, mix together the cream and curry powder and set aside.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta, and cook for 8 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: ha avocado,onion flake,brown rice,corn niblets,rotisserie chicken,thyme sprig,cremini mushroom
title: Fiesta Crockpot Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 2 lbs chicken or 2 lbs vegetarian chicken breasts, or vegetarian sausage ( can use turkey or beef ) | 3 1/2 cups cooked brown rice ( or white or brown ) | 2 packages frozen corn niblets, thawed | 1/2 cup shredded cremini mushroom, or fresh mushrooms | 1/2 cup chopped onion ( i use the frozen mixed vegetables ) | 2 tablespoons instant minced onion flakes | 2 tablespoons dried thyme sprigs | 1 cup prepared cremini mushroom, or fresh mixed vegetables ( i use the fresh mushrooms )
instructions: Place the chicken in the slow cooker.  Place the remaining ingredients in the order listed in the ingredients list except the mushrooms.  Cover and turn on low.  Stir once or twice.  Turn the crockpot to high and bring to a boil.

title: Braising Spice for Lamb and Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Use as much shaker or dry mix as you like.  Apply to lamb and chicken and allow to marinate overnight.  If you have the time, leave the meat to marinate for a further 2 hours.  Heat oven to 180°c / 375°f.  Place lamb on an ovenproof dish, pour over marinade.  Cover and cook in the oven 30 minutes or until done as desired.  Baste with cooking liquid or balsamic before serving.

title: Garbanzo Bean and Ziti Salad
ingredients: 2 packages dry ziti pasta | 1 container garbanzo beans, drained | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 1 bunch swiss chard, sliced | 1 jalapeno, sliced | wasabi powder
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat.  Rinse in cold water.  Drain well and put into a large bowl.  Mix with remaining ingredients.  Chill.

Random Ingredients: masa harina,cream celery soup,garlic,olive,orange,garlic clove,pork tenderloin,bread crumb
title: Tia's Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloins, trimmed of excess fat | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup minced ripe olives | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 2 teaspoons minced peeled orange rind | 1 1/2 cups dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup garlic-flavored masa harina | 4 tablespoons dried bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon minced peeled fresh garlic | 1/2 cup olive, coarsely chopped | 1 garlic clove, minced | finely grated orange rind
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Place pork between two sheets of foil, and pound to about 1/4 inch thickness.  Place onto a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with 4 tablespoons of garlic flavored masa harina and bread crumbs.  Drizzle with remaining 1 teaspoon garlic flavored masa, and top with remaining 1/2 cup of bread crumbs.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Let stand 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Fennel & Raisin Cream Trifle
ingredients: 1 sponge cakes | 150 g raisins | 150 g fennel seeds | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Wash currants & raisins until any harshness has been released.  Heat oven to 200c.  Cut sponge cakes in half diagonally.  Mix currants ingredients together & spread over base of a 2 litre trifle dish.  Pour cream over currants, sprinkle with fennel seeds & bake for 45 - 55 minutes till set.  Serve with a crisp seasonal salad or crusty bread.

title: Red Chile Roasted Red Chile Rub
ingredients: 8 red chilies, fresh | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Prepare red chilies roasted on an oiled cookie sheet in a pre heated oven, 375 farenheit for about 10 - 15 minutes.  After about 5 minutes, open chilies using a sharp knife and remove stems and seeds.  Rinse chilies under cold water and place in a bowl.  Drain and pat dry with paper towels.  Place the chilies in the bowl with the garlic, bouillon and 2 tablespoons of water, and mix well to combine.  Spread the chilies on a clean dry surface and rub all over the chilies.  Let dry for about another hour.  Remove from refrigerator and wipe dry.  Refrigerate for at least 12 hours or up to 3 weeks so the chilies have a chance to dry out as they dry.  Serve as a snack or with poultry or vegetable accompaniments.

title: Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 2 tablespoons milk chocolate chips ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons mascarpone ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine the marscapone and chocolate in a small bowl.  Stir until smooth.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,vodka,rice wine,cake flour,margarine,white wine vinegar,farfalle pasta
title: Pasta With Gluten Free Sweet Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 cup sweetened condensed milk ( i use 2 % ) | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 1/3 cups cake flour | 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1/8 cup port wine ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons vodka ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet, melt butter.  Add sweetened condensed milk and white wine vinegar and let simmer over medium heat.  Turn off heat and set aside to cool.  While the mixture is cooling, add the sald on floured surface to the milk mixture and stir until smooth.  Add in the flour and mix until smooth.  Add pasta, wine, and vodka if using and stir.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of pasta onto a cookie sheet.  Bake at 375 for 10 minutes until golden.

title: Kirsty's Florentine Party Lunch
ingredients: 1/2 cup flour tortilla | 8 large lettuce leaves, cut in half | 1/2 cup mayonnaise ( i use hellman's | 2 cups rice, cooked according to package directions ( i used long grain white rice ) | 1/2 cup madeira wine | dill pickle slices ( to serve ) ( optional ) | 1/2 medium celery rib, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 medium bell pepper, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Wrap tortillas in aluminum foil and heat in oven for 5 minutes, remove and place in serving dish, keep warm.  Prepare all the other ingredients, and mix well.  Place tortillas on individual serving plates.  Place 2 lettuce leaves on tortillas and top with remaining tortillas, lettuce, mayonaise and any other topping your liking.
