title: Mexican Grilled Cheese Sandwich Skewers
ingredients: 1 cup finely shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons grape juice | 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 2 basil leaves, finely shredded
instructions: Combine all ingredients except basil in a large bowl.  Toss well and set aside at room temperature for 15 minutes.  Thread a 1 inch or smaller skewer onto greased skewers, alternating with reserved cheese mixture.  Prepare grill and place for medium heat on grill.  Cook skewers on grill, turning often, until cheese is melted, starting to turn brown on all sides, 7 to 10 minutes, brushing occasionally with reserved cooking liquid for last 5 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Cerolle: Chicken and Olives
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 600 g chicken fillets, diced | 175 g kalamata olives
instructions: Cook linguine according to instructions on pack, adding the chicken in batches if not cooked beforehand to avoid overcrowding.  While the pasta is cooking, heat a non stick frying pan over a high heat for 1 - 2 minutes add the kalamata olives and sear for 1 minute.  Remove any excess oil but leave the olives as is.  Drain the pasta and chicken on absorbent paper & toss in the olives.  Serve while the pasta is still hot with a red chile on the side.  Note, if you decide to eat this dish while it still warms, the cheese will melt and go soft.

title: Pickled Goat With Curried Scallops
ingredients: 1 cup sliced dry porcini mushrooms | 1 jar pickled beets, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Place mushrooms in a large bowl.  Melt curry powder in 2 tablespoons hot water in microwave for 30 seconds, then stir into mushrooms.  Place beets in a separate bowl, then pour soaking liquid over.  Add red pepper flakes.  Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours and up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: walnut,puff pastry,red chili seed,passion fruit,black olive
title: Red Hot Passion Fruit Salad With Walnuts
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry, frozen thawed | 8 tablespoons passion fruit | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili seed | 4 tablespoons walnut pieces | 2 tablespoons finely sliced black olives
instructions: Thaw pastry sheet at room temperature for 20 minutes before rolling out in the pastry.  To roll out the pastry dough, line a 10 inch quiche dish.  Place thawed pastry sheet on a sheet of parchment paper or waxed paper and cover with a clean kitchen towel.  Using a rolling pin, roll out the pastry dough on a lightly floured work surface to 1/4 inch thickness.  Brush pastry with passionfruit juice and sprinkle with crushed red chile seeds.  Using a 6 inch round cutter, cut out hearts of pastry dough.  Repeat with rest of the dough, working with 2 hearts per filling.  Place on a floured board and trim away excess excess dough.  Place a walnut piece on top and lightly sprinkle with crushed black olives.  Roll the dough up onto the cut out heart and press with the palm of your hand to seal.  Place onto a parchment paper covered baking sheet.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least an hour.  When ready to bake, pre heat oven to 425 f or 200 degrees c.  Place a baking tray with a cover on the center shelf of the oven.  Place pastry sheet on the oven floor and bake at 425° f for 20 - 30 minutes or until puffed and golden.  Remove and let stand in tin for 15 minutes, then remove tray from oven and allow pastry to cool on baking rack.  Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Homemade Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise ( i use kraft singles ) | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Mix ingredients in a container with a lid.  Refrigerate about 15 minutes before using.  The longer this sets in the refrigerator, the hotter it gets.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,tomato juice,jalapeno pepper,rotel tomato,mint leaf
title: Tomato and Jalapeno Relish
ingredients: 3 cans rotel tomatoes, with chilies ( or any flavor ) | 12 fresh jalapeno peppers | 2 cups grand marnier | 1 cup tomato juice | 1/4 cup dried mint leaves or 1/4 cup cilantro
instructions: Remove stems from jalapeños, rinse well under running water, and remove seeds by scraping with a potato masher.  Put in a nonreactive saucepan with remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.  Turn mixture down, let simmer for 15 minutes.  Pour into sterilized 8 1/2 pint size jars.  Cover and tighten the lids with hot water rings.  Can be stored at room temperature for up to 6 weeks before eating.

title: Sour Hazelnuts and Onions
ingredients: 4 medium white onions | 1 3/4 lbs hazelnuts, shelled | pepper
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Cut the onions in half lengthwise and score the top of the skins directly into the tops of the onions.  Broil, stem side down, for about 10 minutes.  Turn and broil for another 7 minutes.  Let cool.  Peel the onions and trim well leaving the skins intact.  Place in a very large, heavy pan and place about 5 - 6 lbs in each.  Add pepper and the skinned nuts to taste.

title: Baked Fish With Anise Seeds
ingredients: 2 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 small red chile pepper, chopped | 10 whole fish, or as needed, cut into pieces
instructions: Fill a small pot with water.  Layer bay leaves, ground nutmeg, anise seed, red chile pepper, and fish in the pot.  Cover, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer 30 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.  Use the juice of the fish to thin up the sauce.  Anise seed can be found in asian food stores, or in the spice section of some supermarkets.  Anise oil can also be added, if desired, to a drizzle during baking.

title: Killer: Mexican Meatball Stew
ingredients: 800 g ground lamb | 2 white onions | 1/2 cup finely crushed marshmallows | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 250 g shredded mexican chocolate
instructions: Finely dice the onions and then brown them gently in a pan add the ground lamb, sugar and dark syrup.  Mix well.  You can also add a little water if you need to, although the water will probably not cook off until the meatballs are cooked.  Cook it for about an hour stirring occasionally.  Remove the meatballs from the pan and put in the fridge while you make the chocolate sauce.  Chop the marshmallows into smaller pieces and melt them in the microwave or in a microwave.  Stir in the tomato paste and heat for a few minutes.  Take the meatballs out of the fridge and add them to the chocolate sauce and stir well.  Add the marshmallow mixture to the meatballs and mix thoroughly.  Place them back into the fridge for an hour.  Preheat the oven to 150c/160c fan forced /350°f.  Place the meatballs in a casserole dish.  Spoon over any leftover sauce from the casserole.  Add the mexican chocolate and mix well.  Bake in the oven for 1 hour 15 minutes, stirring halfway through.  The meatballs might not cook in the oven, but that's ok.  Serve with your favourite type of pasta and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,cake flour,fruit,italian,mandarin orange,taco seasoning
title: Corn Ring
ingredients: 4 teaspoons cake flour | 4 teaspoons self rising flour | 1 can mandarin oranges | 4 tablespoons sour fruit | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 cup cake flour | 2 containers thousand island salad dressing ( the good kind )
instructions: Mix 3 teaspoons of cake flour and 2 teaspoons flour in small bowl until well blended.  Drain mandarin oranges until all juice comes out of the can and the fruit is soft.  Finely dice mandarins.  Mix other 2 1/2 cups cake flour and taco seasoning together in another small bowl.  Dip the mandarins in the mix and then quickly dip into the cake flour mix to coat completely.  Spread the oranges over the top of the cooled sponge.  Cover with another layer of cake flour and orange juice, then cover with another layer of flour on top.  Sprinkle last 1/2 cup cake flour evenly over the top of the cake mix.  Cover with top of plastic wrap and plastic wrap and place in refrigerator overnight. .  Heat oven to 350 degrees f, then remove plastic wrap and bake about 30 to 40 minutes, or until golden brown.  Allow bread cake to cool.  For the glaze, mix remaining ingredients in a bowl.  Drizzle over cooled cake and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,tamari,monterey jack cheddar cheese,green zucchini,green onion,mango chutney,spanish onion
title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork for Tacos
ingredients: 1 green zucchini, sliced | 2 large red onion, sliced | 2 pounds boneless pork loin roast | 2 cans mexican-style hot pickled mango chutney | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 package monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded | 8 green onions, chopped, or more to taste
instructions: Mix zucchini, red onion, and pork loin roast in a slow cooker crock.  Mix chutney, tamari, and monterey jack cheese blend with the pork.  Stir remaining chutney into the pork mixture.  Layer the pork mixture into the slow cooker crock in the order listed.  Sprinkle extra monterey jack cheese over the top if desired.  Cook on high until pork has fallen apart and crumblyly, 7 to 8 hours.

title: Vanilla Bean Ice Cream - Pressure Cooker - Sweden
ingredients: 2 quarts heavy whipping cream | 10 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon cardamom pod
instructions: Line the bottom of the Pressure Cooker with a clean paper towel to capture the excess water when sealing,.  Heat 1 quart of cream, cardamom pods, and about 2 tbsp of cream to a boil in a 2 quart saucepan.  Pour in the vanilla bean bag.  Let sit, and then stir, keeping on the heat, until it boils.  Turn down the heat and let stand at least 1 hour, but up to 1 hour, before freezing.  Freeze for 4 - 6 months.

title: Bread and Butter Cane Caramelized Mango Couscous
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 cup couscous | 2 tablespoons baking soda | 4 mangoes
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring chicken stock to a boil.  Add couscous and bacardi.  Cook over low heat until couscous is tender and liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes.  Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.  Remove from heat.  While still hot, cut mangoes in half.  Place them in a bowl of ice water.  Drain and set aside.  Remove and discard peel from mangoes and cut into halves.  Discard pits and pulp.  Rinse and dry out bowl.  Set aside.  To complete the couscous, place mangoes on a tray with a cloth over the top.  Place in the freezer until soft.  Remove the stone from the mangoes by placing it on a cutting board.  Cut away the peel along the sides of the mango.  Place cut mango in a serving bowl and sprinkle lightly with baking soda.  Pour the chicken stock over the top and toss.  Serve chilled, with the sweet shell cream on the side.

title: The Easy Art for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup wheat flour | 6 slices pancetta | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Place the barley in a large pot along with 1 cup cold water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cook for at least an hour.  Drain liquid off of the barley in a colander until well drained and place it back into the pot with the wheat and flour.  Place cooked barley, pancetta, golden syrup and vinegar into a large glass dish.  Pour in the heated bbq.  Stir to combine and cook for a further 15 minutes on a moderately hot heat.  To serve, remove from the heat and allow to sit for several minutes before turning out onto a serving plate.

title: Taktoboyaki
ingredients: 1 bag pretzels | 2 medium chipotle peppers | 2 black cardamom pods, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 tsbt tamari
instructions: Boil chipotle peppers in water until skin is blistered, about about 6 minutes.  Immediately transfer in a sieve and cool.  Peel under running water and drain.  Peel skins.

title: Chocolate-Peeled  Deveined  Jumbo Shrimp
ingredients: 5 lbs jumbo shrimp | 3 large vidalia onions | dark chocolate
instructions: In a large kettle, cook the onion in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove with a slotted spoon, plunge into the hot onion and repeat with the shrimp.  Cool and pull off the shells of the shrimp with a paring knife.  Cut tails into 2 halves.  Chop coarsely.  Place on wax paper on a hard surface, cover with heavy duty aluminum foil, and refrigerate overnight.  Chop coarsely and set in a small bowl.  Preheat oven to 475°f.  Uncover the kettle with hot water and boil for 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove with a slotted spoon and strain, reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid.  Cook shrimp on a rack for 3 to 5 minutes.  Turn and cook the other side for 3 to 5 minutes.  Remove the shrimp and drain the cooking liquid.  Place the jumbo shrimp mixture in a large baking dish.  Smooth the top with a spatula.  Sprinkle with chocolates.  Place the baking dish in the broiler and broil for 5 minutes.  Cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,chili,apricot preserve,season salt,bamboo skewer,coconut flake,jumbo shrimp
title: Spicy-Baked Apricot Shrimp
ingredients: 1 jar apricot preserves or ( 15 ounce ) jar raspberry preserves | 12 jumbo shrimp, shelled, and deveined | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon chili | 1/4 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1/4 cup flaked coconut flakes ( approx, see note ) | bamboo skewer, soaked in water for 10 minutes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.  In a medium bowl, combine the preserves with the shrimp, seasoning salt, chili, and adobo.  Toss well.  Arrange the shrimp on a baking sheet, and sprinkle with coconut flakes.  Bake for 6 - 8 minutes, or until shrimp are just pink and coconut flakes are slightly crisp and golden.  Sprinkle with reserved coconut flakes when serving, and serve with spanish rice and sliced green onion.

title: Mexican Cornbread (Pupusas)
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese ( or ricotta or half and half or sour cream ) | 1/3 cup chopped pecans | 1 tablespoon rice flour, or more to taste | 1 medium red bell pepper, diced ( optional )
instructions: Stir cottage cheese, chopped pecans, rice flour, and red bell pepper in a small bowl.  Mash pecans with a fork until mixture is the consistency of corn meal.  Shape mixture into 1 inch round balls.  Preheat griddle or frying pan over medium heat.  Place griddle over medium heat.  Cook until tops start to lighten, about 6 minutes.  Turn over and cook until second side is lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes longer.

title: Greek Spinach
ingredients: 1 pound spinach | 1 jar diced pimento peppers | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed
instructions: Wash spinach, and cut off stems.  Wash peppers and dice.  In a large bowl, mix together spinach, dill weed and pimentos.  Add peppers and toss to mix.  Chill for 2 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Indian Mango and Spinach Appetizers
ingredients: 6 large baking potatoes | 2 cups spinach leaves, chopped | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( optional ) | 1 mango, peeled and chopped
instructions: Bake the potatoes at 425 degrees until soft the potatoes.  You will be tempted to leave them at least 3/4” thick.  Cool and cut in half.  Scoop out the center.  Reserve 1 2/3 cups of the potato flesh, leaving 1/4” chunks and finely chop remaining potato meat.  Put spinach, syrup and cinnamon in blender and puree until well mixed.  Stir in potatoes, cover and chill 8 hours or overnight.  Drop the mixture into a greased casserole dish, placing the reserved potato skins in the center.  Top with mango and bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until heated through and the mango bits turn a golden color.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,italian herb seasoning,apple cider vinegar,butternut squash,cranberry,fast rise yeast
title: Cheaters Butternut Squash With Fruit Relish
ingredients: 1/2 cup picante sauce, divided | 1 -2 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1 1/2 1 1/2 tablespoons fast rising yeast ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried italian herb seasoning ( or 4 - 5 teaspoons oregano and basil ) | 1 1/2 lbs butternut squash ( or butternut squash ) | 1 1/2 cups dried cranberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 and lightly oil a small roasting pan.  In 2 tablespoons of the picante sauce and 1/2 teaspoon of the oregano, stir together.  Pour into a small bowl or serving platter and spread over the squash with a long spoon.  Cover and let rise until puffy.  Meanwhile, prepare your fruit relish, rinse the dried italian herb.  Finely chop or tear the fruit and stir in the remaining picante and 1/2 teaspoon of oregano.  Slice the squash into large chunks.  Arrange the fruit and relish evenly over the squash.  Scatter cranberries over the top.  Cover and let rise 15 to 20 minutes or until squash is almost doubled in size.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until the squash is tender.

title: Achiote Balls
ingredients: 12 dried sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, about 12 ounces | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 teaspoon achiote paste or 1 teaspoon an adobo sauce | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Place sun dried tomatoes in a shallow glass pan or bowl and cover with warm water.  Let soak until softened.  Drain and squeeze out excess water.  Place all ingredients in blender and blend until ingredients are smooth.  Form into small balls using about 1 tablespoon of mixture for one batch.  Roll in bread crumbs.  Chill and store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: french bread,parmesan cheese,asafoetida powder,black mustard seed,pea,cauliflower floret
title: Spicy French Bread Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower florets | 2 cups peas, thawed | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 16 slices | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | grated parmesan cheese, garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cut french bread slices into 1 slices & arrange slices over the bottom half of a large salad bowl.  Mix peas, cauliflower, & mustard seeds, then top with bread slices, asafoetida & sprinkle with parmesan cheese, if using.  Mix lightly & serve.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,black bean,italian breadcrumb,wild rice,irish cream,cream mushroom soup,vanilla extract
title: Wild Rice With Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed & drained | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup irish cream | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons italian breadcrumbs | 2 cups cooked wild rice, chilled
instructions: Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Stir in wild rice and bread crumbs.  Cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until they just start to color.  Stir in the beans and the soup.  Reduce heat to low.

title: Salsa Dribs
ingredients: 2 cups chunky salsa ( i like pace ) | 1/2 cup raw pistachios or 1/2 cup peanuts, toasted, roughly chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cracked pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Combine salsa, pistachios, and black pepper in medium bowl.  Seal in plastic bag.

title: Beef and Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 225 g quinoa ( i like wholemeal, but any grain will do ) | 400 g pink beans, drained | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 450 g iceberg lettuce ( use a little less then normal to reduce )
instructions: Cook the quinoa according to directions on the package, but keep hot.  Drain the quinoa, but leave it wet, if necessary.  Wash and pat dry the beans.  Toast the quinoa in a dry frying pan set over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until it begins to brown around the edges.  Add the beans and beef oxo and continue to stir.  Keep stirring until all the ingredients are well mixed, but do not burn.  To serve, cut the lettuce into wedges and place on a plate.  Pile the salad over top of the lettuce.

title: Vietnamese Hamburger Salad
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 lebanese cucumber, diced | 7 cups lettuce, torn | 1 cup frozen baby peas | 1 tablespoon lime zest
instructions: Brown onion in nonstick skillet.  Drain.  Heat beans.

title: Kielbasa and Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces kielbasa, cut into 1 inch pieces | 12 tablespoons provolone cheese, cut into 8 pieces | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground cumin | 8 ice cubes
instructions: Place kielbasa in a microwave safe bowl with 2 tablespoons water.  Set aside 10 minutes.  Drain kielbasa, removing excess fat.  Place kielbasa pieces in a microwave safe bowl, cover, and cook in the microwave on high for 5 minutes.  Stir in provolone cheese until blended.  Heat remaining teaspoon of water in a small skillet over medium heat until boiling.  Cook kielbasa about 4 minutes or until heated through.  Stir in cumin, stir, and serve.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,triple sec,basil,pickle,fillet catfish,mint leaf
title: Spiced Catfish for 2
ingredients: 4 fillets catfish | 12 ounces chunky peanut butter | 4 tablespoons triple sec | 12 fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Lay catfish into a glass baking dish.  In a saucepan over medium heat, combine peanut butter, triple sec, mint leaves, basil and parsley.  Heat through, stirring constantly.  Pour peanut sauce over the fish and refrigerate for 1 hour to cool.  Preheat broiler.  Broil catfish for 4 - 5 minutes on each side, until just done.

title: Garlic Noodle Dish
ingredients: 2 -4 cloves ( or more if you like ) | 2 -2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 2/3 cup rice noodles ( jumbo size )
instructions: Boil your noodles according to instructions on bag.  Add garlic powder or a good sprinkling of salt.  Serve with freshly grated cheese.

title: Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces buttery gorgonzola, grated | 1/4 cup unbleached cake flour | 6 tablespoons clear broth | 10 ounces sweet cherries, halved
instructions: Cream butter or margarine or margarine into flour until smooth and creamy, gradually add broth.  Add cherries, mix well and put aside for 20 minutes at room temperature.  Turn mixture out onto a hot dish and cook until bubbles form on the surface.  Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Creole Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb fresh sliced creole-style veal or 1 lb frozen sliced veal | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained reserving juice | 1 small onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning
instructions: Coat a 9x13 inch pan with olive oil or spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Place meat and juice in pan and stir to combine.  Sprinkle with onions, creole seasoning and cover with the bamboo shoots.  Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Basil-Barley Pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 2 cups barley ( white ) | 4 -5 large fresh basil leaves, washed
instructions: Combine everything and store in a tightly sealed jar, and use as directed below.  This recipe is excellent for bar basting during the final baking time.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,ginger garlic paste,sea salt,red chilies,graham cracker crumb,herb,semolina
title: Chai Balls (Sooji Ka Halwa)
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup semolina ( sooji ) | 1/3 cup ginger-garlic paste | 1 green cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon mixed candied herbs ( kasoori methi ) | 2 dried red chilies | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Take a bowl and mix graham crackers, semolina, ginger garlic paste, cardamom, lemon juice, kasoori methi, and salt into the mixture.  Roll into small balls about the size of walnuts, roll those into sugar syrup, refrigerate for at least an hour or until solid.

Random Ingredients: pork butt roast,vanilla sugar,sunflower oil,meat,collard green,five spice powder,walnut oil
title: Roast Pork with Collard Greens
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 3 lbs pork butt roast, trimmed and cut in 1 1/2 x 1 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup natural polvoron five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon meat fat | 3 lbs collard greens, stemmed and torn into bite size pieces | 1/3 cup walnut oil
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a large frying pan set over a high heat.  Pat pork dry and add to the hot oil.  Cook, turning several times until brown on both sides.  Reduce the heat to medium and stir in the polvoron five spice powder, vanilla sugar, and meat fat.  Cook, turning several times, 4 minutes for the pork, 5 minutes for the pork, and 10 minutes for the pork, until browned and caramelized.  Remove the pork and spice mixture from the frying pan, and discard any fat.  Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot.  Add the greens and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender.  Remove greens with a slotted spoon and drain in a colander set over a bowl with cold water.  Dice the pork into 1/2 inch cubes, and return to the pot.  Toss well.  Add the walnut oil and toss with the greens just before serving.

title: Sardines in a Coat
ingredients: 24 fresh sardines | 1 cup dark seedless raisin | 1/4 cup fresh dill weed
instructions: In a very large skillet arrange the sardines on half the raisins.  Sprinkle seeds over the sardines so that they are all submerged.  Scatter dillweed over them and cook over medium heat for about 10 - 15 minutes until they are golden.  Turn down heat and cover the skillet.  Cook sardines for 30 minutes, removing the sardines and cooking them on their own.  Serve with lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,cranberry juice concentrate,mustard powder,hoisin sauce
title: Beef Cranberry-Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef sirloin | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1 can frozen cranberry juice concentrate | 1/8 teaspoon mustard powder, may desired
instructions: Trim fat from beef.  Cut beef in 1/4 inch slices.  Combine with hoisin sauce, cranberry juice concentrate and mustard powder.  Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: wild mushroom,head bok choy,egg,taco seasoning mix,italian sausage
title: Wild Mushroom and Italian Sausage Omelette
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix, divided | 3/4 cup chopped fresh wild mushrooms | 1 pound ground italian sausage | 1 head bok choy, chopped with tough stems | 2 packages taco seasoning mix
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat.  Lightly grease the pan.  Beat eggs with 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix in a shallow dish.  Add mushrooms to egg mixture, stirring to coat in batter.  Cook mushrooms just until tender, about 3 minutes per side.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Spread sausage and remaining 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning in the pan.  Cook and stir until sausage is evenly browned, and vegetables are crisp tender, about 5 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, remove sausage, vegetables and sausage to a bowl.  Spread remaining taco seasoning over sausage mixture in the pan.

title: Tortilla Espanola
ingredients: 1 package hard salami, thinly sliced | 1 can chopped mild green chile peppers | 3 tablespoons arrowroot, dissolved in | 2 tablespoons water | 2 slices pickled green chile peppers, cut into thin slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place salami slices onto a large sheet of aluminum foil.  Bake salami slices in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until crisp and lightly browned.  Place chiles on a plate while preparing caramel sauce.  Place arrowroot in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: herb,red bean paste,french dressing,fenugreek leaf,maple syrup,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Easy Baked Red Bean Paste
ingredients: 1/4 cup french dressing, divided | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon red bean paste | 1/4 cup mixed herbs, chopped, divided | 1/4 teaspoon ground fenugreek leaves | 1 tablespoon pure maple syrup
instructions: Line a 4 cup capacity oven proof pan with baking paper.  Combine 2 tablespoons of the french dressing with the oil spray in a blender, 1 teaspoon at a time, pulsing 2 times.  Set aside.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Combine bean paste, herbs, fenugreek and maple syrup in a small bowl and stir to blend well.  Add remaining french dressing and stir to combine.  Spread paste in prepared pan, sprinkle with remaining tablespoonful of french dressing and bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, then cover with aluminum foil and bake 20 minutes more.  Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.  Store for up to a week.

title: Ginger Beef
ingredients: 2 ounces fresh ginger, peeled, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 175 g beef mince, coarsely chopped | 375 g beef rump roast, trimmed, finely chopped
instructions: Heat the oil in a frypan and cook the ginger until it turns golden.  Add the beef and cook until brown all the way through.  Reduce the heat and stir in the mince.  Cook, stirring for 5 minutes or until the beef has melted and the mixture is creamy and cooked through.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,liquid smoke,filling,fish sauce,hot sausage,red bell pepper
title: Devilled Chutney Pastries (Nuoc Leo Mandarin)
ingredients: 3/4 cup liquid smoke, or as needed | 1/3 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1/4 cup fish sauce | filling : | 1 package hot roll dough, frozen biscuits, crushed | 1/2 pound sliced sweet sausage
instructions: Place 2 tablespoons liquid smoke in a microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: spice,italian parsley,phyllo dough,bread,fennel bulb,lime juice,beef chuck
title: Cuban Spiced Meat Rolls
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried fennel bulbs, mashed | 1 tablespoon chopped italian parsley | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons ground mixed spice ( i use spice hunter brand ) | 1 beef chuck | 1 slice bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 8 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place fennel bulbs, parsley, lime juice, mixed spice, and ground beef in a large zip top plastic bag.  Shake well to combine.  Transfer mixture to a rimmed baking pan.  Using a melon baller, gently crush meat with a rolling pin to coat.  Lay bread cubes on beef, cut side down, in a cross hatch pattern.  Roll up meat and secure with a toothpick.  Repeat with remaining bread, meat, and spice mixture.  Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray.  Arrange rolls on top of baking sheet.  Cover loosely with foil and bake 40 minutes.  Uncover and bake 25 minutes longer or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f.

title: Nutsy Butter Cannoli
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine, softened | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 2 -5 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Beat margarine for 3 minutes in a bowl.  Add cottage cheese, coffee granules and spice and mix until combined.  Chill until mixture stiffens.  Roll into balls about the size of a ping pong ball.  Dust with a little confectioners' sugar if desired.  Refrigerate until firm.

title: Cauliflower Cheese Skewers With Coconut, Peas and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 200 g manchego cheese, block cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1/2 cup frozen peas | 1 tablespoon fresh grated coconut | 10 bamboo skewers
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat.  Thread cauliflower onto six 6 - 8 bamboo skewers, accordion style.  Pour oil into a large non stick fry pan, add manchego, peas and coconut.  Cook, tossing and heating until cheese has melted and mixture begins to caramelise.  Cook for 2 minutes.  Place vegetables on a platter or tray, spoon over drippings and serve.

title: Hawaiian Pepper Tea
ingredients: 30 1/4 ounces pineapple chunks ( not canned ) | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 1/2 ounce teabags ( cellophane )
instructions: Fill tea bottle with boiling water, add tea bag and brew 1 - 2 minutes.

title: Cornbread Scones or Wedges
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 3 tablespoons self-raising flour | 3 tablespoons corn syrup | 2 tablespoons onion flakes
instructions: Put the flour, corn syrup, and onion flakes in a bowl and make a well in the centre.  Add the butter and mix thoroughly with your hands.  Mix all the ingredients together with clean palms.  Form into small balls and flatten slightly with your hands.  Bake on an oven tray for 45 minutes at 190oc/375f / gas mark 6, depending on the size of your breads.  The amount of breads required determines the size of your breads, therefore, it is important to bake until the tops and bottoms have crisped up some.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,pecorino romano cheese,dark chocolate,swiss chard,dijon mustard,vanilla essence,malt vinegar,mace
title: Black Forest Swiss Chard -  Hot Heat & Savoury
ingredients: 200 g swiss chard | 1 teaspoon malt vinegar | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon dark chocolate | 100 g kidney beans ( rinsed if you want, see note ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( or 2 tbsp honey ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | grated pecorino romano cheese, to serve
instructions: Wash and core the swiss chard, then cut into 4 pieces on a diagonal.  Remove the stalks if your chard is large and if it is large, cut to fit a flat dish or similar.  Wash and rinse the chard, dry well and leave covered in a warm place until tender, about 30 minutes, then pat dry with towel.  Trim stalks off of chard and cut into 2cm pieces.  Bring 2 cups of water to the boil, add the chard, cover and cook over a low heat for about 25 - 30 minutes until tender.  Meanwhile, mix together the vinegar, Dijon, dark chocolate, kidney beans, vanilla and mace in a medium bowl, then add to the chard mixture and stir.  Serve the hot chard salad on a bed of warm crusty bread with pecorino romano cheese sprinkled over for decoration.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,baking potato,horseradish,salad oil,puff pastry,sesame seed,feta cheese,marshmallow
title: Beef Tenderloin Mini Pies
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed, and unfolded | 1 tablespoon salad oil, or as needed, divided | 1/2 cup crushed miniature marshmallows | 1/4 cup thinly sliced salisbury-style chips | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon horseradish | 1/4 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f.  Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.  Place beef on the prepared baking sheets.  Bake beef in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the beef reaches 120 degrees f on an instant reading thermometer, about 20 minutes.  Allow to cool slightly before slicing against the grain with a sharp knife.  Heat 1 tablespoon salad oil in a skillet over medium high heat until hot and bubbling.  Cook marshmallows in the hot oil until softened and beginning to caramelize.  Add chipped beef.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,ice water,baby carrot,mirin,tagliatelle pasta noodle,onion soup mix
title: Togarashi (Japanese Style Fresh Noodle)
ingredients: 8 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles ( or linguine ) | 1/2 large onion, grated | 2 teaspoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 6 tablespoons ice water | 4 cups shredded baby carrots | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Boil about 6 quarts of water with the onion.  Add noodles and cook until al dente, about 8 minutes.  Drain, and set aside.  Heat a large pot of water on the stove.  Place the drained noodles and grated carrots in the pot and cook for a few minutes to soak some of the liquid.  Pour in the rice wine and evaporated milk, stir.  Return noodles to the pot, mixing in the yogurt.  Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.  Serve hot.

title: Camarones  With Shrimp (Camarones De Camarones)
ingredients: 20 shrimp, large | 4 ounces cashews | 1 tablespoon nam pla | 3/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 green cardamom pod | 20 pepperoncini peppers | 20 slices zucchini
instructions: Shell the shrimp and let them cool down by running a knife under cold water and setting aside.  In a mortar and pestle grind cashews until smooth.  Break the shrimp up with a teaspoon of nam pla, thyme and pepperoncino.  Place 2 tablespoon of nuts into the shell on the shrimp.  Place a few slices of zucchini into the shell on top of the shrimp.  Roll the shrimp in cashews, ensuring that they are completely covered.  Repeat on other side.  Makes approximately 2 dozenCamarones.  Keep in the refridgerator.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,red bell pepper,peanut butter,coriander,radish,cotija cheese
title: Ww 5 Points - Thai Peanut Butter Salad With Radishes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons smooth peanut butter | 1 tablespoon water chestnut, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh coriander | 1/4 teaspoon grated fresh coconut ( optional ) | 1/2 small red bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 small radish, peeled and chopped
instructions: Mash peanut butter in medium bowl with fork until smooth.  Stir in water chestnuts, coriander, coconut, and optional red pepper.  Add radish.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,cod,lima bean,italian turkey sausage,canola oil,jam,almond extract
title: Italian Sausage and Lima Beans
ingredients: 2 teaspoons canola oil or 2 teaspoons olive oil | 6 italian turkey sausage, remove casings | 1 can lima beans, drained and rinsed ( cannellini beans ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon jam ( we used maple syrup ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Heat oil in a skillet and brown sausages until almost no longer pink, about 10 minutes.  Place remaining ingredients in a 2 to 3 qt.  Baking dish.  Place sausage on top and pour the mixture over the sausage and beans.  Cover and bake for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.  If desired you can make a gravy with the preserves, pour the sauce over the sausage and beans.

title: Baked Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck or 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 1/4 cup lemon pepper | 1/4 cup lemon sauce | 1/4 cup catsup | 3 tablespoons cream | 1/2 cup pepitas ( pumpkin seeds, crushed ) | 1/2 cup quick tapioca | 1/2 cup chopped roasted pumpkin seeds
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a ziplock bag, marinate overnight.  Preheat oven to 300°f.  Line a 13x9x2 inch baking pan with foil.  Thread meat onto skewers.  Place on rack in pan with meat.  Bake for 1 hour or until cooked to your liking.  During the last 15 minutes of cooking, mix lemon pepper sauce with cream.  Spread kabobs with sauce and garnish with pepitas.  Serve with rice.  Garnish with pumpkin seeds.

title: Guloubeh (Gorkhali Braised Beef and Pearl Onions)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs of beef bones ( kidneys, mutton, beef and marrow ) | 4 large brown onions | 1 teaspoon citric acid | 1/2 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Wash and cut the onions into halves lengthwise.  Put them into the pan with the meat.  Add the liquid and spices. .  Bake in a preheated oven at 360°f for 2 1/2 hours or until the meat is tender and has begun to fall off of bones.  Note, if using a wooden spoon, mix gently by hand to ensure that spices are neither sticks to the pan.  If using a mortar and pestle, pulverize the ingredients.  If not using a mortar and pestle, pulverize using a stick blender or blending in batches.  Serve hot.

title: Guatemalan Peanut Butter Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Mix peanut butter with cocoa in a bowl until smooth.  Fold in guacamole until smooth.  Refrigerate for an hour to blend flavors.

title: Super Easy Spinach and Eggplant
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 large eggplants | 4 cups fresh spinach, chopped
instructions: Heat oil in pan on medium heat.  Peel and cube eggplants.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,beef tenderloin,chunky salsa,italian tomato,vegetable stock
title: Hearty Beef and Bean Sprout Soup
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 3-inch pieces | 12 ounces chunky salsa | 4 cups vegetable stock | 1 1/2 cups fresh bean sprouts | 1 can italian tomatoes, with liquid
instructions: Place meat in crockpot and place on high 2 hours.  Add salsa and vegetable stock and cook on high 15 minutes.  Turn slow cooker to low and add sprouts and tomatoes.  Cook for an additional 45 minutes.

title: French Dip for Beef
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat | 1 cup chicken bouillon
instructions: Cut beef into 1 inch pieces.  Place in a saucepan with enough water to cover.  Bring to a slow boil.  Stir in bouillon, and reduce heat.  Simmer for 1 hour.

title: Chile Fritters
ingredients: 4 ripe tomatoes and green chilies, seeded and chopped ( or 8 ounces frozen fava beans ) | 1 can chopped ripe olives | 1/2 bun ( pita bread ), split and halves - warmed
instructions: Chop the tomatoes and onions very finely.  Scoop out and discard the seeds and juices in a large bowl and set them aside.  Add the olives and fava beans and finely chop them, then mix through the tomatoes with the chile paste.  Heat a frying pan over medium heat and use a spoon to pour approx 2 ladlefuls of the vegetable mixture in along with warmed pita bread and cook quickly, to your liking.  Allow about a minute or two for the bread to soak up the flavours, it will go crispy and go lovely and sticky.  Serve immediately.

title: Shaggy Piglets
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds boneless pork roast | 1 1/2 cups minced beets | 4 -8 cloves garlic paste
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees.  Rub pork with garlic paste and put on a rack in a roasting pan or large roasting pan.  Bake in preheated oven for 2 to 3 hours at 325 degrees, or until meat is very tender.  This can be checked and covered with a towel and taken off the oven just as the end of the 2 to 3 hours.  It should take at least 1 1/2 hours to reach the degree of crispiness you prefer.

title: My Own Zucchini and Bulgur
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lard or 1 1/2 lbs vegetable fat | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds ( crushed ) | 1 large bulb | 3/4 cup grain bulgur ( fine )
instructions: Rinse the bulgur and add the oil to a nonstick fry pan.  Add the bulgur and fry until it is a pale brown color, then pour into a colander over a bowl or colander, place the bowl over the bowl and allow to drain for 5 minutes.  Cut the bulb into 1 inch cubes and fry in a pan of hot lard, until it is golden brown.  This step is optional if you have a zucchini fryer, but will assure a crispier zucchini.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Prawns with Celery
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1 celery ribs, leaves only
instructions: Shell & devein prawns.  Chop vegetables & mix with eggs till they are just heated through.

title: Hot Spinach
ingredients: 1 bag fresh spinach leaves, washed | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 cup salsa, or to taste
instructions: Place spinach in a bowl and coat with tomato paste.  Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.  Bring salsa to a boil in a microwave safe bowl, stirring occasionally.  Remove spinach from salsa and place on a serving dish.  Stir until spinach becomes bright green and limp.  Serve hot.

instructions: Pour 1 1/2 quarts boiling water over the cubed bacon pieces to soften them slightly and to stop them from browning.  Drain off any excess grease. 3 tablespoons brown rice, soaked in cold water | 1 loaf rye bread ( approx.

instructions: Break bread into small pieces.  Remove crusts and tear bread into small bits.  Add the rice and oregano to the bread bits.  Wrap the bread in foil and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Serve warm or cold.

instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil.  Add vermicelli, cook for 3 - 4 minutes drain and place the noodles on a clean cloth. Place the chopped coriander seed in a dry frypan over a medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes until they smell aromatic.  Remove from the heat and leave until cool and slightly darker. Place the noodles and the spice paste into a bowl and toss to coat.  Spoon into serving bowls and chill for 2 hours to develop the flavours of the flavours.

instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Place the rags in a pan, cook over medium heat, stirring often, for 1 minute. title: Easy Mustard Salmon

title: Chicken Legs and Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 8 boneless chicken legs | 2 tablespoons self rising flour | 1 can chopped canned tomatoes | 2 cups self-rising flour, or as needed ( optional ) | 1 cup chocolate chips | 2 cans chili-garlic sauce | 1 package wide rice noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the chicken legs onto a baking sheet or pan, fatty side down.  Drizzle with 1 tablespoon flour, and lightly salt the chicken.  Roast chicken in preheated oven until no longer pink in the center, about 15 minutes.  Remove from oven, and set aside for about 10 minutes.  Remove the chicken from the oven, and return it to the oven.  Turn off the oven completely, and leave oven door slightly ajar.  Place the tomatoes and 1 cup flour in a blender, and process on high speed until smooth.  When the chicken legs are cool enough to handle, remove meat from the meat, and cut into cubes.  Place half of the chopped onion into the blender.  Pour half of the chili garlic sauce into the blender, and process on high to get the sauce.  Mix in the remaining chopped onion.  Put the chicken back into the oven, and return it to the oven for 15 more minutes.  While the chicken is cooking, make the noodles.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and add the rice noodles.  Cook until tender, about 5 minutes, and drain.  Set aside.  When the chicken is done, drain excess fat.  Bring a pot of water to a boil, and cook the noodles.  Drain and set aside.  Place the chicken pieces atop hot water in a roasting pan or stockpot for about 5 minutes.  While the chicken is roasting, spread half of the chocolate chips over the top of the chicken, and turn the chicken, skin side down onto the chocolate chips.  Set the roasting pan on the top shelf of the oven, so the chip will remain hot.  When the chocolate is melted, poke the chicken with a fork several times, until the chocolate chip is mostly covered.  Pour the chicken and sauce over the noodles, and sprinkle with the remaining chocolate chips.  Use a wooden spoon to stir the noodles with the chicken, and cook on high heat until the sauce is hot and bubbling.  Turn off the heat, open the oven door, and leave the roasting pan in the oven for 10 minutes.  Remove chicken from the oven, and wrap a piece of aluminum foil around the chicken, or leave the foil on the pot and place over a burner in the oven.  Turn the heat back to medium, or set the chicken pieces back onto the roasting pan, and roast for 20 more minutes.  Do not leave the pot on the burner over the stove too long, because it scorches.  When the chicken legs are slightly browned on the back of a fork, flip them over, then place the pot back on the burner.  Continue to roast for 15 more minutes.  To serve, scoop out some noodles from the roasting pan, and drop them into the chicken and chocolate sauce.  Garnish with a slice of chicken, drizzle with some of the chili garlic sauce, and serve.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Arrange the pita bread on a baking sheet.  Bake for about 6 minutes, or according to the instructions on the pita breads.  When the pita bread is toasted, spray it with non stick cooking spray.  Spread the chili sauce over the pitas.  Sprinkle sage over the pita bread.  Top with dates, cherries and shaved parmesan cheese.  Broil for a few minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

title: Parmesan Gnocchi
ingredients: 2 lbs grape tomatoes | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 6 ounces gin ( schlenker zwiebelers ) | 1/3 cup parmesan cheese | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne | 6 cups flour
instructions: Cut grape tomatoes in half.  Scoop out seeds leaving about 1/2 inch of juice for juice.  Place in saucepan.  Add 1/2 cup dark soy sauce diluted in 1/3 cup of the gin.  Bring to a boil, add 3/4 cup parmesan cheese.  Stir until melted.  Drop tomatoes in, spooning some of the juice onto the tomatoes.  Leave about 1/2 2/3 cup liquid in saucepan.  Add 1/3 cup dark soy sauce diluted in 1/3 cup of the gin to tomato juice mixture.  Repeat with remaining batches and add to tomato mixture.  Bring juice and juices to boil and boil for 3 - 5 minutes.  Take off heat.  Place 1 1/2 cups Gnocchi in a well oiled pot.  Cover with boiling water.  Add 2 tbsp parmesan cheese.  Bring to boil and boil 2 - 3 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Scoop out and place on side for garnish.  Garnish with some fresh parsley.  Enjoy.

title: Currants With Red Onion
ingredients: 1 cup dried currant | 1 red onion
instructions: Soak the currants overnight.  Slice the onion.  Place the onion with their liquid in a saucepan with the currants.  Cook over medium heat until the onion softens and all the liquid is absorbed.  Reduce the heat to a low simmer and cook for 15 minutes.

title: Nigella Lawson
ingredients: 2 teaspoons finely chopped green cardamom pods | 4 tablespoons orange liqueur
instructions: Place cardamon in a small heatproof bowl, add 1 tbsp orange liqueur and set aside to marinate for 1 hour.  Thread the cardamon on 2 skewers and grill over hot coals, with a pinch of salt, or until lightly golden around the edges.  Serve sprinkled with orange liqueur.

title: Pasta With Sweet Chilli Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat penne | 4 cups cabbage ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup raspberry | 2 teaspoons sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup fresh white breadcrumb | 1/4 teaspoon salt or 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Cook pasta according to instructions.  Meanwhile, fry cabbage and drain in a skillet adding raspberry.  Toss through warm pasta with sweet chilli sauce and bread crumbs.  Top with paprika.

title: Mustard Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 2 tablespoons mustard | 1 tablespoon ginger juice | 1 tablespoon chives | 3 tablespoons virgin olive oil
instructions: Separate cauliflower into bite sized florets.  Heat the mustard and chives in a bowl.  Add all of the mixed spices to the cauliflower and toss together until the cauliflower is coated in the sweet mustard/chive mix.

title: Tasty Lamb Salad With Mango and Rosemary
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped ripe mango | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons freshly chopped rosemary | 4 ripe thin, thin-cured greek cucumbers | 2 -3 slices country cut lamb | 1/2 cup thinly sliced fresh maraschino cherry

title: Serves 4 when My Mum's Pies!

Turn off heat and leave.  Pie shell.  Spoon beetroot mixture into the shell evenly so that each pie comes full.  Top with remaining gruyere cheese and bake in 375f oven until browned and crust is crisp. .

instructions: Stir the orange juice, tamari, lemon juice and grated lemon rind into the white flour, and beat for two minutes over a hot grill or saucepan of boiling water, until thick and smooth.

While you are waiting for it to cool down, add a handful of your pasta to the skillet and cook for about 2 minutes on each side or until browned and crispy on the outside. After cooking all the eggplant, drain and put into a large bowl.  You will not need to drain it, but if you do, add about 1/2 cup of olive oil to the eggplant.  Mix the flour with a large drop or two of olive oil to make a slurry.  After about 1 minute add the eggplant, then the flour and eggplant/onion mixture back into the hot skillet, stirring to coat everything with the oil.  You may need to add a little more.  Keep going on your pancetta/olive oil sauce while you start pasta.  Add two cups of sauce to the pasta, mix well and cook in the same pan as stated above.  I usually add an extra tablespoon of olive oil, but when you take it out of the skillet, it should turn a nice golden brown color.  If necessary, you can use more oil.  When it is done, it will absorb the sauce and become soft.  You can enjoy this simple meal as is, or serve as is with a traditional italian vegetable.

title: Chinese Savoury Rings (Chokladbollar)

instructions: Mix cake, 3 1/4 cups all purpose flour with sweet rice wine or sherry in a large bowl.  Cut breadsticks into 4 slices, and toss with 2/3 cup of the remaining cake flour. Brown on both sides, turning as necessary, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red snapper fillet,red chili,sugar,coriander seed,courgette,snap pea
title: Spicy Red Snapper for Two

instructions: Place whole chillies, coriander seeds, and sliced fish in a small frying pan or wok over medium high heat, cook, stirring, for about 1 - 2 minutes, until dark and fragrant/smoked. title: Citrus Dolce De Provencale: Glazed Fresh Herb Salad
ingredients: 75 g fresh dill weed ( about 15 leaves, or 2 teaspoons dried ) | 2 tablespoons of good quality pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 tablespoons aged cinamole ( optional or chilli sauce ) | 120 ml sake ( for dipping ) | 2 teaspoons caster sugar
instructions: Prepare or prepare the pesto.  Put all the remaining ingredients in a blender or mortar and whiz until the mixture is smooth. Remove from the heat and immediately drop in the sugar.  Stir until all the sugar has dissolved.  Pour the syrup into a small bowl and set aside until needed.  Use as a dressing for french bread or serve as a side.  You can also use as a topping for fresh herbs.

title: Easy Gingerbread
ingredients: 500 g graham crackers, coarsely crushed | 80 g honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c/350f.  Melt honey and mix with graham crackers.  Press mixture together on a cake rack and bake for 20 25mins.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,head cauliflower,lemon zest,cayenne pepper,cottage cheese,arrowroot,gingerroot,cold milk
title: Cauliflower Cheese
ingredients:
1 small head cauliflower, cored and cut into florets | 1 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon lemons, zest of or 1/4-1/2 teaspoon orange zest ( i just leave the 1/2-1 tsp, as i find it less bitter ) | 1/4 - 1/3 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( more or less according to your preference ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cottage cheese ( depending on how much you like cheese ) | 1 tablespoon arrowroot ( or cornstarch, if you like this.

instructions: Steam the cauliflower until tender but not mushy, usually around 10 - 15 minutes, i have it in a crockpot for about 6 - 8 hours, but you can even pop it back in the crockpot and let it cook on low for a while it really does change the texture in the dish.  Remove cauliflower from stock and place into bowl.  Place all remaining ingredients in the blender and puree together until smooth. .  Pour over cauliflower and toss to coat.  Serve on plate with a sprinkling of poppy seeds, if desired.

title: Sausage and Pear Pizza
ingredients: 500gr fresh pork sausage | parsley and part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 pear ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°.  Cut bacon into 1 slices.  Poke holes in the sausage with a fork poke slices in, to release flavor.  Sprinkle with parsley then place on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake for about 40 minutes or until heated through.  Remove from oven.  Spread a slice of pizza dough with 1 tablespoon of goat cheese and top with the sausages.  Bake for about 10 minutes or until golden brown.  Enjoy.

title: Cazuki Beans (Japanese Beans, Zucchini) With Tomatoes & Pimento
ingredients: 1 lb dried cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 6 medium zucchini, cut lengthwise into eighths | 4 tablespoons margarine or 4 tablespoons butter | 6 tablespoons brandy or 6 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 cup kumara ( japanese pumpkin ), cut into 1/4-inch chunks ( or use as many as desired ) | 1 pimento pepper, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place water and beans into a large saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium, cover and simmer 15 minutes.  Drain and set aside. Heat margarine in a large skillet over medium high heat.  Saute zucchini for 15 minutes, or until browned, stirring often.  Remove zucchini and place in a bowl. Remove from heat and stir in the beans and vegetables.  Taste the beans and adjust seasoning.  Serve hot.

title: Mmmm Beef Gravy for 1
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef gravy ( or venison steak ) | 1 leaf fresh oregano leaves | cooked rice, to serve with
instructions: Heat 1 tsp.  Of the gravy in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture just begins to bubble, but before it reaches boiling cook a strip of the meat and add it to the skillet.  Stir until meat is lightly browned and the gravy thickens.  Stir in the oregano leaves and serve over cooked rice.

Place stuffed vegato on a non stick baking tray lined with baking paper.  Brush tops of rolls with peter luger sauce.  Bake in the oven for 40 minutes, or until tender.

ingredients: 1 lb dried kidney beans ( or red kidney beans ) | 2 teaspoons dried chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon hot chili paste | 12 sheets chopped phyllo pastry | 2 tablespoons chocolate, melted
instructions: Rinse the beans and drain the liquid.  Place the beans in a saucepan with enough cold water to cover them by at least 2 inches.
