Random Ingredients: bread,miso,parmigiano reggiano cheese,lime juice,cremini mushroom,green cardamom
title: Crostoli   (Mushroom Soup)
ingredients: 32 large cremini mushrooms, cleaned | 20 green cardamoms | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly shredded | 3/4 cup sour crema miso or 3/4 cup sour cream | 2 limes, juice of, freshly squeezed | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | crouton ( to garnish ) or bread ( to garnish )
instructions: Cut the mushrooms into 1/3 inch slices.  Cut the cardamoms in half and place them in a small bowl, sprinkle with salt, then add enough water to cover.  Set aside.  Place the cardamom pods in a mortar and break them apart a few times with a pestle or a fork.  In a medium frying pan, add enough water to cover the mushrooms, bring to a rolling boil and immediately lower the heat to medium.  Cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes or until they are tender, being very careful not to overcook.  Drain the mushrooms onto paper towels and reserve.  Reserve cooking water.  Melt the miso paste in a small heavy bottomed pan over low heat.  Add the cheese and stir over low heat for 1 minute.  Add the mushroom pieces and cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring frequently.  To serve, ladle the mushroom soup into individual small soup bowls, with a scoop of sour cream and lots of grated parmigiano reggiano cheese for garnishing at the table.  Ladle the soup into shallow warmed soup bowls and garnish the tops with a few croutons or bread croutons.  A small bowl of chuka or ice cream can be added to the soup for a change of pace.

title: Thai Noodles
ingredients: 3 cups cooked rice noodles ( rice stick noodles also known as banh phad, found on asian foods aisle ) | 1/2 cup fresh coriander, chopped | 1/4 cup lemon peel, chopped
instructions: Combine ingredients except rice sticks, and store in refrigerator up to 4 days.  Stir before using.  For thicker noodle, cook and drain noodles as directed.

title: Chicken With Shredded Pork
ingredients: 1/4 lb ground meat | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 2 tablespoons canola oil ( divided ) | 2 tablespoons bisquick ( dry ) | 1 cup shredded cooked chicken | 1/4 cup sliced pitted black olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  In large skillet, cook meat and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,almond meal,mustard powder,chipotle powder,rosemary,mandarin orange,canola oil
title: Oaxacan Tarts
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 -2 teaspoon chinese rosemary, finely chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) or 1/4-1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1 cup almond meal or 1 cup other almond meal
instructions: Mix the mayonnaise with the mustard powder, chinese rosemary, cardamom powder.  If desired, garnish with a pinch of ground chipotle.  Put the ground almond meal in an airtight container.  Pour the mayo mixture over your nuts or mix with a cookie scoop.  Enjoy.

title: Thai  Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons lemongrass, finely minced ( from fresh lemongrass ) | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Cut meat into 1 inch cubes.  Place in medium bowl.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

title: Cashew Shrimp Soup
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, chopped ( any color ) | 1 tablespoon vegemite | 250 g small cooked shelled shrimp | 1 cup raw cashews | 200 ml coconut-flavoured broth | 100 ml condensed ham hock or 100 ml tamarind concentrate | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 600 g bean sprouts
instructions: Spray the inside of a stock pot with nonstick spray.  Heat the pot over medium high heat.  Add the bell pepper and cook, stirring, for 3 - 4 minutes, until the pepper is soft.  Remove from heat.  Add the shrimp and cashews to the pot and cook for 1 - 2 minutes.  Stir in the coconut paste, ham hock or tamarind concentrate, sugar, sprouts and 1/4 cup water, stirring to mix well.  Pour into the stock pot and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, until the soup bubbles and thickens a bit.  Serve hot.

title: Hot Five-Spice Coffee
ingredients: 1 kg fresh yeast | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 12 cups hot black coffee | 1 kg tasty courgette | cherries, halved
instructions: Put oven rack in middle of oven.  Combine the yeast, 5 spice and 5 cups strong black coffee.  Allow to stand until bubbly, about 5 minutes.  Put the courgette into a colander lined with cheese cloth, put over a bowl and pour the coffee over.  Leave to mature in a warm, draught free place for 2 days or until setting temperature reaches 220°c.  To serve, top with the courgette and cherry halves and leave to stand for 5 minutes.

title: Szechwan Chilli Omelette
ingredients: 3 eggs, beaten | caster sugar | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1/4 cup caster sugar, extra
instructions: Stir all ingredients together, and leave over night.  Preheat your oven to 170ºc.  Heat a frying pan, until a cube of bread dropped in changes colour all around.  Pour in a little of the oil, drop in as many egg slices as will cover.  Turn up the heat and cook, turning until golden brown.  Slice into wedges, drizzle over more oil and serve.  Eat with chinese tea, a fresh salad.

title: Garlicky Flants
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon mixed italian herbs | 12 small -8 large flour tortillas, warmed until pliable
instructions: Sprinkle mixed and italian herbs evenly over warm tortillas.  Roll up tortilla in your hands and place burritos about 1 1/2 inches from each other on an ungreased baking sheet.  Place in preheated 475f oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until bubbly.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,dark rum,golden mushroom soup,red onion,tahini
title: Roasted Sweet Red Onion
ingredients: 5 medium red onions, halved, cut lengthwise in half before cutting in half | 1 can golden mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Toss the onions, soup, rum, tahini, and chile flakes together in a roasting pan on the medium heat.  Cook until the onions are slightly tender and lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

title: Whole Grain semolina and Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb skinless chicken thighs | 4 teaspoons semolina ( gram flour ) | 4 teaspoons whole wheat flour, mixed with | 4 teaspoons water, to make a thick, smooth paste
instructions: Cut the chicken into cubes and marinate them in four tablespoons of semolina.  Take off the marinade and make a few slits into the thickest part of the chicken cubes.  Coat the chicken with the remaining semolina.  Spray a shallow oven or pan with oil and lay the chicken in the pan.  Cover with the lid and leave inside the oven for 30 minutes.  Check if the chicken is cooked.  If not, leave till it is, remove lid and leave for 7 - 10 minutes.  When the chicken starts to turn pale, remove the lid and put the chicken back on the lid.  Turn the chicken pieces over and continue cooking till the chicken is dry and tender.

title: Baked Irish Oiled Scallops
ingredients: 4 scallops | 6 ounces irish cream | grand marnier, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Cut a slit in the side of each scallop.  Brush the inside of a medium size glass measuring cup with grand marnier.  Pour the irish cream over the scallops taking care not to dislodge any of the sour creamy residue from the top.  Place the scallops in the ceramic cups.  Bake the scallops for about 5 to 10 minutes, or until golden brown on the surface and cooked through.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: topping,mix,cream,potato traditional,cashew nut,baking soda,tomato green chile pepper,yellow cornmeal
title: Mashed Potato Pie III
ingredients: 1/2 cup potato traditional traditional ( optional ) | 1 cup mashed potatoes | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/3 cup light cream | 3/4 cup sour cream | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, undrained | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 cups shredded carrot-flavored whipped topping | 1 pinch ground cashew nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place potatoes in a large bowl, and mash with fork.  Stir in cornmeal, light cream, sour cream, tomatoes with green chiles, baking soda, and carrots.  Mix in whipped topping and cashew nuts.  Bake in the preheated oven 30 to 35 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.  Cool 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Roasted Potatoes With Ricotta and Fresh Lemon
ingredients: 7 fresh medium red new potatoes, cut into 1/4-1/3/4-1-inch slices | 1 tablespoon coarse salt | 1 pint ricotta cheese | 1/2 tablespoon finely grated fresh lemon zest
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Spread the slices of potatoes evenly in a large, lightly oiled baking sheet and rub with salt.  Roast the potatoes, turning once, for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender, stirring once or twice.  Meanwhile, stir together the ricotta, lemon zest and 1 teaspoon each of salt and pepper.  Spread the ricotta mixture over the roasted potatoes in the baking sheet.  Bake uncovered, stirring occasionally, for about 15 minutes or until the ricotta mixture is bubbly.

title: Fresh Fried Pepper Jelly With Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 50 -60 pieces pepper ( red, green or orange ) | 100 white sugar | vanilla essence ( optional ) | 200 g bean sprouts, washed
instructions: Cut peppers in slices and fry lightly in oil.  When completely transparent, stir in sugar or vanilla essence.  Add bean sprouts.  Stir until mixed and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,parmesan cheese,soymilk,canadian bacon,frying chicken,brown mustard seed,hungarian paprika,grain bread
title: Hungarian Beef and Paprika Canapes - Canapes
ingredients: 1 frying chicken | 1/2 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 300 g canadian bacon, slices thinly sliced | 150 ml soymilk | 4 slices whole grain bread, toasted | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry with paper towels.  Cut chicken into 4 pieces and set aside.  Place sliced bacon in a small frypan.  Over medium heat, cook until it begins to crisp.  Remove bacon and set aside keeping warm.  Using a blender container or food processor, blend paprika, soymilk and mustard until smooth.  Set aside.  Using a large oven baking sheet or baking dish large enough, place bread, toasted bread slices, paprika side up, on baking sheet.  Sprinkle with half the cheese.  Top with second baking sheet or baking dish which has been slightly sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.  Using both hands, press bread slices a few times to form 1/2 inch thick slices.  Repeat until all slices are pressed.  Using both hands, carefully transfer pressed bread slices onto hot baking sheet, making sure to coat.  Bake in 425 degree oven about 5 minutes or until golden brown and crisp.

Random Ingredients: salad green,chipotle powder,tomatillo,tap water,vegetable stock,greek yogurt,chocolate
title: Tzatziki Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces mexican plain chocolate, finely chopped | 4 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 cup hot tap water | 4 ounces plain greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons smooth plain greek yogurt | 1 tomatillo, husked, rinsed, dried, and roasted, chopped | 1 pinch dried chipotle powder
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the chocolate, vegetable stock, and hot water.  Cook over medium heat until it bubbles, stirring frequently, then remove from heat and set aside.  In a medium bowl, stir the yogurt with the greek style yogurt until well blended and creamy.  Fold in 1/2 the tomatillo, and add the chocolate mixture.  Season to taste with dried chipotle, and set aside until cool to the touch.  Serve in the refrigerator.  The yogurt can be made 1 day ahead, kept covered at room temperature, and refrigerated until the chocolate is firm, about 1 hour.  Serve with salad greens for dipping.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin,hash brown potato,salmon fillet,sea bass fillet,hot italian sausage,corn syrup,chicken breast tender
title: Italian Sausage & Chicken #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast tenders | 1/2 lb smoked salmon fillet, diced | 1/2 lb smoked sea bass fillet, diced | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 cup frozen southern style hash brown potatoes, cubed | 1/4 cup canned pumpkin or 1/4 cup chopped tomato | 2 tablespoons light olive light corn syrup ( or more to taste, for a darker sauce, i've never tried this )
instructions: In a large skillet, place the chicken tenders and smoked salmon.  Over high heat, sear the chicken to desired doneness.  Remove from heat.  Add the remaining ingredients, mix well, and transfer to a greased casserole dish or roasting pan.  Cover with foil, and bake in a 350 degree oven for 15 to 20 minutes.  Uncover the sauce and bake for 7 to 8 minutes longer.  Great with a salad and crusty french bread or french bread.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,rom tomato,taco sauce,epazote leaf,tomato green chilies,baking soda
title: Tomato Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti or ( 16 ounce ) package vermicelli | 2 quarts prepared taco sauce or 2 quarts homemade salsa | 2 large roma tomatoes, sliced | 24 ounces canned diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 pinch baking soda | 12 small epazote leaves ( optional )
instructions: Boil water.  Add pasta to water.  While heating up, soak tortillas in warm water.  Heat a 5 quart kettle on medium heat and add taco or salsa.  Drain spaghetti when it is tender and add it to the kettle.  Stir and cover.  Put on low and wait a minute and a half.  When pasta is tender stir in the tomatoes and chiles.  If it looks like it needs longer add a little water.  When pasta is done, stir once and serve.

Random Ingredients: hot chili pepper,lemon juice zest,mozzarella cheese,baby spinach,mushroom,shrimp,red capsicum
title: Shrimp, Capsicum and Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons fresh lemon juice or 4 tablespoons lime juice, from 2 lemons | 2 lbs shrimp, cooked, shelled and deveined, leave tails attached | 2 green capsicums, roasted, sliced in half lengthways then thinly sliced | 2 red hot chili peppers, deseeded and thinly sliced | 8 ounces baby spinach | 1 ounce fresh mushrooms | 4 ounces mozzarella cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Make the dressing by mixing the lemon juice with the shrimp.  Place the capsicums, roasted chilies, spinach, onions and mushrooms in a serving bowl.  Add the dressing and toss.  Sprinkle the cheese over and place in the oven for 7 - 10 minutes until the cheese is hot and bubbling.  Serve straight away.

title: Waldorf Style Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower, separated into small florets | 3 leeks, cleaned washed well and chopped into thin strips | 1 can tuna, drained, flaked and flaked | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon raisins ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon walnut halves ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large saucepan half full with water and bring to the boil.  Add cauliflower and lemon slices.  Boil for 5 minutes and drain.  Set aside.  Place rest on stovetop.  When it starts to boil, add tuna.  When all meat has been added, lower heat to very low.  Mix in the malt vinegar, vanilla and raisins.  Keep warm until ready to serve.  Serve with toast or french bread.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,red bell pepper,pearl barley,beet,lime wedge
title: Cannel's Pink Beet and Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 can beets | 1/2 pound pearl barley | 1 red bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 2 cans vegetable broth | 4 lime wedges, for garnish
instructions: Pare and cube the beets, discarding ends.  Place the beets into a large pot with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and simmer over high heat until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain water, and mash with a potato masher.  Place barley into a large soup pot.  Cook over medium heat until it begins to turn color.  Stir in red bell pepper, and heat through.  Combine beets, barley, and vegetable broth in a separate soup pot.  Cook over medium high heat until hot through.  Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,banana,onion soup mix,puff pastry,cilantro leaf
title: Corn and Banana Strumettes
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 3 bananas ( sliced ) | 1/2 cup sweet corn kernels | 1 package onion soup mix | cilantro leaf ( chopped ) ( optional )
instructions: On ungreased cookie sheet, spoon out enough corn kernels to approximately 1/4 inch depth.  Bake for 5 minutes @ 400 f or until golden brown.  While corn and bananas are baking, cook onion soup mix in a large pot on low heat till it thickens slightly.  Add soup mix to corn and water in pan and stir till dissolved.  After corn and bananas are finished baking, spoon soup mixture into corn and bananas with a spoon, leaving 1 inch of space left for a spoonful of soup to float and expand during baking.  Remove from oven and top with cilantro leaves if desired.  Allow strumettes to sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,white radish,button mushroom,vanilla ice cream,peanut oil,vanilla pod,pork tenderloin
title: Beef and Pork Tenderloin (Puerco Com Molcajete)
ingredients: 1 ounce dried mexican oregano | 2 lbs pork tenderloin, sliced 1-inch thick | 6 ounces button mushrooms, quartered | 4 large fresh white radishes, cut into 2 x 1/2 x 1/4-inch pieces | 2 small vanilla pod, split lengthwise | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | coarsely crushed mexican oregano | 8 slices vanilla ice cream
instructions: Place oregano on rimmed baking sheet.  Let stand 20 minutes to release possibility of bacteria.  Using hands, rub oregano onto pork.

title: Quick Sausage - Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breast halves | 2 jar dry roasted red peppers, drained and cut into strips
instructions: Preheat the oven rack to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Place the chicken breasts on the prepared pan.

Random Ingredients: ghee,nori,granny smith apple,tuna water,peanut butter,rice noodle,tomato puree
title: Tuna Noodle Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces rice noodle | 1 1/4 cups canned tuna in water, drained | 4 granny smith apples | 6 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 tablespoon tikka dibis tamarind paste ( see note below ) | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water according to package directions.  Drain, rinse, and cut into 8 even sized squares.  Cut apples into wedges, and soak for several minutes in enough cold water to loosen the skin.  Shred tuna with a fork.  Stir fry apple pieces in about 2 - 3 tbs.  Of peanut butter and tomato puree for about about 3 minutes.  Drain noodles and add noodles.  Stir fry over very low heat until most of the liquid has evaporated and noodle mixture has thickened slightly.  Remove from heat, and stir in tamarind paste.  Note, the tamarind paste can be found in oriental grocery stores and is very hot not powdery.  It is used in place of the soy based peanut butter.  Variation, add 1 - 2 tbs.  Ghee to hot peanut butter when browning noodles, but if you add tamarind paste to hot rice noodles and tuna, add now.  Dump in 1 - 2 spoons of hot noodle mixture and mix.

title: Lamb, Blueberry and Orange Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs lamb meat, lean | 1 cup mixed blueberries ( or any fresh salad ) | 1/2 cup mixed black peppercorns, crushed | 1 large orange, juice of ( or fresh lime juice ) | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 2 lbs small firm ripe berry tomatoes cut into eighths
instructions: Preheat oven to 325º.  Place lamb, blueberries and crushed peppercorns in oven casserole dish or roaster.  Cut a slit in the sides of the lamb, to allow a natural cup like texture to penetrate the meat if there is any fat, and place lamb on top of the berries.  Bake in the preheated oven 1½ - 2 hours, until tender.  Remove from oven, cover loosely with foil, and chill overnight.  When lamb is chilled, remove meat from refrigerator.  Place tomatoes in a bowl, pour orange juice over them, and gently toss.  To serve, remove bones from tomatoes, cut tomatoes crosswise in half, discard tomatoes, and arrange on plates.  Cut lamb into bite sized pieces, arrange on top of tomatoes and serve.

title: Perfect Easy Egg & Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons shortening | 1 teaspoon golden syrup | 2 large free range eggs or 8 ounces egg substitute, egg yolks | 2 8 inch tortillas or 8 -10 one and one half pint egg tortilla
instructions: Cut the fat and melt the shortening, and pour into a shallow oven proof dish or pie plate.  Add the golden syrup, then the eggs, and finally the tortillas.  Mix well.  Cook in a hot oven, 350°f / 180°c / 375°f for about 10 minutes, or until the egg mixture and tortillas are puffed up and golden, but still firm in the centre.  Serve with your favourite salsa, guacamole or salsa.

title: Linguine with Garlic
ingredients: 2 packages dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon crushed garlic | 1 tablespoon dried minced mint | 3 cans sliced water chestnuts, undrained | 1/4 cup water
instructions: In a large pot, mix soup mix with garlic, mint, and water chestnuts.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: arugula leaf,ziti pasta,green cardamom pod,blue corn tortilla,tahini,bread,chili sauce,cilantro leaf
title: Spicy Blue Corn Bread Tacos
ingredients: 1 bag ziti pasta | 6 tablespoons tahini ( may use a mixture of both ) or 6 tablespoons mayonnaise ( may use a mixture of both ) | 3 tablespoons green chili sauce or 3 tablespoons minced red hot chilies | 6 large arugula leaves, chopped ( italian salted or curly leaf ) | 1 cup fresh bread, cut into 1/4 inch chunks ( crusty works fine and is easiest to grate coarsely, i used whole wheat ) | 8 large green cardamom pods, bruised | 2 cups fresh cilantro leaves | 12 hard-cooked blue corn tortillas, cut into 6 sections
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions.  Rinse and drain the pasta, toss it with a little water, and set aside.  In a small bowl, mix together the tahini, green chili sauce, and 3 tablespoons of the tahini liquid.  Spread the mixture evenly on the hot, dry pasta, and toast in a toaster oven until warm through.  Remove the toast and spread the bread on the toast, and top with 3 tablespoons of the sauce and 1 tablespoon of arugula.  Wrap the remaining 3 tablespoons of sauce around the toast and arugula and serve.

title: Lobster Sole With Turnips
ingredients: 2 sole fillets | 2 tablespoons crushed pineapple chunks or 2 tablespoons mandarin orange sections | 2 tablespoons diced pared turnip | 2 tablespoons crushed red peppers | 1 can lobster tails, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Spread 1 tablespoon of crushed pineapple onto each side of each sole fillet, then sprinkle with one tablespoon of crushed pineapple slices onto each.  Divide the pear halves into 2 equal halves and divide each half into 1/2 pieces.  Cut the pared turnip lengthwise in half.  Scoop out the insides of the turnip halves and set them aside.  Place the remaining two tablespoons of crushed pineapple into a small bowl.  Spread the crushed pineapple onto the outsides of the sole fillets.  Sprinkle with red pepper.  Insert two lobster tails at one end of the turnip half.  Roll the turnip around the skewer so that the tail ends emerge from the tail.  Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining turnip and lobster tails, placing them side by side on a baking sheet.  Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.  Serve hot.

title: Super Easy Beef and Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 8 ounces uncooked rice, any kind will work
instructions: Slice beef into 1/2 inch slices.  Lay out rice on cookie sheet.  Place meat slice evenly on top of rice.  Pour some tomato flavored cooking juice into a glass measuring cup.  Pour any cooking juice into a clean baking pan.  Cover the top of the meat with tin foil, and bake in oven for approximately 2 hours at remove meat and set aside and let sit for about an hour before serving the meat.  This is an extra great make ahead meal just heat rice to just warm and enjoy.  Serve with veggie sticks.

title: Coconut Bliss
ingredients: 1 cup coconut cream | 2 ounces gorgonzola, crumbled | 1/2 cup chopped nuts, to drizzle
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour into a serving dish.  Sprinkle with additional chopped nuts.

title: Simple Chipotle Salt
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sweetened margarine | 3 -4 chipotle chiles ( canned )
instructions: Pour the margarine in the blender and add 3 - 4 chopped chipotle peppers, or to taste.  Blend until smooth.  Transfer the mixture to a storage container and refrigerate for up to 1 week.

title: Pizza Bell Peppers
ingredients: 8 bell peppers ( red, yellow, green, or sweet ) | 1 cup pizza pepperoni ( or a combination ) or 1 cup spicy italian sausage ( or a combination ) | 1/2 vanilla bean
instructions: Cut bell peppers in half and remove seeds and white pith.  Set aside. .  Place pizza peppers on baking foil and bake in a hot oven for about 25 - 30 minutes or until they are done.  While the pizzas are baking, place the vanilla bean in a small paper sack.  Place the bag in the microwave and let it heat up about 20 seconds or until it is almost boiling and the vanilla is slightly spongy.  This will allow easier removal from the sides of the bag.  Remove the vanilla bean and discard.  Remove the vanilla bean from the bag.  Place the bell peppers in the bag with the vanilla bean and squeeze out the excess liquid.  Drain the peppers, slice them into thin strips, and arrange on a platter.  Serve warm.  Note, this dish tastes best when served topped with a dollop of sour cream or fresh grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,brown rice,basil leaf,ginger garlic paste
title: Thai Sticky Basil Rice
ingredients: 2 cups short grain brown rice, washed | 12 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup basil leaves, roughly fresh, washed & drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silpat.  Put the sprigs in a food processor along with the ginger garlic paste.  Process until combined, but still with slight graininess.  Add the rice and 2 tbsp water.  The rice should become loose, but if not, add more water.  Turn the rice mixture onto a floured surface.  Roll out to an approximately ¾ inch thick round on your lightly floured hands.  Pinch the edges firmly around the grain with your fingers.  Transfer the rice to the parchment paper, smoothing the top with your hands.  Make a neat border of ½/2 inch of rice around the rice on your finger.  Fold the rice in half & pinch the edges firmly around the grain to seal.  Repeat with remaining rice.  Put the prepared baking sheet in the oven & bake for about 45 minutes or until a sticky rice is golden on the top.  Remove from the oven, cover with tin foil & let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Creme De Menthe, Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 2/3 cup creme de menthe, original recipe, and it was not very good | 1 bunch fresh coriander, roughly chopped
instructions: Trim the chicken meat of all the fat around the thighs and discard it.  Cut the chicken thighs into 2 equal pieces.  In a large bowl or resealable plastic bag place the thighs, creme de menthe and coriander.  Place the bag or plastic wrap over the mixture and massage the contents to thoroughly coat the chicken pieces.  Cover with a sheet of plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.  Remove the chicken from the bag and thread it onto skewers.  Grill or broil the skewers until golden.

title: Shiitake and Red Enchilada Sauce Recipe
ingredients: 1 cup fresh shiitake mushrooms | 2 cups red enchilada sauce | 8 ounces canned red enchilada sauce ( from a 10 oz can )
instructions: Wash and coarsely chop the shiitake mushrooms.  Wash the enchilada sauce with cold water then drain very well, place 2 tbsps.  Of enchilada sauce in blender or food processor.  Place the mushrooms in an enchiladas baking dish and fill with enchilada sauce.  Top with enchilada sauce and sprinkle with remaining 1 tbsps.  Of enchilada sauce.  Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Salsa Verde
ingredients: 4 dried guajillo chilies | 2 medium cups white wine vinegar | mace ( optional )
instructions: Place dried guajillo chilies in a bowl with boiling water to cover.  Let stand 30 minutes, then rinse and devein.  Place chilies in a bowl.  Cover with cold water to cover.  Let stand 20 minutes, then rinse and remove skins.  Using hands, rub and remove stems and seeds from chilies.  Rinse chilies and remove seeds.  Rinse until water is clear.  Soak chilies 30 minutes in water to cover.  Drain.  Dry roasted chilies on paper towels.  Chill uncovered until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,kale,rose water,white flour,egg noodle,orange juice,bacon,heirloom tomato
title: Bequeta Salad
ingredients: 15 ounces frozen uncooked egg noodles | 3 cups kale, fresh, coarsely chopped and packed into a bowl | 2 cups heirloom tomatoes, chopped ( about 1 3/4 pounds ) | 4 bacon, cooked and crumbled | 1/3 cup fresh orange juice | 2 teaspoons rose water | 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 1/2 cups white flour
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions.  Drain and run cold water over the noodles to loosen the pasta.  Let drain in a colander, then rinse the pot a few times with cold water until it reaches room temperature.  In a large bowl, combine the kale, tomatoes and bacon.  Heat the canola oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add the pasta and oregano.  Stir until well combined.  Gradually stir in the flour, and cook over medium heat, stirring, for about 2 minutes.  The flour will start to stick to the pan, and have a browned roux.  Pour pasta mixture onto the greens, and stir until mixed well.  Serve warm, or keep warm refrigerated until serving.

title: Italian Meatball Heroes'
ingredients: 2 lbs ground ham | 1 lb ricotta cheese | 1/2 ounce italian seasoning
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the ricotta cheese and italian seasoning in a food processor.  Add more seasoning if desired, and form into desired size meatballs.  Brown on a greased griddle or skillet, and serve with bread, pasta or cheese on the side and warm tomato and clam boats, or just by itself.

title: Nigella Lawson Black Honey
ingredients: 6 tablespoons clear honey | 24 tablespoons oil, for deep frying
instructions: Heat 4 tablespoons of the clarified oil in a large, preferably deep frying pan.  Add 40 tablespoons of honey and stir regularly with a wooden spoon until the honey is completely dissolved.  Add the remaining honey and stir continuously.  Heat oven to 220c/fan 200c/gas 6 and allow to stand 5 minutes.  After five minutes, test one tablespoon's temperature, the temperature should be 160c/160f/gas 3, or until the temperature reaches 190°c if you do not want the honey to become too dark, stir in a tsp or so of oil at a time, then check it regularly with a toothpick or a slotted spoon.  When the honey reaches the correct temperature, remove from the heat and beat in 25 tablespoons of oil at once until the mixture is a shaggy, grainy consistency, and forms a paste.  Taste the oil again and adjust the seasoning.  This should have a syrupy consistency.  Transfer the oil to a flat surface and use it to sandwich up 2 - 3 pieces of string together. title: Rice Cheeks
ingredients: 12 ounces tequila | 1 zucchini, sliced | 4 ounces dark soy sauce | 15 ounces rice chex
instructions: In a medium size pan boil your tequila with the zucchini and soy sauce over medium heat for 5 minutes.  Then remove the zucchini soy sauce pan from the heat.  Toss out the zucchini and rice until they are completely coated but not completely cooked.  Serve with crushed ice and a splash of the dark soy sauce sauce.

title: Pumpkin & Yoghurt Cheesecake
ingredients: 250 g dark brown sugar | 400 g pumpkin flesh ready to eat stew meat, chopped | 150 g mozzarella cheese, shredded | 100 g goat's cheese, crumbled | 300 g strawberries, hulled, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Grease and flour a 20cm x 30cm cake tin.  Melt 120g of the sugar in a large pan over a low heat, stirring until dissolved.  Increase the heat to low.  Add the stew meat and brown for 5 minutes or until the meat comes together.  Remove the pan from the heat.  Stir in the remaining sugar until dissolved then stir in the tomato and coconut.  Arrange the cheeses around the base of the prepared tin.  Spoon the pumpkin mixture over the cheese, then scatter over the strawberries.  Pour over remaining sugar/wine mixture.  Bake the cheesecake in an oven on top shelf for 45 minutes or until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean.  Remove from the oven and leave to cool in the tin for 15 minutes before turning out onto a large piece of reynold's wrap, refrigerate until required.  Cut into squares to serve.

title: Shedden Veggies
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 package firm tofu | 4 tablespoons frozen apple pie filling | 1 can cranberry juice ( or pineapple juice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Combine potatoes and 1/2 can of apple juice in baking dish.  Add more or less depending on you like your veggies crisp and coated.  Place in oven for approximately 40 minutes or until tender.  Pierce with fork and top with cranberry sauce.

title: Saucy Pineapple Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta or 1 lb penne pasta ( 16 ounces is 2 cups ) | 1 jar sweetened pineapple chunks | 1 can apricots, cut up | 1 cup hot water | 1 -2 tablespoon dried parsley | 1 1/3 cups pineapple juice
instructions: Cook pasta according to instructions on package.  Drain and set aside.  Place pineapple, apricots, hot water, parsley in a large bowl and mix.  Add pasta and pineapple juice.  Toss well to coat pasta.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Curried Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice, uncooked | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons curry, hot, to your preference
instructions: Saute wild rice and balsamic vinegar in a saucepan for about 3 - 5 minutes or until just starting to get slightly crispy.  Stir in curry before serving.

title: Cherry Clafouti
ingredients: filling : | 2 ripe marsala cherries | 1 bunch fresh basil sprigs, or to taste
instructions: To help keep basil leaves from turning brown, spoon a little filling onto a plate.  Roll the cherry halves in the remaining filling, and drizzle with a few teaspoons of olive oil and a little bit of your favorite salad dressing.

title: Lemony Chili Powder
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground chili | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground mexican dried chili
instructions: Mix chili and mexican red chili powder and store in airtight glass jar.  You make your own chili powder by heating 2 teaspoons in a 1 1/2 pint hot pan for 1 - 2 minutes.  Stir and allow to cool to room temperature before preparing your meal or hot meat for your meal.

title: Granny Smith Applesauce
ingredients: 1 pound fresh granny smith apples - peeled, cored, and chopped | 4 bananas, peeled
instructions: Chop and stir apples into a bowl.  Stir bananas and apples into the bowl.  Serve chilled.

title: Burning Cow Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb cabbage, shredded | 1 large seedless watermelon, sliced | 1/2 cup coarsely ground hazelnuts | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 1/4 cup boiling water | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules
instructions: Steam shredded cabbage and watermelon slices until slightly wilted, then mash together.  Stir in hazelnuts, rum, and boiling water.  Cool before filling cabbage rolls.  Seal rolls loosely, and refrigerate several hours or overnight.  Prepare coffee granules by boiling water with the coffee granules.

title: Goan Poached Cheese With King Prawns
ingredients: 1 kg small king prawns | 500 g white onions | 1 cup halved black olives | 500 g courgettes
instructions: Cook onions and prawns over medium heat until prawns change colour.  Meanwhile, gently fry oxo in batches.  Add courgettes.  Cover and gently simmer for 10 minutes.  Gently stir through prawns.  Serve with hot bread or a crusty bread dish.  Variation, use a mixture of king prawns and chilli prawns instead of prawns.

title: French Vanilla Cookies
ingredients: 2 egg whites, room temperature | 1/3 cup powdered mustard powder, preferably grainy ( or use dijon mustard powder ) | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped ( or 1 t dry parsley ) | 2 -3 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
instructions: Beat the egg whites, mustard powder, parsley, and vanilla extract in a large bowl with an electric mixer on low until the mixture is shiny and dry, about 10 minutes.

title: Tasty Roasted Fresh Pepper Seeds
ingredients: 4 -5 whole dried chili peppers ( i've never made this type of dried chili peppers, so any type you would choose would ) | salt | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract ( optional, i would use almond powder )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Using a small cookie scoop or small piece of reynolds wrap non stick foil, place the dried chili peppers on the foil and poke the'seeds' into them with a fork.  Drizzle 1 tsp vanilla over the top of the chilies making a 'pizza' with tiny bits of the canned chilies.  Sprinkle with 1 teaspoons of salt.  Bake for about 10 - 12 min or until roasted.  You might need a bit more olive oil to keep the roasted chilies from burning. .

title: Raspberry Macadamia Nut Salad
ingredients: 7 tablespoons fresh pineapple juice, divided | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 lb jicama, peeled and cut into julienne strips | 4 ounces dried baby peas, thawed | 1/4 lb shelled ripe, chopped macadamia nuts | 1 tablespoon lard, fat free and light-colored, divided | fresh raspberry, for garnish
instructions: Put the orange juice and 1 tablespoon of the juice from the can into a food processor.  Add the beans, jicama and the peas.

title: Peanut Butter, Sesame Seeds and Spice Mix
ingredients: 1/3 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Store in airtight container.  Makes 2 tbsp of spreadable peanut butter.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,pecorino cheese,green chili pepper,mexican cheese,green curry paste,pear,chuck
title: Aussie Pepper Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 teaspoon crushed green chili pepper | 1 tablespoon hot green curry paste | 2 tablespoons paresment pecorino cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | pepper
instructions: Heat grill pan to medium high until pan is hot.  Place ground chuck in pan.  Sprinkle with the green chili pepper.  Cook until ground chuck is browned and crumbly.  Remove beef mixture from pan.  Place in bowl.  Stir in hot green curry paste.  Place paresment pecorino cheese and mexican style cheese on top.  Mix together thoroughly.  Shape into four patties.  Place on hot grill and cook for 5 to 7 minutes per side.  Be careful not to let them dry up enjoy.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,white wine,mandarin orange,turmeric powder,radicchio,hard egg,strawberry,milk
title: Mandarin and Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 2 dozen small strawberries | 1 dozen small radicchio | 4 small hard-boiled eggs | 1 medium mandarin orange | 1 cup fresh baby spinach | 1 tablespoon white wine | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Dice 3 to 4 very small strawberries and the mandarin oranges if large.  If small, it probably won't need it.  Set aside.  Wash and cut the rest of the radicchio into very thin rounds.  Place the cut radishes on top of the mixed.  Tear the remaining leaves from the baby spinach.  Cut in half.  Toss the salad.  Whisk everything together except the garnishes, including the turmeric.  Add this mixture to salad and toss to mix.  Refrigerate until dinner time.

title: Spanish Lamb Baked
ingredients:
1 lamb meat ( lamb loin chops, etc.
    - ) | 1 can tomatoes | 1/4 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons red wine, white
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Place lamb into the bottom of a greased baking dish.  Pour cans of tomatoes over the lamb.  Sprinkle with raisins.  Sprinkle with a little bit of each.  Combine red wine and a little bit of the liquid from the can in a measuring cup or small jug.  Pour over lamb.  Cover dish and bake for 2 1/2 hours or until lamb is browned and cooked to your liking top with a little red wine before serving over spaghetti noodles or spaghetti.

title: Easy French Dip (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 ounce chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Brown ground beef, drain.  Place meat and bouillon in crock pot.  Cook on high about 3 - 5 hours.  Serve with crusty bread.

title: Creamy Low Sugar Condensed Milk Substitute
ingredients: 1 quart soymilk | 1 pinch garlic powder
instructions: Stir together the soy milk and garlic powder in a small bowl.

title: BBQ Bamboo Smoker - Microwave
ingredients: 2 bamboo shoots ( i used red ) | 225 g ham ( finely cubed ) | 2 -4 teaspoons rosemary leaves ( i used fresh ) | 2 -3 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Wash bamboo and cut off the root ends, remove the excess skin and trim off any excess moisture.  Wrap the ham in a piece of aluminum foil big enough to fit into the mug.  Sprinkle the ham with rosemary leaves and drizzle with golden syrup.

title: Cindi
ingredients: 250 g egg noodles | 1 pinch cumin powder | 1 teaspoon white flour
instructions: Take a pot, on the hob, on the stove, over a very low heat.  Mix the flour with some water.  Put the cumin and egg noodles in it and mix it.  Add the oil and mix everything well.  Take the stove off the gas.  Let the cumin mixture cool a bit.  Add flour.

title: Noodle Kugel III
ingredients: 12 ounces prepared japanese egg noodles | 1 tablespoon coconut extract | white pepper to taste | 1 package fried udon noodles, drained
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the egg noodles, and return to a boil.  Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Transfer the drained noodles to a mixing bowl and add the coconut extract and white pepper.  Toss to coat, cover, and refrigerate until chilled, about 30 minutes.  Serve the kugel in a large serving bowl with a fried udon noodle on the side.

title: Pita Burgers
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon tomato soup | 1 1/4 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 apple, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Place steak slices in a medium bowl, and drizzle with pesto sauce.  Mix together the tomato soup and cheese.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,pre mozzarella cheese,milk ricotta cheese,spearmint,alfalfa sprout,cayenne pepper
title: Cheesy Alfredo
ingredients: 1 pint whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 6 ounces thinly sliced spearmint | 1 bunch flat-leaf italian parsley, leaves picked from stems and coarsely chopped | 1 cup loosely packed baby arugula ( about 4 cups ) or 1 cup alfalfa sprout, trimmed ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup coarsely grated freshly shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine ricotta, cayenne pepper and remaining ingredients in a medium bowl.  Cover and chill.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  In a small pan, heat the alfredo sauce over high heat until boiling.  Ladle the sauce over the chilled ricotta mixture and sprinkle with any remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,red onion,black pepper,cherry tomato
title: Pesto Cherry Tomato Relish
ingredients: 1/2 red onion, chopped | 1 -2 red chili pepper, finely chopped ( more or less, to taste ) | fresh coarse ground black pepper, to taste | 2 bunches cherry tomatoes, chopped ( or more )
instructions: Put the chopped onions, red chili, and pepper into your blender, add a little bit of the cherry juice to give it a nice, sweet consistency.  Continue adding the cherry juice until the mixture is a paste.  Add black pepper.  Mix everything together well.  You may now also chill the mixture over night.  Serve chilled with fresh bread.

title: Peruvian Vegetarian
ingredients: 1 kg minced meat | 2 raw eggs | 2 tablespoons chicken substitutions ( i use soy sauce ) | 600 g green vegetables | 2 serrano chilies | 1 teaspoon parsnip | 1 tablespoon green tomatillos or 1 tablespoon aji panca chilies
instructions: Mix meat, eggs, and chicken substitutions.  Add rest of ingredients and knead.  Separate and bake in a very hot pan.  Note, you can mix more chicken or beef substitute, other vegetables or spices to taste.

title: Tex Mex Brown Rice With Currants
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, uncooked ( white or brown ) | 3/4 cup dried currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Combine tomatoes with chilies, rice, and currants in 1 quart casserole.  Cover.  Bake 50 - 55 minutes or until rice is hot.

title: Gâteaux Bourguignonne (French Onion Soup)
ingredients: 6 medium onions | 8 ounces beef broth | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 4 eggs, lightly beaten
instructions: Slice off the bottom 3 inches of each onion and, between the layers, carefully slice them very thinly.  Remove the top layer of onion and discard.  Place the slices in a large saucepan, pour in the beef broth and bring to a simmer over medium heat.  Cook, uncovered, over low heat until the onions are translucent and tender. .  Turn off the heat and stir in the sherry.  Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and add them to the soup.  Simmer the soup for 5 minutes and serve hot.

title: Speedy Irish Apple-Ice
ingredients: 8 cups tea, i like eckrich's herbal tea bags | 1/4 cup ginger beer ( or other stout beer ) | 1/4 cup celery, chopped | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Put tea bags, ginger beer and celery on your tea brewer and blend for ten seconds or so until it is smooth and strong.  Add the sugar, blend again and blend for 1 minute or so.  Pour mix into ice cube trays and freeze.

title: Easy English Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes, scrubbed with a fork | 1/2 cup sugar | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1 teaspoon mustard seed | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, chopped
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water and bring to a boil.  Boil until you have a thick syrup.  Dissolve lemon pepper in hot syrup.  Drain and set aside for later.  Peel potatoes and cut into 1/4 inch slices.  Cut into 1 inch pieces.  Place in a bowl of salted water and let sit until tender, 15 - 20 minutes.  Do not drain.  Drain and set aside.  Heat oven to peel potatoes and place in a 1 quart bowl.  In a microwave safe bowl combine the syrup and mustard seeds.  Microwave on full power for 1 minute or until seeds are a shade darker.  Remove from microwave and add to potatoes.  Stir well.  Spread potato mixture into a greased 9 inch square pan.  Sprinkle with olives.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Cut into squares and serve warm.

title: Lebanese Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dry peas | 1 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: Add vanilla and 2 tblsps oil to the water.  Cook on medium heat about 2 min to dry water.  Add peas.

title: Japanese Honito Dipping Sauce (Zaru Sushi)
ingredients: 1/2 cup light soy sauce, for dipping | 1/2 cup sake
instructions: Combine the soy sauce and sake in a small bowl.  Set aside.  In another small bowl, mix the two kikkoman sweet sauce ingredients.  Serve dipping utensils at a picnic spot.  Garnish with some katsuobushi.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,duck leg,colby monterey jack cheese,bicarbonate soda,rum
title: Duck Grilled Cheese (Antilles)
ingredients: 2 duck legs | corn oil | 4 -6 tablespoons rum | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 3 tablespoons shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Rinse duck wings under warm water, place in oven at gas mark 2 for 30 minutes.  Dry all over and remove wing tips.  Brush with rum, add bicarb soda and sprinkle cheese around duck.  Return to oven and bake for 15 minutes.  Eat while still hot.

title: The Easiest & Best Versatile Meat & Veggies
ingredients:
1 lb veal, diced ( beef is traditional, any meat type will do ) | 1 lb cooked meat ( pork, turkey, etc.
    - )
instructions: Boil veal in salted water for 10 min.  Drain.  Put meat back into the pan, add veal mix& cook for 10 more min, until veal is tender and mixed in well in the meat.  Serve over your favorite type of bread,.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,sea salt,red curry paste,allspice,basmati rice
title: Red Curry Rice
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 can tomato soup | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground allspice | 1 cup jasmine rice
instructions: Warm curry paste in pot on the stove with the 1/2 tsp of the sea salt, cook for 30 seconds, mix in tomato soup and cook for 30 seconds more.  Add remaining sea salt and allspice and bring to a boil.  Add jasmine rice and then bring back to boil.  Reduce heat to medium, cover and cook for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Easy Pizza Sauce (For Pizza)
ingredients: 4 slices whole-wheat bread ( i use one slice which has been sliced and buttered ) | 1 teaspoon tomato paste ( my tweak is in the ethnic aisle of my supermarket ) | 1 teaspoon allspice ( or to taste )
instructions: In small bowl blend and transfer all of the above into blender jar.  Pour into a sauce pan in the following way.  Use as needed in your pizza topping, pizza toppings, etc when freezing.  I use a pizza pan with sides to make a thicker crust and easier to place on your boboli.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,ginger garlic paste,black olive,tortilla chip,taco seasoning
title: Crock Pot Oriental Black Olive Fajitas
ingredients: 3/4 lb white mushroom, halved | 14 1/2 ounces black olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning, divided | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 cups tortilla chips
instructions: Lightly toss all ingredients in crock pot.  Cover and cook on auto for 6 - 8 hours.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Tangerine Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs chicken wings | 2 tangerines, zested or 2 oranges | 1/2 cup light vodka | 1/2 cup light currants or 1/2 cup raisins | dark chocolate, grated
instructions: Mix the vodka, currants and chocolate.  Separate wings in two pieces.  Place in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes.  Place in foil lined baking pan.  Place 2 tangerines in center of the chicken.  Spread over them a portion of the vodka mixture and then top with remaining tangerines or oranges.  Bake in a 425 degree f/180 degree oven for 30 - 40 minutes.  Note, for darker chicken, this recipe is very important, as if you paint the top of the marinade with a marrinade brush, the marrinade will brown the chicken.  For color more intense, broil for 10 minutes.

title: Molho
ingredients:
2 tablespoons butter | 3 cups long grain rice or 3 cups carnaroli rice | 1 -2 fresh green chile, seeded.
    - seeds and membrane discarded | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet until foam subsides, but does not brown.  Add rice and stir until grains turn white and are light gold in color.  Add the chiles and vodka, stir to combine.  When all ingredients are evenly blended, turn heat to lowest setting.  Put the skillet into a pot capable of holding the mixture.  Cook a tight lid at least five inches above the surface of the liquid.  When steam is coming from the top, you can turn off the burner temporarily and leave the lid slightly ajar.  Leave the lid inside the skillet.  Keep warm.  Do not take off and turn off the heat.  Put rice into serving bowl.  Remove foam that forms on top of the rice.  Do not eat it right away or it will get soggy.  Let stand until cool.  Serve by itself or with your favorite mexican hot sauce, such as salsa verde.

Random Ingredients: walnut half,mexican cheese,flour tortilla,salsa,dark sesame oil
title: Quesadillas With Mexican Cheese
ingredients: 1 flour tortillas, heated | 2 tablespoons shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup salsa | 2 tablespoons walnut halves, toasted and crushed or 2 tablespoons slivered almonds, coarsely chopped
instructions: Spread each flour tortilla with a tablespoon of cheese and roll into a 4 inch quesadilla.  Lightly spread with sesame oil, and sprinkle with salsa.  Then sprinkle with nuts.  Cut in half and serve.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,granny smith apple,cream chicken soup,green onion,yoghurt,ramen noodle,sesame oil
title: Chicken Salad with Egg Noodle Dip
ingredients: 6 ounces ramen noodles | 1 cup thinly sliced green bell pepper | 1 cup thinly sliced green onion | 1 granny smith apple, chopped | 1/2 cup plain fat free sour cream | 2 tablespoons chopped green onion | 2 tablespoons yoghurt | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.  Drain noodles and rinse with cold water until cool.  In a bowl, combine noodles, bell pepper and green onions.

title: Spicy Apple Strudel
ingredients: 2 unbaked pie crusts | 8 ounces spaghetti, broken in half | 3 cups shredded cooked apples | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 cup spicy brown mustard | 1 can chicken broth
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Line with a pie shell.  Prick the crusts several times with a fork, then cut a hole in the center.  Bake for about 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned.  Remove from the oven and set aside.  Meanwhile, bring the apple and chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.  Remove from the heat and add the crusts.  Pour the cooked apples over the crusts.  Mix the mustard and mustard into the remaining chicken broth and spread the mixture over the apples.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the mustard has started to turn golden brown.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,sesame oil,clam,snow pea,prune,basil leaf,mozzarella cheese,french bread
title: Baked Clam Sandwiches
ingredients: 36 finely chopped clams, with liquid | 8 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese | 1 bag baby basil leaves | 1/2 cup thinly sliced fresh carrot | 2 cups finely chopped russet potatoes, unpeeled | 2 tablespoons minced walnuts | 1/4 cup chopped prunes | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil | 12 slices french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a 9 inch square baking dish with wax paper or parchment paper, and coat lightly with cooking spray.  Arrange clams on the bottom of the dish, and top with the mozzarella cheese.  Arrange carrots over the cheese, and top with basil.  Top with potatoes, then chopped nuts.  Toast bread on baking sheet in the preheated oven until lightly toasted, about 5 minutes.  Cut into 6 equal triangles.  To serve the clams, run a knife around the edges of each clam, lift the clams out of the shell and onto a plate or other flat surface.  Place a clamb on top of the potatoes, and serve with sesame oil and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.

title: Barbecue Pork on a Stick
ingredients: 500 -800 g pork mince | 1/2 cup paprika | 50 g dried oregano leaves ( or normal ) | 8 ounces orange juice | 2/3 cup dark molasses | pitted cherries or halved strawberries | lettuce, to serve
instructions: Mix the pork mince, paprika, oregano and orange juice into a bowl.  Place two tablespoons of the spice mix and half the water into a small frying pan.  Heat over low heat, stirring until simmering.  Remove from heat.  Remove from heat and stir in the molasses and cherries until mixed.  Split the pork mince in two and form into balls.  Heat up another pan over medium high heat and cook the pork balls a few at a time for 2 - 3 minutes, allowing for a few extra minutes on each side.  Serve the pork on a wooden skewer with lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,hard egg,fine salt,vanilla sugar,tuna water,confectioner ' sugar,orange,dark sesame oil
title: Crispy Fried Eggs With Tuna (Chawan Mushi)
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons fine salt ( or to taste ) | 2 whole eggs | confectioners'sugar | dark sesame oil | white sesame oil | fine salt
instructions: Soak the rice in 2 – 3 cups of cold water for 15 minutes.  Drain off the water and set aside.  Place the eggs on to a flat surface and slice lengthways in half.  Using a teaspoon, gently crack the yolks, leaving about 2cm whole.  Place a teaspoon of salt on the flat surface of each yolk, and coat each half of the egg white lightly.  Heat a wok with a shallow layer of sesame oil over a high heat for 2–3 minutes.  Add the rice and cook, stirring, until the grains are crisp and golden.  Be very careful not to overcook the rice or it will loose it's delicate texture.  Add a pinch of fine salt, then tip in the eggs, a ladleful at a time and swirl it around with a spatula so that they cook evenly.  Fry them until they are firm, and turn over in the oil.  Sprinkle with confectioners sugar, and allow to cool slightly before sprinkling with sesame oil.  To serve, place the fried eggs on a plate, drizzle with a small quantity of dark sesame oil and sprinkle with fine salt and more sesame oil.

title: Pork Kebabs With Halloumi Cheese & Tofu Dip
ingredients: 600 g kabochi loin ( asian beef steak ) | 50 g tofu ( kabochi ) | 50 g cheddar cheese | 100 g halloumi cheese or 100 g feta cheese | 1/3 cup honey
instructions: Soak skewers in water for at least 2 hours.  Cut each kabochi ball into 3 - 4 squares.  Mix kabochi and tofu into a paste.  Cut haloumi in long pieces or strips about 1cm thick.  Toss kabochi and tofu into a bowl with cheese.  Place onto skewers and brush with honey.  Place on grill or under grill tray and grill for 5 minutes per side or until desired doneness.  Serve with dip or pitta to dip.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,flat leaf parsley,turmeric,cottage cheese,oyster sauce,mace
title: Cheese Paste
ingredients: 1 container cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon ground fresh ginger root | 1 dried turmeric, crushed | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Place cottage cheese, parsley, ginger and turmeric into a food processor and process until smooth.  Stir in oyster sauce and process on coarse.  Be sure to scrape the bottom of the food processor.  The mixture can be stored at room temperature for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: mint,pork chop,feta cheese,cheese product,beef stock,dark red kidney bean,apple juice,watercress
title: Charcoal-Braised Pork Chops With Rich Apple Gravy
ingredients: 1 can dark red kidney beans, undrained | 1 cup watercress, cleaned and stems removed | 1 cup chopped apple | 8 tablespoons beef stock | 1 tablespoon instant cheese product ( a-1 ) | 8 large boneless pork chops, trimmed | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint | 1 tablespoon fresh coarse ground coarse salt
instructions: Combine the beans, watercress, apple and beef stock in a large pot and heat to boiling.  Reduce the heat to low.

title: Greek Fried Green Olives (Kourabiedes)
ingredients: 2 cups green olives, cleaned | 4 tablespoons vanilla essence
instructions: Mash the green olives.  Add sugar, vanilla.  Add nuts of choice.  You can sprinkle with vanilla sugar if you like.  I serve the pitted green olives with a dollop of whipped cream and some cinnamon.  If you don't want the taste of cinnamon, you can sprinkle with cinnamon right before serving.

title: Tempered French Toast
ingredients: 1 large egg | 2 teaspoons tamari, divided | 1 teaspoon orange extract | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Combine egg, 1/4 teaspoon tamari, orange extract, and fenugreek in a shallow dish and beat well.  Dip 1/2 cup of texas toast into egg mixture and fry.  Serve immediately.

title: Apple Butter, A Hint of Schmoozing
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups unsweetened applesauce | 2 cups low sodium chicken broth
instructions: In a blender, combine applesauce and chicken stock and puree until smooth.

title: Sunflower Seeds for Jian Bing
ingredients: 200 g sunflower seeds ( try to use a good seed that is already roasted ) | 1 liter molasses
instructions: Roast sunflower seeds on a griddle or frying pan until they are golden brown and crispy.  Let nuts cool completely.  In a blender, mix sunflower seeds and molasses in a medium bowl.  Spread the nuts onto a greased tray.  Cool completely before slicing.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,spring onion,tamari,lump crabmeat,kalamata olive
title: Pan-Gravy
ingredients: 500 g beef stew meat ( lean ) | 2 -3 tablespoons tamari or 2 -3 tablespoons soy sauce | 350 g lump crabmeat ( fresh or frozen ) | 100 -200 -250 g pitted kalamata olives | 2 -3 spring onions, finely chopped
instructions: Brown meat in a large deep frying pan over high heat, adding tamari or soy sauce as needed to deglaze the meat.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for an hour or until meat is tender.  Add crab or fresh crab as suggested in description above.  If you don’t like the crab add 1 - 2 tablespoons of kalamata olive oil to the pan, add spring onions.

title: Frozen Spiced Spinach
ingredients: 5 packages chopped spinach | 2 ounces shaoxing wine or 2 ounces chinese wine | 1/2 ounce lemons, juice of or 1/2 ounce lime juice | 8 -10 fresh rosemary sprigs | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1/8 - 1/4 cup refined flour
instructions: Place all ingredients into the microwave safe bowl.  Mix well to blend.  Microwave for 20 seconds on high uncovered.  Stir.  Then microwave longer if desired.  The tighter the microwave is allowed to heat, the faster it will thaw out.  Serve as a side dish or as a topping for cakes, egg noodles, or anything else.

title: Seafood Filled Crescents
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups yellow cake mix | 5 tablespoons oil | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 1/2 lbs bay scallops, coarsely chopped | 1 3/4 lbs medium cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 cup grated emmenthaler cheese | 1 tablespoon tapioca, dissolved in | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Prepare yellow cake mix according to package directions.  Drain.  Place cake mix in medium bowl.  In small bowl, combine oil, oregano and seasoning mix.  Add scallops and cauliflower.  Using fork, mix well.  Roll dough into 1 dozen inch sticks.  Place sticks on parchment paper covered cookie sheet.  Flatten sticks to 1/4 inch thickness.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake 10 - 12 minutes or until firm.  Let stand 3 - 4 minutes.  Transfer to cutting board.  Cut sticks diagonally in 1/2 inch pieces.  Place pieces on serving.

title: Black Bean, Black Cumin, and Lettuce Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup black beans | 1 1/4 cups heavy cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 head lettuce, sliced | 24 slices of dry white white white bread cut on an angle for garnish
instructions: Place the cumin powder in a wide, heavy skillet with deep sides over medium heat.  When the cumin begins to crackle, pour in the cream, and boil while stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until it becomes thick.  Reduce heat to medium.

title: Quick & Easy Pesto and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice or 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice, washed | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon sage leaves ( to taste )
instructions: Wash your rice, soak it in at least 1 cup of water for at least a few hours, or up to 1 day minimum.  Saute your onion in a bit of veggie oil, for about 2 minutes until translucent, then remove it and set aside.  Add 2 cups of water to your steamer, it should be big enough for the rice to float when you add the onions.  Place the rice in the steamer.  Add 3 cups of water, basil leaves & sage.  When your steamer runs out of the water, take your steamer out and place it on the rice to steam.  After about 5 minutes check the rice for doneness, it should be tender and there should be a little broth left in the pan.  If the rice is a little jicier, just add a little of the broth, water for a bit more of the broth and maybe a tsp of pesto.  Serve while it's hot.  You may add more or less of whatever vegetables you choose, such as broccoli, zucchini, mushrooms, onions, etc.

title: Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1 can refried beans | 1/2 cup finely chopped parsnip | 9 ounces cooked chicken, chopped | 1 teaspoon peppermint extract | 1 package refrigerated crescent roll dough | parsley and mint extract
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f.  Coat an 11x7 baking dish with cooking spray.  In a large bowl, combine mushroom soup and refried beans.  Stir in parsnip, chicken, peppermint extract and 1 package crescent roll dough.  Place in dish.  Spread remaining dough mixture over top.  Bake for 20 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Easy Cremoli Shells
ingredients: 7 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1/4 cup quick cooking creme fraiche or 1/4 cup creme fraiche fraiche
instructions: Remove and discard gills from mushrooms.  Rinse mushrooms under cold water.  Cut up mushrooms into 1/2 pieces.  Place all in saucepan and cover.  Cook slowly until onions are caramelized.  Add the crème fraîche.  Stir until smooth.  Remove from heat and allow to cool completely.  Fill shells with filling.

title: Mace and Almond Salad Dressing (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 cups almond milk | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Add all ingredients and mix well.  Adjust spices & taste.

title: The Best Puff Pie Ever
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed and defrosted | 3 tablespoons skim milk
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Place the puff pastry sheets over a baking sheet.  Place milk into a bowl and mix to form a paste.  Spread paste on top of dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edge.  Bake for 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown and puffed.

title: Stuffed Red Capsicums
ingredients: 1 red capsicum, halved | 1 lb string bean, ends removed & cut into 4cm lengths | 60 g cake flour, sifted
instructions: Parboil the string beans for 5 to 7 minutes in plenty of boiling salted water.  Drain & place in a bowl.  Grate capsicum onto the flat of a sharp knife, then add beans.  Using a lightly knead the dough until smooth & slightly flattened, then knead a minute or two more until mixture is smooth & elastic.  Place into a buttered & lined ovenproof dish & cover with pastry.  Preheat oven to 230 degree c or 200 degree c if using a fan forced oven.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown, then turn out onto a rack, cool, then serve as is & with creme fraiche or cream.

title: Black Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 5 tablespoons sour cream | 5 tablespoons cream cheese | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 slices rye bread
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the sour cream and cream cheese.  Stir in the garlic salt.  Spread about 1 teaspoon of cream cheese cheese mixture on one side of one slice of bread.

title:

    -.

ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 3 cans tomato juice | radish, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Brown the ground beef and drain.  Set aside.  Add salt and pepper to tomato juice.  Stir.  Add beef to tomato juice.  Simmer for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,deli ham,roast pork,fish sauce,vinegar,nutmeg,italian seasoning
title: Crazy French Rollups
ingredients: 1 can deli ham, cut into slabs about 1/2 inch thick | 1 tablespoon fish sauce or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon vinegar, white or cider | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder ( optional ) | french roll breads, loaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375º.  Place ham slices on a foil lined baking sheet.  In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce or soy sauce, vinegar, old bay seasoning, nutmeg and baking powder in a small saucepan over medium heat.  Heat mixture just until it is warm and bubbly.  Pour sauce over ham and bake just until the cheese is melted.  Serve with loaves of french roll.  This is good served with chicken.  To make ahead, store refrigerated rolls in an airtight container.  Reheat under the broiler just until hot.  To reheat, heat under broiler just until hot.

title: Squash and Ham Crostini

instructions: Preheat the oven to 500ºf.  Brush the cut surfaces with the liquid smoke.  Place the baguette halves on a baking sheet.  Bake until toasted and bubbly, 7 - 8 minutes.  Add the ham and zucchini and toast another 2 minutes.  Remove and set aside.  To serve, split the crostini and top with the ham and zucchini mixture.  Wine accompaniment, french moutarde, for the crusty side, mix the cornstarch and 1 1/4 cups of cream and place over medium heat.  When slightly thickened, add a little dry white wine, if you like.

title: Thai Chips With Ham (Phat Met Mamuang Kway)
ingredients: 4 lbs russet potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 cup thai sweet chili paste | ham, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Cut potatoes into rounds with a biscuit cutter or glass.  Transfer to a baking sheet lined with parchment or waxed paper.  Arrange 3 or 4 chips on a baking sheet, spaced slightly apart.  Lightly press each chip with a wooden toothpick, making sure each toothpick is slightly in the center.  Bake until chips are golden on both sides, 25 to 30 minutes.  Let cool on a rack.

title: Kiwi Steak With Sage
ingredients: 600 g flank steaks | 4 kiwi fruits | 2 dashes tabasco sauce | 2 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Score steak and insert slices of kiwi.  Rub sauce into flank steak.  Place sage leaf on top.  Cook in a moderate oven to 200°c for 1 - ½ hours.  Serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,onion powder,basil leaf,tomato puree,cream chicken soup
title: Quickest and Easy Creamy Slow Cooker Tomato Basil Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 can canned tomato puree | 1 pinch dried basil leaves
instructions: Spread cream of chicken soup into the bottom of a slow cooker.  Place bamboo slices around the base of the slow cooker.  Sprinkle chopped onion over the top of soup.  Next spoon tomato puree over the onion.  Top with basil leaves.  Cook on low for 6 to 7 hours.  Serve with a green salad and enjoy.

title: Thai Dry Rub
ingredients: 1/4 cup thai fish sauce | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a jar or glass mixing bowl.  Shake well to coat.  Use as a dip with chicken or pork.

title: Linguine With Lettuce and Romaine and Herby Butter
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 4 tablespoons butter, softened | 2 heads of romaine lettuce, washed and chopped
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain and set aside.  Meanwhile, cream butter with 3 tbsp of the butter.  Wash and chop romaine and toss with butter.  After linguine is tossed, place in large mixing bowl.  Pour in linguine and mix well.  Enjoy.

title: Shrimp and Tuna Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces cooked baby shrimp | 2 cans tuna, with liquid | 1/2 cup baby carrots, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup celery, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried summer savory
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook over low heat, partially covered, until shrimp and tuna are heated through.  Serve over a bed of cooked rice.  If using cooked rice, heat in microwave on high for about 1 minute.  If using cooked rice, cook 3 minutes.

title: Tomato Egg Sauce(Sbd P5)
ingredients: 3 large beefsteak tomatoes | 2 -3 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Slice the tomato in slanted, thin slivers, using a sharp knife.  Place the tomatoes onto a tray, sprinkle with molasses.  Bake them on a low heat, shaking them every so often, and simmer them for about twenty minutes.  Don't let them brown.  Cool and eat them as a dip with french fries or with hamburger buns.

title: Hot Cheese Logs
ingredients: 1 jar marshmallows | 3 tablespoons caster sugar ( demerara ) | 3 sheets manchego cheese
instructions: Put the marshmallows and sugar into a bowl, add a few drops of hot water, and leave for 10 - 15 minutes.  Preheat an oven griddle or frying pan for 3 - 5 minutes using about ¼ cupfuls of the marshmallow syrup until the sugar turns a light brown colour.  Cut the cheese into 1cm thick rounds and spread out on a dry tea towel to dry out.  Place the cheese pieces on a baking tray and brush them with the remaining marshmallow syrup.  Bake in the oven for 7 - 10 minutes, until the outside of the cheese has turned a light golden brown.  Serve while still warm, with a drizzle of the sweetened marshmallow syrup,.

title: Chile Fritters
ingredients: 1 carrot, peeled, grated | 1 poblano chile, seeded, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 loaf crusty bread, cut into small triangles | 2 teaspoons icing sugar
instructions: Combine carrot, chile and vinegar in nonreactive bowl.  Add sugar, stir to dissolve.  Dip bread triangles into the mixture, coating evenly.

Random Ingredients: white bread,chicken bouillon,nutmeg,garam masala,club soda,lemon peel,baking soda,pasta
title: Hollow out Fresh Breadcrumb Stuffing for Freezing
ingredients: 250 g pasta | 1 cup club soda | 1 tablespoon lemon peel ( or lemon jell o ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons chat masala | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon ( i use chicken broth ) | 2 teaspoons grated nutmeg
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until tender.  Drain and set aside.  Place all ingredients into a bread machine bag.  Add pasta into the crock pot, and mix.

title: Roasted Peppers With Honey and Parmigiano
ingredients: 2 large yellow bell peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded | 1/2 cup honey | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus extra | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for topping
instructions: Position oven rack in center of oven and preheat to 425 degrees.  Place peppers skin side up in large rimmed baking sheet and brush with olive oil.  Roast peppers until skin is dark golden and blistered, 30 to 40 minutes.  Transfer roasted peppers to bowl of ice water.  Peel off burned skin and discard.  Place peppers in bowl and brush with oil.  Add honey and turmeric.  Cover and refrigerate peppers until ready to serve.  When ready to serve, sprinkle peppers with freshly grated pecorino romano cheese and drizzle generously with honey.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Beef, Pork and Snow Pea Sandwiches

instructions: Heat a heavy based frying pan over a medium high heat.  Add the oil and fry the pork until browned.  Remove the meat and add the sugar, cook for about 3 - 5 mins then add the hamburger, cook for another 2 - 3 mins, then set aside.  Meanwhile slice the baguette into 1/2 slices and warm in the microwave for 2 - 3 mins until warm.  Spread the bread with a tiny bit of guacamole if using, top with meat, add some snow peas and eat.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 1/4 cup mustard | 1/4 cup sugar or 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute
instructions: Place mustard & sugar in small bowl and blend until blended.

title: Basmati Rice with Feta Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked basmati rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 cup long grain rice | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Put the ghee in a large pan and turn heat to high.  When it's hot, put the first 3 ingredients in the pan, and stir fry 1 minute, then remove from heat.  Put in rice and stir to coat with ghee and serve.

title: Pheasant Roast (Grilled)
ingredients: 12 -20 lbs beef rib-eye roast | 2 tablespoons oil | 4 poblano chiles ( preferably anaheim ) | 1/2 cup peanuts, roasted, peeled and unsalted | 1/4 cup roasted cashews | 1/4 cup prosciutto | 1 red chile, chopped finely | 1 small fresh red chile, chopped finely | 1/2 anaheim chilies, chopped finely

Broil or broil or roast, in batches or on sheets of foil, turning occasionally, until completely seared and charred on all sides. Serve roast directly from bones, with the remaining roasted peanuts sprinkled on top.  To make vegetarian spread, cook meat juices with green vegetables if using salted meats, for 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,spaghetti sauce mix,wonton wrapper,jasmine rice

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Lay each potato slice on a piece of aluminum foil and place on a baking sheet.  Sprinkle each slice with 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar and sprinkle over baking soda.  Bake until potatoes are tender and lightly coloured, 25 to 30 minutes.  Sprinkle each slice with raisins and basil and top with almonds.  Serve with lime wedges and almond extract.

title: Smooth Blue Cheese Rice Con Carne

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Put cardamom seeds over medium heat and toast for 1 minute.  Pour oil into a 13x9 baking dish with lid.  Over med heat, saute garlic and the rice until rice is cooked, 2 - 3 minutes.  Add beans, 1/4 cup of oil, rum, and turmeric.  Stir into rice.  Sprinkle top with sugar.  Add cheese.

instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with margarine.  Spread sauerkraut on the bottom of pan.  Layer shallots, rice, olives in another pan and spread the mixture on top.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 45 minutes.  Slice and serve.

instructions: Place lamb in casserole dish or dutch oven.  Combine ginger and garlic paste over top of lamb.

ingredients: 1 1/4 cups mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons garlic, minced
instructions: Stir all ingredients together until well combined.  Chill until ready to use.  Keep refrigerated up to 3 days.

instructions: Combine chocolate into a saucepan and melt over low heat.  Remove from heat and stir in almond extract.  Let mixture sit for a few minutes to rest for easy stirring. instructions: To make cappuccino, place 1 1/2 liters vanilla ice cream in large freezer plastic tub, or bowl over freezer, and freeze.  To make cappuccino by placing spaghetti sauce in freezer bowl and stirring after 1/2 hour.  After 6 hours add 2 tsp instant coffee and stir.  Freeze one more time.  To make cappuccino, place cappuccino in small serving dish and pour cappuccino sauce over the top.

title: Hibachi Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 4 green olives ( optional ) | 1 lb beef sirloin, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 cups chopped fresh kale
instructions: Mix all ingredients except kale in a large glass or plastic bowl.  Add beef and stir to thoroughly coat meat with marinade.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours.  Meanwhile, cover and grill kale.

title: Cheese and Hot Dog Brunch
ingredients: 250 g muenster cheese | 1 egg white | 1/2 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Line a 4 hole, deep, straight sided ovenproof shallow fry pan with non stick baking paper, allowing the paper to extend over the bottom of the dish. Bake the sandwiches in a low oven for about 10 to 12 minutes or until golden.

title: French Pork Tenderloin

instructions: Mix pork tenderloins, italian parsley, and green onion pepper sauce together in a sealable plastic bag.  Allow pork to marinate in the refrigerator 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Penne With Red Pepper & Cauliflower
ingredients:
1 head cauliflower ( about 1 1/2 lb.

instructions: Toast the sunflower seeds in a skillet for 1 - 2 minutes remove from the heat. Add the red chili slices and continue cooking, stirring often, 1 - 2 minutes.  Add the cauliflower and roasted sunflower seeds and stir well to coat.  Add pasta and continue cooking over low heat until pasta is tender and heated through.  Serve immediately.

title: Kathy's Easy Chicken Ziti
