instructions: Place ziti in a 6 qt.  Resiler and cover with water.

title: Seared Mango and Jalapeno Ranchero
ingredients: 5 mangos, peeled and cut into about 4 thick slices ( yellow mango, red mango, green mango ) | 1 fresh jalapeno chile pepper, seeded
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Heat a skillet over medium high heat.  Place a small scoop of the mango mixture on the palm of your hand, then roll it into a cylinder 2 to 3 inches in diameter.  Repeat with the balance of the mango mixture.  Remove the roll and wipe out the skillet with a paper towel as necessary.  Adjust the heat to maintain a low simmer. Remove from the heat and drizzle the mixture with your favorite white sauce and garnish with additional jalapenos.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,vegetable stock,lime wedge,cheddar cheese,wonton wrapper,gruyere cheese,cinnamon
title: Cheese Wrapped Bites
ingredients: 12 wonton wrappers | 3/4 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 tablespoon vegetable stock | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In medium size bowl, combine cheeses, cumin, and cinnamon.  Using a very sharp serrated knife, cut a slit into about 1/2 inch deep crosswise cuts in about 1/4 inch wide cheese mixture all the way through the biscuit tube.  Place biscuit cut side down onto a sheet of wax paper and carefully remove wax paper.  Using a pastry brush, lightly brush cut side of each biscuit with a little water, then sprinkle each with cheese mixture.  Bake in preheated oven for 5 minutes, then turn over onto a plate.  Serve warm with lime wedges.

title: Spiced Beef Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala, spice mix ( i've used pamela's bulk barn zaar spice mix for this ) | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Stir together the flour and chaat masala in a small bowl.  Rub the spice paste onto the beef.  Place in a roasting pan, fat side up.  Roast until an instant read thermometer reads 160f for rare or 170f for medium rare, turning over once halfway through.  Let stand for 5 minutes, then slice thin across the grain.  Serve with pita bread, salad, pickles or vegetables.

title: Fresco De Reyes - Preserved Lemons

instructions: Rinse the lemons well in lukewarm water before using them.  Using a sharp knife, cut the lemons at an angle about 1 1/2 wide, 1/2 depth, into a large bowl of kosher salt.  Use a vegetable peeler to remove the colored or black sections of the rind from the lemons and place the sections into the bowl. Cover and set aside until cooled to the touch about 15 to 20 minutes to let all of the water drip off.  When the rind/flowers have been chilling, place the jars in a hot water bath and immediately remove the water bath.  Leave a piece of rell of lemon in the jar for each person to use.  Remove the rind, unwrap the cloves and place into a large pot or bowl.  Juice one or two of drained rind from the lemon using a juicer and the juice.  Add to the rinsed rind the drained lemon juice in the bowl with the drained lemon pieces.  Place the rinsed lemon pieces on a foil or a tea towel and rub the rind lightly with a little water.  Add a layer of crushed fEW to the rinsed rinsed rinsed lemon juice.  Add the drained lemon juice to the rinsed lemon juice in the bowl.  Repeat for the remaining rinsed lemon pieces.  Place all of the food in the food processor fitted with the metal blade and process to a smooth paste.

title: Crispy Mexican Limes
ingredients: 2 limes | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cut the limes into wedges.  Place in a skillet and fry over medium heat until the edges begin to curl up, about 5 minutes.  Turn out on a plate with tongs, sprinkle with the cheese and continue to fry the limes until the cheese begins to melt, 1 to 2 minutes.  Transfer to a serving dish and serve with salsa fresca or sour cream if desired.

title: Yummy Asian Rice Paper Wraps (Rice Paper Wraps)
ingredients: 1/2 jalapeno | 1/2 inch ginger-garlic paste | 4 sheets rice paper ( round ) | 1/3 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Heat a little oil in a frying pan.  Add the jalapeno, ginger garlic paste and fry on medium high heat for about 3 minutes or until the ginger garlic paste turns golden in color.  Take care as the jalapeno can make the dish extremely hot add dry mustard powder.  Add the rice paper sheets and keep moving them so that they do not break apart.  After 5 minutes, the rice paper wrapper will start to form a slight crunchy mess on the bottom of the pan.  Turn over the rice paper wrapper on its side and make sure to roll it carefully.  When you end, the wrapper will be crisp and glossy.  Remove it all to a tray with a spatula and let it cool.  Once cool, it can be served.  Be sure to eat it the same day that it is made.

title: Faux Nachos
ingredients: 1 bag tortilla chips | 2 tablespoons lime zest | 1 tablespoon ginger | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 dash pepper ( any amount to taste ) | 2 tablespoons prunes
instructions: Put prunes in microwave safe container.  Microwave on high 6 - 8 min's. .  Put in a strainer to drain.  Chop fine.  If you leave the zest, the zest goes into a bowl or container with 1 teaspoon of salt.  Mash or mash with a fork and stir in the rest of the salt and pepper.  Add spices to prunes and mix well.  Toss with chips.  Serve with a little guacamole if you like.

title: Spanish Chorizo-Apple Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups arborio rice ( a short grain sweet rice is the preferred flavor ) | 2 cups chorizo, cooked, diced ( i used turkey chorizo ) | 1 cup green olive, chopped ( about 6 ounces ) | 2 medium apples, peeled, cored and chopped ( i used a combination of both ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh peppercorn ( or peppercorn powder ), to taste ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f/190°c and keep covered with foil, in a shallow roasting pan big enough to fit all ingredients in the pan.  Wash and drain rice.  Put rice into a sieve, rinse under cold water and drain thoroughly.  Place chorizo in the pan and stir fry over medium heat until browned.  Add rice, olives, cored apples and the chopped peppercorns.  Stir, cover with foil and bake for 15 - 20 minutes.  Remove cover, sprinkle with cheese and bake 5 more minutes.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Mexican Asparagus Dogs
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 package frozen asparagus, thawed and finely sliced | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 cup buttermilk, warmed
instructions: Preheat the grill for high heat.  Spray one side of a cookie sheet with cooking spray.  In a small bowl, combine the chili paste, asparagus, catsup, and cajun seasoning.  Place the asparagus and chili paste mixture on a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated grill until the topping is lightly browned, about 10 to 12 minutes.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,bean sprout,white onion,chicken stock cube,canadian bacon,parsley,marmalade
title: Hamburger and Bow Ties (Sour Beef or Pork)
ingredients: 4 slices canadian bacon, chopped | 1 small white onion, sliced up | 1 1/2 lbs lean fat-free lean beef chuck, trimmed, and cut into 1 1/2 inch squares ( i get sirloin chops for this ) | 2 tablespoons fat | 2 tablespoons marmalade | 4 cups chicken stock cubes | 1 cup fresh bean sprout, washed and dried | parsley, for garnish
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp.  Remove bacon with slotted spoon and set aside.  Drain off all but 2 t.  Of the fat.  Fry onion in the bacon fat until caramelized.  Slice beef into 1/4 inch pieces and add to the onions in the skillet.  Fry beef until browned on all sides.  Pour in marmalade and toss to coat.  Add chicken stock cubes and bring to a gentle simmer.  Cover the skillet and let simmer for 45 minutes.  Add beansprouts, stir, and cook until tender.  Remove the cover.  Garnish with parsley and serve with crusty bread.

title: Rice & Passionfruit Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 cup rice, cooked ( instant or cooked ) | 1 cup coleslaw mix | 1/3 cup brandy | 1/4 cup romano cheese or 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons fresh passion fruit, chopped ( or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl and toss well.  Chill.  Tip, store unused portion of slaw with fridge covered for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: mace,red capsicum,rice,lime juice zest,leek,msg,orange bell pepper,white wine
title: Crispy Citrus Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lime juice, zest of | 1/2 teaspoon msg | 1 tablespoon sweet white wine or 1 tablespoon water | 1 small leeks or 1 small green onion, finely chopped | 2 cups rice, uncooked ( i prefer jasmine rice which has a wonderfully flavour ) | 1 red bell pepper or 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 red capsicum, chopped or 1/2 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients except rice in saucepan and stir to combine.  Cook on medium heat for about 12 minutes until rice is tender stir occasionally.  Add rice and stir until well coated and heated through.

title: Carnitas in a Jar
ingredients: 1 whole raspberries or 1 pint fresh raspberry | 1 lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Place raspberries in a glass jar with a round tip or round tip cut 2 to 3 slits on top.  Squeeze lime wedge over berries.  Make sure to cover raspberries very well.  Add a small glass jar, or a second large jar, if using.  Refrigerate raspberries for up to 2 months.  Garnish with a lime wedge and serve at once.

title: Raspberry Asiago Cheese Salad
ingredients: 5 cups raspberries, washed and dried | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Briefly combine raspberries, cheese, lemon juice and harissa.  Add salt to taste if needed.  You can add a little water or a little vinegar to the mix.

title: Creamy Italian Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, unpeeled | 1/2 small red onion, thinly sliced | 1 cup blueberries | 1/4 cup fat-free italian dressing ( i like nancy's house italian dressing )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Place the unpeeled potatoes in an ovenproof skillet and bake for about 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, add the onion and blueberries to a medium saucepan, place over medium heat and heat until the berries pop open.  Remove from heat.  Remove potatoes from the oven and cut into quarters.  Add the potatoes to the blueberry mixture.  Mix together and refrigerate 3 hours.  Serve.

title: Caramelized Broccoli With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli, cut into florets | 1/2 cup agave nectar | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 4 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Heat the nectar and corn syrup over medium heat until the syrup has been mostly absorbed.  Combine the peanut butter with 1/2 cup water and stir until smooth.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,green leaf lettuce,chili pepper,maple syrup,rice vinegar,olive
title: Dried Chili-Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup brown lentils, dried and rinsed | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili peppers, dried or 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chili peppers | 1/3 cup sliced ripe olives | 4 cups shredded green leaf lettuce and fresh green lettuce
instructions: Place all ingredients except lettuce in a large salad bowl.  Toss lightly.  Serve over lettuce.

Random Ingredients: lemon,green chilies,tomato juice,green cardamom pod,oil black olive
title: Fried Green Chile Olives
ingredients:
2 tablespoons oil ( black olive, olive, etc.
    - ) | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods, crushed ( optional ) | 1 pint tomato juice, chilled
instructions: Heat oil in a large saute pan over medium heat, until it shimmers.  Add the green chilies and brown lightly, stirring often.  Add the lemon juice and continue cooking for 2 minutes.  Add the cardamom pods, if using.  Add the tomatoes and cook for a few minutes.  Bring the mixture to a boil and then lower the heat, partially cover and simmer for 5 minutes.  Add salt to taste.  Stir.  Cool and serve.  If necessary, reheat the sauce before adding it to the finished olives.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,ladyfinger,ginger powder,whipping cream,peanut butter,rum cream liqueur
title: Creamy African Tiramisu
ingredients:
8 ounces cream cheese | 1/2 cup smooth peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon rum or 1/2 teaspoon rum flavored liqueur | 1.
    -5 packages ladyfingers | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder
instructions: In a bowl, beat cream cheese with a mixer on high speed for 30 seconds.  Add peanut butter and rum and beat for 2 minutes on medium speed.  Reserve.  Arrange lady fingers in a single layer in a shallow dish.  Pour cream evenly over the lady fingers.  Cover and refrigerate for 60 minutes to 10 minutes.  Spread cream mixture over cream and sprinkle with ginger.  Refrigerate for 20 to 30 minutes until firm.

Random Ingredients: hot salsa,russet potato,chicken bouillon granule,vegetable shortening,caper,romaine lettuce
title: Mashed Potato and Carrots
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, peeled, halved ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 cup hot salsa ( your salsa, or medium ) | 3 tablespoons capers | 2 tablespoons chopped romaine lettuce
instructions: Place the potatoes in a medium saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 15 to 18 minutes.  Drain potatoes, then return to simmering pan.  Mash the potatoes with a fork.  Place the shortening in a medium size skillet.  When the shortening foams, add the potatoes in a thin, even layer.  Sprinkle potatoes with chicken bouillon.  Heat briefly until fragrant but not browned.  Stir in the salsa, capers, and lettuce just before serving.

title: Mussels in Thai Coconut Salad
ingredients: 2 heads cabbage, chopped | 1 loaf fresh ginger root, chopped | 1 pound mussels, cleaned | 1 can coconut cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons honey | 1 head fresh boston lettuce, torn into pieces
instructions: Place cabbage in a large pot with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and cook over medium heat until cabbage is tender and bright green, about 20 minutes.  Rinse and discard any tough outer leaves and coarsely shredded leaves.  Remove and discard the outer leaves, and tear leaves into pieces.  Rinse and debeard mussels.  In a medium saucepan over medium heat, cook cabbage and ginger in coconut cream until cabbage is limp, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and mash through a fork.  Stir in honey.  Bring to a boil, and cook until thickened and reduced by half, 5 to 10 minutes.  Arrange mussels in a small bowl on top.  Pour syrup over the mussels, and gently toss to coat.  Serve immediately.

title: Fruit Salad With Yogurt and Ancho Chiles
ingredients: 1 pint plain yogurt, chilled ( can substitute mayonnaise ) | 1 1/2 ancho chiles powder ( with seeds, if you like a milder flavor try with 1 tablespoon )
instructions: Put the yoghurt in a bowl, sprinkle in a little chile powder and mix to combine.  Taste and adjust the seasoning to your liking.  Leave it at a low light, for a few hours if you prefer.  You can serve this chilled or right away.  It gets really good with dried or toasted pumpernickel dill bread, as an accompaniment to a meat pita.

title: Pan Fried Salmon
ingredients: 6 salmon, approximately | 150 g plain flour | 12 small fresh salmon
instructions: Cut each fresh thawed salmon into four squares or six slices.  Dip each square or slice of salmon into flour, place onto oiled baking trays and fry in batches until crisp and golden.  Serve with home made salmon salad.

title: Frozen Chocolate "glue"
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen chocolate, squares | 14 ounces light sour cream | 1 celery rib
instructions: Pour chocolate, sour cream, and celery in a large bowl at least 1 - ½ - 2 days before making trip to the store.  When ready to use, place in a freezer bag.  Label the bag and freeze.  When ready to use, remove from freezer and place in a large freezer bag.  Label the bag and freeze.  Remove from freezer and place in the freezer on the counter top overnight. .  During the colder section of the refrigerator, remove bag from the freezer 10 minutes before making trip to the store to get a cold loaf.  Make sure all pieces are frozen on the counter top.  Place loaf in a plastic or paper bag to catch drips or frosting.  Label and store in the freezer.  Thaw when no longer frozen.  When ready to use, lightly coat a 10 inch round baking pan or a 2 1/2 quart souffle dish with a nonstick coating.  Place the prepared loaf in the pan.  Freeze for up to 4 days.  The longer it stays frozen, the easier it will be to slice.

title: BBQ (Served as Lamb) with Guinness
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs leg of lamb, with bone | 1/4 cup guinness stout | 4 teaspoons white sugar
instructions: Preheat your outdoor grill to medium.  Place lamb on skewers and brush with beer.  Leave on medium heat for about 10 minutes, flip and brush with remaining beer.  Sprinkle lightly with sugar.  Grill for about 10 minutes for medium rare, about 5 minutes for medium well.  Remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,cream chicken soup,tamarind juice,oregano,shell pasta
title: Tamarind Noodles
ingredients: 2 medium bell peppers, chopped | 7 ounces small shell pasta, uncooked | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup tamarind juice | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Spray large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray and heat to medium.  Add the bell pepper and cook stirring frequently, over medium heat until tender crisp, about 8 minute.  Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain pasta and set aside.  Add soup, tamarind juice, oregano and pepper mixture to skillet.  Heat through.  Serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,black pepper,arborio rice,kiwi fruit,spring onion
title: Cottage Cheese, Kiwi and Risotto
ingredients: 50 g cottage cheese or 75 g feta cheese, cut into 1cm cubes | 3 spring onions, chopped | 150 g arborio rice | 2 teaspoons black pepper | 1 kiwi fruit, sliced
instructions: Cook rice till tender.  Drain.  Add cheese and mix well.  Stir in black pepper and kiwifruit.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: orecchiette,marjoram,half,heavy whipping cream,ginger,chicken bouillon,tomato juice,vegetable oil
title: Baked Orecchiette With Ginger Dressing
ingredients: 1 lb orecchiette, uncooked | 2 cups vegetable oil | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger ( peeled, chopped or finely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon marjoram, chopped ( fresh ) | 1 teaspoon orecchiette ( fresh, chopped ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Coat a 9x13 inch metal loaf pan with vegetable oil.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add orcchiette and cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until al dente.

title: Cheats Roti
ingredients: 250 g plain yogurt ( i used low-fat plain yogurt but i think it would be better to'siti'brand') | 1/2 teaspoon dried leaf thyme ( or more if you like ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried cayenne ( or more if you like it spicy ) | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 tablespoon plain unsalted butter
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c.  Mix the yogurt with spices i like the s&w to the yogurt.  Stir well until smooth, add flour and butter and mix well.  Shape the dough into a ball, cover and refrigerate for at least 60 minutes.  Remove from refrigerator and work the dough on a floured surface.  You can roll it out as thin as you want, you just don't want it to be too elastic.  Take a piece of dough about the size of golf ball with diameter of pinch then flatten to a round.  Place one teaspoon or less of filling in the centre of the round.  Bring the edges of the rounds together tightly to seal the filling.  Place the rotis onto baking trays which has been dusted with flour or bread crumbs. .  Bake for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.  Serve immediately.

title: Simple Mexican Cauliflower
ingredients:
1 small cauliflower, about 10 oz.
    - | 2 -3 tablespoons taco sauce
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into flowerettes, about 1-1/2 inches in diameter.  Fill a large skillet with water and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Place cauliflower into water and reduce heat so it just barely boils over.  The cauliflower begins to wilt as it cooks.  You may need to use a fork to scrape the cauliflower from the bottom of the pan.  Cook until cauliflower is soft and florets look vibrant.  This will take about 45 minutes to an hour.  Taste the cauliflower for tenderness.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf powder,tomato paste,spinach,taco seasoning mix,savory
title: Savory Spinach
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped spinach ( squeezed dry with a brush ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon dried parsley or 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1 cup tomato paste
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions.  Mix all together.  Serve warm or chill for later use.

title: Tortellini Cones
ingredients: 1 package cheese tortellini | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup maple syrup
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions.  Meanwhile, combine soy sauce and maple syrup.  Drain tortellini and toss with soy sauce mixture.  Note, for added protein, omit the soy sauce and maple syrup.

title: Guinness Cottage With Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut-up ( optional ) | 1/2 cup guinness stout | 2 slices bacon or 2 slices pancetta, chopped | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts | 1 pinch cayenne | 2 teaspoons besan
instructions: Steam or boil cauliflower until tender.  When done, transfer to large serving bowl.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Mound on top.  Serve chilled.

title: Almond Breakfast Cups
ingredients: 1 cup flour tortillas | 1/3 cup sliced almonds | 3/4 cup chopped zucchini | 1/2 cup chopped yellow squash | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 egg white | 1 cup chicken or 1 cup broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees.  Place tortilla squares on baking sheets and toast for about 10 minutes or until slightly crispy.  In a measuring cup or small bowl, combine the nuts, zucchini, squash, flour, and egg white.  Stir until mixed well.  Roll each cup in the almond mixture, then place on cookie sheet.  Bake 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,emmenthaler cheese,apple juice,hot water,cremini mushroom,mesclun
title: Vegetable and Cheese Fondue (For the Crock Pot or Not)
ingredients: 6 ounces shredded emmenthaler cheese | 1/2 cup hot water | 1/4 cup chopped cremini mushroom ( about 6 ounces ) | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar | 1/2 cup packed brown sugar | 2 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Put ingredients in cooker.  If it's a crock pot, put it on high.  Cover and cook for 1 hour.  Let stand 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: parsley,lima bean,maple syrup,iceberg lettuce,italian salad dressing mix,dill pickle,sea salt,almond milk
title: Italian Lima Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup frozen lima beans, thawed and well drained | 5 tablespoons creamy italian salad dressing mix | 1/3 cup almond milk | 12 cups sliced iceberg lettuce | 3/4 cup thinly sliced dill pickles | 1 tablespoon minced fresh parsley | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian-style salad dressing mix | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped | cracked sea salt ( optional )
instructions: To prepare dressing, mix sugar, celery seed, celery salt or celery salt and dijon mustard blend well.  Place the lettuce in a large salad bowl.  Drain and save 1 cup of the liquid from the lima beans.  Toss into the salad.  Sprinkle pickles on top.  Place remaining lima beans on top.  Mix remaining ingredients until well blended.  Add enough of the reserved liquid if necessary to make dressing creamy.  Refrigerate and serve.

title: Quick Microwave Mushroom Delight
ingredients: 2 tablespoons palm sugar or 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 8 -10 cremini mushrooms, washed, dried and torn | 6 small spring onions, sliced into rings | 10 -12 slices bamboo shoots
instructions: Toss mushrooms with sugar and microwave on high for 5 - 7 minutes or until the sugar has melted.  Add spring onions, bamboo shoots, stir.  Serve hot with white rice.

title: Gefilte Marinated Beef Tips - 4-Qt Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, fat trimmed | 1/2 cup cognac | 1 cup hoisin sauce | 2 teaspoons chili paste with garlic
instructions: Trim fat from beef and discard.  Thoroughly drain beef and cut into 2 or 3 inch cubes.  Transfer meat to one or two gallon or larger zipper lock plastic bags.  Combine cognac, hoisin sauce and chili paste in pressure cooker.  Add meat.  Refrigerate pressure cooker 30 minutes, then remove meat from bags.  Shake bag around gently to coat the meat cubes.  Refrigerate at least 6 hours, preferably overnight.  Discard bag of any remaining marinade.  Transfer meat to a hot saute pan.

title: Mimosa Shumai (Beef Strips)
ingredients: 1 cup beef steak, thinly sliced ( japanese-style preferred ) | 1 egg yolk | nori, seaweed shavings ( garnish )
instructions: Combine beef, egg yolk and seasoning paste in a medium size glass bowl.  Heat a large nonstick pan over medium high heat for 3 minutes.  Add beef mixture and cook, using a spatula, turning strips, until seared but tender, 3 - 5 minutes.  Place on a serving dish and garnish with nori.

title: Coconut Fudge
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups light coconut milk ( or other brand ) | 2 ounces soft ladyfingers, about 1/2 cup each | cayenne, for dusting
instructions: Place the coconut milk into a small pan and bring to the boil.

title: Low-Fat Oven Roast Chicken With Aubergine, Raisins, and Cherry
ingredients: 4 large aubergines | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 8 ounces frozen cherries | 3 cups frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Cut a slit in the center of each of the aubergines, lengthwise.  Enlarge the holes with a sharp knife into the core so that the cuts will be removed later.  Cut each aubergine in half lengthwise.  Squeeze the pulp from its shells so that they don't need to be rinsed in the milk and drain.  Place the aubergines cut side up in a roasting pan, fat side down.  Roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.  Turn off the oven, and allow the oven to cool.  Place the soup, broth, and raisins in a large bowl, and stir to mix.  Pour mixed vegetables into the bowl, and gently fold in the aubergine pulp and roasted meat.  Let stand for 10 minutes.  Remove meat, reserving marinade, and sprinkle the meat with reserved raisins.  Place meat on serving platters, cover, and refrigerate until ready to bake.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,gouda cheese,peanut oil,white wine,beet,chicken breast half
title: Beets Baked in Garlic and White Wine
ingredients: 3 large beets, grated | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded to 1/4 inch thick | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/4 cup shredded gouda cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.  To make beets in garlic and wine, heat oil in a medium skillet over medium heat.  Stir in 1/4 cup of swiss cheese during the last minute of cooking.  To make beets in cheese, in a large bowl, mix together the shredded beets, shredded chicken, flour, and browned chicken.  Spoon mixture in the baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven until the beets are bubbly and the edges are crispy and brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,ginger garlic paste,hazelnut,orange juice,pineapple chunk
title: Hazelnut Scented Pineapple
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, lightly toasted | 2 tablespoons candied ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup orange juice | 12 kalamata olives, pitted and halved
instructions: Preheat grill to moderate heat.  Toast hazelnuts in a dry skillet on grates, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.  Transfer hazelnuts to a small bowl and set aside.  Toast candied ginger in a dry skillet on Grates on direct heat until fragrant, 30 seconds to 1 minute.  Transfer the hazelnuts to a plate and reserve juice in the skillet.  Add orange juice and reserved hazelnuts to hazelnuts and cook, stirring constantly, until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.  Add candied ginger and olives and cook, stirring constantly, just until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,gingerroot,butter,mustard seed,monterey jack cheese,shell pasta
title: Garicalli (Ginger Pasta)
ingredients: 1/2 lb shell pasta ( i used whole zucchini but i think hal would work ) | 1 3/4 teaspoons coarse mustard seeds or 1 3/4 teaspoons yellow mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons minced fresh gingerroot | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter or 2 tablespoons olive oil, divided | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese at room temperature
instructions: Cook the shell pasta in a large pot of boiling water until just tender, about 11 minutes.

title: Horseradish & Roasted Potatoes - #5FIX
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled ( about 2 pounds total ) | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with a little olive oil.  Roast potatoes for 20 minutes or until soft and tender.  Meanwhile combine the horseradish and tomato juice in a medium bowl and mash together until smooth.  Remove the potatoes from the oven and spread the horseradish on, then top with the potato mixture.  Return potatoes to oven, and continue roasting potatoes until done.

Random Ingredients: corn cob,red currant jelly,white cabbage,ginger,lentil,beef tenderloin
title: Lentils and Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 large red currant jelly | 8 ounces sweetened condensed lentils, soaked overnight and drained | 8 ounces small white cabbage, shredded | 12 ounces beef tenderloin, cooked and cut into thin strips | 2 corn on the cob, husk and silks removed | 3 tablespoons thinly sliced peeled fresh ginger
instructions: Place the beans in a large pan of boiling water and bring back to the boil.  Cover, remove from the heat and set aside to steam.  Place the cabbage and ginger in a large bowl and add the lentils, stir together well and season with salt and pepper to taste.  Cut the beef into thin strips and coat with the jam.  Line the salad leaves with lettuce leaves, alternating the cabbage and the beef.  Add the beans and pour over the remaining jam.  Serve with crisp fresh fruit and cream.

title: Refreshing Veggies Tacos
ingredients: 2 -4 large flour tortillas | 1 can refried beans | 1/2 cup yellow sweet pepper, diced | 1 can cherry pie filling
instructions: Prepare a small amount of oil spray in a saucepan,.  Cut each tortilla into 6 slices.  Dip each slice in fryer or set aside to drain.  Heat up refried beans.  When heated warm, place one slice on a soft tortilla.  Make sure it is soft enough with the rolling the tortilla.  Spoon about 1 tbsp of refried beans onto the tortilla, place in hot oil, flipping over once.  Place on a paper towel covered plate and spread a bit of cherry pie filling over it.  Roll up and place on plate seam side down.  After all tortillas are rolled up & placed on a plate, cover tortillas with a lid to keep them soft.  Once you are done rolling all your tortillas, take them off of the oil and let cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes.  Carefully remove the toothpicks.  Cut into 6 even pieces.

Random Ingredients: pam cooking spray,chicken bouillon cube,red potato,blackberry,fruit
title: Crock Pot Blackberry Potato and Berry Dressing
ingredients: 6 -8 small red potatoes, cut into quarters | 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit, such as currants, raisins, chopped dates, etc | 4 fresh blackberries | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | pam cooking spray
instructions: Place potatoes into a slow cooker.  Put mixed dried fruit under the skin of chop the potato sections up finely and add to the slow cooker. .  Add bouillon cubes and blackberries.  Top with pam sprayed pam.  Cover and cook on high setting for 5 hours.  Turn cooker to low and cook for another 6 - 8 hours.  Do so, periodically check and stir mixture.  After taking mixture out, store in refrigerator for up to 3 weeks.

title: Penne Con Papas (Chilled Pasta)
ingredients: 12 tablespoons vegetable broth | 7 tablespoons dill weed | 8 ounces penne | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Bring the broth to a boil in a skillet.  Add the pasta, dill weed, and sugar.  Mix thoroughly, turn off heat, cover, and leave to sit for four minutes.  After 4 minutes, stir pasta and sauce together and pour into a bowl or glass jar.  Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight to chill.  Shake the jar to combine, return to the refrigerator, and let mellow overnight to chill.

Random Ingredients: fine sugar,almond milk,tabasco sauce,chocolate square,hamburger bun,broccoli,iceberg lettuce
title: Chocolate Sandwich with Grilled Beef
ingredients: 3 hamburger buns, split lengthwise | 1 cup sliced broccoli | 4 tablespoons fine sugar | 1/2 cup almond milk | 4 grated chocolate squares | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Place hamburger on split halves of the bun with the broccomended bun top and broil until lightly browned and the beef is no longer pink inside.

title: Beet and Pepper Cookies
ingredients: 1 orange | 1 yellow pepper | 5 -6 beetroots | 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup beets ( finely diced to serve )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c or 170°c if using a fan forced oven or 180°c if using a fan forced oven.  Place the orange and pepper into a small dish, cover with plastic wrap and place in the oven on medium.  Remove from the oven and leave to cool.  The peppers should be charred but not burnt.  Peel, then slit each pepper lengthways through their base so you have 5 or 6 thin strips.  Place the beetroot in a large bowl and toss with the flour to a firm paste.  Add the diced peppers and the reserved orange and black liquid.  If using gluten free beets, place in a bowl of water and lightly pat dry.  Lightly spray 2 1/2cm cake tins with cooking oil spray.  Working with one third of the mixture at a time drop the mixture of beets into the oiled tin.  Use a wooden spoon to flatten the mixtures gently so they are level.  Spread evenly with a teaspoonful of the beets.  Cook until the tops are golden.  Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

title: Fried Onions

Cover the towel with a double thickness of paper towels and set aside for 30 to 45 minutes.  Press the salt firmly and evenly over the surface and gather the corners of the towel.  Repeat twice more, working quickly, until the salt is completely soft and completely soft.  Pat the salt dry with a paper towel.  Place a small piece of aluminum foil over the top, then cover the foil tightly with additional plastic wrap.  This will keep the salt from drying out until it is needed and will crisp up any moisture released from the salt in the final dish.  Let it dry at room temperature for about 1/2 an hour.  Rinse the salt well again and pat it dry again.  If the jar is wide, cut it in half lengthwise.  Pack the salt into a clean jar or container, leaving 1/2 inch of headspace.  Carefully line the jar rim with the top of the foil with a double thickness of paper towels, then fill the holes with any additional slices of salt, making sure there is an airlock.  Place the jar in a cool, dark place or on the counter, where it should be completely cool and dry before use.  The salt may last up to a year in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,raspberry jam,cream cheese,cardamom seed,dark soy sauce
title: Raspberry Tea Cheesecake (Russian)
ingredients: 16 ounces cream cheese ( neufchatel ) | 14 ounces dark soy sauce | 3/4 cup raspberry jam | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed or 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Using an electric mixer beat the cream cheese and both soy sauces until smooth.  Stir in the jam. Place in oven and bake until chocolate is melted and the top is lightly browned.  After removing from oven, place cheesecake in refrigerator to cool for at least 30 minutes.  Spoon cooled chocolate on top of the cheesecake and chill for at least 1 hour or as long as 4 hours.  Garnish with fresh raspberry slices.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,cabbage,beef gravy,ginger garlic paste,red chili pepper,garlic
title: Beef 'n Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, chopped | 300 g beef gravy ( home made but home made if you are able to find it ) | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper, crushed | 2 dashes baking powder | 2 cloves garlic, minced
instructions: Chop up the cabbage finely and put into a saucepan with the beef gravy.  Add the ginger, garlic and chili and let it simmer. title: The Real Deal Spanish Onion Rings

instructions: Heat your oil in a deep fryer to 375f or the microwave reaches 380f.  In a medium bowl toss together the onion and the gingerale. instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions.  Drain and set aside.  Heat olive oil over medium heat.  Cut fish fillets into 1/2 inch thick slices.  Sprinkle with salt & pepper. title: Baked Beef & Pepperoni Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked penne pasta | 2 lbs lean ground chuck | 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1 jar sliced pears, drained | 12 ounces pepperoni, chopped | 1 package large marshmallows, chopped
instructions: Cook penne, al dente, according to package directions.  Meanwhile, cook beef over medium high heat, breaking up when necessary.  Drain.  Stir in oil. Bake at 350 degrees for 1/2 hour, stirring once.

title: Wheat Bran Oat
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat bran | 1 cup rolled oats

title: Tostones for Two (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina | 10 corn tortillas or 10 flour tortillas, cut into 1/4-inch squares | 3/4 cup fresh corn kernels or 3/4 cup canned corn | 1/4 cup light corn oil ( or more if you prefer ) or 1/4 cup lemon-flavored oil ( or more if you prefer ) | 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika ( or mild-flavored spanish smoked paprika )

title: Aloo Ka Salan for Idlis

title: Brandy Glaze for Beef Brunch or Fried Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/4 cup brandy ( i use cognac for a sweeter flavor ) | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons carob powder ( carob powder is the same thing )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl or jar with a tight fitting lid.  Whisk the contents until well combined, then add the beef tenderloin.  If the beef is dry, add a little more apple juice or Brandy to moisten.  Let sit for at least 2 hours.

instructions: Whisk tahini, tea, sesame oil, and duck seasoning mix together in a bowl.

title: Fried Tofu With Cucumbers

title: Tropical-Style Turkey

Add onions to skillet and continue sautéing until onions are translucent, about 5 minutes more.  Turn heat to low and add green onions.  Serve immediately.

instructions: Soak the chickpeas overnight.  Drain, place in a large bowl, add the red pepper and french bread mixtures.  Mix well.  Add the turmeric and mix well.  Place the steak on the skewers. instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease a 9x1 inch deep dish pie plate.  Whisk mixed vegetables, bread crumbs, 1 teaspoon of dried thyme, and egg whites together in a bowl.  Pour meat mixture into pie plate.

title: Onions - Honey Hodges

instructions: Cut onions in half lengthwise.  Slice onions vertically into 1 1/2 inch slices.  Place the halves cut side down in a 13x9 inch x 2 inch baking dish. Of oil to a frying pan and add refried beans and cook, stirring frequently, until cooked but with a little crunch, about 2 min.  Stir in cheddar cheese until melted and set aside. title: Coconut Clam Sauce
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1 cup clam juice, bottled
instructions: Strain coconut milk into blender and add remaining ingredients and blend until smooth.  Pour into 1 quart shallow glass baking dish.  Cover dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.  Serve over prepared white rice.

Random Ingredients: farmer cheese,kaffir lime leaf,deli roast beef,golden syrup,baby potato
title: Roast Beef and Potato Surprise
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 lb fresh baby potato | 1 large whole deli roast beef | 16 kaffir lime leaves, crushed | 1 package farmer cheese | 1/4 cup australian golden syrup
instructions: Heat the golden syrup in a 1 quart saucepan over medium heat until it just shimmers.  Cut the potato in half and cut into 1/4 inch chunks.  Place potatoes into the sugar syrup, heat to just barely simmering, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,morel mushroom,turmeric powder,goya chicken bouillon
title: Morel Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces chorizo sausage ( cut into chunks ) | 6 -7 ounces morels mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1/2 packet goya chicken bouillon ( or your favourite bouillon ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Place the mushrooms in the pot and mix the chicken bouillon with the turmeric and then add it.  Cover and cook for 5 days on medium heat.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,chicken breast,green pepper,swiss chard,oil,loaf french bread,arborio rice,roasting chicken
title: Mixed Chicken & Swiss Chard Stuffed French
ingredients: 1 chicken breast | 1 roasting chicken ( or your choice ) | 3 boxes arborio rice | 3 bunches swiss chard ( the smaller green leaves, the more leaves you take ) | 1/2 red peppers or 1/2 green pepper ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon oil ( optional ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional ) or 1/2 cup currants ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Cut slits or any small pieces of meat that fit over the breasts to create small pockets, about 1 foot long, or bigger if you prefer.  Take the chicken breast, skin side up, in a flat dish or in a resealable freezer bag, and carefully remove all the meat/herbs inside of the container or bag.  Pull out the meat, leaving just the meat mixture in the bottom.  Reserve the leftover meat/herbs for another use.  If using the meat around the chicken, trim any excess fat.  Cut the chicken into a 1 inch cubes, set aside.  Cut the stalks off the swiss chard leaves, and then finely chop the leaves into roughly 1 inch lengths, set aside.  Remove any thin shreds from the stalks and set aside.  Remove the stems from each swiss chard leaf and then chop roughly.  Place the chard in a pot of boiling water and remove the stems, then rinse the leaves in the water.  Drain of the water and then remove all of the water.  Preheat 1/4 cup of the oil in a non stick fry pan until hot, then place the chicken, skin side up, in the pan and cook over medium heat, turning once or twice, until golden brown.  Remove the chicken to a plate, then slice thinly across the grain.  Place the roasting chicken in the slow cooker on top of the chicken, and add the cooked rice.  Add the chard leaves and green pepper, if using.  If serving over rice, stir the chicken slices once to mix thoroughly.  Sprinkle over your ras el hanout and serve with raisins/currants/currants and a drizzle of the remaining 1/4 cup of oil.

Random Ingredients: loaf bread,chicken liver,chicken leg,self raising flour,basil leaf,palm sugar
title: Chicken and Liver Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 chicken liver, peeled and very finely chopped | 1/2 lb chicken leg, in thin slices | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 4 large fresh basil leaves, finely sliced | 3 loaves bread, slices thinly toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees.  Combine the chicken and liver with the remaining ingredients and stir well to combine.  Grease a large ovenproof sandwich/sauce tray with butter or oil, place the sandwiches on it and arrange them in alternate layers on the tray.  Bake for 20 minutes, then turn the bread over.  Place under a hot grill to crisp the top.  Cut into 4 or 5 slices while the bread is still slightly warm, and serve while warm.

title: Shra's Lentils With Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted, shelled and skin on | 1 cup green lentil | 1/2 teaspoon coarse red chili powder
instructions: Boil the lentils.  Drain and add the hazelnuts together with the chilli powder.  Place in a refrigerator for about 15 minutes.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red chile,chicken breast fillet,vanilla,chocolate,poppy seed,trout,breadcrumb,cremini mushroom
title: Smoky and Creamy Chicken
ingredients:
3/4 cup of canned crushed red chile ( with or without seeds ) | 1 teaspoon ground red chile | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla | 10 ounces chicken breast fillets | 1/4 cup unseasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup snipped fresh cremini mushroom ( about 4 oz.
    - ) | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons snipped choclate | 3 teaspoons snipped fresh sweet chilies or 3 teaspoons dried minced red chiles, to garnish
instructions: Drain cans in a sieve until no more liquid remains, about 2 minutes, taking care not to over soak.  Place chicken in a shallow dish.  Combine chilies and ground red chiles in a small bowl.  Sprinkle over the chicken and turn to coat.  Cover tightly and marinate in refrigerator 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, process bread crumbs and mushrooms in 4 batches in a food processor until finely chopped.  Set aside.  Drain chicken and pat dry with paper towels.  Remove chicken from marinade.

title: Polish Pickle With Fresh Dill
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dill pickles, in the jar | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon dill pickle, in the jar
instructions: Drain the pickles from their jar, and reserve them.  Place them in a saucepan with a little of the pickling liquid.  Bring the liquid to boil over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, then remove from heat.  Cover the jar and let stand for 5 minutes, then strain it through a fine sieve.  Place the strained pickles back in the jar, cover and seal.  Discard any unstrained pickles.  If possible, remove the jar lid for at least one day, to let the pickles mellow some of the flavors of the pickle.  If you prefer a smoother dressing, remove the lid for a short period of time before serving, to allow the pickles to settle.  Store the unused pickles in a small, heavy pot in which they can be packed to transport themselves.  Note, use a thin metal or glass jar for this recipe.  If the pickles begin to float to the top of the jar, simply heat a few drops of water in it to soften the water.  If to thickening the flavored water, re heat.  Use less water when cooking these pickles.  Dill pickles can be kept in a dark, cool place in a dry place for several months.  If they look too oily and a little stringy, blot them clean.  It is important that the pickles are tightly covered with a cloth.  They are not likely to be eaten.  Note, the flavor will develop over time, developing sour flavor, but will not be any worse at all after this stage.  You may need to use a spoon to clean and sterilize the jar after the next stage.  The finished vinegar can also be refrigerated for a long time to mellow some of the pickle flavor, even for a small amount.  The flavors develop more as the quality of the pickles mellows.

title: Skirt Steak Skewers for Two - Make Ahead!
ingredients: 1 teaspoon brandy | 8 slices mozzarella cheese | 16 slices skirt steaks | pita wedges or rye bread, accompaniment ( optional )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the brandy and 1/8 teaspoon salt.  Add the skirt steak and let it sit for at least 15 minutes.  Toss the steaks with the brandy mixture until to your preference.  Thread 2 - 6 slices cheese down the center of each skewer to form a link.  Put under broiler to melt cheese.  Arrange steaks on skewers with the cheese and continue grilling until desired doneness.  Serve immediately or cover and let stand for 5 minutes before serving.  If desired, serve with pita chips.

title: Coco Beer Peach Dip With Kahlua
ingredients: 3 -4 fresh peaches, peeled and halved ( not the canned variety, just warn peaches not to touch the peel ) | 4 ounces kahlua | 2 ounces chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 1 ounce guacamole | 2 ounces cool whip | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 6 -8 ounces beer
instructions: Boil 3 - 4 cups of water to boiling.  Add the peach halves for 6 - 8 minutes or until fork tender.  Drain water and transfer to blender and puree.  Add remaining ingredients and puree until smooth.  Serve with toothpicks if desired.

title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken legs | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/4 cup chopped shallot | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Remove any skin and excess fat from chicken legs, and cut legs into thirds.  Place in 13x9 inch baking dish.  Combine tomatoes and next 3 ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Aceitun Silver Bar Bar Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar | 1/2 - 3/4 cup cornflour | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 6 maraschino cherries ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | salt
instructions: In a large, heavy saucepan stir together brown sugar, corn flour, cayenne, and cherries, leaving some whole for garnish and to serve as fondue sauce.  Bring to a boil and then simmer for a few minutes.  Dice fondue into a medium sized dipping bowl or fondue pot, dip in cheese, add to fondue and sprinkle on more whole cherries.  Serve warm with lots of fresh bread, crackers, fresh veggies, etc.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,apple,tapioca starch,french green bean,poblano chile,bacon dripping,marshmallow,chinese cabbage
title: Bacon Wrapped Green Bean and Apple Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 slices bacon drippings | 1 cup sliced peeled apple | 1 cup sliced frozen french-cut green beans | 1 cup chopped fresh marshmallows | 1 can sliced poblano chiles, drained | 1 1/2 cups short-grain white rice | 2 cups shredded chinese cabbage | 1/4 cup tapioca starch, or as needed
instructions: Heat the bacon drippings in a large, deep skillet over medium high heat.  Add the apple slices and brown for about 4 minutes, stirring frequently.  Mix in the sauteed green beans and marshmallows.  Add rice and poblano chilies.

Random Ingredients: stout beer,orange flower water,chipotle chile,salad oil,stewing beef,garbanzo bean
title: Beef and Garbanzo Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dried garbanzo beans ( chickpeas ) | 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 cup guinness stout or 1 cup other stout beer | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle chile, crushed | 1 teaspoon orange flower water
instructions: Place the beans in a large bowl and cover with several inches of cool water.  Let soak, covered, overnight.  Drain the beans and reserve the soaking liquid.  Meanwhile, make the stew sauce with half the reserved soaking water in a pot over medium heat.  Add the beef, remaining soaking liquid, guinness or stout, and chipotle and orange.  Bring to a boil, then simmer, partially covered, for about 1½ hours, until the meat is tender and the sauce is thickened.  Serve the beef and garbanzo bean stew over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Capelli & Macaroni With Anise
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon aise seed | 1 1/2 cups macaroni cheese | 1 1/2 cups wine
instructions: Melt butter and sesame seeds.  Add remaining ingredients.  Stir fry for 2 minutes.  Serve with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: greek feta cheese,salt pork,chili flake,monterey jack cheese,mayonnaise,dark raisin
title: Cheesy Sweet Raisin and Chili Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb dark raisin | 1/2 lb monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 lb greek feta cheese, grated | 1/2 lb chili flakes | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | salt ( for seasoning )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit.  Place raisins in a large sauce pan and cover with water.  Bring to a boil and lower the heat.  Cook at a slow boil for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  You want to break up the raisins but the idea is not so easy.  After about one hour, turn off the heat, remove the raisins and cool completely.  Combine cheeses and chili flakes in a food processor, and process till smooth.  Add raisins and mayo and process till smooth.  If the mixture is too thick, add the can of mayo little by little.  You should only be able to gather the ingredients, because cheese tends to vary on how long it takes for the raisins to cook. .  Transfer to a bowl and serve.  Note, i usually let the dip chill and then proceed with the recipe as written.  I like to serve with bread and crackers, but that's up to your discretion depending on what else is in yours.

title: Lebanese Smoked Beef Ribs
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups tahini | 1/2 cup instant tea | 5 tablespoons smoked papaya or 5 tablespoons ginger-garlic 
    - 1 tablespoon lemon-pepper blend | 4 tablespoons grated carrot ( or grated wafer grate ) | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef ( or use sirloin ) | 2 medium carrots, peeled, cut into 4 equal pices | 1 red chile, stemmed, seeded and thinly sliced, if desired | 2 medium pinches lemon pepper blend, if desired
instructions: In a bowl, mix together tahini, tea, grated carrot or wafer grate, 5 tablespoons of the smoked papaya, 3 tablespoons of the ginger garlic, and 1 tablespoon of the lemon pepper blend.  Add beef and mix so that everything is fully mixed.  Heat a grill pan over high heat.  In batches, lightly form meat mixture into 12 patties, then place on grill pan.  Grill meat until well browned and no longer pink in the middle, about 3 minutes per side.  During grilling, baste meat with 1 teaspoon of the lemon pepper blend.  Turn once during the cooking process and remove from grill.  Serve with carrot fries, potatoes or on top of cooked beans, along with a side of plantains and a vegetable of your choice.  Also delicious with a fresh salad and fresh bread or a simple vegetable soup.  If you have no charcoal, turn on fire and add 1/2 cup of water to the pan.  When water comes to a boil, add red chile.  Turn off and reduce heat to low.  Let chile simmer in liquid for approximately 5 minutes while removing the pan of contents.  Strain liquid, removing seeds and discarding solids.  Serve with steamed vegetables and yogurt, if desired.

title: Fireside Baster (Lazy Baster)
ingredients: 7 -8 cups pearl barley | 1 package dry yeast | 2 lbs raw lean pork shoulder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f place pearl barley and meat into roaster.  Add 1/2 cup water, 1/2 tablespoon yeast and salt.  Allow to come to a bubble.  Once bubbles form, transfer into large bowl and cover with a tea towel.  Allow to sit for 30 - 45 minutes.  Turn off and leave to ferment for a few days.  Take out from fridge and add to your loafmaker as you would your favorite germany.  Use in place of your favorite dry recipe, including sugar, brown sugar, etc.  When ready to use.  Note, i prefer to use my large loafmaker as my german friends like to bake on a low rack.  I prefer to use a large loafmaker in a larger pan.  I use 3 1/2 lbs of raw pork shoulder.

title: Tahini Sesame Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 package slaw mix | 1 red bell pepper, small dice | 1 bunch green onion, sliced on the diagonal | 3/4 cup fresh dill, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh oregano, chopped | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon cardamom, ground
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, stir and chill up to a few hours serve.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,nonfat vanilla yogurt,chocolate pudding mix,ice water,lasagna noodle,saffron
title: Chocolate-Saffron Baked Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 10 lasagna noodles ( large ) | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 2 cups nonfat vanilla yogurt | 2 cups ice water | 1 tablespoon saffron
instructions: Brown hamburger with salt and pepper.  Remove from pan.  Drain excess fat.  Add 1 pkg.  Cookie mix, yogurt, icewater, saffron and noodles.  Mix.  Place meat on top and bake 375° for 45 minutes or until hot through and noodles are tender.

instructions: Cover potatoes with cold water, and set aside for 1 hour.  Heat the cream in a medium skillet over medium heat.  Add the taco seasoning packets and vanilla beans.

instructions: Combine catsup, garlic, sugar, cocoa, and milk in a small saucepan.  Bring to boil, remove from heat, and stir well.  Add rice and feta cheese.  Season with black pepper to taste.

title: Horseradish Plums (Tantalized Tomatoes): Domates
ingredients: 6 firm ripe plum tomatoes | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 1 cup pitted dates, halved
instructions: Cut off tops of plum tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,cherry brandy,parsley,anchovy,pasta,chicken bouillon,miracle whip,dill weed
title: Aphrodisiac's  Pasta Sauce with Chicken and Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 1 lb pasta ( i used whole wheat ) | 4 tablespoons miracle whip | 4 tablespoons dijon ( or similar ) | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons parsley | 1 tablespoon dill weed | 1 cup cherry brandy | 2 cups anchovies
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water with chicken boullion, chopped parsley, dill weed and a little olive oil until pasta is al dente.  This depends on the size of the pasta and maybe what you have left over in the pan.  After pasta is al dente, drain and return to pot.  Add miracle whip and mix well.  Add dressing and continue to mix well.  Add brandy and anchovies and heat through.  If dressing is hard to obtain, add 1 little milk to dilute.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,jumbo shrimp,garlic salt,vegetable stock,white wine vinegar,green bell pepper,island dressing,farfalle pasta
title: Jambalaya Wabo
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 pound jumbo shrimp, shelled and deveined | 2 ounces island dressing | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 10 pita bread rounds, warmed and cut in half | 1 small green bell pepper, diced
instructions: In a large pot over high heat, combine 1 cup stock, shrimp, island dressing, white wine vinegar and garlic salt. instructions: Mix all ingredients together to make one small batch at a time.  Enough for a bag of beef or chicken in a shaker.  Keep refrigerated overnight to cure or to ensure a good coating.  You can use the marinade as a basting sauce for basting fish or grilled meats.

title: Chinese 5 Fry Bread
ingredients:
1 loaf ( i used whole wheat or 8 ounce ) | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder ( or 1/2 tsp.
    - salt mixed into equal amount of spices )
instructions: Cut off bread from top.  Make sure you cut it around every other top layer.  Spread 1 - 2 tsp.  Of the spices over the top of the bread.  It's best to make it so that the bread is 'glue' in the bread if using whole wheat bread.  Wrap and tie in a piece of foil.  Leave to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes before frying.  Preheat olive oil to 325 degrees fahrenheit.  Test slices with a slice of bread using toothpick or knife.  They should crack open, but not too much.  This will be when the bread is golden brown.  Drain on paper towels or a piece of foil.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar to eat with the hot oil.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,romaine leaf,olive,cream cheese,caster sugar,cheddar cheese
title: Baked Italian Salad
ingredients: 2 cups romaine leaves ( washed of sand and spun dry ) | 4 ounces cream cheese, softened | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 3/4 cup tomato sauce | 3 tomatoes, cut into wedges | 1/2 cup sliced olive ( mixed colours )
instructions: Heat oven to 175c/170c fan forced.  Line a baking tray with baking paper.  Combine the softened cream cheese and sugar until light and creamy, about 5 mins or until light and fluffy.  Stir in the tomato and 3/4 cup of tomato sauce.  Pour into the centre of the tray and bake for 10 mins, stirring regularly, until golden and bubbling.  Stir in the rest of the tomato.  Arrange the salad on 4 plates and sprinkle with the olives and remaining tomato sauce.  Serve warm or cool and serve cold.

title: Nuts and Straws With Fish Stuffing
ingredients: 1 small whole wheat bread, torn into small pieces | 1/4 cup sliced straw mushroom | 1 cup fresh cranberries ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons snipped fresh sweetened dried fish or 2 teaspoons dried fish flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Line baking dish with foil and spray with cooking spray.  Put the bread pieces in a bowl.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Mix together to make the stuffing.

Random Ingredients: lamb rib chop,milk chocolate,cornmeal,ranch dressing mix,wasabi paste,sherry,marjoram
title: Mama's Hot Beef Hash

instructions: Pour a little oil in a fry fry pan and lightly saute the chops on both sides for around 6min.  Sprinkle with cornmeal.  Place the cooked pork chops onto a cake tin or cookie sheet and sprinkle with seasoning.  Sprinkle on any remaining seasoning.  Bake at 350f for about 20mins or until browned and cooked to your liking.  In a small bowl, combine all remaining ingredients.  Drizzle over the tops of the fried bacon& serve with salad.

title: Herbed Steak Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice wine or 1/2 cup dry white wine | 7 -10 pieces herbs, including rosemary, sage, and thyme
instructions: Combine the wine, herbs, and 1 teaspoon of the herb mixture or marinade in a bowl.  Pierce the steak numerous times with fork, place onto a rack in a baking pan, and allow to marinate at least 1 hour, brushing with the marinade frequently.  Broil about 1 minutes on each side, until cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: date,watermelon,worcestershire sauce,mexican chocolate,red pepper flake,jalapeno,green chilies
title: Merryly's Stone Crab
ingredients: 5 ounces mexican chocolate, chopped ( like prego ) | 3 green chilies, chopped | 3 large dates, pitted and chopped | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 jalapeno, minced | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup watermelon, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon water
instructions: Microwave chocolate, chilies, dates, pepper flakes, jalapeno, worcestershire, watermelon, and 1 teaspoon water in 1/2 cup glass measure around 20 seconds.  Scramble mixture in microwave and stir.  If mixture is too thick, add up to 1/4 cup water.  Spread mixture in 9 inch pie plate.  Microwave 30 seconds, or until slightly darkened in color.

title: White Bean, Salmon and White Beans
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped white beans | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/8 teaspoon coarse seasoning salt | 1 -2 tablespoon grated fresh rind of an apple
instructions: Dry the beans lightly.  Sprinkle with seasoning salt.  Toss with apple.

title: Pam's Favorite Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 20 -25 large fresh green enchilada sauce ( or any flavor you prefer ) | 1/2 cup virgin olive oil ( or as needed )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Line setup, baking pans or whatever you have.  Mix 1/2 of the enchilada sauce with the virgin olive oil you can put aside.  Mix the remaining sauce with the green enchilada sauce and mix well.  You can sprinkle on the remaining green enchilada sauce just before removing the baking pans.  You can even pour the enchilada sauce mixture into bowls or tortillas if you wish to, i do.  Place the baking pans in a large pan or a large roasting pan that has been lined with aluminum foil, or they may line the two pans and have a removable bottom.  Pour the remaining 1/2 the sauce to the bottom of the pan to make sure the enchiladas have enough sauce for dipping.  Put the baking pans or pan in the oven for about 30 minutes or until the shells are golden and bubbling.

title: Cheese and Bacon Appetizer
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 cups shredded muenster cheese, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Brush both sides of a baking sheet with cooking spray.  Spread 2/3 of the muenster cheese over your cut edge of the prepared baking sheet.  Evenly sprinkle half of the bacon over the cheese.  Repeat layering with remaining muenster and bacon.  Bake in the preheated oven until bacon is warmed and bubbly, 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Spiced Jack Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  In a medium bowl, combine cheese and coriander.  Roll each pastry sheet into 6 inch diameter circles.  Place on baking sheet.  Top each circle with about 1 tablespoon cheese mixture.  Bake in the preheated oven 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden.

title: Green Beans-Meatball Pot
ingredients: 1 package hamburger | 8 ounces cream cheese, softened | 2 tablespoons huziki ( japanese soy sauce ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1 can green beans, drained
instructions: In an extra large frying pan brown hamburger until crumbly.  Add cream cheese and huziki.  Mix together and add oregano.  Combine the two cans of green beans and hamburger mixture, and make into balls or patties.  Serve with hot japanese rice.

title: Sensational Fettuccine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried dill | 21 ounces fettuccine pasta | 3 cups pecan halves, toasted
instructions: Cook fettucini as directed on package.  Drain.  Return to pot.  Add pecans.  Stir.  Cook 10 - 15 minutes, or till pasta is done.  Serve.

title: Mango Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 medium mango | 2 ounces vanilla beans
instructions: Place mango, vanilla beans and vanilla extract in the bowl of an electric blender.  Process for about 10 seconds or until well mixed.  Press mixture through an ice cream maker.  Turn into an airtight container.  Refrigerate until cold.  Remove from the freezer 30 minutes before serving.

title: Curry Flavored Walnut Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup thinly sliced celery | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 1 small white onion, thinly sliced | freshly chopped red curry paste ( to taste ) | apple jelly, any flavor ( optional )
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients well in a skillet and heat over medium low heat.  Cook, mixing frequently, until curry starts to turn red and nutty smell is gone.  Remove from the heat and spoon into serving bowls.  Cover with warm apple jelly and sweetener for an extra kick.

title: Vodka Sauce

instructions: Saute in oil over medium heat until skin starts to blister and it turns light tan.  Stir in bell pepper and remove from heat to a dish lined with plastic wrap and chill for about 2 hours.

title: Chipotle Tofu Dip or Salad

instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Mix well.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Pork in Coconut Beer
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 1 lb pork tenderloin or 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup shredded cabbage, divided in half | 1 cup crushed coconut oil
instructions: In a deep non reactive skillet, heat together the coconut oil and asafoetida over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,self rising flour,granny smith apple
title: Welsh Apple Cake
ingredients: 500 g self-rising flour | 250 g icing sugar | 1 granny smith apple
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°c.  Use a food processor to grate the granny smith apple.  You can grate it in the food processor or with your hands.  Mix the flour and icing sugar and work into a firm dough.  Turn out onto a lightly floured surface.  Knead dough until smooth.  Roll dough out to 5cm thickness.  Wrap in greaseproof paper and use a knife to cut into 5cm squares or rectangles.  Press squares into the sides of a greased 24 cm/8 inch cake tin or springform tin.  Prick the top of the cake all over with a fork.  Place tin on the centre shelf of your oven to preheat.  When the oven is heated, reduce heat slightly, but leave the cake warm for 15 minutes.  Prick each layer of cake in several places and return to oven for 10 - 15 minutes more, until cooked.  Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly.  If biscuit dough is still lumpy, remove from tin and knead it together with the remaining ingredients.  Place on a plate and cut into squares to serve.

title: Cherro in Paprika Style (Kielbasa and Kielbasa)
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa | 2 tablespoons sour cream | cilantro leaf, freshly chopped
instructions: In a medium frying pan, brown the kielbasa, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks, as it browns, until it starts to caramelize.  When browned, drain the oil from the kielbasa.  Toss the kielbasa with the sour cream in a non reactive bowl and scatter with cilantro leaves.  Serve.

title: Chinese Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 16 sheets phyllo dough | 8 dried chinese mushrooms | 1 1/2 ounces prosciutto, chopped | 12 large kumquats, halved lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/8-inch slices | 1 jar chinese noodles | chinese grape leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Soak mushrooms in water for 25 minutes.  Drain and chop coarsely.  Heat a large saute pan over medium high heat.  Saute proscuitto in the pan until browned.  Remove prosciutto, and drain on a paper towel lined plate.  Drain all but 1/4 cup of fat from pan and saute mushrooms.  Spread half of mushrooms over phyllo dough.  Sprinkle 1/4 lb of mushrooms over mushrooms.  Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of proscuitto on top.  Lay one kumquat slice onto mushrooms, and roll up length wise into a log.  Repeat with remaining phyllo and kumquat slices, ending with remaining kumquats.  Arrange the rolls in a lightly buttered 9x13 baking dish, seam side down.  Cover tightly with foil.  Bake 30 minutes, uncover and bake until rolls are golden brown.  Serve in small buns.

title: Poppy J's Italian Baked Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 jar orange marmalade, divided | 1 package regular-size ladyfingers, thawed ( about 36 ladyfingers ) | 2 tablespoons orange zest, finely grated | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 cup finely chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f combine 1/4 of the marmalade with the remaining marmalade.

title: Pineapple Muffins [ Native American]
ingredients: 2 cups pineapple juice | 1 package dry yeast | 1 large avocado | 3 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: In a mixing bowl, dissolve sugar in pineapple juice.  Dissolve 2/3 cup of the yeast into it.  Add to the remaining mixture, add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Let stand 1 hour or until frothy.  Pour into clean, well oiled bowl and let rise in a warm draft free place until doubled in bulk.  This will take about 2 hours.  Bake at 400 deg f for about 15 minutes.  If the muffins are too brown at the bottom sprinkle tops with icing sugar.

title: Swiss Chard Stew
ingredients:
2 lbs swiss chard, stems removed | 1 lb stewing beef | 1 lb lean tomato puree | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 teaspoons mixed mixed italian herbs | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional but adds a kick - or 2tbs.
    - to taste )

title: Teriyaki Chicken Linguine
