instructions: Cook linguine according to directions.  Rinse with cool water and drain.  In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except the linguine.  Toss well with hot cooked linguine and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,egg,strawberry jam,lasagna noodle,italian salad dressing,grain white rice
title: Rice Chicken Bake
ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 1 1/4 cups chicken meat, cooked and cubed | 1 1/4 cups uncooked long-grain white rice | 1/4 cup strawberry jam | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 2 eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a 9x13 inch baking dish layer 1/4 of noodles, tomato paste, chicken, rice, jam, and salad dressing.  Repeat layering, ending with sauce.  Cover and bake for 50 minutes.

title: Tandoori (Indian Spice Mix)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds ( coriander seeds ) | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Grind coriander seeds together with the chilli oil.  Store in an airtight bowl.

title: Ham Hock and Cheese
ingredients: 4 -5 fresh jalapeno peppers ( or to your desired level of heat ) | 1 -2 lean ham hock | 1 can diced tomatoes ( i prefer fresh, but you may use 1 large can ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped toasted pecans, walnuts, chopped candied cherries, chopped pecans, almonds ( optional ) | shredded monterey jack cheese ( optional )
instructions: Trim stems off of peppers and discard.  Cut pepper lengthwise and remove seeds as above.  Rinse well and scrape the loose black interior, stem and all visible white membrane.  Place the ham hock into a medium size cooking pot, put the lid on and poke a few holes in it a few times with a sharp knife or a fork.  Pour enough water into the pot to cover the hock.  Add 1 can of diced tomatoes.  Do not drain the liquid, and turn the heat to medium high.  Do not cover the ham hock, use the tip of sharp knife on the top of the hock to loosen any bubbles that may be forming over the top.  Turn the heat to low and cook the ham slowly, stirring, for approximately 1½ hours.  You may insert an instant read thermometer for a little bit of gravy, if desired, but check that it is cooked enough, and there is enough liquid in the pot to prevent the ham from drying out.  If necessary, cut a slit through the top of the ham hock for additional cooking, if desired.  During this time, remove the meat from the pot and set aside to cool.  When cool enough to handle, remove the skin and discard.  Using your hands, remove a thick slice from the stem and any leftover fat and place it on the side of a small serving plate.  Add the diced tomato, pepper, nutmeg and/or salt to the ham hock and mix well.  Top with shredded cheese, if using.  Serve at room temperature along with cooked noodles or rice, if desired.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,chicken breast half,beef base
title: Easy Pico de Gallo Chicken
ingredients: 5 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup beef base | 1/3 cup pico de gallo, or to taste
instructions: Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Cut slits in chicken so that it can stand its own.

title: Chilled Chicken Nacho Gravy
ingredients: 2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground horseradish | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili paste, such as mccormick hot mustard flavor | kosher salt
instructions: Combine the chicken broth and the onion flakes in a small saucepan.  Over medium heat, bring to a bubble.  Add the horseradish and chili paste and whisk continuously until hot, about 2 minutes.  Add the chili gravy and simmer, whisking constantly, for about 15 minutes.  Season with salt.

Random Ingredients: coffee powder,spam,cilantro leaf,margarine,dark soy sauce,soya sauce,sherry,turmeric powder
title: Spam Satay
ingredients: 250 g spam | 150 g dried saffron threads or 150 g other black dried saffron | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons grated fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 tablespoon light soya sauce | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons margarine
instructions: Soak the spam for 2 or 3 hours, then remove the excess water.  Rinse and drain.  Soak the saffron threads in hot water for 30 seconds.  Drain once more.  Add turmeric and saffron to the spam along with the 3 teaspoons of the cilantro leaves and dry sherry.  Stir to mix well.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Stir in soya sauce and soy sauce and set aside for 10 minutes.  Melt the margarine in a small saucepan over medium heat.  Saute the spam for 2 or 3 minutes, stirring constantly, or until it starts to brown.  Pour onto the spam, and spread.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,mustard seed,mozzarella cheese,vegetable stock,chicken leg,flour tortilla
title: Guatemalan Chicken Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 chicken legs, skin removed and discarded | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 ounce grated mozzarella cheese | 1 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 teaspoon chopped semisweet chocolate
instructions: Place chicken legs between sheets of plastic wrap and pound with a meat mallet until the chicken pieces are 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick and the pieces are slightly flattened.  Place the chicken legs in a medium saucepan, pour in the stock, and cover.  Bring the mixture to a boil, skimming off any foam that rises to the top.  Turn the heat down to medium and simmer chicken until very tender, about 20 minutes.  Remove chicken from the pan, cool slightly and shred into a bowl.  Stir in mustard seeds, mozzarella cheese, and salt to taste.  Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Brush both sides of the tortillas with oil and sprinkle with the chopped semisweet chocolate.  Wrap tortillas in aluminum foil and place in the oven for 8 to 10 minutes, until hot and lightly toasted.  Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Spicy Blender Albacore Tuna Batter
ingredients: 2 cans albacore tuna in water, drained, and cut into chunks | 1 1/2 cups white flour | 1 cup bourbon ( i use bacardi 151 )
instructions: Place flour, bourbon, and tuna chunks into a food processor.  Blend until well blended and pour into a bowl with a few drops of water to prevent the tuna chunks from clumping together.  Repeat 2 or 3 times until it reaches a thickness of 1/4.  You don't want it too thick or it may curdle at the texture.  If it does, cover for 5 minutes and stir again before you continue.

title: Baked Rice With Cream
ingredients: 1 cup rice ( i prefer to skip this step entirely ) or 1 cup arborio rice ( i prefer to use this step entirely ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Rinse the rice or arborio in a strainer until rice is all dried to your liking.  In a medium sized bowl add cream and rice and stir to mix well.  In a casserole dish add cream mixture and cover with aluminum foil tightly.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until all the cream is absorbed and rice is tender.  Let sit for 5 minutes and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,beef sirloin,sazon seasoning,heavy cream,garbanzo bean
title: Easy Beef Sirloin Steak
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin | 1 medium yellow squash | 1 packet sazon seasoning | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained
instructions: Cut beef into serving size pieces.  Place in crockpot, along with squash slices.  Sprinkle sazon seasoning over steak.  Pour heavy cream over meat and veggies.  Cook on high for 6 hours.  Remove meat to serving platter, reserving juices, and set aside with squash.  Slice the meat and return to juices.  Spoon sauce over meat and vegetables, and serve.

title: Easy Fondue
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1 can hot broth ( use broth as needed )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and serve in a fondue pot or crockpot.

title: Pork Chowder
ingredients: 800 g lean pork, cubed | 1/4 cup catalina salad dressing | 1 bunch fresh tarragon | 1 liter vegetable stock
instructions: Heat a deep frying pan.  Fry pork until golden brown and crispy.  Mix together the Catalina and butter until creamy with the pork and pour into pan.  Add the sprigs of tarragon and allow to cook through.  Add vegetable stock and heat through until thickened.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,blade steak,black coffee,jasmine rice,linguine,pastry,red chili powder,cayenne pepper
title: Aussie Rissoles With Coffee and Rice
ingredients: 2 -3 blade steaks | 1 1/2 glasses black coffee | 1/4 cup jasmine rice | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | cayenne pepper | 300 g rigatoni pasta | 1 pastry for double-crust 9-inch deep dish pie or 1/2 cup other risotto rice | 1 -4 tablespoon pastry for double-crust 9-inch deep dish pie mix ( see rissoles )
instructions: Boil the water with the black coffee in a large saucepan until it has reduced to 3/4 cup.  Place the steaks in this in a separate pan and pour the coffee over them.  The steaks are ready when the internal temp is 150 degrees f or the meat is just about cooked through.  Meanwhile cook the steaks, if using, in a shallow baking tray at room temperature for 12 to 15 minutes for medium rare to medium doneness, or as long as they have been boiled and steaming at very very least for about 20 to 25 minutes.  When they are cooked through, drain them off as much as possible and pat dry with a paper towel.  When the steaks are cooked through, remove them from the oven and leave them for about 5 to 10 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, remove the steaks from the pan.  Turn the heat down to low.  Stir the cooked rice and chilli powder in a jug or bowl until the rice has mixed well with the coffee.  While the steaks are cooking, cook the rigatoni in plenty of salted boiling water and drain before adding it to the steaks.  Drain the rigatoni in a colander for about 2 to 3 minutes, or until it is just starting to crisp up.  While the rigatoni is cooking, pre heat the oven to gas mark 7/360°f with a baking sheet or rack in the middle.  While the rigatoni is cooking, roll and cut the rissoles into about 2 to 3 inch size cubes, or if preferred, 3/4 to 1 inch lengths.  Brush them with a little oil as soon as they are warm, but remember, they will likely get reheated in about 10 to15 minutes as they cook.  When the rissoles are ready, arrange them on a large, buttered baking tray, pour their coffee and rice onto the steaks, smoothing the rice.  Cover tightly and bake in the oven for 10 to 12 minutes until they are steaming hot and the rice is golden and crispy.  When you have arrived at the table, remove the tray and the rissoles, placing each one on a small serving plate.  Serve the steaks on their own or with the rice alongside.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,salt black pepper,date,dark brown sugar,okra
title: Spiced Okra and Okra Appetizer(Gluten Free)

instructions: Boil okra until tender, then drain and run under cool water to cool, then remove the stems.  Chop into 3/4 inch pieces.  Combine okra, dates, chipoltes and brown sugar, and mash with an electic mixer until the ingredients are well incorporated, using a spatula if the mixture separates from the bottom of the bowl.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Creamy Italian Recipes for a Crowd (Crock Pot)

title: Gogonzola Gnocchi  (From a Humble Humblegourmet)

instructions: Cut the cheese in half horizontally, from top to bottom, so that you have 12 small squares.  Sprinkle a little flour over them and let them fall into a large pot of salted water.  Heat water to boiling, then remove from heat.  Let cool 1 - 2 minutes, then fluff up the cheese with a fork.  Drain the gorgonzola well and place in a bowl.  Add the flour.

title: Beef or Pork Stuffed With Pasta, Nepalese Style

instructions: Prepare grill for direct or indirect cooking over medium/hot heat.  Combine lemon juice, vinegar, ground mustard seeds, chutney and 1/4 cup water in a small bowl.  Combine remaining 1/4 cup water and the mustard seed, chutney mixture and 1/4 cup water in a small saucepan.  Bring to boiling.  Reduce heat.

title: Farfalle Salad With Mango and Grape

instructions: Cook farfalle according to package directions.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Place remaining ingredients in salad bowl and toss.  Add farfalle and toss.

title: Copenhagen Fresh Tomatoes With Beans

instructions: Pulse tomatoes in a food processor until coarsely chopped.  Transfer tomatoes to a colander.  Rinse beans with cold water until water runs clear.  Combine ouzo with crushed crackers.  Dip the beans in ouzo, then add to tomatoes in colander.  Sprinkle with mace.  Chill for at least 30 minutes.  If possible, chill in refrigerator for up to 1 day before serving.

title: Hot and Hearty Beef Liver Pate
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice flour or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/4 cup ice water | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1/4 dried hot red chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon dried gingerroot | 1/2 lb kielbasa, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 can button mushrooms | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 canned medium green chili peppers or 1 small red chili pepper, chopped | 4 1/2 ounces fresh button mushrooms, halved
instructions: In large mixing bowl, combine rice flour, water, dried onion flakes, dried chili flakes, and gingerroot.  Using a knife, cut kielbasas into about 12 small pieces and add to mixture.  Cut fresh mushrooms and add to mixture.  Add chopped green chiles to mixture.  Using a spoon or an ice cream scoop, make into patties about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.  Fry in oil on both sides until golden brown and cooked to desired doneness.  Drain on paper towel lined baking sheet and keep warm in a 200 degree oven.  Repeat with remaining oil.  Serve warm.

title: Italian Sesame Baked Stuffed Grape Leaves
ingredients: 1 lb seedless grapes | 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup italian dressing | 5 -6 cups dry red wine | sesame seeds
instructions: The day before baking, place grapes in pot with oil.  Sprinkle 2 1/3 1/2 tablespoons yeast on grapes.  Add water.  Set on stove and bring to a boil.  Cover and allow to steam about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside in a warm place to drain.  The next morning, remove the grapes from pot and set the stones aside.  When grapes have drained, place in a bowl & add enough dry italian dressing to moisten.  Drain the grape leaves, reserving 1 1/2 cups of the liquid.  Set the reserved liquid aside as the dressing will need it.  Cover the jar of grapes with a damp cloth to keep them warm.  Place the jar in a warm place to drain the liquid.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place 1 teaspoon of sesame seed into a small bowl and sprinkle the seeds onto a baking sheet.  Bake the sesame seeds until light golden brown, about 10 minutes in a hot oven.  Do not let the seeds become too dark/golden.  Place the grape leaves back on the baking sheet and remove sesame seeds.  Remove grape leaves from the oven and place in a large bowl.  Allow to cool.  Place 1 teaspoon yeast in each grape leaf along with enough wine to moisten them.  Place grape leaves in jars and pour 2 cups of the reserved soaking liquid into each jar.  Top with additional yeast.  Seal and place in a cool place to dry for 2 - 4 weeks.  Afterwards transfer the grape leaves to a cookie sheet and refrigerate.  To serve, remove and drain grape leaves and spoon the juice into a bowl or bowl and place in small containers to serve.

title: Pickled Herbs

instructions: Stir the flour and potato starch in a mixing bowl.  Stir in the orange zest, orange juice, and the cream.  Turn onto a floured surface and knead lightly for 3 minutes. title: Mexican Vermicelli (Sushi) - Wonton

instructions: In a non metallic bowl, stir together rice wine vinegar, and 1 - 2 quarts of iceburg lettuce to blend together.  Add remaining ingredients and stir gently.  Serve immediately.

title: Beans & Daikon Radish Skewers (Yum Yum)
ingredients: 1 cup chopped daikon radish | 1 1/2 cups packaged bean pieces | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 2 tablespoons seeded chopped red chili peppers | 1/2 cup tomato juice | skewer ( optional ) | 1 small head cauliflower, cut into 1-inch florets
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine daikon, beans, rosemary and chilepepper.  Stir in tomato juice and pour over salad.  Cover, and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour.  When ready to serve, remove from marinade and thread vegetables onto skewers.  Serve with sauce poured over.

title: Slow Cooker Beef Brisket and Gravy
ingredients: 9 -10 lbs beef brisket | 11 ounces condensed cream of mushroom soup | 12 ounces buttermilk | 1 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 1 cup cold water | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary sprigs | 8 ounces lasagna noodles, broken into 6 wedges | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh gingerroot
instructions: Trim brisket of unnecessary visible fat or connective tissue.  Place brisket in crock pot, making sure meat is completely submerged in mushroom soup.  Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours or high for 4 minutes per pound of brisket.  Remove meat from crock pot, reserving cooking liquid and brisket.  Skim fat from surface of gravy and discard.

Spread about half of the meat over the tortillas.  Arrange the other half of the tortillas.  Place in the oven and roast for 15 minutes or until thermometer reads 140 degrees f.

title: Yummy &   Hearty Pizza With Mango Salad

instructions: Put the pizza crust on kitchen counter, to form a well in the center and grab all your ingredients.  Then, peel the cucumber, peel and deseed it, and finely dice it. title: Penne Carbonara

instructions: Boil water, add penne pasta & allow to cook according to the packet directions or until soft.  Drain pasta well & return to the pan. Enjoy.

title: Pasta & Chickpeas (Mediterranean style )
ingredients: 455 g pasta | 1 long shortcrust pastry | 200 g chopped sun-dried tomatoes | 1 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 125 g of chopped plum tomatoes, with juice
instructions: Heat a large frying pan with a little oil.  Roll the shortcrust pastry onto a lightly floured board.  Cut a strip of tin foil slightly larger than the edges of your pastry paper. title: Chinese Pea Pods and Rice Balls
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups pinto beans or 3 1/2 cups kidney beans, cooked and drained | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 package frozen chinese pea pods ( precooking instructions on box ) | 6 tablespoons orange juice | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 1/4 ounces cajun seasoning | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon white flour
instructions: Place the pinto beans in a large bowl and add cold water to cover by 2.  Stir well and let soak for at least 30 minutes, overnight is best. Pour the orange juice mixture into the pan and stir well to combine, breaking up the peas while they stick.  Add the peas and coat with the vinegar mixture, toss well.  The peas will absorb the remaining sauce slightly, so if necessary add a little water or cornstarch.

title: Mexican Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 anaheim chilies or 1 jalapeno chile
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut ends from chilie pepper and remove seeds.  Slice each chilie into about 4 pieces crosswise and divide them into halves.  Place chilie pepper halves in boiling water and boil until blistered.  Remove chilie and drain through cheese cloth.  Immediately drain chilie.  Cut the chilie in half and remove as many seeds as you like.  Coarsely chop.  Cut chilie into about 2 pieces.  Place the green beans in a medium sized serving dish and cover with chile mixture. title: Swiss Pea and Corn Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1 tablespoon marjoram, leaves | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 100 g caster sugar | 200 -250 g frozen shelled corn ( thawed, about 2 cups, drained in a colander ) | 200 g frozen microwavable microwavable sticks ( thawed, about 30cm, or 100 grams ) | chocolate chips, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Cut stew meat into 1 inch cubes. When hot, add beef and cook, stirring occasionally, until beef is brown on all sides and juices evaporate.  Add corn and microwave sticks and microwave one half cup water, covered, on high for one minute.  Stir again and then microwave one half cup water again for one minute longer until corn is tender and liquid is absorbed.  Stir in chocolate chips, if using or serve separately.

title: Baked Mozzarella Cheese
ingredients: 1 package aboli pizza crust | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spray a 9 inch square pan with cooking spray.  Arrange pizza crust pieces on their sides, and spread with cider vinegar.  Bake in preheated oven until crust is a deep brown, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Easy Microwave French Fries
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, cubed | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Microwave potatoes on high for 7 minutes, then reduce heat to 5, cover and cook for 10 more minutes.  Remove lid, and continue until potatoes are tender, stirring every 10 minutes during cooking.  Drain potatoes in a colander and transfer to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: green bean,creamy peanut butter,margarita mix,tilapia fillet
title: Crunchy Lemon-Lime Tilapia
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets, about 1 1/2 inches thick | 4 cups creamy peanut butter, smooth | 1 package frozen green beans, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Place a wire rack on a baking sheet and spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Place each fillet on the rack, skin side down.  Combine peanut butter and green beans in a food processor or blender, blend until smooth.  Spread the peanut butter mixture onto each fillet.  Bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Garlic Sesame Oil
ingredients: 5 teaspoons unbleached sesame seeds, about 6-7 leaves | 4 teaspoons scallions, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons finely grated bulbs of garlic
instructions: Preheat a griddle over high heat for 10 seconds.  Put the sesame seeds in a small bowl with 3/4 teaspoon of their soaking water, and toss to coat.  Sprinkle the scallions over the top and set aside to set, but not dry, 10 minutes.  Heat the griddle on medium heat.  When hot, oil is ready.  Toss the garlic in the sesame oil and place them in a small, single layer.  Cook just until lightly golden, about 1 minute.  Watch and rotate the garlic after 30 seconds, and don't burn it.  Watch out, garlic burns easily.  Remove from the griddle, and place on a plate lined with paper towel.  Sprinkle the oil over the top, and toss to coat.  Let the oil finish smoking.  Store in an airtight container out of direct light, not cool.

title: Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 lb bok choy, washed and cut in 3-inch lengths | 1 teaspoon dill weed | 1 cup dill weed, fresh chopped or 1/2 cup mixed fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Stir in the bok choy and return to a boil.  Cover and simmer over medium heat until tender, about 8 minutes.  Drain and discard the outer leaves.  Drain the water.  Squeeze the water out of the bok choy and remove the root and tough, woody tops with a sharp knife.  Rinse the pieces under cold running water and drain.  Slice the tips into bite size pieces, remove any tough stalk ends.  Set aside.  Meanwhile, combine the dill and 3 tbsp of the dill weed in a small bowl, and set aside.  When the bok choy is done, drain it, discarding any unpeeled pieces, and set aside.  Using a fork or a slotted spoon, remove the leaves from the stalks and discard and discard the stems.  Slice off the root ends and discard the tough outer leaves.  Discard the hard, woody stems.  Rinse well, drain and set aside.  When the bok choy is done, put it on a platter, remove the leaves and slice the leaves into slivers and toss them with the bok choy, leaves, dill and reserved dill.  Serve right away.

title: Tivoli & Chocolate Mincemeat
ingredients: 500 g mutton | 100 g icing sugar | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 package milk chocolate chips | spices
instructions: Grind the meat with a knife or a meat pounder, or in blender.  Place in pan and add the icing sugar and fry with constant whisks until the colour is light brown. title: Oatmeal-Rhubarb
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick cooking oats, powder | 1 large head of garlic | 4 ounces grated chocolate | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats, powder | 2 cups chopped fresh rhubarb or 2 cups frozen rhubarb | 1 1/2 cups frozen broccoli | 1 english muffin, split, toasted
instructions: To prepare the rice, place the garlic on a cutting board, and place it in the freezer for 10 minutes.  Turn over onto a cutting board, and cut in half crosswise. In the bowl with the oatmeal, toss together the 1/2 cup oat powder, 2/3 cup of water, and the rhubarb.  Set aside.  When the rice is time to cook, preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Add 1 1/2 cups water and the broccoli to the oatmeal, stir, and set aside.  Remove 1 split section from each english muffin, and place on baking sheet, top with 1 cup or more of the rice mixture.  Place a teaspoonful or two of the chocolate crumb mixture along the length of the english muffin.  Broil, watching carefully, until chocolate is melted, then stir over the rice mixture.  Serve warm.

title: Hungarian Lamb Bites With Sherry & Beans
ingredients: 1 bunch sultana | 1 tablespoon hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon garlic granules | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1/4 cup low-fat yogurt | 1 lb leg of lamb, cut into bitesize chunks | 1 can dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( white kidney beans may also be used )
instructions: Soak overnight's sultanas in water.  Rinse & drain the soaked sultanas in a strainer to remove the excess moisture.  In a bowl combine the paprika, garlic & pan drippings. Remove the skillet from the heat, stir in yoghurt, then transfer the mixture to a slow cooker.  Add the lamb & stir to coat the meat evenly.  Add the drained kidney beans & stir to combine.  Cover the cooker & cook on high setting for 3 1/2 hours.  Remove cover of cooker, stir well, then cook on high for 30 - 45 minutes until the lamb is very tender & cooked through.  If you need to thicken the sauce slightly, stir in 1tbsp of water.  Remove the pan from the heat, stir & serve either hot or cold with crusty bread.

title: Award Winning Venison Jerky

Remove from oven and let it sit off the heat for about 20 minutes if you can then place the tray it was baked in under it's own juices, until the juices are reduced a little and syrupy. instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degree fahrenheit.  Wash and halve the anaheim or poblano chiles lengthwise and remove the seeds. instructions: Place your raspberries in a small bowl, and toss to coat.  Place the raspberries on a plate, and sprinkle each one with some of the grated cheese.  Garnish with a drizzle of some remaining butter, if desired.  You can serve this immediately.  Variation.

title: Homemade Almond Paste (Amish Recipe, Apruhay)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons almond paste ( see amish homemade powdered almonds ) | 1/2 teaspoon savory
instructions: Mix well.  Use as required.  Store in an airtight container.  Note, if you are using a glass almond paste, add 1/2 cup powdered sugar to the dough before adding the almond paste and continue to mix until it is all incorporated.  Scoop out as desired.

title: Italian Style Orange Ham Shank
ingredients: 4 ham shanks | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon orange zest, grated | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 170 degrees celcius f, or gas mark line a baking tray with baking paper and place the ham shanks in it.  Mix together the garlic powder, orange zest & vanilla essence and brush over the ham shanks.  Bake in oven for about 30 - 45 minutes depending on your normal oven temperature or your oven, turning or tossing every 10 - 15 minutes.  When cooked, remove from oven and let cool to room temperature.  Take the cooled ham shank out of the oven and cut into slices.  To serve, arrange slices on warmed plates, sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar etc.

title: French Bread W-Soup Dressing
ingredients: 20 slices french bread | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh french harvey's fresh yellow mustard, if using canned, omit if using canned | 20 ounces fresh snow peas, trimmed and cut on the diagonal into 3 inch lengths or 20 ounces frozen snow pea pods, if using frozen, defrosted if frozen
instructions: Arrange the french bread slices on a foil lined baking sheet.  Cut a slit down the center of each slice so the bread will absorb the dressing.  Arrange the peas in rows across the bread, with the tops pointing in opposite directions.  Sprinkle with the mustard.  Drizzle about 3/4 cup of water over the top and the remaining dressing over the top.  Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours but no longer than 4 hours.  Place under the broiler just until the french bread starts to brown.

title: Linguini With Pork and Spicy Oil
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 lb lean pork, shaved
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water cook linguini until al dente, about 4 - 5 minutes.  Drain linguini.  Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  When hot, add pork and cook 3 minutes or until browned.  Drain linguini.  Toss with pork and heated oil.  Serve immediately.

title: Baked Apples With Red Wine and Apple (Mark Bittman)
ingredients: 2 large apples, such as granny smith plump, such as granny smith, peeled, halved | 1/3 cup dry red wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place apples and wine in a shallow baking pan.  Cover with plastic wrap.  Bake, covered, in preheated oven until apples are soft, about 1 hour.  Transfer to a clean platter.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Cook and stir lamb and onion in the hot skillet until lamb is evenly browned, 2 to 3 minutes.  Transfer to a medium bowl.  Spoon raspberries into the skillet.

Carefully scoop out the head and reserve.  Cut off and discard the dark green bitter pith of the garlic.  Do not discard.  Place the reserved garlic into a bowl and add the sherry vinegar, irish cream and oatmeal.

title: Cousin Baratha(Moroccan Rice & Barley Pilaf)
ingredients: 3/4 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup garlic clove, sliced | 1 inch gingerroot, peeled & grated | 6 cups arborio rice | 1/4 cup pearl barley | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic paste, more if needed | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ginger-garlic paste, for additional flavor | 1 -2 teaspoon dried shrimp ( optional ) or 1 -2 teaspoon dried shrimp ( optional )
instructions: Start by soaking your dried shrimp or dried shrimp in hot water for about 20 minutes, or until they have no white or yellow taste.  Soak the garbonzo and pearl barley in water for at least 30 minutes to an hour, but longer is preferred over night.  I like to let it soak for even longer.  Drain the rice and barley in a colander for about an hour, or until the water is cloudy and the grains are soft and sticky.  Place in a dutch oven or an 8x8 square or other oven proof dish.  Set aside.  In the food processor or a mortar and pestle mince the garlic and about 1 inch of ginger.  Heat the garlic and ginger over medium heat in a small, non stick skillet, stirring frequently.  As soon as garlic starts to sizzle, add the rice and barley.  Stir over medium heat just to mix the grains.  Immediatizing that garlic should also start to make contact with the rice, add the ginger garlic paste.  Continue cooking, stirring frequently, until the rice is almost fully cooked.  Add additional oil if needed to keep the grains from sticking to bottom of the pan, and stir in the garlic paste.  Add the dried shrimp if using.  Stir until shrimp are pink.  Pour the mixture into the dutch oven, then sprinkle the remaining ginger garlic paste over the top.  Cover the pot, and cook over medium low heat for 20 minutes, or until the rice is just tender and liquid is absorbed.  The dish should be bubbling and hot.

title: Chilli Cheese Taquitos

instructions: To make the flour, combine the flour, corn, & chili flakes in a bowl.  Then, using damp hands, mix in the grated cheese.  Using a rolling pin roll the mixture into balls, then flatten them with your hands in circular motions to make round circles about ¾in diameter.  Lightly brush the tortillas with oil and grill over a moderate heat for 4 - 5 minutes or until golden brown.

instructions: Spray bottom of a large frypan well with cooking spray.  Cut a piece of chicken in half.  Cut each half into quarters after removing the skin, wing or breast. instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the potatoes in a large pot and cover with water.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Fruit Pizza
ingredients: 500 g fresh yeast | 250 ml freshly squeezed orange juice ( from about 5 oranges ) | 140 ml thick mango chutney ( or your choice of other mild chutney ) | 250 ml ghee ( or oil ) | paprika
instructions: First, make your yeast.  If you haven’t prepared your yeast, try my recipe here on Zaar in a large glass mixing bowl.  Add 200ml orange juice.  Wait five minutes and whisk until frothy.  Add your 100ml chutney.  Mix.  Allow to sit in a warm spot for about 5 - 10 minutes to ferment properly.  Add ghee just to incorporate.  Mix.  Allow to rest till slightly frothy.  If you’re going to bake as this, it’s a good idea to mix a little bit of the oil/oil/ghee at the start and start whisking it to incorporate before measuring which will have you s going to add more at a later time. .  If you’re going for the greek style, go somewhere other route.  The longer it incubates, the more pronounced the flavor.  This could take up to three days.  Once you have achieved this stage, you can transfer the yeast to an airtight container and refrigerate for about an hour.  Pour the liquid in a large pot and sprinkle over a third of the paprika.  Add 1/2 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil and stir.  If you are going to bake as below, stir it with a fork and pour it into the bowl in which your yeast has been mixed.

title: Roasted Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 8 teaspoons baking powder | 3 -6 lbs bone-in leg of lamb, with some fat on it
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit.  Roll lamb out to about 1/8 thickness.  Place on a large roasting tray or baking sheet and sprinkle with 4 teaspoons baking powder.  Bake in upper 1/3 of oven until internal temperature reaches 170 degrees fahrenheit in the thickest part of the leg.  Turn leg over and bake for 15 minutes.  Remove from oven and allow to rest for 5 minutes.  Slice crosshatch through the thickest part of the thigh and the fat.  Serve with pan juices, if desired.

title: Cashew Nut-Date-Chicken Patties
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely chopped cashew nuts | 2 teaspoons chopped green onions | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt, divided | 2 large chicken breast halves | 1 1/4 cups finely chopped fresh dates | 1 cup fresh pineapple, chopped | 8 leaves fresh cilantro leaves, chopped ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons chopped green onions | 10 ounces cooked chicen ground chuck ( optional ) | 8 teaspoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves, for garnish
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium high.  In a large bowl, combine the cashews and 1 teaspoon of the green onion.  Season with 1/4 teaspoon of salt.  Dip the chicken in the cashew mixture, then transfer the chicken to your work surface.  Place the chopped dates and pineapple in a food processor.  Pulse until finely chopped, stopping to scrape down the sides.  Add the remaining 1/4 teaspoon green onion and 2 tablespoons chopped green onion to the chopped dates and pineapple.  Add the cashew mixture, 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro, and 1 tablespoon chicken cooking liquid to the food processor.  Pulse until mixture is finely chopped, stopping to scrape down the sides.  Form into 4 equal sized patties, then lightly brush the remaining 1 tablespoon green onion over the patty.  Grill for 10 to 15 minutes, turning over once, until cooked through and browned, and meat is no longer pink.  Remove from grill and place patties on a serving plate.  Cut remaining green onion into 1/4 inch wide slices.  Top with the remaining chopped ingredients and serve garnished with additional chopped cilantro leaves.

title: Dairy and Salt-Free Lentils - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry lentils | 1/4 cup mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon lavender | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Rinse lentils and soak for 12 - 24 hours.  Drain lentils and cut into 5 - 6 serving sizes.  Mix lentils, mustard seeds, lavender and lemon pepper together in 3 - 4 quart slow cooker.  Cook on low heat setting approximately 8 hours or on high heat for about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Italian Turkey and Rice Dinner
ingredients: 1 package long grain rice | 1 cup wine ( riesling ) | 1 package ricotta cheese | 1 medium head red cabbage | 14 ounces turkey breast | 14 ounces turkey fat
instructions: Rinse rice in a sieve under running water for 2 minutes.  Stir in wine and refrigerate one hour.  Meanwhile, cut turkey into bite size pieces and place into a large bowl.  Add cabbage, ricotta cheese and red cabbage to mixture and toss to coat.  Spoon into serving platter.  This meal can be made in the crock pot or a 4 pound turkey and turkey sausage type.  I have never had success because it was never refrigerated.

title: Molho Dois
ingredients: 10 -12 chicken wings | 2 tablespoons fat | 2 1/2 teaspoons lard
instructions: Cut wings in two lengthwise.  Cut tips into thirds.  Trim wings and fry in oil until golden brown on top.  Take out and reserve.  Add sugar and brown.  Place wings into a bowl and coat with sugar then return them to sugar, turning over until all pieces are coated.

title: Tamarind Pasta
ingredients: 6 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow shaped pasta ) | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Prepare the pasta.  While the pasta is cooking, pour boiling water over the tamarind paste in a 1 quart saucepan.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer until the tamarind is very soft, about 5 minutes.  Drain and set aside to cool.  Place the breadcrumbs into a shallow bowl.  Dip each noodle in the breadcrumbs to coat then coat with the crumbs.  Set aside to cool and harden before serving.

instructions: Toss the cut up potatoes with the chilies, beans and lime leaves and add 1/3 cup rice vinegar.  Let stand about 20 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350f & grease 2 baking sheets.  Mix the remaining ingredients, except the kugel, in a medium bowl and set aside.  Bake the kugel about 50 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.  While warm, cut into wedges & serve on plates with your favorite toppings.

title: Busy Day Goose-Stuffed Roast

instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f.  Line a large dutch oven roasting pan with kitchen towels.  Arrange the ladyfingers side by side in the pan, overlapping slightly. Cover roasting pan with foil and bake at 500 degrees f for about 1 hour, then remove one roasting pan from the oven.

instructions: Combine all ingredients in dish.  Heat, covered, on stovetop over low heat until it is reduced to 1 tablespoon of syrupy glaze pour over cooked pasta, tossing well to coat.  Allow to cool to room temperature, then cover and chill overnight.

instructions: Peel and slice potatoes in half lengthwise.  Layer in large skillet, potatoes, mushrooms, anchovy paste, salt, and chili oil over top in whatever order your family likes, and place in preheated 450°f oven, and bake until potatoes are tender and a little crispy, about 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Kielbasa and Rotini
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta | 4 -6 ounces kielbasa | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce, i use bull's eye | 1 1/2 tablespoons light muscovado sugar | 6 -8 basil leaves | 1/2 cup plain low-fat yogurt
instructions: Place a large pot of water on to boil.  After 5 minutes, add the pasta, cooking until al dente, about 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, cut kielbasa into 1 1/4 inch squares.  To prepare the kielbasa, place the kielbasa into a colander or strainer and press with the side of a large spoon until the sausage breaks into small chunks.  Set aside.  Add the barbecue sauce and sugar to the pan with the pasta and water, stirring until sugar is melted and pasta is heated through.  Add the sausage and basil to the pasta and mix.  Remove the pan from the heat and gently fold in the yogurt.  Serve.

title: Mushrooms Stuffed With a Thousand Herbs

instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees.  In a large bowl, place mushrooms, eggs, breadcrumbs, almonds, serrano chilies, bouillion cube, and basil leaves.  Stuff into the caps of each mushroom.  Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour until mushrooms are lightly browned.  Serve hot.

title: Quickie Clam Croissants With White Beans, Chilli & Basil

instructions: Heat large frying pan or skillet on medium low heat.  Tear croissants into strips or pieces, and spread on flat surface leaving about 8cm of space around edge of pan.  Place a dollop of rice on top of croissants and push rice firmly down.  Add a few drops of water to cover.  Place a couple of clams or 1 to 2 tablespoons of the liquid from the white beans in pan.  Cover with lid and reduce heat to low.  Cook for 5 minutes.  Serve with chillies and basil leaves.  Cooking time does not reflect 5 minutes.  To make chunky white bean soup, drain beans and rinse well and simmer in 2 cups of water.  Discard any excess liquid.  Place on large serving platter and top with white beans and a mound of the creamy bean soup.  Enjoy.

title: Caramelized Guacamole - Michael Chiarello
ingredients: 2 ripe avocados | 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped | 1 cup dry red wine
instructions: Peel avocados and mash them with the peeled garlic.  In a small bowl, combine the avocado flesh with the red wine and blend well.  The guacamole will have a creamy, slightly chunky texture.

title: Vanilla Zinfandel
ingredients: 1 cup vanilla yogurt | 1 cup zinfandel ( dry, not sweet )
instructions: Add vanilla yoghurt and black zinfandel to a non metallic bowl.  Stir until well combined.  Serve right away, or cover with plastic wrap and chill until ready to serve.

title: Smoor Salmon Sandwich #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 can salmon | 4 teaspoons hot chili bean paste | 1 teaspoon greek oregano | 1 tablespoon provolone cheese or 1 tablespoon monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon chili bean paste with greek oregano over medium heat, stirring occasionally until fragrant and bubbly.  Set aside.  In a 12 inch skillet over medium heat, cook salmon until golden brown, about 4 - 5 minutes each side.  Set aside and reserve 1 tablespoon chili bean paste for garnish, and place the remaining 1 tablespoon in a small bowl.  Sprinkle potato mixture evenly over top of salmon, and gently press into the potatoes with your thumb and index finger.  Slice salmon into approximately 4 thin slices.  Spoon the reserved chili bean paste mixture evenly over potatoes.  Sprinkle the provolone cheese on top and continue layering until you have used up all the potatoes.  Place skillet over medium low heat for 1 more minute to melt cheese.

title: Swedish Flatbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup rye flour | 1 yellow bell pepper
instructions: Make a hole in each of 4 pie plates.  Place 2 peppers in each pie plate.  In a small bowl combine the whole wheat flour and rye flour.  Dip the outside of the bell pepper in the mixture, allowing it to drip off and into the holes in the dough.  Lightly spray a griddle with pam.  Lightly spray the hot griddle and cook the bell pepper until the skin crisps up and blackens.  This may take 10 - 15 minutes depending on the size.  Let cool completely before slicing.

title: Sweet Potato and Peach Stir Fry for Two
ingredients: 1 cup cabbage, sliced paper thin | 1 medium sweet potato, peeled, cut in half and sliced thin | 4 -5 large peach slices | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup green beans, sliced thin | 3 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Set your wok on the stove top and add 1 t salt in it.  Add the cabbage, sweet potato and peach slices.  Turn the heat down to medium.  Cook this for about 8 - 10 minutes or until the sweet potato slices are soft and the sweet potato slices are cooked.  Turn the heat off just before you're ready to serve the stir fry.  Pour the mirin over the vegetables in the wok.  Stir it and serve immediately.

title: Stove Top Smothered Meat Loaves
ingredients: 12 slices bacon, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 1/2 lbs stew meat | 3 tablespoons flax seeds | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 small yellow peach, diced | 8 slices prosciutto
instructions: Place bacon in a large, deep frypan and cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer bacon to paper towels to drain.  To the drippings in the pan, add meat and brown on all sides, about 10 minutes.  Remove meat and set aside.  Return drippings to the pan and add flaxseed powder, garlic powder, peaches and reserved bacon.  Heat mixture over medium heat 3 minutes, stirring constantly.  Slide meat into heated mixture, working in batches if necessary, and set aside.  Poke holes in the loaves with a fork or skewer and bake in the broiler for about 8 minutes, or to desired doneness, basting once or twice with the juices during baking.  Let loaves cool for about five minutes, then warm throughly between paper towels.  Remove and discard toothpicks.

title: Beef Tips (Sausages With Char Siu Sauce)
ingredients: 4 beef stew meat | 4 links cooked sausage links, casings removed and meat cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Sprinkle beef with salt and black pepper.  Place in a large, resealable bag, and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours, turning as needed.  Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil grate.  Grill sausages on the prepared grill until the meat is no longer pink in the center, about 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,flat leaf parsley,red wine,hoisin sauce,ginger garlic paste,brandy
title: Soy Sauce for Shrimp (Maui Fonte)
ingredients: 300 g raw shrimp ( in the shell ) | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 3 tablespoons unsalted dry red wine | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons brandy, cognac or 2 tablespoons port wine | 4 tablespoons flat leaf parsley
instructions: Put the shrimp in a pot of cold water and boil them for 3 to 5 minutes and then set aside to cool.  Place the hoisin sauce, wine, syrup, brandy or cognac, and half the parsley in a blender and blend till smooth, pour the sauce into a pan and bring it to the boil.  Add the shrimp to the sauce and add the rest of the chopped parsley.  Serve at once, garnished with the rest of the parsley.

title: French Oven Poached Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, defrosted and patted dry
instructions: Position your oven rack in the center of the oven.  Spray a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray and arrange chicken thighs skin side up on the same baking dish.  Sprinkle garlic salt evenly over chicken and bake, uncovered, about 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.

title: Crunchy Cauliflower Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup small cauliflower florets | 1 cup whole wheat pita bread, warmed | 1 cup granola cereal ( such as sun-dried )
instructions: Place cauliflower in strainer, and cover with boiling water.  Let stand 10 minutes, or until crisp.  Drain, and cut into florets.  Place bread in 1, and coat with granola cereal.  Set aside a few crumbs to sprinkle over top if desired.

title: Italian Flank Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 12 -14 ounces rump steak | 2 cups fresh italian parsley | 2 cups celery, sliced
instructions: Cut steak into diagonal slices and arrange in a lightly buttered baking dish.  Combine parsley and celery and sprinkle evenly over steak.

Random Ingredients: colby cheese,mint leaf,cocoa,basil leaf,cream celery soup
title: Irish Mint Colcannon
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup shredded colby cheese | 1/4 cup shredded fresh basil leaves | 1/4 cup dried mint leaves | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Mix together the soup, cheese, basil, mint, and cocoa in a bowl until well mixed.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,beef gravy,horseradish,chicken breast half,lemon extract,mustard,tomato juice
title: Italian Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning, or more to taste | 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cup beef gravy | 1 cup tomato juice | 1 teaspoon lemon extract, or more to taste
instructions: Mix horseradish, mustard, and italian seasoning together in a bowl until thoroughly blended.  Rub mixture all over the chicken breasts.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow creme,gnocchi,lemon filling,water chestnut,sesame oil,swiss cheese
title: Gnocchi Bake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 package uncooked gnocchi | 3/4 cup shredded, processed swiss cheese | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 2 cups light marshmallow creme, divided | 1 can lemon filling
instructions: In a 5 to 6 quart slow cooker heat oil.  Add gnocchi, cheese, water chestnuts and marshmallow creme.  Cover and cook on low heat setting 7 minutes.  Remove lid and stir mixture until cheese is melted.  Stir in the lemon filling.  Cover and cook on low heat setting 30 minutes.  Serve warm or cool.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,red enchilada sauce,broccoli stem,honey,superfine sugar,spanish chorizo
title: Chorizo and Broccoli Enchilada
ingredients: 1 lb bulk spanish chorizo or 1 lb crumbled mexican sausage | 1/3 lb frozen broccoli stems, thawed, ends trimmed and cut on diagonal into 1/2 inch slices | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon honey or 1 tablespoon agave nectar | 48 fluid ounces mild red enchilada sauce | shredded parmesan cheese or romano cheese
instructions: If grilling or broiling the vegetables, preheat broiler.  For chorizo in a 10 inch skillet, cook chorizo over medium heat, stirring often, until sausage is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.  Remove chorizo from pan and slice into 3 inch pieces.  Add broccoli stems, sugar and honey to chorizo in pan and stir.  Return chorizo to pan.  Heat to boiling, then reduce heat.  Cover and continue cooking until broccoli is crisp tender, about 3 minutes.  Stir well.  Spoon enchilada sauce into bowl and divide among 4 serving plates.  Top with chorizo slices.

title: Sweet Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cups bean ( cooked or canned ) | 1/2 cup rice vinegar
instructions: Place the first 3 ingredients in a blender and cover with a lid.  Cover with lid and blend at least 6 times, using 1/4 cup water to stop the mixture from sticking, until smooth.  If the dip is to thick, use a whisk to stir it into the rest of the ingredients until smooth.  If it gets too stiff, add more water until it's the consistency you want.

title: Indian Fritters(Bollywood)
ingredients: 1 pastry for double-crust deep-fried fritos corn chips | 2 tablespoons fritos corn chips | 4 -6 tablespoons fritos corn chips ( for dipping the fritters ) | 1 -2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom powder or 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Spread the fritters out on a lightly oiled tray, and roll out to desired thickness.  Heat a flat griddle pan over medium high, until almost smoking.  Carefully transfer the fritters to the hot pan, and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of fritos and 1 tablespoon of ground fritos.  Sprinkle the remaining fritters with 1 tablespoon of ground fritos and 1 tablespoon of ground fritos.  Dip both sides of each fritter into the fritters, letting any extra oil drip back into the pan.

Random Ingredients: pork,creole seasoning,celery seed,white vinegar,celery salt,serrano pepper,almond
title: Creole Roast Pork with Candied Celery (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1/3 cup creole seasoning | 4 lbs pork, cubed | 1/2 cup celery salt | 2 tablespoons celery salt | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 serrano pepper | 2 slob almonds, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a bowl mix first 3 ingredients sprinkle pork with celery salt and vinegar toss to coat.  Place in crock pot.  Brown for 6 - 7 hours on high.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,pecorino romano cheese,quinoa,pork tenderloin,scotch whisky,chicken broth,catalina dressing
title: Scotch Crusted Pork Tenderloin(ATK)
ingredients: 1 package quinoa | 1 teaspoon peanut oil or 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 3 1/2 - 4 lbs pork tenderloin, cut diagnal into 1-1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup scotch whisky | 1/4 cup catalina dressing ( i used kraft catalina dressing ) | 1 1/2 cups canned chicken broth | freshly grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 1/3 cup )
instructions: Place quinoa in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,potato,corn kernel,cardamom seed,pasta,taco sauce,monterey jack cheddar cheese,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Potatoes Macaroni & Cheese
ingredients: 5 medium potatoes, scrubbed and cut into 3/4 inch slices | 1 1/2 cups corn kernels | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack-cheddar cheese | cooked medium pasta
instructions: In a colander toss the potato slices with 1 teaspoon salt and let sit to drain excess water.  Meanwhile, combine the mustard powder, parmigiano reggiano cheese, taco sauce and cardamom seeds in a medium bowl.  Mix well.  Spread potato slices with the mustard mixture.  Arrange potato slices over the mustard and cheese mixture, overlapping slightly.  Spoon the corn over the potatoes.  Sprinkle with monterey jack and cheddar cheese.  If needed, microwave the potato slices on high for 1 1/2 minutes or until the cheese is melted.  Serve and refrigerate leftovers.  Garnish with parsley and serve with warmed pasta.

title: Roasted Hazelnuts
ingredients: 10 cups blanched hazelnuts, rinsed | 3 1/2 cups broth | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread hazelnuts onto an aluminum foil lined baking sheet.  Roast until fragrant, about 10 minutes.  Run hazelnuts under a warm water tap to remove skins, rub skins onto dry skins to release all the steam.  Place hazelnuts, broth and tarragon vinegar in a large roasting pan.  Cover and roast in the preheated oven, setting the oven rack about 2 inches from the heat source, until hazelnuts are tender, 25 to 35 minutes.  Cool.  Break into small pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: soy cheese,almond,yellow bell pepper,cremini mushroom,baking potato,sesame seed
title: Sesame Mushroom Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled | 1 tablespoon soy cheese, divided ( see instructions ) | 1/3 cup slivered almonds, divided ( about 9 large ones in the jar ) | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds ( not sesame powder ) | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 -3 small cremini mushrooms, halved ( not mushrooms )
instructions: Grate the potato into a large bowl.  Add 1/4 cup of the soy cheese, half of the ground almonds and 1/2 of the sesame seeds.  Stir until well blended.  Add bell pepper and onions.  Stir well.  Cover and refrigerate for one hour or overnight.  Cook, covered until the potatoes start to become tender.  If desired, microwave the whole pot for 1 minute.  Drain potatoes, remove seeds from pot.  Place potatoes, remaining soy cheese, remaining ground almonds, salt, and remaining sesame seeds in separate bowls.  Drain mushrooms, reserving the liquid, and place in a food processor or blender.  Process until finely chopped.  To serve, place the potato potato mixture on a serving platter.  If the sesame seeds are not well stirred, use a fork or potato masher to stir a couple of times just to toast some of them.  Top with sauteed mushrooms and drizzle with remaining soy from step #10.  If you like, you can also serve the mushrooms over another serving.

title: Irish Breaded Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Combine bread crumbs, marjoram, and bouillon in a saucepan, and stir in whiskey until dissolved.  Dip mozzarella cheese in the mixture, and arrange in a rectangle on a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until the topping is lightly browned, about 25 minutes.

title: Rhubarb and Apple Loaf (Paleo)
ingredients:
2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon table salt ( kosher.
    - ) | 1 lb fresh rhubarb, stemmed, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Combine the yeast, salt, and 1 cup cold water in the bowl of a standing electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment and let it stand until foamy, about 10 minutes.  Add the rhubarb and stir until it begins to form a smooth, wet ball about 5 minutes.  Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead it briefly until the dough starts to form a round ball, about 8 minutes.  Shape the dough into a ball and place it in an oiled bowl, turning the top with a razor blade or rubber spatula to coat it with oil.  Cover the bowl with a warm place and let the dough rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 1 hour.  Lightly oil a baking sheet and preheat the oven to 500°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Turn the dough out onto the prepared baking sheet and brush with oil.  Cut the dough in half crosswise, then cut each half into 24 equal pieces.  Shape each piece into a ball and place on the prepared baking sheet.  Cover and let rise until tripled in volume, about 45 minutes.  Transfer to a wire rack to cool to luke warm, about 15 minutes.  Carefully transfer the bread to a cutting board and score each cross in a cross, about 1/2 1/2 inch thick.  Repeat with the remaining dough.  Transfer to baking sheets lined with parchment paper and serve warm.

title: Anchovy Cocktail (Salsa Verde)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh anchovy fillet | 2 cups salsa verde | 4 ice cubes
instructions: In two to three pint wine glasses, place the anchovies.  Cover with salsa verde.  Chill for at least one hour.  Serve.  Enjoy.

title: Rajma (Cranberry Noodle Kebabs)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 package egg noodles | 1 cup fresh peas or 1 cup frozen fennel or 1 cup frozen cranberries | 1 1/2 cups corn kernels | 1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | pitted dried breadcrumbs ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Place tamarind paste in a small saucepan and let it boil for a few seconds.  Add noodles and peas, cook over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove pan from stove, add blue cheese and toast bread crumbs on a baking sheet or shallow plate.  Lightly grind bread crumbs using a mortar and pestle.  Dip kababs into crumbs and fry in 2 tbs oil for 10 minutes on each side or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: beef base,salt black pepper,beef sirloin steak,chilies,vanilla bean,chestnut,balsamic vinegar,cheese tortellini
title: P F Chang's Tortellini With Chicken and Sweet Beef
ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, very thinly sliced ( or 1 1/2 lbs of your choice ) | 1/2 cup beef base | 1/8 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 vanilla bean, split and scraped | 1 small chilies, julienned ( or more, to taste ) | 1/2 lb cheese tortellini | salt & freshly ground black pepper | beef sirloin steaks or sliced pickled chestnuts
instructions: Start slicing the beef into thin strips, then trimming any excess fat.  Cut the meat lengthwise into 1/4 inch wide strips.  In a bowl, combine the beef, beef base, balsamic vinegar, vanilla bean and chilies.  Marinate the meat at room temperature for about 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, bring about 7 quarts of water to a boil over high heat.  Salt the water lightly and add the tortellini.  Cook for about 5 minutes and drain.  Meanwhile, heat a little oil over high heat in a nonstick skillet or wok.  Add the chicken and stir fry quickly to a nice caramel color, about 2 min.  Season with salt and pepper.  Add the marinated meat and cook 2 to 3 min.  Or until it's done.  Pour in the tomato sauce.  Stir for about 2 minutes or until heated through.  Serve immediately.

title: Cheese Tortellini
ingredients: 1 package cheese tortellini | 1 package pears, drained and sliced
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions.  Drain and cool.  Place sliced pears into the cooked tortellini.  Heat in a medium saucepan over medium heat until cooked through, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Pho Vo Vo Violette
ingredients: 2 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise | 2 ounces prunes ( prune halves can be used ) | 1 hard-boiled egg, peeled | 1 tablespoon finely chopped mint | 1 tablespoon mild red chili paste or 1 tablespoon coriander | 1 tablespoon mustard, to taste | 5 tablespoons walnut halves ( optional )
instructions: Remove the seeds and rind from the olives if using, slice them and put on top of bread.  Place the prunes on top of the olives if using, if using finely sliced olives.  Grate the egg into a small bowl, beat in the chopped mint, chilli paste or coriander.  Spread the mustard on each piece of bread, top with chopped egg and chopped olives.  Serve immediately.

title: Rosemary Corn
ingredients: 2 cups corn oil | 8 sprigs rosemary, leaves removed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f.  Pour the corn oil into a 9x13 inch baking dish or deep fying pan.  Lay the rosemary leaves on a piece of damp kitchen towel.  Sprinkle the rosemary leaves on top.  Bake in the preheated oven until crisp, about 30 minutes.  Cool over the handle of a wooden spoon to remove the rosemary.  Transfer the corn to a serving platter, and drizzle with more oil.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,parsnip,rye bread,sushi rice,celery seed,bread flour
title: Sweet Stuffed Parsnips
ingredients: 1/4 cup diced candied pineapple chunk ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1/4 cup finely diced raw parsnip | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped celery seeds | 5 2 tablespoons bread flour or 5 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 1/4 cups cooked sushi rice ( cooked al dente ) | 1/4 cup seasoned rice flour or 1/4 cup bread flour
instructions: Prepare the fruit by mixing the pineapple, parsnip, celery seed, and 2 tablespoons of seasoned rice in a small bowl, add salt to taste and set aside for 20 minutes.  In a large bowl, mix 4 tablespoons seasoned rice and 2 tablespoons of seasoned rice flour until well combined.  Fold in the fruit mixture.  Prepare the rice mixture by mixing the 1 1/4 cups seasoned rice flour or bread flour, 1/4 cup seasoned rice flour, and 2 tablespoons seasoned rice in another small bowl, add 2 tablespoons seasoned rice and 2 tablespoons seasoned rice, and mix well.  Using a pastry cutter or sharp knife, cut the mixture into 12 wedges.  Place each wedge on a parchment lined baking sheet.  Place the baking sheet in a 375f degree oven until each wedge of parsnip is golden, about 15 minutes.  Remove the pans from the oven and place on a wire rack to cool completely.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: topping,turmeric powder,chili pepper,pepper,vegetable oil peanut,meat,chicken base,baguette
title: Baked Indian Sandwiches
ingredients: topping | topped meat | 1 can chicken base | 1 small chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper | topped | toasted baguette
instructions: Heat chicken base together in microwave or microwave on high 15 second intervals.  Put toasted baguette pieces in a bowl of warm water until ready to serve.  Add a bit of water and let sit another 5 seconds to soak.  Slice baguette into thin 3 inch slabs.  Cut to fit sandwiches, dip into warm sauce, and layer on top of meat.  Add slices of turmeric and chili pepper.  Top with hot sauce and toasted baguettes.

title: Champinones Al Morron (Chile Mushrooms)
ingredients: 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, sliced and stems blanched | 2 dried red chilies, seeded ( pablano, enchilada or other chile ) | 1/2 cup dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon coarsely ground dried cherries ( or dried dill flakes )
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, add mushrooms and chile peppers.  Sprinkle with a little oregano.  Let sweat for about 3 minutes.  Add a generous pinch of red pepper flakes.  Add 1/4 cup water.  Cover and simmer until done, about 3 minutes.  Stir occasionally.  Let cool for a minute, then transfer to serving dishes, sprinkle with remaining minced fresh oregano, crushed roasted red pepper and cherries, serve as a dip or as an accompaniment to meat.

title: Canadian Bacon With Pork
ingredients: 1 canadian bacon | 1 pork shoulder ( with or without skin ) | barbecue sauce | celery rib | 1 can cranberries
instructions: Cook all ingredients except duck and canadian bacon pieces.  Cool.  Place bacon, pork, and carolina bacon in a food processor and blend until well mixed.  Add the duck and canadian bacon pieces and blend again.  Taste and adjust seasonings as you would like them.  Bake 300 - 450 degrees for 30 minutes.  Slice and serve with your favourite condiments and sauce.

Random Ingredients: mango,vermicelli,pizza crust,garam masala powder,beef mince,tabasco sauce,pineapple,english muffin
title: Beef Rissoles (Meat Mince)
ingredients: 600 g beef mince | 1 cup prepared pizza crust | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 1/3 cup pineapple, chopped | 4 slices mango | 3 slices english muffins | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup mangoes, diced small
instructions: Mix beef, pizza crust, garam masala and pineapple in bowl until combined.  Divide mixture between beef mixture and top with mango slices, followed by english muffins.  Heat under grill for about 5 - 7 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: celery,cayenne,green olive brine,avocado,pineapple chunk,cream,baby portabella mushroom,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Moroccan Mushrooms With Avocado With Fruit Applesauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs mixed baby portabella mushrooms | 1/2 cup green olives with brine | 1 tablespoon dried ras el hanout spice mix ( see notes in description ) | 1 avocado, diced | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup prepared unsalted pineapple chunk ( from a can or tidbits ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery or 1 1/2 teaspoons chives, finely chopped ( or more )
instructions: Wash mushrooms.  Rinse under cold water, pat dry and trim stems.  Chop caps and saute in a saucepan of low heat about 5 minutes.  Sprinkle with ras el hanout and saute another minute.  Remove from heat and add olives, stirring to combine.  Place avocado and sour cream in a bowl and add ra el hanout & cayenne to taste.  Stir and divide avocado mixture among mushrooms.  Add celery or chives and pour over the salad and enjoy.

title: Herring in the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dry hake rig dinner fish, cleaned | 2 zucchini, diced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 2 herring fillets, in water
instructions: Rinse and dry fish.  Cut into 6 pieces, 1 inch to 1 inch wide at one end.  Cut a slit in the top of each fish for stuffing.  Mix zucchini, thyme and herring with 1 tbl.  Water.  Place fish in the bottom of a 10 inch crockpot.  Cover.  Cook on low 3 - 4 hours.  When fish is very tender, stir in remaining 1 tbls.  Water.  The herring can be served at room temperature or chilled.

title: Frozen Chipotle Chiles - for Canning
ingredients: 4 ounces chipotle chiles ( canning jars ) | fresh ground black pepper, to taste, is not necessary ( optional )
instructions: Soak chiles over night or in boiling water.  Soak chiles in hot water until softened, 24 hours, making sure they are re hydrated.  Peel off the black skins.  In the freezer, let the chiles cool and remove stems.  Place the chiles in a plastic bag.  For each chili, take a 1/4 inch to 1/8 inch slice from the chiles.  Use a vegetable peeler to remove the seeds and membrane.  Use a vegetable peeler to remove the hard membrane from each chile.  Press the seeds or membrane into a large saucepan.  When cool enough to handle, transfer to a large plastic bag.  Add pepper to taste.  Seal and refrigerate overnight.  If using, remove seeds.

title: Chipotle Fried Chicken
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs chicken ( breast, drumsticks, wings, and wings ) | 4 -5 tablespoons bacon drippings ( can use olive oil ) | 2 -3 chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons margarine | 8 slices sandwich bread ( preferably white ) | 1 -2 radish ( optional )
instructions: If using chicken parts, remove skin.  Rinse well, trim excess fat, and remove wing tips.  Rinse chicken well.  Preheat heavy skillet or grill pan.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Caviar
ingredients: 3 small eggplants, unpeeled | 1 teaspoon margarine | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 cup thinly sliced onion | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons rose water | 3/4 - 1 cup prepared fruit ( optional )
instructions: Slice eggplant thinly.  Lay out on a cookie sheet and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of margarine.  Let stand about 15 minutes, then turn over and repeat process.  In a large skillet, heat oil and add the eggplant slices, onion and salt.  Over medium heat, brown the vegetables in the hot oil turning frequently about 2 to 3 minutes.  Sprinkle eggplant with the remaining tablespoon of margarine, and sprinkle with sugar.  Serve on plated toast or crackers.  Garnish with rosewater if desired.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,baby spinach,parsley flake,dark soy sauce
title: Spinach with Raw Dressing
ingredients: 4 lbs baby spinach, cleaned | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2/3 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well, using your hands.  Cover and leave in fridge.  When not eating, toss and serve.

title: Chipotle Snack Cake
ingredients: 500 -568 ml icing sugar, powdered type | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile | 1 chipotle chile, finely ground
instructions: Place icing sugar on an 18cm square tin and line the base of a 24cm flatbread tin.  Heat in microwave until spreading consistency.  Beat chipotle in a small saucepan and heat just until very warm.  Beat in grated chipotle and set aside to cool.  Spread the chipotle mixture evenly over the base of the tin and return to the microwave to warm slightly.  Cook for 3 - 4 minutes, until the mix has set slightly.  Allow to cool completely.  To serve, split the biscuits into 2 - 3 layers.  Place each biscuit in the microwave and spread evenly with the chipotle mixture.  Re cover with plastic wrap and continue to cook for 15 minutes or until firm and lightly coloured.  Allow to cool slightly, then cut the biscuits into square squares.

title: Spicy Oranges With Broccoli Burritos
ingredients:
14 -16 ounces mandarin oranges | 1 package taco flour tortillas ( or more.
    -.
    -.
    - burrito size ) | 16 ounces frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
instructions: Prepare or pan fry the noodles according to package directions.  After the first five minutes of cooking, take the noodles from the stove and set aside.  While the noodles are steaming, cut the orange in half then slice each half into 1/4 strips and set aside.  Drain the noodles then return the noodles to the pan.  Now add the broccoli to the pan and cook for 5 minutes.  Drain the oranges then cut them in half again and set aside.  Cook only the number of tortillas needed or you can make your own using the above instructions.  Place the noodles on a platter, then top with the orange slices, broccoli and your favorite fillings.  Serve with more toppings.

title: Sliced Salmon With Pesto Mayo
ingredients: 16 ounces salmon | 3 ounces pesto sauce, made from a 1-ounce package
instructions: Wash and remove all bones from the salmon.  Cut into 2 fillets.  Dry the salmon with paper towel.  Cut each fillet into 6 - 8 pieces of salmon, each about 3 1/2 lbs. .  Using a pastry brush, coat the salmon generously with the pesto mayo.  Grill under high heat, with the bottom side down, over moderate heat, to salmon's middle of the grid, turning once until marked in the center and slightly opaque in the centre, and the tip of a knife inserted near the center registers 375°f transfer salmon to a warm serving platter, surrounded by pieces of salmon.  Serve at once.

title: Italian Spiced Tomato-Squash
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes | 1 yellow squash | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Cut tomatoes in half.  Scoop out tomato pulp and add to a large casserole dish.  Cut squash in chunks and add to sauce.  Sprinkle with mustard and sprinkle with italian seasoning.  Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: White Posole - Hominy, Cheese, and Sour Cream Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil, divided | 1 can hominy, drained & rinsed | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped, divided
instructions: In a medium pot with a lid, heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium heat.  When hot, add hominy, stirring.  Simmer 5 minutes, stirring frequently.  Mix in cream cheese until melted.  Pour into the bowl with hominy, leaving a small amount of excess liquid in the bowl to moisten.  Fill each warm tortilla about 2/3 full with cheese mixture, fold and serve.

title: Wasabi Blueberry Salad
ingredients: 1 package fresh blueberries | 1 teaspoon wasabi paste
instructions: In a bowl, toss together the blueberries and wasabi paste.  Chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,leek,celery rib,cherry tomato,dark rum,red cayenne pepper
title: Devon Lentil Ceviche
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown lentils | 1 small leek, white part only, finely chopped | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon light brown rum | 1 -4 teaspoon red cayenne pepper | 1 cherry tomatoes, cut into wedges
instructions: Put lentils and leek in large pan with celery.  Pour boiling water, over high heat, until just boiling.  Cover, and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until tender.  Drain thoroughly.  Return to pot, stir in rum, cayenne, and tomatoes.  Serve, sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander.

Random Ingredients: walnut,no salt tomato paste,artichoke heart,lamb stock cube
title: Artichoke and Chard Balls - Low Fat
ingredients: 400 g no-salt-added tomato paste | 140 g marinated artichoke hearts, thawed and chopped | 4 g walnuts, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons low-sodium lamb stock or 2 tablespoons low-sodium beef stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Spread the paste evenly over the base of a 30x20cm baking tray.  Cover with the chopped artichoke hearts, walnuts and stock.  Bake for 30 minutes or until the artichoke hearts are soft.  Remove from the oven and leave to cool in the tin.

title: Pumpkin Mole Barley Hot Spot
ingredients: 2 cups cold water | 1 can pumpkin puree | 3/4 cup picante sauce | 1/2 cup barley | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Place water at the top of a double boiler over low heat.  Add pumpkin, picante sauce, barley, coriander seeds and cocoa.  Stir occasionally to blend and to make sure ingredients are well incorported from the bottom of the pan.  Heat to simmer and stir occasionally but do not boil.  Remove from heat after 20 minutes in a metal bowl.  Serve immediately or store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks, refrigerated, or freeze in 1/2 cup portions for later use.  Be sure to stir before use.

title: Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 small cabbage, core trimmed | 2 star anise | 5 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek or 1 tablespoon jalapeno chili sauce ( optional )
instructions: Place cabbage into a bowl and add 1 tbs warm water.  Set aside to soften slightly.  Chop the star anise, trim ends.  Finely mince the mushrooms.  Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Put some water in the bottom of a baking dish or baking pan so the pieces don't stick to the bottom and to help them out if needed.  Place 3 tablespoons of filling at the base of each cabbage, fold the left and right sides of the cabbage over the filling and roll up.  Secure with toothpicks. title: Cashew Cheesecake
