instructions: Heat the oven to 180 c or 340°f.  Grease a 13 x9 x 2cm pan with butterflied margarine and line with a piece of parchment paper.  The paper should fit the pan in a roasting pan.  Cut the lamb in to chunks.  Cook the pork for 5 mins slowly over a medium heat, stirring, then stir through the pork cubes as you cook.  Add half the prawns and half the glutinous/rice flour to thicken the mixture slightly.  Simmer for 10 mins.  Mix through the anchovy fillet.  Serve with fried rice and a salad.

title: Stout-Baked Cauliflower With Beer
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, plus extra for greasing the baking dish | 3/4 cup stout beer | 4 tablespoons of grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees.  Place the cauliflower, stem side down, on a baking sheet and drizzle with 1 tablespoon olive oil.  Bake until just slightly crisp and browned, about 15 minutes.  Remove from the oven.  Add the stout and stir well.  Place the prepared cauliflower on a lined baking sheet and cook in the oven for 2 - 3 minutes, until the cauliflower has given off enough water to leave a slight crunchy coating on top.  Sprinkle with the grated cheese.  Bake for 5 minutes more.

title: Tropical BBQ'd Bananas
ingredients: 1 banana | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Rinse the banana and slice lengthways.  Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and set aside for 2 hours.  Put the bananas on grill and cook until golden brown.

title: Lentils in Green Sauce
ingredients: 300 g dried lentils ( green or brown ) | 100 g beans sprouts | wine ( optional )
instructions: Soak lentils in enough water to cover them by 5cm.  Place lentils in a pot, add the remainder of the water, bring to the boil reduce the flame and simmer until the lentils are soft, about 1 hour.  Drain well the water will cook the lentils and will keep for another use in cooking.  Remove from the heat and let stand for 10 minutes then drain.  To serve, stir lentils in sauce and sprinkle over lots of freshly ground pepper.

title: Bacardi
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/8 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 cup dark rum
instructions: Rub salt into both sides of chicken.  In a bowl, stir together the rum and the rum.  Place the chicken in the marinade, and coat well with the rum and rum.  Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator for 90 minutes to 1 hour.  Preheat grill for high heat.  Place the chicken on hot grate.  Cook for about 5 minutes on each side, until juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,dark rum,blue curacao,extra virgin olive oil,lard
title: Blue Cheese Bleu
ingredients: 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 package firm blue curacao or 1 package other dark rum | 1 dash dark rum | sea salt | 1 teaspoon lard, or other fat
instructions: Pour olive oil into a 1 quart glass jar, coating the jar entirely.  Rinse the curacao with an old splash of rum, a pinch of sea salt, and a tiny bit of lard as you rinse a clean.  Shake the olive oil and rum together, pour over the blue cheese, and set the jar aside.  Stir or shake to ensure the cheese completely coats the jar and leaves the sides of the jar.  Let stand at room temperature for four hours before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Broccoli Puree
ingredients: 1 lb fresh broccoli floret | 1/4 cup firm tofu, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.  Add the broccoli and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain.  Transfer the broccoli to a bowl.  Microwave the tofu in the sauce for 1 minute in 30 second intervals, then drain.  In a blender, combine the broccoli puree with the dark brown sugar until smooth.  Cook the broccoli puree over medium low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 15 minutes.  Stir in sugar, if desired.

title: Broccoli in Hot Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 3 medium tomatoes ( i like roma tomatoes! ) or 14 ounces tomatoes, diced ( i like roma tomatoes! ) | 4 large stems broccoli florets | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, freshly grated | 1 2/3 teaspoons salt-free hot pepper flakes, if you like it very hot
instructions: Core tomatoes.  Using a mandolin, slice each into about 20 half moons.  Remove the ends from the broccoli florets and wash well under running water to remove all sand and dirt.  Slice the pieces into about a inch long pieces.  I like a bit thinner because sometimes we like our sauce a bit thinner, but you can do more or less.  Place tomatoes in a small saucepan.  Cover with water and bring to boil.  Cover and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes.  While it simmers, preheat grill.  Combine the drained broccoli, lemon zest and 1/4 cup of the hot water in a large bowl.  Stir in remaining hot water.  Arrange the broccoli in a serving dish.  Spoon the tomato sauce evenly over the broccoli and serve.

title: Spiced Eggplant With Prawn Croquettes
ingredients: 1 lb firm ripe eggplant, peeled, trimmed, cut in 1/4 inch dice | 1 lb leek, white and light green parts, sliced in 1/4 inch rounds | 2 -3 red chilies, sliced in 1/2 inch rounds | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1/2 lb gorgonzola, crumbled | 1 dash hot sauce
instructions: Combine eggs, chilies, cream, soya sauce, gorgonzola and hot sauce in a heavy skillet.  Simmer until sauce thickens.  Keep warm.  Arrange eggplant on cookie sheets.  Broil until brown, turn over and broil until other side browns.

title: Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1 can crushed tomatoes with tomato paste | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in a large bowl.  Press 2 or 3 at a time through a meat grinder so that you have the right texture.  Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the cottage cheese, then return to a boil.  Cook the gnocchi uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has been processed into a smooth, creamy texture, about 5 minutes.  Drain well.  Serve over spaghetti.

title: Rhubarb Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and sliced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rhubarb | water | 1/4 cup powdered milk
instructions: Cook the potato cubes in the boiling water over high heat until tender, about 10 minutes.  Drain, allow to cool slightly, then toss with the rhubarb.  Lightly spray 2 qt.  Saucepan with cooking oil spray and place over medium high heat.  Add water chestnuts, and saute until lightly browned, about 4 minutes.  Remove all but 1 tablespoon of the rhubarb, stir in the powdered milk, and stir until well blended.  Add the reserved rhubarb and potato mixture, and mix to coat.

title: Aussie Baked Sausages with Blackberry Salad
ingredients: 4 links sweet sausage, british | 12 pimento stuffed olives, drained and halved | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 cup blackberry, washed | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Place the sausage links in a casserole over a moderately high heat.  Cook for 3 - 5 minutes until coloured on all sides.  Remove from the heat and keep warm.  Place on a baking tray with the olives, curry paste and blackberries and season with saly.  Roast for 15 minutes or until golden on top.  Slice and serve immediately.

title: Spicy Artichoke cabbage
ingredients: 2 -3 artichokes | 1 large cabbage ( about 16 cups, or 8 brussels sprouts, if you're feeling artistic ) | 1/2 head cabbage ( about 1 1/2 inches long ) | 3 -4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil in a small frying pan on medium high heat.  Cut the outer leaves off of your cabbage and core the leaves.  Place cabbage leaves in a large pot of boiling, salted water.  Cook cabbage 3 - 4 minutes.  Remove the leaves from the water with a slotted spoon and place them in a bowl of ice water to stop cooking.  When cool, squeeze out as much water as possible.  Cut the cabbage head in half across the middle and slice the halves on the diagonal into about 1/2 inch slices.  Place cabbage leaves face down on a clean plate while you prepare all ingredients.  Slice up your artichokes and place the peeled cabbage in a colander lined with cheese cloth.  Rinse the cabbage leaves generously.  Discard the outer leaves.  Cut the outer leaves off your cabbage, or sprouts.  The leaves only need to be washed in the wash.  Remove the outer leaves from the cabbage and place them on clean plates next to each other.  You can set each layer of your cabbage in the freezer.  When you are ready to eat, place a teaspoon of sesame oil to make sure it has been spread thinly on each leaf.  Place the sesame oil on a plate of your cabbage leaves.  Place your cabbage leaves face down on the sesame oil.  Dinner will be ready for dipping later.  In a large non stick, large frying pan, place your cabbage leaves that have been turned around and coated with sesame seed oil.  Be careful, they may burn before the cabbage is cooked, so be very careful as your sesame oil may burn.  If it does, you can drain off as much oil as desired.  Add the sliced chili peppers if using.  You may also add small amounts of dark sesame oil, or to taste.  Place a handful of ice cold water in a strainer.  Place a cabbage leaf at a time over the sesame oil.  If it is soft and has a coating of sesame oil, blot off all the excess oil.  It may take a few minutes to reach “hard” on the bottom, but it’ll be ready shortly after it has been cut in quarters.  It should be a nice golden color when it has been cut in strips.  Place two large spoonfuls of your sesame oil over the cabbage and cabbage leaves and garnish each with a few strips of freshly diced onion.  Serve hot.

title: Duck Falscher à La Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1/2 veal | 300 g brie cheese | 1 leek
instructions: Pound the leeks.  Grind them finely.  Slice meat as thinly as possible.  Place cheese in a bowl, pour leeks on top and then pour on cheese.  Stir.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Before serving, break in pieces.

title: Crunchy Broccoli with Chinese Sour-Cucumber Dressing
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast ( one pkg ) | 2 1/2 cups cooked broccoli florets ( about 1 large head ) | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray, divided | 1 cucumber | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the yeast over 1 tablespoon water.  Let stand until foamy, about 10 minutes.  Stir in the cooked broccoli.  In a food processor, pulse the remaining ingredients except the sour cucumber until finely chopped but not quite smooth, leaving some coarse bits.  Add the mixture to the yeast mixture and mix to combine.  Scrape into a bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place until well bubbly, about 1 hour.  Turn the bread out onto a lightly floured surface.  Knead in enough of the remaining dough to produce a soft, well blended dough.  Shape the dough into a compact round with lots of sticky, tapered ends.  Lightly oil a large cookie sheet with 2 tablespoons cooking spray.  Transfer the dough to the oiled cookie sheet, and sprinkle with salt.  Allow to rise until doubled in size, about 1 hour.  Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Turn your broiler/grill pan on to the middle rack, and preheat the broiler to high.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Using a sharp knife, make a cross on the top of the dough.  Using your fingers press down on the top layer of dough, making several indentations and some holes in the dough.  Repeat with the remaining dough.  Gently slide the bread out onto the prepared cookie sheet.  Bake until very pale golden brown and springy to the touch, 40 to 55 minutes, rotating the bread at least 20 times during baking.  Allow to cool slightly before slicing.

title: Rab Cakes With Chili-Miso Flavoured Cheese

title: Cambodian Grilled Pork
ingredients: 1/2 cup dijonnaise mustard | 2 tablespoons jalapeno juice | 1 lb pork ( country-style trimmed ) | 3/8 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Mix dijon style mustard with jalapeno juice to make a relish.  Cover pork cutlets with relish.  Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes.  Coat pan with nonstick cooking spray.  Spread dry breadcrumbs on bottom of pan.  Arrange pork in a single layer on breadcrumbs.  Sprinkle with chopped water chestnuts.  Combine grand marnier and salt.  Add to breadcrumbs.

title: Sautéed Plums with Raisins And Smoked Sauerkraut
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground sauerkraut | 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced | 1 red chilies, sliced ( remove seeds if using dried ) | 1/4 cup plain semolina | 2 tablespoons oil | 2 cups red grapes, halved
instructions: Place saurkraut in a large microwave safe bowl, cover and microwave on high power for 2 minutes, stir and microwave for an additional 2 minutes until it is warm to the touch.  Remove from microwave and stir in tomatoes and chilies.  Stir in semolina, cover and microwave on high power for 1 minute, stir and microwave on high power for an additional 3 minutes.  While the saurkraut is cooking, heat oil in a large nonstick skillet.  Add sautéed plum tomatoes and sauté over high until they wilt.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer tomatoes to platter and sprinkle with raisins.  Makes 2 servings.

title: Langoup Style Peppercorns
ingredients: 12 fresh green peppercorns | 1/2 lb white onion, chopped and covered in water
instructions: Wash peppercorns well and remove the center stem end, make a slit all the way down the peppercorns.  Place in a dish, cover and put in the fridge overnight for a better flavour.  Fry onions along with 1/2 lb of water to make a thick paste.  Add to frying pan the mixture, and boil gently until the onion is reduced to 3/4 inch in size.  Add 1 1/4 pint of water, and cover until peppercorns are soft, adding more water after 5 minutes, if the water is boiling out add a little more.  Note this might make a little over three pounds of peppercorns.  When you add the water you shouldn't need to add any more at one time.

title: Salsa Ranchera
ingredients: 5 -10 anaheim chilies ( depending on the size ) | 1 lb lean beef chuck or 1 lb lean ground lamb
instructions: Slit the chilies lengthwise and remove the seeds and stem.  You can either peel the seeds or put them in a bowl and put the seeds in as well.  You decide on the size of the chili you use.  If you decide to peel the stems off, be sure to use long stems for the first cut.  They may help you slice them later at servingtime.  You can also slit them lengthwise at chopping time if you are using a knife.  The idea is to preserve the seed/sourness and keep the chilies' tough shells intact.  You can stuff the chilies through a meat grinder or whish to a fine consistency.  I use the fine side.  Place the chilies in a food processor or blender and process until all the desired consistency is obtained.  You may need a bit of water to process.  Cut the meat into 1 inch pieces.  Taste for seasoning and add more salt if necessary.  Pack all the ingredients into a small, heavy ovenproof casserole.  Put a lid on the pan so it doesn't stick.  You can also put the lid on tightly and slow cook it in the oven for 3 to 4 hours.  Stir as needed, removing the lid for the last 20 minutes or so.  The salsa will thicken into a chunky consistency.  To be authentic, you may serve this with crusty bread and a salad.

title: Pimento Spread (Paprika)
ingredients: 10 pimento, roasted stems and all, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a small bowl, mash roasted vegetables with cream of tartar.  Stir in the roasted pimentos, and season to taste with salt.  Refrigerate 1 hour to firm up before spreading on crackers.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,king prawn,orange,mini chocolate chip,nori,water,golden syrup
title: King Prawns W- Yummy Nori Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 2 sheets nori | 1 can tomato juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons golden syrup | 3/4 cup mini chocolate chip | 1 large orange, sliced thinly | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 lb king prawns
instructions: Mix together the tomato juice, syrup and golden syrup in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil.  Add mini chocolate chips and stir to melt.  Add orange slices, stirring to coat.  Set aside until cool.  Set aside.  In a preheated nonstick skillet cook prawns in boiling sauce.  Drain and set aside.  Bring mixture to a boil.  Reduce heat and continue to cook until prawns are cooked.  Drain excess liquid and divide the mixture among nori sheets.  Roll and serve.

title: Stevia Beef Filling
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds ( or try ancho chilies ) | 1 1/3 cups currants | 1 tablespoon stevia
instructions: Brown beef in a skillet with the caraway seeds and stevia.  Add the currants and simmer until tender.  Add water if you require more liquid.  Put into a bowl and stir in the stevia.  This makes enough for about 2 1/2 cups of filling.

Random Ingredients: hoagie,beef chuck roast,cashew nut,mascarpone cheese,red potato,kidney bean,mango,ketchup
title: Slow Cooker Cheater's Mexican Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 jar sliced mango | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 package mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup cashew nuts | 4 hoagie rolls | 1 package red potatoes, quartered
instructions: Place chuck roast in the bottom of the slow cooker.  Place drained kidney beans, mango slices, ketchup, and mascarpone cheese onto meat.  Close lid securely, and cook on low until meat is browned and cooked through, 6 to 8 hours.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place shredded plastic wrap onto a cutting board.  Slice meat into strips, and wrap each slice around the plastic wrap.  Wrap tightly in plastic wrap.

title: Cauli and Cheese (Colcannon)
ingredients: 4 medium new potatoes, sliced into 3/4 inch rounds | grated cheese | 1 jar pimientos or 1 jar roasted red peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to melt cheese in microwave.  Drain potatoes until they're soft enough that you can pick out.  Arrange in a casserole pan.  Pour cheese mix over and sprinkle with pimentos.  Bake covered for 30 min at 350.

title: Stuffed ramps
ingredients:
1/2 cup shredded sweetened coconut | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard, or more to taste | 2 ramps, halved crosswise.
    - ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place coconut in a bowl, and stir in mustard.  Place a ramp over the coconut, top with shredded cheese, and roll up.

title: Simple Mexican Avocado Appetizer
ingredients: 1 small avocado | 1/4 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Poke holes into the avocado skins with a fork dipped in warm water.  Spread salsa or picante sauce onto avocado, taking care to leave some of the avocado behind.  Place a fork alongside the avocado to keep the bread from falling out of the fork.  Let the bread soak up the liquid.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,yellow pepper,red bell pepper,grand marnier,chili pepper flake,soymilk,onion flake
title: Zucchini Pepper-Zucchini
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini, sliced julienne style on a mandolin | 2 medium red bell peppers, sliced julienne style | 2 medium yellow peppers, sliced julienne style | 1/4 cup soymilk ( skim ) | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup dried onion flakes | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Place the zucchini slices in a single layer on a plate.  Sprinkle with minced onion, chile flakes and half of the soy milk.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least an hour, turning the zucchini occasionally so they get both crisp and dark.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Remove the zucchini from the refrigerator and arrange in an ungreased 9 x 12 inch casserole dish.  Pour remaining soy milk over the zucchini, top with remaining onions and pepper flakes.  Sprinkle with grand marnier and cover with foil.  Bake for 45 minutes, uncover and bake for 15 minutes more or until zucchini is tender, puffed and slightly crusty.

title: Chinese Peas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 pinch ground szechwan pepper | 1 cup frozen green peas | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Combine olive oil, sichwan pepper, peas and cream in skillet.  Cook over low heat to mix.  Continue cooking until peas are heated through.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,buttermilk,taco sauce,prosciutto,pea,tahini,kosher salt,coriander seed
title: Spiced Corn Soup
ingredients: 2 ears fresh corn, shucked | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 tablespoon minced ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/2 cup shredded provolone cheese or 1/2 cup prosciutto, coarsely chopped
instructions: If using the husks of the corn, soak them in water for 2 hours.  If using the husks, soak them in cold water for 25 minutes then drain.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Meanwhile remove the kernels from the corn.  Shuck the kernels, if any, and place in a blender along with the peas, salt, ginger garlic paste, and coriander.  Blend until the corn is finely chopped.  Pour into a clean bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour so all the husks can absorb the flavors.  When ready to use, place the buttermilk in a medium bowl and slowly whisk in the tahini, so that the tahini is emulsified.  Taste for seasoning and adjust if necessary.  Slice the reserved husks in half lengthwise.  Remove the silks and discard.  Place a scoop of the soup in a blender and puree until smooth.  Return to the soup in the pot, and sprinkle with the cheese.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: jerk seasoning,cannellini bean,pork tenderloin,bouillon cube,jamaican jerk spice,bacon grease
title: Costa Rican Pork Tenderloin, Lisbon Style
ingredients:
6 slices bacon grease, divided | 1 whole pork tenderloins or 2 1/2-3 lbs trimmed tenderloins | 0.
    -5 package jamaican jerk spice | 2 -3 cups canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon bouillon powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Place two thirds of bacon grease in a roasting pan or dutch oven that has a tight fitting cover, such as a large roasting pan.  Arrange the meat tenderloins over the bacon grease in pan, cover loosely with aluminum foil, and put in the oven to roast for about 2 hours, until a meat thermometer reads at least 160 degrees.  Check tenderloins at 2 to 3 hours, and stir every 15 or 20 minutes, until meat has the desired degree of good browning.  Remove meat from oven, and set aside, covered,.  Place a large pot over medium heat, and add about 1/8 cup oil.  Add the beans and remaining bacon grease to the pot, and stir.  Add the jamaican jerk seasoning, and stir to combine.  Add a bouillon cube, if using, and add 3 1/2 cups more water to the pot, and heat to boiling, stirring frequently.  Boil 5 - 5 minutes, or until sauce has reduced slightly.  Remove the meat from the oven, and transfer the pieces to a platter in the juices.  Pour the sauce over the meat, garnish with remaining bacon slices, and serve.  You can also add shrimp, bacon bits, or any other meat that you prefer, for flavor.  Some recipes serve with white rice on top, with beans and other desired sides dishes.  Also, this can also be served with pita bread.  Note, do not use your thermometer because this could cause holes in the bacon.  The bread is soft enough to soak up all of the sauce, but not mushy.  If you are using a thermometer, you shouldn't need to grease it.  If you are serving this right away, cover with a piece of plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight.  It should keep for a few days.

title: Pizzas
ingredients: 1 box whole wheat spaghetti | 3 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | chopped fresh chives | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.  Drain.  While spaghetti is cooking, prepare cheese topping.  Remove spaghetti from heat and spread on a greased baking sheet.  Mix mozzarella cheese and bread crumbs together.  Place bread crumb mixture on top of spaghetti.  Sprinkle with chopped chives.  Sprinkle with cardamom seeds.  Allow pizzas to sit for 5 minutes.  Then cut in half diagonally.

title: Lebanese Mesclun Cheese
ingredients: 600 g mesclun | 1 cup nonfat dry milk | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Clean the mesclun by submerging it in boiling water for 2 minutes.  Drain and rinse well with cold water.  Dry off the excess moisture with paper towels and then set aside.  In a cheesecloth bag or large bowl, mix together wet milk and olive oil.  Place mesclun on top of the mixture, making sure there is some space between cheesecloth.  Squeeze the moisture dry cheesecloth bag to release excess liquid and then fold together to form a compact cheesecloth bundle.  Wrap loosely in new cheesecloth and refrigerate for up to half an day.  When you are ready to eat, allow cheese bundle to sit at room temp until the cheese is warm to the touch.  Wrap in new cheesecloth and place in an airtight container.

title: Lite Spaghetti Squash and Prosciutto Bake
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, peeled and halved lengthwise | 1/2 lb prosciutto, sliced thinly | 2 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 cans rotel diced tomatoes | 1 cup raisins ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Place the spaghetti squash in a baking dish and sprinkle the prosciutto evenly over it.  Drizzle diced tomatoes over the top, then top with mozzarella cheese and then the rotels.  Sprinkle raisins over the top.  Bake for 30 - 35 minutes until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

title: Tomato Garlic Shrimp Jam
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh shrimp paste or 4 lbs shrimp, shelled, deveined ( 8-12 shrimp per pound ) | 1/2 cup dry wine | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, peeled | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried italian bread or 1 1/2 tablespoons arabic bread, crumbs ( 1/2 cup ) | 2 cups cherry tomatoes
instructions: Combine the shrimp paste and wine in a large saucepan.  Heat over medium heat until the liquid is reduced by half.  Increase the heat to medium high.  Add the coriander and bread crumbs.  Stir well.  Remove pan from heat.  Add shrimp and stir well.  Cover and let stand 5 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally.  Strain out the contents, pressing the shrimp liquid through a paper towel.  Add tomatoes and cook over low heat until shrimp mixture thickens slightly.  Stir occasionally.  Transfer the mixture to a large heatproof bowl.  Cover and chill 1 to 2 hours.  Transfer the jam to a clean, dry metal ring, pressing the center firmly.  Bring 4 cups or ice water to a boil and skim.  Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until jam reaches jam consistency.  Remove from heat.

instructions: Put beans in a bowl and cover with boiling water.

instructions: Sieve the mayonnaise into a bowl.  Add the rosemary and mix well.  Serve over brown rice.  Enjoy.

instructions: To prepare the cranberry sauce, combine the berry cranberry sauce, chicken stock, bread crumbs, kaffir lime leaves, and couscous in the top of a double boiler.  Place over low heat and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes or until couscous is tender.  Remove from heat and stir until the liquid is absorbed and the bread crumbs are moist.  Spoon hot chicken and broth mixture onto couscous and serve.

title: Tamarind Beef Pot Pie
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs stewing beef | 14 ounces tamarind paste | 1 -2 cup dry white wine, depending on how sweet you want it
instructions: Cut the stewing beef into 1 cubes, removing the tips.  Place the meat, cubed, in the pie shell.  Pour the tamarind paste over the meat.  Cover and marinate for at least 4 - 8 hours.  After 4 hours, remove the meat and add the wine.  Let simmer on low oven setting for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat and vegies are tender.

title: Quick & Easy Foolproof Beef & Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef sirloin, 1 inch thick | 1 package beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 can fava beans, rinsed and drained | 2 -3 sheets deli ham or 2 -3 sheets spicy italian bacon
instructions: Freeze beef if using frozen.

title: Lori's Slow Cooker Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck ( can use sirloin or similar beef ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 lbs boneless chuck, cooked and cubed
instructions: Remove roast from slow cooker, and place in a bowl of water.  Combine the soup, golden syrup, and beef in a crockpot, and heat on high for 4 - 5 hrs, stirring often.  Remove beef and beef from soup mixture, and place in a baking dish.  In a bowl, combine 1 tablespoon of cold water and 2 tablespoons of the soup mix.  Stir to blend, and pour over meat in the crockpot.  Cover, and cook on low all day.  Serve with mashed potatoes and a green vegetable.

title:
St.
    - Patrick’s Day Party Daikon Dessert
ingredients: 20 dates, pits removed | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 2 packages trident vanilla instant cream and frosting | 3 1/3 cups irish cream | 5/8 cup granulated sugar | fresh shaved daikon radish
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Place 1 box instant vanilla pudding mix, 2 boxes of trident vanilla instant cream and frosting blend in blender, set aside 5 cups and pour remaining contents into a small pot, stir well, allow to cool.  Cut a round glass approximately 20 x 2 - 3 inches and spray with non stick spray.  Place round glass in glass bowl with ice cubes in a small circle around the edge of the glass, allowing a large layer to form on top of the round glass.  This is best done by placing the glass on a flat surface for a moment or two before placing it in a larger glass bowl until serving.  After removing round glass from bowl in bowl and making sure the round is completely flat place the small circle of ice mixture onto the round, using more glass if necessary, then fill the empty round with ice mixture.  Chill several hours so the ice does not melt.  Garnish with shaved radish and serve.  Keep refrigerated after removal from glass.

title: Taco Sauce for Shrimp
ingredients: 1 bottle taco sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco rennet taco seasoning, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Mix taco sauce, zest, and seasoning together in a bowl.

title: Lemonade Beef

instructions: Put meat in crock pot and stir occasionally.  Mix in lemonade.  Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours or til fork tender.

title: Brown Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tri-colored whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup cocoa powder ( not self-rising ) | 1 can fat-free refried beans with low fat | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 8 ounces rotini pasta | 1 cup sliced celery | 1 1/4 cups miniature graham cracker crumbs
instructions: In bowl, stir together flour, cocoa, beans, and celery salt.  Stir in pasta until almost dry.  In greased 2 x 1/4 inch loaf pan, layer half of pasta, half the sprouts, and half the crumbs.  Repeat layers.  Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.

title: Vanilla Bean Soup (Toffee - Cold)
ingredients: 1 small vanilla bean | 500 g organic beef stock or 500 g beef base | simple syrup ( optional ) or sugar ( optional )
instructions: Wash the inside of the vanilla bean and scrape out any hard shell.  Split the vanilla bean and place inside the scraped out vanilla bean with the scraped out vanilla bean fillings.  Set over to low heat and cook for 15 - 20 minutes or until it starts to bubble.  Remove vanilla bean from heat and let stand for 5 min to cool, skim foam out and serve with desired flavorings.

instructions: Boil rice until half way cooked.  Drain and rinse rice under cold water for several minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside to cool until warm.  In a 3 quart saucepan, add stock, nuts and water.  Bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.  Add spices and tofu.  Simmer for 20 minutes.  Add rice and stir.  Garnish with lime wedges to serve.

title: Easy Chipotle Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup lard | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup long grain white rice ( can use brown rice and pearl barley ) | 4 -5 chipotle chiles, in adobo | 2 -3 drops orange zest | 1 can condensed tomato soup | splash white vinegar
instructions: In a large pot melt lard and cook the rice until half cooked and a little crispy.  Meanwhile, in a separate pot heat up the chilies until they are just warm, but not sizzling.  Take the first two chilies and slice out the stems and seeds.  Set aside.  Warm up the tomato soup.  Add the chilies and rice to the soup and stir constantly.  Add vinegar, chipotle paste and zest and heat through.  I do this the night before and heat the rest of the night in the fridge.  It tastes even better the next day.

Random Ingredients: new potato,sirloin,cranberry bean,cream,plain nonfat yogurt,buttermilk biscuit
title: Baked Potato & Beef  Mini-Sloafs
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 24 ounces new potatoes, scrubbed | 2 cans cranberry beans, drained | 1/3 cup dried cranberries & amp ; craisins | 3/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 8 ounces sour cream | 8 ounces plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f season ground sirloin evenly with salt & pepper.  Cook until heated through & browned breaking it into chunks as it cooks, cook potatoes until tender but not mushy, drain then put potatoes into large mixing bowl & stir in beans & cranberries, mix well.  Combine yoghurt & sour cream together until well mixed & creamy, then place mixture into buttered loaf tin.  Spread yoghurt mixture evenly over the top of the potato mixture allowing for extra to run down the sides.  Take a knife and cut a 1 lenght cross on top of each loaf, then place loaf on tin & bake about 40 - 45 minutes until tester comes out clean.  Serve warm with fresh yogurt and a salad, as an appetizer, as an accompaniment for chicken or sausage sandwiches or as a side dish.  Enjoy.

title: Prawns - Brazil

instructions: Remove tails from prawns and reserve for later use, if using larger meat.  Mash the prawns slightly in the palm of your hand to break them up slightly and mix the prawns into smaller ones. .  Mix the breadcrumbs and mineral water in a small bowl, then sprinkle into the prawn meat and stir lightly.  Pour the mixture into the bowl and refrigerate for an hour or two or until it is cold.

title: Roast Chicken Kebabs

title: Saltine Crackers

instructions: Mix and eat.  To serve, put 2 tsp in a hot coffee mug.  Top with 1 - 2 tsp crumbs and 1 1/4 tsp water.

instructions: Combine the stock, onion flakes and shrimp in a saucepan and bring to a boil.  Add the cornstarch, chili power, yogurt, chipotle powder and chile peppers to the pan and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until the shrimp are cooked.  Serve immediately.

title: Pesto Glazed Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork roast | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 cup pine nuts, coarsely chopped | 2 leaves pine nuts ( optional ) | 2 cups breadcrumbs ( or toasted bread crumbs ) | 1/2 cup honey | 3/4 cup water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.  Butter a 2 qt casserol dish.  Tear the pork into small strips removing as many fat as possible from the meat.  Spread the meat with the pesto, arrange the pine nuts over the meat, and bake until golden about 30 minutes.  Remove the pork from the oven and pour the meat off the drippings.  Return the pork to the oven and bake for about an hour, till the juices from the pork are mostly absorbed.  Toss the reserved pine nuts in a bowl with the bread crumbs.  Sprinkle the bread crumb mixture over the pork and bake for about 10 minutes, till golden.  Add the honey and water and stir.  Turn the pork out of the dish, cool slightly, and cut into slices.  Serve at once or keep warm for later.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,thyme sprig,orange zest,head celery,cream tartar,fennel bulb
title: Tartar Sauce for Vegetables
ingredients: 2 small fennel bulbs, cut into thin slices | 2 medium head of celery, cut into thin slices | 1 tablespoon sour cream | 3 tablespoons cottage cheese | 1 orange, zest of | 1 fresh thyme sprig, 1-2 sprig | 1 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: Bring 3/4 cups water to simmer in a small saucepan, pour in fennel, stir.  Remove fennel, celery, and orange zest, leaving orange zest and 1/2 cup of the vegetables for garnish.  Boil 1 minute.  Drain fennel and celery, discarding remaining fennel and celery.  Add sour cream and cottage cheese, simmer 5 minutes or until heated through.  Add zest, herbs, and ¾ teaspoon salt.  Mix thoroughly.  Transfer to a bowl, garnish with reserved fennel bulb and a dollop of sour cream.

title: Homemade Kale
ingredients: 1 quart kale | 1 pound kielbasa, cut into pieces | 1 package instant kale
instructions: Wash and thoroughly dry kale.  Place kale in bottom of a large pot, or dutch oven.  Add enough water to cover the kale, and bring to a boil.  When water begins to boil again, reduce heat to low, and simmer until tender, about an hour.  When kale has finished cooking and is tender, remove kale from the cooking pot, and cut into thick slices, discarding any tough stems.  Set kale aside to cool.  Place kielbasa in a large pot, and fill with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil.

title: Pasta Con Piselli E Piselli
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 2 medium red onions, sliced | 300 ml milk | red onion ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the rigatoni and cook it in a large pan of boiling, slated water for 4 minutes, until it is al dente.  Drain and return the rigatoni to the pan.  Heat 3 tbsp of oil in a large pan and saute the sliced red onions over medium heat for 5 minutes, until they are golden.  When they have sweated down for about 5 minutes add 1/4 cup of milk, stirring well, and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes.  Pour over the rigatoni and stir to mix.  Serve with freshly grated parmesan or romano cheese, if desired.

title: Simple and Healthy Low Fat Tiramisù

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit.

title: Peppers in Sun Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon jeera powder ( or cumin powder ) | 1 jar roasted red peppers in tomato oil (, 1 jar ) | 1 tablespoon red pepper sauce | 1/4 cup reduced fat cream cheese, room temperature | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar
instructions: To prepare dressing, combine all ingredients in small pot.  Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until almost all of the liquid evaporates.  Pour warm dressing over peppers.  Let cool for a few minutes, then chill and serve.

title: Almond Cornbread
ingredients: 3 cups cornmeal | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 1/2 cups slivered almonds | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Add all ingredients in the order given to a greased and sprayed 8x8 baking dish or pan.  Bake in a 300 degree oven for 25 - 30 minutes or until the tops are brown and crisp.  Enjoy.

title: Thai Bread Salad
ingredients: 2 loaves french bread, cut in 1 inch slices | 1 package frozen strawberries, thawed and sliced | 1 large onion, chopped | 1/2 cup thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Arrange bread slices in a large, shallow bowl.  Pour thawed strawberries over bread.  Sprinkle chopped onion and fish sauce over bread and let stand 20 minutes.  Mix well.  Sprinkle with pepper.

title: Pasta Salad II
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 3 stalks celery, chopped | 3 leeks, chopped | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh leek | 1 1/2 cups iceberg lettuce, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil.  Cook rigatoni in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes.  Drain and allow to cool slightly.  Transfer pasta to a bowl.

title: Penne Al Forno (Penne With Potatoes, Cheese, and Hot Peppers
ingredients: 14 ounces penne | 12 cups hot water ( more as needed ) | 1 cup hot smoked polsole cheese | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon mace, and or 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 cup diced red potatoes, if you prefer
instructions: In a large pot, bring 12 cups of fresh hot water to a boil, add it to the hot penne pasta.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,coriander,rom tomato,pork tenderloin,orange zest,lime wedge,black pepper,flour tortilla
title: Spicy Pork Tacos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 2 tablespoons flour | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut in 3/4-inch cubes | 1/4 cup marinara sauce | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1 large roma tomato, seeded and cut into 8 wedges | 4 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°.  Combine orange zest, flour, and coriander in large bowl.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,scallion,carrot,bread flour,black pepper,dark sesame oil,canola oil
title: Chinese Fried Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 cup bread flour, plus extra for dusting | 1 cup canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper ( i like lots! ) | 12 scallions, chopped ( or 1/2 of a large green onion, chopped ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 bell pepper, sliced | 1 carrot, sliced
instructions: Heat canola oil to 120 degrees f in a large nonstick skillet, add flour all at once and stir while cooking over medium high heat.  When the flour forms a smooth, lightly colored and golden brown, add the oil, a pinch each of black pepper and white pepper if using all at once and continue to cook the mixture, stirring, until the mixture is light and a bit more fragrant.  Add scallions, bell pepper and carrot and stir, scraping up every bit of the browned flour.  The final product should be a light, golden color with the bell pepper pieces crispier than the green onion pieces.  If not, add some more bread flour until the mixture is like sticky crumbs, but not as crisp as cornmeal.  This is also lovely with a bit of green onion pieces on top and a sprinkling of sesame seeds just before removing from the heat.

title: Simple English Broccoli
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs broccoli florets, with stems | 3 tablespoons extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup soy milk | 1/4 cup small curd | 2 cups ice
instructions: Steam broccoli in a steamer basket over boiling water until tender.  Immediately toss together broccoli with cheese in a bowl.  In a heavy saucepan over medium heat, whisk together soy milk and curd until curds dissolve.  Whisk about 1/2 cup of the mixture, then stir in broccoli and 1 cup of the ice.  Cook until mixture begins to bubble, stirring often.  Pour into a serving bowl, then top with remaining cheese.

title: Tuscan Steak  (Or Fried Chicken)  Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 package cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 lb veal, cut in strips | 1 package frozen corn kernels | 1 pint marinara sauce
instructions: Heat up your wok over medium high heat, and add your catsup, tabasco sauce and mushrooms.  Stir fry about 1 minute.  Remove veal, mix in corn, cover and cook about 3 minutes.  Add cooked veal mixture, and marinara sauce, stir fry until warm.  Serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,vanilla essence,hoagie,vegetable oil,coriander seed,okra,ice
title: Prawn  (Shrimp) and Okra French Toast
ingredients: 4 thick ice, rounds | 1 tablespoon coriander seed ( cilantro ) | 4 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, sliced | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 okra, trimmed and halved lengthways | 8 thick prawns, cooked peeled and devoured | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Place 4 ice rounds in a food processor and process until roughly chopped.  Add coriander, tomatoes, oil and okra to processor and pulse until combined.  Add prawns and 2 teaspoons of essence to processor and process until well mixed.  Divide this between 4 thick slices of bread and press a quarter wedge of okra mixture along the edge of each bread slice pressing firmly.  Heat remaining oil in non stick frying pan over medium high heat.  Cook prawns 4 - 4 mins per side or until just cooked through and lightly browned.

title: Mexican Corn
ingredients: 4 medium mexican corn, husks removed | 4 cups mexican-style corn
instructions: Cook the mexican style corn in boiling water to cover for 20 minutes, or until tender.  Remove half of the corn kernels to a food processor or blender, and add the corn.

Random Ingredients: rice vermicelli,coffee,onion salt,almond extract,olive oil,cooking spray
title: Faux Espresso Rice Noodle Strips
ingredients: 1 lb rice vermicelli | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, lightly toasted and chopped coarsely or 2 teaspoons coarsely chopped almonds | cooking spray | 1/2 cup chopped small onion or 2 1/2-inch red onions | 1 1/2 tablespoons coffee ( optional if using instant expresso ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons water ( optional ) | 2 -4 teaspoons almond extract | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Cook rice vermicelli according to package directions, omitting salt and fat.

Random Ingredients: peanut,juice,onion soup mix,corn flake,garam masala,whipping cream
title: Peanut Bisque
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry-roasted peanuts, chopped | 1/2 cup onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons lime juice, divided ( juice of 4 limes ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 cup whipping cream | 4 -5 cups corn flakes, crushed
instructions: Combine peanuts, onion soup mix and 2 tablespoons lime juice in a blender with 1/2 cup water, 1 teaspoon lime juice, and 1 tablespoon garam masala.  Blend thoroughly.  Add remainder of the garam masala and blend.  Stir in cream.  Fold soup mixture, peanuts, onion soup mix and crushed corn flakes.  The more garam masala you add, the better.

title: Tahini Green Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch green peas, fresh picked through | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/2 cup white vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender, and process until creamy.

title: Spicy Spaghetti Chips
ingredients: 1 can chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 1/4 cups oyster sauce | 10 ounces thin spaghetti
instructions: Pour the can of chipotle chile powder in a mixing bowl and microwave on high for 20 seconds or so.  Stir in the turmeric and oyster sauce until well blended.  Cook the noodles according to package directions to desired doneness.  Drain well and toss with the sauce.  Serve with plain or chunky french bread and fresh fruit.

title: Authentic Mexican Croutons
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko bread crumbs, divided | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Lightly grease cookie sheets.  In a shallow bowl, mix panko crumbs, cilantro, and 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce.  Shape croutons into small balls about 1 1/2 inches diameter.  Place on cookie sheets.  Bake in the preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,dark sesame oil,half cream,tomato green chilies,pear,celery seed
title: Chiles and Pear Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 pears, pared, cored and diced | 8 small pears, cored and diced | 2 stalks celery seeds | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 cup fat-free half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 3 -5 drops dark sesame oil ( optional )
instructions: In large skillet, sauté the pears, celery seeds, and pears in 1 tablespoon of the sesame oil until tender, stirring occasionally.  Meanwhile, in bowl, combine the remaining 1 tablespoon sesame oil with diced tomatoes and green chilies and heat until heated through.  Add remaining 1 tablespoon sesame oil to skillet and cook the sliced fruit for about 2 to 3 minutes, stirring frequently.  Add the tomatoes, green chiles, and fruit to skillet.  Simmer sauce, stirring frequently for about 10 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in remaining sesame oil.

title: Beer & Pudding Caffee
ingredients: 12 ounces red mug instant vanilla pudding ( not instant ) | 12 ounces dark beer
instructions: Stir instant pudding into dark beer until well mixed.  Let set several hours for easier blending.  This is a very rich beer.  If your pot is very tall, this will not make much of a difference.  If you are using a non reactive pot, do not stir.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,orange juice,horseradish,raisin,greek yogurt,wheat flour,potato flake
title: Gluten  & Soy  Gluten Free Pita (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 12 ounces plain gluten free greek yogurt ( low calorie or gluten free, try low fat greek yogurt if you are not to find this ) | 2 cups mashed potato flakes ( or gluten free plain flour ) | 7/8 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons sweet dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons orange juice ( or a combination of orange juice, sherry ) | 1 tablespoon dry horseradish | 1 tablespoon flaked wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Mix well all ingredients together, using enough gluten free flour to make a thin batter for pita's.  Pour batter into a lined and lightly greased jelly roll pan or baking dish.  Sprinkle with cracked wheat flour on top and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden.

title: Cumberland Grilled Cheese Sandwich With Sourdough Crumb Topping and Cabbage
ingredients: 2 teaspoons yeast | 2 cups ice, icy cold | 1 large red cabbage, grated | 1/4 cup creme fraiche | 2 spring onions, sliced thinly | 1 bunch red cabbage, grated
instructions: First make the topping and cabbage.  Put the cucumber into a bowl and sprinkle over the creme fraiche.  Put the red cabbage in a large bowl and sprinkle over the crumb topping.  Stir well until everything is mixed.  Tightly cover with clingfilm then leave at room temperature for 30 minutes.  To serve, preheat the grill to medium or low, cut the sandwich in half and cut each half into four squares.

title: Homemade Laben
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups thick greek yogurt or 1 1/4 cups strained plain greek yogurt | 1/4 cup orange juice concentrate | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon allspice
instructions: In small bowl combine yogurt, orange juice concentrate, cinnamon and allspice.  Stir well.  Cover and chill in refrigerator 4 to 24 hours.  Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,zucchini,maple syrup,tarragon,caraway seed,roast beef
title: Flemish Grilled Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb top round steak | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 small zucchini, cut from ends, ends chopped 1 cup | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 6 slices maple-flavored roast beef | fresh tarragon ( optional )
instructions: Season beef with salt and pepper to taste.  Coat grill lightly with cooking spray.  Grill beef, covered, over indirect medium heat for 16 minutes or until thermometer inserted into thickest part of meat registers 140°f.  Turn steak and brush with cooking spray.  Grill, covered, another 16 minutes or until internal temperature is 140°f allow steak to rest 5 minutes.  Cut into thin slices.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,veal,rigatoni pasta,greek yogurt,herb,bell pepper,pork loin
title: Capellini
ingredients: 350 g rigatoni pasta | 150 g ground veal | 150 g ground pork loin | 200 ml puffed greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon fresh herbs, chopped | 1 large bell pepper, diced finely | 300 ml beef stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius.  Cook rigatoni in boiling water for 20 minutes set aside drain when cooked and then boil with salt.  Heat 1tbsp of oil in pan and fry meat for a couple of minutes mix it up and add the veg, puffed greek and chopped herbs.  Fry for 2 - 3 minutes add to rigatoni and stir until combined and cooked through serve topped with diced bell pepper, and a big helping of greek yogurt on top.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle spear,italian seasoning,vegetable broth,tortilla,semolina,apricot jam,vermicelli,orange juice
title: Crispy Oranges in Peppered Noodle Sauce
ingredients: 4 scoops thin vermicelli | 14 slices very thin round pickle spears | 14 ounces sweet apricot jam ( or tart cherry ) | 2 1/2 cups hot vegetable broth, heated to boiling and kept hot | 2 tablespoons minced fresh dill pickle spears | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh italian-style seasoning | 2 tablespoons toasted tahini, or to taste ( optional ) | tortilla, triangles, for serving
instructions: To make the noodles, trim ends from vermicelli and cook in boiling water for about 3 to 5 minutes or until tender.  Drain and set aside.  Cut the rounds of pickle spears in half lengthwise and slice into thin rounds.  Set aside.  Arrange half of the noodles in the bottom of a 3 cup glass measuring 3/4 full.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,white mushroom,ice,cod,barramundi fillet,corn,cumin,chicken bouillon cube
title: Baked Cod With Mushrooms and Corn on a Bed of Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup frozen corn, thawed | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 pieces cod ( skinless, boneless ) | 2 large white mushrooms, quartered | fresh frozen corn, thawed | 2 medium slices smoked barramundi fillets or 2 medium other thick smoked fish | crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven 375.  Combine all ingredients.  Cover and let sit 30 minutes.  Bake 15 minutes.  Cut bread into cubes or triangles if large, and bake until golden brown, about 10 minutes.  Fill into warm bowls with cream and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola,cashew,beef mince,eggplant,dark sesame oil,italian bread,vanilla extract
title: Beef Mince With Cashew Eggs
ingredients: 300 g beef mince | 80 g gorgonzola | 100 g fresh cashews | 2 eggplants | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 cups italian bread
instructions: Mix well and marinate beef mince for one hour in the refrigerator.  Cut mince into small pieces.  Slice eggplants into small pieces and place on an absorbent tray.  Set aside for five minutes to soak and then cut into small peices.  Drain beef mince from marinade, reserving marinade.  Combine eggs, vanilla sugar and sesame oil.  Heat up one cup of water in a large pot.  Add cashew nuts and let them simmer until they become tender.  Add meat and continue to cook over medium heat until meat becomes firm.  Cut bread into small pieces and coat in egg mixture.  Arrange on a serving platter.  Add cashew mixture to meat and cashew mixture on top of bread pieces.

title: Sausages in Wine
ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage | 1/2 cup brandy | 4 1/2 fluid ounces white wine ( white should be your favorite )
instructions: Brown sausage and remove from pan.  Brown sausage over medium heat in the brandy over medium heat.  Add wine to pan and bring to a boil.  Cover and cook for 5 minutes, do not remove from heat until sausage has cooled a bit but remove sausage and slice into 1/2 thick slices, about 1 1/2 in thickness.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: potato gnocchi,grenadine,sun tomato,angel hair pasta,apricot,nutritional yeast,pizza crust
title: Gnocchi Gnocchi Pizza
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes gnocchi, gnocchi | 2 sun-dried tomatoes | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 15 ounces pizza crust, plain | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, diced ( i love san marzano, as i have them ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup apricot, diced, fresh ( depending on size, i have never tried dried or chopped dried ) | 10 ounces angel hair pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Dice gnocchi.  Set aside.  Chop sun dried tomatoes.  Mix sun dried tomatoes and nutritional yeast together in a large bowl.  If there isn't enough sun dried tomato, you can use dried tomatoes that you have in the freezer.  Set aside.  Combine cooked gnocchi, diced tomatoes, sun dried tomatoes, and prepared pizza crust.  Spread the dough evenly on the pizza.  Sprinkle dried tomato/nut mixture evenly over the entire pizza.  Dot with diced tomatoes and garnish with fresh apricots or dried apricot pieces.

title: Beef Souvlaki
ingredients: 3/4 pound pork loin, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 3 cans beef consomme | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill | 2 cups greek yogurt | 3/4 cup yellow cornmeal
instructions: Place pork in a large pot and cover with water.  Bring to a boil.  Stir in consomme.  Bring back to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and cover.  Simmer for 20 minutes, or until meat is no longer pink.  Drain the fat and add lamb, dill, and yogurt.  Mix cornmeal and 1 cup water in a small bowl until well blended.  Drain any excess liquid from meat mixture, and spread into a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Place meat mixture over cheese sauce, and sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,sharp white cheddar cheese,lobster,chicken meat,kosher salt,red bean,cherry tomato
title: Lobster Lobster Casserole
ingredients: 1 can red beans ( well drained ) | 1 lb fresh lobster ( or lobster pieces ) | 1 1/4 lbs cooked chicken meat ( or cooked pork ) | 1/2 cup shredded sharp white cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh cherries or 1 teaspoon dried cherries | 3 -4 tablespoons prepared beef gravy | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: In bowl, mash red beans together with fork.  In large bowl, combine lobster, ham, and any other choice of fillings, except cheese, mix well.  Transfer lobster mixture to a lightly oiled 13x9 casserole dish.  Mix beans with remaining ingredients.  Pour into casserole.  Dot top with cheese.  Bake in a 375 degree oven for 25 minute.

title: Kalops (Polish Style Cutlets)
ingredients: 4 ounces veal, cut into thin slices about 1/2 inch thick | 4 ounces scallops, cleaned | 1/2 cup chutney | 1 tablespoon brandy | hot pepper flakes, to taste | crushed hot pepper flakes, to taste
instructions: Spread out each piece of veal with a thin layer of chutney.  Cover each slice of veal with about 2 oz.  Shredded scallops.  Sprinkle the brandy over each piece of veal.  If desired, sprinkle with crushed chili flakes.  Place the top of each roll over the chili flakes.  Sprinkle each roll with crushed hot pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: wooden skewer,rye bread,dark sesame oil,palm sugar,ham,currant
title: Ham & Walnut Sandwiches (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 9)
ingredients: 8 ounces lean ham, cut into 3 x 2in strips | 2 ounces currants | 4 slices rye bread, toasted | 2 ounces dark sesame oil or 2 ounces light olive oil | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil or 2 teaspoons light sesame oil | 1 teaspoon palm sugar or 1 teaspoon raw sugar
instructions: Place half the ham and half the currants in a small bowl and set aside.  Cut the bread into 2 x 1in slices and toast the bread on the back of a clean, dry metal griddle until golden brown, brushing with a little oil if necessary.  Heat the sesame oil in a small frying pan, add the sugar and cook gently over a moderate heat, stirring, until the sugar has dissolved.  Remove the pan from the heat.  Add the remaining sesame oil, stir well and set aside.  Brush the ham with olive oil and cook under a hot grill until golden brown, about 5 minutes per side.  Return all the ham to the pan, add the ham mixture and a drizzle of the sesame oil.  Add the remaining currants and top with the rye bread slices.  Serve immediately.

title: Simple and Delicious Pomegranate-Cumin Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 -2 teaspoon cumin | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice
instructions: Cut the bread into bite size pieces.  Put rice in a bowl with water cover with plastic wrap.  Place on burner on med high until it starts boiling.  Once it comes to boil, turn your burner off just enough and let sit for about 5 - 10 minutes to absorb the steam.  You can check your rice though, then take off all of the grease as much as you want out of the cumin.  If it's very wet, strain the bowl, then set the bread aside.  Add a small amount of oil to a frying pan and warm over a medium flame.  Once hot, add a few bread cubes to the pan.  The bread will sink a little as it bakes.  You may need to do two batches depending on the size of your pan.  Brown the bread on the 2nd side.  Keep turning pieces, browning each batch with the oil from the pan.  Remove to a plate.  Repeat steps 6 to 7 until all bread is cut into squares, or you have used up all the mixture.  Serve warm or at room temperature.  You can also serve this just as is and if you like, put into a bowl, cover and put in the fridge until you need it.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,beef brisket,bamboo shoot,ginger,sugar snap pea,maple syrup,plum tomato,dill weed
title: Beef Bamboo Salad
ingredients: 1 trimmed beef brisket | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 2 tablespoons fat-free maple syrup | 4 tablespoons sugar snap peas | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 plum tomato, halved, seeded, and chopped | 1 beef chuck roast, trimmed | 1/4 cup canned sliced green fresh dill weed
instructions: Spray crockpot with nonstick cooking spray or oil.  Combine beef with dill and maple syrup in crockpot.  Add the sugar snap peas, ginger, bamboo shoots, tomato, and beef.

title: Rough Vegetables for the Brave and Black Man
ingredients:
1 large white onion, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs mixed vegetables ( spinach, carrots, cauliflower, celery stalks, etc.
    - ) | 2 lbs coarse salt pork, such as rump, cubed | 1 pint vegetable stock
instructions: Place the vegetables in a heavy saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for about 1 hour until the vegetables are completely cooked.  Remove the cover, increase the heat, and simmer, uncovered, for another 45 minutes, or until the vegetables are cooked.  Remove from the heat and allow to stand for 15 minutes before serving.  Note, there should be very little water left in the saucepan.  Make sure to drain the vegetables before you start cooking them in order to get rid of excess moisture.

title: Guinness Cucumber Pickles
ingredients: 1/2 cucumber, peeled | 3 tablespoons white miso ( shiro ) | 3 tablespoons liqueur or 3 tablespoons white rum | 3 1/2 fluid ounces guinness stout | hot steamed rice or noodles ( optional ) | fresh jalapeno pepper ( optional )
instructions: Slice cukes thickly and place in a bowl with the miso and liqueur.  Mix and set aside for about 30 minutes.  Drain the liquid and chill in the fridge for about 1 hour.  Serve in a small glass containers and serve with steamed rice or noodles if desired.

title: Spiced Mashed Potatoes and Cheese
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes | 2 large onions, sliced | 8 ounces gruyere cheese, shaved | 1 red capsicum, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon mango chutney
instructions: Scrub the potatoes clean.  Place them in a pan with the onions, capsicum and chutney.  Simmer for around 20 minutes, until softened.  Meanwhile, fry the potato slices in olive oil until golden brown.  Serve alongside.

title:
D's Japanese Quinoa and Grapefruit Salad.
    -
ingredients: 4 cups quinoa | 1 cup grapefruit juice | 1 -2 teaspoon ajinomoto
instructions: Rinse quinoa well in a strainer and rinse well.  Drain in a strainer until water runs clear.  In a medium sized container, bring grapefruit juice and ajinomoto to a boil.  Cover and reduce heat, simmering for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,rye bread,canola oil,cayenne pepper,oyster sauce,curry powder
title: Grilled Oysters With Coriander Blend
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup chopped toasted hazelnuts | 1/2 tablespoon sweet curry powder | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Combine the nuts and curry powder in a large bowl.  Mix in the oyster sauce.  Add salt and cayenne pepper to taste.  Set aside.  Soak the rye bread slices on the counter, for 2 - 3 minutes each side.  Brush with oil and grill over medium high heat, on all sides, for 2 - 3 minutes or until lightly toasted.  Cut each piece of toast into 4 triangles and serve with the coriander sauce.

title: Apple Cider
ingredients: 4 pounds potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 3/4 cup apple cider
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain and allow to steam dry for a minute or two.  Drain the potatoes, return to the pot, and stir in the apple cider.  Cover and continue to cook over medium heat until the potatoes are coated with the cider.

title: Cottage Bites
ingredients: 1 package salt pork, cut in slices | 1 stick celery, cut into sticks | 8 ounces cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Brown salt pork in a large skillet.

title: Baked Seitan
ingredients: 2 lbs seitan ( or similar meat ) | 1 can beets, drained | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon curry powder ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Cut seitan into small chunks about 2” in size.  Place in a 9 x 13 dish.  Combine remaining ingredients in a 1 gallon freezer bag or large ziploc bag with 2 - ¾ inch of space for heat circulation.  Put seitan chunks in bag and add to bag with other ingredients.  Shake so seitan is coated evenly, or seal bag if you don’t want large chunks.  Place bag in fridge to chill before baking.  The longer you let it set the better it will taste.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Bake for 45 - 50 minutes, until meat is browned. .

title: Lamb Shank Loaf
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 5 lamb shanks | 2 -3 chinese cabbage, shredded | mature topping ( optional )
instructions: Wash lamb and remove any excess fat.  Slice lamb into 1 inch cubes.  Place lamb in crockpot.  Cover with cabbage.  Add mature topping to taste.  Cook on high for 3 - 4 hours.  When you remove lamb let it rest for 10 - 15 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,cilantro leaf,white vinegar,picante sauce,french,beef brisket,french mustard,sunflower oil
title: Santa Fe-Style Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 trimmed beef brisket | 3 tablespoons pickled cranberries | 6 fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 4 teaspoons white vinegar | 2 teaspoons prepared french mustard | 6 fluid ounces picante sauce | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl combine the pickled cranberries and 3 tablespoons of the remaining pickled cranberries.  Set the brisket aside.  In a small nonreactive dish, combine the oil, vinegar, mustard and 1/4 cup of chopped cilantro.  Add the mustard mixture to the oil mixture and toss well.  Place a second layer of brisket on the plastic wrap and then coat with the dressing.  Use scissors or skewers to spear the brisket.  Repeat for the other brisket.  Cover the meat with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 1 hour.  Preheat the broiler.  Remove the brisket from the plastic wrap and place on a baking sheet.  Lightly brush the brisket with the remaining dressing, cover with aluminum foil and broil on high, turning once, for 30 to 45 minutes, or until the temperature reaches 160 degrees f.  Meanwhile, prepare the picante sauce.  Place the remaining 1/4 cup of white cilantro leaves on a small platter or in a bowl.  When the brisket is done, slice the brisket across the grain into thin slices, approximately 2 1/4 inches long.  Spread 1/4 cup of picante sauce on the bottom of a shallow serving platter.  Place a slice of brisket across the picante sauce.  Spoon remaining picante sauce over the brisket.  Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup of fresh cilantro leaves on top.

title: Savory French Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon vinegar | fresh chives, chopped | salad greens | roasted rotisserie chicken or turkey | rye bread
instructions: Cut the french bread into about 4 long slices.

title: Cardamom Martini
ingredients: 1 ounce amaretto | 1 1/2 ounces vodka ( preferably cointreau or similar brand ) | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds, crushed
instructions: Pour amaretto, vodka and crushed cardamom seeds into a cocktail shaker or other highball glass and shake well to combine.  Strain and serve.

Random Ingredients: flour,deli ham,sesame seed oil,bay leaf,yellow onion,pecan
title: Ham Lovers Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs deli ham | 1/2 cup sesame seed oil | 1 small yellow onion, minced | 4 cups flour | 2 teaspoons caraway seed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup pecans, coarsely chopped ( optional ) or 1/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place ham in a large pan over medium heat and cover with water.  You should have about 3 quarts of water in a large pot.  Bring to a boil and skim off the foam that rises to the surface at the boil.  As soon as the foam subsides, stir in the olive oil, onions and 2 cups of the flour.  Whisk the mixture into the hot ham and water.  Simmer over low heat until the dough is very smooth, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f, spray a jelly roll pan with cooking spray and spread evenly with the remaining 4 cups of flour, or more if needed, to make a 6x12 in size rectangle.  Slice the rectangle into 1/2 thick slices and place on the prepared pan with the ham and cover with the remaining 1 cup of flour, adding a bit of flour as needed to make a firm, slightly flattened dough.  Spray the top of the dough with cooking spray and bake it for 45 minutes, until lightly browned, bubbling, and crispy.  Remove from the oven and spread the pecans on top before cutting into 12 equal squares.  Variation, i sometimes sprinkle the ham with chopped fresh parsley before serving.

title: Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1 pint chickpeas, washed | 1/4 cup sultana | 1 teaspoon caraway seed, crushed | 12 small lettuce leaves
instructions: Soak the sultanas in hot water until they plump up a little, then drain them well and set them aside.  Boil the chickpeas till soft, then mash them with a potato masher till they resemble fine paste.  Mix in the chickpeas and sultanas.  Add the crushed caraway seeds.  Allow to cool slightly.  Line a serving plate with lettuce leaves.  Spoon on the chickpea mixture and serve.

title: Moroccan Quinoa for Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quinoa | 1/2 cup olive, sliced

title: Indonesian Beef Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, sliced to 1/4 inch pieces | 6 -12 ounces tamarind pulp or 6 -12 ounces lemon juice, about one 28 ounce can | 2 tablespoons corn flour | cold water | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp ( fresh, frozen or fresh ) | 1 large leek | 1 small cayenne ( optional ) or 2 large chili peppers
instructions: For the sauce,.  Put the tamarind pulp or juice into a blender or food processor or chop the tamarind pulp with the tamarind water.  Set aside.  Peel and finely chop the leek, the amount you like, and the amount of green parts as you like. .  Chop the peppers.  If you like your sauce with a little watery texture, set up a small bowl of a few tablespoons or tamarind flavored shortening or butter in the freezer for a few hours or overnight to make easier to work with later.  You should have about two cups.  To add the oil to a large heavy skillet over medium heat, add half of the beef and sauté until brown.  Remove beef pieces and set aside.  Repeat with the rest of the beef.  Remove the fat from the skillet and deglaze by boiling water.  Add to pan the green parts of the leek stalk and sauté for 15 - 20 minutes.  Add the peppers and sauté for another 15 - 20 minutes.  Add salt, soy sauce and tamarind liquid.  Stir well.  Add beef to pan and simmer for a few minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken (Indian-Style)
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons white poppy seeds ( available at indian markets or online ) | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped | 2 cups chicken stock ( optional ) | 8 large tortillas, warmed | 2 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Place chicken breast halves between 2 pieces of heavy plastic wrap.  Using your fingers, rub the poppy seeds on both sides of the chicken, then coat chicken thoroughly with poppy seeds.  Place in refrigerator to marinate, 10 minutes.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Add half of the cilantro leaves.  Cook, stirring often, until the leaves are wilted and aromatic, about 10 minutes.  Stir in chicken stock and continue to cook and stir until the liquid evaporates, about 5 more minutes.  Place a second piece of plastic wrap on the top, and carefully flip the breast halves over in a thin layer.  Set this aside at room temperature.  Repeat with all chicken breasts.  When ready to cook, place the tortillas on a serving plate.  Spoon some chicken into each tortilla, then top with more cilantro, half of the remaining cilantro, and/or more chicken.  Serve at once with spanish rice or your fava rice.

title: Chicken Chorizo Wrapped in Lettuce

instructions: Preheat a bbq or griddle to high, set aside the sausages, and toast them on both sides, turning only once, for approximately 5 minutes and then remove to a warm plate using slotted spoon and allow to cool. Split the rolls and place the halves on the foil lined bbq and spread with the chorizo mixture. title: Grecian Cucumber Salad

Serve at room temperature.

Spread marshmallows onto cooked beef so that it covers the beef with the mixture and serve.

instructions: Place the black beans and tomatoes in a heat proof bowl mix with 1/2 cup cold water and set aside. Sprinkle with fresh herbs, serve immediately.

title: Grasshopper Baked Sweet Mustard
