Spread 1 tablespoon of the crumb mixture onto the waxed paper, making sure all crumbs are covered and shaking off any excess.  Place the crumb mixture in a pastry bag fitted with a medium size plain tip with a 1 inch round tip or the tip of a sharp knife.  Pipe the mustard onto the waxed paper, making sure they are not crowded.  You may need to use more than one crumb mixture.  Repeat the process for the remaining crumbs.  The mustard may be sprinkled generously with more sugar and a second teaspon of crushed peppercorns if they are not.  Roll the bag in the remaining crumbs.  Let it dry for 30 minutes, then chill.  You can store, tightly covered, for up to 3 days.

title: Caryn's Duck
ingredients: 2 duck breasts, split | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 cup fish stock | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/4 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Bring the duck breasts to a boil.  Remove the duck and place in a roasting pan or serving platter.  Pour the chicken stock and fish stock into the pan.  Place the duck on top of the stock.  Cover with a tight fitting lid or place in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours to marinate the duck for better flavor.  Remove the duck from the pan and place on the top rack of the oven on broil to desired brownness, about 10 minutes.  Remove the duck and top the legs with the thawed whipped topping.  Return to the oven to melt the duck and caramelize the liquid.

Random Ingredients: backfin crab meat,white mushroom,french bread,chili sauce,cocoa powder,dark soy sauce,date,kidney bean
title: Lite Crab and Chinese Mushrooms Crostini
ingredients: 2 cans organic kidney beans ( drained ) | 2 cans organic white mushrooms ( with the stems ) | 2 containers organic strong chili sauce ( no-name soup base, no-name mushroom soup base ) | 1 bottle dark soy sauce | 4 boxes french bread | 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 1 1 lb backfin crab meat, chopped coarsely | 1 bunch dates, diced ( optional )
instructions: Empty canned beans into a large stockpot along with the mushrooms, chili sauce and dark soy and bring to a boil.  Once the chili starts boiling turn down heat to a simmer.  Slice the french bread in half lengthwise and then soak in hot water to soften.  Squeeze out excess water and toss in the crostini.  Mix the crab with the cocoa and add to the crostini.  Mix the dates into the crostini.  You can eat the mixture right away, but the taste will improve with that.

title: Homemade Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon juice, fresh | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, stirring to mix well.  Cover with plastic wrap and allow to rest 20 minutes at room temperature.  Using a pizza paddle, form into a ball by stretching the blade of your pestle.  Dip in water.  Drain well and serve.  Store refrigerated, in ziploc bags.

title: Thai Grilled Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup fish sauce | 1 teaspoon coriander powder ( or equivalent )
instructions: Mix the coriander and fish sauce together.  Thin with some water or brine if necessary.  Set aside.  Grill or pan fry the fish until cooked.  Serve immediately or refrigerate for a bit of the spice for later.  You can add other sauces or eat as is.

Random Ingredients: msg,coriander seed,pea,rice wine vinegar,cremini mushroom,pizza crust
title: Wild Mushroom & Rice Cones
ingredients:
2 medium cremini mushrooms ( about 1 lb.
    - ) | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried coriander seeds | 2 packages prepared pizza crust | 1 package frozen peas, thawed, divided | 1 tablespoon msg ( optional )
instructions: In a small jar with a lid, stir together the mushrooms, rice vinegar and coriander.  Unwrap the mushrooms.  Slice the mushrooms into thin, uneven slices, and sprinkle both sides of the pizza dough with half the parmesan cheese.  Spoon equal amounts of the mushroom mixture among the pizza crusts.  Scatter the peas over the top of the pizza crusts.  Sprinkle with msg and the remaining cheese.  Bake in a 350 f.  Oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Rice Noodle Almond Salad
ingredients: 2 cups rice noodles | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.  Stir in almond extract until well blended.  Let cool, but serve.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,apple butter,ginger juice,cannellini bean,chicken broth,rice,linguine
title: Ziti With Red Beans in Apple butter
ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth ( can use low sodium ) | 8 ounces ziti pasta or 8 ounces other tubular pasta | 2 tablespoons apple butter | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger juice | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked rice ( can use long grain if desired ) | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a 10 - 12 inch skillet.  Add ziti pasta.

title: Spicy Chicken Kabobs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried marjoram, or to taste | 1 tablespoon dried red chile pepper, or to taste | 1 pound cooked chicken meat, cut into thin strips | 1/4 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Mix marjoram, red chile pepper, and chicken in a bowl, mix well.  Thread chicken strips onto soaked bamboo skewers.  Grill skewers until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side, or to desired doneness.

title: Grammy's Artful Pastry With Mandarin or Fruit
ingredients: 200 g frozen mixed fruit | 50 g seedless rye flour | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 4 mandarin oranges | 8 -10 mixed seeds free fruit, peeled
instructions: Slice fresh fruit into cubes, discarding any damaged sections.  Put all ingredients together except for the frozen grated mix ingredients into a food processor.  Add food processer until dough starts to form a ball.  Refrigerate for 2 hours.  Divide dough into 24 equal balls.  Flatten each, wrap in wax paper.  In plastic bag, put each ball onto a lightly floured surface, cover with plastic wrap, and place on a tray in the freezer until solid.  Remove dough from freezer and roll out into 1 inch thickness.  Cut out desired shapes and place on baking tray.  Bake at 425 deg for around 20 minutes or until lightly browned.  Eat in slices, using a spoon.

title: Corn and Black Beans (South Beach Diet Friendly)
ingredients: 1 corn, fresh, cut from cob ( about 2 cups ) | 1 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Prepare corn as directed.  Meanwhile, place corn, covered, in a shallow baking dish and sprinkle with cumin.  Bake 30 minutes or until heated through and corn is lightly golden.

title: Mushroom Caps on Skewers
ingredients: 2 large mushroom caps, trimmed | 1/4 cup peanut butter
instructions: Combine the peanut butter into a large skillet over medium high heat and heat until bubbly and slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.  Stir in the mushroom caps just before serving.  They are best served immediately.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,cabbage,green cardamom pod,green chili,chervil,tomato green chilies
title: Tomato Oats With Cabbage (Dajajaj Mahed Saag)
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking oats | 2 large tomatoes and green chilies | 1 small head cabbage | 2 tablespoons cooking oats | green chili, sliced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chervil
instructions: Boil the oats and leave to cool.  Wash, pat dry, cut into quarters and place to one side in an airtight container, add a handful of water and mix.  Place the tomatoes, chillies, chervil and oatmeal and mix well.  Cover the container and refrigerate the mixture.  To serve, leave to cool slightly.  Unwrap, add some chopped coriander and/or chopped fresh cilantro to top.

title: Chiles Rellenos and Provolone
ingredients: 12 ounces monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 4 red chiles, sliced | 4 ounces prosciutto | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 cup fresh red chile, cut into thin strips
instructions: Arrange bell pepper slice on serving platter.  Top with red pepper slices, prosciutto strips and allspice.  Sprinkle with chiles.  Serve with pumpernickel cocktail or rye bread.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,graham cracker crumb,pork roast,brown onion,rotini pasta,chilies
title: Slow Cooker Carnitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork roast, cut into cubes | 3 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 brown onion, grated | 1 can rotini pasta, drained | 1 can diced chilies, drained
instructions: In a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, toss pork with creole seasoning until well coated.  Sprinkle crumbs in slow cooker.  Top with onion and sausage.  Add remaining ingredients.

title: Souches With Tou Cheong Beef
ingredients: 1 loaf sourdough bread | cooking oats ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1 tablespoon yellow sweet pepper, finely chopped ( also known as red pepper )
instructions: Slice the loaf of sourdough into 3 or 4 wedges each.  Cut away the top crust of the bread in half and cut out the crust about 1/4 inch below the crust.  Cut 1 strip of bread at a time around a rounded star shaped piece of bread.  Cut off the tip of a wedge of bread the so you end up with a 1 inch star shaped opening.  Repeat until all the bread is used/wedges.  Place the bread pieces into a large bowl or dish.  Sprinkle with brown sugar, mirin or sweet wine.  Stir well to combine and let mixture marinate at least 30 minutes, but not more than one hour.  Pour mixture over the bread.  Sprinkle with yellow pepper and stir to combine.  Cover and refrigerate 3 - 4 hours to let flavors blend.  Preheat grill and heat to medium high.  Oil grate with olive oil or butter.  Grill burgers until done to your liking.  Serve on a warm bun, with a dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,vanilla essence,sherry,sun tomato oil,shallot,kiwi fruit
title: Sun-Dried Tomatoes & Kiwi Salsa
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 2 shallots, sliced | 2 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled, sliced into thin rounds | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients.  Toss to coat.

title: Baked Geel Masala (Indian Sticky Rice Balls)
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, washed and soaked | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Wash the rice and soak it in water for 15 minutes.  Drain it and dry it by brushing lightly with oil/butter mix or rubbing the grains dry with a cloth or absorbent paper.  Spread salt/ghee on your palms.  Cut the grains in small pieces/mold into a circle, about 1/2 inch thick.  Place them on a baking tray lined with baking paper and make a hole in each ball.  Sprinkle anise seeds on rice balls.  Set in a preheated oven 180 degrees celsius for about 20 minutes.  Check the time by poking anise seeds in between.  If seeds do not burn at all, remove the oven for another 10 minutes.

title: Dawn's Borracho Beans Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh lavender | 2 tablespoons jalapeno juice
instructions: Combine beans and lavender in a bowl.  Stir in jalapeno juice to taste.  Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Simple German Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 quarts half-and-half cream
instructions: Cook kielbasa pieces in peanut oil in a large heavy dutch oven over medium heat, stirring to brown just a hint of color, 8 - 10 minutes or until lightly colored but not cooked all the way through.  Pour half and half into the pan and bring to a boil.  Cover and reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,shrimp,pork,white pepper,lemon lime beverage,salt black pepper
title: Lemon Noodle Cocktail
ingredients:
4 ounces hot pork fat | 1 tablespoon lemon-lime beverage | 3 ounces shrimp, cooked ( see note in introduction ) | 12 ounces egg noodles, prepared according to pkg.
    - directions | salt & freshly ground black pepper | white pepper
instructions: Note, a fresh shrimp is usually the best when cooked in small bites.  Slice the shrimp into thin wedges or 1/4 inch wide slivers.  In a large bowl, whisk together the ingredients.  Pour half the mixture into 4 martini glasses.  Garnish with a sliver or fresh parsley sprig if desired.

title: Scotch Broiled Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb scallops, whole | 1 ounce veal fat
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil.  Place scallops in a bowl.  Put fat in a frying pan over medium heat.  Cook scallops, turning only once, until brown on both sides, about 5 minutes.  Do not overcook, or scallops will shrink during cooking.  Remove scallops from water and dip in a bowl of salt.  Place scallops on a hot rack of a broiler pan.  Place pan under broiler 1 - 2 minutes.  Turn scallops over and broil for additional 2 to 3 minutes.  Turn scallops once again and broil for an additional 3 to 5 minutes.  Remove scallops from heat.  Serve scallops hot or at room temperature.

title: Mock Devonshire Scones
ingredients: 3 cups self-rising flour | 1/4 cup unsweetened chocolate, melted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f.  In a bowl, mix together the flour and melted chocolate.  Sprinkle a tablepoon of the melted chocolate over the flour mixture.  Mix well until the dough is evenly moistened, then knead until smooth.  Roll out the dough to about a 1/8 thick, 6 inches thick, and cut into 3 equal parts.  Using a round, dull edged cookie cutter, cut each part of the scones into 6 wedges.  Arrange on an ungreased baking sheet.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the scones are lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,pineapple chunk,jicama,tequila,tilapia fillet,brown mustard seed
title: Jicama and Pineapple Tuling a Bottle
ingredients: 2 lbs jicama ( jicama ) or 2 lbs butternut squash ( jicama ) | 1/4 cup tequila | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 1/2 cup orange juice | 3 tablespoons pineapple chunks ( from an apricot halves or small cactus cubes ) or 3 tablespoons canned pineapple chunks ( from an apricot halves or small cactus cubes ) | 8 tilapia fillets
instructions: Place jicama, squash, tequila and mustard seeds in a large skillet.  Cook over medium high heat for 3 to 4 minutes until jicama begins to soften.  Stir in orange juice and pineapple pieces.  Remove from heat.  Cover and allow to stand for 10 minutes.  Remove skins from fish and place fish, skin sides down, in the skillet and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until fish flakes when tested with a fork.

title: Tin and Tangy Roasted Green Pea Sprouts
ingredients: 1 can french onion soup | 1/4 cup tahini | 12 medium lemons grass root, peeled, cut into 6 sections and crushed ( optional ) | 2 -3 cups whole, unpeeled ripe olives, drained ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  In a medium dutch oven or oven safe dish, mix soup and tahini.  Add lemons and onions if using and stir to mix thoroughly.  Add olives, if desired.  Place in oven and bake for 5 minutes, then lower temperature to 350 degrees f and bake for 1 hour to 1/2 hour, until vegetables are tender.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,serrano chili pepper,almond essence,curry powder,italian sausage hot,sirloin,quinoa
title: Sausage, Pepper & Pepper Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1 tablespoon ground sirloin | 3 slices italian sausage ( hot or sweet, sliced into 1/2-inch-thick slices ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon roasted & salted quinoa ( from a jar ) | 1/4 cup crumbled queso fresco | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic paste or 1 teaspoon hot red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions.  Drain, toss quinoa with the curry powder and leave to cool.  Combine beef, quinoa & salted quinoa in a bowl.  Tear italian sausage into bite size pieces.  Add meat to quinoa, tossing to coat in curry powder.  Sprinkle queso fresco over the top.  Sprinkle chili garlic paste on top. .

title: Chinese Sweet Peanuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey ( can be replaced with fish or chicken flavor if desired ) | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 3 cardamom pods, cracked & crushed | 1 lb pecan ( optional ) | freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Combine honey and oyster sauce, add cardom pods.  Rinse & dry the nuts, then place in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Sprinkle with ground black pepper to taste, then scatter over the nuts.  Bake until peanuts are toasted, about 40 - 45 minutes.  If nuts are a little browned, watch carefully.  Serve warm.

title: Lazy Quinoa Stoup
ingredients: 6 cups water | 1/3 cup za'atar split sweet chili | 100 g quinoa or 100 g red quinoa, rinsed | 100 g swiss chard | 1 small yellow pepper, diced ( i used jalapeno ) | 1 cup lima beans | 8 peppercorns, crushed | 1 teaspoon knorr extra-virgin olive oil or 1 teaspoon lite olive oil
instructions: In a 4 quart saucepan combine the water with the za’atar, quinoa, chard, bell pepper, lima beans, and peppercorns.  Bring to a boil.  Turn the heat down to a simmer and cover.  Simmer for 40 minutes remove from the heat and let stand covered for another 10 minutes.  Stir a few times.  Note, i left this in the pan to warm up and i did not rinse the chard leaves.  Note, also when adding the vegetables and spices mix the soup will be thicker.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,taco seasoning,oregano sprig,clove,red chilies,dark soy sauce,thyme leave
title: My Version of Chili
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, boneless trimmed and cut into 3 1/2-by-1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon dried oregano sprig | 6 dried red chilies | 6 cloves | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme leave
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until the meat falls apart, about 2 hours.  Remove from heat.  Transfer the meat to a bowl, reserving most of the cooking liquid, and let cool slightly.  Discard the solids.  Place the reserved cooking liquid in a small dutch oven and bring to a boil over high heat.  Add the onion, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add the meat and simmer for 20 minutes more.  Remove the meat and the onion and discard the onions.  Strain the liquid and pour the liquid into a container or bowl.  Place meat, onions and onion flavored liquid back into the stockpot and add water to cover and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until meat is very tender, about 1 1/2 hours.  Remove the meat, cover and refrigerate overnight.  Skim any excess fat that rises to the top.  Serve with shredded lettuce, cheese and sour cream.

title: Baked Okra
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated tahini | 2 eggs | 6 fresh sage leaves, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground star anise | 2 pounds eggplant, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 pound frozen okra | 1 tablespoon dry bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a bowl, mix together tahini, eggs, sage, and star anise.  Arrange slices of eggplant in a glass baking dish.  Sprinkle with okra.  Dot with bread crumbs, and top with the tahini mixture.  Bake 30 to 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

title: Mock Beef Jerky
ingredients: 2 lbs meatballs | 1 1/2 ounces metaxa brandy
instructions: Dip meat in molasses and sprinkle with salt, rubbing in as much fat as possible.  Bake for 2 hours at 275°f.  The meat should be browned and crispy.  Pulverize in a food processor and serve as a snack with a dollop of yoghurt on top.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,leek,apple cider vinegar,self raising flour,mango chutney
title: Apple Leek Fritters
ingredients: 600 g leeks | 120 ml apple cider vinegar, chilled | 120 g natural self-raising flour | 200 ml mango chutney, chopped | salt and pepper
instructions: Peel the leeks and cut off the root ends.  Rinse off any soil or sand, then trim the roots and discard.  Slice into about half inch lengths.  In a large bowl combine the leeks and 1 tablespoon of water and stir, then leave to stand for 15 minutes.  Pour the vinegar into a medium sized bowl, and add 125ml water to make a dressing of 100mls.  Add the flour and stir to make a thick paste.  Drain the leeks and dry thoroughly.  Mash the leeks thoroughly with a fork.  If the batter is too thick, add a little water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until your desired consistency is achieved.  Fill a large bowl with cold water, and pour in the batter all at once.  Leave for about 15 minutes or until the batter thickens.  Add the chopped mango chutney, toss to coat everything, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,vegetable,milk ricotta cheese,golden raisin,corn chip,beef tenderloin,rigatoni pasta,kiwi fruit
title: Peruvian Style Beef Stuffed Kiwifruit With Rigatoni
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 12 ounces dark beer ( a good one ) | 32 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 6 ounces kiwi fruits, sliced ( frozen ) | 1/2 cup golden raisin ( frozen ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta ( frozen ) | corn chips, for garnish ( optional ) | vegetables, of your choice ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees.  Cut a 1/4 inch deep slit in each side of beef and stuff well with ricotta cheese.  Place beef in an oven proof pan for approximately 35 minutes.  Remove beef from oven and cool.  Shred beef with 2 or 3 forks into small pieces.  Put meat back in pan and mix it with kiwifruit and golden raisins.  Bake for approximately 40 - 50 minutes.  While beef is baking, cook rigatoni according to package directions, drain and mix with other 1/4 cup of yogurt.  If serving with corn chips and vegetables, sprinkle with additional dark beer and some cayenne pepper to your taste.  Serve beef topped with yogurt and a bit of the shredded cheddar if desired.

title: Coleslaw With Watermelon & Radishes
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh water | 1 small red cabbage ( medium ) | 1/2 cup diced seedless watermelon | 3 -4 small radishes, julienned | 1/4 cup toasted aioli, to taste ( or horseradish-based )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the water with the buttermilk until a small lump is formed.  Cut the cabbage in half, removing the core and thick stem.  Cut into 1/4 slices.  Heat a small skillet over high heat.  Add the watermelon and radish, and steam until the vegetables are crisp tender and have released their water, about 4 minutes, then remove all the vegetables from the pan and place them on a plate.  Return the pan to the heat and toss the vegetables until evenly coated with oil.  Remove the pan from the heat and add the toasted aioli.

title: Coco - Nutella Pasta Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/2 package tri-colored pretzels | 1 can flax seed, mixed with | 1 can lentils, drained | 16 ounces can tuna in water, drained | 16 ounces smoked cod, sliced and cut in chunks | 8 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | fresh ginger, minced | 12 toothpicks
instructions: In bowl combine pretzels, 1/4 cup of the coconut pesto sauce and 1/4 cup of the ginger.  Stir in remaining ingredients and adjust seasoning if necessary.  Serve in toothpicks.

title: Red Wine Balsamic and Basil Salad
ingredients: 1 lemon, zested | 1 lemon, juice of | 120 g basmati rice, washed and drained | 120 g dry red wine vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the lemon zest in 100ml boiling water over a medium heat in a small pan, then remove from heat.  Place into a screw top jar.  Add the water and then stir to combine.  Cover the jar, and place onto the grill.  Grill for 5 - 7 minutes, or until golden at the edges.  Remove from heat, transfer to a bowl and leave to cool, then drain.  Wash and dry your salad or mix together and serve.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: walnut,pear,red cabbage,cabbage,taco seasoning mix,chicken,red onion,baby beet
title: Taco Chicken and Beet Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces baby beets | 1 small red onion, chopped | 1 cup shredded red cabbage ( about 1 small head ) | 1/2 cup shredded red radish ( about 6 small ) | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts, toasted | 1 medium bag shredded cooked chicken, chilled | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup shredded carrot, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.  Line a jelly roll pan with foil and arrange beets on it.  Bake for 20 minutes or until tender.  Cool and then peel, then using a small sharp knife, trim off the beets.

title: Baby Carrots W-Breadcrumbs (Kesker Spatzda)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 lb baby carrots, peeled | 8 slices white bread ( about 24 inches long, each slice should be about 6 inches long each )
instructions: Heat oil in large nonstick skillet on medium high.  Add carrots.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,carrot,beef consomme,ginger garlic paste,italian salad dressing mix,lamb shank
title: Lamb Shanks for Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 lamb shanks | 1 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 can beef consomme, undiluted | 1 lime wedge | 2 small carrots, with the tails on
instructions: Place shanks in crock pot.  Mix together the italian salad dressing mix, ginger garlic paste and consomme in a small bowl.

title: Rajas Con Jerez
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces serrano chilies | 2 ounces fresh parsley | 6 ounces rum | 1/2 teaspoon fresh red chile | 1 1/2 ounces sweet sherry wine or 1 1/2 ounces dry white wine
instructions: Chop chiles, parsley and sherry or any spirit you like to taste.  Stir together and strain.  Can be eaten immediately.  Note you can use other flavours like apple cider vinegar, vinegar, lemon juice, pineapple juice or red pepper sauce.  This is also great wiht prawns.

title: Queso Blanco (Veal Zurich)
ingredients: 4 lbs veal, cut in 2-inch cubes | 1 bouquet garni ( consisting of 1 parsley leaves, 2 bay leaves and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon, or 3 whole sprigs of thyme ) | 3 sprigs mixed spice | 1 chinese roasted poblano chile ( aji amarillo or anjou ) | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | spices or salt | 3 tablespoons fine dry vermouth or 3 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 pinch ground szechwan pepper
instructions: In a large soup pot combine all the ingredients, except the sherry and szechwan pepper.  Mix for around 5 minutes to a minute or until smooth.  Cover and cook on low to medium heat until the meat has all fallen off the bones.  Remove the cover and stir.  Cook on high stirring occasionally to avoid scorching the meat.  Cook until meat has caramelized to a rich rich brown color and the liquid has been reduced.  Serve at once in bowls.  Top with sherry or sweet vermouth or dry vermouth if desired.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,cremini mushroom,orange peel,asafoetida powder,orange,baking potato
title: Mushroom Korma -- Indian Fries (Peshkali)
ingredients: 10 medium baking potatoes, peeled sliced in quarters | 4 cups asafoetida powder ( deepak ) | 1/4 head of sliced cremini mushroom | 1 teaspoon baking potato, grated | 1 small orange peel, cut into 2 pieces | 1 fresh orange, cut into two pieces ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f.  Place sliced potatoes on a medium cookie sheet.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool potatoes for 5 minutes while you prepare the other ingredients.  After removing the potato from the oven, place the cut side up on the cookie sheet.  Sprinkle the cut side with the grated baking potato and the asafoetida powder over the potatoes.  Bake at 400 f for 20 minutes, or just until crust start to crisp and darken a little.  Remove from oven and sprinkle with the grated orange peel and freshly squeezed orange juice.  Serve.

title: Fruit Fried in Peanut Oil
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs strawberries | powdered peanut oil ( vegetable oil )
instructions: Remove the hulls from the strawberries and slice the strawberries in thin slices with a grater.  The slices should be about 1 inch thick.  Heat the oil in a 10 inch skillet or deep fryer to 400 degrees f and fry the strawberries until they are tender and lightly browned, about 3 minutes.  Remove from the pan immediately and sprinkle with powdered peanut oil.

title: Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 6 ounces milk chocolate candy bars, chopped | 1 liter marinara sauce
instructions: Put the melted sugar & marinara sauce in a large mug / saucepan.  Bring to the simmer over a low heat & stir until melted & combined.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: jicama,red chile pepper,cream tartar,tabasco sauce,garlic clove
title: Spicy Italian Salsa
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 red chile peppers | 1 large garlic clove | 1 large jicama, peeled and diced | 2 -4 dashes tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Cut peppers into thin strips.  Peel garlic.  Mince garlic.  Chop jicama, making sure it's the small dice.  Add peppers, cream of tartar, and tabasco to food processor.  Pulse until all ingredients are mixed well.  Taste the sauce and add more tabasco if necessary.

Random Ingredients: mirin,plain flour,guacamole,self raising flour,arborio rice,parsnip,star anise
title: Caps of Nine Things
ingredients: 450 g arborio rice | 1 star anise | 1 teaspoon mirin | 110 g plain flour | 110 g self-raising flour ( sifted ) | 1/3 cup chopped parsnips | 1 teaspoon guacamole
instructions: Place rice and star anise in a large bowl.  Sift flour into measuring cup then sift with combined flours and sifted parsnips into bowl.  Add guacamole and whisk until combined.  Using hands, add rice/star anise mixture, stirring until coated.  Place onto prepared tray and lightly flatten with the back of your fork.  Bake in a preheated oven for 15 minutes or until set.  Allow to cool for approximately 10 minutes.  Mark into squares with a sharp knife.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,pancetta,annatto oil,white pepper,basil pesto,baby corn
title: Roasted Beef Strips Au Jus
ingredients: 24 baby creamed corn | 12 slices pancetta | 3 tablespoons basil pesto | 1/2 tablespoon white pepper | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | annatto oil, to coat
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Slice beef thinly to yield about 11 thin strips.  Dry out the excess moisture.  Wash creamed corn quickly.  Place corn slices in a 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish and sprinkle with salt and pepper over it.  Add the sliced beef.  Top with remaining ingredients, coating each with olive oil.  Sprinkle with basil pesto.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.  Serve when beef is cool enough to handle.

title: Spicy Asafoetida
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pure chili paste | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Combine the chilli paste and 1/2 tbsp boiling water in a small bowl.  Stir well and let set for 10 minutes.  Use immediately.  This can also be used for green food.

title: Kibris (Fried Japanese Eggplant With Chiles and Rice)
ingredients: 3/4 lb japanese eggplant | 1/2 cup long-grain white rice ( preferably japanese eggplant ) | 1 1/2 cups simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 1 medium white cayenne pepper ( seeds and veins removed ) | 1/4 cup dry vermouth or 1/4 cup white wine | 1 1/2 cups italian plum tomatoes, rinsed and quartered | 2 pinches red cayenne pepper
instructions: Rinse the eggplants and place them directly over boiling water in a saucepan or dutch oven.  The water should cover them completely.  Turn the heat to high but do not boil.  Reduce the heat to very low and simmer the eggplants, covered, until tender, 20 to 25 minutes.  Drain the water, turn the heat to very low, leave the eggplants to cool, about 15 minutes.  Peel the eggplants and cut them lengthwise into slices about 1/2 inch thick.  Discard the stems.  Cut the potatoes into 1/2 inch thick rounds.  Remove the rind and core from the cayenne with a vegetable peeler and place it in a skillet or skillet over medium high heat.  Stir in the sweet vermouth or wine.  Place the tomatoes, potatoes, eggplants, and red cayenne into the skillet and heat until the mixture boils.  Place a towel over the top of the skillet and carefully, lower the heat.  Simmer the mixture until the vegetables are tender and the filling is hot.  Add the tomatoes and their liquid to the mashed potatoes.  Stir well and serve.

title: Cachupa

title: Tasty Indian Filter Oil
ingredients: 150 ml oil | 1 teaspoon turmeric ( optional )
instructions: Pour the turmeric powder in to the funnel.  Then pour the turmeric in this way.  Leave it on the funnel.  After 2 whistles, the funnel should have a continuous circular action like the one you had set aside in step #6 at the beginning of the cooking process.  If you put the funnel in the funnel too early, it will cause the funnel to burst open.  Otherwise, pour it in the funnel at the end of step #7 and let it drip through the funnel.  After 10 - 20 minutes, the funnel will not clear in the middle of cooking.  It should be clear.  This is called urad dal.  You can get this funnel in indian grocery stores.  This funnel can be bought at indian indian grocery stores as well as indian grocery stores.  It is a very popular powder for soups, salads and snacks.  Tip, make sure to make sure that the funnel does not go all the way through step #6 once in a while.  Once the funnel is clear, the funnel can be stuffed into a funnel with a funnel of turmeric.  Tip, for an aromatic taste, reduce the amount of turmeric powder to 1/2 if you leave it in the funnel in place and it is too strong.  You can reduce the amount of turmeric.

title: Beef and Pepperoni Stew

If your mixer does not have a whip attachment, take a swivel whip and whip the butter into it.  Once the water in your bowl is at the right temperature, pour the butter into the bowl. I usually add a little more water at a time& after that, add the rest of the water, i like to make sure the butter, salt & salt get all well incorporated. Cut the pastry into equal squares, approximately 25x 20.  Prick the tops of the pastries with a fork.  Cook in the oven for about 10 minutes until lightly browned.  Cut into quarters.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350/190/gas mark 6.  Place the chopped tomatoes on a baking board with 1 - 2 tsp of sage or other herbs.  Cook for approx 25 – 30 minutes.  Remove tomatoes and drain the fat that has risen to the top.  Sprinkle the rest of the sage on.  Leave to cool and harden for a bit.  Break up the meat.  This is best served as a raw side dish and is best served with the fish dishes we like.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,phyllo pastry,black bean,lime zest,apricot preserve,white tuna
title: Black Bean Triangles
ingredients: 1 can white tuna, drained | 2 cans black beans, drained | 1 cup apricot preserves ( store-bought or homemade ) | 2 tablespoons lime zest, finely minced | 1/4 cup ground cinnamon | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets ( thawed if frozen, thawed if frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a large bowl, toss together the tuna, black beans, apricot preserves, lime zest, and cinnamon.  Lay 2 sheets of phyllo pastry on top of each other on a work surface.  Top with 2 or 3 spoonfuls of the tuna mixture and 1 tablespoon of the black bean mixture and spread out to make 8 stacks.  Fold each stack into thirds, and roll into cigar shapes.  Place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet.  Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until bubbly.  Serve hot.

title: Easy Chicken Stock
ingredients: 1 large stewing chicken, boned with meat | 1 cup red wine | 2 teaspoons dried dill weed
instructions: Place chicken and the wine into a large, heavy stock pot or skillet.  Cover pot and bring to a simmer over medium heat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer, skimming any fat that rises to the top and allowing chicken and wine to separate and continue cooking until chicken is thoroughly cooked and falling off the back bone.  When finished, discard chicken and place pot on a cutting board and carefully remove all visible fat.  Allow the chicken to cool enough to handle using your hands, then shred meat and discard any bones.  Drain most of the liquid from the pan, leaving about 1 1/2 cups to skim the fat.  Return chicken back to soup pot, add 2 tablespoons of the fat from the pot and stir to mix.  This will make a thick and velvety stock with reduced fat chunks and bits of meat on the bottom of the pot.  Add the remaining fat from the pot and stir to blend with the stock pot juices to make a gravy.  Cook 5 minutes over low heat, stirring occasionally.  Stir in the dill, taste, and adjust seasoning before serving.

Random Ingredients: vodka,chuck steak,tomato sauce,mustard powder,lemon juice,white wine vinegar
title: Creamy Hungarian Beef
ingredients: 1 lb chuck steak, cut in cubes | 2 cans tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 teaspoon vodka
instructions: Combine tomato sauce, mustard, vinegar, and lemon juice in slow cooker.  Pour meat into slow cooker.  Make sure all pieces are covered with tomato mixture.  Cook on high for 3 - 4 hours.  Pour mixture over steak, and cook on high another hour or until steak is tender.

Random Ingredients: orange flower water,xanthan gum,extra beef,rotel tomato chilies,grape leaf,plain yogurt
title: Mexican Meatball and Grape Leaves
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 2 cans rotel tomatoes & chilies, drained | 32 grape leaves, washed | 2 tablespoons xanthan gum | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons orange flower water
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Line a large cookie sheet with aluminum foil.  In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and blend with your hands.  Roll heaping teaspoons of the mixture into balls.  Place balls on the cookie sheet. .  Bake for 20 minutes or until meatballs are cooked through.

title: Chermoula
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 15 fresh cilantro stems | 3 teaspoons tamari or 3 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup unsalted butter
instructions: Toast the coriander seeds in a dry skillet over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 3 minutes.  Transfer the seeds to a mortar and pestle or sieve and let cool to room temperature before grinding.  Grind the seeds using a mortar's pestle, pestle or a coffee grinder until powdery.  Transfer the spice powder to a small bowl and stir in the tamari or dark soy sauce.  In a skillet over medium low heat, melt the butter.  Add the shredded coriander and cook, shaking the pan often, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.  Add the butter and cook, stirring, until the butter is almost syrupy, about 3 minutes.  Taste and add more tamari, or salt, if needed.  Serve with bread or crostini.  It can be reseasoned with other flavors like cilantro, but it is never necessary.  It may also be stored in an airtight container for up to a week.

title: Applesauce Crusted Halibut

instructions: Place halibut in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  In a medium bowl, mix together flour, applesauce, and jalapeno.  Gradually pour mixture over fish.  Sprinkle top with ground black pepper.  Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight to marinate.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Bake fish uncovered in the preheated oven 15 minutes.  Uncover fish, and continue baking 15 more minutes, until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a large skillet over low heat.  Add mushrooms, chile, potato flakes and dill and cook until the mushrooms are soft and the liquid has thickened, about 10 minutes.  Stir in raisins and tamarind paste.  Cool completely before filling fritters.

title: Enchilada Noodle Salad with Beer

title: Granny's Potatoes

Place in the oven and cook for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through.

title: Faux Tangy Lamb With Sesame Crust

Place the onions on a cookie sheet, and place in the freezer.  For 20 minutes.  Remove from the freezer, and set aside.  Heat the vegetable broth over medium heat, and set aside.  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the onions and their juices, 1 teaspoon coriander seeds and 1/2 teaspoon turmeric together in a blender.  Puree until smooth, stopping occasionally to scrape the sides of the blender.  Pour the puree into an oven safe dish, and bake for 25 minutes.  Remove from the oven, and add more water to cover.  Place the dish on a baking sheet, and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Cod - Crock Pot

title: Green Beans & Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb french style green bean, trimmed & cut in 1 in pieces | 4 -5 medium idaho potatoes, peeled | 3 1/2 ounces firm white chocolate chips | 3/4 lb frozen cooked spinach leaves, thawed & squeezed dry | 12 pitted dates, halved | 1 jalapenos or 1 green chili pepper, minced | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon finely-chopped white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place potatoes, beans& chilies in saucepan and cover with cold water.  Bring to boil over high heat, then reduce to med low & simmer till potatoes are tender approx, 8 - 10 minutes.  Drain potatoes & beans and return to skillet.  Dilute white chocolate chips in remaining 1/2 cup cold water & stir till smooth stir in melted white chocolate& pepper to taste.  Gently stir into potato beans.  To make ahead, make ahead and cover tightly and let chill up to 3 days & reheat to near boiling.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,french bread,spinach leaf,egg,self rising flour,currant
title: Spinach Bread Bread and Pepper Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups thawed spinach leaves | 1 red bell pepper, diced | 2 cups self-rising flour, divided | 3 eggs, beaten | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 3/4 inch thick slices | 1/2 cup currants ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with parchment paper, and grease the paper.  Mix spinach and bell pepper in a microwave safe bowl.  Drizzle with 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, and cook on medium high power in the microwave until just wilted, about 2 minutes.  Remove and keep warm.  In a bowl, combine 2 cups flour, eggs and remaining 2 cups flour.  Set aside.  Slice bread into 2 inch thick slices.  Pour cooked spinach mixture over the bread, and sprinkle with currants.  Mix thoroughly.  Spoon mixture into prepared pan.  Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Artichoke (Beetroot) Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts | 2 tablespoons ghee | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt ghee over medium heat.  Sauté the artichoke hearts until they turn translucent.  Reserve the artichoke hearts and puree the hearts in a blender or food processor.  In a medium bowl, pour in the puree and the cilantro.  Stir to combine.  Cook the mixture for 5 minutes, or until the mixture is lightly browned.

title: Tropical Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb tomatoes, halved vertically | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 lemon zest, grated | 1/3 cup mixed dried fruit | 2 ounces blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Place the tomatoes and sunflower oil in a baking dish.  Bake for 20 minutes or until the tomatoes are very tender.  Toss the lemon rind with the mixed fruit and top with the tomatoes.  Scatter over the blue cheese.  Bake for a further 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sauce,black sesame seed,cooking spray,italian breadcrumb,beer,kernel corn,turmeric
title: Beer-And-Corn Sausage
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs sweet italian sausage ( casings removed ) | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1 packet hot sauce | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 12 -14 dashes black sesame seeds | cooking spray
instructions: Heat grill to medium.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,salsa,sherry wine vinegar,clear honey,chunky salsa,halibut fillet
title: Spanish Halibut
ingredients: 2 tablespoons clear honey | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 4 halibut fillets | 1 jar mild chunky salsa | 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 1/4 cup salsa
instructions: Make the honey glaze in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring well.  Add the honey and vinegar and simmer gently for 3 minutes.  Brush fillets with the glaze and season with salt and pepper.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place a baking sheet on the centre shelf of the oven and place fish in the oven.  Bake the fish until cooked through, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat the salsa and tomato sauce together until heated through.  Slice fish and serve.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,german chocolate,ranch dressing mix,strawberry ice cream,cheese,peanut oil
title: German Chocolate Mint Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 packages german sweet chocolate, broken into pieces | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 4 cups fresh strawberries and/or 4 cups frozen strawberries, cleaned and sliced | 1 package processed cheese, cut into small cubes
instructions: Heat peanut oil in a saucepan, but do not let it smoke.  Remove from heat.  Add chocolate and vinegar, stir until smooth and melted.  Remove from heat and stir in dressing mix.  Let cool until easy to handle, stirring occasionally.  Toss with strawberries and cheese cubes.  Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,beefsteak tomato,tortilla,vanilla bean,serrano chile pepper,peanut,london broil beef,jalapeno chile
title: Chile & Pepper Burritos
ingredients: 1 large serrano chile pepper, deseeded & finely diced | 1 jalapeno chile, deseeded & finely diced | 24 small tortillas | 1 can chopped beefsteak tomatoes | 4 slices colby-monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons peanuts ( toasted ) | 1/2 - 1 whole vanilla bean ( optional ) | 1/4 cup julienne-cut serrano chile pepper ( optional )
instructions: Roast or grill serrano chili, jalapeno & chile until tender.  Remove chile & discard.  Remove seeds from chile & finely dice.  Wrap tortillas in foil & warm in over at 450 degrees.  Assemble burritos, place a cheese slice over the tortilla & spread with the chile pepper.  Carefully add a slice of colby jack cheese & top with another cheese slice & sprinkle with peanuts.  Add the whole vanilla bean.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,italian tomato,cream celery soup,crabmeat,curry leaf,vegetable shortening,ketjap manis
title: Kathy's Easy Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles | 6 ounces crabmeat | 4 1/2 ounces french-fried crispy noodles | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 4 tablespoons ketchup | 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 2 tablespoons cream of celery soup
instructions: Brown crab meat in large skillet with shortening, drain and set aside.  In medium skillet, cook noodles in slightly warm water until just tender to bite.  Meanwhile, combine ketchup, tomatoes with liquid, and soup in a large bowl.  Pour noodles into saucepan, with soup, and toss well or use tongs.  Serve over hot rice noodles.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,ricotta cheese,coconut milk,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Ricotta Green Chile Dip
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 can diced green chilies | 1/2 cup skim-milk nonfat yogurt, for topping for dipping ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the ricotta cheese, 3/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt, green chilies and 3/4 cup nonfat yogurt.  Spread on top of a layer of nonfat yogurt.  If desired, drizzle extra yogurt on top of dip.

title: Halibut Parcels
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 large onion, thin slice | 1 medium yellow pepper, thin slice | 3 cups mixed vegetables, cut into wedges | 2 teaspoons ground coriander, divided | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 12 ounces halibut fillets, about 1 inch thick ( about 1 pound ) | 1 medium radish, sliced, about 1 cup ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.  Place 2 teaspoons oil in a small skillet over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,sausage,tamari,bread flour,gingerroot,spicy brown mustard,kidney bean
title: Kofta (Bean Bread)
ingredients: 1 lb sausage, casings removed | 2 tablespoons minced fresh gingerroot | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 cup spicy brown mustard | 1 tablespoon pam or 1 tablespoon spicy brown mustard | 1 1/2 cups country bread flour | 1 cup canned kidney beans
instructions: If the casings aren't already in one piece, cut them into half moon shapes, and cut into halves if not, press the halves together like a pie.  Cut the sausages in half and saute them over medium low heat, in 3 t.  Oil for about 10 minutes, or until starting to brown.  Set aside.  Combine the ginger root, tamari and spicy brown mustard.  Set aside and let sit for 10 to 15 minutes, depending on how spicy you like your mustard.  In a large mixing bowl, mix the bread flour and the beans.  Add the ginger and mix with your hands until a dough forms.  Add just enough of the mustard to bind, so that it forms a clump free lump free dough.  Put the dough into an oiled cake pan and smooth out the surface.  Dip each piece of dough in the flour mixture and press flat on the pan to make sure that all the pieces are smooth.  Heat the remaining oil over medium heat and brown the kofta.  Take out the kofta and drain off the excess oil, and let cool.

Random Ingredients: currant,fruit,garbanzo bean,pork neck,sriracha sauce,stock cube,panko breadcrumb,maraschino cherry
title: Bananas Daiquiri (Stuffed Pork Tenderloin)
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 lb pork neck or 1/2 lb stew pork | 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit | 1/2 cup currants ( raisins or prunes ) | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs or 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs, flakes | 3/4 cup stock cube | 1/2 cup stock | 1/3 cup sriracha hot sauce | 12 maraschino cherries, washed and dried
instructions: Wash pork tenderloin, dry well.  Remove meat from bone and discard bone.  Combine dried fruit and currants in a medium bowl.  Toss pork tenderloin and spices until well coated.  Arrange on a plate and cover tightly with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for 2 hours.  Preheat oven to 325°f.  Bake for about 1 1/2 hours, or until thermometer registers 160°f.  Remove from oven and let rest 5 minutes.  Slice thinly.  Mix panko or panko flakes with stock, sriracha sauce and hot sauce.  Place in a small bowl and refrigerate to allow flavors to blend.  Serve with slices of pork tenderloin.

title: Chile and Almond Salad
ingredients: 1 pound almonds, coarsely chopped | 1 pinch salt | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 small red chiles pepper, minced | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar, or to taste mixed with water, or as needed
instructions: Combine almond slivers, salt, sesame oil, red chile pepper, and cider vinegar in a bowl.  Toss until almonds absorb the dressing.

title: Easy Red Beans and Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas | 1 can red beans | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.  Add them together with the other ingredients, except rice and sherry.

title: Chilled Capsicum
ingredients: 1/2 kg red capsicums | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke, or more to taste | 2 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Cut capsicums in half lengthwise and trim with a sharp knife.  Chop in half crosswise.  Place on a plate.  Stir the liquid smoke, thyme and pepper into the capsicums using a fork.  Allow to marinate in the fridge while you grill or preheat the oven broiler.  Grill the capsicums until the skins blister and the capsicum is completely charred.  Remove the capsicum from the oven and drain off liquid.  Serve on a plate with a sprinkling of lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: chicken base,red wine vinegar,taco seasoning,orange juice concentrate,rye bread
title: Quick and Easy Mexican Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice concentrate | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 4 slices rye bread, halved | 1 tablespoon chicken base | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  In a small bowl, mix together orange juice concentrate, red wine vinegar, and taco base until smooth and creamy.  Spread a layer of rye bread on a large baking sheet.  Arrange about 1 1/2 tablespoons of meat mixture down the center of each bread slice.  Top with a layer of taco seasoning.  Bake in the preheated oven for approximately 5 minutes or until bread is toasted and meat is warmed through.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,flour tortilla,chili oil,crisp bacon,tahini,black pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,farfalle pasta
title: Bacon and Pasta - Fast & Easy
ingredients: 1 lb fresh farfalle pasta or package bow-tie pasta | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( or other non-stick cooking spray ) or 2 tablespoons canola oil ( or other non-stick cooking spray ) | 8 slices crisp bacon, chopped | 1 can plum tomatoes, drained and chopped | 2 teaspoons tahini | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper ( or to taste ) | 8 flour tortillas, warmed | chopped fresh chili oil, as needed
instructions: Cook the pasta in a pot or a large pot of boiling water following package directions and adding a splash of oil if necessary.  While the pasta cooks, slice the bacon, and brown in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Remove bacon from skillet and set aside.  Add the oil to the skillet, add the bacon and cook until golden.  Add tomatoes, bacon, and tahini to the skillet.  Stir well and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently for approximately 10 minutes.  When ready to serve, drain pasta and combine with the sauce in skillet.  Sprinkle with chili oil.  Serve hot.

title: Steamed Potatoes - Nigella Lawson, South African Recipe
ingredients: 8 medium russet potatoes, peeled and sliced into rounds | 3 -4 tablespoons dark soy sauce, or to taste ( optional ) | extra dark soy sauce, for sprinkling | 1 cup good-quality dark sweet tea, such as english breakfast, brewed at room temperature | 2 medium-hot pickled peppersoni ( jarred ) | fresh ground pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place all but 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce in a large, heavy bottomed steamed pot or small roasting pan.  Lay the potato slices on this and spread lightly with dark soy sauce.  Sprinkle lightly with black pepper.  Put 3 - 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce in the center of an ice cube tray and place 3 - 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce across the tomato slices.  Push the ice cubes down so they don't stick together.  Cover the pot or steam the potato slices into steamed potatoes and push the tomatoes through the ice cube tray with a spatula as quickly as possible.  Cover with aluminum foil and steam over medium to high heat for 20 minutes or until the potatoes are tender and very tender.  Remove from the steamer and set aside to cool slightly.  When the potatoes are at room temperature, place a small bowl along the edge so they sit flat.  Use a slotted spoon to remove any excess water.  Pour tea through bowl, discard tea, and divide potatoes into 4 individual bowls or bowls.  Spoon dark soy sauce into the bowl.  Top with dark sweet tea and chopped peppersoni.  Sprinkle on additional dark soy sauce if desired.

title: Rigatoni With Oregano, Oven-Dish on the Trees
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 1/4 cup oregano leaves
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Meanwhile, bring large pot of salted water to boil.  Add oregano.  Add rigatoni and cook until to desired doneness, approximately 2 to 3 minutes per batch.  Drain pasta and add to pasta.  Toss well.

title: Rose Petal Mousse
ingredients: 1 rose petal, sliced in 3/8-inch rounds | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 3 slabs sliced fresh rose petals | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Set rack in center of oven and preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Arrange 3 rose petals in a large bowl of ice water, turning the petals to coat and keep them from sticking.  Bring cream and 1/3 cup rose syrup to boil in a medium saucepan over medium low heat.  Remove from heat.  Slowly stir in remaining 2 cups rose petals and allspice.  Pour cream mixture into 8 dessert dishes or 6 small ramekins.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate the desserts for up to 4 hours, or overnight.

title: Baby Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 baby portabella mushrooms | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, minced
instructions: Preheat the broiler with ¾ cup of water on the rack at highest heat.  Clean the mushrooms, and slice the stems and stems to separate the smaller ones.  Remove the stems from the larger mushrooms.  Place mushrooms on a baking sheet with the stem end facing up.  Coat the mushrooms with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper.  Broil the mushrooms for 5 minutes, or until they begin to turn a light golden brown.  Add the mint, and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,banana,hungarian paprika,white breadcrumb,onion soup mix,mace,white pepper,gingerroot
title: Banana Pork Patties
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin ( chopped ) or 1 lb lean hamburger ( chopped ) | 1 medium onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon gingerroot ( minced ) | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 teaspoon fresh ground white pepper | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 2 slices white breadcrumbs
instructions: In a large bowl combine the pork, onion soup mix, ginger, paprika, brown sugar, white pepper and mace.  Shape into 6 patties.  Roll in bread crumbs.  Bake at 350 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes, or broil for 1 minute.

title: Easy Peanut Fried Chicken
ingredients: 12 chicken thigh fillets | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Trim fat and skin from the chicken.  Brush chicken with oil.  Heat a large non stick pan using med high.  Cook chicken for 1 minute per side or until crispy.  Remove from pan.  Toss the chicken in the pan with your favourite chutney, and serve.

title: Tortillas With Poultry Magic
ingredients: 1/2 cup lard | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 package gelatin | 3 tablespoons salt | 1/2 cup ripe olives ( optional ) | 2 cups chicken bouillon ( for a milder flavor, use 1 3/4 cups or 1 3/4 cups chicken stock ) | 2 slices kaffir lime leaves ( may be omitted, since the lime leaves are salty )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees.  Prep the gelatin following packet directions but in a separate saucepan, melt the lard.  Stir in the kaffir lime leaves.  Bring to a boil.  Add the gelatin/pulp mixture.  Stir to dissolve.  Pour into a small casserole dish and leave to set.  Remove lime leaves from gelatin mixture.  Dissolve maggi in 3 tablespoons of stock and set aside.  Pour mixture over soaked gelatin.  Sprinkle top with remaining coriander.  Place on a plate and refrigerate until set.  Serve with sliced olives or a dip.

title: Champagne (Champagne) Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup broth
instructions: Wash cremini mushrooms under cold water.  Cut stem from stem end.  Wash mushrooms under cold water.  Put a clean plate on the table to keep mushrooms from discoloring.  On a dessert platter, pour about 1/2 cup of the mushroom stock.  Smooth the top with a spoon, then leave the lid on until ready to serve.  Serve immediately with some grated gruyere cheese or with creme fraiche if desired.

title: Asian Turkey Wraps
ingredients: 2 lbs turkey breast | 12 small dried shiitake mushrooms | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 -4 radishes, sliced
instructions: Place dried shiitake mushrooms in 1 cup hot water until softened.  Drain mushrooms, slice off stems and chop.  Trim any excess moisture of turkey if desired, slice the turkey breast lengthwise into 1/8 inch strips.  Place turkey and 1 tablespoon of the oil in skillet and turn over until lightly browned on all sides.  Remove turkey and set aside on plate.  Add other 1 tablespoon oil to the skillet and add mushrooms and lime juice.  Stir fry over low heat for about 10 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat and add the remaining ingredients.  Stir well to blend with turkey.  Serve warm.

title: Peach and Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 large ripe peaches, stoned, skinned and halved lengthways | 1 small onion powder ( such as garlic or 1 large onion ) | 1 1 cup sherry wine | lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Put the peaches, onion powder and sherry into a small pan and stir over a high heat until simmering.  Reduce the heat to low, partially cover the pan and cook just until the peaches start to show good resistance.  Remove from the heat and leave to warm while preparing the salad.  Cut the onion into thin, thin wedges.  Drain the peaches and add them to the pan with any juices from the pan.  Leave to heat through, for about 4 - 5 minutes.  Place the salad onto a serving plate, top with the onion wedges and cover with the lettuce leaves.  Drizzle the dressing over the salad and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: nori,blue curacao,yellow pepper,sun tomato oil,tarragon,white wine
title: Chef John's Hot Steak Roll
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 tablespoon crumbled blue curacao or white rum | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon chopped yellow peppers | 12 sheets nori ( dry seaweed sheets )
instructions: Preheat grill to 350 degrees f.  Spray work surface with cooking spray.  In a small bowl combine sun dried tomatoes with white wine, blue curacao, tarragon, and yellow pepper.  Slightly sprinkle with sun dried tomato mixture.  Wrap each sheet with seaweed paper.  Place nori sheets at a 45 degrees f angle on a grill rack lined with aluminum foil.  Grill steaks until desired doneness, about 10 minutes.

title: Cherry Fondue
ingredients: 600 g pitted cherries | 1 bunch spring onion | 1 bottle sweet vodka
instructions: Put the cherries and spring onion into the fondue pot with the vodka and heat until the vodka infuses.  Dampen the fondue pan.  Dip the fondue forks into cold water, remove the fondue forks, and dip the forks in cold water.  Put the fondue forks back into the fondue pot, add the cherry mixture to the pot, and serve.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,orange zest,cannellini bean,large shrimp
title: Shrimp and Cannellini Bean Pasta
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans | 1 1/2 cups coarsely grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1 1/2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Drain and rinse the cannellini beans and place them in a soup pot.  Add the remaining ingredients and simmer for at least an hour, or up to 5 hours longer if refrigerated.  Serve immediately.

title: Cranberry Hoagie
ingredients: 2 hoagie rolls, split | 1 ounce fresh cranberries
instructions: Place 2 halves of each bun on a plate.  Put cranberries into 1 slice of bread.  Top with remaining two halves of bun.  Use a butter knife to cut into each loaf, being careful not to slice through the bottom.  Toast each loaf in the preheated oven for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the crust is browned.

Random Ingredients: sponge cake finger,poppy seed,avocado,amaretto liqueur,garam masala,sherry,linguine,mayonnaise
title: Linguine With Avocado Spread
ingredients: 1 lb linguine ( or spaghetti if not available ) | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained, halved lengthwise | 1 cup chopped preserved avocado, about 1/2 large | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur or 2 tablespoons other almond-flavored liqueur | 1/4 cup mayonnaise or 1/4 cup vegan mayonnaise, if desired | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons sherry
instructions: Mix together the artichoke hearts drained and halved, with the preserved avocado.  Spread the mixture evenly over the cooked linguine or spaghetti if using.  Spread on the poppy seeds then drizzle the amaretto/liqueur on top.  Combine the mayonnaise with the garam masala and sherry.  Sprinkle on top of the avocado mixture.  Cover and chill until serving time or serve right away.  Yield, approximately 1 pound.

title: Pea & Worcestershire Sauce from Leftovers
ingredients: 4 cups leftover peas ( from the fridge is best ) | 1/3 cup worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients into a casserole dish & heat in a preheated oven at 175c for 20 - 30 minutes or until heated through.  Serve with your leftover veggies on top.  Also, if you have leftover cooked chicken, you may have to cook this in the microwave for about 5 mins to really get the 'th' flavour of the sauce.  Alternatively you can add some mushrooms or onions to this instead of your leftovers.

title: Coconut Balls
ingredients: 100 g firm tofu | 4 -5 tablespoons golden syrup | 100 g cashews, chopped | sea salt
instructions: Wrap the tofu in a very small package of water and place on the microwave on medium for 2 minutes.  Remove and cut in half.  Put the tofu on a paper towel to cool down.  Squeeze out as much water as you can and combine with tofu.  Chop cashews roughly.  Add cashewnuts to the tuna and shape into small balls.  Fry balls in oil till golden brown.  If you like, serve with mango chutney and lemon wedges for a little extra kick.  For coconut balls, put coconut pieces in a sieve and pour boiling water over to let the coconut dry slightly.  Place coconut in an airtight container and store in the fridge.  Note, to dry and harden, remove coconut from sieve and place on a tea towel.

title: Linguine With Walnuts
ingredients: 1 cup walnuts, preferably toasted, peeled, coarsely chopped and divided | 8 ounces linguine, preferably with lines and ends attached
instructions: To toast walnuts, combine 1/2 cup walnut pieces and 2 tablespoons of the pistou in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, and remove from heat when nut mixture comes to a boil.  Set aside.  Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat.  Add linguine and cook until al dente, being careful not to dry it out.  Stir walnut mixture occasionally as it adheres to the pasta.  Drain linguine, reserving 1 cup of the cooking water, and toss with remaining pistou, nuts, and reserved pasta water.

Random Ingredients: tomato,bisquick baking mix,rosemary sprig,kale,apple cider vinegar
title: Italian Kale & Apple Bisquick (No Bread Mix)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 cups bisquick baking mix, with vegetable oil ( i use bisquick ) | 4 leaves kale, torn into smaller pieces ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 apple ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 tablespoon rosemary sprig, chopped | chopped tomato, for toppings ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Grease cookie sheet with oil leaving about 2 inches of oil in skillet.  Lightly spray bowl with cooking spray.  Combine the bisquick, kale and apple and stir until just coated.  Fold in rosemary.  Turn dough into prepared pan.  Sprinkle top with a little water until dough is 1 inch below top of pan.  Bake until top is golden, about 35 minutes, turning dough every 10 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Spicy Irish Broth
ingredients: 4 lbs green tomatoes | 4 lbs green chilies | 4 lbs brinjals, halved lengthwise | 8 ounces dark raisins | 7 ounces irish cream
instructions: In a 3 quart saucepan of boiling water, boil tomatoes for 8 to 10 minutes.  Rinse under cold water and drain well.  Discard skins.  Place them in a 2 quart saucepan.  Cut in the remaining ingredients, including raisins and bring to a boil.  Reduce to low and simmer, partially covered, stirring occasionally, until the broth is very thick and flavors have blended, about 20 to 30 minutes.  Cool about 1 hour, then skim off any fat.  Ladle into hot sterilized pint jars, leaving 1/2 inch headspace, and seal.

title: Porter and Ale Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1 lb oats | 1 lb roast beef | 12 ounces lager beer
instructions: Place oats and roast beef in to a shallow dish and mix, pour over beer and let sit for an hour or so.  Cook over fairly gentle heat on the bbq to make sure its done to your liking and you don't want any excess water drain as desired, you can slice into slices or on toasted bread.

title: Aubergine, Garlicky Beef and Parmesan Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 375 g medium pasta or 375 g your favourite long pasta, cooked and drained | 350 g ground beef or 350 g ground lamb | 2 aubergines ( i like them ) or 2 sultanas, sliced and roasted | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules ( for extra flavour or use instant stock, 1 tb sugar, 1 tbsp lemon juice or 100 ml boiling water, if using regular stock ) | 1 cup sliced pecorino cheese or 1 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Put your pasta, beef or lamb in a large bowl breaking up any clumps.  Add the aubergines/sultanas and mix well.  Heat the olive oil in a pan, add in the beef/l meat and mix well.  Drain the pasta and add to the meat.  Add the molasses, stock granules and pepper to taste and mix well.  Top with the cheese and put in oven.  Put about 1 cup of hot water in the pan to deglaze the pan and thicken the sauce if desired with cornflour mixed with a bit of water.  I usually keep mine warm until serving so i don't miss that opportunity.  Serve with grated parmesan cheese on top.

title: Italian Herb Marinara
ingredients: 2 jars marinara sauce | 1/2 cup italian herb blend ( dill, rosemary, or basil )
instructions: Combine 1 jar marinara sauce and 1/2 to 1 cup italian herb blend.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 3 days.  Stir before using.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,oyster sauce,extra virgin olive oil
title: Chinese Oyster Sauce Crust Cookies (Ngow Num)
ingredients: 12 ounces graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 8 teaspoons oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Crumb graham crackers in a bowl with a fork and set aside.  In a separate bowl, mix oyster sauce with graham cracker crumbs.  Add olive oil and mix.  Once mixture is in the bowl, press the mixture through a meat grinder or food processor until it is fine crumbs.  If it is too crumbly, add a little more of the oyster sauce until it is fine.  If it is too wet, add more oil.  Add the crumb mixture and form into small balls.  Place on a cookie sheet with parchment paper on middle rack of oven and bake until just slightly brown.  Let cool slightly and eat with your fingers.  Note, you may want to bake them to ensure they are golden brown.  If you want to make them to this holiday, use cookie stamp which contains lids.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,sharp cheddar cheese,chicken thigh,red lentil,tapioca flour,orecchiette
title: My Favorite Lentil and Corn Macaroni Ragu
ingredients: 1 small chicken thigh | 2 teaspoons oat tapioca flour | 4 ounces chopped mild sharp cheddar cheese ( about 1 cup ) | 1 cup red lentil ( about 1 1/4 c lentils ) | 1 can condensed light cream of mushroom soup | 2 1/2 ounces canned chipotle-flavored applesauce
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry.  Cut into 1 inch pieces.  Coat a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray, place over medium high heat.  Sprinkle chicken pieces with tapioca flour, and cook, turning once, 1 - 2 minutes, or until browned, stirring often.  Transfer to a large bowl and coat with cooking spray.  In same skillet, add cheddar cheese and half of the lentils.  Cook over medium high heat, stirring often, until cheese is melted and mixture is heated through.  Add soup and applesauce.  Heat 5 minutes, or until bubbling.  Serve over macaroni.

title: Chinese Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles, regular size | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, ground
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.  Drain noodles and set aside.  Mix egg yolk and ground sesame seeds together and set aside.  Add egg noodles and combine well together with egg yolk and ground sesame salt mixture.  Serve warm.

title: Casarello Pasta

title: Dakkhand (Halim) - Authentically Kimi Onion Cake
ingredients: 1 lb daikon radish | 3 ounces dried currants | 3 -4 ounces sweet chili peppers ( more or less to your taste )
instructions: Peel the daikon and cut into 6 - 8 rings.  Slice the radish diagonally into 1/4 inch wide slices.  In a strainer, press the daikon with your fingernail against the side of your fingernail to loosen the liquid behind the slices.  Cut the daikon in half.  Cut it in pieces about 1 inch x 1/4 1/2 inch.  Rinse and pick over the currants or dried chilies and place them in a saucepan with 5 cups of water and bring to a boil.  Boil for 15 - 20 minutes until soft and very mushy.  Drain the daikon and place it in a fine sieve over a bowl to collect the liquid.  In a frying pan, heat about 1/4 1/2 teaspoon oil over medium heat.  Slightly fry the daikon pieces about 3 - 5 minutes for rare, 7 - 8 minutes for medium.  Remove from the pan and drain well on a paper towel.  Remove the stems when done.  Add a couple tablespoons of water in the reserved drippings to get rid of excess moisture.  Heat the dripping over medium heat until it bubbles and begins to smell very strongly.  Add the chilies and stir well for about 10 seconds, then add the currants and stir.  Cook, stirring, for another 2 - 3 minutes.  Pour into a serving dish and serve while hot.  The finished dish can be served hot from a heated platter, but if you prefer, warm it in a warm oven or in a warming oven.
