Brush with cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: parsley,chicken breast half,lemon,boston lettuce,chicken breast,spaghetti,flat leaf parsley
title: Chicken Caesar Salad
ingredients: 3 large skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1 lemon, juiced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, divided | 6 cups torn torn leaves from a large romaine lettuce | 6 slices lemons | 1 package spaghetti
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread the chicken breasts flat in a thin layer onto a baking sheet.  Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.  Whisk together the parsley, 1/4 cup of the fresh parsley, lemon juice and 1/4 cup of the parsley to make the dressing.  Set aside.  Toss the torn lettuce with remaining parsley and lemon slices.  Reserve remaining 3/4 cup of the parsley for garnish.  Place chicken with the reserved parsley mixture over the lettuce, and top with remaining parsley.  Serve remaining dressing in a bowl for dipping.

title: Spicy Cheese
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated hot smoked sausage | 1/3 cup fish sauce | 3 cups shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Stuff sausage into the corners of a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Bring seafood into the noodles with a splash of soy sauce.  Sprinkle with remaining swiss cheese.  Bake in the preheated oven 35 minutes, or until bubbly.

title: Snap Pea and Mint Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 12 )
ingredients: 450 g snap peas | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Place snap peas in a heatproof bowl using a fork.  Add the mint and toss to combine.  Cool quickly and serve.

title: Lebanese Cabbage and Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 500 g cabbage | 500 g ground veal pork or 500 g ground lamb | 3 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Cut the cabbage into thick wedges and separate them into thick slices.  Combine meat and mint.  Using a large shallow casserole dish or oven proof dish, arrange the pork/mangoes over the bottom of the dish, then top with cabbage wedges, overlapping slightly.  Spread the top with remaining mixture in a roasting tin.  Place in oven for 45 mins or until cooked and crusty.  Let stand for 10 mins before serving.  Tip, to reduce fat content, use 2 tsp oil instead of meat or lamb fat and leave out the mint and leave it for up to 3 hours.

title: Jif's Mushrooms
ingredients: 14 ounces button mushrooms | 10 1/2 fluid ounces dark brown sugar | allspice, to taste | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Cut the mushrooms into quarters.  Place in the centre of a square of tin foil, with the brown sugar in one corner pointing towards you, and a pinch of allspice on the other side.  Close up the foil, and leave to stand there before you cook the remaining mushrooms.  Heat up the corn oil in a large pan.  When the oil is smoking, put in the mushrooms.  Sprinkle the allspice over, and fry for 1 minute.  Stir once in a while, and don't stir because spices keep breaking.  Drain all the liquid out, and spread the mushrooms at the bottom of the tin foil.  Sauce should be runny, bubbly and slightly thick.  Add a touch of water if necessary.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,white pepper,chicken meat,canola oil,chipotle chile adobo
title: Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 3 fresh chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 3/4 cup chopped hazelnuts, toasted | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken meat - cubed | ground white pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f.  Mix the chipotle chiles, hazelnuts, canola oil, and chicken together in a large bowl.

title: Cabbage, Sausage and Hot Pepper Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/4 cup cabbage, shredded | 1 green pepper, sliced in rings | 8 dried red chilies, crushed | 8 dried hot red chilies, crushed | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander, chopped
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil.  Add sausage, stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes.  Add green pepper, chilis and sugar.  Stir fry till cooked and the colour of the sugar dissolves.  Remove.  Add corriander and fry for 2 minutes.  Remove.  Serve.

title: Baked Haddock
ingredients: 225 g self raising flour | 200 g silver tequila | 150 g savory, leaves picked clean | 5 lbs hake fillets, cut into quarters
instructions: Grease a shallow, shallow ovenproof dish with butter and place the fish pieces in it.  Mix the flour, salt, and savory in a mixing bowl.  Pour the tequila into a third bowl and add the passionfruit juice to the third bowl with the flour mixture.  Add a third of the tequila to the bowl with the passionfruit juice.  Turn the food into the prepared dish.  Put the dish in a pan of hot water with a tablespoonful of water and a tablespoonful of water.  Put the dish of fish in the oven and reduce the temperature to 150 degrees centigrade.  Bake at 150 degrees for about 1 1/2 hours until the fish is cooked.  Allow it to cool a minute or two before serving.

title: Macaroni With Radishes and White Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups macaroni | 1/2 small red swiss cheese, diced | 6 radishes, sliced | 10 -12 small curry leaves
instructions: Drain the macaroni noodles and set aside.  In a large nonstick skillet cook the ginger and cheese over medium heat until cheese is completely melted and the mixture is beginning to brown, about 5 minutes.  Add the radishes to the pan and continue to cook for about 5 minutes.  If it seems dry and the radishes begin to color too quickly, add a little warm water.  Add the cooked macaroni noodles to the pan and toss lightly to coat with the mixture.  Top with curry leaves and serve.

Random Ingredients: rice,jasmine rice,barbecue sauce,rosemary,fruit,cottage cheese,sourdough bread,celery rib
title: BBQ Rice Casserole
ingredients: 3/4 cup jasmine rice | 3/4 cup cooked rice | 1 1/2 cups cottage cheese | 1 jar barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary or 1 tablespoon oregano | 3 celery ribs, cooked, chopped | fruit or pickled fruit, to taste | 2 slices sourdough bread, cut into squares
instructions: Put first 3 ingredients in large bowl, cover and set aside in a warm place till warm.  Remove top layer of fat in large skillet on med hi.  Stir well, then spread cottage cheese over rice.  Add barbecue sauce, rosemary and celery.  Stir and cover with lid on skillet.  Let simmer about 20 - 30 min till rice has absorbed all the excess liquid, then spread mix to cover in a warm place, covered.  Put into lightly oiled 8 x 8 pan or baking dish and spread rice over top.  Bake 25 min till liquid is absorbed and top is nice and browned.  Serve with salad of course, but can also be served on a plate and sliced fruit.  Also can be placed in a 9 x 13 pan, but then spread to cover.  Put into warm place till ready to serve.

title: Russian Carrots & Yogurt Salad on Fresh Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 6 large lettuce leaves ( or 6 lettuce leaves in a salad bowl ) | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon kraft fat-free creamy low-fat plain yogurt | canola oil or vegetable oil | fresh carrots, julienned or shaved, according to your taste | 1/4 cup light irish cream | fresh basil leaf,, if desired
instructions: In a small bowl, mix all ingredients.  Chill until serving time, if possible, or serve at room temperature on lettuce leaves.

title: Crispy Kielbasa
ingredients: 4 packages kielbasa | 1/4 cup thick & chunky salsa | kosher salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Wrap each kielbasa link individually with aluminum foil.  Bake kielbasa until no longer pink inside, 20 to 25 minutes.  Place kielasapas in a large baking dish.  Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees f.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Continue cooking kielasapas in the preheated oven until the internal temperature is 190 degrees f, 25 to 30 minutes.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f.

title: Beef and Feta Melt
ingredients: 2 -3 slices french bread | 1/2 lb ground beef | salsa ( optional ) | 3/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Mix up until thoroughly blended.  Spread onto bread slices.  Top with ground beef.  If desired, top with salsa and feta cheese.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,lard,tortilla,raspberry jam,rotel tomato,garbanzo bean
title: Cuban Style Tortilla Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lard | 2 tablespoons hot green chile peppers, chopped | 2 cups cooked garbanzo beans | 2 1/2 teaspoons raspberry jam | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 6 soft corn tortillas, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Heat the lard in a skillet over medium heat.  Add the green chile peppers, beans, and jam.  Stir and cook for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in the tomatoes.  Spoon the guacamole onto a warm tortilla.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,chayotes,green cardamom,hard egg,green onion,semolina flour
title: Bengali Yakh Dar Baingan (Spicy Sooji Kaingani(Semolina Flour Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon semolina flour | 2 ounces baby carrots or 2 ounces green peas, trimmed and halved | 3 -5 green onions, chopped ( green part only ) | 4 ounces chayotes, chopped | 2 teaspoons green cardamoms ( optional ) | 10 -12 hard-boiled eggs, sliced thin
instructions: Place the flour in a mixing bowl.  Add the carrots, peas, green onions, chayote and cardamom and stir to blend.  Heat a medium size nonstick skillet on medium high heat, add 3 tablespoons vegetable oil.  When the pan is hot, drop tablespoon sized spoonfuls of batter into the pan and spread to form mini pancake shapes, flattening them out a little and cooking until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side.

title: Tasty Lentil Burger
ingredients: 400 g red lentils | 4 tablespoons french bread, soft | 3 tablespoons fat free french dressing | 1 sirloin
instructions: Wash lentils in plenty of water to remove any stones, drain.  Transfer to a bowl and cover with water.  Place in the fridge for about 15 - 20 minutes depending on how thick you want it.  Remove the sirloin from the fridge and slice thinly across the grain.  Heat a nonstick pan and cook the sirloin till browned.  Add the french dressing then add the lentils.  Stir fry till lentils are tender and the mixture has no colour.  Serve burgers straight away on a plate.  Enjoy.

title: Horseradish Pasta Salad II
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat penne | 1/4 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Celery Seed Seasoning
ingredients: 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon dried parsley sprigs
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small dish.  Store in dry container.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,serrano chili,lettuce,taco seasoning mix,leek,sesame seed
title: Mexican Lemons and Garlic
ingredients: 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 4 serrano chili, minced | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 2 medium leeks, sliced into thin half moons | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 head lettuce
instructions: Spread the sesame seeds in a small microwave safe dish, or in a small bowl, and heat in the microwave until the seeds crackle and change color, 1 to 2 minutes.  Transfer the seeds into a bowl and let cool slightly before grinding with the back of a spoon.  Add the serrano peppers, taco seasoning mix, and leeks to the ground sesame seeds and chiles, and mix thoroughly.  Store in the refrigerator.  Lightly toss the lemons with the tomato puree, then serve on lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,red wine vinegar,gnocchi,mushroom soup,wheat penne
title: Smooth & Creamy Gnocchi Pasta Salad from Campbell's Kitchen
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1 medium green pepper, thinly sliced | 10 ounces canned mushroom soup, drained ( any brand ) | 1 package whole wheat penne, cooked and drained | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Toss the first seven ingredients together in a large serving bowl.  Sprinkle red wine vinegar over the salad.  I like to use grape vineger brand grape vineger for this.  I like to serve this on some nice crusty bread, cut into wedges.

title: Chicken Sandwich Filler
ingredients: 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon ground chile | 1/4 cup chicken breast half | 1 loaf whole wheat bread
instructions: Slice the bread lengthwise in half horizontally, cutting through the crust at 1 inch intervals.  Lay out 1 slice of bread, then spread with worcestershire sauce, chile and top with another slice of bread.  Cut into 6 triangles, then cut each wedge into 6 triangles.  Brush on the tops with remaining worcestershire sauce.  Broil on each side for about 5 minutes or until bubbly, then serve, cut into 6 wedges.

title: Cuban Black Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained | 1 can chicken broth
instructions: Pour the drained black beans into a blender, along with the chicken broth and puree until smooth.

Random Ingredients: apricot,chili powder,penne pasta,rice noodle,red chili pepper,beef roast,ziti pasta,dark raisin
title: Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 lbs beef roast ( not round ) | 1 package uncooked penne pasta | 3 cans sliced dried apricots, cut in half | 1 can dark raisins, and | 1 can sweetened condensed milk tomatoes ( 398 ml ) | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper, in adabo sauce ( 1/2 tsp ) | chili powder
instructions: Trim fat from meat.  Place meat in the 5 1/2 quart slow cooker.  Add all remaining ingredients.  Cover and cook on low heat setting for about 3 hours or until the meat is tender.  During last 10 - 15 minutes of cook time remove meat to warm platter.  Discard fat from slow cooker.  Slice meat and serve on warmed platter.

title: Easy Brown Rice
ingredients: 3 cups cooked brown rice | 1 medium red bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine rice and peppers in a 2 qt casserole dish.  Sprinkle wiht tabasco to taste.

title: Kormeh-Sabzi (Channa Dal Leaves)
ingredients: 2 cups channa dal ( masoor dal with green tops ) | 1 tablespoon lemon extract
instructions: Soak the black gram in 4 cups water along with some salt for a few hours.  Remove the remaining water and add channa dal to it.  Heat on high heat till boiling.  Lower the flame and let the dal cook for 15 minutes on low heat.  Add lemon extract and lemon juice and mix.  Serve hot with chapathi or bread.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,butternut squash,onion flake,asiago cheese,cream,white pepper,creme fraiche,head cabbage
title: Creamy Italian Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1 medium head of cabbage, shredded | 1 medium butternut squash, unpeeled and cut into cubes ( about 1 lb ) | 1/2 cup sliced onion | 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper, freshly ground | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 °f.  Cook pasta, in boiling salted water until just tender, approximately 15 minutes.  Drain well.  Meanwhile, cover and microwave squash and onion in microwave safe dish on high power for 3 minutes, until softened slightly.  Mix with chopped cabbage.  Set aside, covered, and keep warm.  When pasta is done, drain and drain well.  Return to large skillet, along with remaining ingredients.  Stir in sour cream and bring to a boil, then remove from heat and sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,double cream,bean sprout,yellow pepper,feta,tuna olive oil,peanut,pistachio
title: Creamy Mediterranean Tuna Salad
ingredients: 400 g tuna in olive oil | 1 bell pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 yellow pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 250 g plain refried beans sprouts | 250 g pistachios | 200 g crumbled feta | 150 ml double cream | 100 g fresh flat unsalted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Break tuna into chunks about the size of a large marble and place in the bowl of a food processor.  Add bell pepper, yellow pepper and pistachios and process until finely chopped and combined.  Return to the large mixing bowl.  Add feta, cream and peanuts and gently mix.  Refrigerate.

title: Cajun Bacon Gravy
ingredients: 1/4 cup bacon grease | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, pour bacon grease.  Add poultry seasoning and stir.

title: Ripe Rub
ingredients: 1/4 cup ground coriander | 4 celery ribs, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Baharat Oil
ingredients:
3 -4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 100 ml brandy ( or greek sherry or rum ) | 1/4 tablespoon baharat ( baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix, or you can use turmeric.
    - you can also use any other spice, try this -- rose, sambal olek, marjoram, fenugreek or even a pinch of nutmeg if it is )
instructions: Heat up the oil, and gently heat the brandy until it's bubbly a bit.  Add brandy to this mixture and mix really well.  This will give you all the flavours meld.  I've deliberately not given the proportions of the baharat i had posted, so use what you like best.  Add the oil to a small saucepan or deep fryer vessel.  Heat up the mixture until the brandy has liquified.  Pour in the oil and let it warm up a bit, just to warm the oil.  The oil should be on a medium heat so watch it carefully and carefully place the lid on.  When it starts to get hot, take the lid off carefully and lower on the oil.  It is important to check that the mixture does not stick to the bottom of the oil.  If the oil starts to smoke, this is the time for a piece of kitchen towels to drain off the oil.  If it does, the oil is ready.  When the mixture is hot again, remove the lid and reduce the oil again a bit.  If it is too thick, add a splash of brandy and a drop of brandy to help thicken the consistency.  This should keep it separated in two.  After a few seconds, the mixture should be the consistency of a cake batter.  Leave the mixture to settle, if it is too thick, add a little more brandy.  The oil should be quite hot but not boiling.  You may even wish to leave all the pan off and leave it on a warm spot.  Take this cake out of the oil and put in the refrigerator.  Leave to set up in the refrigerator for at least 20 minutes.  It will keep, refrigerated and used up, for a day or two.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon powder,marinade,white wine vinegar,sesame seed,iceberg lettuce
title: Chinese Steak and Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon powder | marinade | grated iceberg lettuce
instructions: Toast sesame seed in skillet.  Add beef and cook about 5 minutes on one side then turn and cook other side.  Place a dab of marinade on steak and warm.  Put in baking dish and broil 3 - 5 minutes on each side.  Top with lettuce, pour remaining marinade over and enjoy as side dish.

title: Chinese Style Pea-And-Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 lb fresh peas and carrots, washed and cut into 2-inch lengths | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: In a large saucepan or dutch oven, combine peas, carrots and tabasco.  Cover and cook over medium low heat for 15 minutes.  Stir, cover and cook for 10 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,potato,onion powder,kosher salt,celery rib,sage leaf
title: Pommes De Terrine(Vegetarian Version of Terrine in Microwave)
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes, peeled | 1 medium onion | 2 -3 tablespoons sage leaves | 4 celery ribs | 1 1/2 tablespoons kosher salt, divided | 1/2 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: Place potatoes in a large mixing bowl.  Add onion, celery and seasonings.  Cut a small slit in the side of each potato so it will stay peeled.  Cut out as many of the outer layers as possible of potatoes.  Use the cut out portions to make terrine.  Place the terrine in microwaving dish and microwave on high for 5 minutes.  When terrine starts to get crispy, take out the potatoes from the microwave and put them in a bowl.  Then wrap the terrine around the potatoes, squeezing out the moisture.  Place the terrine in a 9x13 glass pan and microwave on high for an additional 7 minutes.  Take off the foil and set it aside to cool.  The terrine can be stored or frozen at this point for up to 4 months.  When serving, take the terrine out of the microwave, or on your serving plate.  Cut into 1/2 slices to serve.

title: Soya Spicy Sauteed Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soy sauce ( kha size ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet.  Add kaffir lime leaf.  When kaffir lime leaf turns white, add onions.  Saute.  When onions are half cooked, turn over and add soy sauce, garam masala, and red chilli powder.  Enjoy with chapati, parantha, or rice.

Random Ingredients: water,coconut cream,coconut extract,sage,lime juice zest,gherkin,white onion
title: Paleo Sage Scented Onion Dip and Coconut Bliss Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried gherkins, minced ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons dried sage, minced | 1 tablespoon lime juice, zest of | 1 teaspoon pure coconut extract | 6 medium sized onions, quartered if large | 2 tablespoons boiling water | 1 cup coconut cream, can use light or reduced fat, stirred
instructions: Place the gherkins & sage in a small microwaveable bowl & cover with the lime juice, zest & coconut extract, stir to combine, set aside.  Heat the oven to 180c.  Line a shallow baking tray with parchment paper & cover lightly with baking paper.  Put the onions in a small roasting pan on the tray & sprinkle over the boiling water.  Cook, uncovered, for 25 minutes.  Uncover & cook for 25 - 35 mins, until tender, releasing the tartness from the onion when pierced.  Allow to cool on the tray, then cover loosely with a double thickness of foil & chill until required.  Bring to the boil, then set aside to cool.  Combine the onion & coconut cream in a large bowl, add the dry onion spice mixture, season to taste & chill in the fridge until serving.  Serve with a light sprinkling of toasted coconut & garnish with sprigs of fresh mint.

Random Ingredients: cherry,ginger garlic paste,white onion,parsley leaf,green chili salsa,phyllo pastry,romano cheese,black pepper
title: Spicy Cheese Triangles
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 cup cherry, shredded ( canned works fine ) | 1/4 cup white onion, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste ( optional but good ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic, minced ( optional but good ) | 1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves, minced ( use fresh ) | 1/2 cup black pepper | 1 3/4 cups grated romano cheese or 1 3/4 cups parmesan cheese | sweet green chili salsa ( optional ) | bottled green chili salsa ( optional )
instructions: In a small mixing bowl place diced/marinated cherry and chopped white onion.  Set aside and allow it to mix with the cherry onion.  In a smaller mixing bowl add the ginger garlic paste or minced garlic powder.  Set aside.  Lightly spray a cookie sheet with olive oil spray.  Take phyllo sheets and line them evenly at the bottom and up from side.  Take 1 sheet and brush with olive oil on all exposed sheets and then lightly spray with olive oil.  Repeat this process until all sheet has been brushed but has been layered, reserving about 1/4 cup of the sheet brushed with olive oil.  Cover the dough with 2 additional sheets brushed with olive oil and repeat until all remaining sheets have been used.  This step should be done with the 2 additional sheets of phyllo brushed with olive oil.  Set aside.  Once all 8 sheets have been layered, stack and repeat same steps with the remaining 4 sheets of phyllo, making 6 layers.  To fill filling sprinkle 1/4 cup of the cheese over each layer.  If desired, drizzle on the chili salsa.  Cover the top of each stack with the remaining 1/4 cup of cheese.  Place 1 layer of phyllo on top of each filled layer and top with 1/4 cup of the cheese.  Prevent this step for very long rising or rolling.  You may cut a slit in the top of the phyllo and make several air vents around the phyllo to prevent pastry from puffing up.  If you have a vacuum sealer you can use the tip of a spoon to open the opening slightly.  I find this method to produce moisture that is just right.  I was also told that after placing phyllo in your oven on a rack that it went from oven to a low temperature, the phyllo sheets got cooked and chewy, about 20 minutes.  Then after that time i discovered, my oven has a tendency to let the phyllo dry out.  And that is why i added phyllo sheets with 2 sheets brushed brushed with olive oil.  It worked the best and it turned out great.  Enjoy.

title: Lebanese Sourdough Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry white bread, cubed | 1/2 cup celery leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons bread flour, plus | 2 teaspoons bread flour | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 2 teaspoons white sugar, for sprinkling
instructions: Dry the cubed bread well with paper towels set aside.  Combine the celery leaves, 2 tablespoons of the bread flour, 2 tablespoons of the sugar, and 2 teaspoons of the sugar in a mixing bowl and mix well.  Toss the bread cubes with the celery mixture and sprinkle with the remaining tablespoon of flour.  Shape into a loaf and wrap in plastic wrap.  Freeze for at least 2 hours or until firm.  Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place the bag of bread on a baking sheet and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until puffed.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,brown sugar,peanut oil,bacon,gorgonzola,ancho chilies,lemon juice zest,lasagna noodle
title: A Different Way to Make Noodles (Lagasse Et Gorgonzola)
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles ( or more, if desired ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon bacon fat | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 - 3/4 cup roasted peanuts, chopped or 1/2-3/4 cup gorgonzola, crumbled | 2 tablespoons ancho chilies ( dried, chopped fresh, to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Make the noodles as directed on the package except instead of adding oil and topping, use a small food processor or blender and pulse the noodles a few times to break them up.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,yellow mustard,red chili powder,caper,vanilla,puff pastry
title: Vanilla Danish
ingredients: 1/2 small red chili powder, seeded | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons yellow mustard | 1 sheet fresh puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup capers, drained & rinsed | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Prepare pastry as directed on package.  In a small bowl, combine chili powder, sugar, mustard, capers and oil.  Brush pastries with oil, and sprinkle over mixture.  Bake until slightly browned on bottom.  Slice as needed.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,onion salt,yellow bell pepper,butterscotch pudding mix,hot red chili pepper,rice wine,tequila apple juice
title: Hot and Spicy Appetizer Relish
ingredients: 1 box butterscotch pudding mix | 2 cups sweet rice wine ( not cooking wine ) | 1 cup tequila-flavored apple juice | 1 medium sweet onion ( about 3/4-3/4 cup ) | 1 small yellow bell pepper | 1 hot red chili pepper | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chile
instructions: Drain all the juice from the bell pepper into a saucepan with a tight fitting lid to let the juice out into the pan.  Heat until juice is reduced by half.  Remove from heat and let set for about five minutes to cool down and combine the pepper mixture into the hot pepper juice.  Add the remaining spices including your chipotle pepper to the mix and stir.  Transfer to glass pie plate, chill for half an hour.  Place mixture in food processor and pulse a couple times.  Place in jar or container and refrigerate to get very cold.  The longer it sets the hotter it becomes but the more frequent it receives.  Shake well before using and remember the longer the chill for the hotter relish and to be happy.

title: King Prawns in Tomato and Cardamom Sauce
ingredients: 600 g king prawns, peeled and deveined | 10 green cardamom pods | 2 plum tomatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 220 degrees centigrade.  Place cardamom pods in a large roasting tin and place on top of the oven shelf.  Place the prawns upright on the baking tray and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.  The prawns will be just cooked when they are.  When prawns are almost cooked, remove the cardamom pods and place in a large heatproof bowl.  Sprinkle with half the cardamom and cover with the remaining cardamom.  Cut the tomatoes into half and peel off the top of the tomatoes.  Heat the pan and roast the prawns for 8 to 10 minutes until they turn a medium golden brown.  Serve the prawns topped with the tomato cream and a dollop of cream.  Cardamom cream sauce blend all of the ingredients together except the cream.  You may wish to add a teaspoon of cardamom powder at this point to make it the way you like your sauce.

title: Champignons Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb large button mushroom | 2 packages frozen baby spinach leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place mushrooms in a large shallow baking pan and toss with 4 or 5 tablespoons water to coat and mingle the stems.  Cover mushroom caps with the spinach and bake for 30 minutes or until spinach is tender.

title: Choy Sum Salad
ingredients: 3 kg choy sum | 1 kg prawns | 500 g meat | 200 g berry beans, washed and chopped | 175 g cranberries ( or other berry of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Trim the prawn heads.  Cut the backs into 2 1/2 inch pieces.  In a large bowl put the heads, prawns and meat and berry beans.  Sprinkle over the worcestershire sauce.  Mix thoroughly.  Add the cranberries or berries of your choice and mix well again, making sure the berry and prawn mixture is mixed thoroughly.  Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,green bean,vanilla extract,black olive,creme de cacao
title: Chef John's Yummy and Yummy Black Olive Tart
ingredients: 15 pounds fresh green beans, ends trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 pound sliced black olives | 1/4 cup crème de cacao | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/4 cup creme de cacao
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Arrange green beans in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over green beans, cover with aluminum foil, and bake in the preheated oven until crumbs are lightly browned, 5 to 8 minutes.  Remove foil and black olives from oven, and set aside to cool.  Stir graham cracker crumbs, black olives, 1/4 cup crème de cacao, and vanilla extract in a bowl until smooth.  Spread bottom of a 9x3 inch baking dish with creme de cacao.  Spread cooled green beans with crème de cacao, and top with remaining crème de cacao.  Garnish with remaining black olives.  Bake in the preheated oven until hot and bubbling, about 45 minutes.

title: Babaci
ingredients: 1 cup self raising flour, sifted | 1 1/2 cups dried shredded phyllo dough
instructions: Mix sifted flour, salt and shredded phyllo dough.  Dough should not be sticky.  Lightly beat with fork or dough scraper for 2 minutes.  Place on an oiled baking tray, 1 1/2 cm from the edges.  Bake at 200c for 20 - 30 minutes or until golden.  Cool for 10 minutes for a few minutes then brush with melted melted white glaze or brush with melted ganache or butter.  Cut into squares and serve with butter.

title: Simple Pizza Batter
ingredients:
1 small tomatoes | 4 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast ( or 2 2g packages frozen yeast in syrup ) | 1 1/2 cups fontina cheese ( can use mozzarella or cheddar instead ) | 5 tablespoons crisco ( can use 1/2 tsp extra-virgin olive oil, or 2 tbsp.
    - canola )
instructions: If the tomato is big, cut it in halves to compensate.  If it is small, cut it about 1/4 inch, and cut those halves in half again if the stem grows out on the plate, too.  In a bowl, dissolve the yeast in the warm water, and set to proof.  Dice the fontina and mozzarella.  Place the crisco, olive oil in a large mixing bowl.  Add the yeast, and mix with clean hands.  Add half of the bread to the bowl.  Add half the tomato halves, then add all the other half of the bread, then mix with a spatula.  Let stand 10 minutes, then add all the remaining bread, and knead to a dough that can be turned out and covered with a clean surface.  Add water if necessary, but it shouldn't be sticky and dry, as with pizza dough.  Lightly grease a large bowl.  Put the dough in in the oil, and let rise 15 - 20 minutes in a warm place, or until the dough has doubled in size.  Punch down, then divide in half.  Using one piece of dough for each bun, divide the second half into 8 - 8 large pices, then divide those half between the 8 pices.  Let rise 15 - 20 minutes, then punch down, and divide each portion into 6 - 8 round balls.  Lightly oil two pizza pans or flat pizza pans.  Place the first round on the bottom, then the second round over that and then the top, on top of the first round. .  Sprinkle the last two rounds with the cheese, then spread the top of the dough over the top of the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border on the sides.  Bake the rolls at 425 deg for 10 - 18 minutes.  They should be golden brown outside and crisp inside.  Cool on a wire rack and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Korean Beef Tips
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed, scored on all sides | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons tapioca
instructions: Place tenderloin in a freezer bag or large resealable plastic bag with a vent on top.  Combine the ketchup, tblsps.  Of ketchup and salt and pepper in a bowl.  Remove the beef from the freezer, add the ketchup mixture to the bag, seal the bag, and put in the freezer for 30 minutes.  Remove beef from bag and dry on paper towels.  Meanwhile, in a shallow bowl, place ketchup and tapioca and toss gently until well mixed.  Slice the beef and serve with the ketchup mixture.

title: Failsafe Red Beans & Rice
ingredients: 1 lb bulk red beans and rice | 1/2 lb italian sausage | 1 cup long grain brown rice | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Bring 2 liters of salted water to boil in a medium roasting pan.  Add red beans to boiling water and cook uncovered about a minute on each side until it is lightly cooked.  Drain beans and mix together into a saucepan with the sausage.  Cook over medium heat until sausage is cooked thoroughly.  Add brown rice to sausage and cook for 1 minute.  Remove sausage from heat and set aside.  Combine chicken bouillon and hot pepper flakes and stir into the pan with a fork.  Drain most of the bean liquid from the beans and add in to the sausage and sausage mixture.  Cover and bake for 30 minutes, remove cover and bake slightly, uncovered for 15 minutes more.  Enjoy.

title: Smoked Ham Hock Omelette
ingredients: 4 ounces ham hocks | 2 ounces red capsicums, sliced ( capsicums ) | 6 ounces egg yolks | 1 1/2 ounces tomato soup | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Lightly toast egg and set aside.  Put ham hocks in hot fat and lightly brown.  Meanwhile combine the egg yolks, tomato soup and cayenne pepper and mix well.  Drain ham and chop up roughly.  Add ham to egg and stir around, leaving mixture undone.  Serve hot with yoghurt, papadam or celery.  Cooks note, the ham hocks can also be frozen on the back of a wooden board and thawed overnight in the fridge.  If frozen, thaw just before cooking the omelette.  The flavour of the ham and omelette improves with standing overnight in the fridge.

title: Italian Bean Salad
ingredients: 4 cups mixed beans | 4 cups corn | 1 can pigeon peas | 15 -20 pieces salami | 16 ounces cannellini beans
instructions: Blanch the beans and corn until al dente, cool well, and set aside.  Prepare beans and corn in salamaria or salad pan, and set aside.  Wash and dry salami and cut into small cubes.  Prepare beans and corn on the stove or a grill.  Cut salami into slices and arrange on top of the beans and corn.  Slice cannellini beans and tomatoes and scatter over all.  Toss it all together before eating.

title: Fennel-Pesto Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1 cup frozen chopped fennel seed | 1/2 cup red bell pepper | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1/4 cup golden raisins | 1 teaspoon hot mustard powder | 1 teaspoon dried basil pesto
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add rice and stir.  Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 minutes.  Remove from heat, cover, and let stand for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, place fennel seeds, red bell pepper, tomatoes with green chile peppers, golden raisins, mustard powder, and basil pesto in a salad bowl, and toss to combine.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add rice, and cook uncovered 5 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Chilled Carrots With Mascarpone Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb carrot, peeled, halved lengthwise, and sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine, dry | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 ounce mascarpone cheese, room temperature ( room temperature )
instructions: Rinse and dry the carrots.  Place in a double thickness of cheesecloth, and tie the ends of the ends with kitchen string.  Heat a griddle, comal or heavy skillet over medium heat.  Add the carrots and sherry and cook, tossing, about 2 minutes.  Transfer carrots to a bowl and cover with plastic wrap.  Let cool.  In a small bowl, mix the olive oil and mascarpone with a fork.  Transfer the carrots to a serving plate, and serve garnished with the cheese.

title: Mexican Spicy Veggies and Polenta
ingredients: 2 frozen rotel | 1 cup polenta | 4 slices bacon bits
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Cook polenta according to package directions, stir in bacon bits and remove from oven.  Lightly coat a large pan with nonstick cooking spray and place over medium high heat.  Cook until golden brown then remove to paper towel lined plate.  When cool, slice into thick slices and serve.

title: Smoked Ham and Scallops for Two
ingredients: 1 ounce scallops | 4 slices ham | 1 egg white | 1/4 cup irish salad dressing | 1 cup arugula leaf
instructions: Arrange the scallops on a serving platter.  Bring the ham and egg white to a boil in a small pan, gently poach the scallops.  Drain the ham and scallops and arrange them on the scallops.  Drizzle over the dressing and scatter with arugula leaves.  Serve hot.

title: Pineapple-Cashews Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cashews halves | 3/4 cup rice wine | 1 small fresh pineapple rind, peeled
instructions: Line a broiler rack with parchment paper.  Place the cashews on the parchment and press onto both sides of the rack in a single layer.  Bake at 300 f for 10 minutes or until they are lightly toasted and fragrant.  Cool completely and cut into squares or chunks.  Mix the rice wine with the cashews.  Serve.

title: Stove Top Teriyaki Asparagus and Fennel Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds, crushed | 3 cups baking potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 egg free, active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups teriyaki sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds, crushed | 1 1/2 lbs asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | pecan pieces, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425'f and lightly coat a 10 by 7 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Sprinkle the potatoes with baking soda.  Set aside.  In a small bowl, blend together the yeast and 1 1/2 cups of the teriyaki sauce.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,double cream,virgin olive oil,cilantro leaf,pork shoulder
title: Puerco En Chartreuse
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 4 -5 cups double cream | 4 large cilantro leaves | 4 large fresh tortillas | 1 1/2 tablespoons virgin olive oil ( not olive oil )
instructions: Rinse the pork under cold water.  Slice into thin slices and pat dry with paper towels.  Using a fine sieve, drain the fat from the pork.  Set the meat aside.  Blend the cream and the cilantro.  Heat the olive oil in a large skillet.  When it's just barely starting to smoke, reduce the heat.  Add the pork in a single layer, a few pieces at a time, and fry until lightly browned on all sides, about 10 minutes.  Spread some of the cream mixture in a round oven proof casserole or roasting pan, top with strips of pork, and cover with a sheet of foil.  Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f.  Bake the casserole until the pork is cooked, about 30 minutes, and the cream is warm, about 12 or 15 minutes.  Serve the pork with tortillas and the cheese on the side.

Random Ingredients: green onion,white sugar,pineapple juice,oyster sauce,heavy whipping cream,ham
title: Ham, Pineapple and Green Onion Salad
ingredients: 3/4 pound fresh ham, cut into matchsticks ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/3 cup dry white sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped green onions | 2 tablespoons sweetened sliced green onion
instructions: Place ham in a medium skillet.  Pour pineapple juice over ham and marinate for 15 minutes.  Blend cream, sugar, oyster sauce, green onions, green onions and half the marinated ham with a mixer on high speed until mixture is smooth and creamy about 8 minutes.  Refrigerate dressing overnight if desired.

title: Pan Seared Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, 1 cut into 12 equal-size pieces | 2 -3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, for brushing
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat and lightly oil a baking sheet.  Rinse the beef tenderloin under cold water, wipe off excess water, and pat dry.  Brush the beef with 1 teaspoons oil and season with salt and pepper.  Grill the beef, 4 to 6 minutes for rare, 7 to 10 minutes for medium rare, 12 to 15 minutes for medium well.  Transfer to a cutting board and allow to rest 3 to 5 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,chocolate chip,cheddar cheese,salt black pepper
title: Jalepeno Peppers and Chocolate (Jalapeno Nibbles)
ingredients: 2 large jalapeno peppers | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 4 ounces of good cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons unsweetened chocolate chips
instructions: Wash, slit, and deseed the peppers.  You can also cut the pepper in half or through the stem.  Put the seeds in with the peppers.  In a small nonstick frying pan, melt the cheese over high heat.  As soon as the cheese starts to melt, add the chocolate, stirring so it melts evenly around the pan.  Stir frequently.  When the mixture becomes too thick, pour all of it over the pepper mixture.  Let it bubble for a few minutes longer or until it begins to melt and slightly browned.  Remove from heat.  Let stand for a couple of minutes and then serve right away.

title: Southern Style Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with the seasoning salt.  Slide onto a plate and coat with a mixture of green and red peppers and onions, respectively.

title: Apricot-Glazed Bean Sandwich
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 jar apricot jam, divided | 1 small loaf country bread | 24 ladyfingers | 3 stalks celery, chopped | 1/4 cup prepared marinade
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Combine the beans, 1/4 cup apricot jam, bread, ladyfingers, celery, and remaining jam in a 3 quart casserole.  Bake in the preheated oven, stirring every 20 minutes, until bread absorbs the juices, about 1 1/2 hours.
